original_text: 云天河：（这地方好暗，以前都没进来过——）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (This place is so dark, never been in here before-)

original_text: 云天河：（那是……？）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (That's...?)

original_text: 云天河：（……爹说过的机关？）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (...The mechanism father mentioned?)

original_text: 云天河：（爹说只要有这机关，其他人绝对不会闯到洞里。）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (Father said with this mechanism, no one else could ever break into the cave.)

original_text: 云天河：……不～会～吧！！
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... No~ way!!

original_text: 云天河：刚才闯进来的那只，难不成就是爹说过的“妖怪”？……“猪妖”？
translation: Yun Tianhe: That thing that barged in earlier, could it be what Father called a 'yaoguai'? ...Is that a 'pig fiend'?

original_text: 云天河：所以才会开机关？！
translation: Yun Tianhe: So that's why the mechanism opened?!

original_text: 云天河：糟了、糟了！<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>猪妖闯进了石沉溪洞，</colour><dc0>被爹知道我就惨了！怎么会这样？！</dc0>
translation: Yun Tianhe: Oh no, oh no!<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> A pig fiend has broken into the Stone Sink Cave,</colour><dc0> if Father finds out, I'm done for! How could this happen?!</dc0>

original_text: 云天河：死猪妖，看我饶不了你！把你抓来烤上十遍八遍！！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Damn pig fiend, I won't let you off! I'll catch you and roast you dozen times over!!

original_text: 云天河：……可是，又没见过妖怪，不知道打不打得过……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... But... I've never seen a yaoguai before, I don't know if I can fight it...

original_text: 云天河：不行！打不过也要打，妖怪厉不厉害不知道，但爹生起气来我可是知道的。
translation: Yun Tianhe: No! Even if I can't win, I have to fight. I don't know if yaoguais are powerful, but I know how angry Father gets.

original_text: 云天河：死猪妖，快给我出来呀！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Damn pig fiend, come out right now!

original_text: 云天河：（……不太妙！越往里走地面的土越少，都看不清猪妖的脚印了——）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (...Not good! The further in I go, the less soil on the ground, and I can barely see the pig fiend's footprints-)

original_text: 云天河：（咦？！）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (Huh?!)

original_text: 云天河：（在那边！！死猪妖！看你往哪跑！）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (Over there!! Damn pig fiend! See where you run!)

original_text: ？？：啊！！谁这么卑鄙，居然放冷箭！
translation: ???: Ah!! Who's so despicable, firing a sneak arrow!

original_text: 云天河：（那是……）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (That's...)

original_text: ？？：咦？！——喂喂喂，到底有没有常识啊，把剑当箭射！
translation: ??: Huh?!-Hey hey hey, do you have any common sense, shooting a sword like an arrow!
??: Damn-!

original_text: 少女：我说，你谁啊？难道是住在这里的山顶野人？居然趁别人不注意偷袭！阴～险～！！
translation: Young Girl: Hey, who are you? A mountain barbarian living here? Sneak attacking when others aren't looking! How underhanded!!

original_text: 云天河：…………你……不是吧？怎么还会说人话？
translation: Yun Tianhe: ...... You... no way? How can you still speak human language?

original_text: 少女：这可奇怪了～你还不是一样站在这里同我说话？还是说～你是野猴子变的妖怪？
translation: Young Girl: How strange~ Aren't you standing here talking to me too? Or are you~ a monster transformed from a wild monkey?

original_text: 云天河：你才是妖怪！我不饶你——
translation: Yun Tianhe: You're the monster! I won't spare you-

original_text: 少女：喂，你、你别靠过来啊！
translation: Young Girl: Hey, you, don't come any closer!

original_text: 少女：哼～比蛮力我可拼不过你，姑娘我有要事在身，不奉陪了！
translation: Young Girl: Hmph~ I can't match your brute strength. This lady has important business-I'm not sticking around!

original_text: 少女：看招～烟雨夺魂！
translation: Young Girl: Take this~Misty Rain!

original_text: 云天河：……呛死人了！！
translation: Yun Tianhe: ...it's choking me!!

original_text: 云天河：糟糕，被它逃了……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Darn, it got away...

original_text: 云天河：（这支剑……奇怪～怎么还会发光？……那我以后夜里不是都不用点灯了？）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (This sword... Weird~ why is it still glowing?... Does that mean I won't need a light at night anymore?)

original_text: 云天河：（啊！光又消失了？……）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (Ah! The light disappeared again?...)

original_text: 云天河：（死猪妖不但会变人形、会说人话，还使出奇怪的妖法，按爹说的，道行已经挺高了……）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (Dead pig fiend not only has human form, speaks human language, but uses strange demon arts. According to Father, its cultivation is quite high...)

original_text: 云天河：（……不怕，就算弓箭对付不了它，还有爹教我的剑术，好在木剑我也一直带在身边～那猪妖绝对逃不掉！）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (...Not afraid, even if arrows can't deal with it, there's still the sword techniques Father taught me. Good thing I've always kept the wooden sword with me~ That pig fiend definitely won't escape!)

original_text: 云天河：（整个石沉溪洞都跑遍了，也没瞧见那只猪妖，难不成逃到洞外去了？）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (Searched the entire Stone Sink Cave, didn't see that pig fiend, could it have escaped outside the cave?)

original_text: 云天河：（呼～但愿爹在阴间偶尔打打瞌睡，没瞧见这里发生的事，不然我可惨了。）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (Whew~ I hope Father dozes off occasionally in the Netherworld and didn't see what happened here, or I'm in trouble.)

original_text: 云天河：（爹说他和娘葬在洞中，连我都不清楚在哪，他总是神神秘秘的——）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (My Father said he and Mother are buried in the cave, even I don't know exactly where; he's always been so mysterious-)

original_text: 云天河：（石沉溪洞……爹……）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (Stone Sink Cave... Father...)

original_text: 云天河：……唉……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... Sigh...

original_text: 云天河：……我命在我也，不在于天……似懂非懂，有点难懂……还是别懂了……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... My fate lies with me, not with heaven... I sort of get it, but it's hard to understand... better not to understand...

original_text: 少女：啊！！怎么、你比我先到？！
translation: Young Girl: Ah!! How, how did you get here before me?!

original_text: 云天河：来的正好，看你这回往哪逃！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Perfect timing, see where you'll run this time!

original_text: 少女：烟雨夺——咦？！
translation: Young Girl: Misty Ra-Huh?!

original_text: 少女：不可能！我明明记得还剩一个！！
translation: Young Girl: Impossible! I clearly remember there was one left!!

original_text: 云天河：死猪妖，别想再用古怪的妖法！今天的晚饭已经决定！就是你了！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Damn pig fiend, don't think you can use your weird demon arts again! Tonight's dinner is decided! It's you!

original_text: 云天河：怎么会……
translation: Yun Tianhe: How could...

original_text: 云天河：这把剑……
translation: Yun Tianhe: This sword...

original_text: 少女：可恶！还好我闪得快！真想要我的命吗？！
translation: Young Girl: Damn it! Good thing I dodged fast! Did you really want to kill me?!

original_text: 少女：你到底是哪里来的野人啊！带着一把怪剑，还会自己飞来飞去！
translation: Young Girl: Where on earth did you come from, you barbarian! Carrying a strange sword that flies around by itself!

original_text: 云天河：我、我也不知道，以前从来没有这样过……
translation: Yun Tianhe: I, I don't know either, never happened before...

original_text: 云天河：又是发光，又是自己飞回来……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Glowing, flying back on its own...

original_text: 少女：你刚才说我什么？你说的最后一句！
translation: Young Girl: What did you just say about me? The last thing you said!

original_text: 云天河：你是我的晚饭！
translation: Yun Tianhe: You're my dinner!

original_text: 少女：不对，是你说的倒数第二句！
translation: Young Girl: No, it's the second-to-last sentence you said!

original_text: 云天河：你是猪妖！
translation: Yun Tianhe: You're a pig fiend!

original_text: 少女：你你你——！！洗干净你的耳朵听好了，本姑娘“韩菱纱”，好歹也算一个如花似玉的少女，几时成了你嘴里的“猪腰”、“猪肝”！
translation: Young Girl: You, you, you-!! Listen carefully with clean ears! This young lady has a name 'Han Lingsha'. I am a blooming and jade-like maiden no less. When did I become the 'pig thing' or 'pig wing' in your mouth!

original_text: 云天河：少、女？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Young, lady?

original_text: 韩菱纱：而且还说我是你的晚饭，下流淫贼！你想对我做什么？！
translation: Han Lingsha: And you even said I was your dinner, you lecherous scoundrel! What do you want to do to me?!

original_text: 云天河：你……是女人？爹说过的那种？
translation: Yun Tianhe: You... are a woman? The kind Father talked about?

original_text: 韩菱纱：越说越过份！你倒是说说我哪点不像女人！
translation: Han Lingsha: You're going too far! Tell me, what part of me isn't like a woman!

original_text: 云天河：……是女人，那就不是猪妖啰……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ...  a woman, not a pig fiend then...

original_text: 韩菱纱：（……骗、骗人的吧？这人到底是从哪冒出来的呆子，好像连女人也没见过，看起来又不像假的……）
translation: Han Lingsha: (...No way, is this for real? Where did this clueless fool come from? He acts like he's never even seen a woman before, and it doesn't seem fake...)
Yun Tianhe: ......

original_text: 云天河：山、山猪…………
translation: Yun Tianhe: Boar...the boar?...
Han Lingsha: ......

original_text: 韩菱纱：哦～我明白了，你追着山猪进山洞，后来遇上我，所以就弄错了，对不对？
translation: Han Lingsha: Oh~ I get it. You chased the boar into the cave, then met me, so you got confused, right?

original_text: 云天河：我弄错了？……好、好像是……
translation: Yun Tianhe: I got it wrong?... Oh, seems like I did...

original_text: 云天河：(奇怪……她不是猪妖，那门的机关是哪只猪打开的？！)
translation: Yun Tianhe: (Strange... she's not a pig fiend, so which pig opened the door mechanism?!)

original_text: 云天河：你，刚才有没有受伤？
translation: Yun Tianhe: You, were you hurt just now?

original_text: 韩菱纱：哼，可算想起来了，还不过来扶我一把，闪得太急，脚都扭到了。
translation: Han Lingsha: Hmph, finally remembered. Come over and give me a hand up. I dodged too quickly and twisted my ankle.

original_text: 云天河：扶你？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Give you a hand?

original_text: 云天河：那不行！我爹说过，男女授受不亲，不能乱摸的。
translation: Yun Tianhe: That won't do! My father said, men and women should not touch each other casually.

original_text: 韩菱纱：你！想得美！谁让你摸了，是扶、扶我一下！
translation: Han Lingsha: You! Dream on! Who said you could touch me? It's to give a hand, to help me up!

original_text: 云天河：好吧，我这可是为了帮你……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Alright, I'm doing this to help you...

original_text: 韩菱纱：哼～谢啦。
translation: Han Lingsha: Hmph~ Thanks.

original_text: 韩菱纱：我说，看你这样，好像完全没见过什么世面，连女人都没见过，应该也不是山脚下村子里的人吧？
translation: Han Lingsha: I say, looking at you, it seems you've never seen much of the world, not even women. You probably aren't from the village at the foot of the mountain either, right?

original_text: 云天河：我一直住在山上。
translation: Yun Tianhe: I've always lived in the mountains.

original_text: 韩菱纱：难怪从没见过女孩子～真不知道你爹怎么和你说的！
translation: Han Lingsha: No wonder you've never seen a girl before~ I really don't know what your father told you!

original_text: 云天河：说什么？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Told what?

original_text: 韩菱纱：说“男女授受不亲”之类的啊。
translation: Han Lingsha: Something like 'men and women not touching each other'.

original_text: 云天河：他、我爹说，女孩子的胸和男孩子的不一样，软软的，不可以随便乱摸。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Well, my father said, a girl's chest is different from a boy's, soft, we can't just touch it casually.

original_text: 韩菱纱：你！淫贼啊！原以为你爹是个儒酸文人，竟然教出你这种傻瓜，没想到也是个胡言乱语之徒。
translation: Han Lingsha: You! Lecher! I thought your father was a pedantic scholar, raising a fool like you, but it turns out he's also a raving lunatic.

original_text: 云天河：住口！虽然我听不太懂你在说什么，不过不许说我爹的坏话，他是天底下最厉害的人！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Shut up! I don't really understand what you're saying, but don't speak ill of Father; he's the most amazing person in the world!

original_text: 韩菱纱：好了好了～别气，算我讲错总行了吧？
translation: Han Lingsha: Alright, alright~ Don't be mad, I admit I am wrong, okay?

original_text: 韩菱纱：你一直说这个山洞叫“石沉溪洞”，是不是知道这里的秘密？告诉我好不好？
translation: Han Lingsha: You always call this cave 'Stone Sink Cave'. Do you know its secret? Tell me, please?

original_text: 云天河：你是故意闯进来的？我爹说过，不能让别人进到石沉溪洞。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Did you break in on purpose? Father said not to let anyone into Stone Sink Cave.

original_text: 云天河：看来猪没开机关，是你把机关打开闯进来的，你到底想干什么？！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Looks like the pig didn't trigger the mechanism. You opened it and barged in. What exactly do you want?!

original_text: 韩菱纱：我……
translation: Han Lingsha: I...

original_text: 云天河：（嗯？！有杀气！）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (Hmm?! Killing intent!)

original_text: 云天河：（难道…………这女的要杀我？！）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (Could it be... this woman wants to kill me?!)

original_text: 韩菱纱：喂喂喂～怎么说的好好的，你翻脸跟翻书一样？
translation: Han Lingsha: Hey hey hey~ How come you're suddenly turning on me like flipping a page in a book?

original_text: 韩菱纱：洞口那里又没写不让人进，我哪知道呀，你说对不对？
translation: Han Lingsha: There was no sign at the cave entrance saying we couldn't enter, so how was I supposed to know? Right?

original_text: 云天河：话不能这么说吧……你、你到底想怎样？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Can't say that... You, what exactly do you want?

original_text: 韩菱纱：这样好了，我告诉你我来这儿的原因，你就说出你知道的秘密好不好？
translation: Han Lingsha: How about this, I'll tell you why I'm here, and you tell me the secret you know, okay?

original_text: 韩菱纱：这就扯平了，谁也不吃亏～
translation: Han Lingsha: That evens things out, no one loses~

original_text: 云天河：我——
translation: Yun Tianhe: I-

original_text: ？？：嘘为云雨，嘻为雷霆。通天彻地，出幽入明，千变万化，何者非我！
translation: ???: A whisper becomes cloud and rain, a laugh becomes thunder. Piercing heaven and earth, emerging from darkness into light, ever-changing-what is not me!

original_text: 韩菱纱：呀！这、这是什么？！鬼吗？
translation: Han Lingsha: Yikes! Wh-what is this?! A ghost?

original_text: 云天河：……不知道，难道杀气是他发出的？
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... I don't know, could the killing intent be coming from him?

original_text: 韩菱纱：我、我看他好像很凶，我们先跑吧！
translation: Han Lingsha: I-I think he looks really fierce, let's run first!

original_text: 云天河：为什么要跑？我爹凶起来比他凶多了。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Why run? My Father gets fiercer than him when he's angry.

original_text: ？？：吾乃魁召，奉主人之命镇守此地，凡擅自闯入者，令其立毙当场！
translation: ??: I am Kuizhao, ordered by my master to guard this place. Any who trespass shall be slain on the spot!

original_text: 韩菱纱：立毙当场？！山顶野人，小心啦！
translation: Han Lingsha: Slain on the spot?! Mountain barbarian, be careful!

original_text: 韩菱纱：不行！这样砍上几百年也伤不了他！只好用那一招了，死马当活马医……
translation: Han Lingsha: No good! Chopping like this for centuries won't harm him! Have to use that move, as a desperate gamble...

original_text: 韩菱纱：喂，你静下心来听我念咒，<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>我们一起用仙术对付他！</colour>
translation: Han Lingsha: Hey, calm down and listen to me chant the spell,<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> let's use immortal arts together to deal with him!</colour>

original_text: 云天河：什么仙术？我不会啊！
translation: Yun Tianhe: What immortal arts? I don't know any!

original_text: 韩菱纱：呆子～所以才让你静下心来听我念，临阵磨枪，总比等死强！
translation: Han Lingsha: Silly~ That's why I want you to calm down and listen to me recite. Sharpening your spear in front of battle is better than waiting to die!

original_text: 韩菱纱：道贯三才为一气耳，天以气而运行，地以气而发生，阴阳以气而惨舒，风雷以气而动荡，人身以气而呼吸，道法以气而感通。
translation: Han Lingsha: The Dao permeates the three powers-heaven, earth, and humanity-as one Qi. Heaven moves by Qi, earth generates by Qi, yin and yang contract and expand by Qi, wind and thunder surge by Qi, the human body breathes by Qi, and Taoist arts connect by Qi.

original_text: 云天河：你、你念慢一点，太快了我记不下来！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Y-you, say it slower, too fast, I can't remember!

original_text: 韩菱纱：水之润下，无孔不入；火之炎上，无物不焚；雷之肃敛，无坚不摧；风之肆拂，无阻不透；土之养化，无物不融！
translation: Han Lingsha: Water moistens downward, seeping everywhere; fire blazes upward, burning all; thunder gathers sternly, crushing all hardness; wind sweeps freely, penetrating all barriers; earth nurtures and transforms, merging with all things!

original_text: 韩菱纱：唉，不是让你静下心来吗？不要这么乱七八糟好不好……
translation: Han Lingsha: Sigh, didn't I tell you to calm down? Must you be such a mess...?

original_text: 韩菱纱：好了！我们尽全力打倒他！
translation: Han Lingsha: Alright! Let's give it our all to defeat him!

original_text: 韩菱纱：（……不行，太厉害了……我心愿还没了，怎么能死在这里……还是和来路不明的山顶野人一起……）
translation: Han Lingsha: (...No, this is too much... I haven't fulfilled my wish yet, how can I die here... and with an unknown mountain barbarian here...)

original_text: 云天河：厉害……我跟你拼了！看箭！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Impressive... I'll fight you to the death! Take this arrow!

original_text: 韩菱纱：你…………！
translation: Han Lingsha: You...... !

original_text: 魁召：望舒……
translation: Kuizhao: Wangshu...

original_text: 魁召：原来是主人驾临。
translation: Kuizhao: So it is Master who has arrived.

original_text: 云天河：啊！主人？！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Ah! Master?!

original_text: 魁召：无怪乎吾感应到“望舒之气”而醒觉，初时以为错认，故言行犯上，望主人恕罪。
translation: Kuizhao: No wonder I sensed 'Wangshu' and awoke. At first I thought I was mistaken, hence my disrespectful words and actions. I beg my master's forgiveness.

original_text: 魁召：魁召告退。
translation: Kuizhao: Kuizhao takes my leave.

original_text: 韩菱纱：……消失了？
translation: Han Lingsha: ... Disappeared?

original_text: 云天河：呼～好险……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Whew~ that was close...

original_text: 韩菱纱：……你好厉害～原来你早知道那个怪物害怕弓和……剑！
translation: Han Lingsha: ... You're amazing~ So you already knew that monster was afraid of bows and... swords!

original_text: 云天河：它害不害怕我可不知道，反正用砍的打不赢，射死它不就得了？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Whether it's scared or not, I don't know. Anyway, if you can't win by slashing, just shoot it dead, right?

original_text: 韩菱纱：什么嘛……搞半天还是傻瓜一个，以为你多威风呢……
translation: Han Lingsha: What the... after all that, you're still a fool. I thought you were so impressive...

original_text: 云天河：什么？
translation: Yun Tianhe: What?

original_text: 韩菱纱：没、没有啦，我是说这个山洞够古怪的，居然会有这种东西。
translation: Han Lingsha: N-no, I mean this cave is strange enough to have something like this.

original_text: 云天河：……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ...

original_text: 韩菱纱：喂，怎么了？好歹刚才那么威风，现在又变呆呆的，不会是吓傻了吧？
translation: Han Lingsha: Hey, what's wrong? You were so impressive just now, now you're all dazed again, not scared silly, are you?

original_text: 韩菱纱：<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>……是密室？！</colour>
translation: Han Lingsha: <colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>...A secret chamber?!</colour>

original_text: 韩菱纱：这地上的……好像是……道家的符咒！这么说来，刚才那个是用法力驱使的符灵？！
translation: Han Lingsha: This on the ground... looks like... a Taoist talisman! So, that earlier thing was a talisman spirit driven by magic?!

original_text: 韩菱纱：太好了！我就知道剑仙的传说果然是真的！
translation: Han Lingsha: Great! I knew the Sword Immortal legends were true!

original_text: 云天河：剑……仙？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Sword... immortal?

original_text: 韩菱纱：是啊，就是仙人嘛，会很多法术，飞来飞去的那种～
translation: Han Lingsha: Yes, they're immortals, know many spells, the kind that fly around~

original_text: 韩菱纱：你爹说不定也是剑仙的有缘之人，他不许别人进这个山洞，想必是担心泄露了剑仙的行踪吧？
translation: Han Lingsha: Your father might also be someone destined to meet the Sword Immortal. He forbids others from entering this cave, probably worried about revealing the Sword Immortal's whereabouts, right?

original_text: 云天河：……这我不知道，爹可没交代过。
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... I don't know about that, Father never mentioned it.

original_text: 韩菱纱：哎～一问三不知，真没劲！可我瞧你那支古怪的剑，也许就是剑仙之物呢。
translation: Han Lingsha: Sigh~ You know nothing, how dull! But that strange sword of yours might be an immortal's artifact.

original_text: 云天河：你怎么知道？连我爹都没交代过。
translation: Yun Tianhe: How do you know? Even my father never told me.

original_text: 韩菱纱：嘻嘻，傻瓜，不然刚才那些符灵干嘛怕它？
translation: Han Lingsha: Hehe, silly, otherwise why were those talisman spirits afraid of it?

original_text: 韩菱纱：再说一般的剑长不过三尺左右，这把剑却超出许多，最怪异的是，剑柄和剑身之间没有剑格，要怎么握啊？江湖规矩，文剑挂剑穗，武剑不挂，要说你这把剑是“武剑”，偏又不像……
translation: Han Lingsha: Besides, ordinary swords are about three chi long at most, but this one is much longer. The strangest part is there's no guard between the hilt and the blade-how do you even hold it? By martial arts customs, decorative swords have tassels, while combat swords don't. If we say your sword is a 'combat sword', it doesn't quite fit...

original_text: 云天河：剑不是只分用来砍的和用来射的吗？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Aren't swords only divided into ones for slashing and ones for shooting?

original_text: 韩菱纱：大～错～特～错！除了你这种山顶野人，谁会把剑拿来射！
translation: Han Lingsha: Dead~ wrong! Except for a mountain barbarian like you, who would shoot with a sword!

original_text: 韩菱纱：寻常剑以铁铜打造，再好一点也不过是乌金、玄铁，你这把倒是非金非玉，看不出质地。
translation: Han Lingsha: Ordinary swords are made of iron or bronze, better ones from black gold or dark iron. Yours seems neither metal nor jade, can't tell the material.

original_text: 云天河：那个……用来砍的剑不是用木头做的吗？
translation: Yun Tianhe: That... Aren't swords for chopping made of wood?

original_text: 韩菱纱：不一样不一样，那只是小孩子耍着玩的。
translation: Han Lingsha: It's not the same, not the same. That's just child's play.

original_text: 韩菱纱：对了，这把剑叫什么名字啊？
translation: Han Lingsha: Right, what's the name of this sword?

original_text: 云天河：哦，这我爹交代过～这是剑！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Oh, my Father told me about this~ It-is-a Sword!

original_text: 韩菱纱：你耍我呢？我也知道这是剑，我问它有没有名字。
translation: Han Lingsha: Are you teasing me? I know it's a sword, I'm asking if it has a name.

original_text: 云天河：我说了，它的名字就叫“这是剑”。
translation: Yun Tianhe: I said, its name is 'It-is-a Sword'.

original_text: 韩菱纱：嘻嘻，怎么可能～我看这把剑即便不是神兵，也算利器，哪会取这种蠢名字？
translation: Han Lingsha: Hehe, as if~ Even if this sword isn't a divine weapon, it's still a fine blade. Who'd give it such a silly name?

original_text: 云天河：名字是爹亲口说的。
translation: Yun Tianhe: The name was told to me by Father himself.

original_text: 云天河：有一回我问他，既然木头做的剑叫“木剑”，那这把蓝色的剑又叫什么。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Once I asked him, since a sword made of wood is called 'wooden sword', then what's this blue sword called.

original_text: 云天河：爹那天心情好像不怎么好，脸上都不笑，就说名字有什么重要，今天你叫“云天河”，明天也可以改叫“云阿三”，但你还是你。剑也一样，你喜欢取什么名字都行，嫌麻烦就干脆叫“这是剑”，又简单又好记。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Dad seemed in a bad mood that day, not smiling at all. He just said, 'What's so important about a name? Today you're called Yun Tianhe, tomorrow you could change it to Yun A'san, but you'd still be you'. It's the same with the sword. You can call it whatever you like. If it's too much trouble, just call it 'It-is-a Sword'-simple and easy to remember.

original_text: 韩菱纱：哈、哈哈～你爹真有意思！
translation: Han Lingsha: Ha, haha~ Your dad is really interesting!

original_text: 云天河：不对，他是厉害，我打赢了山里那只吊睛白老虎，也还是打不赢他！
translation: Yun Tianhe: No, he's strong. I beat the striped white tiger in the mountains, but I still couldn't beat him!

original_text: 韩菱纱：（……又在说傻话了……）
translation: Han Lingsha: (...Talking nonsense again...)

original_text: 韩菱纱：好好好，你说得都对，如果他这么厉害，说不定真的认识剑仙，这个山洞里也有大秘密。
translation: Han Lingsha: Alright, alright, you're right. If he's that amazing, maybe he really knows Sword Immortals, and this cave holds big secrets too.

original_text: 韩菱纱：喂，我们来都来了，入了宝山哪有空手而回的？嘻嘻，走啦～
translation: Han Lingsha: Hey, we're already here. How can we leave a treasure mountain empty-handed? Hehe, let's go~

original_text: 云天河：等一下，你不能乱闯！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Wait, you can't just barge in!

original_text: 韩菱纱：喂，快来看！这玉石好漂亮！像有光在里面流动一样。
translation: Han Lingsha: Hey, come look! This jade is so beautiful! It's like light is flowing inside.

original_text: 韩菱纱：不过呢，依我看修这个墓的人是个大大的外行，洞外就有瀑布河流，穴前去水可是大忌，俗话说“穴前水去不聚，则生气外泄”呢！
translation: Han Lingsha: However, in my opinion, the person who built this tomb was a complete amateur. There's a waterfall and river right outside the cave; having water flow away from the tomb entrance is a major taboo. As the saying goes, 'If water flows away from the tomb, it disperses the vital energy'.

original_text: 韩菱纱：（最古怪的还是这些冰，和我以前在冰川古墓里见过的一样，硬得不得了……只可惜这回出门前没准备，那些宝贝也没带在身上，不然一定能把冰层破了……这棺材里肯定大有玄机……）
translation: Han Lingsha: (The strangest thing is still this ice. It's exactly like what I saw before in the glacier tomb-incredibly hard... Too bad I didn't prepare before leaving this time, and I didn't bring those treasures with me. Otherwise, I could definitely break through the ice layer... There must be something mysterious inside this coffin...)

original_text: 云天河：这里…………难道就是爹和娘的墓室？
translation: Yun Tianhe: This place... Could it be my father and mother's tomb chamber?

original_text: 韩菱纱：好冷……整个山洞就这儿最冷，还莫名其妙结了这么厚的冰……
translation: Han Lingsha: So cold... This is the coldest spot in the whole cave, and there's inexplicably such thick ice here...

original_text: 韩菱纱：对了，你刚才说什么？什么爹和娘？
translation: Han Lingsha: Right, what did you just say? Something about dad and mom?

original_text: 云天河：我爹说过，他死了以后要和我娘合葬在这里，他不想被打扰，连我也是第一次——
translation: Yun Tianhe: My father said that after he died, he wanted to be buried here with my mother. He didn't want to be disturbed. Even I'm here for the first time-

original_text: 韩菱纱：慢慢慢慢——慢！
translation: Han Lingsha: Slow slow slow-slow!

original_text: 韩菱纱：你、你说清楚！这是你爹娘的墓室？
translation: Han Lingsha: Y-you, explain clearly! This is your parents' tomb chamber?

original_text: 云天河：嗯……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Mm...

original_text: 韩菱纱：那那那那——那么～这两副棺木里就是他们的尸骨？！
translation: Han Lingsha: Th-th-th-th-that means... these two coffins contain their remains?!

original_text: 云天河：应该是吧……除非这个山洞里还有其他的墓室。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Should be... Unless there are other tomb chambers in this cave.

original_text: 韩菱纱：咦？！你看，后面山壁上好像还有……字？
translation: Han Lingsha: Huh?! Look, on the mountain wall behind, there seem to be... words?

original_text: 韩菱纱：是用剑锋刻上去的！……
translation: Han Lingsha: It was carved with the sword's edge! ...

original_text: 云天河：写的是……啥意思？
translation: Yun Tianhe: It says... what does it mean?

original_text: 韩菱纱：前面两句……说的是秦始皇、汉武帝求仙问道的事，后面两句嘛，我也不太明白……
translation: Han Lingsha: The first two lines... talk about Qin Shi Huang and Emperor Wu of Han seeking immortality. The last two, I'm not too sure either...

original_text: 云天河：秦始皇、汉武帝？又是什么人？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Qin Shi Huang, Emperor Wu of Han? Who are they?

original_text: 韩菱纱：唔……真看不出你这样一个山顶野人，居然……
translation: Han Lingsha: Hmm...I truly can't believe that a mountain barbarian like you would actually...

original_text: 韩菱纱：你爹和你娘难道就是传说中的剑仙？
translation: Han Lingsha: Your father and mother, could they be the legendary Sword Immortals?

original_text: 云天河：剑仙是什么？
translation: Yun Tianhe: What's a Sword Immortal?

original_text: 韩菱纱：你、你再仔细想想，你爹真的没有说起过“剑仙”之类的话吗？
translation: Han Lingsha: Y-you, think carefully. Did your father really never mention anything about 'sword immortals' or the like?

original_text: 云天河：爹只教我练剑，说长大以后不至于受人欺负。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Father only taught me sword practice, said when I grew up I wouldn't be bullied.

original_text: 韩菱纱：（……你这一身蛮力，像个野人，又学了剑术，不欺负别人已经是万幸了……）
translation: Han Lingsha: (...With your brute strength, like a barbarian, and now learning swordsmanship, not bullying others is already a blessing...)

original_text: 韩菱纱：方才看你使剑，不像懂得以气御剑，真正的剑仙都可御剑而飞，瞬息千里，寻常人一辈子也做不到这样的事。
translation: Han Lingsha: Just now, watching you wield the sword, it didn't seem like you know how to control the sword with qi. True Sword Immortals can fly on their swords, covering thousands of miles in an instant-something ordinary people could never achieve in a lifetime.

original_text: 云天河：以气御剑？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Control sword with qi?

original_text: 云天河：这个爹说过的，他说那是很难达到的境界，还不如学点强身的剑术杀杀野猪来得实在，至少不会饿肚子。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Dad mentioned this before. He said it's a very hard state to achieve, and it's better to learn some practical swordsmanship for self-defense and hunting wild boars-at least you won't go hungry.

original_text: 韩菱纱：（……高人的行事当真古怪。）
translation: Han Lingsha: (...Behaviours of a Master are truly strange.)

original_text: 韩菱纱：哎～用膝盖想都知道，你肯定也不明白仙术是什么，不过资质倒是很好。我刚才念的那些咒法也是从一本古书上看来的，没修炼多久，要不是为了打那些符灵，才不会告诉你呢！
translation: Han Lingsha: Hey~ It's obvious even to a fool that you don't understand what immortal arts are either, though your aptitude is quite good. Those spells I just recited are from an ancient book I read. I haven't practiced long, and I wouldn't have told you if not for dealing with those Talisman Spirits!

original_text: 云天河：我又不想知道，听你那样念，我胡乱想一通，手脚都不受控制了。
translation: Yun Tianhe: I didn't want to know. Hearing you chant like that, my thoughts went wild, and my limbs stopped obeying me.

original_text: 韩菱纱：你这大呆子，天底下多少人做梦都想学的五灵仙术，被你讲成这样，少得了便宜卖乖～
translation: Han Lingsha: You big fool, the Five Element Immortal Arts that countless people in the world dream of learning, you describe them like that. Don't act coy after getting a bargain~

original_text: 云天河：哦。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Oh.

original_text: 韩菱纱：什么“哦”，你装傻啊？一副有听没懂的样子……
translation: Han Lingsha: What 'oh'? Are you playing dumb? Looking like you heard but didn't understand...

original_text: 云天河：我是没太懂……
translation: Yun Tianhe: I didn't quite get it...

original_text: 韩菱纱：喂，我把我知道的都告诉你了，换你说说剑仙前辈的事了！
translation: Han Lingsha: Hey, I've told you everything I know. Now it's your turn to talk about the Sword Immortal senior!

original_text: 云天河：剑仙……前辈？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Sword Immortal... senior?

original_text: 韩菱纱：就是你爹和你娘嘛。
translation: Han Lingsha: I mean your dad and your mom.

original_text: 云天河：哦……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Oh...

original_text: 云天河：我没见过我娘，听爹说，她生下我之后没多久就死了，她是世上最好的人。
translation: Yun Tianhe: I never met my mom. Dad said she died not long after giving birth to me. She was the best person in the world.

original_text: 韩菱纱：……那你爹真有福气。
translation: Han Lingsha: ...Then your father is truly fortunate.

original_text: 云天河：爹经常咳嗽，咳出来都是血——
translation: Yun Tianhe: Dad often coughed, and it was always blood-

original_text: 韩菱纱：啊！！这么重的病？！
translation: Han Lingsha: Ah!! Such a serious illness?!

original_text: 云天河：爹他总是待在屋子里，很少出来，他怕冷。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Dad always stayed inside, rarely came out, he was afraid of cold.

original_text: 韩菱纱：……也许、也许我弄错了，剑仙怎么还会生病……
translation: Han Lingsha: ... Maybe, maybe I'm mistaken. How could Sword Immortals still get sick...

original_text: 云天河：那个……你、我们快些离开吧，不然爹要生气了。
translation: Yun Tianhe: That... You... let's leave quickly, otherwise Father will get angry.

original_text: 韩菱纱：嘻～什么这个那个，我又不是没名字，叫我“菱纱”就好了。
translation: Han Lingsha: Hehe~ What's with 'this and that'? I do have a name. Just call me 'Lingsha'.

original_text: 云天河：哦，菱、菱纱。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Oh, Ling, Lingsha.

original_text: 韩菱纱：嘻嘻，不是菱菱纱，是菱纱～傻瓜！
translation: Han Lingsha: Hehe, not LingLingsha, it's Lingsha~ Silly!

original_text: 韩菱纱：我们先出去吧，在这儿人都要冻成冰了！
translation: Han Lingsha: Let's get out first, staying here we'll freeze into ice!

original_text: 云天河：咦？！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Huh?!

original_text: 韩菱纱：怎么了？
translation: Han Lingsha: What's wrong?

original_text: 韩菱纱：呀！这把剑怎么回事？
translation: Han Lingsha: Ah! What's wrong with this sword?

original_text: 云天河：我也不知道！它突然就变这样了！
translation: Yun Tianhe: I don't know either! It suddenly became like this!

original_text: 云天河：……咳、咳咳……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ..., cough, cough...

original_text: 云天河：不～是～吧——！！
translation: Yun Tianhe: No~ way-!!

original_text: 韩菱纱：……唔，好痛…………
translation: Han Lingsha: ...Ouch, that hurts...

original_text: 云天河：爹和娘的墓室被我一剑毁了！！
translation: Yun Tianhe: My parents' tomb chamber was destroyed by my sword!!

original_text: 韩菱纱：……脚好像被石头砸到了……
translation: Han Lingsha: ... My foot seems to have been hit by a stone...

original_text: 韩菱纱：你帮我一下好不好？
translation: Han Lingsha: Can you help me out?

original_text: 云天河：我把爹和娘的墓室毁了…………！！
translation: Yun Tianhe: I destroyed my father and mother's tomb chamber...!!

original_text: 韩菱纱：……喂………你先冷静一下……
translation: Han Lingsha: ... Hey... calm down first...

original_text: 云天河：怎么办怎么办怎么办啊…………
translation: Yun Tianhe: What do we do what do we do what do we do...

original_text: 韩菱纱：我说……能不能先静一静？
translation: Han Lingsha: I say... can we quiet down first?

original_text: 云天河：惨了惨了惨了……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Oh no, oh no, oh no...

original_text: 韩菱纱：可恶……
translation: Han Lingsha: Damn it...

original_text: 云天河：……好痛啊……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... It hurts so much...

original_text: 韩菱纱：我都说了，让你冷静一下！
translation: Han Lingsha: I told you, calm down!

original_text: 韩菱纱：这样大吼大叫也没用，这事情我也有错，要不是我闯进这个山洞，说不定……说不定什么都不会发生了……如果你怕被爹娘责骂，最多我帮你担一份好了！
translation: Han Lingsha: Shouting like this won't help either. I'm also at fault in this matter. If I hadn't barged into this cave, perhaps... perhaps nothing would have happened... If you're afraid of being scolded by your parents, at most I'll share the blame with you!

original_text: 云天河：那怎么行？我爹说不可以骂女孩子。
translation: Yun Tianhe: That won't do! My father said you can't scold girls.

original_text: 韩菱纱：那更好了，你爹要是不忍心骂我，说不定对你也只随便说上两句。
translation: Han Lingsha: Even better then. If your father can't bear to scold me, he might only say a few words to you as well.

original_text: 云天河：……不可能，你不知道他发起脾气来…………
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... Impossible, you don't know how he gets when he loses his temper...

original_text: 韩菱纱：那我们把石头搬开，找找你爹娘的尸骨！
translation: Han Lingsha: Then let's move the stones, look for your parents' remains!

original_text: 云天河：……还是不要了。
translation: Yun Tianhe: ..., better not.

original_text: 云天河：这么大的石头压下来，里面不晓得变成什么样，如果再进去打扰，爹肯定打死我，我还是等他出现骂我好了。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Such big rocks fell; who knows what it's like inside. If I go in and disturb, Father would definitely beat me to death. I'd better wait for him to appear and scold me.

original_text: 韩菱纱：（这……算什么歪理啊？野人和一般人想的就是不同……）
translation: Han Lingsha: (This... what kind of nonsense is this? Barbarian and ordinary people think so differently...)

original_text: 云天河：啊，菱纱，你刚才有没有受伤？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Ah, Lingsha, were you hurt just now?

original_text: 韩菱纱：哼～总算想到我了？喊你又不理，到现在才问，我的伤早好了！
translation: Han Lingsha: Hmph~ Finally thought of me? I called you and you ignored me, only asking now. My injury healed ages ago!

original_text: 云天河：伤能好这么快？那肯定是小伤～
translation: Yun Tianhe: Wounds heal that fast? Then it must be a minor injury~

original_text: 云天河：唉……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Sigh...

original_text: 韩菱纱：你！……
translation: Han Lingsha: You!...

original_text: 韩菱纱：（傻瓜傻瓜傻瓜！连气话都听不出来，就不会再多问一句吗？）
translation: Han Lingsha: (Idiot idiot idiot! Can't even tell it's an angry remark, couldn't you ask one more question?)

original_text: 云天河：……怎么办呀？爹和娘的墓室……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... What to do? Father and Mother's tomb chamber...

original_text: 韩菱纱：（算了，他够可怜的，说起来我也有错……）
translation: Han Lingsha: (Forget it, he's pitiful enough. Actually, I'm partly to blame...)

original_text: 韩菱纱：喂，那接下来怎么办？
translation: Han Lingsha: Hey, so what do we do next?

original_text: 云天河：……你把东西给我先。
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... Give me the thing first.

original_text: 韩菱纱：什么东西啊～莫名其妙。
translation: Han Lingsha: What thing? That's nonsense.

original_text: 云天河：墓室里的那块石头，你不是拿出来了吗？我要挖个坑把它埋了，陪着爹娘。

original_text: 某云天： 都说我“花心”，其实是我“很花心思”而已～
translation: Some Yun Tian: They all say I'm 'fickle-hearted', but actually, I just 'put a lot of thought into it'~

original_text: 某云天： 现实里何尝没有“菱纱、梦璃”呢？我就认识这么一个女孩……嗯嗯，想要电话号码吗？
translation: Some Yun Tian: Aren't there 'Lingsha, Mengli' in reality? I know such a girl... Hmm, want her phone number?

original_text: 笑犬：……企鹅……企鹅到底是白底黑边的鸟，还是黑底白肚子的鸟？
translation: Xiao Quan: ...Penguin... is a penguin a bird with a white body and black edges, or a black body with a white belly?

original_text: 笑犬：………………我常常在想，嘴炮，到底是嘴上有炮，还是炮上长嘴？？？
translation: Xiao Quan: ...I often wonder, 'lip cannon'-does it mean a cannon on the lips, or lips growing on a cannon???

original_text: 笑犬：…………如果我们的精神真的能透过游戏传达给你……
translation: Xiao Quan: ........If our spirits can truly reach you through the game...

original_text: 笑犬：……盗版的，这句送你……众人皆醒汝独昏，人皆食毂君食屎。
translation: Xiao Quan: ...A pirated copy, this line's for you... While all others are awake, you alone are muddled; while all others eat grain, you alone eat shit.

original_text: 基将军：“同一个仙剑，同一个梦想”，听起来是不是有点耳熟呢？呵呵，重在参与嘛～
translation: General Ji: 'One Pal, One Dream'. Sounds a bit familiar, doesn't it? Hehe, participation is what matters~

original_text: 基将军：从前有只家猪，喜欢爬山，爬着爬着突然有一天就变成山猪了。
translation: General Ji: Once there was a domestic pig who loved climbing mountains. One day, after climbing and climbing, it turned into a wild boar.

original_text: 基将军：你是风儿我是沙，他是天河我是菱纱；说起来我也长得不差，为什么你每次跑迷宫都用天河那个呆瓜……
translation: General Ji: You're the wind, I'm the sand; he's Tianhe, I'm Lingsha. Honestly, I'm not bad-looking either, so why do you always use that clueless Tianhe in mazes...

original_text: 基将军：适度游戏益脑，沉迷游戏伤身～注意劳逸结合:）
translation: General Ji: Moderate gaming benefits the brain, excessive gaming harms the body~ Remember to balance work and rest :)

original_text: 胃妖：话说某树家那只大脸猫，不知怎么喂养的，一个月可以长出一斤肉，现在已经是十一斤重的“小”猫了……而且居然还长出了狸猫的大尾巴！
translation: Wei Yao: Speaking of that big-faced cat from Mou Shu's house, I don't know how they feed it, but it can gain one jin of meat a month. Now it's already an eleven-jin 'little' cat... and it even grew a raccoon dog's big tail!

original_text: 胃妖：嘿嘿～～我买了好多猫罐头，改天把某树家的胖猫骗出来，翻它个肚皮朝天！……你是谁，不要偷听别人说话，也不要妄想阻止我！
translation: Wei Yao: Hehe~~ I bought lots of cat cans. Someday, I'll trick that fat cat from Mou Shu's house out and flip it belly-up! ... Who are you? Don't eavesdrop, and don't even think about stopping me!

original_text: 胃妖：我虽然叫“胃妖”，但吃的一点也不多，真的，真的，真的！绝对没有骗人！！
translation: Wei Yao: Even though I'm called 'Stomach Yao', I really don't eat much, really, really, really! I'm absolutely not lying!!

original_text: 胃妖：我们家的饭很好吃哦，真是又高兴又苦恼——吃习惯家里的饭，外面的就吃不下了，怎么办……家里要是不高兴做给我吃了………………千万不要呀！
translation: Wei Yao: Our family's meals are so delicious, it's both a joy and a worry-once you're used to home cooking, you can't eat outside food anymore. What to do... If my family ever stops cooking for me............ Please don't let that happen!

original_text: 巨云侠：看大侠一身行头，是打算踏上遥远的旅程吧，看来你已经闯过了不少劫难。不急的话，到是可以在此好好歇歇哦XD～～～
translation: Ju Yunxia: Judging by your gear, you're planning a long journey, it seems you've already overcome many trials. If you're not in a hurry, you can rest well here XD~~~

original_text: 巨云侠：能在此地见到用剑如此之快的少侠，算是给我最大的安慰。其实用剑不需要力气，想斩也斩不下去，在下巨云到是很想和少侠一战。
translation: Ju Yunxia: Being able to meet a young hero who uses a sword so swiftly here is the greatest comfort to me. Actually, using a sword doesn't require strength; wanting to slash but unable to slash down. I, Ju Yun, would very much like to have a battle with you, young hero.

original_text: 巨云侠：又在用语言思考了，鸟儿想飞却不飞，唉～～难得有这种清静，你在笑吗？等你看了结局一切就明白了～～
translation: Ju Yunxia: Thinking with words again. The bird wants to fly but doesn't fly, sigh~~ It's rare to have such tranquility. Are you smiling? You'll understand everything once you see the ending~~

original_text: 巨云侠：我把每天的工作，像写日记一样记下来。会明白任何一件事都有去做的理由和意义，而没有意义或是不想做的事，好像变得越来越少去做，大侠也别耽搁太久啦，快点前去山的另一边吧，希望还能再相见。
translation: Ju Yunxia: I record my daily work like a diary. You'll come to understand that everything has its reason and meaning to be done, and things without meaning or that you don't want to do seem to become fewer and fewer. Great hero, don't delay too long either. Hurry to the other side of the mountain. I hope we can meet again.

original_text: 阿德：告诉你个天机哦，其实在下就是那只可爱的小山猪的声优，我的目标就是把猪叫演绎到极致，OH，YEAH！
translation: Ade: Let me tell you a heavenly secret-I am actually the voice actor for that adorable little wild boar. My goal is to perfect the art of pig squealing, OH, YEAH!

original_text: 地瓜：只要你一转身，我就会给你丢个死死团的诅咒……囧囧囧……
translation: Sweet Potato: As soon as you turn around, I'll curse you with the Forever Alone curse... awkward awkward awkward...

original_text: Vampirefox：感谢您对《仙剑奇侠传四》的支持与厚爱！！！
translation: Vampirefox: Thank you for your support and love for "Chinese Paladin: Sword and Fairy 4"!!!

original_text: Vampirefox：警告！与我对话完毕5分钟后仙4盗版盘片将自动销毁，如有需要请在5分钟内存档并将盘片取出以免损坏您的光驱，谢谢合作！
translation: Vampirefox: Warning! After completing this conversation, the pirated disc of Pal 4 will automatically self-destruct in 5 minutes. If needed, please save your game within 5 minutes and remove the disc to avoid damaging your optical drive. Thank you for your cooperation!

original_text: 寸身言：告诉你哦，我在八公山北边的海边小镇碰到一个小姑娘，好可爱哦！我正准备买花去看她，可惜现在加班没时间啊……等游戏出了，我一定买套正版送给她。
translation: Cun Shenyan: Let me tell you, I met a little girl at a seaside town north of Mount. Bagong, so adorable! I was just about to buy flowers to visit her, but unfortunately, I'm working overtime now and have no time... When the game is released, I'll definitely buy a genuine copy to give her.

original_text: 寸身言：梦璃粉丝团，菱纱歌迷会现在招募粉丝中，报名请排队。报名条件必须会跳草裙舞。不会的跟我学，12，12，123……
translation: Cun Shenyan: Mengli Fan Club, Lingsha Fan Club now recruiting! Please queue to sign up. Must know how to hula dance. If not, learn from me: 12, 12, 123...

original_text: 寸身言：这里太危险，你们还是快回去吧。被我们美术看到了，一定拿你们做模特。
translation: Cun Shenyan: It's too dangerous here, you should go back quickly. If our art team sees you, they'll definitely use you as models.

original_text: 豆腐：我爱的人名花有主，爱我的人不堪入目……
translation: Doufu: The one I love is taken, the one who loves me is unsightly...

original_text: 豆腐：这年头要找个媳妇太难了，都说天上能掉老婆，那我怎么从来没捡到过……要是真能掉老婆下来，那最好掉个柳MM给我，哈哈哈！
translation: Doufu: It's too hard to find a wife these days. They say wives can fall from the sky, but I've never picked one up... If a wife really could fall, I hope it's Miss Liu for me, hahaha!

original_text: 天天猫：我们的灵魂在游戏中跳跃，我们的游戏是梦想之源。
translation: Tian Tian Mao: Our souls leap in the game, our game is the source of dreams.

original_text: 天天猫：玩家们欢笑而来，也将欢笑而去，只留下水中幻像，和存在者的证言。
translation: Tian Tian Mao: Players come with laughter, and will leave with laughter, leaving only illusions in the water and the testimony of those who exist.

original_text: 天堂我恨神：上天是公平的，得到一些的同时必然会失去另一些。至于是否值得，只有等经过时间的洗礼后才能得到答案。所以，做现在的自己想做的事才是王道！
translation: Heaven-I-hate-god: Heaven is fair; gaining something inevitably means losing something else. As for whether it's worth it, only time can tell. So, doing what you want to do as your present self is the way to go!

original_text: 天堂我恨神：等游戏出来了，忙完了就去找个老婆，听说春天把老婆埋在地里，秋天就有一大堆老婆了。嘿嘿……
translation: Heaven-I-hate-god: Once the game is out and I'm done with work, I'll go find a wife. I heard if you bury a wife in the ground in spring, you'll have a whole bunch of wives by autumn. Hehe...

original_text: 天堂我恨神：好想吃地道的回锅肉啊！
translation: Heaven-I-hate-god: I really want to eat authentic twice-cooked pork!

original_text: 天堂我恨神：想知道我最大的爱好吗？那就是一觉睡到晌午，没人打扰。哈哈，人生一大乐趣啊！
translation: Heaven-I-hate-god: Want to know my greatest hobby? It's sleeping in until noon without anyone disturbing me. Haha, one of life's great pleasures!

original_text: 伊维鲁：小仓抹茶意大利面一份，不加韭菜。
translation: Iviru: One Ogura matcha pasta, no chives.

original_text: Niko：请支持正版，谢谢！
translation: Niko: Please support the official version, thank you!

original_text: 鲸鱼：什么？你想知道我主人的大名？！！！
translation: Whale: What? You want to know my master's great name?!!!

original_text: 鲸鱼：不说。
translation: Whale: Won't say.

original_text: 鲸鱼：咕噜咕噜……（吐泡泡）
translation: Whale: Glug glug... (blowing bubbles)

original_text: 鲸鱼：其实我是汪汪旺旺财。
translation: Whale: Actually, I'm Wang Wang Wang Wangcai.

translation: Proceed to?

original_text: 韩菱纱：讨厌～昨天明明翻过黄历，怎么大吉也会变大凶？
translation: Han Lingsha: Annoying~ I checked the almanac yesterday, how did great luck turn into great misfortune?

original_text: 韩菱纱：唔……瞧你五官端正、眉清目秀，看不出晦气这么重，真是人不可貌相。
translation: Han Lingsha: Hmm... Look at you-proper features, clear-eyed and handsome-can't tell you carry such heavy misfortune. Truly, appearances deceive.

original_text: 云天河：菱纱，他们干嘛要赶我们走？是因为我射死了那只胖鸟？那胖鸟的名字叫“鸡”？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Lingsha, why are they trying to chase us away? Is it because I shot that fat bird? Is that fat bird's name 'chicken'?

original_text: 韩菱纱：怎么可能～那只笨鸟和你爹一比根本不够看嘛，也不知他老人家什么来头，搞得天怒人怨……
translation: Han Lingsha: How could that be~ That stupid bird is nothing compared to your dad. Who knows what his background is, stirring up such wrath from heaven and resentment from people...

original_text: 韩菱纱：尤其那个凶巴巴村长，都过了好多年，气还没消的样子……
translation: Han Lingsha: Especially that fierce village chief-after so many years, he still seems angry...

original_text: 云天河：他说的那些我爹的事情，到底什么意思？
translation: Yun Tianhe: What did he mean by all that stuff about my Father?
Han Lingsha: ......

original_text: 韩菱纱：哎呀～也没怎么样啦！听他唠唠叨叨说一堆，其实就是你爹个性和别人不太一样，后来四处闯荡去了。
translation: Han Lingsha: Ah~ It's nothing much! After listening to his long-winded talk, it just boils down to your father having a different personality and later wandering off to explore the world.

original_text: 云天河：哦……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Oh...

original_text: 云天河：呵呵～
translation: Yun Tianhe: Hehe~

original_text: 韩菱纱：傻笑什么？怪人……
translation: Han Lingsha: What are you grinning about? Weirdo...

original_text: 云天河：菱纱，你不觉得很棒吗？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Lingsha, don't you think it's amazing?

original_text: 云天河：原来我爹以前待过这里，离青鸾峰还这么近！
translation: Yun Tianhe: So my father used to stay here before, and it's so close to Qingluan Peak!

original_text: 韩菱纱：……
translation: Han Lingsha: ...

original_text: 韩菱纱：喂，如果…………
translation: Han Lingsha: Hey, what if...

original_text: 云天河：什么？
translation: Yun Tianhe: What?

original_text: 韩菱纱：我是说假如……你爹他是个大恶人，你还会像现在这样喜欢他吗？
translation: Han Lingsha: I mean hypothetically... if your father were a great villain, would you still like him as you do now?

original_text: 云天河：大恶人？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Big villain?

original_text: 韩菱纱：就是做了很多不好的事，大家都很讨厌他的那种人。
translation: Han Lingsha: He's the kind of person who did many bad things, and everyone hates him.

original_text: 云天河：别人干嘛讨厌我爹？我就很喜欢他啊！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Why would others dislike my Father? I really like him!

original_text: 韩菱纱：……好啦好啦，不说你爹，就说假如有个人是这样——
translation: Han Lingsha: ... Alright, alright, let's not talk about your father. Suppose there was a person like this-

original_text: 云天河：不会吧？有人这么可怜？
translation: Yun Tianhe: No way? Someone is that pitiful?

original_text: 云天河：那我更要帮他了！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Then I'll help him even more!

original_text: 韩菱纱：傻瓜，你干嘛突然热血起来？！那人说不定是自作自受，做了坏事才会受罚——
translation: Han Lingsha: Fool, why are you getting all fired up all of a sudden?! That person might have brought it on himself, being punished for doing bad things-

original_text: 云天河：呵呵，这个我懂，以前我做错事，也会被爹罚，但他对我还是很好。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Hehe, I understand that. When I did something wrong before, Father would punish me too, but he was still good to me.

original_text: 云天河：如果有个人，别人都对他不好，那他一个怎么可能打赢那么多个，我当然要帮忙，爹说过要保护弱小嘛！
translation: Yun Tianhe: If someone is treated badly by everyone else, how can they possibly win against so many alone? Of course I should help. Dad said we should protect the weak!

original_text: 韩菱纱：你……哈哈哈，不错不错，锄强扶弱，有当大侠的潜质！
translation: Han Lingsha: Haha, not bad, not bad, fighting the strong and helping the weak-you have the makings of a great hero!

original_text: 韩菱纱：（才怪……）
translation: Han Lingsha: (Yeah right...)

original_text: 云天河：大侠？是什么？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Hero? What's that?

original_text: 韩菱纱：哎？这个说来话长，先不说了，<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>我们要在天黑前赶到巢湖边，</colour><dc0>我可不要睡树林！</dc0>
translation: Han Lingsha: Huh? That's a long story, let's not talk about it now.<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> We need to reach Chao Lake before dark,</colour><dc0> I don't want to sleep in the woods!</dc0>

original_text: 云天河：呵呵，树林也没什么不好，打猎多方便～
translation: Yun Tianhe: Hehe, the forest isn't bad either, makes hunting so convenient~

original_text: 韩菱纱：哼，以为别人都和你一样是野人啊……
translation: Han Lingsha: Hmph, thinking everyone's a barbarian like you...

original_text: 韩菱纱：喂，山顶野人！
translation: Han Lingsha: Hey, mountain barbarian!

original_text: 云天河：啊？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Huh?

original_text: 韩菱纱：你不是说树林好吗？这里野兽多，你在前面开路吧！
translation: Han Lingsha: Didn't you say the forest was good? There are many beasts here, you lead the way!

original_text: 云天河：行呀，我开路，哈哈～～～
translation: Yun Tianhe: Sure, I'll lead the way, haha~~~

original_text: 韩菱纱：（唉，真受不了他……一副傻样……）
translation: Han Lingsha: (Sigh, can't stand him... such a fool...)

original_text: 云天河：哟嚯～～好大的水潭！！这就是“海”吗？！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Whoa~~ Such a big pond!! Is this the 'sea'?!

original_text: 韩菱纱：（没听见，没听见，没听见，懒得理你……）
translation: Han Lingsha: (Didn't hear, didn't hear, didn't hear, can't be bothered with you...)

original_text: 云天河：咦？菱纱你做什么？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Huh? Lingsha, what are you doing?

original_text: 韩菱纱：生火啊……不知怎么了，今天特别累，早点歇息吧。天色都暗下来了，赶夜路不安全。
translation: Han Lingsha: Making a fire... I don't know why, I'm especially tired today. Let's rest early. It's already getting dark; traveling at night isn't safe.

original_text: 云天河：这样，能生火吗？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Like this, can it start a fire?

original_text: 韩菱纱：啰嗦，不然怎么办，打火石被我弄丢了……应该也不会很难吧？没听说那些大侠在野外还有生不起火的。
translation: Han Lingsha: Stop nagging, what else can I do? I lost my flint... Shouldn't be too hard? Never heard of great heroes failing to make fire outdoors.

original_text: 云天河：菱纱，你搞错了！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Lingsha, you've got it wrong!

original_text: 韩菱纱：什么搞错了？
translation: Han Lingsha: What's mistaken?

original_text: 云天河：你在这里等一下！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Wait here for a moment!

original_text: 云天河：菱纱，来这边！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Lingsha, over here!

original_text: 云天河：这里、这里～～
translation: Yun Tianhe: Here, here~~

original_text: 韩菱纱：这是……？
translation: Han Lingsha: This is...?

original_text: 云天河：想睡觉的话，一定不要在上风处，不然野兽的鼻子那么灵，等你一觉醒来说不定已经在它肚子里了～
translation: Yun Tianhe: If you want to sleep, never stay upwind. Wild beasts have such sharp noses-you might wake up inside one's belly!

original_text: 云天河：太靠近水边的木头也不好，不容易点着，就算点起来，烟都熏得够呛了。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Wood too close to the water isn't good either, hard to light, even if it lights, the smoke is enough to choke you.

original_text: 云天河：好了，你看！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Here, look!

original_text: 韩菱纱：这些，都是你爹教的吗？！
translation: Han Lingsha: All these... were taught by your father?!

original_text: 云天河：啊？爹教过一些吧，还有我自己发现的。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Huh? Dad taught me some, and I figured some out myself.

original_text: 韩菱纱：好厉害，难怪你能做山顶野人这么多年！
translation: Han Lingsha: So amazing, no wonder you could be a mountain barbarian for so many years!

original_text: 云天河：……？
translation: Yun Tianhe: ...?

original_text: 韩菱纱：啊，不，我这绝对是夸你！
translation: Han Lingsha: Ah, no, I'm definitely praising you!

original_text: 云天河：会吗？这些都很平常啊，没什么、没什么，哈哈哈～
translation: Yun Tianhe: Really? These are all normal things, nothing, nothing, hahaha~

original_text: 韩菱纱：听到没？好怪的声音，像很大只的虫子。
translation: Han Lingsha: Hear that? A strange sound, like a really big insect.

original_text: 云天河：不是虫子……是我肚子叫，我饿了。
translation: Yun Tianhe: It's not a bug... it's my stomach growling, I'm hungry.

original_text: 韩菱纱：嘻嘻，不早说，那我们吃干粮吧。
translation: Han Lingsha: Hehe, you should've said so earlier, then let's eat dry rations.

original_text: 云天河：干粮？是什么？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Dry rations? What's that?

original_text: 韩菱纱：（可恶……刚才还觉得他懂很多东西，很了不起……结果该懂的还是不懂……）
translation: Han Lingsha: (Darn it... I just thought he knew a lot and was impressive... Turns out he still doesn't get the important stuff...)

original_text: 云天河：菱纱，“干粮”到底是什么？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Lingsha, what exactly is "dry rations"?

original_text: 韩菱纱：那，这个给你。
translation: Han Lingsha: Here, this is for you.

original_text: 韩菱纱：我带的干粮，可以吃，我们分着吃。
translation: Han Lingsha: The dry rations I brought, we can eat them, let's share.

original_text: 云天河：原来这就叫作干粮呀！
translation: Yun Tianhe: So this is what they call dry rations!

original_text: 云天河：耶～不用饿肚子，太好了！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Yay~ No more going hungry, great!

original_text: 云天河：……唔，这个“干粮”怎么比那个粽子还难吃，又干又硬，吃得好噎……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... Ugh, how is this 'ration' even worse than that zongzi, so dry and hard, it's choking me...

original_text: 韩菱纱：出门在外能填饱肚子就行了，哪来这么多挑剔。
translation: Han Lingsha: When you're out and about, as long as you can fill your stomach, that's enough-no need to be so picky.

original_text: 云天河：……唔，我还没饱。
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... Hmm, I'm not full yet.

original_text: 韩菱纱：还说呢，要不是你爹把太平村的人都得罪了，你又这么活宝，我们哪会沦落至此啊！
translation: Han Lingsha: You're one to talk! If your dad hadn't offended everyone in Taiping Village, and you weren't such a clown, would we be in this mess!

original_text: 云天河：是山下的人太古怪，一下要那个什么“钱”，一下又乱说话，杀不杀鸟自己都没想清楚，爹肯定也是受不了他们，才住到山里去的。
translation: Yun Tianhe: It's the people down the mountain who are too strange. One moment they want that thing called 'money', the next they talk nonsense, not even having thought clearly about whether to kill the bird or not. Father must have been unable to stand them either, which is why he moved to live in the mountains.

original_text: 韩菱纱：笨笨笨！人家凭什么白给你东西，吃的用的，都要拿钱去换。
translation: Han Lingsha: Stupid, stupid, stupid! Why would anyone give you things for free? Food and supplies all have to be exchanged with money.

original_text: 韩菱纱：哼，这回算是运气好，万一在城里遇上官差，把你抓到衙门关起来，看你怎么办！
translation: Han Lingsha: Hmph, we were lucky this time. What if we encounter constables in the city and they arrest you and lock you up in the yamen? What would you do then!

original_text: 云天河：关豺是啥？牙门又是什么东西？
translation: Yun Tianhe: What's a 'constable'? What's a 'yamen'?

original_text: 韩菱纱：你还真是什么都不懂啊……如果有人不守法令，就会被抓去关起来，严重一点说不定还要被杀头，负责抓人的就是官差，关人的地方就是衙门。
translation: Han Lingsha: You really don't understand anything... If someone disobeys the law, they'll be arrested and imprisoned. In more serious cases, they might even be executed. The ones responsible for making arrests are the constables, and the place where people are locked up is the yamen.

original_text: 韩菱纱：至于法令嘛，是皇帝定的，他说什么大家都得听。
translation: Han Lingsha: As for laws, they're set by the emperor; whatever he says, everyone must obey.

original_text: 云天河：呵呵，那个关豺又不一定打得赢我，遇上他我也不怕～
translation: Yun Tianhe: Hehe, that constable might not beat me, I'm not afraid if I meet him~

original_text: 韩菱纱：我不是说过吗？别总比谁的拳头硬。要跟官府对上，就凭你一个人，有几条命都不够。
translation: Han Lingsha: Didn't I say before? Don't always compare whose fist is harder. If you go against the authorities, with just you alone, you wouldn't have enough lives to waste.

original_text: 云天河：一个人？不是还有你吗？加一起两条命。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Alone? I've got you with me. That's two lives together, not alone.

original_text: 韩菱纱：你！……
translation: Han Lingsha: You!...

original_text: 韩菱纱：你少乱说！我、我又和你没什么关系，干嘛帮你……
translation: Han Lingsha: Stop talking nonsense! I, I have nothing to do with you, why would I help you...

original_text: 云天河：菱纱，你怎么脸红了？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Lingsha, why is your face flushed?

original_text: 韩菱纱：多话！是火光，才不是我脸红！
translation: Han Lingsha: Shush! It's the firelight, I'm not flushed!

original_text: 韩菱纱：……总之如果有人告诉你那东西是拿来卖的，你想要就得拿钱去换！没钱问我要好了，太多我可不帮你出。
translation: Han Lingsha: ... In short, if someone tells you that thing is for sale, you want it, you have to pay money for it! If you're short on money, you can ask me, but I won't cover too much for you.

original_text: 云天河：哦。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Oh.

original_text: 云天河：呵呵，菱纱你对我真好，除了爹以外，你是对我最好的人。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Hehe, Lingsha, you're so good to me. Besides Dad, you're the best person to me.

original_text: 韩菱纱：胡说什么，你这辈子才认识几个人，又哪里知道谁是真正对你好。
translation: Han Lingsha: Nonsense! How many people have you met in your life? How could you possibly know who truly cares for you?

original_text: 云天河：我当然知道。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Of course I know.

original_text: 云天河：爹说过，对你好的人，不一定看得出来，要用心去体会，这和学剑术是一个道理，不能只看外表。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Dad said, those who are truly good to you aren't always obvious; you have to feel it with your heart. It's the same principle as learning swordsmanship-you can't judge by appearance alone.

original_text: 韩菱纱：……你爹虽然过世得早，可教了你很多东西，不像我，连话都没和爹说上几句……
translation: Han Lingsha: ... Your father passed away early, but he taught you many things. Not like me, I didn't even get to speak with my father more than a few times...

original_text: 云天河：天天在一起，怎么可能不说话？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Being together every day, how could we not talk?

original_text: 韩菱纱：就算爹娘在世的时候，我们也不住一起……只有伯父对我好……
translation: Han Lingsha: Even when my parents were alive, we didn't live together... Only my uncle was good to me...

original_text: 云天河：……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ...

original_text: 韩菱纱：哎，瞧你那副呆呆的样子，天底下什么事都有，只是你没见过罢了。
translation: Han Lingsha: Ah, look at your dumbfounded expression. Everything exists under heaven; you just haven't seen it before.

original_text: 韩菱纱：不说了，今天不知为什么，就是觉得比平时累，早点睡吧。
translation: Han Lingsha: Enough talk. I don't know why, but I feel more tired than usual today. Let's sleep early.

original_text: 云天河：这就睡了吗？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Going to sleep already?

original_text: 韩菱纱：对啊，养足精神，<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>明天一早赶去附近的寿阳城，</colour><dc0>不管要办什么事，都还是大城里方便些。</dc0>
translation: Han Lingsha: Right, let's rest up,<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> head to nearby Shouyang City first thing tomorrow,</colour><dc0> whatever we need to do, it's always easier in a big city.</dc0>

original_text: 云天河：可是……我还没怎么吃饱……
translation: Yun Tianhe: But...I haven't really eaten my fill yet...

original_text: 韩菱纱：没吃饱就再吃啊，这种事还要问我？
translation: Han Lingsha: If you're not full, then eat more, why ask me about such a thing?

original_text: 云天河：但是干粮没了。
translation: Yun Tianhe: But we're out of rations.

original_text: 韩菱纱：你烦不烦呐？我要睡觉，安静点好吗？
translation: Han Lingsha: Aren't you annoying? I want to sleep-quiet, okay?

original_text: 韩菱纱：等等！你说什么？！干粮没了？
translation: Han Lingsha: Wait! What did you say?! The rations are gone?

original_text: 韩菱纱：你！简直是饭桶！饭桶猪！三天的干粮被你一顿就吃完了，还～没～吃～饱？
translation: Han Lingsha: You! You're such a glutton! Glutton pig! You finished three days' worth of rations in one meal and still~ not~ full?

original_text: 云天河：也不是一点没饱，就是怕夜里会饿……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Well, I'm a little full, just afraid I'll get hungry at night...

original_text: 韩菱纱：哼，干粮我都没吃几口，全被你吃光，要喊饿也该我先喊。
translation: Han Lingsha: Hmph, I barely ate any of the rations-you finished them all. If anyone should complain of hunger, it's me.

original_text: 韩菱纱：真是懒得理你了，我要睡觉……
translation: Han Lingsha: Really can't be bothered with you, I'm going to sleep...

original_text: 云天河：（饿醒了，睡不着……）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (Woke up hungry, can't sleep...)

original_text: 云天河：（……干脆去树林里猎熊，呵呵，烤熊掌～）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (...Might as well go hunt bears in the forest, hehe, roasted bear paws~)

original_text: 韩菱纱：……咦？你要去哪？
translation: Han Lingsha: ... Huh? Where are you going?

original_text: 云天河：我、我去猎熊，那个干粮吃得不过瘾，又饿了。
translation: Yun Tianhe: I... I am going to hunt bears. Those dry rations weren't satisfying, and I'm hungry again.

original_text: 韩菱纱：荒郊野外，又是大半夜的，太危险了吧？！
translation: Han Lingsha: In the wilds, in the middle of the night, isn't that too dangerous?!

original_text: 云天河：不会不会～熊就是夜里才出来比较多。你在这等我。
translation: Yun Tianhe: No, no~ Bears come out more at night. Wait for me here.

original_text: 韩菱纱：可是，这又不是青鸾峰，你对附近不熟……你别去了，我——
translation: Han Lingsha: But, this isn't Qingluan Peak. You're not familiar with the area... Don't go. I-

original_text: 云天河：什么……？
translation: Yun Tianhe: What...?

original_text: 韩菱纱：我——
translation: Han Lingsha: I-

original_text: 云天河：呵呵，我懂了～爹说女孩子胆子都很小，你一个人待在这会害怕吧？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Hehe, I get it~ Father said girls are easily scared. You're alone here, so you must be afraid, right?

original_text: 云天河：放心，我不去了，肚子饿最多再想别的办法，我先保护好你。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Don't worry, I won't go. If I get hungry, I'll just think of another way. I'll protect you first.

original_text: 韩菱纱：你懂什么懂，自作聪明的傻瓜！我……我自己……才没那么娇气呢～
translation: Han Lingsha: What do you know, you self-righteous fool! I... I myself... am not that delicate~

original_text: 云天河：娇气？……不懂……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Delicate? ...Don't get it...

original_text: 韩菱纱：……懒得跟你解释，老是问东问西的……
translation: Han Lingsha: ... Can't be bothered to explain to you, always asking this and that...

original_text: 云天河：我……
translation: Yun Tianhe: I...

original_text: 韩菱纱：唉……算了，不说这个了……
translation: Han Lingsha: Sigh... Forget it, let's not talk about this...

original_text: 韩菱纱：嘻，你看！
translation: Han Lingsha: Hehe, look!

original_text: 云天河：……粽子？！
translation: Yun Tianhe: ...Zongzi?!

original_text: 韩菱纱：哼哼～吓一跳吧？姑娘我顺手牵羊，不不不，是神机妙算，早就准备好了。
translation: Han Lingsha: Hmph~ Surprised? This lady picked it up, no no, planned ahead and was already prepared.

original_text: 韩菱纱：那个摊主好讨厌，明明说了要给钱，他还纠缠不休，摆明欺负人！
translation: Han Lingsha: That vendor is so annoying! I clearly said I'd pay, yet he kept pestering us-obviously bullying us!

original_text: 云天河：可是……你拿了粽子，我没见你给他“钱”。
translation: Yun Tianhe: But... You took the zongzi, but I didn't see you give him 'money'.

original_text: 韩菱纱：都说顺手拿的了，还给什么钱？
translation: Han Lingsha: I said I just picked it up, why pay?

original_text: 韩菱纱：对了！先说好，你可不能学我，这次是那些村民错在先，他们不仁，我们也就不义！
translation: Han Lingsha: Right! Let's agree first, you can't copy me. This time, the villagers were wrong first; they were heartless, so we can be ruthless.

original_text: 云天河：哦……蛮公平的嘛，先不仁后不义，我知道了。但是这个粽子不好吃，里面还好，外面的壳嚼不烂！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Oh...That's pretty fair, I guess. Heartless first, ruthless second, I get it. But this zongzi isn't tasty; the inside is okay, but the outer shell is too tough to chew!

original_text: 韩菱纱：原来……哈哈，怎么会有人连粽叶也吃下去！
translation: Han Lingsha: So that's it... Haha, how could someone even eat the bamboo leaves!

original_text: 韩菱纱：来来来，你过来，看我大发善心，帮你把粽叶剥了，你再尝尝！
translation: Han Lingsha: Come here, come here. Watch me be kind-hearted, I'll peel the bamboo leaves for you, then you try it!

original_text: 韩菱纱：……这样……再这样……好，大功告成～
translation: Han Lingsha: ... Like this... then like this... Okay, all done~

original_text: 云天河：……唔……好香！
translation: Yun Tianhe: ..., hmm... smells good!

original_text: 云天河：不错！和烤的肉不太一样。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Right! It's not quite like roasted meat.

original_text: 韩菱纱：嘻～饥时百味香，有三只粽子也是好的——
translation: Han Lingsha: Hehe~ When hungry, all food is fragrant, even three zongzi are good-

original_text: 韩菱纱：咦？你、你又全部吃完了？！
translation: Han Lingsha: Huh? Y-you, you finished it all again?!

original_text: 云天河：是、是吗？实在很好吃，我一不小心就……呵呵。
translation: Yun Tianhe: R-really? It was really delicious, I couldn't help myself... hehe.

original_text: 韩菱纱：傻笑什么？！想蒙混过去？
translation: Han Lingsha: What are you grinning about?! Trying to weasel out?

original_text: 韩菱纱：我可是一口还没吃，肚子咕咕叫呢！
translation: Han Lingsha: I haven't taken a single bite yet, my stomach's growling!

original_text: 云天河：没、没有啦！
translation: Yun Tianhe: N-no, not at all!

original_text: 云天河：啊！这样吧，菱纱你别气，我让好吃的自己送上门来！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Ah! How about this, Lingsha don't be angry, I'll make delicious food deliver itself!

original_text: 韩菱纱：你？你那木鱼脑袋，除了气我，还能想出什么妙计？
translation: Han Lingsha: You? With your wooden head, besides annoying me, what clever plan could you think of?

original_text: 云天河：看我的！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Watch me!

original_text: 云天河：哎哟，痛！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Ouch, that hurts!

original_text: 韩菱纱：三更半夜的，杀猪啊！
translation: Han Lingsha: In the dead of night, what's all the racket!

original_text: 云天河：不是，刚才我学母山猪叫，公山猪听到这个声音就会被引过来，呵呵～
translation: Yun Tianhe: No, just now I imitated a female boar's call. Male boars hear that sound and get lured over, hehe~

original_text: 云天河：春天这招特别管用，就不知道夏天灵不灵了。
translation: Yun Tianhe: This move works especially well in spring, just don't know if it'll work in summer.

original_text: 韩菱纱：什么？母……公……引过来……春天……
translation: Han Lingsha: What? Female... male... lure over... spring...

original_text: 韩菱纱：你！……好粗俗！！
translation: Han Lingsha: You!... So vulgar!!

original_text: 云天河：慢——你听，有动静了！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Wait-listen, there's movement!

original_text: 云天河：来了来了，烤山猪！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Coming coming, roasted wild boar!

original_text: 韩菱纱：……真、真的吗？
translation: Han Lingsha: ... Re-really?

original_text: 韩菱纱：呀！是妖怪！！
translation: Han Lingsha: Yikes! It's a yaoguai!!

original_text: 云天河：啊？怎么会这样？春天夏天真的不一样啊！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Huh? How did this happen? Spring and summer really are different!

original_text: 韩菱纱：早说你笨了！再这样下去，迟早被你害死！
translation: Han Lingsha: Told you you're dumb! Keep this up, you'll get us killed sooner or later!

original_text: 韩菱纱：可恶！从山上一路下来，我受了多少气，你可不可以别再气我了呀？！
translation: Han Lingsha: Damn it! All the way down the mountain, I've put up with so much, can you please stop annoying me?!

original_text: 云天河：……话是这么说没错，但我真的不是故意的………
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... That's true, but I really didn't mean it...

original_text: 云天河：呼～～这两只挺厉害的嘛，差一点就打不过。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Whew~~ These two are pretty tough, almost couldn't beat them.

original_text: 云天河：菱纱，你受伤了？！这么多血，有没有伤到骨头？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Lingsha, you're injured?! So much blood, are your bones hurt?

original_text: 韩菱纱：好晕……别大呼小叫，扶我到火堆边上……
translation: Han Lingsha: So dizzy... Stop shouting, help me to the fire...

original_text: 云天河：糟了！！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Oh no!!

original_text: 韩菱纱：……天河，你快跑吧！
translation: Han Lingsha: ...Tianhe, run!

original_text: 韩菱纱：往东边跑，快！！
translation: Han Lingsha: Run east, hurry!!

original_text: 云天河：我不走！你没有不仁，我不可以对你不义！
translation: Yun Tianhe: I won't leave! You haven't been heartless, I can't be ruthless to you!

original_text: 韩菱纱：你……你这笨蛋倒学得快……真要你我两条命搁这儿了吗……
translation: Han Lingsha: You... You idiot learn fast... Are we really going to waste our two lives here...

original_text: ？？：紫英师叔，等一下，等等我嘛！
translation: ??: Martial Uncle Ziying, wait, wait for me!

original_text: ？？：真是的，又没追上！
translation: ???: Really, didn't catch up again!

original_text: ？？：璇玑，你慢点……
translation: ??: Xuanji, slow down...

original_text: 璇玑：怀～朔～师～兄，要不是你慢慢吞吞，我们怎么可能把紫英师叔追丢了！
translation: Xuanji: Martial ~ Brother ~ Huai~ Shuo! If you weren't so slow and dawdling, how could we have lost track of Martial Uncle Ziying!

original_text: 怀朔：璇玑，别忘了，你我之前收妖时不慎中了禁咒，四十八个时辰内无法施展御剑之术，光凭两条腿，如何追得上紫英师叔啊？
translation: Huaishuo: Xuanji, don't forget, we accidentally got hit by a forbidden curse while capturing fiends earlier. We can't use Sword Flight for 96 hours. How can we catch up with Martial Uncle Ziying just on foot?

original_text: 怀朔：何况师叔他本次下山，也是有正事要办，你这样一味跟着，又算什么？
translation: Huaishuo: Besides, Martial Uncle has official business to attend to on this trip down the mountain. What do you think you're doing by following him like this?

original_text: 璇玑：我不管～我就喜欢跟着他！你陪我去陈州，现在就去！
translation: Xuanji: I don't care~ I just like following him! You take me to Chenzhou, right now!

original_text: 璇玑：师叔说过要去陈州察看那里的先天八卦阵有无乱象，我们去了就能遇到他！
translation: Xuanji: Martial Uncle said he was going to Chenzhou to check if the Primordial Eight Trigrams array there had any disturbances. If we go, we'll surely meet him!

original_text: 怀朔：好好好，都依你。
translation: Huaishuo: Alright, alright, as you wish.

original_text: 怀朔：先找个地方歇脚，待御剑术恢复之后，关山万里也不过瞬息而至，又何必急在一时呢？
translation: Huaishuo: Let's find a place to rest first. Once our can cast Sword Flight, traversing mountains and rivers is but an instant. Why rush now?

original_text: 璇玑：嗯～你说话要算数！
translation: Xuanji: Mm~ You have to keep your word!

original_text: 怀朔：这小师妹，真是……唉……
translation: Huaishuo: This little Martial sister, really... sigh...

original_text: 怀朔：抱歉，惊扰二位。
translation: Huaishuo: Sorry to disturb you both.

original_text: 韩菱纱：哪、哪里，是我们该道谢才对。
translation: Han Lingsha: N-not at all, we should be thanking you.

original_text: 韩菱纱：要不是刚才那位剑……剑仙前辈出手相助，我们怕是已经进了妖怪的肚子。
translation: Han Lingsha: If not for that sword... Sword Immortal senior helping us earlier, we'd probably be in a monster's belly by now.

original_text: 怀朔：哈哈，师叔的年纪其实与你们相仿，我还虚长他几岁，不过剑术进境却是望尘莫及的。
translation: Huaishuo: Haha, Martial Uncle is actually about your age. I'm even a few years older, but his sword progress is beyond my reach.

original_text: 怀朔：师叔最是嫉恶如仇，适才想必也是举手之劳，两位不必放在心上。
translation: Huaishuo: Martial Uncle is most intolerant of evil. He likely just lent a hand earlier. No need for you two to take it to heart.

original_text: 云天河：他那一招……用几把剑同时砍中妖怪，真是厉害！
translation: Yun Tianhe: That move of his... hitting the monster with several swords at once, it's really amazing!

original_text: 怀朔：紫英师叔已臻“以气成剑”之境，剑气收发，有形而无质，区区几只小妖，自然应付自如。
translation: Huaishuo: Martial Uncle Ziying has already reached the realm of "forming swords from qi." His sword energy can be manifested and withdrawn-it has form but no physical substance. A few little yaoguais are naturally no trouble for him..

original_text: 怀朔：如今这附近妖气已除，二位安心即可。
translation: Huaishuo: Now that the yao aura around here is gone, you two can rest easy.

original_text: 韩菱纱：还没请教尊姓大名？
translation: Han Lingsha: I haven't asked for your honorable name yet?

original_text: 怀朔：在下怀朔，相逢自是有缘，二位气质不凡，不知不觉与你们多说了几句。
translation: Huaishuo: I am Huaishuo. Meeting is fate; your auras are extraordinary, and I unconsciously spoke more with you.

original_text: 怀朔：我也该去追我那小师妹了，告辞！
translation: Huaishuo: I should go catch up with my little Martial Sister, farewell!

original_text: 韩菱纱：哎，害我紧张得要命～真不敢相信，我刚才是在和剑仙说话耶！
translation: Han Lingsha: Ah, you had me so nervous~ I can't believe I was just talking to a Sword Immortal!

original_text: 云天河：剑仙？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Sword Immortal?

original_text: 韩菱纱：你也看清楚了吧？尤其那个“师叔”，不但一下就打倒难缠的妖怪，还治好了我的腿伤，修仙的时日肯定不短。
translation: Han Lingsha: You saw it clearly too, right? Especially that 'Martial Uncle'-not only did he instantly defeat troublesome monsters, but he also healed my leg injury. He must have cultivated immortality for a long time.

original_text: 韩菱纱：我想想～他们说要去陈州，不如我们也赶去那里碰碰运气，那个怀朔看起来很好讲话，要是肯收你我入剑仙门下，就再好不过了！
translation: Han Lingsha: Let me think~ They said they were going to Chenzhou. Why don't we also hurry there to try our luck? That Huaishuo seems very easy to talk to. If he's willing to accept us into the Sword Immortal sect, that would be perfect!

original_text: 韩菱纱：喂，你有没有在听我说话？倒是回一句啊！
translation: Han Lingsha: Hey, are you listening to me? Say something!

original_text: 云天河：……菱纱，为什么只有一开始那人是用飞的，其他两个都用走的？还有，要怎么样才能站在剑上飞？
translation: Yun Tianhe: ...Lingsha, why was only that first person flying, while the other two were walking? Also, how do you stand on a sword to fly?

original_text: 韩菱纱：嘻嘻，那个就是我和你提过的御剑术，修仙之人几乎都会。
translation: Han Lingsha: Hehe, that's the Sword Flight technique I mentioned. Almost all cultivators know it.

original_text: 云天河：真的吗？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Really?

original_text: 云天河：那我也要修仙！！学会御剑术之后，如果想去山里打猎吃烤肉，“嗖”的一下就到了，多快！而且还可以像老鹰一样从空中往下看，这样就很容易发现山猪啦，哈哈！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Then I want to cultivate immortality too!! After learning sword flight, if I want to go to the mountains to hunt and eat roast meat, I can get there 'whoosh'-so fast! And I can look down from the sky like an eagle, making it easy to spot wild boars, haha!

original_text: 韩菱纱：（……三句不离山猪……这人真是……嗜猪成性……）
translation: Han Lingsha: (...Can't go three sentences without mentioning wild boars... This guy really... is obsessed with pigs...)

original_text: 云天河：这么好玩的事，爹以前怎么都不告诉我！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Such a fun thing, why didn't dad ever tell me about it before!

original_text: 韩菱纱：（大傻瓜一个……）
translation: Han Lingsha: (What a big fool...)

original_text: 云天河：爹……咦？不对呀……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Dad... Huh? That's not right...

original_text: 云天河：菱纱，那几个人衣服上的花纹我觉得很眼熟……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Lingsha, the patterns on those people's clothes look very familiar to me...

original_text: 韩菱纱：嘻，别说笑了，你又没什么见识，虽说那个图案是挺特别的——
translation: Han Lingsha: Heh, don't joke. You're not very knowledgeable, although that pattern is quite special-

original_text: 韩菱纱：咦？——等等！快把那块古玉拿出来，墓室里的那个！
translation: Han Lingsha: Huh? -Wait! Quickly take out that ancient jade, the one from the tomb chamber!

original_text: 云天河：怎么了？
translation: Yun Tianhe: What's wrong?

original_text: 韩菱纱：笨，看上面的图案，一模一样！！
translation: Han Lingsha: Dummy, look at the pattern above, exactly the same!!

original_text: 云天河：真的……这……是不是说明他们认识我爹和我娘？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Really... this... does it mean they knew my father and mother?

original_text: 韩菱纱：也不一定吧，要是你爹娘在山上隐居好多年，以年纪来算，不太可能是相识的，不过说不定他们和这个修仙门派有什么关系呢。
translation: Han Lingsha: Not necessarily. If your parents have been living in seclusion on the mountain for many years, considering their age, it's unlikely they knew your parents. But perhaps they have some connection with this immortal cultivation sect.

original_text: 韩菱纱：（看来我估计的没错，这野人的爹应该是剑仙，真是太好了！）
translation: Han Lingsha: (Looks like my guess was right. This barbarian's father must have been a Sword Immortal. That's great!)

original_text: 云天河：门牌？啥东西？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Sack? What's that?

original_text: 韩菱纱：受不了你……是门“派”，简单说就是很多人聚在一起练功，那他们都算这一派的人，你爹也许就是哦。
translation: Han Lingsha: Can't stand you... It's a 'sect' not 'sack', simply where many people gather to train. And they're all sect members-your father might have been one.

original_text: 云天河：好，我们马上去那个门派，问清楚！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Good, let's go to that sect right away and ask clearly!

original_text: 韩菱纱：唉，你刚才果然没听我讲话，都已经说了要去陈州找怀朔，运气好点说不定就拜入他们的门派修仙，这下可好了，还能顺便查你爹娘的事。
translation: Han Lingsha: Sigh, you really weren't listening to me earlier. I already said we're going to Chenzhou to find Huaishuo. With a bit of luck, we might even join their sect to cultivate immortality. Now it's even better-we can also investigate your parents' affairs along the way.

original_text: 韩菱纱：时间嘛，我知道寿阳城有条近路可以去陈州，只好拼一拼啰！
translation: Han Lingsha: As for time, I know there's a shortcut from Shouyang City to Chenzhou. We'll just have to give it a try!

original_text: 云天河：菱纱，你好像什么都懂，真厉害！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Lingsha, you seem to know everything, you're amazing!

original_text: 韩菱纱：哼哼～山里你是山大王，下山后还是多听我的为好——
translation: Han Lingsha: Hmph~ In the mountains, you're the king, but after coming down, you'd better listen to me more-

original_text: 云天河：什么声音？
translation: Yun Tianhe: What's that sound?

original_text: 韩菱纱：没、没有啊，你听错了吧？
translation: Han Lingsha: N-no, you must have misheard?

original_text: 云天河：明明是肚子叫的声音，我肚子没叫，那——
translation: Yun Tianhe: Clearly a stomach growling sound, my stomach didn't growl, so-

original_text: 韩菱纱：……干粮粽子都被吃光了，我肚子饿也不行吗？
translation: Han Lingsha: ...All the dry rations and zongzi are gone. Is it wrong for me to be hungry?

original_text: 云天河：呵呵，差点忘了，你等一下！我马上把这两只死妖怪烤了，保证香喷喷！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Hehe, almost forgot, wait a sec! I'll roast these two dead monsters right away, guaranteed delicious!

original_text: 韩菱纱：你你你！你到底有没有常识啊？！妖怪怎么能吃？！
translation: Han Lingsha: You you you! Do you have any common sense at all?! How can you eat a monster?!

original_text: 云天河：怎么不能吃？和山猪一样，有皮有肉，没差多少。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Why can't it be eaten? It's like a boar, has skin and meat, not much difference.

original_text: 韩菱纱：差很多好不好？你这山顶野人……
translation: Han Lingsha: Very different, okay? You mountain barbarian...

original_text: 韩菱纱：算了，我睡了。
translation: Han Lingsha: Forget it, I'm going to sleep.

original_text: 云天河：可是饿着肚子很难受吧？
translation: Yun Tianhe: But isn't it awful to be hungry?

original_text: 韩菱纱：要我吃那些东西，我宁可饿死算了！
translation: Han Lingsha: If I have to eat that stuff, I'd rather starve to death!

original_text: 韩菱纱：……喂，如果下次再遇到危险，我让你先逃，你动作要快点哦，少婆婆妈妈的。
translation: Han Lingsha: ... Hey, if we run into danger again next time and I tell you to run, you better move fast, okay? Don't dawdle.

original_text: 云天河：不行，我不能丢下女孩子！
translation: Yun Tianhe: No, I can't abandon a girl!

original_text: 韩菱纱：可笑！打不过你留下来一样打不过，又没什么江湖经验，乖乖听我的才对。
translation: Han Lingsha: Ridiculous! Staying behind won't help if we can't beat them, and with no experience, you should just listen to me.

original_text: 韩菱纱：这样，至少以后还有报仇的机会。
translation: Han Lingsha: This way, at least there's still a chance for revenge later.

original_text: 云天河：但是……就算报了仇，已经死的人也不会再活过来了吧？
translation: Yun Tianhe: But...Even if you take revenge, those who have died won't come back to life, right?

original_text: 韩菱纱：当然呐，又不是僵尸。所以才说人命宝贵，何必多拖累一个人呢？
translation: Han Lingsha: Of course not, they're not zombies. That's why human life is precious. Why drag another person into it?

original_text: 云天河：话是这么说没错，但是丢下你，我做不到就是做不到！
translation: Yun Tianhe: That's true, but leaving you behind-I just can't do it, no matter what!

original_text: 韩菱纱：你？……
translation: Han Lingsha: You?...

original_text: 韩菱纱：简直太傻了，世上怎么会有你这样的傻瓜……
translation: Han Lingsha: That's just too foolish. How can there be a fool like you in this world...

original_text: 云天河：菱纱？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Lingsha?

original_text: 云天河：你睡了吗？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Are you asleep?

original_text: 韩菱纱：……唔……天亮了吗？……奇怪……又累又饿，以前不会这样的，我是不是生病了……
translation: Han Lingsha: ... Hmm... is it dawn already?... Strange... so tired and hungry, it wasn't like this before. Am I sick...

original_text: 韩菱纱：……什么味道？烟？……
translation: Han Lingsha: ... What's that smell? Smoke? ...

original_text: 韩菱纱：我说，大清早的，你在干嘛？！
translation: Han Lingsha: I say, what are you doing so early in the morning?!

original_text: 云天河：爹说过，早晚三柱香，我可不能忘了。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Dad said, three incense sticks morning and night, I can't forget.

original_text: 云天河：呵呵，老爹看到我这么听他的话，说不定就晚几天来找我算帐了，你瞧他昨晚就没来～
translation: Yun Tianhe: Hehe, if Dad sees me obeying him so well, maybe he'll wait a few more days to settle accounts. See, he didn't come last night~

original_text: 韩菱纱：……是啊，他老人家大概有别的事在忙，哈、哈哈。
translation: Han Lingsha: ... Yeah, he's probably busy with other matters. Ha, haha.

original_text: 云天河：菱纱，我有好东西给你，你看——
translation: Yun Tianhe: Lingsha, I have something good for you, look-

original_text: 韩菱纱：呀——！！！！！这……黑黑的，这不是蜻蜓吗？！
translation: Han Lingsha: Yaa-!!!!! This... black thing, isn't this a dragonfly?!

original_text: 云天河：原来这东西叫“青亭”，我以前都不知道名字。烤过以后味道还不错，你尝尝！
translation: Yun Tianhe: So this thing is called 'dragon fly'. I never knew its name before. Tastes pretty good roasted, try some!

original_text: 韩菱纱：不要不要不要～拿开啦！
translation: Han Lingsha: No no no~ take it away!

original_text: 韩菱纱：你还问？看起来好恶心，怎么能吃？！
translation: Han Lingsha: You still ask? It looks disgusting-how could you eat it?!

original_text: 云天河：烤熟了，怎么不能吃？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Once it's roasted, why can't it be eaten?

original_text: 韩菱纱：跟你这野人说不清，反正一般人不可能吃那种东西的！
translation: Han Lingsha: I can't get through to you, you barbarian! Normal people just don't eat that sort of thing!

original_text: 云天河：……明明你自己说过的，出门在外，能填饱肚子就行了，别挑三捡四……你不吃，我自己吃啰？不能浪费。
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... Didn't you say yourself that when traveling, as long as the food fills your stomach, it's fine, don't be picky... If you won't eat it, I'll eat it myself? Can't let it go to waste.

original_text: 韩菱纱：少废话，被你气都气饱了！
translation: Han Lingsha: Enough talk, I'm already full from anger!

original_text: 韩菱纱：快点收拾东西，<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>我们去寿阳城，</colour><dc0>立刻！马上！</dc0>
translation: Han Lingsha: Hurry up and pack your things.<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> We're going to Shouyang City,</colour><dc0> immediately! Right now!</dc0>

original_text: 云天河：哎，你等一等！我不能把我爹丢在——不，是不能把爹的牌位丢在这里啊！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Hey, wait! I can't leave my Father here-no, I can't leave Father's memorial tablet here!

original_text: 韩菱纱：哼，谁管你啊～～
translation: Han Lingsha: Hmph, who cares about you~~

original_text: 渔民甲：醒醒！你醒醒啊！
translation: Fisherman A: Wake up! Wake up!

original_text: 韩菱纱：这是……怎么一回事？
translation: Han Lingsha: What's going on here?

original_text: 渔民甲：哇！仙女？！
translation: Fisherman A: Wow! A fairy?!

original_text: 韩菱纱：什么仙女，你快告诉我们，这个人是不是溺水了？
translation: Han Lingsha: What fairy? Tell us quickly, is this person drowning?

original_text: 渔民甲：他、他这不是溺水，是被湖里的水妖害了！
translation: Fisherman A: He, he's not drowning, he was harmed by the water demon in the lake!

original_text: 慕容紫英：水妖？现在何处？！
translation: Murong Ziying: Water demon? Where is it now?!

original_text: 渔民甲：这、我也不知道啊……
translation: Fisherman A: This, this, I don't know either...

original_text: 渔民甲：以前我们在湖里打渔，从来都是太太平平，这段日子却总有人失踪，没过几日就被发现昏倒在岸边……肯定是被水妖害的……
translation: Fisherman A: Before, when we fished in the lake, it was always peaceful. Lately, people keep disappearing, only to be found unconscious on the shore days later... It must be the water demon's doing...

original_text: 渔民乙：唔……妖怪……
translation: Fisherman B: Ugh... yaoguais...

original_text: 渔民甲：他醒了！
translation: Fisherman A: He's awake!

original_text: 渔民甲：……你们、你们真的是仙人？！
translation: Fisherman A: ...Are you really immortals?!

original_text: 慕容紫英：请问，你可记得是如何遇见妖怪的？
translation: Murong Ziying: May I ask, do you remember how you encountered yaoguais?

original_text: 渔民乙：我……我记不太清了……
translation: Fisherman B: I... I don't remember clearly...

original_text: 渔民乙：我把船划到百翎洲边上，就被大漩涡卷了进去……船没了……水下好像有很多长相吓人的妖怪……
translation: Fisherman B: I rowed the boat near Bailing Island and got swept into a huge whirlpool... the boat was lost... Underwater, there seemed to be many scary-looking yaoguais...

original_text: 渔民乙：后来……后来我就醒了……
translation: Fisherman B: Later... later I woke up...

original_text: 韩菱纱：我只听过巢湖的百翎洲上住着奇怪的大鸟，倒不知这里的水下有妖怪……
translation: Han Lingsha: I've only heard that strange big birds live on Bailing Isle in Chao Lake, but I didn't know there were yaoguais underwater here...

original_text: 韩菱纱：难道……和那个遗迹有关？
translation: Han Lingsha: Could it be... related to that ruin?

original_text: 慕容紫英：什么遗迹？
translation: Murong Ziying: What ruins?

original_text: 韩菱纱：……据说巢湖边曾有一个小国，因为触怒了神明，被罚整个国家都沉入湖底，不过那是很久以前、殷商时候的事，也不知真假……
translation: Han Lingsha: ... It is said that there was once a small kingdom by the side of Chao Lake. Because it angered the deities, the entire country was punished and sank to the bottom of the lake.
