translation: Yun Tianhe: I sense killing intent! Powerful!!

original_text: 韩菱纱：哪里？！
translation: Han Lingsha: Where?!
Liu Mengli: ........

original_text: 云天河：…………那个……杀气好像一会儿强……一会儿弱的……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Um... The killing intent seems to be strong one moment... and weak the next...

original_text: 韩菱纱：杀什么杀！从一进淮南王陵就念个不停，有这工夫还不快帮忙找找宝贝！
translation: Han Lingsha: Cut this talk of killing! You've been mumbling since entering Huainan King's tomb! You'd better help me seek treasures instead!

original_text: 云天河：痛……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Ouch...

original_text: 云天河：菱纱你听到没？我没说错吧？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Lingsha, did you hear? Am I right?

original_text: 韩菱纱：糟糕！不会是碰到厉鬼了吧？
translation: Han Lingsha: Crap! Could it be a vengeful ghost?

original_text: 柳梦璃：是那个壶发出的声音！大家小心！
translation: Liu Mengli: The sound comes from that flask! Take care, all!

original_text: ？？：哈哈哈！本王重见天日了！！
translation: ???: Hahaha! I, thy king, behold the light of day once more!!

original_text: ？？：唔？！尔等何人？！
translation: ???: Hmm?! Who are ye?!

original_text: 韩菱纱：本王？难道是……
translation: Han Lingsha: "I, thy king"? Could it be...

original_text: 云天河：笨……王……？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Thi... Thick... King...?

original_text: ？？：尔等竟敢如此无礼？！受死！
translation: ???: How darest thou show such disrespect?! Perish!

original_text: 淮南王：……尔等究竟何人？莫非是那妖道的门徒？！
translation: Huainan King: ..Who are ye, in truth? Are ye disciples of that sorcerous Taoist?!

original_text: 韩菱纱：你、你自称“本王”，难道是淮南王？！你不是已经成仙了？
translation: Han Lingsha: You... you call yourself "I, thy king". Are you really the Huainan King?! Didn't you attain immortality?

original_text: 淮南王：成仙？
translation: Huainan King: Attain immortality?

original_text: 淮南王：当初本王自是积功德、求仙道，却不想被一个无耻道士所欺，和八位贤人服下所谓“太仙霞丹”，反而送掉性命！
translation: Huainan King: In those days, I, thy king, indeed accumulated merit and sought the immortal path, yet never thought to be deceived by a shameless Taoist! Eight Lords and I consumed the so-called 'Grand Immortal Aurora Elixir', only to forfeit our lives!

original_text: 韩菱纱：啊！！
translation: Han Lingsha: Ah!!...

original_text: 淮南王：那妖道一心骗取荣华富贵，眼见酿成大祸，又心恐本王索命报复，便将本王与八公的魂魄封于赤绯玉壶，自行逃之夭夭！
translation: Huainan King: That treacherous Taoist, bent on obtaining wealth and glory, saw the disaster he had caused and feared that I, the king, would seek revenge. So he sealed the souls of thy king and the eight lords inside the Crimson Jade Pot and fled!

original_text: 淮南王：如今真乃天助我也！
translation: Huainan King: Now Heaven truly aideth me!

original_text: 淮南王：这玉壶力量渐失，尔等又闯入此间，有生人阳气为助力，本王与八公得以更早脱出，日后定要索那妖道性命！
translation: Huainan King: The power of this jade vessel wanes, yet ye have trespassed hither. With some breath of living souls as aid, I, thy king, and the Eight Lords may sooner break free. Verily shall I claim that Taoist's life anon!

original_text: 韩菱纱：……我说老头你啊……你死都死了，还让手下写什么《玉鼎灵丹文》骗人，又把地宫修得神神秘秘，让姑娘我白白高兴一场！
translation: Han Lingsha: ....I say, old man... You're dead and gone, yet you had your servants write that 'Jade Cauldron Elixir Script' to fool people, and built this crypt all mysterious, raising my hopes for nothing!

original_text: 韩菱纱：实在太可恶了！
translation: Han Lingsha: That's just too hateful!

original_text: 淮南王：大胆刁民！竟一再放肆！
translation: Huainan King: Audacious knave! To presume thus again!

original_text: 韩菱纱：哼，老头，我劝你好好投胎去吧！
translation: Han Lingsha: Hmph, old man, I advise you to seek rebirth properly!

original_text: 柳梦璃：世间改朝易代，你早已不是淮南王了，你要找的道士已经不在世上，你如何报仇？
translation: Liu Mengli: Dynasties have risen and fallen in this world; you are no longer the King of Huainan. The Taoist you seek is no longer among the living. How can you take vengeance?

original_text: 淮南王：……一派胡言！！
translation: Huainan King: ...Mere babble!!

original_text: 柳梦璃：你应该知道，你是在自欺欺人。
translation: Liu Mengli: Thou knowest in thy heart thou dost deceive thyself.

original_text: 淮南王：好！那么本王即刻出去，杀光全天下的道士！以泄本王数载怨恨！！
translation: Huainan King: Well then! I, thy king, shall forthwith emerge and slay every Taoist under heaven! To vent mine accumulated wrath of years!!

original_text: 柳梦璃：那些墓中的鬼魂可是因你而出？
translation: Liu Mengli: Were those specters in the tomb awakened by you?

original_text: 淮南王：鬼魂？
translation: Huainan King: Specters?

original_text: 淮南王：哈哈哈哈，看来本王的仆役也都醒了，如此甚妙！
translation: Huainan King: Hahahaha, it seems my servants too have stirred. Most excellent!

original_text: 柳梦璃：害你的人早已不在人世，你怎能以这股怨气伤及无辜？！
translation: Liu Mengli: The one who wronged you is long gone. How can you harm the innocent with your resentment?!

original_text: 淮南王：区区几个贱民竟然非议本王！本王就先吸干尔等的精血，再出去杀光全天下的道士！
translation: Huainan King: Base churls dare censure me, thy king! First shall I drain your vital essences, then emerge to slaughter every Taoist under heaven!

original_text: 云天河：哼！又是一个先不仁的家伙，虽然你说的话我听不大懂，但我不会让你出去乱杀人的！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Hmph! Another heartless villain! I don't really get what you're saying, but I won't let you go around killing innocent people!

original_text: 韩菱纱：（这野人被惹毛了……）
translation: Han Lingsha: (This barbarian is provoked...)

original_text: 云天河：他也不怎么经打，刚刚都被打败了，我一个人就可以对付他！
translation: Yun Tianhe: He's not even that tough-he just went down easy! I can take him on by myself!

original_text: 淮南王：哈哈！本王便让尔等见识见识八公的怨力！
translation: Huainan King: Hah! I, thy king, shall show ye the baleful might of the Eight Lords!

original_text: 云天河：啥？！……八加一等于九……那个，我们要不要一起打？
translation: Yun Tianhe: What?!... Eight plus one equals nine... That is, should we fight together?

original_text: 韩菱纱：（真想揍扁你这笨蛋……）
translation: Han Lingsha: (I want to hit this fool...)

original_text: 淮南王：不可能！这不可能……
translation: Huainan King: Impossible! This cannot be...

original_text: 淮南王：本王……本王还要千秋……万代……与……天同……寿…………
translation: Huainan King: I, thy king... thy king would endure for millennia... forever ... and share... heaven's... longevity............

original_text: 淮南王：……我不甘心……我……诅咒……你们…………
translation: Huainan King: ...I am not resigned... I... curse... you............

original_text: 韩菱纱：好险……还以为这次真的要去见玉皇大帝了呢……
translation: Han Lingsha: That was close... Thought I was really going to meet the Jade Emperor this time...

original_text: 云天河：为什么去见玉黄大弟？他大哥是谁？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Why do you go to meet the Jade Brother? Who is Jade?

original_text: 柳梦璃：幸好……这淮南王生前求仙不成，心里怨恨极重，若是让他跑了出去，不知有多少百姓要遭殃……
translation: Liu Mengli: Fortunately... this Huainan King failed in his quest for immortality in life, his heart brimming with bitter rancor. If he had escaped, countless common folk would have suffered...

original_text: 韩菱纱：总之啊，都怪那臭老头不好！明明没有成仙，还故弄玄虚，浪费人家感情！
translation: Han Lingsha: Anyway, it's all that nasty old man's fault! Clearly not an immortal, yet putting on airs, wasting people's feelings!

original_text: 韩菱纱：……还以为真的能找到长生不老药呢，结果又是空欢喜一场……
translation: Han Lingsha: ...I thought we could really find the elixir of longevity, but it's another disappointment...

original_text: 韩菱纱：讨厌讨厌讨厌！！
translation: Han Lingsha: Hateful, Hateful, Hateful!!

original_text: 柳梦璃：唔……菱纱你在找那种药，莫非是想长生不老吗？
translation: Liu Mengli: Hmm... Lingsha, are you seeking to be immortal?
Han Lingsha: ............

original_text: 柳梦璃：也许……也许我不该这么说，可是人生在世虽然只有短短数十年，只要能和喜欢的人在一起，也好过一个人孤孤单单过上百年千年……那样的日子，不是更让人痛苦……
translation: Liu Mengli: Perhaps... perhaps I shouldn't say this, but though life in this world is only a few short decades, being with the one you love is better than living alone for a hundred or a thousand years... Wouldn't such days be even more painful...

original_text: 柳梦璃：长生之法，人人艳羡，却又有几人真正明白自己想要什么——
translation: Liu Mengli: The method of longevity-everyone covets it, yet how many truly understand what they themselves desire-

original_text: 韩菱纱：不是的！你什么都不知道！
translation: Han Lingsha: No! You know nothing of this!

original_text: 柳梦璃：……！
translation: Liu Mengli: ...!

original_text: 云天河：菱纱，你……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Lingsha, you...

original_text: 韩菱纱：啊！对、对不起，我不是…………我只不过……只不过…………
translation: Han Lingsha: Ah! I-I'm sorry, I didn't mean... I just... just...

original_text: 韩菱纱：…………我……我要救人，我要找到长生药，救整个村子的人！
translation: Han Lingsha: ........ I... I must save them. I must find the elixir to rescue the entire village!

original_text: 韩菱纱：如果我找不到，他们就要永远永远受苦下去……每次一想到这个……我就、我就…………
translation: Han Lingsha: If I fail, they would suffer eternally... Each time I think about it... I... I just...

original_text: 柳梦璃：……都怪我不好……我真的什么都不知道……有没有可以帮你的？
translation: Liu Mengli: ...it's my fault... I knew nothing... Is there anything I can help you with?

original_text: 韩菱纱：谢谢，可是……这是我们韩家的事……我不想再多说了……
translation: Han Lingsha: Thanks, but... it's our Han family matters... I don't want to talk about it anymore...

original_text: 云天河：呵呵，不说就不说，反正我帮你一起找就好了！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Hehe, we don't have to - I'll simply help you search for it!

original_text: 云天河：原来你不是只会玩，还像爹说过的一样，救人于水火之中～他说这种人最了不起了！
translation: Yun Tianhe: So you're not just here to have fun. You're just like Father said-someone who saves others from trouble~ He said people like that are the most amazing!

original_text: 韩菱纱：……什、什么啊，你这野人突然说这么正经的话……
translation: Han Lingsha: ...Wh-What's with you? You barbarian talking all serious out of nowhere...

original_text: 云天河：梦璃，你说过，看一个人顺眼，就会想要嫁给他对不对？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Mengli, you said that if you like someone, you wish to marry into his family, correct?

original_text: 柳梦璃：是啊……
translation: Liu Mengli: Yeah...

original_text: 云天河：哈哈，菱纱！我越看你越顺眼，干脆我嫁给你～以后我们俩都一起玩，找什么东西也可以一起找！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Haha, Lingsha! The more I look upon you, the more I like you - why don't I just marry into your family?~ Then we can hang out all the time and look for stuff together!
Han Lingsha: ..............

original_text: 柳梦璃：噗～～～
translation: Liu Mengli: Pfft~~~

original_text: 韩菱纱：你！你白痴啊！！猪头！！什么嫁、嫁给我！我才不要你这种野人！！
translation: Han Lingsha: You! You idiot!! Blockhead!! What 'marry into my family'! I don't want any barbarian like you!!

original_text: 云天河：痛！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Ouch!

original_text: 韩菱纱：不！不对，根本不是这个问题！
translation: Han Lingsha: No! That's not it at all!

original_text: 韩菱纱：气死我了！不晓得是不是上辈子作了什么孽，这辈子遭报应才遇到你！
translation: Han Lingsha: I'm so mad! I must've done something terrible in my past life to be stuck with you in this one!

original_text: 云天河：菱、菱纱，你别气……你脸都红了，是不是气上不来……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Ling-Lingsha, don't be angry... Your face is flushed - are you having trouble breathing?

original_text: 韩菱纱：多话！我哪有脸红！哼！！
translation: Han Lingsha: Shut up! My face is not flushed! Hmph!!

original_text: 云天河：……又怎么了？她今天特别生气……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ...What now? She is extra mad today...

original_text: 柳梦璃：云公子……
translation: Liu Mengli: Yun...

original_text: 柳梦璃：你看菱纱很顺眼，所以就想要“嫁”给她？
translation: Liu Mengli: You find Lingsha likeable, so you want to 'marry into her family'?

original_text: 云天河：是啊。不过我看你也很顺眼就是了，可以的话，我嫁你们两个，以后我们三个都一起四处玩，找什么东西也一起找！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Yeah. But I like you a lot too. If I could, I will marry into both of your families! Then the three of us can travel around and look for things together!

original_text: 柳梦璃：云公子，只有女孩子才能嫁人，男孩子是不能嫁的～
translation: Liu Mengli: Yun, only girls may marry into a family, while boys cannot marry that way~

original_text: 云天河：啊？那男孩子不是很可怜？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Ah? Then aren't boys pitiful...?

original_text: 柳梦璃：……噗～
translation: Liu Mengli: ...Pfft~

original_text: 柳梦璃：没什么，给你这样一闹，至少菱纱没那么伤心了～我们也快点离开这儿吧。
translation: Liu Mengli: Nothing. Thanks to you, at least Lingsha isn't so sad anymore~ Let's get out of here quickly.

original_text: 云天河：是、是吗？好！
translation: Yun Tianhe: R-really? Good!

original_text: 韩菱纱：……你们看，<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>这儿又有个机关。</colour>
translation: Han Lingsha: ...Look, <colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>here's another mechanism.</colour>

original_text: 韩菱纱：我猜<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>只要解开它，丹室里就会打开其他的路了。</colour>
translation: Han Lingsha: I guess<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> once we solve it, other paths in the alchemy chamber will open.</colour>

original_text: 柳梦璃：那我们快些试试吧～
translation: Liu Mengli: Then let's try it quickly~

original_text: 韩菱纱：这……天呐！
translation: Han Lingsha: This... oh heavens!

original_text: 韩菱纱：有人、有人把淮南王的冥宫风水给破了！难怪那些鬼怪都跑出来！
translation: Han Lingsha: Someone... someone broke the Feng Shui of Huainan King's Nether Palace! No wonder those ghosts and monsters got out!

original_text: 柳梦璃：菱纱，你是说……墓道中的厉鬼和淮南王要从玉壶里出来，并无半点因由？
translation: Liu Mengli: Lingsha, are you saying... the fierce ghosts in the tomb passage and the King of Huainan emerging from the jade pot had no reason at all?

original_text: 韩菱纱：……嗯，话这么说也没错啦！
translation: Han Lingsha: ... That's true, but!

original_text: 韩菱纱：（呃……我竟然被野人感染，说话跟他一样……）
translation: Han Lingsha: (Uh... I've actually been infected by that barbarian, talking like him...)

original_text: 柳梦璃：我虽不懂风水之说，但也明白这种事关系甚大，莫非是有人和淮南王结下了深仇大怨？
translation: Liu Mengli: Although I don't understand Feng Shui, I know such matters are of great importance. Could it be that someone bore a deep grudge against the Huainan King?

original_text: 韩菱纱：……是有这种可能。
translation: Han Lingsha: ... That is a possibility.

original_text: 韩菱纱：我倒觉得弄得这么乱七八糟，或许只是不懂事的小毛贼，一味蛮干，闯了大祸自己都不一定晓得……
translation: Han Lingsha: I think this messy situation might just be some clueless petty thief, recklessly causing trouble without even realizing the scale of it...

original_text: 韩菱纱：唉～墓道吹着这种怪风，冥宫里肯定被破坏得更厉害，那帮白痴……丢脸……
translation: Han Lingsha: Sigh~ With this weird wind blowing in the tomb passage, the Nether Palace must be even more wrecked. Those idiots... so embarrassing...

original_text: 韩菱纱：梦璃你放心～淮南王老头选的风水还不是顶好，这地宫虽然在龙脉处，但怎么看也只是个小旁支，就算风水骤变，也成不了灭族绝后的大凶地。
translation: Han Lingsha: Mengli, don't worry~ The Feng Shui that old man Huainan King chose isn't the absolute best. Although this underground palace is located on a dragon vein, it looks more like a minor branch. Even if the Feng Shui suddenly changes, it won't become a place of great misfortune.

original_text: 柳梦璃：可是这些鬼怪不会出去害人吗？
translation: Liu Mengli: But won't these ghosts go out to harm people?

original_text: 韩菱纱：算是不幸中的大幸吧～这儿如今成了地缚之象，怨魂都被束缚住，跑不出地宫，以后我们找个厉害的道士来收魂，也算做件大好事！
translation: Han Lingsha: It's a blessing in disguise~ This place has now become an'earth-bound' phenomenon, trapping the resentful souls so they can't escape the underground palace. Later, we can find a powerful Taoist to collect the souls, doing a great good deed!

original_text: 柳梦璃：但愿不要有人误闯进来，枉送了性命……
translation: Liu Mengli: I hope no one mistakenly wanders in here and loses their life for nothing...

original_text: 韩菱纱：嘻嘻～这种地方，除非是亡命之徒，寻常人应该不会想靠近吧？
translation: Han Lingsha: Hehe~ A place like this, unless you're a desperate outlaw, ordinary people probably wouldn't want to get close.

original_text: 云天河：菱纱，我不懂……风水被弄坏了，可是你那么厉害，再把它改回来不就好了？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Lingsha, I don't get it... The Feng Shui is ruined, but you're so capable, can't you just fix it back?

original_text: 韩菱纱：……说什么傻话，你当改风水跟吃吃喝喝一样简单呐，弄得不好可要遭天谴的！
translation: Han Lingsha: ... What nonsense are you talking? You think altering Feng Shui is as simple as eating and drinking? Do it wrong and you'll incur divine punishment!

original_text: 韩菱纱：你可别想跑进冥宫胡闹哦！
translation: Han Lingsha: Don't even think about sneaking into the Nether Palace to cause trouble!

original_text: 韩菱纱：那是淮南王安置棺椁的地方，机关重重，现在更成了凶地，我们几个就这样进去，有几条命都不够死的！
translation: Han Lingsha: That's where Huainan King placed his coffin, full of traps, now a deadly place. Entering like this, we'd need multiple lives!

original_text: 云天河：……不会，我随便问问……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... No, I was just asking...

original_text: 韩菱纱：哼，最好是这样！刚才的事我可还没原谅你，再惹麻烦就给我小心点！
translation: Han Lingsha: Hmph, it better be! I haven't forgiven you for what happened earlier, cause more trouble and you'll be sorry!

original_text: 云天河：……刚才的事？什么事啊？
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... What happened earlier? What thing?

original_text: 柳梦璃：……菱纱，我看我们还是快找出口吧，这儿的风吹得人好不舒服……
translation: Liu Mengli: ... Lingsha, I think we should hurry and find the exit. The wind here makes me very uncomfortable...

original_text: 韩菱纱：嗯，我记得<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>那条通向碗丘山的捷径就在附近，过了碗丘山便是陈州，</colour><dc0>脚程快些午后一定可以到～</dc0>
translation: Han Lingsha: Hmm, I remember<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> that shortcut to Bowl Hill is nearby, past Bowl Hill is Chenzhou,</colour><dc0> if we hurry, we can definitely make it by afternoon~</dc0>

original_text: 慕容紫英：畜生！休要伤人！
translation: Murong Ziying: Beast! Do not harm anyone!

original_text: 韩菱纱：紫英，我们来帮你！
translation: Han Lingsha: Ziying, we're here to help you!

original_text: 韩菱纱：呼～你们，没有人受伤吧？
translation: Han Lingsha: Whew~ Is everyone... unhurt?

original_text: 猎户：头头头头头…………
translation: Hunter: Hhh-head...

original_text: 青年：头掉下来了！
translation: Youth: His head fell off!

original_text: 韩菱纱：呀——！大大大、大姐相公的头——
translation: Han Lingsha: Yaa-! Big, big sister's husband's head-

original_text: 猎户：身、身体和头都分了家，还不见血！那人一定是妖怪！
translation: Hunter: Body and head separated, yet no blood! That person must be a fiend!

original_text: 青年：妖怪会吃人！我们快逃！
translation: Youth: Fiends eat human! Let's run!

original_text: 夙莘：唉，看样子陈州也不能待了……不过这些人真没礼貌，自己打猎时惹了祸，好心救他们还被当妖怪……
translation: Sushen: Sigh, it seems I can't stay in Chenzhou either... But these people are so rude. They caused trouble while hunting, and when I kindly saved them, they treated me like a fiend...

original_text: 韩菱纱：大姐……
translation: Han Lingsha: Big sister...

original_text: 夙莘：不怕不怕，小事一桩～
translation: Sushen: Don't worry, it's a small matter~

original_text: 慕容紫英：师叔！您这是……
translation: Murong Ziying: Martial Aunt! What you are doing?...

original_text: 云天河：太厉害了！太好玩了！头掉了还能接回去，怎么做的？能不能教我？！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Amazing! So fun! The head can be reattached after falling off? How is it done? Can you teach me?!

original_text: 夙莘：那可不行～冷毅是我做的机关人，头自然能接回去，换了其他人，不早就一命呜呼了～
translation: Sushen: That won't do~ Lengyi is a mechanical puppet I made, so of course his head can be reattached. Anyone else would have been long dead~

original_text: 韩菱纱：机关人？可是，他和寻常人一样，会走路、会做动作，还能和你说话……
translation: Han Lingsha: A mechanical puppet? But... he walks, moves, and talks just like a normal person...

original_text: 韩菱纱：难道……大姐你通晓传说中“偃师”的技艺？！
translation: Han Lingsha: Could it be... you've mastered the legendary art of the 'Yanshi'?!

original_text: 夙莘：唔，看不出小姑娘年纪轻轻，见识却不浅～
translation: Sushen: Hmm, wouldn't have guessed such a young girl has such broad knowledge~

original_text: 夙莘：你猜的没错，我曾蒙一位老人传授绝技，能够以各种材料制成机关，无论是七巧暗器，亦或飞禽走兽，任何东西都可以做出。
translation: Sushen: You guessed correctly. I was once taught a unique skill by an old man, enabling me to create mechanisms from various materials-whether intricate hidden weapons, flying birds, or running beasts, anything can be made.

original_text: 夙莘：偶尔……将附着法力的“咒”与机关融为一体，也会诞生像冷毅这样的机关人，但这却已是很难得的秘术了。
translation: Sushen: Occasionally... when a 'spell' imbued with magic power is fused with a mechanism, it can give birth to a mechanical puppet like Lengyi. But this is already a very rare and secret art.

original_text: 韩菱纱：那……大姐你又说，“他”是你相公？
translation: Han Lingsha: Then... big sister, you said 'he' is your husband?

original_text: 夙莘：哈哈，谁让世间男子多半长得不堪入目，我做一个长相英俊的，天天看着，心里也舒坦得很～
translation: Sushen: Haha, since most men in the world are unsightly, I made a handsome one. Looking at it every day makes me feel quite comfortable~

original_text: 韩菱纱：……英……英俊……他吗？
translation: Han Lingsha: ...Hand... handsome... him?

original_text: 夙莘：当然！他要是活人，可就是我生平仅见的美男子了。
translation: Sushen: Of course! If he were alive, he'd be the most handsome man I've ever seen in my life.

original_text: 慕容紫英：师叔……不知能否即刻启程，随弟子回琼华派？
translation: Murong Ziying: Martial Aunt ... I wonder if you can depart immediately and return to Qionghua Sect with me?

original_text: 夙莘：你怎么还不死心呀？在陈州街头遇上你时，我就说不想回去了，要不是你请我喝酒……
translation: Sushen: Why won't you give up? When I met you on the streets of Chenzhou, I said I didn't want to return. If you hadn't bought me drinks...

original_text: 夙莘：再说你刚才也亲眼看到，这些年来我沉迷于做机关，什么仙术剑术早就荒废了，要不是有冷毅护着，寻常野兽都能伤到我，回去又能怎样？当初闹脾气信誓旦旦跑下山来，如今还要被同门嘲笑吗？
translation: Sushen: Besides, you saw with your own eyes just now-over the years, I've been obsessed with crafting mechanisms, letting all my immortal arts and swordsmanship fall into disuse. If not for Lengyi protecting me, even ordinary beasts could harm me. What good would returning do? I left the mountain in a fit of pride, swearing oaths back then. Would I now return only to be mocked by my fellow disciples?

original_text: 慕容紫英：师叔，自从您十年前下山，掌门一直十分挂念，嘱咐派中弟子若是见到您，定要请您回去！
translation: Murong Ziying: Martial Aunt, since you left the mountain ten years ago, the sect leader has missed you greatly, instructing disciples to invite you back if we ever saw you!

original_text: 夙莘：…………夙瑶师姐……
translation: Sushen: ............ Martial Sister Suyao...

original_text: 夙莘：哎哎哎哎哎～我都下山这么多年，除了有冷毅陪着，一个人独来独往惯了，谁还要再去理那种婆婆妈妈的事……
translation: Sushen: Ah Ah Ah Ah Ah~ I've been down the mountain for so many years, except for having Lengyi by my side, I'm used to coming and going alone. Who wants to bother with such fussy matters anymore...

original_text: 夙莘：师姐……整个门派我最服的就是你了……你这样，叫我怎么办才好……唉～～
translation: Sushen: Martial Sister... In the entire sect, you're the one I respect the most... Seeing you like this, what should I do... Sigh~~

original_text: 慕容紫英：师叔，这是……？
translation: Murong Ziying: Martial Aunt, what is this...?

original_text: 夙莘：紫英，请你帮我把这个箱子带回琼华派，师姐要是问起我怎么不回去，你就当着她的面打开箱子，她，应该会明白吧……
translation: Sushen: Ziying, please take this box back to Qionghua Sect for me. If Martial Sister asks why I'm not returning, open it in front of her. She... should understand then...

original_text: 慕容紫英：……是，弟子遵命。
translation: Murong Ziying: ... Yes, disciple obeys.

original_text: 夙莘：行了，没事的话，我要走了。
translation: Sushen: Alright, if there's nothing else, I'm leaving.

original_text: 云天河：等、等等！你不是会做可以动的木头老鼠吗？能不能给我一只？我买酒来跟你换～
translation: Yun Tianhe: W-wait! Don't you know how to make moving wooden mice? Can you give me one? I'll trade you some wine for it~

original_text: 夙莘：什么？！你这孩子怎么不早说？老鼠已经被我换酒换完了，和别人谈只能换到一小壶，你是我师侄的师侄，好歹也要给我两壶吧，可惜可惜……亏了亏了……
translation: Sushen: What?! Why didn't you say so earlier, kid? I've already traded all the mice for wine. Trading with others only gets me a small pot. You're my grand-disciple's disciple, you should at least give me two pots. What a pity... what a loss...

original_text: 云天河：现在说……来不及了吗？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Is it too late to say it now?

original_text: 夙莘：当然，别小看小小的机关鼠，做它的材料可不好找……算了算了，这个东西先拿去玩儿，以后有缘再见，我再送你一只好了～
translation: Sushen: Of course, don't underestimate the tiny mechanical mouse; the materials to make it are hard to find... Never mind, take this to play with for now. If we meet again by fate, I'll give you another one~

original_text: 夙莘：冷毅，咱们走了。
translation: Sushen: Lengyi, let's go.

original_text: 慕容紫英：师叔！
translation: Murong Ziying: Martial Aunt!

original_text: 夙莘：……小紫英，我离开昆仑山时，你才九岁，还有点胖胖的，像个面团儿，想不到一晃眼已经长成一个好男人了……
translation: Sushen: ...Little Ziying, when I left Kunlun Mountain, you were only nine, still a bit chubby, like a dough ball. Who'd have thought in the blink of an eye, you'd grown into such a fine man...

original_text: 夙莘：唉，妖界又快来了吧？你可得保重，千万别一不小心香消玉殒了，哈哈。
translation: Sushen: Sigh, the yao realm is coming again soon, right? You must take care, don't accidentally perish, haha.

original_text: 慕容紫英：师叔……
translation: Murong Ziying: Martial Aunt...

original_text: 夙莘：我啊，最讨厌离别时不干脆，所以别再说什么了，就让我这样走吧。
translation: Sushen: Me, I hate drawn-out goodbyes the most, so let's not say anything more. Just let me leave like this.

original_text: 韩菱纱：什么“香消玉殒”，这大姐讲话好乱七八糟……不过，她真的好潇洒，叫人羡慕……
translation: Han Lingsha: What's with this 'accidentally perish'? This lady talks such nonsense... But she's so free-spirited, it's really enviable...

original_text: 慕容紫英：师叔的性情原本并非如此，也不知这十年间究竟发生过什么……
translation: Murong Ziying: Martial Aunt's temperament wasn't originally like this. Who knows what happened these past ten years...

original_text: 云天河：她说有缘再见，才给我老鼠，那要是以后都见不到，我的老鼠怎么办呀……
translation: Yun Tianhe: She said she'd give me the mouse if we meet again. But if we never meet again, what about my mouse...

original_text: 机关已经开启
translation: Mechanism Activated

original_text: 柳梦璃：……这千佛塔内确实是宝气庄严……
translation: Liu Mengli: Inside this Thousand Buddha Pagoda, it truly is majestic and solemn...

original_text: 琴姬：秦家家大业大，<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>相公的牌位应该是供在最上面几层，我们边走边找吧。</colour>
translation: Qin Ji: The Qin family is wealthy and influential,<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> my husband's memorial tablet should be enshrined on one of the upper floors. Let's search as we go up.</colour>

original_text: 云天河：好！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Okay!

original_text: 韩菱纱：啊，这里有人？！不是和尚！
translation: Han Lingsha: Ah, there's someone here?! Not a monk!

original_text: 姜氏：……我知道，终有一天你会来的……虽然我们从来没有见过面，但是我一眼就能认出你……
translation: Lady Jiang: ...I knew you would come one day... Although we have never met, I recognized you at first glance...

original_text: 琴姬：你是……？
translation: Qin Ji: You are...?

original_text: 姜氏：想不出吗？……我却是一眼就认出你了。
translation: Lady Jiang: Can't figure it out? ...Yet I recognized you at a glance.

original_text: 琴姬：……！你是秦逸他、他的——
translation: Qin Ji: ...! You're Qin Yi's, his-

original_text: 姜氏：他的妾。
translation: Lady Jiang: His concubine.

original_text: 姜氏：……直到相公过世，我也做不了他的妻子，你尽可安心，我的名份永远都只是一个妾。
translation: Lady Jiang: ...Even until my husband passed, I could never be his proper wife. You can rest assured; my status will always remain that of a concubine.

original_text: 琴姬：我……我从来没有这样想过……
translation: Qin Ji: I... I have never thought that way...

original_text: 姜氏：不管你是怎么想的，在相公和公公婆婆心里，我却胜过你这个妻子百倍千倍！
translation: Lady Jiang: No matter what you think, in the hearts of my husband and my parents-in-law, I was a hundred, a thousand times better than you as a wife!

original_text: 姜氏：若不是相公心肠太好，顾念一点旧情，今天又哪里轮到你坐正妻之位！
translation: Lady Jiang: If my husband hadn't been so kind-hearted and held onto old sentiments, how could you possibly be sitting in the position of the rightful wife today!

original_text: 韩菱纱：喂，你别这么尖酸刻薄地欺负人！人都过世了，争这些有的没的名份还有什么用！
translation: Han Lingsha: Hey, don't be so sarcastic and bully people! The person has passed away, what's the use arguing about meaningless titles now!

original_text: 姜氏：小姑娘，你说的太好了。
translation: Lady Jiang: Little girl, you said it perfectly.

original_text: 姜氏：没什么可争的，毕竟相公生前，是我日日夜夜侍候左右，替他熬药穿衣，他也待我惜如珍宝。
translation: Lady Jiang: There's nothing to argue about. After all, when my husband was alive, I served him day and night, brewing medicine and dressing him, and he cherished me like a treasure.

original_text: 姜氏：夫妻同心，心意相连，就算……就算他的病再也没法治了，这短短数月，不也如神仙眷侣一般——
translation: Lady Jiang: Husband and wife share one heart, connected in spirit. Even if... even if his illness can never be cured, these few short months are still like an immortal couple-

original_text: 琴姬：不、不要说了！
translation: Qin Ji: No, stop talking!

original_text: 姜氏：怎么？你不爱听？不爱听我和相公是如何恩爱？
translation: Lady Jiang: What? You don't like hearing it? Don't like hearing how my husband and I loved each other?

original_text: 姜氏：你可知，妇人妒忌、合当七出？也难怪公公婆婆不喜欢你——
translation: Lady Jiang: Do you know, a woman's jealousy warrants the seven grounds for divorce? No wonder your in-laws dislike you-

original_text: 琴姬：求你……求你别再说了……
translation: Qin Ji: I beg you... please don't say anymore...

original_text: 琴姬：我今天来……只是想给相公上柱香，很快就走……
translation: Qin Ji: I came today... just to offer incense to my husband, and I'll leave soon...

original_text: 姜氏：走？是啊，你又可以抛下他，就跟从前一样。
translation: Lady Jiang: Leave? Yes, you can abandon him again, just like before.

original_text: 琴姬：不是的、我不是——
translation: Qin Ji: No, I don't-

original_text: 姜氏：不是什么！你知道吗？自从相公去了，我怕他一个人孤单寂寞，每天都来这儿陪着他，从早到晚都待在他身边。
translation: Lady Jiang: Then what else do you mean?... Did you know? Since husband passed, afraid he'd be lonely, I come here every day to accompany him, staying by his side from morning till night.

original_text: 姜氏：可你呢？！你抛下了他整整四年！不是四天、四个月，是四年！
translation: Lady Jiang: But you?! You abandoned him for four whole years! Not four days, not four months, but four years!

original_text: 琴姬：我！……
translation: Qin Ji: I!...

original_text: 姜氏：不用说了！！你如今要说的话，相公他若泉下有知，也不会愿意听的！
translation: Lady Jiang: Enough!! If my husband were alive, he would not want to hear what you have to say now!

original_text: 姜氏：你要上香，可以！但须得答应我一件事！
translation: Lady Jiang: You want to offer incense? Fine! But you must promise me one thing!

original_text: 琴姬：……什么事？只要我能做到……
translation: Qin Ji: ... What is it? As long as I can do it...

original_text: 姜氏：放心，你当然能！这件事一点都不难！我要你上完香之后，即刻离开陈州，永远不许再回来！你根本不配待在这里！
translation: Lady Jiang: Don't worry, of course you can! This matter isn't difficult at all! I want you to leave Chenzhou immediately after offering incense, and never come back! You don't deserve to stay here at all!

original_text: 韩菱纱：太过份了！凭什么？！
translation: Han Lingsha: That's too much! On what grounds?!

original_text: 柳梦璃：……
translation: Liu Mengli: ...

original_text: 韩菱纱：琴姬姐姐……
translation: Han Lingsha: Sis. Qin Ji...

original_text: 琴姬：……我、我答应你……
translation: Qin Ji: ... I, I promise you...

original_text: 琴姬：……心愿了却，我再也不踏进陈州半步！
translation: Qin Ji: ... With my wish fulfilled, I'll never set foot in Chenzhou again!

original_text: 姜氏：这样最好，我想相公他也不愿意再见你的。
translation: Lady Jiang: That's for the best. I think my husband wouldn't want to see you again either.

original_text: 琴姬：多谢……告辞！
translation: Qin Ji: Thank you... farewell!

original_text: 韩菱纱：哼，真没礼貌！
translation: Han Lingsha: Hmph, how rude!

original_text: 柳梦璃：……菱纱，走吧，孰是孰非，不是我们可以说的。
translation: Liu Mengli: ... Lingsha, let's go. Right and wrong are not for us to judge.

original_text: 姜氏：……相公，那个人，就是你直到过世前都念念不忘的女子？她……比我好吗？
translation: Lady Jiang: ...Husband, that person, is she the woman you couldn't forget until your death? Was she... better than me?

original_text: 姜氏：相公，我从小就一心一意喜欢着你，只想做你的妻子……可是为什么、为什么你要和别的女人在一起……
translation: Lady Jiang: Husband, I've liked you wholeheartedly since childhood, only wanting to be your wife... But why, why did you have to be with another woman...

original_text: 姜氏：……后来她把你抛下，姑妈说要我嫁入秦家冲喜，你知道……我有多高兴吗？
translation: Lady Jiang: ...Later, she abandoned you. My aunt said she wanted me to marry into the Qin family to bring good fortune. Do you know... how happy I was?

original_text: 姜氏：我想好好照顾你，让你忘记那个女人，从今往后只想着我……可你、你怎么忍心看都不看我一眼……
translation: Lady Jiang: I wanted to take good care of you, make you forget that woman, and from now on think only of me... But you, how could you bear not to even look at me...

original_text: 姜氏：……相公……你在那边会冷吗？是不是很寂寞？我来陪你好不好？
translation: Lady Jiang: ...Husband... are you cold under there? Are you lonely? Let me keep you company, sounds good?

original_text: 姜氏：……先前我只是不甘心，想要看看是什么样的人把你迷得神魂颠倒，今日终于见着了，她……不过是个很寻常的女子，没有我美……也没有我对你那样好……
translation: Lady Jiang: ...Before, I was just unwilling, wanting to see what kind of person had you so bewitched. Today I finally saw her... she's just a very ordinary woman, not as beautiful as me... and not as good to you as I was...

original_text: 姜氏：相公，你要记得，这世上只有我是最爱你的，不管你在哪里，我都跟着……不像其他人会把你抛下……
translation: Lady Jiang: Husband, remember, I am the only one in this world who loves you the most. Wherever you go, I will follow... Unlike others who would abandon you...

original_text: 熄灭的蜡烛
translation: Extinguished Candle

original_text: 被点燃的蜡烛
translation: Lit Candle

original_text: 云天河：菱纱说<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>要在封神陵找一件很重要的东西</colour><dc0>，现在暂时不回琼华派。</dc0>
translation: Yun Tianhe: Lingsha said<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> We need to find a very important thing in Fengshen Mausoleum</colour><dc0>, so we won't return to Qionghua Sect for now.</dc0>

original_text: 1.去琼华派
translation: 1. Go to Qionghua Sect

original_text: 2.御剑飞行
translation: 2. Sword Flight

original_text: 3.什么都不做
translation: 3. Do Nothing

original_text: 准备<colour red=255 green=102 blue=0 alpha=255>去琼华派</colour><dc0>还是</dc0><colour red=255 green=102 blue=0 alpha=255>御剑飞行</colour><dc0>？</dc0>
translation: Proceed to?

original_text: 1.去播仙镇
translation: 1. Go to Boxian Town

original_text: 准备<colour red=255 green=102 blue=0 alpha=255>去播仙镇</colour><dc0>还是</dc0><colour red=255 green=102 blue=0 alpha=255>御剑飞行</colour><dc0>？</dc0>
translation: Proceed to?

original_text: 云天河：这味道……要下雨了？！
translation: Yun Tianhe: This smell... it's going to rain?!

original_text: 云天河：（……不对，是杀气！）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (...No, it's killing intent!)

original_text: 柳梦璃：真想不到，在这儿竟还有这样绿树荫荫的地方！
translation: Liu Mengli: I truly never imagined there would be such a lush, green place here!

original_text: 韩菱纱：嘻～不然怎么叫仙山呢。
translation: Han Lingsha: Hehe~ why else would it be called an Immortal Mountain.

original_text: 韩菱纱：你干嘛紧张兮兮的样子？
translation: Han Lingsha: Why are you acting so nervous?

original_text: 云天河：杀气！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Killing intent!

original_text: 韩菱纱：又来了，哪来这么多杀气……
translation: Han Lingsha: Here we go again, where's all this killing intent coming from...

original_text: 云天河：真的，相信我……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Really, believe me...

original_text: 韩菱纱：喂！有点礼貌好不好，我在跟你讲话呢，背对我干嘛？
translation: Han Lingsha: Hey! Have some manners, will you? I'm talking to you, why are you turning your back?

original_text: 云天河：真的有——
translation: Yun Tianhe: There really is-

original_text: 云天河：哇——！！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Wow-!!

original_text: 韩菱纱：……！
translation: Han Lingsha: ...!

original_text: 柳梦璃：云公子，你受伤了？！
translation: Liu Mengli: Yun, you're hurt?!

original_text: 云天河：没、没有……只是全身麻了……不能动……你们小心……
translation: Yun Tianhe: N-no... I'm just numb all over... can't move... be careful...

original_text: 韩菱纱：怪物偷袭！梦璃，你先看看天河的伤！我来对付这个怪物！
translation: Han Lingsha: Monster ambush! Mengli, check Tianhe's injury first! I'll deal with this monster!

original_text: 韩菱纱：你是……？
translation: Han Lingsha: You are...?

original_text: 韩菱纱：你……剑仙！谢谢，你又帮了我们一次！
translation: Han Lingsha: You... Sword Immortal! Thank you, you've helped us once again!

original_text: 柳梦璃：云公子，你好些了吗？
translation: Liu Mengli: Yun, are you feeling better now?

original_text: 云天河：呃……身上已经不麻了……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Uh... My numbness is gone...

original_text: 柳梦璃：嗯，没事就好。
translation: Liu Mengli: Mm, as long as you're okay.

original_text: 云天河：刚才怎么回事？突然打下那么厉害的雷？
translation: Yun Tianhe: What happened just now? Such a powerful thunderbolt suddenly struck?

original_text: 韩菱纱：梦璃～这就是在巢湖岸边救过我和天河的剑仙，他的剑术很厉害呢！
translation: Han Lingsha: Mengli~ This is the sword immortal who saved me and Tianhe by the Chao Lake shore. His sword skills are amazing!

original_text: 少年剑客：……
translation: Young Swordsman: ...

original_text: 少年剑客：你们为何在此？
translation: Young Swordsman: Why are you here?

original_text: 韩菱纱：我们正要上山寻仙访道。
translation: Han Lingsha: We're just heading up the mountain to seek immortals and Taoism.

original_text: 少年剑客：……原来如此，刚才不应该帮你们的。
translation: Young Swordsman: ... I see. I shouldn't have helped you just now.

original_text: 韩菱纱：你……？！
translation: Han Lingsha: You...?!

original_text: 少年剑客：姑娘莫要误会，若是来求仙，太一仙径只不过是小小试炼，须得凭自身之力通过。
translation: Young Swordsman: Miss, don't misunderstand. If you seek immortality, the Taiyi Immortal Path is merely a small trial. You must pass through relying on your own strength.

original_text: 韩菱纱：太一仙径？名字很好听，怎么这样凶险啊……
translation: Han Lingsha: Taiyi Immortal Path? The name sounds nice, but why is it so dangerous...

original_text: 韩菱纱：不如剑仙你好人做到底，就带我们上山吧～
translation: Han Lingsha: How about Sword Immortal doing a good deed to the end, and taking us up the mountain~

original_text: 少年剑客：不可。
translation: Young Swordsman: No.

original_text: 韩菱纱：哎，等等！
translation: Han Lingsha: Hey, wait!

original_text: 韩菱纱：虽说要凭自身之力，可剑仙你刚才明明帮了我们，既然出手，就是打破规矩了，破例一次和破例两次又有什么分别呢？对不对？
translation: Han Lingsha: Although you said to rely on our own strength, Sword Immortal, you clearly helped us just now. Since you intervened, you've already broken the rules. What's the difference between making an exception once or twice? Am I right?

original_text: 少年剑客：……不必多逞口舌之利。你们适才遇雷电也不知闪躲，毫无应变可言，若是没有修仙资质，就请回吧。
translation: Young Swordsman: ... No need to argue with words. You just encountered lightning and didn't even try to dodge, showing no adaptability. If you lack the aptitude for cultivation, please leave.

original_text: 韩菱纱：什么？你！你少瞧不起人！
translation: Han Lingsha: What? You! Don't look down on us!

original_text: 少年剑客：我不过就事论事。
translation: Young Swordsman: I'm merely stating the facts.

original_text: 韩菱纱：不是吧？这家伙的性格这么讨人厌……
translation: Han Lingsha: No way? This guy's personality is so annoying...

original_text: 云天河：他也没怎样，还帮了我们……
translation: Yun Tianhe: He didn't do anything wrong, and even helped us...

original_text: 韩菱纱：你啊，到底懂不懂人争一口气的道理！
translation: Han Lingsha: You, do you even understand the importance of standing up for your own pride?

original_text: 韩菱纱：走！拼了命我们也要爬上山，让那个冰块脸刮目相看！
translation: Han Lingsha: Let's go! We'll climb this mountain even if it tries to kill us, and make that ice-face look at us with new eyes!

original_text: 柳梦璃：嗯……有些人就是面冷心热，他出手帮我们，应该也没有恶意，菱纱你就别气了。
translation: Liu Mengli: Mm...Some people just have a cold face but a warm heart. He helped us, likely without ill intent, Lingsha, please don't be angry.

original_text: 韩菱纱：……其实，我也知道啊，他救了我们两次，是个好人，我只是不喜欢他那么说话……我们走吧。
translation: Han Lingsha: ... Actually, I know too. He saved us twice; he's a good person. I just don't like the way he talks... Let's go.

original_text: 韩菱纱：走了大半天，不要说什么修仙门派，连个人影都没看见……
translation: Han Lingsha: We've walked for half a day-not a sign of any cultivation sect, not even a person in sight...

original_text: 耿峰：此山是我开，此树是我栽！
translation: Geng Feng: This mountain was opened by me, these trees were planted by me!

original_text: 巴靖安：要从此路过，留下干粮来！
translation: Ba Jing'an: To pass here, leave your rations behind!

original_text: 韩菱纱：哈，才说没人呢，马上就来了两个傻瓜。
translation: Han Lingsha: Ha, just said no one was here, and two fools show up right away.

original_text: 云天河：你们是谁？有事吗？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Who are you? Need something?

original_text: 巴靖安：老大，怎么办？我们都已经讲这么白了……
translation: Ba Jing'an: Boss, what do we do? We've already spoken so plainly...

original_text: 耿峰：担心什么，他们只是在故作镇定罢了！
translation: Geng Feng: What's there to worry about, they're just putting on a brave face!

original_text: 柳梦璃：仙山之中……怎会有匪徒？
translation: Liu Mengli: In a mountain of immortals... how could there be bandits?

original_text: 耿峰：错！我们不是匪徒，而是江湖上人称“剑南双侠”的豪杰！
translation: Geng Feng: Wrong! We are not bandits, but heroes known in the martial world as the 'Twin Heroes of Jiannan'!

original_text: 韩菱纱：贱男？双侠？……那，请问有何贵干？
translation: Han Lingsha:  Twin Heroes? ...Then, Twin Zeroes, what business do you have?

original_text: 巴靖安：刚才不是说过了吗？！哼，那我再说一次，听好！
translation: Ba Jing'an: Didn't I just say it?! Hmph, then I'll say it again, listen well!

original_text: 云天河：为什么要把干粮给你们？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Why should I give you the rations?

original_text: 耿峰：蠢货！你没看我们手上拿着剑吗？！
translation: Geng Feng: Fool! Can't you see we're holding swords?!

original_text: 巴靖安：对！拳头大的人有干粮吃，快拿来！
translation: Ba Jing'an: Right! The one with the bigger fist gets the rations, hand them over!

original_text: 云天河：剑？可是我也有啊，还不止一把。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Swords? But I have one too. More than one actually.

original_text: 云天河：还有拳头？我看你们拳头小得很，应该你们把干粮给我。
translation: Yun Tianhe: And fists? I see your fists are tiny-you should give me your rations instead.

original_text: 柳梦璃：噗～
translation: Liu Mengli: Pfft~

original_text: 韩菱纱：哈哈，人说秀才遇到兵，有理说不清，今天是强盗遇到野人，一样有理说不清。
translation: Han Lingsha: Haha, they say a scholar can't reason with a soldier. Today it's a robber meeting a barbarian-same story, no reasoning.

original_text: 巴靖安：老大，怎么办？打不？
translation: Ba Jing'an: Boss, what do we do? Fight or not?

original_text: 耿峰：咳咳……这个……
translation: Geng Feng: Ahem... this...

original_text: 巴靖安：老大，这小子身形剽悍呐，打不？
translation: Ba Jing'an: Boss, this kid looks tough, should we fight?

original_text: 耿峰：咳咳……那个……我看……
translation: Geng Feng: Ahem... well... I think...

original_text: 巴靖安：莫非老大一眼就看出他是使双剑的好手？
translation: Ba Jing'an: Could it be Boss saw at a glance he's skilled with twin swords?

original_text: 耿峰：啊？！对、对、对，是使双剑的好手，一流的剑客呀！
translation: Geng Feng: Ah?! Right, right, right, a master of twin swords, a first-rate swordsman!

original_text: 巴靖安：高！还是老大眼光高啊，那我们…………打不？
translation: Ba Jing'an: High! Boss's  judgment is as sharp as ever, so then we... do we fight or not?

original_text: 耿峰：咳咳……这位少侠，既然都是使剑高手，我们英雄惜英雄，单剑惜双剑。这样吧，你继续吃你的干粮，我继续吃我的干粮。
translation: Geng Feng: Ahem... Young hero, since we're both sword masters, heroes admire heroes, a single-sword master admires a twin-sword master. How about this: you continue eating your rations, and I'll continue eating mine.

original_text: 云天河：（听不懂……到底干粮要给谁？）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (Don't understand... who exactly is getting dry rations?)

original_text: 耿峰：青山不改，绿水长流，就此别过！我们走！
translation: Geng Feng: Green hills and blue waters remain; We shall part here! Let's go!

original_text: 巴靖安：是，老大！
translation: Ba Jing'an: Yes, boss!

original_text: 韩菱纱：慢～～着～～
translation: Han Lingsha: Sloooow doooown~~

original_text: 耿峰：你、你想怎样？
translation: Geng Feng: You, what do you want?

original_text: 韩菱纱：不怎样，只是想问问这条路是不是能通到仙山顶上？
translation: Han Lingsha: Nothing much. Just wanted to ask if this road leads to the top of the immortal mountain?

original_text: 巴靖安：就算是，就凭你们几个也上不去！连我们“剑南双侠”都——
translation: Ba Jing'an: Even if it is, you few won't be able to go up there! Even we, the 'Twin Heroes of Jiannan', couldn't-

original_text: 耿峰：咳咳！！
translation: Geng Feng: Cough cough!!

original_text: 巴靖安：对啊，你问我就说，不是太没面子了！
translation: Ba Jing'an: Right, if you ask, I'll tell, wouldn't that make me lose face?

original_text: 少女：你们两个！又在欺负刚上山的人！
translation: Young Girl: You two! Bullying newcomers to the mountain again!

original_text: 耿峰：石榴妹妹，你可别冤枉人，我和大巴也是好心，怕他们在山上迷了路，才来帮忙的。
translation: Geng Feng: Sister Shiliu, don't wrong us. Daba and I meant well, afraid they'd get lost on the mountain, so we came to help.

original_text: 石榴：听你鬼扯！
translation: Shiliu: Don't talk nonsense!

original_text: 耿峰：不信就算了，咱兄弟俩还要练剑，先走一步！
translation: Geng Feng: Don't believe me then, my brother and I still need to practice swordsmanship, we're off!

original_text: 柳梦璃：这，究竟是……？
translation: Liu Mengli: This, what exactly...?

original_text: 石榴：别理那两个混蛋！除了欺软怕硬，别的什么都不会！
translation: Shiliu: Don't mind those two scoundrels! They only know how to bully the weak and fear the strong, nothing else!

original_text: 云天河：他们干嘛要干粮？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Why do they need rations?

original_text: 石榴：那个啊～当然拿来吃了！
translation: Shiliu: That? Of course it's for eating!

original_text: 石榴：其实我们都是来求仙问道的，可惜通不过试炼，又不甘心就此离开，所以在山腰结庐，苦修武功，想要再去闯关。
translation: Shiliu: Actually, we all came here seeking immortality and enlightenment. Unfortunately, we failed the trials, but unwilling to just leave, we built huts on the mountainside to train hard, hoping to challenge again.

original_text: 石榴：虽然山上偶尔也会送些东西下来，但这儿毕竟很清苦，那两个没骨气的东西就想了个馊主意，专打劫你们这种刚上山的人。
translation: Shiliu: Although things are occasionally sent down from the mountain, this place is still quite harsh. Those two spineless fellows came up with a stupid idea-specializing in robbing people like you who've just come up the mountain.

original_text: 韩菱纱：你说的山上，是指那个修仙门派吗？
translation: Han Lingsha: The mountain you mentioned, is it that immortal cultivation sect?

original_text: 石榴：是啊，据说昆仑山中一共有八个修仙门派，在播仙镇附近的这个最大最强，叫作“琼华派”，供奉着九天玄女。
translation: Shiliu: Yes, it's said there are eight immortal cultivation sects in the Kunlun Mountains. The largest and strongest one near Boxian Town is called the 'Qionghua Sect', which venerates the Ninth Heaven Xuannv.

original_text: 石榴：这一派讲究“人剑合一”的修行之法，收取门徒极是严格，可以说是百里，不，千里挑一！
translation: Shiliu: This sect emphasizes the cultivation method of 'unity of man and sword', selecting disciples extremely strictly-one in a hundred, no, one in a thousand!

original_text: 云天河：有这么难？那你和我们一起上山吧，人多不怕闯不过去！
translation: Yun Tianhe: That hard? Then come up the mountain with us! With more people, we're bound to get through!

original_text: 石榴：多谢，但是我不能入门并非因为走不过太一仙径，这儿不少人都和我一样……
translation: Shiliu: Thank you, but my inability to join isn't because I can't pass the Taiyi Immortal Path. Many people here are like me...

original_text: 柳梦璃：那你能不能告诉我们——
translation: Liu Mengli: Then could you tell us-

original_text: 石榴：对不起……我知道你想问什么，可往后的试炼我连一点点都不能透露，要是让人知道了，我会立刻被送下山去。
translation: Shiliu: I'm sorry... I know what you want to ask, but I can't reveal even a little about the trials ahead. If anyone found out, I'd be sent down the mountain immediately.

original_text: 柳梦璃：抱歉，让你为难了……
translation: Liu Mengli: Sorry for putting you in a difficult position...

original_text: 石榴：没关系，但愿你们都能如愿以偿～
translation: Shiliu: It's fine, I just hope you all get your wishes fulfilled~

original_text: 石榴：累了的话，可以在前面稍微歇息一下。
translation: Shiliu: If you're tired, you can rest a bit up ahead.

original_text: 韩菱纱：谢谢！
translation: Han Lingsha: Thanks!

original_text: 韩菱纱：听她这么一说，我更是想快点上山看看！
translation: Han Lingsha: Hearing her say that makes me want to go up the mountain even sooner!

original_text: 韩菱纱：天河！
translation: Han Lingsha: Tianhe!

original_text: 云天河：啊？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Huh?

original_text: 韩菱纱：青山不改、绿水长流！我们走！嘻嘻～
translation: Han Lingsha: Green hills and blue waters remain like ever! Let's go! Hehe~

original_text: 云天河：是……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Yes...

original_text: 云天河：咦？那是什么？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Huh? What's that?

original_text: 云天河：住手！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Stop!
Road Monster: ...?!

original_text: 云天河：这猎物是我的！
translation: Yun Tianhe: This prey is mine!

original_text: 云天河：此山是我开，此树是我栽！要……嗯？
translation: Yun Tianhe: This mountain I opened, these trees I planted! To... huh?

original_text: 云天河：后面忘了怎说了……反正这只看上去嫩嫩的会飞小猪我要了！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Forgot what comes next... anyway, this tender-looking flying piglet is mine!

original_text: 路怪甲：咕呱～！！
translation: Road Monster: Gwaa~!!

original_text: 云天河：啊？！想打架？我不怕你！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Huh?! Want to fight? I'm not afraid of you!

original_text: 云天河：实在太弱了，连个肉渣都没剩下……
translation: Yun Tianhe: They're really too weak, not even a scrap of meat left...

original_text: 云天河：（看样子皮也很薄，应该不用剥皮，直接烤了算了……）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (Looks like the skin is thin too-probably don't need to peel it, just roast it...)

original_text: 天河：（奇怪……这只猪不逃走？跟其他的不太一样……）
translation: Tianhe: (Strange... This pig isn't running away? It's different from the others...)

original_text: 云天河：（怎么给我一种感觉……唔，长得很有勇气的样子……）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (Why do I get the feeling... Hmm, he looks... so brave...)

original_text: 云天河：（………………难得见到这么勇敢的猪，居然不怕我，了不起！）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (.................. Rare to see such a brave pig, not afraid of me at all. Impressive!)

original_text: 云天河：唔，算了，今天就先放过你吧，以后再来找你，哈哈，记得多吃点，把自己养肥一点～
translation: Yun Tianhe: Hmm, forget it, I'll let you off today. I'll come back for you later, haha. Remember to eat more, get nice and plump~

original_text: 云天河：再见了，勇气猪～
translation: Yun Tianhe: Farewell, brave pig~

original_text: 云天河：你干嘛一直跟着我？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Why do you keep following me?

original_text: 云天河：……说什么？不懂……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... Saying what? Don't get it...

original_text: 云天河：难道你觉得自己够肥了？不会吧？好歹吃到身体比头大吧？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Do you think you're fat enough already? No way? At least get your torso bigger than your head!

original_text: 云天河：啥意思？……你要跟着我？
translation: Yun Tianhe: What do you mean? ... you want to follow me?

original_text: 云天河：哈哈，真的吗？这可是你自己送上门来的！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Haha, really? You brought this upon yourself!

original_text: 云天河：（太好了～～～这样下次烤肉的时候就可以……哈哈、哈哈哈……）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (Great! Next time I roast meat, I can... Haha, hahaha...)

original_text: 云天河：（要是紫英师叔问起来，也不关我的事，是这只勇气猪自己要跟来的～）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (If Martial Uncle Ziying asks, it's not my fault, it's this brave pig that insisted on following~)

original_text: 云天河：走吧，勇气！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Let's go, Brave!

original_text: 云天河：哈哈，第一次有食物跟着我跑，不是我追着食物跑，实在太高兴啦！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Haha, it's the first time food has chased after me, not me chasing food! I'm so happy!

original_text: 阿吉达：太一仙径的路实在太难走！我走了十几天，包袱里的大饼都快吃完了，才刚走到这里！留在这里的大叔看起来都比我厉害，可他们说，再往上的路更难走！
translation: Ajida: The Taiyi Immortal Path is just too hard! I've been walking for over ten days, and the flatbread in my pack is almost gone, and I've only just reached this point! The uncles staying here all seem more capable than me, but they say the road ahead is even tougher!

original_text: 阿吉达：……看来我是无缘见到山上的天神了……可是下山的路我也不记得，只能先在这里住一阵再说……
translation: Ajida: ...It seems I'm not fated to see the celestials on the mountain... But I don't remember the way down either, so I'll have to stay here for a while first...

original_text: 阿吉达：天神的使者告诉我们，山上出了大事，这里不能继续住下去了，让我们尽快下山！
translation: Ajida: The messenger of the celestials told us a major incident has occurred on the mountain, we can't continue living here, we must descend the mountain quickly!

original_text: 萧秋语：昆仑仙山果然不同凡响，山下播仙镇一派绿洲景象，山道上四时景观又各不相同，即使琼华派不收我入门，我这一趟西域之行，也不算白来。
translation: Xiao Qiuyu: The Kunlun Immortal Mountain truly lives up to its reputation. At its foot, Boxian Town presents an oasis scene, while the mountain paths showcase different seasonal landscapes. Even if Qionghua Sect doesn't accept me as a disciple, this journey to the Western Regions won't have been in vain.

original_text: 萧秋语：据说太一仙径分别有紫微道、白灏道、玄寂道，乃是含有通神之意。
translation: Xiao Qiuyu: It's said that the Taiyi Immortal Path has three sections: Ziwei Path, Baihao Path, and Xuanji Path, each containing divine meaning.

original_text: 萧秋语：仙家讲求缘分，看来你们几个才是和琼华派有缘的人，却不知道我的仙缘又在哪里呢？
translation: Xiao Qiuyu: The immortals believe in fate. It seems you few are the ones destined for the Qionghua Sect. I wonder where my own immortal fate lies?

original_text: 邓一浩：谢大哥，你功夫高，能不能告诉我，再往上的山路到底好走不好走？
translation: Deng Yihao: Brother Xie, you're highly skilled. Can you tell me if the mountain path ahead is easy to traverse?

original_text: 谢见星：再往上啊，冷得要命，河水都结冰了……
translation: Xie Jianxing: Further up, it's freezing cold, the rivers are all frozen...

original_text: 邓一浩：这么说来，我们两人多穿点，还是能上山求仙？
translation: Deng Yihao: So you're saying if we bundle up, we can still go up the mountain to seek the immortals?

original_text: 谢见星：其实我已经上过山了，只是琼华派不肯收我，我才刚入山门，就被站在门口的弟子请出来了。
translation: Xie Jianxing: Actually, I've already been up the mountain, but the Qionghua Sect wouldn't accept me. I had just entered the Sect Gate when a disciple standing at the entrance asked me to leave.

original_text: 邓一浩：我是千里迢迢从京城来昆仑求仙的，希望仙人一定要收我入门，不然我在家中立下重誓，回去岂不是脸都丢光了？……
translation: Deng Yihao: I traveled all the way from the capital to Kunlun seeking immortality. I hope the immortals accept me; otherwise, I made a solemn vow at home-I'd lose all face returning...

original_text: 邓一浩：之前有琼华派的剑仙来过，我还以为他们要改变主意收我入门，没想到是来让我们速速下山的……
translation: Deng Yihao: Before, sword immortals from Qionghua Sect came. I thought they had changed their minds and would accept me as a disciple, but they just told us to leave the mountain quickly...

original_text: 谢见星：除了昆仑之外，蜀山也是赫赫有名的修仙之地，不过我仰慕琼华派炼剑之法，所以宁可跑这么远来西域！
translation: Xie Jianxing: Besides Kunlun, Mount Shu is also a famous cultivation site. But I admire Qionghua Sect's sword-forging methods, so I'd rather travel this far to the Western Regions!

original_text: 谢见星：邓兄算不上习武之人，能来到半山腰已经很不容易，我看还是不要强求了……
translation: Xie Jianxing: Brother Deng isn't really a martial artist; making it halfway up the mountain is already quite an effort. I think we shouldn't push it...

original_text: 谢见星：什么？我上山时琼华派的人明明跟我说他们不收弟子的呀！你比我晚上山，他们凭什么收你不收我？
translation: Xie Jianxing: What? When I went up the mountain, the Qionghua Sect people clearly told me they weren't accepting disciples! You went up later than me-why would they accept you and not me?

original_text: 石榴：你们几个一路小心～我相信只要有决心，一定能入琼华派门下的！
translation: Shiliu: Be careful on your journey~ I believe with determination, you can surely join the Qionghua Sect!

original_text: 石榴：呀！恭喜你们，看来已经被收入剑仙门下了！……只可惜……我似乎是没有这里的仙缘，剑仙说近日将有大事发生，遣我们速速下山去……
translation: Shiliu: Ah! Congratulations! It seems you've been accepted into the sword immortals' sect!... It's just a pity... I seem to lack the fate here. The sword immortals said a major event is imminent and sent us down the mountain quickly...

original_text: 沙依木：天神保佑！我终于来到了半山腰……可是为什么又马上就让我下山呢……好累……
translation: Sayim: Celestials bless! I finally reached the mountainside... But why must I go back down immediately... So tired...

original_text: 云天河：太好了！可以回去了吗？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Great! Can we go back now?

original_text: 酒仙翁：当然不是，后面还有其他的考验等着你们呐！
translation: Wine Immortal Elder: Of course not. There are other trials waiting for you ahead!

original_text: 云天河：哦……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Oh...

original_text: 柳梦璃：多谢仙翁。
translation: Liu Mengli: Thank you, Immortal Elder.

original_text: 酒仙翁：哈哈哈～女娃儿不用谢老夫。待老夫想想，“酒色财气”四关，你们已经过了“酒”这一关，接下来嘛……
translation: Wine Immortal Elder: Hahaha~ No need to thank me, lass. Let me think... You've passed the 'wine' trial among the four trials of 'wine, lust, wealth, and wrath'. Next...

original_text: 酒仙翁：我瞧小娃儿艳福不浅，身边两个如花似玉的女娃儿应该挺喜欢你的吧？“色”那一关就可以省下啰！
translation: Wine Immortal Elder: I see you, young lad, have quite the luck with ladies. The two lovely girls by your side must really like you, right? The 'lust' trial can be skipped then!

original_text: 柳梦璃：仙翁你……
translation: Liu Mengli: Immortal Elder, you...

original_text: 韩菱纱：仙翁！你搞错了吧？！我我我、怎么可能喜欢这块木头！根本没有的事！
translation: Han Lingsha: Immortal Elder! You've got it wrong! I, I-how could I possibly like this blockhead! Absolutely not true!

original_text: 酒仙翁：哈哈，喜不喜欢，你们自己心里都有数，老夫说对说错，又有什么关系。
translation: Wine Immortal Elder: Haha, whether you like it or not, you know in your hearts. Whether I'm right or wrong, what does it matter?

original_text: 云天河：呃，那个、我……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Uh, well, I...

original_text: 韩菱纱：你、你想说什么？可别胡思乱想哦……
translation: Han Lingsha: You-what are you trying to say? Don't think nonsense...

original_text: 云天河：我……我是想说，原来你这么讨厌我，以前都不知道……
translation: Yun Tianhe: I...I mean... I never knew you disliked me this much before...

original_text: 韩菱纱：什么？我几时说过讨厌你了？
translation: Han Lingsha: What? When did I ever say I disliked you?

original_text: 云天河：就在刚才啊……可是，我就很喜欢你和梦璃，为什么你会讨厌我？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Just now... But, I really like you and Mengli. Why do you dislike me?

original_text: 韩菱纱：你！你这野人，木头脑袋！这要我怎么说啊！
translation: Han Lingsha: You! You barbarian, blockhead! How am I supposed to say this!

original_text: 酒仙翁：哈哈，小娃儿，你的喜欢和女娃儿说的喜欢，可不是一回事～
translation: Wine Immortal Elder: Haha, little one, the 'like' you mean and the 'like' this girl means are not the same thing~

original_text: 云天河：……？
translation: Yun Tianhe: ...?

original_text: 酒仙翁：你说的恐怕是朋友之谊，可女娃儿和老夫说的，却是男女之情啊。
translation: Wine Immortal Elder: What you speak of is likely friendship. But what this girl and I discussed was romantic love.

original_text: 云天河：有什么不一样吗？
translation: Yun Tianhe: What's the difference?

original_text: 酒仙翁：哈哈，老夫是仙，你却问老夫这个问题，让老夫如何回答你呢？
translation: Wine Immortal Elder: Haha, I am an immortal, yet you ask me this. How should I answer?

original_text: 酒仙翁：老夫只知凡人追求痴情爱欲，何谓情爱，并无定论，有人平平淡淡便是真情，有人却非要弄到天崩地裂才罢休，一切只看你自己是如何想法，反正啊，和她在一起便觉最舒心、最自在的人，八成就是你真正喜欢的人了！
translation: Wine Immortal Elder: I only know that mortals pursue passionate love and desire. What love truly is-there's no fixed rule. Some find it in plain simplicity, others need heaven and earth to shake. It all depends on your own heart. Anyway, the person you feel most comfortable and at ease with?-Nine times out of ten, that's the one you truly like!

original_text: 云天河：……我还是不懂，喜欢还有假的吗？而且要分那么多种？好难……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... I still don't understand. Can liking someone be fake? And there are so many kinds? It's so difficult...

original_text: 酒仙翁：有人一见倾心，有人朋友之谊会变为爱怜之情，呵呵～小娃儿懂是不懂啊？
translation: Wine Immortal Elder: Some fall in love at first sight, some find friendship turning into affection. Hehe~ young lad, do you understand?

original_text: 云天河：不懂……
translation: Yun Tianhe: No?...

original_text: 酒仙翁：那教你一个不用伤脑筋的办法好不好？
translation: Wine Immortal Elder: Then shall I teach you a way that doesn't strain your brain?

original_text: 云天河：好啊！谢谢～～
translation: Yun Tianhe: Great! Thank you~~

original_text: 酒仙翁：两个字……喝酒……
translation: Wine Immortal Elder: Two words... just drink...

original_text: 柳梦璃：噗……
translation: Liu Mengli: Pfft...

original_text: 云天河：……呃，那个……菱纱说喝酒伤身，我喝多了会被她骂，还有别的办法吗？
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... Uh, well... Lingsha says drinking alcohol is harmful to health. If I drink too much, she'll scold me. Is there another way?

original_text: 柳梦璃：……
translation: Liu Mengli: ...

original_text: 韩菱纱：……天河，我说你呀，别总在这个问题上纠缠不休了，我们快点通过试炼比较重要吧？
translation: Han Lingsha: ... Tianhe, I'm telling you, don't keep getting hung up on this issue. Isn't it more important for us to pass the trial quickly?

original_text: 酒仙翁：不错不错，哈哈，女娃儿说的对，跳脱不出尘世多情，你们还求什么仙道啊？
translation: Wine Immortal Elder: Good, good, haha, the girl is right. If you can't break free from worldly passions, what are you seeking the path of immortality for?

original_text: 酒仙翁：快走吧，老夫要开始畅饮美酒了，然后睡上个天昏地暗，你们也加把劲，快快通过考验～
translation: Wine Immortal Elder: Hurry along. I'm about to indulge in fine wine and sleep like the dead. You all should work hard and pass the trial quickly~

original_text: 云天河：这是哪里？掌门不是说要带我们去一个地方？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Where is this? Didn't the Sect Leader say he'd take us somewhere?

original_text: 韩菱纱：嘻，不懂了吧～还跑路爬山的，掌门可不是要带你去踏青，她使的是仙～法～
translation: Han Lingsha: Heh, you don't get it, do you~ With all that running and climbing, the Sect Leader isn't taking you on a spring outing. She's using immortal~ arts~

original_text: 柳梦璃：嗯……这法术十分厉害，须臾之间便将几人送来此地，绝非易事，但是掌门施展起来却不费吹灰之力。
translation: Liu Mengli: Mm... This spell is incredibly powerful, transporting several people here in an instant-no easy feat. But the Sect Leader performed it effortlessly.

original_text: 韩菱纱：好梦璃，你不是也会幻术？能带我们出去吗？
translation: Han Lingsha: My dear Mengli, don't you know illusion magic too? Can you get us out?

original_text: 柳梦璃：此地亦幻亦真，虚实难辨，凭我的法力还不能破解。
translation: Liu Mengli: This place is both illusion and reality, hard to distinguish between real and fake. With my current power, I cannot break it.

original_text: 韩菱纱：哇～这么厉害？琼华派果然不简单！
translation: Han Lingsha: Wow~ That impressive? Qionghua Sect is truly extraordinary!

original_text: 韩菱纱：最想不到的，掌门居然是个女的，还是个大美人，看起来又那么威严，害我刚才好紧张。
translation: Han Lingsha: Most surprising, the Sect Leader is actually a woman, and a great beauty too, looking so dignified. That made me so nervous earlier.

original_text: 云天河：<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>那边有人，问问他怎么走好了～</colour>
translation: Yun Tianhe: <colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>Someone over there, I'll ask him for directions~</colour>

original_text: 韩菱纱：也好，一时半会想不到其他办法了。
translation: Han Lingsha: Fine, can't think of any other way for now.

original_text: 酒仙翁：还不快去给老夫找酒？<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>找到了酒就倒进后面的酒缶里！</colour>
translation: Wine Immortal Elder: Still not going to find wine for me?<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> Once you find the wine, pour it into the wine urn behind!</colour>

original_text: 酒仙翁：快走吧，老夫要开始畅饮美酒了，然后睡上个天昏地暗～
translation: Wine Immortal Elder: Hurry and go. This old man is about to start drinking fine wine, then sleep like the dead~

original_text: 柳梦璃：老人家，打扰一下可以吗？
translation: Liu Mengli: Elder, may we trouble you for a moment?

original_text: 老人：……唔？
translation: Elder: ...Hmm?

original_text: 韩菱纱：……老人家？
translation: Han Lingsha: ... Elder?

original_text: 老人：……唔……好酒……
translation: Elder: ...Mmm... good wine...
Han Lingsha: ......

original_text: 韩菱纱：老人家！
translation: Han Lingsha: Elder!

original_text: 老人：啊？！我梦里的酒！没了、全没了！你们、你们没见老夫正在打盹吗？！吵醒了老夫，梦里的好酒都喝不上了！
translation: Elder: What?! My dream wine! Gone, all gone! You, you didn't see this old man was napping?! You woke me up, and now I can't drink the fine wine from my dream!

original_text: 柳梦璃：实在对不住，我们不是有意要打扰您睡觉，只是想问问从这儿怎么出去。
translation: Liu Mengli: We're truly sorry; we didn't mean to disturb your sleep. We just wanted to ask how to get out from here.

original_text: 老人：唔？原来是从琼华派来的小娃儿。
translation: Elder: Hmm? So you're youngsters from Qionghua Sect.

original_text: 韩菱纱：正是，老人家您认识琼华派的人吗？能不能告诉我们出去的路啊？
translation: Han Lingsha: Exactly, Elder, do you know anyone from Qionghua Sect? Could you tell us the way out?

original_text: 老人：……唉，被你们这一闹，肚子里的酒虫全醒了，咕咕直叫！
translation: Elder: ...Sigh, with all your commotion, the wine bugs in my belly have all woken up, gurgling and growling!

original_text: 云天河：你肚子饿的话，我们带了干粮～
translation: Yun Tianhe: If you're hungry, we brought dry rations~

original_text: 老人：干粮管什么用？老夫乃是酒仙翁，自然要喝酒。
translation: Elder: What use are rations? I am the Wine Immortal, naturally I need wine.

original_text: 韩菱纱：老人家～喝酒伤身，而且会喝醉呢。
translation: Han Lingsha: Elder~ Drinking harms your health, and you'll get drunk.

original_text: 酒仙翁：哈哈哈～莫说醉，醉了海阔天空！喝酒好、喝酒好啊～
translation: Wine Immortal Elder: Hahaha~ Don't talk about being drunk, being drunk is liberating! Drinking is good, drinking is wonderful~

original_text: 云天河：（爹也是这么爱喝酒吗……）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (Did father love wine this much too...)

original_text: 酒仙翁：说起来，你们几个娃儿，刚才把别人好梦惊醒，害老夫没能喝到梦中的美酒，居然还想要老夫帮忙，想得美哦。
translation: Wine Immortal Elder: Speaking of which, you kids just woke someone from a sweet dream, making me miss out on the fine wine in that dream, and now you still want my help? Dream on!

original_text: 酒仙翁：唔……刚刚梦到蜜酒，好久没梦到了，真是好喝啊，嗯……嗯……
translation: Wine Immortal Elder: Hmm... just dreamed of honey wine. Haven't dreamed of it in a long time. So delicious, hmm... hmm...

original_text: 云天河：蜜酒？我爹也很爱喝的！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Honey wine? My father loved it too!

original_text: 酒仙翁：是吗？看你这傻小子的眼睛就知道说的是实话，不是顺竿爬来哄老翁开心，呵呵呵～你我有缘，你我有缘啊。
translation: Wine Immortal Elder: Is that so? Looking at your honest eyes, I can tell you're speaking the truth, not just flattering this old man to please him, hehehe~ You and I are fated, truly fated.

original_text: 韩菱纱：老人家～我们也不知道您正梦见喝美酒啊，所谓不知者不罪，您就大人有大量，别计较了。
translation: Han Lingsha: Elder~ We didn't know you were dreaming of drinking fine wine. As they say, ignorance is no sin. Please be magnanimous and don't take it to heart.

original_text: 酒仙翁：女娃儿说的轻松，老夫才没那么好打发，除非……
translation: Wine Immortal Elder: Girl, you speak lightly. This old man isn't so easily dealt with, unless...

original_text: 韩菱纱：除非什么？！
translation: Han Lingsha: Unless what?!

original_text: 酒仙翁：哈，你们害老夫没喝到酒，自然要给老夫找酒来，这样吧，<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>去找九十九坛美酒，把我身后这个酒缶装满，</colour><dc0>老夫能喝得过瘾，少不了要帮帮你们。</dc0>
translation: Wine Immortal Elder: Ha! You made me miss my drink, so you owe me wine. Here's the deal: find ninety-nine jars of fine wine to fill this urn behind me. If I drink my fill, I'll help you out.

original_text: 韩菱纱：嘻，太好了，谢谢仙翁指点！
translation: Han Lingsha: Hehe, great, thank you for the guidance, Immortal Elder!

original_text: 云天河：你这么想喝酒，为什么自己不去找呢？
translation: Yun Tianhe: You want to drink so much, why don't you go find it yourself?

original_text: 韩菱纱：哎呀，少呆了，这就是仙翁给我们的考验呐！
translation: Han Lingsha: Hey, don't just stand there! This is the test the Immortal Elder gave us!

original_text: 酒仙翁：哈哈，无妨，就当老夫年纪大了，只好麻烦年轻人跑跑腿。
translation: Wine Immortal Elder: Haha, no matter. Just consider this old man too aged and needing young folks to run errands.

original_text: 云天河：可你一次喝那么多酒，头不会晕？我上回只喝了一点，就撑不住了……
translation: Yun Tianhe: But you drink so much wine at once, won't your head get dizzy? Last time I only drank a little and couldn't handle it...

original_text: 酒仙翁：你这娃儿有意思，求人办事还问东问西的。这倒让我想起很久以前，也有个年轻人，哄得老夫很开心呢！仔细看，你和那人长得真有几分像。
translation: Wine Immortal Elder: You're an interesting kid, asking this and that while seeking a favor. This reminds me of a long time ago, when there was also a young man who made me very happy! Look closely, you really resemble that person somewhat.

original_text: 韩菱纱：喂，天河，他说的是不是你爹啊？
translation: Han Lingsha: Hey, Tianhe, is he talking about your father?

original_text: 云天河：真的吗？爹也来过这里？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Really? Father has been here too?

original_text: 酒仙翁：好了，闲话少说，去吧！动作不够快，老夫可要生气的！
translation: Wine Immortal Elder: Enough, less chatter, go! If you're not fast enough, this old man will get angry!

original_text: 酒仙翁：这味儿，好香哇！小娃儿不错，手脚俐落得很，这些瓶瓶罐罐的，就拿去玩吧！
translation: Wine Immortal Elder: This aroma, so fragrant! Not bad, kid, you're quite nimble. Take these bottles and jars to play with!

original_text: 韩菱纱：嘻！谢谢仙翁！不过，那个出口……
translation: Han Lingsha: Heh! Thank you, Immortal Elder! But, that exit...

original_text: 酒仙翁：莫急，莫急～老夫这就送你们一程。
translation: Wine Immortal Elder: Don't rush, don't rush~ I'll send you on your way now.

original_text: 酒仙翁：不是让你们动作快一点吗？！
translation: Wine Immortal Elder: Didn't I tell you to hurry up?!

original_text: 酒仙翁：老夫等了又等，被酒虫闹得浑身发痒，来来来！你们几个，找不到酒，就陪我活动活动筋骨！
translation: Wine Immortal Elder: I've waited and waited, itching all over from the wine bugs. Come, come! You lot, if you can't find the wine, then accompany me in some exercise to loosen my joints!

original_text: 云天河：要打架？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Want a fight?

original_text: 云天河：我不干，你年纪这么大了，我不出手。
translation: Yun Tianhe: I won't do it. You're so old, I can't hit you.

original_text: 酒仙翁：哈哈，大话别说得太早！
translation: Wine Immortal Elder: Haha, don't boast too soon!

original_text: 酒仙翁：你们几个打架倒不含糊，好吧，也算通过这一关，老夫送你们一程！
translation: Wine Immortal Elder: You all fight without hesitation. Alright, you pass this trial. I'll give you a lift!

original_text: 韩菱纱：这个人……好像很有钱的样子。
translation: Han Lingsha: This person... seems quite wealthy.

original_text: 韩菱纱：但是他好严肃……都不讲话。
translation: Han Lingsha: But he's so serious... doesn't talk at all.

original_text: 柳梦璃：请问，这一关要怎样才能通过呢？
translation: Liu Mengli: May I ask, how can we pass this trial?

original_text: 财神爷：不难、不难，让我高兴就好。
translation: God of Wealth: Not difficult, not difficult, just make me happy.

original_text: 韩菱纱：（哼～神气什么？讲话都不看人的……）
translation: Han Lingsha: (Hmph~ So arrogant? Not even looking at people when talking...)

original_text: 柳梦璃：……那，要怎样您才会高兴呢？
translation: Liu Mengli: Then, what would make you happy?

original_text: 财神爷：去找十颗宝石给我，听好～只要最值钱的九眼石，其他的我通通看不上眼。
translation: God of Wealth: Find 10 gems for me. Listen~ only the most valuable Nine-Eyed Stones. I won't accept any others.

original_text: 韩菱纱：九……眼石？没听说过啊……是什么样子的？
translation: Han Lingsha: Nine-...Eyed Stone? Never heard of it... What does it look like?

original_text: 财神爷：唉！怎地如此孤陋寡闻？一看就知道生财无方，注定要做穷鬼。
translation: God of Wealth: Sigh! How can you be so ignorant? Clearly, you have no knack for making money, destined to be a pauper.

original_text: 韩菱纱：你！……
translation: Han Lingsha: You!...

original_text: 财神爷：九眼石就是一种金色的石头，这么简单都不知道……
translation: God of Wealth: A Nine-Eyed Stone is just a type of golden stone. You don't even know something that simple...

original_text: 财神爷：唉，指点你们费时又费力，快去吧，找十一颗九眼石给我。
translation: God of Wealth: Sigh, instructing you is such a hassle. Hurry up and find eleven Nine-Eyed Stones for me.
Liu Mengli: ......

original_text: 韩菱纱：咦？不是十颗吗，怎么又多一颗？！
translation: Han Lingsha: Huh? Wasn't it ten? How come there's one more?!

original_text: 财神爷：既然你问我答，多一颗是我回答你们的报酬。去找十二颗宝石来吧。
translation: God of Wealth: Since you ask, I answer, the extra gem is my reward for answering. Go find twelve gemstones.

original_text: 韩菱纱：骗人的吧？财神爷不是应该散财吗？这个家伙居然见钱眼开又乱抬价……
translation: Han Lingsha: You've got to be kidding me? The God of Wealth should be giving out money! This guy gets money-grubbing at the sight of cash and jacks up the prices...

original_text: 财神爷：小姑娘，别以为小声说我坏话，我就听不见。你问我答～天上各路财神一大把，要是不想办法敛财，哪来的财可以散？单是我的这身行头也不便宜呐——
translation: God of Wealth: Little girl, don't think I can't hear you just because you're whispering bad things about me. Let me answer your question-there's a bunch of Wealth Gods up in heaven. If we didn't find ways to gather wealth, what would we have to give out? Even this outfit of mine isn't cheap-

original_text: 财神爷：<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>去找十三颗九眼石来吧。</colour>
translation: God of Wealth: <colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>Go find thirteen Nine-Eyed Stones.</colour>

original_text: 柳梦璃：菱纱你先别和财神爷说话了，我们说越多，他要的宝石就越多……
translation: Liu Mengli: Lingsha, stop talking to the God of Wealth. The more we say, the more gems he'll want...

original_text: 云天河：是啊，好像夏天山里的蚊子，越杀越多。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Yeah, like mosquitoes in the mountains in summer, the more you swat, the more there are.

original_text: 财神爷：嗯，这句免钱～还是你们两个聪明，快去快回吧！
translation: God of Wealth: Hmm, that one's on the house~ You two are the smart ones. Off you go, and hurry back!

original_text: 韩菱纱：（……气死人了！不痛骂这破财神，难消我心头之恨！可是，这家伙又会坐地起价敲竹杠……）
translation: Han Lingsha: (...So infuriating! I'm dying to curse this lousy God of Wealth to vent my anger! But then he'd just raise the price and rip us off...)

original_text: 柳梦璃：财神爷，您要的宝石我们已经带来了。
translation: Liu Mengli: God of Wealth, we've brought the gemstones you requested.

original_text: 财神爷：不错不错，快给我吧！
translation: God of Wealth: Good, good, give them to me quickly!

original_text: 韩菱纱：慢——！
translation: Han Lingsha: Wait-!

original_text: 柳梦璃：菱纱？有什么不对吗？
translation: Liu Mengli: Lingsha? Is something wrong?

original_text: 韩菱纱：财神爷，你看清楚了，是这些吗？
translation: Han Lingsha: God of Wealth, take a good look. Are these the stones what you want?

original_text: 财神爷：是啊，还不快给我。
translation: God of Wealth: Yes, now hurry up and give them to me.

original_text: 韩菱纱：嘻嘻，既然你是财神爷，那一定懂商道吧？没听过一手交钱一手交货吗？
translation: Han Lingsha: Hehe, since you're the God of Wealth, you must know business very well, right? Ever heard of 'payment on delivery'?

original_text: 财神爷：嗯，有道理！
translation: God of Wealth: Hmm, makes sense!

original_text: 韩菱纱：天河！
translation: Han Lingsha: Tianhe!

original_text: 云天河：啊？干嘛？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Huh? What?

original_text: 韩菱纱：你数一下，刚刚我放你包里的宝石有几颗～
translation: Han Lingsha: Count them, how many gems did I just put in your bag~

original_text: 云天河：不就是十三颗吗？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Isn't it just thirteen?

original_text: 韩菱纱：少多话，叫你数就数啊。
translation: Han Lingsha: Less talk, just count when I tell you to.

original_text: 云天河：呃，我数数……咦，不对，怎么多了三颗？！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Uh, let me count... Huh? That's not right, how come there are three extra?!
God of Wealth: ...!!

original_text: 韩菱纱：嘻嘻～既然财神爷这么喜欢这些宝石，那一定很值钱，我刚才顺手多弄了几颗，打算带回去卖钱。
translation: Han Lingsha: Hehe~ Since the God of Wealth likes these gems so much, they must be very valuable. I grabbed a few extra just now, planning to take them back to sell.

original_text: 云天河：啊？！难怪刚才打得有点慢，你竟然偷藏……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Huh?! No wonder our progress was a bit slow just now, you actually hid...

original_text: 韩菱纱：小赚一笔嘛～
translation: Han Lingsha: A little profit~

original_text: 柳梦璃：……菱纱……我懂你的意思，但是你这样做，会不会太冒险了……
translation: Liu Mengli: ... Lingsha... I understand what you mean, but isn't this too risky...

original_text: 韩菱纱：好梦璃，你放心吧，瞧我的！
translation: Han Lingsha: My dear Mengli, don't worry, watch me!

original_text: 云天河：什么意思？我都糊涂了……
translation: Yun Tianhe: What do you mean? I'm all confused...

original_text: 财神爷：不可不可！这些宝石并非凡物，你们不能把多余的带走！
translation: God of Wealth: No, no! These gems are not ordinary objects. You cannot take any extras with you!

original_text: 韩菱纱：哼，懒得管你，反正门开了，给你十三颗，银货两讫。
translation: Han Lingsha: Hmph, can't be bothered with you. Anyway, the door's open. Here are thirteen for you, payment settled.

original_text: 财神爷：放肆！竟然敢跟财神爷这样说话！你们都别想走！
translation: God of Wealth: How dare you! How dare you speak to the God of Wealth like that! None of you shall leave!

original_text: 韩菱纱：咦？刚刚说好的，一手交钱一手交货，想讲话不守信用吗？你懂不懂商道啊？
translation: Han Lingsha: Huh? We just agreed, payment on delivery. Are you trying to go back on your word? Do you even understand business?

original_text: 财神爷：你！你！你好大的胆子！三个年轻人不懂爱惜自己的性命，不要以为财神爷只数钱不打架！
translation: God of Wealth: You! You! You have some nerve! Three youngsters who don't value their own lives, don't think the God of Wealth only counts money and can't fight!

original_text: 韩菱纱：呀！恼羞成怒？你想动手？！
translation: Han Lingsha: Yikes! Angry from embarrassment? You want to fight?!

original_text: 财神爷：从来没人会想多带宝石！每个试炼的人都是战战兢兢、规规矩矩！你、你、你们这几个闯关的家伙，尤、尤、尤其是你，太不像话了！
translation: God of Wealth: No one ever thinks to bring extra gems! Every trial-taker is trembling and strictly obedient! You, you, you lot breaking through, e-especially you, are utterly outrageous!

original_text: 财神爷：看我今天好好收拾你们，我、我、我一定要给你们好看！
translation: God of Wealth: Watch me teach you a lesson today. I, I, I'll show you what I've got!

original_text: 财神爷：……我败了……
translation: God of Wealth: ..., I've lost...

original_text: 韩菱纱：怎样？服不服气？
translation: Han Lingsha: Well? Convinced?

original_text: 财神爷：……
translation: God of Wealth: ...

original_text: 韩菱纱：……
translation: Han Lingsha: ...
God of Wealth: ......

original_text: 云天河：（怎么他们都不讲话？是不是这个老头还想打？……但我没感到杀气啊……）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (Why aren't they talking? Does this old man still want to fight?... But I don't sense any killing intent...)
God of Wealth: ...... ...

original_text: 财神爷：哈哈哈，三位真乃人中豪杰，刚才是开个小玩笑，别当真啊，有话好商量嘛～
translation: God of Wealth: Hahaha, you three are truly heroes among mortals. That was just a little joke earlier; don't take it seriously. Let's talk things over~

original_text: 韩菱纱：（……转得好硬，果然是无奸不商……）
translation: Han Lingsha: (...That was a forced pivot. A true merchant's cunning, indeed...)

original_text: 财神爷：这么多闯关的人来来去去，就只有这位姑娘会想到多搜集一些宝石，真是难得的人才啊！
translation: God of Wealth: So many challengers come and go, but only this young miss thinks to collect more gems. Such a rare talent!

original_text: 韩菱纱：别嘴巴跟抹了蜂蜜似的，姑娘我不吃这一套。
translation: Han Lingsha: Don't sweet-talk me. This lady isn't falling for that approach.

original_text: 财神爷：是是是～那到底该用哪一套，望姑娘指点一二。
translation: God of Wealth: Yes, yes, yes~ So what approach should I take? Please, miss, give me some guidance.

original_text: 韩菱纱：哼，想要全部的宝石也行，直接让我们把“气”那一关也过了！
translation: Han Lingsha: Hmph, if you want all the gems, fine! Just let us pass the 'wrath' trial directly!

original_text: 财神爷：啊？！你们不一关一关地闯，这不合规矩呀！
translation: God of Wealth: Ah?! You're not clearing the trials one by one? That's against the rules!

original_text: 韩菱纱：是～～吗～～那就没得谈了，你要的宝石给你，多余的我带着继续闯关啰。
translation: Han Lingsha: Re~ally~? Then there's nothing to discuss. Here's the gem you want, I'll keep the extras and continue clearing the trials~

original_text: 财神爷：别～别～别～有话好商量。大家都是熟人、都是熟人呀！不用这么计较吧？
translation: God of Wealth: No~ no~ no~ Let's talk this over. We're all acquaintances, all friends! No need to be so particular, right?

original_text: 韩菱纱：（谁跟是你熟人……）
translation: Han Lingsha: (Who's your friend...)

original_text: 财神爷：……我想想……
translation: God of Wealth: ..., let me think...

original_text: 柳梦璃：菱纱你实在是……呵呵……
translation: Liu Mengli: Lingsha, you really are... hehe...

original_text: 财神爷：唉～～～罢了、罢了，亏了、亏了。
translation: God of Wealth: Sigh~~~ forget it, forget it, a loss, a loss.

original_text: 财神爷：三位过去吧，从这里直接就能回琼华派了。
translation: God of Wealth: You three may pass, from here you can return directly to Qionghua Sect.

original_text: 财神爷：姑娘……你看……那个宝石……
translation: God of Wealth: Miss... look... those gemstones...

original_text: 韩菱纱：哼！给你。
translation: Han Lingsha: Hmph! Here.

original_text: 韩菱纱：我们走了！
translation: Han Lingsha: We're leaving!

original_text: 财神爷：是、是、是，您慢走。
translation: God of Wealth: Yes, yes, yes, take care on your way.

original_text: 云天河：……一下就能过关了？
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... Can we pass just like that?

original_text: 柳梦璃：嗯，多亏了菱纱的妙计呢。
translation: Liu Mengli: Mm, thanks to Lingsha's clever plan.

original_text: 财神爷：哈哈……三位慢走、三位慢走。
translation: God of Wealth: Haha... take care, you three, take care.

original_text: 财神爷：（哼！可恶的三个小娃儿，别再给我看到！不然我、我、我……罢了，和气生财、和气生财。）
translation: God of Wealth: (Hmph! Those three wretched kids, don't let me see you again! Otherwise I, I, I... Forget it, harmony brings wealth, harmony brings wealth.)

original_text: 财神爷：没找到<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>十三颗九眼石</colour><dc0>之前，不要和我说话。</dc0>
translation: God of Wealth: Don't speak to me until you find<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> thirteen nine-eyed stones</colour><dc0>.</dc0>

original_text: 云天河：<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>先要找人问路。</colour>
translation: Yun Tianhe: First, we need to ask for directions.

original_text: 酒仙翁：还少
translation: Wine Immortal Elder: Still short

original_text: 坛酒。
translation: Jar of wine.

original_text: 酒仙翁：还不快去给老夫找酒？老夫可要等不及了！
translation: Wine Immortal Elder: Still not hurrying to find wine for this old man? I'm growing impatient!

original_text: 云天河：十三颗宝石收集齐了，<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>我们赶快找财神去吧。</colour>
translation: Yun Tianhe: All thirteen gems are collected.<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> Let's hurry and find the God of Wealth.</colour>

original_text: 韩菱纱：十三颗宝石收集齐了，<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>我们赶快找财神去吧。</colour>
translation: Han Lingsha: All thirteen gems are collected.<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> Let's hurry and find the God of Wealth.</colour>

original_text: 柳梦璃：十三颗宝石收集齐了，<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>我们赶快找财神去吧。</colour>
translation: Liu Mengli: All thirteen gems are collected.<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> Let's hurry and find the God of Wealth.</colour>

original_text: 慕容紫英：十三颗宝石收集齐了，<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>我们赶快找财神去吧。</colour>
translation: Murong Ziying: All thirteen gems are collected,<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> let's hurry and find the God of Wealth.</colour>

original_text: 迷宫中有三个区域会依次掉落九眼石。
translation: ##NOWRAP##In the maze, 3 areas will sequentially drop Nine-Eye Stones.

original_text: 每个区域的大门每三十秒开启一次，三十秒后关闭。

original_text: 云天河：这儿的土怎么和播仙镇的不太一样？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Why is the soil here different from Boxian Town's?

original_text: 韩菱纱：哪儿有土？分明全是沙子。
translation: Han Lingsha: Where's the soil? It's clearly all sand.

original_text: 韩菱纱：看样子这里原本有条河，后来水都干了，才会变这样。
translation: Han Lingsha: Looks like there was originally a river here, but the water dried up later, which is why it's like this now.

original_text: 柳梦璃：……这，就是沙漠吗？我在书上念到过，大地干涸，树木都会枯死，人也会迁徙离开……
translation: Liu Mengli: ... So... this is a desert? I read about it in books-the land parched, trees withering and dying, people migrating away...

original_text: 云天河：沙漠？那沙漠的另一边是什么？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Desert? What's on the other side of that desert?

original_text: 韩菱纱：不知道，可能是绿洲，也有可能什么都没。
translation: Han Lingsha: Don't know, might be an oasis, or maybe nothing at all.

original_text: 云天河：呵呵，那我们过去看看不就知道了？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Hehe, then why don't we go take a look and find out?

original_text: 韩菱纱：什么？！哪有人会跑去沙漠里玩？
translation: Han Lingsha: What?! Who would go play in the desert?

original_text: 云天河：不行吗？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Can't we?

original_text: 韩菱纱：哎，跟你说不清，反正那里面很没意思，又危险，去了也白去。
translation: Han Lingsha: Ah, it's hard to explain. Anyway, that place is boring and dangerous, going there is pointless.

original_text: 柳梦璃：<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>其实……进去看看也无妨啊。</colour>
translation: Liu Mengli: <colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>Actually... there's no harm in going in to take a look.</colour>

original_text: 柳梦璃：我们身上都有水袋……若有危险，也随时都可以御剑离开不是吗？
translation: Liu Mengli: We all have water pouches... If there's danger, we can always leave by Sword Flight, right?
Han Lingsha: ......

original_text: 韩菱纱：好吧好吧，拗不过你们两个……
translation: Han Lingsha: Fine, fine, can't argue with you two...

original_text: 云天河：哈哈，太好了！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Haha, great!

original_text: 韩菱纱：梦璃，你未免对那个傻瓜太好了吧？
translation: Han Lingsha: Mengli, aren't you being too good to that fool?

original_text: 柳梦璃：没有啊，是我自己想去看看……
translation: Liu Mengli: No, I wanted to go see for myself...

original_text: 韩菱纱：唉，一个愿打，一个愿挨，倒显得我是大坏蛋～
translation: Han Lingsha: Sigh, it takes two to tango. This all makes me look like the big villain~

original_text: 云天河：菱纱说<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>要在封神陵找一件很重要的东西</colour><dc0>，现在暂时不回琼华派。</dc0>
