translation: Yun Tianhe: Hey~~~ we're already up, where are you?

original_text: 衔烛之龙：凡人，你可知道？对神龙呼来喊去，是何等的大不敬？！
translation: Candle-Holding Dragon: Mortal, do you realize? To shouting at a divine dragon is a grave disrespect?!

original_text: 云天河：啊——！！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Ah-!!

original_text: 韩菱纱：天河！你、你怎么样？
translation: Han Lingsha: Tianhe! Are... are you alright?

original_text: 云天河：好痛，为什么……我下山以后总要被雷劈……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Ouch, why... Ever since I came down the mountain, I keep getting struck by lightning...

original_text: 衔烛之龙：凡人，这便是无礼的下场！
translation: Candle-Holding Dragon: Mortal, this is the consequence of disrespect!

original_text: 云天河：我不晓得什么才算有礼！你让我们上来，说是有去鬼界的办法，我们当然是急急忙忙跑上来找你！有什么不对吗？
translation: Yun Tianhe: I don't know what counts as disrespect! You told us to come up, saying you had a way to the Ghost Realm, so of course we rushed up to find you! What's wrong with that?

original_text: 衔烛之龙：……看来你的胆子很大，也不怕死，但若是本尊告诉你，想去鬼界，你的两个朋友之中，必须死一个人，你会如何回答本尊？
translation: Candle-Holding Dragon: ...It seems you are quite bold and unafraid of death. But if this deity tells you that to go to the Ghost Realm, one of your two friends must die, how would you answer this deity?

original_text: 韩菱纱：……！
translation: Han Lingsha: ...!

original_text: 慕容紫英：……！
translation: Murong Ziying: ...!

original_text: 云天河：死？为什么？！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Die? Why?!

original_text: 衔烛之龙：本尊说过，这里是幽冥之国的属地，若是毫无缘由让凡人进入鬼界，本尊日后要如何忍受阎王的蔑视？
translation: Candle-Holding Dragon: I've said this is the territory of the Netherworld Kingdom. If mortals enter the ghost realm without reason, how could I endure the King of Hell's contempt afterward?

original_text: 衔烛之龙：大胆的凡人，本尊只要求一个魂魄，已是相当宽大！
translation: Candle-Holding Dragon: Audacious mortal! This deity only demands one soul, which is already exceedingly lenient!

original_text: 衔烛之龙：快选吧！到底要谁死？一位是红颜知己，另一位是至交好友，想清楚！
translation: Candle-Holding Dragon: Choose quickly! Who shall die? One is a cherished confidante, the other a bosom friend. Think carefully!

original_text: 韩菱纱：这、这算什么条件？更何况我……不是他的……
translation: Han Lingsha: What... what kind of condition is that? Besides, I... am not his...

original_text: 慕容紫英：…………
translation: Murong Ziying: ......

original_text: 云天河：……一定要这样吗？
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... Must it be this way?

original_text: 衔烛之龙：不错！本尊等你的答案！
translation: Candle-Holding Dragon: Good! I await your answer!

original_text: 云天河：那我一个都不选。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Then I won't choose any.

original_text: 衔烛之龙：好大的胆子！敢戏弄本尊！！
translation: Candle-Holding Dragon: How audacious! Daring to mock me!!

original_text: 云天河：虽然为了找我的朋友，我一定要去鬼界，但是如果因为这样，必须失去另一个朋友，我宁可不要！就算离开不周山，总能找到其他办法进鬼界的！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Although I must go to the Ghost Realm to find my friend, if doing so means losing another friend, I'd rather not! Even if we leave Mount Buzhou, we can always find another way to enter the Ghost Realm!

original_text: 衔烛之龙：此地岂是你要来便来，要去便去！
translation: Candle-Holding Dragon: This is not a place you can come and go as you please!

original_text: 云天河：（杀气！好强！！）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (Killing intent! So strong!!)

original_text: 衔烛之龙：若是激怒了本尊，本尊可以让你们几个通通死在这里！
translation: Candle-Holding Dragon: If you anger this deity, I can make all of you die right here!

original_text: 云天河：你很强，我感觉得出来。不过……是我不愿意选，和他们俩没关系……请你不要杀他们。
translation: Yun Tianhe: You're strong, I can feel it. But... I don't want to choose, it has nothing to do with the two of them... Please don't kill them.

original_text: 韩菱纱：天河……
translation: Han Lingsha: Tianhe...

original_text: 云天河：要我牺牲朋友绝不可能，我不会改变主意的。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Asking me to sacrifice my friends is absolutely impossible, I won't change my mind.

original_text: 衔烛之龙：…………
translation: Candle-Holding Dragon: ............

original_text: 衔烛之龙：凡人，你很有趣，你一定还看不清世间真正的疾苦，一定认为所有事情都能靠自己的力量解决。
translation: Candle-Holding Dragon: Mortal, you are interesting. You must still not see the true suffering of the world, and must believe that everything can be solved by your own strength.

original_text: 衔烛之龙：凡人，或许你值得本尊欣赏你，或许你只是一个什么都不懂的愚人！
translation: Candle-Holding Dragon: Mortal, perhaps you are worthy of my esteem, or perhaps you are merely a fool who understands nothing!

original_text: 云天河：什么意思……？
translation: Yun Tianhe: What do you mean...?

original_text: 衔烛之龙：本尊给你一个机会，本尊将会释放相隔千万年、未飞升得道之前的幻影，你们若能战胜它，本尊就打开往鬼界无常殿的通路。
translation: Candle-Holding Dragon: I'll give you a chance. I will summon a phantom from millions of years ago, from before I ascended and attained the Dao. If you can defeat it, I will open the path to the Impermanence Hall of the ghost realm.

original_text: 云天河：真的？！你愿意帮我们了？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Really?! You're willing to help us?

original_text: 衔烛之龙：哈哈！本尊镇守此地已经九千九百年，即将功德圆满之际，还能遇上你这种可笑的凡人，我是帮助你们进入鬼界呢，还是——
translation: Candle-Holding Dragon: Haha! I have guarded this place for ninty-nine hundred years. Just as my merit is about to be fulfilled, I encounter a laughable mortal like you. Should I help you enter the ghost realm, or-

original_text: 衔烛之龙：将你们的魂魄送入鬼界！！
translation: Candle-Holding Dragon: I will send your souls to the Ghost Realm!!

original_text: 衔烛之龙：很好，凡人，你很努力。
translation: Candle-Holding Dragon: Very well, mortal, you have worked hard.

original_text: 云天河：呃……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Uh...

original_text: 韩菱纱：天河！你受伤了？！
translation: Han Lingsha: Tianhe! You're injured?!

original_text: 衔烛之龙：白费力气，神龙所伤，凡人的法术岂能治愈？
translation: Candle-Holding Dragon: A waste of effort. The wounds inflicted by the divine dragon cannot be healed by mortal magic.

original_text: 衔烛之龙：你们有所求，就要付出代价。
translation: Candle-Holding Dragon: You have desires, you must pay a price.

original_text: 韩菱纱：代价？你对天河做了什么？！
translation: Han Lingsha: Price? What did you do to Tianhe?!

original_text: 衔烛之龙：既然放你们通过，本尊干脆跟阎王多开个小玩笑。
translation: Candle-Holding Dragon: Since I'm letting you pass, I might as well play an extra little joke with the King of Hell.

original_text: 云天河：……你可以打开鬼界的门了吧？
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... Now you can open the gate to the Ghost Realm now, right?

original_text: 衔烛之龙：此法阵有去无回，如何从鬼界重返人间，你们须得自己想办法。
translation: Candle-Holding Dragon: This array is one-way. How to return to the mortal realm from the Ghost Realm, you must figure it out yourselves.

original_text: 云天河：啊？原来还要自己想法子回人间啊……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Huh? So we have to figure out a way back to the mortal world ourselves...

original_text: 韩菱纱：这是……？
translation: Han Lingsha: This is...?

original_text: 衔烛之龙：凡人进入无常殿，岂非与送死无异？此法术可令汝等生人之气不被鬼察觉，十二个时辰后自行消散。
translation: Candle-Holding Dragon: For mortals to enter the Hall of Impermanence-is that not akin to courting death? This spell shall conceal thy living aura from ghosts, and it shall dissipate after twenty-four hours.

original_text: 云天河：……谢谢。
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... Thank you.

original_text: 衔烛之龙：本尊今日令你得偿所愿，但是等你有朝一日，尝遍世间辛酸之时，或许就会怨恨这样的命运。
translation: Candle-Holding Dragon: I grant your wish today. But one day, when you have tasted all the bitterness of the world, you may come to resent such a fate.

original_text: 衔烛之龙：胆大又有趣的凡人啊，待你此生阳寿尽时，本尊会来找你，看一看你是否还是如此洒脱！
translation: Candle-Holding Dragon: Bold and interesting mortal, when your allotted lifespan in this life ends, this venerable one will come find you, to see if you remain as carefree as you are now!

original_text: 衔烛之龙：哈哈——！
translation: Candle-Holding Dragon: Haha-!
Yun Tianhe: ......

original_text: 韩菱纱：天河，你的伤，真的不要紧吗？……
translation: Han Lingsha: Tianhe, your injury, are you really okay? ...

original_text: 云天河：没关系的。
translation: Yun Tianhe: It's okay.

original_text: 云天河：……我刚才觉得全身都像被火烧着了一样，现在已经好多了，大概是大哥教我的凝冰诀起了作用……只是一下冷、一下热，有点难受……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ...Just now, I felt my whole body burning as if on fire. It's much better now, probably thanks to Cryomancy Big Brother taught me... It's just alternating between cold and hot, a bit uncomfortable...

original_text: 云天河：啊！————
translation: Yun Tianhe: Ah! ----

original_text: 韩菱纱：天河！你怎么了？！你别吓我……别吓我……
translation: Han Lingsha: Tianhe! What's wrong?! Don't scare me... Don't scare me...

original_text: 云天河：我……我……
translation: Yun Tianhe: I...I...

original_text: 慕容紫英：切勿勉强开口！还不快静下心神，我运功助你调息！
translation: Murong Ziying: Don't force yourself to speak! Calm your mind quickly, I'll use my energy to help you regulate your breath!

original_text: 云天河：唔……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Hmm...

original_text: 慕容紫英：吐息引气，宁神静心，如是往来——
translation: Murong Ziying: Breathe in, guide the qi, calm the spirit, focus the mind, repeat-
Murong Ziying: ...! This is............!!

original_text: 云天河：……紫英……不行，我觉得很冷、又很热……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... Ziying... No, I feel very cold, and also very hot...

original_text: 慕容紫英：静下心来！不可自乱心神！
translation: Murong Ziying: Calm down! Don't let your mind become unsettled!

original_text: 韩菱纱：紫英，天河他……会没事吗？
translation: Han Lingsha: Ziying, will Tianhe... be alright?

original_text: 慕容紫英：……他体内气息已归于平和，应无大碍。
translation: Murong Ziying: The energy in his body has returned to calm, he should be fine.

original_text: 云天河：呼～～
translation: Yun Tianhe: Whew~~

original_text: 云天河：哈哈，好了！一点都不难受了！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Haha, really good! Doesn't hurt at all anymore!

original_text: 韩菱纱：……真的吗？要不要再休息一会儿？你刚才还那么糟……
translation: Han Lingsha: ...Really? Do you want to rest a bit longer? You were just in such a bad state...

original_text: 云天河：没事、没事～我精神反而比之前还好呢！
translation: Yun Tianhe: It's fine, it's fine~ I actually feel more energetic than before!

original_text: 云天河：谢谢你，紫英！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Thank you, Ziying!

original_text: 慕容紫英：不必客气。
translation: Murong Ziying: No need for formalities.

original_text: 云天河：我们出发吧！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Let's set off!

original_text: 云天河：菱纱，你怎么了？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Lingsha, what's wrong with you?

original_text: 韩菱纱：……我还从来没有见你为什么事这样拼命过……你……对梦璃真好……
translation: Han Lingsha: ...I've never seen you fight so desperately for anything before... You... are truly good to Mengli...

original_text: 云天河：什么？
translation: Yun Tianhe: What?

original_text: 韩菱纱：……如果，我是说如果，有一天，我也像梦璃一样不见了，你也会不顾一切来找我吗？
translation: Han Lingsha: ... If, I mean if, one day, I also disappear like Mengli, would you also search for me regardless of everything?

original_text: 云天河：呃……一个不见，已经够麻烦的，要是两个都不见了，我、我也不知道怎么办才好……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Uh... One missing is trouble enough; if both are gone, I... I don't know what to do either...

original_text: 韩菱纱：……
translation: Han Lingsha: ...

original_text: 云天河：你放心！要是真有那么一天，我一定也会去找你，直到找到你为止……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Don't worry! If that day really comes, I'll definitely look for you, until I find you...

original_text: 云天河：虽然有时候你会说我笨，不过你是除了爹以外，第一个对我好的人，我知道你对我其实是很好很好的……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Even though you sometimes call me dumb, you're the first person besides Father to be good to me. I know you're actually very, very kind to me...

original_text: 云天河：所以不管发生什么事，我都会去找你，你比梦璃还——
translation: Yun Tianhe: So no matter what happens, I'll come find you. Comparing to Mengli, you are even more...

original_text: 韩菱纱：等、等一下！你别说了，我只问一句，你有的没的说一堆干嘛！
translation: Han Lingsha: Wait, wait! Stop talking. I just have one question, why are you rambling about all this nonsense!

original_text: 韩菱纱：后面的、后面的我不想知道了！
translation: Han Lingsha: The rest... I don't want to know the rest!

original_text: 云天河：明明是你问我啊，又不让我说……不想知道还问干嘛……
translation: Yun Tianhe: But you asked me first, and now you won't let me speak... Why ask if you don't want to know...

original_text: 慕容紫英：天河，你受伤之后，内息极是古怪，有一寒一热两道完全不同的气在体内交织——
translation: Murong Ziying: Tianhe, after you were injured, your internal energy became very strange-there are two completely different energies, one cold, one hot, intertwining within you-

original_text: 韩菱纱：啊，听起来好像走火入魔！
translation: Han Lingsha: Ah, that sounds like falling into demonic madness!

original_text: 慕容紫英：不错……乍听与走火入魔无异，但这两道气息冲撞过后，却又似乎融于一体，并无异状……
translation: Murong Ziying: Indeed... At first it sounds like falling into demonic madness, but after the two energies clash, they seem to merge into one without any abnormality...

original_text: 慕容紫英：这盘龙镇柱直耸入天，那衔烛之龙也是神龙见首不见尾，所以再难请他治天河的伤……
translation: Murong Ziying: This Coiling Dragon Pillar reaches straight into the heavens, and the Candle-Holding Dragon is also elusive. So, it's difficult to ask him again to treat Tianhe's injury...

original_text: 云天河：紫英，我真的没事！全身上下都是使不完的力，简直比受伤前还要好。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Ziying, I'm really fine! I'm full of boundless energy all over, even better than before I was injured.

original_text: 慕容紫英：无论如何，还是多加小心，觉得难受的话，要立刻告诉我。
translation: Murong Ziying: Regardless, be extra careful. If you feel unwell, tell me immediately.

original_text: 韩菱纱：对啊，不许逞强、闷着不说。
translation: Han Lingsha: Right, no acting tough, no keeping things bottled up.

original_text: 云天河：哦，好……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Oh, okay...

original_text: 慕容紫英：（……神龙说跟阎王多开个小玩笑，到底何意？）
translation: Murong Ziying: (...The Divine Dragon said he'd play an extra little joke with the King of Hell. What exactly does that mean?)

original_text: 慕容紫英：（天河的阴阳之气委实古怪……神龙似乎是帮他，但言语之中，又有不善之意……）
translation: Murong Ziying: (Tianhe's yin-yang energy is truly peculiar... The Divine Dragon seemed to help him, yet its words carried ill intent...)

original_text: 云天河：<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>我们走吧，进传送法阵，</colour><dc0>再不走，这个法阵会不会消失啊？</dc0>
translation: Yun Tianhe:<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> Let's go, into the teleportation array,</colour><dc0> if we don't leave now, will this array disappear?</dc0>

original_text: 慕容紫英：也只能先去鬼界了，但愿一切顺利……
translation: Murong Ziying: We can only head to the Ghost Realm first. May all go smoothly...

original_text: 韩菱纱：啊，这个人……他的尸骨上插着一把巨剑……
translation: Han Lingsha: Ah, this person... There's a giant sword stuck in his skeleton...

original_text: 韩菱纱：剑身上的刻纹，像是很久以前的古物了——
translation: Han Lingsha: The engraving on the sword seems like an ancient artifact from long ago-

original_text: 慕容紫英：菱纱，莫要动手！
translation: Murong Ziying: Lingsha, do not attack!

original_text: 韩菱纱：呀——！
translation: Han Lingsha: Yaa-!

original_text: 云天河：怎么了？有没有受伤？！
translation: Yun Tianhe: What's wrong? Are you hurt?!

original_text: 韩菱纱：没、没有，不过这把剑上好像附着什么东西，好可怕……刚才碰到的一瞬间，我、我听到许多厉鬼嚎叫的声音……
translation: Han Lingsha: N-no, but there seems to be something attached to this sword, so terrifying... The moment I touched it, I... I heard many wails of vengeful ghosts...

original_text: 慕容紫英：你们暂且退下。
translation: Murong Ziying: You all step back for now.

original_text: 韩菱纱：紫英，小心……
translation: Han Lingsha: Ziying, be careful...

original_text: 慕容紫英：……实在罕见，这竟是一把“未成之剑”！
translation: Murong Ziying: ... Truly rare-this is actually an 'unfinished sword'!

original_text: 云天河：未成之剑？啥意思？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Unfinished sword? What does that mean?

original_text: 慕容紫英：便是只铸到一半，功亏一篑……但此剑不知为何，却又有“天成”之象，凶煞之气极重。
translation: Murong Ziying: Even if only half-forged, it fell short of completion... But for some reason, this sword has a 'heaven-made' appearance, with an extremely heavy aura of ferocity.

original_text: 韩菱纱：咦？那是……
translation: Han Lingsha: Huh? That's...

original_text: 韩菱纱：紫英，它好像对你很依恋的样子呢。
translation: Han Lingsha: Ziying, it seems very attached to you.

original_text: ？？：你们……不要接近魔剑……小葵不想再害人了……
translation: ??: You... stay away from the Fellblade... Xiao Kui doesn't want to hurt anyone anymore...

original_text: 韩菱纱：“小葵”？你是谁，是从剑里飞出来的吗？还有你说这把剑叫作“魔剑”？
translation: Han Lingsha: 'Xiao Kui'? Who are you? Did you fly out of the sword? And you say this sword is called 'Fellblade'?

original_text: 小葵：你们走……这个人他知道的，这把剑是凶煞，是不祥之物……
translation: Xiao Kui: You should leave... this person knows, this sword is ominous, it's an ill-fated object...

original_text: 慕容紫英：你本身鬼力与此剑并不完全相融，应该并非恶鬼，但此剑煞气过重，我要将它带走，想办法予以净化。
translation: Murong Ziying: Your inherent ghostly power does not fully harmonize with this sword, so you likely aren't an evil spirit. But this sword's baleful aura is too strong; I must take it away and find a way to purify it.

original_text: 小葵：不要、千万不要！魔剑的力量很大，你会被它、被它……
translation: Xiao Kui: No, please don't! The Fellblade's power is immense, you'll be... consumed by it...

original_text: 慕容紫英：是否此剑会反噬执拿之人？
translation: Murong Ziying: Could it be that this sword backfires on its wielder?

original_text: 小葵：……好多人……好多人都想得到魔剑……可是他们都死了，被害死了……
translation: Xiao Kui: ...So many people... so many wanted to obtain the Fellblade... but they all died, killed...

original_text: 韩菱纱：被害死？难道这具尸骨也是？
translation: Han Lingsha: Killed? Could this skeleton also be...?

original_text: 小葵：嗯……他和别人争了好久，终于抢到魔剑，可是又有更多的人要杀他……他逃到这儿，为了摆脱怪物，一直挥剑，这把剑突然就发出红光，刺进了他的胸口……
translation: Xiao Kui: Mm... He fought with others for a long time and finally seized the Fellblade, but then even more people wanted to kill him... He fled here, and to fend off the monsters, he kept swinging the sword. Suddenly, the sword emitted a red light and pierced his chest...

original_text: 小葵：小葵也不知道怎么回事……小葵不是有意害他的……
translation: Xiao Kui: Xiao Kui doesn't know what happened either... Xiao Kui didn't mean to harm him...

original_text: 韩菱纱：你……不能控制这把剑吗？
translation: Han Lingsha: You...can't control this sword?

original_text: 小葵：……小葵、小葵只是附在剑中的鬼，没有办法完全驾驭这把剑……
translation: Xiao Kui: ...Xiao Kui, Xiao Kui is just a ghost attached to the sword, unable to fully control this sword...

original_text: 慕容紫英：那你又是如何进入剑中？
translation: Murong Ziying: Then how did you enter the sword?

original_text: 小葵：……因为……哥哥死了，可是这把剑还没有铸成，敌人已经攻进城来……小葵就……就跳进了铸剑炉……
translation: Xiao Kui: ...Because... my brother died, but this sword wasn't finished yet... The enemies had already breached the city... Xiao Kui... jumped into the sword-forging furnace...

original_text: 韩菱纱：呀！你、你是以身殉剑？！
translation: Han Lingsha: Ah! You... you sacrificed yourself for the sword?!

original_text: 慕容紫英：原来如此……铸剑之道中，以活人祭剑最为凶戾，此剑因你血气而天成，反而获得了非同寻常的力量。若我所料不差，剑成之后只怕顷刻便将方圆数里化为焦土，饮万人之血。
translation: Murong Ziying: I see... In sword-forging, using a living person as sacrifice is the most sinister. This sword, tempered by your blood and vitality, gained extraordinary power. If my guess is correct, once forged, it would likely turn miles around into scorched earth in an instant, drinking the blood of thousands.

original_text: 小葵：……是的……后来，小葵好像在魔剑里待了很久很久，那里面有许多怨灵，很可怕……
translation: Xiao Kui: ...Yes... Later, Xiao Kui seemed to stay inside Fellblade for a very, very long time. There were many vengeful spirits inside, very frightening...

original_text: 韩菱纱：实在太可怜了……
translation: Han Lingsha: It's just too pitiful...

original_text: 慕容紫英：……令兄莫非是位铸剑高人，否则如何会想到铸造这样一把“魔剑”？
translation: Murong Ziying: ... Could it be that your elder brother is a master swordsmith? Otherwise, how would he conceive of forging such a 'Fellblade'?

original_text: 小葵：我不知道……不过哥哥他是姜国的太子，他做什么都是很厉害的……我们姜国有本祖传的手卷，上面记载了魔剑铸法，哥哥就是看过那个，才想到铸剑以解围城之困……
translation: Xiao Kui: I don't know... but my brother was the crown prince of Jiang Kingdom, he excelled at everything he did... Our Jiang Kingdom has a hereditary scroll that records the method of forging the Fellblade. It was after reading that, that my brother thought of forging a sword to break the siege...

original_text: 韩菱纱：你说姜国，我记得是春秋时的一个小国，以织纫而闻名……天呐，那你在剑里究竟过了多久啊……难道你要一直这样下去？……
translation: Han Lingsha: You mentioned the Jiang Kingdom, I remember it was a small kingdom during the Spring and Autumn period, famous for its weaving... Oh heavens, how long have you actually been inside the sword... Could it be you'll continue like this forever?...

original_text: 小葵：……小葵不知道该怎么办……我不要投胎，我想去找哥哥的转世，我想哥哥……可是我还不能化出人形，也不能离开魔剑……
translation: Xiao Kui: ...Xiao Kui doesn't know what to do... I don't want to reincarnate; I want to find my brother's reincarnation, I miss my brother... But I can't yet take human form, nor can I leave the Fellblade...

original_text: 韩菱纱：……转世以后就是另一个人了，即使真的见到你哥哥，你还认得出他吗？
translation: Han Lingsha: ... After reincarnation, it's a different person. Even if you truly meet your brother, would you still recognize him?

original_text: 小葵：一定可以的，就算相貌变了、性格变了，只要是哥哥，小葵一眼就能认出来……
translation: Xiao Kui: It must be possible. Even if his appearance changes, his personality changes, as long as it's my brother, Xiao Kui will recognize him at a glance...

original_text: 韩菱纱：你一直待在这里，是不可能遇见你哥哥的转世的……不如，我们把魔剑带在身边，帮你找——
translation: Han Lingsha: If you stay here forever, you'll never meet your brother's reincarnation... How about we take the Fellblade with us and help you search-

original_text: 小葵：不行！我……你们是好人，小葵不能害你们……
translation: Xiao Kui: No! I... You are good people, Xiao Kui cannot harm you...

original_text: 慕容紫英：……不必担心。我可以暂时压制魔剑的凶煞之力，相信踏遍天下，总能找到净化它的办法。
translation: Murong Ziying: ... No need to worry. I can temporarily suppress the Fellblade's malevolent power. I believe by traveling the world, we'll find a way to purify it.

original_text: 慕容紫英：此剑若是继续留在这里，落入不义之人的手中，只怕又是一场腥风血雨，倒不如我将它带走。
translation: Murong Ziying: If this sword remains here and falls into the hands of unjust individuals, it will surely stir another storm of bloodshed. It would be better for me to take it away.

original_text: 小葵：真的吗？你真的不怕魔剑的煞气？
translation: Xiao Kui: Really? You're really not afraid of the Fellblade's baleful aura?

original_text: 云天河：紫英说没事，就一定没事啦！他最擅长铸剑，不会说错的。
translation: Yun Tianhe: If Ziying says it's fine, then it's definitely fine! He's the best at sword forging, he wouldn't be wrong.

original_text: 小葵：……谢谢，他、他叫紫英吗？他和哥哥有一点像，小葵能感觉到，都很正气，又很温柔……
translation: Xiao Kui: ...Thank you. H-he's called Ziying? He reminds me a little of my brother. Xiao Kui can sense it-both are very righteous and very gentle...

original_text: 慕容紫英：……你且进入剑中，我将魔剑收入剑匣，便启程吧。
translation: Murong Ziying: ... You enter the sword first. I'll store the Fellblade in the scabbard, then we depart.

original_text: 小葵：好……可是，如果有一天真的找到哥哥，他知道魔剑害了这么多人，会不会以为小葵不乖？不要小葵了？
translation: Xiao Kui: Okay... But, if one day we really find my brother, and he knows the Fellblade has harmed so many people, will he think Xiao Kui was naughty? Will he not want Xiao Kui anymore?

original_text: 韩菱纱：……不会的，你这样乖，他一定舍不得……
translation: Han Lingsha: ... No, you're so well-behaved, he surely couldn't bear to...

original_text: 小葵：嗯……小葵要回去修炼了，不会再理外物，除非你们呼唤我，或是……我感觉到哥哥在附近……
translation: Xiao Kui: Mm... Xiao Kui needs to go back to cultivate. I won't pay attention to worldly matters anymore, unless you call me, or... I sense my brother nearby...

original_text: 韩菱纱：知道了，你尽管安心吧……一定、一定可以找到你哥哥的。
translation: Han Lingsha: Understood, rest assured... We will definitely, definitely find your brother.

original_text: 壬癸：你们可算来了！
translation: Rengui: You're finally here!

original_text: 壬癸：快点快点，<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>穿过放逐渊，就是冥河，那条河上常有青竹船往来阴阳两界，</colour><dc0>你们到了那里，就跳上河边的船，一路回去人间吧！</dc0>
translation: Rengui: Hurry, hurry,<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> crossing the Exile Abyss leads to the River Styx, where bamboo boats often travel between the realms of yin and yang,</colour><dc0> once you get there, board a boat by the river and ride it all the way back to the mortal world!</dc0>

original_text: 慕容紫英：谢谢……可是，你为何会帮我们？
translation: Murong Ziying: Thank you... but, why are you helping us?

original_text: 壬癸：哈哈，这也算好人有好报吧，你们还记不记得即墨的夏元辰？
translation: Rengui: Haha, I guess good deeds bring good rewards. Do you remember Xia Yuanchen from Jimo?

original_text: 韩菱纱：咦？你是夏书生的朋友？
translation: Han Lingsha: Huh? You're a friend of Scholar Xia?

original_text: 壬癸：非也，我只是刚巧认识他的养女。
translation: Rengui: Not exactly, I just happen to know his adopted daughter.

original_text: 韩菱纱：莲宝？！
translation: Han Lingsha: Lianbao?!

original_text: 壬癸：没错、没错！
translation: Rengui: That's right, that's right!

original_text: 壬癸：说起来，我和那女人，对了，她这一世叫作“莲宝”，也已经有六世的交情了！
translation: Rengui: Speaking of which, that woman and I-oh right, in this life she's called 'Lianbao'-have already shared six lifetimes of acquaintance!

original_text: 韩菱纱：哎？六世？
translation: Han Lingsha: Huh? Six lifetimes?

original_text: 壬癸：她前前后后死了六次，都是我去勾她的魂啊，后来我发觉那女人呆呆笨笨的，就不由得关照起她来了。
translation: Rengui: She died six times in total, and each time I went to collect her soul. Later, I noticed the woman was a bit simple-minded, so I couldn't help but look out for her.

original_text: 壬癸：她可真是个傻女人，明明和前世的恋人缘分都已经尽了，偏偏还不死心，转世六次，都要陪在他身边，有时是树、有时是鸟，总之没一次是人，到了这一世，终于成了人，偏偏又是个痴儿……唉！
translation: Rengui: She's truly a foolish woman. Her karmic bond with her lover from past lives had long ended, yet she refused to let go. Reincarnating six times, she always stayed by his side-sometimes as a tree, sometimes as a bird, never once as a human. This lifetime, she finally became human, only to be born with an intellectual disability... Alas!

original_text: 韩菱纱：慢慢慢慢——慢！你说、你说前世的恋人，难道莲宝就是静兰？！是夏书生的恋人转世？！
translation: Han Lingsha: Wait, Wait, Wait! You said, you said her lover from past lives? Could it be that Lianbao is Jinglan?! Is she the reincarnation of Scholar Xia's lover?!

original_text: 壬癸：没错、没错！小姑娘你真聪明，一点就通！
translation: Rengui: That's right, that's right! Little girl, you're really smart, catch on quick!

original_text: 壬癸：我啊，就是放不开她，时常去看她，虽然她不做鬼时，也不记得我……
translation: Rengui: Me? I just can't let her go. I often go to see her, though whenever she wasn't a ghost, she didn't remember me...

original_text: 壬癸：上回我见你们救了她，这一次才会帮你们！
translation: Rengui: Last time I saw you save her, that's why I'm helping you this time!

original_text: 韩菱纱：……她……肯定很痛苦吧，夏书生也不再认得她了，为什么……还要纠缠生生世世……
translation: Han Lingsha: ... She... must be in great pain. Scholar Xia doesn't recognize her anymore either. Why... still cling to life after life...

original_text: 壬癸：唉，你问我，我又怎么知道，做鬼太久，早忘记做人时的感觉了。
translation: Rengui: Sigh, you ask me, but how would I know? Been a ghost too long, long forgotten what it feels like to be human.

original_text: 壬癸：你们人的情爱本来就没什么道理可言，明知不可为，偏要去做的事，恐怕比天上的星星还多！
translation: Rengui: Human love has never made sense. Things you know you shouldn't do but do anyway, probably more than stars in the sky!
Han Lingsha: ......

original_text: 壬癸：不说这个了，你们快走吧，我帮得了一时，帮不了一世啊！
translation: Rengui: Enough of that. You should go quickly. I can help for a while, but not forever!

original_text: 慕容紫英：多谢，今日的恩情无以为报——
translation: Murong Ziying: Thank you, today's kindness is beyond repayment-

original_text: 壬癸：不用不用～小事一桩，有什么可报的！
translation: Rengui: No need, no need~ a small matter, nothing to repay!

original_text: 壬癸：不过嘛，你们要是方便，记得去了阳间多烧些纸钱给我！鬼差的俸禄也太少了，大家都是叫苦连天。
translation: Rengui: But, if it's convenient for you, remember to burn more paper money for me when you're back in the mortal realm! A ghost officer's salary is too meager; everyone's complaining bitterly.

original_text: 壬癸：还有那三只鸟，他们叫风雅颂，是鬼界里最爱管闲事的鬼了，可惜运气不好，从来没正经差事派给他们。
translation: Rengui: And those three birds, they're called Feng, Ya, and Song. They're the most meddlesome ghosts in the ghost realm. Unfortunately, they're unlucky and never get any proper assignments.

original_text: 云天河：纸钱……？啥东西？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Paper money...? What's that?

original_text: 慕容紫英：有机会再说给你听，我们先离开这里吧！
translation: Murong Ziying: I'll tell you when there's a chance. Let's leave this place first!

original_text: 韩菱纱：那边！真的有船哎！
translation: Han Lingsha: Over there! There really is a boat!

original_text: 慕容紫英：我们上船。
translation: Murong Ziying: Let's board the boat.

original_text: 云天河：好！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Okay!

original_text: 阿月：哎呀～我是不是眼花啦，怎么如今的鬼都是男的俊、女的俏，让我们这些老鬼多没面子……
translation: A Yue: Oh my~ Am I seeing things? Why are ghosts nowadays so handsome and pretty? It makes us old ghosts lose face...

original_text: 小古：你们也是来玩的吗？只要一敲墓碑，就会有人陪你玩游戏哦～我最喜欢来这里了～
translation: Xiao Gu: Are you here to play too? Just knock on the tombstone, and someone will play games with you~ I love coming here the most~

original_text: 郝大刚：放逐渊游荡的都是孤魂野鬼，再往东边就是冥河了，你们几个新鬼怎么会跑来？！哈哈，我知道了，你们是不是想来给我填饱肚子的？！
translation: Hao Dagang: The Exile Abyss is haunted by wandering lonely ghosts and wild spirits. Further east is the River Styx. How did you few new ghosts end up here?! Haha, I know-you must be here to fill my belly, right?!

original_text: 金夫人：夫君他念旧情，经常烧纸钱给我，我但愿他能再娶一个贤惠女子，好好过日子，却又舍不下他，不想去投胎……
translation: Madam Jin: My husband is sentimental and often burns paper money for me. I wish he would remarry a virtuous woman and live well, yet I can't bear to leave him, not wanting to reincarnate...

original_text: 现在不可使用土灵珠
translation: Earth Spirit Pearl cannot be used now.

original_text: 1.御剑飞行
translation: 1. Sword Flight

original_text: 2.什么都不做
translation: 2. Do Nothing

original_text: 准备<colour red=255 green=102 blue=0 alpha=255>御剑飞行</colour><dc0>吗？</dc0>
translation: Ready to <colour red=255 green=102 blue=0 alpha=255>use Sword Flight</colour><dc0>?</dc0>

original_text: 慕容紫英：此地气氛异常肃穆，又悬浮于空中，似乎不可能是寻常墓穴……
translation: Murong Ziying: This place has an unusually solemn atmosphere and floats in the air. It seems unlikely to be an ordinary tomb...

original_text: 云天河：是啊，我有点紧张，这地方……很特别……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Yeah, I'm a bit nervous, this place... is very special...

original_text: 韩菱纱：原来你野人也有怕的时候～
translation: Han Lingsha: So even you, as a barbarian, have times you're scared~

original_text: 云天河：不是怕……这地方有一种气，像是杀气，但又不是，我觉得怪怪的。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Not scared... This place has an aura, like killing intent, but not quite. It feels strange to me.

original_text: 韩菱纱：其实这儿是不是墓穴，我也不太清楚，也有人说，这是一个太古遗迹，似乎被什么东西守护着。
translation: Han Lingsha: Actually, I'm not too sure if this is a tomb. Some say it's an ancient ruin, seemingly guarded by something.

original_text: 慕容紫英：太古遗迹？是否曾有神明居于此地？那我们贸然闯入，岂非大大的不敬？
translation: Murong Ziying: Ancient ruins? Did deities once reside here? Then wouldn't our rash intrusion be a great disrespect?

original_text: 慕容紫英：何况于你阳寿，恐怕……
translation: Murong Ziying: Moreover, regarding your lifespan, I fear...

original_text: 云天河：唔，紫英说的对，我们还是快点离开吧！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Mm, Ziying is right, we should leave quickly!

original_text: 韩菱纱：什么“说的对”，你真懂紫英在说什么吗？就知道附和……
translation: Han Lingsha: What do you mean he is 'right'-do you even understand what Ziying meant? You just agree blindly...

original_text: 韩菱纱：我不管……来都来了，我一定要进去拿一样东西，就一样而已！
translation: Han Lingsha: I don't care... Since we're already here, I must go in and take one thing, just one thing!

original_text: 韩菱纱：不然我这辈子都会不甘心！
translation: Han Lingsha: Otherwise I'll regret it for the rest of my life!

original_text: 慕容紫英：你究竟所为何物？
translation: Murong Ziying: What exactly do you want?

original_text: 韩菱纱：……等找到你们就知道了。
translation: Han Lingsha: ...You'll know when we find it.

original_text: 韩菱纱：我的曾祖父曾经来过这里，我不清楚他是用了什么法子，因为封神陵悬在半空，除了御剑还有其他办法可以靠近吗？……
translation: Han Lingsha: My great-grandfather once came here. I'm not sure what method he used, because Fengshen Mausoleum floats in mid-air. Besides sword flight, are there other ways to approach it?...

original_text: 韩菱纱：听说曾祖父他回到故乡之后，就变得沉默寡言，好像整个魂都已经不在身上了，有人说他疯了，也有人说他只是偶尔会神智不清……不过还是有族人从他的只字片语里，知道了这个地方，还有那件宝物……
translation: Han Lingsha: I heard that after my great-grandfather returned to his hometown, he became silent and withdrawn, as if his whole soul was no longer in his body. Some said he went mad, others said he just occasionally lost his senses... But still, some clansmen learned about this place, and that treasure, from his fragmented words...

original_text: 韩菱纱：……我……我怕我现在不来，再过个几年，就没机会来了。
translation: Han Lingsha: ...I... I'm afraid if I don't come now, in a few years, I won't have the chance anymore.

original_text: 慕容紫英：人为财死、鸟为食亡。菱纱，听我一劝，此地凶多吉少，有什么宝物会比性命还重要？我们即刻离开才是上上之举——
translation: Murong Ziying: Men die for wealth, birds die for food. Lingsha, listen to me. This place is fraught with danger. What treasure could be more important than your life? Leaving immediately is the best course of action-

original_text: 云天河：对啊，你那个什么曾祖父，只是来了这里，就变得怪怪的，谁知道里面有什么东西！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Right! Your great-grandfather or whoever, just came here and became all strange. Who knows what's inside that place!

original_text: 韩菱纱：你怕了？
translation: Han Lingsha: Are you scared?

original_text: 云天河：我才不怕！我是担心你，我们别进去了，马上走！
translation: Yun Tianhe: I'm not scared! I'm worried about you, let's not go in and leave right now!

original_text: 韩菱纱：不要！我说过，来都来了，我不甘心！大不了我答应你们，真的遇到什么危险，我们马上逃就是了！
translation: Han Lingsha: No! I said, since we're already here, I'm not giving up! At most, I promise you: if we really encounter any danger, we'll run away immediately!

original_text: 云天河：你……
translation: Yun Tianhe: You...

original_text: 韩菱纱：走吧、走吧，别又一副臭脸。<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>快点进去，找到那件宝物，</colour><dc0>不就可以速战速决了？</dc0>
translation: Han Lingsha: Let's go,  don't pull that sour face again.<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> Let's hurry inside, find that treasure,</colour><dc0> and we can finish this quickly, okay?</dc0>

original_text: 韩菱纱：嘻嘻，果然找到了！
translation: Han Lingsha: Hehe, found it as expected!

original_text: 慕容紫英：……！
translation: Murong Ziying: ...!

original_text: 云天河：这是……？！
translation: Yun Tianhe: This is...?!

original_text: 韩菱纱：怎么样？这把弓很漂亮吧？就算静静地在那里，都能感觉到一股好强的灵力！应该就是我曾祖父提过的神弓了！
translation: Han Lingsha: How about it? This bow is beautiful, right? Even just sitting there, you can feel its immense spiritual power! It must be the divine bow my great-grandfather mentioned!

original_text: 韩菱纱：这把弓天河你拿着一定很帅～
translation: Han Lingsha: This bow would look really cool on you, Tianhe~

original_text: 云天河：啊？！……原来……原来你说要来这里取个东西，是为我？！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Huh?! ...So... so you said you came here to get something, it was for me?!

original_text: 韩菱纱：什、什么，谁为了你！少往自己脸上贴金！
translation: Han Lingsha: Wh-what, who's doing it for you! Stop flattering yourself!

original_text: 韩菱纱：我只不过觉得这次去妖界，一定会有大事发生，你拿着它，也算多一份力量，对我们几个都有好处！
translation: Han Lingsha: I just feel that something big is bound to happen when we go to the yao realm. You holding it means an extra bit of strength, which benefits all of us!

original_text: 云天河：是、是吗？
translation: Yun Tianhe: R-really?

original_text: 韩菱纱：是啊…………
translation: Han Lingsha: Yes...

original_text: 韩菱纱：不过……你硬要说成是为了你，那我、我也没办法，谁让我们几个人里面，只有你是用弓的，哼，便宜你了。
translation: Han Lingsha: But... if you insist it's for you, then I-well, I can't really argue. After all, you're the only one among us who uses a bow. Hmph, lucky you.

original_text: 云天河：哦……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Oh...

original_text: 韩菱纱：咦？！
translation: Han Lingsha: Huh?!
Yun Tianhe: ......

original_text: 韩菱纱：我没看错吧？野人也会眼眶湿润呀～
translation: Han Lingsha: Am I seeing things? Even the barbarian's eyes are getting moist~

original_text: 韩菱纱：在心里感动就好了，可别真的流下眼泪啊，男儿有泪不轻弹嘛……
translation: Han Lingsha: It's fine to be moved in your heart, but don't actually shed tears. A real man doesn't cry easily...

original_text: 云天河：哪有……哪有眼泪……你看错了……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Where... where are there tears... you're seeing things...

original_text: 韩菱纱：你喜欢这个礼物，我就很开心了。
translation: Han Lingsha: If you like this gift, I'm already very happy.

original_text: 云天河：这把弓真的很不错，但是……
translation: Yun Tianhe: This bow is really good, but...

original_text: 韩菱纱：什么……？
translation: Han Lingsha: What...?

original_text: 云天河：……早知道来这里是要拿弓，我死都不会让你来……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... If I'd known coming here was to get a bow, I'd have never let you come, no matter what you say...

original_text: 韩菱纱：为什么？
translation: Han Lingsha: Why?

original_text: 云天河：世上再好的弓，也只是一把弓，根本不值得拿你的命来换，哪怕只是一个月、几天……都不值得……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Even the best bow in the world is just a bow. It's not worth trading your life for, not even for a month, or a few days... It's never worth it...

original_text: 韩菱纱：……你……要是真的这么想，就好好地用这把弓吧……
translation: Han Lingsha: ... You... if you really think that way, then use this bow properly...

original_text: 云天河：嗯，我会的……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Hmm, I will...

original_text: 韩菱纱：你答应我，永远把它带在身边，就算有一天你用不着了，也要带着……
translation: Han Lingsha: Promise me, you'll always keep it with you, even if one day you don't need it anymore, keep it...

original_text: 云天河：好，我答应你！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Okay, I promise you!

original_text: 韩菱纱：你总是说……我对你很好很好，其实那些都没什么……
translation: Han Lingsha: You always say... I'm so good to you, but really, it's nothing...

original_text: 韩菱纱：可是，有了这把弓……不管以后你和谁在一起，不管我是不是已经死了……你偶尔念着我对你的好，我就会很开心了……
translation: Han Lingsha: But with this bow... no matter whom you end up with in the future, no matter if I'm already dead... as long as you sometimes think of how good I was to you, that'll make me happy...

original_text: 云天河：什么叫我“跟谁在一起”，那个“谁”又是谁啊？
translation: Yun Tianhe: What do you mean 'whom I end up with'? And who is that 'whom'?

original_text: 韩菱纱：哎，不管是谁啦，总之我跟你约定了。
translation: Han Lingsha: Hey, whoever it is, I've made a promise to you.

original_text: 韩菱纱：（……你可以有资格去喜欢一个人，但我却不能……我的阳寿可能……我是没有资格去喜欢别人的……）
translation: Han Lingsha: (...You could have the right to like someone, but I do not... My lifespan might be... I have no right to like anyone...)

original_text: 云天河：你别说这种话，你一定会活很久很久的，有我保护你，一定没关系的！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Don't say things like that. You'll definitely live a very, very long time. With me protecting you, it'll be fine!

original_text: 韩菱纱：嗯，傻瓜……
translation: Han Lingsha: Hmm, silly...

original_text: 云天河：我……
translation: Yun Tianhe: I...

original_text: 韩菱纱：云、天、河。
translation: Han Lingsha: YUN-TIAN-HE

original_text: 云天河：啊？怎么？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Huh? How?

original_text: 韩菱纱：不管我还有多少时间，一定要记得我这个好朋友，好吗？
translation: Han Lingsha: No matter how much time I have left, you must remember me as a good friend, okay?

original_text: 云天河：好朋友……我知道……我怎么可能忘记…………
translation: Yun Tianhe: Good friend... I know... How could I ever forget...

original_text: 慕容紫英：…………
translation: Murong Ziying: ......

original_text: 韩菱纱：……对不起哦，紫英，我都没有想到什么好东西，是你适用的……
translation: Han Lingsha: ... Sorry, Ziying. I couldn't think of suitable things for you...

original_text: 慕容紫英：适用的东西…………
translation: Murong Ziying: Suitable things...

original_text: 慕容紫英：不必……神兵利器，我并不稀罕，但你须记得自己的誓言，往后不可再因盗墓折去阳寿，这才是最重要的。
translation: Murong Ziying: No need... I don't care for divine weapons or sharp blades, but you must remember your vow. From now on, you must not shorten your lifespan by tomb robbing again. That is what matters most.

original_text: 慕容紫英：今日之行我并不认同，但……如若取此弓会有任何报应，慕容紫英为朋友心甘情愿。
translation: Murong Ziying: I do not agree with today's venture, but... if taking this bow brings any retribution, Murong Ziying willingly accepts it for the sake of friends.

original_text: 韩菱纱：紫英，谢谢你……
translation: Han Lingsha: Ziying, thank you...

original_text: 慕容紫英：快去将弓取下吧，然后速速离开此地，以免夜长梦多。
translation: Murong Ziying: Quickly take down the bow, then leave this place at once to avoid complications.

original_text: 韩菱纱：嗯！
translation: Han Lingsha: Mm!

original_text: 慕容紫英：（……九龙缚丝剑穗…………菱纱……）
translation: Murong Ziying: (...Nine-Dragon Tassel... Lingsha...)

original_text: 韩菱纱：拿到了，走吧！
translation: Han Lingsha: Got it, let's go!

original_text: ？？：罪人！还不快将后羿射日弓放下！
translation: ???: Sinner! Quickly put down the Houyi Sun Bow!

original_text: 云天河：谁？！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Who?!

original_text: ？？：吾乃神将句芒，镇守封神陵！
translation: ??: I am the Divine General Goumang, guarding Fengshen Mausoleum!

original_text: 句芒：凡间的罪人，你满是罪孽的双手不配执拿神器，放下！！
translation: Goumang: Mortal sinner, your hands are tainted with sin and are unworthy of wielding a divine artifact. Put it down!!

original_text: 韩菱纱：罪……人……是说我……？
translation: Han Lingsha: Sin...ner... you mean me...?

original_text: 句芒：你身上的罪孽，连同你们一族的世代因果，本神将不会错认！
translation: Goumang: The sins upon you, along with the karmic cycle of your clan, I will not mistake!

original_text: 韩菱纱：……！！你怎么会知道……
translation: Han Lingsha: ...!! How do you know...

original_text: 句芒：念你窃取神器并非利己私心，本神将饶你不死，也不夺你二魂六魄！速将后弈射日弓归位，即刻离开封神陵！
translation: Goumang: Considering you stole the divine artifact not for selfish gain, I, this divine general, will spare your life and not take the better part of your soul! Quickly return Houyi Sun Bow to its place and leave Fengshen Mausoleum immediately!

original_text: 慕容紫英：夺取二魂六魄？！难道菱纱的曾祖父……
translation: Murong Ziying: Take the better part of ... soul?! Could it be Lingsha's great-grandfather...

original_text: 韩菱纱：可是，这把弓——
translation: Han Lingsha: But, this bow-

original_text: 云天河：杀气！！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Killing intent!!

original_text: 句芒：告诫再三而执迷！本神将不会姑息！
translation: Goumang: Warned repeatedly yet obstinate! I, this divine general, will not be lenient!

original_text: 云天河：菱纱！小心！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Lingsha! Careful!

original_text: 句芒：唔？！神龙之息！！
translation: Goumang: Huh?! Dragon's Breath!!

original_text: 句芒：你！衔烛之龙与你有何关系？
translation: Goumang: You! What is your relation to the Candle-Holding Dragon?

original_text: 云天河：什么关系？简单的打架关系啊！
translation: Yun Tianhe: What relation? A simple fighting relationship!

original_text: 句芒：大胆！竟敢在本神将面前胡言乱语！
translation: Goumang: How dare you! To speak nonsense before me!

original_text: 韩菱纱：唔……
translation: Han Lingsha: Hmm...

original_text: 慕容紫英：菱纱！你受伤了！
translation: Murong Ziying: Lingsha! You're injured!

original_text: 云天河：你！竟敢打伤菱纱……
translation: Yun Tianhe: You! How dare you hurt Lingsha...

original_text: 句芒：能与本神将战到此种地步，在凡人之中，亦属罕见！
translation: Goumang: It's really rare to be able to fight with a divine general to this extent, as a mortal!

original_text: 句芒：罪人！本神将不收你性命，因你一生所为，死后皆由鬼界而断！
translation: Goumang: Sinner! I, this divine general, will not take your life, for all your deeds in life will be judged by the ghost realm after death!

original_text: 句芒：尔等速离封神陵！
translation: Goumang: You all, leave Fengshen Mausoleum quickly!

original_text: 云天河：等等！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Wait!

original_text: 云天河：可恶！这把弓要是不能拿，我们就不拿！但你干嘛要打伤她？！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Damn it! If we can't take this bow, we won't take it! But why did you have to hurt her?!

original_text: 句芒：本神将不容罪人玷污神器！此乃天经地义！
translation: Goumang: We will not allow a sinner to defile the divine artifact! This is heaven's ordinance!

original_text: 云天河：你，可恶！我——
translation: Yun Tianhe: You, damn it! I-

original_text: 韩菱纱：天河！不要……
translation: Han Lingsha: Tianhe! Don't...

original_text: 韩菱纱：千万不要为了我顶撞神将……是我不好，我太没用了……本以为这一次可以替你找到一把好弓……
translation: Han Lingsha: Please don't defy the divine general for my sake... It's my fault, I'm too useless... I thought this time I could find a good bow for you...

original_text: 云天河：什么破射日弓！我不要了！
translation: Yun Tianhe: What lousy Sun Bow! I don't want it!

original_text: 云天河：可他竟然把你打伤！！我真的、真的生气了！！
translation: Yun Tianhe: But he actually hurt you!! I'm really, really angry!!

original_text: 句芒：唔？！
translation: Goumang: Huh?!

original_text: 韩菱纱：……别担心……我的伤其实还好，只不过最近总是很容易没力……
translation: Han Lingsha: ... Don't worry... My injury is actually okay. It's just that lately I tire very easily...

original_text: 句芒：罪人之手，不容玷污神器！心如明镜、三世澄澈之人，方有资格成为神器之主！
translation: Goumang: The hands of sinners are unworthy of defiling the divine artifact! Only one with a heart clear as a mirror and purity across three lifetimes is qualified to become the master of the divine artifact!

original_text: 韩菱纱：……心如明镜……三世澄澈……
translation: Han Lingsha: ... Clear as a mirror across three lifetimes...

original_text: 韩菱纱：那……那天河呢？天河能拿这把弓吗？！换他拿……是不是就没关系？
translation: Han Lingsha: Then... what about Tianhe? Can Tianhe hold this bow?! If he holds it... would it be okay?

original_text: 句芒：一介凡人，为何身上竟有神龙之息！
translation: Goumang: A mere mortal, why do you possess the breath of a divine dragon!

original_text: 云天河：你说什么我听不懂！而且我现在很生气，就算听懂，也不想回答你！！
translation: Yun Tianhe: I don't understand what you're saying! And I'm very angry now. Even if I understood, I wouldn't answer you!!

original_text: 韩菱纱：天河……你别这样……
translation: Han Lingsha: Tianhe... don't be like this...

original_text: 句芒：凡人，你想成为后弈射日弓之主？
translation: Goumang: Mortal, do you wish to become the master of the Houyi Sun Bow?

original_text: 云天河：……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ...

original_text: 句芒：凡人，回答本神将！
translation: Goumang: Mortal, answer this divine general!

original_text: 云天河：有什么稀罕的！我不——
translation: Yun Tianhe: What's so special! I don't-

original_text: 韩菱纱：天河！
translation: Han Lingsha: Tianhe!

original_text: 韩菱纱：你忘了？你答应过我什么？
translation: Han Lingsha: Have you forgotten? What did you promise me?

original_text: 韩菱纱：我想要看你用这把弓的样子……不管以后会发生什么，你都永远把它带在身边……
translation: Han Lingsha: I want to see you use this bow... No matter what happens in the future, always keep it with you...

original_text: 韩菱纱：快、快点头啊！你要是说“不”，这一路过来的辛苦不都白费了？！
translation: Han Lingsha: Quick, quick, nod! If you say no, won't all our hard work coming here be wasted?!

original_text: 韩菱纱：天河！！
translation: Han Lingsha: Tianhe!!

original_text: 云天河：……我、想要这把弓！
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... I, want this bow!

original_text: 句芒：盘古有训，纵横六界，诸事皆有缘法！凡人仰观苍天，无明日月潜息、四时更替，幽冥之间，万物已循因缘，恒大者则为“天道”。
translation: Goumang: Pangu has taught that across Six Realms, all things follow predestined fate! Mortals gaze at Heavens, unaware of sun and moon's hidden cycles, changing seasons. Between Netherworlds, all things follow causality; the greatest constant is the 'Way of Heaven'.

original_text: 句芒：今日始，后羿射日弓尊你为主，力量挥放多寡，决于主人！
translation: Goumang: From today, Houyi Sun Bow honors you as its master. How much power it releases depends on its master!

original_text: 云天河：……决于主人……？
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... Depends on its master...?

original_text: 句芒：凡人，既然你不愿多说，本神将也不再追问，望你善用神器，好自为之！
translation: Goumang: Mortal, since you are unwilling to say more, this divine general will not press further. I hope you use the divine weapon wisely and take care!

original_text: 句芒：你若身死，神器将重返封神陵！
translation: Goumang: If you die, it will return to Fengshen Mausoleum!

original_text: 云天河：到底要我说什么？……而且为什么又有人说我死了以后会怎样怎样……我……
translation: Yun Tianhe: What exactly do you want me to say?... And why do people keep talking about what happens after I die... I...

original_text: 韩菱纱：太好了，天河！
translation: Han Lingsha: That's great, Tianhe!

original_text: 韩菱纱：想不到……会这样顺利，更想不到……你啊，居然还算是个大好人，不像我……哈哈……
translation: Han Lingsha: Never thought... it'd go so smoothly, and never thought... you're actually quite a good person, unlike me... haha...

original_text: 云天河：菱纱，那家伙乱讲的！你要是不高兴，我把弓扔掉好了！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Lingsha, that guy was talking nonsense! If you're upset, I'll just throw the bow away!

original_text: 韩菱纱：什么？！你敢！要是扔了，我跟你没完！
translation: Han Lingsha: What?! You dare! If you throw it away, I'll never forgive you!

original_text: 慕容紫英：……
translation: Murong Ziying: ...

original_text: 韩菱纱：哎，你们！干嘛一副要死不活的样子？弓也拿到了，大家都没事，不是皆大欢喜？
translation: Han Lingsha: Hey, you guys! Why the long faces? We got the bow, everyone's safe and sound, isn't that a happy ending for all?

original_text: 云天河：可是……
translation: Yun Tianhe: But...

original_text: 韩菱纱：其实啊，你们根本不用替我难过，在鬼界听到伯父说那些话，我心里反而静下来了。
translation: Han Lingsha: Actually, you really don't need to feel sorry for me. Hearing Uncle say those things in the ghost realm, my heart actually calmed down.

original_text: 韩菱纱：就算不信命，我也相信这世上有因才有果……韩氏一族会落到今天这个地步，不怪别人……事到如今，让族里更小的孩子别再去盗墓，以后也不要有人去……我就安心了。
translation: Han Lingsha: Even if I don't believe in fate, I do believe that everything has a cause... The Han clan ending up in this situation today is no one else's fault... Now, as long as the younger children in the clan stop raiding tombs, and no one does it in the future... I'll be at peace.

original_text: 云天河：那你呢？你也不会再去了吧？！你说过这是最后一次的！
translation: Yun Tianhe: What about you? You won't go again either, right?! You said this was the last time!

original_text: 韩菱纱：傻瓜，你担心什么？我可是向来言出必行！
translation: Han Lingsha: Silly, what are you worried about? I always keep my word!

original_text: 慕容紫英：不但不可再去盗墓，日后也应多做善事，累积功德，于你有益无害。
translation: Murong Ziying: Not only must you never tomb-raid again, but you should also do more good deeds in the future to accumulate virtue; it will do you nothing but good.

original_text: 韩菱纱：知道～小紫英又在说教了！
translation: Han Lingsha: I know~ Little Ziying is lecturing again!

original_text: 韩菱纱：走啦，回琼华派去！我们刚才走过的地方，应该只是封神陵的冰山一角，这里还藏着许多秘密，要是太深入，可能就出不去了，早早回头为妙。
translation: Han Lingsha: Let's go, back to Qionghua Sect! The area we just passed through is probably just the tip of the iceberg of Fengshen Mausoleum. There are still many secrets hidden here. If we go too deep, we might not be able to get out. It's best to turn back early.

original_text: 云天河：……好，<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>一回到琼华派，我们就进妖界找梦璃！</colour>
translation: Yun Tianhe: ...Alright,<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> once we're back at Qionghua Sect, we'll enter the yao realm to find Mengli!</colour>

original_text: 明召：还以为这些妖怪有多厉害呢，不过如此！
translation: Mingzhao: Thought these yaoguais were tough, but they're nothing special!

original_text: 元越：哈哈！要说厉害，只有掌门和玄霄师叔才称得上，他们俩闭关修炼过后，不是一下就破了那个结界吗？
translation: Yuanyue: Haha! If we're talking about power, only Sect Leader and Martial Uncle Xuanxiao truly qualify. After their secluded cultivation, didn't they break that barrier in one go?

original_text: 虚凉：所以说，我们是养精蓄锐，这些妖怪却是在故弄玄虚，还以为进了结界会遇到什么强手，结果都是这样弱。不管是杀妖，还是夺取紫晶石，简直轻而易举！
translation: Xuliang: So, we're conserving our strength, while these yaoguais are just putting on a show. Thought we'd encounter some tough opponents inside the barrier, but they're all so weak. Whether it's killing yaoguais or seizing the amethyst crystals, it's almost too easy!

original_text: 柳梦璃：你们！你们简直太过份了！！
translation: Liu Mengli: You! All of you are simply too much!!

original_text: 明召：咦？这儿怎会有人？难道是妖怪变的？！
translation: Mingzhao: Huh? Why are there people here? Could they be yaoguais in disguise?!

original_text: 元越：慢着！连紫英师弟都在！他们是本派弟子？！
translation: Yuanyue: Wait! Even Martial Brother Ziying is here! Are they disciples of our sect?!

original_text: 虚凉：难道他们早就趁乱杀了进来，想要抢功？
translation: Xuliang: Could they have already infiltrated during the chaos to steal credit?

original_text: 柳梦璃：你们都滚！滚出幻瞑界！这里不是你们该来的地方！！
translation: Liu Mengli: All of you, get out! Get out of Twilight Realm! This is no place for you!!

original_text: 元越：你说什么？居然这样对同门讲话？难道是脑子不清醒了？！
translation: Yuanyue: What did you say? How dare you speak to a fellow disciple like that? Are you out of your mind?!

original_text: 柳梦璃：再往前一步，我就不客气了！
translation: Liu Mengli: Take one more step, and I won't be polite!

original_text: 明召：你！岂有此理！
translation: Mingzhao: You! How preposterous!

original_text: 重伤的貘：……少……主……
translation: Severely Injured Baku: ...Young... Mistress...

original_text: 柳梦璃：我、我在这里！
translation: Liu Mengli: I, I'm here!

original_text: 重伤的貘：……少主……我……我……为了保护…………才……战死……没有给……爹……娘……丢…………脸…………
translation: Severely Injured Baku: ...Young Mistress... I... I... to protect... fought to the death... didn't disgrace... parents...

original_text: 柳梦璃：……当然没有……你、你已经很勇敢了…………
translation: Liu Mengli: Of course not... you, you've already been very brave...

original_text: 元越：你们！听到没？那妖怪，叫那个女的“少主”？
translation: Yuanyue: You! Hear that? That yaoguai, called that woman 'Young Mistress'?

original_text: 虚凉：原来……那女的也是妖怪！难怪会对我们讲那种话！
translation: Xuliang: So... that woman is also a yaoguai! No wonder she said those things to us!

original_text: 明召：不对啊！既然如此，紫英师叔怎会与妖怪在一起？！
translation: Mingzhao: That's not right! If so, why would Martial Uncle Ziying be with yaoguais?!

original_text: 慕容紫英：…………
translation: Murong Ziying: ......

original_text: 虚凉：师弟……莫非你是与妖孽虚与委蛇，想要伺机动手将之铲除？
translation: Xuliang: Martial Brother... Could it be you're pretending to cooperate with the yaoguai, waiting for a chance to eliminate them?

original_text: 元越：哈哈，何必如此大费周章？我们师兄弟联手，妖孽根本不堪一击！
translation: Yuanyue: Haha, why go to such lengths? With us brothers joining forces, yaos are no match at all!

original_text: 明召：对！先杀了妖女，再杀其他的！
translation: Mingzhao: Right! Kill the yaoguai first, then deal with the others!

original_text: 明青：元越师叔，我们来帮你！
translation: Mingqing: Martial Uncle Yuanyue, we're here to help you!

original_text: 明戍：师叔师兄，我等奉掌门之命，也来此地除妖了！
translation: Ming Shu: Martial Uncle, Martial Brothers, we have been ordered by the sect leader to eliminate yaos here as well!

original_text: 怀朔：那是紫英师叔！还有天河他们！
translation: Huaishuo: That's Martial Uncle Ziying! And Tianhe and the others!

original_text: 元越：诸位师侄来得甚好，这便随我们一同荡尽妖孽！
translation: Yuanyue: Fellow disciples, your arrival is most timely. Now follow us to eradicate these evil creatures!

original_text: 柳梦璃：你们！——
translation: Liu Mengli: You all!-

original_text: 元越：紫英！你还愣着干什么，赶快给那妖女一剑！
translation: Yuanyue: Ziying! What are you standing there for? Quickly give that evil woman a sword strike!
Huaishuo: ...?!

original_text: 虚凉：唉！急死我也！莫非你是被妖女施了迷魂法术？！
translation: Xuliang: Ah! I'm going crazy with worry! Could it be that you've been bewitched by that evil woman?!

original_text: 元越：不管他了，我们动手！
translation: Yuanyue: Forget him, let's do it!

original_text: 柳梦璃：紫英……！
translation: Liu Mengli: Ziying...!

original_text: 慕容紫英：……师兄，请你们回去，离开幻瞑界。
translation: Murong Ziying: ... Martial Brothers, please return, leave the Twilight Realm.

original_text: 元越：什么？！
translation: Yuanyue: What?!

original_text: 明召：好哇！慕容紫英，你今日这般古怪，原来早已自甘堕落，做了妖孽的同党！
translation: Mingzhao: Well! Murong Ziying, so your strangeness today is because you've willingly sunk so low, becoming an accomplice of yaoguais!

original_text: 虚凉：可恶！我们饶不了你！
translation: Xuliang: Damn it! We won't let you off!

original_text: 慕容紫英：……你们、别逼我！我不想对同门挥剑，但也不会退开！
translation: Murong Ziying: ... You, don't push me! I don't want to swing my sword at fellow disciples, but I won't back down either!

original_text: 韩菱纱：紫英……
translation: Han Lingsha: Ziying...

original_text: 元越：走开！你这叛徒！我们要为老掌门和十九年前死去的同门报仇！
translation: Yuanyue: Get away! You traitor! We will avenge the old sect leader and the fellow disciples who died nineteen years ago!

original_text: 怀朔：等等！你们别动手！不可以动手！那是、那是紫英师叔啊！
translation: Huaishuo: Wait! Don't fight! You mustn't fight! That's... that's Martial Uncle Ziying!

original_text: 慕容紫英：怀朔！！
translation: Murong Ziying: Huaishuo!!

original_text: 元越：我、我不是故意的！是怀朔自己不好，突然冲了出来！
translation: Yuanyue: I... I didn't mean to! It was Huaishuo's own fault, suddenly rushing out!

original_text: 明戍：……对、对啊，他袒护叛徒，岂不就是袒护妖孽！
translation: Ming Shu: ...Right, right! He shielded a traitor, which is practically shielding a yaoguai!

original_text: 云天河：闭嘴！你敢再说一遍！！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Shut up! How dare you say that again!!

original_text: 怀朔：……师叔……天河……不用争了……
translation: Huaishuo: ...Martial Uncle... Tianhe... no need to argue...

original_text: 慕容紫英：怀朔！
translation: Murong Ziying: Huaishuo!

original_text: 怀朔：……还好……师叔你没事，不然璇玑要把我骂死了……
translation: Huaishuo: ...Thank goodness... Martial Uncle, you're alright. Otherwise, Xuanji would have scolded me to death...

original_text: 怀朔：……呵呵，我总算也保护了师叔一回……以前下山，不管发生什么事……都是师叔保护我们……
translation: Huaishuo: ...Hehe, I finally protected Martial Uncle once... Before when we went down the mountain, no matter what happened... it was always Martial Uncle protecting us...

original_text: 慕容紫英：怀朔！你先别说话！我马上给你疗伤……
translation: Murong Ziying: Huaishuo! Don't speak yet! I'll heal your wounds immediately...

original_text: 柳梦璃：让我看看！
translation: Liu Mengli: Let me see!

original_text: 柳梦璃：……这个伤、这个伤……
translation: Liu Mengli: ... This wound, this wound...

original_text: 怀朔：我知道的……没用了……那一剑正中心脉，就算是大罗金仙也医不好……
translation: Huaishuo: I know... it's useless... that sword strike pierced my heart meridian; even a great immortal couldn't heal it...

original_text: 慕容紫英：你、你为什么要冲出来！！
translation: Murong Ziying: You, why did you rush out!!

original_text: 怀朔：……师叔……我……我只是个无用之人……只要师叔你没事就好……
translation: Huaishuo: ...Martial Uncle... I... I'm just useless... As long as you're safe, Martial Uncle...

original_text: 慕容紫英：什么无用之人！不许你这么说……
translation: Murong Ziying: What useless! Don't you dare say that...

original_text: 怀朔：我是说真的……我很小的时候……就被师父带上山修行，村子里那么多小孩……只有我一个人被剑仙看中……大家……都很羡慕我……
translation: Huaishuo: I'm telling the truth... When I was very young... I was taken up Kunlun mountain by my master to cultivate. Among all the children in the village... I was the only one chosen by the Sword Immortal... Everyone... envied me...

original_text: 韩菱纱：怀朔……你、你先别说了，歇息一下，等你的伤好了，要说多久都可以……
translation: Han Lingsha: Huaishuo... you, stop talking for now, rest a bit. Once your wounds heal, you can talk as long as you want...

original_text: 怀朔：不……让我说吧……以后……再也没机会了……
translation: Huaishuo: No... Let me say it... Later... There won't be another chance...

original_text: 怀朔：……自从上山以后……我常常想念亲人……尤其是……在家乡的小妹……
translation: Huaishuo: ...Since coming up Kunlun... I often miss my family... especially... my little sister back home...

original_text: 怀朔：……我想下山……可是……我不敢辜负师父的期望……好多年过去……修为……还是一点长进都没有……
translation: Huaishuo: ...I want to leave the mountain... But... I dare not betray Master's expectations... Many years have passed... my cultivation... still hasn't improved at all...

original_text: 慕容紫英：胡说……你在同辈弟子中，已经够好了……
translation: Murong Ziying: Nonsense... Among your peers, you are already good enough...

original_text: 怀朔：……呵呵……师叔，想不到你也会说谎骗人……
translation: Huaishuo: ...Hehe... Martial Uncle, never thought you'd lie too...

original_text: 怀朔：……我死了以后……师叔……请你……把我的骨灰……带回故乡……
translation: Huaishuo: ...After I die... Uncle... please... take my ashes... back to my hometown...

original_text: 怀朔：其实……这样也好……你们不要怪罪其他人……我但愿来世……不要再修仙……过最……最平凡的日子……
translation: Huaishuo: Actually... this is great in a way... Don't blame anyone else... I wish in my next life... not to seek the immortality again... to live the most... most ordinary life...

original_text: 怀朔：……只是……对不起璇玑……她得自己……照顾自己……如今也没有……其他师兄弟……再照顾她了……
translation: Huaishuo: ...It's just... sorry, Xuanji... She'll have to... take care of herself... Now there are no... other Martial siblings... to look after her anymore...

original_text: 怀朔：……因为……自从掌门出关……不少……弟子……受不了本门……行事……都……一一……下山……去……了…………
translation: Huaishuo: ... Because... since the sect leader emerged from seclusion... many... disciples... couldn't bear our sect's... actions... and have... one by one... left Kunlun mountain...
Yun Tianhe: ......

original_text: 慕容紫英：你们——！！
translation: Murong Ziying: You-!!

original_text: 虚凉：你、你想做什么？！都说了！不是我们的错！
translation: Xuliang: What, what are you doing?! I told you! It's not our fault!

original_text: 慕容紫英：不可原谅！！既然你们要打，我奉陪！
translation: Murong Ziying: Unforgivable!! Since you want to fight, I'll!

original_text: 云天河：……就算把那些人打跑，怀朔也不会再回来了……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... Even if we drive those people away, Huaishuo won't come back...

original_text: 慕容紫英：走！我们一起把琼华派弟子赶出幻瞑界！
translation: Murong Ziying: Let's go! Together, we'll drive the Qionghua Sect disciples out of Twilight Realm!

original_text: 柳梦璃：紫英……？！
translation: Liu Mengli: Ziying...?!

original_text: 慕容紫英：……其实，刚才有一瞬间，我真的很想杀了他们，但是……我不想变得和他们一样，只要有一个冠冕堂皇的理由，连自己的同门兄弟都杀……我……
translation: Murong Ziying: ...Actually, for a moment, I really wanted to kill them... but I don't want to become like them-using a righteous excuse to kill even fellow disciples or martial siblings... I...

original_text: 韩菱纱：……紫英，你什么也别说了……我们都明白的……
translation: Han Lingsha: ... Ziying, don't say anything more... We all understand...

original_text: 云天河：<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>我们去出口！找琼华派的人、找掌门！</colour><dc0>让他们不要再对付幻瞑界！</dc0>
translation: Yun Tianhe:<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> Let's go to the exit! Find the Qionghua Sect people, find the Sect Leader!</colour><dc0>Tell them to stop attacking the Twilight Realm!</dc0>

original_text: 1.御剑飞行
translation: 1. Sword Flight

original_text: 2.什么都不做
translation: 2. Do Nothing

original_text: 准备<colour red=255 green=102 blue=0 alpha=255>御剑飞行</colour><dc0>吗？</dc0>
translation: Ready to <colour red=255 green=102 blue=0 alpha=255>use Sword Flight</colour><dc0>?</dc0>

original_text: 韩菱纱：……天啊……琼华派……琼华派怎么会变成这个样子？
translation: Han Lingsha: ... Heavens... Qionghua Sect... How could the Qionghua Sect have become like this?

original_text: 慕容紫英：可恨！
translation: Murong Ziying: Hateful!

original_text: 韩菱纱：……这儿……还有其他人吗？……看起来……就像是一座死城……
translation: Han Lingsha: ... Is there... anyone else here?... It looks... like a dead city...

original_text: 慕容紫英：掌门和师叔一定还在某处操纵着双剑之力！不然绝无可能维持琼华派不坠。
translation: Murong Ziying: Sect Leader and Martial Uncle must still be manipulating the power of dual swords somewhere! Otherwise, it would be absolutely impossible to keep Qionghua Sect from falling.

original_text: 云天河：那快点找到他们！还来得及——
translation: Yun Tianhe: Then find them quickly! There's still time-

original_text: 虚凉：什么人？！胆敢闯入！
translation: Xuliang: Who?! How dare you intrude!

original_text: 虚凉：慕容紫英……？！！你这叛徒！居然还敢回来！
translation: Xuliang: Murong Ziying...?!! You traitor! How dare you return!

original_text: 慕容紫英：虚凉师兄，告诉我，掌门和玄霄师叔现在何处？！
translation: Murong Ziying: Martial Brother Xuliang, tell me, where are the Sect Leader and Martial Uncle Xuanxiao now?!

original_text: 虚凉：放肆！还敢质问于我！清修静地，岂容你这叛徒任意来去！
translation: Xuliang: How dare you! Still questioning me! This place of pure cultivation is not for a traitor like you to come and go as you please!

original_text: 慕容紫英：清修静地？
translation: Murong Ziying: Place of pure cultivation?

original_text: 慕容紫英：……师兄，琼华派数百年基业已几近全毁，昔日清修之所，今日变成一座冰封死城，你身为琼华弟子，竟可视而不见！
translation: Murong Ziying: ... Martial Brother, the centuries-old foundation of Qionghua Sect is nearly destroyed. What was once a place of pure cultivation has now become a frozen dead city. As a disciple of Qionghua, how can you turn a blind eye to this?

original_text: 慕容紫英：赶快带我去见掌门和师叔！或许还能阻止这场大难！
translation: Murong Ziying: Quickly take me to see the Sect Leader and Martial Uncle! Perhaps we can still stop this disaster!

original_text: 虚凉：慕容紫英，你自甘堕落，与妖为伍！根本是师门之耻！有何资格在此胡言乱语！
translation: Xuliang: Murong Ziying, you willingly degrade yourself, associating with yaos! You're a disgrace to our sect! How dare you talk nonsense here!

original_text: 虚凉：琼华派脱离山体，虽然不再受地灵之气庇护、四时如春，但却有双剑灵气支撑，飞往昆仑天光处！用不了多时，本派弟子皆可白日飞升，乃是否极泰来、先破后立！容不得你在此大放厥词！
translation: Xuliang: Though the Qionghua Sect has detached from the mountain and lost the protection of Earth's spiritual energy and perpetual spring, it is now supported by the dual swords, flying toward Kunlun radiance site! It won't be long before all our disciples ascend to immortality in broad daylight-this is the darkest hour just before the dawn, out with the old and in with the new! I won't tolerate your reckless talk here!

original_text: 慕容紫英：好一个否极泰来、先破后立！
translation: Murong Ziying: How wonderful-'darkest before dawn, out with the old'!

original_text: 慕容紫英：琼华派升起引发大地震动、昆仑山河水污浊，祸及山下百姓，如此为之，也是否极泰来、先破后立？
translation: Murong Ziying: The Qionghua Sect's ascent caused earthquakes, polluted Kunlun's rivers, and harmed the commoners below. Is this also 'the darkest hour and out with the old'?

original_text: 虚凉：既要成仙入圣，此等取舍何足挂齿！
translation: Xuliang: Since we seek to become immortals and sages, such sacrifices are insignificant!

original_text: 慕容紫英：求仙问道亦是为了兼济天下，假如行事与此相违，岂不早已背离修道的初衷？！不是入邪却又是什么？
translation: Murong Ziying: Seeking immortality and enlightenment is also about benefiting the world. If one's actions contradict this, wouldn't that already deviate from the original purpose of cultivation?! Isn't that falling into evil?

original_text: 虚凉：慕容紫英！我当真后悔在妖界没有将你斩于剑下！让你如今还有机会满口胡言！
translation: Xuliang: Murong Ziying! I truly regret not cutting you down with my sword in the yao realm! Letting you have the chance to spout nonsense now!

original_text: 韩菱纱：你说什么！当初明明是紫英饶你一条命！你非但不感激他，还要杀他！
translation: Han Lingsha: What are you saying! Back then, it was Ziying who spared your life! Not only are you ungrateful, you want to kill him!

original_text: 虚凉：门派叛徒，人人得而诛之！连同你们一起，我今日便要替掌门清理门户！
translation: Xuliang: Sect traitors, anyone may rightfully slay you all! Today I shall cleanse the sect on behalf of the Sect Leader!

original_text: 慕容紫英：你我相斗，毫无意义，我只要见掌门与师叔！
translation: Murong Ziying: Our fighting is meaningless, I only wish to see the Sect Leader and Martial Uncle !

original_text: 虚凉：住口！不必多说，拔你的剑！
translation: Xuliang: Silence! No need to say more, draw your sword!

original_text: 云天河：可恶！浪费时间，紫英不打我打！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Damn! Wasting time, if Ziying won't fight, I will!

original_text: 慕容紫英：……天河，菱纱，你们都退开，让我一个人来。
translation: Murong Ziying: ... Tianhe, Lingsha, both of you step back. Let me handle this alone.

original_text: 韩菱纱：……紫英……这个人……
translation: Han Lingsha: ... Ziying... This person...

original_text: 慕容紫英：……无妨，我下手留有分寸，他的伤并无大碍。
translation: Murong Ziying: ... It's fine. I held back. His injuries are not serious.

original_text: 慕容紫英：……但他的心性，却与走火入魔无异……如今会留在琼华派中的，只怕都是这样的人了……
translation: Murong Ziying: ... But his temperament is no different from falling into demonic madness... Those who remain in Qionghua Sect now are likely all like this...

original_text: 慕容紫英：……逆天而行，终将有谴…………毁了的房屋可以再建，断了的桥可以再搭，绿洲的住民可以迁徙，可变了的人心又如何能回到以往……
translation: Murong Ziying: ... Defying heaven's way will eventually bring retribution... Destroyed houses can be rebuilt, broken bridges can be repaired, oasis dwellers can migrate, but how can a changed heart return to how it was before...

original_text: 慕容紫英：……青阳长老说得不错，琼华派乃是一错再错，自取灭亡……
translation: Murong Ziying: Elder Qingyang is right. The Qionghua Sect has made repeated mistakes, bringing about its own destruction...

original_text: 云天河：……走吧，我们再去找其他人，问出玄霄和夙瑶在哪里。
translation: Yun Tianhe: ...Let's go, we'll find the others and ask where Xuanxiao and Suyao are.

original_text: 慕容紫英：……不必了。如今门派中的弟子只存飞升之念，再无他想，问了也不可能有结果，只会引来争端。
translation: Murong Ziying: ... No need. Now, the disciples in the sect only think of ascension and nothing else. Asking won't yield any results and will only lead to conflict.

original_text: 云天河：那要怎么办？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Then what should we do?

original_text: 慕容紫英：我们直往卷云台去看看。
translation: Murong Ziying: Let's head straight to the Cloud Terrace to see.

original_text: 慕容紫英：依师公手记所言，<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>在卷云台上仍有一处秘台</colour><dc0>，平日并不可见，乃是宿主二人一同使用双剑秘法的地方，掌门和师叔或许会在那里……</dc0>
translation: Murong Ziying: According to Grandmaster's journal, there is <colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>a hidden platform atop Cloud Terrace</colour><dc0>, usually invisible, where two hosts practice the dual sword technique. Sect Leader and Martial Uncle might be there...</dc0>

original_text: 云天河：好！<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>那现在就去卷云台！</colour>
translation: Yun Tianhe: Okay! <colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>Then let's go to Cloud Terrace now!</colour>

original_text: 夙瑶：何人如此大胆！不是吩咐过，任何弟子不可闯入卷云台？！
translation: Suyao: Who dares so boldly! Did I not order that no disciple may intrude upon Cloud Terrace?!

original_text: 夙瑶：慕容紫英？！——
translation: Suyao: Murong Ziying?!-

original_text: 夙瑶：哼，仍不死心，想夺走望舒剑吗？
translation: Suyao: Hmph, still not giving up, trying to take Wangshu Sword?

original_text: 慕容紫英：我们并非来夺望舒剑。
translation: Murong Ziying: We are not here to take Wangshu Sword.

original_text: 玄霄：哦？！不夺望舒剑，难道是……天河，你想通透了，要与我一同飞升？
translation: Xuanxiao: Oh?! Not taking Wangshu Sword, then... Tianhe, have you come to your senses and decided to ascend with me?

original_text: 玄霄：好！好！天河你能来，大哥很高兴！
translation: Xuanxiao: Good! Good! Tianhe, I'm very happy you could come!

original_text: 云天河：玄霄，我来这里，是劝你放弃飞升。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Xuanxiao, I came here to persuade you to give up ascension.

original_text: 玄霄：……我未听错吧？此等梦话，今日说来未免大煞风景。
translation: Xuanxiao: ... Did I hear correctly? Such dream talk, spoken today, is rather inappropriate.

original_text: 云天河：我是说真的……你用双剑飞升，只会害人害己……不为别人，就算为你自己，也不该继续下去！
translation: Yun Tianhe: I'm serious... Using the dual swords to ascend will only harm others and yourself... Even for your own sake, you shouldn't continue!

original_text: 玄霄：这么想要回望舒剑吗？借口拙劣之至！
translation: Xuanxiao: So eager to get Wangshu Sword back? What a clumsy excuse!

original_text: 云天河：不是借口！——
translation: Yun Tianhe: Not an excuse!-

original_text: 玄霄：双剑飞升之法，经年而累，不须他人指摘。
translation: Xuanxiao: The method of ascension via dual swords has been perfected over years; it needs no criticism.

original_text: 云天河：我不知道琼华派造出双剑是对是错，我只知道……你现在满身杀气，根本已经走火入魔，这个样子，不可能飞升成仙的！
translation: Yun Tianhe: I don't know if it was right or wrong for the Qionghua Sect to forge the dual swords. I only know... you're filled with killing intent now, completely fallen into demonic madness. In this state, you can't possibly ascend to immortality!

original_text: 玄霄：无稽之谈！我今日之力，远胜往昔，何来走火入魔！
translation: Xuanxiao: Nonsense! My power today far surpasses the past, how could I fall into demonic madness!

original_text: 云天河：不对！青阳长老说，就算你力量再大，也已经入了邪道，只是自己还不明白！
translation: Yun Tianhe: That's not right! Elder Qingyang said, even if your power is great, you've already fallen into evil ways, you just don't realize it!

original_text: 玄霄：青阳？！……他遣你们来的？
translation: Xuanxiao: Qingyang?! ...Did he send you here?

original_text: 玄霄：哈哈！他是不是说我入了心魔、无可救药？命你们杀了我，救琼华派于水火之中！
translation: Xuanxiao: Haha! Did he say I've fallen to inner demonic madness, beyond saving? Ordering you to kill me to rescue the Qionghua Sect from peril!

original_text: 玄霄：我留青阳性命，不是让他兴风作浪，废人就该有废人的样子！安心等死便是。
translation: Xuanxiao: I spared Qingyang's life not to let him stir up trouble. A useless person should act like one-just wait quietly for death.

original_text: 慕容紫英：住口——！！
translation: Murong Ziying: Shut up-!!

original_text: 慕容紫英：即便你是师叔，也不可如此数说长老！而且你竟杀害重光长老，做出这等欺师灭祖之事！
translation: Murong Ziying: Even if you are my Martial Uncle, you cannot speak of the elders like that! And you actually killed Elder Chongguang, committing such an act of betraying mentors and ancestors!

original_text: 夙瑶：什么？！……重光长老被杀！
translation: Suyao: What?!... Elder Chongguang has been killed!

original_text: 玄霄：欺师灭祖？——又待如何！！莫要忘记，也是他们将我冰封。
translation: Xuanxiao: Betraying mentors and ancestors?-So be it!! Don't forget, they were the ones who sealed me in ice.

original_text: 云天河：你这样根本就是错的！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Your way is completely wrong!

original_text: 云天河：可是……可是你心里一定还有些善念，不然为什么没有杀死青阳长老？
translation: Yun Tianhe: But... But you must still have some kindness in your heart, otherwise why didn't you kill Elder Qingyang?

original_text: 玄霄：天河……你……
translation: Xuanxiao: Tianhe... you...

original_text: 玄霄：哼！不对——！
translation: Xuanxiao: Hmph! No!

original_text: 玄霄：我放过青阳，是不屑动一个废人！早知如此，便一掌将他杀了！
translation: Xuanxiao: I spared Qingyang because I disdain harming a cripple! Had I known, I would have killed him with one palm!

original_text: 慕容紫英：你——！简直丧心狂乱、是非不分！
translation: Murong Ziying: You! You're completely insane and have lost all sense of right and wrong!

original_text: 慕容紫英：掌门！弟子始终不明，您执掌琼华多年，所有行事向来以门派为重，如今之势，楼宇冰封，河水污浊，分明不是正道所趋，掌门为何还要执意飞升？！
translation: Murong Ziying: Sect Leader! I have never understood: You have led Qionghua for many years, always acting in the sect's best interest. Yet now, with buildings frozen and rivers polluted, clearly this is not the righteous path. Why are you still so determined to ascend?!

original_text: 夙瑶：……
translation: Suyao: ...

original_text: 慕容紫英：掌门——！
translation: Murong Ziying: Sect Leader-!

original_text: 夙瑶：……三代铸剑，一朝乃成，琼华派多年夙愿，传于我手中，岂能轻言放弃？
translation: Suyao: ... Three generations forging the sword, achieved in one day. The long-cherished wish of Qionghua Sect, passed into my hands-how could I lightly give up?

original_text: 夙瑶：与玄霄一同使用双剑，乃是我自己决定，飞升成与不成，皆看天意，我也只有顺势而为！
translation: Suyao: Using the dual swords with Xuanxiao is my own decision. Whether ascension succeeds or not is up to fate. I can only seize the momentum!

original_text: 慕容紫英：若是不成，琼华派就此自毁，又该如何？！
translation: Murong Ziying: If it fails, and the Qionghua Sect destroys itself, what then?!

original_text: 夙瑶：箭在弦上，已不得不发！此时放弃，更是一无所得！
translation: Suyao: The arrow is set on the string - it must be fired! To give up now is to gain nothing!

original_text: 慕容紫英：……掌门……请您三思而后行，弟子觉得纵然琼华派为求飞升，已付出太大代价，但是当断则断，不然后果只会不堪设想！
translation: Murong Ziying: ...Sect Leader... I beg you to think twice. This disciple believes that even though Qionghua Sect has paid too great a price in seeking ascension, it's time to make a decisive break. Otherwise, the consequences will be unimaginable!

original_text: 慕容紫英：师叔分明心性成狂！掌门！仙神之界岂能容忍如此心魔深重之人飞升成仙？！
translation: Murong Ziying: Martial Uncle has clearly gone mad with obsession! Sect Leader! How can the Divine realm or immortal realm tolerate someone so deeply consumed by inner demonic madness ascending to immortality?!

original_text: 玄霄：哈哈哈！心性成狂、心魔深种！说得好！
translation: Xuanxiao: Hahaha! Deeply consumed by inner demonic madness! Well said!

original_text: 玄霄：我一生清心修道，竟有半生被人视为颠狂！若不做尽狂事，岂非名难副实！！
translation: Xuanxiao: I've cultivated with a pure heart all my life, yet half my life I've been seen as mad! If I don't commit every mad act, wouldn't the name be undeserved!!

original_text: 慕容紫英：……唔……
translation: Murong Ziying: ...Hmm...

original_text: 韩菱纱：紫英！你怎么样？！
translation: Han Lingsha: Ziying! Are you alright?!

original_text: 慕容紫英：……没事，我撑得住……
translation: Murong Ziying: ... It's fine, I can hold on...

original_text: 玄霄：我九成功力用于维持琼华不坠，否则刚刚便已将你击毙！
translation: Xuanxiao: I am using ninety percent of my power to keep Qionghua from falling, otherwise I would have struck you dead just now!

original_text: 玄霄：你劝夙瑶能有何用？箭在弦上不得不发！何况以她之力，只能对我惟命是从！
translation: Xuanxiao: What use is persuading Suyao? The arrow is set on and must be fired! Besides, with her power, she can only obey my commands!

original_text: 云天河：玄霄！——
translation: Yun Tianhe: Xuanxiao!-

original_text: 玄霄：趁我未动杀念，通通滚回山下！
translation: Xuanxiao: Before I decide to kill, all of you, get down the mountain!

original_text: 夙瑶：紫英，你们速速离开。
translation: Suyao: Ziying, you all must leave quickly.

original_text: 慕容紫英：掌门！……
translation: Murong Ziying: Sect Leader!...

original_text: 夙瑶：走！不要让我说第二遍。
translation: Suyao: Go! Don't make me say it twice.

original_text: 云天河：……我不会走的。
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... I won't leave.

original_text: 韩菱纱：天河……
translation: Han Lingsha: Tianhe...

original_text: 云天河：……既然劝不动你……只能……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... Since I can't persuade you... I can only...

original_text: 韩菱纱：……！天河，不要……
translation: Han Lingsha: ...! Tianhe, don't...

original_text: 玄霄：如我所料，口说不成，便要动手。
translation: Xuanxiao: As I expected, words fail, so force follows.

original_text: 云天河：玄霄——
translation: Yun Tianhe: Xuanxiao-

original_text: 云天河：直到现在，我还是忘不了曾经喊你一声“大哥”，你教我很多东西……没有你的话，天河一定不是现在的天河……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Even now, I still can't forget that I once called you 'big brother'. You taught me so many things... Without you, Tianhe definitely wouldn't be the Tianhe I am today...

original_text: 云天河：如果眼下还有其他办法，就算千难万难，就算要杀了我自己，我都会去做，也不会拿剑对着你！
translation: Yun Tianhe: If there were any other way right now, no matter how difficult, even if it meant killing myself, I would do it, and I wouldn't point this sword at you!

original_text: 玄霄：可笑！说不再做兄弟的人是你！说顾念旧情的人也是你！
translation: Xuanxiao: Ridiculous! The one who said we are no longer brothers is you! The one who speaks of cherishing old sentiments is also you!

original_text: 玄霄：如兄如弟，如师如父，又能怎样？！为了别人一样和我作对！
translation: Xuanxiao: Like brothers, like mentor and father-so what?! You still oppose me for others' sake!

original_text: 云天河：你不肯放弃飞升……至少我还要救菱纱、救其他人。
translation: Yun Tianhe: You refuse to give up ascension... but at least I must save Lingsha, save the others.

original_text: 玄霄：哼！当真恩深义重，令人动容！
translation: Xuanxiao: Hmph! Truly profound loyalty, truly moving!

original_text: 云天河：……杀气…………没想到我们会有这么一天……
translation: Tianhe: ...Killing intent... I never thought we'd come to this day...

original_text: 玄霄：还等什么！一起上吧！
translation: Xuanxiao: What are you waiting for! Attack together!

original_text: 玄霄：兄弟阋墙、朋友反目！十九年前我便遇过了！
translation: Xuanxiao: Brothers turning on each other, friends becoming foes! I experienced it nineteen years ago!

original_text: 玄霄：好小子！真不简单，原来你也不弱！
translation: Xuanxiao: Good lad! Truly remarkable, it turns out you're not weak either!

original_text: 玄霄：当初在禁地授你凝冰诀，如今士别三日刮目相看！竟修炼出能与凝冰诀融合一气的灼烈阳气！
translation: Xuanxiao: Back when I taught you Cryomancy in Forbidden Area, and now, after just a short separation, I must view you with new eyes! You've actually cultivated such intense yang energy that can fuse with Cryomancy!

original_text: 玄霄：云、天、河！你实在令我惊讶！不愧是我的好兄弟！
translation: Xuanxiao: YUN-TIAN-HE! You truly amaze me! Worthy of being my sworn brother!

original_text: 玄霄：哈哈——哈哈哈哈！
translation: Xuanxiao: Haha-Hahahaha!

original_text: 云天河：…………动手吧！
translation: Yun Tianhe: ......Let's fight!

original_text: 玄霄：有此实力，难怪敢来阻我！但结果一样是死！
translation: Xuanxiao: With such strength, no wonder you dare obstruct me! But the result is still death!

original_text: 夙瑶：……你受伤了？！
translation: Suyao: ... are you injured?!

original_text: 云天河：……！
translation: Yun Tianhe: ...!

original_text: 玄霄：……天河，我不忍下手，你却招招毫无容情！不错、当真不错！
translation: Xuanxiao: ... Tianhe, I couldn't bear to strike, yet you showed no mercy with every move! Well done, truly well done!

original_text: 玄霄：你竟能抵御……甚至吸纳我的攻击，看来日后修为必定胜于我！
translation: Xuanxiao: You could resist... even absorb my attacks. It seems your future cultivation will surely surpass mine!

original_text: 云天河：不是！我——
translation: Yun Tianhe: No! I-

original_text: 玄霄：如今我只存一成功力，其他须用于维持琼华不坠，你们这样，可也算趁人之危？
translation: Xuanxiao: Now I only have ten percent of my power spare; the rest must be used to keep Qionghua from falling. Is this what you call taking advantage of someone's weakness?

original_text: 云天河：不是的！我不想和你打！
translation: Yun Tianhe: That's not it! I don't want to fight you!

original_text: 云天河：玄霄……为什么要这样！就算想成仙，一定还有其他办法！我可以陪你去找，直到找到为止！难道就不能放弃双剑？！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Xuanxiao... why do this?! Even if you want to become immortal, there must be other ways! I can help you search until we find one! Can't you just give up on the dual swords?!

original_text: 玄霄：……天河，你晚了二十二年。
translation: Xuanxiao: ...Tianhe, you're twenty-two years late.

original_text: 云天河：什么……？
translation: Yun Tianhe: What...?

original_text: 玄霄：昔日修炼双剑、苦无进境之时，无人让我放弃……初有所成、经络逆变之时，无人让我放弃……失却望舒、日夜受火焚之苦，无人顾我生死……如今，太迟了。
translation: Xuanxiao: In the past, when I cultivated the dual swords and made no progress, no one told me to give up... When I first achieved success and my meridians reversed, no one told me to give up... When I lost Wangshu and suffered day and night from fire torment, no one cared if I lived or died... Now, it's too late.

original_text: 玄霄：一生成于修道、亦毁于修道，纠结已深不可解，此种心境，他人怎能体会？！
translation: Xuanxiao: A life built on cultivation, also ruined by cultivation. Entanglements too deep to unravel-how could others understand this state of mind?!

original_text: 夙瑶：那是——昆仑天光！！
translation: Suyao: That is-the Kunlun Radiance!!

original_text: 玄霄：飞升的最后时刻已至！哈哈哈哈——！
translation: Xuanxiao: The final moment of ascension has come! Hahahaha--!

original_text: 慕容紫英：天河，来不及了……
translation: Murong Ziying: Tianhe, it's too late...
Han Lingsha: ......

original_text: 玄霄：韩、菱、纱！我知道你在想什么！
translation: Xuanxiao: HAN-LING-SHA! I know what you're thinking!
Han Lingsha: ...!!

original_text: 玄霄：从你走上秘台，我便时刻注意你，你是否想过无力阻止飞升之际，便要自尽？！
translation: Xuanxiao: From the moment you stepped onto the secret platform, I've been watching you. Did you ever think that if you couldn't stop the ascension, you'd have to kill yourself?!

original_text: 韩菱纱：你？！我……
translation: Han Lingsha: You?! I...

original_text: 玄霄：你的性命是我的！飞升最后时刻将你牺牲，才算死得其所！想要自尽乃是痴心妄想，我不会让你如愿！
translation: Xuanxiao: Your life is mine! Sacrificing you at the final moment of ascension is the only fitting death! Thinking of suicide is wishful thinking-I won't let you have your way!

original_text: 云天河：你！你疯了！你凭什么拥有别人的命？！凭什么决定别人生死！！
translation: Yun Tianhe: You! You're crazy! What right do you have to own someone else's life?! To decide their life or death!!

original_text: 玄霄：不用多言！再战便是！生生死死，须怨不得我！
translation: Xuanxiao: No need for more words! Let's fight again! Life or death, blame no one but yourselves!

original_text: 云天河：好！这次我不会只是伤你！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Okay! This time I won't just injure you!

original_text: 玄霄：很好！很好！
translation: Xuanxiao: Very good! Very good!

original_text: 玄霄：你体质特异，如今内修仙功、外执神器，云天河！你竟还不知足？看我飞升便心生妒恨、一力阻止吗？！
translation: Xuanxiao: With your unique physique, cultivating immortal arts internally and wielding a divine weapon externally-Yun Tianhe! Are you still unsatisfied? Do you envy my ascension and strive to stop me?!

original_text: 云天河：你——！我根本不是这样想！
translation: Yun Tianhe: You-! That's not what I meant at all!

original_text: 玄霄：休要得意！即便我没有你融合阴阳的修为，但双剑力量何其强悍霸道，若是全力施为——
