translation: Xuanxiao: Do not gloat! Even without your cultivation that merges yin and yang, the power of the dual swords is immensely fierce and domineering. If unleashed fully-

original_text: 玄霄：不逊于仙神之力！
translation: Xuanxiao: A power not inferior to GOD or IMMORTAL!

original_text: 慕容紫英：天河，小心！这力量——
translation: Murong Ziying: Tianhe, careful! This power-

original_text: 夙瑶：我来助你。
translation: Suyao: I'll help you.

original_text: 慕容紫英：掌门！您——
translation: Murong Ziying: Sect Leader! You-

original_text: 夙瑶：琼华飞升，兹事体大，容不得你们继续妨碍！
translation: Suyao: Qionghua's ascension is a matter of great importance, I cannot allow you to continue hindering it!

original_text: 夙瑶：韩菱纱，与我动手便是耗你元神！你可想清楚了？
translation: Suyao: Han Lingsha, fighting me will drain your vitality! Have you thought this through?

original_text: 云天河：可恶！太过份了！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Damn it! That's too much!

original_text: 玄霄：云、天、河！我全力一搏，看看你能支撑多久吧！
translation: Xuanxiao: YUN-TIAN-HE! I will fight with all my might-let's see how long you can hold out!

original_text: 慕容紫英：天河……<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>我们一定要先打败掌门，</colour><dc0>毕竟她手执的是望舒剑！</dc0>
translation: Murong Ziying: Tianhe...<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> We must first defeat Sect Leader,</colour><dc0> After all, she wields Wangshu Sword!</dc0>

original_text: 云天河：好！拼了！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Okay! Fight to the end!
Suyao: ... Hmm...

original_text: 玄霄：还是如此无用。
translation: Xuanxiao: Still so useless.

original_text: 韩菱纱：天河！你怎么了？！
translation: Han Lingsha: Tianhe! What's wrong with you?!

original_text: 云天河：……我……身体里气息激荡…………你怎么样……你自己脸色这么苍白……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... I... feel many surges of energy inside me... How are you... You look so pale yourself...

original_text: 韩菱纱：我……我……不要管我了……
translation: Han Lingsha: I... I... don't worry about me...

original_text: 云天河：啊——！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Ah-!

original_text: 慕容紫英：天河！！
translation: Murong Ziying: Tianhe!!
Yun Tianhe: ......

original_text: 韩菱纱：天河！到底怎么了？你说话，别吓我啊！
translation: Han Lingsha: Tianhe! What's wrong exactly? Say something, don't scare me!

original_text: 玄霄：哈哈～～～哈哈哈～～～
translation: Xuanxiao: Haha~~~ Hahaha~~~

original_text: 韩菱纱：你……你笑什么？
translation: Han Lingsha: You... What are you laughing at?

original_text: 韩菱纱：天河受伤你很开心吗？！你知不知道他是真的不想跟你打！他心里有多痛苦！
translation: Han Lingsha: Are you happy that Tianhe got hurt?! Don't you know he really do not want to fight you! How much pain he's in!

original_text: 玄霄：不自量力！不惧炎寒又如何？！实力相差如此之巨，自保尚且勉强，竟还想分神替别人挡下攻势！
translation: Xuanxiao: Overestimating yourselves! So what if you fear neither heat nor cold?! With such a vast gap in strength, barely able to protect yourselves, yet you still try to divert attention to shield others from attacks!

original_text: 韩菱纱：……！……是、是为了我们……
translation: Han Lingsha: ...! ...It was... for us...

original_text: 玄霄：云天河！我笑你以卵击石、自寻死路！更笑我自己！直到此时仍想留你性命！
translation: Xuanxiao: Yun Tianhe! I laugh at you—an egg against a stone, courting death! And at myself—for still hesitating to end you!

original_text: 玄霄：最后一次问你，到底离不离开琼华派？！
translation: Xuanxiao: I ask you one last time-will you leave Qionghua Sect or not?!

original_text: 云天河：……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ...

original_text: 云天河：我不走。
translation: Yun Tianhe: I'm not leaving.

original_text: 玄霄：哈哈哈哈！
translation: Xuanxiao: Ha ha ha ha!

original_text: 玄霄：顽固至此，我便成全了你！
translation: Xuanxiao: Since you're so stubborn, I'll grant your wish!

original_text: 玄霄：……！何人阻我！
translation: Xuanxiao: ...! who dares block me!

original_text: ？？：本座乃天帝驾下九天玄女，奉命相传神界旨意。
translation: ???: I am the Ninth Heaven Xuannv under the Celestial Emperor's command, sent to convey the divine realm's decree.

original_text: 夙瑶：……九天玄女娘娘……
translation: Suyao: ... Goddess Ninth Heaven Xuannv...

original_text: 夙瑶：终于……终于……琼华派已升至昆仑天光处，琼华派多年夙愿，终于我手中达成！
translation: Suyao: Finally... finally... Qionghua Sect has ascended to the Kunlun Radiance Site. The long-cherished wish of Qionghua Sect is finally achieved in my hands!

original_text: 九天玄女：无知！凡心入魔，妄想升仙。
translation: Ninth Heaven Xuannv: Ignorant! Mortal heart fallen to demonic thoughts, vainly hoping to ascend.
Suyao: ...!!

original_text: 九天玄女：天帝有命，琼华派逆天行事，犯下滔天罪孽，令其受天火焚烧，陨落大地，派中弟子打入东海漩涡之中，囚禁千年！
translation: Ninth Heaven Xuannv: By the Heavenly Emperor's decree, Qionghua Sect has acted against heaven, committing heinous sins. They shall be burned by heavenly fire, fall to earth, and their disciples imprisoned in the East Sea vortex for a thousand years!

original_text: 九天玄女：但上天有好生之德，慕容紫英、云天河、韩菱纱虽为琼华弟子，心中却存清明善念，故可免去此劫。
translation: Ninth Heaven Xuannv: But the heavens cherish all life. Although Murong Ziying, Yun Tianhe, and Han Lingsha are Qionghua disciples, they harbor clarity and kindness in their hearts, thus they may be spared this calamity.

original_text: 玄霄：岂有此理！！什么天帝之命！
translation: Xuanxiao: Outrageous!! What Heavenly Emperor's decree!

original_text: 玄霄：我琼华派已至昆仑天光，飞升近在眼前！毋须别人来代天授命！
translation: Xuanxiao: My Qionghua Sect has reached the Kunlun Radiance Site; ascension is at hand! There's no need for others to act on Heaven's behalf!

original_text: 九天玄女：玄霄，一切因果，皆由自生。神界确也只是“代天授命”，维系天道不坠。
translation: Ninth Heaven Xuannv: Xuanxiao, all causes and effects arise from oneself. The divine realm indeed only 'acts on heaven's behalf', maintaining the heavenly way.

original_text: 九天玄女：盘古有训，纵横六界，诸事皆有缘法！凡人仰观苍天，无明日月潜息、四时更替，幽冥之间，万物已循因缘，恒大者则为“天道”。
translation: Ninth Heaven Xuannv: Pangu's teaching: across the six realms, all things follow predestined fate! Mortals gaze at the heavens, unaware of the sun and moon's hidden rhythms, the changing seasons. Between the netherworld and the living, all things follow cause and effect. The eternal constant is the 'Way of Heaven'.

original_text: 玄霄：一派空谈！世间天灾人祸，神界不恤苍生！却要碍我琼华升仙，莫非也是遵循天道？！
translation: Xuanxiao: Empty talk! Natural disasters and man-made calamities plague the world, yet the Divine Realm shows no pity for mortal lives! They hinder Qionghua's ascension-is this also following the Way of Heaven?!

original_text: 九天玄女：不错。南斗掌生，北斗注死，所有生灵往复六界之间，寻常病苦如是，天灾人祸亦如是，此谓“天之道”，而非“逆天救世之道”。
translation: Ninth Heaven Xuannv: Correct. Southern Dipper governs life, Northern Dipper governs death. All living beings cycle through the six realms-ordinary illnesses and sufferings, as well as natural disasters and man-made calamities. This is the 'Way of Heaven', not the 'Way of Defying Heaven to Save the World'.

original_text: 九天玄女：琼华派人心成魔，恶念万般，却妄图升仙，乃天道不容！
translation: Ninth Heaven Xuannv: The hearts of Qionghua Sect have turned demonic, full of wicked thoughts, yet they vainly seek ascension-this is intolerable to the Way of Heaven!

original_text: 玄霄：什么“天道”！不过是神界一面之辞！为何凡人命运要由你们一句话而定！
translation: Xuanxiao: What 'Way of Heaven'! That's merely the Divine Realm's one-sided decree! Why should mortal fate be decided by your words alone!

original_text: 玄霄：给我滚回天庭！！
translation: Xuanxiao: Get back to the heavens!!
Xuanxiao: Hmm!!-

original_text: 云天河：玄霄！！——
translation: Yun Tianhe: Xuanxiao!!-

original_text: 九天玄女：蝼蚁之力，敢与天争！
translation: Ninth Heaven Xuannv: The strength of ants dares contend with Heaven!

original_text: 九天玄女：玄霄，蔑视天地，只会令你入邪更深！
translation: Ninth Heaven Xuannv: Xuanxiao, scorning heaven and earth only deepens your corruption!

original_text: 玄霄：苍天在上，我自敬畏！但若让我任由神界驱使，却是妄想！
translation: Xuanxiao: Heaven above, I revere it! But to let the divine realm command me as they wish? That is delusion!

original_text: 九天玄女：凡人无识，但觉自己命如草芥，神明高高在上，却不懂天道有常，即便是神，也只能依天命而行。
translation: Ninth Heaven Xuannv: Mortals are ignorant, only feeling their lives are as worthless as grass, with deities high above. They don't understand that the heaven has its way; even gods can only act according to heavenly fate.

original_text: 夙瑶：……天命……难道说琼华派数代所求，皆是虚妄……
translation: Suyao: ... Heavenly destiny... Could it be that what Qionghua Sect has sought for generations is all in vain...

original_text: 夙瑶：可是……本派斩妖除魔、护佑世间，竟也毫无功德……全是恶念吗……
translation: Suyao: But... our sect slays evil creatures, protects the world... yet we have no merit at all... Only wicked thoughts? ...

original_text: 九天玄女：善恶行止，本无人界、妖界之分，妖不为恶，为何杀之？琼华派起于贪念，屠戮幻瞑界，与邪魔何异？
translation: Ninth Heaven Xuannv: Good and evil deeds are not divided by human or yao realms. If yaoguai do no evil, why kill them? The Qionghua Sect, driven by greed, slaughtered the Twilight Realm-how is that different from evil demons?

original_text: 九天玄女：欲求仙道、先修人道，不明是非，何以为仙！
translation: Ninth Heaven Xuannv: To seek immortality, first cultivate humanity. Without understanding right and wrong, how can one become immortal!

original_text: 夙瑶：……！欲求仙道、先修人道……
translation: Suyao: ...! To seek immortality, first cultivate humanity...

original_text: 夙瑶：…………原来如此……原来如此…………
translation: Suyao: ............ I see... I see...

original_text: 夙瑶：……夙瑶知错，甘心受罚。
translation: Suyao: ... Suyao admits her mistake and willingly accepts punishment.

original_text: 九天玄女：上天有好生之德，既然知错能改，囚禁东海漩涡五百年后便入轮回去吧。
translation: Ninth Heaven Xuannv: Heaven values life. Since you can recognize your mistakes and reform, after 500 years of imprisonment in the East Sea vortex, you may enter the cycle of reincarnation.

original_text: 玄霄：夙瑶！！
translation: Xuanxiao: Suyao!!

original_text: 韩菱纱：那是……？好多光……往东方飞去了……
translation: Han Lingsha: That's...? So many lights... flying eastward...

original_text: 九天玄女：天火即将落下，本座缚咒自会将琼华弟子带往东海漩涡。
translation: Ninth Heaven Xuannv: Heavenly fire is about to fall. My binding spell will take the Qionghua disciples to the East Sea vortex.

original_text: 云天河：天火落下……琼华派也会落下，那山下的人怎么办？都会死吗？……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Heavenly fire falls... Qionghua Sect will fall too. What about the people below the mountain? Will they all die? ...

original_text: 九天玄女：今日之因，必有明日之果，而今日之果，亦起于昔日之因。
translation: Ninth Heaven Xuannv: Today's cause will inevitably bring tomorrow's effect, and today's effect also stems from past causes.

original_text: 云天河：可是……就算琼华派做错了，山下那些人有什么错？！
translation: Yun Tianhe: But... Even if Qionghua Sect is wrong, what did the people down the mountain do wrong?!

original_text: 云天河：有因才有果，但为什么要报应在其他人身上？！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Cause leads to effect, but why must the retribution fall on others?!

original_text: 九天玄女：云天河，你是质疑天命，还是心存不忍？
translation: Ninth Heaven Xuannv: Yun Tianhe, do you question destiny, or harbor reluctance?

original_text: 云天河：……我、我想救那些人！
translation: Yun Tianhe: ...I... I want to save those people!

original_text: 云天河：之前救不了月牙村的人，那种难受的感觉我再也不想尝了！
translation: Yun Tianhe: That awful feeling when I couldn't save the people of Crescent Village before-I never want to experience it again!

original_text: 九天玄女：天意难违！
translation: Ninth Heaven Xuannv: Heaven's will is hard to defy!

original_text: 玄霄：哈哈哈！难怪说“天地不仁，以万物为刍狗”！果然无情无义，草菅人命！
translation: Xuanxiao: Hahaha! No wonder they say 'Heaven are heartless', treating all beings as straw dogs! Truly heartless and ruthless, treating lives like grass!

original_text: 九天玄女：玄霄！你罪孽深重，至此仍无悔心！更道出荒谬之言！
translation: Ninth Heaven Xuannv: Xuanxiao! Your sins are heavy, and you still show no remorse! You even speak such absurd words!

original_text: 九天玄女：所谓“天地不仁”，乃神与天道都视天地万物为平等，竟被你曲解至此！
translation: Ninth Heaven Xuannv: So-called 'Heaven are heartless' means all gods and Heavenly Way regard all things as equal. How could you distort it to this extent!

original_text: 玄霄：哈哈哈哈～～～～
translation: Xuanxiao: Hahahaha~~~~

original_text: 玄霄：神界自许为天、自比为地，如此天地，令人不齿！！
translation: Xuanxiao: The divine realm claims to be heaven, compares itself to earth-such a heaven and earth are despicable!!

original_text: 玄霄：玄霄以命立誓！！苍天弃吾、吾宁成魔——！！
translation: Xuanxiao: I, XUANXIAO, SWEAR BY MY VERY LIFE!! HEAVEN HAS FORSAKEN ME! THEN I WOULD RATHER BECOME A DEMON-!!
Yun Tianhe: ...!!!

original_text: 九天玄女：玄霄，留你性命，日后必为祸端！
translation: Ninth Heaven Xuannv: Xuanxiao, sparing your life will surely lead to disaster in the future!

original_text: 玄霄：哈哈！不错！待我成魔，定要杀上天庭，将之夷为平地！！若是怕了，劝你们快快将我除去！！
translation: Xuanxiao: Haha! Correct! Once I become a demon, I will surely storm the heavenly court and raze it to the ground!! If you're afraid, I advise you to quickly eliminate me!!

original_text: 九天玄女：玄霄！你心魔已成！本座先将你打入东海漩涡最深之处，另禀天帝，再议生杀！
translation: Ninth Heaven Xuannv: Xuanxiao! Your heart has become a demon! I shall first cast you into the deepest depths of the East Sea's vortex, then report to the Heavenly Emperor to decide your fate-life or death!

original_text: 玄霄：唔！……
translation: Xuanxiao: Hmph!...

original_text: 九天玄女：一力相抗，只会更加痛苦！
translation: Ninth Heaven Xuannv: Resisting with all your might will only bring more pain!

original_text: 九天玄女：本座回天庭复命，望你好自为之，脱身魔障！
translation: Ninth Heaven Xuannv: I return to the Heavenly Court to report. I hope you will behave yourself and free yourself from demonic obstacles!

original_text: 云天河：等等！你还没有告诉我，要怎样才能救山下那些人！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Wait! You still haven't told me how to save those people down the mountain!

original_text: 九天玄女：天意难违。
translation: Ninth Heaven Xuannv: Heaven's will is hard to defy.

original_text: 云天河：不对，你明明说过，万物就是天道，那人也算天道的一部分吧？！为什么不能自己定自己的命？！
translation: Yun Tianhe: No! You clearly said that all things are within Heavenly Way, and humans are part of the Way of Heaven too, right?! Why can't one decide one's own fate?!

original_text: 云天河：…………我命由我、不由天！
translation: Yun Tianhe: ......My fate is mine to command, not heaven's!

original_text: 九天玄女：……云天河，你的想法果然与众不同，难怪衔烛之龙和句芒都对你另眼相看。
translation: Ninth Heaven Xuannv: ... Yun Tianhe, your way of thinking is indeed unique. No wonder the Candle-Holding Dragon and Goumang regarded you differently.

original_text: 云天河：他们……！
translation: Yun Tianhe: They...!

original_text: 九天玄女：逆天改命，何等大事！但你身具神龙之息与后羿射日弓，能否扭转乾坤，由你自己而定！
translation: Ninth Heaven Xuannv: Defying fate is no small matter! But you possess Divine Dragon's Breath and Houyi Sun Bow. Whether you can change fate is up to you!

original_text: 云天河：等一下！我不明白什么意思啊——！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Wait! I don't understand what you mean---!

original_text: 慕容紫英：掌门……
translation: Murong Ziying: Sect Leader...

original_text: 夙瑶：……紫英……琼华派毁于我手，实在无颜面对历代祖师……
translation: Suyao: Qionghua Sect is now destroyed by my hand-I truly have no face to meet the past masters...

original_text: 夙瑶：……昔日妒你才华，不再让你修习高深的仙术，实乃目光短浅，望你能原谅我……日后定要再光大琼华派，一切便交付于你了……
translation: Suyao: ... In the past, I envied your talent and stopped you from learning advanced immortal arts-truly short-sighted. I hope you can forgive me... In the future, you must restore Qionghua Sect to glory; I entrust everything to you...

original_text: 慕容紫英：掌门！
translation: Murong Ziying: Sect Leader!

original_text: 玄霄：我不甘心！我怎能甘心！！
translation: Xuanxiao: I can't accept this! How can I accept this!!

original_text: 云天河：……大哥……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ...Big brother...

original_text: 玄霄：……你！……刚才喊我什么？……
translation: Xuanxiao: ... You! ...What did you just call me? ...

original_text: 云天河：……大哥……你…………
translation: Yun Tianhe: ...Big brother...You...

original_text: 玄霄：哼！不必同情于我，玄霄行至今日，从未后悔！
translation: Xuanxiao: Hmph! No need to pity me. Xuanxiao has walked this path to today and never regretted it!

original_text: 云天河：不是同情！在我心里，你始终都是我大哥，从来没有变过……
translation: Yun Tianhe: It's not pity! In my heart, you've always been my big brother, that's never changed...

original_text: 玄霄：……想不到我一生多舛，到头来竟还有你这个兄弟！
translation: Xuanxiao: ... To think my life has been so troubled, yet in the end, I still have you as a brother!

original_text: 玄霄：……云天河，适才相争，大哥说了许多气话，你莫要放在心上，你大概永远不会知道，大哥有多羡慕你……
translation: Xuanxiao: ... Yun Tianhe, during our earlier dispute, I said many angry words. Don't take them to heart. You probably will never know how much I envy you...

original_text: 玄霄：哼！不过区区东海，能奈我何！！天河，今生定有再会之时！
translation: Xuanxiao: Hmph! What can the East Sea do to me?! Tianhe, we will surely meet again in this lifetime!

original_text: 云天河：大哥！——
translation: Yun Tianhe: Big Brother!-

original_text: 玄霄：天河，大哥最后再助你一次……
translation: Xuanxiao: Tianhe, big brother will help you one last time...

original_text: 云天河：什么？……
translation: Yun Tianhe: What?...

original_text: 玄霄：你当局者迷，我细想刚才……之言，你若是想救山下之人，便全力激发体内阴阳之气，配合后羿射日弓的力量，或可毁去下落的琼华派。
translation: Xuanxiao: You're too close to see clearly. Thinking carefully about what... said just now-if you want to save the people below the mountain, fully stimulate the yin-yang energy within you, combine it with the power of Houyi Sun Bow, and perhaps you can destroy the falling Qionghua Sect.

original_text: 玄霄：言尽于此，如何行止，你自己想清楚！以凡人之躯承受神器的威力，定会付出代价！
translation: Xuanxiao: I've said all I need to. Think carefully about your course of action! A mortal body wielding the power of divine artifacts will surely pay a price!

original_text: 云天河：代价……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Pay a price?...

original_text: 慕容紫英：羲和剑还是认玄霄为主，一起往东海去了……
translation: Murong Ziying: Xihe Sword still recognizes Xuanxiao as its master, they went to the East Sea together...

original_text: 韩菱纱：玄霄和这把入魔之剑，不知是谁驾驭了谁……
translation: Han Lingsha: Xuanxiao and this demonic sword, I wonder who is controlling whom...

original_text: 云天河：天火！！菱纱、紫英，我们快御剑离开！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Heavenly fire!! Lingsha, Ziying, let's leave quickly by sword flight!

original_text: 慕容紫英：天火降下！快走！
translation: Murong Ziying: Heavenly fire has bugun! Go, quickly!

original_text: 慕容紫英：唔！……
translation: Murong Ziying: Mm!...

original_text: 韩菱纱：啊！……
translation: Han Lingsha: Ah!...

original_text: 云天河：菱纱！紫英！你们受伤了？！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Lingsha! Ziying! Are you injured?!

original_text: 韩菱纱：那是……
translation: Han Lingsha: That's...

original_text: 慕容紫英：……！！璇玑！
translation: Murong Ziying: ...!! Xuanji!

original_text: 韩菱纱：怎么会、怎么会这样？！璇玑她——
translation: Han Lingsha: How could, how could this be?! Xuanji-

original_text: 云天河：……紫英，璇玑她……已经没有气息了……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... Ziying! Xuanji... she already has no breath left...
Murong Ziying: ......... ...

original_text: 慕容紫英：…………我知道……我只是、只是不能相信……眼前这些都是真的…………
translation: Murong Ziying: ...... I know... I just, I just can't believe... that everything before my eyes is real...

original_text: 慕容紫英：……也许是我错了……我不该将璇玑留在琼华派，当日在卷云台要是带她一起走，她又怎会枉送性命！…………
translation: Murong Ziying: ... Perhaps I was wrong... I shouldn't have left Xuanji at Qionghua Sect. If I had taken her with me that day at Cloud Terrace, how could she have died in vain! ............

original_text: 韩菱纱：……我不明白……璇玑看起来并无外伤，又怎么会…………
translation: Han Lingsha: ... I don't understand... Xuanji doesn't seem to have any injuries, so how could she...

original_text: 慕容紫英：……琼华派脱离昆仑山，双剑的力量必然与地灵之力彼此激荡，像璇玑这般修为尚浅的弟子，若不能护住心脉，根本无以自保……
translation: Murong Ziying: ... Once Qionghua Sect separates from Kunlun Mountain, the power of the dual swords is bound to clash with the earth's spiritual energy. For disciples like Xuanji, whose cultivation is still shallow, if they cannot protect their heart meridian, they simply will die...

original_text: 韩菱纱：无以自保……为什么会这样……这，也是琼华派逆天而行、要遭受的天谴吗？！可是璇玑的年纪还那么小，她根本什么都没做……
translation: Han Lingsha: Cannot protect... Why is it like this... Is this also the heavenly punishment that Qionghua Sect must suffer for defying the heavens?! But Xuanji is still so young, she hasn't done anything at all...

original_text: 慕容紫英：……是啊，她年纪尚小，许多事情还不明白，又如何分辨是非曲直？……我却将她一人丢下，害了她……也愧对怀朔……
translation: Murong Ziying: ... Yes, she's still young and doesn't understand many things, so how can she distinguish right from wrong?... Yet I left her alone, harming her... and failing Huaishuo...

original_text: 韩菱纱：……不是的……紫英，你不要这样怪自己……要说错，琼华派飞升才是天大的错误，除了璇玑，不知还有多少弟子埋骨在冰雪之中……
translation: Han Lingsha: ...No... Ziying, don't blame yourself like this... If we're talking about mistakes, Qionghua Sect's ascension was the greatest error. Besides Xuanji, who knows how many disciples lie buried in the ice and snow...

original_text: 慕容紫英：…………
translation: Murong Ziying: ......

original_text: 韩菱纱：走吧……如果不快点阻止玄霄，或许还有祸事发生，还有人会失去最宝贵的性命……
translation: Han Lingsha: Let's go... If we don't stop Xuanxiao quickly, more disasters might happen, and more people could lose their precious lives...

original_text: 慕容紫英：……一切事了之后，我再来接璇玑……把她的骨灰一同送去怀朔的故乡，让他们死后亦能团聚……
translation: Murong Ziying: ... Once everything is settled, I will come back for Xuanji... to take her ashes to Huaishuo's hometown, so they can be reunited even in death...

original_text: 韩菱纱：天河，怎么了？……
translation: Han Lingsha: Tianhe, what's wrong? ...

original_text: 云天河：……璇玑的手里握着东西…………是我给怀朔的那个虫笼……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... Xuanji is holding something in her hand... it's the insect cage I gave Huaishuo...

original_text: 韩菱纱：虫笼？
translation: Han Lingsha: Insect cage?

original_text: 韩菱纱：……我想起来了，这儿……原本是怀朔的房间啊……
translation: Han Lingsha: ... I remember now. This place... used to be Huaishuo's room...

original_text: 韩菱纱：璇玑她……到死还守在怀朔住过的地方吗…………
translation: Han Lingsha: Xuanji... she stayed where Huaishuo lived until death...

original_text: 云天河：……梦璃说他们俩的感情很好很好……璇玑一定很想怀朔吧……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... Mengli said their feelings for each other were very, very deep... Xuanji must miss Huaishuo a lot...

original_text: 云天河：想一个人，却再也见不到她……我知道，那种时候心一定会很痛……比受了任何伤还要痛……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Missing someone but never being able to see them again... I know, the heart must ache terribly then... worse than any injury...

original_text: 云天河：现在还是不要进去了……
translation: Yun Tianhe: It's better not to go in now...

original_text: 云天河：好大的剑～～
translation: Yun Tianhe: What huge swords~~

original_text: 韩菱纱：你们不觉得奇怪吗？紫英明明说过这个地方不能靠近，可是这么重要，居然连一个看守的人都没有。
translation: Han Lingsha: Don't you think it's strange? Ziying clearly said this place is off-limits, yet it's so important, and there isn't even a single guard posted.

original_text: 云天河：听！这把剑又发出声音了！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Listen! This sword is making sounds again!

original_text: 韩菱纱：看来找对地方了，先进去看看再说！
translation: Han Lingsha: Looks like we found the right place, let's go in and see first!

original_text: 魁召：主人有命，琼华派一般弟子不可通过此地！
translation: Kuizhao: By the master's order, ordinary Qionghua Sect disciples may not pass!

original_text: 云天河：是石沉溪洞里那个怪物！长得一模一样！
translation: Yun Tianhe: It's that monster from Stone Sink Cave! Looks exactly the same!

original_text: 韩菱纱：不怕，反正这怪物害怕你的剑，快亮给他看，让他放我们过去！
translation: Han Lingsha: Don't be afraid. This monster is scared of your sword anyway. Show it to him quickly, so he lets us pass!

original_text: 云天河：好！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Okay!

original_text: 云天河：哈哈，你看这是什么！怕的话就快快消失！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Haha, look what this is! Scared? Then vanish quickly!

original_text: 魁召：主人有命，擅闯者杀无赦！
translation: Kuizhao: By the master's order, intruders will be slain without mercy!

original_text: 云天河：等等！你是不是没看清楚啊？！你看你看！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Wait! Didn't you see clearly?! Look, look!

original_text: 云天河：啊啊啊～你再仔细看看呀！喂——
translation: Yun Tianhe: Aahhh~ Look more carefully! Hey-

original_text: 韩菱纱：……看来就算长得一样，不同的符灵忌讳的东西也不同，他不怕天河的剑呢……
translation: Han Lingsha: ... It seems even if they look the same, different talisman spirits fear different things. He's not afraid of Tianhe's sword...

original_text: 柳梦璃：……这些灵的气很强，可见驱符的是个高手，这么强的气，即便一时消失了，过一段时间又会生聚而成。
translation: Liu Mengli: ... The spiritual energy here is very strong, indicating the talisman was activated by an expert. Such strong energy, even if it dissipates temporarily, will gather and regenerate after some time.

original_text: 韩菱纱：这就对了！所以这儿才没有其他人把守！
translation: Han Lingsha: That's it! That's why there are no other guards here!

original_text: 韩菱纱：嘻～害人家越来越想知道，禁地里到底有些什么。走，<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>进去瞧瞧！</colour>
translation: Han Lingsha: Hehe~ It just makes me more and more curious about what's actually inside the forbidden area. Come on,<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> let's go take a look!</colour>

original_text: 云天河：有扇门，我推开它！
translation: Yun Tianhe: There's a door, I'll push it open!

original_text: 柳梦璃：云公子，等一下……
translation: Liu Mengli: Yun, wait a moment...

original_text: 柳梦璃：这门似乎是被法力所封，用寻常方法打不开的。
translation: Liu Mengli: This door seems sealed by magical power, ordinary methods won't open it.

original_text: 韩菱纱：唔～法力……被梦璃一说，我倒觉得门上这个标志，像是对应什么东西，说不定就是开门的机关，可惜我们不知道是什么……
translation: Han Lingsha: Hmm~ magical power... now that Mengli mentions it, I think the symbol on this door corresponds to something. It might be the mechanism to open it, but unfortunately, we don't know what it is...

original_text: 云天河：我明白了～
translation: Yun Tianhe: I understand~

original_text: 韩菱纱：明白什么？
translation: Han Lingsha: Understand what?

original_text: 云天河：嘿嘿，试试看～
translation: Yun Tianhe: Hehe, let's try~

original_text: 韩菱纱：咦？对啊，这块玉——
translation: Han Lingsha: Huh? Right, this jade-

original_text: 云天河：哈哈，猜对了！上面的图案是一样的～
translation: Yun Tianhe: Haha, guessed right! The patterns on them are the same~

original_text: 韩菱纱：瞧你得意的……不过你爹留下的玉，居然能打开琼华派禁地的大门，越想越不可思议……
translation: Han Lingsha: Look at you, so smug... But the jade your father left can actually open Qionghua Sect's forbidden area gate-the more I think about it, the more unbelievable it seems.

original_text: 云天河：呵呵，一定是爹在保佑我，让我来这里～
translation: Yun Tianhe: Hehe, it must be Father's spirit watching over me, guiding me here~

original_text: 柳梦璃：<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>进去看看吧，</colour><dc0>或许真是云叔保佑，冥冥之中自有天意……</dc0>
translation: Liu Mengli:<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> Let's go in and take a look,</colour><dc0> perhaps it truly is Uncle Yun's blessing, with fate's will at work in the unseen...</dc0>

original_text: 韩菱纱：那个人……真的太奇怪了，怎么会被封在冰里呢？
translation: Han Lingsha: That person... is really strange, how could he be sealed in ice?

original_text: 柳梦璃：他……也许是个很可怜的人，我还从来没有感觉过一个人的灵，像那样孤单、寂寥，简直像要把身边所有的一切都冰结了，实在太痛苦了……
translation: Liu Mengli: He... might be a very pitiful person. I've never felt a person's spirit so lonely, so desolate-as if freezing everything around him. It's truly too painful...

original_text: 云天河：那，我们以后过来多陪陪他不就好了？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Then, we can just come visit him more often in the future, right?

original_text: 慕容紫英：师叔之事，我们做后辈的，不必妄加猜测！
translation: Murong Ziying: Regarding our Martial Uncle 's affairs, we juniors should not speculate recklessly!

original_text: 慕容紫英：倒是你们几个，究竟如何打开禁地石门的？
translation: Murong Ziying: But you few, how exactly did you open the stone door to the forbidden area?

original_text: 云天河：很简单啊，用这块玉就打开了～
translation: Yun Tianhe: It's easy, I opened it with this jade~

original_text: 慕容紫英：……！这玉哪里来的？
translation: Murong Ziying: ...! Where did this jade come from?

original_text: 云天河：是在我爹和我娘的墓室里找到的，就一直带身边了……
translation: Yun Tianhe: I found it in my father and mother's tomb chamber, and I've kept it with me ever since...

original_text: 慕容紫英：……
translation: Murong Ziying: ...

original_text: 韩菱纱：紫英，你之前说没听过云天青这个人，铁定是骗人的吧？
translation: Han Lingsha: Ziying, you said earlier you hadn't heard of Yun Tianqing-you were definitely lying, right?

original_text: 韩菱纱：玄霄明明说了～天河的爹娘都做过琼华派的弟子。
translation: Han Lingsha: Xuanxiao clearly said~ Tianhe's parents were both disciples of Qionghua Sect.

original_text: 慕容紫英：我确实不知，何必欺瞒。
translation: Murong Ziying: I truly do not know, why would I deceive you?

original_text: 韩菱纱：干嘛一脸严肃，你、你可别想阳奉阴违，处罚我们哦。
translation: Han Lingsha: Why so serious? You... you better not try to punish us while pretending to obey.

original_text: 慕容紫英：我已答应师叔不再追究，自会做到。
translation: Murong Ziying: I promised Martial Uncle I wouldn't pursue it further, and I'll keep my word.

original_text: 慕容紫英：时候不早了，你们几个回房去吧。
translation: Murong Ziying: It's getting late, you all should go back to your rooms.

original_text: 韩菱纱：啊，险些忘了！还要送水给月牙村的人！怎么办，天都快亮了！
translation: Han Lingsha: Ah, I almost forgot! I still need to deliver water to the people of Crescent Village! What to do, it's almost dawn!

original_text: 慕容紫英：……不必去了。
translation: Murong Ziying: ... No need to go.

original_text: 韩菱纱：为什么？水灵珠又没拿到！
translation: Han Lingsha: Why? We didn't get the Water Spirit Pearl again!

original_text: 云天河：对，我也要去！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Right, I'm going too!

original_text: 慕容紫英：不必。我已命弟子每日送足够的水和食物给村民。
translation: Murong Ziying: No need. I've already ordered disciples to deliver sufficient water and food to the villagers daily.

original_text: 慕容紫英：村长留恋故土，不愿离去，但掌门又是心意已决，或许……妖界之事过后，她会愿意借出水灵珠……如今也只能静观其变，你们不要莽撞行事。
translation: Murong Ziying: The village chief is attached to his homeland and unwilling to leave, but the sect leader is also determined in her decision. Perhaps... after the matter with the yao realm is settled, she might be willing to lend the Water Spirit Pearl... For now, we can only wait and see. Do not act rashly.

original_text: 韩菱纱：咦咦咦？小紫英～你是个大好人嘛，想得比我们周全，那你刚才怎么不讲清楚，让别人误会～
translation: Han Lingsha: Huh? Little Ziying~ You're such a good person, thinking more thoroughly than us. Why didn't you explain clearly earlier, letting others misunderstand~

original_text: 慕容紫英：我只做应做之事，无须向任何人解释。
translation: Murong Ziying: I only do what must be done, and owe no explanation to anyone.

original_text: 云天河：也对，有些事只管做就好了，干嘛要说那么多？
translation: Yun Tianhe: True, some things you just do. Why talk so much about them?

original_text: 韩菱纱：受不了……男孩子就是粗枝大叶的，对吧，梦璃？
translation: Han Lingsha: Unbelievable... Boys are so careless, right, Mengli?

original_text: 柳梦璃：嗯，我觉得这样也不错啊。
translation: Liu Mengli: Mm, I think this is quite nice too.

original_text: 慕容紫英：不必在此多话，通通回房去歇下。
translation: Murong Ziying: No need for more talk here, everyone go back to your rooms and rest.

original_text: 韩菱纱：先等一下～
translation: Han Lingsha: Wait a moment~

original_text: 韩菱纱：听其他弟子说，紫英你喜欢宝剑，还有和宝剑相关的东西，这玩意我一直带在身边，用不上也可惜了，不如送给你吧～
translation: Han Lingsha: I heard from other disciples that you like swords, Ziying, and things related to swords. I've been carrying this thing with me, and it's a shame not to use it. Why don't I give it to you~

original_text: 慕容紫英：……九龙缚丝剑穗？！
translation: Murong Ziying: ... Nine-Dragon Tassel?!

original_text: 韩菱纱：哇，你果然识货！这确实是选了万年冰蚕丝，再用“九龙缚丝”的特殊手法结成的剑穗，虽然看起来不是珠玉在外，但绝对是个好东西。
translation: Han Lingsha: Wow, you really know your stuff! This sword tassel is indeed made from ten-thousand-year ice silk, woven using the special 'Nine Dragons Binding Silk' technique. Though it doesn't look flashy, it's absolutely a fine item.

original_text: 慕容紫英：……如此贵重之物，唯有皇族方能持有，你如何得来？
translation: Murong Ziying: Such a precious item can only be held by royalty-how did you obtain it?

original_text: 韩菱纱：别管那些有的没的，你拿着就是。
translation: Han Lingsha: Never mind all that, you just take it.

original_text: 韩菱纱：人说拜师有大礼，才显得诚心，你怎么说也是师叔，我们还没送过你什么东西呢！
translation: Han Lingsha: They say when you become a disciple you should give a grand gift to show sincerity. You're our Martial Uncle after all, and we haven't given you anything yet!

original_text: 慕容紫英：琼华派乃是修仙清静之地，何来此等世俗规矩？
translation: Murong Ziying: Qionghua Sect is a place of purity for cultivating immortality. How can such worldly rules exist here?

original_text: 慕容紫英：何况此物贵重，我不能收。
translation: Murong Ziying: Moreover, this item is too valuable; I cannot accept it.

original_text: 韩菱纱：唉……就知道你是一板一眼的人……俗话说宝剑配英雄，香花赠美人，你拿着不是刚刚好？
translation: Han Lingsha: Sigh... I knew you were a stickler for rules... As the saying goes, a fine sword matches a hero, fragrant flowers suit a beauty. Isn't it just perfect for you to have it?

original_text: 慕容紫英：不必多言，我已说过不收。
translation: Murong Ziying: No need to say more, I've already said I won't accept it.

original_text: 韩菱纱：好嘛……那你就当帮这剑穗找到原本相配的宝剑好了，我得到它的时候，只有剑穗，剑早就不知所踪了，要是能物归原处，也算一件功德吧？
translation: Han Lingsha: Alright then... Just think of it as helping this sword tassel find its originally matched sword. When I got it, there was only the tassel; the sword had long been missing. If it can be returned to its rightful place, that's also a good deed, right?

original_text: 韩菱纱：我听说琼华派藏剑上千，说不定其中就有那把剑呢。
translation: Han Lingsha: I heard Qionghua Sect has thousands of stored swords, maybe that sword is among them.

original_text: 慕容紫英：…………若是如此，我暂且替你保管，看看能不能找到原本的那支剑……
translation: Murong Ziying: ...... If that's the case, I'll keep it for you temporarily and see if I can find the original sword...

original_text: 韩菱纱：嘻嘻，太好了！
translation: Han Lingsha: Hehe, that's great!

original_text: 慕容紫英：……你既然能寻到剑穗，也算与它有缘。找到原本的配剑之后，若是掌门允许，我自会一同交付给你。
translation: Murong Ziying: ... Since you managed to find the sword tassel, it seems you have a connection with it. After finding the original matching sword, if the sect leader permits, I will naturally deliver it to you together.

original_text: 韩菱纱：给我？不用、不用，你尽管留着！
translation: Han Lingsha: Give it to me? No need, no need, you keep it!

original_text: 慕容紫英：……好了，<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>通通回房去，</colour><dc0>若是错过明日早课，我定不轻饶！</dc0>
translation: Murong Ziying: ...Alright,<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> Everyone back to your rooms,</colour><dc0> If you miss tomorrow's morning lecture, I will not go easy on you!</dc0>

original_text: 韩菱纱：哼，凶巴巴～
translation: Han Lingsha: Hmph, so fierce~

original_text: 韩菱纱：不过呢，至少他把剑穗收下了，嘻！
translation: Han Lingsha: But at least he accepted the sword tassel, hee!

original_text: 云天河：菱纱，我不明白，你不是说别把师叔当成师叔吗？可你刚才又说，因为他是师叔，才送他东西……？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Lingsha, I don't understand. Didn't you say not to treat Martial Uncle as a Martial Uncle? But you just said you gave him gifts because he is your Martial Uncle ...?

original_text: 韩菱纱：笨，所谓吃人的嘴软、拿人的手短，紫英拿了我的东西，以后就不太会对我们凶了，多少总要有点顾忌吧？
translation: Han Lingsha: Silly, as the saying goes, 'If you eat someone's food, your mouth gets soft; if you take someone's gift, your hands get short'. Since Ziying took my things, he won't be as harsh on us in the future; he'll have to show some consideration, right?

original_text: 韩菱纱：而且据我观察，小紫英八成是那种刀子嘴豆腐心的人，对付他用这招最有效了～我也是想让往后日子好过点嘛。
translation: Han Lingsha: And from what I've observed, little Ziying is probably the type with a sharp tongue but a soft heart. This tactic works best on him~ I just want to make life easier for us later.

original_text: 云天河：哦……真难懂……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Oh... that's really hard to understand...

original_text: 韩菱纱：……也没指望你能懂…………
translation: Han Lingsha: ... Didn't expect you to understand anyway...

original_text: 韩菱纱：<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>回房、回房，</colour><dc0>我都睏了。</dc0>
translation: Han Lingsha: <colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>Back to the room, back to the room,</colour><dc0> I'm sleepy.</dc0>

original_text: 柳梦璃：嗯。
translation: Liu Mengli: Mm.

original_text: 慕容紫英：天河，师叔传你的心法……
translation: Murong Ziying: Tianhe, the cultivation method that Martial Uncle taught you...

original_text: 云天河：怎么？
translation: Yun Tianhe: What?

original_text: 慕容紫英：……各人体质不同，故适合修习的心法也不尽相同，长老传授菱纱心法一事姑且不论，一般而言，所学甚杂未必是好事。
translation: Murong Ziying: ... Each person's constitution differs, so the suitable mental cultivation methods vary. Setting aside the elder teaching Lingsha's method, generally speaking, learning too many different things isn't necessarily good.

original_text: 云天河：不是好事？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Isn't necessarily good?

original_text: 云天河：不会啊，大哥自己想出来的心法比琼华派的功夫厉害多了！练过之后身体变得好轻，心里也会觉得很平静、很舒坦。
translation: Yun Tianhe: No, that's not true. The cultivation method Big Brother devised himself is way more powerful than Qionghua Sect's techniques! After practicing, my body feels incredibly light, and my mind becomes very calm and comfortable.

original_text: 慕容紫英：……难怪，你修为进境非同一般。
translation: Murong Ziying: No wonder, your cultivation progress is extraordinary.

original_text: 云天河：掌门又不教我们厉害的功夫，我跟大哥学几招应该没什么吧？
translation: Yun Tianhe: The sect leader doesn't teach us powerful skills, so learning a few moves from big brother shouldn't be a problem, right?

original_text: 云天河：反正我也不怎么想做神仙，只要变更强就好了，不然也帮不上大哥和你。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Anyway, I don't really want to be an immortal, just getting stronger is enough, otherwise I can't help Big Brother and you.

original_text: 慕容紫英：……随你吧。
translation: Murong Ziying: ...as you wish.

original_text: 慕容紫英：天河，这些日子你多注意菱纱和梦璃，刚才师叔提及她们，似乎有未尽之言，我不太放心……
translation: Murong Ziying: Tianhe, these days, pay extra attention to Lingsha and Mengli. Just now, Martial Uncle  mentioned them but seemed to hold back some words. I'm rather uneasy...

original_text: 云天河：有吗？那我去找玄霄问清楚——
translation: Yun Tianhe: Did he? Then I'll go ask Xuanxiao to make it clear-

original_text: 慕容紫英：不必了……这几日奔波劳顿，<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>先在派中歇息一晚，</colour><dc0>明日再去找剩余两件寒器。</dc0>
translation: Murong Ziying: No need... We've been traveling hard these past few days.<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> Rest at the sect for tonight first,</colour><dc0> and search for the remaining two Cold Artifacts tomorrow.</dc0>

original_text: 云天河：（……紫英是不高兴了？可又不见他说出来……）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (...Is Ziying unhappy? But he doesn't say it...)

original_text: 云天河：（……大哥今天真是有些古怪，说的话也让人听不太懂……）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (...Big brother is really acting strange today, saying things that are hard to understand...)

original_text: 云天河：（……算了，想不明白就不想！）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (...Forget it, if I can't figure it out, I won't think about it!)

original_text: 云天河：（不知道梦璃回来了没有？<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>我先回房休息一下，</colour><dc0>等她回来，就喊上菱纱，一起去找紫英……）</dc0>
translation: Yun Tianhe: (Wonder if Mengli is back yet?<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> I'll head back to my room and rest a bit,</colour><dc0> when she returns, I'll call Lingsha, and we'll go find Ziying together...)</dc0>

original_text: 云天河：（唉，但愿真像大哥说的那样，紫英还会跟我们和好……）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (Sigh, I hope it's really like Big Brother said, that Ziying will make up with us...)

original_text: 韩菱纱：咦？禁地入口怎会有其他人？
translation: Han Lingsha: Huh? How could there be others at the forbidden area gate?

original_text: 慕容紫英：元亦，你们在这里做什么？
translation: Murong Ziying: Yuanyi, what are you doing here?

original_text: 元亦：是紫英师兄！
translation: Yuanyi: It's Martial Brother Ziying!

original_text: 元亦：掌门命我们从今日起镇守禁地，未经允许，不得让任何人入内，她自己似乎也要在禁地内闭关了。
translation: Yuanyi: Sect Leader ordered us to guard the forbidden area from today onward. No one is allowed inside without permission. She herself seems to be going to seclusion there.

original_text: 慕容紫英：这等时候，掌门却要闭关？
translation: Murong Ziying: At such a time, the Sect Leader wants seclusion?

original_text: 元亦：是啊，掌门说妖界或许是有了死守之心，才会在入口布下结界，但我们一日不攻进去，妖界却也未必会主动攻过来。掌门打算先闭关修炼一段日子，似乎另有秘法。
translation: Yuanyi: Indeed. Sect leader said the yao realm might be determined to defend, hence the barrier at the entrance. But if we don't attack, they may not strike first. Sect leader plans to seclude herself for cultivation, as if she has a secret method in mind.

original_text: 云天河：那我大哥呢？他还在禁地里吗？！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Then what about my big brother? Is he still in the Forbidden Area?!

original_text: 元亦：你大哥？谁啊？
translation: Yuanyi: Your big brother? Who?

original_text: 云天河：我自己进去看！
translation: Yun Tianhe: I'll go in and look myself!

original_text: 元亦：慢着！你——
translation: Yuanyi: Hold on! You-

original_text: 夙瑶：何事喧哗？！
translation: Suyao: What's all this noise?!

original_text: 慕容紫英：弟子参见掌门！
translation: Murong Ziying: Disciple pays respects to Sect Leader!

original_text: 夙瑶：哦？几天不见，紫英你竟已目无尊长了？
translation: Suyao: Oh? A few days apart, and you, Ziying, already show no respect for elders?

original_text: 慕容紫英：弟子不敢！
translation: Murong Ziying: This disciple dares not!

original_text: 夙瑶：不敢？！那你们几人跑来禁地，所为何来？
translation: Suyao: Dares not?! Then what brings you few to the forbidden area?

original_text: 云天河：我们是来找我大哥、找玄霄的！
translation: Yun Tianhe: We're here to find my big brother, to find Xuanxiao!

original_text: 夙瑶：玄霄？哼，他不会见你们。
translation: Suyao: Xuanxiao? Hmph, he won't see you.

original_text: 云天河：为什么？你为什么会在禁地里？你把我大哥怎么了？！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Why? Why are you in the forbidden area? What did you do to my big brother?!

original_text: 夙瑶：你口口声声称玄霄大哥，看不出他还颇有办法，让你这么死心塌地。
translation: Suyao: You keep calling Xuanxiao Big Brother. I can't believe he's so capable, making you so devoted.

original_text: 云天河：你……什么意思？
translation: Yun Tianhe: You... what do you mean?

original_text: 夙瑶：可悲，还想不明白吗？
translation: Suyao: Pitiful, you still don't understand?

original_text: 夙瑶：今日一切都是我与玄霄策谋，而你们，不过是棋盘中的几颗小小棋子。
translation: Suyao: Everything today was planned by me and Xuanxiao. You are merely a few small pieces on the chessboard.

original_text: 慕容紫英：……！
translation: Murong Ziying: ...!

original_text: 韩菱纱：……！
translation: Han Lingsha: ...!

original_text: 云天河：不可能！你胡说！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Impossible! You're lying!

original_text: 夙瑶：玄霄身为羲和剑之主，在望舒剑被你们带至山门时，自然有所感应，有他告知，我才会见机收你们入门。
translation: Suyao: As the master of Xihe Sword, Xuanxiao naturally sensed when Wangshu Sword was brought to the Sect Gate by you. It was he who informed me, so I seized the opportunity to accept you into the sect.

original_text: 夙瑶：不然就凭你们在禁地数次大摇大摆地出入，我又怎会不知？
translation: Suyao: Otherwise, with you swaggering in and out of the forbidden area multiple times, how could I not know?

original_text: 韩菱纱：……所以、所以你根本不是靠什么占术，才知道有故人之子上山……
translation: Han Lingsha: ... So... so you didn't actually rely on divination to know that the child of an old friend was coming up the mountain...

original_text: 慕容紫英：掌门，弟子斗胆。弟子实在不解，难道如此做，只是为了取回望舒剑？此剑乃本门之物，若是向天河索要，他自然也会归还……
translation: Murong Ziying: Sect Leader, this disciple is bold. I truly don't understand. Could it be that all this is just to retrieve Wangshu Sword? This sword belongs to our sect. If we asked Tianhe for it, he would naturally return it...

original_text: 夙瑶：你莫弄错，我要的不是望舒剑，而是再度苏醒过来的望舒剑。
translation: Suyao: Don't misunderstand, what I want isn't Wangshu Sword, but the awakened Wangshu Sword.

original_text: 慕容紫英：弟子驽钝……
translation: Murong Ziying: This disciple is dull-witted...

original_text: 夙瑶：不懂便罢，如今妖界虽然按兵不动，但大敌当前，岂可轻忽？紫英你还是回去多多修行，勿要被杂念所扰。
translation: Suyao: If you don't understand, so be it. Although the yao realm is holding back for now, with a great enemy at hand, how can we be careless? Ziying, you should return and focus on cultivation-don't let distractions trouble you.

original_text: 夙瑶：至于其他几人就自行下山去吧，最好将山上的一切通通忘记。
translation: Suyao: As for the others, you may leave the mountain on your own, best to forget everything about Kunlun.

original_text: 云天河：等等！我不懂你的意思！你说大哥骗了我们？可是大哥为什么要骗我们？！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Wait! I don't understand! You say Big Brother deceived us? But why would Big Brother deceive us?!

original_text: 云天河：他、他不是我爹娘的师兄吗？
translation: Yun Tianhe: He, wasn't he my parents' Martial Brother?

original_text: 夙瑶：……师兄？那又如何？
translation: Suyao: ... Martial Brother? So what?

original_text: 夙瑶：你可知道？玄霄恨云天青、夙玉入骨，没有杀了你，已算手下留情！
translation: Suyao: Do you know? Xuanxiao detests Yun Tianqing and Suyu to the bone. Not killing you is already an act of mercy!

original_text: 云天河：你……说什么？怎么可能？！
translation: Yun Tianhe: What... What did you say? How could that be?!

original_text: 夙瑶：看样子，不与你说清楚，你是不会死心的。
translation: Suyao: It seems I must make things clear, or you won't give up.

original_text: 夙瑶：元亦，去将本派秘卷取来。
translation: Suyao: Yuanyi, go fetch the sect's secret scrolls.

original_text: 元亦：是。
translation: Yuanyi: Yes.

original_text: 夙瑶：元亦，我命你将卷轴上所记，一字不差地念出来。
translation: Suyao: Yuanyi, I order you to read out exactly what is recorded on the scroll, word for word.

original_text: 元亦：……！掌门，这……
translation: Yuanyi: ...! Sect Leader, this...

original_text: 夙瑶：念！
translation: Suyao: Read!

original_text: 元亦：是！
translation: Yuanyi: Yes!

original_text: 元亦：“吾派第二十代掌门道胤真人以惊世之才，苦修终年，于晚年参悟以阴阳双剑合合之力，携派中弟子飞升之秘法。自此，穷三代之人力、物力，终成羲和、望舒双剑。”
translation: Yuanyi: Our sect's 20th-generation leader, the Daoyin Perfected Person, with his extraordinary talent and lifelong cultivation, comprehended in his later years the secret of ascension through the combined power of the Yin and Yang swords, enabling disciples to ascend. From then on, our sect devoted three generations of manpower and resources, finally forging the dual swords Xihe and Wangshu.

original_text: 元亦：“阴阳双剑需以‘人剑相合’之法修炼，数载方有所成。而双剑飞升之法，必辅强盛灵力，非人世苦修所能及。道胤真人不愧思虑深远，曾夜观星象，占一奇地，灵气充沛异常，应能为吾派所用。奈何此为妖界，并不易与……”
translation: Yuanyi: "The Yin-Yang dual swords require cultivation through the 'unity of man and sword' method, taking years to achieve mastery. As for the method of ascending with the dual swords, it must be aided by immense spiritual power, unattainable through mere mortal cultivation. Master Daoyin was truly far-sighted. He once observed the stars at night and divined a wondrous land, exceptionally abundant in spiritual energy, which should be usable by our sect. However, this is a yao realm, not easy to deal with..."

original_text: 元亦：“……吾派弟子玄霄、夙玉资质上佳，乃被选为双剑宿体。历三载，逢妖界以十九年为一周，再度降临。玄霄、夙玉合双剑之力网缚妖界，令其不可动弹，以引取极大灵力。而妖界顽抗，吾派与之力斗，第二十四代掌门太清真人不幸为妖孽所害，引发战局旷日持久，惨烈非常。”
translation: Yuanyi: "...Our sect's disciples Xuanxiao and Suyu possessed exceptional aptitude and were chosen as hosts for the dual swords. After three years, the yao realm, which returns every nineteen years, descended once more. Xuanxiao and Suyu combined the power of the dual swords to bind the yao realm, rendering it immobile, to draw immense spiritual power. Yet the yao realm resisted fiercely. Our sect battled them, and the 24th generation sect leader, Taiqing Perfected Person, was unfortunately slain by the evil creature, leading to a prolonged and extremely brutal conflict."

original_text: 元亦：“关键之时，望舒剑宿体夙玉心生怯意，更因私情，与其师兄云天青携剑出逃。羲和剑宿体玄霄独力难支，令妖界脱离昆仑而去。此一役吾派伤亡过百，其中掌门太清真人、掌门首徒玄震、长老——”
translation: Yuanyi: "At the critical moment, Wangshu Sword's host, Suyu, lost heart and driven by personal feelings, fled with her Martial Brother Yun Tianqing, taking the sword. Xihe Sword's host, Xuanxiao, struggled alone, allowing the yao realm to break free from Kunlun and escape. In this battle, our sect suffered over a hundred casualties, including Sect Leader Taiqing Perfected Person, Head Disciple Xuanzhen, Elder-"

original_text: 夙瑶：够了。
translation: Suyao: Enough.

original_text: 元亦：是……
translation: Yuanyi: Yes...
Yun Tianhe: ......

original_text: 韩菱纱：怎么、怎么会这样……
translation: Han Lingsha: How... how could this be...

original_text: 夙瑶：云天河，这下你再无疑惑了吧？
translation: Suyao: Yun Tianhe, now you have no more doubts, right?

original_text: 夙瑶：若非云天青、夙玉临阵脱逃，玄霄又怎会运功过度？且他无望舒剑支持，内息大乱，才终致阳炎侵体，变为后来的模样！
translation: Suyao: If Yun Tianqing and Suyu hadn't deserted, would Xuanxiao have overexerted himself? Without Wangshu Sword's support, his inner energy went chaotic, leading to the Yang Flame invading his body, turning him into what he became!

original_text: 云天河：大哥……他……他是被我爹和我娘害的……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Big brother... He... he was harmed by my parents...

original_text: 韩菱纱：天河，你别理她！不知从哪里找来的卷轴，随便念一念，就要别人相信啊！如果这些都是真的，那这卷轴为何不敢放在经楼里？
translation: Han Lingsha: Tianhe, don't listen to her! Where did she find that scroll, just reciting it casually and expecting others to believe it! If all this were true, why wouldn't this scroll dare to be kept in the scripture library?

original_text: 夙瑶：派中秘辛，岂是人人可知？何况有你妙手空空，万一卷轴被你所见，那我与玄霄不是功亏一篑？
translation: Suyao: Sect secrets are not for everyone to know. And with your nimble fingers, if you saw the scroll, wouldn't all my and Xuanxiao's efforts be in vain?

original_text: 韩菱纱：你……！！
translation: Han Lingsha: You...!!

original_text: 慕容紫英：掌门，弟子还是不明，无论如何，本派只是要将望舒剑取回，又何必……何必如此对待天河他们？
translation: Murong Ziying: Sect Leader, this disciple still doesn't understand. No matter what, our sect only aims to retrieve Wangshu Sword, so why... why treat Tianhe and the others this way?

original_text: 夙瑶：大胆！你有此一问，是觉得我曾错待他们？
translation: Suyao: How bold! Asking such a question, do you think I wronged them?

original_text: 夙瑶：云天河等人入门以来，我命你尽心传授心法，如今令他们下山，也不以驱逐之名，我自问待他们已是不薄。
translation: Suyao: Since Yun Tianhe and the others joined the sect, I ordered you to diligently teach them cultivation methods. Even now, sending them down the mountain isn't framed as an expulsion. I believe I've treated them fairly.

original_text: 云天河：我、我还是不信……你让我见大哥一面！
translation: Yun Tianhe: I, I still don't believe it... Let me see big brother!

original_text: 夙瑶：……我说过，玄霄不会见你。
translation: Suyao: ... I told you, Xuanxiao will not see you.

original_text: 夙瑶：他此时正运功调息，不可被打扰。何况，真的令你与他相对，你又如何言语？玄霄未因前事报复，已是难得，难道非要引出他旧恨，弄到不可收拾的地步？
translation: Suyao: He is currently meditating and channeling his energy; he must not be disturbed. Moreover, even if you were to face him, what would you say? Xuanxiao has not sought revenge for past grievances, which is already rare. Must you provoke his old hatred and push things to an irreparable point?

original_text: 云天河：我……
translation: Yun Tianhe: I...

original_text: 夙瑶：我并非危言耸听，你好自为之！
translation: Suyao: I'm not exaggerating the danger; you'd better be careful!

original_text: 夙瑶：元亦！我要入禁地闭关！你带人在此守好，绝不可让人闯入！
translation: Suyao: Yuanyi! I'm entering seclusion in the forbidden area! You guard here with others, absolutely no one may enter!

original_text: 元亦：是！掌门！
translation: Yuanyi: Yes! Sect Leader!

original_text: 韩菱纱：……天河，你还好吗？……
translation: Han Lingsha: ...Tianhe, are you alright?...

original_text: 云天河：我、我也不知道，要是真像掌门说的那样，是我爹娘害了大哥……我又该怎么办？
translation: Yun Tianhe: I... I don't know either. If what the Sect Leader said is true, that it was my parents who harmed Big Brother... what should I do then?

original_text: 韩菱纱：振作一点，天河！你别听信掌门的一面之辞！再说梦璃还下落不明，等着我们去弄清楚真相！
translation: Han Lingsha: Cheer up, Tianhe! Don't just believe the Sect Leader's one-sided story! Besides, Mengli is still missing, waiting for us to uncover the truth!

original_text: 云天河：梦璃……大哥……怎么会……怎么所有事都变得这么乱……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Mengli... Big Brother... how could... why has everything become such a mess...

original_text: 韩菱纱：天河……
translation: Han Lingsha: Tianhe...

original_text: 云天河：菱纱……也许我错了，我真的不该下山，真的真的不该下山……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Lingsha... Maybe I was wrong, I really shouldn't have left Qingluan Peak, really, really shouldn't have...

original_text: 韩菱纱：……或许吧……你说的对，许多事情、知道了……还不如不知道……
translation: Han Lingsha: ... Perhaps... You're right. Many things... it's better not to know than to know...

original_text: 韩菱纱：我……对不起你……
translation: Han Lingsha: I... I'm sorry...

original_text: 韩菱纱：……不如，我们硬闯进去，问过玄霄，就什么都清楚了！
translation: Han Lingsha: ... How about we force our way in and ask Xuanxiao? Then everything will be clear!

original_text: 云天河：不！我、我不想这样，掌门说大哥正在运功，不可以被打扰……而且、而且我根本不知道要问他什么……

original_text: 韩菱纱：天河，你……

original_text: 云天河：爹和娘害了大哥……真的吗？我该怎么办？

original_text: 慕容紫英：……禁地这条路已是不通了，<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>我们不如去找青阳、重光两位长老</colour><dc0>。无论玄霄师叔之事，还是梦璃之事，或许长老都会有些办法可想……</dc0>
translation: Murong Ziying: ...There is no solution from Forbidden Area, perhaps we should seek Elders Qingyang and Chongguang. They might have ideas for both Martial Uncle Xuanxiao's situation and Mengli's matter...

original_text: 韩菱纱：……紫英，掌门都已经让我和天河下山了，你……还要跟我们一起吗？

original_text: 慕容紫英：……我并非不信掌门的话，但是也不能丢下你们不管，就算天河的爹娘……那些事也不该由他来背负……

original_text: 慕容紫英：何况，梦璃失踪之事也要弄清楚原由。

original_text: 韩菱纱：……谢谢你，天河现在这样，有你一起，总好过我一个人陪着他……

original_text: 慕容紫英：……走吧。
translation: Murong Ziying: ...Let's go.

original_text: 韩菱纱：天河，我们走吧。
translation: Han Lingsha: Tianhe, let's go.

original_text: 云天河：嗯……

original_text: 云天河：不过……说来说去，都怪昨晚山猪叫太凶，害得人直到半夜还睡不着，睡着了又醒不了……

original_text: 云天河：唉～春天早过了，也不晓得它们在乱叫个啥？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Sigh~ Spring is long over, no idea what they're grunting about?

original_text: 小山猪：哼唧～哼唧～

original_text: 云天河：小猪～小猪～小肥猪～你叫再多声“哦咿”也没用，马上把你烤熟了当供品！

original_text: 云天河：呵呵，爹看到香喷喷的肉，心里铁定高兴……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Hehe, Father would definitely be happy to see such delicious-smelling meat...

original_text: 云天河：爹以前嘱咐过的，早晚三柱香……你不知道他发起脾气来多可怕……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Father instructed this before: three incense sticks morning and night... You don't know how scary he gets when angry...

original_text: 云天河：爹，早上没点的三柱香，孩儿也补上了，还另加了三柱呢～
translation: Yun Tianhe: Father, the three incense sticks I didn't light this morning, I've made up for them, plus three more~

original_text: 云天河：……爹，你会原谅孩儿吧？
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... Father, you'll forgive your child, right?
Yun Tianhe: (...one...two...)
Yun Tianhe: (...Three...)

original_text: 云天河：哈哈，看来爹是原谅孩儿了，孩儿这就去烤山猪啦！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Haha, seems Father has forgiven his child. I'll go roast the boar now!
??: Roar~ roar~

original_text: 云天河：什么声音？！……是山猪？
translation: Yun Tianhe: What's that sound?! ... is it a wild boar?

original_text: 云天河：这倒好！抓一只还引一只，哈哈～

original_text: 云天河：山猪……在那边——

original_text: 云天河：（爹交代过，那山洞不让进的……我得马上跟去看看！）
