original_text: 云天河：好！<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>回房拿弓，顺便猎山猪！</colour>
translation: Yun Tianhe: Okay!<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>Go back to the room to get the bow, and hunt wild boar while at it!</colour>

original_text: 云天河：（呵呵，八成是小山猪的叫声把它引来了，早上梦见吃烤全猪果然是好兆头～）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (Hehe, probably the little boar's calls attracted it. Dreaming of eating roast whole pig this morning was indeed a good omen~)

original_text: 云天河：（哈哈，今天这顿烤全猪是吃定了～）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (Haha, today's roast whole pig is definitely mine~)

original_text: 云天河：哟嚯～～～
translation: Yun Tianhe: Yoho~~~

original_text: 小山猪：哦咿～哦咿～哦咿咿咿咿咿咿咿～
translation: Little Boar: Oink~ oink~ Oiiiiiiiiiiiiii~

original_text: 云天河：喝！——喝！——喝！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Hah!-Hah!-Hah!

original_text: 云天河：哟嚯～三百下练完了！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Yoho~ Finished three hundred reps!

original_text: 云天河：……咦？爹呢？
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... Huh? Where's Father?

original_text: 云天河：爹……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Father...

original_text: 云天青：……夙玉，你看这云海雾松，当真是美不胜收，只是这世上没有了你，即使再有千般美景，却也无趣得很。
translation: Yun Tianqing: ... Suyu, look at this sea of clouds and rime-covered pines, truly breathtakingly beautiful. It's just that with you gone from this world, even if there were a thousand more such scenes, they'd all be utterly joyless.

original_text: 云天青：呵呵，这道理我也是近些日子才想明白，如今我大限将至，反而觉得心里舒坦许多。待我死后，就同你合葬在石沉溪洞。
translation: Yun Tianqing: Hehe, I only recently came to understand this truth. Now that my time is near, I actually feel much more at ease. After I die, I will be buried with you in Stone Sink Cave.

original_text: 云天青：石沉溪洞……洞悉尘世……哈哈哈，这世上又有几人真能做到，求个问心无愧已是很不容易了……
translation: Yun Tianqing: Stone Sink Cave... 'Cave' as in 'see through' the mortal world... Hahaha, how many in this world can truly achieve that? Seeking a clear conscience is already hard enough...

original_text: 云天青：…………天河，我交代你的三百下挥剑都练完了？
translation: Yun Tianqing: ...Tianhe, have you finished the three hundred sword swings I assigned you?

original_text: 云天河：练、练完了。
translation: Yun Tianhe: D-done practicing.

original_text: 云天青：好小子，什么不学，学起偷看偷听来了！你当爹和你猎的那些兔子一样，耳朵不灵便呐？
translation: Yun Tianqing: You little rascal, not learning anything proper, learning to peek and eavesdrop! You think your father's ears are as dull as the rabbits you hunt?

original_text: 云天河：不是啊，爹！孩儿、孩儿肚子饿，想叫你一起吃饭。
translation: Yun Tianhe: No, Father! Your son... your son is hungry, wanted to call you to eat together.

original_text: 云天青：吃吃吃！你这野小子除了又吃又睡又玩，还会想什么？
translation: Yun Tianqing: Eat, eat, eat! You wild kid, besides eating, sleeping, and playing, what else do you think about?

original_text: 云天河：呵呵，爹～
translation: Yun Tianhe: Hehe, Father~

original_text: 云天青：算了，今日有其他事要交代你，爹说的每一句话，你都要牢牢记住，知道吗？
translation: Yun Tianqing: Enough, I have other matters to tell you today. Remember every word I say firmly, understand?

original_text: 云天河：……嗯！
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... Hmm!

original_text: 云天青：有朝一日爹离开人世，就和你娘合葬在石沉溪洞里……
translation: Yun Tianqing: One day when I pass away, I'll be buried with your mother in the Stone Sink Cave...

original_text: 云天青：一切我都已安排妥当，洞口设有机关，寻常人绝对无法乱闯，你也不用费什么心，如果想尽孝道，对我牌位早晚三柱香便是。至于你娘……多年来未曾给她立个牌位，那也是她的意思，我们都不要拂逆吧。
translation: Yun Tianqing: I have arranged everything. The cave entrance has mechanisms, so ordinary people absolutely cannot barge in. You needn't trouble yourself much. If you wish to fulfill filial duties, offer three incense sticks morning and evening before my memorial tablet. As for your mother... we never set up a memorial tablet for her all these years, which was her own wish. Let's not go against that.

original_text: 云天青：……干嘛？瞧你一张苦瓜脸。
translation: Yun Tianqing: ...What? Look at your bitter melon face.

original_text: 云天河：爹，孩儿不要你离开……就剩孩儿一个，没人陪着玩了！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Father, I don't want you to leave... If you're gone, your child will be all alone, with no one to play with!
Yun Tianqing: ............

original_text: 云天青：……小子，爹得去陪你娘，再说你整天上蹿下跳，玩得不是很乐吗？
translation: Yun Tianqing: ...Kid, I need to go keep your mother company. Besides, you're always jumping around, having fun, aren't you?

original_text: 云天青：记好了！爹教你的剑术，你练到不好不坏，足以自保就行。我云天青的儿子，岂能受人欺负？
translation: Yun Tianqing: Remember this! The swordsmanship I taught you, practice it until you're decent enough to protect yourself. How could my son, Yun Tianqing's son, be bullied?

original_text: 云天河：爹，我…………
translation: Yun Tianhe: Father, I...

original_text: 云天青：听不明白也无妨，记在心里，你现在年纪还小，终有一日会明白的。
translation: Yun Tianqing: It's fine if you don't understand now. Keep it in your heart. You're still young; one day you will understand.

original_text: 云天河：是，爹。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Yes, Father.

original_text: 云天青：……好孩子……
translation: Yun Tianqing: ...Good child...

original_text: 云天青：夙玉啊夙玉，我若离开，唯一放心不下的就是天河。这些年来，我从未让他下过山，也不知是做对还是做错了……
translation: Yun Tianqing: Suyu, oh Suyu, if I leave, the only thing I can't rest easy about is Tianhe. All these years, I've never let him go down the mountain. I don't know if I did right or wrong...

original_text: 云天青：夙玉，你告诉过我，死生在手，变化由心，地不能埋，天不能煞，此之为我命在我也，不在于天，莫非早就料到今日之局？
translation: Yun Tianqing: Suyu, you told me: life and death are in my hands, change comes from the heart, earth cannot bury me, heaven cannot harm me. This is my fate being in my own hands, not in heaven. Did you foresee today's situation long ago?

original_text: 云天青：……唉，也罢，天河的命自是交由他自己，我再多操心过问也是无用……
translation: Yun Tianqing: ...Ah, fine, Tianhe's fate is his own to decide, me worrying and interfering more is pointless...

original_text: 云天河：屋子里变这么乱！！是、是我爹！！他来过了！
translation: Yun Tianhe: The room is such a mess!! It's... my Father!! He was here!

original_text: 云天河：怎么办怎么办怎么办啊！他生气了、他生气了……
translation: Yun Tianhe: What to do! What to do! What to do! He's angry! He's angry!...

original_text: 韩菱纱：（……又开始发疯了……）
translation: Han Lingsha: (...Sign, he's still acting crazy...)

original_text: 韩菱纱：……
translation: Han Lingsha: ...

original_text: 韩菱纱：……这是……
translation: Han Lingsha: ... This is...

original_text: 韩菱纱：（……唉，还在发疯……）
translation: Han Lingsha: (...Sigh, still crazy...)

original_text: 云天河：……好痛……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ...It hurts...

original_text: 云天河：……干嘛又扔我……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... Why throw me again...

original_text: 韩菱纱：你冷静一下！过来看看这是什么？
translation: Han Lingsha: Calm down! Come look, what's this?

original_text: 云天河：这是……爹的牌位？
translation: Yun Tianhe: This is... Father's memorial tablet?

original_text: 韩菱纱：上面刻着“云天青”，我想应该是你爹的名字。
translation: Han Lingsha: It says 'Yun Tianqing' on it. I think it must be your father's name.

original_text: 韩菱纱：……云天青、云天河……父子俩的名字只差一个字，真少见，该不会你爹给你取名，也是用给“这是剑”取名的方法吧……
translation: Han Lingsha: ... Yun Tianqing, Yun Tianhe... father and son's names differ by only one character, how rare. Could it be your father named you the same way as naming 'It-is-a Sword'...

original_text: 云天河：爹说过，我的名字是娘取的。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Father said, my name was given by Mother.

original_text: 韩菱纱：（……一家人都很古怪……）
translation: Han Lingsha: (...The whole family is quite strange...)

original_text: 韩菱纱：这牌位是我从地上捡起来的……你爹发再大脾气，也不会把自己的牌位都扔地上吧？
translation: Han Lingsha: I picked up this memorial tablet from the ground... Even if your Father was furious, he wouldn't throw his own tablet on the floor, right?

original_text: 云天河：话是这么说没错，但是……
translation: Yun Tianhe: That's true, but...

original_text: 韩菱纱：你再好好想想，没有其他人会来这里？
translation: Han Lingsha: Think carefully-no one else would come here?

original_text: 云天河：……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ...

original_text: 云天河：……哈、哈哈、哈哈哈！知道了，是那只山猪！绝对没错！它的蹄印还留在这呢！
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... Ha, haha, hahaha! I know! It's that wild boar! Absolutely! Its hoof prints are right here!

original_text: 韩菱纱：什么山猪？
translation: Han Lingsha: What wild boar?

original_text: 云天河：就是我们在石沉溪洞里看到的那只！
translation: Yun Tianhe: It's the pig we saw in the Stone Sink Cave!

original_text: 云天河：我抓了只小山猪给爹做供品，也不知是不是那只大猪的孩子，大猪就毁我房子，把小猪带走了。
translation: Yun Tianhe: I caught a piglet as an offering for my Father. I don't know if it was the big wild boar's child, but the big wild boar destroyed my house and took the little one away.
Han Lingsha: ......

original_text: 云天河：呃，我猜的……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Uh, I guessed...

original_text: 韩菱纱：真想不到，人虽是万物灵长，但爱子心切，连山猪也是一样。
translation: Han Lingsha: I never thought that although humans are the wisest of all creatures, even wild boars share the same deep love for their young.

original_text: 云天河：唉，可惜了一顿香喷喷的烤猪，下次再给我遇上，绝不放过！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Sigh, what a waste of a delicious roast pig, next time I run into one, I won't let it get away!

original_text: 韩菱纱：喂！你这野人，怎么连一点同情心也没有？
translation: Han Lingsha: Hey! You barbarian, how can you have no sympathy at all?

original_text: 云天河：……你才奇怪，我不吃它们就会饿死啊。
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... You're the weird one. I'll starve if I don't eat them.

original_text: 韩菱纱：就算是这样，也不用说那么冷血吧！
translation: Han Lingsha: Even if that's the case, you don't have to say something so cold-blooded!

original_text: 云天河：你生什么气？爹说活着的东西都是要死的。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Why are you angry? Dad said all living things must die.

original_text: 韩菱纱：是啊，你们说的都对，可是就算结果都一样，各人的命还是不一样呐……
translation: Han Lingsha: Yes, you're all right, but even if the outcome is the same, everyone's fate is still different...

original_text: 云天河：你说什么？
translation: Yun Tianhe: What did you say?

original_text: 云天河：爹说的对，女孩子有时候很古怪。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Father was right, girls can be really strange sometimes.

original_text: 云天河：不管她～赶快收拾东西！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Never mind her~ Hurry and pack up!

original_text: 云天河：……爹……孩儿要下山去了……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... Father... Your child is going down the mountain...

original_text: 云天河：孩儿真的很想知道，你和娘……你们到底………………真是菱纱说的剑仙吗……
translation: Yun Tianhe: I really want to know, you and Mother... were you really... the Sword Immortals Lingsha talked about...

original_text: 云天河：你留给我的剑，怎么有那么大的力量……一百只大山猪加起来大概也没它厉害……
translation: Yun Tianhe: The sword you left me... how does it have such immense power... probably a hundred giant boars combined aren't as strong as it...

original_text: 云天河：……墓室毁了……都是孩儿的错，和菱纱无关……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... The tomb chamber is destroyed... It's all my fault, it has nothing to do with Lingsha...

original_text: 云天河：爹你说过的，用剑不能心浮气躁，孩儿那时却心里慌张，控制不住力道……爹，你要罚就罚吧……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Father, you said one must not be impatient or impetuous when wielding a sword, but back then I was panicked and couldn't control my strength... Father, punish me if you must...

original_text: 云天河：不过……你要是有其他事，晚一天，不不不，晚几天再来也没关系……
translation: Yun Tianhe: But... if you have other matters, come a day later, no no, even a few days later is fine...

original_text: 云天河：爹，刚才说的那些都是真的……所以，晚上不用来找孩儿了，孩儿不在……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Father, what was said just now is true... So, don't come looking for me tonight. Your child won't be here...

original_text: 云天河：（老爹的早晚三柱香绝不能少，牌位和香炉都得带着……其他也没什么要带了。）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (Father's three daily incense offerings must never be missed. The memorial tablet and incense burner must be taken... nothing else really needs to be packed.)

original_text: 云天河：你饿了？没力气站？
translation: Yun Tianhe: You're hungry? No strength to stand?

original_text: 韩菱纱：以为谁都像你啊，就知道吃。
translation: Han Lingsha: As if everyone's like you, only thinking about eating.

original_text: 韩菱纱：我在想，这火炉这么大，看样子你爹真的很怕冷？
translation: Han Lingsha: I'm thinking, this stove is so big, looks like your father was really afraid of the cold?

original_text: 云天河：嗯，除了夏天，炉子都得点着，火要是熄了，爹会冷得受不了。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Yeah, except in summer, the stove has to be lit. If the fire goes out, my father can't stand the cold

original_text: 韩菱纱：这到底是什么怪病？
translation: Han Lingsha: What kind of strange illness is this?

original_text: 云天河：不知道，听说娘比爹更怕冷，大概他们身体都不够壮吧。
translation: Yun Tianhe: I don't know. I heard Mother was even more afraid of the cold than Father. Probably neither of them was very strong.

original_text: 韩菱纱：（……歪理，猪那么壮，还不是一样会冷……）
translation: Han Lingsha: (...Nonsense. Pigs are so sturdy, but they still get cold...)

original_text: 韩菱纱：对了，你东西都收差不多了？
translation: Han Lingsha: Right, have you packed most of your things?

original_text: 云天河：嗯，重要的都拿了，<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>得再去树屋一趟，</colour><dc0>走吧！</dc0>
translation: Yun Tianhe: Mm, I've taken all the important things.<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> Need to go to the treehouse again,</colour><dc0> let's go!</dc0>

original_text: 韩菱纱：<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>树屋？是在房子旁边的那棵大树上？</colour>
translation: Han Lingsha: <colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>Tree house? Is it in the big tree next to the house?</colour>

original_text: 云天河：对啊，<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>沿着树干上去就行了～</colour>
translation: Yun Tianhe: Right, <colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>just go up along the tree trunk~</colour>

original_text: 韩菱纱：（……不愧是野人，和猴子一样上蹿下跳的……）
translation: Han Lingsha: (... Truly a barbarian, jumping around like a monkey...)

original_text: 云天河：止血草、鼠儿果……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Mending Herbs, Moonberries...

original_text: 韩菱纱：这儿风景真好！看来你爹娘都是有心人。
translation: Han Lingsha: The scenery here is great! Seems your parents were thoughtful people.

original_text: 韩菱纱：……以后我年纪大了，也来这儿住，不问江湖世事。……要是真有那么一天，该多好啊……
translation: Han Lingsha: ... When I'm old, I'll come live here too, leaving the affairs of the martial world behind. ...If that day really comes, how wonderful it would be...

original_text: 云天河：风景看来看去还不都一样，不过住这里好哇！到处都能猎到好吃的野味！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Scenery looks pretty much the same everywhere, but it's great living here! Can hunt tasty game everywhere!

original_text: 韩菱纱：野人！跟你说也白说！收拾好了没？
translation: Han Lingsha: Barbarian! Talking to you is useless! Are you packed up yet?

original_text: 云天河：好了，带了些止血草在身边，还有鼠儿果。
translation: Yun Tianhe: All set, brought some Mending Herbs and Moonberries.

original_text: 韩菱纱：看不出哟～你不懂世事，疗伤本事倒不含糊。
translation: Han Lingsha: Didn't expect it~ You don't understand the world, but your healing skills are quite good.

original_text: 云天河：会吗？用草药是爹教我的。力气大的野兽没两下就挣脱陷阱了，受伤是常有的事。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Really? Using herbs is what Dad taught me. Strong beasts break traps easily; getting hurt happens often.

original_text: 韩菱纱：这么说来，你的弓也使得很好啰？
translation: Han Lingsha: So that means you're quite skilled with a bow too?

original_text: 云天河：还、还好吧，用左手还射得挺准，换用右手虽然力量大了很多，可就是容易射偏了。
translation: Yun Tianhe: It's, it's okay. Using my left hand I can still shoot pretty accurately. Switching to my right hand, although the power is much greater, it's just easier to miss.

original_text: 韩菱纱：挺厉害的嘛，还能左右开弓！我一路上山，光是应付那些猪啊熊啊就累得够呛，等下就靠你啦！
translation: Han Lingsha: Pretty impressive, able to use both hands! I was exhausted just dealing with those boars and bears on the way up the mountain. I'll rely on you later!

original_text: 云天河：没问题，连爹都夸我打猎功夫高明呢！
translation: Yun Tianhe: No problem, even Father praised my hunting skills!

original_text: 韩菱纱：（臭美～～你大概也就这么一个长处了……）
translation: Han Lingsha: (So vain~~ That's probably your only strong point...)

original_text: 韩菱纱：那块玉带了没？
translation: Han Lingsha: Did you bring that jade?

original_text: 云天河：带了呀。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Brought it.

original_text: 韩菱纱：不要再待一会儿？
translation: Han Lingsha: Won't you stay a bit longer?

original_text: 云天河：呃……不用了。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Uh... No need.

original_text: 韩菱纱：嘻嘻……
translation: Han Lingsha: Hehe...

original_text: 云天河：喂～～～走快点吧！不然天要黑了！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Heyyy~~~ Walk faster! Otherwise, it'll get dark!

original_text: 韩菱纱：瞎～说～～明明离天黑还早得很，肯定是心虚。
translation: Han Lingsha: Nonsense! It's still early, far from dark. He must just be feeling guilty.

original_text: 云天河：<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>先回房拿弓，</colour><dc0>再去石沉溪洞猎山猪～</dc0>
translation: Yun Tianhe:<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> First, go back to the room to get my bow,</colour><dc0> then head to Stone Sink Cave to hunt wild boars~</dc0>

original_text: 云天河：那边好像是下山的路，现在不用过去吧……
translation: Yun Tianhe: That seems to be the path down the mountain. No need to go there now...

original_text: 韩菱纱：<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>先进小木屋吧，</colour><dc0>天河还在等着呢。</dc0>
translation: Han Lingsha:<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> Let's enter the small wooden house first,</colour><dc0> Tianhe is still waiting.</dc0>
Yun Tianhe: Ah~~~~~~!!

original_text: 云天河：我回来啦！！好～高～兴～呀！！
translation: Yun Tianhe: I'm back!! So~ hap~py~!!

original_text: 慕容紫英：这里便是青鸾峰？
translation: Murong Ziying: So this is Qingluan Peak?

original_text: 云天河：对啊，我从小就住这儿，山上很好玩的！能打野猪、吃烤肉、抓松鼠！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Right, I've lived here since I was little. The mountain is so fun! You can hunt boars, eat barbecue, catch squirrels!

original_text: 云天河：那边就是我的房子！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Over there is my house!

original_text: 云天河：哈，这么久没回来，还是老样子。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Ha, after being away so long, it's still the same old place.

original_text: 云天河：你们看，你们看！哈哈～
translation: Yun Tianhe: Look, look! Haha~

original_text: 韩菱纱：野人一回到山上，就是不一样，好久没见天河这样上蹿下跳了。
translation: Han Lingsha: A barbarian is different once he's back in the mountains. Haven't seen Tianhe bouncing around like this in a long time.

original_text: 韩菱纱：以前无忧无虑的日子一直是他最想念的。
translation: Han Lingsha: The carefree days of the past are what he misses most.

original_text: 云天河：哇！山猪！我看到你了，别跑！哈哈～
translation: Yun Tianhe: Wow! Wild boar! I saw you, don't run! Haha~

original_text: 云天河：山猪！你跑不掉了～
translation: Yun Tianhe: Wild boar! You can't escape~

original_text: 慕容紫英：……他一个人，在这待了十几年？
translation: Murong Ziying: He's been here alone for over ten years?

original_text: 韩菱纱：是啊，横行霸道，像个山大王似的。
translation: Han Lingsha: Yeah, acting like a tyrant, just like a mountain bandit king.

original_text: 云天河：哟嚯～哈哈哈哈～
translation: Yun Tianhe: Yoohoo~ Hahahaha~

original_text: 慕容紫英：……一人当大王，那兵是谁？
translation: Murong Ziying: ... He is the only one person being the king, then who are the soldiers?

original_text: 韩菱纱：……可能是那些猪吧……
translation: Han Lingsha: ... Probably those pigs...

original_text: 慕容紫英：……
translation: Murong Ziying: ...

original_text: 韩菱纱：噗……呵呵……呵呵呵呵……
translation: Han Lingsha: Pfft... hehe... hehehehe...

original_text: 慕容紫英：哈哈……哈哈哈……
translation: Murong Ziying: Haha... hahaha...

original_text: 韩菱纱：我还是第一次看紫英你这样开怀的笑呢～
translation: Han Lingsha: This is the first time I've seen you laugh so heartily, Ziying~

original_text: 慕容紫英：嗯……确实……大概是被天河现在的心情影响了。
translation: Murong Ziying: Hmm... Indeed... Probably influenced by Tianhe's current mood.

original_text: 云天河：奇怪，猪不见了！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Strange, the boar is gone!

original_text: 云天河：算了……改天再跟你玩捉迷藏，我赢就吃你，我输就下次再吃你，哈哈～
translation: Yun Tianhe: Forget it... I'll play hide-and-seek with you another day, if I win I eat you, if I lose I eat you next time, haha~

original_text: 云天河：你们快来，进屋来！看看有没有那本书……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Come on, come inside! See if that book is there...

original_text: 韩菱纱：紫英小时候呢？是什么样子的？从来没有听你提过。
translation: Han Lingsha: What about Ziying as a child? What was you like? Never heard you mention it.

original_text: 慕容紫英：……我六岁即被送往琼华派修行，在家中的那些日子，只依稀记得是锦衣玉食，并不为吃穿所累。
translation: Murong Ziying: ... I was sent to Qionghua Sect for cultivation at age six. My days at home are only a vague memory of luxury, free from worries about food and clothing.

original_text: 韩菱纱：唔，那你真是了不起，过惯了富贵日子，到山上还能忍受清淡。
translation: Han Lingsha: Hmm, then you're really something. Used to a life of luxury, yet you can endure the plain living up in the mountains.

original_text: 慕容紫英：那没什么了不起……比起天河自幼失去双亲，在山林中自求生存，我所得到的，已经太多……
translation: Murong Ziying: That's nothing remarkable... Compared to Tianhe, who lost both parents young and survived alone in the wilderness, what I've received is already too much...

original_text: 慕容紫英：初时我只觉天河单纯异常、不懂世事，如今才知他过得辛苦，却难得保持一颗赤子之心，我又有什么资格去对他品头论足……实在惭愧……
translation: Murong Ziying: At first, I only thought Tianhe was exceptionally simple and ignorant of worldly affairs. Now I realize he has lived a hard life, yet remarkably maintained a childlike heart. What right do I have to judge him... I am truly ashamed...

original_text: 韩菱纱：哎，小紫英～你又来了……
translation: Han Lingsha: Ah, little Ziying~ Here you go again...

original_text: 韩菱纱：对自己别那么苛刻嘛，照你这么说，没吃过苦的人就一定比不上吃过苦的人啰？嘻，我可觉得你比天河那只野猴子强多了。再说我看天河在山上过挺开心的，自得其乐得很。
translation: Han Lingsha: Don't be so hard on yourself. By your logic, those who've never suffered can't compare to those who have? Heh, I actually think you're much better than that wild monkey Tianhe. Besides, I think Tianhe was quite happy living in mountains, content with his own little world.

original_text: 山猪：哼唧、哼唧～～～
translation: Wild Boar: Oink, oink~~~

original_text: 韩菱纱：走吧、走吧，<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>我们进屋去，</colour><dc0>不然天河那家伙要来催了！</dc0>
translation: Han Lingsha: Let's go, let's go.<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> We should head inside,</colour><dc0> otherwise that guy will come to hurry us up!</dc0>

original_text: 韩菱纱：怎样？找到了吗？
translation: Han Lingsha: Well? Found it?

original_text: 云天河：……爹留下的书，没烧掉的，都在这儿了，不过没一本是和铸剑有关的……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... The books Father left, the ones not burned, are all here. But none are about sword forging...

original_text: 韩菱纱：你啊，平时就大大咧咧，说不定看漏了，我和紫英再仔细瞧瞧。
translation: Han Lingsha: You, usually so careless, might have missed something. Ziying and I will take a closer look.

original_text: 云天河：哦，好……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Oh, okay...

original_text: 韩菱纱：没有……真的没有，都翻遍了……
translation: Han Lingsha: No... really none, searched everywhere...

original_text: 韩菱纱：不用指望啦，一定是被这笨蛋给烧了……
translation: Han Lingsha: Don't get your hopes up. It must have been burned by this idiot...

original_text: 云天河：怎么办、怎么办……
translation: Yun Tianhe: What to do, what to do...

original_text: 慕容紫英：天河，云前辈留下的东西，全在这里了？
translation: Murong Ziying: Tianhe, are all the things Senior Yun left behind here?

original_text: 云天河：其他就只有些锅子什么的……
translation: Yun Tianhe: There are only some pots and stuff left...

original_text: 韩菱纱：算了……虽然空欢喜一场……但是回到青鸾峰还是一件很高兴的事。
translation: Han Lingsha: Forget it... Even though it was a false hope... returning to Qingluan Peak is still a very happy thing.

original_text: 慕容紫英：至此定论，为时尚早……我在想，如此重要之物，云前辈既然并无交代，或许他根本没有留给天河……
translation: Murong Ziying: It's too early to conclude... I'm thinking, since Senior Yun left no instructions about such an important item, perhaps he never intended to leave it for Tianhe...

original_text: 韩菱纱：……！紫英，你是说……？
translation: Han Lingsha: ...! Ziying, are you saying...?

original_text: 慕容紫英：天河说过，前辈在山洞中修了一间隐秘的墓室，他是否会将手记带入墓中？或藏于其他地方？
translation: Murong Ziying: Tianhe mentioned that Senior built a hidden tomb chamber in the cave. Would he have taken the journal into the tomb? Or hidden it somewhere else?

original_text: 韩菱纱：咦……！！
translation: Han Lingsha: Huh...!!

original_text: 云天河：……呃，那个……爹和娘的墓都塌了，难不成还要挖开？！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Uh, that... Father and Mother's graves collapsed, do we really have to dig them open?!

original_text: 云天河：好！为了菱纱……我现在去挖！！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Okay! For Lingsha... I'll go dig right now!!

original_text: 韩菱纱：慢……等等！墓中、墓中……
translation: Han Lingsha: Wait... hold on! The tomb, in the tomb...

original_text: 韩菱纱：手记……手记会不会是这一本？！
translation: Han Lingsha: The journal... could this be the journal?!

original_text: 云天河：啥？你哪来的？我瞧瞧。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Huh? Where did you get it? Let me see.

original_text: 云天河：奇怪，这什么？上面的字都看不懂，涂涂画画的……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Strange, what's this? Can't read the words, just scribbles and drawings...

original_text: 慕容紫英：拿来我看一下！
translation: Murong Ziying: Hand it over, let me see!

original_text: 慕容紫英：这确是师公的笔迹！
translation: Murong Ziying: This is indeed Grandmaster's handwriting!

original_text: 韩菱纱：真的？！紫英，你看得懂这些符号？
translation: Han Lingsha: Really?! Ziying, can you understand these symbols?

original_text: 慕容紫英：这并非符号，而是一种数百年传承的秘形文字，只有真正懂得琼华派铸剑秘术的人方能读懂！寻常人看来自是一头雾水。
translation: Murong Ziying: This isn't a symbol, but a secret script passed down for centuries, only readable by those truly versed in the Qionghua Sect's sword-forging secrets! Ordinary people would naturally be baffled by it.

original_text: 慕容紫英：菱纱，师公的手记，你从何处得来？
translation: Murong Ziying: Lingsha, where did you get Grandmaster's journal from?

original_text: 韩菱纱：啊？……嗯……这个…………
translation: Han Lingsha: Huh? ...Hmm... this...

original_text: 云天河：对啊，为什么青阳长老给爹的东西，会在你那里？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Right, why would something Elder Qingyang gave to Father be with you?

original_text: 韩菱纱：……其实……也没什么啦……
translation: Han Lingsha: ... Actually... it's nothing really...

original_text: 云天河：那，到底是什么？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Then, what exactly is it?

original_text: 韩菱纱：哎呀，不就是当初和你进到墓室里，我看见放灵光藻玉的台子上有本书，一时手快，忍不住就拿了嘛……不过，你好像没注意到……
translation: Han Lingsha: Oh, it's just that when we entered the tomb chamber back then, I saw a book on the pedestal where the Spiritual Light Jade was placed. I couldn't help but take it quickly... But you didn't seem to notice...

original_text: 云天河：怎么可能？你动作有那么快？
translation: Yun Tianhe: How could that be? Are you that fast?

original_text: 韩菱纱：哼，也不想想我是做什么的，不眼疾手快怎行？
translation: Han Lingsha: Hmph, don't you know what I do for a living? How could I not be quick-eyed and fast-handed?
Yun Tianhe: ......

original_text: 韩菱纱：好啦，瞒着你是我不对……我错了还不行吗？……
translation: Han Lingsha: Alright, hiding it from you was my fault... I admit I'm wrong, okay?...

original_text: 云天河：…………后来，你就一直把手记带在身上？
translation: Yun Tianhe: ...... After that, you kept the journal with you all along?

original_text: 韩菱纱：……那个时候被你这野人发现我拿了灵光藻玉，实在很丢脸，但是你没看见这本书……所以我一直随身带着，准备哪天跟你吵架时当作秘密武器，可以嘲笑你一下……
translation: Han Lingsha: ...Back then, being discovered by you, this barbarian, when I took the Spiritual Light Jade, was really embarrassing. But you didn't see this book... So I've kept it with me all along, planning to use it as a secret weapon someday when arguing with you, to mock you a little...

original_text: 慕容紫英：……菱纱你想太多了……
translation: Murong Ziying: ... Lingsha, you're overthinking it...

original_text: 云天河：女孩子怎么老是一堆秘密……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Why do girls always have so many secrets...

original_text: 韩菱纱：哼……
translation: Han Lingsha: Hmph...

original_text: 慕容紫英：无论什么原由，阴差阳错之下，却也令我们寻得了宗炼师公的手记，或许都是天意安排……
translation: Murong Ziying: Whatever the reason, through twists of fate, we found Grandmaster Zonglian's journal. Perhaps it was all arranged by heaven's will...

original_text: 云天河：哈，这真是太好了！就像人家说的，穿着鞋子找不到，不穿就找到了！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Ha, this is great! Just like they say: you can travel all over the world looking for treasure, and after all that hard work, it turns out to be right at your feet!

original_text: 韩菱纱：天啊，什么穿着鞋子找不到，是踏破铁鞋无觅处，得来全不费功夫……
translation: Han Lingsha: Oh heavens, what 'right at your feet'... The real saying is: 'A man travels the world over in search of what he needs and returns home to find it'...

original_text: 云天河：对对对，就是这么讲！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Right, right, that's how you say it!

original_text: 慕容紫英：我且翻看一遍，其中是否有阻止宿主使用双剑之法。
translation: Murong Ziying: Let me review it once to see if there's a way to stop the hosts from using the dual swords.

original_text: 云天河：好，你快点看，越快越好——
translation: Yun Tianhe: Good, look quickly, the faster the better-
Han Lingsha: ...! Hmm...

original_text: 慕容紫英：菱纱？！
translation: Murong Ziying: Lingsha?!

original_text: 云天河：菱纱你怎么了？是不是又难受了？！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Lingsha, what's wrong? Are you feeling unwell again?!

original_text: 韩菱纱：……我、我头好晕……
translation: Han Lingsha: ...I... I feel so dizzy...

original_text: 慕容紫英：师叔和掌门，他们……
translation: Murong Ziying: Martial Uncle and Sect Leader, they...

original_text: 韩菱纱：……天河……好冷啊…………
translation: Han Lingsha: ... Tianhe... so cold...

original_text: 云天河：你别怕！我马上运功帮你驱寒！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Don't be afraid! I'll use my energy to drive out the cold right away!
Han Lingsha: ..., hmm...

original_text: 慕容紫英：……菱纱如何？
translation: Murong Ziying: ... How about Lingsha?

original_text: 云天河：已经睡了。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Already asleep.

original_text: 慕容紫英：一定是掌门和师叔又用了望舒剑之力，如此反反复复，还不知要让菱纱受多少苦……
translation: Murong Ziying: It must be that Sect Leader and Martial Uncle have used the power of Wangshu Sword again. This back and forth... who knows how much more suffering Lingsha will have to endure...

original_text: 云天河：紫英，你快点把那本手记看完吧。看完说不定就能知道救菱纱的办法了！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Ziying, hurry up and finish reading that journal. After reading, maybe we'll know a way to save Lingsha!

original_text: 云天河：每一次这样，她身体里的寒气都会越来越多，就算我替她驱寒……也已经没有多大用了……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Every time like this, the cold energy in her body increases. Even if I dispel it for her... it's not much use anymore...

original_text: 慕容紫英：……你不必多说，我都明白……也一样心急如焚……
translation: Murong Ziying: ... No need to say more, I understand... and I'm equally anxious...

original_text: 慕容紫英：只是手记中所载内容十分艰深，有些说法更是我铸剑至今，闻所未闻，一时半刻却是无法读通……
translation: Murong Ziying: It's just that the contents recorded in the journal are extremely profound. Some theories are unheard of in my entire sword-forging career, making it impossible to comprehend in a short time...

original_text: 云天河：不管怎样，能快一点都是好的！
translation: Yun Tianhe: No matter what, being faster is always good!

original_text: 慕容紫英：我知道，我会全力而为。
translation: Murong Ziying: I know, I will do my utmost.

original_text: 云天河：紫英……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Ziying...

original_text: 慕容紫英：还有其他事？
translation: Murong Ziying: Is there anything else?

original_text: 云天河：……紫英，你害怕过吗？
translation: Yun Tianhe: ...Ziying, have you ever been afraid?

original_text: 慕容紫英：…………为何这样问？
translation: Murong Ziying: ...... Why do you ask that?

original_text: 云天河：……我以前，总是天不怕地不怕……觉得就像爹说的，堂堂男子汉，没什么可惊怕的……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... Before, I was always fearless... I thought like father said, a real man has nothing to fear...

original_text: 云天河：可是现在……我好像变得胆小了，会害怕很多事……我怕这辈子真的再也不能见到梦璃，怕我们阻止不了玄霄…………我更怕……救不了菱纱，她会死…………
translation: Yun Tianhe: But now... I seem to have become cowardly, afraid of many things... I'm afraid I might never see Mengli again in this lifetime, afraid we can't stop Xuanxiao... I'm even more afraid... that we can't save Lingsha, that she will die...

original_text: 云天河：原来，天底下有这么多的事，我没办法做到……不是所有事情，尽全力做就会好了…………
translation: Yun Tianhe: So, there are so many things in this world I can't do... Not everything gets better just by trying your hardest...

original_text: 慕容紫英：天河，你我皆是凡人，生老病死、一世的结果，冥冥之中恐怕已有天意安排……人，要怎么与天争？
translation: Murong Ziying: Tianhe, we are both mortals. Birth, aging, illness, death-the outcome of a lifetime is likely already arranged by fate... How can man contend with fate?

original_text: 云天河：天意……你们都说是“天意”，那为什么爹和娘要说“我命在我，不在天地”？……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Fate... You all call it Fate, then why did father and mother say 'My fate is mine to command, not Heaven's'?...

original_text: 云天河：……爹就算拼尽全力，也救不了娘的时候，是不是就像我现在对着菱纱，什么都做不到，恨自己一点用都没有……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... When Father tried his hardest but couldn't save Mother, was it like me facing Lingsha now-helpless, hating myself for being useless...

original_text: 慕容紫英：天河，你问的这些……实在太难回答，就算是阅遍人生的老者也不一定说得清楚……
translation: Murong Ziying: Tianhe, the questions you ask... are truly difficult to answer. Even an elder who has experienced all of life might not be able to explain them clearly...

original_text: 慕容紫英：我自问并不畏惧世间强权，自己的生死也可相轻，若是用我一命，能换菱纱一命，我定会毫不犹豫。
translation: Murong Ziying: I do not fear worldly power, and I hold my own life lightly. If my life could be exchanged for Lingsha's, I would not hesitate.

original_text: 慕容紫英：但是有些事情，我知道……我们只能祈求所谓的天意……
translation: Murong Ziying: But some things, I know... we can only pray for so-called fate...

original_text: 慕容紫英：你也累了，先歇息一下，我尽快读通师公的手记，说不定一切还有转机。
translation: Murong Ziying: You must be tired. Rest for a while. I'll try to comprehend Grandmaster's journal as soon as possible. Perhaps there's still a chance to turn things around.

original_text: 云天河：我不睡，我陪着菱纱。
translation: Yun Tianhe: I won't sleep, I'll stay with Lingsha.

original_text: 慕容紫英：……师公，但愿您已经找到阻止双剑宿主的办法……这一切即使是天意，难道就不能给予凡人一点眷顾吗……
translation: Murong Ziying: ...Grandmaster, I pray you've found a way to stop the dual swords' hosts... Even if all this is fate, can't mortals be granted a little favor...

original_text: 云天河：紫英，怎么样？手记看完了吗？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Ziying, how is it? Finished reading the journal?

original_text: 云天河：那有没有找到阻止宿主的办法？！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Then did you find a way to stop the host?!

original_text: 慕容紫英：…………
translation: Murong Ziying: ......

original_text: 云天河：怎么了？为什么不说话？
translation: Yun Tianhe: What's wrong? Why aren't you speaking?

original_text: 云天河：你摇头……是没找到……？
translation: Yun Tianhe: You shook your head... so there isn't any way...?

original_text: 慕容紫英：…………并非没有，只不过……
translation: Murong Ziying: ...... Not that there isn't, only...

original_text: 云天河：只不过什么？你快说呀！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Only what? Hurry up and say it!

original_text: 慕容紫英：那方法难于登天，尤其对你我而言……
translation: Murong Ziying: That method is as difficult as climbing to heaven, especially for you and me...

original_text: 云天河：到底是什么？只要有办法，就一定能办到的，你告诉我！
translation: Yun Tianhe: What is it? As long as there's a way, it can definitely be done, tell me!

original_text: 慕容紫英：……好吧，我说出来，但你听后，切不可乱了心神，一定要冷静。
translation: Murong Ziying: ... Alright, I'll tell you, but after hearing it, you must not lose your composure. Stay calm.

original_text: 云天河：好！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Okay!

original_text: 慕容紫英：羲和、望舒剑成之后，与幻瞑界的大战开始之前，宗炼师公已隐约觉得双剑力量过于霸道，随着玄霄师叔和夙玉前辈不断修行有成，师公此念愈发强烈。
translation: Murong Ziying: After Xihe and Wangshu swords were forged, and before the great battle with the Twilight Realm, Grandmaster Zonglian vaguely felt the dual swords' power was too domineering. As Martial Uncle Xuanxiao and Senior Suyu continued to achieve success in their cultivation, Grandmaster's concern grew stronger.

original_text: 慕容紫英：尽管由昆仑山上白日飞升，乃是凡人梦寐以求的美好夙愿，但所谓物极必反，若是琼华双剑的力量失去控制，则羲和宿主可能堕入嗜血狂乱之道，望舒宿主则会变得冷酷凶残……
translation: Murong Ziying: Although ascending to immortality from Kunlun Mountain is a cherished dream for mortals, things turn at their extremes. If the power of the Qionghua dual swords goes out of control, Xihe host may fall into a path of bloodthirsty madness, while Wangshu host becomes cold and cruel...

original_text: 云天河：……！嗜血乱狂……现在的玄霄不就是……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ...! Bloodthirsty and frenzied... isn't Xuanxiao now just...

original_text: 慕容紫英：师公将这些话告诉了玄霄师叔和夙玉前辈，命他们二人修炼时务必循规蹈矩，不可躁进，以免走火入魔，引发祸事。
translation: Murong Ziying: Grandmaster told these words to Martial Uncle Xuanxiao and Senior Suyu, ordering them to strictly follow the rules during cultivation, not to rush recklessly, lest they fall into demonic madness and cause disaster.

original_text: 慕容紫英：怎料与幻瞑界一战，双剑失去其一，师叔受阳炎所扰，变得暴躁异常，更是狂性大发，将数名弟子打成重伤……
translation: Murong Ziying: Who would have thought that after the battle with the Twilight Realm, one of the dual swords was lost... Martial Uncle, troubled by the yang flame, became extremely irritable and even went into a frenzy, severely injuring several disciples...

original_text: 慕容紫英：凡此种种，似乎都应验了师公当初的忧虑，令他万分痛心，双剑既可以是飞升的灵器，也可以成为起祸的凶器！
translation: Murong Ziying: All these things seem to confirm Grandmaster's initial worries, causing him immense grief. The dual swords can be spiritual artifacts for ascension, but they can also become instruments of calamity!

original_text: 慕容紫英：师公他决心找出当宿主失控时，封印双剑力量的办法。
translation: Murong Ziying: Grandmaster was determined to find a way to seal the dual swords' power when the host loses control.

original_text: 云天河：他找到了是吗？要怎么做才能封印住？！
translation: Yun Tianhe: He has found it, right? What do we need to do to seal it?!

original_text: 慕容紫英：……“宿主殪，则双剑亡”，这便是师公留下的话。
translation: Murong Ziying: ... 'If the host perishes, the dual swords die'. That is what our grandmaster left behind.

original_text: 云天河：这……什么意思？是说……要让宿主“死”？……
translation: Yun Tianhe: This... What do you mean? Are you saying... to make the host die?...

original_text: 慕容紫英：宿主若死其一，则他持有的剑将会陷入长眠，双剑缺一，自然无法再用……
translation: Murong Ziying: If one of the hosts dies, the sword they hold will fall into a deep slumber. With one sword missing, naturally, they can no longer be used...

original_text: 云天河：可是……这只是说要怎样阻止双剑，根本没说能不能让宿主恢复正常啊……
translation: Yun Tianhe: But... This only says how to stop the dual swords. It doesn't say if the hosts can be restored to normal at all...

original_text: 慕容紫英：……我想，师公他直至过世，并未真正找到将双剑之祸消于无形的办法……
translation: Murong Ziying: ... I think, until his passing, Grandmaster never truly found a way to avert the calamity of the dual swords...

original_text: 云天河：啊？！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Huh?!

original_text: 慕容紫英：……玄霄师叔之所以在夙玉前辈离开后，变得狂暴难以自控，乃是因为他二人共同修炼双剑……
translation: Murong Ziying: ... The reason why Martial Uncle Xuanxiao became violent and uncontrollable after Senior Suyu left is because the two of them cultivated the dual swords together...

original_text: 慕容紫英：而菱纱令望舒剑复苏，如今师叔与掌门不断催动望舒之力，未经修炼的宿主只能元神不断受损，一再被寒冰之气所扰……
translation: Murong Ziying: And Lingsha revived Wangshu Sword. Now, with the Martial Uncle and sect leader continuously harnessing Wangshu's power, an untrained host can only suffer continuous soul damage, repeatedly disturbed by the icy energy...
Yun Tianhe: ...!!

original_text: 慕容紫英：师公还说，宿主持剑，则力量异常强大，要将其杀死谈何容易，寻常修行之人与之交手，必会被阳炎烈火或冷凝寒冰所伤，除非有人……能够抵御这两种力量……
translation: Murong Ziying: Grandmaster also said that the sword's host possesses abnormally great power. Killing him would be no easy task. Anyone who fights him would surely be injured by the blazing yang flames or the freezing cold ice, unless someone... could resist these two forces...

original_text: 慕容紫英：他当年万万料想不到，当真有人体质如此特异，既不畏寒，亦不怕炎热……
translation: Murong Ziying: He never imagined back then that there truly existed someone with such a peculiar constitution, neither fearing cold nor heat...

original_text: 云天河：……紫英，这是……什么意思……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... Ziying, what... do you mean...

original_text: 慕容紫英：天河，你知道我在说什么……
translation: Murong Ziying: Tianhe, you know what I'm talking about...

original_text: 慕容紫英：从你手触三寒器而不觉得冰冷、在炎帝神农洞中又不觉炎热，就已经令人又惊又疑……
translation: Murong Ziying: Ever since you touched Three Cold Artifacts without feeling their chill, and felt no heat in the Shennong Cave, it has been both astonishing and perplexing...

original_text: 慕容紫英：在不周山时，我替你疗伤，初时以为你走火入魔，后来才发觉你体内有一寒一热两道气息，冲撞之后竟是融为一体，并无异状……连玄霄师叔也说过你体质特异……还有其他许多有迹可循之处——
translation: Murong Ziying: At Mount Buzhou, when I treated your injuries, I initially thought you had fallen into demonic madness. Later, I realized there were two opposing energies-one cold, one hot-inside you. After clashing, they actually merged into one without any adverse effects... Even Martial Uncle Xuanxiao mentioned your unique constitution... And there are many other observable signs-

original_text: 云天河：你说这些……是要我去做什么？
translation: Yun Tianhe: You're saying all this... what do you want me to do?

original_text: 慕容紫英：唉……
translation: Murong Ziying: Sigh...

original_text: 慕容紫英：天河，你是否无论如何都要救菱纱？
translation: Murong Ziying: Tianhe, are you determined to save Lingsha no matter what?

original_text: 云天河：还用说吗？这是一定要救的！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Need I say? We must save her!

original_text: 慕容紫英：菱纱是未经修炼完成的宿主，当双剑做成剑柱、琼华飞升之际，强烈催动双剑必定令菱纱元神耗尽而亡……
translation: Murong Ziying: Lingsha is an incomplete host. When the dual swords form the sword pillars and Qionghua ascends, forcefully activating the dual swords will surely drain Lingsha's spirit essence and kill her...

original_text: 云天河：嗯！为了菱纱，一定要阻止琼华飞升！而且玄霄飞升，反而会害了他自己，害了所有人……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Yes! For Lingsha, must stop Qionghua's ascension! And if Xuanxiao ascends, it'll harm himself, and harm everyone...

original_text: 慕容紫英：要阻止琼华飞升有三种方法……
translation: Murong Ziying: There are three methods to stop Qionghua's ascension...

original_text: 慕容紫英：一是夺回望舒剑，从此隐居山林……姑且不论你我如何夺回此剑，即便顺利夺回……师叔已无法再被冰封，不能飞升又再度失去了望舒剑，你能想像心魔深种的师叔会狂乱到何种程度……
translation: Murong Ziying: First, to retrieve Wangshu Sword and then live in seclusion in the mountains... Leaving aside how we would retrieve the sword, even if we succeed... Martial Uncle can no longer be frozen. Unable to ascend and having lost Wangshu Sword again, can you imagine how deranged Martial Uncle, with his deep-seated inner demons, would become...

original_text: 云天河：是的……他已经控制不住自己了……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Yes... he can no longer control himself...

original_text: 慕容紫英：所以只夺回望舒，后果必定危害整个琼华派，甚至更多无辜的人……
translation: Murong Ziying: So merely reclaiming Wangshu would inevitably endanger the entire Qionghua Sect, and even more innocent people...

original_text: 慕容紫英：第二个方法就是……让双剑宿主死其一，则持有的剑会陷入长眠，双剑缺一，自然无法再用于飞升……所以只能除去羲和剑的宿主……
translation: Murong Ziying: The second method is... to have one of the dual swords' hosts die. Then the held sword will fall into deep slumber. With one sword missing, they naturally can't be used for ascension... So we can only eliminate the host of Xihe Sword...

original_text: 云天河：要我去……杀死……大哥？！
translation: Yun Tianhe: You want me to... kill... big brother?!

original_text: 慕容紫英：天河——
translation: Murong Ziying: Tianhe-

original_text: 云天河：他、他是玄霄……是除了爹以外对我最好的人之一，是我的大哥啊，就算我再也不肯喊他大哥，就算他杀了重光长老，就算他变成那样……
translation: Yun Tianhe: He... he is Xuanxiao... one of the people who treated me best besides my father, my big brother. Even if I never call him big brother again, even if he killed Elder Chongguang, even if he became like that...

original_text: 慕容紫英：天河！我已说过，师公留下的办法，对你我而言太难了……
translation: Murong Ziying: Tianhe! I've already said, the method left by Grandmaster is too difficult for you and me...

original_text: 云天河：……你说还有第三种方法？
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... You said there's a third method?

original_text: 慕容紫英：……你劝师叔放弃飞升、放弃执念……但是……天河，第三种方法最简单却也最难，你认为师叔会听你的吗？
translation: Murong Ziying: ... You ask Martial Uncle to give up ascension, give up obsession... But... Tianhe, the third method is the simplest yet hardest. Do you think he will listen to you?

original_text: 慕容紫英：你先静一静吧……
translation: Murong Ziying: You should calm down first...

original_text: 云天河：……玄霄…………
translation: Yun Tianhe: ..., Xuanxiao...

original_text: 云天河：……大哥……我到底该怎么办？…………
translation: Yun Tianhe: ...Big brother... What should I do? ........

original_text: 云天河：……！菱纱！
translation: Yun Tianhe: ...! Lingsha!

original_text: 云天河：人呢？！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Where is she?!

original_text: 慕容紫英：发生何事？！
translation: Murong Ziying: What happened?!

original_text: 云天河：菱纱、她不见了！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Lingsha-she's gone!

original_text: 慕容紫英：什么？！
translation: Murong Ziying: What?!

original_text: 云天河：先前明明还睡在这里的！
translation: Yun Tianhe: She was clearly sleeping here earlier!

original_text: 慕容紫英：……糟！她会不会是……
translation: Murong Ziying: ... Damn! Could she be...

original_text: 慕容紫英：快走！我们分头去找！她应该还没走远，<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>你找青鸾峰附近，</colour><dc0>我直接御剑往山下去！</dc0>
translation: Murong Ziying: Hurry! Let's split up and search! She probably hasn't gone far.<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> You search near Qingluan Peak,</colour><dc0> I'll ride my sword directly down the mountain!</dc0>

original_text: 云天河：好！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Okay!

original_text: 韩菱纱：天河……
translation: Han Lingsha: Tianhe...

original_text: 云天河：菱纱，你怎么会在这？！你没在房里，把我和紫英吓了一跳。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Lingsha, why are you here?! You weren't in your room, you gave Ziying and me a scare.

original_text: 韩菱纱：早知道……我就该直接下山去的……可我还是忍不住，想来这里……
translation: Han Lingsha: If I had known... I should have just gone down the mountain... But I couldn't help it, I wanted to come here...

original_text: 云天河：下山？你要去哪？……干嘛不跟我和紫英说？我们一起去。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Down the mountain? Where are you going? ... Why not tell me and Ziying? Let's go together.

original_text: 韩菱纱：……还记得吗？我们第一次来树屋时，我说以后要到山上隐居，不问江湖世事，那些……都还像是昨天的情景，可仔细想想，原来已经过了那么久啊，发生了好多好多事……
translation: Han Lingsha: ...Remember? The first time we came to the treehouse, I said I wanted to live in seclusion in the mountains, away from the affairs of the martial world. Those... still feel like scenes from yesterday, but thinking carefully, it turns out so much time has passed, and so many, many things have happened...

original_text: 云天河：我不明白，不是说好了吗？以后一起住在青鸾峰……怎么你又要走？
translation: Yun Tianhe: I don't understand. Didn't we agree? To live together on Qingluan Peak from now on... Why are you leaving again?

original_text: 韩菱纱：……我听见了，你和紫英的话……
translation: Han Lingsha: ... I heard your conversation with Ziying...

original_text: 云天河：……！那是——
translation: Yun Tianhe: ...! That's-

original_text: 韩菱纱：不要瞒我……也别安慰我好吗？
translation: Han Lingsha: Don't hide it from me... and don't comfort me, okay?

original_text: 韩菱纱：其实……你和紫英，你们不用这样痛苦……只要我把自己杀了，所有的一切不都结束了？
translation: Han Lingsha: Actually... you and Ziying, you don't have to suffer like this... If I just kill myself, wouldn't everything end?

original_text: 云天河：菱纱……你在乱说什么……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Lingsha... What nonsense are you talking about...

original_text: 云天河：这、这怎么可以？！！
translation: Yun Tianhe: This, this can't be?!!

original_text: 韩菱纱：……我只想找个地方，静静了结自己的性命……日子久了，你和紫英会慢慢把我忘记的，忘记了，就不会再伤心……
translation: Han Lingsha: ... I just want to find a place to quietly end my life... Over time, you and Ziying will slowly forget me. Once forgotten, there will be no more sorrow...

original_text: 云天河：别说了！你跟我回去，好好休息，别再想这些！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Stop talking! Come back with me, rest well, and don't think about these things anymore!

original_text: 韩菱纱：……可是，人一旦要死了，反而会多很多牵挂，想起从前的事……
translation: Han Lingsha: ... But when a person is about to die, they suddenly have many more attachments, remembering things from the past...

original_text: 韩菱纱：第一次见梦璃，我想世上怎么会有这样漂亮的人，只可惜是个任性的大小姐，把人耍得团团转……
translation: Han Lingsha: When I first saw Mengli, I thought how could there be such a beautiful person in the world? It's just a pity she's a willful young lady, making people run in circles...

original_text: 韩菱纱：……在太一仙径的时候，我们虽然是被紫英救了，却也被他数落了几句，把我气得直跳脚……
translation: Han Lingsha: ... In the Taiyi Immortal Path, although we were saved by Ziying, he also scolded us a few times, making me so angry I was hopping mad...

original_text: 韩菱纱：……可有些事情，就算开始的时候乱七八糟，最后却变成了无论如何也不想忘掉的回忆……
translation: Han Lingsha: ... But some things, even if they start out all messy, end up becoming memories you absolutely don't want to forget...

original_text: 韩菱纱：出来这么久了，不晓得故乡的亲人有没有盼我回去……
translation: Han Lingsha: We've been away for so long. I wonder if my family back home is hoping for my return...

original_text: 韩菱纱：这些……我通通舍不得、放不下……我是不是太贪心了？
translation: Han Lingsha: All these... I can't bear to part with any of them, can't let go... Am I too greedy?

original_text: 云天河：舍不得的话，为什么还要说死？！
translation: Yun Tianhe: If you can't bear to part, why even talk about dying?!

original_text: 韩菱纱：正因为舍不得，才只能这样……
translation: Han Lingsha: Precisely because I can't bear to, it has to be this way...

original_text: 韩菱纱：天河，我不像你和紫英那么强，我还有什么其他的办法，能保护自己想保护的人呢？
translation: Han Lingsha: Tianhe, I'm not as strong as you and Ziying. What other ways do I have to protect those I want to protect?

original_text: 云天河：不对！是我要保护你，要是做不到，我就太没用了……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Wrong! I should protect you, if I can't do that, I'm too useless...

original_text: 韩菱纱：……你知道我最放不下的，是什么吗？
translation: Han Lingsha: ... Do you know what I can't let go of most?

original_text: 韩菱纱：……有一天，我误打误撞进到一个山洞里，在那里遇上一个人，看着还挺顺眼的，脑袋却不怎么灵光，居然把我当成了山猪精……
translation: Han Lingsha: ... One day, I accidentally stumbled into a cave and met a person there. He looked quite pleasing to the eye, but his head wasn't very bright-he actually mistook me for a mountain boar spirit...

original_text: 云天河：……！
translation: Yun Tianhe: ...!

original_text: 韩菱纱：我那时就觉得，这真是个傻子，呆呆的，怕是被人卖了都不知道。
translation: Han Lingsha: Back then, I thought, what a fool, so clueless, probably wouldn't know if he was being sold.

original_text: 韩菱纱：和他一起下山闯荡，就只是觉得好玩，虽然他常常做出些吓到人的事，让我收烂摊……
translation: Han Lingsha: Going down the mountain to adventure with him, I just thought it was fun. Although he often does things that scare people, leaving me to clean up the mess...

original_text: 韩菱纱：渐渐地，我越来越把他放在心上，总想着……要是哪一天没有了我，谁来照顾他，他那么呆，一定会被人骗、被人欺负……
translation: Han Lingsha: Gradually, I cared about him more and more, always thinking... if one day I were gone, who would take care of him? He's so clueless, he'd definitely get tricked or bullied...

original_text: 云天河：菱纱……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Lingsha...

original_text: 韩菱纱：其实，那都是些借口，他已经比以前懂事好多，是我……是我自己离不开他……
translation: Han Lingsha: Actually, those are all excuses. He's become much more sensible than before. It's me... I'm the one who can't let go...

original_text: 云天河：不是，菱纱……不是这样！我知道自己笨，没有你的话，很多事都做不成，你不要走……
translation: Yun Tianhe: No, Lingsha... it's not like that! I know I'm dumb. Without you, I couldn't do many things. Don't go...

original_text: 韩菱纱：就算没有望舒剑，我也注定是要短命的……为了那短短几年阳寿，真的值得你和玄霄拼个你死我活吗？
translation: Han Lingsha: Even without Wangshu Sword, I was destined to have a short life... Is it really worth it for you and Xuanxiao to fight to the death over just a few extra years of life?

original_text: 云天河：我和紫英不是去拼命！是……是去劝玄霄放弃飞升……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Ziying and I aren't going to fight to the death! We're... going to persuade Xuanxiao to give up ascension...

original_text: 韩菱纱：……劝他放弃？你……你真的是笨蛋……
translation: Han Lingsha: ... Persuade him to give up? You... you really are an idiot...

original_text: 韩菱纱：……我的一条命，能救很多人……如果琼华派数百年基业，真的毁在玄霄手里，我们要怎么面对青阳长老的嘱托……
translation: Han Lingsha: ... My life can save many... If the centuries-old foundation of Qionghua Sect is truly destroyed by Xuanxiao, how can we face Elder Qingyang's last wish...

original_text: 慕容紫英：若是唯你一死，方能解我派之灾，那琼华派即使无恙，往后又有何颜面存于世间？
translation: Murong Ziying: If only your death could avert our sect's disaster, then even if Qionghua Sect remains unharmed, what dignity would it have to stand in this world thereafter?

original_text: 韩菱纱：……紫英……
translation: Han Lingsha: ... Ziying...

original_text: 慕容紫英：抱歉，我无意旁听……只是在山下没找见你，回到山上找，听见树屋有人声……
translation: Murong Ziying: Apologies, I didn't mean to eavesdrop... I just couldn't find you down the mountain, returned to search, and heard voices in the treehouse...

original_text: 韩菱纱：对不起，害你担心……
translation: Han Lingsha: Sorry for making you worry...

original_text: 慕容紫英：菱纱，你可知你求得一死，也只不过令琼华派暂时无法飞升，但望舒剑还在师叔手中，他只需寻到合适的宿体，今日之局又会重演……
translation: Murong Ziying: Lingsha, do you realize that even if you seek death, it will only temporarily prevent Qionghua Sect from ascending? But Wangshu Sword is still in the Sect Elder's hands. He just needs to find a suitable host, and today's situation will repeat...

original_text: 韩菱纱：但是……想找到宿体，一定很难吧？
translation: Han Lingsha: But... it must be very difficult to find a host body, right?

original_text: 韩菱纱：能拖多久就是多久，说不定、说不定那段日子里，就能发现其他阻止玄霄的办法了……
translation: Han Lingsha: Delay as long as possible. Maybe, just maybe, during that time, we can discover other ways to stop Xuanxiao...

original_text: 慕容紫英：纵然有此可能，但师叔只会入魔更深，力量更加不可控制，他若带着双剑踏遍天下，寻找宿体，不知将会引出多少腥风血雨……
translation: Murong Ziying: Even if that's possible, Martial Uncle will only fall deeper into demonic ways, his power becoming even more uncontrollable. If he roams the world with the dual swords, seeking hosts, who knows how much bloodshed he'll cause...

original_text: 韩菱纱：……或许……真的会这样吧……
translation: Han Lingsha: ... Perhaps... it really will be like that...

original_text: 慕容紫英：被羲和剑之力吞噬的宿主，将变得嗜血狂乱，直到完全迷失心智，师叔如今的样子，也已相差无几了……
translation: Murong Ziying: A host consumed by the power of Xihe Sword will become bloodthirsty and frenzied, until completely losing their mind. Martial Uncle's current state is already not far from that...

original_text: 云天河：菱纱，你别再乱想了……所有的事，都在玄霄身上，只要他还有升仙的念头，别人做什么都没用……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Lingsha, stop overthinking... Everything depends on Xuanxiao. As long as he still wants to ascend to immortality, nothing anyone else does will matter...

original_text: 云天河：……天已经快亮了，等天一亮，我就御剑去琼华派。
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... It's almost dawn. Once the sky brightens, I'll ride my sword to Qionghua Sect.

original_text: 云天河：不能再等下去，要是玄霄和夙瑶已经做成剑柱，就太迟了！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Can't wait any longer. If Xuanxiao and Suyao have already completed the sword pillars, it'll be too late!

original_text: 云天河：我会劝他放弃……
translation: Yun Tianhe: I'll persuade him to give up...

original_text: 韩菱纱：如果他不愿意呢？
translation: Han Lingsha: What if he's unwilling?

original_text: 云天河：我…………
translation: Yun Tianhe: I......

original_text: 云天河：我……会……会杀了他！
translation: Yun Tianhe: I... will... will kill him!

original_text: 韩菱纱：天河……你让你自己太痛苦了……
translation: Han Lingsha: Tianhe... You're making yourself suffer too much...

original_text: 云天河：不要再说了……没有别的方法……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Don't say anymore... There's no other way...

original_text: 韩菱纱：……那，我和你一起去。
translation: Han Lingsha: ... Then, I'll go with you.

original_text: 云天河：不，你留在青鸾峰，让紫英和“梦璃”照顾你！
translation: Yun Tianhe: No, you stay on Qingluan Peak. Let Ziying and 'Mengli' take care of you!

original_text: 韩菱纱：不行，到现在你还想把我丢下？！你去，我就一定要去！
translation: Han Lingsha: No way, you still want to leave me behind now?! If you go, I'm definitely going too!

original_text: 云天河：菱纱！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Lingsha!

original_text: 云天河：你……
translation: Yun Tianhe: You...

original_text: 慕容紫英：……也罢，我们就一起去琼华派，也免得彼此担心，反而误事。
translation: Murong Ziying: ... Fine then, let's go to Qionghua Sect together, so we won't worry about each other and cause trouble.

original_text: 慕容紫英：菱纱的状况时好时坏，若是突然发作起来，天河你可以及时替她运功驱寒……不然我也难料后果……
translation: Murong Ziying: Lingsha's condition fluctuates. If it suddenly worsens, Tianhe, you can promptly channel energy to dispel her coldness... Otherwise, the consequences are unpredictable...

original_text: 韩菱纱：我们这三个好朋友既然都替彼此着想，也放心不下彼此，不如就一起去，不是吗？
translation: Han Lingsha: Since we three good friends all care for each other and worry about each other, why not just go together, right?

original_text: 韩菱纱：放心吧，天河你每次都瞻前顾后，后来还不是没事？别瞧不起人了，我能照顾好自己的。
translation: Han Lingsha: Don't worry, Tianhe, you always hesitate, but things turn out fine. Don't look down on me, I can take care of myself.

original_text: 云天河：哎呀！！我真是说不过你……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Aiya!! I really can't argue with you...

original_text: 云天河：那好吧，身体不舒服的话，要马上告诉我！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Alright then. If you feel unwell, tell me right away!

original_text: 韩菱纱：知道了啦。
translation: Han Lingsha: Got it, got it.

original_text: 慕容紫英：我们即刻动身。不知琼华派的结界有无撤去，<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>先御剑飞往播仙镇，</colour><dc0>到了那里再做打算。</dc0>
translation: Murong Ziying: We set off immediately. I don't know if Qionghua Sect's barrier has been lifted.<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> First, ride our swords to Boxian Town,</colour><dc0> and make plans once we arrive there.</dc0>

original_text: 韩菱纱：先回小木屋吧，看看天河找到那本书了没有～
translation: Han Lingsha: Let's return to the small cabin first, see if Tianhe found that book~

original_text: 云天河：先回屋看看菱纱吧。
translation: Yun Tianhe: First go back to check on Lingsha.

original_text: 云天河：已经晚了，还是<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>回屋去看看菱纱吧</colour><dc0>。</dc0>
translation: Yun Tianhe: It's already late, better<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> go back to the cabin and check on Lingsha</colour><dc0>.</dc0>

original_text: 云天河：那边已经是下山的路了，我先<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>在山上找菱纱……</colour>
translation: Yun Tianhe: That way is already the path down the mountain. I'll<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> look for Lingsha on the mountain first...</colour>

translation: Proceed to?

original_text: 云天河：这边是仓库，就不要进去了吧。
translation: Yun Tianhe: This side is the warehouse, better not go in.

original_text: 云天河：哇～～～～～～人好多！这么多人！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Wow~~~~~~ so many people! So many!

original_text: 男孩：王大哥跳舞跳得真好！
translation: Boy: Brother Wang dances so well!

original_text: 青年：什么跳舞……小孩子不懂别乱讲，王大哥这是扮钟馗打鬼，等下还得去祠堂前的戏台上。
translation: Youth: What dancing... children shouldn't speak nonsense if they don't understand. Brother Wang is playing Zhong Kui to beat the ghosts; later he still has to go to the stage in front of the ancestral hall.

original_text: 韩菱纱：大惊小怪，没见过人多啊……
translation: Han Lingsha: Making a fuss, never seen so many people before...

original_text: 云天河：是、是没见过啊，人原来这么多啊……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Y-yes, I've never seen so many people before...

original_text: 韩菱纱：唉……
translation: Han Lingsha: Sigh...

original_text: 韩菱纱：土包子别东张西望，小心招来麻烦～
translation: Han Lingsha: Country bumpkin, don't gawk around, you might attract trouble~

original_text: 云天河：快看！中间那个！那个穿红衣的，是他们的大王？……啊，他们走了，往另一个方向去了……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Look! The one in the middle! The one in red-is that their king? ...Ah, they're leaving, heading in another direction...

original_text: 韩菱纱：（……根本没在听我说话……）
translation: Han Lingsha: (...He's not listening to me at all...)

original_text: 韩菱纱：什么大王小鬼？又在说傻话？
translation: Han Lingsha: What king or little ghost? Talking nonsense again?

original_text: 云天河：呵呵，原来你不懂啊？猴群里的猴子都会跟着最厉害的猴王。那个红衣服的要不是老大，干嘛一堆人围着他？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Hehe, so you don't understand? In a monkey troop, all the monkeys follow the strongest monkey king. If that guy in red isn't the boss, why would a bunch of people surround him?

original_text: 韩菱纱：傻瓜，我看你干脆去当猴子算了！
translation: Han Lingsha: Fool, I think you might as well go be a monkey!

original_text: 韩菱纱：你记住了，山下和山上不一样，不是只比谁的拳头硬，凡事都要讲个规矩，就像老百姓要听当官的，当官的要听皇帝的。
translation: Han Lingsha: Remember, it's different down the mountain than up. It's not just about who has the hardest fists. Everything has its rules, just like commoners obey officials, and officials obey the emperor.

original_text: 云天河：那个叫“黄弟”的，很厉害吗？剑法如何？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Is that 'The Emperor' guy really powerful? How's his swordsmanship?

original_text: 韩菱纱：我又没见过皇帝，哪知道他会不会使剑啊。反正他权力很大，只要一声令下，成千上万的人都得掉脑袋。
translation: Han Lingsha: I've never met the emperor, how would I know if he wields a sword? His power is immense-one order and thousands lose heads.

original_text: 云天河：这么厉害？那不是已经到了爹说的以气御剑的境界？
translation: Yun Tianhe: That powerful? Has he reached the level controlling Sword with Qi that Father mentioned?

original_text: 韩菱纱：哎呀～根本不是一回事嘛。
translation: Han Lingsha: Oh dear~ That's not the same thing at all.

original_text: 韩菱纱：少问一些有的没的，天色不早了，我们先找个地方歇息，然后商量接下来要去哪里。
translation: Han Lingsha: Stop asking pointless questions. It's getting late; let's find a place to rest first, then discuss where to go next.

original_text: 云天河：找地方？不用找啦，这儿这么多房子，我随便睡哪都行。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Find a place? No need to look, there are so many houses here, I can sleep anywhere.

original_text: 韩菱纱：天呐～～傻瓜傻瓜大傻瓜！
translation: Han Lingsha: Heavens~~ Fool, fool, big fool!

original_text: 韩菱纱：房子再多也是别人的，主人不同意你就进去住，是想做强盗啊？
translation: Han Lingsha: No matter how many houses there are, they belong to others. Moving in without the owner's permission, are you trying to be a robber?

original_text: 云天河：……？
translation: Yun Tianhe: ...?

original_text: 韩菱纱：停——！接下来你别问我“强盗”是什么，反正在山下你都不懂，一个不懂和两个三个不懂也没差啦。
translation: Han Lingsha: Stop-! Don't ask me what a 'robber' is next. Since you didn't understand it down the mountain, one thing you don't know versus two or three makes no difference.

original_text: 云天河：哦……饿死了，我想吃东西。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Oh...Starving, I want to eat something.

original_text: 韩菱纱：哼，别满嘴死啊死的，你哪有这么虚弱！
translation: Han Lingsha: Hmph, stop talking about death all the time, you're not that weak!

original_text: 韩菱纱：这太平村地方小，也没客栈，我们借住在村长家好了。
translation: Han Lingsha: This Taiping Village is small, with no inns. Let's stay at the village chief's house.

original_text: 云天河：村长家有好东西吃吗？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Does the village chief's house have good food?

original_text: 韩菱纱：……唉，我现在就去找村长，你别跟来了，免得添乱。
translation: Han Lingsha: ... Sigh, I'm going to find the village chief now. Don't follow me, you'll just cause trouble.

original_text: 云天河：那我去看那个穿红衣服的～
translation: Yun Tianhe: Then I'll go look at the one in red clothes~

original_text: 韩菱纱：……
translation: Han Lingsha: ...

original_text: 韩菱纱：听好了！有什么事等我回来再说，不～许～惹～麻～烦！
translation: Han Lingsha: Listen up! Whatever it is, wait until I get back to talk about it, do~not~cause~trouble!

original_text: 云天河：哦，那些人我又不认识。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Oh, I don't know those people anyway.

original_text: 韩菱纱：（哼，就是不认识，才更麻烦。）
translation: Han Lingsha: (Hmph, it's precisely because we don't know them that it's more troublesome.)

original_text: 韩菱纱：我走了，记得你答应的话！
translation: Han Lingsha: I'm leaving, remember what you promised!

original_text: 李慎：又香又好吃的粽子咧～
translation: Li Shen: Fragrant and delicious zongzi~

original_text: 李慎：只有端午节才吃的到，过了这村可就没这店了！
translation: Li Shen: You can only eat these during the Dragon Boat Festival. Miss this chance, and it's gone!

original_text: 李慎：嘿嘿，小哥尝尝看吧。
translation: Li Shen: Hehe, young man, have a taste.

original_text: 云天河：这个，真的好吃？
translation: Yun Tianhe: This, is it really tasty?

original_text: 李慎：哈哈，那当然！看你打扮是附近村子的猎户吧，居然不清楚我李家这块大好招牌～
translation: Li Shen: Haha, of course! Judging by your attire, you're a hunter from a nearby village, yet you don't know about my Li family's renowned reputation~

original_text: 李慎：我们村里还有个习俗，每年端午就有扮钟馗、斩小鬼的戏目，谢他老人家保佑平安。一边吃粽子，一边看戏，真是再好不过了～
translation: Li Shen: Our village also has a custom: every Dragon Boat Festival, there's a play where someone impersonates Zhong Kui to slay little ghosts, thanking him for protecting our peace. Eating zongzi while watching the play is simply wonderful~

original_text: 云天河：……原来山下的人不吃烤肉。
translation: Yun Tianhe: ...So people below the mountain don't eat roasted meat.

original_text: 云天河：这玩意怪模怪样，外面壳好像很硬，还绑了绳子，古怪。
translation: Yun Tianhe: This thing looks weird. The outer shell seems hard, and it's tied with rope-strange.

original_text: 李慎：小哥你……
translation: Li Shen: Young man, you...

original_text: 云天河：唔、唔……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Mm, mm...

original_text: 云天河：唔，不好吃、不好吃！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Ugh, not tasty, not tasty!

original_text: 云天河：三两口就吃完了，外面的壳还嚼不烂！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Finished in two or three bites, and the outer shell is too tough to chew!

original_text: 李慎：我说小哥，你和我说笑呢？
translation: Li Shen: I say, young man, are you joking with me?

original_text: 云天河：这种东西哪比得上香喷喷的烤肉，你们吃这个，难怪长得不结实，看我下回猎几头山猪来送你！
translation: Yun Tianhe: How can this stuff compare to delicious roasted meat? You eat this, no wonder you're not sturdy. Next time I'll hunt some boars for you!

original_text: 李慎：哎，等等！你还没付钱呢！
translation: Li Shen: Hey, wait! You haven't paid yet!

original_text: 云天河：……钱？
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... Paid?

original_text: 李慎：一个粽子一文钱，招牌上写得清清楚楚，我小本生意，你可别吃霸王饭坑人呐！
translation: Li Shen: One zongzi costs one coin, clearly written on the sign. I run a small business; don't you dare eat without paying and cheat me!

original_text: 云天河：是你要我尝尝，我才吃的。
translation: Yun Tianhe: You told me to try it, so I ate it.

original_text: 李慎：好哇！你想赖帐？！
translation: Li Shen: Wow! Trying to weasel out?!

original_text: 韩菱纱：怎么回事？
translation: Han Lingsha: What's going on?

original_text: 李慎：这位姑娘来的正好，你评评理，这小子吃东西不给钱，还一副理直气壮的样子。
translation: Li Shen: This young lady came just in time. You judge: this kid eats without paying money and still acts all righteous.

original_text: 云天河：“钱”是什么？是他让我尝尝看，我才拿起来吃，又不好吃……
translation: Yun Tianhe: What is 'money'? He told me to try it, so I picked it up and ate it, but it didn't taste good...

original_text: 李慎：你敢瞧不起李家的手艺？！
translation: Li Shen: You dare look down on the Li family's craftsmanship?!

original_text: 韩菱纱：对不住，我这个朋友不懂世事，也不会说话，他欠你多少钱，我赔就是！
translation: Han Lingsha: Sorry, my friend here doesn't know much about the world and isn't good with words. How much does he owe you? I'll pay!

original_text: 韩菱纱：（云天河，我竟然相信你不会惹麻烦，可恶～～！！）
translation: Han Lingsha: (Yun Tianhe, I actually believed you wouldn't cause trouble, damn it~~!!)

original_text: 李慎：敢情你们俩认识？
translation: Li Shen: So you two know each other?

original_text: 李慎：别跟我谈钱，俗气！钱财事小，名声事大！让这小子乱说我李家的粽子难吃，我以后还要不要在村里混——
translation: Li Shen: Don't talk to me about money-how vulgar! Money is trivial; reputation is what matters! If this kid keeps saying my Li family's zongzi taste bad, how can I keep my standing in the village-

original_text: 宋大田：混蛋！给我站住——！
translation: Song Datian: Bastard! Stop right there-!

original_text: 宋大田：气死我了！还不给我乖乖滚回鸡窝！！
translation: Song Datian: So mad! Get back to the chicken coop obediently!!

original_text: 宋大田：……
translation: Song Datian: ...

original_text: 青年：哈哈哈，宋大叔你还是老样子，吼得最响，退得最快～
translation: Youth: Hahaha, Uncle Song, you're still the same-shout the loudest, retreat the fastest~

original_text: 宋大田：谁、谁说的！我今天非教训它不可！
translation: Song Datian: Who, who said that! I'm going to teach it a lesson today!

original_text: 宋大田：别以为能生几个蛋我就治不了你！瞧我宰了你炖汤！
translation: Song Datian: Don't think laying a few eggs means I can't deal with you! I'll slaughter you for soup!

original_text: 宋大田：呃……
translation: Song Datian: Uh...

original_text: 云天河：别怕，我帮你！！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Don't be afraid, I'll help you!!

original_text: 女孩：哇！小花怎么不动了？！
translation: Girl: Wow! Why isn't Xiaohua moving?!

original_text: 青年：这、这是什么妖法……
translation: Youth: Wh-what sorcery is this...

original_text: 猎户：就是就是！刚才眼前蓝光这么一闪，像是一把剑飞了出去，可是剑又怎么会自己飞回来，八成是妖法……
translation: Hunter: Exactly! Just now, a blue light flashed-like a sword flying out. But how can a sword fly back on its own? Must be demonic magic...

original_text: 宋大田：你！你杀了我家小花！！
translation: Song Datian: You! You killed my Xiaohua!!

original_text: 云天河：呵呵，它凶得很，你又说要宰了它，我帮你一把嘛。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Hehe, it's fierce, and you said you'd kill it, so I gave you a hand.

original_text: 宋大田：臭小子，我饶不了你！！
translation: Song Datian: Brat, I won't let you off!!

original_text: 韩菱纱：等一下！大叔你冷静点，有话好说。
translation: Han Lingsha: Wait! Uncle, calm down, let's talk this out.

original_text: 韩菱纱：这只鸡……我、我赔钱就是！
translation: Han Lingsha: This chicken... I, I'll pay for it!

original_text: 宋大田：赔钱？！你赔得起吗？！我这可是一天能下四只蛋的宝贝母鸡，臭小子不知用什么古怪法子把它弄死了，以后我们全家靠什么吃饭啊～！！
translation: Song Datian: Compensate?! Can you afford it?! This is my precious hen that lays four eggs a day! This brat killed it with some weird method. What will my family rely on for food from now on?!!

original_text: 云天河：吃饭？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Eat?

original_text: 云天河：简单呐，不就是靠自己的一张嘴张口吃饭，有什么困难？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Simple, isn't it? Just rely on your own mouth to eat-what's so hard about that?

original_text: 宋大田：气～气～气～气死我也！小子欠揍！
translation: Song Datian: Angry~ angry~ angry~ I'm furious! You brat, asking for a beating!

original_text: 李慎：等等！揍人也要有个先来后到，他头一个得罪的是我，宋大叔你让让先！
translation: Li Shen: Wait! Beating someone up should follow order. He offended me first, Uncle Song, please step aside!

original_text: 宋大田：凭什么？！看你身上没几两肉，打架行不行啊？
translation: Song Datian: Why should I?! Looking at you, you don't have much meat on you, can you even fight?

original_text: 李慎：嘿嘿，我有帮手！
translation: Li Shen: Hehe, I have help!

original_text: ？？：王魁山在此！谁敢吃霸王饭！
translation: ??: Wang Kuishan is here! Who dares to eat without paying!

original_text: 李慎：王大哥，就是他！头像鸟窝的那个！
translation: Li Shen: Brother Wang, it's him! The one with the bird's nest hair!

original_text: 王魁山：吃霸王饭的，来来来！你跟俺较量较量，看你还敢不敢白吃东西！
translation: Wang Kuishan: You freeloader! Come on! Let's see if you still dare to eat without paying after a match with me!

original_text: 李慎：这位王魁山王大哥是我们村的大力士，年年都在端午节扮钟馗，他的力气可不比真钟馗小，专门对付那些捣乱的家伙！
translation: Li Shen: This big brother Wang Kuishan is our village's strongman. He plays Zhong Kui every Dragon Boat Festival-his strength rivals the real Zhong Kui, dealing with troublemakers!

original_text: 韩菱纱：你们别不讲理，我明明说了要给钱的。
translation: Han Lingsha: Don't be unreasonable-I clearly said I'd pay.

original_text: 云天河：菱纱，打就打！他们不讲理，我听他们的话，还要被揍！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Lingsha, hit them then! They're being unreasonable-I listen to them and still get beaten up!

original_text: 韩菱纱：（不好！野人牛脾气发了……）
translation: Han Lingsha: (Oh no! This barbarian's stubborn temper is flaring...)

original_text: 云天河：就算他们的大王来了，我也不怕！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Even if their king comes, I'm not afraid!

original_text: 青年：糟糕！那边……王大哥要和人打起来了……
translation: Youth: Oh no! Over there... Brother Wang is about to get into a fight...

original_text: 王魁山：……厉害，俺不是这小伙子的对手……
translation: Wang Kuishan: ...Impressive. I'm no match for this young man...

original_text: 李慎：王大哥！你、唉！你怎么就输了呢？
translation: Li Shen: Brother Wang! You, ah! How could you lose?

original_text: 女孩：呜哇～爹爹骗人，还说钟馗是最厉害的！
translation: Girl: Waa~ Daddy lied, said Zhong Kui was the strongest!

original_text: 宋大田：你们！以多欺少，不算英雄好汉！
translation: Song Datian: You! Ganging up on one, that's not heroic!

original_text: 韩菱纱：你说什么？！
translation: Han Lingsha: What did you say?!

original_text: 李慎：说的好！宋大叔，换你好好教训这小子！
translation: Li Shen: Well said! Uncle Song, teach this kid a good lesson!

original_text: 宋大田：啊？！这个嘛……我看魁山他也是一时不小心……歇息歇息肯定能把他们打趴下！
translation: Song Datian: Ah?! Well... I think Kuishan was just careless for a moment... after resting, he'll definitely be able to beat them down!

original_text: 王魁山：俺、俺不打了，刚才这姑娘好像说了要给钱，俺不能冤枉好人。
translation: Wang Kuishan: I-I won't fight. Just now, this young lady mentioned giving money. I can't wrong good people.

original_text: 谷婆婆：瞧瞧，今天是端午节，大伙儿本该聚到戏台去看戏，怎么这儿比戏台还热闹？
translation: Granny Gu: Look, today is the Dragon Boat Festival. Everyone should be gathering at the opera stage to watch a play. Why is it more lively here than the stage?

original_text: 谷婆婆：咦？这孩子看起来眼熟得很呐……我年纪是大了，但眼睛可一点没昏花……
translation: Granny Gu: Huh? This child looks very familiar... I may be old, but my eyesight hasn't dimmed at all...

original_text: 云天河：是说我？我没见过你啊。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Are you talking about me? I haven't met you.

original_text: 谷婆婆：……像，真是像，这眉毛、这眼睛，和云家那惹祸精十几岁时没两样……
translation: Granny Gu: ...Alike, truly alike. These eyebrows, these eyes-just like that troublemaker Yun when he was in his teens...

original_text: 村民甲：对啊，他不就是那个云天青？！不对不对……年纪差太多了，可是……
translation: Villager A: Right, isn't he that Yun Tianqing?! No, no... the age difference is too big, but...

original_text: 云天河：你认识我爹？
translation: Yun Tianhe: You knew my father?

original_text: 村民甲：好哇！原来你是那混帐的儿子！他回村了没？！我可要找他算帐！
translation: Villager A: Great! So you're that bastard's son! Has he returned to the village? I need to settle accounts with him!

original_text: 村民乙：谁？！谁说云天青回来了？找他算我一个！
translation: Villager B: Who?! Who said Yun Tianqing is back? Count me in if you're looking for him!

original_text: 云天河：怎么你们都认识我爹？
translation: Yun Tianhe: How come you all know my Father?

original_text: 村民乙：岂止认识？那小子的事我记得最清楚了！从小就不学好，三天两头骗我糖吃！
translation: Villager B: More than just know? I remember that kid's affairs most clearly! Never behaved since childhood, cheating me out of candy every other day!

original_text: 村民乙：隔壁阿香喜欢我，他偏要和我抢！幸好阿香有眼光，最后还是做了我老婆！
translation: Villager B: My neighbor A-Xiang liked me, but he insisted on competing with me! Fortunately, A-Xiang had good taste and ended up becoming my wife!

original_text: 阿香：死鬼～多少年以前的事了，说出来也不害臊！
translation: A-Xiang: You devil~ That was so many years ago, aren't you ashamed to say it!

original_text: 村民甲：你那些事算什么！有一回他趁我醉酒，把我扒光了衣服扔在路上，脸都丢光了！
translation: Villager A: Your troubles are nothing! Once, when I was drunk, he stripped me naked and threw me on the road-utterly humiliating!

original_text: 少女：嘻，原来爹还有这样的糗事啊，瞧你平时都一本正经的～
translation: Young Girl: Hehe, so Dad had such an embarrassing story. You always act so serious usually~

original_text: 村民甲：笑什么笑！静儿你回去，村里大事，小孩子少管！
translation: Villager A: What are you laughing at! Jing'er, go home. Village affairs are no business for children!

original_text: 村民丙：你们都没我惨！有一回云天青和我打赌，输了的人要大冬天浸冰水，结果那家伙耍赖，害我……害我在床上躺了半个多月——
translation: Villager C: None of you had it as bad as me! Once, Yun Tianqing bet with me-the loser had to soak in icy water in winter. That guy cheated, and I... I ended up bedridden for over half a month-

original_text: ？？：够了！吵些什么？！
translation: ???: Enough! What's all this noise?!

original_text: 村民乙：啊？！村长来了！
translation: Villager B: Huh?! The village chief is here!

original_text: 宋大田：村长来的正好！来替我们评评理！
translation: Song Datian: The village chief came just in time! Judge this for us!

original_text: 云靳：端午节这等日子，喧哗胡闹，还有没有祖宗礼法了？！
translation: Yun Jin: On a day like Dragon Boat Festival, such noise and mischief, is there no respect for ancestral rites?!

original_text: 云靳：韩姑娘，我念你一个女孩孤身在外不易，才答应让你留宿村中，可不是让你招出是非！
translation: Yun Jin: Miss Han, I allowed you to stay in the village because I pitied a young girl alone and vulnerable outside, not so you could stir up trouble!

original_text: 韩菱纱：村长，我们不是——
translation: Han Lingsha: Village Chief, we're not-

original_text: 云天河：你干嘛？！
translation: Yun Tianhe: What are you doing?!

original_text: 云天河：爹说过女孩子是要好好对待的，不是拿来凶的！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Dad said girls should be treated well, not yelled at!

original_text: 云靳：你是——？！
translation: Yun Jin: You are-?!

original_text: 云靳：云……天青？！
translation: Yun Jin: Yun... Tianqing?!

original_text: 云靳：……不对，你刚才说……云天青是你爹？！
translation: Yun Jin: ...Wait, you just said... Yun Tianqing is your dad?!

original_text: 云天河：对啊，原来你们都认识我爹。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Right, so you all knew my father.

original_text: 云靳：是谁让他进村的？还不快把他赶出去！
translation: Yun Jin: Who let him into the village? Hurry up and chase him out!

original_text: 韩菱纱：村长——？！
translation: Han Lingsha: Village chief-?!

original_text: 云靳：云天青早已不是云家子孙，和他有亲缘之人也不得留在太平村中！
translation: Yun Jin: Yun Tianqing is no longer a descendant of the Yun family, and anyone related to him cannot stay in Taiping Village!

original_text: 云天河：菱纱，他说的什么意思？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Lingsha, what does he mean?
Han Lingsha: ......

original_text: 云靳：……看样子你爹也羞于向你提起旧事。也罢，不管你来此何意，今日我就当着大伙的面，再说一说这村里的大事和规矩！
translation: Yun Jin: ...It seems your father was too ashamed to tell you the old story. Fine, regardless of your purpose here, today I'll explain the village's major events and rules in front of everyone!

original_text: 云靳：我云家先祖镇守边疆有功，得以被朝廷恩赐修建祠堂，并将原本的云家村赐名“太平”。
translation: Yun Jin: Our Yun family ancestors rendered meritorious service guarding the border, earning imperial favor to build this ancestral hall. The original Yun Family Village was also renamed 'Taiping'.

original_text: 云靳：赫赫天威，皇恩浩荡！云家后代未再有人入仕已是惭愧，不想到了这代，本家竟出了一个浪荡子云天青，不遵礼法，行止违和，实是家门不幸！
translation: Yun Jin: The majestic power of heaven, the boundless grace of the emperor! It is already shameful that no descendants of the Yun family have entered government service since then. Yet in this generation, the main branch has produced a prodigal son, Yun Tianqing, who disregards propriety and behaves improperly-truly a misfortune for the family!

original_text: 云靳：家中长辈痛心疾首，奈何此人屡教不改，已在多年前被逐出家门，永不得返！
translation: Yun Jin: The elders of the family were deeply grieved, but this person repeatedly failed to mend their ways. They were expelled from the family years ago and may never return!

original_text: 宋大田：竟……竟还有这事，我十年前才迁过来，都不知道。
translation: Song Datian: Re... really such a thing? I moved here only ten years ago, didn't know.

original_text: 谷婆婆：唉，云家人虽然读过圣贤书，对那孩子却一点也没办法。
translation: Granny Gu: Sigh, although the Yun family has read the classics of sages, they have no way with that child at all.

original_text: 韩菱纱：哼，<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>天河，我们走！</colour>
translation: Han Lingsha: Hmph, <colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>Tianhe, let's go!</colour>

original_text: 云天河：等等！我爹的事还没问完呢。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Wait! I haven't finished asking about my father yet.

original_text: 韩菱纱：还问什么问，他们除了骂人什么都不会说的！
translation: Han Lingsha: Why even ask? They won't say anything except curse at people!

original_text: 云靳：韩姑娘此言差矣，今日就事论事，绝无像市井谩骂一般有失体统。
translation: Yun Jin: Miss Han, you are mistaken. Today we are discussing the matter at hand, not engaging in vulgar street arguments.

original_text: 韩菱纱：村长不知有时候人言快过刀子吗？天河是天河，他爹是他爹，你们这么多人围着一个小辈，还真是客气啊！
translation: Han Lingsha: Does the village chief not know that sometimes words are sharper than knives? Tianhe is Tianhe, his father is his father. All of you surrounding a junior like this, you're really being polite!

original_text: 云靳：岂有此理！放肆了！！
translation: Yun Jin: How outrageous! How insolent!!

original_text: 村民乙：竟敢对村长无礼？
translation: Villager B: How dare you disrespect the chief?

original_text: 宋大田：就算不管他爹，这小子杀了我家的鸡又怎么算？！
translation: Song Datian: Even if we ignore his father, how do we account for this kid killing my family's chickens?!

original_text: 村民乙：你们走！不然别怪我们动粗！
translation: Villager B: You leave! Or don't blame us for getting rough!

original_text: 韩菱纱：走就走，姑娘我也不稀罕留下！
translation: Han Lingsha: Fine, I'll go! I don't care to stay anyway!

original_text: 云天河：可是——
translation: Yun Tianhe: But-

original_text: 韩菱纱：还可是什么，走了！
translation: Han Lingsha: What 'buts'? Let's go!

original_text: 小洛子：村长伯伯家来了客人，小洛子想要伯伯给我讲故事，伯伯都没空……
translation: Little Luozi: Uncle Village Chief has guests over, and I wanted him to tell me a story, but he's too busy...

original_text: 云天河：菱纱说我们<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>要离开这地方了</colour><dc0>，那些人好像也不想我们留下来……</dc0>
translation: Yun Tianhe: Lingsha said<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> We need to leave this place</colour><dc0>, it seems those people don't want us to stay either...</dc0>

original_text: 林环凤：前几天，咱这太平村来了一个女娃，穿着一身红衣裳，又机灵又俊俏，那晚找不着地方住，还是在村长家借宿的呢。
translation: Lin Huanfeng: A few days ago, a girl in red came to our Taiping Village-clever and pretty. She couldn't find a place to stay and ended up lodging at the village chief's house.

original_text: 林环凤：原本想去找村西边的石匠打个石磨，但今天大伙儿都在祠堂外看“跳钟馗”，去了也不一定能找到人。
translation: Lin Huanfeng: I originally wanted to find the stonemason west of the village to make a millstone, but everyone's watching the 'Zhong Kui Dance' outside the ancestral hall today. Might not find him if I go.

original_text: 林环凤：哎，我看什么剑仙的传说都是别人胡乱说的，不能当真～
translation: Lin Huanfeng: Ah, I think all those tales about sword immortals are just nonsense people made up, can't take them seriously~

original_text: 林环凤：听说那些大城里的人把吃茶叫作“品茗”，不是泡了茶就喝，而是一滴一滴落在嘴唇上尝。
translation: Lin Huanfeng: I heard people in big cities call drinking tea 'pinming'. They don't drink it right after brewing; instead, they taste it drop by drop on their lips.

original_text: 单广青：此地名为太平村，今日正是端午，村民大多去祠堂看扮钟馗的戏了，有趣倒也有趣，可惜那戏台太小，哪比得上城里的气派～
translation: Shan Guangqing: This place is called Taiping Village. Today is Dragon Boat Festival, most villagers are at the ancestral hall watching the Zhong Kui play. It's fun, but the stage is too small, nothing like the grandeur in the city~

original_text: 单广青：听说太平村附近的深山里住着仙人，可我远道而来，在此半年有余，上山不下十几次，却从未见过仙人的踪影……
translation: Shan Guangqing: I heard that immortals live in the deep mountains near Taiping Village, but I've come from afar and have been here for over half a year, going up the mountain more than ten times, yet I've never seen any trace of immortals...

original_text: 单广青：传说中的剑仙我没见过，倒是太平村的临睦茶，是为一绝，若送去京城，也许能与寿阳的宁香一较长短。
translation: Shan Guangqing: I've never seen legendary sword immortals, but Taiping Village's Linmu Tea is truly exceptional. If sent to the capital, it might rival Shouyang's Ningxiang Tea.

original_text: 单广青：茶可解渴，也能解毒，传说炎帝神农尝百草，日遇七十二毒，得茶而解之。
translation: Shan Guangqing: Tea can quench thirst and also detoxify. Legend says Emperor Yan Shennong tasted hundreds of herbs, encountered seventy-two poisons in a day, and was cured by tea.

original_text: 云庚年：我孙女的手艺不错，今天过端阳，她正在厨房里忙着准备饭菜呢！
translation: Yun Gengnian: My granddaughter's cooking is quite good. It's the Dragon Boat Festival today, she's busy in the kitchen preparing the meal!

original_text: 云庚年：村里的茶叶收成一直不错，可惜总没商人来村里买，我跟云靳说，应该找几个年轻力壮的小伙子，用马车拉了茶叶，咱们自己去城里卖！
translation: Yun Gengnian: The village's tea harvest has always been good, but sadly, no merchants come to buy. I told Yun Jin we should find some strong young men, load the tea onto carts, and sell it in the city ourselves!

original_text: 云庚年：上一回村里几个小伙子拉了一车茶叶去寿阳，没几日茶叶就卖完了。现在咱们村的茶叶不愁卖不了，只怕没货卖！
translation: Yun Gengnian: Last time, a few young men from the village pulled a cart of tea leaves to Shouyang, and they sold out in just a few days. Now, our village's tea isn't worried about selling; we're only afraid of running out of stock!

original_text: 玲珑：大家都说剑仙保佑着咱们村～可是为什么每年端午节都是扮钟馗，不是扮剑仙呢？
