translation: Linglong: Everyone says the Sword Immortal protects our village~ But why do we always dress up as Zhong Kui instead of the Sword Immortal for the Dragon Boat Festival every year?

original_text: 小山子：这个……大概是因为钟馗比剑仙还厉害吧！
translation: Xiao Shanzi: This... probably because Zhong Kui is even more powerful than sword immortals!

original_text: 玲珑：那为什么从来没人说钟馗降妖的故事呢？
translation: Linglong: Then why does no one ever tell stories of Zhong Kui subduing demons?

original_text: 小山子：钟馗不是捉妖的，是捉鬼的啦～
translation: Xiao Shanzi: Zhong Kui doesn't catch demons, he catches ghosts~

original_text: 玲珑：端午节时要把艾草、菖蒲和大蒜挂在门口，听阿娘说这样就没有鬼怪来害人了～
translation: Linglong: During the Dragon Boat Festival, we hang mugwort, calamus, and garlic at the door. Mom says this keeps ghosts and monsters from harming people~

original_text: 玲珑：上次小山哥在湖边看见了剑仙，要是我也去湖边玩，是不是也能见到剑仙？
translation: Linglong: Last time, Brother Xiaoshan saw a Sword Immortal by the lake. If I go play by the lake too, might I also see a Sword Immortal?

original_text: 玲珑：爹说家里的茶叶卖得很好，这次去城里，会给我买新衣服～等爹回来，就有新衣服穿喽！
translation: Linglong: Dad said the family's tea is selling very well. This time when he goes to the city, he'll buy me new clothes~ When Dad returns, I'll have new clothes to wear!

original_text: 小山子：好想到戏台前头去看魁山伯伯扮钟馗、打小鬼，可是那里围着好多人，挤也挤不进去！
translation: Xiao Shanzi: I really want to go to the front of the stage to see Uncle Kuishan play Zhong Kui and beat the little ghosts, but there are so many people crowded there, I can't squeeze in!

original_text: 小山子：阿爹和阿娘常上山采银杏，我好想跟他们一块儿去！可是阿爹说山上有猛兽，不肯带我去。
translation: Xiao Shanzi: Dad and Mom often go up the mountain to pick ginkgo nuts. I really want to go with them! But Dad says there are fierce beasts on the mountain and won't take me.

original_text: 小山子：告诉你，我见过剑仙哦～就在巢湖边上，有几个仙人踩着剑从天上飞过去，一眨眼就不见了～
translation: Xiao Shanzi: Let me tell you, I've seen sword immortals~ Right by the Chao Lake, several immortals flew past on swords and disappeared in the blink of an eye~

original_text: 小山子：最近茶颜姐姐总是忙着烘茶揉茶，都不陪我玩，还说什么大人的事情小孩子不会懂，我已经不是什么都不懂的小孩子了！
translation: Xiao Shanzi: Recently, Sister Chayan has been busy roasting and rolling tea leaves and won't play with me. She even says adult matters are beyond children, but I'm not a kid who doesn't understand anything anymore!

original_text: 云颂：别看魁山在台上的样子高大威猛、又打鬼来又驱邪，其实他人很好，小孩子们都很喜欢他。
translation: Yun Song: Don't be fooled by Kuishan's imposing stage presence, where he battles ghosts and exorcises evil. He's actually a very kind person, and all the children adore him.

original_text: 云颂：这云氏宗祠是先皇为封赏我们云家一位战功卓著的先祖而下令建的，算到如今也有百多年了～可惜云家自那以后就再也没出过什么大人物了……
translation: Yun Song: This Yun Family Ancestral Hall was built by imperial decree to reward an ancestor of our Yun family for his outstanding military achievements. It has been over a hundred years now~ Sadly, the Yun family hasn't produced any great figures since then...

original_text: 云颂：村里人的祖宗牌位大都在这祠堂里，这段日子听说湖里闹妖怪，就经常有人来上香，求祖宗保平安。
translation: Yun Song: Most of the villagers' ancestral tablets are in this ancestral hall. Lately, with talk of demons in the lake, many come to offer incense, praying for their ancestors' protection.

original_text: 云颂：如今茶叶卖得好，大伙儿日子也过得好，祠堂里的贡品也比以前多多了。
translation: Yun Song: Now that tea sells well, everyone's lives are better, and the offerings in the ancestral hall are much more plentiful than before.

original_text: 虎头王：俺是住在山上的猎户，今天下山来赶集，正巧赶上端午节，又能吃粽子又能看戏～不错不错！
translation: Hutou Wang: I'm a hunter living in the mountains. I came down to the market today and happened to catch the Dragon Boat Festival. I can eat zongzi and watch the opera~ Not bad, not bad!

original_text: 虎头王：俺常常来太平村卖兽皮、换柴米，这村子每年到了这几天都会特别热闹～
translation: Hutou Wang: I often come to Taiping Village to sell hides and trade for supplies. This village gets especially lively these few days every year~

original_text: 秋兰：扮钟馗的戏～每年也就只有端午能看到，整出戏分三段，正对应避祸、祈福、驱邪这三件事。
translation: Qiulan: The play where they impersonate Zhong Kui~ you can only see it during the Dragon Boat Festival each year. The whole play is in three parts, corresponding exactly to avoiding disaster, praying for blessings, and exorcising evil.

original_text: 秋兰：下月初我就要嫁人了，嫁到很远很远的海边……这一去，以后就再也吃不到小李裹的糯米粽、看不到王大哥扮的钟馗了……
translation: Qiulan: Next month, I'm getting married and moving far, far away to the seaside... Once I go, I'll never get to eat Xiao Li's glutinous rice dumplings or see Big Brother Wang play Zhong Kui again...

original_text: 云小宝：今天是端午节，有好吃的粽子吃！可是……为什么不是天天过节呢？
translation: Yun Xiaobao: It's Dragon Boat Festival today, we get to eat delicious zongzi! But... why isn't every day a festival?

original_text: 云小宝：你喜欢钟馗，还是喜欢剑仙？我就最喜欢剑仙了，剑仙一定比钟馗好看得多，又会飞，还有厉害的宝剑来除妖！
translation: Yun Xiaobao: Do you like Zhong Kui or sword immortals? I like sword immortals best! They must be much better-looking than Zhong Kui, can fly, and have powerful swords to slay demons!

original_text: 云小宝：小山子总说他见过剑仙，可是问他剑仙长什么样，他又说不清，我看他一定在骗人！
translation: Yun Xiaobao: Little Shanzi always says he's seen a sword immortal, but when you ask what the sword immortal looks like, he can't explain clearly. I think he must be lying!

original_text: 云小宝：娘说今年和往年不一样，我们的茶叶卖了好价钱，以后天天都能吃鱼吃肉！
translation: Yun Xiaobao: Mom says this year is different from before. Our tea sold for a good price. From now on, we can eat fish and meat every day!

original_text: 蔡三刀：这几天小李的肉粽卖得好啊，我这儿的猪肉都让他给包了，只剩下猪头猪尾猪脚爪。
translation: Cai Sandao: Xiao Li's meat zongzi have been selling well these days. He's bought up all my pork, leaving only the head, tail, and trotters.

original_text: 蔡三刀：那些小鬼，总说剑仙会踩着云在天上飞，要我说，剑仙剑仙，当然是踩着剑飞，否则就该叫云仙了不是～
translation: Cai Sandao: Those little ghosts always say sword immortals fly on clouds. I say, sword immortals should fly on swords-otherwise they'd be cloud immortals, right~

original_text: 蔡三刀：这可是今天早上刚从猎户手里收来的山猪，扛条后腿回家烧着吃，保准味美无比！
translation: Cai Sandao: This wild boar was just brought in from a hunter this morning. Take a hind leg home to roast, guaranteed delicious beyond compare!

original_text: 蔡三刀：我们太平村的茶叶都进京了，什么时候我的山猪肉也能卖到京城去呢 ？
translation: Cai Sandao: Our Taiping Village tea has reached the capital. When will my wild boar meat also sell in the capital?

original_text: 云湘秀：年年端午，村里都有扮钟馗的戏，魁山大哥演这钟馗也有些年头了。
translation: Yun Xiangxiu: Every Dragon Boat Festival, the village has a play where someone acts as Zhong Kui. Brother Kuishan has played Zhong Kui for years.

original_text: 云湘秀：我爹最喜欢吃的就是清炒蕨菜了～做起来也简单，蕨菜在附近山坡上就能挖到。
translation: Yun Xiangxiu: My dad's favorite dish is stir-fried fern fronds~ Simple to make too. You can dig up fern fronds on the nearby hillsides.

original_text: 云湘秀：你看起来有些面善呢，以前是不是来过我们村？……
translation: Yun Xiangxiu: You look somewhat familiar, have you been to our village before?...

original_text: 云湘秀：茶笋炖肉是我们太平村的好菜，以前茶叶卖得不好，大伙儿日子不好过，这道菜只有逢年过节才能吃上。
translation: Yun Xiangxiu: Tea Bamboo Shoot Stewed Pork is a specialty dish of Taiping Village. Back when tea sales were poor and times were tough, we could only eat this dish during festivals.

original_text: 李慎：我、我怎么觉得你眼熟得很？可这身打扮明明就没见过啊……
translation: Li Shen: I, I feel like you look very familiar? But I've definitely never seen this outfit before...

original_text: 茶颜：村子里原本只有一个云家，像我们这些外姓人，都是从别处迁来的。
translation: Chayan: Originally, there was only the Yun family in the village. Those of us with other surnames all moved here from elsewhere.

original_text: 茶颜：传说附近的山里住着剑仙，是一男一女～男仙英俊神武，女仙更是如观音娘娘般温柔美丽～
translation: Chayan: Legend says sword immortals live in the nearby mountains-a man and a woman~ The male immortal is handsome and mighty, the female immortal gentle and beautiful like Guanyin~

original_text: 茶颜：每年总有几天，村长会召集村里人到祠堂去议事，但是爹从来不带我一起，说是那种时候女孩子不准进祠堂……
translation: Chayan: Every year, there are a few days when the village chief summons everyone to the ancestral hall for discussions. But Father never takes me along, saying girls aren't allowed in the ancestral hall at such times...

original_text: 茶颜：今年的茶叶不但长得特别好，卖得也特别好，村里人开始有些闲钱了，再也不用羡慕寿阳人了～
translation: Chayan: This year's tea leaves not only grew exceptionally well but also sold very well. The villagers are starting to have some spare money and no longer need to envy the people of Shouyang~

original_text: 赵元吉：唉，我七次赶考，七次都未能中秀才，难道真的与功名无缘？
translation: Zhao Yuanji: Sigh, I've taken the imperial exams seven times, and seven times I've failed to even become a xiucai. Could it be that I truly have no fate with scholarly honors?

original_text: 赵元吉：一生为墨客，几世作茶仙～既然考不上功名，就在此地当个茶仙也不错。
translation: Zhao Yuanji: A lifetime as an ink scholar, several lives as a tea immortal~ Since I can't pass the imperial exams, being a tea immortal here isn't bad.

original_text: 徐婆婆：记得有一年端午啊，祠堂里“钟馗”演得好好的，就是云家那个小惹祸精，居然在钟馗的戏袍上系了一串鞭炮！那场面，真叫鸡飞狗跳！
translation: Granny Xu: I remember one Dragon Boat Festival, the 'Zhong Kui' opera at the ancestral hall was going smoothly, until that little troublemaker from the Yun family tied a string of firecrackers to Zhong Kui's costume! What a scene-pure chaos!

original_text: 徐婆婆：年纪大了就是苦啊，想吃粽子，又怕粘口吞不下……
translation: Granny Xu: Getting old is tough. I want to eat zongzi, but I'm afraid it'll stick in my mouth and I won't be able to swallow...

original_text: 徐婆婆：剑仙也好，妖怪也好，我老太婆这辈子都还没见过，现在只求祖宗保佑，让我安安稳稳过完剩下的日子就是了……
translation: Granny Xu: Sword immortals or yaoguais, I, an old woman, have never seen either in my life. Now I just pray to our ancestors to let me live out the rest of my days peacefully...

original_text: 徐婆婆：小李卖的茶叶蛋又香又入味，可惜我牙不利索，吃得慢，没吃到半个，蛋就凉了……
translation: Granny Xu: Little Li's tea eggs are fragrant and flavorful. Too bad my teeth aren't sharp, I eat slowly, and before I finish half, the eggs are cold...

original_text: 金兰：别看我相公平时只帮村里人打些农具，其实他打造兵器的手艺才是最好的！
translation: Jin Lan: Don't think my husband only makes farm tools for villagers. Actually, his skill in forging weapons is the best!

original_text: 金兰：记得小时候，村里云家的小哥哥总爱捣蛋，大伙都躲着他，那会儿只有我和我如今的相公，经常和他在一起玩。
translation: Jin Lan: I remember when I was little, the young brother from the Yun family in the village was always mischievous, and everyone avoided him. Back then, only my current husband and I often played with him.

original_text: 金兰：哎？我没认错的话，你就是前阵子的那个……你真是云家小哥的儿子？都长这么大了？
translation: Jin Lan: Huh? If I'm not mistaken, you're the one from a while back... You're really the son of the Yun family lad? You've grown so big?

original_text: 金兰：李家打铁的手艺是祖上传下来的，传儿传媳不传女～
translation: Jin Lan: The Li family's blacksmithing skill is passed down from ancestors-to sons and daughters-in-law, not daughters~

original_text: 李九金：你想买农具的话，到门口找我娘子！有现成打好了的。
translation: Li Jiujin: If you want farming tools, find my wife at the door! We have ready-made ones.

original_text: 李九金：我和弟弟从小就爱铸兵器，可惜当年只有云家小哥欣赏咱们的手艺……后来他说要去闯江湖，弟弟也说要搜集最好的兵器图谱，两人结伴走了，就再没回来过……
translation: Li Jiujin: My brother and I loved forging weapons since childhood. Sadly, only Yun appreciated our craft back then... Later, he said he'd venture into the world, and my brother wanted to collect the best weapon blueprints. They left together and never returned...

original_text: 李九金：剑仙用的剑，既能用来踩着飞，也能用来杀妖怪，一定不是寻常兵器，要能见识一下就好了～
translation: Li Jiujin: The swords used by sword immortals can be used to fly on and kill monsters. They must be extraordinary weapons. I wish I could see one~

original_text: 李九金：村里人都种茶去了，没人种稻，也没人来我这儿打镰刀，正好让我有时间钻研武器图谱。
translation: Li Jiujin: The villagers have all gone to grow tea. No one grows rice, and no one comes to me for sickles. It's given me time to study weapon blueprints.

original_text: 云阿菊：哎？你不就是那个……？
translation: Yun Aju: Huh? Aren't you that...?

original_text: 云阿菊：不对、不对……都这么多年了，那孩子怎么可能还是这个年纪……
translation: Yun Aju: No, no... It's been so many years, how could that child still be this age...

original_text: 云阿菊：我儿子和媳妇经常在巢湖捕鱼，巢湖离这儿也不远，从村北出去一直走就是了。
translation: Yun Aju: My son and daughter-in-law often fish in Chao Lake. It isn't far from here. Just head north from the village and keep going.

original_text: 云阿菊：听说巢湖在闹妖怪，村里人都不敢去，只有我那傻儿子，说什么有剑仙护佑，啥都不怕。
translation: Yun Aju: I heard there are demons causing trouble at Chao Lake. The villagers are too scared to go, but my foolish son says he's not afraid of anything because the Sword Immortals will protect him.

original_text: 云阿菊：媳妇怀了小娃娃，儿子说要给她补补，这些日子除了捕鱼，有时还上山打野味。
translation: Yun Aju: My daughter-in-law is pregnant. My son says he wants to nourish her. Lately, besides fishing, he sometimes hunts game in the mountains.

original_text: 王章寿：从这儿往北一直走，穿过林子，要不了多久就能到巢湖边上了。
translation: Wang Zhangshou: Head north from here, straight through the woods, and you'll reach the shore of Chao Lake before long.

original_text: 王章寿：今天村里热闹得很～家家户户都在庆贺端阳节，我早上打了鱼过来卖，没多久就全卖完了。
translation: Wang Zhangshou: The village is very lively today~ Every household is celebrating the Dragon Boat Festival. I caught fish to sell this morning, and they were all gone in no time.

original_text: 王章寿：那天我和闺女在湖上收网，一不小心掉水里，脚上被水草给缠住，我还以为死定了！后来也不知怎么着就上了岸，要说是剑仙救的，却又不太像……
translation: Wang Zhangshou: That day, my daughter and I were pulling in the nets on the lake when I accidentally fell in. My foot got tangled in weeds-I thought I was done for! Later, somehow I ended up ashore. If you say a sword immortal saved me, it doesn't quite seem like it...

original_text: 王章寿：闺女说我年纪大了，让我别再上船打鱼，可不上船的话，每天又能做啥呀？
translation: Wang Zhangshou: My daughter says I'm too old and shouldn't go fishing on the boat anymore. But if I don't go on the boat, what can I do every day?

original_text: 姚若琴：当年我刚刚嫁到这儿的时候，村里有个姓云的小鬼，竟把我煮了想给婆婆吃的粥，整锅偷去送乞丐！我现在想想都还有气！
translation: Yao Ruoqin: Back when I first married into this village, there was a little brat surnamed Yun who actually stole the whole pot of porridge I cooked for my mother-in-law and gave it to beggars! I still get angry thinking about it!

original_text: 姚若琴：别看我这铺子不大，可麻雀虽小五脏俱全，南杂北货无一不有～不过不许赊帐哦！
translation: Yao Ruoqin: Don't judge my shop by its size. Though small, it has all the essentials, goods from north and south~ But no credit allowed!

original_text: 姚若琴：当初我从家乡嫁过来，本以为有了依靠，却没想到相公常常出远门，一年到头也见不上几面，唉……
translation: Yao Ruoqin: When I married here from my hometown, I thought I'd have someone to rely on, but my husband is often away on long trips. We hardly see each other all year. Sigh...

original_text: 姚若琴：相公从城里托人捎了个玉镯子给我，说是最近的茶叶生意突然好起来，可他却没说什么时候能回来，也没说什么时候接我去城里……
translation: Yao Ruoqin: My husband sent someone from the city to bring me a jade bracelet, saying the tea business has suddenly picked up recently. But he didn't say when he can come back, nor when he'll take me to the city...

original_text: 赵元吉：外面怎么这么吵……害我书都读不进去，眼看三年一度的“乡贡”就在秋天，这……让我如何是好啊！
translation: Zhao Yuanji: Why is it so noisy outside... I can't even focus on reading. The triennial 'local tribute exam' is this autumn-how am I supposed to prepare?

original_text: 云天河：热闹不好吗？山上没这么多人，也就没意思了～
translation: Yun Tianhe: Isn't lively good? The mountain doesn't have many people, so it's boring~

original_text: 赵元吉：然也，然也～兄台一语惊醒梦中人，山上清静，我干脆去那里结庐苦读算了。
translation: Zhao Yuanji: Indeed, indeed~ Your words have awakened me. The mountain is quiet; I might as well build a hut there and study hard.

original_text: 李宝儿：两根筷子夹着碗，屏障在西也在南，东面不平北面平，黄山胜过九华山～
translation: Li Bao'er: Two chopsticks hold a bowl, barriers lie west and south. East is uneven, north is flat, Mount Huang surpasses Jiuhua Mountain~

original_text: 李宝儿：嘻嘻，告诉你们！昨天我在湖边玩儿，看到湖里面爬出一只妖怪，有三只脑袋，九条手臂，张牙舞爪的样子，可吓人啦！它对我说，今天晚上就要来抓云芳！
translation: Li Bao'er: Hehe, let me tell you! Yesterday, while playing by the lake, I saw a demon crawl out of the water. It had three heads and nine arms, with a ferocious, clawing appearance-so scary! It told me it would come to capture Yunfang tonight!

original_text: 云芳：啊！呜……哥哥！！哥哥救我！！呜……
translation: Yun Fang: Ah! Woo... Brother!! Brother save me!! Woo...

original_text: 云喜：云芳，你别理他，他是故意吓唬你的！
translation: Yun Xi: Yun Fang, don't mind him, he's just trying to scare you on purpose!

original_text: 李宝儿：云芳总是嚷着要跟我上山去玩儿，我才不要带这种爱哭的女孩子上山呢！
translation: Li Bao'er: Yun Fang always nags to go up the mountain with me. I don't want to take such a crybaby girl up the mountain!

original_text: 云喜：端阳节，食五黄；门插艾，香满堂；吃粽子，蘸白糖，天中五瑞虎称王。钟馗挂在大墙上，蝎子、蜈蚣无处藏～～
translation: Yun Xi: On Dragon Boat Festival, eat the five yellows; hang mugwort on the door, filling the hall with fragrance; eat zongzi dipped in white sugar, the five auspicious herbs reign supreme. Zhong Kui hangs on the wall, scorpions and centipedes have nowhere to hide~~

original_text: 云喜：宝儿，你要是再欺负我妹妹，我们以后就再也不和你玩儿了！！
translation: Yun Xi: Bao'er, if you bully my sister again, we'll never play with you again!!

original_text: 李宝儿：嘻，我只是瞎编了几句想逗逗她，谁知道会把她吓哭嘛！
translation: Li Bao'er: Hehe, I just made up a few lines to tease her, who knew it would scare her to tears!

original_text: 云喜：宝儿总是欺负云芳，可是云芳还是很喜欢和宝儿一起玩……真不知道女孩子都是怎么想的～
translation: Yun Xi: Bao'er always bullies Yun Fang, but Yun Fang still likes playing with Bao'er... I really don't know what girls are thinking~

original_text: 云芳：粽子香，香厨房；艾叶香，香满堂。桃枝插在大门上，出门一望麦儿黄，这儿端阳，那儿端阳～
translation: Yun Fang: Zongzi fragrant, fragrant in the kitchen; mugwort fragrant, fragrant fills the hall. Peach branches on the door, look out to golden wheat fields, here's Dragon Boat, there's Dragon Boat~

original_text: 云芳：宝儿说巢湖里面有妖怪，晚上会来抓我走，我……我好害怕！呜……
translation: Yun Fang: Bao'er said there are demons in Chao Lake, they'll come and take me away at night. I... I'm so scared! Woo...

original_text: 云芳：为什么哥哥和宝儿都不肯带云芳到山上去玩呢……
translation: Yun Fang: Why won't brother and Bao'er take Yun Fang up the mountain to play...

original_text: 云三娘：九金其实还有个弟弟，从小喜欢打兵器，后来和云家那个惹祸精一起出了村，就再也没回来过。
translation: Yun Sanniang: Jiujin actually had a younger brother who loved forging weapons since childhood. Later, he left the village with that troublemaker from the Yun family and never returned.

original_text: 云三娘：金兰的手艺是跟着九金学的，算到如今也有三、四年了，如今这大李铁铺卖的农具，大都是金兰打造的。
translation: Yun Sanniang: Jin Lan learned her craft from Jiujin, and it's been three or four years now. Most of the farming tools sold at Dali Iron Shop these days are forged by Jin Lan.

original_text: 云三娘：村里的茶叶卖得好，大伙儿都去种茶了，用不到什么大农具，九金得了空闲，这几天又在钻研武器图谱了。
translation: Yun Sanniang: Village tea sells well, everyone grows tea now, less need for big farm tools. Jiujin has free time, studying weapon blueprints again lately.

original_text: 王小鹏：今天是端阳节，阿爹的鱼一会儿就卖完了，现在阿爹还要带我去看戏吃粽子呢！
translation: Wang Xiaopeng: It's the Dragon Boat Festival today, and Dad's fish sold out in no time. Now he's taking me to watch the opera and eat zongzi!

original_text: 王小鹏：最近湖面上多了好多漩涡，风浪也比从前大，姐姐都不让我和爹上船了……
translation: Wang Xiaopeng: There have been many more whirlpools on the lake lately, and the waves are bigger than before. My sister won't let me or dad on the boat anymore...

original_text: 王小鹏：姐姐说的对，阿爹年纪大了，就算湖上很太平，也不该让阿爹再上船。何况我也长大了，可以帮姐姐一起撒网收网了！
translation: Wang Xiaopeng: Sister is right. Father is old; even if the lake is peaceful, he shouldn't go out on the boat anymore. Besides, I've grown up and can help sister cast and haul the nets!

original_text: 茶馨：白头老媪簪红花，黑头女娘三髻丫。背上儿眠上山去，采桑已闲当采茶。
translation: Cha Xin: White-haired old woman adorns red flower, black-haired young maiden with triple buns. Carrying a sleeping child up the mountain, done picking mulberries, now picking tea.

original_text: 茶馨：都说巢湖上有妖怪，最近捕鱼卖鱼的人少了，想给阿娘买条鲫鱼补身子都不成了，唉……
translation: Cha Xin: They all say there are demons on Chao Lake. Recently, fewer people are fishing and selling fish. I can't even buy a crucian carp to nourish Mother. Sigh...

original_text: 茶馨：茶叶摘了之后，要烘干揉细，才能泡着喝。如果是要送到大城里去卖的，还得制成饼团才行。
translation: Cha Xin: After tea leaves are picked, they need to be dried and finely rolled before they can be brewed. If they're to be sold in big cities, they must also be pressed into cakes or balls.

original_text: 姚若琴：没想到……我还以为相公他出了什么事，日日睡不安稳，没想到他竟在陈州迷恋一个风尘女子，我……我怎么这样命苦啊！
translation: Yao Ruoqin: I never expected... I thought something had happened to my husband, losing sleep every day, but he's actually infatuated with a courtesan in Chenzhou... I... why is my fate so bitter!

original_text: 姚若琴：唉，不好意思，让小哥你见笑了，我这儿也没别的好东西，这两个东西你拿着，别客气。
translation: Yao Ruoqin: Ah, sorry to make you laugh, young man. I don't have anything else good here. Take these two things, don't be shy.

original_text: 李慎：嘿！不错不错，小哥你办事倒是挺利索～来，这些是咱太平村的点心，就送给你当酬劳吧！
translation: Li Shen: Hey! Not bad, not bad. You're quite efficient, young man~ Here, these are some dim sums from our Taiping Village. Take them as your reward!

original_text:
相公他虽然常常出远门，但两、三个月总能回来一趟，可这回去了陈州，已经快半年了，还没个音信！小哥，如果你路过陈州，就帮忙打听一下我相公云遥庆的下落吧！谢谢你了！
你愿意帮忙打听下吗？
translation:
Although my husband often travels far, he usually returns every two or three months. But this time he went to Chenzhou, and it's been almost half a year with no word! Young man, if you pass through Chenzhou, please help inquire about my husband Yun Yaoqing's whereabouts! Thank you!
Will you help ask around?

original_text:
嘿，小哥我看你怎么有点面熟呢……你说要帮我办事？那太好了！玲珑那小姑娘突然想吃醉枣糕，我李慎可从来不拒绝像玲珑那么可爱的小女娃儿！所以……你能不能帮我跑一趟陈州，带五份醉枣回来？
你愿意帮我去买吗？
translation:
Hey, young man, you look somewhat familiar... You say you'll help me with something? That's great! That little girl Linglong suddenly wants to eat drunken date cake, and I, Li Shen, never refuse a cute little girl like Linglong! So... could you run an errand to Chenzhou for me and bring back five portions of Drunken Jujube?
Will you help me go buy them?

original_text: 云天河：菱纱说要在客栈门口等她，别进去……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Lingsha said to wait for her at the inn entrance, don't go in...

original_text: 云天河：<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>那个胖胖的柳波波让我进那间大房子，</colour><dc0>我就跟进去看看好了～</dc0>
translation: Yun Tianhe:<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> That chubby Ankle Liu told me to enter that big house,</colour><dc0> so I'll just follow and take a look~</dc0>

original_text: 云天河：我要<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>先去前厅找菱纱</colour><dc0>～</dc0>
translation: Yun Tianhe: I need to <colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>go to the front hall to find Lingsha first</colour><dc0>~</dc0>

original_text: 云天河：菱纱让我不要去打扰柳波波他们，我还是别进去了。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Lingsha told me not to disturb Ankle Liu and them, I better not go in.

original_text: 1.去巢湖
translation: 1. Go to Chao Lake

original_text: 2.御剑飞行
translation: 2. Sword Flight

original_text: 3.什么都不做
translation: 3. Do Nothing

original_text: 准备<colour red=255 green=102 blue=0 alpha=255>去巢湖</colour><dc0>还是</dc0><colour red=255 green=102 blue=0 alpha=255>御剑飞行</colour><dc0>？</dc0>
translation: Proceed to?

original_text: 1.去八公山
translation: 1. Go to Bagong Mountain

original_text: 准备<colour red=255 green=102 blue=0 alpha=255>去八公山</colour><dc0>还是</dc0><colour red=255 green=102 blue=0 alpha=255>御剑飞行</colour><dc0>？</dc0>
translation: Proceed to?

original_text: 郭正忠：衙门重地，闲杂人等速速离开！
translation: Guo Zhengzhong: Official grounds! Unrelated persons, leave at once!

original_text: 仇敬：牢房重地，闲杂人等速速离开！
translation: Qiu Jing: Prison area! Unrelated persons, leave at once!

original_text: 云天河：里面是厨房，还是不要进去为好。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Inside is the kitchen, better not go in.

original_text: 云天河：这边城门已经关闭，走另外一边吧。
translation: Yun Tianhe: This city gate is already closed, let's go the other way.

original_text: 云天河：里边正在修缮，就别进去了吧。
translation: Yun Tianhe: They're doing repairs inside, better not go in.

original_text: 云天河：…………好大的门、好多房子！！
translation: Yun Tianhe: ...... Such a big gate, so many houses!!

original_text: 韩菱纱：嘻嘻，见识到了吧～
translation: Han Lingsha: Hehe, see what I mean~

original_text: 韩菱纱：走，<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>先去客栈找点吃的，</colour><dc0>我都饿得前胸贴后背了……</dc0>
translation: Han Lingsha: Let's go,<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> first to the inn to find something to eat,</colour><dc0>I'm so hungry my stomach's sticking to my back...</dc0>

original_text: 云天河：克占？
translation: Yun Tianhe: The in?

original_text: 韩菱纱：那边，看到没？阳～春～客～栈几个大字！
translation: Han Lingsha: Over there, see? The characters for Yang~ Chun~ Inn!

original_text: 韩菱纱：听好了，所谓“客栈”呢，就是供人休息睡觉的地方——
translation: Han Lingsha: Listen, so-called 'inn' is a place for people to rest and sleep-

original_text: 韩菱纱：喂，人家好心和你解释，你怎么不听？真没礼貌！
translation: Han Lingsha: Hey, someone kindly explains to you, why won't you listen? So rude!

original_text: 云天河：我、我在想，你饿得真快，一下又要吃饭了。
translation: Yun Tianhe: I, I was thinking, you get hungry really fast, it's time to eat again already.

original_text: 韩菱纱：说什么呢，我可是从昨晚一直饿到现在……
translation: Han Lingsha: What are you saying, I've been starving since last night...

original_text: 云天河：你不是讲过，被我气都气饱了？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Didn't you say before, you were so angry and that made you full?

original_text: 云天河：这气饱的，果然比不上吃东西填肚子，一会儿就撑不住了。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Being full from anger really isn't as good as filling your stomach with food-you can't hold out much longer.

original_text: 韩菱纱：你！——傻瓜！气话也当真！
translation: Han Lingsha: You!-Idiot! Taking angry words seriously!

original_text: 云天河：哦……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Oh...

original_text: 韩菱纱：哦什么哦，遇上你算我倒霉……
translation: Han Lingsha: 'Oh' what? Meeting you was my bad luck...

original_text: 韩菱纱：（不教而杀谓之过，我忍！）
translation: Han Lingsha: (To punish without teaching is a transgression. I must restrain myself!)

original_text: 云天河：菱纱说<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>要先去那个叫“客栈”的地方</colour><dc0>……</dc0>
translation: Yun Tianhe: Lingsha said <colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>we should go to that place called 'inn' first</colour><dc0>...</dc0>

original_text: 云天河：现在<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>该去那个老大的家里</colour><dc0>……</dc0>
translation: Yun Tianhe: Now <colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>we should go to that boss's house</colour><dc0>...</dc0>

original_text: 云天河：快到吃晚饭的时间了吧？还是别出城了。
translation: Yun Tianhe: It's almost dinnertime, right? Better not leave the city.

original_text: 云天河：什么味儿？好香～～
translation: Yun Tianhe: What smell? So fragrant~~

original_text: 韩菱纱：香？我说，你该不会是个酒鬼吧？！
translation: Han Lingsha: Smells fragrant? I say, you're not an alcoholic, are you?!

original_text: 云天河：酒柜？什么东西？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Academic? What's that?

original_text: 韩菱纱：不懂算了，总之这些坛子先前装过一种叫作“酒”的东西，和水差不多吧，但它可不是个好东西，喝下去会头晕乱说话，说不定会做出不可挽回的祸事呢。
translation: Han Lingsha: Never mind if you don't understand. Anyway, these jars previously contained something called 'wine'. It's similar to water, but it's not a good thing. Drinking it makes you dizzy, talk nonsense, and you might even do something irreparable.

original_text: 云天河：真的？！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Really?!

original_text: 韩菱纱：难道我会骗你不成？所以酒是少碰，不，别碰的为好！
translation: Han Lingsha: Would I lie to you? So it's best to drink less, no, not at all!

original_text: 云天河：……原来“酒”是个坏东西，可这味道，实在很香……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... So 'wine' is a bad thing, but this smell, it's really fragrant...

original_text: 韩菱纱：（不妙……这家伙有做酒鬼的潜质，闻到酒味这么兴奋，要是让他知道客栈里卖酒……）
translation: Han Lingsha: (Trouble... this guy has potential to be an alcoholic, so excited by wine smell. If he finds out the inn sells wine...)

original_text: 韩菱纱：啊，我看既然要赶路去陈州，也不用住店了，你在这儿等着，我去去就回。
translation: Han Lingsha: Ah, since we're hurrying to Chenzhou, no need to stay at an inn. Wait here, I'll be right back.

original_text: 云天河：好！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Okay!

original_text: 韩菱纱：别乱跑，也别多管闲事哦！
translation: Han Lingsha: Don't run off, and don't meddle in others' business!

original_text: 韩菱纱：……别多管闲事，别惹麻烦！
translation: Han Lingsha: ... Don't meddle in others' business, don't cause trouble!

original_text: 韩菱纱：还有别乱拿东西、别帮别人忙！
translation: Han Lingsha: And don't take things randomly, don't help others!

original_text: 韩菱纱：唉～好好好，就怕最后又不好了……
translation: Han Lingsha: Sigh~ Alright, alright, I'm just afraid it'll end badly again...

original_text: 云天河：咦——这是菱纱？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Huh- Is this Lingsha?

original_text: 云天河：（眉毛、鼻子，还有眼睛都差不多～）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (Eyebrows, nose, and eyes are all quite similar~)

original_text: 官差甲：小兄弟！你既然揭了告示，可是见过画上之人？
translation: Officer A: Young brother! Since you took down the notice, have you seen the person in the portrait?

original_text: 云天河：这是你的？不能拿？还是……要钱？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Is this yours? Can't take it? Or... does it cost money?

original_text: 官差甲：莫要说笑，你可知画上此人现在何处？
translation: Officer A: Don't joke. Do you know where the person in this portrait is now?

original_text: 云天河：哦，她刚进客栈了…………没想到她跟我爹一样有名——
translation: Yun Tianhe: Oh, she just went into the inn... I didn't expect her to be as famous as my father--

original_text: 官差甲：快！你马上禀报裴捕头！
translation: Officer A: Quick! Report to Constable Pei immediately!

original_text: 官差乙：好！
translation: Officer B: Good!

original_text: 官差甲：别怕，那贼人虽然狡猾，也挡不住人多势众！你今日举报有功，官府必有重谢！
translation: Officer A: Don't be afraid. That thief may be cunning, but she can't withstand our numbers! You'll be handsomely rewarded for reporting her today!

original_text: 云天河：什么？
translation: Yun Tianhe: What?

original_text: 韩菱纱：天河，我们走吧！
translation: Han Lingsha: Tianhe, let's go!

original_text: 官差甲：大胆贼人，果然是你！还不乖乖束手就擒！
translation: Officer A: Bold thief, it is indeed you! Surrender quietly at once!

original_text: 韩菱纱：什么贼？你居然说我是“贼”？！
translation: Han Lingsha: What thief? You actually call me a 'thief'?!

original_text: 韩菱纱：可恶！睁大你的眼睛！倒是看看我从头到脚哪一点像“贼”！
translation: Han Lingsha: Damn it! Open your eyes wide! Look at me from head to toe and tell me which part looks like a 'thief'!

original_text: 官差甲：还敢狡辩！旁边这位小兄弟已揭了通缉告示，我在此守着，果然等到你来！
translation: Officer A: Still trying to deny it! This young brother here has already taken down the wanted poster. I've been waiting here and indeed caught you coming!

original_text: 韩菱纱：云——天——河！！
translation: Han Lingsha: Yun-Tian-he!!

original_text: 云天河：我、我也不知道怎么回事，那纸上有你的脸，我撕下来想让你看看……画得挺不错的……
translation: Yun Tianhe: I, I don't know what happened either. Your face was on that paper, I tore it off wanting to show you... It was drawn quite well...

original_text: 韩菱纱：笨笨笨！笨死啦！
translation: Han Lingsha: Stupid stupid stupid! So stupid!

original_text: 云天河：我是不是又做错什么了啊？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Did I do something wrong again?

original_text: 韩菱纱：还用问？！自从遇到你以后，我的火气比以前大了好多！拜托别老是做让我没气质的事好不好？换谁都受不了啦……
translation: Han Lingsha: Do you even need to ask?! Ever since meeting you, my temper has gotten much worse! Please stop doing things that make me lose my composure, okay? Anyone would be driven crazy...

original_text: 官差乙：裴捕头到！
translation: Officer B: Constable Pei is here!

original_text: 官差乙：将犯人拿下！
translation: Officer B: Seize the criminal!
Pei Jian: ..., wait-!!

original_text: 裴剑：请问小兄弟姓谁名甚，哪里人氏？
translation: Pei Jian: May I ask your name, young brother, and where you're from?

original_text: 云天河：我？你问我？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Me? You're asking me?

original_text: 云天河：我叫云天河，刚从山上下来，怎么了？
translation: Yun Tianhe: I'm Yun Tianhe, just came down from the mountain. What's wrong?

original_text: 裴剑：果然是云公子……
translation: Pei Jian: So it is Young Master Yun...

original_text: 裴剑：裴剑代我家大人请云公子去府上一叙，请一定赏脸。
translation: Pei Jian: Pei Jian, on behalf of my lord, invites Yun to the mansion for a chat. Please do honor us.

original_text: 云天河：啊？什么意思？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Huh? What do you mean?

original_text: 韩菱纱：嗯……说好懂一点，就是他的老大想让你去他家玩。
translation: Han Lingsha: Hmm... To put it simply, his boss wants you to go play at his place.

original_text: 裴剑：我家大人姓柳，正是寿阳县令。
translation: Pei Jian: My lord's surname is Liu; he is the magistrate of Shouyang County.

original_text: 裴剑：大人与云家颇有渊源，叮嘱我留意云家人的行踪，若是公子不肯前去，裴剑受罚事小，大人多年的夙愿却难了却了。
translation: Pei Jian: My lord has deep ties with the Yun family and instructed me to watch for their movements. If you refuse to go, my punishment is trivial, but my lord's long-held wish will remain unfulfilled.

original_text: 云天河：哦～～这回我懂了，大人就是老大，我不去你就要挨骂，那我去总行了吧？不能害你。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Oh~~ Now I get it. Your lord is your boss; if I don't go, you get scolded. So I'll go, okay? Can't get you in trouble.

original_text: 裴剑：多谢云公子！
translation: Pei Jian: Thank you, Young Master Yun!

original_text: 韩菱纱：嘻嘻，这不就结了？喊打喊杀干嘛呀？一场误会～
translation: Han Lingsha: Hehe, isn't that settled? Why all the fighting and killing? A misunderstanding~

original_text: 裴剑：对不住，姑娘请和诸位官差回衙门一趟，最后若是查清冤枉了你，自会还你公道。
translation: Pei Jian: My apologies, miss. Please accompany these officers back to the yamen. If you're proven innocent in the end, justice will be served.

original_text: 韩菱纱：什么？有没搞错？我和他是一起的，哪有他吃大鱼大肉，我吃牢饭的道理！
translation: Han Lingsha: What?, are you kidding? I'm with him. How can he feast while I eat prison food!

original_text: 裴剑：姑娘和那通缉要犯实在相像，官府办案宁枉勿纵，还请见谅。
translation: Pei Jian: Miss, you look very much like the wanted criminal. The authorities would rather err on the side of caution-please understand.

original_text: 韩菱纱：（……麻烦，好像遇上个难缠的家伙……）
translation: Han Lingsha: (...Troublesome, seems like we've run into a tough character...)

original_text: 云天河：不行！菱纱不想跟你们去，谁也不许强迫她！她说去牙门是要杀头的！
translation: Yun Tianhe: No! Lingsha doesn't want to go with you, and no one is allowed to force her! She said going to Yamen means getting beheaded!

original_text: 官差乙：大胆！敢这样对裴捕头讲话，你待如何？！
translation: Officer B: How dare you! Speaking to Constable Pei like that, what do you intend?!

original_text: 云天河：我呆如何？……呆又怎样？反正………你们先不仁，我也可以不义！
translation: Yun Tianhe: So what if I'm foolish? ...What does it matter? Anyway... you were disloyal first, so I can be unjust too!

original_text: 韩菱纱：哈、哈哈……
translation: Han Lingsha: Ha, haha...

original_text: 云天河：菱纱你干嘛笑？快走！不然你我两条命就搁这儿了。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Lingsha, why are you laughing? Hurry! Or both our lives will end here.

original_text: 韩菱纱：（哎，这家伙真是傻得可爱，突然觉得他顺眼多了～）
translation: Han Lingsha: (Ah, this guy is really adorably foolish. Suddenly, I find him much more likable~)

original_text: 裴剑：……都住手，不得对云公子无礼！
translation: Pei Jian: ... Everyone stop! Do not be rude to Yun!

original_text: 韩菱纱：好了好了～我看都别争了。
translation: Han Lingsha: Alright, alright~ I think we should stop arguing.

original_text: 韩菱纱：捕头大人简直是块又臭又硬的石头，一点情理都不通，真没办法。天河你就去吧，不要忘了和县令大人说个明白，还我清白！
translation: Han Lingsha: The constable is like a stubborn, smelly rock-completely unreasonable, no way around it. Tianhe, you go ahead. Don't forget to explain clearly to the magistrate and clear my name!

original_text: 云天河：你要跟他们走？去杀头？
translation: Yun Tianhe: You're going with them? To be executed?

original_text: 韩菱纱：放心，他们不会把我怎么样的，别多问了。倒是你，趁这机会看看那个县令到底怎么回事，说不定他认识你爹呢。
translation: Han Lingsha: Don't worry, they won't do anything to me. No more questions. Instead, use this chance to see what's up with that county magistrate-maybe he knew your father.

original_text: 云天河：爹？！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Dad?!

original_text: 韩菱纱：嘘，小声点～你走吧，见机行事，我自然会去找你的。
translation: Han Lingsha: Shh, keep it down. Go ahead, play it by ear, I'll come find you when the time is right.

original_text: 裴剑：云公子，我们这就走吧，请。
translation: Pei Jian: Yun, let's go now, please.

original_text: 韩菱纱：喂！野人！
translation: Han Lingsha: Hey! Barbarian!

original_text: 云天河：啊？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Huh?

original_text: 韩菱纱：谢谢你～
translation: Han Lingsha: Thank you~

original_text: 云天河：谢我？为什么？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Thank me? Why?

original_text: 韩菱纱：没事，走啦走啦，别问这么多！
translation: Han Lingsha: It's fine, let's go, don't ask so much!

original_text: 云天河：好……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Okay...

original_text: 韩菱纱：嘻，真是个大孩子……
translation: Han Lingsha: Hehe, what a big kid...

original_text: 裴剑：云公子，<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>我家大人的府邸就是寿阳北城门附近的柳府，</colour><dc0>请随我来。</dc0>
translation: Pei Jian: Yun,<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> My lord's mansion is the Liu Mansion near the north city gate of Shouyang,</colour><dc0> Please follow me.</dc0>

original_text: 裴剑：云公子，请在此稍候，我去禀报大人，速速便回。
translation: Pei Jian: Yun, please wait here for a moment. I will go report to my lord and return swiftly.

original_text: 云天河：好啊，你快点，我也有事想问你的老大。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Okay, hurry up. I have some questions for your boss too.

original_text: 裴剑：……
translation: Pei Jian: ...

original_text: 云天河：（这里的房子真大……）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (The houses here are really big...)

original_text: 云天河：（那个老大……真的认识我爹吗？）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (That boss... really knew my father?)

original_text: 云天河：（以前常听爹说怎么打坏人，人的老大和猴子的老大不一样，很多都是大大的坏蛋……）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (Often heard father talk about how to fight bad guys before. Human bosses are different from monkey bosses; many are really big villains...)

original_text: 禄珠：快看！哪来的傻小子～
translation: Luzhu: Look! Where did this silly boy come from~

original_text: 禄蓉：嘘！小点儿声，他能进到内院，肯定是老爷的客人，太稀奇了！
translation: Lurong: Shh! Keep your voice down. He can enter the inner courtyard, surely a guest of the master. How rare!

original_text: 禄蓉：仔细瞧瞧，他穿得是破，可长得很俊呢！
translation: Lurong: Look closely-his clothes are ragged, but he's quite handsome!

original_text: 禄珠：哎呀！他过来了，我们快走～
translation: Luzhu: Oh dear! He's coming over, let's go quickly~
??: Wor~thy~nephew~~~
??: Ah!! This-!!

original_text: ？？：长得太像了！裴剑说的时候，我还不敢相信，这天底下哪有这等巧事！
translation: ??: You look so alike! When Pei Jian said it, I couldn't believe it. How could such a coincidence happen under heaven!

original_text: ？？：你叫云天河？你爹可是云天青？！
translation: ???: Your name is Yun Tianhe? Is your father Yun Tianqing?!

original_text: 云天河：对啊，你认识我爹？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Right, you know my father?

original_text: 云天河：（看来他不当老大好多年，都胖成这样了……）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (Seems he hasn't been the boss for many years, he's gotten this fat...)

original_text: ？？：当然！老夫柳世封，乃是受过你爹恩惠之人！
translation: ??: Of course! I, Liu Shifeng, am someone who received kindness from your father!

original_text: 柳世封：来来来，贤侄进屋再说，我已经吩咐下去准备饭菜，一定要好好招待你。
translation: Liu Shifeng: Come, come, my worthy nephew, let's talk inside. I've ordered preparations for a meal; we must treat you well.

original_text: 云天河：……咸枝？是叫我吗？
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... Wordy-net-few? Calling me?

original_text: 柳世封：哈哈，自然如此，你若不嫌弃，可以喊我一声“柳伯伯”～
translation: Liu Shifeng: Haha, naturally so, if you don't mind, you can call me 'Uncle Liu'~

original_text: 云天河：柳波波？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Ankle Liu?

original_text: 柳世封：嗯，好！好！
translation: Liu Shifeng: Mm, good! Good!

original_text: 柳世封：来！<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>随我进屋吧，</colour><dc0>怎好叫客人一直站着。</dc0>
translation: Liu Shifeng: Come!<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> Follow me inside,</colour><dc0>we can't keep our guests standing out here.</dc0>

original_text: 云天河：柳波波？……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Ankle Liu?...

original_text: ？？：这位便是云家的公子？！
translation: ???: So this is the Yun family's young master?!

original_text: 柳世封：哈哈，没错，我还以为又见着了多年前的云贤弟咧！
translation: Liu Shifeng: Haha, that's right. I thought I was seeing my sworn brother Yun from many years ago again!

original_text: 柳世封：贤侄，这是我夫人阮慈，你喊她“柳伯母”就好。
translation: Liu Shifeng: Nephew, this is my wife, Ruan Ci. You can call her 'Aunt Liu'.

original_text: 云天河：柳波母……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Ant Liu...

original_text: 云天河：（山下的人好像很喜欢帮别人乱取名字，自己的名字也都奇奇怪怪的……）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (People down the mountain seem to like giving others random nicknames, and their own names are also weird...)

original_text: 阮慈：哎，乖孩子～
translation: Ruan Ci: Ah, good child~

original_text: 阮慈：你们一老一小，还不快入座，我马上命人上饭菜，不然可都要凉了。
translation: Ruan Ci: You two, old and young, hurry and take your seats. I'll have the food served immediately, or it'll all get cold.

original_text: 柳世封：夫人说的甚是！
translation: Liu Shifeng: My wife speaks wisely!

original_text: 云天河：饭菜…………
translation: Yun Tianhe: Food...

original_text: 柳世封：贤侄，先坐下吧～
translation: Liu Shifeng: Nephew, sit down first~

original_text: 云天河：柳波波，我身上的钱就这么多，都给你了！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Ankle Liu, this is all the money I have, take it!

original_text: 柳世封：贤侄这是为何？！难道、难道你不爱吃炒菜，喜欢吃凉菜？！
translation: Liu Shifeng: Nephew, why is this?! Could it be... you don't like stir-fried dishes, but prefer cold dishes?!

original_text: 云天河：我、我刚从山上下来没多久，菱纱说山下吃饭吃菜都要给钱的，不能白吃。
translation: Yun Tianhe: I, I just came down from the mountain not long ago. Lingsha says you have to pay for food and vegetables down here, can't eat for free.

original_text: 阮慈：……傻孩子～那些卖东西给你的都是商人，自然要你的银钱，可我们不一样，我们是你爹的朋友，难道请你吃顿饭还收钱？
translation: Ruan Ci: ...Silly child~ Those who sell you things are merchants, of course they want your money, but we're different, we're your father's friends, would we charge you for a meal?

original_text: 柳世封：对对对，夫人说的甚是！莫说是几顿饭，就算你今后都在府上吃住，我们也是理应照顾的，何况说不准以后还变一家人！
translation: Liu Shifeng: Yes, yes, my wife is absolutely right! Not just a few meals, even if you stay and eat here from now on, we should take care of you. Besides, who knows, we might even become family in the future!

original_text: 云天河：……一家人？
translation: Yun Tianhe: ...Family?

original_text: 阮慈：老爷……
translation: Ruan Ci: My lord...

original_text: 柳世封：没什么、没什么，我们吃饭，哈哈，先吃饭！
translation: Liu Shifeng: It's nothing, nothing. Let's eat, haha, let's eat first!

original_text: 云天河：……这个好吃，那个也不错，原来肉还有这种味道的，比烤的还香～这碗里一粒粒白白的东西，就是爹说过的“饭”啊，真好吃！
translation: Yun Tianhe: This is delicious, that's good too. So meat can taste like this, even more fragrant than roasted~ These white, grainy things in the bowl, are they the 'rice' Dad mentioned? So tasty!

original_text: 柳世封：唉！想不到云贤弟已经过世了，还是得了如此重病，连弟妹也一起……这、怎么会这样？！
translation: Liu Shifeng: Sigh! I never thought Brother Yun had passed away, and from such a serious illness, even his wife too... This, how could this be?!

original_text: 云天河：对了，柳波波，你能不能告诉我一些关于爹的事情？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Right, Ankle Liu, can you tell me some things about my father?

original_text: 柳世封：当然！多年前幸亏云贤弟救我性命，不然我早成了路边枯骨。
translation: Liu Shifeng: Of course! Many years ago, thanks to Brother Yun saving my life, otherwise I'd have become bones by the roadside.

original_text: 柳世封：那时候我刚接任寿阳县令一职，走马上任，不想途中被人打劫，你爹路见不平、出手相助，还将那些强盗戏弄惩戒了一番！
translation: Liu Shifeng: At that time, I had just taken up my post as the magistrate of Shouyang County. On my way to assume office, I was unexpectedly robbed. Your father, seeing injustice on the road, stepped in to help and even playfully punished those robbers!

original_text: 柳世封：我们就此结识，兄弟相称，我想要他留在寿阳助我治理此地，但人各有志，你爹那时一心要成剑仙，几日后便离开了。
translation: Liu Shifeng: We became acquainted then, calling each other brothers. I wanted him to stay in Shouyang to help me govern, but each has their own aspirations; your father was determined to become a Sword Immortal and left a few days later.

original_text: 云天河：……有点难懂，反正我爹做了好事就对了～
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... A bit hard to understand, anyway my Father did a good thing~

original_text: 云天河：（原来这位老大当年挺惨的，还打不过别人，难怪爹要出手帮忙。）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (So this old-timer had it rough back then, couldn't even beat others. No wonder Father stepped in to help.)

original_text: 云天河：那后来呢？爹成了剑仙吗？
translation: Yun Tianhe: What happened after that? Did father become a Sword Immortal?

original_text: 柳世封：惭愧！这我也不太清楚，你爹如此一去，数年没有音讯，直到有一天……
translation: Liu Shifeng: Shameful! I'm not too clear either. Your father left like that, with no news for years, until one day...

original_text: 柳世封：他突然出现在我府中，怀抱一名女婴，托我把那孩子抚养长大，让她做个心地善良之人。我和夫人成亲后一直未有生养，自然十分乐意，你爹见我们答应下来，转眼便纵身去了。
translation: Liu Shifeng: He suddenly appeared in my mansion, holding a baby girl, and entrusted me to raise her to be kind-hearted. Since my wife and I had no children after marriage, we were naturally delighted. Your father, seeing us agree, vanished in an instant.

original_text: 柳世封：他向来行踪飘忽，不知何年何月能再相见，所以我命裴剑带了他的画像，一有机会便四处寻访，这才有今日的相聚呐。
translation: Liu Shifeng: He has always been elusive; who knows when we might meet again. So I ordered Pei Jian to carry his portrait and search for him whenever possible, leading to today's reunion.

original_text: 云天河：哦……那我娘是什么样的人？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Oh...Then what kind of person was my mother?

original_text: 柳世封：这……别说我没见过，云贤弟连提都没提起过啊。
translation: Liu Shifeng: This... Not only have I not seen her, Brother Yun didn't even mention her.

original_text: 阮慈：看你们～我才离开一会儿，就只顾着说话了。
translation: Ruan Ci: Look at you~ I was only gone a moment, and you're just talking.

original_text: 云天河：这味道……是酒！！好香～～
translation: Yun Tianhe: This smell... is wine!! So fragrant~~

original_text: 阮慈：老爷说你爹最喜欢这“蜜酒”，我才想到地窖里藏了几瓶，也该拿出来喝了。
translation: Ruan Ci: My lord said your father loved this 'honey wine' most. That reminded me of a few bottles hidden in the cellar-time to bring them out and drink.

original_text: 柳世封：对对对，贤侄多喝几杯！
translation: Liu Shifeng: Right, right, nephew, have a few more drinks!

original_text: 云天河：不，我不喝，菱纱说酒不是好东西！
translation: Yun Tianhe: No, I won't drink it. Lingsha said wine is no good!

original_text: 柳世封：哈哈哈，男子汉大丈夫，哪能不识酒味！贤侄不用担心，酒喝多了当然糟糕，但偶尔喝一点却没什么！
translation: Liu Shifeng: Hahaha, a real man must know the taste of wine! Worry not, nephew. Drinking too much is bad, of course, but a little now and then is fine!

original_text: 云天河：（怎么办……菱纱说不能喝，柳波波又说能喝，到底该听哪边的？）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (What to do... Lingsha says not to drink, but Ankle Liu says it's okay. Whose side should I listen to?)

original_text: 云天河：爹喜欢这“蜜酒”？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Did Father like this 'honey wine'?

original_text: 柳世封：不错，这酒乃是用了上好的糯米，佐以酒药酿制而成，还加了蜂蜜，所以喝到嘴里香味醇厚，贤侄定要尝尝呐～
translation: Liu Shifeng: Indeed, this wine is made from premium glutinous rice, fermented with yeast, and also blended with honey. That's why it tastes rich and mellow with a fragrant aroma. Nephew, you must give it a try~

original_text: 云天河：（味道这么香……不管了，爹爱喝就代表我能喝！）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (Smells so good... never mind, if Father loved to drink it, I can drink it too!)

original_text: 云天河：那我喝啰～
translation: Yun Tianhe: Then I'll drink~

original_text: 云天河：好喝、好喝！比白水好喝多了！！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Tasty, tasty! Much better than plain water!!

original_text: 柳世封：哈哈，贤侄今后有何打算？
translation: Liu Shifeng: Haha, what are your plans from now on, nephew?

original_text: 云天河：我？我要和菱纱一起去做剑仙，可以在天上飞来飞去～
translation: Yun Tianhe: Me? I want to become a sword immortal with Lingsha, to fly around in the sky~

original_text: 阮慈：你和那位姑娘，你们认识很久了？
translation: Ruan Ci: You and that young lady, have you known each other long?

original_text: 云天河：对啊，挺久的，都快两天了。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Right, quite long, almost two days.

original_text: 柳世封：嗯，是挺久的…………啊？！才两天？！
translation: Liu Shifeng: Hmm, it does feel like a long time... Huh?! Only two days?!

original_text: 云天河：（……奇怪～头晕乎乎的……）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (...Strange~ feeling dizzy...)

original_text: 柳世封：唉！那姑娘的来历恐怕不单纯，数月前有樵夫看到一人在寿阳东北的陵墓附近鬼祟行事，十有八九是盗墓的贼人，我请那樵夫口述，再由小女画像，与你那朋友倒是极为貌似。
translation: Liu Shifeng: Sigh! That girl's origins are likely dubious. Months ago, a woodcutter saw someone lurking suspiciously near the tombs northeast of Shouyang-almost certainly a grave tief. I had the woodcutter describe the person, and my daughter drew a portrait. It bears a striking resemblance to your friend.

original_text: 云天河：菱纱？贼？……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Lingsha? Thief? ...

original_text: 云天河：（……我晕……）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (...I'm dizzy...)

original_text: 阮慈：那姑娘莫非是你的心上人？
translation: Ruan Ci: That girl, could she be your sweetheart?

original_text: 云天河：心上人？不懂……她对我好，我当然对她好，她是我朋友。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Sweetheart? Don't understand... She's good to me, so of course I'm good to her. She's my friend.

original_text: 柳世封：原来是朋友，如此甚好！如此甚好！哈哈哈～
translation: Liu Shifeng: So you're friends. That's excellent! That's excellent! Hahaha~

original_text: 柳世封：实不相瞒，这几年我一直很头疼，小女待字闺中，却难觅佳婿，如今见到贤侄相貌人品出众，不妨和小女见上一面，若是你们彼此有意，倒是美事一桩、美事一桩呐！
translation: Liu Shifeng: To be honest, I've been troubled for years. My daughter remains in her chamber, yet finding a suitable match is difficult. Now, seeing your outstanding appearance and character, nephew, why not meet my daughter? If you both take a liking to each other, it would be a wonderful match, truly wonderful!

original_text: 云天河：（……咦？柳波波怎么变、变两个了…………）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (...Huh? How did Ankle Liu turn into... two of him?...)

original_text: 柳世封：贤侄觉得如何？
translation: Liu Shifeng: What does my nephew think?

original_text: 云天河：……什么？
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... What?

original_text: 柳世封：我与云贤弟、与贤侄都是一见如故，若是你能成为柳家的女婿，那真是再好不过了！
translation: Liu Shifeng: I felt an instant connection with Brother Yun and with you, nephew. If you could become the Liu family's son-in-law, that would be truly wonderful!
Yun Tianhe: Right... right... I'm right dizzy...

original_text: 柳世封：好！太好了，贤侄既然说好，我真是太高兴了，哈哈哈～
translation: Liu Shifeng: Right! Excellent, since my worthy nephew says it's right, I'm truly delighted, hahaha~

original_text: 云天河：呃……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Uh...

original_text: 柳世封：贤侄？！
translation: Liu Shifeng: Nephew?!

original_text: 阮慈：你啊，我看天河早醉了，就你还一个劲唠唠叨叨。
translation: Ruan Ci: You! I think Tianhe has been drunk for a while, and you're still chattering away.

original_text: 柳世封：哈哈，他的酒量可比他爹差远了。
translation: Liu Shifeng: Haha, his alcohol tolerance is far worse than his father's.

original_text: 阮慈：唉，老爷别高兴得太早，你这样给璃儿配夫婿，依她的性子肯定不悦，何况天河对那位菱纱姑娘颇有情意，怕不会随随便便转了心思。
translation: Ruan Ci: Alas, my lord, don't rejoice too soon. If you arrange a marriage for Lili like this, given her temperament, she'll surely be displeased. Besides, Tianhe seems quite fond of that Miss Lingsha; I'm afraid he won't easily change his mind.

original_text: 柳世封：夫人此话怎讲？！他们不只是朋友吗？
translation: Liu Shifeng: My wife, what do you mean?! Aren't they just friends?

original_text: 阮慈：这种事情，你们男人粗枝大叶当然看不出来，可小儿女的心思，哪有这么简单？
translation: Ruan Ci: Such things-you men are too thick-headed to notice them-but the feelings of young lovers aren't that simple, are they?

original_text: 柳世封：这……你我百年之后，璃儿她无人照顾，又该怎么办！
translation: Liu Shifeng: This... After we are gone, who will take care of Lili?!

original_text: 阮慈：儿孙自有儿孙福，老爷又何必太过担心？
translation: Ruan Ci: Children have their own fortunes-why worry so much, my lord?

original_text: 柳世封：还有一事，裴剑和我形容日间的情形，贤侄老实木讷，那韩姑娘却是古灵精怪，若真像夫人所说，二人怎么看也并非良配啊！
translation: Liu Shifeng: There's another thing. Pei Jian described the daytime situation to me: my worthy nephew is honest and simple, while that Miss Han is clever and quirky. If it's truly as my wife said, how could the two of them be a good match?

original_text: 阮慈：依我之见，老爷是多虑了，天河这孩子外表朴实，实则心如明镜，识人处事自有他的原则。
translation: Ruan Ci: In my opinion, you worry too much. Tianhe may appear simple, but his heart is clear as a mirror; he has his own principles in judging people and handling matters.

original_text: 柳世封：但愿如此——
translation: Liu Shifeng: I hope so-

original_text: 云天河：……爹……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... Father...
Yun Tianhe: ... Father... ...Mother...

original_text: 阮慈：可怜的孩子，一定是想他爹娘了……
translation: Ruan Ci: Poor child, must be missing his parents...

original_text: 柳世封：唉～是啊，一个人孤苦无依地住在山上，真是难为他了……
translation: Liu Shifeng: Sigh~ yes, living alone on the mountain without support, it's really hard on him...

original_text: 韩菱纱：真气人……我在牢里吃干烧饼，找这地方又累得半死才找到，你却吃饱睡好，快活着呢……
translation: Han Lingsha: So annoying... I ate dry flatbread in jail, and nearly exhausted myself finding this place, while you've been eating well, sleeping well, living it up...

original_text: 云天河：……唔……死猪妖哪里跑！！……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... Hmm... Damn pig fiend, where do you think you're running!!...

original_text: 韩菱纱：还猪妖？！我看你是猪头差不多，起来！
translation: Han Lingsha: Pig fiend?! I think you're a pig-headed fool, get up!

original_text: 云天河：……猪妖？……不对，是菱纱的声音？
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... Pig fiend?... No, it's Lingsha's voice?

original_text: 韩菱纱：哼，终于醒啦。
translation: Han Lingsha: Hmph, finally awake.

original_text: 云天河：那些人，让你走了？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Those people, they let you go?

original_text: 韩菱纱：小小一间破牢房哪困得住我？不过是想等夜里再行动，懒得和官府起冲突。
translation: Han Lingsha: How could a tiny, broken jail cell hold me? I was just waiting for night to act, too lazy to clash with the authorities.

original_text: 韩菱纱：你呢？有没有打听到你爹的事情？
translation: Han Lingsha: And you? Did you find out anything about your father?

original_text: 云天河：有啊，那个柳波波说他以前被爹救过，他想和爹一起玩，但是爹想当剑仙，就离开了，后来还送了个女儿给他。柳波波也没见过我娘。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Yes, that Ankle Liu said he was once saved by my father. He wanted to play with my father, but my father wanted to become a sword immortal and left. Later, he even entrusted him a daughter. Ankle Liu never met my mother either.

original_text: 韩菱纱：那个“女儿”又是怎么回事？你们见过面了？
translation: Han Lingsha: And what's with that 'daughter'? Have you met her?

original_text: 云天河：柳波波说我爹把一个女孩送给他，人就不见了。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Ankle Liu said Father gave him a girl and then disappeared.

original_text: 韩菱纱：……什么乱七八糟的，听上去都是不太管用的消息。
translation: Han Lingsha: ... What a mess. Sounds like all pretty useless information.

original_text: 韩菱纱：既然这样，我们还不如快点赶去陈州呢——
translation: Han Lingsha: In that case, we might as well hurry to Chenzhou-

original_text: 韩菱纱：咦？什么味儿？……你、你喝酒了？！
translation: Han Lingsha: Huh? What's that smell? ...You-you've been drinking wine?!

original_text: 云天河：呵呵，一点点而已，柳波波说没关系的～
translation: Yun Tianhe: Hehe, just a little bit. Ankle Liu said it's fine~

original_text: 云天河：对了，我当时晕乎乎的，柳波波好像还让我做他们家的女须，什么意思？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Right, I was dizzy then, but I think Ankle Liu also wanted me to be their family's 'sun in law', what does that mean?

original_text: 韩菱纱：大傻瓜，喝酒误事，说你不听，哪天——
translation: Han Lingsha: Big fool, drinking wine causes trouble, you won't listen, one day-

original_text: 韩菱纱：等等！！女婿？……女婿？！你答应他了？！
translation: Han Lingsha: Wait!! Sun in law?... Son-in-law?! You agreed to him?!

original_text: 云天河：我？我不记得了……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Me? I don't remember...

original_text: 韩菱纱：可恶！我们尽快离开这儿，这柳家真是莫名其妙，连你这种山顶野人都要收作女婿，说不定他女儿比你大上十岁八岁，早已经徐娘半老了！
translation: Han Lingsha: How infuriating! Let's leave this place quickly. This Liu family is utterly ridiculous-they even want to take a mountain barbarian like you as their son-in-law. Maybe their daughter is eight or ten years older than you, already past her prime!

original_text: 云天河：唔……菱纱，什么叫“贼”啊？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Hmm... Lingsha, what does 'thief' mean?

original_text: 韩菱纱：什么？！你哪里听来的？！是那个柳大人说的对不对？他说我是偷东西的小贼？！
translation: Han Lingsha: What?! Where did you hear that?! Was it that Lord Liu who said it? Did he say I was a little thief who steals things?!

original_text: 云天河：是、是啊，他讲的时候还一副不高兴的样子……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Y... yes, he said it with an unhappy look on his face...

original_text: 韩菱纱：胡说！我韩家子孙习风水堪舆、通机关巧槛，世世代代都是独行千里的陵墓大盗，又哪里是白痴小毛贼可以相提并论的？
translation: Han Lingsha: Nonsense! We descendants of the Han family study feng shui and geomancy, understand mechanisms and traps. For generations, we have been lone tomb raiders and great bandits traveling thousands of miles-great bandits! How could we be compared to some stupid little thief?

original_text: 韩菱纱：以后不许说我是贼，不然我翻脸了！
translation: Han Lingsha: From now on, don't call me a thief, or I'll get angry!

original_text: 云天河：哦……那你去我爹娘的墓，是……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Oh... Then you went to my parents' grave, is that...

original_text: 韩菱纱：…………我、我上山是为了找剑仙的宝物，绝对没有冒犯他们的意思，墓室毁了我也很抱歉，所以现在要将功补过，帮忙找你爹娘的消息……
translation: Han Lingsha: ...... I, I came up the mountain to find the sword immortals' treasure, and I had absolutely no intention to offend them. I'm also sorry the tomb chamber was destroyed, so now I want to make amends by helping you find news of your parents...

original_text: 云天河：呵呵，还是你对我好。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Hehe, you're still the one who's good to me.

original_text: 韩菱纱：什、什么啊，一个大男生讲这种话也不害臊……还有……你要在床上坐多久！起床走了啦！
translation: Han Lingsha: Wh-what's this, a big guy saying such things without feeling embarrassed... And... how long are you going to sit on the bed! Get up, let's go!

original_text: 云天河：（呵呵，柳波波的女儿夸我爹是大英雄～她是好人。）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (Hehe, Ankle Liu's daughter praised Father as a great hero~ She's a good person.)

original_text: 云天河：（……菱纱老爱生气，爹常说我让他生气，容易伤肝，这样不好，我得和她说说……）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (...Lingsha gets angry so easily. Father often said I made him angry, which easily harms the liver. That's not good. I should talk to her about it...)

original_text: 云天河：（……睏了……今天的饭菜真香……真是好吃……）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (...Sleepy... today's meal was so fragrant... really delicious...)

original_text: 云天河：唔～睡得好沉，真舒服。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Mmm~ Slept so soundly, feels great.

original_text: 云天河：<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>不晓得菱纱起床没有，去找她～</colour>
translation: Yun Tianhe: <colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>Wonder if Lingsha's up yet, gonna go find her~</colour>

original_text: 云天河：喂，你……知不知道菱纱在哪？带我去找她行吗？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Hey, you... do you know where Lingsha is? Can you take me to find her?

original_text: 禄蓉：啊，是未来的姑爷……
translation: Lurong: Ah, it's the future Young Master...

original_text: 禄蓉：不对、不对，是云公子，<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>老爷请你睡醒后去前厅，</colour><dc0>我家小姐和韩姑娘都已经等在那里了。</dc0>
translation: Lurong: No, no, it's Mr. Yun.<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> The master requests you come to the front hall after you wake,</colour><dc0> my lady and Miss Han are already waiting there.</dc0>

original_text: 禄蓉：禄蓉就先告退了～
translation: Lurong: Lurong will take her leave now~

original_text: 云天河：（……干嘛这么急，我还没问<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>前厅</colour><dc0>是哪里……）</dc0>
translation: Yun Tianhe: (...Why so urgent? I haven't even asked<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> where the front hall</colour><dc0> is...)</dc0>

original_text: 云天河：（算了，边走边找，总能找到。）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (Forget it, we'll search as we walk, we'll find it eventually.)

original_text: 柳世封：哈哈，贤侄～来得正好，我们正要向韩姑娘说女萝岩之事，你也听听。
translation: Liu Shifeng: Haha, dear nephew~ Perfect timing. We were just about to tell Miss Han about the Nvluo Rock incident; you listen too.

original_text: 云天河：哦，好……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Oh, okay...

original_text: 柳世封：说来惭愧，我初来寿阳时，治理无方，此地百姓虽不至困顿潦倒，却也绝非大有余钱，行商买卖之人更是少之又少……
translation: Liu Shifeng: To my shame, when I first came to Shouyang, my governance was poor. The people here, though not destitute, were far from wealthy, and merchants were few and far between...

original_text: 阮慈：老爷何必耿耿于怀，尽人事而后听天命，璃儿后来帮了寿阳百姓，不也是一种福缘吗？
translation: Ruan Ci: My lord, why dwell on it? Do your best and leave the rest to fate. Lili later helped the people of Shouyang-isn't that also a kind of blessing?

original_text: 柳世封：夫人说的甚是！多亏璃儿巧手，把山上的“离香草”做成熏香，从此各地商贩争相竞买，连京城里的贵人都对这种香赞不绝口，寿阳也才有了今日的富庶。
translation: Liu Shifeng: My wife speaks wisely! Thanks to Lili's skillful hands, turning the mountain's 'Parting Herb' into incense, merchants from all over now compete to buy it. Even nobles in the capital praise this incense endlessly, which is why Shouyang has become so prosperous today.

original_text: 云天河：唔……这样很、很好啊……和妖、唔……怪有什么相干？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Hmm...That's... that's very, very good... What does it have to do with...yao... mmm... yaoguais?

original_text: 韩菱纱：笨蛋！不要边吃东西边说话！
translation: Han Lingsha: Idiot! Don't talk while eating!

original_text: 韩菱纱：还有那糕点，你从哪里拿的？太没礼貌了吧！
translation: Han Lingsha: And that dim sum, where did you get it from? That's so rude!

original_text: 阮慈：没关系、没关系，这桌上的核桃糕原本就是留给天河的。
translation: Ruan Ci: It's fine, it's fine. The walnut cakes on the table were originally left for Tianhe.

original_text: 阮慈：慢慢吃，小心别噎着。
translation: Ruan Ci: Eat slowly, be careful not to choke.

original_text: 云天河：唔，这个好吃，我正好肚子咕咕叫了～
translation: Yun Tianhe: Mmm, this is tasty, my stomach's been growling~

original_text: 韩菱纱：（……丢脸，真想当作不认识他……算了，当他不存在好了……）
translation: Han Lingsha: (...So embarrassing, I really wish I didn't know him... Fine, I'll just pretend he doesn't exist...)

original_text: 柳梦璃：<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>寿阳西北面的女萝岩</colour><dc0>盛产离香草，城里人多半都去那采摘，只是近半月女萝岩忽然有妖物频频伤人，如今没有人再敢接近了。</dc0>
translation: Liu Mengli:<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> Nvluo Rock, northwest of Shouyang,</colour><dc0> is rich in Parting Herb. Most people in the city go there to gather it, but in the past half month, monsters have suddenly been frequently injuring people at Nvluo Rock, so no one dares to go near anymore.</dc0>

original_text: 韩菱纱：麻烦，财路断了，这可是大大不妙。
translation: Han Lingsha: Trouble, the money trail's cut off, this is really bad.

original_text: 柳世封：老百姓心中慌恐，更是令人忧心……
translation: Liu Shifeng: The panic among the common people is even more worrying...

original_text: 柳梦璃：待云公子用完点心，我们就出发吧，这种事情总是越早解决越好。
translation: Liu Mengli: After Yun finishes his dim sum, let's set off. Such matters are always better resolved sooner.

original_text: 韩菱纱：那个傻瓜……根本不用理他嘛……事不宜迟，马上走就好了！
translation: Han Lingsha: That fool... There's no need to pay him any mind... No time to lose, we should leave right away!

original_text: 柳世封：这就要走了？璃儿，爹真是不放心你……
translation: Liu Shifeng: Leaving already? Lili, I'm truly worried about you...

original_text: 柳世封：你看，桌上这篮是爹嘱咐王厨娘做的点心，都是你平时爱吃的，要记得带上～
translation: Liu Shifeng: Look, this basket on the table contains dim sums Dad asked Chef Wang to make, all your usual favorites. Remember to take them~

original_text: 韩菱纱：（喂喂……老伯，我们可不是去踏青玩乐……）
translation: Han Lingsha: (Hey hey... Old man, we're not going on a spring outing for fun...)

original_text: 柳梦璃：爹，女儿心里记挂着事情，哪还有心情吃点心？不如等到一切解决之后，再慢慢品尝也不迟。
translation: Liu Mengli: Father, my heart is preoccupied with matters, how could I have the mood for dim sums? Let's wait until everything is resolved, then savor them slowly.

original_text: 云天河：你、你不吃啊？真可惜，不能浪费，那我带着吃好了——
translation: Yun Tianhe: You... you're not eating? What a shame, can't let it go to waste. I'll take it with me then--

original_text: 韩菱纱：你！哼～就知道吃～吃～吃～
translation: Han Lingsha: You! Hmph~ only know how to eat~ eat~ eat~

original_text: 云天河：又怎么了？菱纱真爱生气……不吃就不吃……
translation: Yun Tianhe: What now? Lingsha really loves to get angry... Fine, don't eat then...

original_text: 柳梦璃：爹、娘，不用挂念，我们会早去早回的。
translation: Liu Mengli: Father, Mother, don't worry. We'll return as soon as possible.

original_text: 柳世封：璃儿，你和天河，还有韩姑娘都要小心，万一情况不妙就跑，可不要逞强吃眼前亏。
translation: Liu Shifeng: Lili, you, Tianhe, and Miss Han must all be careful. If the situation turns bad, run. Don't be stubborn and get yourself into unnecessary trouble.

original_text: 云天河：柳波波，你放心，我不怕妖怪的，就怕打不过它们……呵呵～～
translation: Yun Tianhe: Ankle Liu, don't worry, I'm not afraid of yaoguais, just afraid I can't beat them... hehe~~

original_text: 柳梦璃：…………走吧。
translation: Liu Mengli: ......, let's go.

original_text: 柳世封：唉呀～爹的宝贝女儿，你可算回来了！有没有哪里受伤？是不是遇到了什么危险？
translation: Liu Shifeng: Oh dear~ My precious daughter, you're finally back! Are you hurt anywhere? Did you encounter any danger?

original_text: 柳世封：唉，怪我这老糊涂，我越想越后悔，就不应该答应让你们去！
translation: Liu Shifeng: Ah, it's my fault, this old fool. The more I think, the more I regret it. I shouldn't have agreed to let you go!

original_text: 柳梦璃：爹，您别这么担心，您看，什么事也没有，大家都好好的。
translation: Liu Mengli: Father, don't worry so much, see, nothing's wrong, everyone's fine.

original_text: 韩菱纱：对啊，闹妖怪的事也解决了，我们虽无太大功劳，总也有些苦劳～
translation: Han Lingsha: Right, the yaoguai trouble is solved too. We may not have great merit, but we did put in some hard work~

original_text: 韩菱纱：嘻嘻，县令大人你可要言而有信哦！别再让官差追着我跑了！
translation: Han Lingsha: Hehe, County Magistrate, you must keep your word! Don't let the constables chase me anymore!

original_text: 柳世封：这、这真是天大的好消息！可妖怪到底……
translation: Liu Shifeng: This, this is truly wonderful news! But yaoguais, after all...

original_text: 柳梦璃：爹，当时情形容女儿慢慢说来，而且女儿也另有重要的事想告诉你和娘。
translation: Liu Mengli: Father, let me explain the situation slowly. Also, I have other important matters to tell you and mother.

original_text: 阮慈：这倒难得～不如我们去璃儿房里谈。
translation: Ruan Ci: That's rare~ Why don't we go talk in Lili's room.

original_text: 阮慈：天河、韩姑娘也辛苦多时，想必累了，可以稍稍歇息一下。
translation: Ruan Ci: Tianhe and Miss Han have also worked hard for a long time, surely tired. You can rest a little.

original_text: 云天河：累？不会啊，比在山上打猎轻松多了，我还有使不完的力气呢！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Tired? Not at all, it's much easier than hunting in the mountains. I still have endless energy!

original_text: 韩菱纱：什么使不完的力气！你过来！
translation: Han Lingsha: What endless strength! You come here!

original_text: 韩菱纱：算我求你别那么活宝……别人一家子要说说话，你杵在那儿当烛台啊？
translation: Han Lingsha: I'm begging you, stop being such a clown... The family wants to talk, are you going to stand there like a candlestick?

original_text: 韩菱纱：各位～不用管我们啦，我和天河先四处逛逛，你们慢慢聊。
translation: Han Lingsha: Everyone~ Don't mind us. Tianhe and I will wander around first-you chat slowly.

original_text: 云天河：菱纱，你要去哪玩？我们一起去～
translation: Yun Tianhe: Lingsha, where do you want to go play? Let's go together~

original_text: 韩菱纱：……不要。
translation: Han Lingsha: ...No.

original_text: 韩菱纱：怎么说我都是女孩子，也有一两个自己的小秘密，不能老和你粘在一块。
translation: Han Lingsha: I am a girl, after all, and I have a few secrets of my own. I can't always be stuck to you.

original_text: 云天河：小秘密？我不能知道吗？
translation: Yun Tianhe: A few secrets? Can't I know?

original_text: 韩菱纱：你找碴啊，都说是秘密了……
translation: Han Lingsha: Are you picking a fight? I said secrets...

original_text: 韩菱纱：总之，你无聊的话，就自己去街上走走，或者<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>在柳家逛逛</colour><dc0>，反正这里够大，风景又不错！</dc0>
translation: Han Lingsha: Anyway, if you're bored, just take a walk around the streets yourself, or<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> wander around the Liu mansion</colour><dc0>, it's big enough here and the scenery is nice!</dc0>

original_text: 韩菱纱：嘻嘻，待会儿再见～
translation: Han Lingsha: Hehe, see you later~

original_text: 云天河：……咳咳……又是这招……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... Ahem... this move again...

original_text: 禄翠：韩、韩姑娘不见了？！真的，“嘭”的一下就没了！
translation: Lucui: Miss Han, Miss Han is gone?! Really, she disappeared with a 'poof'!

original_text: 柳心：那肯定是仙法！小姐的朋友就是了不得！
translation: Liu Xin: That must be immortal art! Miss's friends are truly amazing!
Yun Tianhe: ......

original_text: 禄蓉：咦？是未来的姑爷呀？
translation: Lurong: Huh? Is it the future Young Master?

original_text: 禄蓉：小姐正在亭子里呢，好像有什么烦心事，您可要想想法子哄她开心～
translation: Lurong: My lady is in the pavilion. She seems troubled by something. You should think of a way to cheer her up~

original_text: 云天河：我？我去？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Me? I go?

original_text: 禄蓉：是呀，当然要姑爷去才行，嘻！
translation: Lurong: Yes, of course our Young Master must go, hehe!

original_text: 柳梦璃：是云公子？
translation: Liu Mengli: Is it Yun?

original_text: 云天河：啊！是我。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Ah! It's me.

original_text: 云天河：唔……刚才那女孩，说你不高兴……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Hmm... That girl just now said you were unhappy...

original_text: 柳梦璃：别听她的，禄蓉这丫头就喜欢添油加醋，我只是想到要和爹娘分开那么久，有点不习惯……
translation: Liu Mengli: Don't listen to her. Lurong likes to exaggerate. I'm just not used to the thought of being away from my parents for so long...

original_text: 柳梦璃：对了，爹和娘答应我了，以后我就能跟着云公子、还有菱纱四处游历～
translation: Liu Mengli: By the way, Father and Mother have agreed. From now on, I can travel with Yun and Lingsha~

original_text: 云天河：那……那真是太好了……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Then... that's really great...

original_text: 云天河：你，很想当剑仙吗？
translation: Yun Tianhe: You really want to be a sword immortal?

original_text: 柳梦璃：……从小到大，我都在这个府邸里，过了一天又一天，可有的时候，我也会想知道自己究竟从哪里来，发生过什么……
translation: Liu Mengli: ... From childhood till now, I've spent day after day in this mansion. But sometimes, I also wonder where I truly come from and what happened...

original_text: 柳梦璃：在我的脑海里总闪过一些奇异的景象，说不定……说不定到了外面，就能找到什么线索……
translation: Liu Mengli: Strange scenes always flash through my mind. Perhaps... perhaps once I go outside, I can find some clues...

original_text: 云天河：我爹……他什么都没说吗？
translation: Yun Tianhe: My father... he didn't say anything?

original_text: 柳梦璃：云叔肯定有他的理由，或许连他也不知道呢。再说，爹和娘都很疼我，能遇上他们，我已是天底下最幸运的人了。
translation: Liu Mengli: Uncle Yun must have his reasons, maybe even he doesn't know. Besides, Father and Mother love me dearly. Meeting them makes me the luckiest person in the world.

original_text: 云天河：嗯！你、你说的对！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Mm! Y-you're right!

original_text: 云天河：柳波波他们是好人～我说不上来，不过像你们这样一直在一起，也挺不错的。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Uncle Liu and them are good people~ I can't explain it, but being together like you are seems pretty nice.

original_text: 柳梦璃：……如果你愿意，也可以把他们当成你的爹娘……我听说，你娘也是很早就过世了……
translation: Liu Mengli: ... If you're willing, you can also think of them as your parents... I heard your mother also passed away very early...

original_text: 云天河：啊？不用不用！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Huh? No no!

original_text: 云天河：我是说……我不能抢走你的爹娘，还有啊，我要是喊别人作“爹”，老爹说不定真要气歪了！
translation: Yun Tianhe: What I mean is... I can't take your parents away. Also, if I called someone else 'Dad', my old man would probably be furious!

original_text: 柳梦璃：嘻，云叔哪有你说的那么凶。
translation: Liu Mengli: Hehe, Uncle Yun isn't as fierce as you say.

original_text: 云天河：……梦、梦璃，我能问你一件事吗？
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... Meng, Mengli, can I ask you something?

original_text: 柳梦璃：嗯？
translation: Liu Mengli: Hmm?

original_text: 云天河：柳波波他总是喊我“咸枝”，还有这里的女孩叫我“姑爷”，我都不明白是怎么一回事，你知道吗？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Uncle Liu always calls me 'Wordy-net-few', and the girls here call me future 'Young Master'. I don't understand what's going on. Do you know?

original_text: 柳梦璃：贤芝……贤侄？
translation: Liu Mengli: Wordy-net-few... worthy nephew?

original_text: 柳梦璃：云公子，云叔教过你读书写字吗？
translation: Liu Mengli: Yun, did Uncle Yun teach you to read and write?

original_text: 云天河：爹教过一些，他还留了几本书给我念，呵呵，不过烤肉的时候为了生火方便，差不多都烧掉了。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Dad taught me some, and he left a few books for me to read, hehe, but I burned most of them to make fire for roasting meat.

original_text: 柳梦璃：这么说来，你只是不晓得哪些字该对上哪些意思，以后我找时间慢慢告诉你吧～
translation: Liu Mengli: So, you just don't know which words match which meanings. I'll find time to teach you slowly later~

original_text: 云天河：好、好啊！我多学点，也省得菱纱老说会被我气死，哈哈～
translation: Yun Tianhe: Okay, okay! I'll learn more, so Lingsha won't keep saying I'll annoy her to death, haha~

original_text: 柳梦璃：…………至于“姑爷”……那是丫头们闹着玩的，别理她们～她们大概听了我爹的话，以为我和云公子要成亲呢。
translation: Liu Mengli: ...... As for 'Young Master'... that's just the maids joking around, ignore them~ They probably heard my father and think I'm going to marry Yun.

original_text: 云天河：成亲？啥意思？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Marry? What's that mean?

original_text: 柳梦璃：……简单些说，假如有个女孩子看着你心里舒坦，便会想要嫁给你，从今往后两个人一生一世都厮守在一起，永远也不分离。
translation: Liu Mengli: ...Simply put, if a girl feels happy looking at you, she'll want to marry into your family. From then on, the two of you stay together for a lifetime, never parting.

original_text: 云天河：哦～听起来……还挺不错的，呵呵。可是……那个……连、连去茅房都要一起，不太好吧？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Oh~ sounds... pretty good, hehe. But... that... even, even going to the outhouse together, isn't that a bit much?

original_text: 柳梦璃：…………噗～～云公子真是有趣。
translation: Liu Mengli: ...... Pfft~ Yun, you're really amusing.

original_text: 柳梦璃：时候也不早了，我还有事要出府一趟，明日再见吧，到时有件东西要送给云公子呢。
translation: Liu Mengli: It's getting late. I have matters to attend to outside the manor. Until tomorrow. I have something to give you then, Yun.

original_text: 云天河：送我东西？真的吗？！是什么？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Giving me something? Really?! What is it?

original_text: 柳梦璃：秘密～云公子见了便知。
translation: Liu Mengli: It's a secret~ You'll know when you see it, Mr. Yun.

original_text: 柳梦璃：云公子……有件事我还想要谢谢你。
translation: Liu Mengli: Yun, I have something else I want to thank you for.

original_text: 云天河：啊？什么？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Huh? What?

original_text: 柳梦璃：你对那两个人说，女萝岩里没有妖怪，我……很谢谢你愿意帮槐米他们。
translation: Liu Mengli: You told those two there are no yaoguais in Nvluo Rock. I... thank you for being willing to help Huaimi and the others.

original_text: 云天河：那也没什么……
translation: Yun Tianhe: That's nothing...

original_text: 柳梦璃：云公子你是个好人，让我想起云叔……你们都有一副好心肠……
translation: Liu Mengli: Yun, you are a good person. You remind me of Uncle Yun... You both have kind hearts...

original_text: 云天河：（奇怪，怎么女孩子都有秘密……）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (Strange, why do girls all have secrets...)

original_text: 韩菱纱：哈哈，情意绵绵的，我可全听见了！！
translation: Han Lingsha: Haha, all that affection-I heard everything!!

original_text: 韩菱纱：无聊～看我突然出现，你都不会吓一跳，连眉毛都不动。
translation: Han Lingsha: Boring~ I suddenly appear, and you don't even get startled, not even an eyebrow twitch.

original_text: 云天河：我爹说过，男子汉立世无所畏惧，没什么好怕的。
translation: Yun Tianhe: My father said, a real man faces the world without fear, there's nothing to be afraid of.

original_text: 韩菱纱：好啦好啦，开个玩笑嘛，干嘛严肃得像根木头……
translation: Han Lingsha: Alright, alright, just joking, why so serious like a block of wood...

original_text: 韩菱纱：我问你，你真的想好了？要和梦璃一起去求仙？
translation: Han Lingsha: I'm asking you, have you really thought it through? You want to seek immortality with Mengli?

original_text: 云天河：和她一起？呵呵，好、好啊……
translation: Yun Tianhe: With her? Hehe, okay, okay...

original_text: 韩菱纱：（……一脸白痴相，想到哪里去了……）
translation: Han Lingsha: (...looking like an idiot, where's your mind wandering...)

original_text: 韩菱纱：说真的，像梦璃这样，虽然不清楚自己的身世，可是养父母待她那么好，还真让人有点羡慕呢……可惜不是人人都有这种福气。
translation: Han Lingsha: Honestly, someone like Mengli, even though she doesn't know her own origins, her adoptive parents treat her so well, it's really a bit enviable... Unfortunately, not everyone has that kind of luck.

original_text: 韩菱纱：唉，她好歹也是个千金大小姐，不知对江湖上的事了解多少……
translation: Han Lingsha: Sigh, she's a young lady from a wealthy family after all. I wonder how much she knows about the martial world...

original_text: 云天河：……？
translation: Yun Tianhe: ...?

original_text: 韩菱纱：她对妖怪的态度跟你一个样子，真是有趣。
translation: Han Lingsha: Her attitude toward yaoguais is just like yours, really amusing.

original_text: 云天河：好像是吧，哈哈……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Seems so, haha...

original_text: 韩菱纱：一个从小到大都在山顶当野人，一个从小到大都在家里当千金大小姐，想法又差不多，难怪要你当“姑爷”呀！哼！
translation: Han Lingsha: One grew up as a barbarian on a mountaintop, the other as a pampered young lady at home, yet you think alike-no wonder they want you as their 'Young Master'! Hmph!

original_text: 云天河：哈哈……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Haha...

original_text: 韩菱纱：就知道哈哈哈傻笑……
translation: Han Lingsha: All you do is laugh foolishly...

original_text: 韩菱纱：但是不管怎么说，她也比你这种初次见面，因为人家貌美就断定她是好人的笨家伙要强！
translation: Han Lingsha: But no matter what, she's still better than a fool like you who decides someone is good just because they're pretty at first sight!

original_text: 韩菱纱：哼哼，色心不死，小心以后桃花劫要你小命！
translation: Han Lingsha: Hmph, your lustful heart won't die. Be careful, a peach blossom encounter might take your life!

original_text: 云天河：逃花？不是啊，我是因为梦璃没有杀气，院子里那些怪物也没有，才知道她不是坏人。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Beach blossom? No, I knew she wasn't bad because Mengli had no killing intent, and the monsters in the yard didn't either.

original_text: 韩菱纱：嘻嘻，我还香气臭气呢，少拿这么玄的东西来唬人。
translation: Han Lingsha: Hehe, I'm sensitive with the fragrant intent and stinky intent. Stop trying to fool people with such mysterious stuff.

original_text: 云天河：真的！就像山上的黑熊，没杀气时不会伤人，但是万一被激怒，十几步之外都能听见磨牙和喘气声。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Really! Just like the black bears in the mountains, they won't hurt you when they have no killing intent. But if they get provoked, you can hear their teeth grinding and heavy breathing from over a dozen steps away.

original_text: 韩菱纱：（……说什么呢，人又不是熊，哪来的磨牙和喘气声……）
translation: Han Lingsha: (...What are you talking about? People aren't bears-there's no grinding teeth or heavy breathing...)

original_text: 云天河：菱纱，你、你不喜欢梦璃吗？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Lingsha, do you ... dislike Mengli?

original_text: 韩菱纱：没有啊，干嘛突然这么问？
translation: Han Lingsha: No, why ask so suddenly?

original_text: 云天河：没、没什么。
translation: Yun Tianhe: N-nothing.

original_text: 韩菱纱：……
translation: Han Lingsha: ...

original_text: 韩菱纱：……我……
translation: Han Lingsha: ...I...

original_text: 云天河：怎么了？
translation: Yun Tianhe: What's wrong?

original_text: 韩菱纱：…………我没有不喜欢她。
translation: Han Lingsha: ......I don't dislike her.

original_text: 韩菱纱：其实……谁喜欢谁，又讨厌谁，这种事情真有那么重要吗？
translation: Han Lingsha: Actually... who likes whom, who dislikes whom-is that really so important?

original_text: 韩菱纱：……虽然世上的人千千万万，可每个人都是孤伶伶地来，又孤伶伶地去，没有其他任何人是可以依靠和作伴的。
translation: Han Lingsha: ... Though there are countless people in the world, each comes alone and leaves alone, with no one else to rely on or accompany them.

original_text: 韩菱纱：再真挚的感情、再深沉的牵挂，还是会有分开的一天，好像你爹和你娘，到头来又怎么抵得过生死离别……
translation: Han Lingsha: Even the most sincere feelings, the deepest attachments, will one day end in separation. Just like your father and mother, in the end, how could they withstand parting or death...

original_text: 云天河：…………不是……你说的不对，虽然我讲不出来，可不应该是这样的……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ...... No... What you said isn't right, even though I can't explain it, it shouldn't be like this...
Han Lingsha: ......

original_text: 韩菱纱：……哼，你这家伙，下山才多久，倒学会数落我了！
translation: Han Lingsha: ...Hmph, you! You've only been off the mountain for a few days, and you've already learned to lecture me?

original_text: 云天河：我觉得……有时候你好像不是菱纱……不……像是另外一个菱纱……
translation: Yun Tianhe: I feel... sometimes you don't seem like Lingsha... No... more like a different Lingsha...

original_text: 韩菱纱：你！…………
translation: Han Lingsha: You!......

original_text: 韩菱纱：什么这个那个，我又不是妖怪，还会变来变去。
translation: Han Lingsha: What's with all that 'like' and 'like a different' me talk? I'm not a yaoguai-I don't just change into different people.

original_text: 云天河：话是这么说没错，但是……
translation: Yun Tianhe: That's true, but...

original_text: 韩菱纱：少啰嗦，就凭你这种木鱼脑袋，想太多搞不好会突然爆掉，先管好自己吧！
translation: Han Lingsha: Less chatter! With a blockhead like you, thinking too much might make it burst. Just take care of yourself first!

original_text: 云天河：知道了……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Okay...

original_text: 韩菱纱：我回房了，<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>你也早点去休息，</colour><dc0>明天赶路去陈州可是很辛苦的！</dc0>
translation: Han Lingsha: I'm going back to my room,<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> You should rest early too,</colour><dc0> Tomorrow's journey to Chenzhou will be very tiring!</dc0>

original_text: 云天河：菱纱……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Lingsha...

original_text: 云天河：女孩子的心情怎么老是变来变去？好像前一刻天晴，后一刻又下雨……难道我刚刚又说错话？奇怪……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Why do girls' moods always change so much? Like clear skies one moment, then rain the next... Did I say something wrong again just now? Weird...

original_text: 云天河：…………再真挚的感情、再深沉的牵挂，还是会有分开的一天……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ...... Even the most sincere feelings, the deepest attachments, will one day end in separation...

original_text: 韩菱纱：哎～怎么慢吞吞的，到现在才来！
translation: Han Lingsha: Hey~ why so slow, only coming now!

original_text: 柳梦璃：云公子，你昨夜休息得可好？
translation: Liu Mengli: Yun, did you rest well last night?

original_text: 云天河：好、好……我很好！
translation: Yun Tianhe: G-good... I feel very good!

original_text: 韩菱纱：（……白痴，脸都红了，一看就知道色心又起……）
translation: Han Lingsha: (...Idiot, your face is red, clearly lustful thoughts again...)

original_text: 柳梦璃：云公子，你看，这是昨日说要送你的，试试称不称手。
translation: Liu Mengli: Yun, look, this is what I promised to give you yesterday. Try if it fits your hand.

original_text: 云天河：这是……弓？！
translation: Yun Tianhe: This is... a bow?!

original_text: 柳梦璃：我见云公子的弓用得久了，似乎有些破旧，所以请人做了把新的，你可喜欢吗？
translation: Liu Mengli: I noticed Yun's bow is quite worn from long use, so I had a new one made. Do you like it?

original_text: 云天河：喜、喜欢！
translation: Yun Tianhe: L-like it!

original_text: 云天河：哈哈，这弓不错，简直太好了！木头好，木纹又匀，射出去的箭肯定强劲、箭路不偏，而且木头外面还加了小石头，握着应该很稳！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Haha, this bow is good, simply excellent! The wood is good, the grain is even, the arrows shot from it are sure to be powerful and fly straight. And there are small stones added to the outside of the wood, so it should be very steady to hold!

original_text: 韩菱纱：什么小石头……明明是玉……
translation: Han Lingsha: What little stone... it's clearly jade...

original_text: 柳梦璃：太好了，云公子喜欢就好，其实弓的优劣我不太懂……
translation: Liu Mengli: Great, I'm glad Yun likes it. Actually, I don't know much about bows...

original_text: 云天河：喜欢、我当然喜欢！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Like it? Of course I like it!

original_text: 韩菱纱：梦璃你的眼光不错哦～造这把弓的人可一点也没偷工减料，玉片都是用上好的碧玉打磨，这样一把“玉腰弓”肯定价值不菲了。
translation: Han Lingsha: Mengli, you have a good eye~ The person who made this bow didn't cut corners at all. The jade pieces are polished from top-quality jasper. Such a 'Jade-Waist Bow' must be worth a fortune.

original_text: 柳梦璃：哪里，我什么都不懂，多亏了<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>铁泽居的刘老板</colour><dc0>，他手艺精湛，人又热心，实在帮了大忙，我们出城前也可以去他那儿挑几件防身器用——</dc0>
translation: Liu Mengli: Not at all, I know nothing. Thanks to Boss Liu of Iron Forge Residence-his superb craftsmanship and warm-heartedness were a great help. Before leaving the city, we can pick up some defensive gear from him.

original_text: 柳世封：璃儿、璃儿～快来看，爹都给你准备妥当了！！
