translation: Liu Shifeng: Lili Lili~ Come quick, look, father has everything ready for you!!

original_text: 柳梦璃：爹？这是……？
translation: Liu Mengli: Father? What is this...?

original_text: 柳世封：哈哈！这是爹特地为你挑的宝马加香车！车上已铺了毯子，放好点心～
translation: Liu Shifeng: Haha! This is the fine horse and fragrant carriage Father specially picked for you! The carriage is already carpeted, with dim sums prepared~

original_text: 柳世封：你们不是要去陈州？璃儿你就在里面舒舒服服地睡上一觉，醒来就到了～
translation: Liu Shifeng: Aren't you heading to Chenzhou? Lili, you can sleep comfortably inside and wake up once you arrive~
Liu Mengli: ......

original_text: 韩菱纱：我说……县令大人，这马车看起来是不错，可要乘着它走官道，不知何年何月才到得了陈州啊……
translation: Han Lingsha: I say... County Magistrate, this carriage looks good, but taking it on the official road, who knows how many years it'll take to reach Chenzhou...

original_text: 柳世封：什么？你们不要车？！
translation: Liu Shifeng: What? You don't want the carriage?!

original_text: 柳世封：裴剑！你快去牵三匹马来，这车先不要了！
translation: Liu Shifeng: Pei Jian! Quickly bring three horses, forget about the carriage for now!

original_text: 裴剑：是。
translation: Pei Jian: Yes.

original_text: 柳梦璃：爹～我看都不用了。
translation: Liu Mengli: Father~ I think none are needed.

original_text: 柳梦璃：女儿虽然没有出过远门，但韩姑娘颇有阅历，先听她安排便是，最多多带些银两在身边，不至捉襟见肘。
translation: Liu Mengli: Although I've never traveled far, Miss Han is quite experienced. Let's follow her arrangements for now. If anything, we'll bring more silver currency with us to avoid being short on funds.

original_text: 柳梦璃：……至于点心……
translation: Liu Mengli: ... As for the dim sums...

original_text: 柳梦璃：点心便带在路上吃吧。
translation: Liu Mengli: We can take the dim sums to eat on the road.

original_text: 云天河：好啊、好啊～点心是好东西！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Good, good~ dim sums are great!

original_text: 韩菱纱：（唉……我忍，当没听见……）
translation: Han Lingsha: (Sigh... I'll endure, pretend I didn't hear...)

original_text: 柳世封：这……好吧，爹都依你，璃儿高兴就好。
translation: Liu Shifeng: This... Alright, Father will agree to whatever you want, as long as Lili is happy.

original_text: 阮慈：唉，我早劝过老爷别又一时动念，看吧，你果然是说不过璃儿～
translation: Ruan Ci: Sigh, I advised my lord long ago not to be impulsive again. See, you really can't win an argument against Lili~

original_text: 柳梦璃：娘，不妨事的，我知道爹也是为我好，只是这些年来你们已经操心太多，女儿不能再事事都依赖你们。
translation: Liu Mengli: Mother, it's alright. I know Father means well. But you've worried too much over the years; I can't rely on you for everything anymore.

original_text: 柳世封：璃儿，你尽管、尽管依赖爹！
translation: Liu Shifeng: Lili, you can rely on me, rely on your father completely!

original_text: 阮慈：老爷，我们就少说两句吧，这样讲下去，可要耽搁他们的时间了。
translation: Ruan Ci: My lord, let's speak less. Continuing like this will delay their time.

original_text: 柳梦璃：爹、娘，你们毋须挂心，我又不是永远不回来了。
translation: Liu Mengli: Father, Mother, don't worry. It's not like I'm never coming back.

original_text: 柳梦璃：看，这是离香草制成的香囊，我把它带在身边，传说它会离家越远、香气越浓，女儿终有一日也会回到你们身边……
translation: Liu Mengli: Look, this sachet is made from Parting Herb. I carry it with me. Legend says the farther from home, the stronger its scent, and a daughter will one day return to her parents...

original_text: 柳世封：呜～璃儿……
translation: Liu Shifeng: Waa~ Lili...

original_text: 柳梦璃：爹，还有一事须记得，我留下的香足够今年进贡了，何况禄珠、禄蓉也手艺渐好，制香之事不必担心，只不过半年之内不可再采摘离香草，无论如何采摘过度都是有害而无益……
translation: Liu Mengli: Father, one more thing to remember: the incense I left is enough for this year's tribute. Besides, Luzhu and Lurong's skills are improving, so incense-making isn't a concern. However, do not harvest Parting Herb for the next six months-over-harvesting is harmful and offers no benefit...

original_text: 柳世封：璃儿你放心，爹已经让人贴出告示，裴剑自会管好此事。
translation: Liu Shifeng: Lili, don't worry. Father has already had notices posted, Pei Jian will handle this matter properly.

original_text: 阮慈：璃儿，还有天河、韩姑娘，你们几个事事都要小心，保重身体。
translation: Ruan Ci: Lili, and Tianhe, Miss Han, you all must be careful in everything and take good care of yourselves.

original_text: 云天河：呵呵，柳波波、柳波母，等我学会乘剑在天上飞之后，再来找你们玩～
translation: Yun Tianhe: Hehe, Ankle Liu, Ant Liu, after I learn to ride swords and fly in the sky, I'll come play with you again~

original_text: 韩菱纱：（唉，臭美吧你～）
translation: Han Lingsha: (Sigh, you're so vain~)

original_text: 裴剑：云公子。
translation: Pei Jian: Yun.

original_text: 裴剑：裴剑斗胆说一句，我家小姐从未出过远门，请好好照顾她。
translation: Pei Jian: I dare say, my lady has never traveled far. Please take good care of her.

original_text: 云天河：哈、哈哈哈，包在我身上，我一定、一定不让别人欺负她！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Ha, haha, leave it to me. I definitely, definitely won't let anyone bully her!

original_text: 柳梦璃：……
translation: Liu Mengli: ...

original_text: 韩菱纱：（瞎说……连自己都顾不好，还要顾别人？）
translation: Han Lingsha: (Nonsense... Can't even take care of yourself, and you want to care for others?)

original_text: 韩菱纱：县令大人放宽心吧。
translation: Han Lingsha: Magistrate, set your mind at ease.

original_text: 韩菱纱：就算别的不行，江湖规矩我可是懂不少，梦璃跟着我不会有事的。
translation: Han Lingsha: Even if I'm not good at other things, I know a lot about the ways of the jianghu. Mengli will be fine with me.

original_text: 韩菱纱：我们走了，嘻嘻！
translation: Han Lingsha: We're leaving, hehe!

original_text: 柳梦璃：爹、娘、裴大哥，保重……
translation: Liu Mengli: Father, mother, Brother Pei, take care...

original_text: 柳世封：……哈哈，夫人你看，璃儿到底还是喜欢天河，这回我绝非乱点鸳鸯。
translation: Liu Shifeng: ...Haha, dear, look, Lili really does like Tianhe. This time, I'm definitely not mismatching them.

original_text: 阮慈：哦？老爷又怎知道的？
translation: Ruan Ci: Oh? How do you know that?

original_text: 柳世封：她、璃儿不是还送了把弓给天河？除了你我和裴剑，几时见她为旁人这般费心？
translation: Liu Shifeng: She... Lili even gave a bow to Tianhe. Aside from you, me, and Pei Jian, when has she ever gone to such lengths for anyone else?

original_text: 阮慈：倘若他们彼此有意，自然是好，只是这种事情谁也说不准，璃儿做事向来有主见，想要如何就随她去吧。
translation: Ruan Ci: If they have feelings for each other, that's good. But such things are uncertain. Lili has always been decisive; let her do as she wishes.

original_text: 柳世封：唉，女儿养这么大，最后还是别人的……
translation: Liu Shifeng: Ah, raising a daughter all these years, only for her to become someone else's in the end...

original_text: 阮慈：老爷说什么呢～璃儿也还没嫁掉。
translation: Ruan Ci: What are you saying, my lord~ Lili isn't married off yet.

original_text: 柳世封：……想到她以前小小的，一晃眼就这般亭亭玉立，却终究也要喜欢上别人，我、我这心里……
translation: Liu Shifeng: ...Thinking of how small she used to be, and now she's grown so graceful, yet she'll eventually fall for someone else, my heart...

original_text: 阮慈：我说老爷啊～雏鸟离巢本是天经地义，儿女养大了，总有一天要离家的。至少……还有我陪着老爷，就算有朝一日老爷的头发牙齿都掉光了，我们两个在一起，总也是有个伴。
translation: Ruan Ci: I say, my lord... It's only natural for fledglings to leave the nest. Once children are grown, they must leave home someday. At least... I'm still here with you, my lord. Even if one day your hair and teeth all fall out, the two of us together will always have each other.

original_text: 柳世封：夫人……
translation: Liu Shifeng: My wife...

original_text: 阮慈：哎，何况裴剑也算你的半子，女儿虽走，儿子总还在吧～
translation: Ruan Ci: Ah, besides, Pei Jian can be considered like a son to you. Even though your daughter has left home, your son is still here, right?~

original_text: 柳世封：没错没错，看我老糊涂的！
translation: Liu Shifeng: Right, right, look at my old muddled head!

original_text: 柳世封：来来来，今天你就陪我多喝两杯，我们来个不醉不归！
translation: Liu Shifeng: Come, come, today you'll drink a few more cups with me. We won't stop until we're drunk!

original_text: 裴剑：是，老爷。
translation: Pei Jian: Yes, my lord.

original_text: 柳世封：你啊……什么都好，就是太一本正经又太闷，不是说私底下不用喊我“老爷”嘛……
translation: Liu Shifeng: You... are good in every way, just too serious and dull. Didn't I say you don't have to call me 'my lord' in private...

original_text: 柳世封：你啊……唉，不说了，喝酒去～
translation: Liu Shifeng: You... ah, never mind, let's go drink~

original_text: 裴剑：小姐……你多保重……
translation: Pei Jian: My lady... take good care of yourself...

original_text: 柳梦璃：菱纱，你适才说不走官道，是有其他办法去陈州吗？
translation: Liu Mengli: Lingsha, you just said not to take the official road. Do you have another way to get to Chenzhou?

original_text: 韩菱纱：那当然！韩女侠自有妙计！
translation: Han Lingsha: Of course! Heroine Han has her own clever plans!

original_text: 韩菱纱：（哼哼，我～偏～不～说～了，想知道就来问呐！）
translation: Han Lingsha: (Hmph, I~ won't~ say~, if you want to know, come ask!)

original_text: 韩菱纱：（…………一个只管笑，一个呆若木鸡，你们、你们都没有好奇心的吗？！）
translation: Han Lingsha: (...One just keeps laughing, the other's dumbstruck. Don't, don't either of you have any curiosity?!)

original_text: 云天河：……菱纱，你是不是想拉肚子？脸色这么难看……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... Lingsha, do you need to use the bathroom? You look so pale...

original_text: 韩菱纱：不、要、你、管！我正要说下去呢！
translation: Han Lingsha: None~ of~ your~ business! I was just about to continue!

original_text: 韩菱纱：咳、咳咳，其实我早想好了，<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>我们这次取道淮南王陵地宫，</colour><dc0>顺利的话，要不了多久就能到陈州附近的碗丘山，比起走官道，那是大大的省事了。</dc0>
translation: Han Lingsha: *cough* Actually, I've already planned it: we'll take the route through Huainan King's Tomb. If all goes well, we'll reach Bowl Hill near Chenzhou soon-much faster than official road.

original_text: 柳梦璃：淮南王陵？！
translation: Liu Mengli: Huainan King's Tomb?!

original_text: 柳梦璃：可是……贸然进入那里，有违法令，怕是不好，何况你的通缉告示才撤下没多久……
translation: Liu Mengli: But... Entering there rashly violates the law and is inadvisable, especially since your wanted notice was only recently removed...

original_text: 韩菱纱：不用怕啦～凡事都有变通嘛，我们此去又不是搜刮宝器，不过是借人家的地盘当一下过道，堂堂一个王爷，不至于这么小气吧？
translation: Han Lingsha: Don't worry~ There's always a way around things. We're not going there to plunder treasures, just borrowing their place as a passage. A king of such stature wouldn't be that stingy, right?

original_text: 柳梦璃：……嗯，既然你都有打算，就按你说的。
translation: Liu Mengli: ... Well, since you already have plans, let's proceed as you say.

original_text: 云天河：走那个什么陵，就能遇上剑仙？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Taking that... what tomb, we'll meet a sword immortal?

original_text: 韩菱纱：当然不是！御剑之术瞬忽万里，哪里是这样便能追上？如今也只好碰碰运气，盼怀朔他们在陈州多逗留几天了。
translation: Han Lingsha: Of course not! Sword flight covers thousands of miles in an instant-how could we catch up like this? Now we can only rely on luck, hoping Huaishuo will linger in Chenzhou a few more days.

original_text: 韩菱纱：别担心！就算错过他们，天下之大，我就不信没有别的法子找到那个门派的线索！
translation: Han Lingsha: Don't worry! Even if we miss them, the world is vast. I refuse to believe there's no other way to find clues about that sect!

original_text: 柳梦璃：嗯，天无绝人之路的，我也帮忙一起找。
translation: Liu Mengli: Well, heaven never seals off all exits. I'll help search together.

original_text: 云天河：一起？好、好啊，一起找，呵呵～
translation: Yun Tianhe: Together? Okay, okay, let's search together, hehe~

original_text: 韩菱纱：……梦璃，我们走！别理那个傻笑的家伙！
translation: Han Lingsha: ... Mengli, let's go! Ignore that grinning fool!

original_text: 云天河：啊！你们、等等我啊！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Ah! You two, wait for me!

original_text: 云天河：（……梦璃她、她说要教我认字呢，呵呵～～）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (...Mengli said... she said she'd teach me to read, hehe~~)

original_text: 云天河：（自从下了山，好多人说的话我都不懂……要是多念点书，是不是就能弄懂很多事？……也就能明白菱纱为什么会变来变去了…………）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (Since coming down the mountain, I haven't understood many things people say... If I studied more, would I understand many things?... And understand why Lingsha keeps changing...)

original_text: 云天河：（想睡了……唔…………烤全猪…………）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (Getting sleepy... hmm... roast whole pig...)

original_text: 禄珠：……公子，您起身了吗？
translation: Luzhu: ...Sir, have you risen?

original_text: 云天河：唔……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Hmm...

original_text: 云天河：（睏～～被吵醒……这女孩的脚步声真沉，不像菱纱，几乎没啥声息……）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (Sleepy~~ Woken up... This girl's footsteps are really heavy, not like Lingsha, who barely makes a sound...)

original_text: 禄珠：云公子，小姐猜您大概不喜欢让人服侍，所以请您打理妥当后，<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>就去柳府大门口准备起程了～</colour>
translation: Luzhu: Yun, my lady guessed you might not care for attendants, so she asks that once you're ready,<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> please head to the main gate of the Liu Mansion to prepare for departure~</colour>

original_text: 云天河：哦……知道了。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Oh... Understood.

original_text: 云天河：菱纱说要在客栈门口等她，不要去别的地方。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Lingsha said to wait for her at the inn entrance, don't go anywhere else.

original_text: 赵孟坚：县令大人的府邸，不可随意入内！
translation: Zhao Mengjian: The County Magistrate's mansion, you cannot enter freely!

original_text: 赵孟坚：柳大人现下不在府中，云公子若是要拜会柳大人，还请改日再来。
translation: Zhao Mengjian: Lord Liu is not at the mansion at the moment. If Yun wishes to visit Lord Liu, please come another day.
1.Yes
2.No

original_text: 是否要<colour red=255 green=102 blue=0 alpha=255>休息</colour><dc0>一下？</dc0>
translation: Do you want to <colour red=255 green=102 blue=0 alpha=255>rest</colour><dc0> for a while?</dc0>

original_text: 人物<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>精</colour><dc0>、</dc0><colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>神</colour><dc0>回复满值</dc0>
translation: Character's <colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>HP</colour><dc0> and </dc0><colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>MP</colour><dc0> fully restored</dc0>

original_text: ？？：喂！我说周老板，客栈里的酒全都被人订下了，这话是你诓人的吧？刚才问你儿子，他可全都说了。
translation: ??: Hey! I say, Boss Zhou, the claim that all the wine in the inn has been reserved-is that a lie? I just asked your son, and he told me everything.

original_text: 周金福：小同你这孩子！怎么随便乱讲话！
translation: Zhou Jinfu: Xiaotong, you child! How can you speak so carelessly!

original_text: 周小同：哼，我才没乱讲，明明是爹爹骗人……
translation: Zhou Xiaotong: Hmph, I'm not talking nonsense, it's clearly Dad who lied...

original_text: 周金福：你……
translation: Zhou Jinfu: You...

original_text: 周金福：大姐～您瞧瞧，今天能不能暂且放过本店算了？您十次有九次都是赊帐，酒量又大，我这小本生意，怎么经得起啊——
translation: Zhou Jinfu: Big sister~ Please, can you let our shop off just for today? Nine out of ten times you drink on credit, and your capacity is huge. How can my small business withstand this-

original_text: ？？：哎！大男人一个，婆婆妈妈做什么，不就是一点酒水吗？！
translation: ??: Hey! A big man like you, why so fussy? It's just a little wine!

original_text: ？？：我可不白喝你的酒！小同一直想要个木头老鼠，我做给他就是了，快快快，去帮我打二十壶酒来～
translation: ??: I won't drink your wine for free! Xiaotong has always wanted a wooden mouse. I'll make one for him. Hurry, hurry, go help me fetch twenty jugs of wine~

original_text: 周小同：会动的木头老鼠～～
translation: Zhou Xiaotong: A moving wooden mouse~~

original_text: 周小同：爹爹，我想要那个嘛！
translation: Zhou Xiaotong: Daddy, I want that one!

original_text: 周金福：去去去！今早先生教你的功课做好了没？没做好就给我回后院去！
translation: Zhou Jinfu: Go away! Have you finished the homework the teacher assigned you this morning? If not, go back to the backyard!

original_text: 周小同：……讨厌，爹爹是坏人！
translation: Zhou Xiaotong: ...Annoying, daddy is a bad person!

original_text: ？？：周老板你这样可不好，总让小孩子念书，小心他长大变书呆～
translation: ???: Boss Zhou, that's not good, always making the kid study, be careful he grows up to be a nerd~

original_text: 周金福：唉，大姐您饶了我吧，说白了，那木头老鼠要再多有什么用，又不能养家糊口，您、您不还是让我为难吗？
translation: Zhou Jinfu: Ah, elder sister, please spare me. To put it bluntly, what's the use of having more of those wooden mice? They can't support a family. You... you're still making things difficult for me.

original_text: ？？：好啦好啦，真是扫兴，看你一副苦脸，不知情的还以为我逼你做啥……这里的酒喝不成，<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>我改天去陈州喝，</colour><dc0>哼！</dc0>
translation: ??: Alright, alright, how disappointing. Looking at your bitter face, anyone would think I'm forcing you to do something... Can't drink the wine here,<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> I'll go to Chenzhou another day to drink,</colour><dc0> hmph!</dc0>

original_text: 周金福：天呐……这难缠的大姐，到底什么时候才会离开寿阳……
translation: Zhou Jinfu: Heavens... This troublesome lady, when will she ever leave Shouyang...

original_text: 慕容紫英：……刚才那人，莫非是夙莘师叔？
translation: Murong Ziying: That person just now, could it be Master-Anut Sushen?

original_text: 云天河：紫英，你认识那个女的？能不能帮我找她要个会动的木头老鼠啊？听起来很好玩的样子～
translation: Yun Tianhe: Ziying, you know that woman? Can you help me ask her for a moving wooden mouse? Sounds really fun~

original_text: 刘卫平：此地乃寿州州治寿阳城，现由柳世封柳大人所管！
translation: Liu Weiping: This place is Shouyang City, the seat of Shouzhou, currently governed by Lord Liu Shifeng!

original_text: 刘卫平：奇怪，“年内都不可再采离香草”……柳大人颁的告示，也不知是怎么回事……
translation: Liu Weiping: Strange, 'No picking of Parting Herb within the year'... Lord Liu issued the notice. Wonder what's going on...

original_text: 刘卫平：这段时间柳大人有事去了京城，现下寿阳的大小事务都由裴护卫管着。
translation: Liu Weiping: During this time, Lord Liu has gone to the capital on business, so all matters in Shouyang are currently managed by Guard Pei.

original_text: 刘卫平：前些日子听说巢湖底下有妖怪，城里的渔民都不去捕鱼了，最近才终于明白是湖里漩涡惹的祸，根本就没妖怪嘛！
translation: Liu Weiping: A while ago, I heard there were monsters at the bottom of Chao Lake, so the fishermen in the city stopped fishing. Only recently did we finally realize it was the whirlpools in the lake causing trouble-there were no monsters at all!

original_text: 谭婆：唉，我的腰啊……前几天上山采离香草，被山里的妖怪盯上，吓得我拼命跑，结果把这老骨头给闪着了……
translation: Granny Tan: Ah, my back... Days ago picking Parting Herb on the mountain, a demon spotted me. I ran desperately in fright and strained this old bone...

original_text: 谭婆：真是作孽啊！听说又有人被妖怪咬了……那妖怪这么厉害，连柳大人都没办法，我们以后可怎么办啊？
translation: Granny Tan: What a calamity! I heard more people have been bitten by monsters... That monster is so powerful, even Lord Liu can't handle it. What are we going to do from now on?

original_text: 谭婆：前阵子山上有妖怪，衙门也不见动静，如今妖怪被剑仙除去了，柳大人反倒不让大伙上山采离香草，这……
translation: Granny Tan: Earlier there were demons on the mountain, yet the authorities did nothing. Now that sword immortals removed them, Lord Liu forbids picking Parting Herb... This...

original_text: 谭婆：听说现在山上真没妖怪了，不过我也年纪大了，自从上回闪了腰，就很少再出门啰……
translation: Granny Tan: I hear there really are no monsters on the mountain now, but I'm old. Since I strained my back last time, I rarely go out anymore...

original_text: 谭婆：听说了吗？前段时间失踪的渔民不是被妖怪害的，而是被湖里漩涡卷走了！我说呢，这好端端的，哪里会有那么多妖怪……
translation: Granny Tan: Have you heard? The fishermen who went missing recently weren't killed by monsters, but were swept away by whirlpools in the lake! I thought so, how could there suddenly be so many monsters...

original_text: 刘小侠：爹爹一心想让我成为剑仙那样的大侠，所以给我取名叫刘小侠，可我只喜欢养鸭。嘎嘎嘎～多可爱啊，只要给它们一些糠，它们就会好开心～
translation: Liu Xiaoxia: My father wants me to become a great hero like a sword immortal, so he named me Liu Xiaoxia. But I only like raising ducks. Quack quack~ So adorable. Just give them some bran, and they'll be so happy~

original_text: 刘小侠：嘘～告诉你个秘密，县令家的柳姐姐其实是仙女哦！
translation: Liu Xiaoxia: Shh~ A secret: the magistrate's daughter, Sister Liu, is actually a fairy!

original_text: 刘小侠：……我好久都没看见柳姐姐了，她到底去了哪里呢……小侠想她……
translation: Liu Xiaoxia: ...I haven't seen Sister Liu for so long. Where did she go... Xiaoxia misses her...

original_text: 刘二嫂：你看见我家小侠了吗？是不是又到院子里数鸭子去了？唉！这样怎么会有出息呢！
translation: Auntie Liu: Have you seen my little Xia? Did he go count ducks in the yard again? Sigh! How will he ever amount to anything like this!

original_text: 刘二嫂：说也奇了，自从我家搬到寿阳后，我那夜里失眠做恶梦的毛病就再也没犯过，每天晚上都睡得很舒坦。
translation: Auntie Liu: It's strange to say, ever since my family moved to Shouyang, my insomnia and nightmare problems at night have never recurred. I sleep very comfortably every night.

original_text: 刘二嫂：今天一大早，我看见那张缉拿盗墓贼的告示不见了？难道那贼已经被捉住了？
translation: Auntie Liu: Early this morning, I saw that wanted poster for tomb robbers gone. Could the thief have been caught already?

original_text: 刘二嫂：山上的妖怪真的没了？我心里总还是觉得不踏实……
translation: Auntie Liu: The mountain monsters are really gone? I still feel uneasy inside...

original_text: 刘二嫂：原本听说巢湖里有妖怪害人，现在又说那是水里的漩涡，根本不是妖怪。这到底是怎么一回事啊？
translation: Auntie Liu: First, I heard there were monsters in Chao Lake harming people. Now they say it's just whirlpools in the water, not monsters at all. What in the world is going on?

original_text: 李山：干炒蒿子，肉丝辣面、糖醋银鱼，还有淮王鱼和八公山豆腐，客官您可都要来点？
translation: Li Shan: Stir-fried artemisia, spicy shredded pork noodles, sweet and sour silverfish, plus Huaiwang fish and Bagongshan tofu-would you like to try them all, sir?

original_text: 李山：淮王鱼其实就是打鱼人常说的“江团”，当年淮南王刘安最喜欢吃这鱼，后来我们寿阳人就改叫这鱼作“淮王鱼”。
translation: Li Shan: 'Huaiwang Fish' is actually what fishermen call 'Jiangtuan'. Liu An, the Huainan King, loved this fish, so we Shouyang folks later renamed it 'Huaiwang Fish'.

original_text: 李山：咦？你不就是那天在客栈外头被裴护卫请走的人吗？看不出你小小年纪，竟然能结识柳大人。
translation: Li Shan: Huh? Aren't you the person taken away by Guard Pei outside the inn the other day? I didn't expect someone so young to know Lord Liu.

original_text: 李山：客栈门前的缉拿告示撤下来了，看来那女贼已经被擒啦！
translation: Li Shan: The arrest notice in front of the inn is gone. Looks like that female thief has been caught!

original_text: 李山：昨天夜里我睡得不太好，还被一个恶梦给吓醒了！已经十几年没做恶梦，昨天的那个梦，八成不是好兆头……
translation: Li Shan: I didn't sleep well last night and was even startled awake by a nightmare! I haven't had nightmares for over a decade, so last night's dream is probably a bad omen...

original_text: 李山：连太平村的茶叶也进了京，还卖得特别好？就他们那种穷地方出的茶叶，怎么能和我们寿阳的贡品“宁香”相提并论呢？
translation: Li Shan: Even Taiping Village's tea has reached the capital and sells exceptionally well? How can their tea from such a poor place compare to our Shouyang's tribute tea 'Ningxiang'?

original_text: 杨铮：唉！虽说我以云游四海为志，但到底离家三年，也不知道家中父母兄妹都如何了？
translation: Yang Zheng: Sigh! Though I aspire to wander the world, it's been three years since I left home. I wonder how my parents and siblings are doing?

original_text: 张严钧：杨兄，我和你不同～家中没有父母弟妹，倒没什么可牵挂。
translation: Zhang Yanjun: Brother Yang, I'm different from you~ I have no parents or siblings at home, nothing much to worry about.

original_text: 杨铮：我也是来了此地，听说附近山上长着一种叫离香草的东西，离香草、离乡草，唉，这才伤感起来……
translation: Yang Zheng: I also came here and heard that a plant called Parting Herb grows on the nearby mountains. Parting Herb, 'parting from home'... sigh, that's what makes me sentimental...

original_text: 杨铮：那日在客栈门口被逮住的人，真是那个盗墓贼？怎么可能是个女娃儿？
translation: Yang Zheng: Was the person caught at the inn entrance that day really the tomb robber? How could it be a young girl?

original_text: 杨铮：没想到那八公山女萝岩上的妖怪被剑仙给除了，否则我还想上山探一探，看看到底是什么样的妖在作怪！
translation: Yang Zheng: I never thought the demons on Bagong Mountain's Nvluo Rock would be eliminated by sword immortals. Otherwise, I'd have gone up to investigate what kind of demons were there!

original_text: 杨铮：近日我便要起程回家一趟，也是该探望探望父母了。
translation: Yang Zheng: I'll be setting off home soon. It's time to visit my parents.

original_text: 张严钧：我和杨兄本想结伴去巢湖看看，没想到杨兄却借酒浇愁起来，看来巢湖之游，只能再等几天了。
translation: Zhang Yanjun: Brother Yang and I planned to visit Chao Lake together, but he started drowning his sorrows in drink. Looks like the trip will have to wait a few more days.

original_text: 张严钧：寿阳城东有淝水古战场，西有廉颇墓，北有八公山淮南王陵，南有古刘备城，每个地方都是我想去看的，若要全都游历一番，至少也要在这里住上一、两个月吧。
translation: Zhang Yanjun: Shouyang has the ancient Fei River battlefield to the east, Lian Po's tomb to the west, Mount. Bagong and Huainan King's mausoleum to the north, and ancient Liu Bei's city to the south. I want to visit them all-it'd take at least a month or two to tour everything.

original_text: 张严钧：我和杨兄初来此地时就听闻女萝岩闹妖怪，原本也打算前去一探，只是那段日子杨兄心情不好，才将此事搁下了。
translation: Zhang Yanjun: When Brother Yang and I first came here, we heard there were monsters in Nvluo Rock. We originally planned to go investigate, but Brother Yang was in a bad mood during that time, so we put it aside.

original_text: 张严钧：寿阳附近的巢湖、八公山、淝水古战场这些地方，我们已经全都游历过了，看杨兄思家心切的样子，再过几日就起程陪他回一趟宾化吧。
translation: Zhang Yanjun: We've already toured all the places around Shouyang like Chao Lake, Bagong Mountain, and the ancient Fei River battlefield. Seeing Brother Yang so homesick, we'll set off in a few days to accompany him back to Binhu.

original_text: 来顺：我可是寿阳城里出了名的包打听！凡是城里的事，只要你想知道，我都能帮你打听来！当然啦，这银子可不能少～
translation: Lai Shun: I'm Shouyang City's famous information broker! Anything happening in the city, if you want to know, I can find out for you! Of course, proper payment is required~

original_text: 来顺：嘿嘿，那天在客栈门口被裴护卫带走的那位少侠，其实是柳大人的远房亲戚，这回到咱们寿阳城，是来迎娶柳大小姐的！
translation: Lai Shun: Hehe, that young master taken away by Guard Pei at the inn gate the other day is actually a distant relative of Lord Liu. He came to our Shouyang City this time to marry Miss Liu!

original_text: 来顺：告诉你！剑仙之所以会帮咱们除去女萝岩上的妖怪，那都是因为柳大人的关系！柳大人的千金是仙女，柳大人当然有办法请剑仙来除妖啦！
translation: Lai Shun: Let me tell you! The reason sword immortals helped us eliminate the yaoguais on Nvluo Rock is all because of Lord Liu! Lord Liu's daughter is a fairy, so of course Lord Liu can ask sword immortals to exterminate the yaoguais!

original_text: 来顺：其实我早就知道巢湖底下没妖怪，可那些渔民硬是不信，现在知道了吧？那只是湖心的漩涡，跟妖怪扯不上半点关系。
translation: Lai Shun: I've long known there are no demons under Chao Lake, but the fishermen wouldn't believe it. Now they see-it's just a whirlpool, nothing to do with yaoguais or fiends.

original_text: 刘平：县令柳大人家的小姐不仅是咱寿阳的第一大美人，还是百姓的第一大恩人！要不是柳小姐教城里人制香的法子，咱寿阳人哪能过上现在这等好日子？
translation: Liu Ping: The magistrate Lord Liu's daughter is not only the greatest beauty in Shouyang but also the greatest benefactor to the people! If it weren't for Miss Liu teaching the city's residents how to make incense, how could we people of Shouyang live such a good life as we do now?

original_text: 刘平：你可别小看这家不起眼的铁泽居，听说连剑仙都来请刘师父给他打造宝剑呢！
translation: Liu Ping: Don't underestimate this unassuming Tieze Residence. I've heard even a Sword Immortal came to ask Master Liu to forge a precious sword for him!

original_text: 刘平：缉拿告示撤下来了，这么说盗墓贼已经被抓了吧？但又没听到衙门里有多大动静，真是奇怪……
translation: Liu Ping: The arrest notice has been taken down, so the tomb robbers must have been caught, right? But there hasn't been much commotion at the yamen. It's strange...

original_text: 刘平：那天我看见县令和夫人坐着马车出了城，还带着家丁丫鬟，一定是去办什么重要的事。
translation: Liu Ping: That day I saw the county magistrate and his wife leave the city in a carriage, with servants and maids in tow. They must be off to handle some important matter.

original_text: 刘平：现在太平村那个穷地方的茶叶也进了京，还卖得不错，不过比咱们寿阳的宁香还差一截～
translation: Liu Ping: Now even the tea from that poor place Taiping Village has reached the capital and sells quite well, but it's still a notch below our Shouyang's 'Ningxiang'~

original_text: 周小珊：阿娘说，自从柳大人来了寿阳，日子就越来越好，柳大人一定是神仙派来帮我们的！
translation: Zhou Xiaoshan: Mother says ever since Lord Liu came to Shouyang, life has gotten better and better. Lord Liu must have been sent by the immortals to help us!

original_text: 周小珊：离香草制的香叫“宁香”，晚上睡不着的时候就在香炉里放上一点，一会就能睡着了～
translation: Zhou Xiaoshan: The incense made from Parting Herb is called 'Ningxiang'. When you can't sleep at night, just put a little in the incense burner, and you'll fall asleep soon~

original_text: 周小珊：八公山上的妖怪被剑仙赶跑了～我和毛毛又可以去山上玩了～
translation: Zhou Xiaoshan: The monsters on Bagong Mountain were driven away by the sword immortals~ Mao Mao and I can go play on the mountain again~

original_text: 周小珊：听匡大叔说，京城里好多人都喜欢我们的宁香，可为什么阿娘现在都不太上山采香草了呢……
translation: Zhou Xiaoshan: Uncle Kuang says many people in the capital love our Ningxiang. But why doesn't Mother go up the mountain to gather herbs much anymore...

original_text: 秋荻：呵呵，我相公三天不吃这里的粉折就难受，真拿他没办法。
translation: Qiu Di: Hehe, my husband can't go three days without eating the rice noodles here, I really can't do anything with him.

original_text: 粉折张：哈哈哈，这也没什么，柳大人家的夫人也喜欢吃粉折，常派丫鬟来买呢！
translation: Noodles Zhang: Hahaha, it's nothing really. Lord Liu's wife also loves wide rice noodles and often sends her maid to buy some!

original_text: 秋荻：寿阳粉折是用绿豆混着麦粉和佐料在锅上烙出来的，其实我自己也能做。只是小张这儿的粉折得了城外真武庙里和尚大师父的真传，我自己可烙不出这味道～
translation: Qiu Di: Shouyang wide rice noodles is made by mixing mung bean flour with wheat flour and seasonings, then pan-frying it. Actually, I can make it myself. It's just that Little Zhang's wide rice noodles here has been passed down from the master monk at the Zhenwu Temple outside the city. I can't quite replicate that flavor myself~

original_text: 秋荻：一听说山上的妖怪已经被除去了，我相公就高兴得不得了，一定要我上市集来多买些小菜，说是要庆贺！
translation: Qiu Di: As soon as my husband heard the monsters on the mountain had been eliminated, he was overjoyed and insisted I come to the market to buy more dishes, saying we must celebrate!

original_text: 秋荻：全寿阳城卖粉折的摊子倒也不只这一家，但我相公只爱吃这家的粉折，我也拿他没办法。
translation: Qiu Di: There's more than one stall selling wide rice noodles in all of Shouyang City, but my husband only likes this stall's wide rice noodles. What can I do?

original_text: 粉折张：我这做粉折的手艺是跟城外真武庙的和尚学的，连县令夫人也爱吃得不得了！
translation: Noodles Zhang: I learned my wide rice noodles making skills from a monk at the Zhenwu Temple outside the city; even the county magistrate's wife loves eating it!

original_text: 粉折张：山上妖怪没了是好事，至于能不能上山采草嘛，就跟我没多大关系了。我张家世代卖粉折，我也不必靠什么离香草过活。
translation: Noodles Zhang: It's a good thing the mountain monsters are gone. As for whether we can go up the mountain to pick herbs, that's not really my concern. My Zhang family has sold wide rice noodles for generations, I don't need to rely on any Parting Herb to make a living.

original_text: 粉折张：你……你就是上次来寿阳，住在柳家的小伙子吧？你小子真不赖，几天不见，现在穿得跟什么似的，害我差点就认不出来啦！
translation: Noodles Zhang: You... you're that young man who stayed with the Lius in Shouyang last time, right? You're something else-after just a few days, you're dressed so finely I almost didn't recognize you!

original_text: 粉折张：今年是不能采离香草了，不过我看大伙的日子也没比从前差，至少我这小摊的生意还是不错～
translation: Noodles Zhang: We can't pick Parting Herb this year, but I see everyone's lives aren't worse than before. At least the business at my little stall is still good~

original_text: 豆腐西施：人家这豆腐是用寿阳城外的珍珠泉水磨的，买些回去煮汤喝，一定比别处的豆腐都鲜美～
translation: Tofu Beauty: My tofu is ground with the Pearl Spring water from outside Shouyang City. Buy some to make soup, it'll definitely be more delicious than tofu from anywhere else~

original_text: 豆腐西施：做豆腐的方子相传是淮南王留下来的，所以寿阳的豆腐，也叫八公山豆腐～
translation: Tofu Beauty: The recipe for making tofu is said to have been passed down from the King of Huainan, so tofu in Shouyang is also called Bagong Mountain Tofu~

original_text: 豆腐西施：城里虽然太平，但外面的世道如何，人家是半点也不晓得的～人家只管做豆腐赚钱，已经很辛苦了～
translation: Tofu Beauty: The city may be peaceful, but I know nothing of the outside world. I just focus on making tofu for money-it's already hard enough.

original_text: 沈仕途：我自问我的文治武功都不比柳世封差，若这寿阳城让我来治理，一定比他管得好！可叹这世道不是唯才是用……
translation: Shen Shitu: I consider my civil administration and martial prowess no worse than Liu Shifeng's. If I were to govern Shouyang City, I'd surely manage it better than he does! Alas, this world does not employ based solely on talent...

original_text: 沈仕途：柳世封的事儿还真多，说要采这离香草的是他，说不要再采的，又是他～这样的父母官，竟然还有那么多老百姓喜欢，真让我想不明白。
translation: Shen Shitu: Liu Shifeng has so many whims. He's the one who wanted to pick this Parting Herb, and now he's the one saying to stop. Such a local official, yet so many commoners like him-I really don't understand.

original_text: 沈仕途：沈家现在就指望状元那孩子能好好念书，将来考个状元！
translation: Shen Shitu: The Shen family now pins its hopes on that child Zhuangyuan studying hard and passing the top exam in the future!

original_text: 沈状元：爷爷总说他当官能当得比柳大人好，我看这世上才没有比柳大人更好的官呢～
translation: Shen Zhuangyuan: Grandpa always says he could be a better official than Lord Liu, but I think there's no better official in the world than Lord Liu~

original_text: 沈状元：爷爷经常在屋子里叹气，好像是因为一直没考上状元……其实爷爷可以去找柳大人帮忙，有什么事情是柳大人做不到的呢？
translation: Shen Zhuangyuan: Grandpa often sighs in his room, probably because he never passed the imperial exams... Actually, Grandpa could ask Lord Liu for help. Is there anything Lord Liu can't do?

original_text: 沈状元：我的名字是爷爷取的，听爹说，是因为爷爷太想我长大能中状元了～
translation: Shen Zhuangyuan: My name was given by my grandfather. Father said it's because Grandpa really wanted me to become the top scholar when I grew up~

original_text: 莲琪：离香草是我们寿阳才有的东西，游子带在身上，离故乡越远，香气就会越浓。哥哥，你的故乡在哪里呢？
translation: Lianqi: Parting Herb is something only we in Shouyang have. Travelers carry it, and the farther from home, the stronger its scent. Brother, where is your hometown?

original_text: 莲琪：吴叔叔总说他卖的月牙蹄味道好，可我只喜欢张叔叔的粉折，粉折下到娘调的汤里面，味道比什么都好！
translation: Lianqi: Uncle Wu always says his crescent hoof tastes good, but I only like Uncle Zhang's wide rice noodles. Those noodles cooked in my mother's soup taste better than anything!

original_text: 莲琪：山上的妖怪已经被剑仙除去了，柳县令却发了告示让大家别去采香草，我不明白这是为什么……
translation: Lianqi: The monsters on the mountain have been eliminated by the sword immortals, but Magistrate Liu issued a notice telling everyone not to pick Parting Herbs. I don't understand why...

original_text: 莲琪：巢湖另一边的太平村出产一种临睦茶，都已经卖到京里去了……真想尝尝那茶什么味道！
translation: Lianqi: Taiping Village on the other side of Chao Lake produces a Linmu tea that's even sold in the capital... I'd really like to taste what that tea is like!

original_text: 童小石：哈哈，你是不是第一次来寿阳？要不要尝尝五香茶干？炒菜好吃、配茶也好吃！
translation: Tong Xiaoshi: Haha, is this your first time in Shouyang? Want to try the five-spice dried tofu? It's great stir-fried or as a tea snack!

original_text: 童小石：吴叔叔做的“金边红心月牙蹄”实在美味，我一天不吃就馋得慌！
translation: Tong Xiaoshi: Uncle Wu's 'Golden-Edged Red-Heart Crescent Hoof' is truly delicious. I crave it if I don't eat it for a day!

original_text: 童小石：柳大人让大家少采离香草，一定有他的道理！反正寿阳好东西多，明年若是没有宁香可贡，把吴叔叔做的月牙蹄送去京里也行嘛！
translation: Tong Xiaoshi: Lord Liu told everyone to pick less Parting Herb; there must be a reason! Anyway, Shouyang has many good things. If there's no Ningxiang to offer as tribute next year, we can send Uncle Wu's Crescent Hoof to the capital!

original_text: 童小石：自从剑仙来八公山除了妖，这寿阳城周围，就再也没人见过妖怪啦！
translation: Tong Xiaoshi: Ever since the sword immortals eliminated the demons at Mount Bagong, no one around Shouyang City has seen demons again!

original_text: 心清：柳县令是城中第一大善人，他不仅令所有寿阳百姓衣食无忧，更是慷慨出资重修这东禅寺。
translation: Xin Qing: Magistrate Liu is the greatest philanthropist in the city. He not only ensures all Shouyang citizens have food and clothing but also generously funded the restoration of this East Zen Temple.

original_text: 心清：阿弥陀佛！善有善报，恶有恶报，山上妖孽为剑仙所铲除，也都是寿阳百姓平日行善积德换来的福报啊。
translation: Xin Qing: Amitabha! Good deeds bring good rewards, evil deeds bring evil retribution. The mountain demons being eradicated by the sword immortals is also the blessed reward earned by the people of Shouyang through their usual good deeds and accumulated virtue.

original_text: 心清：魔由心生、障由心生，巢湖中本无妖孽，是人心自生妖孽；心中魔障既除，湖中妖孽亦自然不见。
translation: Xin Qing: Demons arise from the heart, obstacles arise from the heart. There were no monsters in Chao Lake originally; it was people's hearts that bred them. Once the inner demons are dispelled, the lake's monsters naturally vanish as well.

original_text: 丁巧儿：这如意铺的店名，是街坊邻居一块儿想出来的，大伙都说只要有柳县令在，我们寿阳城的家家户户，年年月月都称心如意！
translation: Ding Qiao'er: The name 'Ruyi Shop' was thought up by the neighbors together. Everyone says that as long as Magistrate Liu is here, every household in Shouyang City will be content and satisfied year after year!

original_text: 丁巧儿：说起来，八公山上的妖怪也闹了好一阵子，我还担心它们会不会闹进城，多亏有剑仙来除妖，现在终于可以放心了。
translation: Ding Qiao'er: Speaking of which, the monsters on Bagong Mountain have been causing trouble for a while. I worried they might enter the city. Thankfully, sword immortals came to exterminate them-now we can finally rest easy.

original_text: 丁巧儿：最近店里的生意越来越好，爹说要多雇几个伙计来帮忙，到时候可就不用像现在这样整天忙个不停啦！
translation: Ding Qiao'er: Business at the shop has been getting better lately. Dad says we need to hire more helpers. Then we won't be as busy nonstop as we are now!

original_text: 宋敏春：我看施家妹子这几天精神很差，该不会是跟她娘一起制香，睡得太少累着了吧？
translation: Song Minchun: I see Sister Shi has been looking very tired lately. Could it be from making incense with her mom, sleeping too little and overworked?

original_text: 宋敏春：施家妹子她爹，昨天傍晚在山上遇到妖怪啦！现在人是回来了，就不知道有没有受伤……
translation: Song Minchun: Miss Shi's father encountered a monster on the mountain yesterday evening! He's back now, but we don't know if he's injured...

original_text: 宋敏春：昨天还说到妖怪害人，今天山上的妖就已经没了，这都要感谢上天开眼啊！
translation: Song Minchun: Yesterday we were talking about monsters harming people, and today the monsters on the mountain are gone. We must thank the heavens for opening their eyes!

original_text: 宋敏春：上次我让施家妹子用檀香提神，没想到她现在用上瘾了，天天都用，整个人都有淡淡的香气～
translation: Song Minchun: Last time I suggested Sister Shi use sandalwood to refresh herself, but now she's addicted, using it every day, and she has a faint fragrance all over~

original_text: 施青青：最近我总觉得精神很糟，昨天走在路上差点睡着，还撞了人，被笑话了好一阵。
translation: Shi Qingqing: Lately, I've been feeling very unwell. Yesterday, I almost fell asleep walking and bumped into someone, getting laughed at for a while.

original_text: 宋敏春：要真是这样，你可以去涵草堂买些檀香，每天在炉子里放一些，听说这法子是柳大人的千金告诉永馨的，永馨又告诉了我～
translation: Song Minchun: If that's really the case, you can buy some sandalwood at Hancao Hall and put a little in the incense burner every day. I heard this method was told to Yongxin by Miss Liu, the magistrate's daughter, and Yongxin told me~

original_text: 施青青：檀香？那东西可不便宜呐……
translation: Shi Qingqing: Sandalwood? That stuff isn't cheap, you know...

original_text: 施青青：涵草堂永家的母女俩，原本不太会制香，都是得了柳小姐指点，如今她们靠自己的手艺，也算是吃穿不愁了。
translation: Shi Qingqing: The mother and daughter of the Yong family at Hancao Hall originally weren't skilled at making incense. They received guidance from Miss Liu, and now they make a decent living from their own craft.

original_text: 施青青：那天爹爹一个人上山采草，傍晚下山的时候就真的遇到妖怪了！要不是他腿脚俐落跑得快，就不只是被咬一口那么简单了！
translation: Shi Qingqing: That day, my father went up the mountain alone to gather herbs and really encountered a monster on his way down at dusk! If he hadn't been quick on his feet, it wouldn't have been just a bite!

original_text: 施青青：这阵子精神不太好，本想听宋大姐的话去买些檀香来用，但爹爹又被妖怪咬伤了，我现在哪还有心思顾上檀香的事啊，只好一直跑药铺给爹爹买药。
translation: Shi Qingqing: I haven't been feeling well lately. I meant to follow Sister Song's advice and buy some sandalwood, but my father got bitten by a monster again. How can I care about sandalwood now? I just keep running to the pharmacy to buy medicine for him.

original_text: 施青青：我们寿阳的宁香是皇上御封的“天下第五香”，就算太平村的茶叶进京了，也别想和宁香比～
translation: Shi Qingqing: Our Shouyang's Ningxiang is the emperor's officially titled 'Fifth Fragrance Under Heaven'. Even if Taiping Village's tea reaches the capital, it can't compare to Ningxiang~

original_text: 赵孟坚：此乃县令大人的府邸，若无拜帖，不能随意入内！
translation: Zhao Mengjian: This is the County Magistrate's mansion. Without an invitation, you cannot enter freely!

original_text: 赵孟坚：常有人听说我家小姐貌美，找尽理由要见上一面，他们也不看看自己的模样，个个都是纨绔子弟，哪里配得上小姐！
translation: Zhao Mengjian: Many hear of my lady's beauty and find every excuse to see her. They don't even look at themselves-all spoiled young masters, utterly unworthy of her!

original_text: 赵孟坚：哎？云公子，你怎么来了？可是要找我家大人？大人和夫人一起进京了，一时半会应该回不来。
translation: Zhao Mengjian: Huh? Yun, what brings you here? Are you looking for my master? The master and madam have gone to the capital together and won't be back for a while.

original_text: 葛大路：哈哈哈～这城里几乎没人见过柳家千金的容貌，说不准是个丑八怪，我今天就要从这儿游进县令府，看看她到底长什么样！
translation: Ge Dalu: Hahaha~ Almost no one in the city has seen the appearance of the Liu family's daughter. Maybe she's an ugly duckling. Today, I'm going to swim into the magistrate's mansion and see what she really looks like!

original_text: 周晨浩：好你个小贼！竟敢在这里偷窥！我要带你回去让柳大人亲自发落！
translation: Zhou Chenhao: You little thief! How dare you peep here! I'm taking you back for Lord Liu to deal with personally!

original_text: 葛大路：糟了！有官差！好汉不吃眼前亏，我闪～
translation: Ge Dalu: Oh no! Constables! A wise man doesn't fight when the odds are against him. I'm outta here~

original_text: 周晨浩：小贼别跑！！
translation: Zhou Chenhao: Stop right there, thief!!

original_text: 永馨：沉香、檀香、龙脑香、麝香是四种最为名贵的香，当今皇上封我们寿阳的香为“天下第五香”，从此“沉檀龙麝”之后，就是“宁香”啦！
translation: Yong Xin: Agarwood, sandalwood, borneol, and musk are the four most precious incenses. The current emperor honored our Shouyang incense as 'the Fifth Incense under Heaven'. So after 'Agarwood, Sandalwood, Borneol, Musk', comes Ningxiang!

original_text: 永馨：店里有些药材都快没了，可山上有妖怪，叫人怎么敢去采药啊？
translation: Yong Xin: Some herbs in the shop are almost gone, but with monsters on the mountain, how dare anyone go gather herbs?

original_text: 永馨：衙门那张告示真的让人摸不着头脑啊……这不能再采离香草，不就做不出“宁香”进贡了吗？
translation: Yong Xin: That notice from the yamen is really puzzling... If we can't gather Parting Herb anymore, how can we make Ningxiang for tribute?

original_text: 永馨：以前梦璃小姐在，还会和我说说制香的法子，如今她不在城里，要我找谁去问啊？
translation: Yong Xin: When Miss Mengli was here, she'd tell me about making incense. Now that she's away, who can I ask?

original_text: 溪莲：离离香草生故乡，临行勿忘备行囊，香气幽幽愿君记，离香散尽是故乡～嘻，莲儿已经会背诗了，很聪明吧？
translation: Xilian: Parting Herbs grow in my hometown, don't forget to pack before leaving. Their subtle scent I hope you'll remember, when the fragrance fades, it's home~ Hehe, Lian'er can already recite poetry, isn't she clever?

original_text: 溪莲：柳家的仙女姐姐离开寿阳好久好久了，到底什么时候才能回来呢？溪莲好想她哦……
translation: Xilian: The fairy sister from the Liu family left Shouyang a very, very long time ago. When will she ever return? Xilian misses her so much...

original_text: 郭正忠：你在此处张望什么？是要伸冤还是要告状？
translation: Guo Zhengzhong: What are you looking around for here? Seeking justice or lodging a complaint?

original_text: 云天河：……啥意思？
translation: Yun Tianhe: ...What do you mean?

original_text: 郭正忠：……都不是的话，就快点离开，衙门乃肃静之地，别在这儿闲逛。
translation: Guo Zhengzhong: ...If not, then leave quickly. The yamen is a place of solemnity. Don't loiter here.

original_text: 郭正忠：柳大人为官清廉，爱民如子，连上天都受到了感动，所以才派剑仙来帮我们除去了八公山上的妖怪！
translation: Guo Zhengzhong: Lord Liu is a clean and upright official who loves the people like his own children. Even the heavens were moved, which is why they sent sword immortals to help us eliminate the monsters on Bagong Mountain!

original_text: 郭正忠：自从柳大人进京办事以来，寿阳城里大大小小的事情都是裴捕头在打理，没想到他一个习武之人，竟有这番才干。
translation: Guo Zhengzhong: Since Lord Liu went to the capital on business, Constable Pei has been managing all affairs in Shouyang, big and small. Who'd have thought a martial artist could have such talent.

original_text: 宋旭鸣：柳大人常常会在衙门处理公务到三更半夜，比起那些自称大侠英雄，却整天只会打打杀杀的江湖中人，真心为民的柳大人才是当之无愧的真英雄！
translation: Song Xuming: Lord Liu often handles official business at the yamen until the third watch of the night. Compared to those who call themselves great heroes and warriors but only know how to fight and kill all day, Lord Liu, who sincerely serves the people, is the true and worthy hero!

original_text: 宋旭鸣：上回城里莫名其妙闹毒虫，柳小姐说可以燃香驱虫，一试之下果然有效～但小姐她一直都只替柳大人出主意，自己却从不露面，连我都没见过她的长相……
translation: Song Xuming: Last time, when poisonous insects inexplicably infested the city, Miss Liu said we could burn incense to repel them. We tried it, and it really worked~ But she only ever gives advice for Lord Liu, never shows herself. Even I haven't seen what she looks like...

original_text: 宋旭鸣：听县令府里的柳勤说，为了这妖怪的事，柳大人已经许多天没睡好觉了，如今总算能安心了。
translation: Song Xuming: According to Liu Qin from the magistrate's mansion, Lord Liu hasn't slept well for many days because of this monster business. Now he can finally rest easy.

original_text: 宋旭鸣：最近上山采草的人少了，不过寿阳的宁香在京城里的价钱涨了不少，没想到少做宁香也有好处，柳大人真是有先见之明啊！
translation: Song Xuming: Recently, fewer people have been going up the mountain to gather herbs, but the price of Ningxiang from Shouyang has risen a lot in the capital. Who would have thought that producing less Ningxiang could be beneficial? Lord Liu truly has foresight!

original_text: 卓见慈：东禅寺整修也有些时日了，我想等禅寺修好之后，就去寺里给柳大人全家捐长生牌位，求菩萨保佑他们长命百岁。
translation: Zhuo Jianci: The renovation of Dongchan Temple has been going on for some time now. I want to go to the temple after it's repaired to donate a longevity plaque for Lord Liu and his whole family, praying to the Bodhisattva for their long lives.

original_text: 卓见慈：东禅寺的心清方丈确实是个慈眉善目的大好人啊，这次重修寺院，他一个人东奔西走，劳心又劳力。
translation: Zhuo Jianci: Abbot Xinqing of Dongchan Temple is truly a kind and benevolent man. For this temple renovation, he has been running around tirelessly, working so hard.

original_text: 卓见慈：上次是谭婆遇妖怪，这回是青青的爹被咬伤！阿弥陀佛！求菩萨多保佑保佑我们寿阳，别再让谁被妖怪咬了！
translation: Zhuo Jianci: Last time it was Granny Tan encountering a monster, this time it's Qingqing's father being bitten! Amitabha! I pray to Bodhisattva to protect our Shouyang, don't let anyone else get bitten by monsters!

original_text: 卓见慈：我这几天一直在求菩萨保佑，没想到菩萨真的显灵了，不然怎么会有剑仙来除妖？真是要感激菩萨救苦救难啊！
translation: Zhuo Jianci: I've been praying to Bodhisattva for days, and who knew Bodhisattva would truly answer? Otherwise, why would sword immortals come to slay demons? Truly grateful for Bodhisattva's mercy and salvation!

original_text: 卓见慈：本来我还担心呐，这采的离香草少了，大伙的日子会不会不好过？没想到现在宁香的价钱涨了，看来还是菩萨保佑～
translation: Zhuo Jianci: I was worried that with less Parting Herb gathered, life might get harder for everyone. But now the price of Ningxiang has risen-seems the Bodhisattva is watching over us~

original_text: 成诗京：我对柳小姐仰慕已久，却苦于不能一见……只好在柳府外候着，若能有幸一睹她的芳容，我、我就算死了也甘愿……
translation: Cheng Shijing: I've long admired Miss Liu, but I've never had the chance to meet her... I wait outside the Liu Mansion, hoping for a glimpse of her beauty. I'd die content...

original_text: 成诗京：我听说柳府里来了个陌生男人！和柳小姐年龄相仿，莫非、莫非他是柳小姐的心上人？！不可能，这绝对不可能！
translation: Cheng Shijing: I heard there's a strange man in the Liu Mansion! About the same age as Miss Liu, could he, could he be Miss Liu's sweetheart?! Impossible, absolutely impossible!

original_text: 成诗京：柳小姐离开寿阳已经很久，听说是修仙去了……要是她真的成了仙人，岂不是从此与我无缘？
translation: Cheng Shijing: Miss Liu has been away from Shouyang for a long time, I heard she went to cultivate immortality... If she really becomes an immortal, wouldn't we be forever separated?

original_text: 谢媒婆：说也怪了，这城里明明没几个人见过柳家闺女的相貌，偏偏总有人托我去柳府说媒，依我看呐，他们还不是看上她爹是个县令……
translation: Matchmaker Xie: It's strange. Few in the city have seen the Liu family girl's appearance, yet people keep asking me to propose to the Liu Mansion. In my view, they're just eyeing her father being a county magistrate...

original_text: 谢媒婆：从寿阳远嫁别处的闺女啊，出嫁的时候身上都得带着离香草～离故乡越远，那香气越浓。
translation: Matchmaker Xie: Girls marrying far from Shouyang must carry Parting Herb when they leave~ The farther from home, the stronger the scent.

original_text: 谢媒婆：哎，柳家闺女啊，八成有了心上人，说不定还是自小订的娃娃亲呢！不然柳大人怎么一点也不着急她的终身大事……
translation: Matchmaker Xie: Ah, the Liu family's daughter probably has a sweetheart, maybe even a childhood betrothal! Otherwise, why isn't Lord Liu worried about her marriage prospects at all...

original_text: 谢媒婆：柳小姐离开寿阳也有些日子了，前阵子我看见柳家夫妇从府里出来，坐上马车出城去了，难不成是要去哪里探望自己的闺女？
translation: Matchmaker Xie: Miss Liu has been away from Shouyang for some time now. Recently, I saw Mr. and Mrs. Liu leave their mansion and take a carriage out of the city. Could they be heading somewhere to visit their daughter?

original_text: 尤向石：想我尤向石也算长得一表人才，要钱有钱，要权嘛～这功名也可以用钱买到！我到底哪里不合柳小姐的意，别说答应嫁给我，她连见我一面都不肯！
translation: You Xiangshi: I, You Xiangshi, consider myself quite handsome, with money to spare, and as for power-well, official rank can be bought with money too! What exactly doesn't suit Miss Liu's fancy? Not only has she refused to marry me, she won't even agree to meet me!

original_text: 尤向石：柳小姐总在深闺之中，大门不出，二门不迈，想必是个娴良淑德的女子，若她能嫁给我尤向石，那真是再般配不过了！
translation: You Xiangshi: Miss Liu always stays deep in her boudoir, never stepping beyond the inner gates. She must be a gentle and virtuous lady. If she could marry me, You Xiangshi, it'd be a perfect match!

original_text: 尤向石：上回我去柳家提亲，柳大人竟然说他女儿已经离开了寿阳，这……不会是偷偷嫁掉了吧？
translation: You Xiangshi: Last time I went to the Liu family to propose marriage, Lord Liu actually said his daughter had already left Shouyang. This... she couldn't have been secretly married off, could she?

original_text: 孔三刚：从这里出城就上山了，东边山上的是淮南王陵，西边山上的就是女萝岩。
translation: Kong Sangang: Leaving the city from here leads up the mountain. To the east is the Huainan King's Tomb; to the west is Nvluo Rock.

original_text: 孔三刚：这次柳大人离开寿阳城，就把城里的事情都交给裴捕头打点了。不过裴捕头也很能干，柳大人出去这许多天了，城里还真没出什么事。
translation: Kong Sangang: This time when Lord Liu left Shouyang City, he left all city affairs in the hands of Constable Pei. But Constable Pei is quite capable too-it's been many days since Lord Liu left, and nothing has really happened in the city.

original_text: 孔三刚：上山采离香草的人越来越少了，不过听柳大人说明年进贡的香料都已经备齐了，如果真是这样，那么少采点倒也没关系～
translation: Kong Sangang: Fewer and fewer people are going up the mountain to pick Parting Herb, but I heard Lord Liu say next year's tribute spices are already prepared. If that's true, then picking less doesn't matter~

original_text: 孙强：城北的山上最近不太平，如果没什么重要的事，还是不要出城的好。
translation: Sun Qiang: The mountains north of the city have been restless lately. If it's not important, better not leave the city.

original_text: 孙强：城里上山采药采草的人，没少被山上的妖怪咬伤！你们几个上山捉妖，可千万要小心！
translation: Sun Qiang: Many people from the city who go up the mountain to gather herbs get bitten by monsters! You all going up to catch demons must be very careful!

original_text: 孙强：八公山之所以叫八公山，好像是因为从前有个淮南王和另外八个人在这里得道成仙，据说当时王府里的鸡犬吃了剩下的仙丹，也都成仙啦！真羡慕～
translation: Sun Qiang: The reason Bagong Mountain is called Bagong Mountain seems to be because long ago, a Huainan King and eight other people achieved enlightenment and became immortals here ('bagong' means eight lords). It's said that even the chickens and dogs in the prince's mansion ate the leftover elixirs and became immortals too! So envious~

original_text: 孙强：本以为柳大人去了京城，这几天稍微偷点懒不打紧，没想到裴捕头管得比柳大人在的时候更严，稍微打个哈欠被看到就要挨骂！
translation: Sun Qiang: I thought with Lord Liu gone to the capital, slacking off a bit these days wouldn't matter. Who knew Constable Pei would be stricter than when Lord Liu was here-even yawning gets you scolded!

original_text: 笑鱼儿：你听说过寿阳城外的八公山吗？我娘说山里藏着长生不老的秘密哦～
translation: Xiao Yuer: Have you heard of Mount. Bagong outside Shouyang City? My mother says there's a secret to immortality hidden in the mountains~

original_text: 笑鱼儿：溪莲常念的那首诗是县令府的仙女姐姐作的，我长大了也要和仙女姐姐一样，作首大家都喜欢的诗！
translation: Xiao Yuer: The poem Xilian often recites was composed by the fairy sister from the magistrate's mansion. When I grow up, I want to be like the fairy sister and write a poem everyone loves!

original_text: 笑鱼儿：娘常常上山去采草，可是现在山上有妖怪了……怎么办？我好怕娘被妖怪吃了……
translation: Xiao Yuer: Mother often goes up the mountain to gather herbs, but now there are monsters on the mountain... What should we do? I'm so afraid mother will be eaten by monsters...

original_text: 笑鱼儿：县令府的仙女姐姐什么都会，一定是她请来了剑仙除了妖！
translation: Xiao Yuer: The fairy sister at the magistrate's mansion can do anything-she must have summoned the sword immortals to slay the monster!

original_text: 笑鱼儿：娘说就算不上山采草～我们也过得够好了，每天都能吃到鱼和肉～
translation: Xiao Yuer: Mom says even if we don't go up the mountain to gather herbs~ we live well enough, eating fish and meat every day~

original_text: 郭志远：暮鼓晨钟，指的就是庙里的和尚早晨敲这钟楼的钟，晚上打那边鼓楼的鼓～啥？你问我和尚为什么要打鼓敲钟？我又不是和尚，我怎么会知道。
translation: Guo Zhiyuan: 'Evening drum, morning bell' refers to the temple monks ringing the bell in this bell tower in the morning and beating the drum in that drum tower at night~ Huh? You ask why monks beat drums and ring bells? I'm not a monk, how would I know.

original_text: 郭志远：钟楼上的巨钟声音洪亮，用力敲击的话，城外都能听见，不过东禅寺正在整修，和尚都住到别处去了，最近也没人敲钟了……
translation: Guo Zhiyuan: The giant bell in the bell tower has a resonant sound; if struck hard, it can be heard outside the city. However, Dongchan Temple is under renovation, the monks have moved elsewhere, and no one has been ringing the bell lately...

original_text: 郭志远：剑仙神通广大，竟然知道我们正为山上妖怪所苦，特地赶来除妖！剑仙慈悲、菩萨慈悲，等东禅寺修好了，我一定去多烧几柱高香。
translation: Guo Zhiyuan: The Sword Immortal is truly powerful, actually knowing we were suffering from mountain demons and coming specifically to exorcise them! Sword Immortal, have mercy, Bodhisattva, have mercy. Once Dongchan Temple is repaired, I'll definitely burn many sticks of incense.

original_text: 郭志远：东禅寺修了也有半年多，心清大师每日在寺内寺外照应着，操劳了这么久，也真够辛苦的。
translation: Guo Zhiyuan: Dongchan Temple has been under construction for over half a year. Master Xinqing has been overseeing things inside and outside the temple daily. He's worked so hard all this time, it's truly exhausting.

original_text: 洛丹霞：我这趟来寿阳，是为了瞻仰城东淝水古战场之貌～虽然身为女儿家，但我早就打定主意，要像爹一样走遍所有名山大川，把那些美景都写进书里！
translation: Luo Danxia: I came to Shouyang this time to behold the ancient battlefield of the Fei River east of the city~ Although I'm a girl, I've long resolved to travel all famous mountains and great rivers like my father, and write all those beautiful scenes into books!

original_text: 洛丹霞：寿阳附近最多的就是泉水，什么水晶泉、玛瑙泉、还有珍珠泉。城里人说那些泉水的味道都不一样，可惜我还没一一尝过……
translation: Luo Danxia: The most abundant things around Shouyang are springs-Crystal Spring, Agate Spring, and Pearl Spring. Townsfolk say each spring tastes different, but sadly, I haven't tried them all yet...

original_text: 洛丹霞：当年秦王苻坚战败淝水，就是往八公山方向撤退。我曾沿着八公山麓往东直到淝水，一路上看遍晋时古风，这趟寿阳也不算白来了。
translation: Luo Danxia: Back then, when King Fu Jian of Qin was defeated at the Fei River, he retreated towards the Bagong Mountains. I once traveled east along the Bagong foothills all the way to the Fei River, seeing the ancient customs of the Jin era along the way. This trip to Shouyang wasn't in vain.

original_text: 周晨浩：我负责在城内巡逻，要是你看到什么可疑人物，可随时向我通报。
translation: Zhou Chenhao: I'm responsible for patrolling the city. If you see any suspicious people, you can report to me anytime.

original_text: 陆羽恒：所谓娶妻当娶贤，我虽未及弱冠，但已想好自己未来的妻子一定要温柔贤惠、谨守妇德。若像柳大人的夫人那样，时常在外抛头露面，实在不太好啊……
translation: Lu Yuheng: They say when taking a wife, choose one virtuous. Though I'm not yet of age, I've already decided my future wife must be gentle, virtuous, and adhere to feminine virtues. Someone like Lord Liu's wife, often appearing in public, really isn't ideal...

original_text: 陆羽恒：爹和娘直到上个月才告诉我，原来我自小定了亲，对方竟然还是武林世家……这、这可如何是好，女子舞刀弄剑，岂不变得性情暴烈？
translation: Lu Yuheng: My parents only told me last month that I was betrothed since childhood, and the other party is actually from a prominent martial arts family... This, this is terrible. A woman wielding swords and sabers would surely become fierce-tempered?

original_text: 毛令毅：寿阳西南淮水和颖口相交处原有苍陵城，只是已经毁于战乱，现在只剩下废墟，实在很可惜。
translation: Mao Lingyi: There used to be Cangling City at the intersection of the Huai River and Yingkou southwest of Shouyang, but it was destroyed in the war. Now only ruins remain, which is truly a pity.

original_text: 毛令毅：原以为不能多采离香草，会对城里的百姓有很大影响，没想到现在宁香的价钱反而高了，柳县令行事果然英明～
translation: Mao Lingyi: I originally thought not being able to gather more Parting Herb would greatly affect the city's residents. Unexpectedly, the price of Ningxiang has risen instead. Magistrate Liu's actions are indeed wise~

original_text: 朱心蕾：柳家人真是我们寿阳的大恩人呐，要不是他们传给百姓制香的法子，大伙哪有现在的好日子呢？
translation: Zhu Xinlei: The Liu family are truly great benefactors to Shouyang. If they hadn't taught the townsfolk the incense-making method, how could everyone enjoy such good days now?

original_text: 朱心蕾：先有柳家教我们制香，后有剑仙为我们除妖，寿阳城一定是有神仙保佑的！
translation: Zhu Xinlei: First, the Liu family taught us how to make incense; then, Sword Immortals helped us eliminate monsters. Shouyang City must be blessed by deities!

original_text: 朱心蕾：对街沈家的那孩子取名叫状元，为的就是想他长大了考个状元回来。不过他家老爷子学问不怎么样，那孩子跟着老爷子学，恐怕到时候也是考不中状元的。
translation: Zhu Xinlei: The child across the street from the Shen family is named Zhuangyuan, hoping he'll grow up to pass the imperial exam and become a top scholar. But his father's learning isn't great, and the child studies with him, so I'm afraid he won't pass the exam when the time comes.

original_text: 莫如长：这谢媒婆真是不识抬举，本公子重金请她去县令府上说媒，她却一副爱理不理的样子……
translation: Mo Ruchang: This Matchmaker Xie is really ungrateful. I paid her handsomely to propose at the magistrate's mansion, but she acted indifferent...

original_text: 莫如长：谢媒婆说县令千金已经有了未婚夫婿，这怎么可能？！分明是推托之辞！
translation: Mo Ruchang: Matchmaker Xie says the magistrate's daughter already has a fiancé. How can that be?! Clearly just an excuse!

original_text: 莫如长：那天我看见县令府里走出来一个丫鬟，真是漂亮呀～听说那就是以前柳小姐的贴身丫鬟，名叫禄翠。我这就来找媒婆去提亲，小姐我娶不到，丫鬟总没问题吧？
translation: Mo Ruchang: That day I saw a maid coming out of the magistrate's mansion-so beautiful! I heard she used to be Miss Liu's personal maid, named Lucui. I'm off to find a matchmaker to propose. If I can't marry the young lady, surely the maid is no problem, right?

original_text: 仇敬：慢！再往里走可就是关押犯人的牢房，难道你是来探监的？裴捕头允许了吗？
translation: Qiu Jing: Halt! Further in are the prison cells holding criminals. Are you here to visit a prisoner? Did Constable Pei give permission?

original_text: 仇敬：柳大人竟然就这样放走了好不容易才抓到的女贼，真是让人想不明白……不过大人行事一向有他的道理，我们当差的还是不要问太多。
translation: Qiu Jing: Lord Liu actually let go of the female thief we worked so hard to capture just like that. It's really hard to understand... But the lord always has his reasons for his actions. We subordinates shouldn't ask too much.

original_text: 仇敬：日子越过越太平，县衙大牢里面已经好几个月没犯人啦！要是牢里一直都没犯人，我就不用天天在这儿傻站了。
translation: Qiu Jing: Life is getting more peaceful; the county jail hasn't had any prisoners for months! If the jail stays empty, I won't have to stand here like a fool every day.

original_text: 心净：东禅寺香火向来很旺，这次重修也多亏了寿阳百姓的捐助，我们不仅能重修大殿，还能再造一座九层佛塔。
translation: Xin Jing: East Chan Temple has always had thriving incense offerings. Thanks to the donations from Shouyang's residents for this renovation, we can not only rebuild the main hall but also construct a nine-story pagoda.

original_text: 心净：我跟着方丈来此查看重修大殿的情况，看这情形，应该花不了几个月了，只是如要造塔，没有三、五年是不成的。
translation: Xin Jing: I followed the abbot here to inspect the progress of the main hall's reconstruction. Judging by the situation, it shouldn't take more than a few months. But if we were to build a pagoda, it would take three to five years.

original_text: 心净：心清方丈一直想在寺庙中建一座宝塔，好用来供奉他去年偶得的一颗舍利子。
translation: Xin Jing: Abbot Xin Qing has long wanted to build a pagoda in the temple to enshrine a relic he obtained by chance last year.

original_text: 何常卫：此门是寿阳通淝门，取“通淝水”的意思，不过由此往南是巢湖，淝水之战的古战场在东边宾阳门外。
translation: He Changwei: This gate is the Shouyang Tongfei Gate, meaning 'connecting to the Fei River'. However, going south from here leads to Chao Lake. The ancient battlefield of the Fei River Battle is east, outside the Binyang Gate.

original_text: 何常卫：进城时要穿过的那道外城墙叫做“月城”，战时可驻兵，也可将敌人引至月城内，关上两处城门，在城墙上放箭杀敌。
translation: He Changwei: The outer wall you pass through when entering the city is called the 'Moon City'. In wartime, troops can be stationed there, or enemies can be lured inside, both gates closed, and arrows fired from the walls to kill them.

original_text: 何常卫：以前淮河发大水时常会冲坏寿阳的城墙，是柳县令带着方圆百里的百姓重修了城墙，许多年了，还是这么牢固啊！
translation: He Changwei: In the past, when the Huai River flooded, it often damaged Shouyang's city walls. It was Magistrate Liu who led the people from hundreds of miles around to rebuild the walls. Many years later, they're still this sturdy!

original_text: 何常卫：城西南十五里外有座小城，据说是当年刘备被曹操围困的地方，现在只剩下一堆破土墙了，不过倒还能看出原先城墙的样子来。
translation: He Changwei: Fifteen li southwest of the city, there's a small town said to be where Liu Bei was besieged by Cao Cao. Now it's just a pile of broken earthen walls, but you can still see the outline of the original city fortifications.

original_text: 卢莫石：孟坚总想着县令府里的丫鬟禄蓉，那禄蓉长得也没禄翠漂亮，人也没禄翠大方，照我看，要娶就娶禄翠才好！
translation: Lu Moshi: Mengjian always thinks about the maid Lurong in the magistrate's mansion. Lurong isn't as pretty as Lucui, nor as generous. In my opinion, if you're going to marry, marry Lucui!

original_text: 卢莫石：柳大人和夫人如今都不在府里，据说是去京城办事了，唉，我什么时候也能去趟京里啊……
translation: Lu Moshi: Lord Liu and his wife aren't at the mansion now, said to be in the capital on business. Ah, when can I go to the capital too...

original_text: 柳奉：要说我家老爷，那可是寿阳城的第二号人物！城里百姓遇到什么大困难，多半会想到我家老爷！
translation: Liu Feng: Speaking of my Lord, he's the second most important person in Shouyang City! When the citizens encounter major difficulties, they mostly think of my Lord!

original_text: 柳奉：啥？你是不是想问我这第一号人物是谁？嘿嘿，天机不可泄露～
translation: Liu Feng: Huh? Do you want to ask who this number one person is? Hehe, heaven's secrets must not be divulged~

original_text: 柳奉：原来是您保护小姐上山查妖怪的事，果然是少年英雄，够胆识！也只有您这样的少侠才配得上我们小姐！
translation: Liu Feng: So it was you who protected my lady up the mountain to investigate the demons. Truly a young hero, bold and discerning! Only a young hero like you is worthy of our lady!

original_text: 柳忠：那年云大侠送小姐来的时候，小姐才那么一丁点儿大！没想到一晃眼就是好多年，小姐也到了该嫁人的时候啦！
translation: Liu Zhong: When Great Hero Yun brought my lady here that year, she was just a tiny little thing! Who would have thought so many years would pass in a blink, and now my lady is of marriageable age!

original_text: 柳忠：听说老爷为小姐相中的姑爷就是云大侠的公子，只是小姐似乎不怎么中意这位姑爷……唉，女儿家的心思，我们这等粗人当真猜不透……
translation: Liu Zhong: I heard the young master my lord picked for my lady-Great Hero Yun's son-isn't really to her liking... Sigh, a girl's heart is beyond us rough folk to guess...

original_text: 柳忠：小姐从小在府里长大，什么时候一个人出过远门了？这一路上舟车劳顿，就算有姑爷照顾，也还是很辛苦的事啊。
translation: Liu Zhong: My lady grew up in the manor-when has she ever traveled far alone? The journey is tiring by carriage and boat, and even with  young master's care, it's still quite arduous.

original_text: 柳诚：你……你就是老爷故人的儿子？可那从牢里出来的韩姑娘又是谁？县令府上留宿要犯，这……我总觉得不妥当。
translation: Liu Cheng: You... you are the son of the master's old friend? But then who is the Miss Han who came out of prison? Hosting a fugitive at the magistrate's mansion... I feel this is improper.

original_text: 柳诚：从这儿往西穿过一道门，就是前厅，老爷、夫人，还有小姐，今天早早的就等在那儿了，好像在等什么人的样子……
translation: Liu Cheng: Go west through a gate from here to reach the main hall. My lord, my mistress, and my lady have been waiting there since early today, as if expecting someone...

original_text: 柳诚：我家小姐这样神仙般的人，有谁能配得起她……依我看，就算一辈子不嫁，也好过一朵鲜花插牛粪……
translation: Liu Cheng: My lady is like a celestial being. Who is worthy of her... In my opinion, it's better to remain unmarried for life than for a fresh flower to be stuck in cow dung...

original_text: 柳诚：禄翠平时总喜欢小姐长小姐短，这回小姐出远门，也不带她一起去，我看她要难受一阵子啦。
translation: Liu Cheng: Lucui always likes to chatter about my lady. This time, my lady is going on a long journey without taking her along. I think she'll be sad for a while.

original_text: 赵三娘：夫人呐，就是心地好～她喜欢吃斋，老爷疼夫人，小姐孝顺夫人，所以除非是有贵客来，整个柳府上下都跟着夫人吃素。
translation: Zhao Sanniang: The mistress is truly kind-hearted~ She prefers vegetarian food, the master dotes on her, and my lady is filial, so unless there are distinguished guests, the entire Liu Mansion follows the mistress in eating vegetarian.

original_text: 赵三娘：当年我们老爷刚当上寿阳县令时，曾经结交过一个侠士，那段日子两人常常在前厅喝酒，喝到醉倒才罢休。
translation: Zhao Sanniang: Back when our master first became the magistrate of Shouyang County, he befriended a knight-errant. In those days, the two often drank in the front hall until they passed out.

original_text: 赵三娘：我也是看着小姐长大的，一想到她要出远门，还不知道什么时候回来，我这心里就有些舍不得……
translation: Zhao Sanniang: I've watched my lady grow up too. Thinking about her going on a long journey, not knowing when she'll return, my heart feels a bit reluctant to let go...

original_text: 西山：小姐住在后院，那地方可不是我们这些粗人能随便去的。其实我在柳家当差半年多，从来都没去过后院呢。
translation: Xishan: My lady lives in the backyard, a place not for us rough folk to visit casually. Actually, I've worked at the Liu mansion for over half a year and never been to the backyard.

original_text: 西山：女萝岩的妖怪真是被你除去的？要说是小姐做的，我倒也相信，至于你嘛，哎，真是人不可貌相……
translation: Xishan: So the monsters in Nvluo Rock were really eliminated by you?If it were said that my lady did it, I'd believe that, but as for you... well, appearances can be deceiving...

original_text: 禄蓉：说也奇怪，自从我来了柳家，每天夜里都睡得特别香，连梦也不做，好像还能闻到阵阵花香呢！
translation: Lurong: It's strange to say, since I came to the Liu family, I've slept especially soundly every night, not even dreaming, and it seems I can still smell waves of floral fragrance!

original_text: 禄蓉：老爷和夫人脾气都很好，上回我打扫卧房的时候不小心砸坏一个花瓶，他们也没骂我，更没说要扣我的工钱～
translation: Lurong: My lord and mistress are both very good-tempered. Last time, I accidentally broke a vase while cleaning the bedroom, and they didn't scold me or say they'd deduct my wages~

original_text: 禄蓉：我听府里其他人说，小姐一向是很少出门的，老爷和夫人对小姐更是宝贝得不得了，辟了个后院只她一人住，这回又怎么舍得让她出远门呢？
translation: Lurong: I heard from others in the mansion that my lady rarely goes out. My lord and madam dote on her immensely, even setting aside a backyard for her alone. So why would they let her travel far this time?

original_text: 柳勤：老爷常在书房里批阅卷宗到深夜，最近城外闹妖怪，老爷更是整夜在此思索对策，到天亮都不合一下眼，这样下去身体怎么受得了……
translation: Liu Qin: My lord often reviews documents in his study late into the night. Recently, with monsters causing trouble outside the city, my lord has been staying up all night here pondering countermeasures, not closing his eyes until dawn. How can his body endure this...

original_text: 柳勤：城里的百姓都夸赞我家老爷勤政爱民，可谁又知道这几句话是老爷用多少年的劳心劳力换来的啊！
translation: Liu Qin: The townsfolk all praise my lord for being diligent in governance and caring for the people. But who knows how many years of toil and effort those words have cost him!

original_text: 柳勤：我倒觉得小姐是应该去外面走走玩玩，每天闷在家里岂不要闷坏了～她那么聪明，什么事都难不倒她，就算出门应该也能照顾好自己。
translation: Liu Qin: I actually think the young lady should go out for walks and fun. Staying cooped up at home every day would surely make her depressed~ She's so clever, nothing can trouble her. Even if she goes out, she should be able to take care of herself.

original_text: 柳常：看你这打扮，不像是哪家公子，说是大侠嘛，倒也称不上，老爷究竟看上你哪一点？竟想招你做女婿……
translation: Liu Chang: Your attire doesn't look like a young master's, nor quite a hero's. What did my lord see in you? He actually wants you as a son-in-law...

original_text: 柳常：这园子的尽头就是小姐平日制香的地方，柳府里的人都知道，尽量不要去打扰小姐。
translation: Liu Chang: The end of this garden is where the young lady usually makes incense. Everyone in the Liu Mansion knows to avoid disturbing her as much as possible.

original_text: 柳常：老爷也真是的，什么事都顺着小姐，这次小姐出远门，万一有什么闪失可怎么办啊……
translation: Liu Chang: My lord is really something, always indulging the young lady. Now that she's traveling far, what if something happens...

original_text: 禄珠：小姐虽然不是老爷和夫人的亲生女儿，但平日里对他们俩十分孝顺，老爷治理寿阳城，小姐还私下帮他出了不少主意呢～
translation: Luzhu: Although my lady isn't the biological daughter of my lord and mistress, she is very filial to them. When my lord governs Shouyang City, my lady privately gives him many suggestions~

original_text: 柳心：我绝对不是在做梦！这柳府在夜里经常会有奇怪的香气，闻着闻着就睡着了，一觉睡到大天亮，睡得特别香，可我总觉得心里不踏实……这究竟是怎么一回事啊？
translation: Liu Xin: I'm definitely not dreaming! This Liu Mansion often has a strange fragrance at night. After smelling it, I fall asleep and sleep soundly until dawn, but I always feel uneasy... What in the world is going on?

original_text: 柳心：哈哈，姑爷您真是了不得！女萝岩闹妖怪，您一出马，就啥事都没有了～
translation: Liu Xin: Haha, Young Master, you're truly amazing! With the demon trouble at Nvluo Rock, once you stepped in, everything was resolved~

original_text: 禄翠：今天一大早我就见小姐去了前厅，到底是什么事非得她亲自去办呢？
translation: Lucui: Early this morning, I saw my lady go to the front hall. What matter requires her personal attention?

original_text: 禄翠：用离香草制宁香的法子，其实是小姐告诉老爷，老爷再传给寿阳百姓的～她还会制许多其他的香，譬如给夫人用来修禅供佛的瑞脑香～
translation: Lucui: The method of making Ningxiang from Parting Herb was actually told to my lord by my lady, and then my lord passed it on to the people of Shouyang~ She can also make many other incenses, like the Ruinao incense that Madam uses for meditation and Buddha offerings~

original_text: 禄翠：官家小姐出嫁不是都带丫鬟的吗？这次小姐跟着姑爷您走了，跟出嫁有什么不一样？为什么不肯带我一起去？
translation: Lucui: Don't official ladies all bring maids when they marry? This time, my lady is leaving with you, sir, my Young Master -how is that different from marrying? Why won't you take me along?

original_text: 禄芙：我家小姐向来都很有主意，老爷在衙门里头痛的事情，小姐常常能想到一些不错的法子～
translation: Lu Fu: My young lady has always been full of ideas. Often, for matters that trouble my lord in the yamen, she can think of some good solutions~

original_text: 禄芙：老爷很少留人在家作客的，难道、难道你真是我家小姐的未婚夫婿？
translation: Lu Fu: My lord rarely keeps guests at home. Could it be... could you really be our young lady's fiancé?

original_text: 禄芙：原以为小姐是不可能嫁给你的，可看她今天的样子，对你似乎又不错～从来也没人能猜中她的心思。
translation: Lu Fu: I originally thought it was impossible for the young lady to marry you, but seeing her today, she seems quite fond of you~ No one has ever been able to guess her thoughts.

original_text: 阿福：嘿哟！客官您一看就知道是外地来的，要不要到我们阳春客栈打个尖儿，歇歇脚？
translation: A Fu: Hey there! You look like an out-of-towner, sir. Care to stop by our Yangchun Inn for a bite and a rest?

original_text: 阿福：前几天城外山上闹妖怪，吓跑了好几个想出城游历的客人，害得我们客栈生意清淡了许多，现在妖怪是没了，可是这跑了的客人，十天半月之内怕是回不来哟～
translation: A Fu: A few days ago, monsters caused trouble on the mountain outside the city, scaring away several guests who wanted to travel. It really hurt our inn's business. Now the monsters are gone, but those guests who fled probably won't return for ten days to half a month~

original_text: 阿福：寿阳东有淝水古战场，西有禹王庙，南有巢湖，北有八公山，客官您可以在咱客栈多住几天，把我说的这些地方都看遍了，也算没白来一趟寿阳城～
translation: A Fu: Shouyang has the ancient Fei River battlefield to the east, Yu Wang Temple to the west, Chao Lake to the south, and Bagong Mountain to the north. Sir, you can stay a few more days at our inn and see all these places I mentioned, so your trip to Shouyang won't be in vain~

original_text: 谭七：二十多年前，这寿阳柳县令上任的时候，曾在八公山脚下遇“淮南十三盗”，险些丢了性命！然而江湖上却没人知道当时是哪位大侠出手救了柳大人。
translation: Tan Qi: Over twenty years ago, when Magistrate Liu of Shouyang first took office, he encountered the 'Huainan Thirteen Bandits' at the foot of Bagong Mountain and nearly lost his life! Yet, no one in the jianghu knows which great hero saved Lord Liu back then.

original_text: 谭七：你听说了没有？江淮一带有名的“书剑双侠”前几天来了咱们寿阳城！我猜他们一定是柳县令请来除妖的！
translation: Tan Qi: Have you heard? The famous 'Scholar-Sword Duo' from Jianghuai visited Shouyang City days ago! I bet County Magistrate Liu invited them to exterminate demons!

original_text: 谭七：三年前，江湖上突然出现一位英武少年，使一套自创的“剑指双绝”，那些赫赫有名的少侠如“清风剑”张玉太、“夺命书生”宋笑生等，全都败在他的手下！
translation: Tan Qi: Three years ago, a heroic young man suddenly appeared in the martial world, wielding a self-created 'Twin Sword-Finger Technique'. Famous young heroes like 'Breeze Sword' Zhang Yutai and 'Deadly Scholar' Song Xiaosheng were all defeated by him!

original_text: 茶露：我猜寿阳城年年进贡的“宁香”之中，除了离香草，一定还用了麝香、苏合香等安心定神的香料，否则这“宁香”可没有那么好的静心宁神之效！
translation: Chalu: I guess among the 'Ningxiang' tribute from Shouyang City every year, besides Parting Herb, they must also use musk, storax, and other calming fragrances. Otherwise, this 'Ningxiang' wouldn't have such good soothing and calming effects!

original_text: 茶露：我猜县令小姐一定是个精通药理的人，她调制的“宁香”不但能安心养神，还能通窍活血～
translation: Chalu: I guess the county magistrate's daughter must be skilled in pharmacology. The 'Ningxiang' she concocts not only calms the mind but also unblocks meridians and invigorates blood~

original_text: 茶露：我从小跟着阿爹上山采药，对药理也有些了解，那“离香草”除了能制香之外，也没有别的大用处，即使不能再采摘，也没什么关系。
translation: Chalu: I've followed my father up the mountain to gather herbs since I was little, so I know a bit about medicinal properties. That 'Parting Herb' has no other major use besides making incense. Even if we can't pick it anymore, it doesn't really matter.

original_text: 茶露：调香和调药其实是一样的，其中需要拿捏的份量、火候等等，全都是细功夫，没有两三年的时间，是学不来的。
translation: Chalu: Perfume blending and medicine blending are actually quite similar-the precise measurements, heat control, and such all require delicate skill. It takes at least two or three years to learn properly.

original_text: 尤向玉：秀妹，爹听说寿阳附近在闹妖怪，担心的不得了，特地让我和大哥来接你回京住，你就跟哥哥回去吧！
translation: You Xiangyu: Xiumei, Father heard there are monsters near Shouyang and was extremely worried. He specifically sent me and our elder brother to take you back to the capital to live. Please come back with us!

original_text: 余竹秀：竹秀自小便没有爹娘，这位公子您认错人了吧？
translation: Yu Zhuxiu: Zhuxiu has been without parents since childhood, young master, you must have mistaken me for someone else?

original_text: 尤向玉：……
translation: You Xiangyu: ...

original_text: 尤向玉：当年爹被调任上京时，娘刚生下小妹，行动诸多不便，爹无奈带着我和大哥先行赴京，未料后来娘和小妹却在进京途中遭了盗匪，娘被害死，小妹也下落不明……
translation: You Xiangyu: When Father was transferred to the capital, Mother had just given birth to my little sister and couldn't travel easily. Father had no choice but to take my elder brother and me ahead. Sadly, Mother and my sister were attacked by bandits on the way-Mother killed, my sister missing...

original_text: 尤向玉：原来秀妹迟迟不肯跟我回京见爹，是担心余家老爷年迈无人照料，这事儿好办，余老爷是秀妹的救命恩人，把他一并接去京里住不就好了？
translation: You Xiangyu: So the reason Xiumei has been reluctant to return to the capital with me to meet Father is her worry that Elder Yu, being old, has no one to care for him. That's easy to solve. Elder Yu saved Xiumei's life-we can just bring him to live in the capital too, right?

original_text: 余竹秀：我自小跟着爷爷长大，从来不知道自己还有爹娘，这位尤公子不知道是打哪儿来的，硬是把我当成他家失散的么妹，真是说都说不清！
translation: Yu Zhuxiu: I grew up with my grandfather and never knew I had parents. This Mr. You, who knows where he came from, insists I'm his long-lost younger sister. It's impossible to explain!

original_text: 余竹秀：爷爷以前说过，我娘当年被凤凰山麓的盗匪所害，爷爷是在上山打柴的时候捡到我的，当时我娘已经去了……
translation: Yu Zhuxiu: My grandfather once said that my mother was killed by bandits on Phoenix Mountain Ridge. Grandpa found me while gathering firewood on the mountain; my mother had already passed by then...

original_text: 余竹秀：原来我亲爹真的是当朝一品大员尤大人……可、可我若跟哥哥们回京见爹爹，谁来照顾爷爷呀……
translation: Yu Zhuxiu: So my real father is indeed Lord You, a top-ranking official in the court... But, but if I go back to the capital with my brothers to see Father, who will take care of Grandfather...

original_text: 刘铁山：唉……我早知道，她是不愿意离开即墨的……罢了、罢了，这些玉石是我云游各地时收集的，全都是铸剑的良材，可笑自己还都当宝贝似的舍不得卖，其实除了懂得铸剑的人之外，谁还知道这些石头的珍贵呢……
translation: Liu Tieshan: Sigh... I knew all along she didn't want to leave Jimo... Forget it, forget it. These jade stones are what I collected while wandering the lands, all fine materials for sword forging. It's laughable that I treasured them so much I couldn't bear to sell them. But really, aside from those who understand sword forging, who else would know the value of these stones...

original_text: 开启新交易品
translation: New Trade Items Unlocked

original_text: 花费150文钱住宿吗？
translation: Spend 150 wen to stay the night?

original_text: 周金福：您身上的钱不够。
translation: Zhou Jinfu: You don't have enough money on you.

original_text: 吴丹：哈哈哈哈！小哥你真是个大善人！！辛苦了辛苦了！来，这几样东西你拿好了，算是我吴丹答谢你的！
translation: Wu Dan: Hahahaha! Young man, you are truly a great benefactor!! Thank you for your hard work! Here, take these items as my thanks!

original_text:
我虽然见识了很多食谱，但是却没有吃过寿阳以外的小吃，小哥你如果能帮我带来醉枣、炸馓子、奶茶、手抓饭、醪酒和红绿八宝饭的话，我一定会很感激你的！
你愿意帮我去买来吗？
translation:
Although I've seen many recipes, I've never tasted snacks from outside Shouyang. Young man, if you could bring me Drunken Jujube, fried Dough Twists, milk tea, pilaf, Laojiu, and Eight-Treasure Rice, I'd be very grateful!
Will you help me buy them?

original_text:
小伙子，看你的样子，不是本地人吧？如果有机会去北方海边的即墨，能不能帮我把这块“九转圣光石”带给一位姑娘？她叫张艳，常常喜欢站在栈桥上看海。
你愿意帮我把“九转圣光石”带给她吗？
translation: Young man, you don't look like a local. If you ever get a chance to the northern seaside town <colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> Jimo</colour><dc0>, could you deliver this 'Saintlight Stone' to a young lady? Her name is</dc0><colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> Zhang Yan</colour><dc0>. She often likes to</dc0><colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> stand on the pier</colour><dc0> and watch the sea.</dc0>

original_text: 凌天守：府衙重地，闲杂人等速速离开！
translation: Ling Tianshou: Government office, no loitering! Leave at once!

original_text: 1.去碗丘山
translation: 1. Go to Bowl Hill

original_text: 2.御剑飞行
translation: 2. Sword Flight

original_text: 3.什么都不做
translation: 3. Do Nothing

original_text: 准备<colour red=255 green=102 blue=0 alpha=255>去碗丘山</colour><dc0>还是</dc0><colour red=255 green=102 blue=0 alpha=255>御剑飞行</colour><dc0>？</dc0>
translation: Proceed to?

original_text: 云天河：还是不要进去为好。
translation: Yun Tianhe: It's better not to go in.

original_text: 云天河：房门锁住了……
translation: Yun Tianhe: The door's locked...

original_text: 韩菱纱：说起来，陈州才算得上是淮河岸边真正的宝地～传说天神伏羲在这儿设下了先天八卦之阵，再厉害的妖魔也不能作乱。而且历朝历代的皇亲国戚都特别偏爱这里，最最有名的要数那个才高很多斗的曹、曹……曹子佳？
translation: Han Lingsha: Speaking of which, Chenzhou is the real treasure along the Huai River~ Legend says the god Fuxi set up the Primordial Eight Trigrams formation here, so even the fiercest demons can't cause trouble. And royalty from every dynasty especially favored this place, the most famous being that super-talented Cao, Cao... Cao Zijia?

original_text: 韩菱纱：不对、不对，梦璃你在书上读过吧？那人叫什么来着？
translation: Han Lingsha: No, no, Mengli, you've read about it in books, right? What was that person's name again?
Han Lingsha: ......

original_text: 韩菱纱：云～天～河——！！竟然又给我乱跑，还把梦璃一起拐走！
translation: Han Lingsha: Yun~ Tian~ He-!! You ran off again and even dragged Mengli away with you!

original_text: 韩菱纱：（真是被他气累了……）
translation: Han Lingsha: (Really exhausted by him... )

original_text: 书生：姑娘息怒，姑娘息怒！我家的小黄胆子特别小，别人一吼它就害怕……
translation: Scholar: Miss, please calm down! My dog Xiaohuang is very timid; he gets scared when people shout ...

original_text: 韩菱纱：……胆子这么小，还做什么狗。
translation: Han Lingsha: ... So timid, and you call yourself a dog.

original_text: 书生：岂、岂有此理……脾气这么坏，还当什么女人……
translation: Scholar: .. So bad-tempered, and you call yourself a woman?...

original_text: 韩菱纱：你说什么？有胆子再说一遍！
translation: Han Lingsha: What did you say? Say that again if you dare!

original_text: 书生：没有，不敢、不敢，小生先走一步！
translation: Scholar: No, no, I wouldn't dare! I'll be on my way!

original_text: 韩菱纱：（云天河！不要让我<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>找到你</colour><dc0>，姑娘我自从遇到你以后衰事连连，现在连狗都欺负我！）</dc0>
translation: Han Lingsha: (Yun Tianhe! Don't let me<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> find you</colour><dc0>. Ever since I met you, misfortune has followed me one after another, and now even dogs bully me!)</dc0>

original_text: 韩菱纱：好哇！总算给我找到了！
translation: Han Lingsha: Great! Finally found you!

original_text: 云天河：菱纱，你快来～
translation: Yun Tianhe: Lingsha, come quick~

original_text: 韩菱纱：来什么来！你又到处乱跑！嫌以前闯的祸不够多是不是！
translation: Han Lingsha: Come? As if! You're running around again! Think all the troubles you caused before wasn't enough, huh?!

original_text: 云天河：我、我也不知道，不知不觉就走到这里来了……呵呵。
translation: Yun Tianhe: I, I don't know either, I just ended up here... hehe.

original_text: 韩菱纱：……
translation: Han Lingsha: ...

original_text: 柳梦璃：菱纱，是我不好……我见云公子看新奇的东西看得入迷了，越走越远，本想把他喊回来，结果却也……
translation: Liu Mengli: Lingsha, it's my fault... I saw Yun get fascinated by novel things and wander farther away. I meant to call him back, but ended up...

original_text: 韩菱纱：好梦璃，你别事事都替这傻瓜担待。四处逛逛也没什么啦，可千万别不打招呼就消失，害我担心……
translation: Han Lingsha: My dear Mengli, don't always cover for this fool. Wandering around is fine, but don't disappear without saying a word and make me worry...

original_text: 云天河：菱纱，我想买样好东西～可身上没钱，你有吗？能不能给我？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Lingsha, I want to buy something good~ but I have no money, do you have any? Can you give me some?

original_text: 韩菱纱：…………居然还有脸说，一点不知反省……真服了你……
translation: Han Lingsha: ...... You still have the face to say that, not reflecting at all... I'm really impressed by you...

original_text: 云天河：反省？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Reflecting?

original_text: 云天河：我知道啊，爹说过有句话叫“一日三省吾身”，意思是一天要反省三次，今天的三次我都用完了，所以剩下的留到明天再做。
translation: Yun Tianhe: I know, Father said there's a saying 'introspect three times a day', meaning reflect three times daily. I used up today's three, so I'll save the rest for tomorrow.

original_text: 韩菱纱：你…………
translation: Han Lingsha: You......

original_text: 柳梦璃：我看……不如先听听云公子说的吧，他这次倒也是一番好意呢。
translation: Liu Mengli: I think... perhaps we should listen to what Yun has to say first. This time, he genuinely means well.

original_text: 韩菱纱：唉，说吧，你到底想买什么？
translation: Han Lingsha: Sigh, speak, what exactly do you want to buy?

original_text: 云天河：那个……
translation: Yun Tianhe: That...

original_text: 韩菱纱：这是……
translation: Han Lingsha: This is...

original_text: 韩菱纱：你想买琴？要送给梦璃？
translation: Han Lingsha: You want to buy a Qin? To give to Mengli?

original_text: 云天河：不是、不是，就是买她！
translation: Yun Tianhe: No, no, I mean buy her!

original_text: 韩菱纱：她？……她？！你要买的竟然是……太胡闹了！你这色心不死的野人！不行！我绝不同意！
translation: Han Lingsha: Her? ... Her?! What you want to buy is actually... This is outrageous! You shameless, lustful barbarian! No! I absolutely won't agree!

original_text: 云天河：可是……
translation: Yun Tianhe: But...

original_text: 韩菱纱：少废话！不行就是不行！
translation: Han Lingsha: Enough nonsense! No means no!

original_text: ？？：姑娘莫要误会。
translation: ??: Miss, don't misunderstand.

original_text: ？？：我只是答应为云少侠唱上一曲，还未来得及告诉他不纳金银，我只想求他帮我一个忙。
