translation: ???: I only agreed to sing a song for Yun, hadn't told him yet I don't accept money, just wanted to ask him for a favor.

original_text: 韩菱纱：……真的？只是唱歌？还不要钱？我看要帮的忙肯定麻烦……
translation: Han Lingsha: ... Really? Just singing? And no charge? I bet the help needed must be troublesome...

original_text: 柳梦璃：……菱纱，我刚才听这位姑娘抚琴，曲意凄婉哀伤，好像有莫大的痛苦。我们要是力所能及，就帮帮她吧。好吗？
translation: Liu Mengli: ... Lingsha, I just heard this young lady play the qin; the melody is sorrowful, as if she bears great pain. If we can help, let's do so. Okay?

original_text: 云天河：对、对啊，我也觉得是要帮她！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Y-yeah, I think we should help her too!

original_text: ？？：两位姑娘，还有云少侠，若是愿意耽搁片刻，我自会把前因后果都告诉你们……
translation: ???: You two ladies, and young hero Yun, if you're willing to spare a moment, I'll tell you the whole story from start to finish...

original_text: 柳梦璃：我们自然愿意听。
translation: Liu Mengli: We are naturally willing to listen.

original_text: 韩菱纱：（……如果很麻烦，不就耽误了找怀朔的事……）
translation: Han Lingsha: (... If it's troublesome, won't it delay finding Huaishuo...)

original_text: 韩菱纱：……说了这么久，还不知道怎么称呼这位姑娘？
translation: Han Lingsha: ... We've been talking for so long, but I still don't know how to address this miss?

original_text: ？？：三位叫我“琴姬”便好，已为人妇，又哪敢再以姑娘自居。
translation: ??: You three can just call me 'Qin Ji'. I'm already a married woman, how dare I still call myself a miss.

original_text: 琴姬：这位柳姑娘说我曲意哀伤，心中痛苦，倒是言重了……
translation: Qin Ji: This Miss Liu said my melody is sorrowful, my heart in pain. That's putting it too strongly...

original_text: 琴姬：人生在世，难免有许多妄念，我有个心愿未了，怕是到死都看不破……
translation: Qin Ji: In life, it's hard to avoid many delusions. I have an unfulfilled wish that I fear I'll never see through, even in death...

original_text: 云天河：心愿？是什么？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Wish? What's that?

original_text: 琴姬：这可得从头说起——
translation: Qin Ji: This has to be told from the beginning-

original_text: 琴姬：我自幼喜爱音律，却更是仰慕世间的高人侠士，及笄之后便出门闯荡，仗着一身武艺惩奸除恶，倒也十分痛快。
translation: Qin Ji: Since childhood, I've loved music, but I admired the world's noble heroes and warriors even more. After coming of age, I ventured out, using my martial skills to punish evil and uphold justice, which was truly exhilarating.

original_text: 韩菱纱：呀，了不起！你竟是个锄强扶弱的女侠！
translation: Han Lingsha: Wow, impressive! You're actually a chivalrous heroine who helps the weak!

original_text: 琴姬：什么女侠，也不过是年少时的胡闹……后来我因音律结识了陈州秦家的独子，他虽不懂武功，也很文弱，却是我见过最好的人，没过多久他就将我迎娶入门。
translation: Qin Ji: What heroine, it was just youthful mischief... Later, through music, I met the only son of the Qin family in Chenzhou. Although he didn't know martial arts and was quite frail, he was the best person I'd ever met. Not long after, he married me.

original_text: 韩菱纱：那很好啊，能和自己喜欢的人在一起～
translation: Han Lingsha: That's wonderful, to be with someone you love~

original_text: 柳梦璃：莫非……他有负于你？
translation: Liu Mengli: Could it be... he wronged you?

original_text: 琴姬：不，他对我很好，我们在一起钻研曲谱，他还教我读书写字……那真是、是我一生中最快乐的一段日子……
translation: Qin Ji: No, he treated me very well. We studied music scores together, and he taught me to read and write... Those were truly... the happiest days of my life...

original_text: 琴姬：可惜……不管我怎么做，也做不来知书达理的大家闺秀，让公公婆婆开心……
translation: Qin Ji: It's a pity... no matter what I do, I can't become a well-educated lady from a good family to make my in-laws happy...

original_text: 柳梦璃：那你相公呢？这些事他知道吗？
translation: Liu Mengli: What about your husband? Does he know about these things?

original_text: 琴姬：他？他那样孝顺的一个人，当初为了娶我，却不惜违逆家里的意思……只是这种事又怎能一而再、再而三地犯……
translation: Qin Ji: Him? He was such a filial person, yet back then, to marry me, he dared to defy his family's wishes... but such matters cannot be committed again and again...

original_text: 琴姬：渐渐地，就算有相公陪伴，日子也变得越来越难熬……我那时就有了重出江湖的念头……直到有一天，我又惹得婆婆不高兴……那一次连相公也责怪了我几句，我一怒之下留书出走……
translation: Qin Ji: Gradually, even with my husband's company, life became harder to bear... I began to think of returning to the jianghu... Until one day, I upset my mother-in-law again... That time, even my husband scolded me a little. In anger, I left a note and ran away...

original_text: 韩菱纱：……与其在家里受气，当女侠说不定还自在很多呢。
translation: Han Lingsha: ... Rather than suffering at home, being a heroine might actually be much more freeing.

original_text: 琴姬：岂止是女侠？每个学剑的人都梦想成为上天入地的剑仙，我也是一样，离家以后就遍访名山大川，求仙问道……
translation: Qin Ji: More than just a heroine? Everyone who learns the sword dreams of becoming a sword immortal who can soar through the heavens and traverse the earth. I was the same-after leaving home, I traveled far and wide to famous mountains and great rivers, seeking immortality and enlightenment...

original_text: 云天河：哦～原来你也喜欢在天上飞。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Oh~ So you like flying in the sky too.

original_text: 琴姬：……可能人心就是这么不知足，当我剑术大进，反而常常想念相公，他的身子本来就不是特别好，我很担心……我为自己找了很多理由，想回到陈州来看看他……
translation: Qin Ji: ... Perhaps human hearts are just never satisfied. When my sword skills greatly improved, I often missed my husband instead. His health wasn't particularly good to begin with, and I was worried... I found many reasons for myself, wanting to return to Chenzhou to see him...

original_text: 柳梦璃：那后来呢？你见到他了吗？
translation: Liu Mengli: What happened after that? Did you see him?

original_text: 琴姬：我回到陈州时，才知他已过世好几个月了……
translation: Qin Ji: When I returned to Chenzhou, I learned he had passed away several months before...

original_text: 韩菱纱：他、你相公是怎么了？！怎么会……？
translation: Han Lingsha: He-your husband-what's wrong?! How could...?

original_text: 琴姬：听说相公在我离开后身子更是糟糕，婆婆为他定下一门亲事冲喜，但新妇过门没多久，他还是去了……
translation: Qin Ji: I heard my husband's health worsened after I left. My mother-in-law arranged a marriage for him to ward off misfortune, but he passed away not long after the bride entered the household...

original_text: 琴姬：我曾经想过千百遍和他重逢的情形，我宁可他骂我、不原谅我，也不要这个样子……
translation: Qin Ji: I've imagined our reunion a thousand times. I'd rather he scolded me, refused to forgive me, than have things turn out like this...

original_text: 柳梦璃：……那，我们要怎么做才能帮你？
translation: Liu Mengli: ... Then, what can we do to help you?

original_text: 琴姬：……如今后悔也没用了，我根本不知道秦家把相公葬在哪里，我只想去千佛塔，在他的牌位前上柱香，请他原谅我以前的不懂事……
translation: Qin Ji: ... Now it's useless to regret. I don't even know where the Qin family buried my husband. I just want to go to the Thousand Buddha Pagoda, burn incense before his memorial tablet, and ask him to forgive my past immaturity...

original_text: 云天河：点柱香有什么难的？我天天都会点给我爹啊。
translation: Yun Tianhe: What's so hard about burning incense? I do it for my father every day.

original_text: 琴姬：云少侠有所不知，陈州的千佛塔中供有佛门圣物，塔顶有圣光投下，所以不单是本城，许多有钱人都千里迢迢把亲眷的牌位送来此地，想要他们的魂灵受佛祖保佑。
translation: Qin Ji: Hero Yun, you may not know-Chenzhou's Thousand Buddha Pagoda houses sacred Buddhist relics, with holy light shining from the top. So not just locals, but many wealthy people bring their ancestors' tablets here from afar, hoping their souls receive Buddha's protection.

original_text: 琴姬：秦家当然也是一样，他们还曾经捐钱修塔，和方丈也颇有交情，或许是秦家知会过什么，那些僧人根本不让我进塔，我也想过在夜里进去，可是为了守护圣物，那儿夜里更是有武僧把守……
translation: Qin Ji: The Qin family is naturally the same. They even donated money to repair the pagoda and are quite acquainted with the abbot. Perhaps the Qin family notified them of something, as those monks simply wouldn't let me enter the pagoda. I also thought about going in at night, but to protect the sacred relics, there are even martial monks guarding it after dark...

original_text: 琴姬：我看得出诸位身手不凡，只想请你们帮我，让我进入塔内，祭拜亡夫。
translation: Qin Ji: I can see you all are quite skilled. I just ask you to help me enter the pagoda to pay respects to my late husband.

original_text: 韩菱纱：可是，以你的剑术竟然打不过那些和尚？
translation: Han Lingsha: But, with your swordsmanship, you couldn't defeat those monks?

original_text: 琴姬：……说来也是阴差阳错，当初听到相公过世，我伤心欲绝，想到他生前不喜我舞刀弄剑，便立下重誓再也不使用一身武艺，谁又料到后来有这许多波折……
translation: Qin Ji: ... It's all a twist of fate, really. Back when I heard of my husband's passing, I was heartbroken. Remembering he disliked me practicing martial arts, I swore a solemn oath never to use my skills again. Who could have predicted so many twists and turns later...

original_text: 琴姬：……那以后我一直在陈州街头弹琴，想要找到心地善良又身怀武艺的人帮帮我。
translation: Qin Ji: After that, I've been playing the qin on the streets of Chenzhou, hoping to find someone kind-hearted and skilled in martial arts to help me.

original_text: 韩菱纱：那秦家人也太过份了，人都入土了，祭拜一下又不会怎样。这个忙我是帮定了！
translation: Han Lingsha: That Qin family is too much. The person's already buried; paying respects won't hurt. I'm definitely helping with this!

original_text: 云天河：对，我也要去！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Right, I'm going too!

original_text: 柳梦璃：既然这样，是否需要我们今夜就进入千佛塔？
translation: Liu Mengli: In that case, do we need to enter the Thousand Buddha Pagoda tonight?

original_text: 琴姬：有劳各位，你们的大恩大德我一生一世都铭记在心。
translation: Qin Ji: Thank you all for your trouble. I will remember your great kindness and virtue for the rest of my life.

original_text: 柳梦璃：你太客气了，我还想听你弹琴唱歌呢，所以也不算白帮你～
translation: Liu Mengli: You're too polite, I still want to hear you play the qin and sing, so it's not for nothing~

original_text: 琴姬：……多谢。这样，<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>今日戌时我便在湖心岛的千佛塔下等你们。</colour>
translation: Qin Ji: ... Thank you. In that case,<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> I'll wait for you tonight at Xu hour (7 p.m.) under the Thousand Buddha Pagoda on the lake's central island.</colour>

original_text: 柳梦璃：嗯，一言为定。
translation: Liu Mengli: Mm, it's a promise.

original_text: 韩菱纱：……哎，老天爷也太会作弄人了吧？明明是一段好姻缘，偏偏变成这样。
translation: Han Lingsha: ... Ah, does fate love to play tricks? Clearly a good match, yet it ends up like this.

original_text: 柳梦璃：这次也多亏云公子误打误撞，不然我们可能就错过了……
translation: Liu Mengli: This time it's also thanks to Yun's accidental stumbling, otherwise we might have missed it...

original_text: 云天河：是吗？呵呵～
translation: Yun Tianhe: Really? Hehe~

original_text: 韩菱纱：少得意，琴姬的事和你乱跑胡闹根本是两回事……
translation: Han Lingsha: Don't get cocky, Qin Ji's matter and your reckless running around are two different things...

original_text: 云天河：哦…………
translation: Yun Tianhe: Oh......

original_text: 柳梦璃：到戌时还早，不如我们先在城里四处看看。
translation: Liu Mengli: It's still early before Xu hour, why don't we look around the city first.

original_text: 韩菱纱：好啊，被这样一闹，我精神又好些了呢～去逛一逛，要是能遇上怀朔他们就太好了。
translation: Han Lingsha: Great, after all that commotion, I'm feeling more energetic~ Let's stroll around; it'd be great if we run into Huaishuo.

original_text: 柳梦璃：嗯，若是累了，再<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>去客栈歇息</colour><dc0>。</dc0>
translation: Liu Mengli: Mm, if you're tired, <colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>go rest at the inn</colour><dc0>.</dc0>

original_text: 韩菱纱：刚刚好耶～快到戌时了。
translation: Han Lingsha: Perfect timing~ it's almost Xu hour.

original_text: 韩菱纱：走吧！<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>从客栈西边的渡口乘船，就能去湖心岛了。</colour>
translation: Han Lingsha: Let's go!<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> Take a boat from the ferry west of the inn, and we can reach the island in the lake.</colour>

original_text: 云天河：哟嚯～去打坏人啰！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Yoho~ Off to fight bad guys!

original_text: 韩菱纱：……白痴，哪来的坏人……
translation: Han Lingsha: ...Idiot, what bad guys...

original_text: 柳梦璃：云公子真是好心人。
translation: Liu Mengli: Yun is truly kind-hearted.

original_text: 琴姬：……一切就有劳了。
translation: Qin Ji: ... I'll leave everything to you.

original_text: 云天河：呵呵，包在我身上！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Hehe, leave it to me!

original_text: 韩菱纱：太奇怪了吧？这一路上竟没遇见半个和尚。
translation: Han Lingsha: So strange? We haven't met a single monk this whole way.

original_text: 云天河：对啊，坏人呢？在哪里？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Right, where's the bad guy? Where is he?

original_text: 琴姬：出家人讲究六根清静，无论何时都是空门大开，只不过塔中的圣物实在很重要，寺院才会派人把守。
translation: Qin Ji: Monks emphasize purity of the six senses; the temple gates are always open. However, the sacred relics in the pagoda are extremely important, so the monastery posts guards.

original_text: 柳梦璃：……塔门似乎关着，我们要如何进去呢？
translation: Liu Mengli: ... The tower door seems to be closed. How are we to enter?

original_text: 韩菱纱：我瞧瞧～
translation: Han Lingsha: Let me see~

original_text: 韩菱纱：有了，看那边！
translation: Han Lingsha: There, look over there!

original_text: 云天河：什么那边？
translation: Yun Tianhe: What over there?

original_text: 云天河：菱纱，你是不是又要学老鼠打洞？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Lingsha, are you going to learn to dig holes like a mouse again?

original_text: 柳梦璃：……噗～
translation: Liu Mengli: ... Pfft~

original_text: 韩菱纱：打、打洞？！
translation: Han Lingsha: D-dig a hole?!

original_text: 韩菱纱：（……我倒觉得比较想打人……）
translation: Han Lingsha: (...I feel more like hitting someone...)

original_text: 琴姬：韩姑娘可是想从窗子进去？
translation: Qin Ji: Miss Han, are you thinking of entering through the window?

original_text: 韩菱纱：嗯～正门看起来又厚又沉，从那儿走八成会打草惊蛇，不如赌一把，试试窗户啰！
translation: Han Lingsha: Hmm~ The main gate looks thick and heavy. Going that way would likely alert them. Might as well gamble and try the window!

original_text: 琴姬：……也好。
translation: Qin Ji: ... That's fine too.

original_text: 琴姬：……
translation: Qin Ji: ...

original_text: 韩菱纱：那个女的，好讨厌！陈州又不是她家大院，要由她做主！
translation: Han Lingsha: That woman, so annoying! Chenzhou isn't her family courtyard, how can she decide everything!

original_text: 琴姬：……别说了，她也不过是个可怜人……
translation: Qin Ji: Don't say anymore, she's just a pitiful person...

original_text: 韩菱纱：她……她说的那些，你不生气吗？
translation: Han Lingsha: She... what she said, aren't you angry?

original_text: 琴姬：……生气又有什么用……一切都是我咎由自取……如果当初没有意气用事，再和相公想想别的法子，或许……或许很多事情就会不同了……
translation: Qin Ji: ... What's the use of being angry... It's all my own fault... If I hadn't acted impulsively back then and thought of other ways with my husband, perhaps... perhaps many things would be different...

original_text: 柳梦璃：嗯……我看那女子满面怨怼……她说的，也未必全是真的……
translation: Liu Mengli: Mm... I saw that woman's face full of resentment... What she said may not be entirely true...

original_text: 琴姬：……生人已逝，真的还是假的，已无所谓了……若她令相公开开心心过完那段日子，我反倒只有说不尽的感激和惭愧……
translation: Qin Ji: ... The deceased is gone; whether it was real or fake no longer matters... If she made my husband happy during those days, I would only feel endless gratitude and shame...

original_text: 云天河：……你这么说，和我爹说过的好像……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... What you said sounds similar to what Father said...

original_text: 云天河：他说真心为一个人好，就是要让她天天高兴，就算那个人不喜欢自己，甚至根本不认识自己也没关系。
translation: Yun Tianhe: He said that truly caring for someone means making them happy every day, even if that person doesn't like you, or doesn't even know you at all.

original_text: 琴姬：……这话一点都没错……世人只盼做神仙的好，却不知心有牵挂，无论圆满不圆满，也胜过孑然一身……
translation: Qin Ji: ... That's absolutely true... People only wish for the benefits of being immortals, not knowing that having attachments, whether fulfilled or not, is better than being utterly alone...

original_text: 韩菱纱：琴姬姐姐，以后……你要去哪里呢？
translation: Han Lingsha: Sis. Qin Ji, in the future... where will you go?

original_text: 琴姬：……与琴相伴，四海为家，走到哪里便是哪里了。
translation: Qin Ji: ... I will travel the world with my qin, making my home wherever I go.

original_text: 琴姬：其实……记不清有多少次，我真想放下尘世一切，就这样随相公去了……
translation: Qin Ji: Actually... I've lost count of how many times I've truly wanted to let go of all worldly matters and just follow my husband in death...

original_text: 韩菱纱：琴姬姐姐……
translation: Han Lingsha: Sis. Qin Ji...

original_text: 琴姬：……可是，我对不起相公……我没有脸去见他……
translation: Qin Ji: ...But... I have wronged my husband... I have no face to see him...

original_text: 琴姬：我告诉自己，至少……要放下武功，尽心搜集历代的乐曲残谱，替相公了却生前心愿，或许……或许这样……他才愿意在梦中与我见上一面……
translation: Qin Ji: I told myself, at the very least... I must give up martial arts and diligently collect scattered scores of ancient music, to fulfill my husband's unfulfilled wish in life. Perhaps... perhaps then... he would be willing to meet me in a dream...

original_text: 韩菱纱：琴姬姐姐，别这样，你……
translation: Han Lingsha: Sis. Qin Ji, don't be like this, you...

original_text: 琴姬：不用担心……该怎么做，我心里很清楚……我不在相公身边的时候，他一定也很痛苦、很伤心……如今，我不过是尝到昔日的苦果，又凭什么一死以求解脱呢……
translation: Qin Ji: Don't worry... I know very well what to do... When I wasn't by my husband's side, he must have suffered and been heartbroken too... Now, I am merely tasting the bitter fruit of the past, so how can I seek relief through death...

original_text: 琴姬：……各位的热血心肠，琴姬不胜感佩，既已说过为你们歌唱一曲，自当信守诺言——
translation: Qin Ji: ...I am deeply moved by everyone's passionate sincerity. Since I promised to sing a song for you, I shall keep my word-

original_text: 柳梦璃：……细雨飘，轻风摇，凭藉痴心般情长……
translation: Liu Mengli: This lyrics... Fine rain drifts~ gentle breeze sways~ relying on infatuation~ such deep affection...

original_text: 韩菱纱：琴姬姐姐……她是用自己全部的心和命在唱这首歌啊……太悲伤了……为什么上天要让两个人有缘，却又无份……
translation: Han Lingsha: Sis. Qin Ji... She sang this song with all her heart and soul... So sorrowful... Why does fate bring two people together, yet deny them a shared destiny...

original_text: 柳梦璃：……或许人和人之间的缘份，都是注定的……等到上天要收回的时候，连一天一刻都不会多等……
translation: Liu Mengli: ... Perhaps the fate between people is all predestined... When heaven decides to take it back, not even a day or a moment will be spared...

original_text: 韩菱纱：……这样，好残忍……要我选的话，我宁可一开始就不认识那个人，也好过相识以后却要生离死别……
translation: Han Lingsha: ... That's so cruel... If I had to choose, I'd rather never have met that person than to face life-and-death separation after knowing them...

original_text: 云天河：话是这么说没错，但是……就算我们三个明天就会分开，我也不后悔认识你和梦璃。
translation: Yun Tianhe: That's true, but... Even if the three of us were to part ways tomorrow, I wouldn't regret knowing you and Mengli.

original_text: 云天河：爹说过，活着的时候要尽欢，死的时候才没有遗憾，要是因为害怕以后的事，一直避开当下的事，那活着也不会开心的，还有什么意思。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Father said, live joyfully while alive, so you have no regrets when you die. If you avoid the present because you fear the future, then living won't be happy. What's the meaning then?

original_text: 柳梦璃：……我想、我明白云叔说的……与其担心人生无常，不如多珍惜眼前时光……多珍惜和重要的人在一起的时光啊……
translation: Liu Mengli: ... I think... I understand what Uncle Yun said... Instead of worrying about life's impermanence, better to cherish the present more... Cherish the time with important people more...

original_text: 云天河：差不多吧，反正每天都要过得开心，以后想起来也就没什么遗憾了。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Pretty much. Just live happily every day, so you won't have regrets when you look back later.

original_text: 韩菱纱：……是吗？……生尽欢、死无憾……
translation: Han Lingsha: Is that so?... Live joyfully, die without regret...

original_text: 韩菱纱：……天河，醒醒！
translation: Han Lingsha: ... Tianhe, wake up!

original_text: 云天河：唔……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Hmm...

original_text: 韩菱纱：出事了！
translation: Han Lingsha: Something's wrong!

original_text: 云天河：……什么……好睏哦……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ...What... so sleepy...

original_text: 韩菱纱：……昨天，我们在千佛塔里见过的那个人……她……她自尽了……
translation: Han Lingsha: ... That person we saw in the Thousand Buddha Pagoda yesterday... she... she took her own life...

original_text: 云天河：啊？！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Huh?!

original_text: 韩菱纱：想不到……她的性情那么烈，……也许……我昨天不应该那样讲……我……我实在是……
translation: Han Lingsha: Never thought... her temper was so fierce... Maybe... I shouldn't have said those things yesterday... I... I really...
Yun Tianhe: ......

original_text: 韩菱纱：你……怎么都不说话？
translation: Han Lingsha: You... Why are you suddenly so quiet?

original_text: 云天河：……我觉得，那个女的说不定是个很了不起的人……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... I think... that woman might have been a truly remarkable person...

original_text: 韩菱纱：了不起？
translation: Han Lingsha: Remarkable?

original_text: 云天河：她……是想去陪那个男的吧？那是她自己的愿望。我爹说过，人能够按自己的愿望选择生死，不管对错，都是一件了不起的事。
translation: Yun Tianhe: She... She wants to accompany that man, right? That's her own wish. My father said that being able to choose life or death according to one's own wish, right or wrong, is a remarkable thing.

original_text: 云天河：所以我想……要是我们可怜那个女的，她大概也不会高兴……
translation: Yun Tianhe: So I thought... if we pity that woman, she probably wouldn't be happy either...

original_text: 韩菱纱：…………也许，你是对的吧……
translation: Han Lingsha: ...... Perhaps... you're right...

original_text: 韩菱纱：……她生前不一定被相公所爱，死后却一定要去争，这份心意，也很让人动容了……
translation: Han Lingsha: ... She might not have been loved by her husband in life, but she insists on contending after death. Such sentiment is also quite moving...

original_text: 韩菱纱：……不过发生了这种事，总是让人难过……一个人，昨天明明还和你说话、还会动，今天却哪里都找不到了，这样的感觉……一点都不好受……
translation: Han Lingsha: ... But when something like this happens, it's always sad... A person who was talking to you and moving around just yesterday can't be found anywhere today. That feeling... is really hard to bear...

original_text: 韩菱纱：……算了，不说了……<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>我们还是下楼去找梦璃吧，</colour><dc0>她都起来好久了。</dc0>
translation: Han Lingsha: ... Forget it, let's not talk about it...<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> We should go downstairs to find Mengli,</colour><dc0> she's been up for quite a while.</dc0>

original_text: 客人甲：听说没？城里首富家中又出大事了！
translation: Guest A: Have you heard? Something big happened again at the richest family in town!

original_text: 客人乙：你说那个秦家？！
translation: Guest B: You mean that Qin family?!

original_text: 客人甲：不然还有谁！他们家的媳妇昨夜在千佛塔里自尽了！仵作看过，说是吞毒死的！更奇怪的是，守塔的僧人都说昨天夜里有人闯进去，偏偏又讲不出贼人相貌，方丈已经决定关闭禅寺三个月，秦家的人恐怕也不会善罢甘休！
translation: Guest A: Who else could it be! Their daughter-in-law killed herself in the Thousand Buddha Pagoda last night! The coroner examined her and said she died from poison! Stranger still, the monks guarding the pagoda all said someone broke in last night, but couldn't describe the intruder's appearance. The abbot has decided to close the temple for three months, and the Qin family probably won't let this go either!

original_text: 客人乙：竟有这等事？！你又如何知道的？
translation: Guest B: Such a thing?! And how do you know about it?

original_text: 客人甲：嘿嘿，我表弟是禅寺的伙头，这事当然比别人都清楚。
translation: Guest A: Hehe, my cousin is the temple cook, so of course I know more about this than others.

original_text: 客人丙：唉，可叹世上痴情女，丈夫死后竟如此贞烈……
translation: Guest C: Alas, lamentable are the infatuated women in this world, so chaste and devoted after their husband's death...

original_text: 璇玑：——哎，那个女的好可怜哦……
translation: Xuanji: -Ah, that woman is so pitiful...

original_text: 韩菱纱：两位，想不到真的会在这里遇上，我们找你们好久了。
translation: Han Lingsha: You two, I never thought we'd really meet here. We've been looking for you for a long time.

original_text: 璇玑：找我们？难怪到哪都会遇上……你们干嘛要跟着我和师兄啊？
translation: Xuanji: Looking for us? No wonder we run into you everywhere... Why are you following me and my Martial Brother?

original_text: 怀朔：璇玑！
translation: Huaishuo: Xuanji!

original_text: 韩菱纱：没关系，其实小妹妹说的也对。
translation: Han Lingsha: It's okay, what the little sister said is actually right.

original_text: 韩菱纱：我叫韩菱纱，他叫云天河，我们特意赶来陈州，便是想拜入二位的师门！
translation: Han Lingsha: I'm Han Lingsha, he's Yun Tianhe. We came to Chenzhou specifically to join your sect!

original_text: 璇玑：什么？要入我们琼华派？！
translation: Xuanji: What? You want to join our Qionghua Sect?!

original_text: 云天河：穷华派？是啊，我最想学那招御……对了，御剑飞仙！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Qionghua Sect? Yeah, I really want to learn that move-oh right, Sword Flight move!

original_text: 璇玑：不行不行，修仙哪有你们想得那么容易！
translation: Xuanji: No way! Cultivating immortality isn't as easy as you think!

original_text: 韩菱纱：小妹妹，我们自然知道不容易，但早已下定决心了。
translation: Han Lingsha: Little sister, we naturally know it's not easy, but we've long been determined.

original_text: 璇玑：什么小妹妹，总这么喊，人家哪里小啦！
translation: Xuanji: Who's 'little sister'? Stop calling me that-I'm not little!

original_text: 韩菱纱：那……璇玑姑娘，你和你师兄能不能带我们入门拜师呢？当日在巢湖，多亏你师叔仗义相助，不然我们早成了妖怪的口粮，那之后对剑仙之风更是仰慕——
translation: Han Lingsha: Then... Miss Xuanji, could you and your Martial Brother help us enter the sect and become disciples? That day at Chao Lake, thanks to your Martial Uncle's righteous help, otherwise we would have become food for monsters. Since then, we've admired the ways of the sword immortals even more-

original_text: 璇玑：师叔？你、你不会也看上我师叔了吧？
translation: Xuanji: Martial Uncle? You, you're not also interested in my Martial Uncle, are you?

original_text: 怀朔：璇玑，怎可这样讲话！
translation: Huaishuo: Xuanji, how can you speak like that!

original_text: 怀朔：实在抱歉，小师妹她——
translation: Huaishuo: I'm really sorry, little Martial Sister she-

original_text: 韩菱纱：没什么，我们求仙是一片诚心的，更感激剑仙出手相救，怎敢有其他念头，璇玑姑娘也不过是心直口快。
translation: Han Lingsha: Nothing. Our quest for immortality is sincere, grateful for sword immortals' rescue-how dare we have other thoughts? Sister Xuanji is just outspoken.

original_text: 韩菱纱：……我见璇玑姑娘聪明伶俐，一定很得令师叔的喜爱吧？
translation: Han Lingsha: ... I see Miss Xuanji is clever and quick-witted, she must be quite favored by your Martial Uncle, right?

original_text: 璇玑：哼，算你有见识。
translation: Xuanji: Hmph, at least you have some sense.

original_text: 璇玑：……喜爱，嘻嘻～
translation: Xuanji: ...Like, hehe~

original_text: 怀朔：璇玑……
translation: Huaishuo: Xuanji...

original_text: 璇玑：师兄，不如就帮他们一把好了～师父不是常说做人要时存善念吗？反正最后能不能入门还要看他们自己。
translation: Xuanji: Martial Brother, why don't we just help them? Master often says we should always keep a kind heart. After all, whether they can join the sect in the end still depends on themselves.

original_text: 怀朔：……唉，你啊，真是个孩子。
translation: Huaishuo: ...Sigh, you, you really are a child.

original_text: 怀朔：好吧，既然三番五次有缘相遇，或许也是天意……
translation: Huaishuo: Alright, since we've met by chance repeatedly, perhaps it is also fate...

original_text: 韩菱纱：真的？！你们答应了？
translation: Han Lingsha: Really?!You agreed?

original_text: 韩菱纱：太谢谢了！
translation: Han Lingsha: Thank you so much!

original_text: 韩菱纱：天河，叫上梦璃，我们一起走吧！
translation: Han Lingsha: Tianhe, call Mengli, let's go together!

original_text: 韩菱纱：……对啊，梦璃呢？
translation: Han Lingsha: ... Right, where's Mengli?

original_text: 云天河：我也不知道，没看见她。
translation: Yun Tianhe: I don't know either, I didn't see her.

original_text: 怀朔：你们是说上回在女萝岩见过的那位姑娘？
translation: Huaishuo: You mean that lady we saw last time in Nvluo Rock?

original_text: 韩菱纱：嗯，可是她不知去哪里了……
translation: Han Lingsha: Hmm, but she's gone somewhere...

original_text: 怀朔：无妨，我和璇玑没追上紫英师叔，正要赶回门派中，不如就御剑带你们过去，费不了多少工夫。
translation: Huaishuo: It's fine. Martial Uncle Ziying and I didn't catch up, we're heading back to the sect anyway. Why don't I take you there by sword flight? It won't take much effort.

original_text: 韩菱纱：多谢。那，什么时候动身呢？
translation: Han Lingsha: Thank you. So, when do we set off?

original_text: 怀朔：待那位姑娘来了，<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>你们就到城门口去吧，</colour><dc0>我和璇玑在那儿等着。</dc0>
translation: Huaishuo: Once that young lady arrives,<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> you should head to the city gate,</colour><dc0> Xuanji and I will be waiting there.</dc0>

original_text: 韩菱纱：好！
translation: Han Lingsha: Good!

original_text: 韩菱纱：……想不到竟然会这样顺利。
translation: Han Lingsha: ... I never thought it would go so smoothly.

original_text: 柳梦璃：菱纱、云公子。
translation: Liu Mengli: Lingsha, Yun.

original_text: 韩菱纱：好梦璃，你到底跑哪去了？
translation: Han Lingsha: My dear Mengli, where on earth did you run off to?

original_text: 柳梦璃：我见你们迟迟不下来，就去买了些香……
translation: Liu Mengli: Seeing you delayed, I went to buy some incense...

original_text: 韩菱纱：那，我们快些<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>去城门口找怀朔师兄妹吧</colour><dc0>～</dc0>
translation: Han Lingsha: Well then, let's quickly<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> go to the city gate to find Huaishuo and his Martial Sister</colour><dc0>~</dc0>

original_text: 柳梦璃：你们，已经见过面了？
translation: Liu Mengli: You two... have already met?

original_text: 云天河：是啊，那个人是好人～答应带我们飞去仙山。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Yeah, that person is a good person~ Promised to fly us to the immortal mountain.
Liu Mengli: ......

original_text: 韩菱纱：怎么了？你好像一点都不高兴呢。
translation: Han Lingsha: What's wrong? You don't seem happy at all.

original_text: 柳梦璃：我……只是想到这两天发生的事，心里总是不舒坦……
translation: Liu Mengli: I... It's just that thinking about what happened these past two days, I feel uneasy...

original_text: 韩菱纱：……别再想了……昨晚你不是已经说过了吗？我们都要珍惜当下，在一起时就要开开心心的，别辜负了来世上走一遭。
translation: Han Lingsha: ... Stop thinking about it... Didn't you already say last night? We should cherish the present, be happy when we're together, and not waste our time in this world.

original_text: 柳梦璃：嗯……
translation: Liu Mengli: Mm...

original_text: 柳梦璃：刚才为等我耽搁了，实在过意不去。
translation: Liu Mengli: Sorry for making you wait earlier, I really feel bad.

original_text: 怀朔：姑娘多礼了。其实倒没耽搁什么，我也正好陪璇玑去买糖葫芦——
translation: Huaishuo: You're too polite, miss. Actually, it didn't delay anything. I was just accompanying Xuanji to buy sugar-coated haws-

original_text: 璇玑：师～兄～～
translation: Xuanji: Martial~ Brother~~

original_text: 璇玑：这么丢脸的事不要拿出来说嘛～
translation: Xuanji: Don't bring up such embarrassing things~

original_text: 怀朔：好～不说不说。
translation: Huaishuo: Okay~ I won't say anything.

original_text: 怀朔：诸位，本派虽距陈州有万里之遥，但以御剑术一盏茶的工夫即可到了，只不过我与师妹只得两把佩剑，这么多人怕是不行，所以想借云兄弟的佩剑一用。
translation: Huaishuo: Everyone, though our sect is far from Chenzhou, we can reach it in the time it takes to drink tea via sword flight. However, my Martial Sister and I only have two swords, insufficient for all. May we borrow Brother Yun's sword?

original_text: 云天河：好啊，你拿去。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Okay, you take it.

original_text: 怀朔：……！！这把剑造型十分特异……
translation: Huaishuo: ...!! This sword has a very unique design...

original_text: 云天河：唔，我以前也不觉得，爹把剑给了我以后，我就一直用它了，下山后见的多了，才知道它确实和其他剑长得不太一样……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Hmm, I never thought so before. After Dad gave me the sword, I've always used it. Only after coming down the mountain and seeing more did I realize it really does look different from other swords...

original_text: 璇玑：师兄，这剑怪模怪样，连剑格都没有，和寻常的样子差太多了，说不定铸它的人只是想哗众取宠……
translation: Xuanji: This sword looks weird, without even a guard, so different from the usual style. Maybe the person who forged it just wanted to show off...

original_text: 怀朔：这……倒也不能妄下定论…… 此剑灵力强大，并且其中蕴有巨大寒气……
translation: Huaishuo: This... can't be rashly concluded... This sword's spiritual power is immense, and it contains tremendous cold energy...

original_text: 怀朔：云兄弟难道没有察觉？平日使剑不会被寒气伤身？
translation: Huaishuo: Brother Yun, haven't you noticed? Normally wielding the sword doesn't harm you with its cold energy?

original_text: 云天河：伤身？没有啊，这剑我耍着玩好久了。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Harm me? No, I've been playing with this sword for fun for a long time.

original_text: 韩菱纱：这野人身体强壮、四肢发达，那点寒气对他来说不算什么吧……
translation: Han Lingsha: This barbarian is strong and sturdy, that bit of cold probably doesn't mean much to him...

original_text: 怀朔：……这便奇了，莫非云兄弟修炼了何种高深的内功或法术？
translation: Huaishuo: ...That's strange. Could Brother Yun have cultivated some profound internal art or spell?

original_text: 云天河：没啊。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Not really.

original_text: 韩菱纱：他最擅长猎野猪还有吃饭，其他都不会。
translation: Han Lingsha: He's best at hunting wild boars and eating; nothing else.

original_text: 韩菱纱：（哼！讽刺你一下。）
translation: Han Lingsha: (Hmph! A little jab at you.)

original_text: 云天河：对对对！还是菱纱知道我。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Right, right, right! Lingsha knows me best.

original_text: 韩菱纱：（……白痴……讽刺你一点用都没有……）
translation: Han Lingsha: (...Idiot... Sarcasm is completely lost on you...)

original_text: 柳梦璃：如此说来，这是一把很不同寻常的宝剑？
translation: Liu Mengli: So, this is an exceptionally unusual sword?

original_text: 怀朔：不错。
translation: Huaishuo: Indeed.

original_text: 韩菱纱：……有的时候是怪怪的，可平时也不见它特别厉害呐……
translation: Han Lingsha: ... Sometimes it's weird, but usually it doesn't seem particularly powerful either...

original_text: 云天河：这剑我从小就用，也没啥特别，前些日子突然变得有点怪……威力大了些，摸起来更冰凉，夏天用最好，呵呵。
translation: Yun Tianhe: I've used this sword since I was little, and it's nothing special. But recently, it's started acting a bit strange... more powerful, colder to the touch-perfect for summer use, hehe.

original_text: 韩菱纱：（真是糟蹋宝贝……）
translation: Han Lingsha: (What a waste of a treasure...)

original_text: 怀朔：姑且不论此剑，即便宝剑有灵，所持之人也要有与之匹配的力量方可激发，否则人不可役剑，剑无以护人，也是无可奈何的事。
translation: Huaishuo: Regardless of the sword itself, even if a precious sword possesses a spirit, the wielder must have matching strength to awaken it. Otherwise, the person cannot command the sword, and the sword cannot protect the person-such is the inevitable reality.

original_text: 韩菱纱：哦～听着就很有道理，不愧是修仙练剑的人。
translation: Han Lingsha: Oh~ That sounds very reasonable, as expected from someone who cultivates immortality and swordsmanship.

original_text: 怀朔：云兄弟，令尊可是一位高人前辈？
translation: Huaishuo: Brother Yun, was your honored father a senior master?

original_text: 云天河：令尊？……啥东西？
translation: Yun Tianhe: 'Your honored father'? ...What thing?

original_text: 韩菱纱：哎，就是你爹……
translation: Han Lingsha: Hey, it's your father...

original_text: 云天河：哦，爹就是爹，不是其他什么人，不过我知道他很了不起的～呵呵。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Oh, Father is just Father, not someone else. But I know he was amazing~ Hehe.

original_text: 怀朔：……可惜我相剑之术所学不精，看不透此剑深浅。
translation: Huaishuo: ...It's a pity my sword appraisal skills are not refined enough, I cannot discern the depth of this sword.

original_text: 怀朔：罢了……我们即刻起程吧，青冥之中务必要心无杂念，不然——
translation: Huaishuo: Enough... Let's set off immediately. In the azure void, you must clear your mind of distractions, otherwise-

original_text: 璇玑：不然从天上掉下来，我和师兄可不管哦，嘻～
translation: Xuanji: Otherwise, if you fall from the sky, my Martial Brother and I won't care, hehe~

original_text: 怀朔：你啊……
translation: Huaishuo: You...

original_text: 云天河：该去<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>千佛塔</colour><dc0>打坏人了！</dc0>
translation: Yun Tianhe: Time to go to<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> Thousand Buddha Pagoda</colour><dc0>to fight the bad guys!</dc0>

original_text: 韩菱纱：不出城了……<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>先在城里找到云天河</colour><dc0>那个野人！</dc0>
translation: Han Lingsha: Not leaving the city...<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> First, find that barbarian Yun Tianhe in the city</colour><dc0>!</dc0>

original_text: 云天河：这是什么？上面有画、还有字，不过画的不是菱纱了……
translation: Yun Tianhe: What's this? There are pictures and words, but it's not a picture of Lingsha anymore...

original_text: 韩菱纱：天河，在看什么呢？我瞧瞧～
translation: Han Lingsha: Tianhe, what are you looking at? Let me see~

original_text: 韩菱纱：芙蓉转圈舞蹈处，左摇右摆好似鸭。挥袖扭腰真窈窕，看得我心花怒放……
translation: Han Lingsha: Where the hibiscus twirls and dances, swaying left and right like a duck. Sleeves fluttering, waist twisting, truly graceful-makes my heart bloom with joy...

original_text: 韩菱纱：哈、哈哈～～太好笑了，哪有人这样写诗的？“左摇右摆好似鸭”，到底是在夸人还是在损人啊？还有这个……难道就是那个“芙蓉”？
translation: Han Lingsha: Ha, haha~~ That's too funny, who writes poetry like this? 'Swaying left and right like a duck'-is that praising or insulting someone? And this... could this be that 'hibiscus'?

original_text: ？？：好大胆子！竟敢嘲笑本少爷的墨宝！
translation: ???: How bold! You dare mock this young master's calligraphy!

original_text: 韩菱纱：墨～～宝～～？在哪里？
translation: Han Lingsha: Calli~~graphy~~? Where is it?

original_text: ？？：可恶！你们不是刚刚才拜读过！
translation: ??: Damn it! Didn't you just pay your respects!

original_text: 韩菱纱：……不是吧？你说马车背后贴的这张纸？
translation: Han Lingsha: ... No way? You mean this paper stuck on the back of the carriage?

original_text: ？？：当然！本少爷的卓然文采一定要公布出来，让全城的人都能看到！
translation: ??: Of course! This young master's exceptional literary talent must be displayed for all the city to see!
Han Lingsha: ...... ... ...

original_text: 韩菱纱：天河，我们走吧，我想起还有些东西要买呢。
translation: Han Lingsha: Tianhe, let's go. I just remembered there are some things I need to buy.

original_text: 云天河：哦，好。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Oh, okay.
??: Wait a moment!!

original_text: ？？：你竟然小瞧我！告诉你们，我爹当年金榜题名，连中三元，如今官拜礼部尚书！虽然我景阳现下没有功名，可谁人不知本少爷是陈州第一才子？！
translation: ???: How dare you look down on me! Let me tell you, my father topped the imperial examinations back in the day, achieving the highest honors in all three levels, and now he serves as the Minister of Rites! Although I, Jing Yang, currently hold no official rank, who in Chenzhou doesn't know that I am the number one talented scholar?!

original_text: 韩菱纱：姓景？又是礼部尚书？……难道你爹是景桓、景大人？
translation: Han Lingsha: Surname Jing? And the Minister of Rites? ... Could your father be Jing Huan, Lord Jing?

original_text: 景阳：哈哈，没错，看不出你还有点见识，知道我爹大名～～
translation: Jing Yang: Haha, that's right. I didn't expect you to have some insight, knowing my father's great name~~

original_text: 韩菱纱：喂，我说小少爷，你爹又不是你，你的那点本事就不要拿出来显摆了好不好～要是这也算陈州第一才子，那我还是中原第一美少女呢……
translation: Han Lingsha: Hey, I say, little master, you are not your father, so don't show off your meager skills, okay? If this counts as Chenzhou's top scholar, then I'm the Central Plains' number one beauty!

original_text: 景阳：你！可恶！什么中原第一美少女，你敢与我拼一拼诗文吗？！
translation: Jing Yang: You! How dare! What 'Central Plains' number one beauty', dare to compete with me in poetry?!

original_text: 韩菱纱：少来，我没空陪小孩子玩。
translation: Han Lingsha: No way, I don't have time to play with kids.

original_text: 景阳：胆小鬼！你怕了——
translation: Jing Yang: Coward! You're scared-

original_text: 仆人：少爷！你在哪里？夫人说我们要走了！
translation: Servant: Young master! Where are you? Mistress says we're leaving!

original_text: 景阳：……哼，娘在找我，今日就算了，下回再比试！
translation: Jing Yang: ...Hmph, my mother is looking for me. Let's call it off today; we'll compete another time!

original_text: 韩菱纱：真是无聊的小鬼，写那么乱七八糟的诗，谁答应要和他比了……
translation: Han Lingsha: What a silly kid, writing such a messy poem. Who agreed to compete with him...

original_text: 云天河：那几句话是他写的？我觉得还挺有趣的～
translation: Yun Tianhe: He wrote those lines? I think they're quite interesting~

original_text: 韩菱纱：嘻，有趣是有趣，刚看到时简直笑死我了。哎，枉费景大人这样一位治世能臣，他的儿子却是个绣花枕头……
translation: Han Lingsha: Hehe, it's amusing, alright-I nearly died laughing when I first saw it. Ah, such a waste-Lord Jing, a capable minister governing the world, yet his son is just a pretty face...

original_text: 云天河：哦……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Oh...

original_text: 韩菱纱：别哦了，陪我去买点东西吧～<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>改天有空再来看看这小少爷</colour><dc0>，到底有没有成为陈州第一才子～</dc0>
translation: Han Lingsha: Stop 'oh-ing', come with me to buy some stuff~<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> We'll come back another day to see if this young master</colour><dc0> really becomes Chenzhou's top scholar~</dc0>

original_text: 少女：那个是“小鸡啄米图”？鸡是长这样吗？
translation: Young Girl: That's 'Chick Pecking Rice'? Do chickens look like that?

original_text: 少年：这座亭子上压着一块大石头，亭子怎么没塌呀？哈哈哈！好奇怪！
translation: Youth: This pavilion has a big rock pressing on it, why hasn't it collapsed? Hahaha! So strange!

original_text: 书生：待我看看～“芙蓉转圈舞蹈处，左摇右摆好似鸭”……不妥、不妥！玉芙蓉的舞姿窈窕婀娜，怎能用笨拙的“鸭”来比拟？这、这分明是在侮辱玉芙蓉姑娘！！
translation: Scholar: Let me see~ 'Where the hibiscus twirls and dances, swaying left and right like a duck'... No good, no good! Lady Yufurong's dance is graceful and elegant, how can it be compared to a clumsy 'duck'? This, this is clearly an insult to Lady Yufurong!!

original_text: 景阳：你们不买就走开！不要在这里挡我做生意！
translation: Jing Yang: If you're not buying, then move along! Don't block my business here!

original_text: 少年：哈哈，骗人！这摊子摆了好几天，卖出过一幅画吗？
translation: Youth: Haha, liar! This stall has been set up for days, have you sold a single painting?

original_text: 景阳：你、你胡说……本少爷是陈州第一才子，我的字画怎会没人买！
translation: Jing Yang: You... you're talking nonsense! This young master is Chenzhou's top scholar. How could my calligraphy and paintings not sell!

original_text: 云天河：那个……我能用钱换你的画吗？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Can I trade money for your painting?

original_text: 景阳：你看中我的墨宝？果然有眼光！
translation: Jing Yang: You fancy my calligraphy? You truly have good taste!

original_text: 景阳：说吧！到底是哪一幅？
translation: Jing Yang: Speak! Which one exactly is it?

original_text: 云天河：唔，就是这个，芙蓉跳舞的这张～
translation: Yun Tianhe: Mmm, this one, the one with the hibiscus dancing~

original_text: 书生：怎、怎可能……如此拙劣的字画竟会有人赏识？而我十年苦读，所著之书居然未有知音，真是苍天无眼呐！
translation: Scholar: H-how is this possible... Such crude calligraphy and paintings actually have admirers? Yet after ten years of diligent study, my writings find no kindred spirits. Heaven truly has no eyes!

original_text: 景阳：哈，英雄所见略同，这也是我最为得意之作呢。我忍痛割爱，就卖……卖二十文钱好了。
translation: Jing Yang: Ha, great minds think alike. This is also my most proud work. Reluctantly parting with it, I'll sell it for... for twenty wen.

original_text: 云天河：二十文？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Twenty wen?

original_text: 云天河：（那是多少？我算算先……）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (How much is that? Let me calculate first...)

original_text: 景阳：是不是嫌多？那……十五文也可以，或者十文——
translation: Jing Yang: Is it too much? Then... fifteen wen is fine too, or ten wen-

original_text: 韩菱纱：在卖什么东西呀？掉价掉得这样厉害？
translation: Han Lingsha: What are you selling? Discounted so heavily?

original_text: 云天河：菱纱，你快来～上回你说很有趣的那幅画，我买下来送给你～
translation: Yun Tianhe: Lingsha, come quick~ Last time you said that painting was interesting, I bought it to give to you~

original_text: 韩菱纱：嘻，什么有趣的画？
translation: Han Lingsha: Heh, what interesting painting?

original_text: 韩菱纱：“芙蓉转圈舞蹈处，左摇右摆好似鸭”……这、这不是那首蠢蠢的诗？怎么到哪都看见……
translation: Han Lingsha: 'Where the hibiscus twirls and dances, swaying left and right like a duck'... This, isn't this that silly poem? Why do I see it everywhere...

original_text: 景阳：你、你是那个冒牌的中原第一美少女！
translation: Jing Yang: You, you're that fake 'Number One Beauty of the Central Plains'!

original_text: 韩菱纱：哦～原来是任性的景大才子，这一次又在玩什么？难道是要全城的人都来买你字画、见识见识你的文采？
translation: Han Lingsha: Oh~ So it's the willful genius Jing. What game this time? Getting the whole city to buy your calligraphy and admire your talent?

original_text: 景阳：要、要你管！
translation: Jing Yang: N-none of your business!

original_text: 韩菱纱：不管、不管～
translation: Han Lingsha: Don't care, don't care~

original_text: 韩菱纱：天河，走啦，这画虽然有趣，但我又不喜欢，不买了。
translation: Han Lingsha: Tianhe, let's go. This painting is interesting, but I don't like it, so I'm not buying it.

original_text: 景阳：不买？不行，说好了的，你一定要买！
translation: Jing Yang: Not buying? No way, we agreed, you have to buy it!

original_text: 韩菱纱：哪有这道理？又没银货两讫，刚才还在讲价呢。
translation: Han Lingsha: That's not how it works! The deal's not done yet, we were still haggling just now.

original_text: 书生：做生意竟有如此强买强卖的……
translation: Scholar: How is doing business with such forced buying and selling?...

original_text: 少女：是啊，那种字画送我也不要……
translation: Young Girl: Yeah, I wouldn't even want that kind of calligraphy or painting as a gift...

original_text: 景阳：你们……你们都走开！
translation: Jing Yang: You... all of you, go away!

original_text: 书生：散了、散了，留下也是无趣。
translation: Scholar: Scatter, scatter, staying is pointless.

original_text: 景阳：……你，真的不买了？不再想想？
translation: Jing Yang: ...You, really not buying? Won't reconsider?

original_text: 巧婶：少爷！我说少爷啊，你……你怎么又跑来这里卖字画？
translation: Aunt Qiao: Young master! I say, young master, you... why are you selling calligraphy and paintings here again?

original_text: 景阳：巧婶？……你来干嘛？
translation: Jing Yang: Aunt Qiao? ...What are you doing here?

original_text: 巧婶：唉，少爷，你这不是让我和夫人心里难过吗？你从小过得娇贵，怎么吃得起这种苦？
translation: Aunt Qiao: Sigh, young master, aren't you making Madam and me feel terrible? You've lived so delicately since childhood, how can you endure such hardship?

original_text: 景阳：谁说不行？我可以的！要是……要是这笔生意谈成了，至少能赚到十文钱……不，一文也好，攒下来给爹买药！
translation: Jing Yang: Who says I can't? I can do it! If... if this deal goes through, I could earn at least ten wen... no, even one wen would be good, saved up to buy medicine for father!

original_text: 景阳：你回去吧，你出来找我，娘一个人要照顾爹，忙不过来的。
translation: Jing Yang: You should go back. If you come out to find me, Mother will have to take care of Father alone and won't manage.

original_text: 巧婶：……少爷……
translation: Aunt Qiao: ...Young master...

original_text: 景阳：走！你走啊。
translation: Jing Yang: Go! You go away.

original_text: 巧婶：……唉，那我先回去帮夫人了，少爷你也早点回来，夫人她会担心……
translation: Aunt Qiao: ...Sigh, I'll go back and help Madam first. Young Master, you should come back early too, Madam will worry...

original_text: 韩菱纱：喂……景少爷，你爹不是礼部尚书吗？怎么会——
translation: Han Lingsha: Hey... Young Master Jing, isn't your father the Minister of Rites? How could-

original_text: 景阳：我爹当然是礼部尚书！他是最好的官，从来不收贿赂的！他、他被右丞相陷害，丢了官，还生了大病……
translation: Jing Yang: My father is indeed the Minister of Rites! He's the best official, never taking bribes! He... he was framed by the Right Chancellor, lost his post, and fell gravely ill...

original_text: 云天河：你爹生病了？那一定要赶快治，治不好的话就会像我爹那样……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Your father is sick? Then you must treat him quickly. If it can't be cured, he'll end up like my father...

original_text: 景阳：……大夫开出来的方子……那上面的药都很贵，家里已经没多少钱了，能卖的也卖差不多了……
translation: Jing Yang: ...The prescription the doctor wrote... the medicines on it are very expensive. The family is almost out of money, and we've sold almost everything we can...

original_text: 韩菱纱：所以，你才想卖字画、赚钱给你爹抓药？
translation: Han Lingsha: So, that's why you want to sell calligraphy and paintings, earn money for your dad's medicine?

original_text: 景阳：……哼，你、你尽管笑话我好了！
translation: Jing Yang: ...Hmph, you, you can laugh at me all you want!

original_text: 韩菱纱：我干嘛要笑话你？好啦，我承认刚才嘲笑你是我不对，要是……我说有办法帮你呢？
translation: Han Lingsha: Why would I laugh at you? Fine, I admit mocking you was wrong. What if... I said I have a way to help you?

original_text: 景阳：帮我？……我才不要别人施舍！
translation: Jing Yang: Help me? ...I don't want anyone's charity!

original_text: 韩菱纱：少爷脾气还真不小，我又没说要施舍你，是借你钱，有借就要有还，懂吗？
translation: Han Lingsha: Quite the young master's temper! I never said I'd give you charity-it's a loan. A loan means you have to repay in future, got it?

original_text: 景阳：……真的吗？
translation: Jing Yang: ...Really?

original_text: 景阳：可是……我爹的病不是一点点钱就能治好的……
translation: Jing Yang: But... my father's illness cannot be cured with just a little money...

original_text: 韩菱纱：这你不用担心，<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>尽管和我去宝气钱庄取钱好了</colour><dc0>。要是单靠卖字画赚钱，你想想，又得卖到何年何月啊？</dc0>
translation: Han Lingsha: Don't worry about that,<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> just come with me to Baoqi Bank to get the money</colour><dc0>. If we only relied on selling calligraphy and paintings to earn money, think about it, how many years would that take?</dc0>

original_text: 景阳：我…………好，我这就去钱庄！信你一回，哼，大不了被骗，也没什么损失……
translation: Jing Yang: I... alright, I'll go to the bank right now! I'll trust you this once, hmph. At worst, I get cheated; it's not much of a loss...

original_text: 韩菱纱：可恶……对好心帮他的人就是这种态度？这脾气不改，很容易得罪人的好不好？
translation: Han Lingsha: Damn it... Is that your way to treat someone trying to help you? With that temper, you'll easily offend people, you know?

original_text: 云天河：菱纱，你要是不喜欢那个人，干嘛还帮他？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Lingsha, if you don't like that person, why help him?

original_text: 韩菱纱：哎，他那样也不算什么啦，就是个任性少爷，从小到大没吃过什么苦头，但至少还有一份孝心。
translation: Han Lingsha: Ah, he's not that bad really. Just a spoiled young master who's never suffered much growing up, but at least he has some filial piety.

original_text: 韩菱纱：……再说，我也不是为他……他爹景大人真的是个清官、好官……
translation: Han Lingsha: ... Besides, it's not for him... His father, Lord Jing, truly was an honest official, a good official...

original_text: 云天河：清官？……不懂，总之他爹是好人对吧？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Honest official? ...Don't get it, but his dad is a good person, right?

original_text: 韩菱纱：嗯，你说的没错。好人怎么能不救？所以既然这事被我遇上了，一定要管！
translation: Han Lingsha: Hmm, you're right. How can we not save a good person? Since I've encountered this, I must intervene!

original_text: 韩菱纱：掌柜的～麻烦帮我换成一百两的票面。
translation: Han Lingsha: Shopkeeper~ Please exchange this for hundred-tael notes.

original_text: 曾福达：好，姑娘稍等，待我点一下。
translation: Zeng Fuda: Alright, miss, please wait a moment while I check.

original_text: 景阳：原来，你真的有钱……
translation: Jing Yang: So, you really have money...

original_text: 曾福达：是啊，没想到这位姑娘年纪轻轻，却是身家不菲。
translation: Zeng Fuda: Yes, who would have thought this young lady, despite her youth, is quite wealthy.

original_text: 曾福达：姑娘你收好，一张一百，一共五张，就是五百两～
translation: Zeng Fuda: Miss, keep it safe. One hundred each, five in total, that's five hundred taels~

original_text: 景阳：五百两？！
translation: Jing Yang: Five hundred taels?!

original_text: 韩菱纱：这些钱你拿着，给你爹买药，剩下的可以买些吃穿，但是记住哦～千万不许挥霍浪费，再有多下来的，宁可去救济其他人。
translation: Han Lingsha: Take this money for your father's medicine. Use the rest for food and clothing, but remember~ never waste it extravagantly. If there's any left, better to help others in need.

original_text: 景阳：……就算是借的，你、你为什么要平白无故给我这么多钱？
translation: Jing Yang: ...Even if it's borrowed, why would you give me so much money for no reason?

original_text: 云天河：对啊，菱纱说过，一千文钱是一两银子，那五百两就是……就是……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Right, Lingsha said 1,000 wen equals one tael of silver. So 500 taels is... is...

original_text: 云天河：总之～菱纱，你真的有好多好多文钱！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Anyway~ Lingsha, you really have a lot, a lot of money!

original_text: 韩菱纱：嘻嘻，我平日也算出入宝山，当然不能空手而归。
translation: Han Lingsha: Hehe, I usually enter treasure mountains, of course I can't leave empty-handed.

original_text: 韩菱纱：那些东西换成了银子，一时也用不上，就先存着，有人需要帮忙时就拿出来，也不用四处筹钱了～
translation: Han Lingsha: Those things exchanged for silver aren't needed for now, so I'll save them. When someone needs help, I can take them out without having to raise funds everywhere~

original_text: 景阳：……爹以前说做好事会有好报，可是他病倒以后，没有一个亲戚愿意借钱给我们……娘说……不会有人无缘无故对我们好的……
translation: Jing Yang: ...My father used to say doing good deeds brings good rewards, but after he fell ill, not a single relative was willing to lend us money... Mother said... no one would be good to us for no reason...

original_text: 景阳：你，要我怎么报答——
translation: Jing Yang: You, how should I repay you-

original_text: 韩菱纱：我说小少爷，你才几岁，哪来这么多功利的想法呀？别说你现在一文不名，就算富可敌国，我也没什么稀罕的。
translation: Han Lingsha: I say, young master, how old are you to have such utilitarian thoughts? Never mind you're penniless now-even if you were as rich as a nation, I wouldn't care.

original_text: 韩菱纱：反正钱财如那个什么土啦，生不带来、死不带去的，哪比得上活生生一条人命重要？
translation: Han Lingsha: Anyway, money is like dirt or something, you don't bring it at birth or take it at death. How can it compare to a living person's life?

original_text: 景阳：可是……你我萍水相逢，并没有什么交情，你却对我、对我——
translation: Jing Yang: But... we've just met by chance, with no real friendship. Yet you, towards me, towards me-

original_text: 景阳：难道说！……本少爷才貌双全，你一早就对我芳心暗许？
translation: Jing Yang: Could it be!... Since I am talented and handsome, you've secretly admired me all along?

original_text: 韩菱纱：什么什么什么？！我对你？！
translation: Han Lingsha: What what what?! I... admire... you?!

original_text: 景阳：哈哈，我明白了，你叫“菱纱”是吗？
translation: Jing Yang: Haha, I get it, your name is 'Lingsha', right?

original_text: 景阳：我会记住！看在今日这份患难之情的份上，日后我一定会明媒正娶，让你嫁给我，作正房夫人！就算你年纪大了些，又是江湖草莽，我也绝不会让你受半点委屈的！
translation: Jing Yang: I'll remember! For our bond forged in hardship today, I promise to marry you properly as my first wife! Even if you're older and a rough wanderer, I'll never let you suffer any grievance!

original_text: 韩菱纱：你～说～什～么？！
translation: Han Lingsha: Wh-a-t- d-i-d- y-o-u- s-a-y?!

original_text: 云天河：菱纱你要嫁他？就是以后一直都在一起？那我怎么办？就没人陪我玩了……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Lingsha, you're marrying him? That means being together forever? Then what about me? No one will play with me anymore...

original_text: 韩菱纱：你给我闭嘴啦！少来添乱！
translation: Han Lingsha: You shut up! Stop making things worse!

original_text: 韩菱纱：臭小鬼！你你你、你到底是吃什么长大的？！想法乱七八糟！
translation: Han Lingsha: Brat! How on earth did you grow up?! Your thoughts are all over the place!

original_text: 韩菱纱：姑娘我才看不上你！五百两银子以十年为限，利五十，到时候你要连本带利还给我！听到没有？！
translation: Han Lingsha: I don't fancy you at all! Five hundred taels of silver, ten-year term, interest of fifty taels. You'll pay me back principal and interest by then! Hear that?!

original_text: 景阳：哈，菱纱你别这样，我娘说姑娘家就是喜欢口是心非，十年后你来城外龙湖西岸的景家找我，我一定不搬家！
translation: Jing Yang: Ha, Lingsha, don't be like that. My mother says girls like to say one thing and mean another. Come find the Jing family on the west shore of Dragon Lake outside the city in ten years. I definitely won't move away!

original_text: 景阳：至于那些银子，不成问题，我九岁时算命，道士说景家由我开始，往后数代之中必有一人会成为蜀中巨富～区区五百两银子，不足挂齿！
translation: Jing Yang: As for that silver, it's no problem. When I was nine, a fortune-teller said starting with me, one among the Jing family descendants would become a great tycoon in Shu. A mere five hundred taels of silver is nothing to mention!

original_text: 景阳：就这么说定啰～这块宝玉就送给你当定情信物，平时想我的话，也可以来看看我呀～
translation: Jing Yang: It's settled then~ I'll give you this precious jade as a token of affection. If you miss me, you can come visit me~

original_text: 曾福达：唉～想不到本钱庄竟会成为小儿女私定终生的地方……不行，我得找个读书人把这事记下来，日后定会传为一段佳话啊。
translation: Zeng Fuda: Ah~ To think my Bank would become a place for young lovers to pledge their lives... No, I must find a scholar to record this. It will surely become a beautiful tale passed down through the ages.

original_text: 韩菱纱：……早知道……早知道我就不给他钱了，那个臭小鬼根本脑袋有问题！
translation: Han Lingsha: ...If I had known... if I had known, I wouldn't have given him money. That brat clearly has something wrong with his head!

original_text: 韩菱纱：我又不指望他还钱，可他竟然要把还钱的日子拖到下辈子、下下辈子、下下下辈子！谁知道他们家到哪一代才会出什么蜀中巨富……
translation: Han Lingsha: I don't expect him to repay the money, but he actually wants to postpone repayment to the next life, the life after that, and the life after that! Who knows which generation of his family will produce some wealthy magnate in Shu...

original_text: 云天河：菱纱，你、你不会真的要嫁给他吧？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Lingsha, you, you're not really going to marry him, are you?

original_text: 韩菱纱：没有啦！我都快气死了，你别再气我了……
translation: Han Lingsha: Not at all! I'm already furious, don't make me angrier...

original_text: 云天河：我不想气你啊，我只是问问……
translation: Yun Tianhe: I don't want to upset you, I was just asking...

original_text: 云天河：房子里面，应该已经没有人了……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Inside the house, there probably isn't anyone left...

original_text: 钟伯：……那告示在路边贴了也有将近九年了，渐渐无人问津，没想到还有柳姑娘这样的有心人，特地来一趟，这份心意老朽真是感激不尽呐。
translation: Uncle Zhong: ...That notice has been posted by the roadside for nearly nine years, gradually forgotten. I never expected someone like Miss Liu to remember and make a special visit. This kindness truly moves this old man.

original_text: 柳梦璃：钟伯伯，您别这么说，我只不过略通法术，也不晓得能不能帮上忙……
translation: Liu Mengli: Uncle Zhong, please don't say that. I only know a little magic. I'm not sure if I can be of any help...

original_text: 钟伯：唉，无论如何，或许都是小姐的命了，谁也不知上天到底是怎样安排的……
translation: Uncle Zhong: Ah, no matter what, perhaps it's all the young lady's fate. Who knows how Heaven truly arranges things...

original_text: 柳梦璃：嗯……不知欧阳姑娘现在何处？
translation: Liu Mengli: I wonder where Miss Ouyang is now?

original_text: 钟伯：请跟我来。
translation: Uncle Zhong: Please follow me.

original_text: 云天河：梦璃，你要去哪？有什么事吗？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Mengli, where are you going? Is something wrong?

original_text: 柳梦璃：是云公子，你来得正巧……
translation: Liu Mengli: It's Yun, you've come at just the right time...

original_text: 钟伯：这位——
translation: Uncle Zhong: This-

original_text: 柳梦璃：钟伯，他是我朋友，也是身怀异能之人，方便的话，能否让他一起见一见欧阳姑娘呢？
translation: Liu Mengli: Uncle Zhong, he is my friend and also possesses extraordinary abilities. If convenient, could you allow him to meet Miss Ouyang together?

original_text: 钟伯：不妨事的，便请这位公子也进屋吧。
translation: Uncle Zhong: It's no trouble, please invite this young master inside as well.

original_text: 柳梦璃：云公子，这家的小姐似乎生了很不寻常的病，我虽不懂医术，却也想略尽绵薄之力。云公子也一起来帮忙吧。
translation: Liu Mengli: Yun, the young lady of this house seems to have a very unusual illness. Though I don't know medicine, I'd like to offer my humble help. Yun, please come assist too.

original_text: 云天河：帮忙？好、好啊，可是要怎么帮？我也不会替人看病啊……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Help? Okay, okay, but how to help? I don't know how to treat people either...

original_text: 柳梦璃：或许……那根本不是病，我看了告示所言，心中已经有些计量，但总要见过欧阳小姐才知道自己猜的对不对……
translation: Liu Mengli: Perhaps... it's not an illness at all. After reading the notice, I already have some ideas in mind, but I must meet Miss Ouyang to know if my guess is correct...

original_text: 云天河：好，那我们一起去见她，你要我怎么帮忙，尽管说就是！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Alright, let's go see her together. Just tell me how I can help, and I'll do it!

original_text: 钟伯：这便是我家小姐了……唉，她这样昏迷不醒也有九年了，各方名医看过都束手无策……奇怪的是，这么久了，小姐的容貌一点都不见老去……
translation: Uncle Zhong: This is my young lady... Sigh, she has been unconscious like this for nine years. Famous doctors from all over have seen her but are helpless... Strangely, after all this time, the young lady's appearance hasn't aged at all...
Liu Mengli: ...!!

original_text: 柳梦璃：果然如我所想，她这样不是生病，而是睡着了，这些年来一直都在梦中……
translation: Liu Mengli: Just as I thought, her condition isn't an illness but sleep. All these years, she has been in a dream...

original_text: 钟伯：睡着？可是，小姐怎么会一睡就是九年？！
translation: Uncle Zhong: Asleep? But how could the young lady sleep for nine years straight?!

original_text: 云天河：她是不是太累了，才睡那么久不醒？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Is she too tired, sleeping so long without waking?

original_text: 柳梦璃：她被人施了咒术，只要咒术不解，便会一直昏睡下去……
translation: Liu Mengli: She's been cursed. As long as the curse isn't lifted, she'll remain in a deep sleep...

original_text: 钟伯：咒术！天啊，难道自从老爷暴毙，这个家就被妖魔缠上了？！为什么连小姐也……
translation: Uncle Zhong: Curses! Heavens, has this household been haunted by demons since our master's sudden death?! Why even the young mistress...

original_text: 钟伯：柳姑娘，既然你知道小姐是被人害的，请你一定要救救她！老朽求你了！
translation: Uncle Zhong: Miss Liu, since you know my young lady was harmed by someone, you must save her! This old man begs you!

original_text: 柳梦璃：钟伯你莫要着急，我现在就施法进入她的梦中，看看究竟是怎样一回事。
translation: Liu Mengli: Uncle Zhong, don't worry. I'll cast a spell now to enter her dream and see what's really going on.

original_text: 钟伯：好，一切就托付给柳姑娘了……
translation: Uncle Zhong: Good, I entrust everything to Miss Liu...

original_text: 云天河：梦璃，你会不会有危险啊？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Mengli, are you going to be in danger?

original_text: 柳梦璃：放心，我自有办法，不会有事的。
translation: Liu Mengli: Don't worry, I have my own way, nothing bad will happen.

original_text: 云天河：好，我知道了。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Okay, I understand.

original_text: 柳梦璃：梦影雾花，尽是虚空，因心想念动，方化生幻境，令吾～往～梦～之～中！
translation: Liu Mengli: Dream shadows, misty flowers-all are emptiness... Because the heart stirs with thoughts, illusions are born, leading me~ into~ the~ realm~ of~ dreams!

original_text: 柳梦璃：钟伯……
translation: Liu Mengli: Uncle Zhong...

original_text: 钟伯：是柳小姐，还有云公子……
translation: Uncle Zhong: It's Miss Liu, and Mr. Yun...

original_text: 钟伯：唉，这也是天意吧，让你们见我家小姐最后一面……大夫……大夫说小姐是神魂耗尽而亡……明日，她便要入土了……
translation: Uncle Zhong: Sigh, perhaps it's fate that you see my young lady one last time... The doctor... the doctor said she passed from exhaustion of spirit... Tomorrow, she will be laid to rest...

original_text: 柳梦璃：……钟伯，我……我对不起你，救不了欧阳小姐……
translation: Liu Mengli: ... Uncle Zhong, I... I'm sorry. I couldn't save Miss Ouyang...

original_text: 钟伯：此话怎讲，这真是折煞老朽了……欧阳家的命数啊，又怎能怪别人……
translation: Uncle Zhong: What do you mean by that? This truly humbles this old man... The fate of the Ouyang family, how can it be blamed on others...

original_text: 柳梦璃：我们……能见一见欧阳小姐吗？
translation: Liu Mengli: Can we... have a look at Miss Ouyang?

original_text: 钟伯：当然，请随我进屋……
translation: Uncle Zhong: Of course, please follow me inside...

original_text: 钟伯：该打理的东西我都打理好了，明日便将小姐葬在欧阳家的祖坟，陪着老爷、夫人……
translation: Uncle Zhong: I've taken care of all necessary arrangements. Tomorrow, we will bury the young lady in the Ouyang family ancestral tomb, to accompany my lord and mistress...

original_text: 柳梦璃：……那，钟伯往后有何打算？
translation: Liu Mengli: ... Then, what are your plans from now on, Uncle Zhong?

original_text: 钟伯：我侍奉欧阳家一辈子，如今连最后一位主人也不在了……再也没有其他牵挂，等小姐后事办妥，就要回乡下养老去了……
translation: Uncle Zhong: I've served the Ouyang family my whole life, and now even the last master is gone... I have no other ties left. Once the young lady's funeral is settled, I'll return to the countryside to retire...

original_text: 柳梦璃：您要保重。
translation: Liu Mengli: You must take care.

original_text: 钟伯：一把老骨头了，怎么过还不都一样……唉，我这辈子最大的遗憾，就是没能看到小姐披上嫁衣，她那么善良的一个姑娘，连新娘子都没做过，就这样去了……老天、老天真是无眼呐……
translation: Uncle Zhong: An old bone like me, any way is the same... Alas, my greatest regret in life is not seeing the young lady wear her wedding dress. Such a kind girl, never even got to be a bride, just passed away like that... Heaven, heaven truly has no eyes...

original_text: 柳梦璃：……钟伯，您莫要伤心过度，坏了身体……
translation: Liu Mengli: Uncle Zhong, please don't grieve excessively and harm your health...

original_text: 柳梦璃：……
translation: Liu Mengli: ...

original_text: 柳梦璃：我想……在那个奇异的梦里，欧阳小姐她……一定做过世上最美的新娘子……
translation: Liu Mengli: I think... in that strange dream, Miss Ouyang... must have been the most beautiful bride in the world...

original_text: 云天河：下回叫上梦璃，再来这里看钟伯吧。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Next time, let's bring Mengli and come here to see Uncle Zhong again.

original_text: 柳梦璃：啊！——
translation: Liu Mengli: Ah!-

original_text: 云天河：梦璃，你怎么了？！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Mengli, what's wrong?!

original_text: 柳梦璃：……没事，只不过一时不慎，被法术弹出了梦境……
translation: Liu Mengli: ... It's fine. I just accidentally got expelled from the dream by a spell...

original_text: 钟伯：小姐、小姐她到底怎么样？
translation: Uncle Zhong: Miss, how is my lady really doing?

original_text: 柳梦璃：我见到了她，可是她好像只记得梦中的事，那个咒术太过强大，她的意识几乎被吞噬了……
translation: Liu Mengli: I saw her, but she seems to only remember things from the dream. That curse was too powerful; her consciousness was almost devoured...

original_text: 钟伯：那还有没有办法救我家小姐？
translation: Uncle Zhong: Is there still a way to save my young lady?

original_text: 柳梦璃：……很难。
translation: Liu Mengli: ... Very difficult.

original_text: 柳梦璃：让一个人沉睡九年，在梦中度日，如此霸道的咒术必定要布下法阵，若是不知对方在何处布阵，根本无从破解……
translation: Liu Mengli: Making someone sleep for nine years, living in dreams-such a domineering curse requires a magic array. Without knowing where it's set, it's impossible to break...

original_text: 钟伯：也就是说，小姐还是只能继续这样睡下去……
translation: Uncle Zhong: So that means, my lady can only continue sleeping like this...

original_text: 柳梦璃：对不起……钟伯，我什么忙也没帮上……
translation: Liu Mengli: I'm sorry... Uncle Zhong, I wasn't able to help at all...

original_text: 钟伯：不不不，柳姑娘，你千万别这么说，要不是你，我还一直以为小姐是生了病，连她被人害了都不知道……
translation: Uncle Zhong: No, no, Miss Liu, don't say that. If not for you, I'd still think my lady was just ill, unaware she was harmed...

original_text: 柳梦璃：钟伯，恕我冒昧，请问欧阳家是不是曾经与人结仇？而且并非中原人？还有，您说过欧阳小姐的父亲，乃是暴毙而亡，这究竟是怎么回事？
translation: Liu Mengli: Uncle Zhong, forgive my boldness, but may I ask if the Ouyang family ever had enemies? And not from the Central Plains? Also, you said Miss Ouyang's father died suddenly-what exactly happened?

original_text: 钟伯：这……老爷他是很本份的商人，做买卖五湖四海都要跑的，生意场上难免得罪了谁，可是也不至于有什么血海深仇吧……
translation: Uncle Zhong: This... Our master was a very honest merchant. Doing business means traveling far and wide, and it's hard to avoid offending someone in the marketplace, but it shouldn't have led to such a deep blood feud...

original_text: 钟伯：……说到老爷过世，那真是天塌了一般……九年前的一个夜里，是小姐先发现了老爷的尸首……那简直、简直惨不忍睹……老爷的整个身体上都爬满了毒虫，被咬得面目全非……
translation: Uncle Zhong: ...Speaking of Our master's passing, it was like the sky collapsing... Nine years ago, one night, my lady was the first to discover our master's corpse... It was utterly, utterly gruesome... Our master's entire body was covered in venomous insects, bitten beyond recognition...

original_text: 柳梦璃：……！
translation: Liu Mengli: ...!

original_text: 云天河：……真是太可怜了，比我爹还要惨多了……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... That's really pitiful, even worse than my Father...

original_text: 钟伯：从那时起，小姐就好像神魂出窍了一样，不吃不喝、也完全不说话……没过几日，突然昏睡过去，再也没有醒来……夫人的身子本来就不太好，她伤心欲绝，没过半年便跟着老爷去了……
translation: Uncle Zhong: From that moment on, my lady seemed as if her soul had left her body-she wouldn't eat or drink, and she stopped speaking entirely... After a few days, she suddenly fell into a deep sleep and never woke up... Mistress's health was never strong to begin with, and heartbroken, she followed my lord in less than half a year...

original_text: 柳梦璃：钟伯，我觉得你家老爷的过世、还有小姐昏睡，这之间绝对不会毫无关系……
translation: Liu Mengli: Uncle Zhong, I think your master's passing and your young lady's coma are definitely not unrelated...

original_text: 柳梦璃：如今我虽救不了欧阳姑娘，但若是有朝一日，见到那个法阵，我一定能认出来，到时候无论如何都要破阵，救醒欧阳姑娘。
translation: Liu Mengli: Although I can't save Miss Ouyang now, if one day I see that magic array, I will definitely recognize it. No matter what, I will break the array and wake Miss Ouyang.

original_text: 钟伯：大恩大德，老朽先在这里谢过了……唉，事到如今，也只能听天由命……
translation: Uncle Zhong: For your great kindness and virtue, this old man thanks you here first... Alas, at this point, we can only resign ourselves to fate...

original_text: 柳梦璃：钟伯你自己也要保重，不然还有谁能照顾欧阳小姐……我想一定天无绝人之路的……
translation: Liu Mengli: Uncle Zhong, you must take care of yourself too, otherwise who will look after Miss Ouyang... I believe Heaven never seals off all exits...

original_text: 钟伯：柳姑娘，还有云公子，老朽在这里先谢过了！
translation: Uncle Zhong: Miss Liu, and Yun, this old man thanks you here first!

original_text: 钟伯：老爷夫人双双辞世，小姐又长睡不醒，上天怎能如此对待好人呐！
translation: Uncle Zhong: My lord and mistress have both passed, and my lady remains in a deep slumber. How can heaven treat good people so harshly!

original_text: 陈妈：钟老先生侍奉欧阳家一辈子，现今欧阳家最后一口人也去了，钟老先生也算尽了人事了。
translation: Chen Ma: Elder Zhong served the Ouyang family his whole life. Now that the last of the Ouyang family is gone, Elder Zhong has done all that could be done.

original_text: 陈妈：欧阳一家实在太可怜了……管家钟伯也回乡养老了，大家都说这宅子戾气太重，住不得人。
translation: Chen Ma: The Ouyang family is so pitiful... Steward Zhong has retired to his hometown. Everyone says the mansion's aura is too sinister to live in.

original_text: 云天河：菱纱～
translation: Yun Tianhe: Lingsha~

original_text: 韩菱纱：嘘！小点儿声～～紫英这家伙，终于被我看到了不得的事，他居然和一位漂亮大姐在酒坊见面，还出钱请对方喝酒耶～
translation: Han Lingsha: Shh! Keep your voice down~~ I finally caught Ziying doing something unbelievable-he actually met a beautiful lady at the winery and even bought her a drink~

original_text: 云天河：那是……？
translation: Yun Tianhe: That's...?

original_text: 夙莘：哈哈～真是好酒！可惜一壶太少了，喝着总觉得不过瘾，能不能让她们上大坛子的那种？
translation: Sushen: Haha~ Truly fine wine! Pity the jug is too small. Drinking it never feels satisfying. Could we ask them for the kind that comes in large jars?

original_text: 慕容紫英：师叔，饮酒伤身——
translation: Murong Ziying: Martial Aunt, drinking harms the body-

original_text: 夙莘：哎，我记得你才十八、不、十九岁，又不是六十九岁，怎会如此婆妈？还是小时候可爱些，会追在我后面要糖吃——
translation: Sushen: Ah, I remember you're only eighteen-no, nineteen-not sixty-nine, so why are you so fussy? You were cuter when you were little, chasing after me for candy-

original_text: 慕容紫英：夙莘师叔，弟子冒昧！请问师叔何时可以启程，与我返回昆仑山？掌门一直很是记挂于您。
translation: Murong Ziying: Martial Aunt Sushen, this disciple is presumptuous! May I ask when you can depart and return to Kunlun Mountain with me? The sect leader has been very concerned about you.

original_text: 夙莘：哟～小紫英，你脸红了，难不成听到自己以前的事，还会不好意思～
translation: Sushen: Oh~ Little Ziying, you're blushing. Could it be you're embarrassed hearing about your own past~

original_text: 韩菱纱：嘻嘻！
translation: Han Lingsha: Hehe!

original_text: 慕容紫英：菱纱？！
translation: Murong Ziying: Lingsha?!

original_text: 韩菱纱：呃，糟糕……听到有人也会叫“小紫英”，不小心笑出来了……
translation: Han Lingsha: Uh, oops... I heard someone else call him 'Little Ziying' too, and I couldn't help laughing...

original_text: 夙莘：你们是……？
translation: Sushen: Who are you...?

original_text: 慕容紫英：他们乃是……弟子的师侄，初入门派，不太懂规矩，以至冒犯师叔……
translation: Murong Ziying: They are... this disciple's junior sect nephews, new to the sect and unfamiliar with rules, thus offending Martial Aunt...

original_text: 夙莘：好了好了，随口问问罢了，何必一本正经的～
translation: Sushen: Alright, alright, just asking casually, no need to be so serious~

original_text: 夙莘：你们是下山办事来的？跟着这种一板一眼的师叔，日子想必不太好过吧～
translation: Sushen: You came down the mountain on business? Following such a rigid and strict Martial Uncle, life must be quite tough, huh~

original_text: 韩菱纱：不会啦，其实小紫英人很好的，又爱操心又常常害羞，平日里只是顶着一张冰块脸骗人～
translation: Han Lingsha: Not at all! Actually, little Ziying is very kind-always worrying and often shy. He just puts on an ice-face to fool people~

original_text: 慕容紫英：菱纱，休要胡言乱语！
translation: Murong Ziying: Lingsha, stop talking nonsense!

original_text: 夙莘：…………哈哈……哈哈哈！想不到、真想不到，你这小姑娘有点意思，来来来，陪大姐我喝上两杯！
translation: Sushen: ............ Haha... Hahaha! Unexpected, truly unexpected. You're quite interesting, little girl. Come, come, have a couple of drinks with your big sister here!

original_text: 韩菱纱：我、我不喝酒的——
translation: Han Lingsha: I, I don't drink alcohol-

original_text: 夙莘：冷毅，你跑哪里去了～这么久不见人影，害我一个人喝酒，旁边这个师侄实在太正经，连个笑话都不会讲……
translation: Sushen: Lengyi, where did you run off to~ I haven't seen you for so long, leaving me to drink alone. This junior apprentice-nephew here is too proper, can't even tell a joke...

original_text: 韩菱纱：哇～大姐，这个人好高大，他是你相公吗？
translation: Han Lingsha: Wow~ Big sister, this person is so tall, is he your husband?

original_text: 慕容紫英：菱纱！
translation: Murong Ziying: Lingsha!

original_text: 夙莘：相公？哈哈～也差不多啦。
translation: Sushen: Husband? Haha~ pretty much, yeah.

original_text: 夙莘：什么？！你说碗丘山有野兽伤人？快走！我们去看看！
translation: Sushen: What?! You say there are beasts injuring people at Bowl Hill? Hurry! Let's go see!

original_text: 慕容紫英：师叔，弟子与您同去！
translation: Murong Ziying: Martial Aunt, this disciple will go with you!

original_text: 夙莘：那就来吧。
translation: Sushen: Then come on.

original_text: 云天河：那个人……和那女的说话了吗？我怎么没听到声音，难道又是什么“传音入密”？
translation: Yun Tianhe: That person... talked to that woman? Why didn't I hear any sound? Is it another 'secret voice transmission'?

original_text: 韩菱纱：呆子，这种事情等一下再想！<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>我们也快点赶去碗丘山，</colour><dc0>看能不能帮上忙！</dc0>
translation: Han Lingsha: Silly, think about that later!<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> Let's hurry to Bowl Hill too,</colour><dc0> and see if we can help!</dc0>

original_text: 云天河：哦、好……反正我还要找那女的要会动的木头老鼠……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Oh, okay... Anyway, I still need to ask that woman for the moving wooden mouse...

original_text: 陈靖风：陈州就是春秋时期的陈国，当年陈国的王是以国为姓，称为陈胡公，陈胡公便是我们陈姓人的始祖了。
translation: Chen Jingfeng: Chenzhou was the State of Chen in the Spring and Autumn period. Its king took the state as his surname, becoming Lord Chen Hu-our Chen surname's ancestor.

original_text: 陈靖风：前面的杂耍台好像是一群外地人搭起来的，他们来陈州一个多月了，台上的表演天天都有新花样～
translation: Chen Jingfeng: The acrobatics stage ahead seems to have been set up by a group of outsiders. They've been in Chenzhou for over a month, and the performances on stage have new tricks every day~

original_text: 陈靖风：那日琴姬在弦歌台弹唱，那曲子到现在还在我耳边回响，只是之后就再也没有见过她了，可叹呐……
translation: Chen Jingfeng: That day when Qin Ji sang and played at the Melody Terrace, the melody still echoes in my ears. But I haven't seen her since. What a pity...

original_text: 陈靖风：这些驯象人在我们陈州待了大半年，眼看着就快要走了，我也觉得有些舍不得，不过新的杂耍班子应该很快就来了。
translation: Chen Jingfeng: These elephant trainers have stayed in Chenzhou for over half a year and are about to leave. I'll miss them, but a new circus troupe should arrive soon.

original_text: 钱婆婆：儿子前几天刚把我接来陈州，今天一大早就又出门办货去了。他跟我说什么酒坊在湖西，布庄在湖东，医馆在湖的东南边，让我四处逛逛，可这陈州这么大，我哪走得过来啊？
translation: Granny Qian: My son just brought me to Chenzhou a few days ago, and early this morning he went out again on business. He told me the winery is west of the lake, the cloth shop east, the clinic southeast-said I should stroll around. But Chenzhou is so vast, how could I possibly walk all that?

original_text: 钱婆婆：杂货铺我认识，就在我家隔壁不远处，可是那儿的东西太贵了，一团粗线就要十文钱，这不是坑人嘛！
translation: Granny Qian: I know the sundry shop-it's near my house. But things there are too expensive. A ball of coarse thread costs ten wen-what a rip-off!

original_text: 钱婆婆：天呐！千佛塔里死了人，听说还是陈州大户人家的媳妇，那家人也真够可怜的，儿子媳妇都已经不在了……
translation: Granny Qian: Heavens! Someone died in the Thousand Buddha Pagoda, and I heard it was the daughter-in-law of a wealthy family in Chenzhou. That family is truly pitiful, having lost both son and daughter-in-law...

original_text: 钱婆婆：以前的秦家也不知道搬去哪里了，一家人整天愁眉苦脸，也怪可怜的，钱再多又有什么用啊……
translation: Granny Qian: I don't know where the Qin family from before moved to. The whole family always looked worried and miserable, pitiful really. What's the use of having so much money...

original_text: 方琦：上一次，我在璎珞斋里看见两支珍珠簪，那簪头上的珍珠又大又圆，可漂亮呢！听老板娘说那是跟一个安溪来的茶叶商买的，一共也才两支。
translation: Fang Qi: Last time, I saw two pearl hairpins at Yingluo Zhai. The pearls on the pins were big, round, and so beautiful! The shopkeeper said they were bought from a tea merchant from Anxi, and there were only two in total.

original_text: 方琦：后来这两支簪子，我看到秦家的媳妇戴了一支，另外一支就在倚栏歌榭的玉芙蓉身上。
translation: Fang Qi: Later, I saw one of these hairpins worn by the Qin family's daughter-in-law, and the other is on Yufurong at the Yilan Song Pavilion.

original_text: 方琦：璎珞斋里有西域的银镯子、京城的翡翠簪，每一件都好看得不得了！只可惜太贵了……
translation: Fang Qi: Yingluo Zhai has silver bracelets from the Western Regions, jadeite hairpins from the capital-each piece is incredibly beautiful! Just too expensive...

original_text: 方琦：唉，想想那秦家少夫人，嫁过去也没多久，到底为什么会在千佛塔里自尽……真是好可怜……
translation: Fang Qi: Sigh, think about the young mistress of the Qin family. She hadn't been married long. Why would she commit suicide in the Thousand Buddha Pagoda... So pitiful...

original_text: 方琦：安溪的商人又来过了，这回带了银镯子来，还嵌着珍珠！阿娘花大价钱买了那镯子，却说是要给哥哥娶媳妇时当聘礼，不能给我戴……
translation: Fang Qi: The merchants from Anxi came again, this time bringing silver bracelets inlaid with pearls! Mother spent a lot of money on that bracelet, but said it's for Brother's betrothal gift when he gets married, so I can't wear it...

original_text: 伏纳：我们兄弟俩跟着这个杂耍团很久了，女娲娘娘保佑～团里的生意一直都不错。
translation: Funa: We brothers have been with this acrobatic troupe for a long time. May the Goddess Nvwa bless us~ The troupe's business has always been good.

original_text: 伏纳：想看杂耍表演吗？戏台就在路对面呐，不过今天还没开场，得再等等。
translation: Funa: Want to see acrobatics? The stage is right across the road, but it hasn't started today. Need to wait a bit.

original_text: 伏纳：我们差不多要离开陈州了，接下来会坐船沿着淮河走，女娲娘娘保佑～如果找到合适的地方，就再待上几个月。
translation: Funa: We're about to leave Chenzhou. Next, we'll take a boat along the Huai River. May the Goddess Nvwa bless us~ If we find a suitable place, we'll stay for a few more months.

original_text: 伏辞：我们的家乡在离这里很远很远的南边，家乡的大海，比陈州的龙湖大的多！
translation: Fu Ci: Our homeland is far, far south of here, the ocean there is much bigger than Chenzhou's Dragon Lake!

original_text: 伏辞：从西南到中原，这一路上走过的城镇也不少，但没有哪儿比陈州更繁华了，这里不单是人多，连店里卖的东西也比别处多。
translation: Fu Ci: From the southwest to the Central Plains, I've passed through quite a few towns along the way, but none are as prosperous as Chenzhou. Not only are there more people here, but even the goods in the shops are more abundant.

original_text: 伏辞：城里好像有个叫琴姬的女人，唱歌好听，团里其他人都很想跟着她学。
translation: Fu Ci: There seems to be a woman in the city named Qin Ji who sings beautifully. Others in our troupe really want to learn from her.

original_text: 伏辞：在这里待得够久了，过几天我们就启程，到城外找几条大船，把东西都搬上去就走。
translation: Fu Ci: We've stayed here long enough. In a few days we'll set off, find some large boats outside the city, load everything on board, and leave.

original_text: 张小燕：我要看大象～我要看大象～
translation: Zhang Xiaoyan: I want to see the elephant~ I want to see the elephant~

original_text: 张小燕：娘说大象住的地方又臭又脏，不许我来，嘻嘻，我跑出来不告诉娘就好了！
translation: Zhang Xiaoyan: Mom says where elephants live is smelly and dirty, and she won't let me come. Hehe, I'll just sneak out without telling her!

original_text: 张小燕：大哥哥，昨天晚上，你听见有人唱歌了吗？我一直睡不着，就听见一个声音很好听的仙女在唱歌～
translation: Zhang Xiaoyan: Big Brother, last night, did you hear someone singing? I couldn't sleep and heard a fairy with a beautiful voice singing~

original_text: 张小燕：跟大象在一起的大哥哥说，他们就要离开陈州了，那样的话我以后就再也看不到大象了，怎么办？呜呜呜……
translation: Zhang Xiaoyan: The big brother with the elephant said they're about to leave Chenzhou. If that happens, I'll never see the elephant again. What should I do? Woo...

original_text: 许碧依：人都是很久很久以前，女娲娘娘用泥巴捏出来的，你知道她是在什么地方捏的吗？没错啦，就是陈州！
translation: Xu Biyi: People were made from clay by the goddess Nvwa long, long ago. Do you know where she molded them? That's right-Chenzhou!

original_text: 许碧依：湖上的弦歌台人比平时多些，是不是那个人又在那里唱歌呢？……
translation: Xu Biyi: There are more people than usual on the Melody Terrace over the lake. Is that person singing there again?...

original_text: 许碧依：除了女娲娘娘，连天神伏羲都在陈州待过呢，听说他还创了一个先天八卦阵，我们凡人想都想不到那有多厉害～
translation: Xu Biyi: Besides Goddess Nvwa, even the heavenly god Fuxi once stayed in Chenzhou. I heard he created the Primordial Eight Trigrams Formation-something we mortals can't even imagine how powerful it is~

original_text: 许碧依：听爹说，在南方的苗寨里有女娲娘娘庙，可女娲娘娘不是在我们陈州造的人吗？为什么苗寨里才有供奉她的庙呢？
translation: Xu Biyi: Father says there's a temple to the Goddess Nvwa in the southern Miao villages, but didn't Nvwa create humans here in Chenzhou? Why is her temple only in the Miao villages?

original_text: 沈倩：桑克颉，你说你的家乡养了很多骆驼，那你一定是住在西边的沙漠里啰？
translation: Shen Qian: Sankerji, you said your hometown raises many camels. Then you must live in the western desert, right?

original_text: 桑克颉：呵呵，我的家乡离沙漠很近，在昆仑山脚下，那山上住了仙人，我家就是靠着山上流下来的河水，才没有变成沙漠。
translation: Sankerji: Hehe, my hometown is near the desert, at the foot of the Kunlun Mountains. Immortals live on those mountains, and it's only thanks to the river flowing down from them that my home hasn't turned into desert.

original_text: 沈倩：这摊子上的小玩意儿是璎珞斋里都没见过的呢！好多好看的银簪子呀，还有那条红珠子项链，到底买哪件好？
translation: Shen Qian: The trinkets at this stall aren't even seen at Yingluo Zhai! So many beautiful silver hairpins, and that red bead necklace-which one should I buy?

original_text: 沈倩：桑克颉，上次的那串大红珠子，什么时候再有卖啊？
translation: Shen Qian: Sankerji, when will those big red beads from last time be available again?

original_text: 桑克颉：哈哈，那得等我回一趟家，才能把货给带来。
translation: Sankerji: Haha, I'll need to return home once to bring the goods.

original_text: 沈倩：那你什么时候回家？什么时候能再来呢？
translation: Shen Qian: Then when will you return home? When can you come again?

original_text: 桑克颉：唉，昆仑山脚下离这里很远很远，我的年纪也不小了，这次回家乡，大概不会再出远门了……
translation: Sankerji: Sigh, the foot of Kunlun Mountain is very, very far from here, and I'm not young anymore. This time returning to my hometown, I probably won't travel far again...

original_text: 桑克颉：在西域的时候，我还以为我们镇是天底下最热闹的地方，到了中原才知道，那样根本算不上什么～
translation: Sankerji: When I was in the Western Regions, I thought our town was the liveliest place under heaven. Coming to the Central Plains, I realized that's nothing at all~

original_text: 桑克颉：我们家乡的那条河，河水都不过膝，卷起裤角走过去就行了，哪像这陈州，去趟湖心岛还得到城西的码头去坐船。
translation: Sankerji: The river back home is only knee-deep; just roll up your pants and wade across. Not like Chenzhou, where you need to take a boat from the west city dock to reach the lake island.

original_text: 桑克颉：我来到这儿以后，最喜欢听琴姬弹琴，她一弹，我就想起了家乡……可惜以后再也听不到了，听说她离开了陈州……
translation: Sankerji: Since coming here, I've loved listening to Qin Ji play the qin the most. Whenever she plays, it reminds me of home... It's a shame I'll never hear it again; I heard she's left Chenzhou...

original_text: 桑克颉：中原再好，毕竟不是自己的家。出门两三年，也是该回去了。
translation: Sankerji: The Central Plains may be good, but after all, it's not one's own home. Being away for two or three years, it's time to return.

original_text: 朱荷莲：你看见我家小燕了吗？我不过是去酒坊打了些酒，回家就不见她人影！八成又跑去看大象，真是太不听话了，那种动物脏脏的，有什么好看！
translation: Zhu Helian: Have you seen my little Yan? I just went to the winery to get some wine, and when I returned home, she was gone! She probably ran off to see the elephants again-so disobedient! Those animals are dirty; what's so interesting about them!

original_text: 朱荷莲：城里来了杂耍班子，听说还是从西蜀来的，带着大象，我女儿天天都要去摸大象，管也管不住！
translation: Zhu Helian: A troupe of performers has come to town, said to be from Western Shu, bringing elephants. My daughter goes to pet the elephants every day-I can't control her at all!

original_text: 朱荷莲：秦家是不是撞了邪啊，儿子没死多久，媳妇又在千佛塔里自尽了，我看他们家最好请个道士来做法，不然以后可怎么办……
translation: Zhu Helian: Has the Qin family been cursed by evil? Not long after their son died, their daughter-in-law took her own life in the Thousand Buddha Pagoda. I think they'd better invite a Taoist priest to perform rites, or what will become of them...

original_text: 朱荷莲：城里的杂耍班子就要走了，我家小燕看起来很舍不得，害我也不忍心说她。罢了，这几天就让她多看几眼大象吧。
translation: Zhu Helian: The city's acrobatic troupe is about to leave. My little Yan seems reluctant to see them go, making it hard for me to scold her. Fine, let her watch the elephant a few more times these days.

original_text: 余笑才：娘子坐船去湖心岛的庙里拜佛了，我本想和她一起去，可是我见船就晕，只能在渡口这儿等她回来。
