translation: Yu Xiaocai: My wife took a boat to the temple on the lake's central island to pray. I wanted to go with her, but I get seasick just seeing a boat, so I can only wait for her here at the ferry.

original_text: 余笑才：我娘子除了日日到庙里进香之外，还经常朝湖心岛方向合十念佛，求千佛塔上的圣物舍利保佑全家。
translation: Yu Xiaocai: Besides going to the temple to offer incense every day, my wife often folds her hands toward the central island and chants prayers, asking the sacred relic in the Thousand Buddha Pagoda to protect our family.

original_text: 余笑才：千佛塔里闹出了人命，庙里的僧人说圣物染了秽气，要过些日子才能散，让我家娘子把塔中供奉的爹娘牌位先请回家一段日子，娘子好像不是很愿意……
translation: Yu Xiaocai: A death occurred in Thousand Buddha Pagoda. Monks say the relic is tainted and needs time to cleanse, asking my wife to bring her parents' tablets home temporarily. She seems reluctant...

original_text: 余笑才：秦家的房子也卖了，人也都迁走了，新搬来的那户人家，儿子常年在外经商，只有老爷夫人住在那撞邪的宅子里，这……恐怕不妥吧？
translation: Yu Xiaocai: The Qin family sold their house and moved away. The new family that moved in-their son is often away on business, and only the master and mistress live in that haunted house. This... probably isn't appropriate, right?

original_text: 武元甸：近来四海升平，年年五谷丰登，陈州附近从来没有闹过饥荒，粮仓里的储粮，足够供整个城里的百姓吃上三年的！
translation: Wu Yuandian: Recently, peace reigns, harvests are abundant yearly, and Chenzhou has never had a famine. The granary stores enough to feed the entire city for three years!

original_text: 武元甸：都说湖心佛塔里供着舍利子，晚上还有武艺高强的僧人负责把守，也不晓得是不是真的。
translation: Wu Yuandian: They say the Buddha's relics are enshrined in the pagoda at the lake's center, guarded by highly skilled monks at night. I wonder if it's true.

original_text: 武元甸：死在塔里的姜氏，好像是秦家的媳妇，可秦家少爷死了有些日子了，她要跟着相公去，干嘛等到现在呢？何况年纪轻轻的，怎会这么想不开……
translation: Wu Yuandian: Lady Jiang who died in the pagoda seems to be the Qin family's daughter-in-law. But the Qin family's young master died some time ago. If she wanted to follow her husband, why wait until now? And so young, why be so desperate...

original_text: 武元甸：知府大人的公子每天晚上都在倚栏歌榭听玉芙蓉唱歌，我倒是觉得，那玉芙蓉漂亮是挺漂亮，歌唱得却实在不怎么样。
translation: Wu Yuandian: The prefect's son listens to Yufurong sing at Yilan Song Pavilion every night. Personally, I think Yufurong is quite beautiful, but her singing really isn't that great.

original_text: 陈丹：这些女子个个浓眉大眼，头上还戴着珠贝～她们唱的歌、跳的舞，和中原姑娘完全不一样～
translation: Chen Dan: These women all have thick eyebrows and big eyes, wearing pearl shells on their heads~ Their songs and dances are completely different from Central Plains girls~

original_text: 陈丹：刚才出门的时候，我听见弦歌台上传来一阵琴声，实在好听，不过我更喜欢来这儿看杂耍……鱼和熊掌不可兼得啊。
translation: Chen Dan: When I went out earlier, I heard zither music from the Melody Terrace-truly lovely. But I prefer coming here to watch acrobatics... You can't have both fish and bear's paw.

original_text: 陈丹：这些姑娘唱的歌就是好听，老听歌榭里的小调，我都快听腻了。
translation: Chen Dan: The songs these girls sing are really nice. I'm almost tired of listening to the tunes from the song pavilion all the time.

original_text: 恭丽霞：我第一次来陈州，没想到就看见这西蜀来的杂耍班，还带着大象，真新鲜！
translation: Gong Lixia: It's my first time in Chenzhou, and I never expected to see this acrobatic troupe from Western Shu, even bringing an elephant. How novel!

original_text: 恭丽霞：其实台上姑娘在唱些什么，我一点都听不懂，可就是觉得好听～
translation: Gong Lixia: Actually, I don't understand a word of what the girl on stage is singing, but it just sounds beautiful~

original_text: 恭丽霞：前几个月我来过一趟陈州，就迷上了杂耍班的表演，谁料到这回再来，他们已经打算迁去别处了，那我以后要去哪儿看呐？
translation: Gong Lixia: A few months ago, I visited Chenzhou and became fascinated by the acrobatic troupe's performances. Who would have thought that this time I came back, they're planning to move elsewhere. Where will I go to watch them in the future?

original_text: 肖庆：昨天我一进城就看见两头大象在街上走，开始还以为在做梦，梦见了大理城呢！后来才知道，大象是杂耍班子带来的～
translation: Xiao Qing: Yesterday, as soon as I entered the city, I saw two elephants walking down the street! At first, I thought I was dreaming of Dali City! Later, I learned they were brought by an acrobatic troupe~

original_text: 肖庆：传说女娲娘娘造人的地方，就是这陈州，怎么这儿却连座女娲庙都没有？
translation: Xiao Qing: Legend says the place where Goddess Nvwa created humans is this Chenzhou. Why isn't there even a Nvwa temple here?

original_text: 肖庆：我在大理城也见过大象，只是那儿的大象可不会杂耍～
translation: Xiao Qing: I've also seen elephants in Dali City, but the elephants there don't perform tricks~

original_text: 阿升：客官您是第一次来陈州？要不要尝尝“圣人菜”？“圣人菜”就是当年孔圣人在弦歌台绝粮时吃的东西。
translation: A Sheng: First time in Chenzhou, honored guest? Want to try 'Sage's Dish'? It's what Confucius ate at Melody Terrace when his food ran out.

original_text: 阿升：我们客栈里，除了南来北往的商贾旅人，还常常有和尚来，那些和尚都是来参拜千佛塔上的舍利子的，得专门给他们做斋菜。
translation: A Sheng: At our inn, besides merchants and travelers from north and south, we often have monks too. Those monks come to worship the relics in the Thousand Buddha Pagoda, so we have to specially prepare vegetarian dishes for them.

original_text: 阿升：千佛塔……那里不是佛门圣地吗？怎会有人死在里面？想想都觉得可怕……
translation: A Sheng: Thousand Buddha Pagoda... isn't that a Buddhist sanctuary? How could someone die there? Just thinking about it is terrifying...

original_text: 阿升：倚栏歌榭里玉芙蓉唱的曲子，都是一个杨姓书生填的词，那书生词是写得不错，只可惜玉芙蓉唱得就……
translation: A Sheng: The songs Yufurong sings at Yilan Song Pavilion are all lyrics by a scholar named Yang. His words are good, but Yufurong's singing...

original_text: 云遥庆：我也知道自己对不起娘子，可是那倚栏歌榭的玉芙蓉实在太迷人，上回卖茶叶的钱，都在歌榭花完啦！
translation: Yun Yaoqing: I also know I've let my wife down, but that Yufurong at the Yilan Song Pavilion is just too captivating. Last time, all the money from selling tea was spent at the pavilion!

original_text: 云遥庆：不过，最近茶叶的价格忽然涨了，<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>麻烦你回去告诉我娘子</colour><dc0>，再做一笔大买卖，我就立即动身回村！</dc0>
translation: Yun Yaoqing: But, recently tea prices suddenly rose,<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> please go back and tell my wife</colour><dc0>, after one more big deal, I'll head back to the village right away!</dc0>

original_text: 云遥庆：玉芙蓉不愧是倚栏歌榭的花魁～唱的曲儿好听，跳的舞更是能赶上那赵飞燕！
translation: Yun Yaoqing: Yufurong truly lives up to being the top courtesan of Song Pavilion~ Her songs are lovely, her dances rivaling Zhao Feiyan!

original_text: 云遥庆：玉芙蓉的舞，实在是跳得好，可惜这倚栏歌榭的酒钱太贵，我卖茶叶的钱都已经快花光了，回家怎么跟娘子交代……
translation: Yun Yaoqing: Yufurong's dancing is truly exquisite. It's a shame the wine at Yilan Song Pavilion is so expensive. I've almost spent all my tea-selling money-how will I explain this to my wife back home...

original_text: 云遥庆：最近的茶叶卖得特别好，除了能天天去倚栏歌榭听玉芙蓉的曲儿，还能买些首饰捎回去，让家里的娘子也高兴高兴，这就是齐人之福啊，哈哈！
translation: Yun Yaoqing: Lately, tea has been selling exceptionally well. Besides being able to go to Yilan Song Pavilion every day to listen to Yufurong's tunes, I can also buy some jewelry to bring back, making the wife at home happy too. This is the joy of having both, haha!

original_text: 张玉太：哈哈，这不就是“神刀铁胳臂”胡得朔胡大侠嘛？好久不见～
translation: Zhang Yutai: Haha, isn't this the 'Divine Blade Iron Arm' Hu Deshuo, the great hero? Long time no see~

original_text: 胡得朔：哈哈，原来是“清风剑”张玉太张大侠啊～幸会、幸会～～
translation: Hu Deshuo: Haha, so it's 'Breeze Sword' Zhang Yutai, the great hero~ Pleased to meet you, pleased to meet you~~

original_text: 张玉太：却不知胡大侠此来陈州，所为何事？
translation: Zhang Yutai: But I wonder, what brings you, Hero Hu, to Chenzhou?

original_text: 胡得朔：这个嘛～我听说陈州千佛塔上，那守护舍利的僧人，个个都武艺高强！所以我想去和他们切磋一番。
translation: Hu Deshuo: Well~ I heard the monks guarding the relics atop Chenzhou's Thousand Buddha Pagoda are all highly skilled in martial arts! So I want to go spar with them.

original_text: 张玉太：这好办，我跟寺里的方丈也有些交情，我们现在就渡船去湖心岛，只要方丈师父点头，胡大侠你想跟谁切磋就跟谁切磋！
translation: Zhang Yutai: That's easy. I have some connections with the abbot of the temple. Let's take a boat to the island in the lake now. As long as the abbot agrees, you can spar with anyone you want, Hero Hu!

original_text: 胡得朔：啊？！这～这这这～～我突然想起来还有别的事要办，先告辞了！这以武会友之事，反正来日方长，还是改天再说吧……
translation: Hu Deshuo: Huh?! Th-this... I just remembered I have other matters to attend to, I must take my leave! As for this martial arts exchange, there's plenty of time in the future, let's discuss it another day...

original_text: 张玉太：胡大侠？
translation: Zhang Yutai: Hero Hu?

original_text: 张玉太：其实千佛塔上守舍利的武僧也没什么了不起，只要是单打独斗，他们没一个能赢得了我手中这柄宝剑！
translation: Zhang Yutai: Actually, the martial monks guarding the relics in the Thousand Buddha Pagoda aren't that impressive. In a one-on-one fight, none of them can beat this precious sword in my hand!

original_text: 张玉太：骆家公子年纪虽小，于剑术上却很有天赋。上次我见他在湖边舞剑，已隐有大家之风，再过几年，他的剑术，恐怕会在我之上。
translation: Zhang Yutai: Though young, Young Master Luo shows great talent in swordsmanship. Last time I saw him practicing by the lake, he already displayed the bearing of a master. In a few years, his skill may surpass mine.

original_text: 张玉太：我师父说过，三十年前，有一位名满江湖的铁琴女侠，练就一身好武艺不算，还弹得一手好琴，我猜那琴姬就是这位铁琴女侠的后辈弟子！
translation: Zhang Yutai: My master said that thirty years ago, there was a famous Iron Lute Heroine renowned throughout the martial world. Not only did she master superb martial arts, but she also played the lute exceptionally well. I guess this Qin Ji is a descendant or disciple of that Iron Lute Heroine!

original_text: 张玉太：千斗酒坊的赛乃慕小姐看起来好像对我有意思，可我中意的是歌榭里的月桂啊……
translation: Zhang Yutai: Miss Senem from Bottomless Cup seems to like me, but my heart belongs to Yuegui from the song pavilion...

original_text: 张玉太：去年在金陵城外的玄武湖畔和林少侠一战，我虽负于林少侠半招，但那次比武真是痛快至极、痛快至极啊！
translation: Zhang Yutai: Last year, I fought Young Master Lin by Xuanwu Lake outside Jinling City. Although I lost to him by half a move, that duel was truly exhilarating, utterly exhilarating!

original_text: 胡得朔：听说千佛塔上的舍利子一到夜里就会闪闪发亮，绝对是件值钱的宝贝！要是能把它偷过来，那可就发啦～哈哈哈哈！
translation: Hu Deshuo: I heard the relic in the Thousand Buddha Pagoda glows brightly at night-definitely a valuable treasure! If I could steal it, I'd be rich~ Hahahaha!

original_text: 陆寿：升平客栈的菜是好，房间睡得也舒坦，就是价钱贵！别的不说，单一碗豆腐汤，寿阳只卖三文钱，这里竟然要六文！
translation: Lu Shou: Shengping Inn's food is good, the rooms are comfortable, but the prices are steep! Just one bowl of tofu soup costs six coins here, while in Shouyang it's only three!

original_text: 陆寿：不去倚栏歌榭，那真是枉来陈州了！只是那里的酒水钱实在太贵，我、我怕是还要攒上一段日子……
translation: Lu Shou: Not going to Yilan Song Pavilion would be a waste of coming to Chenzhou! But the drinks there are just too expensive. I, I'm afraid I'll need to save up for a while longer...

original_text: 陆寿：要不是我带来的寿阳香料卖得好，我可住不起这么贵的客栈！可惜八公山上的离香草再也不能多采，以后也就没香料卖了，唉……
translation: Lu Shou: If it weren't for the Shouyang spices I brought selling so well, I couldn't afford such an expensive inn! It's a pity we can't pick more Parting Herb from Bagong Mountain anymore. No more spice to sell in the future, alas...

original_text: 曾福达：宝气钱庄在淮水以北所有的大城里都有分号，我这儿开的银票，到京城里都能兑现银！
translation: Zeng Fuda: Baoqi Bank has branches in all major cities north of the Huai River. The banknotes issued here can be exchanged for silver even in the capital!

original_text: 曾福达：客官您要是手头紧，我们钱庄也可以借银两给您。不过这事儿空口无凭可不行，至少您得拿些房屋地契来押着，没有地契，值钱的金玉首饰也行啊～
translation: Zeng Fuda: If you're short on funds, sir, our bank can lend you silver. But we can't just take your word for it-you'll need to provide property deeds as collateral at the very least. If no deeds, valuable gold, jade, or jewelry will do too~

original_text: 曾福达：说起那个琴姬，我倒还有点印象，秦家少爷在世的时候，他俩经常泛舟龙湖，一个弹琴、一个吹萧，看起来真像是神仙眷侣啊……
translation: Zeng Fuda: Speaking of that Qin Ji, I do have some impression. When the Qin family's young master was alive, they often boated on Dragon Lake, one playing the qin, the other the xiao. They truly looked like an immortal couple...

original_text: 曾福达：秦家老爷和夫人在我这儿存了一大笔银子，然后就搬出了陈州，想必他们一定是怕身上带太多现银出门不方便，才都换成了银票。
translation: Zeng Fuda: Master Qin and his wife deposited a large sum of silver with me, then moved out of Chenzhou. Presumably, they were afraid carrying too much cash would be inconvenient, so they exchanged it all for silver notes.

original_text: 陈婆婆：年轻人，你可别小看我摊上这泥泥狗，它是当年女娲娘娘造人时传下来的模子，还有这人面猴，也跟当年女娲娘娘造的一个样～
translation: Granny Chen: Young man, don't look down on the clay-clay dogs at my stall. They're made from molds passed down since the time Goddess Nvwa created humans. And this human-faced monkey is just like the ones Goddess Nvwa made back then~

original_text: 陈婆婆：泥泥狗就是泥娃娃，只有咱们陈州人才这么叫～
translation: Granny Chen: 'Clay-clay dog' is just a clay doll, only we people of Chenzhou call it that~

original_text: 陈婆婆：要不要买几只泥泥狗？它能保佑你没病没灾，长命百岁！
translation: Granny Chen: Want to buy a few clay-clay dogs? They can protect you from illness and disaster, grant long life!

original_text: 郭小明：“老斋公，你别走，给个泥泥狗，活到九十九”。
translation: Guo Xiaoming: 'Old Zhai Gong, don't go, give me a clay-clay dog, live to ninety-nine'.

original_text: 郭小明：哥哥姐姐在陈婆婆这里买了泥泥狗，都会送给我玩呢！
translation: Guo Xiaoming: When the older brothers and sisters buy clay-clay dogs from Granny Chen, they always give them to me to play with!

original_text: 郭小明：湖里的塔上真的有宝贝吗？我想要～～
translation: Guo Xiaoming: Is there really treasure in the lake tower? I want it~~

original_text: 郭小明：我知道的！琴姬姐姐是很好的人，还有秦大哥也是，以前娘生过几次重病，都是他们送药给我家。
translation: Guo Xiaoming: I know! Sis. Qin Ji is a very good person, and so is Brother Qin. When my mother was seriously ill several times before, they sent medicine to our home.

original_text: 洪九：陈州好哇，人多又热闹～我在寿阳要饭的时候，每天要来的也只够填肚子，哪像现在，在街口坐上一整天，除了能吃饱吃好，还有多下来的钱买酒！
translation: Hong Jiu: Chenzhou is great, so many people and so lively~ When I begged in Shouyang, what I got each day was only enough to fill my belly. Not like now, sitting at the street corner all day, besides eating my fill well, I even have leftover money to buy wine!

original_text: 洪九：原来昨天就是那个琴姬在弦歌台上唱曲子，所以才引了一堆人围着，这也难怪，她唱的曲子，实在是太好听了。
translation: Hong Jiu: So it was that Qin Ji singing on the Melody Terrace yesterday that drew such a crowd. No wonder-her songs are truly beautiful.

original_text: 洪九：秦家从陈州搬走了，新住进来的那户人家，夫人好像是吃斋的，每天早上都要去庙里，路过我这儿时，总会给几个钱，倒也不错～
translation: Hong Jiu: The Qin family moved away from Chenzhou. The new family that moved in, the wife seems to be a vegetarian. She goes to the temple every morning and always gives me a few coins when she passes by. Not bad~

original_text: 赛乃慕：我们千斗酒坊不止有上好的女儿红，还有高昌的葡萄酒、波斯的三勒浆和龙膏酒，客官您想来点什么？
translation: Senem: At our Bottomless Cup, we have not only fine Daughter's Red (Wine) but also Gaochang grape wine, Persian Sanlejiang, and Longgao wine. What would you like, honored guest?

original_text: 赛乃慕：知府家的公子现在就在楼上，他经常和朋友来我们酒坊，一坐就是一下午，要的也常常是龙膏酒、三勒浆，从来不喝女儿红。
translation: Senem: The magistrate's son is upstairs right now. He often comes to our winery with friends, staying all afternoon, always Longgao wine or Sanlejiang, never Daughter's Red (Wine).

original_text: 赛乃慕：楼上的两位公子总喜欢谈论一个叫琴姬的女人，说她弹的曲子好听，有机会让我的姐妹和她比一比！
translation: Senem: The two gentlemen upstairs always like to talk about a woman named Qin Ji, saying her tunes are lovely. If there's a chance, I'd have my sisters compete with her!

original_text: 赛乃慕：倚栏歌榭里的女儿红竟然卖那么贵？！那我这酒肆里，如果能请来我的姐妹跳舞，葡萄酒不是可以卖三十两银子一壶了？
translation: Senem: The Daughter's Red (Wine) at Yilan Song Pavilion is sold at such a high price?! Then in my winery, if I could invite my sisters to dance, couldn't I sell a pot of grape wine for thirty taels of silver?

original_text: 公孙异：苏公子总说陈州的花魁玉芙蓉如何如何～害我从京城一路赶来，今夜怎么也要见识见识！
translation: Gongsun Yi: Young Master Su keeps going on and on about Chenzhou's top courtesan, Yufurong~ It made me rush all the way from the capital. Tonight, I simply must see her for myself!

original_text: 公孙异：苏兄啊，那玉芙蓉的眼神，怎么老往我们这儿飘？
translation: Gongsun Yi: Brother Su, why does that Yufurong keep glancing our way?

original_text: 苏俊青：玉芙蓉向来眼高于顶，我来这倚栏歌榭也好多次了，她对我一直都是不冷不热的，看今日这情形，也许是她是看上公孙兄你了也说不定！
translation: Su Junqing: Yufurong has always been haughty. I've been to Yilan Song Pavilion many times, and she's always been lukewarm to me. Seeing today's situation, perhaps she has taken a liking to you, Brother Gongsun!

original_text: 公孙异：哈哈哈哈，苏兄你尽会说笑～
translation: Gongsun Yi: Hahahaha, Brother Su, you're always joking~

original_text: 公孙异：我这几日正在钻研乐理，古乐多是“清乐”，歌榭里那些曲子是“燕乐”，两者各有千秋，本就做不得比较。
translation: Gongsun Yi: I've been studying music theory these days. Ancient music is mostly 'Qingyue', while the tunes in song halls are 'Yanyue'. Both have their merits and cannot be compared.

original_text: 公孙异：我每次和苏兄一起去歌榭时，那玉芙蓉总会多看我几眼，可她也只是看，从来没有别的表示，真让人捉摸不透……
translation: Gongsun Yi: Every time I go to the singing house with Brother Su, Yufurong always glances at me a few extra times, but she only looks and never shows any other signs. It's really puzzling...

original_text: 苏俊青：公孙兄，今日你远道而来，小弟也没什么好招待的。除了这家酒坊的葡萄酒不能不喝之外，倚栏歌榭的舞，也是不能不看呐！
translation: Su Junqing: Brother Gongsun, you've come from afar today, and I have little to offer. Besides having to try this winery's grape wine, you absolutely mustn't miss the dance at the Yilan Song Pavilion!

original_text: 苏俊青：今日这玉芙蓉好奇怪，怎么老是看着我们这边，脸上的笑也有点怪……难道她真的对公孙兄一见倾心了？
translation: Su Junqing: This Yufurong is acting strange today, always looking our way with a weird smile... Could she really have fallen for Brother Gongsun at first sight?

original_text: 苏俊青：听说陈州另有一位弹唱俱佳的姑娘，叫作琴姬，为何我与她有缘无份，她早早地就离开了这儿……
translation: Su Junqing: I heard there's another girl in Chenzhou skilled in both singing and playing, named Qin Ji. Why is fate so unkind? She left this place early on...

original_text: 苏俊青：最近什么事也提不起劲来，爹让我好好念书，求个功名，可那些书……我哪里看得进去啊，光是念上几句就想打瞌睡了……
translation: Su Junqing: Lately, I can't get excited about anything. Dad wants me to study hard and seek fame, but those books... I can't focus at all; just reading a few lines makes me sleepy...

original_text: 张铁口：我张铁口算的卦，说一不二，百算百准！昨天夜里我就算准了，今日弦歌台上会有异象哇！
translation: Zhang Tiekou: The divinations I, Zhang Tiekou, perform are definitive and always accurate! Last night, I predicted that there would be an anomaly on the Melody Terrace today!

original_text: 张铁口：死在塔里的，那是秦家的少奶奶。我以前就说过，秦家那大宅子煞气重，风水不好，可秦老爷偏不信，这下可惨了，儿子媳妇都去了……
translation: Zhang Tiekou: The one who died in the pagoda was the young mistress of the Qin family. I've said before that the Qin mansion has heavy sinister energy and bad Feng Shui, but Master Qin wouldn't listen. Now it's tragic-both his son and daughter-in-law are gone...

original_text: 张铁口：搬进秦家大宅的那一家我见过，老爷夫人都是福泽深厚的面相，也只有那种人，才能在那房子住得久。
translation: Zhang Tiekou: I've seen the family that moved into the Qin family mansion. The master and mistress both have faces blessed with deep fortune. Only people like them can live in that house for long.

original_text: 赖小雯：这个龙湖里，有种蒲草的根能吃～孔夫子来我们陈州的时候没东西吃，就靠吃这蒲根过活，还每天都在弦歌台讲学呢！
translation: Lai Xiaowen: In this Dragon Lake, there's a kind of cattail root you can eat~ When Confucius came to our Chenzhou and had no food, he survived on these roots and lectured daily at Melody Terrace!

original_text: 赖小雯：爹从京城回来了，给小雯带了漂亮衣裳，还给娘买了首饰，可是娘一点都不开心，因为爹还带了个二娘回来……
translation: Lai Xiaowen: Dad came back from the capital, bringing me pretty clothes and jewelry for Mom, but Mom isn't happy at all because Dad also brought back a second wife...

original_text: 赖小雯：骆家哥哥剑法厉害，人也好，上回在碗丘山帮小雯打跑了地洞里爬出来的鬼怪，还送小雯回家……小雯最喜欢骆家哥哥了！
translation: Lai Xiaowen: Brother Luo's swordsmanship is amazing, and he's a good person too. Last time in Bowl Hill, he helped Xiaowen drive away the ghosts from the cave and even escorted Xiaowen home... Xiaowen likes Brother Luo the most!

original_text: 洪三：这陈州好心的有钱人就是多，淮水南北所有丐帮的兄弟当中，只有我和老九的日子过得最舒坦，哈哈！
translation: Hong San: There are many kind-hearted wealthy people in Chenzhou. Among all the Beggars' Sect brothers north and south of the Huai River, only Old Jiu and I live the most comfortable lives, haha!

original_text: 洪三：三教九流、各门各派都有自己的规矩，咱丐帮的规矩就是帮里的兄弟们不准沿着同一条大街要饭～
translation: Hong San: Every walk of life and every sect has its own rules. Our Beggars' Sect rule is that brothers in the gang aren't allowed to beg along the same main street~

original_text: 单百川：我那傻儿子听说黄山有剑仙，就千里迢迢跑去寻访，一走就是大半年，连个音信都没有……
translation: Shan Baichuan: My foolish son heard of sword immortals at Mount Huang, traveled far to seek them, gone over half a year, no word at all...

original_text: 单百川：单家三代单传，我就指望儿子能多娶几房媳妇，为家里留后，没想到那小子竟然迷上了修仙，不娶媳妇不说，如今连人都不知去了哪！
translation: Shan Baichuan: The Shan family has had only one son for three generations. I was counting on my son to marry several wives to continue the family line. Who knew he'd become obsessed with cultivating immortality-not marrying, and now even his whereabouts are unknown!

original_text: 单百川：唉，秦老爷还没抱上孙儿，儿子媳妇就……秦家的香火眼看就这么断了，真不知道是造了什么孽。
translation: Shan Baichuan: Ah, Master Qin hasn't even held a grandchild yet, and now his son and daughter-in-law... The Qin family line is about to be cut off. Truly, what sin brought this upon them?

original_text: 单百川：我儿子捎了口信给我，说他不求仙了，过几天就回来，在外面吃了苦头，总算死心了吧？
translation: Shan Baichuan: My son sent me a message saying he's given up on seeking immortality and will be back in a few days. He must have suffered hardships out there and finally come to his senses, right?

original_text: 陆风：千佛塔上供着舍利，那是真的，但要说那舍利能延年益寿、去病消灾，那八成就是假的了。
translation: Lu Feng: The Buddha's relics are indeed enshrined in the Thousand Buddha Pagoda, but claims they prolong life or cure illnesses are probably false.

original_text: 陆风：要我说啊，秦家少奶奶自从相公过世后，就一直郁郁寡欢，久而久之气血也跟着郁结了，说不定就是得了什么怪病死的～
translation: Lu Feng: If you ask me, ever since her husband passed away, the young mistress of the Qin family has been depressed and melancholy. Over time, her qi and blood have become stagnant too-maybe she died of some strange illness~

original_text: 萍儿：我家小姐喜欢上了那几个跳舞姑娘的裙子，我正要去布庄给小姐裁布做裙子呢！
translation: Ping'er: My lady has taken a liking to the skirts of those dancing girls; I'm just going to the cloth shop to get fabric to make her a skirt!

original_text: 萍儿：小姐挑剔得很，只信前头董广号里董师傅的手艺，不是董师傅裁的衣裳，小姐她看都不看一眼。
translation: Ping'er: My lady is very picky. She only trusts the craftsmanship of Master Dong from the Dongguang store up front. If the clothes aren't tailored by Master Dong, she won't even glance at them.

original_text: 萍儿：那个姜氏，我以前也见过，她娘家是大户的好人家，算起来还是秦府的表亲，我见到她的时候，她还没嫁人，谁想到几年一过，竟然这样薄命……
translation: Ping'er: That Lady Jiang, I've seen her before too. Her maiden family was a good, wealthy household, related to the Qin family. When I saw her, she wasn't married yet. Who would have thought a few years later, her fate would be so tragic...

original_text: 萍儿：小姐的新衣裳做好了，董师傅正在店里等我去取，就不知道那衣裳合不合小姐的意。
translation: Ping'er: My lady's new clothes are ready. Master Dong is waiting for me at the shop to pick them up. I just hope the clothes suit my lady's taste.

original_text: 颜红英：我看城门处杂耍班姑娘的衣裳很漂亮，而且也不像酒坊老板娘那般露肩露臂的，所以就让萍儿去裁缝店，请董师傅帮我也裁一件。
translation: Yan Hongying: I saw that the clothes of the acrobatic troupe girl at the city gate were very beautiful, and they weren't as revealing as the winery owner's wife's, showing shoulders and arms. So I asked Ping'er to go to the tailor shop and ask Master Dong to make one for me too.

original_text: 颜红英：陈州府中的年轻公子虽多，但行止道德却都不尽人意，倒是那位骆家公子，年纪虽小，却正直无私、嫉恶如仇，远非那些富贵人家的纨绔子弟可比。
translation: Yan Hongying: Although there are many young gentlemen in Chenzhou Prefecture, their conduct and morals leave much to be desired. Except for that young Master Luo-though still young, he is upright, selfless, and hates evil, far beyond those spoiled rich kids.

original_text: 颜红英：“梧桐相待老，鸳鸯会双死。贞妇贵殉夫，舍生亦如此。”那个在塔里自尽的女子，听说是殉夫而死，真乃贞烈女子也。
translation: Yan Hongying: 'The phoenix trees grow old together, the mandarin ducks die in pairs. A chaste woman values dying for her husband, sacrificing life is also thus'. The woman who took her own life in the pagoda, I heard she died for her husband, truly a chaste and heroic woman.

original_text: 颜红英：单家老伯说，单公子过段日子就能回陈州了，等他回来，就遣人来提亲……这，我还没见过单公子，不知他是怎样的人？能不能与我过那只羡鸳鸯不羡仙的日子……
translation: Yan Hongying: Old Uncle Shan said that Young Master Shan will be able to return to Chenzhou in a while. Once he's back, he'll send someone to propose marriage... This, I haven't met Young Master Shan yet. I don't know what kind of person he is? Can he live that 'envying lovebirds, not immortals' life with me...

original_text: 晋晖昭：小晶，湖上的荷花开了，我们不如到城东的码头去租条船，两个人在湖上好好游历一番？
translation: Jin Huizhao: Xiao Jing, the lotuses on the lake are blooming. How about we rent a boat at the eastern city dock and take a nice tour on the lake together?

original_text: 贺晶：看荷花又未必要坐船。
translation: He Jing: Viewing lotus flowers doesn't necessarily require a boat.

original_text: 晋晖昭：这……那小晶你说，想上哪儿去，我就陪你上哪儿去。
translation: Jin Huizhao: This... well, Xiao Jing, you say where you want to go, and I'll accompany you there.

original_text: 贺晶：我也想坐船，不过我想去湖心的庙里找方丈大师论佛法，你要不要一起去？
translation: He Jing: I'd like to take a boat too, but I want to go to the temple in the lake's center to discuss Buddhist teachings with the abbot. Would you like to join?

original_text: 晋晖昭：……小晶，你能不能不要整天都想着佛法？我真担心，你哪天想不开就出家当了尼姑！
translation: Jin Huizhao: ...Xiao Jing, can't you stop thinking about Buddhist teachings all day? I'm really worried you'll one day renounce the world and become a nun!

original_text: 晋晖昭：我同小晶是从小一起长大的，我们两人青梅竹马，门当户对……可小晶总喜欢研习佛法，近年来对我越来越冷淡了！
translation: Jin Huizhao: Xiao Jing and I grew up together-childhood sweethearts, well-matched families... But she's always been into studying Buddhism and has grown colder toward me lately!

original_text: 晋晖昭：小晶啊，若爹娘反对我们成亲，或者以后我娘待你不好，你会不会像琴姬那样……那样……
translation: Jin Huizhao: Xiao Jing, if my parents oppose our marriage, or if my mother treats you poorly in the future, would you be like Qin Ji... like that...

original_text: 贺晶：什么是好，什么又是不好？我同晖昭大哥你从小一起长大，我的心思，晖昭大哥你还不清楚吗？
translation: He Jing: What is good, and what is not? I grew up with Brother Huizhao. My feelings, Brother Huizhao, shouldn't you understand them clearly?

original_text: 晋晖昭：小晶～上回我爹找了人去你家提亲，你爹现在都没有给回音，你倒是告诉我，这事到底成是不成？
translation: Jin Huizhao: Xiao Jing~ Last time, my father sent someone to propose marriage at your home, and your father still hasn't given a reply. Tell me, will this work out or not?

original_text: 贺晶：真是的，晖昭大哥你也不想想，若我爹真的不答应，今天我还能来这儿见你吗？
translation: He Jing: Really, Brother Huizhao, haven't you thought? If my father really didn't agree, could I have come here to see you today?

original_text: 晋晖昭：哈哈哈，那就太好了！咦？小晶你怎么脸红了？怕什么羞呀？反正你迟早都得嫁给我！
translation: Jin Huizhao: Hahaha, that would be wonderful! Huh? Xiao Jing, why is your face flushed? Why be shy? You'll have to marry me sooner or later anyway!

original_text: 贺晶：湖心岛上的方丈大师精通佛法，我经常乘船去岛上与他谈经论道，每次都深得启发。
translation: He Jing: The Abbot on the island in the lake center is well-versed in Buddhist teachings. I often take a boat to the island to discuss scriptures with him, gaining profound insights each time.

original_text: 贺晶：其实那姜氏又是何苦，她为秦家少爷自尽，只会加重秦家少爷的罪孽……说不定投胎也寻不到好人家了……
translation: He Jing: Why must Lady Jiang do that? Her suicide for the sake of Qin junior, only adds to his sins... He might not even find a good family in his next life...

original_text: 贺晶：前日晋伯伯让媒婆来我家提亲，我爹想了好久才答应，我知道他也是为我好，不想我嫁得不如意。
translation: He Jing: The day before yesterday, Uncle Jin sent a matchmaker to my home to propose marriage. My father thought for a long time before agreeing. I know he means well, not wanting me to marry unhappily.

original_text: 董师傅：你问我身上带着这两把刀是干嘛的？不会吧，这个你都不知道？刀嘛，当然就是用来……裁衣服的啊！
translation: Master Dong: You ask why I carry these two knives? No way, you don't know? Knives, of course, are for... tailoring clothes!

original_text: 董师傅：在陈州开布庄当裁缝，最大的好处就是每天都能看到年轻漂亮的女子在我面前晃来晃去，真是“人生如此，夫复何求”啊！
translation: Master Dong: The best part of running a cloth shop and being a tailor in Chenzhou is seeing beautiful young women pass by every day. Truly, 'With a life like this, what more could one ask for?'

original_text: 董师傅：秦家公子少年风流，死后还有红颜知己对他念念不忘，要是换成我，我才舍不得死！
translation: Master Dong: Young Master Qin was dashing in his youth. Even after death, a beauty still pines for him. If it were me, I wouldn't be willing to die!

original_text: 董师傅：真正的胡装，其实是千斗酒坊老板娘穿的那样，露肩露臂，裙摆宽大，和汉人女子的衣裳完全不一样。
translation: Master Dong: Real Hu attire is actually like what the owner of Bottomless Cup wears-bare shoulders and arms, wide skirts-completely different from Han women's clothing.

original_text: 杨景庄：三国时候，“独占天下八斗才”的曹植被封为陈王，封地便是陈州。我应该在此地多逗留几日，也好沾沾昔日陈王的才气，免得下回赶考再落第。
translation: Yang Jingzhuang: During the Three Kingdoms period, Cao Zhi, who 'alone possessed eight-tenths of the world's talent', was enfeoffed as the Prince of Chen, with his fief being Chenzhou. I should linger here a few more days to soak up some of the former Prince of Chen's literary aura, lest I fail the imperial exams again next time.

original_text: 杨景庄：当年孔圣人在陈州弦歌台上绝粮七日，就靠蒲根度日，亦没有停止讲学，我只是一次科举未中，怎可轻言放弃？
translation: Yang Jingzhuang: Back in the day, Confucius was stranded on the Melody Terrace in Chenzhou for seven days without food, surviving on cattail roots, yet he never stopped teaching. I merely failed the imperial examination once-how can I lightly speak of giving up?

original_text: 杨景庄：这段日子我都在为倚栏歌榭的姑娘们作些唱词，其实风尘女子最多辛酸，远没有其他人看起来那般快乐无忧。
translation: Yang Jingzhuang: Lately, I've been writing lyrics for the girls at Yilan Song Pavilion. Actually, courtesans harbor much bitterness, far from the carefree joy others might see.

original_text: 杨景庄：听说城中有一位骆先生，也是精通音律之辈，其琴艺不在那琴姬之下，若有机会，真想拜会拜会这位骆先生……
translation: Yang Jingzhuang: I heard there's a Mr. Luo in the city who is also well-versed in music. His qin skills are not inferior to that Qin Ji's. If I get the chance, I'd really like to pay a visit to this Mr. Luo...

original_text: 月桂：我们的花魁玉芙蓉，不只是能歌善舞，连她唱的曲，还都是她自己谱乐填词的呢！
translation: Yuegui: Our courtesan, Yufurong, is not only skilled in singing and dancing but also composes the music and writes the lyrics for her songs herself!

original_text: 月桂：玉芙蓉眼界可高了，普通富贵人家的公子，她可看不上眼，只有苏俊清苏公子，才稍微能博她一笑。
translation: Yuegui: Yufurong has very high standards; ordinary wealthy young masters don't catch her eye. Only Su Junqing, Young Master Su, can slightly make her smile.

original_text: 月桂：秦家的那个少夫人，也太想不开了！不就是死了相公嘛？又不愁吃穿，干嘛要寻死呀！
translation: Yuegui: That young mistress of the Qin family is too unreasonable! So what if her husband died? She's not lacking food or clothing, why seek death!

original_text: 月桂：最近啊，只要苏公子和公孙公子一块儿来我们歌榭，玉芙蓉的心情就特别好，曲儿也会多唱几首～可她到底是喜欢苏公子，还是喜欢公孙公子呢？
translation: Yuegui: Lately, whenever Master Su and Master Gongsun come to our song house together, Yufurong is in a particularly good mood and sings a few more songs~ But does she like Master Su or Master Gongsun?

original_text: 玉芙蓉：来我们倚栏歌榭的，大都是腰缠万贯的富贵之人，温言细语是假，寻欢作乐才是真。
translation: Yufurong: Most who come to our Yilan Song Pavilion are wealthy men laden with riches. Gentle words are false; seeking pleasure is the true aim.

original_text: 玉芙蓉：城里人都说我唱的曲儿不如琴姬唱的，但他们却不知道，我唱的是“燕乐”，她唱的是“清乐”，怎能放在一起比呢？
translation: Yufurong: People in the city say my songs aren't as good as Qin Ji's, but they don't know I sing 'Yanyue', while she sings 'Qingyue'. How can they be compared?

original_text: 玉芙蓉：反正都是要陪人饮酒作乐，与其对着一群秃头的胖子，不如对着两个年轻俊秀的公子，所以我才喜欢苏少爷和公孙少爷～
translation: Yufurong: Since I have to entertain and drink with people anyway, I'd rather face two handsome young masters than a bunch of bald, fat men. That's why I like Young Master Su and Young Master Gongsun~

original_text: 殷函月：原来“清风剑”张玉太张大侠也在陈州，我刚才遇到他，他还邀我共游龙湖，可惜我一见男人，就会浑身不自在，所以只能拒绝了他……
translation: Yin Hanyue: So 'Breeze Sword' Zhang Yutai, the great hero, is also in Chenzhou. I met him earlier, and he invited me to tour Dragon Lake together. Unfortunately, I feel uneasy around men, so I had to decline...

original_text: 殷函月：听说陈州董广号的老板年轻时也是一代大侠，玉树临风，曾博得无数江湖女子的青睐，却不知他到底为何要弃剑封刀，还在陈州开了布庄？
translation: Yin Hanyue: I heard that the owner of Dongguang Store in Chenzhou was also a great hero in his youth, handsome and dashing, winning the admiration of countless martial world women. But I wonder why he gave up his sword and sealed his blade, and even opened a cloth shop in Chenzhou?

original_text: 殷函月：我曾远远见过琴姬一面，她的武艺一定不弱，却已誓言封剑，真是太令人惋惜了……
translation: Yin Hanyue: I once saw Qin Ji from afar. Her martial arts must be formidable, yet she has vowed to seal her sword. Such a pity...

original_text: 殷函月：琴姬当年从夫家出走，我倒也能明白她的心情，江湖儿女过惯了自由自在的日子，一时间要拘束起来，谁也受不了啊。
translation: Yin Hanyue: I can understand Qin Ji's feelings when she left her husband's family. Those accustomed to the free life of the jianghu can't stand being constrained all at once.

original_text: 殷函月：那日我去了千佛塔，想找那些武僧来切磋一番，谁知道守在塔外的和尚根本不让我进去，说什么佛门清净之地，不接待女客！
translation: Yin Hanyue: That day, I went to the Thousand Buddha Pagoda hoping to spar with the warrior monks. Who knew the monks guarding outside wouldn't let me in, saying it's a pure Buddhist sanctuary and doesn't receive female guests!

original_text: 查七娃：爷爷说，弦歌台是从前孔圣人教书时待的地方～可那样的话，不是应该叫念书台吗？
translation: Zha Qiwa: Grandpa said, the Melody Terrace is where Confucius used to teach long ago~ But if that's the case, shouldn't it be called the Reading Terrace?

original_text: 查七娃：娘说我们要从塔里把爷爷的牌位接回来啦，这样以后我就再也不用爬那么高的塔去拜爷爷～
translation: Zha Qiwa: Mom said we're going to bring Grandpa's memorial tablet back from the tower. That way, I won't have to climb such a high tower to pay respects to Grandpa~

original_text: 查七娃：我喜欢看大象，如果能骑在大象背上，一定更好玩～
translation: Zha Qiwa: I like watching elephants. If I could ride on an elephant's back, it would be even more fun~

original_text: 陈泗：我从小喜欢习武，本想去龙湖边的百炼清钢打一把剑，可是刘铁匠说我气力不够，根本提不动他打的剑！
translation: Chen Si: I've loved martial arts since childhood. Wanted a sword from Hundred Refinements Steel by Dragon Lake, but Blacksmith Liu said I'm too weak to lift his swords!

original_text: 陈泗：“清风剑”张玉太张大侠说，他可以收我为徒，可条件却是要我能一手举起千斤之物……
translation: Chen Si: 'Breeze Sword' Zhang Yutai, the great hero, said he could take me as a disciple, but only if I can lift a thousand-catty weight with one hand...

original_text: 三顺：我觉得那弹琴的女人有点脸熟，就是想不起来在哪儿见过……没道理啊，她长那么漂亮……
translation: Sanshun: I think the woman playing the zither looks somewhat familiar, just can't remember where I've seen her... It doesn't make sense, she's so beautiful...

original_text: 三顺：原来那天在弦歌台上弹琴的女人是秦家的媳妇，不过已经被逐出家门了，难怪有点落魄。
translation: Sanshun: So the woman playing the qin on the Melody Terrace that day was the Qin family's daughter-in-law, but she's been expelled, no wonder she seemed down.

original_text: 陈久：那女子弹的曲子真好听，不知跟城里歌榭的玉芙蓉比起来，谁的琴技更好？
translation: Chen Jiu: That woman's zither melody is so beautiful. I wonder, compared to Yufurong from the city's song house, whose skill is better?

original_text: 陈久：听说前阵子在弦歌台上唱曲的女子已经走了，真是太可惜了……就算花大价钱去倚栏歌榭，都听不到那么好的曲子啊！
translation: Chen Jiu: I heard the woman singing on Melody Terrace recently has left-such a pity... Even spending a fortune at the Song Pavilion, you can't hear such fine tunes!

original_text: 洛梅：在前面弦歌台上弹唱的女子，我看着有点面善……是不是在哪里见过？
translation: Luo Mei: The woman singing and playing the qin on the Melody Terrace ahead looks familiar... have I seen her somewhere?

original_text: 洛梅：原来那琴姬是秦家的媳妇，难怪我总觉得面善，没想到她走了那么多年，竟然还会回来。
translation: Luo Mei: So that Qin Ji is the Qin family's daughter-in-law, no wonder she looked familiar. I never thought she'd return after all these years away.

original_text: 洛梅：玉芙蓉的曲子也是越唱越好听了，不过和琴姬比起来，总觉得缺了些什么……
translation: Luo Mei: Yufurong's songs are getting more pleasant to listen to, but compared to Qin Ji, it always feels like something's missing...

original_text: 金盏：弦歌台上那女子，弹唱都有几分能耐，凭她的本事，就算去了京城，也是不愁吃穿的。
translation: Jin Zhan: That woman on the Melody Terrace has some skill in playing and singing. With her abilities, she wouldn't lack food or clothing even in the capital.

original_text: 金盏：提起秦少爷，我也见过几面，那时候他还没成亲，为人温文尔雅，待我们歌榭的姑娘也不像别人那般轻浮，很多姐妹都喜欢他。
translation: Jin Zhan: Speaking of Young Master Qin, I've met him a few times. Back then, he wasn't married yet-refined and gentle, treating us girls at the songhouse with respect, unlike others. Many sisters liked him.

original_text: 金盏：清风拂柳絮，箜篌指尖唱，歌榭栏杆，酒不醉人人自醉。
translation: Jin Zhan: Breeze brushes willow catkins, the konghou sings at fingertips. Pavilion railings, the wine doesn't intoxicate, people intoxicate themselves.

original_text: 金盏：流水逐落红，琵琶因情动，飞燕轻舞，明月曾照彩云归。
translation: Jin Zhan: Flowing water chases fallen reds, the pipa stirs with emotion. Swallows dance lightly, the bright moon once shone upon colorful clouds returning.

original_text: 凌天守：此地是陈州府衙，知府大人现下不在府中，若你有拜帖，可先给我，待大人回来了，我会呈交于他。
translation: Ling Tianshou: This is the Chenzhou Prefecture office. The prefect is not currently in residence. If you have a name card, you may give it to me, and I will present it to him upon his return.

original_text: 凌天守：千佛塔里闹了桩人命，这事一定不简单，官府要好好查查！
translation: Ling Tianshou: There's been a death in Thousand Buddha Pagoda, this is definitely no simple matter, the authorities must investigate thoroughly!

original_text: 凌天守：知府大人三天两头不在府里，也不知道去了哪儿，我手里需要呈上去的拜帖已经有一叠了……
translation: Ling Tianshou: The prefect is rarely at his residence these days; no one knows where he goes. I have a stack of name cards that need to be presented to him...

original_text: 周慈：原先住在城里的秦老夫人，我也见过几次，看她家不像是落魄的样子，倒不知为什么要把房子卖了。
translation: Zhou Ci: I've seen Madam Qin, who used to live in the city, a few times. Her family didn't seem down on their luck, so I don't know why they sold the house.

original_text: 周慈：买宅子的时候，风水先生说那宅子煞气重～我就说了，这煞气不煞气的，都是人心里的鬼，多拜菩萨，多捐香火钱，心里的鬼跑了，就万事吉利了。
translation: Zhou Ci: When I bought the house, the Feng Shui master said the property had heavy negative energy~ I said, whether there's negative energy or not, it's all ghosts in people's hearts. Worship the Bodhisattva more, donate more incense money, drive the ghosts from your heart, and everything will be auspicious.

original_text: 柴忠：我们老爷和夫人是不久前才搬来这里的，听说这宅子不吉利，但是夫人很喜欢，老爷便买下了。
translation: Chai Zhong: Our master and mistress moved here not long ago. I heard this house is unlucky, but the mistress liked it, so our master bought it.

original_text: 穆婉蓉：这里的塔上有佛门圣物舍利子，所以这里的菩萨也特别灵，我每天都会来参拜。
translation: Mu Wanrong: There's a Buddhist relic in the pagoda here, so the Bodhisattva here is especially efficacious. I come to pay my respects every day.

original_text: 穆婉蓉：我相公的身子有些弱，一上船就晕，所以平时都不和我一起来庙里。
translation: Mu Wanrong: My husband is a bit weak and gets seasick as soon as he boards a boat, so he usually doesn't come to the temple with me.

original_text: 穆婉蓉：佛门圣地有了血光之象，太不吉利了……那姜氏一定是个苦命的女子……
translation: Mu Wanrong: A Buddhist sanctuary stained with blood-so inauspicious... That Lady Jiang must have been a woman of bitter fate...

original_text: 穆婉蓉：城里新搬来的那户人家，夫人也经常来拜菩萨，上次我还在旁边的祖师庙里见到她，看样子是在为出门在外的少爷求签。
translation: Mu Wanrong: The lady from that newly moved-in family in the city often comes to worship the Bodhisattva too. Last time, I saw her at the nearby Ancestral Temple. It seemed she was drawing lots for her young master who's away from home.

original_text: 穆婉蓉：骆家父子感情真好，骆少爷还小的时候，骆先生常来寺里为骆少爷上香，如今骆先生出远门去了，换骆少爷日日来此，为爹爹上香求平安。
translation: Mu Wanrong: The Luo father and son have such a good relationship. When Young Master Luo was little, Mr. Luo often came to the temple to burn incense for him. Now that Mr. Luo is away on a journey, Young Master Luo comes here every day to burn incense and pray for his father's safety.

original_text: 净慧：阿弥陀佛，善哉善哉，施主若是来拜佛，就请去佛堂，勿要随意乱闯，扰我佛门清净。
translation: Jinghui: Amitabha, very well, very well. If you've come to worship Buddha, please go to the Buddha hall. Do not wander around and disturb the purity of our temple.

original_text: 净慧：千佛塔上供奉牌位，原本也只是想借舍利圣光令死者求得宁静，如今染了秽气，真是罪过啊！阿弥陀佛！
translation: Jinghui: Enshrining memorial tablets in the Thousand Buddha Pagoda was originally meant to use the holy light of the relics to grant the deceased peace. Now that it's tainted with foul energy, it's truly a sin! Amitabha!

original_text: 净虚：阿弥陀佛，善哉善哉。我看施主身携刀剑，难道是来此和塔中师兄们切磋武艺？出家人六根清净，不会轻易向施主动武，施主还是请回吧。
translation: Jingxu: Amitabha, very well. I see you carry blades and swords, sir. Have you come to spar with the brothers in the pagoda? Monks are pure of the six senses and will not lightly engage in combat. Please return.

original_text: 净觉：祖师殿是寺僧做早课晚课、静思的地方，施主请勿入内。
translation: Jingjue: The Ancestral Hall is where monks perform morning and evening prayers and meditate. Please do not enter, benefactor.

original_text: 净觉：本寺修持，本着禅宗“不立文字，直指人心，见性成佛”之意，寺中经书不多，若心中有惑，就直接请方丈大师解惑。
translation: Jingjue: Our temple's practice follows the Chan principle of 'not relying on words, directly pointing to the mind, seeing one's nature to attain Buddhahood'. There are few scriptures here. If you have doubts, ask the abbot directly for guidance.

original_text: 净觉：方丈大师曾欲点化那位在塔中自尽的女施主，无奈女施主执念太重，终究无法明白方丈的一片苦心。
translation: Jingjue: The Abbot once tried to enlighten that lady who took her own life in the pagoda. Unfortunately, her attachments were too deep, and she ultimately failed to understand the Abbot's sincere efforts.

original_text: 净觉：最近有位女施主常来庙中参拜。贫僧看她面带和善之气，是富贵有福之人，加上她诚心向佛，日后必有善报。
translation: Jingjue: Recently, a female benefactor has been coming to the temple often to worship. This humble monk sees an aura of kindness on her face; she is a person of wealth and fortune. Combined with her sincere devotion to Buddha, she will surely receive good karma in the future.

original_text: 智圆：此地方丈不仅精通佛法，更是善弈，其弈之法，不着痕迹，不露杀意，却将贫僧的执念看的通透，真乃高人也！
translation: Zhi Yuan: The abbot here is not only well-versed in Buddhist teachings but also skilled at chess. His chess style leaves no trace, shows no killing intent, yet sees through my attachments clearly. Truly a master!

original_text: 智圆：贫僧在此地数日，每日同方丈大师手谈数局，每次皆以一、二子落败，但都深得启发。
translation: Zhi Yuan: I've been here several days, playing a few rounds of Go daily with the abbot. Each time I lose by one or two stones, but I gain deep insights.

original_text: 智圆：贫僧在此打扰甚久，每日同方丈大师对弈论禅，受益良多，如今也该启程回去了。
translation: Zhi Yuan: I have troubled you here for quite some time. Discussing chess and Zen with the abbot daily has been most enlightening. Now, it's time for me to depart.

original_text: 净念：智圆你须知道，一味猛斗狠杀，终究流于下品，你我空门中人，原就讲求无欲而欢，如你般行棋，无益修禅。
translation: Jingnian: Zhiyuan, you must understand that relentless aggression and killing ultimately remain inferior. We who have entered the monastic life originally seek joy without desire. Playing chess as you do is of no benefit to Zen cultivation.

original_text: 智圆：智圆与大师多番对弈，心中亦明白这个道理。只是一旦开局，总不能放下心中的执念，还请方丈大师指点。
translation: Zhi Yuan: After many games with the master, I also understand this principle. But once the game starts, I can't let go of my attachments. Please, Abbot, offer some guidance.

original_text: 净念：你当记得，棋盘是禅堂，是山林，不是沙场。对弈之乐在于坐隐，在于忘忧，而不是自寻烦恼。
translation: Jingnian: Remember, the chessboard is a meditation hall, a mountain forest, not a battlefield. The joy of chess lies in sitting in seclusion, in forgetting worries, not in seeking trouble.

original_text: 净念：城里贺家的女施主是个清心寡欲之人，常来此找贫僧谈经论佛，言语间很有见地。贫僧看她也是与佛有缘，只是心中尚有放不下的事，才迟迟没有出家罢了。
translation: Jingnian: The female benefactor from the He family in the city is a person of simple desires. She often comes here to discuss scriptures and Buddhism with me, and her words show great insight. I see she has an affinity with Buddhism, but there are still things in her heart she cannot let go of, which is why she hasn't taken monastic vows yet.

original_text: 净念：常来找贫僧论佛的贺家女施主几日前和一名公子同来，原来他们俩佳期将近，她果然还是尘缘未断。
translation: Jingnian: The Lady He who often comes to discuss Buddhism with this humble monk came a few days ago with a young gentleman. It turns out they are soon to be wed. She truly remains bound to worldly ties.

original_text: 净善：方丈师父好弈，棋力很高，贫僧跟他学了几年，现在同师父下棋，需师父授贫僧七子，才可勉强下出平局。
translation: Jingshan: Abbot Shifu loves playing Go and is highly skilled. After learning from him for a few years, I now need him to give me seven handicap stones to barely manage a draw.

original_text: 净善：经常有棋力高强的人来寺里找方丈师父切磋，不过除了城里来的一位贺姓女施主，别人的棋艺都不能和师父相提并论。
translation: Jingshan: Many skilled chess players often come to the temple to challenge the abbot, but aside from a female patron surnamed He from the city, none can match the master's skill.

original_text: 净善：城中的秦施主是有善心之人，以前时常陪他母亲来寺里参拜，十分孝顺，没想到生了场大病，就这么过世了，佛说死生无常，贫僧似乎还是放不下……
translation: Jingshan: The Qin patron in the city was a kind-hearted soul. He used to accompany his mother to the temple for worship, very filial. Who would have thought he'd fall gravely ill and pass away just like that? The Buddha says life and death are impermanent, yet this humble monk still seems unable to let go...

original_text: 净善：前几日贺姓的女施主带一名公子来寺里，说那位公子前年刚开始学棋，棋力尚浅，让贫僧与他切磋一二，没想到贫僧跟方丈学棋那么多年，却是一败涂地……
translation: Jingshan: A few days ago, a female benefactor surnamed He brought a young master to the temple. She said he only started learning chess the year before last and his skill was still shallow, asking me to play a game or two with him. Who would have thought that after learning chess from the abbot for so many years, I would be utterly defeated...

original_text: 净慈：贫僧曾得一本菜谱，才知即便是素斋，亦有千变万化之理，以前所想未免太过肤浅！阿弥陀佛！
translation: Jingci: I once obtained a cookbook and realized that even vegetarian dishes have endless variations. My previous thinking was too shallow! Amitabha!

original_text: 净慈：阿弥陀佛，善哉善哉！那位女施主在塔里守灵不少时日，原以为她能感悟我佛教诲，没想到却还是执迷啊……
translation: Jingci: Amitabha, well said, well said! That female benefactor has been keeping vigil in the pagoda for quite some time. I thought she might come to understand the teachings of our Buddha, but it seems she remains deluded...

original_text: 净慈：寿阳的东禅寺正在修缮，寺中诸人如今住在寿阳城外的真武庙，真武庙离陈州不远，所以常有东禅寺的僧人来这里同论佛法。
translation: Jingci: The Dongchan Temple in Shouyang is currently under renovation, and the temple's residents are now staying at the Zhenwu Temple outside Shouyang City. Since Zhenwu Temple is not far from Chenzhou, monks from Dongchan Temple often come here to discuss Buddhist teachings.

original_text: 方勇杰：知府大人离开陈州，是去见一位从京城来的贵人。听说那位贵人是来陈州附近游历，不肯入城，知府大人只能出城相见。
translation: Fang Yongjie: The prefect left Chenzhou to meet a noble from the capital. I heard that noble is traveling near Chenzhou and refused to enter the city, so the prefect had to go out to meet him.

original_text: 方勇杰：千佛塔上都闹出人命来了，知府大人他、他……到底是什么重要的贵人，让知府大人出城那么多天还不回来？
translation: Fang Yongjie: There's been a murder at the Thousand Buddha Pagoda! The prefect, he... he... What important noble is it that has kept the prefect away from the city for so many days?

original_text: 方勇杰：唉，知府大人既然不在，不如放我们几天假吧？……
translation: Fang Yongjie: Sigh, since the prefect isn't here, why not give us a few days off?...

original_text: 牡丹：说什么“昆山玉碎凤凰叫，芙蓉泣露香兰笑”～…我奏的曲子哪有这能耐呀！司马公子最爱说笑了！
translation: Mudan: Saying 'Kunshan jade shatters, phoenix cries; lotus weeps dew, orchid smiles'~... How could my music have such power! Young Master Sima loves to joke!

original_text: 司马朝文：我可是认真的！牡丹小姐的箜篌弹奏得如此绝妙无双，即使是京城教坊司里，在皇上面前奏乐的姑娘也比不上你啊！
translation: Sima Chaowen: I'm serious! Miss Mudan's konghou playing is so exquisitely unparalleled, even the girls performing before the emperor in the capital's Music Bureau can't compare to you!

original_text: 牡丹：司马公子总赞我弹奏的曲子比京里教坊司的还动人，若真是如此，我还会坐在这里吗？这些有钱男人的话，没半句是真心的。
translation: Mudan: Sima always praises the tunes I play as more moving than those from the imperial music bureau in the capital. If that were true, would I still be sitting here? These wealthy men's words aren't sincere at all.

original_text: 牡丹：以前秦家少爷未成亲的时候，常来歌榭里和我们谈曲论调，言语间温文有礼，不知比其他轻薄的公子好多少，后来他娶亲了，就再也没来过歌榭。听说他过世的时候，歌榭里认识他的姐妹都很伤心呢。
translation: Mudan: Before the Qin family's young master got married, he often came to the song pavilion to discuss melodies and tunes with us. His speech was gentle and courteous, far better than those frivolous young nobles. After he married, he never visited the song pavilion again. When we heard of his passing, all the sisters here who knew him were deeply saddened.

original_text: 牡丹：杨景庄杨公子人生得俊，又懂音律，还写得一首好诗词，常为歌榭里的姑娘填词，我们每唱一曲杨公子的新词，来歌榭的客人便是平日的两三倍，他真是有才！
translation: Mudan: Young Master Yang Jingzhuang is handsome, skilled in music, and writes excellent poetry. He often composes lyrics for the girls in the song pavilion. Every time we sing a new piece of his, the number of customers doubles or triples. He's truly talented!

original_text: 司马朝文：牡丹姑娘弹奏的曲子自然是很好听，但真要去皇上面前弹奏，就稍欠几分火候了。不过能在陈州这地方听到这样的曲子，也算不容易～
translation: Sima Chaowen: Miss Mudan's music is naturally very pleasant, but to play before the Emperor, it lacks a bit of refinement. Still, hearing such music here in Chenzhou is quite rare~

original_text: 司马朝文：不知那琴姬本名为何，家住何处？我若能寻她到皇上面前弹唱一曲，一定能博得龙颜大悦，说不定还能立刻让我加官进爵！
translation: Sima Chaowen: I wonder what Qin Ji's real name is, where she lives? If I could find her to play before the Emperor, it would surely please His Majesty, maybe even get me a promotion right away!

original_text: 司马朝文：哼！那个姓杨的书生不就是凭着自己略通音律，作些浮艳的诗词，把这里的姑娘哄得服服贴贴，个个都对他推崇得不得了！这种“以才谋艳”的书生，简直就是读书人中的败类！
translation: Sima Chaowen: Hmph! That scholar surnamed Yang just relies on his slight musical talent and writes some flashy, shallow poems, sweet-talking all the girls here into being completely charmed, each praising him endlessly! This kind of scholar who 'uses talent to pursue beauty' is simply the scum of the literati!

original_text: 朱长风：牡丹小姐，别理这家伙的胡言乱语！来！猜猜我把玉佩放在哪只酒杯下了？猜对了玉佩就送你，猜错了可要罚酒！
translation: Zhu Changfeng: Miss Mudan, ignore this guy's nonsense! Come! Guess which cup I hid the jade pendant under? Guess right and it's yours; guess wrong and you drink a penalty!

original_text: 牡丹：嘻嘻，朱大侠在此数日，同我耍玩这分曹射覆之戏，已经让我赢得三枚玉佩，十多锭银子了，还要继续玩？这次若我猜对了，不仅那玉佩是我的，朱大侠你还得连罚三十杯！
translation: Mudan: Hehe, Sir Zhu has been here for days, playing this guessing game with me, and I've already won three jade pendants and over ten silver ingots. Still want to continue? If I guess right this time, not only is the pendant mine, but you, Sir Zhu, must also drink thirty penalty cups!

original_text: 朱长风：别看牡丹姑娘一介女流，流落风尘，就凭她同我玩分曹射覆之戏时的眼力，只要有名师指点，不出三年，牡丹姑娘一定是一流的暗器好手！
translation: Zhu Changfeng: Don't underestimate Miss Mudan just because she's a woman who has fallen into hardship. Based on her keen eye when playing the 'Fen Cao She Fu' game with me, with proper guidance, within three years, Miss Mudan will definitely become a top-tier hidden weapon expert!

original_text: 朱长风：我送你那么多玉佩首饰，天天来此听你弹曲、陪你喝酒，你就不能多念几句我的好，少说几句那个秦逸吗？
translation: Zhu Changfeng: I've given you so many jade pendants and jewelry, coming here every day to listen to you play music and drink with you. Can't you say a few more good things about me and mention that Qin Yi less often?

original_text: 朱长风：牡丹姑娘最近又喜欢上了一个姓杨的书生，说什么杨公子所作之曲甚合她心……唉，她眼中有谁却也没有我啊……
translation: Zhu Changfeng: Miss Mudan has recently taken a liking to a scholar named Yang, saying his compositions suit her taste... Sigh, her eyes see everyone but me...

original_text: 海棠：来我们这里的，管你长得俊还是丑，有钱就是大爷～
translation: Haitang: Those who come here, handsome or ugly, if you have money, you're a lord~

original_text: 海棠：听说皇上要来咱陈州，妈妈整天催着我练舞，可是那跳给皇上看的八佾舞要六十四个姐妹一起呢，光叫我一个人练有什么用！
translation: Haitang: I heard the Emperor is coming to our Chenzhou. The Madam keeps urging me to practice dancing all day, but the Bayi Dance for the Emperor requires sixty-four sisters together! What's the use of making me practice alone!

original_text: 海棠：秦家有财有势，秦少爷又用情专一，真想不通那个琴姬当年有什么不满意，要离家出走！
translation: Haitang: The Qin family is wealthy and powerful, and Young Master Qin is devoted in love. I really can't understand why Qin Ji was dissatisfied back then, to run away from home!

original_text: 海棠：司马大人和朱公子每天都缠着牡丹，苏公子和公孙少爷同玉芙蓉的交情也不错，为什么看上我的却都是些又胖又臭的老男人？……
translation: Haitang: Lord Sima and Young Master Zhu pester Mudan every day. Young Master Su and Young Master Gongsun are also quite close with Yufurong. Why are the ones who fancy me all fat, smelly old men?...

original_text: 王福海：你们倚栏歌榭是怎么搞的！我一个人在这里坐了老半天才有个姑娘来招呼！不知道我是安溪第一茶商吗？！
translation: Wang Fuhai: What's going on with you at Yilan Song Pavilion! I've been sitting here alone for ages before a girl came to attend to me! Don't you know I'm the top tea merchant in Anxi?!

original_text: 海棠：哟！我还道是哪位员外大人呢！原来是王老爷呀～真是不好意思了，让您久等～
translation: Haitang: Oh! I thought it was some rich master! So it's Master Wang~ I'm really sorry to have kept you waiting~

original_text: 王福海：哼！不就是一群卖艺的下贱女子吗？！口气排场大得跟什么似的，我找一个姑娘弹曲，竟然让我在这儿等了整整一个时辰！
translation: Wang Fuhai: Hmph! Just a bunch of lowly performing girls! Their airs are so grand! I asked for a girl to play a tune and actually had to wait here two full hours!

original_text: 王福海：喝一杯酒要三两银子？没弄错吧？！
translation: Wang Fuhai: Three taels of silver for a cup of wine? Are you sure?!

original_text: 海棠：哎呀～王老爷您这就不懂了，所谓酒不醉人人自醉嘛～好酒也须美人斟～
translation: Haitang: Aiya~ Master Wang, you don't understand. As they say, 'It's not the wine that intoxicates, but the drinker'. Fine wine also needs a beauty to pour it~

original_text: 王福海：听说这歌榭里的姑娘跳起舞来，好比天上的仙女！我从安溪来陈州，一为茶叶生意，再为了就是想看这儿的姑娘跳舞！
translation: Wang Fuhai: I hear the girls in this song pavilion dance like celestial fairies! I came from Anxi to Chenzhou partly for the tea business, but also to see the girls dance here!

original_text: 秋英：其实姐妹们跳得最好的舞是佾舞，由歌榭里六十四个姐妹一起演，那场面可漂亮啦！
translation: Qiuying: Actually, the best dance among us sisters is the Yi Dance, performed by all sixty-four sisters from the song hall. The spectacle is truly magnificent!

original_text: 秋英：金盏一大早就跑出去了，说是待在船上闷得慌，非要出去走走，我猜她一定是看上哪家的公子，私会去了～
translation: Qiuying: Jin Zhan ran out early this morning, saying she was bored staying on the ship and insisted on going for a walk. I bet she's taken a fancy to some young master and went for a secret rendezvous~

original_text: 秋英：陈州的年轻公子，也就只有秦逸秦少爷是个好人，以前来我们歌榭，待姐妹们也都不错，可惜好人偏偏不长命啊……
translation: Qiuying: Among Chenzhou's young gentlemen, only Qin Yi was a good man. He used to visit our song house and treated the sisters well. Sadly, good people often die young...

original_text: 秋英：不懂音律的人常分不清琴和筝，其实听音即可分辨，琴声低而绵长，绕梁不绝于耳，筝音脆而动人，如泉流淌不息。
translation: Qiuying: Those unfamiliar with music often confuse qin and zheng. Actually, listen: qin sounds low and lingering, echoing endlessly; zheng is crisp and moving, like flowing spring water.

original_text: 慕蒂：我们听说中原繁华，就跟着大姐赛乃慕从西域到这里来，卖掉家乡带来的一些首饰，开了这家酒肆～
translation: Muti: Hearing of the Central Plains' prosperity, we followed our elder sister, Senem, from the Western Regions here. We sold some jewelry brought from home and opened this winery~

original_text: 慕蒂：中原女人唱的曲子好听是好听，但却很悲伤，歌不是快乐的时候才唱吗？为什么要那么伤心呢？
translation: Muti: The songs sung by Central Plains women are pleasant but very sad. Aren't songs supposed to be sung when happy? Why are they so sorrowful?

original_text: 慕蒂：你们中原的诗人说“葡萄美酒夜光杯”，葡萄酒和夜光杯我们千斗酒坊都有，客人要不要尝尝看？
translation: Muti: You Central Plains poets say, 'Fine wine in luminous cups'. We at Bottomless Cup have both grape wine and luminous cups. Would you like to try some, guests?

original_text: 宋豪书：唐女侠，我只是一个手无缚鸡之力的书生，并非是你所说的什么“夺命书生”，根本不可能和你一起去闯什么王陵，你一定是认错人了！
translation: Song Haoshu: Lady Tang, I am merely a scholar who cannot harm a fly, not the 'Life-Taking Scholar' you speak of. It's impossible for me to venture into some royal tomb with you. You must have mistaken me for someone else!

original_text: 唐含秋：我不管，反正就是夺命书生约我今日此时在千斗酒坊相见，你生得这么俊，还背着一把伞，跟江湖传闻的夺命书生完全一个样，不可能不是他！
translation: Tang Hanqiu: I don't care, anyway, it's the Deadly Scholar who arranged to meet me today at this time in Bottomless Cup. You're so handsome and carry an umbrella, exactly like the Deadly Scholar from Jianghu rumors-you can't not be him!

original_text: 宋豪书：全天下的书生出门赶考，总会带着伞，女侠你不能因为我带着伞，就说我是那什么夺命书生啊！女侠真拉我去闯江湖，我必是一命呜呼的！
translation: Song Haoshu: All scholars traveling for exams always carry umbrellas. Just because I have an umbrella, you can't say I'm that so-called Deadly Scholar! If you drag me into the martial world, I'd surely die!

original_text: 宋豪书：我上京赶考，路过此地见酒肆有葡萄美酒，所以进来喝上一杯，没想到就被这位女侠误认为是什么“夺命书生”了，这……可如何是好呀！
translation: Song Haoshu: I'm on my way to the capital for the exams. Passing by, I saw grape wine at the winery, so I came in for a drink. I never expected to be mistaken by this lady warrior as the 'Deadly Scholar'. This... what should I do?

original_text: 宋豪书：读书人最好还是不要和那些江湖人扯上关系，否则都会和秦府那个少爷一样，自己被江湖女子累死不说，还辜负了秦夫人这般痴情的烈女子……
translation: Song Haoshu: Scholars are best off not getting involved with those martial artists. Otherwise, they'll end up like the Qin family's young master-not only worn out by a martial arts woman himself, but also failing a passionate, devoted woman like Madam Qin...

original_text: 宋豪书：唐女侠，你放我上路去京城吧！再耽搁，我就要赶不上今年的殿试啦！
translation: Song Haoshu: Lady Tang, please let me go to the capital! If delayed any longer, I'll miss this year's imperial examination!

original_text: 唐含秋：这有何难？凭你夺命书生的本事，要抵挡我手中的长剑，根本不费吹灰之力！
translation: Tang Hanqiu: What's so difficult about that? With your Deadly Scholar skills, blocking the longsword in my hand should be effortless!

original_text: 宋豪书：我说了几千几万遍了，我不是女侠你找的什么夺命书生，半点武功都不会，女侠你就不要再为难小生了！……天呐……
translation: Song Haoshu: I've said it thousands of times, I'm not the Deadly Scholar you're looking for, I don't know any martial arts at all. Lady Warrior, please stop troubling this humble scholar!... Heavens...

original_text: 宋豪书：再不启程上京，就要赶不上殿试开考了！可这位唐女侠武功了得，三两下就能把我制得动也动不了……
translation: Song Haoshu: If we don't set off for the capital soon, we'll miss the palace examination! But this Lady Tang is incredibly skilled in martial arts, she can subdue me in just a few moves, leaving me unable to move...

original_text: 唐含秋：这夺命书生好奇怪，明明就是他用飞鸽传书约我来此处相见，我来找他，他却硬说自己是不懂武功的读书人，他这葫芦里到底卖的什么药！
translation: Tang Hanqiu: This Deadly Scholar is so strange. Clearly, he sent a carrier pigeon message to arrange a meeting here. I came to find him, but he insists he's just a scholar who knows no martial arts. What kind of trick is he playing?!

original_text: 唐含秋：就算我面前这人真不是夺命书生，我也要逼他承认是！我唐含秋认错人的事情要是传了出去，今后可怎么在江湖上混！
translation: Tang Hanqiu: Even if the person before me isn't the Deadly Scholar, I'll force him to admit he is! If word got out that I, Tang Hanqiu, misidentified someone, how could I ever survive in the jianghu!

original_text: 唐含秋：琴姬八成是被那个秦少爷迷昏了头，不然好好的江湖儿女，怎么会看上那种又呆又蠢的迂腐少爷？
translation: Tang Hanqiu: Qin Ji must have been utterly bewitched by that Young Master Qin. Otherwise, why would a fine, free-spirited martial artist fall for such a dull, foolish, and pedantic young master?

original_text: 唐含秋：这夺命书生真是气死人！他竟然说要去赶考，当什么狗官，一身武功不就荒废了？！
translation: Tang Hanqiu: That Deadly Scholar is infuriating! He actually said he's going to take the imperial exams and become some corrupt official. Wouldn't all his martial arts go to waste?!

original_text: 露丽尔：哟～客人，我正忙着，你先去旁边坐一坐好吗？我马上就来～
translation: Lulir: Oh~ Customer, I'm busy right now. Could you go sit over there for a moment? I'll be right with you~

original_text: 露丽尔：夜里……我好像听到一首很哀伤的曲子，到底是谁在弹琴呢？
translation: Lulir: At night... I seem to hear a very sorrowful tune. Who on earth is playing the qin?

original_text: 露丽尔：酒肆的生意好，大姐打算回一趟家乡，多带几个姐妹出来，然后再盖一间更大的酒肆，夜夜唱歌跳舞，把那个倚栏歌榭比下去！
translation: Lulir: The winery business is good. Big Sister plans to return home, bring out a few more sisters, and then build an even bigger winery. We'll sing and dance every night, outshining that 'Yilan Song Pavilion'!

original_text: 安尼瓦尔：这是怎么搞的！这么点酒居然这样贵！在我的家乡可不是这样的……
translation: Anwar: What's going on here! Such a small amount of wine is so expensive! In my hometown, it's not like this...

original_text: 安尼瓦尔：没想到中原的葡萄酒这么大价钱，还有许多人喝……以后我也来中原开酒坊好了！
translation: Anwar: I never expected Central Plains wine to be so expensive, with so many people drinking it... I should open a winery in the Central Plains later!

original_text: 安尼瓦尔：姑娘，你的家乡是哪？是疏勒镇还是碎叶镇？
translation: Anwar: Miss, where is your hometown? Shule Town or Suiye Town?

original_text: 露丽尔：我说了你也不一定知道～反正姐妹们都是在龟兹认识的，后来就跟着商队来了中原。
translation: Lulir: Even if I tell you, you might not know~ Anyway, my sisters and I met in Kucha, then followed the caravan to the Central Plains.

original_text: 孙碧露：罗老板卖的炸馓子香酥可口，远近闻名，别处可吃不着。
translation: Sun Bilu: Boss Luo's fried sanzi are crispy and tasty, famous far and wide-you can't get them elsewhere.

original_text: 孙碧露：戏台对面小摊的罗聪很爱喝酒，连他的醉枣也特别好吃！
translation: Sun Bilu: Luo Cong at the stall opposite the stage loves to drink-even his drunken dates are especially delicious!

original_text: 孙碧露：那秦家少夫人也太想不开啦！吃穿不愁的，寻什么死？
translation: Sun Bilu: That young Mrs. Qin is too stubborn! She has no worries about food or clothing, why seek death?

original_text: 孙碧露：年轻的女孩子好像都喜欢吃小食，我就常在这小摊前看见倚栏歌榭的姑娘买醉枣。
translation: Sun Bilu: Young girls all seem to love snacks. I often see girls from the song pavilion buying drunken dates at this stall.

original_text: 谭八：十八年前，江湖上曾出现过一名人称“影煞孤魂”的杀手，他在一夜之间连杀四十名白道高手，之后力竭而亡！不过最近好像又有传闻说那“影煞孤魂”并没有死，而且已经在陈州隐居很久啦！
translation: Tan Ba: Eighteen years ago, a killer known as 'Lone Shadow Ghost' appeared in the martial world. He killed forty righteous martial arts masters in a single night before dying from exhaustion! But recently, there seem to be rumors that the 'Lone Shadow Ghost' isn't dead and has been living in seclusion in Chenzhou for a long time!

original_text: 谭八：话说二十多年前，我曾在陈州遇到过当时赫赫有名的铁琴女侠，那风姿、那琴艺，都和这琴姬如出一辙，我敢肯定琴姬就是铁琴女侠的后人！
translation: Tan Ba: Speaking of over twenty years ago, I once met the then-famous Iron Lute Heroine in Chenzhou. Her grace and lute skills were exactly like this Qin Ji's. I'm sure Qin Ji is a descendant of the Iron Lute Heroine!

original_text: 谭八：骆家少爷小小年纪就使得一手好剑法，连我都看不出他的师承来历！听说这位少爷的师父是骆先生的至交好友……说不定骆先生以前就是江湖中了不得的人物！
translation: Tan Ba: The young master of the Luo family, despite his youth, wields an excellent sword technique. Even I cannot discern his martial lineage! I heard his master is a close friend of Mr. Luo... Perhaps Mr. Luo was once an extraordinary figure in the martial world!

original_text: 谭八：川蜀唐门以毒功闻名江湖，武林中人对他们通常都是敬而远之，倒是想不通最近为什么会传出那夺命书生约唐家堡三小姐在陈州相会之事？
translation: Tan Ba: The Sichuan-Shu Tang Clan is renowned in the martial world for their poison arts, and martial artists usually keep a respectful distance from them. I really can't figure out why recently there's been news that the Deadly Scholar arranged to meet the third young lady of Tang Fort in Chenzhou?

original_text: 艾米拉：苏少爷是知府大人的公子，他经常会带许多朋友来我们酒坊喝酒，二楼里间的那几个座位，几乎是苏少爷包了的。
translation: Amila: Young Master Su is the magistrate's son. He often brings friends to our winery. Those seats in the inner room upstairs are almost reserved for him.

original_text: 艾米拉：这几天来来往往的客人都在说一个名叫“琴姬”的女人，说她唱的歌儿好听，我们酒坊的姐妹也会唱歌，改天一定要和那个“琴姬”比一比！
translation: Amila: These past few days, all the coming and going guests have been talking about a woman named 'Qin Ji', saying her songs are lovely. The sisters at our winery can sing too; someday we must definitely compete with that 'Qin Ji'!

original_text: 艾米拉：中原的英俊男子真是多，可惜却都不怎么强壮高大，看起来都是一副不可靠的样子。
translation: Amila: There are so many handsome men in the Central Plains, but sadly, not many are strong and tall. They all look rather unreliable.

original_text: 拜合蒂：我们酒坊的葡萄酒、三勒浆，那可是别的店里喝不到的，客人您既然都已经来了，就进去喝两杯吧～～
translation: Bahti: Our winery's grape wine and Sanlejiang are unmatched elsewhere. Since you're here, guest, why not come in for a couple of cups~~

original_text: 拜合蒂：中原的女人真是太奇怪了，情郎死了可以再找一个啊！年纪轻轻的就殉情，多不划算呀！
translation: Bahti: Women from the Central Plains are so strange! If your lover dies, you can just find another one! Sacrificing yourself so young is such a poor bargain!

original_text: 拜合蒂：从我们家乡来的人都说我们酒坊的葡萄酒没有家乡的好，可这也不是我们的错呀！中原的葡萄不比家乡的葡萄甜，酿出来的酒，味道当然也会不一样。
translation: Bahti: Folks from our hometown say our winery's wine isn't as good as back home, but it's not our fault! Grapes here aren't as sweet, so the wine's flavor naturally differs.

original_text: 帕夏：最近城里常常有个中原女人在唱歌，唱的真是好听极了！可惜我每次等酒坊打烊了去找她，却总也找不到……
translation: Pasha: Recently, there's often a woman from the Central Plains singing in the city. She sings so beautifully! It's a pity that every time I go look for her after the winery closes, I can never find her...

original_text: 帕夏：听说那个在城里唱歌的女人已经走了，不知道她还会不会回来？真想再听她弹唱的曲子呀……
translation: Pasha: I heard the woman who sang in the city has left. I wonder if she'll come back? I really want to hear her play and sing again...

original_text: 帕夏：大姐已经托商队捎消息回家乡，请家乡的姐妹跟着商队一起来陈州，那样我们千斗酒坊以后也能像那个倚栏歌榭一样，每天夜里都唱歌跳舞！
translation: Pasha: My elder sister has already sent a message home with a merchant caravan, asking our sisters from our hometown to come to Chenzhou with the caravan. That way, our Bottomless Cup can also be like that Yilan Song Pavilion, singing and dancing every night!

original_text: 来奉：咱升平客栈有淮河两岸最好的厨子、最上等的美酒、最舒服的上房！客官您可要歇息一下再上路呀？
translation: Lai Feng: Our Shengping Inn has the best chefs from both sides of the Huai River, the finest wines, and the most comfortable rooms! Would you like to rest a bit before continuing your journey, honored guest?

original_text: 来奉：什么？你问我那边猪肉摊的老板哪儿去了？哈哈，八成又在哪儿喝醉了酒，不记得回来照顾生意啦！
translation: Lai Feng: What? You're asking where the boss of that pork stall went? Haha, probably drunk somewhere again, forgetting to come back and tend to business!

original_text: 来奉：一大早就听说湖心岛上死了人，还是死在千佛塔里的……这佛门圣地闹了血光之灾，真是不吉利啊！
translation: Lai Feng: Early in the morning, I heard someone died on the island in the lake center, right inside the Thousand Buddha Pagoda... This sacred Buddhist site stained with bloodshed is truly inauspicious!

original_text: 来奉：嘿！告诉你一个秘密！陈州董广号的师傅可是昔日江湖上的大人物！他手中那对裁布刀——哦不，锋锐的匕首，曾经杀了不知道多少江湖中人呢！
translation: Lai Feng: Hey! Tell you a secret! The master at Chenzhou's Dongguang Store was once a big figure in the martial world! That pair of cloth-cutting knives-no, sharp daggers-in his hands have killed who knows how many martial artists!

original_text: 杜鹃：这湖面上传来的曲声……不像是我们歌榭里姐妹弹奏的……那么好听的曲子……到底是谁呢？
translation: Dujuan: The music coming from the lake... doesn't sound like it's played by the sisters from our song pavilion... Such beautiful music... who could it be?

original_text: 杜鹃：秦家少爷我倒是认得，当年他也常来歌榭和我们姐妹评曲论调，半分富家公子的架子也没有……可惜这样的好人却不长命……
translation: Dujuan: I actually knew the young master of the Qin family. Back then, he often came to the songhouse to discuss melodies and tunes with us sisters, without any airs of a wealthy young master... It's a shame such a good person didn't live long...

original_text: 杜鹃：我听人说，董广号的裁缝师傅其实是个武林高手！可上次我去裁衣服，他那双眼睛直勾勾地盯着我瞧，哪里有什么高手的样子呀～～
translation: Dujuan: I heard people say the tailor at Dongguang store is actually a martial arts master! But last time I went to get clothes made, his eyes were staring straight at me. What kind of master looks like that~~

original_text: 春梅：小哥儿生得真俊俏，让姐姐我看了好生喜欢，要不要姐姐陪你进歌榭喝两杯呀？
translation: Chun Mei: Young man, you're so handsome, it makes this sister quite fond of you. How about I accompany you into the songhouse for a couple of drinks?

original_text: 春梅：哟！真是个可爱的女娃儿～不过小姑娘家的，最好还是不要随便出入这种风月之地啦～
translation: Chun Mei: Oh! What a lovely girl~ But a young lady like you really shouldn't casually visit such pleasure quarters~

original_text: 春梅：什么“贞妇贵殉夫，舍生亦如此”，我看全都是胡说的！要真如此，天下的青楼女子都可以不用活了！
translation: Chun Mei: What 'A chaste woman values dying for her husband, sacrificing life is also like this'-I think it's all nonsense! If that were true, all the courtesans in the world wouldn't need to live!

original_text: 春梅：其实也有些富家公子老爷帮歌榭的姑娘赎身的，只是那些被带走的姑娘，真正过得快乐的，却也没有几个……
translation: Chun Mei: Actually, some wealthy young masters and lords do redeem the songhouse girls. But among those taken away, truly few end up living happily...

original_text: 李常贵：小茉，我是你哥哥啊！当年家里穷，爹娘没法子才把你卖到青楼，现今哥哥有钱替你赎身了，跟哥哥回家吧！
translation: Li Changgui: Xiao Mo, I'm your brother! Back then, the family was poor, and our parents had no choice but to sell you to the brothel. Now I have money to buy your freedom. Come home with me!

original_text: 茉莉：哼，当年家里穷便要卖了我，现在才想到还有我这个妹妹？这若是家里再出什么事，是不是还要把我卖第二回？！
translation: Moli: Hmph, back when the family was poor, they wanted to sell me off. Now they remember they have a sister? If something happens again at home, will they sell me a second time?!

original_text: 李常贵：看茉莉的样子，似乎挺中意这位赵员外的，但是这门不当户不对的，就像那个琴姬和秦少爷一样，不会有好结果的呀！
translation: Li Changgui: Looking at Moli, she seems quite fond of this Squire Zhao, but with such a mismatch in social status, just like that Qin Ji and Young Master Qin, it won't end well!

original_text: 李常贵：罢了、罢了，只要茉莉她喜欢，跟谁走也都是一样的，现在只盼望这赵员外以后能善待茉莉……
translation: Li Changgui: Enough, enough. As long as Moli likes him, it's all the same who she goes with. Now I just hope Squire Zhao will treat her well in the future...

original_text: 赵员外：茉莉啊茉莉～～我这次去京城做生意，回来之后就立即为你赎身，带你走！
translation: Squire Zhao: Moli, oh Moli~~ I'll go to the capital on business this time and redeem you as soon as I return, then take you away!

original_text: 茉莉：哦？是吗？那妾身真是要多谢赵员外的厚爱了～～～
translation: Moli: Oh? Is that so? Then I must thank Squire Zhao for his great affection~~~

original_text: 赵员外：茉莉啊，我看这个郎中的样子根本就不像是你的什么哥哥，我不在陈州的时候，你可要千万别被他骗了去！
translation: Squire Zhao: Moli, this doctor doesn't look like any brother of yours at all. While I'm away from Chenzhou, you mustn't let him deceive you!

original_text: 赵员外：上次去京城做了一笔大生意，还在京城置办了一处房舍，这回替茉莉赎了身，也不愁没地方安置她了。
translation: Squire Zhao: Last time in the capital, I made a big deal and bought a house there. Now that I've redeemed Moli, I don't worry about where to place her.

original_text: 茉莉：这陈州富庶繁华，歌舞升平，就算要看着一群臭男人的脸色过日子，也比回乡下老家好～
translation: Moli: This Chenzhou is prosperous and bustling, full of song and dance. Even if I have to endure the whims of those wretched men, it's better than returning to the rural hometown~

original_text: 茉莉：唉……如果我有那琴姬的能耐，就算不去闯荡江湖，也能上京城进教坊司，横竖都不用待在这儿看这群臭男人的脸色～
translation: Moli: Sigh... If I had Qin Ji's talent, even without venturing into the martial world, I could join the imperial music bureau in the capital. Either way, I wouldn't have to stay here enduring these foul men's attitudes~

original_text: 茉莉：赵员外常来歌榭听我唱曲儿，虽然年纪有些大了，人倒是还不坏。
translation: Moli: Squire Zhao often comes to the songhouse to listen to me sing. Though a bit old, he's not a bad person.

original_text: 贺敏：师儿的诗固然作的好，可又怎比得上我晶姐姐的文才？可惜晶姐姐如今一心都只在晋家那傻小子的身上，已经很久都没来和我们一起作诗了～
translation: He Min: Shi'er's poems are indeed good, but how can they compare to my Sister Jing's literary talent? It's a pity that Sister Jing is now completely focused on that silly boy from the Jin family and hasn't come to compose poems with us for a long time~

original_text: 贺敏：情之为物，当真叫人难以猜度。想那琴姬，看来是如此飘逸出尘，想不到也为情所困……
translation: He Min: The nature of love is truly hard to fathom. Consider that Qin Ji, who appears so ethereal and transcendent, to also be trapped by love...

original_text: 贺敏：晶姐姐要嫁给晋家那傻小子了……不过好歹也还是在这城里，即使嫁了，也还是能见面的……倒是文秀姐要嫁去京里，怕是再难相见了……
translation: He Min: Sister Jing is going to marry that fool from the Jin family... but at least it's still in this city, so even after she's married, we can still meet... but Sister Wenxiu is marrying into the capital, I'm afraid we'll hardly ever see each other again...

original_text: 苏文秀：此处的亭台临水而建，优雅清净，我们姐妹几个常来这里吟诗作对。不过只有师儿和小晶的诗文才是最好的。
translation: Su Wenxiu: The pavilions here are built by the water, elegant and tranquil. We sisters often come here to recite poetry and compose couplets. But only Shi'er and Xiao Jing's poems are truly the best.

original_text: 苏文秀：前些天还在想，贺晶妹妹那么冰雪聪明的人，怎会喜欢上一个愣头愣脑的傻小子，今日又听说千佛塔里的秦夫人殉情自尽……情之为物，实在叫人看不明白……
translation: Su Wenxiu: A few days ago, I was thinking how someone as clever as Sister He Jing could like a blockheaded guy. Today, I heard that Lady Qin in the Thousand Buddha Pagoda committed suicide for love... The nature of love is truly something hard to understand...

original_text: 苏文秀：日暮湖畔自凭栏，弦歌莲叶无穷碧。他日南望淮河畔，千山万水路遥遥。
translation: Su Wenxiu: By the lakeside at dusk, leaning on the rail alone, strings and songs amidst endless lotus green. Someday gazing south toward the Huai River, mountains and rivers stretch far and wide.

original_text: 楚师儿：文秀姐，远嫁京师，路途遥远，你……一路保重……
translation: Chu Shi'er: Sister Wenxiu, marrying far away to the capital is a long journey. You... take care along the way...

original_text: 楚师儿：最近几日，弦歌台上常有曲声传来……我总觉耳熟，似乎数年前在这龙湖之畔，曾有听过……
translation: Chu Shi'er: In recent days, there have often been melodies coming from the Melody Terrace... They always sound familiar to me, as if I heard them years ago by this Dragon Lake...

original_text: 楚师儿：荷叶碧连天，柳絮随风扬。弦歌丝竹唱，歌榭燕舞翩。
translation: Chu Shi'er: Lotus leaves stretch to the sky, willow catkins dance with the wind. Strings and flutes sing, and the pavilion is filled with graceful dances.

original_text: 楚师儿：忆昔初会龙湖上，萧音清越琴悠扬。问情一曲忘江湖，旧船空横乱荷塘。
translation: Chu Shi'er: Recalling our first meeting on Dragon Lake, the flute clear and bright, the zither melodious. A song of love forgotten by the rivers and lakes, an old boat lies empty across the chaotic lotus pond.

original_text: 楚师儿：先是小晶将要出阁，如今连文秀姐姐也即将远嫁……所谓天下无不散的宴席，我们姐妹几人也许再难像如今一般聚在一起了吧……
translation: Chu Shi'er: First, Xiao Jing is about to be married, and now even Sister Wenxiu is going to wed far away... As they say, all feasts must come to an end. Perhaps we sisters can no longer gather as we do now...

original_text: 陈嫂：我家那个阿泗，整天想着练武功，偏偏又自小多病，连只鸡也抓不住，练什么武呀！
translation: Auntie Chen: My child A-Si, he thinks about practicing martial arts all day, yet he's been sickly since childhood, can't even catch a chicken. What martial arts is he practicing!

original_text: 陈嫂：阿泗他听说那琴姬是个女侠，就吵着要拜人家为师！还好琴姬已经离开陈州了，否则还不知道那孩子会闹出什么事来！
translation: Auntie Chen: When A-Si heard Qin Ji was a female knight, he clamored to become her disciple! Thankfully, she's already left Chenzhou, or who knows what trouble that child would cause!

original_text: 陈嫂：唉……阿泗那孩子……上回竟然去找“清风剑”张大侠，还说要拜人家为师！真是拿他一点办法都没有啊……
translation: Auntie Chen: Sigh... My child A-Si... Last time, he actually went to find 'Breeze Sword' Zhang Daxia and said he wanted to become his disciple! Really, there's no way to deal with him...

original_text: 穆南娃尔：中原的丝绸卖得真便宜，在西域做一条裙子的钱，在中原可以做整整三套漂亮的衣服，董师傅的手艺更是比得过我们家乡手最巧的姑娘家～
translation: Munawar: Central Plains silk is sold so cheaply, the money to make one dress in the Western Regions can make three full sets of beautiful clothes in the Central Plains. Master Dong's craftsmanship even surpasses the most skillful girls back home~

original_text: 董师傅：嘿嘿，哪里哪里～只要姑娘喜欢，什么样的衣裳是我做不来的？
translation: Master Dong: Hehe, not at all~ As long as the young lady likes it, what kind of clothing can't I make?

original_text: 穆南娃尔：旁边的这个差爷整天阴着一张脸，看起来真可怕！不是说千佛塔里面死了人吗？他为什么不去办那个案子……
translation: Munawar: That officer next to me always has a gloomy face-looks really scary! Didn't they say someone died in the Thousand Buddha Pagoda? Why isn't he investigating that case...

original_text: 穆南娃尔：过几天我就要跟爹一起回西域了，这回特地请董师傅替我多裁几件裙子，回到家乡穿给姐妹们看，姐妹们一定羡慕死我了！
translation: Munawar: In a few days, I'll return to the Western Regions with my father. This time, I specially asked Master Dong to tailor a few more dresses for me to wear back home. My sisters will be so envious!

original_text: 刘捕快：我一直怀疑十八年前陈州前任知府大人灭门惨案和此间布庄有所牵连，然而董师傅似乎只喜欢和年轻女子说话，对我不甚理睬，这事情可真是不好办呐～
translation: Constable Liu: I've long suspected the cloth shop's involvement in the former prefect's family massacre eighteen years ago in Chenzhou. But Master Dong only chats with young ladies, ignoring me. Tricky indeed~

original_text: 刘捕快：秦家媳妇死在千佛塔里之事，我原本以为定是那琴姬所为，不过今早仵作前去查看，却一口咬定是自杀身亡……
translation: Constable Liu: Regarding the death of the Qin family's daughter-in-law in the Thousand Buddha Pagoda, I originally thought it must have been that Qin Ji's doing. But this morning, the coroner examined the scene and insisted it was suicide...

original_text: 刘捕快：最近有传闻说，十八年前江湖上那令人闻风丧胆的杀手“影煞孤魂”正是陈州布庄的这位董师傅？可这董师傅横看竖看都只是个有点好色的裁缝而已……
translation: Constable Liu: There's a rumor going around that the terrifying assassin from the Jianghu eighteen years ago, 'Shadow Wraith', is actually Master Dong from the Chenzhou Cloth Shop? But looking at him from every angle, Master Dong just seems like a slightly lecherous tailor...

original_text: 菊香：楼下那捕快好可怕，一大早就带着刀冲进布庄，吓得我连大气都不敢出，倒是董师傅一点都不害怕，理都不理那个人～
translation: Juxiang: The constable downstairs is terrifying! He rushed into the cloth shop with a sword early this morning, scaring me so much I didn't dare breathe. But Master Dong wasn't afraid at all, ignoring him completely~

original_text: 菊香：上个月我还在这儿遇见秦家的丫鬟，说要给少奶奶裁件新衣裳，没想到一转眼那个少奶奶竟然就死了……唉……
translation: Juxiang: Last month, I met the Qin family's maid here, saying she wanted to tailor a new dress for the young mistress. Who would have thought that young mistress would be dead in the blink of an eye... sigh...

original_text: 菊香：别人都说董师傅其实是武林高手，那两把佩刀曾经杀人无数……依我看那些人全都是胡说八道的，董师傅那么和蔼亲切，怎么会杀人？
translation: Juxiang: Others say Master Dong is actually a martial arts master, and those two sabers at his waist have killed countless people... In my opinion, those people are all talking nonsense. Master Dong is so kind and amiable, how could he kill anyone?

original_text: 荆丽：这里的布每一匹都那么漂亮，摸起来也都那么柔滑，我到底要选哪一匹布来裁新衣裳呢？
translation: Jing Li: Every bolt of cloth here is so beautiful and feels so smooth. Which one should I choose to tailor a new dress?

original_text: 荆丽：那位姜氏，明明嫁入豪门，就算死了丈夫，公婆对她也还是不错的，却为什么要寻死呢？
translation: Jing Li: That Lady Jiang, clearly married into a wealthy family. Even after her husband died, her in-laws treated her well. Why did she seek death?

original_text: 荆丽：董师傅为人热情，眼光独到，裁衣服的手艺也好，上回就是他帮我挑的布、裁的衣裳，穿起来又合身、又漂亮！
translation: Jing Li: Master Dong is warm-hearted, has a keen eye, and excellent tailoring skills. Last time, he helped me pick the fabric and cut the dress-it fits perfectly and looks beautiful!

original_text: 骆建勋：最近要跟师父去江南拜会一位剑术超群的老前辈，听说这位前辈有一独子，年龄和我相当，剑术也十分厉害……我真想跟他切磋一番！
translation: Luo Jianxun: Recently, I'm going with my master to Jiangnan to visit an old senior with superb swordsmanship. I hear this senior has an only son, about my age, also very skilled in swords... I really want to spar with him!

original_text: 骆建勋：爹爹既精通音律，又喜习剑，我就是常看爹在院中舞剑，才喜欢上剑术的！
translation: Luo Jianxun: My father is skilled in music and loves practicing swordplay. I often watched him wield his sword in the courtyard, which made me love swordsmanship!

original_text: 骆建勋：琴姬姐姐唱的那首曲子，和爹弹奏的一首曲子真像！可惜近日爹爹出门在外，否则他定然会和琴姬姐姐切磋一番琴艺呢！
translation: Luo Jianxun: The song Sis. Qin Ji sang really resembles one my father plays! Unfortunately, my father has been away recently, otherwise he would surely exchange musical skills with Sis. Qin Ji!

original_text: 骆建勋：上次在苏州和吴公子比剑，我虽然险胜一招，但其实我也紧张得要命，一套剑法使得破绽百出，真是惭愧……
translation: Luo Jianxun: Last time in Suzhou, when I sparred with Young Master Wu, I narrowly won by a single move. But truth be told, I was so nervous that my swordplay was full of flaws. Truly shameful...

original_text: 郑灿英：唉呀呀！真的是银角梳！这、我也不好白拿你的东西，要不然这样，这顶紫阳冠你拿去，当是换梳子的就成！
translation: Zheng Canying: Oh my! It really is a silver horn comb! This, I can't just take your thing for free. How about this-take this Purple Sun Crown as an exchange for the comb!

original_text: 花费300文钱住宿吗？
translation: Spend 300 wen to stay the night?

original_text: 周娟：您身上的钱不够。
translation: Zhou Juan: You don't have enough money on you.

original_text:
我那儿子看上了扬州太守的千金，正准备下聘定亲呢！这聘礼也定下了，是一套银器，只不过还缺了一件，如果小哥你能帮我找一把银角梳来，我就能找人下聘去啦！
你愿意帮我去找吗？
translation:
My son has taken a liking to the daughter of the Yangzhou prefect and is preparing to propose! The betrothal gifts are set-a set of silverware-but one piece is missing. If you could find a silver horn comb for me, I can arrange the proposal!
Will you help me look for it?

original_text: 1.去太一仙径
translation: 1. Go to Taiyi Immortal Path

original_text: 2.御剑飞行
translation: 2. Sword Flight

original_text: 3.什么都不做
translation: 3. Do Nothing

original_text: 准备<colour red=255 green=102 blue=0 alpha=255>去太一仙径</colour><dc0>还是</dc0><colour red=255 green=102 blue=0 alpha=255>御剑飞行</colour><dc0>？</dc0>
translation: Proceed to?

original_text: 1.御剑飞行
translation: 1. Sword Flight

original_text: 2.什么都不做
translation: 2. Do Nothing

original_text: 准备<colour red=255 green=102 blue=0 alpha=255>御剑飞行</colour><dc0>吗？</dc0>
translation: Ready to <colour red=255 green=102 blue=0 alpha=255>use Sword Flight</colour><dc0>?</dc0>

original_text: 云天河：还是不要进去为好。
translation: Yun Tianhe: It's better not to go in.

original_text: 云天河：哟嚯～御剑果然好玩！整个人都飞在天上！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Woo-hoo~ Sword Flight is so fun! Flying through the sky!

original_text: 柳梦璃：这儿……似乎是一个市镇？
translation: Liu Mengli: This place... seems to be a market town?

original_text: 怀朔：此地乃是播仙镇，我和师妹只能将你们带到这里了。若想入门拜师，就一定要自行上山。
