translation: Huaishuo: This place is Boxian Town. My Martial Sister and I can only bring you this far. If you wish to join the sect and become disciples, you must ascend the mountain on your own.

original_text: 云天河：山？哈，那也没啥，走山路一点都不费力。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Mountain? Ha, that's nothing, walking mountain paths isn't tiring at all.

original_text: 璇玑：掉以轻心～小心到时候哭鼻子！
translation: Xuanji: Don't be careless~ Be careful you don't end up crying later!

original_text: 怀朔：……山中设有不少险阻，乃是为考验求仙之人的毅力，诸位多加小心。
translation: Huaishuo: ...There are many obstacles set up in the mountains to test the perseverance of those seeking immortality. Everyone, please be careful.

original_text: 璇玑：师兄～不用讲一堆啦，他们自己去镇上打听打听，就能知道怎么上山，反正我们能帮的也都帮了。
translation: Xuanji: Martial Brother~ No need for a long speech. They can inquire in town themselves to learn how to ascend the mountain. Anyway, we've helped all we can.

original_text: 柳梦璃：谢谢两位，接下来若有任何困难，就让我们试试自行解决，方能显出求仙的诚心。
translation: Liu Mengli: Thank you both. From now on, if we encounter any difficulties, let us try to resolve them ourselves, to truly demonstrate our sincerity in seeking immortality.

original_text: 怀朔：多保重，下回见面时说不定已是同门。
translation: Huaishuo: Take care, next time we meet we might already be fellow disciples.

original_text: 璇玑：师兄～走～啦～！！
translation: Xuanji: Martial Brother~ Let's~ go~!!

original_text: 怀朔：好好好……
translation: Huaishuo: Okay, okay, okay...

original_text: 韩菱纱：就知道没那么容易……
translation: Han Lingsha: Knew it wouldn't be that easy...

original_text: 韩菱纱：啊……
translation: Han Lingsha: Ah...

original_text: 云天河：……！
translation: Yun Tianhe: ...!

original_text: 柳梦璃：菱纱，你怎么了？！
translation: Liu Mengli: Lingsha, what's wrong with you?!

original_text: 韩菱纱：……我也不知道怎么回事，这几天经常头晕……总觉得很累……
translation: Han Lingsha: I don't know what's wrong either. I've been feeling dizzy often these days... always very tired...

original_text: 韩菱纱：没事，一会儿就好了……先去打探打探上山的事……
translation: Han Lingsha: It's fine, I'll be okay soon... Let's first inquire about going up the mountain...

original_text: 云天河：……今天不上山了！
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... Not going up the mountain today!

original_text: 云天河：我们先找那个叫＂客栈＂的地方休息一下。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Let's find that place called 'inn' first and rest a bit.

original_text: 韩菱纱：没关系，我头不晕了……
translation: Han Lingsha: It's fine, my head isn't dizzy anymore...

original_text: 云天河：那也不行，还是过一晚再走。
translation: Yun Tianhe: That won't do either, better stay one more night before leaving.

original_text: 韩菱纱：喂，不是说过在外面都听我的吗？！
translation: Han Lingsha: Hey, didn't we agree to listen to me when we're outside?!

original_text: 云天河：话是这么说没错，可是怀朔讲过那里很危险，所以你一定要先去客栈休息。
translation: Yun Tianhe: That's true, but Huaishuo said that place is dangerous, so you must go rest at the inn first.

original_text: 韩菱纱：你、你这么关心我干嘛……
translation: Han Lingsha: You... why do you care about me so much...

original_text: 韩菱纱：……哼，你走山路一点都不费力，我却要休息，显得我很差劲似的……
translation: Han Lingsha: ...Hmph, you don't struggle on the mountain path at all, while I need to rest, making me seem so inferior...

original_text: 柳梦璃：我看别争了，就按云公子说的吧。
translation: Liu Mengli: I think we shouldn't argue anymore, let's do as Yun says.

original_text: 柳梦璃：我也会担心你啊～菱纱。
translation: Liu Mengli: I worry about you too~ Lingsha.

original_text: 韩菱纱：……好、好嘛。
translation: Han Lingsha: ..., alright, alright.

original_text: 云天河：呵呵，<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>那还是先去客栈</colour><dc0>。</dc0>
translation: Yun Tianhe: Hehe, <colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>then let's go to the inn first</colour><dc0>.</dc0>

original_text: 狄丽拜尔：三位客人，欢迎欢迎！神仙会保佑你们的。
translation: Dilbar: Three guests, welcome, welcome! The celestials will bless you.

original_text: 柳梦璃：老板，请给我们三间客房。
translation: Liu Mengli: Innkeeper, three guest rooms, please.

original_text: 云天河：……这里的房子都怪模怪样，圆圆的，顶上还有尖刺……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ...The houses here are all strangely shaped, round, with spikes on top...

original_text: 狄丽拜尔：哈哈，西域和中土不同，我们世世代代都住在这种房子里，才能躲过风沙日晒。
translation: Dilbar: Haha, the Western Regions are different from the Central Plains. Our generations have lived in such houses to escape the wind, sand, and sun.

original_text: 狄丽拜尔：这个姑娘面孔发白，中暑了吧？这样的身体千万别去仙山！
translation: Dilbar: This girl's face is pale, suffering from heatstroke? With such health, you must not go to the immortal mountain!

original_text: 韩菱纱：咦？！老板，你怎么知道我们要去那里？
translation: Han Lingsha: Huh?! Boss, how did you know we were going there?

original_text: 狄丽拜尔：姑娘～你们几个的装扮一看就是从中原来的，带了刀剑，不是做生意，那应该就是去仙山了。
translation: Dilbar: Miss~ Your attire clearly shows you're from the Central Plains. Carrying swords and blades, not here for trade-then you must be heading to the immortal mountain.

original_text: 狄丽拜尔：山上的神仙连许多中原人都知道，来这儿就是想见神仙一面。
translation: Dilbar: Even many people from the Central Plains know of the immortals on this mountain. They come here hoping to catch a glimpse of them.

original_text: 柳梦璃：那，你能告诉我们去山上的路吗？
translation: Liu Mengli: Then, can you tell us the way to the mountain?

original_text: 狄丽拜尔：当然，这儿人人都知道，<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>出了播仙镇，往南就可以去仙山</colour><dc0>，可是没什么人能见到神仙的。</dc0>
translation: Dilbar: Of course, everyone here knows,<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> head south from Boxian Town to reach the immortal mountains,</colour><dc0> but few ever get to see the immortals.</dc0>

original_text: 柳梦璃：这又是为什么呢？
translation: Liu Mengli: Why is that so?

original_text: 狄丽拜尔：山路上有会伤人的怪物啊，怪物也杀不死，很多人就逃回了镇上。也有人去了那边，再也没回来过，也许是被神仙带走了吧……
translation: Dilbar: There are monsters on the mountain path that can hurt people, and the monsters can't be killed, so many have fled back to the town. Some went there and never returned, perhaps taken away by immortals...

original_text: 韩菱纱：呀……
translation: Han Lingsha: Yikes...

original_text: 云天河：菱纱，不用怕～山上的怪物打不过我们的。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Lingsha, don't be scared~ The mountain monsters can't beat us.

original_text: 韩菱纱：哼，谁怕了？
translation: Han Lingsha: Hmph, who's scared?

original_text: 韩菱纱：镇上的人好像都会说中原话，也很崇拜剑仙，嗯……就是他们说的神仙，要不是房子和衣着不一样，周围又全是黄沙，真看不出这是西域呢。
translation: Han Lingsha: People in the town all seem to speak Central Plains language and also worship sword immortals-well, the 'celestials' they talk about. If not for the different houses and clothing, and all the yellow sand around, you really couldn't tell this is the Western Regions.

original_text: 狄丽拜尔：姑娘，播仙镇能变成绿洲，是因为神仙怜悯我们，才让仙山上的水流下来，所有人都不能忘记这份恩情。
translation: Dilbar: Miss, Boxian Town became an oasis because the immortals took pity on us, letting the water from the immortal mountain flow down. Everyone must never forget this kindness.

original_text: 狄丽拜尔：神仙保佑！要是没有水，也就没有中原人来做生意。中原话都是那些商人教给我们的。
translation: Dilbar: Heaven bless us! Without water, there would be no Central Plains merchants coming to trade. The Central Plains language was taught to us by those merchants.

original_text: 柳梦璃：真是叫人大长见识。
translation: Liu Mengli: It truly broadens my horizons.

original_text: 狄丽拜尔：客人如果喜欢这儿，就多住一段时间吧。
translation: Dilbar: If you guests like it here, stay a while longer.

original_text: 狄丽拜尔：来，我带你们去楼上的房间，再给这姑娘送一杯热乎乎的奶茶。神仙会保佑你快点好的！
translation: Dilbar: Come, I'll take you to the room upstairs and bring this girl a cup of hot milk tea. May the immortals bless you for a speedy recovery!

original_text: 韩菱纱：谢谢……
translation: Han Lingsha: Thank you...

original_text: 韩菱纱：我……我又头晕了……难道真的中暑了吗？
translation: Han Lingsha: I... I'm dizzy again... Could I really have heatstroke?

original_text: 云天河：（……呃……睏死了，晚上没睡好……）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (...Ugh... so sleepy, didn't sleep well last night...)

original_text: 柳梦璃：云公子，你怎么不太有精神的样子？
translation: Liu Mengli: Yun, why do you seem a bit down?

original_text: 云天河：啊？是、是吗？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Huh? Is, is that so?

original_text: 云天河：……其实，昨天夜里我好像一直听到菱纱在说梦话……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... Actually, last night I kept hearing Lingsha talking in her sleep...

original_text: 柳梦璃：……她……肯定很想念自己的爹娘吧……
translation: Liu Mengli: ... She... must miss her parents very much...

original_text: 云天河：咦？原来你也听到了啊。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Huh? So you heard it too.

original_text: 柳梦璃：……
translation: Liu Mengli: ...

original_text: 云天河：……菱纱，你，好了吗？
translation: Yun Tianhe: ...Lingsha, are you... better?

original_text: 韩菱纱：那当然，小病小痛，不算什么～
translation: Han Lingsha: Of course, minor ailments are nothing~

original_text: 韩菱纱：……天呐，你那黑眼圈是怎么回事？看起来好蠢哦～
translation: Han Lingsha: ... Heavens, what's with those dark circles under your eyes? You look so silly~

original_text: 云天河：我……还不是因为……昨晚你……
translation: Yun Tianhe: I... It's all because... last night you...

original_text: 韩菱纱：什么？大点声行吗？
translation: Han Lingsha: What? Can you speak louder?

original_text: 云天河：……不说了，没什么。
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... Never mind, it's nothing.

original_text: 韩菱纱：（奇怪……一点不像平时的天河，难道是水土不服？）
translation: Han Lingsha: (Strange... He's not acting like his usual self at all. Could it be the change in environment?)

original_text: 韩菱纱：是不是换你不舒服了？要不然，我们再歇息一下？
translation: Han Lingsha: Are you feeling unwell now? Otherwise, shall we rest a bit more?

original_text: 云天河：不用不用，<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>我们快点上山，</colour><dc0>越快越好！呵呵。</dc0>
translation: Yun Tianhe: No need, no need.<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> Let's hurry up the mountain,</colour><dc0> the faster the better! Hehe.</dc0>

original_text: 韩菱纱：唉，这么大的人了，还一心只想着玩……
translation: Han Lingsha: Sigh, so grown up, yet still only thinking about playing...

original_text: 韩菱纱：怎么镇上变得冷清好多？难道出了什么事……？
translation: Han Lingsha: Why is the town so much quieter? Did something happen...?

original_text: 库莫若：中原来的朋友，你们怎么还不离开播仙镇？
translation: Kumoru: Friends from the Central Plains, why haven't you left Boxian Town yet?

original_text: 韩菱纱：大叔，请问镇上的人都去了哪里？为什么一下子这样冷清？
translation: Han Lingsha: Sir, where did everyone in town go? Why is it so deserted all of a sudden?

original_text: 库莫若：唉……姑娘你不知道，就在一天以前，仙山上出了天大的事啊，吓得老人孩子都不敢出门了……
translation: Kumoru: Sigh... Miss, you don't know, just a day ago, something huge happened on the immortal mountain, scaring the old and young so much they dare not go out...

original_text: 慕容紫英：……！请问到底是什么事？！
translation: Murong Ziying: May I ask what exactly is the matter?!

original_text: 库莫若：是神仙……神仙发怒了……忽然之间，大地轰鸣、河水沸腾，天空也变得暗沉沉，等到一切平息下来，绿洲的水已经浑浊了……
translation: Kumoru: It's the celestials... the celestials are angry... Suddenly, the earth rumbled, the river boiled, and the sky turned dark. When everything settled, the oasis water had become murky...

original_text: 韩菱纱：啊？！
translation: Han Lingsha: Huh?!

original_text: 慕容紫英：那镇上的人有没有受伤？！
translation: Murong Ziying: Were the people in that town injured?!

original_text: 库莫若：受伤倒是没有，但是水里混了沙土，不再清澈，这是以前从来没有过的事情，老人们都说这不吉利，水会渐渐枯竭的，然后会有大灾难发生……
translation: Kumoru: No one injured, but the water is mixed with sand and mud, no longer clear. This has never happened before. The elders say it's inauspicious; the water will gradually dry up, and then a great disaster will occur...

original_text: 韩菱纱：那后来呢？还发生了其他事吗？
translation: Han Lingsha: What happened after that? Anything else?

original_text: 库莫若：……大地的震动停了之后，仙山上就出现了一座浮着的山峰，慢慢往上升，现在飞得太高，已经看不见了……
translation: Kumoru: ... After the earth's tremors stopped, a floating peak appeared on the immortal mountain, slowly rising. Now it has flown too high and is no longer visible...

original_text: 慕容紫英：……！！
translation: Murong Ziying: ...!!

original_text: 韩菱纱：浮着的山峰？会不会是……
translation: Han Lingsha: A floating peak? Could it be...

original_text: 库莫若：听说那是神仙住的地方，他们要回天上去了，要遗弃我们、遗弃这个镇子了，再也不会像以前一样赐给我们干净的水……
translation: Kumoru: I heard that's where the celestials live. They're going back to the heavens, abandoning us, abandoning this town. They'll never give us clean water like before...

original_text: 库莫若：唉，天神保佑……你们不是镇上的人，快点离开吧，如果真有灾难发生，不要留下受苦……
translation: Kumoru: Sigh, may the celestials bless... You're not from the town, leave quickly. If a disaster really happens, don't stay and suffer...
Han Lingsha: ......

original_text: 慕容紫英：……琼华派已经升起，竟还祸及山脚下的村镇……
translation: Murong Ziying: ... Qionghua Sect has already begun ascending, yet it's still bringing disaster to the villages at the foot of the mountain...

original_text: 云天河：<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>我们现在赶快御剑追上去！</colour>
translation: Yun Tianhe: <colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>Let's quickly chase after them on our swords now!</colour>

original_text: 云天河：菱纱……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Lingsha...

original_text: 韩菱纱：……？
translation: Han Lingsha: ...?

original_text: 韩菱纱：天河……？
translation: Han Lingsha: Tianhe...?

original_text: 云天河：你一定要去的话，这样会好一点吧？
translation: Yun Tianhe: If you really must go, will this make it a bit better?

original_text: 韩菱纱：……嗯，暖暖的，谢谢你。
translation: Han Lingsha: ...Mmm, it's warm, thank you.

original_text: 云天河：走！去找玄霄！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Go! Find Xuanxiao!

original_text: 云天河：现在不要出城了，<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>先去客栈休息</colour><dc0>。</dc0>
translation: Yun Tianhe: Let's not leave the city now. <colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>First, go rest at the inn.</colour><dc0>.</dc0>

original_text: 赫依里：精铁铸老板造兵器的手艺不错！播仙镇上的小伙子，几乎都有一把他打的刀。
translation: Kheiri: Master Jingtie Zhu's weapon-making skills are excellent! Almost every young man in Boxian Town has a knife forged by him.

original_text: 赫依里：西域风沙大，雨下得少，如果不是有了仙山上流下的河水，播仙镇一定会变成一片荒漠。
translation: Kheiri: The Western Regions have strong sandstorms and little rain. Without the river flowing from the immortal mountain, Boxian Town would become a desert.

original_text: 赫依里：附近有个村子断了水，整个村都被黄沙埋了……天神保佑，我们是住在仙山脚下……
translation: Kheiri: A nearby village lost its water, the whole place buried by yellow sand... Celestials bless us, we live at the foot of the immortal mountain...

original_text: 赫依里：现在马贼已经没有以前那么嚣张了，一定又是神仙保佑我们！
translation: Kheiri: The bandits aren't as rampant as they used to be now. It must be the celestials protecting us again!

original_text: 赫依里：天神真的要降罪给我们，我们也是没有办法的，但不管怎么样，我绝对不会离开播仙镇！
translation: Kheiri: If the celestials truly punish us, we can't help it. But no matter what, I will never leave Boxian Town!

original_text: 乌依古尔：播仙镇以前叫且末郡，一直都是丝绸之路上的重镇，大伙儿很长时间受仙人保佑，为了感激，就把这里改叫播仙镇了。
translation: Uygur: Boxian Town used to be called Qiemo County and has always been a key town on the Silk Road. For a long time, everyone here was blessed by immortals, so out of gratitude, they renamed it Boxian Town.

original_text: 乌依古尔：镇上往来的商人很多，全都在镇中心的车马驿歇息，你们想要住店的话，就去那里吧。
translation: Uygur: Many merchants come and go in the town, all resting at the Carriage Post in the center. If you want to stay at an inn, go there.

original_text: 乌依古尔：最近马贼又开始猖獗了，来往客商常常被抢，镇上的人天天都过得不安心！
translation: Uygur: Recently, bandits have become rampant again. Traveling merchants are often robbed, and townsfolk live in unease every day!

original_text: 乌依古尔：天神保佑～官府会来管马贼的事，一定也是天神安排的，这段日子总算平静很多了。
translation: Uygur: Celestials bless~ The officials coming to deal with the bandits must be the celestials' arrangement too; things have been much calmer lately.

original_text: 乌依古尔：唉……以前听说沙漠里有个村落的人触怒了天神，天神发怒惩罚他们，我还不怎么信，现在，惩罚就要降到我们头上了……这可怎么办啊……
translation: Uygur: Sigh... I used to hear that a village in the desert angered the celestials, and the celestials punished them in wrath. I didn't quite believe it then. Now, punishment is about to fall upon us... What should we do...

original_text: 艾沙：镇南药铺伊哈桑老板的药可千万别去买！上回我阿爸跌伤，擦了他的跌打药酒，膝盖肿得像个大包！
translation: Eysa: Never buy medicine from Ihasan, the boss of Zhennan Medicine Shop! Last time my dad fell and got injured, applied his bruise wine, and his knee swelled up like a big lump!

original_text: 艾沙：看你的打扮，是不是要去仙山呢？其实我也去过，不过那实在太危险了，我半路就跑了回来……
translation: Eysa: Judging by your attire, are you going to the immortal mountain? Actually, I've been there too, but it was too dangerous. I ran back halfway...

original_text: 艾沙：以前上山想要见神仙的人，这段日子都下山了，沙依木告诉我，仙人不见他们，让所有人都离开。
translation: Eysa: All those who used to climb the mountain hoping to see the immortals have come down these days. Sayim told me the immortals won't meet them and made everyone leave.

original_text: 艾沙：……是不是要有什么大事发生了？我总觉得……心里很慌……
translation: Eysa: ...Is something big about to happen? I keep feeling... very uneasy inside...

original_text: 阿丹：有很多中原人会到播仙镇来做买卖，车马驿的生意好得不得了，老板娘从早忙到晚，整天乐呵呵～
translation: Adan: Many people from the Central Plains come to Boxian Town to trade. The carriage inn's business is incredibly good. The proprietress is busy from morning till night, always cheerful~

original_text: 阿丹：马贼打劫往来商客，受了伤的人都快把药店的大门给挤破了……
translation: Adan: The bandits rob traveling merchants, and the injured have almost broken down the pharmacy's door...

original_text: 阿丹：伊哈桑的心有点黑，他总要骗中原来的客人，拿不好的药冒充灵药，你千万别上当！
translation: Adan: Ihasan has a bit of a black heart. He always tries to deceive visitors from the Central Plains, passing off poor medicine as spiritual medicine. You mustn't fall for it!

original_text: 阿丹：难道、难道是伊哈桑那个黑心的人做了错事，天神才会惩罚我们？我们把伊哈桑交给天神处置，天神会原谅我们吗？
translation: Adan: Could it be... could it be that the black-hearted Ihasan did something wrong, and the celestials are punishing us? If we hand Ihasan over to the celestials, will they forgive us?

original_text: 伊哈桑：嘿嘿～你是不是要上昆仑山找仙人？那里的路可不好走，要不要在我这儿买些伤药？以防万一嘛！
translation: Ihasan: Hehe~ Are you going to Mount Kunlun to seek immortals? The path there isn't easy. Want to buy some healing medicine from me? Just in case!

original_text: 伊哈桑：自从附近马贼猖獗，来我店里买伤药的人就越来越多，生意好啊！
translation: Ihasan: Since the bandits have been rampant nearby, more and more people have come to my shop to buy healing medicine. Business is good!

original_text: 伊哈桑：马贼被打跑了……没人受伤，我这药店也就没生意了……
translation: Ihasan: The bandits were driven off... No one was hurt, so my pharmacy has no business...

original_text: 伊哈桑：哼！什么天神的惩罚，我伊哈桑才不相信呢！不就是河水有点浑浊吗？有什么要紧的！
translation: Ihasan: Hmph! What celestial punishment? I, Ihasan, don't believe it at all! So the river water is a bit muddy? What's the big deal!

original_text: 乔勒旁：你是去昆仑山拜师的吧？正好我也是～不如我们一起上山，也好有个照应，你看怎么样？
translation: Cholpan: You're going to Kunlun Mountain to seek apprenticeship, right? So am I~ How about we go up the mountain together, to look out for each other?

original_text: 乔勒旁：一听说我要上山去找仙人，阿妈就给我备了一大箱的东西，可我力气小，那么大的箱子怎么抬得动？
translation: Cholpan: As soon as I said I wanted to go up the mountain to find the immortal, Mom prepared a huge box of things for me. But I'm weak-how can I carry such a big box?

original_text: 乔勒旁：你的衣服……好漂亮～你是不是见到仙人了？告诉我他长什么样好不好～
translation: Cholpan: Your clothes... so pretty~ Did you meet an immortal? Tell me what he looked like, okay~

original_text: 乔勒旁：听说做了仙人以后就不会老，可是如果老了以后再做仙人，会变成什么样呢？
translation: Cholpan: I heard that after becoming an immortal, one doesn't age. But if you become an immortal after growing old, what happens then?

original_text: 陈旺财：这批丝绸要是卖了好价钱，我就可以回中原买新房讨老婆了～哈哈！
translation: Chen Wangcai: If this batch of silk sells for a good price, I can return to the Central Plains to buy a new house and get a wife~ haha!

original_text: 陈旺财：西域的姑娘真是热情又大胆，我刚到这儿第一天，就被隔壁绿洲酒肆的老板娘拉进店里灌了个烂醉！
translation: Chen Wangcai: The girls from the Western Regions are so passionate and bold. On my very first day here, the proprietress of the oasis winery next door dragged me into her shop and got me completely drunk!

original_text: 陈旺财：该死的马贼！抢了我一整箱丝绸！这回连老本都蚀了，早知道就不带这么多上路……
translation: Chen Wangcai: Damned bandits! They stole a whole chest of my silk! I've lost my capital this time. I shouldn't have brought so much on the road...

original_text: 陈旺财：没用的官府！把马贼打跑又怎样？也不能把我被抢的丝绸追回来啊！
translation: Chen Wangcai: Useless officials! So what if you drove the horse bandits away? You still can't get my stolen silk back!

original_text: 何生钱：没想到沙尘满天的荒漠中竟然还有播仙镇这样的绿洲！这对商人来说实在太好了！
translation: He Shengqian: Who would have thought there'd be an oasis like Boxian Town in this sandstorm-filled desert! This is truly wonderful for merchants!

original_text: 何生钱：我这是第一回跟着商队来西域，一路上就这儿还能住人，其他地方除了黄沙还是黄沙……
translation: He Shengqian: This is my first time traveling with a merchant caravan to the Western Regions. This is the only habitable place along the entire route; everywhere else is just endless yellow sand...

original_text: 何生钱：商队在路上遇到马贼了！还好我这回只带了一小包金银饰物，拎起包就跑，正巧朝廷的官兵赶来，这才逃过一劫。
translation: He Shengqian: The caravan encountered bandits on the road! Luckily, I only brought a small bag of gold and silver ornaments this time. I grabbed the bag and ran, and just then, the imperial troops arrived, so I escaped disaster.

original_text: 何生钱：所有人都传山上住着仙人，可谁也没亲眼见过啊，你说～要是能弄到仙人衣服上的衣角，那得值多少钱啊！
translation: He Shengqian: Everyone says there are immortals living on the mountain, but no one has ever seen them with their own eyes. I say~ if we could get a corner of an immortal's robe, how much would that be worth!

original_text: 萨迪克：老板娘还没嫁人时，曾经是镇上最受欢迎的女人，她歌唱得动听、舞跳得好，喜欢她的人能从这里排队到昆仑顶上！
translation: Sadiq: Before the landlady married, she was the most popular woman in town. Her singing was enchanting, her dancing superb-her admirers could line up from here to the peak of Kunlun!

original_text: 萨迪克：不管我偷不偷懒，事情永远做不完，不如想办法让自己闲一点～
translation: Sadiq: Whether I slack off or not, the work is never done. Might as well find ways to make myself a bit idle~

original_text: 萨迪克：最近来住店的客人少了很多，听说是因为附近出现了马贼，不来人也好，我正好轻松～
translation: Sadiq: Recently, far fewer guests have been staying at the inn. I hear it's because horse bandits appeared nearby. No guests is fine, I can relax~

original_text: 萨迪克：也许世界上最可怕的不是马贼，而是永远都干不完的活……
translation: Sadiq: Perhaps the scariest thing in the world isn't bandits, but the never-ending work...

original_text: 萨迪克：天神啊！只要您收回您的惩罚，再次赐给我们清澈的河水，我愿意每天都做很多很多的事，再也不偷懒！
translation: Sadiq: Celestials! If you withdraw your punishment and grant us clear river water again, I'll do lots and lots of work every day, never slacking off again!

original_text: 塔依夫：没错，就是我要娶狄丽拜尔！想当年，这播仙镇上多少好男儿争着想娶她？没想到她竟然嫁给一个中原来的男人！
translation: Tayif: That's right, I'm the one who wants to marry Dilbar! Back in the day, how many fine young men in Boxian Town wanted to marry her? Who would have thought she'd marry a man from the Central Plains!

original_text: 塔依夫：本来，这也没什么，可那男人一年到头出门在外，从没好好陪伴过狄丽拜尔！我就是看不下去！<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>你帮我去跟她说</colour><dc0>，只要她愿意，我随时都能带她走！</dc0>
translation: Tayif: Normally, it wouldn't matter, but that man is away all year, never spending time with Dilbar! I can't stand it! Go tell her for me: if she's willing, I can take her away anytime!

original_text: 塔依夫：这里几乎不下雨，全靠仙山上的河水流下，我们才能住下来。
translation: Tayif: It hardly ever rains here, we can only live here thanks to the river flowing down from the immortal mountain.

original_text: 塔依夫：中原人喝酒喜欢用小小的杯子，太没气概！我们习惯大碗喝酒，更厉害的就用桶，譬如说我就是！
translation: Tayif: You Central Plains people drink from tiny cups-no spirit at all! We're used to drinking from big bowls, and the mightier ones use buckets, like me, for example!

original_text: 塔依夫：最近曼丽请了个不太灵巧的人给她做帮手，酒还没酿好，那个人就把酒桶打开了，这样香味会散掉，不好喝……
translation: Tayif: Recently, Menli hired a rather clumsy assistant. Before the wine was ready, that person opened the barrel. The aroma will escape, and it won't taste good...

original_text: 曼丽：播仙镇的葡萄是用昆仑山的仙水灌溉的，所以颗颗都又大又甜～用来酿酒的话，可不是别处的酸葡萄能比的！
translation: Menli: The grapes in Boxian Town are irrigated with immortal water from Kunlun Mountain, so each one is big and sweet~ If used for winemaking, they're far superior to sour grapes from elsewhere!

original_text: 曼丽：酿制葡萄酒的方法说简单也简单，但要酿得好，却不容易～绿洲酒肆的葡萄酒都是我酿的，又香又甜，一点酸涩味都没有，你可要尝尝？
translation: Menli: The method of making grape wine is simple, yet to make it well isn't easy. The grape wine at the Oasis winery is all brewed by me-fragrant and sweet, without any sourness or bitterness. Would you like to try some?

original_text: 曼丽：我不怕马贼！我们可不是好欺负的，要是马贼敢来镇上，一定要给他们些教训！
translation: Menli: I'm not afraid of bandits! We're not easy to bully. If bandits dare come to town, we'll definitely teach them a lesson!

original_text: 曼丽：天神啊！怎么会有人在酒没酿好前，就把木桶打开了……香味都散掉的酒，我可不敢拿给酒肆去卖……
translation: Menli: Heavens! How could someone open the barrel before the wine is fully brewed... Wine that has lost its aroma, I dare not sell it to the winery...

original_text: 曼丽：老人们都说河水快要干了，这是天神抛弃了我们……可是我们到底做错了什么事，天神为什么不再保佑我们了？
translation: Menli: The elders say the river is about to dry up, that the celestials have abandoned us... But what have we done wrong? Why have the celestials stopped protecting us?

original_text: 张远山：要在中原买葡萄酒，几两银子才一点点，这儿的葡萄酒几十文钱就能买一大桶，哈哈！今天我一定要喝个够！
translation: Zhang Yuanshan: Buying grape wine in the Central Plains costs several taels of silver for just a little bit. Here, a whole barrel costs only a few dozen wen. Haha! Today I'm determined to drink my fill!

original_text: 张远山：把中原的丝绸卖到西域，再把西域的葡萄酒、和阗玉带回中原去卖，虽然路上要花的时间不少，但怎么瞧也是一本万利的大生意呐～
translation: Zhang Yuanshan: Selling Central Plains silk to the Western Regions, then bringing Western Region grape wine and Hetian jade back to the Central Plains to sell. Although it takes quite some time on the road, it looks like a hugely profitable business~

original_text: 张远山：经商难、难于上青天！本来千里迢迢往返中原和西域之间已经够受的了！偏偏路上又被马贼给抢了，真是老天无眼啊……
translation: Zhang Yuanshan: Doing business is harder than climbing to the sky! It's already tough enough traveling back and forth between the Central Plains and the Western Regions! And then to be robbed by mounted bandit on the road-it's just heaven turning a blind eye...

original_text: 张远山：播仙镇的人是不是喝酒喝糊涂了？昆仑山上住的哪里是什么天神，明明就是修道的剑仙～那天我亲眼所见，几个人御剑从天上飞了过去！
translation: Zhang Yuanshan: Are the people of Boxian Town drunk? Those living on Kunlun Mountain aren't celestials-they're clearly sword immortals who cultivate the Dao! That day I saw with my own eyes several people flying through the sky on swords!

original_text: 张远山：我看这昆仑山顶上飞起的山峰，难不成就是传说中的白日飞升？看来山顶上的剑仙道行很深啊！
translation: Zhang Yuanshan: That mountain peak rising from the Kunlun summit-could it be the legendary 'ascension in broad daylight'? It seems the sword immortals atop the mountain possess profound cultivation indeed!

original_text: 泽依同：中原来的人总说我们的名字怪，哪里怪了？“泽依同”的意思其实就是你们中原人说的“青果”啊～
translation: Zeytun: People from the Central Plains always say our names are strange. Where's the strangeness? 'Zeytun' actually means what you Central Plains people call 'green fruit'~

original_text: 泽依同：中原人也许不能明白，马匹对我们来说就是像兄弟手足般的亲人～“年少时离开父亲、旅途中失去马匹”对我们来说都是最糟糕的事。
translation: Zeytun: Central Plains folk might not understand-horses are like brothers and family to us. 'Leaving father in youth, losing horse on journey' are the worst things for us.

original_text: 泽依同：哼，那些马贼自以为了不起吗？总有一天我会带着明晃晃的弯刀，跟着哥哥去把他们杀个片甲不留！
translation: Zeytun: Hmph, those mounted bandit think they're so great? Someday I'll take a shiny scimitar and follow my brother to slaughter them until not a single piece of armor remains!

original_text: 泽依同：我……我上回遇见那个马贼的首领了，他长得好英俊，也没我想的那么凶，武艺却比哥哥还好得多！可是……他……他为什么要当马贼呢……
translation: Zeytun: I... I met that bandit leader last time. He was so handsome, not as fierce as I imagined, and his martial arts were even better than my brother's! But... why... why did he become a bandit...

original_text: 泽依同：镇上去过仙山的人，都说仙山和我们想的不一样，到底是哪里不一样？天神更威严、更厉害吗？
translation: Zeytun: Those from town who've been to the immortal mountain all say it's not what we imagined. How exactly is it different? Are the celestials more majestic, more powerful?

original_text: 阿克木：泽依同那丫头从小就跟着我一起骑马射箭，练就一身好武艺，镇上武艺比她好的小伙子都没几个。
translation: Akim: Zeytun has been riding horses and shooting arrows with me since she was a child, training in martial arts. Few young men in town are better than her in martial skills.

original_text: 阿克木：我的武艺也算不错了，但那次在大漠里遇到一只凶恶的妖怪，我使出全部本事都打不倒它，还好有仙人飞过，几招就把它制服了！
translation: Akim: My martial arts are decent, but once in the desert, I met a fierce monster. I used all my skills but couldn't defeat it. Luckily, an immortal flew by and subdued it in a few moves!

original_text: 阿克木：这几天大漠里马贼闹得很凶，我和镇上几个武艺不错的兄弟商量了一下，决定跟着商队一起从镇上出发，遇到马贼时就能把他们给除了！
translation: Akim: These past few days, the desert bandits have been causing a lot of trouble. I discussed with a few skilled brothers in town and decided to set out with the merchant caravan. If we encounter mounted bandit, we can take them out!

original_text: 阿克木：我和那个马贼首领交过手了，他的武艺实在太高强，我都以为自己死定了，没想到他竟然没杀我，还下令放我们所有人平安回来，真是太奇怪了……
translation: Akim: I crossed blades with that leader of mounted bandits. His martial skills were truly formidable; I thought I was dead for sure. Yet, he didn't kill me and even ordered all of us to return safely. It's really strange...

original_text: 阿克木：我们播仙镇上的儿郎个个都是顶天立地的男子汉，天神有什么罪要降 ，就都降在我头上吧！不要牵连那些无辜的老人和孩子！
translation: Akim: The men of our Boxian Town are all upright and honorable! If the celestials have any punishment to bestow, let it all fall upon my head! Do not involve the innocent elders and children!

original_text: 阿娜尔：尼露拜尔奶奶又来啦？这回是给哪个孙女挑首饰啊？
translation: Anar: Has Grandma Nilufar come again? Which granddaughter are you picking jewelry for this time?

original_text: 尼露拜尔：呵呵，我只有泽依同这一个孙女啊～她只喜欢刀剑，不喜欢首饰。
translation: Nilufar: Hehe, I only have this one granddaughter, Zeytun~ She only likes swords and blades, not jewelry.

original_text: 阿娜尔：常有小伙子来我这儿买了首饰送到姑娘家当聘礼，不过也有买不起的，那就只有趁天黑时去把心爱的姑娘偷回家啦～只要是月圆的晚上，偷了姑娘就不用补聘礼。
translation: Anar: Young men often buy jewelry here as betrothal gifts for their sweethearts. But some can't afford it-they just steal their beloved under the cover of night! On a full moon night, stealing a girl means no need to make up the betrothal gift.

original_text: 阿娜尔：真不知道那些强盗什么时候才能被抓住……这几天来镇上的商人大都被马贼打劫过，我这儿的首饰也好久没新的了……
translation: Anar: I really don't know when those barobbersdits will be caught... Most merchants coming to town these days have been robbed by mounted bandit, and I haven't had new jewelry here in a long time...

original_text: 阿娜尔：……有个商人给了阿爸很多钱，说要带我去中原，幸好阿爸看出他的眼神不正直，没有答应。
translation: Anar: ...A merchant offered Dad a lot of money, saying he wanted to take me to the Central Plains. Fortunately, Dad saw the dishonesty in his eyes and didn't agree.

original_text: 尼露拜尔：我想挑些首饰，让孙子送给他的心上人～我孙子是镇上最勇敢的小伙子，喜欢他的姑娘很多，就是不知道他喜欢哪一个。
translation: Nilufar: I want to pick some jewelry for my grandson to give to his sweetheart~ My grandson is the bravest young man in town, and many girls like him, but who knows which one he fancies?

original_text: 尼露拜尔：最近马贼闹得凶，我孙子孙女都说要去打马贼，就只凭他们俩，武艺再强也不行呐……
translation: Nilufar: The mounted bandits have been causing a lot of trouble lately. My grandson and granddaughter both say they want to fight them, but just the two of them, no matter how skilled, can't possibly...

original_text: 尼露拜尔：我孙女说了，她只嫁武艺比她更好的小伙子……唉，我看今年家里是没喜事了。
translation: Nilufar: My granddaughter says she'll only marry a young man more skilled in martial arts than her... sigh, looks like no wedding this year.

original_text: 尼露拜尔：一定是镇上有人惹怒了天神，天神才会降罪惩罚我们的！只要是这个镇上的人，就算跑得再远，也逃不过天神的惩罚呐！
translation: Nilufar: Someone in town must have angered the celestials, so they're punishing us! As long as you're from this town, no matter how far you run, you can't escape celestials' punishment!

original_text: 高琴芬：阿娜尔，我喜欢这条新项链～你是从哪里弄来的？
translation: Gao Qinfen: Anar, I love this new necklace~ Where did you get it?

original_text: 阿娜尔：商队昨天才到镇上，这回是从更西边的地方带回来的首饰，样样都是从前没见过的！
translation: Anar: The caravan just arrived in town yesterday. This time, they brought jewelry from even further west, every piece unlike anything seen before!

original_text: 高琴芬：以前在中原时，难得看见这些样子的首饰，来了这儿天天见，倒也没那么新奇了。
translation: Gao Qinfen: Back in the Central Plains, it was rare to see jewelry like this. Seeing it every day here, it's not so novel anymore.

original_text: 高琴芬：相公打算去更远的地方做生意了，要穿过大沙漠，而且也许一年都不能回来一趟，我好担心他……一年到头都那么辛苦，挣再多钱又有什么用……
translation: Gao Qinfen: My husband plans to do business in farther places, crossing the great desert, and maybe won't return even once a year. I'm so worried about him... Toiling all year round, what's the use of earning more money...

original_text: 沙吾提：花帽子花毯子，大坛子小弯刀，都是新到的货啦！
translation: Sawut: Flower hats, flower rugs, big jars, small scimitars, all newly arrived goods!

original_text: 沙吾提：阿吉达在我这儿买了把弯刀，就上仙山去了，天神保佑！他千万别被山上的怪物伤了……
translation: Sawut: Ajida bought a scimitar from me and went up the immortal mountain. May the celestials protect him! I hope he isn't hurt by the monsters there...

original_text: 沙吾提：上回有个汉人问我买了很多方毯，我猜他是要带回中原去卖，听说这在中原卖得很好、很值钱。
translation: Sawut: Last time, a Han Chinese bought many square carpets from me. I guess he meant to take them back to the Central Plains to sell. I hear they sell very well and are quite valuable there.

original_text: 铁木尔：有个波斯商人经常会来播仙镇，我卖的金器银具都是从他那儿来的。听说中原也有人做类似的东西，但价钱比我这里的贵太多了。
translation: Tomur: A Persian merchant often comes to Boxian Town. The gold and silverware I sell are from him. I hear Central Plains also makes similar items, but much more expensive than mine.

original_text: 铁木尔：别嫌我的银壶贵，告诉你，这样的壶，到了中原你出十两黄金都买不到！
translation: Tomur: Don't complain my silver pot is expensive. Let me tell you, such a pot-even ten taels of gold couldn't buy it in the Central Plains!

original_text: 阿依汗：阿吉达这孩子啊，前不久去了仙山，到现在都没回来……不过镇上有些年轻人也是这样，有的回来了，有的没回来，还不如在这里好好地过日子。
translation: Ayhan: That child Ajida went to the immortal mountain not long ago and hasn't returned yet... But some young people in town are like that too-some came back, some didn't. Better to live well here.

original_text: 阿依汗：听说在更远的西边呐，有种魔毯可以让人在天上飞，可惜我们播仙镇却没有这样的东西。
translation: Ayhan: I heard farther west, there's a magic carpet that lets people fly in the sky. Too bad we don't have such a thing in Boxian Town.

original_text: 阿依汗：我年轻的时候啊，见过仙山上神的仆人，他们都是穿长长的袍子，带着一把剑……我被沙漠里的妖怪追，幸亏他们救了我一命～
translation: Ayhan: When I was young, I saw the servants of the celestials from the immortal mountain. They wore long robes and carried a sword... I was chased by a desert monster, and luckily they saved my life~

original_text: 阿依汗：前几天，天神的仆人从仙山上下来，告诉我们河水快要干了，连神的仆人都帮不了我们，劝我们离开这里……可是我在这里住了一辈子，怎么能说走就走呢！
translation: Ayhan: A few days ago, celestials' servants came down from the immortal mountain and told us the river is about to dry up. Even they cannot help us and advised us to leave... But I've lived here my whole life, how can I just leave!

original_text: 骆远图：这家的毛毯是我看过用料最好、做工最细的，可惜老板娘说这毯子都是她自己家里织出来的，一个月也只能织一条……
translation: Luo Yuantu: Blankets from this shop are the best in materials and finest in workmanship I've ever seen. Too bad the shopkeeper says she weaves them herself at home and can only make one per month...

original_text: 骆远图：这里的人都说山上住着神仙，镇里的河水都是山上仙界流下来的，我看这是积雪融化的水，跟仙人有什么关系？
translation: Luo Yuantu: People here say immortals live on the mountain, and the town's river water flows from the immortal realm. I think it's melted snow water-what does it have to do with immortals?

original_text: 骆远图：原来很多年以前，这附近最有名的河是叫月牙河，但是不知为什么，突然就干涸了……
translation: Luo Yuantu: So many years ago, the most famous river nearby was called Crescent River, but for some reason, it suddenly dried up...

original_text: 萨比尔：阿布都大叔！你教教我吹牛角笛吧！阿依慕说，我吹不好牛角笛，她以后就再也不理我！
translation: Sabir: Uncle Abdu! Teach me to play the horn flute! Ayim said if I don't play it well, she'll never speak to me again!

original_text: 阿布都：我上回不是教过你了吗？你自己不好好练，我也没办法啊。
translation: Abdu: Didn't I teach you last time? If you don't practice properly yourself, I can't help you.

original_text: 萨比尔：阿依慕是镇上舞跳得最好的姑娘，我喜欢她很久了！可她说如果我不学会吹笛子，以后就再也不理我！
translation: Sabir: Ayim is the best dancer in town. I've liked her for a long time! But she says if I don't learn to play the flute, she'll never talk to me again!

original_text: 萨比尔：我好不容易学会吹笛子，阿依慕却又叫我学吹筚篥，说是只要我用筚篥吹出好听的曲子，她就答应嫁给我！
translation: Sabir: I finally learned to play the flute, but Ayim told me to learn the bili instead, saying if I can play a beautiful tune on it, she'll agree to marry me!

original_text: 萨比尔：阿依慕好不容易答应嫁给我了，可是天神的惩罚就要降临，阿爹说大家都会死的……我、我不想阿依慕死，不想大家死！
translation: Sabir: Ayim finally agreed to marry me, but the punishment of celestials is about to fall. Father says everyone will die... I, I don't want Ayim to die, I don't want everyone to die!

original_text: 阿布都：这里的小伙子个个都能吹能唱！要是谁家的孩子不会拍手鼓吹筚篥，是没有姑娘愿意嫁他的～
translation: Abdu: The young men here can all play and sing! If a family's child doesn't know how to clap, drum, or play the bili, no girl is willing to marry him~

original_text: 阿布都：你知道月牙村吗？离这里不算非常远，但现在已经去不了了，我小的时候还跟着爷爷去过一趟，都过了几十年，那里早被黄沙埋了吧……
translation: Abdu: Do you know Crescent Village? It's not too far from here, but it's unreachable now. When I was little, I went there once with my grandpa. Decades have passed, and it must be buried under the yellow sand by now...

original_text: 阿布都：难道我们也和月牙村的人一样触怒了天神，天神才会收回他恩赐给我们的河水？
translation: Abdu: Have we also angered the celestials like the people of Crescent Village, so they're taking back the river water bestowed upon us?

original_text: 阿依慕：镇上人人都会吹牛角笛，只有萨比尔那个大笨蛋不会！要是让别人知道我喜欢的人这么笨，我一定会被笑话！
translation: Ayim: Everyone in town can play the horn flute, except that big fool Sabir! If others knew the person I like is so clumsy, I'd definitely be laughed at!

original_text: 阿依慕：你看起来不像商人，那就是要去仙山啰？那里的路不好走，有勇气去的人，都是我心目中的英雄！
translation: Ayim: You don't look like a merchant, so you must be heading to the immortal mountain, right? The road there is tough. Those brave enough to go are heroes in my eyes!

original_text: 阿依慕：萨比尔学吹牛角笛终于能吹出调子来了，这回我叫他去学吹筚篥，要是他能练好，我就嫁给他～
translation: Ayim: Sabir has finally learned to play a tune on the bullhorn flute. This time I told him to learn the bili. If he can master it, I'll marry him~

original_text: 穆哈希木：沙木沙克成天嚷着要上山去拜天神，可他从来没有去过，这种光说不做的人，是会受到惩罚的！
translation: Muhasim: Samsak keeps clamoring to go up the mountain to worship the celestials, but he's never been there. Such people who only talk without acting will be punished!

original_text: 穆哈希木：昨天夜里，我做梦梦见天神背转过身，连他头上的光芒也看不到了，难道……这是不吉利的征兆？
translation: Muhasim: Last night, I dreamed that a celestial turned his back, and even the light on his head vanished. Could this... be an ominous sign?

original_text: 穆哈希木：天神……天神果然是要抛弃我们了啊！那天梦见天神背转过身的事情，果然是真的！这、这可怎么办啊！
translation: Muhasim: The celestials... The celestials are truly abandoning us! That dream where a celestial turned his back-it really was true! What... what should we do now?!

original_text: 阿克：吉顺大叔卖的饼味道是最好的，就是有点贵～哈哈。
translation: Ake: Uncle Jishun's pancakes taste the best, just a bit expensive~ Haha.

original_text: 阿克：沙依木姐姐说她要去仙山了，娘送给她很多好吃的带在路上～她长得那么漂亮，又聪明，天神一定愿意留下她做自己的仆人。
translation: Ake: Sister Sayim said she's going to the Immortal Mountain. Mom gave her lots of delicious food for the journey~ She's so beautiful and smart; the celestials will surely want to keep her as a servant.

original_text: 阿克：沙依木姐姐从仙山上回来了，仙人不愿意收她做仆人，也不让她继续待在山上……姐姐她好伤心……
translation: Ake: Sister Sayim has returned from the immortal mountain. The immortal didn't want to take her as a servant, nor let her stay on the mountain... Sister is so sad...

original_text: 阿克：天神先是不让沙依木姐姐待在山上，现在又收回了清澈的河水……我们到底做错了什么事，天神要这样惩罚我们？
translation: Ake: First, the celestials wouldn't let Sister Sayim stay on the mountain, now they've taken away the clear river water... What did we do wrong for the celestials to punish us like this?

original_text: 范泰：想不到一路黄沙，竟能在这里看到如此繁华的绿洲～
translation: Fantai: Who would have thought that after all this desert, we'd see such a prosperous oasis here~

original_text: 范泰：这次的货物比以往都多，听说沙漠里还出现了强盗，幸好、幸好大家都平安无事～
translation: Fantai: This shipment is bigger than usual. I heard there are robbers in the desert now. Thankfully, thankfully, everyone is safe and sound~

original_text: 沙木沙克：不管有多难，我一定要上山见到天神，请他给我力量，能够保护这个镇子！
translation: Samsak: No matter how difficult it is, I must go up the mountain to see the celestials and ask them for the power to protect this town!

original_text: 沙木沙克：穆哈希木大爷老喜欢嘲笑我只说不做，其实我衣服和弯刀都准备好了，虽然花了八年时间，但总算可以启程了。
translation: Samsak: Elder Muhasim always mocks me for talking without action. Actually, I've prepared my clothes and scimitar. Though it took eight years, I can finally set off.

original_text: 沙木沙克：那些上仙山的人都回来了，天神不愿意见他们……那我怎么办，我看我还是别去山上了……
translation: Samsak: Those people who went to the immortal mountain have all returned. The celestials didn't want to see them... Then what about me? I think I'd better not go up the mountain...

original_text: 沙木沙克：我、我可什么坏事都没做！天神要降灾，可千万别降到我头上啊！
translation: Samsak: I-I haven't done anything bad! If the celestials are going to bring disaster, please don't let it fall on me!

original_text: 塔吉古丽：汉人的女子要嫁谁，得听父母的，那万一嫁的是不喜欢的人怎么办？
translation: Tajigul: Han women must obey their parents in marriage, but what if they marry someone they don't like?

original_text: 塔吉古丽：阿娘说她曾经见过一次仙山上下来的人，是个非常英俊的男人～
translation: Tajigul: Mother said she once saw someone from the immortal mountain-a very handsome man~

original_text: 塔吉古丽：这回我也见到仙山上下来的人了，他们不肯说仙山上到底发生了什么事，只告诉我们河水也许快要干了，让我们快离开……
translation: Tajigul: This time I also saw people from the immortal mountain. They wouldn't say what happened up there, only told us the river might soon dry up and urged us to leave...

original_text: 阿库：我长大了一定要去山上见天神，请他教我怎么飞，这样我就能带着夏提飞到很远很远的地方去玩！
translation: Aku: When I grow up, I will definitely go up the mountain to see celestials and ask they to teach me how to fly. Then I can take Xat to fly to very far, faraway places to play!

original_text: 阿库：咦？你穿的衣服好奇怪，不像商人，也不像中原来的其他人～
translation: Aku: Huh? Your clothes are so strange-not like a merchant, nor like others from the Central Plains~

original_text: 夏提：阿库说过以后要带我在天上飞哎～阿库是个男子汉，夏提相信他一定会做到的！
translation: Xat: Aku said he'd take me flying in the sky someday~ Aku is a real man, and Xat believes he'll definitely make it happen!

original_text: 夏提：听说天神住的地方平常人是不能去的，要是以后阿库去了，那夏提不就不能经常见到他了？呜呜～～
translation: Xat: I heard ordinary people can't go to where the celestials live. If Aku goes there in the future, won't Xat be able to see him often anymore? Wuwu~~

original_text: 段无名：我从小就喜欢打造兵器，可惜在中原时没人赏识，后来化名到了西域，反而比以前过得快活～不错、不错！
translation: Duan Wuming: I've loved forging weapons since childhood, but unfortunately, no one appreciated it in the Central Plains. Later, I changed my name and went to the Western Regions, where I've been happier than before~ Not bad, not bad!

original_text: 段无名：嘿嘿～这镇上的人都很崇拜所谓的“天神”，他们不知道昆仑山上的“天神”其实就是剑仙，我来这儿以前，也只知道蜀地才有剑仙呢～
translation: Duan Wuming: Hehe~ The people in this town worship so-called 'celestials'. They don't know the 'celestials' on Kunlun Mountain are actually sword immortals. Before I came here, I only knew sword immortals were in the Shu region~

original_text: 段无名：家乡的人只喜欢种菜种茶，我打了武器都没人看一下，这儿就不一样啦，小伙子人人都配一把弯刀，看起来精神得很！
translation: Duan Wuming: Folks back home only like growing vegetables and tea; no one even glances at the weapons I forge. Here it's different-every young man carries a scimitar, looking spirited!

original_text: 崔贵：播仙镇风景独特，虽不及中原繁盛，却别有一番风情，我就是喜欢这儿的人热情好客，爽朗大方，所以迁居此地。
translation: Cui Gui: Boxian Town has unique scenery. Though not as prosperous as the Central Plains, it has its own distinct charm. I moved here because I like the people-warm, hospitable, straightforward, and generous.

original_text: 崔贵：夫人天天都想回中原，可是中原有哪里好？还是这儿悠闲，种点葡萄就能养活一家人，不用整天为了吃口饭而苦恼。
translation: Cui Gui: My wife wants to return to the Central Plains every day, but what's so good about the Central Plains? It's more leisurely here. Planting some grapes can support a whole family, no need to worry about food all day long.

original_text: 崔贵：我家迁来这儿几年，一直都算太平，没想到最近马贼竟然连连闹事，希望朝廷早日将马贼解决，我们也好安心过日子。
translation: Cui Gui: Our family moved here years ago, and it's been peaceful until recently, with bandits causing trouble. I hope the court deals with them soon so we can live in peace.

original_text: 崔贵：百闻不如一见，我那日在沙地里遇见一只怪虫子，才知道世上真的有妖怪……差点就没命回来见夫人了……
translation: Cui Gui: Seeing is believing. That day in the desert, I encountered a strange insect and finally knew monsters truly exist in this world... I almost didn't make it back to see my wife...

original_text: 崔贵：虽然我不信什么天神，但是镇上的人都很不安心的样子，难道播仙镇真的会出什么大事？
translation: Cui Gui: Although I don't believe in any celestials, the townsfolk all seem very uneasy. Could Boxian Town really be headed for some major trouble?

original_text: 崔巧娘：我几次三番跟阿贵说要回中原去，他都不理我，还说要走叫我自己走！真是气死我了！要是我真的回去了，谁给他做饭洗衣，谁帮他一块儿照料这些葡萄啊！
translation: Cui Qiaoniang: I've told Ah Gui several times that I want to return to the Central Plains, but he ignores me and even says if I want to leave, I should go alone! It's infuriating! If I really went back, who would cook and wash for him, who would help him take care of these grapes!

original_text: 崔巧娘：播仙镇再好，到底不是自己的家乡，我做梦都想回中原看看！阿贵怎么就不明白呢！
translation: Cui Qiaoniang: No matter how nice Boxian Town is, it's not our hometown. I dream of returning to the Central Plains to see! Why doesn't A Gui understand!

original_text: 崔巧娘：吓死我了……阿贵他差点在沙漠里被怪虫子吃了，我、我以后再也不和他吵架了，他平安回来就好……
translation: Cui Qiaoniang: That scared me to death... Ah Gui was almost eaten by strange bugs in the desert. I... I'll never argue with him again. It's good that he returned safely...

original_text: 崔巧娘：唉，看看播仙镇现在这个样子，可能连葡萄也种不了了，往后的日子真不知道该怎么过啊……
translation: Cui Qiaoniang: Sigh, looking at Boxian Town now, we might not even be able to grow grapes anymore. I really don't know how we'll live in the future...

original_text: 应玛：马槽里的这几匹海青马听说是花了大价钱从尼雅买来的，我看过的马可不少，这几匹马只是看起来精神些，其实和普通的海青没什么不一样的。
translation: Yingma: These sea-green horses in the stable are said to have been bought at great cost from Niya. I've seen many horses, and these just look more spirited, but they're really no different from ordinary sea-green horses.

original_text: 应玛：镇子附近闹马贼了，害的这些中原商人都不敢出镇去。说也奇怪，那群马贼只挑中原人的商队劫，抢了东西不算，人也都杀光，太可怕了！
translation: Yingma: Bandits have been causing trouble near the town, scaring off all these Central Plains merchants from venturing out. Strangely, those bandits only target Central Plains merchant caravans-not only robbing their goods but also killing everyone. It's terrifying!

original_text: 应玛：说起来，那天一大早，好端端的大晴天突然就阴下来，还刮起了大风！然后天上就多出了一个黑影，朝着仙山的方向飘过去了！
translation: Yingma: Speaking of which, that morning, a perfectly clear sky suddenly turned overcast, with strong winds! Then a dark shadow appeared in the sky, drifting toward the immortal mountain!

original_text: 应玛：这几天镇上人心惶惶，来这里做生意的汉人跑得差不多了，其实大伙儿也没什么心思招呼他们，唉……
translation: Yingma: These days, the town is in a panic. Most Han merchants have fled. Honestly, no one is in the mood to entertain them anymore. Sigh...

original_text: 贾任屏：这次从尼雅带来的这些，可都是上等的海青马，花了我不少银子才搞到的，如果不是熟人，我还不想卖呢！
translation: Jia Renping: These horses I brought from Niya are all top-quality sea-green steeds. It cost me a lot of silver to get them-if you weren't an acquaintance, I wouldn't even sell!

original_text: 赵九贯：上等的海青？我说任屏啊，你该不会是上当了吧？我看这几匹马普通的很，好不到哪儿去嘛！
translation: Zhao Jiuguan: Top-quality Haiqing horses? I say, Renping, you couldn't have been fooled, could you? These horses look quite ordinary to me, not particularly good!

original_text: 贾任屏：最近沙漠里不太平，听说是出了凶狠的马贼，而且只挑汉人的商队动手，杀人越货，手段凶残！我看我还是等过了这一阵再回中原吧。
translation: Jia Renping: The desert hasn't been peaceful lately. I hear vicious horse bandits have appeared, targeting only Han merchant caravans, killing and looting with brutal methods! I think I'll wait until this period passes before returning to the Central Plains.

original_text: 贾任屏：官府派出了兵马，听说是把马贼一网打尽了，不过又有人说其实官府只是封锁了兵败的消息，现在马贼比以前更加猖獗！
translation: Jia Renping: The authorities sent troops, and I heard they wiped out the bandits in one go, but some say the government is just covering up their defeat, and now the bandits are more rampant than ever!

original_text: 贾任屏：这里地动山摇，水也快要不能喝了，不管沙漠里有多危险，我也一定要离开！
translation: Jia Renping: The ground is shaking here, and the water is almost undrinkable. No matter how dangerous the desert is, I must leave!

original_text: 赵九贯：播仙镇是个好地方，南来北往的商贩都会路过这里，什么货想要出手，在这儿最容易找到买家。
translation: Zhao Jiuguan: Boxian Town is a good place. Merchants from north and south all pass through here. If you want to sell any goods, it's easiest to find buyers here.

original_text: 赵九贯：不是说昆仑山上的神仙保佑着这个镇吗？马贼那么猖獗，那些神仙怎么不下山帮忙杀马贼？
translation: Zhao Jiuguan: Isn't it said that the immortals on Kunlun Mountain protect this town? The horse thieves are so rampant, why don't those immortals come down to help kill the horse thieves?

original_text: 赵九贯：我经商多年，来这播仙镇不下数十次，还是头一回看到天上那个黑影！听这里的老人说，这黑影十几年前也见过一次，没什么要紧的……
translation: Zhao Jiuguan: I've been in business for many years and have come to Boxian Town dozens of times, but this is the first time I've seen that black shadow in the sky! I heard from the elders here that this shadow was also seen once over a decade ago, and it's nothing serious...

original_text: 赵九贯：这个播仙镇最近异象连连，先是空中出现黑影，后来又山摇地动，河水浑浊，镇上的人也怪，一边怕的要死，一边却又不肯逃走！
translation: Zhao Jiuguan: This Boxian Town has had strange phenomena lately: first shadows in the sky, then earthquakes, muddy rivers. The townsfolk are weird too, scared to death but refusing to flee!

original_text: 凌剑非：一直听说西域有一种“汗血宝马”，长得不见高大，但却能日行千里，夜走八百！可惜我从雁门关一直走到这里，始终没有探询到这宝马的消息。
translation: Ling Jianfei: I've always heard that there's a breed called the 'Sweating Blood Horse' in the Western Regions. It doesn't look particularly tall or large, but it can travel a thousand li by day and eight hundred li by night! Unfortunately, from Yanmen Pass all the way here, I still haven't managed to find any news of this fine steed.

original_text: 凌剑非：嘿！我原本是来找“汗血宝马”的，到了这儿才听说山上住着会飞的仙人，如果能上山请仙人指点一二，把那个会飞的本事学了，那就什么马都用不着啦！
translation: Ling Jianfei: Hey! I originally came here looking for the 'Sweating Blood Horse', but after arriving, I heard there are flying immortals living on the mountain. If I could go up the mountain and ask the immortals for some guidance, learn that flying skill, then I wouldn't need any horse at all!

original_text: 凌剑非：本来还想上山找仙人的，没想到原本上山的人都回来了，看来是没有指望请仙人指点了……
translation: Ling Jianfei: Wanted to go up the mountain to find immortals, but those who went before all returned. Seems no hope for immortal guidance...

original_text: 凌剑非：这地方似乎有些不妙，前几天一阵山摇地动的，后来水也浊了……我看我还是早点离开的好！
translation: Ling Jianfei: This place seems a bit off. A few days ago, there was a quaking tremor, and then the water turned murky... I think I'd better leave sooner rather than later!

original_text: 吾其昆：我也知道总是泡在酒肆里不好，可是葡萄酒实在是太好喝了，我、我忍不住啊！
translation: Wu Qikun: I know hanging out at the winery all the time isn't good, but grape wine is just too delicious. I, I can't help it!

original_text: 吾其昆：嗝～～我知道兰蒂是关心我，让我少喝酒也是为我好～～嗝～～可是、可是～嗝～她就不能像别的女人那样～～嗝～～温柔一点吗？
translation: Wu Qikun: Burp~~ I know Lanti cares about me, telling me to drink less is for my own good~~ Burp~~ But, but~~ Burp~~ can't she be a bit more gentle~~ Burp~~ like other women?

original_text: 吾其昆：那天一开始，我还以为是我喝多了眼花，没想到我家兰蒂也说她看到天上飞过一个黑影！那个黑影飞到仙山上，现在远远看过去，还能看到模模糊糊的影子！
translation: Wu Qikun: That day, at first I thought I had drunk too much and was seeing things, but then my wife Lanti also said she saw a dark shadow flying across the sky! That shadow flew toward the immortal mountain. Now, looking from afar, you can still see a faint, blurry silhouette!

original_text: 吾其昆：唉呀，真不知道大伙儿在慌什么，就算河里的水浊了、不能喝了，我们还能喝酒嘛！葡萄酒的味道比水好喝多了！
translation: Wu Qikun: Ah, I really don't know what everyone is panicking about. Even if the river water turns muddy and undrinkable, we can still drink wine! Grape wine tastes much better than water!

original_text: 兰蒂：你这个混蛋，叫你不许喝酒，又偷偷跑来酒肆！骑马射箭就喊累，整天喝得烂醉你能不累吗？！
translation: Lanti: You scoundrel, I told you not to drink, yet you sneak off to the winery again! You complain about being tired from riding and archery, but getting drunk all day-no wonder you're exhausted!

original_text: 吾其昆：我我我……我已经六个时辰没有喝酒了，兰蒂你行行好，就让我喝几口吧！
translation: Wu Qikun: I... I... I haven't had a drink for twelve hours. Lanti, have some mercy, just let me take a few sips!

original_text: 兰蒂：天神啊！求您发发慈悲，让我家这男人少喝几口酒，多做点正经事情吧！
translation: Lanti: Oh heavens! Please have mercy, make my man drink less wine and do more proper work!

original_text: 兰蒂：看看你的样子！喝成这样……要是现在马贼杀进来了，别说拿起弯刀和他们斗，就是让你跨上马立刻逃跑都没力气！
translation: Lanti: Look at you! Drunk like this... If bandits attacked now, forget about picking up a scimitar to fight them; you wouldn't even have the strength to mount a horse and flee immediately!

original_text: 吾其昆：嗝～～～说、说什么哪～如果马贼～嗝～～真的来了，我又怎么、怎么能丢下你～嗝～不管？
translation: Wu Qikun: Hic~~ Wha-what are you saying~ If bandits~ hic~~ really come, how could I, how could I~ hic~ leave you behind?

original_text: 兰蒂：那天的风特别大，特别冷！然后天上就飞来一个黑乎乎的大东西，一直飞上了仙山！希望天神保佑，千万不要有什么妖魔出现！
translation: Lanti: The wind that day was especially strong and cold! Then a big dark thing flew across the sky, straight toward the immortal mountain! May the celestials protect us, let no demons appear!

original_text: 兰蒂：你啊！泡在酒缸里人都傻了是不是？！如果河里没了水，你让人拿什么去种葡萄、拿什么去酿酒？
translation: Lanti: You! Have you soaked your brains in a wine vat?! If the river runs dry, what will people use to grow grapes, to make wine?

original_text: 吾其昆：嘿嘿……这话说的……好像也有道理……不管，反正曼丽藏的陈年好酒还多得是，足够我再喝整整三年的～
translation: Wu Qikun: Hehe... what you say... seems to make sense too... Whatever, anyway, Menli has plenty of aged good wine hidden away, enough for me to drink for a full three more years~

original_text: 阿比旦：我们酒肆有西域最好的葡萄酒，还有西域最漂亮的姑娘为您斟酒，客人您要不要来坐坐？
translation: Abida: Our winery has the best wine in the Western Regions and the prettiest girls to pour it for you. Would you like to come in, guest?

original_text: 阿比旦：我们老板娘酿的葡萄酒连驻守龟兹镇的将军都知道，上次还专门派了官兵来买呢！
translation: Abida: The wine our landlady brews is even known by the general stationed in Kucha Town! Last time he specially sent soldiers to buy some!

original_text: 阿比旦：前几天，有个英俊的男人来我们酒肆，他带着一匹好马，披着黑色的斗篷，只在镇上停留了一小会就走了，官爷说，那人很可能是马贼头目！可我看着却不太像……
translation: Abida: A few days ago, a handsome man came to our winery. He had a fine horse and wore a black cloak. He only stayed in town for a short while before leaving. The officials say that man is likely the bandit leader! But to me, he didn't quite seem like it...

original_text: 西琳：你们中原人有句话说“三分长相，七分打扮”，这话说的好！姑娘戴上这店里的帽子，看起来会更像一朵漂亮的花！
translation: Shirin: You Central Plains folk have a saying: 'Beauty is three parts nature, seven parts adornment'-well said! If the young lady wears a hat from this shop, she'll look even more like a beautiful flower!

original_text: 西琳：小伙子，瞧你的装扮，是不是想去仙山？那里很危险，一般人没有办法靠近，我劝你打消这个念头吧。
translation: Shirin: Young man, judging by your attire, do you want to go to the immortal mountain? It's very dangerous; ordinary people can't approach it. I advise you to give up that idea.

original_text: 西琳：这段日子马贼作乱，真是太危险了，商人都来买这儿的护身符，保佑平安，我相信天神一定会来帮我们的。
translation: Shirin: With bandits causing trouble lately, it's so dangerous. Merchants come to buy protective charms here for safety. I believe the celestials will surely help us.

original_text: 西琳：有一些上了仙山的人，最近都回到了播仙镇上，原来他们还没有见过天神，天神也不许他们继续住在仙山山腰，唉，那不就是白白辛苦了……
translation: Shirin: Some people who went up the immortal mountain have recently returned to Boxian Town. It turns out they haven't seen the celestial beings, and the celestials don't allow them to continue living on the mountainside. Sigh, that means all their effort was in vain...

original_text: 王万：沙吾提大叔这儿有的就是各式各样的小东西，看看这些弯刀，最多只能给小孩子玩玩，没有什么大用处。
translation: Wang Wan: Uncle Sawut here has all sorts of little things. Look at these curved knives-only good for children to play with, not much use.

original_text: 王万：有人说那些马贼生性凶残，什么人都杀，又有人说那些马贼只抢中原的商人，从来不抢西域人——到底哪个传闻才是真的？
translation: Wang Wan: Some say those bandits are inherently vicious and kill anyone, while others say they only rob merchants from the Central Plains and never target Westerners-which rumor is actually true?

original_text: 王万：马贼刚刚被官府打跑，太平日子还没过上几天，就刮起了一阵怪风，吹倒了好几个葡萄架子！要不是那些老人说没事，我还以为是天神降祸了呢！
translation: Wang Wan: The bandits were just driven off by the authorities, and before we could enjoy a few days of peace, a strange wind blew, knocking over several grape trellises! If the elders hadn't said it's fine, I'd have thought the celestials sent disaster!

original_text: 夏拉：我家沙依木以前常给吉顺大叔捣蛋，这回赔偿他些银钱也是应该的，没想到他又退回来了，真是太客气啦！<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>替我谢谢吉顺大叔</colour><dc0>！</dc0>
translation: Xara: My husband, Sayim, used to cause trouble for Uncle Jishun often, so it's only right to compensate him with some silver this time. I didn't expect him to return it, he's too polite!<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> Please thank Uncle Jishun for me</colour><dc0>!</dc0>

original_text: 夏拉：西域的天气一直很干燥，很少下雨，我们都用仙山上流下来的水种葡萄，每年都有很好的收成，每一颗葡萄都又大又甜！
translation: Xara: The weather in the Western Regions is always dry, with little rain. We use water from the immortal mountain to grow grapes, getting a great harvest every year. Each grape is big and sweet!

original_text: 夏拉：葡萄收成了之后，除了用来酿酒，还能做成葡萄干，你看西边那些石头屋子，就是专用来晒葡萄干的。
translation: Xara: After the grape harvest, besides making wine, they can also be dried into raisins. See those stone houses to the west? They're specially for drying grapes.

original_text: 夏拉：前几天忽然起了一阵大风，阴冷阴冷的，吹倒了好几个葡萄架子！幸好那风只刮了没多久就停了，大伙儿帮忙，才把这些架子重新搭起来。
translation: Xara: A few days ago, a sudden strong wind blew, cold and gloomy, knocking over several grape trellises! Luckily, the wind didn't last long. With everyone's help, we managed to rebuild these frames.

original_text: 夏拉：眼看着葡萄就要收成，可前几天突然一阵山摇地动，刚熟的葡萄都从架子上掉下来摔烂了，真是叫人心疼啊……
translation: Xara: Just as the grapes were about to be harvested, a few days ago there was suddenly a tremor, and the ripe grapes fell from the vines and smashed. It's truly heartbreaking...

original_text: 吾日耶提：我的孙儿是前年上的仙山，到现在也一直没有他的消息，我想他一定是被天神收做仆人了吧？
translation: Uryet: My grandson ascended the immortal mountain the year before last, and there's been no news since. I think he must have been taken as a servant by the celestials.

original_text: 吾日耶提：你……你是不是神的仆人？有没有见过我那上山的孙儿？他在山上过得怎么样了？没有做错事情被天神惩罚吧？
translation: Uryet: You... are you a servant of the celestials? Have you seen my grandson who went up the mountain? How is he living on the mountain? He hasn't done anything wrong and been punished by the celestials, has he?

original_text: 吾日耶提：前些日子那怪风，在播仙镇也不是第一次啦！十几年前的那一次，风吹的比这次阴冷多了，大伙儿都以为是妖怪来了！结果却什么都没发生。
translation: Uryet: That strange wind a few days ago isn't the first time in Boxian Town! The one over a decade ago was even colder and more sinister; everyone thought demons had come! But in the end, nothing happened.

original_text: 吾日耶提：那时候，地也动、山也摇，震得我这把老骨头都快散了……可是我们到底做错了什么事情，让天神发怒、抛弃我们呢？
translation: Uryet: Back then, the ground shook, the mountains trembled, and it felt like my old bones were about to fall apart... But what did we do wrong to make the celestials angry and abandon us?

original_text: 则南蒂：播仙镇的河水是仙山上流下来的，永远都不会干，不像我的家乡，现在大概已经变成一片荒漠了……
translation: Zenati: The river in Boxian Town flows down from the immortal mountain and will never run dry, unlike my hometown, which has probably turned into a desert by now...

original_text: 则南蒂：大漠里的人过得已经很辛苦了，那些马贼还要打劫往来的客商，这伙没有良心的人，天神会惩罚他们的！
translation: Zenati: Life in the desert is already hard enough, yet those bandits still rob traveling merchants. These heartless people will be punished by celestials!

original_text: 则南蒂：前几天，天上飞过去一个黑乎乎的东西，镇上还刮了大风——不过这没什么好怕的，我小时候就见过一次。
translation: Zenati: A few days ago, a dark thing flew across the sky, and a great wind swept through the town-but there's nothing to fear. I saw something like it once when I was a child.

original_text: 妲蒂：喀玛勒长得是英俊，牛角笛吹的也很棒，就是武艺差，胆子小，骑术也不怎么样，我、我才不要喜欢这样的人呢！
translation: Dati: Kamal is handsome and plays the oxhorn flute wonderfully, but his martial arts are poor, he's timid, and his riding skills aren't great either. I-I definitely don't want to like someone like that!

original_text: 妲蒂：说什么都是假的，有本事你就去把那些可恶的马贼都打跑！
translation: Dati: Talk is cheap. If you have the skill, go drive off those hateful bandits!

original_text: 喀玛勒：去就去！难道我还怕马贼吗？！看着吧，我杀的马贼，一定会比阿克木杀的多！
translation: Kamal: Go then! As if I'm afraid of horse bandits?! Watch, I'll kill more horse bandits than Akim!

original_text: 妲蒂：喀玛勒上次真的跟阿克木他们去杀马贼了！我……我一直都以为他是个只说不干的胆小鬼，原来是错怪他了……
translation: Dati: Kamal really went with Akim and the others to kill the horse bandits last time! I... I always thought he was a coward who only talked, but I was wrong about him...

original_text: 喀玛勒：妲蒂，为什么你总是不愿意喜欢我？我到底哪里不好？你说，你说给我听，我马上就改！
translation: Kamal: Dati, why are you always unwilling to like me? What exactly is wrong with me? Tell me, tell me, and I'll change it right away!

original_text: 妲蒂：我说了你就能改吗？那就等你把武艺练得比阿克木更好，马儿骑得比阿克木更快的时候，再来找我吧！
translation: Dati: Even if I tell you, can you change? Then come find me again when your martial skills surpass Akim's and you can ride faster than him!

original_text: 喀玛勒：哼！就算我武艺比不上阿克木，骑术也、也普通了点，但这并不代表我会害怕！我们得到天神的保佑，去打马贼，一定能胜利！
translation: Kamal: Hmph! Even if my martial arts aren't as good as Akim's, and my riding is... average, that doesn't mean I'm afraid! With the celestials' blessing, we'll defeat the horse bandits for sure!

original_text: 喀玛勒：呵呵，自从上次去打马贼回来，妲蒂对我就和以前不一样了，再也不会不理我，而且常常对我笑呢！
translation: Kamal: Hehe, ever since I came back from fighting the horse bandits, Dati has been different toward me. She no longer ignores me and often smiles at me!

original_text: 卓合拉：艾里西尔，你要是真心喜欢我，就把天神的仆人请下山，让天神的仆人证明你对我的爱情！
translation: Zohra: Elshir, if you truly love me, bring the celestials' servants down the mountain, let them prove your love for me!

original_text: 艾里西尔：卓合拉，你又不是不知道，上了仙山也不一定见得到天神的仆人，就算见到了，他们也不会愿意下山来办这种事的啊！
translation: Elshir: Zohra, you know as well as I do, even if you ascend the immortal mountain, you might not see the servants of the celestials, and even if you do, they wouldn't be willing to come down the mountain for such matters!

original_text: 卓合拉：你……你是仙山上天神的仆人对不对？你能带我上山见见天神吗？卓合拉好想好想见天神一面，就一面，好不好？
translation: Zohra: You... you're a servant of the celestials on the immortal mountain, right? Can you take me up the mountain to see the celestials? Zohra really, really wants to see a celestial, just once, okay?

original_text: 卓合拉：在我很小的时候，哥哥就上山去见天神了，后来一直都没有回来，哥哥一定是被天神留下当仆人了～
translation: Zohra: When I was very young, my brother went up the mountain to see the celestials and never came back. He must have been kept by the celestials as a servant~

original_text: 卓合拉：仙山上下来很多神的仆人，他们叫镇上的人早点离开这里，免得日后遭殃……我们、我们到底要怎么做才能平息天神的怒火？
translation: Zohra: Many servants of the celestials came down from the immortal mountain, telling townsfolk to leave early to avoid future disaster... What must we do to appease the celestials' wrath?

original_text: 帕塔木：姐姐总想些奇怪的事情来为难艾里西尔，不过谁叫艾里西尔要喜欢我姐姐呢？嘻嘻！
translation: Patam: My sister always thinks up strange things to trouble Elshir, but who told Elshir to like my sister? Hehe!

original_text: 帕塔木：其实我想跟阿克木大哥还有泽依同他们一起出去打马贼！可是姐姐说我武艺不够好，硬是不许我去，还一定要我跟在她身边……
translation: Patam: Actually, I want to go fight the horse bandits with Big Brother Akim and Zeytun! But my sister says my martial arts aren't good enough and won't let me go, insisting I stay by her side...

original_text: 帕塔木：听泽依同说，那个马贼的首领长得很英俊，还打赢了阿克木大哥，但是却并没有伤害他们，看来那些马贼也并不像别人说的那么坏……
translation: Patam: According to Zeytun, that bandit leader is very handsome and even beat Brother Akim, but didn't harm them. It seems those bandits aren't as bad as others say...

original_text: 帕塔木：老人们都说一定是镇上有人惹怒了天神，天神要降祸惩罚我们！可是、可是大多数人都没有做错事，也没有不尊敬天神，天神为什么连无辜的人也要惩罚？
translation: Patam: The elders all say someone in town must have angered the celestials, and they are going to punish us with disaster! But, but most people haven't done anything wrong, nor disrespected the celestials. Why would they punish even the innocent?

original_text: 艾里西尔：卓合拉什么都好，就是脾气太古怪，喜欢的东西也和别的姑娘不一样，尽是提些古古怪怪的要求，真让人头疼！
translation: Elshir: Zohra is good in every way, just too eccentric. Her tastes differ from other girls, always making strange requests-such a headache!

original_text: 艾里西尔：帕塔木啊，你年纪也不小了，喜欢你的小伙子又那么多，别总是跟着你姐姐好不好？
translation: Elshir: Patam, you're not young anymore, and so many young men like you. Why must you always follow your sister around?

original_text: 卓合拉：怎么了？你是不是嫌弃我妹妹？你要敢嫌弃我妹妹，那我和她一起走！
translation: Zohra: What's wrong? Do you look down on my sister? If you dare despise her, then I'll leave with her!

original_text: 艾里西尔：哎？没、没有啦，帕塔木这么可爱，我怎么会嫌弃她？卓合拉你、你别生气啊！
translation: Elshir: Huh? N-no, not at all. Patam is so adorable, how could I dislike her? Zohra, d-don't be angry!

original_text: 艾里西尔：不管发生什么事，我也一定会留在播仙镇保护大家，保护卓合拉的！
translation: Elshir: No matter what happens, I will definitely stay in Boxian Town to protect everyone, to protect Zohra!

original_text: 昆仑神丐：老夫乃是大名鼎鼎的“昆仑神丐”，西至精绝古城、东至雁门关，天山南麓各条道上的朋友，谁都要给老夫三分面子！
translation: Kunlun Divine Beggar: I am the famous 'Kunlun Divine Beggar'. From the west at the Ancient City of Jingjue to the east at Yanmen Pass, all friends on the roads south of the Tianshan Mountains have to give me some face!

original_text: 昆仑神丐：哼！那群马贼如此猖獗，真是太不给我“昆仑神丐”面子了！看我亲自出马，三天之内就叫他们从西域消失！
translation: Kunlun Divine Beggar: Hmph! Those horse bandits are so rampant, they really don't give any face to this 'Kunlun Divine Beggar'! Watch me take matters into my own hands-I'll make them vanish from the Western Regions within three days!

original_text: 昆仑神丐：据说十几年前，昆仑山上曾经出现过一个庞然大物，只不过那庞然大物过了一阵子就又飞走了，不知道这次飞到仙山上的，是不是同十几年前的那东西一样？
translation: Kunlun Divine Beggar: It's said that over a decade ago, a colossal creature once appeared on Kunlun Mountain, but it flew away after a while. I wonder if the thing that flew to the immortal mountain this time is the same as the one from over a decade ago?

original_text: 昆仑神丐：我“昆仑神丐”和昆仑山碧玉、紫翠两派的掌门都有点交情，不过他们也都不知道这山顶上突然飞起的东西到底是什么……
translation: Kunlun Divine Beggar: I, the 'Kunlun Divine Beggar', have some acquaintance with the sect leaders of Kunlun's Biyu and Zicui factions. However, even they don't know what that thing suddenly flying up from the mountaintop really is...

original_text: 莱丽：播仙镇来来往往的客商很多，我和阿娘从早忙到晚，偏偏店里帮忙的人又爱偷懒……唉，真是没办法……
translation: Leyli: There are many merchants coming and going in Boxian Town. My mother and I are busy from morning till night, and the helpers in the shop are lazy... Sigh, there's just no way...

original_text: 莱丽：最近这几天附近马贼猖獗，不少中原商人都被抢了，你们来来往往的，可都要小心些。愿天神保佑你们！
translation: Leyli: Recently, bandits have been rampant nearby, and many merchants from the Central Plains have been robbed. You all coming and going must be careful. May the celestials protect you!

original_text: 莱丽：天神保佑！那些马贼终于被赶跑了，但要是不抓到他们，谁知道接下来哪里会遭殃呢……
translation: Leyli: Heaven bless! Those horse bandits are finally driven away, but if they aren't caught, who knows which place will suffer next...

original_text: 萧康：史兄弟，听说上了太一仙径的人，很少有能回来的……这，听起来怪邪门，如果山上住的不是仙人是妖怪，那不是大大的不好？
translation: Xiao Kang: Brother Shi, I heard few who ascend the Taiyi Immortal Path return... That sounds eerie. If what lives on the mountain aren't immortals but yaoguais, wouldn't that be terribly bad?

original_text: 史默遥：萧兄弟你想太多了，播仙镇这么多人都一口咬定山上住的是神仙，怎么会有假？何况我们千里迢迢跑来这里，不上山看看怎么行？！
translation: Shi Moyao: Brother Xiao, you're overthinking it. So many people in Boxian Town insist that immortals live on the mountain. How could it be false? Besides, we've traveled thousands of miles to come here. How can we not go up the mountain to see?!

original_text: 萧康：前几天我们上山，在半山腰遇到两个自称“剑南双侠”的人，两三下就被我打趴了，就这点功夫还敢拦路抢劫，简直就是找死！
translation: Xiao Kang: A few days ago, we went up the mountain and met two people calling themselves the 'Twin Heroes of Jiannan' halfway up. I knocked them down in a couple of moves-with such poor skills daring to rob people, they were asking for trouble!

original_text: 萧康：本来还想和史兄弟再上一次仙山，没想到上次在半山腰见到的几个人现在也都下山了，看来仙山中的确有大事要发生。
translation: Xiao Kang: I wanted to go up the immortal mountain with Brother Shi again, but the people we saw halfway up last time have all come down now. It seems something big is indeed happening on the mountain.

original_text: 萧康：道门中人得道飞升的事情我也不是没听说过，不过要说像前几天看到的那样，整座山都往上飞的，还真是闻所未闻！
translation: Xiao Kang: I've heard of Taoist practitioners achieving enlightenment and ascending to immortality, but seeing an entire mountain fly up like the other day is truly unheard of!

original_text: 史默遥：我们兄弟两人从中原来，昨天刚到播仙镇，总得歇息几天，打听清楚仙山的事情再动身去求仙。
translation: Shi Moyao: My brother and I came from the Central Plains, just arrived in Boxian Town yesterday. We need to rest a few days, inquire about the immortal mountain before heading off to seek immortality.

original_text: 史默遥：说起“剑南双侠”，以前在江南一带行走时倒有听说过，他们虽然没有什么大作为，但也不至于沦落成打家劫舍的盗匪……
translation: Shi Moyao: Speaking of the 'Two Heroes of Jiannan', I've heard of them while traveling in the Jiangnan region before. Although they haven't achieved any great feats, they certainly wouldn't stoop to becoming bandits who rob homes and loot houses...

original_text: 史默遥：山顶上那群道士干嘛那么霸道？昆仑山又不是他们的，住在半山腰都不行？
translation: Shi Moyao: Why are those Taoists on the mountaintop so domineering? Kunlun Mountain isn't theirs. Can't we even live halfway up the slope?

original_text: 史默遥：听说昆仑山上还有别的修仙门派，我和萧兄弟打算过几天就去别处找找，看看有没有别的地方能上山修仙的～
translation: Shi Moyao: I heard there are other immortal cultivation sects on Kunlun Mountain. Brother Xiao and I plan to look elsewhere in a few days, see if there are other places to ascend the mountain for cultivation~

original_text: 易仁：龟兹镇邢大人的公子被刺客掳走，我奉命调查此案多日，终于找到一些蛛丝马迹，追至此地后，线索却又断了，唉……
translation: Yi Ren: The son of Magistrate Xing in Guizi Town was kidnapped by assassins. I've been investigating for days and found some clues, but they vanished after I tracked them here. Sigh...

original_text: 易仁：听往来的商人提起，那马贼首领的相貌，似乎和月前掳走邢公子的刺客有些相似，难道沙漠中的马贼和那刺客有所牵连？
translation: Yi Ren: I heard from traveling merchants that the bandit leader's appearance seems similar to the assassin who kidnapped Young Master Xing last month. Could the desert bandits be connected to that assassin?

original_text: 易仁：那些马贼狡猾地很，朝廷的人马跟他们交手几次，双方都没占到便宜，好在如今他们终于收敛一些，只不过被马贼掳走的邢公子，却还是下落不明……
translation: Yi Ren: Those horse bandits are very cunning. The imperial troops have clashed with them several times, neither side gaining advantage. Fortunately, they've finally toned down a bit now, but Young Master Xing, who was kidnapped by them, is still missing...

original_text: 易仁：播仙镇最近接连发生奇怪的事情，看镇上的人都这么紧张，难道真的会出什么大事？
translation: Yi Ren: Strange things keep happening in Boxian Town lately. Seeing how tense the townsfolk are, could something big really happen?

original_text: 莫夫人：前几次，相公是一个人来西域做买卖的，一趟来回一年多，留下我们孤儿寡母住在京里，还不如像现在这样跟相公一起出门的好。
translation: Madam Mo: The previous times, my husband came to the Western Regions alone for trade, a round trip taking over a year, leaving us orphans and widows in the capital. It's better to travel with him like now.

original_text: 莫夫人：相公去了更西边的城里，说是办货，已经好几天了，最近沙漠里又在闹马贼，真是担心死人了！
translation: Madam Mo: My husband went to the city further west to purchase goods, and it's been several days already. With the bandits causing trouble in the desert again recently, I'm worried sick!

original_text: 莫夫人：听说马贼已经被官兵给除去了，可是相公却还没回来……要是相公他有什么三长两短，可叫我们孤儿寡母怎么活呀！
translation: Madam Mo: I heard the bandits were eliminated by the soldiers, but my husband still hasn't returned... If anything happens to him, how will we orphans and widows survive!

original_text: 莫小福：阿娘说，爹爹去了别的地方，很快就会回来，还会送小福一支新笛子！
translation: Mo Xiaofu: Mama says Daddy went to another place and will come back soon. He'll also give Xiaofu a new flute!

original_text: 莫小福：我和阿娘已经在这里住了好久了，到底什么时候才能回家呢？我还答应了小莲这次回家就送她礼物呢！
translation: Mo Xiaofu: My mother and I have lived here for so long. When can we finally go home? I promised Xiaolian I'd bring her a gift when we return!

original_text: 莫小福：小福天天在等爹爹，娘说只要爹爹一来，我们就回家！
translation: Mo Xiaofu: Xiaofu waits for Daddy every day. Mom says once Daddy comes, we'll go home!

original_text: 粱大刚：哈哈哈！这酒肆的姑娘长得漂亮，葡萄酒也好喝的不得了，最要紧的是——这酒钱也便宜的很！
translation: Liang Dagang: Hahaha! The girls at this winery are pretty, the grape wine is delicious beyond compare, and most importantly-the wine is dirt cheap!

original_text: 粱大刚：那群胆小的商人把那些马贼说的像妖怪一样，我看不过就是一群小毛贼！老板娘！再来三斤葡萄酒！等我喝够了，立刻就去把那群小贼给砍了！
translation: Liang Dagang: Those timid merchants describe the bandits like monsters. I think they're just a bunch of petty thieves! Boss lady! Another three catties of grape wine! Once I've drunk enough, I'll go chop those little thieves right away!

original_text: 粱大刚：上回我喝醉了酒，不知怎么就睡到十里外的荒郊，幸好有朝廷的兵马路过把我救了，否则就算不遇到马贼，也得让野狼吃了……
translation: Liang Dagang: Last time I got drunk, I somehow ended up sleeping in the wilderness ten li away. Luckily, imperial troops passed by and saved me. Otherwise, even if I didn't run into bandits, I'd have been eaten by wolves...

original_text: 粱大刚：仙山上的仙人要回天上去了，以后没有水从山上流下来，就再也喝不到这么好的葡萄酒啦……
translation: Liang Dagang: The immortals on the mountain are returning to the heavens. Once no more water flows down from the mountain, we'll never drink such good grape wine again...

original_text: 罗熙：我在龟兹的时候就听人说起过播仙镇的绿洲酒肆，说是连邢大人的公子都对这里的葡萄酒赞不绝口，今日一尝，果然名不虚传！
translation: Luo Xi: Back in Kucha, I heard people talk about the Oasis winery in Boxian Town, saying even Lord Xing's son praised the wine here. Tasting it today, it truly lives up to its reputation!

original_text: 罗熙：告诉你，邢大人的公子根本就不是被马贼掳走的，而是自愿投奔那群马贼的！至于这其中的蹊跷嘛～～当然是不能告诉你的。
translation: Luo Xi: Let me tell you, Magistrate Xing's son wasn't kidnapped by horse bandits at all-he willingly joined them! As for the strangeness behind it... of course, I can't tell you.

original_text: 罗熙：听说那马贼头头武功很高，朝廷的兵马也在他手里吃了暗亏！如果有机会，我一定要会会那家伙！
translation: Luo Xi: I hear that bandit leader has formidable martial arts-even the imperial troops suffered setbacks against him! If I get the chance, I must meet that fellow!

original_text: 罗熙：我走南闯北数十年，却从来没遇到过这样的事！好好的河水一夜之间变浑浊，天上还飞起一座山！真是个鬼地方，看来还是早点离开为妙！
translation: Luo Xi: I've traveled north and south for decades but never encountered anything like this! Clear river water turning muddy overnight, and a mountain flying in the sky! What a haunted place-better leave soon!

original_text: 西丁：唉……我喜欢泽依同很久了，可是她看也不看我一眼，上次我去她家想带她走，还被她揍了一顿，为什么她要这么待我啊……
translation: Xidin: Sigh... I've liked Zeytun for a long time, but she won't even glance at me. Last time I went to her house to take her away, she even beat me up. Why does she treat me like this...

original_text: 西丁：自从附近闹马贼，泽依同就嚷着要去杀马贼……马贼那么凶悍，她一个小姑娘，出了事怎么办啊！
translation: Xidin: Ever since the bandits started causing trouble nearby, Zeytun has been clamoring to go kill them... The bandits are so fierce. What if something happens to a young girl like her!

original_text: 西丁：上次泽依同和镇上几个小伙子骑马出去找马贼，过了十几天才回来，还好没有人受重伤，真是天神保佑！
translation: Xidin: Last time, Zeytun and some young men from town rode out to find the bandits and came back after over ten days. Thankfully, no one was seriously hurt. Truly blessed by the celestials!

original_text: 西丁：完了，完了！天神已经飞到天上去，再也不会管我们了！河里的水很快就会变成黄沙，大家都会死的！！
translation: Xidin: It's over, over! The celestials have flown to the heavens and will never care for us again! The river will soon turn to yellow sand, and everyone will die!!

original_text: 奈蒂尔：荒漠中的村子很容易就会被黄沙吞没，但是播仙镇受到天神的保佑，不但不怕风沙，而且长年都有清澈的河水可以使用。
translation: Nadir: Villages in the desert can easily be swallowed by yellow sand, but Boxian Town is blessed by the celestials. Not only is it safe from wind and sand, but there's also clear river water available year-round.

original_text: 奈蒂尔：我的家乡原来也有一条清澈的河流，后来村子里的人做了错事，天神惩罚我们，收回了恩赐给我们的河水，日子实在过不下去了，我只能跟着家里人搬到这里来。
translation: Nadir: My hometown once had a clear river. But the villagers did wrong, and the celestials punished us, taking back the river they'd blessed us with. Life became unbearable, so I moved here with my family.

original_text: 奈蒂尔：天上飞过那么大一个黑影，虽然说没有发生什么别的事情，但我心里总觉得不安宁，好像要有不好的事情发生了……
translation: Nadir: That huge shadow flying across the sky-though nothing else happened, I feel uneasy, as if something bad is about to occur...

original_text: 奈蒂尔：天神抛弃我们了，难道播仙镇也要和我的家乡月牙村一样，变成一片黄沙吗……
translation: Nadir: The celestials have abandoned us. Will Boxian Town end up like my hometown, Crescent Crescent Village, turning into yellow sand?...

original_text: 古兰慕：曼丽大姐酿的葡萄酒是整个西域的人都知道的，我要跟着她，把她酿酒的手艺好好地学一学。
translation: Gulam: Sister Menli's grape wine is famous throughout the Western Regions. I want to follow her and learn her winemaking skills thoroughly.

original_text: 古兰慕：听说附近又有一个村子被黄沙吞没了，天神保佑！幸好我们播仙镇一直平安无事……
translation: Gulam: I heard another nearby village was swallowed by the yellow sand. Heaven bless us! Thankfully, our Boxian Town has remained safe and sound...

original_text: 古兰慕：我、我不是故意把装酒的木桶打开的！我只是想闻闻酒酿好了没有，根本不知道这样做会让酒的香味散掉啊……
translation: Gulam: I-I didn't mean to open the wine barrel! I just wanted to smell if the wine was ready. I had no idea doing so would let the aroma escape...

original_text: 古兰慕：天神保佑了播仙镇几百年了，老人们都说天神是永远也不会抛弃我们的……可是为什么现在河里的水变浑浊，而且一天比一天少了呢……
translation: Gulam: The celestials has blessed Boxian Town for centuries. The elders say the celestials will never abandon us... But why has the river water turned muddy and decreased day by day...

original_text: 吉顺：卖大饼啦～香喷喷的大饼出炉啦！不香不收钱啦！
translation: Jishun: Selling big cakes~ Freshly baked, fragrant big cakes! Not fragrant, no charge!

original_text: 阿克：哇！太好了！大叔～来十个不香的！
translation: Ake: Wow! Great! Uncle~ give me ten of the non-fragrant ones!

original_text: 吉顺：阿克你又来捣蛋！再胡闹我就告诉你娘！
translation: Jishun: Ake, you're causing trouble again! If you keep messing around, I'll tell your mom!

original_text: 阿克：吉顺大叔你老那么严肃，真没意思！看在我每天都来买饼的份上～便宜点卖我几个吧，好不好？
translation: Ake: Uncle Jishun, you're always so serious, how boring! Considering I come to buy cakes every day~ sell me a few cheaper, okay?

original_text: 吉顺：好说好说，你别胡闹就成～
translation: Jishun: Easy, easy, just don't cause trouble~

original_text: 云天河：……便宜卖？不懂……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... cheaper? Don't get it...

original_text: 吉顺：哈哈，谢谢兄弟你帮忙，这些手抓饭和奶茶可是播仙镇上的一绝，送你一些，带在路上吃，保证比你们中原人干巴巴的面饼好吃！
translation: Jishun: Haha, thanks for your help, brother. These hand-grabbed rice and milk tea are specialties of Boxian Town. Take some for the road-guaranteed tastier than you Central Plains folks' dry flatbread!

original_text: 花费150文钱住宿吗？
translation: Spend 150 wen to stay the night?

original_text: 狄丽拜尔：您身上的钱不够。
translation: Dilbar: You don't have enough money on you.

original_text: 狄丽拜尔：呵呵，原来是这样……当年我决定嫁给相公的时候，心里就只有相公一个人，就算有再英俊、再好的小伙子，我也都不会喜欢的。
translation: Dilbar: Hehe, so that's how it is... Back when I decided to marry my husband, my heart belonged only to him. Even if there were more handsome, better young men, I wouldn't have liked them.

original_text: 狄丽拜尔：谢谢你帮我这个忙，这件衣裳给你，送给喜欢的姑娘吧！塔依夫的事情，我自己去找他说就行。
translation: Dilbar: Thank you for helping me with this. Here's this dress for you-give it to a girl you like! As for Tayif's matter, I'll go talk to him myself.

original_text: 陈天远：我从中原千里迢迢赶来西域，专为收集到奇珍异宝，没想到播仙镇竟然出了此等大事，到如今只能设法变卖一些东西，凑够回乡的盘缠，尽快离开这里了。
translation: Chen Tianyuan: I traveled thousands of miles from the Central Plains to the Western Regions, specifically to collect rare treasures. I never expected such a major event to occur in Boxian Town. Now, I can only try to sell some things to gather enough travel money to return home and leave this place as soon as possible.

original_text:
沙依木那姑娘上山求仙去啦！临走还特地买了我摊上的大饼，真是……认识她那么久了，我怎么好意思收这么多银钱？小兄弟，帮我把这些钱送还给沙依木他娘吧，她就在车马驿上面葡萄架的附近。
你愿意帮我送去吗？
translation:
That girl ShAyimna has gone up the mountain to seek immortality! Before leaving, she even specially bought the big flatbread from my stall, really... Having known her for so long, how could I accept so much money? Young man, help me return this money to ShAyimna's mother, she's near the grape trellis above the carriage post.
Will you help me deliver it?

original_text:
真不知道是哪家的小伙子，竟然送来一份这么贵重的礼物，还留书说月圆之夜就来“窃婚”？
我出嫁前倒是常常遇到这种事情，但那也都是很多年前啦……小兄弟，如果你有时间，就帮我查查是谁开的这玩笑，他到底想干什么？
你愿意帮我查查吗？
translation:
I wonder which young man it was, sending such an expensive gift and leaving a note saying he'd come to 'steal the bride' on the night of the full moon?
I often encountered such things before I got married, but that was many years ago... Young man, if you have time, could you help me find out who's playing this joke and what he really wants?
Are you willing to help me investigate?

translation: Yun Tianhe: <colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>First find the sect leader, pass the initiation trial...</colour>

original_text: 云天河：师叔让我们<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>去前山的弟子房休息</colour><dc0>，好像不是这边……</dc0>

original_text: 云天河：不晓得那边是什么地方，先别过去了……

original_text: 韩菱纱：不愧是仙山，连大门也特别气派～
