translation: Han Lingsha: Worthy of an immortal mountain, even the gate is especially grand~
Yun Tianhe: ......

original_text: 韩菱纱：（可怜的野人，没见过这样的气派景象，看傻了都。）
translation: Han Lingsha: (Poor barbarian, never seen such a grand sight before, he's completely stunned.)

original_text: 云天河：走！哈哈，我们快进去看看里面啥样！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Let's go! Haha, let's go in and see what it's like inside!

original_text: 明光：请留步！非本门弟子不得入内！
translation: Mingguang: Please stop! Non-sect members are not allowed inside!

original_text: 柳梦璃：我们是来拜师的，能不能劳驾通禀一声？
translation: Liu Mengli: We've come to become disciples. Could you kindly announce our arrival?

original_text: 明光：掌门有令，近日派中诸事甚多，无暇他顾。各位请回吧！
translation: Mingguang: The Sect Leader orders that the sect has many matters recently and no time for distractions. Please return!

original_text: 韩菱纱：哎？不会吧？我们好辛苦才爬上来的……
translation: Han Lingsha: Huh? No way? We climbed up here with so much effort...

original_text: 明尘：若不愿下山，可先在太一仙径白灏道盘桓数日——
translation: Mingchen: If unwilling to descend the mountain, you may linger for a few days on the Baihao Path of the Taiyi Immortal Path-

original_text: 韩菱纱：数日到底是几日啊？
translation: Han Lingsha: How many days is 'a few days' exactly?

original_text: 明尘：这……我们也是奉命行事，请姑娘莫要为难。
translation: Mingchen: This... we are also acting on orders, please don't make things difficult, miss.

original_text: 明光：师弟，不必跟他们多说！
translation: Mingguang: Martial Brother, no need to say more to them!

original_text: 明尘：是……
translation: Mingchen: Yes...

original_text: 韩菱纱：这也太倒霉了吧？那两个门神遮遮掩掩，又不讲清楚，满口推托的话。
translation: Han Lingsha: What rotten luck! Those two 'door gods' were so evasive-wouldn't explain a thing, just full of excuses.

original_text: 柳梦璃：我看他们神情肃穆，举止也很戒备，或许门派里真的有什么事……
translation: Liu Mengli: I see their expressions are solemn and their movements guarded. Perhaps something really is happening in the sect...

original_text: 云天河：现在怎么办？不会要下山吧？
translation: Yun Tianhe: What do we do now? We're not going down the mountain, are we?

original_text: 韩菱纱：来都来了，我可不甘心！
translation: Han Lingsha: We're already here, I won't give up!

original_text: 韩菱纱：嘻～不如我们先偷溜进去瞧瞧。
translation: Han Lingsha: Hehe~ Let's sneak in and take a look first.

original_text: 韩菱纱：啊！我、我说要溜进去，只是说说而已，还什么都没做呢！
translation: Han Lingsha: Ah! I-I said sneak in, but I was just talking! I haven't done anything yet!

original_text: 韩菱纱：……咳，我的意思是，这位道长有何指教？
translation: Han Lingsha: ... Ahem, I mean, what guidance does this Taoist priest have?

original_text: 虚邑：掌门要召见你们！
translation: Xuyi: The Sect Leader wants to see you!

original_text: 韩菱纱：咦咦咦——？！
translation: Han Lingsha: Huh huh huh-?!

original_text: 云天河：掌门？谁啊？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Sect Leader? Who's that?

original_text: 韩菱纱：笨，就是一派之主，门派里所有人都要听他的！
translation: Han Lingsha: Dummy, he's the sect leader, everyone in the sect has to obey him!

original_text: 云天河：哦～那他一定又厉害又威风。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Oh~ Then he must be both powerful and imposing.

original_text: 虚邑：……等一下在掌门面前，不可乱说乱动，无论是不是本门弟子，规矩法度总要守的。
translation: Xuyi: ...When you're before the Sect Leader, don't speak or act carelessly. Disciple or not, you must always follow the rules.

original_text: 虚邑：尤其这位……少侠，似乎阅历甚浅，请注意自己的行止庄重。切记！
translation: Xuyi: Especially you... young hero, you seem rather inexperienced. Please mind your manners and act with dignity. Remember!

original_text: 云天河：呃……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Uh...

original_text: 韩菱纱：嘻嘻，被嫌弃了吧～
translation: Han Lingsha: Hehe, got snubbed, didn't you~

original_text: 柳梦璃：请问，掌门为什么要见我们呢？
translation: Liu Mengli: May I ask, why does the sect leader want to see us?

original_text: 虚邑：掌门行事，自有缘由。你们只须跟我来。
translation: Xuyi: The sect leader always has reasons. Just follow me.

original_text: 韩菱纱：去就去，名门正派不会把我们怎样的，还能见到掌门，怎么想也不吃亏！
translation: Han Lingsha: Fine, let's go. A reputable orthodox sect won't do anything to us. Plus we get to meet the sect leader-no downside, right?

original_text: 虚邑：掌门，弟子已将他们带来了。
translation: Xuyi: Sect Leader, I have brought them here.

original_text: 夙瑶：虚邑，你且退下。
translation: Suyao: Xuyi, you may step back now.

original_text: 虚邑：是！
translation: Xuyi: Yes!

original_text: 韩菱纱：（……掌门是……女的？！）
translation: Han Lingsha: (...The sect leader is... a woman?!)

original_text: 夙瑶：……你，叫什么名字？
translation: Suyao: ... You, what is your name?

original_text: 云天河：啊？问我？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Huh? Asking me?

original_text: 云天河：我、我叫云天河。
translation: Yun Tianhe: I, I'm Yun Tianhe.

original_text: 夙瑶：你爹是云天青？
translation: Suyao: Your father is Yun Tianqing?

original_text: 云天河：是啊，你、掌门也认识我爹？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Yes, you, the Sect Leader also knew my father?

original_text: 夙瑶：今日我在敬天之屋，以天珠占卜，得知会有故人之子前来，想必卦象中说的就是你了。
translation: Suyao: Today in the Heaven-Respecting Hall, I divined with heavenly beads and learned that the child of an old friend would come. The hexagram likely refers to you.

original_text: 云天河：我爹～他以前真的在这儿待过？
translation: Yun Tianhe: My Father~ he really stayed here before?

original_text: 夙瑶：……不错，你爹确实曾入琼华派，只可惜他修行半途而废，后来就自行下山去了。如今他可是心有遗憾，才嘱咐你上山拜师？
translation: Suyao: ... That's right, your father did indeed join the Qionghua Sect, but unfortunately, he abandoned his cultivation halfway and later left the mountain on his own. Now, filled with regret, he must have instructed you to come up the mountain to seek apprenticeship?

original_text: 云天河：是我自己想来，爹很早就死了，也没交代什么。
translation: Yun Tianhe: I came on my own. Dad died long ago and didn't explain anything.

original_text: 夙瑶：他……竟已过世了？……怎会如此……
translation: Suyao: He... has already passed away? ...How could this be...

original_text: 云天河：……掌门？
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... Sect Leader?

original_text: 夙瑶：……也罢、也罢，死生由命……
translation: Suyao: ...Fine, fine, life and death are fated...

original_text: 夙瑶：……近日本门将有大事，我原不想节外生枝，但念及故人情义，且让你们几个试上一试。若能通过考验，我便破例一回，让你们入门又有何妨？
translation: Suyao: ... Recently, our sect will face a major event. I originally did not want to complicate matters, but considering old friendships and sentiments, I will let you all try. If you can pass the trial, I will make an exception-what harm is there in letting you join the sect?

original_text: 云天河：要是没通过呢？
translation: Yun Tianhe: What if we don't pass?

original_text: 夙瑶：那便是几位仙缘浅薄，不适修行，也只能请你们下山去了。
translation: Suyao: Then it means your immortal fate is shallow, unsuited for cultivation, and we must ask you to leave the mountain.

original_text: 云天河：哦……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Oh...

original_text: 云天河：（原来就算掌门认识我爹，也没什么优待……）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (So even if the Sect Leader knew my father, there's no special treatment...)

original_text: 韩菱纱：（掌门竟然只理会天河，当我和梦璃不存在一样……）
translation: Han Lingsha: (The sect leader only pays attention to Tianhe, as if Mengli and I don't exist at all...)

original_text: 夙瑶：<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>准备好了，便上前来。</colour>
translation: Suyao: <colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>Once you're ready, step forward.</colour>

original_text: 夙瑶：我且将你们送往一处境地，如何去而复返，须得自行体悟。
translation: Suyao: I shall send you to a certain realm. How to return from there, you must realize on your own.

original_text: 云天河：呵呵，只要不被送下山，去哪都行。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Hehe, as long as I'm not sent down the mountain, I'll go anywhere.

original_text: 夙瑶：若是在其中困得久了，我自会将你们召回，但入门之事也不必再提了。
translation: Suyao: If you are trapped too long, I will recall you. But forget about joining the sect.

original_text: 云天河：意思就是……不凭自己的本事跑回来，就不算数？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Meaning... if we don't run back by our own ability, it doesn't count?

original_text: 夙瑶：不错。
translation: Suyao: Correct.

original_text: 云天河：掌门你放心，不管跑路还是爬山，我都可以的！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Don't worry, Sect Leader. Whether running or climbing mountains, I can do it!

original_text: 夙瑶：……但愿如此。
translation: Suyao: ...I hope so.

original_text: 韩菱纱：（这傻瓜……再继续耍白痴，我们可能会被直接赶出去……）
translation: Han Lingsha: (That fool... If he keeps acting stupid, we might get kicked out directly...)

original_text: 夙瑶：凝神！
translation: Suyao: Focus!

original_text: 夙瑶：玄女有命，普告万灵，自在往来，腾身紫微！
translation: Suyao: The Xuannv commands, informs all spirits, come and go freely, ascend to the Purple Star!

original_text: 云天河：啊，真的回来了！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Ah, we really came back!

original_text: 夙瑶：不错，比我想的还要快上许多。
translation: Suyao: Good, much faster than I expected.

original_text: 云天河：啊？那是因为——
translation: Yun Tianhe: Huh? That's because-

original_text: 韩菱纱：因为我们都很认真努力地闯关！
translation: Han Lingsha: Because we all worked hard to get through all the trials!

original_text: 云天河：……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ...

original_text: 韩菱纱：（以后还是少跟这野人一起，老实得像个大笨蛋……）
translation: Han Lingsha: (Better not hang out with this barbarian too much in the future, he's as honest as a big fool...)

original_text: 柳梦璃：嗯……可是为什么我会觉得，已经过去很久的样子……
translation: Liu Mengli: Mm... But why do I feel as if a long time has passed...

original_text: 夙瑶：久？自虚邑带你们踏入琼华宫的大门，连一柱香还未燃尽。
translation: Suyao: Long? Since Xuyi brought you through Qionghua Palace's gates, not even an incense stick has burned down.

original_text: 柳梦璃：这……是幻术吗？简直太奇妙了。
translation: Liu Mengli: This... is it illusion magic? It's simply too marvelous.

original_text: 夙瑶：人生一场迷梦，又岂知哪些是幻，哪些是真。你们方才不过神识出窍，历经了一场梦中之梦。
translation: Suyao: Life is a confusing dream, who knows what's illusion, what's real. You just had your spirits leave your bodies, experienced a dream within a dream.

original_text: 夙瑶：吾辈修仙，正是要从生死大梦中超脱，才可窥得世间真意。
translation: Suyao: We cultivate immortality precisely to transcend the great dream of life and death, to glimpse the world's true meaning.

original_text: 云天河：这太好玩了～醒着也能做梦！
translation: Yun Tianhe: This is so fun~ Can dream even while awake!

original_text: 夙瑶：……云天河，你身上佩剑可否让我一观？
translation: Suyao: ... Yun Tianhe, may I take a look at the sword you're wearing?

original_text: 云天河：哦，好。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Oh, okay.

original_text: 夙瑶：此剑……你从何处得来？
translation: Suyao: This sword... where did you get it?

original_text: 云天河：（干嘛每个人都问一样的话？连掌门也……）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (Why does everyone ask the same thing? Even the Sect Leader...)

original_text: 云天河：是爹给我的。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Father gave it to me.

original_text: 夙瑶：威力如何？
translation: Suyao: How's the power?

original_text: 云天河：还不错吧，用着蛮顺手的……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Not bad, it's quite handy to use...

original_text: 夙瑶：近日内可是有些变化？
translation: Suyao: Have there been some changes recently?

original_text: 云天河：原来掌门你这么厉害～连这都看得出来。
translation: Yun Tianhe: So the Sect Leader is this amazing~ You can even tell that.

original_text: 云天河：有一天这剑突然发光后，变得力量好大，我都险些控制不住……
translation: Yun Tianhe: One day, this sword suddenly glowed and became incredibly powerful. I almost couldn't control it...

original_text: 柳梦璃：难道……这把剑以前是琼华派的东西？
translation: Liu Mengli: Could it be... this sword once belonged to Qionghua Sect?

original_text: 夙瑶：此剑不凡，你须小心收好，切勿怠慢。
translation: Suyao: This sword is extraordinary, you must keep it safe and not neglect it.

original_text: 夙瑶：我派素来以剑为尊，炼剑修仙，至天人合一之境，你初入门，便有神兵在手，自然事半功倍。
translation: Suyao: Our sect honors the sword, refining swords to cultivate immortality, reaching unity of sword and human. You start with a divine weapon, surely achieve more with less effort.

original_text: 韩菱纱：掌门，我们是不是很快就能开始修习仙术呢？
translation: Han Lingsha: Sect Leader, will we be able to start learning immortal arts soon?

original_text: 夙瑶：你等虽有些修为，但根基不稳，所学甚杂，实是修仙大忌。
translation: Suyao: Though you have some cultivation, your foundations are unstable and your learning too mixed-a major taboo in immortal cultivation.

original_text: 夙瑶：我本想让一名玄字辈的长老亲自教授，奈何他在外未归，也只得另觅人选，此人名份上虽是你们的师叔，但规矩礼法不可废，须以师道尊之。
translation: Suyao: I originally wanted an elder of  Xuan generation to personally instruct you, but he hasn't returned from outside, so I had to find someone else. Although this person is nominally your Martial Uncle, you must respect him as a teacher, following all rules and etiquette.

original_text: 夙瑶：可都听明白了？
translation: Suyao: Is everything clear now?

original_text: 韩菱纱：是，谢谢掌门！
translation: Han Lingsha: Yes, thank you, Sect Leader!

original_text: 慕容紫英：弟子慕容紫英奉命前来。
translation: Murong Ziying: Disciple Murong Ziying reporting as ordered.

original_text: 慕容紫英：参见掌门！
translation: Murong Ziying: Greetings, Sect Leader!

original_text: 韩菱纱：是你？！
translation: Han Lingsha: It's you?!

original_text: 慕容紫英：你们……
translation: Murong Ziying: You all...

original_text: 夙瑶：怎么？
translation: Suyao: What?

original_text: 慕容紫英：不，没什么，弟子在山下曾与他们有过数面之缘。
translation: Murong Ziying: No, it's nothing. I've met them a few times when I was down the mountain.

original_text: 夙瑶：哦？……如此甚好，看来我没有选错人。
translation: Suyao: Oh? ...Very good, it seems I didn't choose the wrong person.

original_text: 夙瑶：紫英，这几位初入门的弟子，由你负责教授。你在同辈弟子中亦算出类拔萃，却从无授徒经验，不如将此当作一种历练吧。
translation: Suyao: Ziying, you'll be responsible for teaching these newly enrolled disciples. Among your peers, you're also outstanding, but you've never had experience instructing. You could consider this a form of training.

original_text: 慕容紫英：是，弟子定会尽心传授，不辱掌门之命！
translation: Murong Ziying: Yes, I will devote myself to teaching, not dishonoring the Sect Leader's command!

original_text: 夙瑶：好了，都下去吧。余下事便由紫英安排。
translation: Suyao: Enough, all of you may leave. Ziying will arrange the rest.

original_text: 韩菱纱：哈哈～紫英你是不是吓一跳？我们可是凭自己的实力入门的。
translation: Han Lingsha: Haha~ Ziying, were you surprised? We got in based on our own abilities.

original_text: 慕容紫英：……叫我“师叔”，不可无礼。
translation: Murong Ziying: ... Call me 'Martial Uncle', do not be disrespectful.

original_text: 云天河：那、师叔，你认不认识我爹？他叫云天青，以前也是这儿的人。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Then, Martial Uncle, do you know my father? His name is Yun Tianqing, he used to be from here too.

original_text: 慕容紫英：从未听过此人。
translation: Murong Ziying: Never heard of this person.

original_text: 慕容紫英：你们初入本门，理应专心修行，勿念其他杂事。稍后便去前山弟子房歇息，不要错过明日早课。
translation: Murong Ziying: As newcomers to our sect, you should focus on your cultivation and avoid other distractions. Later, go rest in the disciple quarters at the front mountain. Do not miss tomorrow's morning lesson.

original_text: 云天河：弟子房？……是哪里？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Disciple quarters? ...Where's that?

original_text: 慕容紫英：弟子房都在<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>前山剑舞坪</colour><dc0>旁边，你的房间是</dc0><colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>门口有石狮子的那一间</colour><dc0>。</dc0>
translation: Murong Ziying: The disciples' quarters are all<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> next to the Sword Dance Terrace on the front mountain</colour><dc0>. Your room is the one</dc0><colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> with stone lions at the entrance</colour><dc0>.</dc0>

original_text: 韩菱纱：……什么嘛，一副拽拽的样子，小～人～得～志！
translation: Han Lingsha: ... What's with that? Looking all cocky, a~ petty~ man~ gloating~!

original_text: 云天河：他不认识爹……那块玉的事只有问掌门了……
translation: Yun Tianhe: He didn't know Father... The matter of that jade, we can only ask the Sect Leader...

original_text: 韩菱纱：慢慢慢～我们才刚来，你可别随便乱问啊，好歹先待上一段时间，搞清楚状况再说，这里神神秘秘的，我到现在还是一头雾水。
translation: Han Lingsha: Slow down~ We just got here, don't go asking random questions. At least stay for a while, figure out the situation first. This place is so mysterious, I'm still completely in the dark.

original_text: 柳梦璃：不如先按师叔所说，<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>回房休息吧，</colour><dc0>有什么事明日再做打算也不迟。</dc0>
translation: Liu Mengli: Perhaps we should do as Martial Uncle suggested,<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> and return to our rooms to rest.</colour><dc0> Whatever needs doing can wait until tomorrow.</dc0>

original_text: 云天河：好～～
translation: Yun Tianhe: Good~~

original_text: 韩菱纱：我说，你们两个～别那么正经八百地喊他“师叔”好不好，一想到他那张冰块脸，年纪又和我们差不多，不觉得很奇怪吗？
translation: Han Lingsha: Hey, you two~ don't be so formal calling him Martial Uncle. When I think of his ice face and how he's about our age, doesn't it feel weird?

original_text: 柳梦璃：我……不太在意这个。
translation: Liu Mengli: I...I don't really mind that.

original_text: 云天河：我也没差。
translation: Yun Tianhe: It's no different for me.

original_text: 韩菱纱：…………算了，当我什么也没说。
translation: Han Lingsha: ...... Forget it, pretend I said nothing.

original_text: 云天河：（这房间真大……不习惯……床也硬梆梆的，不够软……）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (This room is so big... not used to it... bed is hard too, not soft enough...)

original_text: 云天河：（呵呵，爹也睡过这里吗？……我觉得，自己离爹好像又近了些，虽然以前住在一块儿，有时候却觉得爹离得好远……）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (Hehe, did Dad sleep here too?... I feel like I'm a bit closer to Dad now. Even though we lived together before, sometimes it felt like he was so far away...)

original_text: 云天河：（不知道啥时候才能学御剑？……呼～）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (Wonder when I can learn Sword Flight? ...Hoo~)

original_text: 云天河：（……唔？有杀气……）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (...Huh? There's killing intent...)

original_text: 慕容紫英：云天河，还不快快起床！
translation: Murong Ziying: Yun Tianhe, get out of bed this instant!

original_text: 云天河：紫……不对，师叔？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Zi... errrr, Martial Uncle?

original_text: 慕容紫英：懒散贪睡，不知进取！知不知道早课时辰已过？！
translation: Murong Ziying: Lazy and fond of sleeping, lacking ambition! Do you know morning class time has already passed?!

original_text: 云天河：啊？什么……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Huh? What...

original_text: 慕容紫英：念你初犯，暂不追究，半柱香内洗漱换衣，<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>到剑舞坪来</colour><dc0>！</dc0>
translation: Murong Ziying: Considering it's your first offense, I'll let it pass for now. Wash up and change within half an incense stick,<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> and come to Sword Dance Terrace</colour><dc0>!</dc0>

original_text: 云天河：我、我还没吃早饭……
translation: Yun Tianhe: I, I haven't had breakfast yet...

original_text: 慕容紫英：不必吃了，五谷都是浊气，一早就要沾染，你修为永远也无法精进！
translation: Murong Ziying: No need to eat. The five grains are impure qi; contaminating yourself early will prevent your cultivation from ever advancing!

original_text: 云天河：饭是浊气？那只能吃肉了？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Rice is impure qi? Then we can only eat meat?

original_text: 云天河：（换衣服？是说这个吧？……哈哈，看起来还挺不错的～）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (Change? He mean this? ...Haha, looks pretty good~)

original_text: 云天河：（终于学了御剑……却又开心不起来……）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (Finally learned Sword Flight... yet I can't feel happy...)

original_text: 云天河：（唉～要是爹在，肯定有法子把那个什么水林猪弄到手……）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (Sigh~ if Father were here, he'd definitely have a way to get that Water Spirit Pig...)

original_text: 云天河：啊？！发生什么事？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Huh?! What happened?

original_text: 韩菱纱：嘻嘻～这“鸣钟符”果然厉害，现在你是不是半点也不想睡了？
translation: Han Lingsha: Hehe~ This Bell-Ring Talisman is really powerful. Now you don't feel sleepy at all, do you?

original_text: 云天河：刚才……到底是什么东西？
translation: Yun Tianhe: What happened?... What is it?

original_text: 韩菱纱：这是琼华派的符咒之一，专门用来对付静思时打瞌睡的弟子，除了你本人，其他人是听不见的，我见有趣，就摸了几张来玩～
translation: Han Lingsha: This is one of Qionghua Sect's talismans, specifically for disciples who doze off during meditation. Only you can hear it; others can't. I found it amusing, so I swiped a few to play with~

original_text: 柳梦璃：先别说这个了。
translation: Liu Mengli: Let's not talk about this now.

original_text: 柳梦璃：快看看那把剑到底是怎么回事，我有点担心……
translation: Liu Mengli: Quickly check what's going on with that sword, I'm a bit worried...

original_text: 云天河：这剑怎么浮着？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Why is this sword floating?

original_text: 韩菱纱：问你啊。
translation: Han Lingsha: That should be the question we ask you.

original_text: 韩菱纱：我刚才觉得好累，不知不觉在房里睡着了，后来听到一阵奇怪的鸣声，叫了梦璃，一路寻过来，才发觉是这把剑……
translation: Han Lingsha: I felt so tired earlier, I fell asleep in the room without realizing. Later, I heard a strange humming sound, called Mengli, and followed it here, only to find it was this sword...

original_text: 柳梦璃：奇怪的是，我却半点声音都听不到。
translation: Liu Mengli: What's strange is, I can't hear any sound at all.

original_text: 云天河：好像……真的有声音……
translation: Yun Tianhe: It seems... there really is a sound...

original_text: 柳梦璃：我总觉得，这剑很不简单，会不会和云叔有关呢？
translation: Liu Mengli: I always feel this sword is extraordinary. Could it be related to Uncle Yun?

original_text: 云天河：我爹？
translation: Yun Tianhe: My Father?

original_text: 韩菱纱：梦璃，你为什么会这样想？
translation: Han Lingsha: Mengli, why do you think that way?

original_text: 柳梦璃：我……只是一种感觉，而且想想刚才那把剑浮在空中的样子，像不像指着某个方向呢？
translation: Liu Mengli: I... It's just a feeling. And think about how that sword was floating in the air just now-doesn't it seem like it was pointing in a certain direction?

original_text: 韩菱纱：那边……
translation: Han Lingsha: Over there...

original_text: 韩菱纱：是禁地的方向？！
translation: Han Lingsha: The direction of the forbidden area?!

original_text: 韩菱纱：我们，<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>要不要去禁地看看</colour><dc0>？</dc0>
translation: Han Lingsha: Should we <colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>go check out the forbidden area</colour><dc0>?</dc0>

original_text: 云天河：可以吗？万一师叔又生气……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Is that okay? What if Martial Uncle gets angry again...

original_text: 韩菱纱：怕什么～要是被发现，就装作在梦游好了。
translation: Han Lingsha: What's to fear~ If discovered, just pretend to be sleepwalking.

original_text: 云天河：啊？！话这样讲也行啊？三个人一起梦游？！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Huh?! You can put it that way? The three of us sleepwalking together?!

original_text: 柳梦璃：……还是多加小心为好，这门派似乎有许多隐秘之事……
translation: Liu Mengli: ... It's still best to be extra careful. This sect seems to have many hidden affairs...

original_text: 韩菱纱：嗯，我最喜欢探秘了～走吧、走吧。
translation: Han Lingsha: Mm, I love exploring hidden affairs the most~ Let's go, let's go.

original_text: 云天河：不晓得梦璃的身体好点没有？总觉得这一觉睡得不踏实……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Wonder if Mengli is feeling better? I feel like this sleep wasn't very restful...

original_text: 柳梦璃：咦？云公子好像大不一样了，看起来很精神呢。
translation: Liu Mengli: Huh? Yun seems quite different, looks very spirited.

original_text: 云天河：是吗？呵呵。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Really? Hehe.

original_text: 韩菱纱：唔，果然还是人靠衣装马靠鞍。
translation: Han Lingsha: Hmm, clothes really do make the man.

original_text: 云天河：梦、梦璃，你穿这样也很好看，像仙女一样。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Meng, Mengli, you look really good in this too, like a fairy.

original_text: 柳梦璃：真的吗？谢谢云公子的夸奖。
translation: Liu Mengli: Really? Thank you for the compliment, Yun.

original_text: 韩菱纱：……下山没多久，倒学得油嘴滑舌。
translation: Han Lingsha: ... Not long after leaving the mountain, you've learned to be slick-tongued.

original_text: 云天河：其实……菱纱也蛮漂亮的～
translation: Yun Tianhe: Actually... Lingsha is quite pretty too~

original_text: 韩菱纱：……看不出，你还知道左右逢源呢……
translation: Han Lingsha: ... Didn't expect you to know how to please both sides...

original_text: 慕容紫英：你们几个，言之无聊，成何体统！
translation: Murong Ziying: You all, such pointless talk, what kind of behavior is this!

original_text: 韩菱纱：干嘛摆出一副长辈的样子，说不定啊，你只是长得老成，其实年纪比我还小呢，对吧？小～紫～英～
translation: Han Lingsha: Why act all senior-like? Maybe you just look mature, but you're actually younger than me, right? Little~ Zi~ying~

original_text: 慕容紫英：……叫我“师叔”。
translation: Murong Ziying: ... Call me Martial Uncle.

original_text: 慕容紫英：还有不要拿别人名字开玩笑，很不礼貌。
translation: Murong Ziying: And don't joke about other people's names, it's very impolite.

original_text: 云天河：师叔，今天要练什么？会不会学御剑啊？我想学！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Martial Uncle, what are we practicing today? Will we learn Sword Flight? I want to learn!

original_text: 慕容紫英：我自有安排，等下便知。
translation: Murong Ziying: I have my own arrangements, you'll know soon.

original_text: 慕容紫英：你们几个既入琼华派，自当知晓门派中的一些规矩。
translation: Murong Ziying: Since you've joined Qionghua Sect, you should know some of the sect's rules.

original_text: 慕容紫英：本派前山乃是所有弟子清修之处。铸剑所用之“承天剑台”，位于五灵剑阁上方。后山思返谷为弟子思过之所。剑林则通往禁地，万万不可靠近！切记！
translation: Murong Ziying: The front mountain of our sect is where all disciples cultivate in tranquility. The 'Chengtian Sword Platform' used for sword forging is located above the Five Elements Sword Pavilion. The Reflection Valley in the rear mountain is where disciples reflect on their mistakes. The Sword Forest leads to the Forbidden Area-absolutely do not approach it! Remember!

original_text: 韩菱纱：对了，我以前听说过，蜀山仙剑派也是很有名的修仙门派，那除了蜀山、昆仑，是不是还有其他地方也有人修仙呢？
translation: Han Lingsha: By the way, I've heard before that the Shu Mountain Immortal Sword Sect is also a famous cultivation sect. Besides Shu Mountain and Kunlun, are there other places where people cultivate immortality?

original_text: 慕容紫英：……你所问之事，与你入门修行，似乎没有多大关系吧？
translation: Murong Ziying: ... What you're asking seems to have little to do with your entry into cultivation, doesn't it?

original_text: 韩菱纱：都是修仙，怎会没关系，做老师的不就是要替学生解惑？
translation: Han Lingsha: Both are about cultivating immortality, how could they be unrelated? Isn't a teacher supposed to answer students' questions?

original_text: 慕容紫英：…………
translation: Murong Ziying: ......

original_text: 韩菱纱：说嘛～
translation: Han Lingsha: Tell me~

original_text: 慕容紫英：…………若论到人间仙境，颇成气候的，还有十洲三岛、十大洞天、三十六小洞天、七十二福地，不过彼此之间也并非都有往来。
translation: Murong Ziying: ...... When it comes to earthly paradises, those with considerable presence also include the Ten Continents and Three Islands, the Ten Great Grotto-Heavens, the Thirty-Six Minor Grotto-Heavens, and the Seventy-Two Blessed Lands. However, not all of them have contact with each other.

original_text: 韩菱纱：哇！这么多修仙的地方，一定都藏得很隐秘吧？
translation: Han Lingsha: Wow! So many places for cultivating immortality, they must all be hidden very secretly, right?

original_text: 慕容紫英：那倒未必，有缘之人自然得见。
translation: Murong Ziying: Not necessarily, those destined will naturally see it.

original_text: 柳梦璃：嗯……掌门说过将有大事发生，请问到底是什么事呢？
translation: Liu Mengli: Mm... The Sect Leader said something big will happen. May I ask what exactly it is?

original_text: 慕容紫英：……你们可知，世间有妖界如星辰运行一般，有其既定的天轨？
translation: Murong Ziying: ... Do you know that in this world, there are Yao realms that move like stars, following their set celestial orbits?
Liu Mengli: ...!!

original_text: 韩菱纱：妖界？！
translation: Han Lingsha: Yao realms?!

original_text: 云天河：什么意思？是说所有的妖怪都住一起吗？
translation: Yun Tianhe: What do you mean? You mean all the yaoguais live together?

original_text: 慕容紫英：妖与人不同，彼此之间并不亲厚，多半单独隐匿于山林之中，只存有兽性冷血。他们一旦聚集群居，必是由十分强大且残暴的妖所统领，实力深不可测。
translation: Murong Ziying: Yaoguais are different from humans; they are not close to each other, mostly hiding alone in mountains and forests, retaining only beastly cold-bloodedness. Once they gather and live in groups, it must be led by a very powerful and cruel leader, with unfathomable strength.

original_text: 慕容紫英：分散多处的妖界极难察觉，只有在各处布下八卦灵阵，用以探查妖界所在。
translation: Murong Ziying: Yao realms scattered in many places are extremely hard to detect. Only by setting up Eight Trigrams Spirit Arrays in various locations can we investigate their whereabouts.

original_text: 慕容紫英：我琼华派处于昆仑山巅，本是天地间钟灵毓秀之所，却怎料此地也正是某个妖界运移之天轨，每隔十九年彼此最为接近。
translation: Murong Ziying: Our Qionghua Sect is situated atop the Kunlun Mountains, a place blessed by heaven and earth's spiritual essence. Yet, who would have thought this is also the celestial orbit where a certain yao realm moves, coming closest to us every nineteen years.

original_text: 柳梦璃：那……岂不是……
translation: Liu Mengli: Then... wouldn't that...

original_text: 慕容紫英：不错，十九年前，本派曾与妖界殊死相搏，我虽未亲身经历，但也耳闻状况是何等惨烈。
translation: Murong Ziying: Indeed, nineteen years ago, our sect fought a desperate battle with the yao realm. Although I didn't experience it personally, I've heard how tragic it was.

original_text: 慕容紫英：如今妖界又将降临，那些妖物比寻常精怪更为凶残，法力高深，若琼华派抵御不住，则人间危急，只怕要生灵涂炭……
translation: Murong Ziying: Now the yao realm is about to descend again. Those demons are more vicious than ordinary spirits, with profound magical power. If Qionghua Sect cannot withstand them, the mortal world will be in peril, and I fear it will lead to widespread suffering...

original_text: 慕容紫英：十九年前昆仑山巅一战，全派弟子死伤过半，前任掌门也不幸战死，甚至听说门派中还有叛徒出现。
translation: Murong Ziying: In the battle atop Kunlun Mountain nineteen years ago, over half of our sect's disciples perished or were injured. The former sect leader also fell in battle, and I even heard there were traitors within the sect.

original_text: 韩菱纱：啊？！这么惨……
translation: Han Lingsha: Huh?! So tragic...

original_text: 柳梦璃：那妖界又是怎样呢？
translation: Liu Mengli: And what of the yao realm?

original_text: 慕容紫英：双方两败俱伤。
translation: Murong Ziying: Both sides suffered heavy losses.

original_text: 柳梦璃：……这里竟然有过那样可怕的厮杀……
translation: Liu Mengli: ... Such a terrible battle actually happened here...

original_text: 韩菱纱：对啊，想想都觉得心里好不舒服……
translation: Han Lingsha: Yeah, just thinking about it makes me feel uncomfortable...

original_text: 云天河：还没发生的事，干嘛要去想？想了又不开心。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Things that haven't happened yet, why think about them? Thinking about them just makes you unhappy.

original_text: 慕容紫英：兹事体大，你们几个更应勤加修炼，不可懈怠。
translation: Murong Ziying: This matter is of great importance. You all should train diligently and not slack off.

original_text: 韩菱纱：和妖界打了这么久，我们到底算赢还是输啊？
translation: Han Lingsha: After fighting the yao realm for so long, did we win or lose in the end?

original_text: 慕容紫英：这并非比武争胜，何来输赢之说？何况琼华派只管一力抵挡，稍有不慎，整个门派与山下百姓都将惨遭横祸，又如何输得起？
translation: Murong Ziying: This is not a contest of martial prowess; there is no winning or losing. Moreover, Qionghua Sect is solely focused on defense. The slightest misstep could bring catastrophe upon the entire sect and the people below the mountain. How can we afford to lose?

original_text: 韩菱纱：（瞧他忧心忡忡的样子，十九年前连掌门都战死了，其实就是输了嘛……）
translation: Han Lingsha: (Seeing him so worried... Nineteen years ago, even the Sect Leader died in battle-basically, they lost...)

original_text: 柳梦璃：……听说昆仑山上还有其他的修仙门派，是不是也会同仇敌忾呢？
translation: Liu Mengli: ... I heard there are other immortal cultivation sects on Kunlun Mountain. Will they also share a common hatred against the enemy?

original_text: 慕容紫英：……与妖界抗衡，有性命之危，其他七派处事各有不同，并非都是除魔卫道之士， 与本派也并无同心。
translation: Murong Ziying: ... Resisting the yao realm carries the risk of death. The other seven sects each have their own ways of handling affairs; not all are champions of righteousness who vanquish fiends. They are not of one heart with our sect.

original_text: 韩菱纱：这么惨呐？就是说即使打不过，也不用指望援兵了？
translation: Han Lingsha: That bad? So even if we can't win, we can't expect reinforcements?

original_text: 慕容紫英：不必过早担忧，你们修为尚浅，若不得已与妖界短兵相接，当以保护自身性命为先。
translation: Murong Ziying: No need to worry prematurely. Your cultivation is still shallow. If you are forced into close combat with the yao realm, prioritize protecting your own lives.

original_text: 韩菱纱：性命为先……那你呢？难道就要不顾一切冲上去？
translation: Han Lingsha: Protecting our own lives... Then what about you? Will you just charge in recklessly?

original_text: 慕容紫英：……
translation: Murong Ziying: ...

original_text: 慕容紫英：若有所需，自是不计生死。
translation: Murong Ziying: If there is a need, naturally I would not hesitate to risk my life.

original_text: 云天河：干嘛要说这种死来死去的话？妖怪打过来，尽力打败他们就是了，我才不信会输！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Why talk about risking lives and such? If yaoguais attack, just do our best to defeat them. I don't believe we'll lose!

original_text: 慕容紫英：不错，正要有此气魄！
translation: Murong Ziying: Good, exactly the spirit needed!

original_text: 慕容紫英：你们才刚入门，其实今日本不必跟你们说这些门派旧事，但十九年时限已至，危机迫近，若是觉得心中害怕，可以立即下山去，也不是什么丢脸的事。
translation: Murong Ziying: You've only just joined the sect. Actually, I didn't need to tell you these old sect matters today, but the nineteen-year deadline has arrived, and the crisis is imminent. If you feel afraid, you may leave the mountain immediately-it's nothing to be ashamed of.

original_text: 云天河：没感到杀气就不危险。来都来了，也不用想太多吧？以后危险就以后再下山好了。
translation: Yun Tianhe: If I don't sense killing intent, it's not dangerous. Since we're already here, no need to overthink it. If danger comes later, we'll just go down the mountain then.

original_text: 慕容紫英：你——！
translation: Murong Ziying: You-!

original_text: 柳梦璃：师叔别介意，云公子他没别的意思，他说话一向就是……
translation: Liu Mengli: Martial Uncle, don't mind him. Yun doesn't mean anything else, he always speaks like...

original_text: 韩菱纱：嘿嘿，就是呆头呆脑、胡说八道。
translation: Han Lingsha: Hehe, like dim-witted and talking nonsense.

original_text: 云天河：我……
translation: Yun Tianhe: I...

original_text: 慕容紫英：哼！不必多言。
translation: Murong Ziying: Hmph! No need for more words.

original_text: 慕容紫英：接下来我便教授你们本派的入门心法，须知，琼华以剑为苍冥间浩然正气，习剑者明是非、遵礼仪，即便手中无剑，心中也要存有慧剑——
translation: Murong Ziying: Next, I will teach you our sect's introductory method. You must know this: Qionghua regards the sword as the righteous energy between heaven and earth. Those who practice the sword must understand right and wrong, uphold propriety. Even without a sword in hand, one must hold a sword of wisdom in the heart-

original_text: 慕容紫英：可都清楚了？
translation: Murong Ziying: Is everything clear now?

original_text: 云天河：每个字分开来都明白，可是放在一起就……好像有懂，又好像没懂……
translation: Yun Tianhe: I understand each word separately, but when put together... it's like I get it, yet I don't...

original_text: 韩菱纱：笨～紫英刚才说的，不就有你最想学的御剑吗？
translation: Han Lingsha: Silly~ Didn't Ziying just mention the Sword Flight technique you've been wanting to learn?

original_text: 慕容紫英：本派弟子以习剑居多，修炼其他兵器亦可，御剑之道“在于心而不在于形”。
translation: Murong Ziying: Most disciples in our sect focus on swordsmanship, but other weapons are also practiced. The way of Sword Flight lies 'in the heart, not the form'.

original_text: 柳梦璃：在于心……而不在于形……
translation: Liu Mengli: It lies in the heart... not the form...

original_text: 慕容紫英：你们几个才刚入门，进境不会太快，先在此练习，把口诀融会贯通。
translation: Murong Ziying: You have just begun; progress won't be too fast. Practice here first, and fully comprehend the incantations.

original_text: 慕容紫英：我有事待办，最多两个时辰便会回来。
translation: Murong Ziying: I have matters to attend to; I'll return within four hours at most.

original_text: 韩菱纱：不是吧？这冰块脸说要教人，自己却又跑了……
translation: Han Lingsha: Seriously? That ice-face said he'd teach us, then he just runs off...

original_text: 韩菱纱：不很难嘛～我好像已经能飞了耶。
translation: Han Lingsha: Not too hard~ I think I can already fly, yeah.

original_text: 韩菱纱：梦璃，你呢？
translation: Han Lingsha: Mengli, how about you?

original_text: 柳梦璃：嗯，我也是。
translation: Liu Mengli: Mm, me too.

original_text: 韩菱纱：天河，你还是弄不明白？
translation: Han Lingsha: Tianhe, you still don't get it?

original_text: 韩菱纱：咦？
translation: Han Lingsha: Huh?

original_text: 云天河：哈哈～真好玩，我在上面绕了几圈，看你和梦璃都变好小！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Haha~ So fun, I circled above a few times, you and Mengli looked so tiny!

original_text: 韩菱纱：奇怪……你一会儿说听不懂？一会儿又学得飞快？
translation: Han Lingsha: Strange... You said you didn't understand a moment ago, then learn incredibly fast now?

original_text: 云天河：我、我也不知怎么回事，在脑子里想着想着就突然飞起来了。
translation: Yun Tianhe: I, I don't know what happened either, I was just thinking about it in my head and suddenly flew up.

original_text: 云天河：不过爹留下来的这把剑真厉害，我算算～可以打猎、剥皮、切肉、把肉串起来烤，现在我还能站在上面御剑了！
translation: Yun Tianhe: But this sword my Father left behind is really amazing. Let me think-it can hunt, skin, cut meat, skewer meat for roasting, and now I can even stand on it and ride it through the skies!

original_text: 柳梦璃：云公子你真有趣，这把剑竟有这么多的妙用。
translation: Liu Mengli: Yun, you're so amusing. This sword actually has so many ingenious uses.

original_text: 云天河：嗯，这就是梦璃你教过我的“能者多劳”吧～
translation: Yun Tianhe: Hmm, this must be the 'the capable should do more work' you taught me, Mengli~

original_text: 柳梦璃：噗……
translation: Liu Mengli: Pfft...

original_text: 韩菱纱：（傻瓜，什么能者多劳……用来烤肉又用脚踩，恶心……）
translation: Han Lingsha: (Fool, what 'the capable do more work'... using it to roast meat and stepping on it with your feet, disgusting...)

original_text: 韩菱纱：……我说啊，也只有你这么活宝，把剑用成这样，亏掌门还讲这是厉害的神兵呢。
translation: Han Lingsha: ... I say, only someone as eccentric as you would use a sword like this. Hard to believe the Sect Leader said this was a powerful divine weapon.

original_text: 云天河：呵呵，东西不就是拿来用的。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Hehe, things are meant to be used.

original_text: 韩菱纱：这下可好，我们三个都会御剑了，不如飞去山下玩玩？
translation: Han Lingsha: Great! Now all three of us can perform Sword Flight. How about we fly down to the foot of the mountain for some fun?

original_text: 云天河：好啊好啊，上回是被怀朔带着，一点都不过瘾。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Great, great! Last time Huaishuo took us, it wasn't exciting at all.

original_text: 柳梦璃：……
translation: Liu Mengli: ...

original_text: 韩菱纱：梦璃，你怎么了？脸色怪怪的。
translation: Han Lingsha: Mengli, what's wrong? You look strange.

original_text: 柳梦璃：我……我还想着妖界的事，不过云公子说得对，没发生的，多想也没用，是我自己太放不开了……
translation: Liu Mengli: I... I'm still thinking about the yao realm, but Yun is right-what hasn't happened, overthinking is useless. I'm just too caught up in it myself...

original_text: 韩菱纱：别想啦，难得学会御剑，今天就把烦恼都抛开，开开心心地玩一场！
translation: Han Lingsha: Don't think about it! We've finally learned Sword Flight. Today, let's forget our worries and have a happy time!

original_text: 柳梦璃：嗯！
translation: Liu Mengli: Mm!

original_text: 韩菱纱：反正我们在这待些日子，一来帮天河打探打探他爹的事，二来那个拽拽的紫英也帮过我们，如果妖界打过来，我们帮帮他算是还人情。
translation: Han Lingsha: Anyway, we'll stay here for a while. First, to help Tianhe inquire about his father's affairs. Second, that aloof Ziying helped us. If the yao realm attacks, helping him would be repaying the favor.

original_text: 云天河：对，滴水之恩必当涌泉以报！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Yes, a drop of kindness must be repaid with a spring!

original_text: 韩菱纱：我说……梦璃才教你一点东西，你就在那边显摆什么呀？
translation: Han Lingsha: I mean... Mengli just taught you a little something, and you're already showing off over there?

original_text: 云天河：呵呵，我只是想说说看对不对。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Hehe, I just wanted to see if I said it right.

original_text: 韩菱纱：哎，别多说了，趁紫英还没回来，<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>快下山去吧！</colour>
translation: Han Lingsha: Hey, no more talk. While Ziying hasn't returned yet,<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> let's hurry down the mountain!</colour>

original_text: 明尘：各位师弟师妹，请留步！
translation: Mingchen: Fellow disciples, please wait!

original_text: 韩菱纱：咦，今天就你一个人啊？又要留步？难道这里不许人随便进，也不许人随便出去吗？
translation: Han Lingsha: Huh, just you alone today? Stopping us again? Does this place forbid entering or leaving freely?

original_text: 明尘：师妹有所不知，你们刚刚入门，资历尚浅，若要下山，须得奉了师长之命——
translation: Mingchen: Martial Sister, you don't know. You've just entered the sect and have little seniority. To go down the mountain, you must receive orders from a master-

original_text: 韩菱纱：那就没问题了，正是紫英～师～叔让我们去山下办事呢。
translation: Han Lingsha: Then there's no problem. It was Martial~Uncle~Ziying who sent us down the mountain on business.

original_text: 明尘：咦？师叔他……
translation: Mingchen: Huh? Martial Uncle, he...

original_text: 明尘：如此多有冒犯了，师弟师妹请多加小心。
translation: Mingchen: My apologies for the intrusion, Martial Siblings, please be careful.

original_text: 明尘：……紫英师叔行事当真不拘一格，竟会差入门才一天的弟子下山办事……
translation: Mingchen: ...Martial Uncle Ziying truly acts unconventionally, actually sending disciples who just joined yesterday down the mountain on business...

original_text: 韩菱纱：想不到这里规矩这么多，幸好我急中生智～
translation: Han Lingsha: Never thought there'd be so many rules here, good thing I thought fast~

original_text: 柳梦璃：我们私自下山已经有违门规，刚刚还说是师叔之命，我担心……
translation: Liu Mengli: Leaving the mountain privately already violates sect rules, and we just claimed it was on Martial Uncle's orders. I'm worried...

original_text: 韩菱纱：不用担心啦，先玩再说！
translation: Han Lingsha: Don't worry, let's have fun first!

original_text: 柳梦璃：可是……
translation: Liu Mengli: But...

original_text: 云天河：梦璃，一起走嘛，少了你就玩得不开心了……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Mengli, come with us, it won't be fun without you...

original_text: 柳梦璃：嗯……云公子，梦璃知道了……
translation: Liu Mengli: Yun, Mengli understands...

original_text: 云天河：哈哈，快走吧！最好飞去附近山里，好久没打猎，我手都痒了！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Haha, let's go quickly! Best to fly to the nearby mountains. It's been so long since I hunted, my hands are itching!

original_text: 韩菱纱：谁信，只怕不是手痒，是肚子里的馋虫在闹～
translation: Han Lingsha: Who believes that? I bet it's not your hands itching, but the greedy worm in your stomach~

original_text: 柳梦璃：从陈州来时，我见<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>播仙镇东南烟尘无尽</colour><dc0>，似乎十分广阔，不如我们就去那里看看？</dc0>
translation: Liu Mengli: When we came from Chenzhou, I saw<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> endless dust and haze to the southeast of Boxian Town</colour><dc0>. It seemed very vast. Why don't we go take a look there?</dc0>

original_text: 韩菱纱：好啊，就这么定了！
translation: Han Lingsha: Great, it's settled!

original_text: 云天河：<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>剑舞坪</colour><dc0>应该是</dc0><colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>一出房间的那个平台</colour><dc0>吧？不是这个方向……</dc0>
translation: Yun Tianhe:<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> Sword Dance Terrace</colour><dc0> should be</dc0><colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> that platform right outside the room</colour><dc0>, right? Not this way...</dc0>

original_text: 慕容紫英：掌门，弟子冒昧，有要事求见！
translation: Murong Ziying: Sect Leader, this disciple is presumptuous, I have urgent matters to request an audience!

original_text: 慕容紫英：你们随我来。
translation: Murong Ziying: Follow me.

original_text: 云天河：掌门说过让我们进去了吗？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Did the Sect Leader say we could go in?

original_text: 韩菱纱：你又知道她没说过？说不定她是用传音入密告诉紫英的～
translation: Han Lingsha: How do you know she didn't say it? Maybe she told Ziying through a secret voice transmission~

original_text: 云天河：传音……入……密？啥玩意？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Voice trans... what? What's that?

original_text: 韩菱纱：是种很高深的功夫，简单来说～譬如我们两个互相讲话，就只有彼此听得到。
translation: Han Lingsha: It's a very profound skill. Simply put~ like when we two talk, only we can hear each other.

original_text: 云天河：这个好玩～能用来说悄悄话。
translation: Yun Tianhe: This is fun~ Can use it to whisper.

original_text: 慕容紫英：还不速速进来，门外喧哗，成何体统！
translation: Murong Ziying: Come inside at once! Such commotion outside is utterly improper!

original_text: 夙瑶：紫英，你要说的便是此事？
translation: Suyao: Ziying, is this what you wanted to say?

original_text: 慕容紫英：是！弟子恳求掌门，若能以水灵珠施法，则解月牙村之旱并非难事。
translation: Murong Ziying: Yes! This disciple implores the sect leader: if the Water Spirit Pearl can be used in the spell, relieving the drought in Crescent Village is not difficult.

original_text: 夙瑶：此事我不允。
translation: Suyao: I do not permit this.

original_text: 慕容紫英：掌门？！
translation: Murong Ziying: Sect Leader?!

original_text: 夙瑶：水灵珠乃本派宝物，非同一般，岂能做出这等“出借”之举？何况妖界即将来袭，这种时候本就不该节外生枝。
translation: Suyao: The Water Spirit Pearl is a treasure of our sect, no ordinary treasure, how can we engage in such 'lending'? Moreover, the yao realm is about to attack; this is not the time for unnecessary complications.

original_text: 慕容紫英：可是……那些村民有此一难，弟子……弟子也想不到其他办法可以帮他们……
translation: Murong Ziying: But... those villagers face this calamity, and I... I can't think of any other way to help them...

original_text: 夙瑶：紫英，你要知道，世间困顿比比皆是，我等修仙得道，扶危济困自是应当，却又如何管尽天下事？
translation: Suyao: Ziying, you must understand, worldly troubles are everywhere. We who cultivate immortality should help those in distress, but how can we manage all the world's affairs?

original_text: 慕容紫英：掌门……
translation: Murong Ziying: Sect Leader...

original_text: 夙瑶：我意已决，此事休要再提！
translation: Suyao: My mind is made up, do not bring this up again!

original_text: 慕容紫英：……是。
translation: Murong Ziying: ... Yes.

original_text: 夙瑶：我且问你，云天河三人初入本门，岂可私自下山？
translation: Suyao: Let me ask you, Yun Tianhe and the other two have just joined our sect, how could they leave the mountain without permission?

original_text: 慕容紫英：是弟子管教无方！
translation: Murong Ziying: It is this disciple's failure in discipline!

original_text: 云天河：不关师叔的事，是我们——
translation: Yun Tianhe: It's not Martial Uncle's fault, it's us-

original_text: 夙瑶：大胆！我只问紫英，何时问及他人了？
translation: Suyao: How dare you! I only asked Ziying, when did I ask you?

original_text: 夙瑶：紫英，念你与他们三人都是初犯，本次便不再追究，若有再犯，定不饶恕！
translation: Suyao: Ziying, considering this is the first offense for you and the other three, I will let it pass this time. If it happens again, there will be no mercy!

original_text: 慕容紫英：是，多谢掌门！
translation: Murong Ziying: Yes, thank you, Sect Leader!

original_text: 夙瑶：……除了紫英，其他人都退下吧！
translation: Suyao: Everyone except Ziying may leave!

original_text: 云天河：可是掌门……那个水林猪……
translation: Yun Tianhe: But Sect Leader... that Water Spirit Pig...

original_text: 夙瑶：嗯？
translation: Suyao: Hmm?

original_text: 慕容紫英：出去。
translation: Murong Ziying: Get out.

original_text: 柳梦璃：云公子……
translation: Liu Mengli: Yun...

original_text: 云天河：好……知道了。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Okay... Understood.

original_text: 夙瑶：紫英，你觉得他们三人资质如何？
translation: Suyao: Ziying, what do you think of their three aptitudes?

original_text: 慕容紫英：他们三人入门之前都曾略涉仙术，触类旁通，对御剑之术与基本心法领悟极快，以此看来，资质都在中上。
translation: Murong Ziying: Before joining the sect, all three of them had some exposure to immortal arts. Building on that, they grasped sword control and basic mental cultivation techniques very quickly. Judging by this, their aptitudes are above average.

original_text: 慕容紫英：只是那个云天河……看似驽钝，却是深浅不明。
translation: Murong Ziying: But that Yun Tianhe... seems dull, yet his depths are unclear.

original_text: 夙瑶：哦？此话怎讲？
translation: Suyao: Oh? What do you mean?

original_text: 慕容紫英：……古人云，剑术如琴曲、如心念、如川流、如天地，可随万物而生，故修习剑术亦要顺应四时、吞饮日月，此间之功，非朝夕可成。
translation: Murong Ziying: ... The ancients said, swordplay is like a qin melody, like thoughts, like flowing rivers, like heaven and earth-it can arise with all things. Thus, practicing swordplay must follow the seasons and absorb the sun and moon. This skill cannot be achieved over a short period.

original_text: 慕容紫英：云天河虽不懂高深剑术，但是行止间内息清沛，气韵自敛，举手投足分外自如，似乎是多年静心修行方可达到的境界，令弟子也大为不解。
translation: Murong Ziying: Although Yun Tianhe does not understand advanced sword techniques, his movements show clear and abundant inner energy, with a naturally restrained aura. His every gesture is remarkably free and natural, as if achieved through years of serene cultivation-this puzzles even me.

original_text: 夙瑶：……如此说来，假以时日，他修为突飞猛进，甚至更胜于你，也不是不可能了？
translation: Suyao: ... So you're saying, given time, it's not impossible for his cultivation to advance by leaps and bounds, even surpassing yours?

original_text: 慕容紫英：……弟子不知，且弟子识见难及掌门一二，适才所言也都是些浅见……
translation: Murong Ziying: ... This disciple does not know, and my insight cannot match even a fraction of the Sect Leader's. What I said earlier were merely shallow views...

original_text: 夙瑶：无妨，还有什么想法，你便一并说了吧，我想听听。
translation: Suyao: No matter, if you have any other thoughts, just say them all, I want to hear.

original_text: 慕容紫英：就弟子所知，本门铸剑秘术之精，放眼凡间，几乎无人能够相较，但是云天河随身所携那把细长佩剑，铸造技艺之绝，令弟子大感汗颜。
translation: Murong Ziying: As far as I know, the refinement of our sect's sword-forging secret techniques is almost unmatched in the mortal world. However, the craftsmanship of the slender sword that Yun Tianhe carries with him is so exceptional that it makes me deeply ashamed.

original_text: 慕容紫英：弟子虽未细看，但那把剑的质地绝非乌金或玄铁，要做到如此寒光剔透、冰冷渗骨，而又不伤及手握之人，至少须取得东海海底的沦波净石、天山冰池下的寒珞玉魄，再辅以西北大荒中的上古冥灵木，揉合炼化，而这几样东西，莫说是一人之力如何得到，即便是穷千万人之力，亦是可遇而不可求。
translation: Murong Ziying: Although I did not examine it closely, the material of that sword is definitely not black gold or dark iron. To achieve such a cold, gleaming, bone-chilling transparency without harming the wielder's hand, one would need at least the Pure Wave Stone from the depths of the East Sea, the Cold Jade Soul from beneath the Tianshan Ice Pool, and the Ancient Netherwood from the Great Wastes of the northwest, fused and refined together. These materials are not only beyond the reach of a single person, but even with the efforts of millions, they are a matter of fortune, not mere seeking.

original_text: 慕容紫英：何况剑身看来纤细，想必也是固若玄冰，这却是用了传说中的“百炼之法”，定要反复锻冶，无一次差错！弟子实难想像，那位铸剑之人是何等的神乎奇技……
translation: Murong Ziying: Moreover, the sword appears slender yet must be as solid as profound ice. This uses the legendary 'Hundred Refinements Method', requiring repeated forging without a single error! I can hardly imagine the divine skill of that swordsmith...

original_text: 夙瑶：……
translation: Suyao: ...

original_text: 慕容紫英：云天河既能拥有这样一把不世出的宝剑，又能驾驭于它，此人应是大有来历……
translation: Murong Ziying: That Yun Tianhe can possess such a rare, peerless sword and wield it... this person must have significant origins...

original_text: 夙瑶：……你猜的不错，那把剑确实非同寻常，只不过……
translation: Suyao: ... You guessed correctly, that sword is indeed extraordinary, only...

original_text: 慕容紫英：掌门……莫非知晓剑的出处？可否示下，若有机缘，弟子实在很想拜访一下那位铸剑高人！
translation: Murong Ziying: Sect Leader... Do you perhaps know the sword's origin? Could you enlighten me? If there's a chance, I truly wish to visit that master swordsmith!

original_text: 夙瑶：据我所知，他早已过世，云天河对此剑来历亦是一无所知。
translation: Suyao: As far as I know, he passed long ago. Yun Tianhe also knows nothing of this sword's origins.

original_text: 夙瑶：……你须谨记，只教授他们三人简单的练气吐纳，其他高深剑术不必涉及，谈及本派秘事，更要谨慎出口。
translation: Suyao: ... Remember: only teach those three basic breathing and energy cultivation techniques. Do not involve them in advanced swordsmanship, and be especially cautious when discussing our sect's secrets.

original_text: 慕容紫英：……掌门，弟子不明……
translation: Murong Ziying: ... Sect Leader, this disciple does not understand...

original_text: 夙瑶：其余不必多问，我令他们入门，乃是另有机缘，日后你自会晓得。
translation: Suyao: No need to ask further. I let them join the sect for other reasons. You'll understand in time.

original_text: 夙瑶：其他无事，退下吧。
translation: Suyao: If nothing else, you may leave.

original_text: 夙瑶：莫非还有其他事想要禀报？
translation: Suyao: Is there something else you wish to report?

original_text: 慕容紫英：掌门，弟子斗胆一问，水灵珠之事是否还有商榷余地？
translation: Murong Ziying: Sect Leader, this disciple dares to ask: is there any room for discussion regarding the Water Spirit Pearl?

original_text: 夙瑶：哦？这么说来，我适才的决定，你却是口服心不服？
translation: Suyao: Oh? So it seems you accept my decision verbally but not in your heart?

original_text: 慕容紫英：弟子不敢。
translation: Murong Ziying: This disciple dares not.

original_text: 慕容紫英：弟子只觉修仙之士虽非样样皆能，但毕竟能救一人便是一人，弟子实在不忍看那些村民如此受苦……
translation: Murong Ziying: I only feel that while cultivators cannot do everything, saving even one person is worthwhile. I truly cannot bear to see the villagers suffer like this...

original_text: 夙瑶：慕容紫英！
translation: Suyao: Murong Ziying!

original_text: 慕容紫英：弟子在！
translation: Murong Ziying: Your disciple is here!

original_text: 夙瑶：你可还记得昔日在宗炼长老面前，曾立下怎样的重誓？
translation: Suyao: Do you remember what solemn vow you made before Elder Zonglian in the past?

original_text: 慕容紫英：弟子一日不敢或忘，弟子曾发誓，终身以修仙积德、捍卫天下为己任，对本门更不可有叛逆之心！若有相违，则要受五雷轰顶、神魂俱灭之祸！
translation: Murong Ziying: This disciple dares not forget for a single day. This disciple once swore to dedicate my life to cultivating immortality, accumulating virtue, and defending the world as my duty. I must never harbor rebellious thoughts toward our sect! If I violate this, may I be struck by five thunders and have my soul utterly destroyed!

original_text: 夙瑶：你师父被妖孽所害，早早亡故，宗炼长老虽名义上是你师公，实则待你如徒儿一般，连自己的铸剑秘术都倾囊相授，便是希望有朝一日你能成为本派栋梁，但你今日表现太令我失望了！
translation: Suyao: Your master was killed by evil creatures, passing early. Elder Zonglian, though nominally your grandmaster, treated you like his own disciple, even imparting all his secret sword-forging techniques, hoping you would one day become a pillar of our sect. But your performance today has deeply disappointed me!

original_text: 慕容紫英：弟子惭愧！
translation: Murong Ziying: This disciple is ashamed!

original_text: 夙瑶：你口说惭愧，心中却不知为何惭愧！
translation: Suyao: You speak of ashamed, yet in your heart you know not why you should feel shame!

original_text: 夙瑶：这世上苦痛之人千千万万，你一日救得一个，数十年下来虽有小成，又怎比得上修成仙身、法力无边之时，倾刻便能解救千百？
translation: Suyao: There are countless suffering people in this world. If you save one a day, after decades you may achieve little. How can that compare to cultivating an immortal body with boundless power, saving thousands in an instant?

original_text: 慕容紫英：……掌门说得是，只是……弟子想到那些村民的痛苦，却是半刻也平静不下来，这种心绪纷乱，弟子不知如何是好……
translation: Murong Ziying: ... Sect leader is right, but... when I think of the suffering of those villagers, I can't calm down for even a moment. I don't know what to do with this turmoil in my heart...

original_text: 夙瑶：你若不知如何是好，便想想十九年前，本门与妖界一战，多少弟子就此埋骨，连前代掌门都未能幸免，你师公宗炼长老亦是身受重创，至死不治……
translation: Suyao: If you don't know what to do, think back to nineteen years ago, during the battle between our sect and the yao realm. How many disciples were buried there? Even the previous sect leader did not escape, and your grandmaster, Elder Zonglian, was also severely wounded, ultimately dying from his injuries...

original_text: 夙瑶：这一回，如有危急，水灵珠蕴涵的法力说不定会成为我们抵挡妖界之助，你刻下的举动，只顾眼前，因小失大，届时我方势弱，昆仑山脚下生灵涂炭，远胜月牙村之灾！
translation: Suyao: This time, if danger arises, the power contained within the Water Spirit Pearl may aid us in resisting the yao realm. Your current actions, focusing only on the immediate, risk great loss for small gain. Should our side weaken, the devastation at the foot of Kunlun Mountain would far surpass the disaster of Crescent Village!

original_text: 慕容紫英：这！弟子太过短视……
translation: Murong Ziying: This! This disciple was too short-sighted...

original_text: 夙瑶：紫英，你以前从不会这样，莫非短短时间，便沾染了云天河那几人的浮躁？
translation: Suyao: Ziying, you were never like this before. Could it be that in such a short time, you've been tainted by the impetuousness of Yun Tianhe and the others?

original_text: 慕容紫英：……！！
translation: Murong Ziying: ...!!

original_text: 夙瑶：也罢，今日我言尽于此，能领悟多少，看你自己的造化了。
translation: Suyao: Very well, I've said all I will today. How much you comprehend depends on your own fortune.

original_text: 夙瑶：退下吧。
translation: Suyao: You may leave.

original_text: 云天河：怎么办？掌门不肯借那个宝物……
translation: Yun Tianhe: What to do? The Sect Leader won't lend that treasure...

original_text: 柳梦璃：我看她心意坚决，怕是很难改变主意了。
translation: Liu Mengli: I see her resolve is firm; I'm afraid it will be hard to change her mind.

original_text: 云天河：爹说过，做人不能太小气……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Father said, one shouldn't be too stingy...

original_text: 云天河：又不是借了就不还她，也不知那只“水林猪”多贵重，大不了拿我们的“土林猪”跟她换，听起来都差不多。
translation: Yun Tianhe: It's not like we're borrowing it and not returning it. Who knows how valuable that 'Water Spirit Pig' is? At worst, we can trade it with our 'Earth Spirit Pig'; they sound about the same.

original_text: 韩菱纱：差很多好不好……
translation: Han Lingsha: It's very different, okay?...

original_text: 韩菱纱：唉，怎么又觉得好累……算了，<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>我们先各自回房吧，</colour><dc0>想想还有没有其他办法，不行的话，晚上再偷溜出去，给月牙村的人送些水和吃的～</dc0>
translation: Han Lingsha: Ugh, feeling tired again... Anyway, let's each return to our rooms first and think of other options. If nothing works, we can sneak out tonight to deliver water and food to Crescent Village.

original_text: 柳梦璃：嗯，也只能先这样了。
translation: Liu Mengli: Hmm, I suppose that's the only option for now.

original_text: 韩菱纱：别管他，他这人小孩子脾气，过一会儿就好了。
translation: Han Lingsha: Don't mind him, he's just being childish; he'll get over it in a moment.

original_text: 韩菱纱：一边冷死、一边热死，这究竟是什么怪地方啊……幸好里面没镇着可怕的妖怪。
translation: Han Lingsha: Freezing on one side, boiling on the other, what kind of weird place is this... Luckily there aren't any terrifying monsters sealed inside.

original_text: 云天河：这里～和爹的墓室有点像……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Here~ it's a bit like father's tomb chamber...

original_text: 柳梦璃：你们，快看！
translation: Liu Mengli: Look, everyone!

original_text: 韩菱纱：冰……冰里有什么……
translation: Han Lingsha: Ice... what's in the ice...

original_text: 柳梦璃：云公子，小心点……
translation: Liu Mengli: Yun, be careful...

original_text: 云天河：咦？那把剑……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Huh? That sword...

original_text: 云天河：……这个人又是谁？怎么会在冰里？
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... Who is this person? Why is he in the ice?

original_text: ？？：此话应是由我来问，你们不知擅闯琼华禁地乃是重罪？
translation: ??: I should be asking you, don't you know trespassing into Qionghua's Forbidden Area is a serious crime?

original_text: 韩菱纱：呀！尸体、尸体还会说话！
translation: Han Lingsha: Ah! The corpse... the corpse can talk!

original_text: 柳梦璃：这个人还活着，和我们说话的正是他的生灵，只不过气息很弱……
translation: Liu Mengli: This person is still alive. What's speaking to us is his living spirit, but the aura is very weak...

original_text: ？？：……少年人，你，能否靠近一些？
translation: ???: ...Young man, can you come closer?

original_text: 云天河：我吗？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Me?

original_text: ？？：……你的长相，果真……你，可认识一个叫云天青的人？
translation: ??: ...Your appearance, truly... Do you know someone named Yun Tianqing?

original_text: 云天河：……他是我爹啊。
translation: Yun Tianhe: ..., he's my father.

original_text: ？？：你……你叫什么名字？
translation: ??: You... what's your name?

original_text: 云天河：名字？我叫云天河。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Name? I'm Yun Tianhe.
??: ...Tian...he...the Milky Way... your name is born of the Milky Way...

original_text: ？？：你娘是不是叫夙玉？
translation: ???: Is your mother named Suyu?

original_text: 云天河：对啊。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Right.

original_text: 云天河：到处都有人认识我爹，这次头一回有人问起我娘呢，娘也是琼华派的人吗？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Everyone seems to know my Father. This is the first time someone asked about my Mother. Was my mother also from Qionghua Sect?

original_text: 云天河：你又是谁啊？怎会认识我爹娘？
translation: Yun Tianhe: And who are you? How do you know my Father and Mother?

original_text: ？？：……吾名玄霄，乃是你爹和你娘的师兄。
translation: ???: ...I am Xuanxiao, your Father and Mother's Martial Brother.

original_text: 玄霄：而你身上所携之剑名为“望舒”，与冰中的“羲和”正是一阴一阳的配剑，以日月之神为名，原本都归本派所有。
translation: Xuanxiao: And the sword you carry is named 'Wangshu', which pairs with 'Xihe' within the ice as yin and yang counterparts. Named after the sun and moon deities, they originally both belonged to our sect.

original_text: 云天河：“望舒”……“羲和” ……
translation: Yun Tianhe: 'Wangshu'... 'Xihe' ...

original_text: 慕容紫英：（云天河！半夜不在房中，跑去哪里胡闹！）
translation: Murong Ziying: (Yun Tianhe! Not in your room in the middle of the night, where have you been fooling around!)

original_text: 慕容紫英：（……守夜弟子也说无人御剑离去……）
translation: Murong Ziying: (...The night watch disciples also said no one left by Sword Flight...)

original_text: 慕容紫英：（莫非是………………）
translation: Murong Ziying: (Could it be..................)

original_text: 慕容紫英：（禁地？！）
translation: Murong Ziying: (Forbidden Area?!)

original_text: 慕容紫英：（……以他们的放肆，闯去那里自然也不稀奇，真是太过胡来！）
translation: Murong Ziying: (...Given their recklessness, it's no surprise they barged in there. They're really too unruly!)

original_text: 韩菱纱：你……你是天河爹娘的师兄？那，我们应该称你为前辈了？
translation: Han Lingsha: You... You're Tianhe's parents' Martial Brother? Then, we should address you as Senior?

original_text: 韩菱纱：但是，你看起来一点都不老啊……
translation: Han Lingsha: But, you don't look old at all...

original_text: 玄霄：……前辈后辈，不过都是些繁文缛节，何必理会。
translation: Xuanxiao: ... Seniority and juniority are just formalities, no need to bother with them.

original_text: 玄霄：我于冰中，不知外界年月流逝，只不过看来容颜未老罢了。
translation: Xuanxiao: Trapped in ice, unaware of the passage of time outside, it seems my appearance hasn't aged, that's all.

original_text: 云天河：玄霄……你刚才说……这把剑是琼华派的东西，那为什么又会变成爹传给我的呢？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Xuanxiao... you just said... this sword belongs to Qionghua Sect, so why did it become something my father passed down to me?

original_text: 玄霄：你可是不信？
translation: Xuanxiao: You don't believe me?

original_text: 玄霄：望舒、羲和经久重逢，才会发出共鸣。想必你们也并非无缘无故闯入禁地，那便是最好的证明。
translation: Xuanxiao: Only after Wangshu and Xihe have been reunited after a long time do they resonate. Presumably, you didn't break into the Forbidden Area without reason either, which is the best proof.

original_text: 云天河：不是，我没有不信，只是觉得奇怪，再说……上回菱纱问掌门，她也没告诉我们……
translation: Yun Tianhe: No, it's not that I don't believe, I just find it strange. Besides... last time when Lingsha asked the Sect Leader, she didn't tell us either...

original_text: 玄霄：……是你爹和你娘让你上山来的？
translation: Xuanxiao: ... Did your father and mother send you up the mountain?

original_text: 云天河：不是，爹早就死了，娘也死了，他们什么也没告诉我。
translation: Yun Tianhe: No, father died long ago, mother too, they told me nothing.

original_text: 玄霄：……死了吗？……他们都已经……都已经……唉……
translation: Xuanxiao: ... Died?... They are all... all... Alas...

original_text: 玄霄：……我原以为自己常年于冰中，早已心如止水……不想听到故人噩耗，仍是百感交集……
translation: Xuanxiao: ...I thought that having been encased in ice for years, my heart had long grown still... Yet hearing sad news of old friends still stirs a tumult of emotions...

original_text: 云天河：……我不小心闯进爹和娘的墓室，看到一些东西……我想知道他们以前是什么样的人，才会跑来琼华派。
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... I accidentally entered my parents' tomb and saw some things... I wanted to know what kind of people they were before, which is why I came to the Qionghua Sect.

original_text: 玄霄：哦？你在那墓中所见为何？
translation: Xuanxiao: Oh? What did you see in that tomb?

original_text: 云天河：……其实，要是菱纱不说，我也不觉得有多奇怪……那个房间里全都是冰，把我娘的棺木都埋了起来，还有一块会发光的玉……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... Actually, if Lingsha hadn't mentioned it, I wouldn't have found it so strange... that room was full of ice, burying my mother's coffin, and there was a glowing piece of jade...

original_text: 玄霄：……那块玉，你们是否用它打开了禁地石门？
translation: Xuanxiao: ... Did you use that jade to open the stone door of the Forbidden Area?

original_text: 云天河：对啊，就是这个～
translation: Yun Tianhe: Right, this's the one~

original_text: 玄霄：……灵光藻玉，想不到我有生之年还能再见……
translation: Xuanxiao: ... Spiritual Light Jade. I never thought I'd see it again in my lifetime...

original_text: 玄霄：人生百岁，终归尘土。当初我们三人一同修炼仙道、参研剑术，正当风华之年，如今却只剩我一人……
translation: Xuanxiao: A human life spans a hundred years, returning to dust in the end. Back then, the three of us cultivated the immortal path and studied sword arts together in our prime. Now only I remain...

original_text: 韩菱纱：只剩你一个……但是，这儿冷到骨子里了，你干嘛一个人待在这里呢？
translation: Han Lingsha: You're the only one left... But, it's bone-chillingly cold here, why are you staying here all alone?

original_text: 玄霄：……云天河，你应该自小就十分畏寒吧？进入此地岂非度日如年？
translation: Xuanxiao: ...Yun Tianhe, you must have been very sensitive to cold since childhood, right? Entering this place must feel like each day drags on like a year.

original_text: 云天河：不会啊，我身体一直好好的，也没觉得这儿很冷～倒是爹和娘，他们都特别怕冷……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Not really, my health has always been fine, and I don't find it particularly cold here~ But father and mother, they were both especially afraid of the cold...
Xuanxiao: ...!!

original_text: 玄霄：这……怎么可能……不可能……
translation: Xuanxiao: This... how is it possible... how...

original_text: 云天河：什么？
translation: Yun Tianhe: What?

original_text: 玄霄：噤声！……又有人闯入，今天可真是热闹。
translation: Xuanxiao: Silence! ...More intruders. Today is truly eventful.

original_text: 慕容紫英：云天河！你们简直目无规矩！连禁地都敢闯！
translation: Murong Ziying: Yun Tianhe! You have absolutely no regard for rules! You even dare to trespass into the Forbidden Area!

original_text: 云天河：可是……师叔你不是也来了吗？
translation: Yun Tianhe: But... Martial Uncle, didn't you come too?

original_text: 慕容紫英：岂有此理！
translation: Murong Ziying: How preposterous!

original_text: 玄霄：既已来了，又何必大呼小叫？这禁地中并无惊世骇俗之物。
translation: Xuanxiao: Since you've come, why shout and yell? This Forbidden Area holds nothing shocking or horrifying.

original_text: 慕容紫英：你是……？
translation: Murong Ziying: You are...?

original_text: 韩菱纱：我们也吓一跳呢，想不到这里会有人，玄霄他还是天河爹娘的师兄！
translation: Han Lingsha: We were startled too. Who would have thought there'd be someone here? Xuanxiao is actually Tianhe's parents' Martial Brother!

original_text: 慕容紫英：玄、霄……
translation: Murong Ziying: Xuan...xiao...

original_text: 慕容紫英：你！你是玄霄师叔？！
translation: Murong Ziying: You! You are Martial Uncle Xuanxiao?!

original_text: 韩菱纱：啊？！师叔的师叔……
translation: Han Lingsha: Huh?! Martial Uncle's Martial Uncle...

original_text: 慕容紫英：师叔在上，请受弟子一拜！
translation: Murong Ziying: Martial Uncle, please accept this disciple's bow!

original_text: 玄霄：哦？你是何人门下？竟负有寒月冰魄所铸的剑匣？
translation: Xuanxiao: Oh? Who is your master? How do you carry a sword case forged from the Frost Soul?

original_text: 慕容紫英：弟子慕容紫英。曾蒙宗炼长老传授武功心法、以及铸剑之术。
translation: Murong Ziying: I am your disciple, Murong Ziying. I was fortunate to receive instruction in martial arts, inner cultivation methods, and sword-forging techniques from Elder Zonglian.

original_text: 玄霄：…… 宗炼？他如今……过得如何？
translation: Xuanxiao: ... Zonglian? How is he... doing now?

original_text: 慕容紫英：师公……早些年便已过世了……
translation: Murong Ziying: Grandmaster... passed away many years ago...

original_text: 玄霄：……他曾告知你，我在禁地？
translation: Xuanxiao: ...He told you I was in the Forbidden Area?

original_text: 慕容紫英：师公并未说过，他只交代，若有生之年得见玄霄师叔，必要恭敬相待。师叔有任何差遣，不问原由，弟子纵然粉身碎骨也要达成。
translation: Murong Ziying: Grandmaster did not say. He only instructed that if I ever meet Martial Uncle Xuanxiao in my lifetime, I must treat him with utmost respect. Any task Martial Uncle assigns, regardless of the reason, even if it means being crushed to dust, this disciple must accomplish it.

original_text: 玄霄：……我不过是个遭弃之人，宗炼未免小题大做。
translation: Xuanxiao: ... I am merely an abandoned person. Zonglian is making a mountain out of a molehill.

original_text: 慕容紫英：……无论如何，弟子自当谨遵师公之命。
translation: Murong Ziying: No matter what, this disciple will respectfully follow the Grandmaster's command.

original_text: 玄霄：不问原由？好、好！
translation: Xuanxiao: You said regardless of the reason? Good, good!

original_text: 玄霄：既然如此，我便吩咐你两件事，第一，禁地发生这种种事情，不必告知掌门。
translation: Xuanxiao: In that case, I'll order you to do two things. First, there's no need to inform Sect Leader about the various incidents in the Forbidden Area.

original_text: 慕容紫英：这……
translation: Murong Ziying: This...

original_text: 玄霄：如何？令你为难？
translation: Xuanxiao: Well? Does it trouble you?

original_text: 慕容紫英：不，弟子听命。
translation: Murong Ziying: No, I obey the command.

original_text: 玄霄：第二，其他几人闯入禁地，依照门规本应重罚，但我命你不可追究此事。
translation: Xuanxiao: Second, regarding the others who intruded into the forbidden area, according to sect rules they should be severely punished, but I order you not to pursue this matter.

original_text: 慕容紫英：……是！
translation: Murong Ziying: ... Yes!

original_text: 云天河：就是说不用被训？哈哈！
translation: Yun Tianhe: You mean I won't get scolded? Haha!

original_text: 玄霄：……你们闯入禁地已经很久，<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>都回去吧，</colour><dc0>即便有种种疑问，也无须再提，只当幻梦一场。</dc0>
translation: Xuanxiao: ...You have been in the Forbidden Area for a long time.<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> All of you, return now.</colour><dc0> Even if you have many questions, there is no need to raise them. Just treat it as a fleeting dream.</dc0>

original_text: 云天河：那……还能再来吗？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Then... can we come again?

original_text: 慕容紫英：云天河！你将本门禁地当成什么地方！
translation: Murong Ziying: Yun Tianhe! What do you think the sect's Forbidden Area for!

original_text: 云天河：不行吗？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Not allowed?

original_text: 玄霄：若想来此，改日再说吧。
translation: Xuanxiao: If you wish to come, we'll talk another day.

original_text: 慕容紫英：师叔……？
translation: Murong Ziying: Martial Uncle...?

original_text: 云天河：好，改日～呵呵。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Okay, another day~ Hehe.

original_text: 云天河：（……玄霄……呵呵，感觉跟爹有点像，可是又不太一样……）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (...Xuanxiao... hehe, feels a bit like my father, but also not quite the same...)

original_text: 云天河：（……他以前和爹、还有娘一定很要好吧？后来为什么会被封在冰里呢？）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (...He must have been very close with Father and Mother before, right? Why was he sealed in ice later?)

original_text: 云天河：（下回见面一定要问他……）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (Next time we meet, I must ask him...)

original_text: 云天河：唔……今天好清静，是不是还早？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Hmm... It's so quiet today, is it still early?

original_text: 慕容紫英：无人喊你起床，自然清静。
translation: Murong Ziying: No one is calling you to wake up, so naturally it's quiet.

original_text: 云天河：呃……师叔，我、又起晚了？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Uh...Martial Uncle, did I, oversleep again?

original_text: 慕容紫英：云天河，你一再不上早课，更无悔改之心，今日罚你去思返谷思过，直至子时方可出来！
translation: Murong Ziying: Yun Tianhe, you repeatedly skip morning classes without any remorse. Today, you are punished to reflect in the Reflection Valley until midnight before you can come out!

original_text: 云天河：要去一整天？！那，一日三顿饭怎么办？
translation: Yun Tianhe: It'll take a whole day?! Then, what about the three meals today?

original_text: 慕容紫英：思过便是思过，岂能容你存有这些杂念！
translation: Murong Ziying: Reflection is reflection, how can you be allowed to harbor such distracting thoughts!

original_text: 云天河：（菱纱，你乱说，他算什么好人……）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (Lingsha, you're talking nonsense, what kind of good person is he...)

original_text: 慕容紫英：……你的佩剑为何沾有杂尘？为何不擦拭干净？
translation: Murong Ziying: ... Why is your sword stained with dust? Why haven't you cleaned it?

original_text: 云天河：能用就好，反正一剑射出去没射偏就成了……
translation: Yun Tianhe: As long as it works, just shoot the arrow and don't miss...

original_text: 慕容紫英：什么意思？平时如何使用这把剑？
translation: Murong Ziying: What do you mean? How do you normally use this sword?

original_text: 云天河：我想想啊……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Let me think...

original_text: 云天河：从小打猎都是把这剑搭在弓上射出去，哈哈～很好用的，这把剑很利，那些猪啊熊啊一下子就……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Since I was little hunting, I've always shot this sword out by placing it on the bow, haha~ Works great. This sword is very sharp; those boars and bears go down instantly...

original_text: 慕容紫英：停！还有呢？
translation: Murong Ziying: Stop! What else?

original_text: 云天河：剥兽皮，可以做成衣服、被子，很不错的，呵呵。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Skinning beasts, you can make clothes and blankets, it's really good, hehe.

original_text: 慕容紫英：……还、还有呢？
translation: Murong Ziying: ... A-and also?

original_text: 云天河：有时拿来砍柴啦，但不是很好用，锯木头搭房子倒是不错，唰唰几下木板就切成了，我的树屋就是这么建出来的～
translation: Yun Tianhe: Sometimes I use it to chop firewood, but it's not great. It's good for sawing wood to build houses-a few swishes and the planks are cut. That's how I built my treehouse~

original_text: 慕容紫英：…………还有……吗？
translation: Murong Ziying: ...... Is there still...?

original_text: 云天河：剪发、剃胡子、切肉、削萝卜也靠它，还有用它把肉串起来烤～可惜剑太利了，有时候烤着烤着，肉突然就变两半掉到火里了，真是可惜……唉～～～
translation: Yun Tianhe: Use it for cutting hair, shaving beard, slicing meat, peeling radishes, and even skewering meat for roasting~ Too bad the sword's too sharp; sometimes while roasting, the meat suddenly splits in two and falls into the fire, such a pity... sigh~~~

original_text: 慕容紫英：…………还……有……没……有？
translation: Murong Ziying: Is... there... still... any?

original_text: 云天河：唔……总之好处多多啦，最近御剑时也用它，但这剑太细，踩着不舒服。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Hmm... Anyway, lots of benefits, been using it for sword flight lately too, but this sword's too thin, uncomfortable to stand on.
Murong Ziying: .........

original_text: 云天河：师叔你脸色好差，是不是昨晚没睡好？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Martial Uncle, you look pale. Did you not sleep well last night?

original_text: 云天河：师叔？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Martial Uncle ?

original_text: 慕容紫英：云、天、河！！
translation: Murong Ziying: YUN-TIAN-HE!!

original_text: 云天河：啊！怎么了？！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Ah! What's wrong?!

original_text: 慕容紫英：你立刻滚到思返谷思过！立刻！！
translation: Murong Ziying: You, get to Reflection Valley to reflect on your mistakes! Now!!

original_text: 云天河：（好、好凶……为什么突然气成这样…………）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (So... so fierce... why get so angry all of a sudden...)

original_text: 慕容紫英：（我需要一个人静一静……）
translation: Murong Ziying: (I need to be alone for a while...)

original_text: 云天河：唉，无聊，天早黑了……什么“思过”，就是让人坐在地上发呆……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Sigh, boring. It's been dark for ages... 'Reflection' just means sitting on the ground daydreaming...

original_text: 璇玑：你啊～抱怨什么呢，小心被紫英师叔听见，罚得更重！
translation: Xuanji: You~ What are you complaining about? Be careful Martial Uncle Ziying hears and punishes you even more!

original_text: 云天河：怀朔、璇玑！是你们？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Huaishuo, Xuanji! Is that you?

original_text: 璇玑：怎么不是～
translation: Xuanji: How can it not be~

original_text: 璇玑：你入门时间不长，丰功伟绩倒是不少，嘻嘻，能被紫英师叔送来思返谷的，你还是第一个！连我和师兄都忍不住要来看看了。
translation: Xuanji: You haven't been a disciple long, but you've quite a record of 'achievements', hehe. You're the first to be sent to the Reflection Valley by Martial Uncle Ziying! Even Martial Brother and I couldn't resist coming to see.

original_text: 云天河：……第一个？这么说，我算很厉害啰？
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... The first? So, I'm considered very powerful?

original_text: 璇玑：讨厌～你是真的不懂，还是装傻啊？
translation: Xuanji: Annoying~ Do you really not understand, or are you playing dumb?

original_text: 怀朔：璇玑，别闹了。
translation: Huaishuo: Xuanji, stop fooling around.

original_text: 怀朔：天河，恭喜你入门！自那以后我和璇玑也一直在忙，毕竟妖界之事攸关许多人生死，大家都要严阵以待，所以拖到今日才来见你一面。
translation: Huaishuo: Tianhe, congratulations on joining the sect! Since then, Xuanji and I have also been busy. After all, the matter of the yao realm concerns the lives of many. Everyone must be on high alert, so we only managed to come see you today.

original_text: 璇玑：想不到呀～就见着一个落难的，哈哈。
translation: Xuanji: Didn't expect that~ just met someone in distress, haha.

original_text: 云天河：这里好无聊，我什么时候可以出去啊？
translation: Yun Tianhe: It's so boring here, when can I go out?

original_text: 怀朔：依照本门规矩，<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>子时已过，你可以走了，</colour><dc0>要不然我和璇玑也不敢来打扰。</dc0>
translation: Huaishuo: According to our sect's rules,<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> the hour of Zi has passed, you may leave now.</colour><dc0> Otherwise, Xuanji and I wouldn't dare disturb you.</dc0>

original_text: 云天河：什么敢不敢，你们想找我玩，任何时候都可以的～
translation: Yun Tianhe: What do you mean dare or not? If you want to play with me, anytime is fine~

original_text: 璇玑：不和你说了～我和师兄也有好多事要忙，来打个招呼就得走，菱纱、梦璃方才都已经见过了。
translation: Xuanji: I won't chat with you anymore~ Martial Brother and I also have lots to do. Just came to say hello and must leave now. We've already seen Lingsha and Mengli earlier.

original_text: 云天河：这么快就要走？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Leaving so soon?

original_text: 怀朔：你多保重，既是同门，见面的机会还很多，不在一时一刻。
translation: Huaishuo: Take care. Since we're fellow disciples, we'll have many chances to meet-no rush.

original_text: 云天河：梦璃，你怎么在这？菱纱呢？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Mengli, why are you here? Where's Lingsha?

original_text: 柳梦璃：她不在房间里，不知去了哪……
translation: Liu Mengli: She's not in her room, not sure where she went...

original_text: 柳梦璃：我、听说云公子被责罚，有点担心，所以才过来看看。
translation: Liu Mengli: I... heard that Yun was being punished, so I was a bit worried and came to check on you.

original_text: 云天河：呵呵，我没什么的～
translation: Yun Tianhe: Hehe, I'm fine~

original_text: 柳梦璃：嗯，没事就好。
translation: Liu Mengli: Mm, as long as you're fine.

original_text: 云天河：……梦、梦璃……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ..., Meng, Mengli...

original_text: 柳梦璃：什么？
translation: Liu Mengli: What?

original_text: 云天河：你这几天……好像都不太开心？
translation: Yun Tianhe: These past few days... you seem a bit unhappy?

original_text: 柳梦璃：……原来，还是很明显吗？
translation: Liu Mengli: ... So, is it very obvious?

original_text: 柳梦璃：我自从听说要和妖界开战，便总觉得心里烦闷。
translation: Liu Mengli: Ever since I heard we were going to war with the yao realm, I've felt troubled in my heart.

original_text: 柳梦璃：近日看琼华派其他弟子，其实大家都不清楚妖的实力深浅，若像十九年前那场惨烈大战，你、我、菱纱，我们可能都会……
translation: Liu Mengli: Recently, watching the other disciples of Qionghua Sect, actually no one truly understands the depth of the yaoguais' strength. If it's like the brutal war nineteen years ago, you, me, Lingsha-we might all...

original_text: 云天河：梦璃，你害怕吗？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Mengli, are you scared?

original_text: 柳梦璃：我不怕死，我怕的是、是……
translation: Liu Mengli: I'm not scared of death; what I fear is, is...

original_text: 柳梦璃：那种感觉连我自己都不明白，就像脑中有团影子，但却没办法看清是什么……
translation: Liu Mengli: That feeling, even I don't understand it myself. It's like a shadow in my mind, but I can't see clearly what it is...

original_text: 柳梦璃：我也不喜欢看见流血、受伤……不管是人还是妖……
translation: Liu Mengli: I also don't like seeing bloodshed or injuries... whether it's humans or yaos...

original_text: 柳梦璃：……云公子，记得你说过，人和妖都是一样，不是一定谁要杀谁，你到现在还这么想吗？
translation: Liu Mengli: ... Yun, I remember you said that humans and yaoguais are the same, that one doesn't necessarily have to kill the other. Do you still think that way now?

original_text: 云天河：是啊～人和妖就算长相差很多，也不用一见面就斗个你死我活吧？那样多累～
translation: Yun Tianhe: Yeah~ Even if humans and yaoguais look very different, they don't have to fight to the death upon meeting, right? That's too tiring~

original_text: 云天河：我才不管妖界是怎样的，但他们不能伤害我身边的人！
translation: Yun Tianhe: I don't care what the yao realm is like, but they can't hurt the people around me!

original_text: 云天河：尤其你和菱纱，是除了爹娘以外跟我最亲的人，我早就想好了，我云天河一定要保护你们一生一世，不管今后发生什么，也都要做到！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Especially you and Lingsha-you two are the closest people to me besides my parents. I've long decided that I, Yun Tianhe, must protect you for a lifetime. No matter what happens in the future, I'll do it!

original_text: 柳梦璃：云公子，你……
translation: Liu Mengli: Yun, you...

original_text: 柳梦璃：……其实，这些日子以来，和云公子在一起，我会觉得很安心，你和其他很多人都不同，总是那么磊落坦荡……
translation: Liu Mengli: ...Actually, all these days spent with Yun, I've felt very at ease. You're different from many others, always so upright and candid...

original_text: 柳梦璃：我从小到大最开心的就是这段日子了，能看到许多风景，跟许多人说话……云公子和菱纱都是很好的人，是最好的伙伴……
translation: Liu Mengli: The happiest time of my life, from childhood till now, has been these days-seeing many sights, talking to many people... Yun and Lingsha are both wonderful people, the best companions...

original_text: 云天河：我觉得……自己这段时间也变了不少，有时候想着，要是又回山上一个人过日子，会不会不习惯了……
translation: Yun Tianhe: I feel... I've changed a lot lately too. Sometimes I wonder, if I went back to living alone on the mountain, would I feel unaccustomed to it...

original_text: 柳梦璃：很谢谢云公子要保护我与菱纱一生一世……我听了真的很高兴……只要云公子不嫌弃我，我们可以一起…………去很多地方玩……
translation: Liu Mengli: Thank you, Yun, for wanting to protect me and Lingsha for a lifetime... I was truly overjoyed to hear that... As long as Yun you don't dislike me, we can go... to many places together and have fun...

original_text: 云天河：嫌弃？怎么会啊！梦璃你、你话不要这么说……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Dislike? How could I! Mengli, you... don't say things like that...

original_text: 柳梦璃：咦，怎么了？你脸红成这样。
translation: Liu Mengli: Huh, what's wrong? Your face is so flushed.

original_text: 云天河：没、没有，梦璃，我、我想先走了！
translation: Yun Tianhe: N, no, Mengli, I, I think I'll leave first!

original_text: 云天河：（奇怪……看到梦璃笑，心就跳得好快……气也不太顺了，这到底是怎么回事……）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (Strange... Seeing Mengli smile makes my heart beat so fast... My breath is uneven too, what in the world is going on...)

original_text: 柳梦璃：云公子？
translation: Liu Mengli: Yun?

original_text: 云天河：没、没什么！我……我离开一下！
translation: Yun Tianhe: N-nothing! I... I need to step away for a moment!

original_text: 柳梦璃：云公子……谢谢你……
translation: Liu Mengli: Yun...Thank you...

original_text: 韩菱纱：哈～我看有的人就是不坦率，明明担心自己的师侄，又只会在旁边偷偷看。
translation: Han Lingsha: Ha~ Some people just aren't honest. Clearly worried about his martial nephew, yet only watching secretly from the side.

original_text: 韩菱纱：怎么？
translation: Han Lingsha: What?

original_text: 韩菱纱：喂，明明一副若有所思的样子，干嘛不把话讲出来？
translation: Han Lingsha: Hey, you clearly look thoughtful, why not speak your mind?

original_text: 慕容紫英：……不坦率的人是你吧？
translation: Murong Ziying: ... Aren't you the one who's not being honest?

original_text: 韩菱纱：……什么意思？
translation: Han Lingsha: ..., what do you mean?

original_text: 韩菱纱：哎，讲话又只讲一半，小紫英你不但是个冰块脸，还是个闷葫芦，总这么严肃干嘛？
translation: Han Lingsha: Ah, speaking only half again. Little Ziying, you're not just an ice face, but also a mute gourd, always so serious, why?

original_text: 慕容紫英：……谨言慎行又何错之有？难道人人都要与你性情相投才好？
translation: Murong Ziying: ... What's wrong with being cautious with words and actions? Must everyone share your temperament?

original_text: 韩菱纱：我可没这么说～要是你自己觉得开心，别人才没话好讲。
translation: Han Lingsha: I didn't say that~ If you feel happy yourself, others have nothing to say.

original_text: 韩菱纱：可我见你每天守着规矩，眉头却又常常皱起来，你问问自己嘛，到底过得快不快活。
translation: Han Lingsha: But I see you sticking to rules every day, yet often frowning. Ask yourself, are you really happy?

original_text: 慕容紫英：你这话很奇怪，人生数十载，岂能事事都随人所愿？
translation: Murong Ziying: That's a strange thing to say. Life is but decades, how can everything go as one wishes?

original_text: 韩菱纱：就因为人生苦短～不过得开心点，难道死之前才后悔？
translation: Han Lingsha: Life is short, so you should enjoy it. Why wait until you're dying to regret?

original_text: 韩菱纱：像是天河，有时候我都觉得他很胡闹，可又不知不觉羡慕他，说不定就该那样，才不算白过了一辈子……
translation: Han Lingsha: Like Tianhe-sometimes I think he's reckless, yet unconsciously envy him. Perhaps that's how one should live, not wasting a lifetime...

original_text: 慕容紫英：岂有这种道理？他那样不过是目无礼法、肆意妄为罢了。
translation: Murong Ziying: How can that be right? That's just him being lawless and acting recklessly.

original_text: 慕容紫英：我修仙问道，为世间斩妖除魔，没有一样不是自己想要的，又怎会虚耗一世？
translation: Murong Ziying: I cultivate immortality and seek the Dao, slaying demons and monsters for the world-all things I truly desire. How could I waste my life?

original_text: 韩菱纱：算了算了，和你真的说不通呐，你觉得好就好。
