translation: Han Lingsha: Forget it, forget it, I really can't get through to you. If you think it's good, then it's good.

original_text: 云天河：……真奇怪，有时候对着梦璃，就会觉得头晕晕的，话也说得乱七八糟……是不是病了？可是有菱纱在的时候又不会这样……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... So strange, sometimes when facing Mengli, I feel dizzy and my words get all jumbled... Am I sick? But when Lingsha is around, it doesn't happen...

original_text: 云天河：不管这些了，玄霄说改天再找他，现在应该算是“改天”了吧，呵呵～
translation: Yun Tianhe: Never mind all that. Xuanxiao said to find him another day. Now should count as 'another day', right? Hehe~

original_text: 韩菱纱：天河，等等我！
translation: Han Lingsha: Tianhe, wait for me!

original_text: 韩菱纱：你是想去那个……禁地，对不对？
translation: Han Lingsha: You want to go to that... forbidden area, right?

original_text: 云天河：是啊～
translation: Yun Tianhe: Yeah~

original_text: 韩菱纱：你啊……真的很喜欢那个人。
translation: Han Lingsha: You... really like that person a lot.

original_text: 云天河：我、我喜欢哪个人？！没、没有啊……
translation: Yun Tianhe: M-me? Like which person?! N-no, not at all...

original_text: 韩菱纱：就是玄霄嘛，都写在脸上了！虽然你平时就一副没烦恼的样子，可是只要一说到去看那个人，你的眉毛眼睛，说不出哪里，更是显得特别开心。
translation: Han Lingsha: I mean Xuanxiao, it's written all over your face! Although you usually look carefree, whenever the topic of visiting that person comes up, your eyes and eyebrows-I can't quite pinpoint it-seem especially happy.

original_text: 云天河：玄霄他……是不太一样，我觉得他有点像爹，可是又更像哥哥……唉，我也没有其他兄弟姐妹，不知想得对不对……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Xuanxiao... he's different. I feel he's a bit like Father, but more like an older brother... Sigh, I don't have other siblings, so I'm not sure if that's right...

original_text: 云天河：反正……我爹娘的事、玄霄被封在冰里的事，总也放不下……但是我看玄霄好像不想多说，我……想问又问不出口……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Anyway... I can't let go of my parents' story, or Xuanxiao being sealed in ice... But Xuanxiao doesn't seem to want to talk much, I... want to ask but can't bring myself to...

original_text: 韩菱纱：难得，你这少根筋的家伙也会有放不下的事情。
translation: Han Lingsha: Rare indeed, for a scatterbrain like you to have something you can't let go of.

original_text: 韩菱纱：知道吗？白天我去借了琼华派的弟子名录来看，翻遍了也没瞧见你爹、玄霄和你娘的名字，太奇怪了！
translation: Han Lingsha: You know what? During the day, I borrowed the Qionghua Sect's disciple registry to look through, but I couldn't find your father's, Xuanxiao's, or your mother's names anywhere. So strange!

original_text: 云天河：名录是啥？再说这个地方的人不是很小气吗？怎么你说借就借？
translation: Yun Tianhe: What's a registry? Besides, aren't the people here pretty stingy? How come you can just borrow it?

original_text: 韩菱纱：哎～名录就是记载所有弟子名字的书，至于我如何借来的，你就别管了，姑娘我自有办法，嘻嘻。
translation: Han Lingsha: Hey~ The registry is a book recording all the disciples' names. As for how I borrowed it, don't worry about it. This girl has her own ways, hehe.

original_text: 云天河：你是……想和我一起去找玄霄？
translation: Yun Tianhe: You... want to go find Xuanxiao with me?

original_text: 韩菱纱：嗯，说不定能帮忙查查你爹娘的事呢。
translation: Han Lingsha: Hmm, maybe we can help look into your parents' matter.

original_text: 韩菱纱：再说……其实我也一样放不下，玄霄那种孤单……我能体会，真的太可怜了……
translation: Han Lingsha: Besides... I can't let go either. That kind of loneliness Xuanxiao is facing... I understand it. It's really too pitiful...

original_text: 云天河：好，那就一起去禁地找他吧！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Good, then let's go to the Forbidden Area to find him together!

original_text: 玄霄：是你？
translation: Xuanxiao: You?

original_text: 云天河：是不是这时候不能来？
translation: Yun Tianhe:  Are we not supposed to come at this time?

original_text: 玄霄：……无妨，你可是有事想要问我？
translation: Xuanxiao: ... It's fine. Do you have something to ask me?

original_text: 云天河：我想知道，我爹和我娘为什么又离开琼华派了？他们已经不想做剑仙了吗？
translation: Yun Tianhe: I want to know, why did my Father and Mother leave Qionghua Sect? Did they not want to be Sword Immortals anymore?

original_text: 云天河：还有……你，怎么会被封在冰里？
translation: Yun Tianhe: And... you, how did you get sealed in the ice?

original_text: 玄霄：……这些前尘往事，你知道了又如何？不知又如何？
translation: Xuanxiao: ... These past events, what does it matter if you know? Or if you don't?

original_text: 云天河：我、我也不清楚，就是心里很记挂，想要弄明白。
translation: Yun Tianhe: I... I'm not sure either, I just really care about it and want to figure it out.

original_text: 玄霄：……
translation: Xuanxiao: ...

original_text: 玄霄：……你爹性情不羁，门中诸多清规戒律，委实不适于他。
translation: Xuanxiao: ... Your Father was of an unrestrained nature, and the many strict rules of the sect truly didn't suit him.

original_text: 玄霄：至于你娘，她的性子外柔内刚，既已打定主意随你爹下山，便是不会再留。
translation: Xuanxiao: As for your mother, her nature is gentle on the outside but strong within. Once she decided to leave the mountain with your father, she would never stay.

original_text: 云天河：哦，原来爹和我一样，也受不了这儿这么多规矩～
translation: Yun Tianhe: Oh, so Father was like me, he couldn't stand all these rules here either~

original_text: 玄霄：人各有志，修仙半途而止，并不出奇。
translation: Xuanxiao: Everyone has their own aspirations, stopping halfway in cultivation is not unusual.

original_text: 云天河：但是……那把剑和那块玉，是我爹和我娘带下山的？
translation: Yun Tianhe: But... That sword and that jade, were they brought down the mountain by my father and mother?

original_text: 玄霄：望舒剑与灵光藻玉虽是本门之物，但你娘还在山上时，这两样东西都为她所用，她便一并带走了……这里面的因由也不必多提。
translation: Xuanxiao: Although Wangshu Sword and Spiritual Light Jade belong to our sect, when your mother was still on the mountain, she used both items and took them with her when she left... No need to delve into the reasons.

original_text: 韩菱纱：是不是离开门派的弟子，在名录上就找不到了？
translation: Han Lingsha: If a disciple leaves the sect, will their name no longer appear in the registry?

original_text: 玄霄：……正是。
translation: Xuanxiao: ... Exactly.

original_text: 云天河：那你呢？又怎么会在这里？
translation: Yun Tianhe: What about you? Why are you here too?

original_text: 玄霄：我吗？
translation: Xuanxiao: Me?

original_text: 玄霄：我是罪有应得。
translation: Xuanxiao: I got what I deserved.

original_text: 云天河：……！
translation: Yun Tianhe: ...!

original_text: 玄霄：琼华派虽是人人修道，但所练不尽相同。昔时我修炼的乃是天下至阳至烈之功，不想一时走火入魔，将派中弟子打成重伤。
translation: Xuanxiao: Although everyone in Qionghua Sect cultivates the Dao, what they practice isn't all the same. Back then, I was cultivating the most yang and intense power in the world. Unexpectedly, I fell into demonic madness and lost control, seriously injuring disciples in the sect.

original_text: 玄霄：其他人顾及门规，更念同门之谊，不会杀我，却也不能放我，于是想出这个冰封的法子，让我静思自省。
translation: Xuanxiao: Others, mindful of sect rules and fellowship, wouldn't kill me but couldn't release me either. So they devised this ice-sealing method for me to reflect and repent.

original_text: 云天河：都过了这么久，还不能让你出来吗？
translation: Yun Tianhe: It's been so long, and they still can't get you out?

original_text: 玄霄：如今琼华派中，又有几人还记得当年旧事？若等他们想起，放我出来，只怕要等到海枯石烂。
translation: Xuanxiao: In today's Qionghua Sect, how many still remember the events of the past? If I wait for them to remember and release me, I fear it would take until the seas run dry and rocks crumble.

original_text: 云天河：那怎么办？我们去求掌门——
translation: Yun Tianhe: Then what do we do? Let's go beg the Sect Leader-

original_text: 玄霄：夙瑶吗？求她何用？
translation: Xuanxiao: Suyao? What use is begging her?

original_text: 玄霄：这些年来我内息流转不断，同于苦修，区区寒冰又怎会放在眼里？之所以至今未破冰而出，却是有所顾忌。
translation: Xuanxiao: Over the years, my internal energy has circulated continuously, akin to rigorous cultivation. How could mere ice be of concern? The reason I haven't broken free yet is due to certain reservations.

original_text: 云天河：顾忌？是什么？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Reservations? What are they?

original_text: 玄霄：……我身中阳炎炽烈，自被冰封，便苦修自创的“凝冰诀”加以制衡。若是破冰，我自信不会再重蹈覆辙，但为保万无一失，还需三样至阴至寒之物从旁相辅。
translation: Xuanxiao: ... I am afflicted with intense yang flames. Since being sealed in ice, I have diligently cultivated my self-created 'Cryomancy' to counteract it. If the ice is broken, I am confident I will not repeat past mistakes, but to ensure absolute safety, I still need three items of extreme yin and cold nature to assist.

original_text: 云天河：三样至阴至寒之物？在哪里呢？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Three supremely yin and cold objects? Where are they?

original_text: 玄霄：我也不知究竟在何处，只是当年曾有耳闻。
translation: Xuanxiao: I don't know exactly where, but I heard of them in the past.

original_text: 云天河：这可惨了～天下那么大，就算用御剑来找，也要花上很久，说不定一辈子都找不完！
translation: Yun Tianhe: This is terrible~ The world is so vast. Even using Sword Flight to search would take a long time, maybe a whole lifetime wouldn't be enough!

original_text: 玄霄：你……
translation: Xuanxiao: You...

original_text: 韩菱纱：……天河，你想帮忙吗？
translation: Han Lingsha: ... Tianhe, do you want to help?

original_text: 云天河：当然！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Of course!

original_text: 韩菱纱：可是……这毕竟不算小事，说不定还涉及派中秘辛，我怕……
translation: Han Lingsha: But... After all, this is no small matter. It might even involve sect secrets. I'm afraid...

original_text: 玄霄：你们不必插手，生死之事，尚要听天由命，何况这等去留，又岂随我意。
translation: Xuanxiao: You need not intervene. Matters of life and death are still subject to fate's will, let alone such comings and goings. How could they follow my wishes?

original_text: 云天河：玄霄，别这么说……我是真的想帮忙，你是爹和娘的师兄，爹在的话，也肯定要管！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Xuanxiao, don't say that... I truly want to help. You're father and mother's Martial Brother. If father were here, he'd definitely get involved!

original_text: 云天河：再说，就算你伤了人，被关在这儿这么久，还不够吗？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Besides, even if you hurt someone, being locked here this long, isn't it enough?

original_text: 云天河：我打定主意了，让我帮你吧！
translation: Yun Tianhe: I've made up my mind, let me help you!

original_text: 玄霄：……你已这样说，我再推托，便显矫情。但你随时都可反悔，我不会怨怪。
translation: Xuanxiao: ... Since you've said so, any further refusal would seem insincere. But you may change your mind anytime; I won't hold it against you.

original_text: 云天河：我答应你了，就不会反悔！
translation: Yun Tianhe: I promised you, and I won't go back on my word!

original_text: 玄霄：……若有意帮我，可以<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>穿过本派后山的醉花荫，去往一处叫作“清风涧”的地方</colour><dc0>。那里隐居的两位长老青阳、重光，应该知道何处能找到“三寒器”。</dc0>
translation: Xuanxiao: ...If you wish to help, you can<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> cross the Drunken Bower in the rear mountain of our sect to reach a place called 'Breezy Brook'</colour><dc0>. The two elders living in seclusion there, Qingyang and Chongguang, should know where to find the 'Three Cold Artifacts'.</dc0>

original_text: 玄霄：报上我姓名，他们愿意相助，自然是好，若是不愿，也不必强求……
translation: Xuanxiao: If you mention my name, and they are willing to help, that's naturally good. If they are unwilling, there's no need to force them...

original_text: 云天河：好～不等了，我这就去！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Okay~ I won't wait any longer, I'm going now!

original_text: 玄霄：慢！
translation: Xuanxiao: Wait!

original_text: 玄霄：上回我问你，可是自小畏寒，你说没有？此言不虚？
translation: Xuanxiao: Last time I asked if you've been afraid of the cold since childhood, you said no? Is that true?

original_text: 云天河：是啊，我从小到大都不怕冷，也不怕热～
translation: Yun Tianhe: Yeah, I've never been afraid of cold or heat since I was little~

original_text: 玄霄：……奇了，以你的体质，本不该……
translation: Xuanxiao: ... Strange, with your constitution, you shouldn't have...

original_text: 玄霄：你爹……有没有告诉过你什么？
translation: Xuanxiao: Your dad... did he ever tell you anything?

original_text: 云天河：没有啊。
translation: Yun Tianhe: No, he didn't.

original_text: 玄霄：……无论如何，你气色如常，应可修炼我所创的“凝冰诀”，这虽然只是心法，并不能使功力一日千里，但时日久了，便可固你根基，令你修行事半功倍。
translation: Xuanxiao: ... Regardless, your complexion appears normal, so you should be able to cultivate the 'Cryomancy' I created. Although this is just a mental technique and won't rapidly boost your power, over time it will solidify your foundation, making your cultivation twice as effective.

original_text: 云天河：真的吗？听起来像是很厉害～
translation: Yun Tianhe: Really? Sounds like it's very impressive~

original_text: 玄霄：你先记下口诀——
translation: Xuanxiao: First memorize the incantation-

original_text: 玄霄：不错，你心无杂念，学来倒不费力。
translation: Xuanxiao: Good, your mind is free of distractions, learning it shouldn't be difficult.

original_text: 云天河：真的耶！说不出哪里不一样了，可就是觉得全身很舒畅。
translation: Yun Tianhe: It's true! I can't quite say what's different, but I just feel really comfortable all over.

original_text: 韩菱纱：这么厉害？我也能学吗？
translation: Han Lingsha: That powerful? Can I learn it too?

original_text: 玄霄：不可。
translation: Xuanxiao: Not allowed.

original_text: 玄霄：……你性喜动，而修炼此功务必要意沉如水、心无旁鹜，于你并不合适，若是练了，反而有害无益。
translation: Xuanxiao: ... You have an active nature, but cultivating this art requires a mind as calm as water, free from distractions. It's not suitable for you; practicing it would do more harm than good.

original_text: 韩菱纱：……怎么会呢？天河才是一刻都静不下来，他却能学？
translation: Han Lingsha: ... How could that be? Tianhe can't sit still for a moment, yet he could learn?

original_text: 玄霄：他看来好动，其实最无杂念，不然也不会一听口诀，便能心随意动，立时有感。
translation: Xuanxiao: He seems restless, but actually has the least distracting thoughts; otherwise, he wouldn't be able to grasp the incantation immediately, moving with his mind and sensing it at once.

original_text: 韩菱纱：（……有听没懂……就是说，要脑袋空空才能学这个心法？）
translation: Han Lingsha: (...Heard but didn't understand... So, you need an empty mind to learn this mental cultivation method?)

original_text: 韩菱纱：唉，算了吧……那我还是跟着紫英学功夫好了。
translation: Han Lingsha: Sigh, forget it... I'd better just follow Ziying and learn some martial arts.

original_text: 玄霄：慕容紫英？夙瑶命他来教你们？
translation: Xuanxiao: Murong Ziying? Suyao ordered him to teach you?

original_text: 韩菱纱：掌门原本想让其他人做我们的师父，可那人又正好下山，这才换了紫英……
translation: Han Lingsha: The Sect Leader originally wanted someone else to be our master, but that person happened to go down the mountain, so Ziying was assigned instead...

original_text: 玄霄：下山去了？夙瑶这推托之辞未免太不高明。
translation: Xuanxiao: Gone down the mountain? Suyao's excuse is rather unconvincing.

original_text: 云天河：我就说嘛，掌门一向小气……
translation: Yun Tianhe: See? I told you-the Sect Leader is always stingy..."

original_text: 玄霄：哦？夙瑶如何小气了？
translation: Xuanxiao: Oh? How is Suyao stingy?

original_text: 云天河：……山下有个村子没水了，我们想找她借水林猪用一下，她都不肯——
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... There's a village down the mountain runs out of water. We wanted to borrow her Water Spirit Pig, but she refused-

original_text: 玄霄：你们几个～当真是初生牛犊，要知水灵珠乃是琼华至宝，依夙瑶的性子，她如何会轻易拿出？
translation: Xuanxiao: You lot~ are truly newborn calves unafraid of tigers. You must know the Water Spirit Pearl is a supreme treasure of Qionghua. Given Suyao's temperament, how could she easily part with it?

original_text: 韩菱纱：……她不想教我们，干嘛还让我们入门？难道是怕和妖界拼命的时候人不够？
translation: Han Lingsha: If she doesn't want to teach us, why did she even let us join? Is she afraid there won't be enough people when fighting the yao realm?

original_text: 云天河：对了，玄霄，紫英说马上会有妖界飞来这里，那个妖界很厉害吗？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Right, Xuanxiao, Ziying said a yao realm will soon fly here. Is that yao realm very powerful?

original_text: 玄霄：……妖界降临，便是又过了十九年啊……
translation: Xuanxiao: ... The yao realm descends... another nineteen years have passed...

original_text: 玄霄：十九年前，我的师父，前代掌门太清真人正是被妖界之主所害，此仇不报，琼华派何以雪耻？！
translation: Xuanxiao: Nineteen years ago, my master, the former sect leader Taiqing Perfected Person, was killed by the Mistress of the Yao Realm. If this vengeance is not repaid, how can the Qionghua Sect wash away this shame?!

original_text: 韩菱纱：怪不得……掌门还有紫英，提到妖界都那样小心戒备，妖怪那么强，我们又怎么赢得了？
translation: Han Lingsha: No wonder... the Sect Leader and Ziying are so wary of the yao realm. If yaoguais are that strong, how can we possibly win?

original_text: 玄霄：倒也未必，办法还是有的，却要看天意是否能成了……
translation: Xuanxiao: Not necessarily. There is still a way, but it depends on whether fate will allow it...

original_text: 云天河：我们先去找长老了，玄霄，你就等好消息吧！
translation: Yun Tianhe: We'll go find the Elders first, Xuanxiao, you just wait for the good news!

original_text: 玄霄：去吧，万事小心，若是凶险，不用勉强而为。
translation: Xuanxiao: Go, be careful in all things. If it's too dangerous, don't force it.

original_text: 慕容紫英：你们，又去师叔那里？
translation: Murong Ziying: You two, just visited Martial Uncle again?

original_text: 韩菱纱：（……完了，被他看见……这冰块脸八成要搬出大道理来教训人……）
translation: Han Lingsha: (...It's over, he saw... This ice-face is probably going to lecture with his high-minded principles...)

original_text: 慕容紫英：往来禁地须得小心，若是被其他弟子看到，却也不好解释。
translation: Murong Ziying: We must be careful coming and going to the Forbidden Area. If other disciples see us, it would be hard to explain.

original_text: 韩菱纱：咦？！你你你——你是慕容紫英吧？
translation: Han Lingsha: Huh?! Y-you you-you're Murong Ziying, right?

original_text: 韩菱纱：真的慕容紫英，不是应该立刻板起脸来，训斥一番吗？
translation: Han Lingsha: The real Murong Ziying would have immediately put on a stern face and scolded us, right?

original_text: 慕容紫英：……师叔已经吩咐过，不要把禁地之事告诉其他人，而你们过去他并不阻拦，我便不该多说什么。
translation: Murong Ziying: ... Martial Uncle has already instructed not to tell others about the forbidden area. Since he doesn't stop you from going, I shouldn't say more.

original_text: 云天河：这样的话，你也跟我们一起去找三寒器吧！
translation: Yun Tianhe: In that case, you should come with us to find Three Cold Artifacts!

original_text: 慕容紫英：三寒器？
translation: Murong Ziying: Three Cold Artifacts?

original_text: 韩菱纱：听玄霄说，就是天底下至阴至寒的三样东西，能压制他身体里的阳炎，令他破冰而出～
translation: Han Lingsha: I heard Xuanxiao say, they are the three most Yin and cold things in the world. They can suppress the Yang flame in his body, allowing him to break free from the ice~

original_text: 慕容紫英：此话当真？！
translation: Murong Ziying: Is it true?!

original_text: 韩菱纱：哼，骗你不成～他还让我们<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>去清风涧找隐居的两位长老</colour><dc0>，打听三寒器下落呢！</dc0>
translation: Han Lingsha: Hmph, what would we lie?  He also told us<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> to go to Breezy Brook and find the two reclusive elders</colour><dc0>, to inquire about Three Cold Artifacts!</dc0>

original_text: 慕容紫英：……此事、此事掌门却又不知，这……
translation: Murong Ziying: ... But... Sect Leader doesn't know about this, this...

original_text: 韩菱纱：玄霄好像也不想让掌门知道呢。
translation: Han Lingsha: Xuanxiao doesn't seem to want Sect Leader to know either.

original_text: 云天河：师叔，你不是很担心妖界要来了吗？玄霄如果从冰里出来，一定能帮上忙吧！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Martial Uncle, aren't you worried about the yao realm coming? If Xuanxiao gets out of ice, he can definitely help!

original_text: 慕容紫英：好，我跟你们一起去！
translation: Murong Ziying: Good, I'll go with you!

original_text: 慕容紫英：……宗炼师公命我无论如何也要达成师叔所愿，说不定……正是为了今日。
translation: Murong Ziying: ... Grandmaster Zonglian ordered me to fulfill Uncle's wishes no matter what. Perhaps... he was precisely for today.

original_text: 韩菱纱：那你们先等一下，我去叫上梦璃，去去就来～
translation: Han Lingsha: Then wait here a moment. I'll go get Mengli, be right back~

original_text: 云天河：……师叔，学了基本心法和御剑之后，你怎么都不再教其他东西了？
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... Martial Uncle , after learning the basic spirit method and sword flight, why haven't you taught anything else?

original_text: 慕容紫英：琼华道法博大精深，短短几日又能传授多少，你稍安毋躁，先将根基打好。
translation: Murong Ziying: Qionghua's Taoist arts are vast and profound. How many can be taught in just a few days? Be patient and first solidify your foundation.

original_text: 云天河：不对，是掌门根本不想教我们厉害的道法吧？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Wrong. It's that the Sect Leader simply doesn't want to teach us powerful Taoist techniques, right?

original_text: 慕容紫英：……！
translation: Murong Ziying: ...!

original_text: 慕容紫英：休要胡说，掌门乃是一派之主，行事非你我能够猜臆！
translation: Murong Ziying: Don't talk nonsense! The Sect Leader is the master of the whole sect-her actions are not for us to guess!

original_text: 云天河：……不教就不教，我上山只是想学御剑，对其他的也不稀罕。
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... If she doesn't want to teach, then don't. I came up the mountain just to learn Sword Flight, I'm not interested in anything else.

original_text: 慕容紫英：唉，我说过了，不必心急，如今妖界将临，许多事情千头万绪，一时顾不上你们，也在情理之中。
translation: Murong Ziying: Sigh, I've said it before, no need to rush. With the yao realm approaching, many matters are tangled and complex. It's understandable that no one is available to attend to you three immediately.

original_text: 柳梦璃：事情我都听菱纱说了，要能帮上玄霄，真是再好不过。<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>我们这就动身去清风涧吧。</colour>
translation: Liu Mengli: Lingsha has told me everything. If we can help Xuanxiao, that would be wonderful indeed.<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> Let's set off for Breezy Brook right away.</colour>

original_text: 云天河：好！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Okay!

original_text: 云天河：终于到了～快走！我想马上去找玄霄，告诉他好消息！
translation: Yun Tianhe: We're finally here~ Let's go! I want to find Xuanxiao right away and tell him the good news!

original_text: 柳梦璃：我……
translation: Liu Mengli: I...

original_text: 云天河：梦璃？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Mengli?

original_text: 柳梦璃：有什么、有什么东西……我的头……好晕……
translation: Liu Mengli: Something... something happening... my head... so dizzy...

original_text: 韩菱纱：很不舒服吗？是不是海风吹久了？我扶你回房！
translation: Han Lingsha: Are you feeling sick? Is it because of the sea breeze? Let me help you back to your room!

original_text: 慕容紫英：……你们两个先回去吧，<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>我与天河去见师叔就行了。</colour>
translation: Murong Ziying: ...You two head back first,<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> Tianhe and I will go see our Martial Uncle .</colour>

original_text: 韩菱纱：好，那我和梦璃先走了，她看起来脸色很苍白，得好好休息才行……
translation: Han Lingsha: Okay, then Mengli and I will return first. She looks very pale and needs proper rest...

original_text: 云天河：玄霄～
translation: Yun Tianhe: Xuanxiao~

original_text: 慕容紫英：弟子参见师叔。
translation: Murong Ziying: This disciple pays respects to Martial Uncle .

original_text: 玄霄：何事如此高兴？
translation: Xuanxiao: What's got you so happy?

original_text: 云天河：你看！我们已经找到了三寒器其中一个，光纪寒图！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Look! We've found one of Three Cold Artifacts, Guangji Cold Map!

original_text: 云天河：不算太难，只要再得到另外两个，你就能从冰里出来了！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Not too hard. Once we get the other two, you'll be free from the ice!

original_text: 玄霄：……你怎么……看来比我还高兴？
translation: Xuanxiao: ... You... seem even happier than I am?

original_text: 云天河：呵呵，不可以吗？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Hehe, what's wrong with that?

original_text: 玄霄：只是没想到，这世上竟还有人会为我如此耗费心力…………
translation: Xuanxiao: I just never thought there would still be someone in this world who would expend such effort for me...

original_text: 玄霄：好、好，天河，你很好，你看我们结为义兄弟如何？
translation: Xuanxiao: Good, good, Tianhe, you are very good. How about we become sworn brothers?

original_text: 云天河：义兄弟？啥意思？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Sworn brothers? What does that mean?

original_text: 玄霄：便是没有血缘之人彼此认作兄弟，你尊我为兄长，我视你为亲弟，从今往后，你就是我在世上唯一的亲人了。
translation: Xuanxiao: Even without blood ties, people can acknowledge each other as brothers. You honor me as your big brother, and I regard you as my own younger brother. From now on, you are my only family in this world.

original_text: 云天河：好啊！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Great!

original_text: 云天河：我下了山后才知道，人也会有兄弟姐妹的，可惜我没有……现在有你做我大哥，真是再好不过～
translation: Yun Tianhe: After coming down the mountain, I learned that humans can have siblings too. Too bad I don't... Having you as my big brother now is really the best~

original_text: 慕容紫英：师叔，弟子斗胆……你与天河父亲同辈，这……这只怕于礼法不合。
translation: Murong Ziying: Martial Uncle, this disciple dares to say... You are of the same generation as Tianhe's father; this... this likely violates proper rites.

original_text: 玄霄：礼法？什么东西？
translation: Xuanxiao: ...rites? Nonsense.

original_text: 慕容紫英：师叔……
translation: Murong Ziying: Martial Uncle ...

original_text: 玄霄：琼华派便是事事都合礼数，才会教出些迂腐不堪的弟子。何况我如何行止，却要后辈来管吗？
translation: Xuanxiao: It's precisely because Qionghua Sect adheres strictly to every rule and rite that it produces such pedantic disciples. Besides, how I conduct myself-should that be corrected by a junior?

original_text: 慕容紫英：弟子不敢！
translation: Murong Ziying: This disciple dares not!

original_text: 玄霄：天河，这回怎未见其他两位姑娘？
translation: Xuanxiao: Tianhe, why aren't the other two young ladies here this time?

original_text: 云天河：她们啊，身体不太舒服，就先回去休息了。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Them? They are not feeling well, went back to rest first.

original_text: 玄霄：不太舒服…………大哥问你，那其中可有你的心上人吗？
translation: Xuanxiao: Not feeling too well... Your big brother asks you, is there someone your sweetheart among them?

original_text: 云天河：大哥，怎么你也这样问？我、我不太懂……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Big brother, why ask that too? I, I don't really understand...

original_text: 玄霄：不懂便罢了，只是……那带着琴的女孩子相当特别。
translation: Xuanxiao: If you don't understand, so be it. But... that girl carrying the qin is quite special.

original_text: 云天河：梦璃她……她人很好的……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Mengli... she's a very good person...

original_text: 玄霄：你误会了，我是说她……
translation: Xuanxiao: You misunderstand, I was thinking about...

original_text: 玄霄：罢了，此事日后再说。我教过你的心法练得如何？
translation: Xuanxiao: Enough, we'll discuss this later. How is the cultivation of the mental technique I taught you going?

original_text: 云天河：早晚都练啊，最近总觉得身体变得越来越轻了～
translation: Yun Tianhe: Practice every day and night. Lately, I feel my body getting lighter and lighter~

original_text: 玄霄：很好，眼下务必勤加苦修，勿要牵扯儿女私情，否则只会生出无穷烦恼。
translation: Xuanxiao: Very good. For now, you must diligently cultivate through hard practice. Do not get entangled in romantic affairs, or it will only breed endless troubles.

original_text: 玄霄：……刚才你将光纪寒图直接拿在手中，竟也不觉寒冷？
translation: Xuanxiao: ... Just now you held the Guangji Cold Map directly in your hand, and didn't even feel cold?

original_text: 云天河：不会啊，好像别人都说冷，就只有我没啥感觉。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Not really. It seems others say it's cold, but I don't feel much.

original_text: 玄霄：……<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>你们都出去吧，</colour><dc0>我想静心一段时间，若是找到另外两样寒器，再一并拿来。</dc0>
translation: Xuanxiao: ...<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>All of you, leave now.</colour><dc0> I wish to meditate in peace for a while. If you find the other two cold artifacts, bring them together.</dc0>

original_text: 慕容紫英：是。
translation: Murong Ziying: Yes.

original_text: 云天河：大哥你放心，我一定尽快找到另外两样东西。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Big Brother, don't worry, I'll definitely find the other two things as soon as possible.

original_text: 玄霄：天河，日后大哥必会报答你今日之恩……
translation: Xuanxiao: Tianhe, someday I will repay you for today's kindness...

original_text: 柳梦璃：菱纱，我看你今天还是别出门了吧。
translation: Liu Mengli: Lingsha, I think you better not go out today.

original_text: 慕容紫英：的确……
translation: Murong Ziying: Indeed...

original_text: 云天河：你们都起来了啊？
translation: Yun Tianhe: You're all up already?

original_text: 韩菱纱：嘻～大懒虫都爬起来了，我们还不快走？
translation: Han Lingsha: Hehe~ Even the big lazybones is up, shouldn't we hurry and go?

original_text: 韩菱纱：<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>今天就去炎帝神农洞了！</colour><dc0>那地方我也知道在哪里～</dc0>
translation: Han Lingsha:<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> We're going to the Yan Emperor-Shennong Cave today!</colour><dc0>I know where that place is too~</dc0>

original_text: 柳梦璃：不行……你昨天只顾关照我，自己反而累坏了……
translation: Liu Mengli: No... Yesterday you only took care of me and ended up exhausted yourself...

original_text: 韩菱纱：那算什么？以前闯荡江湖，什么大病小病没生过，现在只是手脚有些发软，没那么容易倒下的。
translation: Han Lingsha: What's that? Roaming the martial world before, I've had all sorts of illnesses, big and small. Now it's just some weakness in my limbs; I won't fall down that easily.

original_text: 云天河：那如果你在路上撑不住，我们就马上回来！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Then if you can't hold on during the journey, we'll come back immediately!

original_text: 韩菱纱：好了，别人念叨也就罢了，怎么连你都爱操心……走啦、走啦！
translation: Han Lingsha: Alright, others nagging is one thing, but why are you worrying too... Let's go, let's go!

original_text: 云天河：有吗？我是关心你啊……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Really? I'm just concerned about you...

original_text: 璇玑：师叔！不好了、不好了！
translation: Xuanji: Martial Uncle! Something terrible has happened!

original_text: 明靖：紫英师叔！你终于回来了！
translation: Mingjing: Martial Uncle Ziying! You've finally returned!

original_text: 慕容紫英：你们怎么了？
translation: Murong Ziying: What's wrong with you all?

original_text: 明桓：师叔，你还不知道吗？！这韩菱纱在入门前是个偷东西的贼！有人已经认出她来了！
translation: Ming Huan: Martial Uncle, don't you know?! This Han Lingsha used to be a thief! Someone has recognized her!

original_text: 怀溪：师叔，我们琼华派收徒甚严，怎能允许这种身份的人混在其中！
translation: Huaixi: Martial Uncle, our Qionghua Sect is very strict in accepting disciples. How can we allow someone of such background to mix in!

original_text: 明采：没错，刚才怀安师兄已去禀报掌门，请掌门将这个女贼逐出门墙！
translation: Mingcai: Exactly! Just now, Martial Brother Huaian went to report to the Sect Leader, asking her to expel this female thief from the sect!

original_text: 明靖：现在逐下山去说不定都为时已晚！谁知道本派有没有丢过什么——
translation: Mingjing: Expelling her from the mountain now might even be too late! Who knows if our sect has lost anything-

original_text: 云天河：你刚才说什么？再说一遍看看！
translation: Yun Tianhe: What did you just say? Try to say it again!

original_text: 明靖：你、你疯啦！竟对同门兵刃相向！
translation: Mingjing: You, you're crazy! Drawing blades on your fellow disciples?

original_text: 云天河：我管你是不是同门！不许有人这样说菱纱，谁再说一句，我就要他好看！
translation: Yun Tianhe: I don't care if we're fellow disciples! No one is allowed to talk about Lingsha like that, one more word and you'll regret it!

original_text: 明桓：岂有此理——
translation: Ming Huan: How outrageous-

original_text: 慕容紫英：都给我退开！
translation: Murong Ziying: All of you, back off!

original_text: 明靖：紫英师叔，你看他如此嚣张——
translation: Mingjing: Martial Uncle Ziying, look how arrogant he is-

original_text: 慕容紫英：闭嘴！通通给我回去！
translation: Murong Ziying: Silence! All of you, go back!

original_text: 慕容紫英：既然你们将此事禀报了掌门，便该由掌门定夺！
translation: Murong Ziying: Since you have reported this to the Sect Leader, it should be left for her to decide!

original_text: 怀溪：师叔——
translation: Huaixi: Martial Uncle -

original_text: 慕容紫英：回去！！
translation: Murong Ziying: Go back!!

original_text: 怀溪：可恶！
translation: Huaixi: Damn it!

original_text: 璇玑：紫英师叔，师兄他们太过份了……
translation: Xuanji: Martial Uncle, they are being too much...

original_text: 璇玑：我和怀朔师兄一直阻止，他们还是要去找掌门……
translation: Xuanji: Huaishuo and I kept trying to stop them, but they still insisted on going to see the Sect Leader...

original_text: 慕容紫英：……璇玑，你与怀朔也先回去吧，此事我自会去求见掌门……
translation: Murong Ziying: ... Xuanji, you and Huaishuo go back first. I will go see the Sect Leader about this matter...

original_text: 璇玑：我也去——
translation: Xuanji: I'm going too-

original_text: 怀朔：师妹，听师叔的话吧，你去了，也不一定能帮上忙。
translation: Huaishuo: Martial Sister, listen to Martial Uncle. Even if you go, you might not be able to help.

original_text: 璇玑：……好吧……
translation: Xuanji: ...Alright...

original_text: 云天河：菱纱，你别理那些人，他们再敢乱说，我就直接打人了！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Lingsha, ignore those people. If they dare talk nonsense again, I'll just hit them!

original_text: 韩菱纱：天河……你冷静点……
translation: Han Lingsha: Tianhe...Calm down...

original_text: 柳梦璃：对啊，那些人根本什么都不明白，只是一派胡言……
translation: Liu Mengli: Right, those people don't understand anything at all. They're just talking nonsense...

original_text: 韩菱纱：谢谢你们，我不在意的。
translation: Han Lingsha: Thank you, I don't mind.

original_text: 韩菱纱：一想到炎帝神农洞的事，心里就难过得不得了，和那一比，这些小事又算得了什么呢？
translation: Han Lingsha: Just thinking about the events at Shennong Cave makes me unbearably sad. Compared to that, what do these trivial matters matter?

original_text: 慕容紫英：菱纱，你以前……真的是……？
translation: Murong Ziying: Lingsha, did you... really use to...?

original_text: 韩菱纱：……是什么？如果我真的是贼，你会怎样？也要看不起我吗？
translation: Han Lingsha: ... What is it? If I really were a thief, what would you do? Would you look down on me too?

original_text: 慕容紫英：……我……我不知道，偷窃虽是品行不端，但或许你有你的理由……
translation: Murong Ziying: ... I... I don't know. Although stealing reflects poor character, perhaps you have your reasons...

original_text: 韩菱纱：哈，有你这句话，也不枉我们相识一场～
translation: Han Lingsha: Ha, with those words from you, our acquaintance wasn't in vain~

original_text: 韩菱纱：你放心，我啊，只是拿死人的钱财去接济一下活着的人，伤天害理的事情是绝对不做的，更看不上琼华派的什么书本刀剑。
translation: Han Lingsha: Don't worry, I only take money from the dead to help the living. I absolutely never do anything harmful or immoral, and I have no interest in Qionghua Sect's books or swords.

original_text: 慕容紫英：……走！<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>我们去琼华宫找掌门，</colour><dc0>请她宽待此事！</dc0>
translation: Murong Ziying: ...Let's go!<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> We'll head to Qionghua Palace to find the Sect Leader,</colour><dc0>and plead for leniency in this matter!</dc0>

original_text: 韩菱纱：不用了吧？我不想去……
translation: Han Lingsha: No need, right? I don't want to go...

original_text: 慕容紫英：不行！
translation: Murong Ziying: No!

original_text: 慕容紫英：你们如想继续修行，此事一定要妥善而为，我们势必得见掌门一面。
translation: Murong Ziying: If you wish to continue cultivating, this matter must be handled properly. We must see the sect leader without fail.

original_text: 韩菱纱：……好吧，也许你说的没错。
translation: Han Lingsha: ... Alright, maybe you're right.

original_text: 虚邑：紫英师兄，掌门有命，任何人都不得靠近琼华宫。
translation: Xuyi: Martial Brother Ziying, Sect Leader has ordered that no one is allowed near Qionghua Palace.

original_text: 慕容紫英：……何事如此慎重？
translation: Murong Ziying: ... What matter is so serious?

original_text: 虚邑：掌门只说有要事待办，不能打扰，或许半日，或许一日。
translation: Xuyi: The Sect Leader only said there were important matters to attend to and must not be disturbed-perhaps half a day, perhaps a full day.

original_text: 慕容紫英：知道了，多谢。
translation: Murong Ziying: Understood, thank you.

original_text: 慕容紫英：实在不巧，我们且在这里等一等吧。
translation: Murong Ziying: Quite unfortunate, let's wait here for a while.

original_text: 云天河：……月亮好大，像个饼……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... The moon is so big, like a pancake...

original_text: 韩菱纱：什么饼……难道你又肚子饿了？
translation: Han Lingsha: What pancake... are you hungry again?

original_text: 慕容紫英：……回去吧，已经这么晚了，掌门是不会见我们了。不如一早我再来求见……
translation: Murong Ziying: ... Let's leave. It's so late already; Sect leader won't see us. I'll come again early tomorrow to request an audience...

original_text: 云天河：紫英……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Ziying...

original_text: 云天河：你觉得，在山上很快乐吗？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Do you feel happy living on Kunlun Mountain?

original_text: 慕容紫英：菱纱也问过我一样的话，我的回答还是不变。
translation: Murong Ziying: Lingsha asked me the same question, and my answer remains unchanged.

original_text: 慕容紫英：求仙问道、斩妖除魔，乃是我一生所向，能做自己想做的事，又怎会不快乐？
translation: Murong Ziying: Seeking immortality and the Dao, slaying demons and yaoguais-this is my life's pursuit. Doing what I want, how could I not be happy?

original_text: 云天河：可是，修仙好像就是些心法口诀，无聊透了，要想行侠仗义，更是不修仙也能做，干嘛不能过以前那种日子呢？
translation: Yun Tianhe: But cultivating immortality seems to be all about mental techniques and incantation-utterly boring. As for upholding justice, you don't need immortality to do that. Why can't we just live like we used to?

original_text: 慕容紫英：并非如此……
translation: Murong Ziying: That's not the case...

original_text: 云天河：我之前总想不通，既然御剑这么好玩，为什么爹来了又要走？可如今我算明白了……
translation: Yun Tianhe: I couldn't understand before, since Sword Flight is so fun, why did father come and then leave? But now I think I understand...

original_text: 云天河：一路上看了许多事，像是琴姬离开了自己最重要的人，去山上做剑仙，可是她一点也不开心……炎帝神农洞的那对姐妹，更是很惨很惨……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Along the way, I've seen many things, like Qin Ji leaving her most important person to become a sword immortal on a mountain, but she wasn't happy at all... And that pair of sisters in the Shennong Cave, their fate was even more tragic...

original_text: 云天河：我这才知道，原来修仙并不是那么好的事，它也会要人伤心、要人性命的……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Only now do I realize that cultivating immortality isn't so great-it can also bring heartache and cost lives...

original_text: 慕容紫英：不对！你怎能以偏概全？
translation: Murong Ziying: Wrong! How can you overgeneralize like that?

original_text: 云天河：……可能我比较笨吧，只能想成这样。
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... Maybe I'm a bit dumb; I can only think of it this way.

original_text: 韩菱纱：什么？！那你的意思是我和你一样笨？
translation: Han Lingsha: What?! In that case, I am just dumb as you!

original_text: 韩菱纱：我也觉得仙山上和自己想的差好多啊，长生之法一点着落都没，我是不是该去其他的修仙门派看看？这里不但没有一个不老不死的仙人，还跟山下一样，有许多让人开心不起来的事……不，是更不开心！
translation: Han Lingsha: I also feel the immortal mountain is quite different from what I imagined. There's no sign of longevity art at all. Should I go check out other sects? Not only is there no immortal who never ages or dies, but just like the mortal world, there are many things that make you unhappy... no, even unhappier!

original_text: 云天河：哦～原来菱纱你也这么想？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Oh~ so Lingsha, you think so too?

original_text: 云天河：那梦璃呢？
translation: Yun Tianhe: What about Mengli?

original_text: 柳梦璃：我？我原本就是想要出门游历，并不在乎修不修仙，只要和你们一起，去哪里也是一样的……
translation: Liu Mengli: Me? I just wanted to travel, and didn't care much about cultivating immortality. As long as I'm with you two, anywhere is fine...

original_text: 柳梦璃：琼华派确实很强大，但注重的并非菱纱所求的长生之道。既然云公子不想待这里，梦璃也不会想留下。
translation: Liu Mengli: Qionghua Sect is indeed powerful, but its focus isn't the path to longevity that Lingsha seeks. Since Yun doesn't wish to stay, neither will Mengli.

original_text: 云天河：……那好，就这么定了！帮完大哥之后，我们一起下山吧！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Alright then, it's settled! After helping Big Brother, let's leave together!

original_text: 慕容紫英：天河？！
translation: Murong Ziying: Tianhe?!

original_text: 云天河：你别担心，我们就先住在山下，万一那个什么妖界打过来了，还能帮到你！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Don't worry. We'll just live at the foot of Kunlun mountain. If that so-called yao realm attacks, we can still help you!

original_text: 慕容紫英：……我哪里是担心这个？妖界实力之强，凭你们几人对战局又能有多少影响？
translation: Murong Ziying: ... Why would I worry about that? The yao realm's strength is immense; what difference can a few of you make in the battle?

original_text: 慕容紫英：我不过是……
translation: Murong Ziying: I'm merely...

original_text: 韩菱纱：嘻，知道了，小紫英是舍不得我们，对吧？
translation: Han Lingsha: Heh, I know, Little Ziying can't bear to part with us, right?

original_text: 慕容紫英：……你们如此来去匆匆，可确实想清楚了？
translation: Murong Ziying: ... You are in such a hurry to come and go, but are you truly certain?

original_text: 韩菱纱：紫英，你听我说……如果修仙是你觉得最快乐的事，那你就一直一直坚持下去。
translation: Han Lingsha: Ziying, listen... If cultivating immortality is what makes you happiest, then you should keep at it, forever and ever.

original_text: 韩菱纱：我、天河，还有梦璃，我们也要去找其它更想做的事。
translation: Han Lingsha: Me, Tianhe, and Mengli, we are going to find other things we truly want to do.

original_text: 韩菱纱：以前，我因为一些事情，偶尔会很消沉很难过，自从认识你们，想了很多，不少事反而豁然开朗了，最重要的不是周围的人和物，而是一个人自己的心境吧～
translation: Han Lingsha: In the past, because of certain things, I would sometimes feel very down and sad. Since meeting you all, I've thought a lot, and many things have become clear. The most important thing isn't the people or things around you, but one's own state of mind~

original_text: 韩菱纱：紫英，你要答应我，即使我们都下山了，你也要过得开开心心，做一个最厉害的剑侠～
translation: Han Lingsha: Ziying, you must promise me, even after we all leave here, you must live happily and become the most formidable swordsman~

original_text: 韩菱纱：如果哪天剑侠变成了剑仙，不要忘了来看看我啊～
translation: Han Lingsha: If one day the swordsman becomes a truly sword immortal, don't forget to come visit me~

original_text: 云天河：对！也不要忘记我，我请你吃好吃的烤猪，哈哈～
translation: Yun Tianhe: Yes! Don't forget me either, I'll treat you a delicious roast pig, haha~

original_text: 慕容紫英：我答应你们…………承君此诺，必守一生。
translation: Murong Ziying: I promise you all... I give you my word, and I will keep it for a lifetime.

original_text: 韩菱纱：哎～今天讲了好多平时不会讲的话，一点都不像我了～
translation: Han Lingsha: Ah~ I said a lot of things today I normally wouldn't say. It's not like me at all~

original_text: 柳梦璃：人世生离，难免有些伤感……
translation: Liu Mengli: Partings in the mortal world, are inevitably a bit sad...

original_text: 云天河：别这样啦，我们又不是马上就走，还得帮大哥找到第三样寒器呢！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Don't be like that. We're not leaving right away. We still need to help Big Brother find the third cold artifact!

original_text: 韩菱纱：对啊，<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>只差最后一件在巢湖附近的了，天亮以后就去找吧，</colour><dc0>一定没问题的！</dc0>
translation: Han Lingsha: Right,<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> only the last piece near Chao Lake is left. Let's go find it after dawn,</colour><dc0> it'll be fine for sure!</dc0>

original_text: 明尘：咦？！你不就是那个女飞贼师妹？怎么紫英师叔还允许你下山吗？
translation: Mingchen: Huh?! Aren't you that thief-Martial-Sister? How come Martial Uncle Ziying still allows you to leave the mountain?

original_text: 云天河：你说什么？！
translation: Yun Tianhe: What did you say?!

original_text: 明尘：没、没什么！其实啊，我觉得师妹肯定不是那样的人，其他人也未免太疑神疑鬼了！
translation: Mingchen: N-nothing! Actually, I think Martial Sister definitely isn't that kind of person. Others are just being overly suspicious!

original_text: 韩菱纱：少来……你有没有看见紫英？
translation: Han Lingsha: Cut it out... have you seen Ziying?

original_text: 明尘：师叔？
translation: Mingchen: Martial Uncle?

original_text: 明尘：有啊有啊，我看到他御剑回来，不过那个时候师叔的表情真可怕，从来没见他那么生气的样子，吓得其他弟子都不敢靠近……
translation: Mingchen: Yes, yes, I saw him return on his sword, but at that time, his expression was terrifying-never seen him so angry before, scaring the other disciples from approaching...

original_text: 韩菱纱：那现在呢？他在哪里？
translation: Han Lingsha: And now? Where is he?

original_text: 明尘：这个嘛，掌门突然把长老和一些弟子都召了去，好像有什么大事要说，师叔他也去了。
translation: Mingchen: Well, the sect leader suddenly summoned the elders and some disciples, as if there's important news. Martial Uncle went too.

original_text: 韩菱纱：天河，<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>我们还是先去找玄霄吧……</colour>
translation: Han Lingsha: Tianhe, <colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>we should go find Xuanxiao first...</colour>

original_text: 明尘：玄……霄？玄霄是谁？是本派玄字辈的？可是也从没听过这名字……
translation: Mingchen: Xuan...xiao? Who is Xuanxiao? A 'Xuan' generation member of our sect? But I've never heard the name...

original_text: 韩菱纱：管那么多干嘛？又不是你认识的人……而且我明明说那么小声，居然还拉长了耳朵听……
translation: Han Lingsha: Why bother so much? That is not a name you know... And I clearly whispered, yet you still eavesdropped...

original_text: 韩菱纱：真、讨、厌！
translation: Han Lingsha: REALLY ANNOYING!

original_text: 明尘：…………我只是……只是……
translation: Mingchen: ...I just... I just...

original_text: 韩菱纱：天河，我们走。
translation: Han Lingsha: Tianhe, let's go.

original_text: 云天河：……菱纱，让我一个人去好吗？
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... Lingsha, let me go alone, okay?

original_text: 云天河：我心里还是不舒坦，想要单独和大哥说说话……
translation: Yun Tianhe: I still feel uneasy inside. I want to talk with big brother alone...

original_text: 韩菱纱：……好吧，我去打听打听到底发生了什么大事，待会儿再见。
translation: Han Lingsha: ... Alright, I'll go inquire about what major event has happened. See you later.

original_text: 云天河：好……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Okay...

original_text: 明尘：师妹！
translation: Mingchen: Martial Sister!

original_text: 韩菱纱：嗯？有事？
translation: Han Lingsha: Hm? Something up?

original_text: 明尘：师妹你别再犯错了……要是惹得掌门发怒，你真会被逐下山的！
translation: Mingchen: Martial Sister, don't make mistakes again... If you anger the Sect Leader, you really will be expelled from the mountain!

original_text: 韩菱纱：……
translation: Han Lingsha: ...

original_text: 韩菱纱：我知道了，谢谢你的关心～～
translation: Han Lingsha: I understand, thank you for your concern~~

original_text: 明尘：师妹……
translation: Mingchen: Martial Sister...

original_text: 玄霄：天河……怎么回事？你气息混乱、神色不定，出了什么事？
translation: Xuanxiao: Tianhe... what's wrong? Your energy is chaotic, your expression unsettled, what happened?

original_text: 玄霄：莫非……是修炼凝冰诀，寒气侵入经络……
translation: Xuanxiao: Could it be... from practicing Cryomancy, the cold energy invaded the meridians...

original_text: 云天河：大哥，我身体没事，好得很……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Big brother, my meridians are fine, really...

original_text: 玄霄：嗯……看来你的体质的确非同一般，实在令人……
translation: Xuanxiao: Hmm... It seems your constitution is indeed extraordinary, truly remarkable...

original_text: 玄霄：……既然无恙，为何气息如此混乱？
translation: Xuanxiao: ... Since your meridians are fine, why is your energy so chaotic?

original_text: 云天河：……大哥，你以前……和别人吵过架吗？是和自己很要好的朋友……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... Big Brother, have you ever... argued with someone before? With a very close friend...

original_text: 玄霄：……为何有此一问？
translation: Xuanxiao: ... Why do you ask?

original_text: 云天河：我和紫英……发生了一些事情，我们都很生对方的气，我不知道……要怎样才能变回以前那样……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Ziying and I... something happened between us. We're both really angry at each other. I don't know... how to go back to how we were before...

original_text: 玄霄：慕容紫英？那定是他的不对了！
translation: Xuanxiao: Murong Ziying? Then it must be his fault!

original_text: 云天河：……虽然我觉得自己没有错，可是对紫英说了那些话，又觉得后悔……我这人不大会说话，有时越搞越糟……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... Although I don't think I was wrong, after saying those things to Ziying, I feel regretful... I'm not very good with words; sometimes I just make things worse...

original_text: 云天河：大哥，你说我该怎么办？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Big brother, what should I do?

original_text: 玄霄：人既有七情六欲，彼此相处，发生争执乃是寻常，不过只要今生今世还能见面，就一定有挽回的余地……
translation: Xuanxiao: Since humans have emotions and desires, conflicts in interactions are common. But as long as two can meet again in this life, there's always room for reconciliation...

original_text: 玄霄：……最怕黯然分别，从此天各一方，直至老死，就算想求得对方的原谅，也永远没有机会了……
translation: Xuanxiao: ... The worst situation would be a sorrowful parting, where each goes their separate way to the ends of the earth until death, and even if one wishes to seek the other's forgiveness, there is never another chance...

original_text: 云天河：大哥，你……遇到过那种事吗？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Big brother, ... have you experienced that kind of thing?

original_text: 玄霄：…………以前年少气盛，曾经伤了一个人的心，等到许久之后冷静下来，才明白大错已成……
translation: Xuanxiao: ............ In my youthful arrogance, I once hurt someone's heart. Only after much time had passed and I calmed down did I realize the grave mistake had already been made...

original_text: 云天河：你破冰出来以后，可以再去找那个人吗？
translation: Yun Tianhe: After you break out of the ice, can you go find that person again?

original_text: 玄霄：……她死了……
translation: Xuanxiao: ... She's dead...

original_text: 玄霄：……阴阳两隔便已无解，除非时光倒流，不然一切都只是枉然……
translation: Xuanxiao: ... Once separated by death, there is no solution. Unless time flows backward, everything is in vain...

original_text: 玄霄：所以……你与慕容紫英之事，倒不必如此沮丧，与其茫然无措，不如鼓足勇气与他说上几句话，或许事情会有意想不到的转机。
translation: Xuanxiao: So... regarding your matter with Murong Ziying, don't be so disheartened. Rather than feeling lost, gather your courage and speak a few words to him. Perhaps things will take an unexpected turn.

original_text: 云天河：我明白了！谢谢大哥，我一定在下山之前去找紫英！
translation: Yun Tianhe: I understand! Thank you, brother. I'll definitely find Ziying before leaving the mountain!

original_text: 玄霄：下山？
translation: Xuanxiao: Leaving the mountain?

original_text: 云天河：大哥，我、我不打算继续待在琼华派了，今天是最后一次来禁地。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Big Brother, I... I don't plan to stay at Qionghua Sect anymore. This is the last time I'll come to the forbidden areas.
Xuanxiao: ...!

original_text: 玄霄：夙瑶逐你们下山？！
translation: Xuanxiao: Did Suyao expell you from Kunlun mountain?!

original_text: 云天河：没有啊……是我自己不喜欢这里。
translation: Yun Tianhe: No... it's just that I myself don't like things here.

original_text: 云天河：以前我住在青鸾峰上，还以为天底下所有的地方都一个样，后来菱纱告诉我，山下和山上完全不同，我觉得新鲜好玩，又想打听爹和娘的事，就高高兴兴跑了出来。
translation: Yun Tianhe: I used to live on Qingluan Peak and thought every place in the world was the same. Later, Lingsha told me that down the mountain is completely different from up there. I found it fresh and fun, and I also wanted to ask about my father and mother, so I happily ran out.

original_text: 云天河：一路上也挺不错，但是进了琼华派，我有点讨厌这里的人……当然不是大哥你，也不是紫英，而是其他弟子，他们骂菱纱是小贼，还想把她赶下山，我实在很生气……
translation: Yun Tianhe: The journey has been pretty good, but after joint Qionghua Sect, I've come to dislike some people here... Of course not you, nor Ziying, but the other disciples. They called Lingsha a thief and wanted to drive her away. I was really angry...

original_text: 玄霄：……这么说来，你要走，却是为了那个姑娘？
translation: Xuanxiao: ... So you're leaving because of that girl?

original_text: 云天河：也不全是吧，反正我待在琼华派就觉得浑身不自在……再说，要帮大哥找的三件寒器也全找到了，这事才是我最挂心的，现在总算有个交代。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Not entirely... Anyway, I just feel restless staying at Qionghua Sect... Besides, we've already found all three cold artifacts needed to help Big Brother. That matter was my greatest concern, and now it's finally settled.

original_text: 玄霄：……！至阴至寒之物，都已找全？！
translation: Xuanxiao: ...! The ultimate yin and cold items, you've found them all?!

original_text: 云天河：是啊，我进来时脑子里一团乱，竟然忘了说……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Yes, when I came in, my mind was a mess, I actually forgot to say...

original_text: 云天河：大哥，你看！这就是长老说的另外两样东西，梭罗果和鲲鳞～
translation: Yun Tianhe: Big brother, look! These are the other two things Elders mentioned, the Suoluo Fruit and Kun Scale~

original_text: 玄霄：……好、好！我等这一日，已等了太久太久！天河，你帮了大哥很多！帮了琼华派很多！
translation: Very well, very well! I have waited for this day far too long! Tianhe, you have helped me greatly! Helped the Qionghua Sect greatly!

original_text: 玄霄：以时机来说，确是分毫不差……
translation: Xuanxiao: In terms of timing, it is indeed perfectly precise...

original_text: 云天河：时机？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Timing?

original_text: 玄霄：……没什么。天河，若是大哥希望你留下，你也不愿吗？
translation: Xuanxiao: ... It's nothing. Tianhe, if your big brother hoped you would stay, wouldn't you be willing either?

original_text: 云天河：啊？…………大哥，这里真的不是我喜欢的地方，你破冰以后要是想见我，就来山下播仙镇吧，我和菱纱、梦璃都有点担心妖界的事，暂时不会走远的。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Huh?......Brother, I truly don't like this place. After you break the ice, if you want to see me, come to Boxian Town below. Lingsha, Mengli, and I are worried about the yao realm and won't go far.

original_text: 玄霄：如此说来，你下山的心意已决，大哥多说也无用了……
translation: Xuanxiao: So it seems your resolve to leave the mountain is firm. Big brother saying more is useless...

original_text: 云天河：大哥，对不起……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Big brother, I'm sorry...

original_text: 玄霄：无妨。人各有志，岂能相强。
translation: Xuanxiao: It's fine. Everyone has their own will; I cannot force you.

original_text: 玄霄：妖界之事你不必过于担心，我有凝冰诀护体，再收融三寒器之力，往昔修为定能毫无顾忌地施展，其他小妖都不足为虑，唯一要注意的只有那妖界之主……
translation: Xuanxiao: You needn't worry too much about the yao realm. With Cryomancy protecting my body and absorbing the power of Three Cold Artifacts, I can unleash my past cultivation without restraint. The lesser yaos are of no concern; the only one to watch out for is the Mistress of the Yao Realm...

original_text: 云天河：那是谁？比大哥你还厉害吗？……比我爹呢？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Who's that? More powerful than even you, Big Brother? ...What about my father?

original_text: 玄霄：……我当年另有他事分心，并未亲眼所见，但我师父，前代掌门太清真人与那妖物缠斗，竟也不敌身死……有弟子说，妖界之主身法诡秘，如幻影飘忽，一招一式尽是俐落狠毒，绝非易与之辈……
translation: Xuanxiao: ...Back then, I was distracted by other matters and didn't witness it personally, but my master, the former Sect Leader, Taiqing Perfected Person, fought that demonic creature and was ultimately defeated and killed... Some disciples said the Mistress of the Yao Realm moved with eerie, phantom-like agility, every strike precise and vicious-definitely not an easy foe...

original_text: 云天河：听起来很厉害……那要怎么样才能打赢他？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Sounds impressive... so how do we beat her?

original_text: 玄霄：……以我今日之力，也未必会居于下风。
translation: Xuanxiao: ... With my current strength, I might not be at a disadvantage.

original_text: 玄霄：不过……大哥尚有一事相求，不知你能否答应？
translation: Xuanxiao: But... I have one more request. I wonder if you can agree?

original_text: 云天河：什么事？大哥你尽管说。
translation: Yun Tianhe: What is it? Big brother, just say it.

original_text: 玄霄：你身上望舒剑可否借我一用？因羲和、望舒原是配剑，我运功破冰，除去三寒器之外，还需双剑的阴阳之力配合。
translation: Xuanxiao: May I borrow Wangshu Sword you carry? Because Xihe and Wangshu were originally paired swords. To break the ice through my cultivation, besides Three Cold Artifacts, I also need the combined yin-yang power of the dual swords.

original_text: 云天河：这个啊～大哥尽管拿去，反正这本来就是琼华派的东西，与其留给那个小气掌门，不如留给你比较好。
translation: Yun Tianhe: This? Big brother, just take it. After all, it originally belonged to Qionghua Sect. Rather than leaving it for that stingy sect leader, it's better to leave it with you.

original_text: 玄霄：……多谢。
translation: Xuanxiao: ... Thank you.

original_text: 玄霄：天河，你助我良多，玄霄永志难忘。
translation: Xuanxiao: Tianhe, you have helped me greatly, Xuanxiao will never forget.

original_text: 云天河：说什么……我们都是兄弟了，帮你是应该的吧？
translation: Yun Tianhe: What's there to say... we're all brothers now, helping you is only right, isn't it?

original_text: 玄霄：是啊，兄弟……
translation: Xuanxiao: Yes, brother...

original_text: 玄霄：……你且走吧，此地玄冰非一时半刻能够破除，而我运功定会波及四周，恐怕要误伤于你。
translation: Xuanxiao: ... You should leave. The profound ice here cannot be broken in a short time, and my energy exertion will affect the surroundings, likely harming you by accident.

original_text: 云天河：好。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Okay.

original_text: 云天河：大哥你从禁地出来以后，要是我已经不在琼华派，千万别忘了来山下看看我～
translation: Yun Tianhe: Big brother, after you leave the forbidden area, if I'm no longer at Qionghua Sect, don't forget to come see me down the mountain~

original_text: 玄霄：…………我相信，你我缘分不会如此之浅……
translation: Xuanxiao: ............ I believe our bond won't be so shallow...

original_text: 云天河：（……呃，大哥这样讲，到底是答应了还是没答应呢？）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (...Huh, with Big Brother saying that, did he agree or not?)

original_text: 玄霄：你去吧……
translation: Xuanxiao: Off may go...

original_text: 玄霄：十九年的遗憾……
translation: Xuanxiao: Nineteen years of regret...

original_text: 玄霄：为前人所不能为之事，否则人生一世，还有何意！
translation: Xuanxiao: To accomplish what no one before has ever achieved-otherwise, what meaning is there in a lifetime!

original_text: 玄霄：玄、霄、誓、灭、妖、界！！！
translation: Xuanxiao: XUANXIAO-VOWS-TO-DESTROY-THE-YAO-REALM!!!

original_text: 云天河：（……对啊，都打算走了，这身衣服干脆换下来，虽然料子软软的，有点舍不得……）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (...Right, since we're leaving, might as well change out of these clothes. Though the fabric's soft, kind of reluctant...)

original_text: 云天河：……这个香气……是梦璃？
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... This fragrance... is it Mengli?

original_text: 柳梦璃：……对不起，云公子，我并不是有意吵醒你的……
translation: Liu Mengli: ... I'm sorry, Yun, I didn't mean to wake you...

original_text: 云天河：没、没什么，我睡得也不是很熟啊。
translation: Yun Tianhe: No, nothing, I wasn't sleeping very soundly either.

original_text: 云天河：咦？你这身打扮……哈哈！我们俩想到一块去了，都不肯再穿琼华派的衣服～
translation: Yun Tianhe: Huh? Your outfit... Haha! We thought alike, both refusing to wear Qionghua Sect clothes anymore~

original_text: 云天河：梦璃？你怎么了？是不是去了寿阳，事情办得不顺？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Mengli? What's wrong? Did things not go well in Shouyang?

original_text: 云天河：那是……有人欺负你？！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Is that... someone bullying you?!

original_text: 柳梦璃：……云公子，你喜欢梦璃吗？
translation: Liu Mengli: ... Yun, do you like Mengli?

original_text: 云天河：我、我……这个……
translation: Yun Tianhe: I, I... emm...

original_text: 云天河：喜、喜欢啊……你怎么、突然问这个……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Li-like... How come you're suddenly asking this...

original_text: 柳梦璃：……现在我的心里好乱，我不知道该怎么说，我……舍不得许多人……
translation: Liu Mengli: ...My heart is in such turmoil now. I don't know how to say it... I can't bear to part with so many people...

original_text: 柳梦璃：我唯一能想到的，就是来见云公子……
translation: Liu Mengli: The only thing I could think of was to come see you, Yun...

original_text: 云天河：舍不得很多人？梦璃你、到底怎么了？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Can't bear to part with many people? Mengli, what's wrong with you?

original_text: 柳梦璃：云公子，你……真的喜欢梦璃吗？
translation: Liu Mengli: Yun, you... Do you really like Mengli?

original_text: 云天河：喜欢……还分真的假的？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Liking someone... there's real and fake?

original_text: 柳梦璃：……还记不记得在须臾幻境的酒仙翁那里……云公子听不懂仙翁说的话……
translation: Liu Mengli: ... Do you remember at the Wine Immortal's Illusory Realm... Yun couldn't understand what the Immortal said...

original_text: 柳梦璃：那如今呢……云公子明白了吗？明白我说的又是什么？
translation: Liu Mengli: And now... does Yun understand? Do you understand what I am talking about?

original_text: 云天河：我……还是不太明白……
translation: Yun Tianhe: I... Still don't quite understand...

original_text: 云天河：只是……每次单独和你在一起，好像总是很紧张……气都有些不顺……
translation: Yun Tianhe: It's just... every time I'm alone with you, I always feel very nervous... even my breath gets a bit uneven...

original_text: 柳梦璃：是吗……真是对不起……
translation: Liu Mengli: Is that so... I'm really sorry...

original_text: 云天河：不是不是，你别误会。我只是觉得你……很好看，对我又很好……我大概像菱纱说的，是个傻瓜，所以搞不清对着你该说什么……
translation: Yun Tianhe: No, no, don't misunderstand. I just think you... are very beautiful, and treat me very well... I'm probably a fool like Lingsha says, so I don't know what to say to you...

original_text: 柳梦璃：真的吗……
translation: Liu Mengli: Really...

original_text: 云天河：嗯……只是你平时教我很多东西，我学的越多，越觉得……
translation: Yun Tianhe: It's just that you usually teach me a lot of things. The more I learn, the more I feel...

original_text: 柳梦璃：觉得什么？
translation: Liu Mengli: Feel what?

original_text: 云天河：……我……还是好多事都不懂……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... I... still don't understand many things...

original_text: 云天河：你又聪明，又好看……我们两个真是差太多了……
translation: Yun Tianhe: You're so smart, so pretty... we two are just too different...

original_text: 云天河：…………我、我也不清楚自己在说什么……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ...... I, I'm not sure what I'm saying either...

original_text: 云天河：哈、哈哈……现在又觉得气都有点不顺呢……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Ha, haha... Now I feel like my breath is even a bit uneven...
Yun Tianhe: ...!!

original_text: 云天河：梦梦梦、梦璃！！！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Meng-Meng-Meng-Mengli!!!

original_text: 柳梦璃：……云公子，你还记得吗？你曾经说过，我们要永远在一起……
translation: Liu Mengli: ...Yun, do you remember? You once said we would always be together...

original_text: 云天河：记、记得！
translation: Yun Tianhe: R-remember!

original_text: 柳梦璃：我好后悔……总以为相处的时间还很多，总是自己一个人默默地想着、看着……我有好多话想跟云公子说……
translation: Liu Mengli: I regret so much... I always thought there was plenty of time to be together, always silently thinking and watching alone... I have so much I want to say to Yun...

original_text: 柳梦璃：云公子，你是一个很特别的人，从小到大我从没有跟任何一个人能相处得如此开心……很谢谢你说要保护我……可惜一切都是这么短暂…………
translation: Liu Mengli: Yun, you are a very special person. From childhood to now, I have never gotten along so happily with anyone... Thank you for saying you want to protect me... It's a pity everything is so brief...

original_text: 柳梦璃：我终于能体会琴姬姐姐的心情……人和人的缘分真是注定的，上天要收回的时候，一时一刻都不会多等……
translation: Liu Mengli: I can finally understand Sis. Qin Ji's feelings... The bonds between people are truly predestined. When heaven decides to take them back, it won't wait even a moment longer...

original_text: 柳梦璃：呜……
translation: Liu Mengli: Woo...

original_text: 云天河：梦璃，你、你怎么哭了？！到底怎么了？是不是身体不舒服？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Mengli, you, why are you crying?! What's wrong? Are you feeling unwell?

original_text: 韩菱纱：天河你在吗？我听其他弟子说，不得了了——
translation: Han Lingsha: Tianhe, are you there? I heard from other disciples, something terrible-

original_text: 韩菱纱：你们？……
translation: Han Lingsha: You? ...

original_text: 柳梦璃：云公子……对不起，我……
translation: Liu Mengli: Yun... I'm sorry, I...

original_text: 柳梦璃：多保重，梦璃会将你永远放在心里记着……永远记着……
translation: Liu Mengli: Take good care. Mengli will always keep you in her heart... always...

original_text: 云天河：梦璃！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Mengli!

original_text: 韩菱纱：这是……怎么一回事？
translation: Han Lingsha: What...What is happening?

original_text: 云天河：你问我、我也不知道啊……
translation: Yun Tianhe: How should I know...

original_text: 韩菱纱：你装傻啊？梦璃抱着你，然后又哭着跑了出去……
translation: Han Lingsha: Are you playing dumb? Mengli hugged you, then ran out crying...

original_text: 韩菱纱：你、你是不是欺负她了？
translation: Han Lingsha: You, did you bully her?

original_text: 云天河：没有啊，我真的不知道！
translation: Yun Tianhe: No, I really don't know!

original_text: 云天河：她……
translation: Yun Tianhe: She...

original_text: 云天河：感觉不太对劲……说话怪怪的……我现在就去找她，问清楚怎么回事。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Something feels off... her words were strange... I'll go find her now and ask what's going on.

original_text: 韩菱纱：呀——！
translation: Han Lingsha: Yaa-!

original_text: 云天河：房子、房子怎么会动？！
translation: Yun Tianhe: The house, how is the house shaking?!

original_text: 韩菱纱：不是房子！是整个山在震啊！大概真像其他弟子说的那样！妖界已经出现了！
translation: Han Lingsha: Not the house! The whole mountain is shaking! Maybe it's really like the other disciples said! The yao realm has appeared!

original_text: 云天河：妖界出现了？！大哥不知现在怎样了！
translation: Yun Tianhe: The yao realm appeared?! I wonder how big brother is doing now!

original_text: 云天河：不对，我要赶紧出去追梦璃，万一她遇到危险怎么办！
translation: Yun Tianhe: No, I need to hurry out and chase Mengli, what if she encounters danger!

original_text: 韩菱纱：唔……
translation: Han Lingsha: Hmm...

original_text: 云天河：菱纱？！！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Lingsha?!!

original_text: 云天河：菱纱！菱纱你怎么了？！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Lingsha! Lingsha, are you alright?!

original_text: 韩菱纱：嗯……
translation: Han Lingsha: Hmm...

original_text: 云天河：菱纱！你醒了？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Lingsha! Are you awake?

original_text: 韩菱纱：……我、我昏倒了吗？
translation: Han Lingsha: ...Did I... faint?

original_text: 韩菱纱：刚才有一瞬间，突然全身的力气都没了……
translation: Han Lingsha: Just now, for a moment, all my strength suddenly vanished...

original_text: 云天河：我现在就去找琼华派的大夫、不，还是先去找紫英，让他来看看怎么回事！
translation: Yun Tianhe: I'll go find a Qionghua Sect doctor right now-no, better find Ziying first, let him see what's wrong!

original_text: 韩菱纱：不用了……我到底昏过去多久？你有没有找到梦璃？
translation: Han Lingsha: No need... How long was I out? Did you find Mengli?

original_text: 云天河：我还没有去，你这样，我不敢离开。
translation: Yun Tianhe: I haven't gone yet. With you like this, I don't dare leave.

original_text: 韩菱纱：什么？那你快点、快点去找她呀……
translation: Han Lingsha: What? Then hurry, hurry up and go find her...

original_text: 韩菱纱：妖界来了，外面说不定很危险——
translation: Han Lingsha: The yao realm is here, outside might be dangerous-

original_text: 云天河：可是……我走了，你怎么办？
translation: Yun Tianhe: But...If I leave, what will you do?

original_text: 韩菱纱：我没事的……最近几个月常常头晕，一时半会儿又不会怎样，<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>你先去找梦璃……</colour>
translation: Han Lingsha: I'm fine... I've been getting dizzy often these past few months, but it won't be a problem for now.<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> You go find Mengli first...</colour>

original_text: 云天河：话是这么说没错，但是……
translation: Yun Tianhe: That's true, but...

original_text: 韩菱纱：快去吧……我在这儿等你们回来，妖怪……妖怪就算再怎么厉害，也不可能马上就杀到屋子里来吧？
translation: Han Lingsha: Go on... I'll wait here for you to return. Monsters... no matter how powerful, surely they can't just storm into the house right away?

original_text: 云天河：……好吧，你自己小心。
translation: Yun Tianhe: ...Alright, be careful yourself.

original_text: 韩菱纱：哎，别多说了，走吧……
translation: Han Lingsha: Hey, enough talk, go...

original_text: 云天河：喂！你有没有看见梦璃？！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Hey! Have you seen Mengli?!

original_text: 怀砚：师弟！你怎么跑出来了？还这副打扮？！
translation: Huai Yan: Martial Brother! Why did you run out? And dressed like this?!

original_text: 怀砚：唉！快快回屋！如今妖界的入口在卷云台现身不久，妖风正盛，修为低一些的弟子抵御不住，便会心神混乱，你千万莫要出来！
translation: Huai Yan: Ah! Hurry back inside! Now that the entrance to the yao realm has recently appeared at Cloud Terrace, yao auras are raging. Disciples with lower cultivation can't resist and will become mentally confused. You must not come out!

original_text: 云天河：先告诉我！你到底有没有看见梦璃？！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Tell me first! Did you see Mengli or not?!

original_text: 怀砚：你、你是说柳师妹？没有啊，她——
translation: Huai Yan: You mean Martial Sister Liu? No, she-

original_text: 怀砚：师弟！师弟——！！
translation: Huai Yan: Martial Brother! Martial Brother-!!

original_text: 明应：天呐！那那那、那就是妖界！入口好像一张狰狞的妖怪脸，实在可怕！
translation: Ming Ying: Heavens! That-that's the yao realm! The entrance looks like a ferocious monster's face. It's truly terrifying!

original_text: 明石：对啊！原本好好的，万里无云，后来只见卷云台上飞出一蓝一赤两道剑光，纠结于半空，紧接着一声巨响，像是从天上硬生生撕开一个大口子，然后就凭空出现了那张妖怪脸……
translation: Mingshi: Exactly! It was perfectly clear, not a cloud in the sky. Then, from Cloud Terrace, two sword beams - one blue, one red - shot out and tangled in mid-air. A tremendous roar followed, as if the sky itself was torn open, and that monstrous face appeared out of nowhere...

original_text: 明应：我、我听师父说过，十九年前那场大战，妖界一出现，天上就落下许多像巨蛋一样的怪东西，从里面出来的妖怪凶恶无比，残杀我派不知多少弟子……
translation: Ming Ying: I... I heard from my master that during the great battle nineteen years ago, as soon as the yao realm appeared, many strange egg-like things fell from the sky. The monsters that emerged were extremely vicious, slaughtering countless disciples of our sect...

original_text: 明石：如今不见什么妖怪出来，却已经妖风四起！那些妖物肯定有阴谋！难怪掌门不许我们靠近卷云台！
translation: Mingshi: Now, no monsters have appeared, yet yao auras already swirl! Those fiends surely have a plot! No wonder the sect leader forbids us from approaching Cloud Terrace!

original_text: 怀理：可、可是……我刚才好像看见有个女孩子跑上了卷云台……
translation: Huaili: B-but... I think I just saw a girl run up onto Cloud Terrace...

original_text: 明石：怎么可能！你眼花了吧？我怎么没看到！
translation: Mingshi: Impossible! You're seeing things! I didn't see anything!

original_text: 怀理：不骗你！就是那个新来没多久的女弟子柳梦璃！说不定你正好走神，才会没看见……
translation: Huaili: Not lying! It's that new female disciple Liu Mengli! Maybe you were just distracted and didn't see...

original_text: 明应：怀理师兄，我看这妖风果然不一般，竟能令人产生幻觉，我们还是早早离开为妙！
translation: Ming Ying: Martial Brother Huaili, this yao aura is truly unusual; it can even cause hallucinations. We should leave as soon as possible!

original_text: 明石：是啊是啊！快点走吧！
translation: Mingshi: Yes, yes! Hurry up and go!

original_text: 怀理：可是……
translation: Huaili: But...

original_text: 明应：走吧！师兄！难道你还要亲自上卷云台察看？！
translation: Ming Ying: Let's go, Martial Brother! Do you still need to personally inspect Cloud Terrace?!
Huaili: I... sigh...

original_text: 云天河：（梦璃她……她跑上了<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>卷云台</colour><dc0>？！</dc0><colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>我要跟去看看！</colour><dc0>）</dc0>
translation: Yun Tianhe: (Mengli... she ran up to the<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> Cloud Terrace</colour><dc0>?!</dc0><colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> I need to go see!</colour><dc0>)</dc0>

original_text: 云天河：（……这是什么……像有一种无形的气，让人连眼睛都睁不开……）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (...What is this... Like an invisible aura, making it hard to even keep my eyes open...)

original_text: 柳梦璃：云公子，你别过来！请你不要过来！
translation: Liu Mengli: Yun, don't come over! Please don't come over!

original_text: 云天河：梦璃……？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Mengli...?

original_text: 柳梦璃：……云公子，在我小的时候，时常会做一个梦，梦见一种不属于人间的景象，那里常年有紫色的雾气弥漫……
translation: Liu Mengli: ... Yun, when I was little, I often had a dream of a scene not of this world, where purple mist lingered all year round...

original_text: 柳梦璃：偶尔……我会猜想自己是从哪里来的，发生过什么事，为什么会被云叔救下呢？
translation: Liu Mengli: Sometimes... I wonder where I came from, what happened, and why Uncle Yun saved me.

original_text: 云天河：梦、梦璃，我们先回去吧，菱纱还在房里等着你！这儿离妖界太近、太危险了！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Meng, Mengli, let's go back first. Lingsha is waiting for you in the room! This place is too close to the yao realm, too dangerous!

original_text: 柳梦璃：……那些事情、梦里的事情，除了爹和娘，我只向你说过……
translation: Liu Mengli: ... Those things, the things from the dream... besides my parents, I've only told you...

original_text: 柳梦璃：那一天，在柳家的庭院里，和你随意地聊着……如今想来，都还是觉得很开心。
translation: Liu Mengli: That day, chatting casually with you in the Liu family courtyard... Thinking back, it still makes me very happy.

original_text: 柳梦璃：幸好，曾经留下了这些回忆……
translation: Liu Mengli: Fortunately, I still have these memories...

original_text: 云天河：……梦璃？你到底在说什么？
translation: Yun Tianhe: ...Mengli? What exactly are you saying?

original_text: 柳梦璃：……我现在想起来了，从之前只是一个模糊的影子，到如今很清晰地出现在我脑海里……
translation: Liu Mengli: ... I remember now. From before, it was just a vague shadow, but now it appears very clearly in my mind...

original_text: 柳梦璃：这个妖界……我就是从这个妖界来的。
translation: Liu Mengli: This yao realm... I came from this very yao realm.

original_text: 云天河：什么？！
translation: Yun Tianhe: What?!

original_text: 柳梦璃：云公子，请你快点带着菱纱下山去吧，若是你不走，或许有一天我们会兵刃相向，我……实在不想那样……
translation: Liu Mengli: Yun, please quickly take Lingsha down the mountain. If you don't leave, perhaps one day we'll end up crossing blades. I... really don't want that to happen...

original_text: 云天河：梦璃，你说什么？我们怎么可能会互斗呢？不可能！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Mengli, what are you saying? How could we possibly fight each other? Impossible!

original_text: 柳梦璃：云公子，你保重……
translation: Liu Mengli: Yun, take care...

original_text: 柳梦璃：梦璃真的很舍不得云公子……
translation: Liu Mengli: Mengli really can't bear to part with Yun...

original_text: 云天河：梦璃！你、你回来！！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Mengli! You, you come back!!

original_text: 云天河：……菱纱……？
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... Lingsha...?

original_text: 云天河：还有紫英？这……是哪里？
translation: Yun Tianhe: And Ziying too? This... where is this?

original_text: 慕容紫英：天河你太过胡闹！！那妖界入口处布有结界，人若想强行穿过，必定会受重伤！所以掌门才不许弟子靠近！
translation: Murong Ziying: Tianhe, you are being far too reckless!! The entrance to the yao realm is protected by a barrier. Any humans trying to force their way through will be severely injured! That's why the sect leader forbids disciples from approaching!

original_text: 慕容紫英：要是我再晚个半刻，你早就性命难保！
translation: Murong Ziying: If I had arrived any later, your life would have been in grave danger!

original_text: 云天河：……会受重伤？可是、可是梦璃她进去了，什么事都没有发生……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... You said severely injured? But... but Mengli went in, and nothing happened to her...

original_text: 韩菱纱：梦璃？！怎么可能？你说她跑进了妖界？！
translation: Han Lingsha: Mengli?! How could it be? You say she ran into the yao realm?!

original_text: 云天河：真的！我没有看错！她还说了一堆很奇怪的话，她说自己是……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Really! I didn't see wrong! She also said a bunch of strange things, she said she was...

original_text: 韩菱纱：是什么？
translation: Han Lingsha: What is it?

original_text: 云天河：……没什么……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... It's nothing...

original_text: 慕容紫英：……莫非……梦璃和妖界有什么关系？不然为何只有她能够通过那个结界？
translation: Murong Ziying: ... Could it be... Mengli has some connection to the yao realm? Otherwise, why is she the only one able to pass through that barrier?

original_text: 韩菱纱：紫英，你不要乱猜！又没有什么凭据！
translation: Han Lingsha: Ziying, don't guess wildly! There's no evidence!

original_text: 云天河：……紫英，我问你，要是梦璃真的是妖，你会怎么办？
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... Ziying, I ask you, if Mengli really is a yao, what would you do?

original_text: 慕容紫英：……梦璃是妖？
translation: Murong Ziying: ... Mengli is a yao?

original_text: 云天河：你回答我，你是不是也要杀了她？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Answer me, are you going to kill her too?

original_text: 慕容紫英：梦璃不可能是妖！她身上没有任何妖气，掌门与长老也未察觉，连师叔都没有说什么，你不要乱想。
translation: Murong Ziying: Mengli cannot be a yao! She has no yaoguai's aura; the sect leader and elders sensed nothing, and even Martial Uncle said nothing. Don't talk nonsense.

original_text: 云天河：可是梦璃她自己说……
translation: Yun Tianhe: But Mengli herself said...

original_text: 云天河：你让开，我要去找梦璃。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Move aside, I need to find Mengli.

original_text: 慕容紫英：胡闹！你被弹开之后，那妖界入口根本纹丝不动！凭你想要穿过那个结界，根本是不可能的！
translation: Murong Ziying: Nonsense! After you were repelled, the yao realm entrance didn't budge at all! With your strength, trying to pass through that barrier is utterly impossible!

original_text: 云天河：……那我去找大哥，他以前和妖界交过手，一定有办法的！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Then I'll go find Big Brother. He's fought the yao realm before; he must have a way!

original_text: 韩菱纱：我也和你一起去！
translation: Han Lingsha: I'll go with you too!

original_text: 慕容紫英：你身体尚虚，最好再多静养。
translation: Murong Ziying: You're still weak, better rest more.

original_text: 韩菱纱：我、我没关系，梦璃的事更重要吧？
translation: Han Lingsha: I-I'm fine, isn't Mengli's matter more important?

original_text: 韩菱纱：如果不是我突然晕倒……也许……天河就能拦住她了……
translation: Han Lingsha: If I hadn't suddenly fainted... maybe... Tianhe could have stopped her...

original_text: 云天河：……和那没关系。
translation: Yun Tianhe: ...that has nothing to do with it.

original_text: 慕容紫英：好吧，要是你们执意去找玄霄师叔，我也一起。
translation: Murong Ziying: Alright, if you insist on finding Xuanxiao, I will join you.

original_text: 云天河：……好，但是不管真相是怎样的，你都不可以伤害梦璃！
translation: Yun Tianhe: ...Fine, but no matter what the truth is, you must not harm Mengli!

original_text: 慕容紫英：……往后的事情，多说无益，如今我只想弄清楚这到底是怎么一回事。
translation: Murong Ziying: ... Speculating about the future is pointless. For now, I just want to understand what exactly is going on.

original_text: 韩菱纱：喂！我说你们两个，与其花时间在这里互看，倒不如快点走！
translation: Han Lingsha: Hey! You two, instead of wasting time staring at each other here, why not hurry up and go!

original_text: 韩菱纱：什么都还没做，自己人就先闹起来啦？
translation: Han Lingsha: Nothing's even started, and we're already fighting among ourselves?

original_text: 慕容紫英：天河，这个给你，拿好。
translation: Murong Ziying: Tianhe, this is for you, take it.

original_text: 云天河：这是……？
translation: Yun Tianhe: This is...?

original_text: 慕容紫英：我替你打造了一把剑——
translation: Murong Ziying: I forged a sword for you-

original_text: 慕容紫英：你且收着。如今妖界降临，任何事情都得小心谨慎，就算你用的是望舒剑，将这支剑带在身边亦无坏处。
translation: Murong Ziying: Please keep this. Now that the yao realm has descended, we must be cautious in all matters. Even though you use Wangshu Sword, carrying this sword with you can do no harm.

original_text: 云天河：……望舒剑……我已经给了大哥，他破冰要用到。
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... Wangshu Sword... I've already given it to Big Brother, he needs it to break the ice.

original_text: 韩菱纱：咦？那不是正好能用这把？
translation: Han Lingsha: Huh? Then this one comes at the perfect time.

original_text: 韩菱纱：我瞧瞧，这剑和望舒长得好像，连颜色都差不多呢。
translation: Han Lingsha: Let me see, this sword looks so much like Wangshu, even the color is similar.

original_text: 慕容紫英：不过是形似罢了，望舒剑所用之材可遇而不可求，何况终我一生，铸剑之术也难及宗炼师公，又如何能再造一把“望舒”……
translation: Murong Ziying: It's merely similar in form. The material used for Wangshu Sword is a rare find, not something one can seek out. Moreover, in my entire life, my sword-forging skill will never reach that of Grandmaster Zonglian. How could I possibly recreate another 'Wangshu'...

original_text: 韩菱纱：别这么说，我知道，你已经很厉害了，而且以你的性情，如果是给朋友用的剑，你一定更会费尽心思去打造……
translation: Han Lingsha: Don't say that. I know you're already very skilled, and with your nature, if it's a sword for a friend, you'd put even more effort into forging it...

original_text: 韩菱纱：我说对了吧？
translation: Han Lingsha: Am I right, huh?

original_text: 慕容紫英：我隐隐觉得，掌门有朝一日必会索回望舒剑，所以在闲暇之时打造了这把剑，希望天河能够用上……却想不到是玄霄师叔破冰会需要望舒……
translation: Murong Ziying: I vaguely feel that Sect leader will one day demand Wangshu Sword back. So in my spare time, I forged this sword, hoping Tianhe could use it... but never thought Xuanxiao would need Wangshu to break the ice...

original_text: 云天河：紫英，谢谢你……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Ziying, thank you...

original_text: 慕容紫英：不必言谢，我只要求一件事，请善待这把剑。
translation: Murong Ziying: No need for thanks, I only ask one thing: please treat this sword well.

original_text: 云天河：……呃，我、我答应你，绝不用它来烧烤……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... Uh, I, I promise you, I'll absolutely never use it for barbecuing...

original_text: 韩菱纱：紫英，它有名字吗？
translation: Han Lingsha: Ziying, does it have a name?

original_text: 慕容紫英：剑的名字，自然是由剑的主人来取。
translation: Murong Ziying: The sword's name should naturally be given by its master.

original_text: 云天河：我、我想叫它“天河剑”，可以吗？……
translation: Yun Tianhe: I, I want to call it 'Tianhe Sword', is that okay? ...

original_text: 慕容紫英：当然。
translation: Murong Ziying: Of course.

original_text: 云天河：……谢谢你，紫英……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... Thank you, Ziying...

original_text: 云天河：在妖界入口也是你救了我，刚才……我不应该那样对你说话……
translation: Yun Tianhe: You saved me at the yao realm entrance too, just now... I shouldn't have spoken to you like that...

original_text: 韩菱纱：紫英啊，就是不坦率，说不定他担心天河，就一直跟在后面呢。
translation: Han Lingsha: Ziying, he's just not straightforward. Maybe he's worried about Tianhe and has been following behind all along.

original_text: 韩菱纱：咦？我说中了？紫英你的脸有点红哎！
translation: Han Lingsha: Huh? Did I hit the mark? Ziying, your face is a bit red!

original_text: 慕容紫英：休要胡闹，当务之急，我们快些去找师叔。
translation: Murong Ziying: Stop fooling around. The urgent matter now is to find our Martial Uncle quickly.

original_text: 韩菱纱：可是，天河已经把三寒器都交给了玄霄，玄霄又说他要破冰而出，现在他人到底在哪里呢？会不会已经不在禁地了？
translation: Han Lingsha: But, Tianhe has already given all three Cold Artifacts to Xuanxiao, and Xuanxiao said he'd break free from the ice. Where is he now? Could he have already left the forbidden area?

original_text: 云天河：不管怎样，<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>我们还是先去禁地看看。</colour>
translation: Yun Tianhe: No matter what,<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> we should go check forbidden area first.</colour>

original_text: 太清真人：玄霄、天青，你二人既是由我亲自教授，切不可懒惰倦怠，何况你们根骨清奇，一看便知是修仙之才，只要勤奋努力，假以时日，必有大成！
translation: Taiqing Perfected Person: Xuanxiao, Tianqing, since I personally taught you two, you must not be lazy or slack. Moreover, your bone structure is extraordinary, clearly showing talent for cultivating immortality. As long as you work diligently, given time, you will surely achieve great success!

original_text: 玄霄：是！师父！
translation: Xuanxiao: Yes! Master!

original_text: 云天青：是，师父。
translation: Yun Tianqing: Yes, Master.

original_text: 太清真人：入门之初，基本的心法最为重要，把我昨日教授你们的，练至第三重境时，再来琼华宫找我。
translation: Taiqing Perfected Person: At the beginning of entry, basic mental techniques are most important. Practice what I taught you yesterday until you reach the third realm, then come find me at Qionghua Palace.

original_text: 玄霄：是！
translation: Xuanxiao: Yes!

original_text: 云天青：唉……第三重境，那要练到哪一天啊，累也累死了……
translation: Yun Tianqing: Sigh... The third realm, when will I ever master that? I'll be exhausted to death...

original_text: 云天青：我说师兄～你我入门两天，吃睡都在一起，好歹也有过同床共枕之谊，可你跟我说话的次数，连十根手指都数不满，也太不够意思了吧？
translation: Yun Tianqing: I say, Martial Brother~ We've been apprentices for two days, eating and sleeping together, at least sharing a bed friendship. Yet you've spoken to me less than ten fingers can count. That's really not very nice, is it?

original_text: 云天青：师兄你倒是说句话啊……
translation: Yun Tianqing: Martial Brother, won't you say something...

original_text: 玄霄：如你这般性情浮躁，说不定几天之后，便受不了练功之苦而放弃，与你说话也是多余。
translation: Xuanxiao: With your impatient temperament, you might give up after a few days, unable to bear the hardship of training. Speaking to you is superfluous.

original_text: 云天青：哎！师兄你去哪里？
translation: Yun Tianqing: Hey! Martial Brother, where are you going?

original_text: 玄霄：……练功！找个清静之地。
translation: Xuanxiao: ... Practice sword! Find a quiet place.

original_text: 云天青：好诈……你想扔下师弟，自己一个人偷偷努力……
translation: Yun Tianqing: So sneaky... You want to leave your Martial Brother behind and work hard alone...

original_text: 云天青：不行，我也要加油！不然和师兄实力相差太远，岂不要被师父念死……
translation: Yun Tianqing: No, I need to work harder too! Otherwise, if I fall too far behind Martial Brother in strength, I'll be lectured to death by Master...

original_text: 云天青：师兄也真是把人看扁了，居然说我受不了练功之苦……怎么可能，我就努力练功跟你玩玩，哈哈！
translation: Yun Tianqing: Martial Brother really looks down on people, saying I can't endure the hardship of training... How could that be? I'll train hard and show you, haha!

original_text: 云天青：唉～～～都练了两个多月，还没到师父说的第三重境，他老人家是不是存心整我们啊……
translation: Yun Tianqing: Sigh~~~ Been practicing over two months, still haven't reached the third realm Master mentioned. Is this old man deliberately messing with us...

original_text: 玄霄：胡闹！自己不够努力，却怪到师父头上！
translation: Xuanxiao: Nonsense! Blaming your master for your own lack of effort!

original_text: 云天青：是是是……你和夙瑶师姐、玄震师兄都是一板一眼的人，就我总犯错……
translation: Yun Tianqing: Yes yes yes... You and Martial Sister Suyao, Martial Brother Xuanzhen are all by-the-book people, I'm always the one messing up...

original_text: 玄霄：我看你待在思返谷，却是很快活。
translation: Xuanxiao: I see you're quite content staying in the Reflection Valley.

original_text: 云天青：思返谷好哇！少了一堆训斥唠叨～不过就是没饭吃，让人有点受不了……
translation: Yun Tianqing: Reflection Valley is great! Fewer scoldings and nagging~ But no food is a bit hard to take...

original_text: 夙汐：两位师兄。
translation: Suxi: Good day! Two Martial Brothers.

original_text: 云天青：哟，是夙汐师妹啊，有何贵干？
translation: Yun Tianqing: Yo, it's Martial Sister Suxi, what brings you here?

original_text: 夙汐：这位是刚入门的夙玉师妹，也已被掌门师伯收入门下。但这几日掌门师伯另有要事忙碌，玄震师兄和夙瑶师姐又都不在门派中，所以请两位师兄多关照她一下。
translation: Suxi: This is the newly entered Martial Sister Suyu, who has also been accepted into the sect by the Sect Leader. But these past few days, the Sect Leader has been busy with other important matters, and Martial Brother Xuanzhen and Martial Sister Suyao are both away from the sect, so please take good care of her.

original_text: 夙汐：夙玉，这便是我说过的玄霄师兄与天青师兄。
translation: Suxi: Suyu, these are the Martial Brother Xuanxiao and Martial Brother Tianqing I mentioned.

original_text: 夙玉：玄霄师兄、天青师兄。
translation: Suyu: Martial Brother Xuanxiao, Martial Brother Tianqing.

original_text: 云天青：哇！你长这么漂亮也来修仙，岂不可惜了？
translation: Yun Tianqing: Wow! Someone as beautiful as you cultivating immortality, what a pity!

original_text: 玄霄：天青，休得胡言乱语。
translation: Xuanxiao: Tianqing, do not speak nonsense.

original_text: 夙玉：……容貌美丑，皆是皮下白骨，表象声色，又有什么分别？
translation: Suyu: ...Appearance, beauty or ugliness, are but skin and bones beneath; what difference do surface sights and sounds make?

original_text: 云天青：唉，你年纪轻轻，便看这么透，岂不是一点也不好玩了……
