translation: Yun Tianqing: Sigh, you're so young yet see things so clearly, isn't that just no fun at all...

original_text: 玄霄：天青！
translation: Xuanxiao: Tianqing!

original_text: 云天青：好，我不说了，还是师兄懂得怜香惜——
translation: Yun Tianqing: Fine, I won't say more. Martial Brother knows how to cherish beauty-

original_text: 云天青：啊！我真的不说了！你别瞪我啊……
translation: Yun Tianqing: Ah! I really won't say anymore! Don't glare at me...

original_text: 夙玉：……
translation: Suyu: ...

original_text: 夙汐：嘻嘻，夙玉，这两位师兄就是这样的，不过他们人都很好，久了你便知道了。
translation: Suxi: Hehe, Suyu, these two Martial Brothers are just like that, but they are very good people. You'll understand once you get to know them better.

original_text: 夙玉：嗯……
translation: Suyu: Hmm...

original_text: 太清真人：玄霄、夙玉，我今日命你二人前来，乃是有一件关乎本派的大事要交托！
translation: Taiqing Perfected Person: Xuanxiao, Suyu, I have summoned you two today because there is a matter of great importance to our sect to entrust to you!

original_text: 太清真人：宗炼，便由你来说吧。
translation: Taiqing Perfected Person: Zonglian, you explain it.

original_text: 宗炼：你们都已知道，昆仑诸峰之巅，有天光投下的地方，便是传说中的通仙之途，若能通过，则可白日飞升成仙，只是那里灵气充沛，彼此激荡，绝非一人之力能够靠近。
translation: Zonglian: You all already know that atop the peaks of Kunlun, where the heavenly radiance shines down, is the legendary path to immortality. If one can pass through, they can ascend to immortality in broad daylight. However, that place is filled with spiritual energy, clashing against itself; it's absolutely not a force one person can approach.

original_text: 宗炼：吾派修仙，虽日积月累，勤奋不懈，可惜成效甚微……
translation: Zonglian: Our sect cultivates immortality, though through daily accumulation and diligent effort, progress is regrettably slow...

original_text: 宗炼：直至第二十代掌门道胤真人，这位绝世之才的先辈，悟出以人养剑，万物分阴阳，而阴阳生万物，若能修炼一对雌雄双剑，以巨大灵力形成剑柱，直冲云霄，至昆仑山上天光投下处，则门派中诸人皆可抛却肉体凡胎，成为仙身！
translation: Zonglian: It wasn't until the 20th generation sect leader, Daoyin Perfected Person, a peerless genius of a predecessor, who comprehended the principle of nurturing swords with humans. All things divide into yin and yang, and from yin and yang all things are born. If we could cultivate a pair of Yin-Yang dualbytg swords, using immense spiritual power to form sword pillars that shoot straight into the clouds, reaching the point where the heavenly radiance descends upon Mount Kunlun, then everyone in the sect could cast off their mortal flesh and become immortals!

original_text: 宗炼：自那之后，吾派穷三代之力，于我手中，终成羲和、望舒两剑！
translation: Zonglian: Since then, our sect exhausted three generations of effort, and in my hands, finally forged Xihe and Wangshu swords!

original_text: 玄霄：这……！确是绝世的神兵利器！
translation: Xuanxiao: This...! Truly a peerless divine weapon!

original_text: 宗炼：如今双剑还是死物，若能灌注生人灵气，则力量之巨不可想像！
translation: Zonglian: Now the dual swords are still lifeless objects, but if infused with living human energy, their power would be unimaginable!

original_text: 太清真人：玄霄、夙玉，你二人已被选为羲和剑、望舒剑之宿体，从今往后，便要人剑同修，助我琼华派早日升仙！
translation: Taiqing Perfected Person: Xuanxiao, Suyu, you two have been chosen as the hosts for Xihe Sword and Wangshu Sword. From now on, you must cultivate in unison with the swords, aiding our Qionghua Sect in ascending to immortality as soon as possible!

original_text: 玄霄：弟子、弟子担此重任，定会勤加修行，不辱使命！
translation: Xuanxiao: This disciple... this disciple will shoulder this great responsibility, diligently cultivate, and not disgrace this mission!

original_text: 太清真人：夙玉，你似乎有话要说？
translation: Taiqing Perfected Person: Suyu, you seem to have something to say?

original_text: 夙玉：弟子惶恐！若是望舒剑需要女子作为宿体，如此重任，为何不交给夙瑶师姐呢？弟子修为浅薄，只怕承担不来……
translation: Suyu: I am filled with trepidation! If Wangshu Sword requires a woman as its host, such a heavy responsibility-why not entrust it to Senior Martial Sister Suyao? This disciple's cultivation is shallow; I fear I cannot bear it...

original_text: 太清真人：……先不说夙瑶资质并不及你，单是这双剑宿体，须得是生辰之中、阴阳极盛之人，我于山下寻访多年，才发现了你与玄霄……
translation: Taiqing Perfected Person: ...Leaving aside that Suyao's aptitude is not as good as yours, the hosts for the dual swords must be individuals with extreme Yin and Yang in their birth charts. After searching the mortal world for years, I finally found you and Xuanxiao...

original_text: 夙玉：原来如此……所以师父才会来到夙玉所居的小城……
translation: Suyu: So that's how it is... That's why Master came to the small town where Suyu lived...

original_text: 太清真人：不错，万里挑一，自然要费一番心思，所幸最后终于找到你们两个，这亦是上天怜我琼华啊！
translation: Taiqing Perfected Person: Correct, finding talents one in ten thousand naturally requires effort. Fortunately, we finally found the two of you. This is also heaven's mercy upon our Qionghua!

original_text: 宗炼：你二人此三年中，务必刻苦修行，三年之后便是一个绝佳的机会……
translation: Zonglian: You two must train diligently these three years. Three years from now will be a perfect opportunity...

original_text: 玄霄：机会？……弟子愚昧，请长老明示。
translation: Xuanxiao: An opportunity? ... This disciple is foolish, please enlighten me, Elder.

original_text: 宗炼：若要做成剑柱，单凭你二人灵力、与附近山峰之灵气，尚且远远不够，其余的便要从妖界取来。
translation: Zonglian: To create the Sword Pillars, the spiritual power of you two and of the nearby peaks are far from enough. The rest must be taken from a yao realm.

original_text: 玄霄：妖界？！
translation: Xuanxiao: Yao realm?!

original_text: 太清真人：不错，道胤真人这位前辈确有惊天动地之才，他夜观星象，发现有一妖界如天轨运移一般，每隔十九年，便接近一次琼华派……
translation: Taiqing Perfected Person: Correct. This senior, Master Dao Yin, truly possessed earth-shattering talent. Observing the stars at night, he discovered a yao realm that, like celestial orbits, approaches the Qionghua Sect once every nineteen years...

original_text: 太清真人：只是此界形迹隐去，本派须以双剑之力冲击而上，令其现形，将其网缚，再想方设法取得其中灵力，同时亦可将妖物除去，岂不是两全之策？
translation: Taiqing Perfected Person: It's just that this realm's traces have vanished; our sect must use the dual swords' power to strike upward, make it appear, ensnare it, then find ways to obtain its spiritual energy while also eliminating demonic creatures. Isn't that a win-win strategy?

original_text: 玄霄：网缚妖界？请长老指教，这要如何行事？
translation: Xuanxiao: Ensnare the yao realm? Elder, please advise-how is this done?

original_text: 宗炼：同样要借助双剑之力！详细情形，我过些时日再与你们说。
translation: Zonglian: It also requires the power of the dual swords! I'll explain the details to you in a few days.

original_text: 玄霄：是。
translation: Xuanxiao: Yes.

original_text: 太清真人：从今日起，你二人便每日去禁地修行，禁地之门须由灵光藻玉开启，你们各持一块，切不可交由其他弟子！
translation: Taiqing Perfected Person: From today on, you two shall cultivate daily in the forbidden area. The forbidden area's door must be opened with the Spiritual Light Jade. You each hold one piece; do not give them to other disciples!

original_text: 夙玉：是！
translation: Suyu: Yes!

original_text: 夙瑶：玄霄！为何将给你送饭的弟子打成重伤？！
translation: Suyao: Xuanxiao! Why did you severely injure the disciples who brought you food?!

original_text: 玄霄：他们看了便让人觉得碍眼，以后都不必再来。
translation: Xuanxiao: They're an eyesore just to look at, no need for them to come again.

original_text: 夙瑶：你！你这样让我如何向同门交代，本派禁地之中养了一只会伤人的怪物吗？！
translation: Suyao: You! How can I explain this to our fellow disciples? That there's a monster kept in our sect's forbidden area that can harm people?!

original_text: 玄霄：我是怪物？！
translation: Xuanxiao: I'm a monster?!

original_text: 玄霄：你说的没错！我如今人不人、鬼不鬼地被囚在这里，自然比不上你做了掌门，风光无限！
translation: Xuanxiao: You are right! Imprisoned here, neither human nor ghost, I naturally cannot compare to you as sect leader, basking in glory and splendor!

original_text: 夙瑶：……玄霄，你早已被阳炎噬心，神智不清了。
translation: Suyao: ...Xuanxiao, you've long been consumed by yang flames, your mind is no longer clear.

original_text: 玄霄：可笑！换你被关在这种暗无天日的地方，你又会多清醒！
translation: Xuanxiao: Ridiculous! If you were locked up in this sunless place, how sane would you be?!

original_text: 夙瑶：多说无益。
translation: Suyao: No need for more words.

original_text: 夙瑶：三位长老，请出来！
translation: Suyao: Three Elders, please come out!

original_text: 玄霄：你们……？
translation: Xuanxiao: You all...?

original_text: 夙瑶：玄霄，你如今走火入魔、丧失清明，我只有与三位长老合力，将你封入玄冰之中！
translation: Suyao: Xuanxiao, you are now fallen into demonic madness, having lost clarity. I have no choice but to join the three elders to seal you within the Profound Ice!

original_text: 玄霄：什么？！你们敢！！
translation: Xuanxiao: What?! How dare you!!

original_text: 夙瑶：动手！！
translation: Suyao: ACTION!!
Chongguang: ............

original_text: 夙瑶：诸位长老还等什么！莫非到此时还存有妇人之仁？！
translation: Suyao: What are you elders waiting for! Do you still harbor compassion at this point?!

original_text: 玄霄：夙瑶，你莫要做的太绝！
translation: Xuanxiao: Suyao, don't go too far!

original_text: 青阳：……玄霄，琼华派数百年基业，有如国有国法，不可相违，今日虽愧对于你，却是不可不为！若有他法能够救你，我等断不会行这下下之策！
translation: Qingyang: ... Xuanxiao, the centuries-old foundation of the Qionghua Sect is like the laws of a country-they cannot be violated. Today, although we feel ashamed towards you, this is something we must do! If there were any other way to save you, we would never resort to this last resort!

original_text: 玄霄：长老！青阳长老！为何连你也——！
translation: Xuanxiao: Elder! Elder Qingyang! Why even you-!

original_text: 玄霄：住手——！！
translation: Xuanxiao: Stop-!!

original_text: 玄霄：夙瑶！你竟如此对我！！
translation: Xuanxiao: Suyao! How dare you treat me like this!!

original_text: 夙瑶：师弟……我这样做也是为了你好，不然你狂性大发，出去伤人，却要如何是好？
translation: Suyao: Martial Brother... I'm doing this for your own good. Otherwise, if you go berserk and hurt people outside, what then?

original_text: 夙瑶：你不该恨我，要恨就恨云天青和夙玉，若不是他们出逃，你又怎会落到这样的下场！
translation: Suyao: You shouldn't hate me. If you must hate, hate Yun Tianqing and Suyu. If they hadn't fled, how would you have ended up like this!

original_text: 玄霄：一派胡言！放我出去！！
translation: Xuanxiao: Nonsense! Let me out!!

original_text: 夙瑶：几位长老，你们也都看到了，如今师弟成狂，若是放他出去，必定酿成大祸！
translation: Suyao: Several elders, you have all seen it. Now that Martial Brother has gone mad, if we let him out, it will surely cause a great disaster!

original_text: 夙瑶：诸位须得谨守禁地的秘密，绝不能存有不必要的恻隐之心！
translation: Suyao: All must strictly guard the forbidden area's secrets, and must not harbor unnecessary pity!

original_text: 青阳：……经历这场大战，我与重光身心俱疲，早已有意隐居后山，不再过问派中诸事，掌门尽可放心，我二人也不会再来禁地。
translation: Qingyang: ...After this great battle, Chongguang and I are both physically and mentally exhausted. We have long intended to retire to the rear mountain and no longer involve ourselves in sect affairs. Sect Leader can rest assured, we will not come to the forbidden area again.

original_text: 夙瑶：与妖界之争，伤亡惨重，门派中正值用人之际，长老何出此言？依我之见，此事再从长计议不迟。
translation: Suyao: With the conflict against the yao realm causing heavy casualties, the sect is in dire need of people. Why do you say this, Elder? In my view, we should deliberate further.

original_text: 青阳：……
translation: Qingyang: ...

original_text: 夙瑶：师弟，你的灵光藻玉暂且由我保管，剑林之中我也会布下符灵。若是弟子们寻到夙玉和望舒剑的下落，我自会放你出来！
translation: Suyao: Martial Brother, I'll keep your Spiritual Light Jade for now, and I'll place talisman spirits in the Sword Forest. If the disciples find Suyu and Wangshu Sword, I'll naturally release you!

original_text: 玄霄：夙瑶！！我要杀了你！
translation: Xuanxiao:  SUYAO!! I WILL KILL YOU!

original_text: 夙瑶：诸位长老，我们走。
translation: Suyao: Elders, let's go.

original_text: 玄霄：回来！你们放我出去——！！
translation: Xuanxiao: COME BACK! LET ME OUT-!!

original_text: 柳梦璃：归邪将军！
translation: Liu Mengli: General Guixie!

original_text: 夙瑶：想要伺机杀死我与玄霄？哼！单凭他一个，怎可能！
translation: Suyao: Want to seize the chance to kill me and Xuanxiao? Hmph! With just him alone, how is it possible!

original_text: 夙瑶：以为琼华派还会如十九年前一般，掌门死了就门派大乱吗？！
translation: Suyao: Do you think Qionghua Sect will be like nineteen years ago, thrown into chaos just because the sect leader died?!

original_text: 玄霄：哼、夙瑶你很得意？
translation: Xuanxiao: Hmph, Suyao, are you proud?

original_text: 璇玑：……紫英师叔！你、你什么时候进去妖界的？我怎么都没看见？
translation: Xuanji: ...Martial Uncle Ziying! When... when did you enter the yao realm? How come I didn't see you?

original_text: 云天河：大哥……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Big brother...

original_text: 玄霄：天河，有一阵子不见了，大哥很是挂念你。
translation: Xuanxiao: Tianhe, it's been a while. I've missed you greatly, brother.

original_text: 云天河：……大哥，一切……都是你骗我吗？
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... Big brother, everything... was it all a lie from you?

original_text: 云天河：你和掌门都在骗我？！其实……你只想取回望舒剑，只想升仙，只想强夺幻瞑界的灵力？！
translation: Yun Tianhe: You and the Sect Leader both lied to me?! Actually... you just want Wangshu Sword back, just want to ascend, just want to rob the Twilight Realm's spiritual power?!

original_text: 玄霄：……有些事，我确实没有对你说真话，但也未必说了假话，事到如今，真真假假又有什么重要，最重要的是——
translation: Xuanxiao: ... There are some things I indeed haven't told you the truth about, but that doesn't necessarily mean I've lied. At this point, what's true and what's false doesn't matter anymore-the most important thing is-

original_text: 玄霄：我还是把你当兄弟，绝无害你之心。
translation: Xuanxiao: I still consider you a brother, I have absolutely no intention of harming you.

original_text: 云天河：可恶！我是那么相信你！！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Damn it! I trusted you so much!!

original_text: 夙瑶：不自量力！！
translation: Suyao: Overestimating yourself!!

original_text: 柳梦璃：菱纱！
translation: Liu Mengli: Lingsha!

original_text: 云天河：怎么会……？！
translation: Yun Tianhe: How could... ?!

original_text: 玄霄：天河，你运功只能救她一时，却不能救她一世，你若再与夙瑶斗下去，那位姑娘只会更惨。
translation: Xuanxiao: Tianhe, using your energy can save her temporarily, but not forever. If you continue fighting Suyao, that girl will only suffer more.

original_text: 柳梦璃：云公子，我先把菱纱送回幻瞑宫，我的族人会照顾她。
translation: Liu Mengli: Yun, I'll take Lingzha back to twilight Palace first. My clansmen will care for her.

original_text: 云天河：……好。
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... Okay.

original_text: 云天河：刚才说的什么意思？！
translation: Yun Tianhe: What did you mean by what you just said?!

original_text: 玄霄：……你一点也未觉察到吗？
translation: Xuanxiao: ... You haven't noticed at all?

original_text: 玄霄：望舒剑以至阴女体为宿体，方可激发灵力。它的前主人夙玉死后，望舒剑力量顿失，从此陷入长眠。
translation: Xuanxiao: Wangshu Sword requires a host with an extremely yin female body to activate its spiritual power. After its former owner, Suyu, died, Wangshu Sword lost its power and fell into a long slumber.

original_text: 玄霄：直到有个女子，亦是阴时阴刻出生，命中带水，命相乃是罕见的天水违行，才可令望舒剑复苏。
translation: Xuanxiao: Until a woman, also born at a yin hour and yin moment, with water elements in her destiny, and a rare Divine-Water-Defying astrological destiny, could revive Wangshu Sword.

original_text: 玄霄：越是使用此剑，新的宿体越会体虚畏寒，如不懂得修行之法，情形更是不妙。
translation: Xuanxiao: The more this sword is used, the more the new host will weaken and fear cold. Without knowing cultivation methods, the situation worsens.

original_text: 云天河：新的宿体，是指菱纱？！
translation: Yun Tianhe: A new host, you mean Lingsha?!

original_text: 玄霄：不错，我不清楚她怎样机缘巧合，竟会碰触到沉眠中的望舒剑，但她成为宿体确是事实，恐怕云天青也料不到天下会有这等巧合之事。
translation: Xuanxiao: Indeed. I don't know how she coincidentally touched the slumbering Wangshu Sword, but her becoming the host is a fact. I'm afraid Yun Tianqing couldn't have anticipated such a coincidence in the world.

original_text: 玄霄：韩菱纱来到琼华派后，夙瑶命慕容紫英传她修行心法，便是令她吐纳运气、强身健体，虽不是很有用，却也聊胜于无。
translation: Xuanxiao: After Han Lingsha joined Qionghua Sect, Suyao ordered Murong Ziying to teach her cultivation techniques, focusing on breath control and physical strengthening. Though not highly effective, it's better than nothing.

original_text: 玄霄：……不过，我破冰而出，又以双剑网缚妖界，对她而言，是极大耗损。
translation: Xuanxiao: ... However, breaking free from the ice and using the dual swords to bind the yao realm was a great drain on her.

original_text: 玄霄：适才我与夙瑶合力破除结界，则又是耗去许多望舒之力，韩菱纱的身体怕是已经支撑不住了。
translation: Xuanxiao: Just now, Suyao and I joined forces to break the barrier, which consumed a great deal of Wangshu Sword's power. Han Lingsha's body probably can't hold on much longer.

original_text: 云天河：……因为这样，所以在墓室里，菱纱碰了那把剑，剑才会发光……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... That's why, in my parents' tomb chamber, when Lingsha touched that sword, it glowed...

original_text: 云天河：所以青阳和重光长老才会让我少用望舒剑……
translation: Yun Tianhe: That's why Elders Qingyang and Chongguang told me to use Wangshu Sword less...

original_text: 云天河：所以重光长老才会传她心法、送出暖玉……
translation: Yun Tianhe: That's why Elder Chongguang taught her some mental techniques, gave the warm jade...

original_text: 云天河：所以菱纱的身体才会越来越差，越来越怕冷……
translation: Yun Tianhe: That's why Lingsha's health keeps getting worse, and she's more afraid of the cold...

original_text: 云天河：这所有一切，都是有原因的！你们通通知道，却从来不说！！
translation: Yun Tianhe: All of these has a reason! You all know, BUT YOU NEVER SAY ANYTHING!!

original_text: 玄霄：天河，你莫焦急，待我成仙，救回韩菱纱不过是举手之劳。
translation: Xuanxiao: Tianhe, don't be anxious. Once I become immortal, saving Han Lingsha will be a trivial matter.

original_text: 云天河：……待你成仙……那是什么时候？
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... When you become immortal... when will that be?

original_text: 玄霄：如今妖界灵力衰竭，而琼华派剑柱将成，飞升指日可待，再慢也是一月之内的事。
translation: Xuanxiao: Now, the yao realm's spiritual power wanes, while the Qionghua Sect's sword pillars near completion. Ascension is imminent, within a month at most.

original_text: 玄霄：……天河，你体质特异，能够天生不受寒冰之气侵扰，想必是万中无一的资质，不如与我一同修行，不久即可白日飞升，从此逍遥天地间，岂不是很好？
translation: Xuanxiao: ...Tianhe, your unique constitution naturally resists icy energy-a rare talent. Why not cultivate with me? Soon you could ascend to immortality and roam heaven and earth freely. Wouldn't that be wonderful?

original_text: 云天河：……大哥，你明明说过的，只要找到那三件至阴至寒的东西，你就不会被阳炎侵蚀！
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... Big brother, you clearly said, as long as we find those three extremely yin and cold items, you wouldn't be eroded by the yang flame!

original_text: 云天河：是不是那些东西根本没用？没用的话，我再去帮你找，直到找到为止！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Are those things completely useless? If they're useless, I'll keep searching for you until I find something that works!

original_text: 云天河：你、你不该是这样的啊，简直就像变了一个人……
translation: Yun Tianhe: You... you shouldn't be like this, it's like you've become a different person...

original_text: 玄霄：变了？这却是从何说起？
translation: Xuanxiao: Become different? How do you mean that?

original_text: 玄霄：那三件寒器自然管用，我十九年来从未这样清醒过……以前在禁地之中，每时每刻都有许多景象出现在脑海里，简直快要把我逼疯了……
translation: Xuanxiao: Those three cold artifacts certainly work. I've never been this clear-headed in nineteen years... Before in the forbidden area, countless scenes appeared in my mind every moment, almost driving me mad...

original_text: 玄霄：所以，现在这样就很好……我失去了太多，如今的琼华派与妖界更是令我大失所望。
translation: Xuanxiao: So, this is perfect as it is... I have lost too much. The current Qionghua Sect and the yao realm have disappointed me greatly.

original_text: 玄霄：天河，你能了解吗？凝冰诀与三寒器，最终还是抵不过人从空虚中生出的欲望……
translation: Xuanxiao: Tianhe, do you understand? Cryomancy and Three Cold Artifacts ultimately couldn't withstand the desires born from emptiness...

original_text: 玄霄：你看，我如今能够自如地操纵火焰，却不会被它吞噬，再加上凝冰诀之力，我已将这两种力量融为一体，功力更胜往昔！
translation: Xuanxiao: See, I can now freely control flames without being consumed by them. Combined with the power of Cryomancy, I've merged these two forces, making my power greater than ever!

original_text: 云天河：那你还要什么呢？除了升仙……你说要给老掌门报仇，如今妖界变成这样，仇也报了！要是你还恨我爹娘，干脆把我也杀了算了！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Then what more do you want? Besides ascending to immortality... You said you wanted to avenge the old Sect Leader. Now that the yao realm is like this, revenge is done! If you still hate my parents, JUST KILL ME TOO!

original_text: 玄霄：天河，你不要搞错了，我对报仇一点兴趣都没有，太清的死活与我何干！
translation: Xuanxiao: Tianhe, don't misunderstand. I have no interest in revenge whatsoever. Why do I care about Taiqing's life or death!

original_text: 夙瑶：玄霄！你……！
translation: Suyao: Xuanxiao! You...!

original_text: 玄霄：我想得很清楚了，以我今时之力，杀这些小妖根本是对我的污辱！琼华雪耻也是多此一举！
translation: Xuanxiao: I've thought it through clearly. With my current power, killing these little yaos is an insult! Seeking revenge for Qionghua is also unnecessary!

original_text: 玄霄：只要取了紫晶石，不久即可白日飞升，为前人所不能为，做到历代掌门梦寐之事！这是我如今唯一要做的！
translation: Xuanxiao: Once we obtain the amethysts, we can soon ascend to immortality in broad daylight, achieving what predecessors could not and fulfilling the dreams of past sect leaders! This is now my sole purpose!

original_text: 玄霄：哈哈、哈哈哈～
translation: Xuanxiao: Haha, hahaha~

original_text: 云天河：……大哥……我当初不该帮你……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ...Big brother... I shouldn't have helped you back then...

With great power in hand, it's inevitable you'd worry about gains and losses, deeply afraid that one day everything you hold would be taken away. original_text: 玄霄：以慕容紫英铸剑之才，数年来却也未得重用，凭他资质，应该早有所成，难道不是你心鬼做祟？你是担心他胜过你吗？哈哈、哈哈哈～

original_text: 玄霄：云天河！你烦是不烦！

original_text: 云天河：呵呵，这好办，我现在就去！大哥你等我。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Hehe, that's easy, I'll go now! Big bro, wait for me.

original_text: 云天河：大哥，你看～你要的凤凰花我摘来了！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Big brother, look~ I picked the phoenix flowers you wanted!

original_text: 云天河：……唔，这么说也不对，应该是有人送给我了……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... Hmm, that's not quite right either, it should be that someone gave it to me...

original_text: 玄霄：……凤凰花开，依旧如霞似锦……可惜夙玉却再也看不到了……
translation: Xuanxiao: ... The phoenix flowers bloom, still radiant as clouds... It's a pity Suyu can no longer see them...

original_text: 云天河：我娘？她喜欢这花吗？
translation: Yun Tianhe: My mother? Did she like this flower?

original_text: 玄霄：是啊，闲暇之时她最爱赏花……只是……人会老去、花会衰败，但花开罢一季又一季，人却再也不会归来……
translation: Xuanxiao: Yes, in her leisure time, she loved admiring flowers the most... But... people grow old, flowers wither, yet flowers bloom season after season, while people never return...

original_text: 玄霄：…………你且出去吧，让大哥一个人静一静。
translation: Xuanxiao: ............ You should go out now, let big brother have some peace alone.

original_text: 玄霄：去吧，莫要扰我。
translation: Xuanxiao: Go, do not disturb me.

original_text: 云天河：好，那我走了，等找齐所有寒器，我再来找大哥。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Okay, then I'm leaving. After I gather all the cold artifacts, I'll come find you, Big Brother.

original_text: 玄霄：……杳杳灵凤，绵绵长归。悠悠我思，永与愿违。万劫无期，何时来飞？
translation: Xuanxiao: ...Dim phoenix, far away you roam, Endless longing, never home. Against my wish, my thoughts still stray- Countless kalpas, no coming day. When will you fly back here to stay?

original_text: 玄霄：夙玉，如今你一缕魂魄又在何处？要是早知今日之境，你悔也不悔？……
translation: Xuanxiao: Suyu, where is your wisp of soul now? If you had known the situation today, would you regret it?...

original_text: 云天河：哈哈～怀朔，你在做什么？有好玩的？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Haha~ Huaishuo, what are you doing? Something fun?

original_text: 怀朔：啊，逃了……
translation: Huaishuo: Ah, they escaped...

original_text: 云天河：怀朔。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Huaishuo.

original_text: 云天河：什么东西逃了？怎么你脸上都是汗？
translation: Yun Tianhe: What escaped? Why is your face all sweaty?

original_text: 怀朔：我……我要捉的虫子，被你惊跑了……
translation: Huaishuo: I... the bug I was trying to catch, you scared it away...

original_text: 云天河：虫子？什么样的？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Bugs? What kind?

original_text: 怀朔：就是这个，我守了一个时辰，也才捉到一只……
translation: Huaishuo: It's this one. I've been waiting for two hours and only caught one...

original_text: 云天河：这虫子这么瘦，身上没肉，会好吃吗？
translation: Yun Tianhe: This bug is so skinny, no meat on it. Will it be tasty?

original_text: 怀朔：吃？……不不不，你误会了，我不是要捉来吃。
translation: Huaishuo: Tasty? ...No, no, no, you've misunderstood. I'm not catching them to eat.

original_text: 怀朔：这虫子叫“夏鸣”，只有在琼华派中才有，山下是见不到的，近几日璇玑忽然说它们的叫声好听，让我捉几只给她，她要送给紫英师叔。
translation: Huaishuo: This insect is called Summerchirp, found only in Qionghua Sect, not seen down the mountain. Recently, Xuanji suddenly said their chirping sounds nice and asked me to catch a few for her to give to Martial Uncle Ziying.

original_text: 云天河：师叔？他要这东西干嘛？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Martial Uncle? What does he want this for?

original_text: 怀朔：师叔要不要倒没什么，但若是不理璇玑，她一定会每日缠着我，不肯罢休……
translation: Huaishuo: Whether Martial Uncle wants it or not doesn't matter much, but if I ignore Xuanji, she'll definitely pester me every day and won't give up...

original_text: 云天河：呵呵，那我来帮你，我最擅长捉虫了～
translation: Yun Tianhe: Hehe, then I'll help you, I'm best at catching bugs~

original_text: 怀朔：不如你将其中诀窍传授我一些，我再试试……刚才想用仙术把虫子定住，却是一碰就死了……
translation: Huaishuo: Why don't you teach me some of the tricks, and I'll try again... I wanted to use immortal arts to immobilize the insect, but it died as soon as I touched it...

original_text: 云天河：你从小到大都没捉过虫子玩吗？
translation: Yun Tianhe: You never caught bugs to play with growing up?

original_text: 怀朔：……惭愧，我幼时在家乡，爹是个私塾先生，管教得甚严，是不许我和其他小孩一起玩闹的。
translation: Huaishuo: ...I'm ashamed. When I was young in my hometown, my father was a private school teacher and was very strict. He didn't allow me to play with other children.

original_text: 云天河：什么？不能出去玩？！这样说起来，你爹比我爹还厉害，你真可怜……
translation: Yun Tianhe: What? Can't go out to play?! That means your father is even stricter than mine. You're so pitiful...

original_text: 怀朔：你莫要误会……
translation: Huaishuo: Don't misunderstand...

original_text: 云天河：来吧！我帮你，捉虫子不能像你那样。你等一下，我做个虫笼先～
translation: Yun Tianhe: Come on! I'll help you. You can't catch bugs like that. Wait a bit, I'll make a bug cage first~

original_text: 云天河：好了！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Done!

original_text: 怀朔：这！……夏鸣虫为何会自己往里飞？！
translation: Huaishuo: This!... Why did the summerchirp bug fly in on its own?!

original_text: 云天河：呵呵～我在笼子里放了干花粉，以前在青鸾峰时，我也常常拿这个引虫子，看来对琼华派的虫子一样行啊～
translation: Yun Tianhe: Hehe~ I put dried flower pollen in the cage. Back on Qingluan Peak, I often used this to attract bugs. Looks like it works on Qionghua Sect's bugs too~

original_text: 云天河：一、二、三……一共三只，加上你捉到的，就是四只，够了吗？
translation: Yun Tianhe: One, two, three... three in total, plus the one you caught, that makes four, is that enough?

original_text: 怀朔：够了、够了，真想不到捉虫也是一门学问。
translation: Huaishuo: Enough, enough. Never thought catching bugs could be such a study.

original_text: 云天河：不够的话再来找我，我还帮你捉！其实还有其他很多办法的～
translation: Yun Tianhe: If it's not enough, come find me again, I'll help you catch more! Actually, there are many other ways~

original_text: 怀朔：多谢，没有你帮忙的话，我还不知要在这里凝神闭气守上多久……
translation: Huaishuo: Thank you. Without your help, I don't know how long I'd have to stay here meditating and holding my breath...

original_text: 怀朔：我先回房去了，本门禁止入夜后喧哗、随意出外，我……我是趁房里其他人都睡着了，才出来的。
translation: Huaishuo: I'm heading back to my room now. Our sect forbids making noise after nightfall or leaving quarters casually. I... I only came out after everyone else in the room had fallen asleep.

original_text: 云天河：哦～这里规矩就是多，你放心，你偷跑出来的事我不告诉别人～
translation: Yun Tianhe: Oh~ there are so many rules here. Don't worry, I won't tell anyone you sneaked out~

original_text: 怀朔：咳咳……你也早点回房吧，我知道你玩心重，耐不住性子，不过今日才被师叔罚去思过，还是莫要再犯错了。
translation: Huaishuo: Cough... You should head back to your room early too. I know you're playful and restless, but you were just punished by your Martial Uncle to reflect on your mistakes today. Best not to err again.

original_text: 柳梦璃：怀朔师兄，想不到你颇有闲情，养了这些叫声好听的虫子～
translation: Liu Mengli: Martial Brother Huaishuo, I never expected you to be so leisurely, raising these pleasantly chirping insects~

original_text: 怀朔：哪里……我本想将它们放了，但自己又有些喜欢，想留下多养几日，正在犹豫，倒让你见笑了。
translation: Huaishuo: Not at all... I wanted to release them, but I've grown fond of them and wanted to keep them a few more days. I was hesitating, so you must find it amusing.

original_text: 云天河：这叫声……不是上回夜里捉的那些夏鸣虫吗？你还没给璇玑啊？
translation: Yun Tianhe: That sound... isn't it the summerchirp insects we caught last night? You haven't given them to Xuanji yet?

original_text: 怀朔：璇玑不知又从哪里听说，紫英师叔不喜这些小东西，所以她不要了。
translation: Huaishuo: Xuanji heard from somewhere again that Martial Uncle Ziying dislikes these little things, so she doesn't want them.

original_text: 怀朔：对了，天河，上次你帮我捉虫，还没有谢谢你，恰好昨日从虚合师叔处得来一些养神的灵药，就送给你吧。
translation: Huaishuo: By the way, Tianhe, thank you for helping me catch insects last time. I happened to get some spirit medicine for nourishing the mind from Martial Uncle Xuhe yesterday, so I'll give it to you.

original_text: 云天河：给我？呵呵，谢谢！
translation: Yun Tianhe: To me? Hehe, thanks!

original_text: 璇玑：师兄，原来你在这儿，我找你好久了！
translation: Xuanji: Huaishuo, so you're here, I've been looking for you for so long!

original_text: 怀朔：什么找好久，刚才可是你让我离开，你不是说要静心练剑，不许别人打扰吗？
translation: Huaishuo: What do you mean 'looking for so long'? It was you who told me to leave just now. You said you wanted to practice swordsmanship in peace without being disturbed.

original_text: 璇玑：那人家现在练完了，来找你不行吗？
translation: Xuanji: I've finished practicing now, can't I come find you?

original_text: 怀朔：行行行，怎样都是你说了算。
translation: Huaishuo: Fine, fine, whatever you say goes.

original_text: 璇玑：嘻嘻，那师兄你陪我去承天剑台，听说虚冶师伯那儿新出炉了几柄宝剑，我要去挑一把！我的紫灵剑在上回除妖时，被那只厉害的蜈蚣精毁了，如今用的这把一点都不称手……
translation: Xuanji: Hehe, then, Martial Brother, accompany me to the ChengTian Sword Platform. I heard Uncle Xuye has just forged several new swords there, and I want to pick one! My Purple Spirit Sword was destroyed by that powerful centipede monster last time we exterminated monsters, and the one I'm using now doesn't suit me at all...

original_text: 怀朔：虚冶师伯？可你之前不是说要请紫英师叔替你铸剑——
translation: Huaishuo: Uncle Xuye? But didn't you say earlier you wanted Uncle Ziying to forge a sword for you-

original_text: 璇玑：师兄你故意气我是不是？！你明知道我求师叔铸剑也不止一年半载了，可他一直都不理我，你还偏要提这个……
translation: Xuanji: Martial Brother, are you deliberately trying to annoy me?! You know full well I've been begging Martial Uncle to forge a sword for me for more than a year, but he's always ignored me, and you just had to bring it up...

original_text: 怀朔：好吧、好吧，都是我不对，师兄给你陪礼了，我们这就去承天剑台吧。
translation: Huaishuo: Alright, alright, it's all my fault. Martial Brother apologizes to you. Let's go to the ChengTian Sword Platform now.

original_text: 璇玑：嗯，这还差不多～～～
translation: Xuanji: Mm, that's more like it~~~

original_text: 璇玑：这些虫子师兄你怎么还没扔掉啊？叫个不停，听了就心烦。
translation: Xuanji: Martial Brother, why haven't you thrown away these bugs yet? Chirping non-stop, it's so annoying to hear.

original_text: 怀朔：会吗？我觉得这声音还挺好听的，不如我先回房一趟，把虫笼放下，再去承天剑台找你。
translation: Huaishuo: Really? I think the sound is quite pleasant. How about I go back to my room first to put down the insect cage, then meet you at the Sword Platform.

original_text: 璇玑：怎样都好啦，那你等会儿一定要来～
translation: Xuanji: Whatever's fine, then you must come later~

original_text: 璇玑：天河、梦璃，今天我和师兄有事，不能陪你们了～
translation: Xuanji: Tianhe, Mengli, my Martial Brother and I have something to attend to today, so we can't accompany you~

original_text: 怀朔：抱歉……先告辞了。
translation: Huaishuo: Sorry... I'll take my leave first.

original_text: 怀朔：唉，小师妹这横冲直撞的性子，什么时候才能改一改啊……
translation: Huaishuo: Ah, my little Martial Sister's reckless, headlong nature-when will she ever change...

original_text: 柳梦璃：怀朔对璇玑真好，处处替她着想、顺她心意，想来亲兄长也不过如此了吧。
translation: Liu Mengli: Huaishuo is so good to Xuanji, always thinking for her and accommodating her wishes. I imagine even a biological brother couldn't be better.

original_text: 柳梦璃：云公子，你怎么了？一直都不说话。
translation: Liu Mengli: Yun, what's wrong? You haven't said a word.

original_text: 云天河：我……我觉得怀朔好了不起，天天和璇玑待在一起，都不会头晕……为什么女孩子的主意总是变来变去？认定一个不就好了？
translation: Yun Tianhe: I... I think Huaishuo is amazing, spending every day with Xuanji without getting dizzy... Why do girls' minds always change? Wouldn't it be better to settle on one?

original_text: 柳梦璃：云公子，女孩子会时常改变主意，多半是有了喜欢的人，想要在那个人面前表现出最好的一面，才会患得患失、反反复复。
translation: Liu Mengli: Yun, when a girl often changes her mind, it's mostly because she has someone she likes. Wanting to show her best side in front of that person makes her anxious and indecisive, going back and forth.

original_text: 云天河：……我知道，你说的“喜欢”，又是我不明白的那种，是不是因为我念的书太少？
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... I know, the 'like' you're talking about is another kind I don't understand. Is it because I haven't read enough books?

original_text: 柳梦璃：云公子，我觉得你这样坦坦荡荡的就很好了，不用强迫自己去改变什么。
translation: Liu Mengli: Yun, I think your straightforward honesty is just fine. No need to force yourself to change anything.

original_text: 柳梦璃：“情”之一物，原本就是世上最难解的东西，譬如怀朔对璇玑的拂照之情，璇玑对怀朔的依赖之情，爹娘对我的养育之情，我和你……还有菱纱在一起的感情，这之间原本就有千千万万的不同，没有谁讲得清楚。
translation: Liu Mengli: The matter of 'affection' is inherently the most difficult thing in the world to unravel. For instance, Huaishuo's protective care for Xuanji, Xuanji's dependence on Huaishuo, my parents' nurturing love for me, the feelings between you and me... and Lingsha. There are countless differences among these from the start, and no one can clearly explain them.

original_text: 云天河：梦璃你说的对，想不透就别想了，爹也说过，想太多容易掉头发，还不如吃饱睡、睡饱吃，呵呵～
translation: Yun Tianhe: Mengli, you're right. If you can't figure it out, don't think about it. Father also said thinking too much makes your hair fall out. Better to eat your fill, sleep, sleep your fill, eat, hehe~

original_text: 柳梦璃：嗯，云叔说的也对～
translation: Liu Mengli: Mm, what Uncle Yun says is also right~

original_text: 韩菱纱：天河你、你身后那是什么？
translation: Han Lingsha: Tianhe, you... what's that behind you?

original_text: 云天河：一只会飞的猪，叫作“勇气”。
translation: Yun Tianhe: A flying pig, called 'Brave'.

original_text: 韩菱纱：你有点常识好不好？猪长这副模样吗？而且猪怎么可能会飞？！
translation: Han Lingsha: Do you have any common sense? Do pigs look like that? And how could a pig possibly fly?!

original_text: 云天河：不是猪？我看它跟山猪哦咿～哦咿～差不多的声音啊！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Not a pig? I think its sound is similar to a wild boar's oink~ oink~!

original_text: 韩菱纱：它真的好可爱哦～嘻，能让我摸摸看吗？
translation: Han Lingsha: It's really so cute~ Hehe, can I pet it?

original_text: 韩菱纱：哟……它还不愿意呢。
translation: Han Lingsha: Oh... it seems unwilling.

original_text: 柳梦璃：云公子，你是不是从怪物手里救下了它？
translation: Liu Mengli: Yun, did you rescue it from a monster?

original_text: 云天河：是可以这么说啦，应该是抢下它，哈哈！
translation: Yun Tianhe: You could say that, more like snatched it, haha!

original_text: 柳梦璃：这便是了。它说你救过它一命，它很感激呢。
translation: Liu Mengli: That's it. It says you saved its life once, and it's very grateful.

original_text: 韩菱纱：梦璃你……你能听懂这小东西说的话？！
translation: Han Lingsha: Mengli, you... you can understand what this little thing says?!

original_text: 柳梦璃：嗯……我自幼就能辨识一些常人听不见的声音、听不懂的话，小时候还不觉得，渐渐长大了，才明白我和别人不太一样……
translation: Liu Mengli: Mm... Since childhood, I could hear sounds and understand words that ordinary people couldn't. When I was little, I didn't notice, but as I grew up, I realized I was different from others...

original_text: 韩菱纱：好梦璃，这有什么的，天赋异禀是好事啊。
translation: Han Lingsha:  My dear Mengli, that's nothing. Having extraordinary talent is a good thing.

original_text: 韩菱纱：嘻嘻，你快告诉我，这只小东西唧唧啾啾的还说了什么，我好想知道～
translation: Han Lingsha: Hehe, tell me quickly, what else is this little thing chirping about, I really want to know~

original_text: 柳梦璃：它说……它是一只五毒兽，因为想让自己变得强一点，才来太一仙径修炼的。
translation: Liu Mengli: It said... it's a Penta-Poison Beast. It came to Taiyi Immortal Path to train because it wanted to become a bit stronger.

original_text: 云天河：（无毒兽？怎么会有这种东西？看起来确实没有毒，应该很好吃吧……）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (Panda-poison beast? Since when are pandas poisonous? It doesn't look like a panda at all. Too bad it's poisonous-so not edible...)

original_text: 韩菱纱：五毒兽？原来这就是五毒兽呀！我以前听族里的人说过，那是一种很了不得的仙兽呢，它们孕育的五毒珠能解世间百毒。真没想到就是这样小小一只～
translation: Han Lingsha: Penta-Poison Beast? So this is it! I heard from my clan it's an amazing immortal beast who can create Penta-Poison Pearl which cures all toxins. Never imagined it'd be so tiny~

original_text: 云天河：（无毒兽能生出无毒猪？越听越不懂……）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (What is a panda-poison beast making panda-poison pigs? The more I hear, the less I understand...)

original_text: 云天河：那它到底是不是猪呀，我都搞糊涂了……它干嘛要跟着我？
translation: Yun Tianhe: So is it a pig or a panda? I'm all confused... Why is it following me?

original_text: 柳梦璃：它说，它在太一仙径里惹到打不过的怪物，幸好被你救了，它想——
translation: Liu Mengli: It said it provoked a monster it couldn't defeat in the Taiyi Immortal Path, but luckily you saved it. It wants-

original_text: 云天河：想什么？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Thinking what?

original_text: 柳梦璃：它想认你作老大。
translation: Liu Mengli: It wants to recognize you as boss.

original_text: 韩菱纱：真是太可爱了，它还懂得知恩图报呢～
translation: Han Lingsha: So adorable-it even knows to repay kindness~

original_text: 云天河：老大？就是像柳波波那样的？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Boss? Like Ankle Liu?

original_text: 云天河：可是……我不想当什么老大啊，我还以为它是会飞的猪，想把它烤来吃，不过那个什么仙兽，也一样可以烤吧？
translation: Yun Tianhe: But... I don't want to be a boss. I thought it was a flying pig and wanted to roast it to eat. But that so-called immortal beast-can't it be roasted too?

original_text: 韩菱纱：有没搞错啊！你这野人，它这么可爱，你居然想吃它！
translation: Han Lingsha: Are you kidding me! You barbarian, it's so cute, and you actually want to eat it!

original_text: 韩菱纱：讨厌！都是你，把它吓跑了，我还没有好好瞧上一眼呢！
translation: Han Lingsha: Annoying! It's all your fault, you scared it away. I didn't even get a good look at it!

original_text: 云天河：……不会吧？刚才你都一直盯着它看……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... No way. You were staring at it the whole time just now...

original_text: 韩菱纱：我！……不和你说了，免得被气死……
translation: Han Lingsha: I! ...Not talking to you anymore, lest I die of anger...

original_text: 云天河：飞走就飞走，有什么好气的……
translation: Yun Tianhe: It flew away, so what? Why get upset...

original_text: 柳梦璃：菱纱大概是想跟那只五毒兽多玩一会儿吧，我也觉得它很可爱呢。
translation: Liu Mengli: Lingsha probably wants to play with that Penta-Poison Beast a bit longer. I also think it's very cute.

original_text: 云天河：那好办，下回我再去太一仙径把它捉回来不就行了？
translation: Yun Tianhe: That's easy, next time I'll just go to Taiyi Immortal Path and catch it again.

original_text: 柳梦璃：不用了，它也不一定会再去太一仙径吧，而且让它自由自在地飞，不是更好吗？
translation: Liu Mengli: No need. It might not return to Taiyi Path, and isn't it better to let it fly freely?

original_text: 云天河：好……我听你的……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Okay... I'll listen to you...

original_text: 柳梦璃：嗯，还有一件事希望云公子能答应我……
translation: Liu Mengli: Hmm, there's one more thing I hope Yun can promise me...

original_text: 云天河：啊？什么事？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Huh? What?

original_text: 柳梦璃：可不可以……那只仙兽……
translation: Liu Mengli: Could we... that immortal beast...

original_text: 云天河：好！我知道了，梦璃你心肠好。我不会再想烤了它填肚子，以后这种什么兽呀猪呀，我都不烤就是了……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Okay! I get it, Mengli, you have a kind heart. I won't think about roasting it for food anymore. From now on, I won't roast any beasts or pigs like this...

original_text: 柳梦璃：云公子，谢谢你，你能明白……我真的很高兴。
translation: Liu Mengli: Yun, thank you. That you can understand... I'm truly happy.

original_text: 云天河：（……话是这么说没错，但说完后感觉……好后悔……）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (...That's true, but after saying it, I feel... really regretful...)

original_text: 云天河：奇怪，床上什么时候多了这些东西？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Strange, when did all these things appear on the bed?

original_text: 云天河：啊？！原来是勇气啊！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Huh?! So it's Brave!

original_text: 云天河：啥意思？这堆东西和你有关？……
translation: Yun Tianhe: What do you mean? This pile of stuff is related to you? ...

original_text: 云天河：好晕～～～～根本什么都听不懂！
translation: Yun Tianhe: So dizzy~~~~ I can't understand anything at all!

original_text: 云天河：对了！梦璃！我去找梦璃，她一定知道你在说什么！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Right! Mengli! I'll find Mengli, she'll know what you're talking about!

original_text: 韩菱纱：梦璃，它到底在讲什么呀？为什么又回来了呢？
translation: Han Lingsha: Mengli, what is it saying? Why has it come back?

original_text: 柳梦璃：天河床上的那些，都是它搜集的漂亮宝石，据说是要送给天河，让天河不要吃自己，然后……带它一起修炼，教它怎样才能变强。
translation: Liu Mengli: Those things on Tianhe's bed are all the beautiful gems it collected. Apparently, it wants to give them to Tianhe so he won't eat it, and then... take it along to cultivate, teach it how to become stronger.

original_text: 韩菱纱：它可真是有心，太了不起了～不过……宝石送给天河这家伙，实在糟蹋，他又不懂欣赏……
translation: Han Lingsha: It's really thoughtful, truly amazing~ But... giving gems to this guy is such a waste; he doesn't even know how to appreciate them...

original_text: 韩菱纱：（还不如给我呢，嘻嘻……）
translation: Han Lingsha: (Might as well give it to me, hehe...)

original_text: 云天河：对啊，我要这些石头又没用，也不能当饭吃。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Right, what use do I have for these stones? Can't even eat.

original_text: 柳梦璃：你不要伤心，人和仙兽的修炼之法应该颇有不同，原本就是不能在一起的。我感觉的到，其实你的灵力很强，不需要羡慕任何人。
translation: Liu Mengli: Don't be sad. The cultivation methods of humans and immortal beasts should be quite different; they were never meant to be together. I can feel that your spiritual power is actually very strong; you don't need to envy anyone.

original_text: 柳梦璃：只不过你的潜力还没有发挥出来，只要多加修炼，一定会变成一只强大的仙兽。
translation: Liu Mengli: It's just that your potential hasn't been fully realized yet. With more cultivation, you'll surely become a powerful immortal beast.

original_text: 韩菱纱：嗯，梦璃说得对，你要有信心～你现在就这么懂事，以后肯定会很强的。
translation: Han Lingsha: Mm, Mengli is right. Have confidence~ You're so sensible now; you'll surely become very strong later.

original_text: 云天河：……？
translation: Yun Tianhe: ...?

original_text: 柳梦璃：它说它决定了，现在先离开，等到炼成五毒珠，变得像老大一样厉害时，再回来报答你。
translation: Liu Mengli: It said it has decided to leave for now. Once it refines the Penta-Poison Pearl and becomes as powerful as boss, it will return to repay you.

original_text: 云天河：变得像我一样厉害？那多猎山猪不就好了，又练臂力又练脚力。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Become as strong as me? Then just hunt more wild boars-it trains both arm and leg strength.

original_text: 韩菱纱：喂，你不要随便乱说好不好，它那么认真，会被教坏的！
translation: Han Lingsha: Hey, don't just talk nonsense, okay? It's so serious, it might learn bad habits!

original_text: 云天河：我是说真的，哪有乱说……
translation: Yun Tianhe: I'm serious, I'm not talking nonsense...

original_text: 韩菱纱：野人……跟你说不通，也不知道那小东西干嘛那么粘你，难不成……你真有当老大的潜力？
translation: Han Lingsha: Barbarian... I can't get through to you. I don't know why that little thing is so attached to you. Could it be... you really have potential as a boss?

original_text: 柳梦璃：是有此可能，云公子是个好人，它很喜欢云公子，所以想要认个好老大。
translation: Liu Mengli: That's possible. Yun is a good person. It likes him, so it wants to acknowledge a good boss.

original_text: 韩菱纱：好梦璃，我发现你现在越来越常笑了，说话也比较有趣了。
translation: Han Lingsha: My dear Mengli, I've noticed you smile more often now, and your words are more interesting too.

original_text: 柳梦璃：啊？！
translation: Liu Mengli: Huh?!

original_text: 柳梦璃：我……有吗……
translation: Liu Mengli: I...am I...

original_text: 韩菱纱：（这个野人，简直跟木头似的，不知现在脑子里又在想什么，笨死了……）
translation: Han Lingsha: (This barbarian is just like a block of wood. Who knows what he's thinking now? So stupid...)

original_text: 云天河：（……无毒兽……无毒猪……不晓得吃起来是什么感觉？可惜已经答应梦璃了，唉……）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (...panda-poison Beast... panda-poison pig... wonder what they taste like? Pity I already promised Mengli, sigh...)

original_text: 夙瑶：紫英，何事禀报？
translation: Suyao: Ziying, what do you want to report today?

original_text: 慕容紫英：掌门，弟子于山下偶遇夙莘师叔，师叔不愿随弟子回来，只托付将一样东西带给您。
translation: Murong Ziying: Sect Leader, this disciple encountered Martial Aunt Sushen. She was unwilling to return with me, entrusting me with delivering something to you.

original_text: 夙瑶：夙莘？！你在何处见到她？她为何不肯回来？
translation: Suyao: Sushen?! Where did you see her? Why won't she come back?

original_text: 慕容紫英：师叔吩咐，若是掌门询问，便打开这个箱子。
translation: Murong Ziying: Martial Aunt instructed that if Sect Leader inquires, to open this box.

original_text: 夙瑶：哦？故弄玄虚，这可不似夙莘的性子。
translation: Suyao: Oh? Playing mysterious, that doesn't seem like Sushen's style.

original_text: 夙瑶：也罢，便依她所言，看看究竟何意……
translation: Suyao: Fine then, as she says, let's see what she means...

original_text: 夙瑶：这是何物？！
translation: Suyao: What is this?!

original_text: 夙莘：师姐，是我呀，你是不是吓一跳？
translation: Sushen: Martial Sister, it's me, did I surprise you?

original_text: 夙瑶：夙莘？
translation: Suyao: Sushen?

original_text: 夙莘：这机关鹰是我自己做的，很不错吧～
translation: Sushen: This mechanical eagle I made myself, pretty good, right~

original_text: 夙莘：师姐，你先别生气，我知道……当初我为了一点小事和其他弟子争执，一气之下竟然离开了昆仑山，让你很是为难……
translation: Sushen: Martial Sister, don't be angry yet. I know... Back then, I argued with other disciples over trivial matters and left Kunlun Mountain in a rage, putting you in a difficult position...

original_text: 夙莘：在山上，你是对我最好的人，可能因为我们性情相近，一样争强好胜，一样不肯服输……夙莘别的都可以不在乎，只是一想到这些年来辜负了师姐的期望，早将修仙所学荒废，就更加不敢回来了……
translation: Sushen: On Kunlun mountain, you were the one who treated me best. Perhaps because our temperaments were similar-both competitive, both unwilling to admit defeat... Sushen could disregard everything else, but the thought of having failed your expectations over the years, letting all my cultivation studies fall to waste, made me even more afraid to return...

original_text: 夙莘：不过……师姐你不用替我担心，我如今过得很好……
translation: Sushen: But... Martial Sister, you don't need to worry about me, I'm living very well now...

original_text: 夙莘：刚下山时脾气还是一样倔，不懂江湖规矩，吃了亏，差点丢了性命，是一位老人做的机关兽救了我，后来我就跟着他学做机关，他是“偃师”一脉的传人，知识很渊博。
translation: Sushen: When I left Kunlun, my temper was just as stubborn, and I didn't understand the ways of the jianghu (martial world). I suffered losses and nearly lost my life. A mechanical beast made by an old man saved me. Later, I followed him to learn mechanical arts. He was a descendant of the 'Yanshi' lineage, very knowledgeable.

original_text: 夙莘：我走遍五湖四海，才发现世间比想像的更加广大，就算不修仙道，一样可以遨游宇内、乘奔御风，在无尽的天地间，人是那样渺小，许多原本看得很重的东西，都变得不那么重要了……
translation: Sushen: I traveled across the lands and seas, only to realize the world is vaster than imagined. Even without pursuing immortality, one can still roam the universe, ride the winds. In the boundless heavens and earth, humans are so small, and many things once held so important become less so...

original_text: 夙莘：所以……还是现在每天喝酒、行走江湖的日子更适合我，我们……相见不如不见，我但愿永远是你心目中那个横冲直撞的小师妹……
translation: Sushen: So... the life of drinking and wandering the martial world every day suits me better now. We... it's better not to meet. I hope I'll always be that reckless little Martial Sister in your memory...

original_text: 夙莘：师姐，保重……
translation: Sushen: Martial Sister, take care...

original_text: 夙瑶：……紫英……
translation: Suyao: ... Ziying...

original_text: 慕容紫英：弟子在。
translation: Murong Ziying: Your disciple is here.

original_text: 夙瑶：你见到夙莘时，她真如刚才所言，自甘堕落，不但荒废所学，竟还酗酒伤身？
translation: Suyao: When you saw Sushen, was she truly as described just now, willingly degrading herself, not only neglecting her studies but also drinking excessively and harming her health?

original_text: 夙瑶：如实答来。
translation: Suyao: Answer truthfully.

original_text: 慕容紫英：是……师叔她确有饮酒——
translation: Murong Ziying: Yes... She did indeed drink wine-

original_text: 夙瑶：够了！你且退下。我自会告知掌管名录的弟子，将夙莘之名除去。
translation: Suyao: Enough! You may step back. I will inform the disciple in charge of the register to remove Sushen's name.

original_text: 慕容紫英：……！掌门，您的意思是……要将师叔逐出门墙？！
translation: Murong Ziying: ...! Sect Leader, do you mean... to expel Martial Aunt from the sect?!

original_text: 夙瑶：不错。本派正值用人之际，她却如此行止，兼之言行不端，习旁门左道之术，我留她何用？
translation: Suyao: Correct. Our sect is in dire need of talent, yet she behaves this way. Coupled with her improper conduct and practice of unorthodox arts, what use do I have for her?

original_text: 夙瑶：去吧，我意已决，不必多言。
translation: Suyao: Go, my decision is made, say no more.

original_text: 夙瑶：……夙莘，竟连你都如此，世情变迁，令人齿冷……可叹妖界将临，身边无一人足以信任，上天何以如此待我琼华……
translation: Suyao: ... Sushen, even you have become like this... The changing world chills my heart. With the yao realm approaching and no one left to trust, why must Heaven treat Qionghua so harshly...

original_text: 夙瑶：……满座衣冠犹胜雪，更无一人是知音……
translation: Suyao: ... No man is an island, entire of itself; but I am...

original_text: 明如：虚寂师叔让我来此等候昆仑山其他几派的道友，共同商议那件了不得的大事，可我等了许久，却也没见他们来……
translation: Mingru: Martial Uncle Xuji sent me here to wait for fellow disciples from the other sects of Kunlun Mountain to discuss that momentous matter together, but I've waited a long time and still haven't seen them arrive...

original_text: 明如：昆仑山中共有八个修仙门派，琼华派乃是其中之一。
translation: Mingru: There are eight immortal cultivation sects in the Kunlun Mountains; Qionghua Sect is one of them.

original_text: 明如：师父曾说我资质不好，当年收我入门，是看在我为人老实又心诚，可你们几个呢？一入门就擅自下山，真不知道掌门是为什么才破例收你们入门的！
translation: Mingru: Master once said my aptitude was poor. He accepted me into the sect back then because I was honest and sincere. But what about you all? You went down the mountain without permission as soon as you joined. I really don't know why the Sect Leader made an exception to accept you!

original_text: 明如：昆仑山其他几派似乎无意与我们一同对抗妖界，唉！早知如此，又何必请他们来商议什么？！本派弟子注定是要背水一战的！
translation: Mingru: It seems the other sects on Kunlun Mountain have no intention of joining us against the yao realm. Sigh! Had we known, why bother inviting them to discuss anything?! Our sect's disciples are destined to fight with their backs to the wall!

original_text: 明如：据说卷云台旁边那个庞然大物便是妖界的入口，其中妖物都是穷凶极恶的！掌门说万万不可莽撞行事，先静观其变！
translation: Mingru: They say that huge thing next to Cloud Terrace is the entrance to the yao realm, filled with vicious monsters! The Sect Leader said we must not act rashly; observe first and wait for changes!

original_text: 明如：掌门似乎已在禁地闭关多日，据说是与我派的另一位前辈高人一同修炼歼灭妖界之法，届时我们一切听掌门吩咐即可！
translation: Mingru: The sect leader seems to have been in seclusion in the forbidden area for days, reportedly training with another senior expert to annihilate the yao realm. When the time comes, we'll follow the leader's orders!

original_text: 虚忘：山门的这四座神兽像乃是昆仑山的守护神，分别为陆吾、开明、离朱、英招。陆吾虎身九尾，而开明则虎身九头，每个头都是一张人面。
translation: Xu Wang: These four divine beast statues at the Sect Gate are the guardian deities of Kunlun Mountain: Luwu, Kaiming, Lizhu, and Yingzhao. Luwu has a tiger's body with nine tails, while Kaiming has a tiger's body with nine heads, each head a human face.

original_text: 虚忘：琼华派修行讲求“人剑合一”，人的修为与剑的品级须相辅相成，我修行似乎过于躁进，三年内已换了五把剑，这样反而无甚进展啊。
translation: Xu Wang: The Qionghua Sect's cultivation emphasizes 'unity of man and sword'. One's cultivation and the sword's quality must complement each other. I seem to have been too impatient in my practice, changing five swords in three years, which actually hindered my progress.

original_text: 虚忘：我曾听长老说过，十九年前那场大战十分惨烈，连前代掌门太清真人都亡于妖界之手，如今妖界又将进犯，我辈弟子宁可头断血流，也不能让妖物祸害山下百姓。
translation: Xu Wang: I once heard the elders say the great battle nineteen years ago was brutal-even the former sect leader, Taiqing Perfected Person, fell to the yao realm. Now the yao realm encroaches again. We disciples would rather shed blood than let yaoguais harm the common folk below.

original_text: 虚忘：妖界已经现身，却也没什么可怕的了，只要一心守住琼华派、不让妖孽为祸人间，即使为此抛却性命也是值得的。
translation: Xu Wang: The yao realm has appeared, but there's nothing to fear. As long as we wholeheartedly defend Qionghua Sect and prevent yaoguais from harming the mortal world, even sacrificing our lives is worth it.

original_text: 虚忘：掌门在禁地闭关也有一些日子了，妖界却也虚实莫测，毫无动静，越是这样，我们越不能掉以轻心！
translation: Xu Wang: Sect leader has been in seclusion in the forbidden area for some time now, and the yao realm remains elusive and inactive. The more it's like this, the more we must not let our guard down!

original_text: 元通：难得，派中近日已不再收徒，你竟能入得山门，想必是有什么过人之处吧！
translation: Yuantong: Rare indeed, the sect has stopped taking disciples recently, yet you managed to enter, you must have some exceptional talent!

original_text: 元通：掌门素来治理门派有方，她决定的事，自是所有弟子听令，不会有违。
translation: Yuantong: The Sect Leader has always managed the sect well. Her decisions are naturally followed by all disciples without question.

original_text: 元通：肃武长老说我体质极弱，宜静不宜动，所以我修炼的这套剑法叫做“静剑”，剑动而人不动，我只需站定，以气御剑，使剑自行出招。
translation: Yuantong: Elder Suwu said my constitution is extremely weak, suited for stillness rather than movement. So the sword technique I practice is called 'Still Sword'. The sword moves while the person remains still. I only need to stand firm, use Qi to control the sword, and make it execute moves on its own.

original_text: 元通：“静剑”修炼的最高境界是御剑于千里之外，但我的修行尚浅，操控的剑还只能飞出三里，唉！这样若是妖界来时，我岂不是半分力都使不上？
translation: Yuantong: The highest stage of 'Still Sword' cultivation is to wield the sword from a thousand miles away, but my cultivation is still shallow-the sword I control can only fly three miles. Sigh! If the yao realm comes, won't I be utterly useless?

original_text: 元通：护卫世间，斩妖除魔乃是琼华弟子职责所在，我们就算与那妖界拼个两败俱伤，也不能让它们危害世间！
translation: Yuantong: Protecting the world and slaying yaoguais or demons are the duties of Qionghua disciples. Even if we fight the yao realm to mutual destruction, we cannot let them harm the world!

original_text: 元通：掌门闭关多日，一定是在修行厉害的仙法，等到她出关，多半就是我派与妖界开战之时。
translation: Yuantong: The sect leader has been in seclusion for many days, surely cultivating powerful immortal techniques. When she emerges, it will likely be time for our sect to go to war with the yao realm.

original_text: 怀思：师父说我们琼华派修仙的法子，比蜀山派高明不知多少倍，可我入门之后，练来练去也就这么一套剑法，完全不觉得是在修仙～
translation: Huaisi: Master says our Qionghua Sect's cultivation method is far superior to Shu Mountain Sect's. But since joining, all I've practiced is this one sword technique-doesn't feel like cultivating immortality at all~

original_text: 怀思：同样都在昆仑山，为什么我们不能学学人家悬圃派和玉英派，炼出仙丹一吃就升仙，根本不用练什么剑法，多轻松啊～
translation: Huaisi: We're all on Kunlun Mountain-why can't we learn from the Xuanpu and Yuying sects? They refine elixirs to ascend instantly, no need for sword training. So much easier~

original_text: 怀思：我可听说了，你的胆子也太大了吧？偷跑下山还跑那么远？！上回我只是偷偷溜去播仙镇喝了两口葡萄酒，就被罚面壁思过七天六夜！
translation: Huaisi: I've heard about it-your courage is too great, isn't it? Sneaking down the mountain and going so far?! Last time, I just sneaked off to Boxian Town to have a couple sips of grape wine and was punished with seven days and six nights of wall-facing contemplation!

original_text: 怀思：最近师父对我越来越严厉，说是什么妖界就要来了，再不用心修行，到时候只有被杀的份！我、我是来修仙的，不是想跟妖怪打架、更不是想被妖怪杀啊！
translation: Huaisi: Lately, Master has been getting stricter with me, saying the yao realm is about to arrive, and if I don't focus on cultivation, I'll only be killed when the time comes! I... I came here to cultivate immortality, not to fight monsters, and definitely not to be killed by them!

original_text: 怀思：卷云台上那是什么东西，看起来好可怕！还好、还好没有一群妖怪从里面冲出来，不然我吓都吓死了……
translation: Huaisi: What is that thing on the Cloud Terrace? It looks so terrifying! Thankfully, thankfully a horde of yaoguais didn't rush out from it, otherwise I'd be scared to death...

original_text: 怀思：掌门和长老们都那么厉害，万一那些妖怪从妖界杀出来，也有他们顶着，我这种辈份低微的弟子嘛，只要乖乖躲在后头就行了～
translation: Huaisi: The sect leader and elders are so powerful. If yaoguais invade from the yao realm, they'll handle it. Low-ranking disciples like me just need to hide safely in the back~

original_text: 怀思：平时看紫英师叔一脸严肃，好像很厉害又很认真的样子，没想到妖界一出现，他跑得比谁都快，整日都不见踪影！真是的……
translation: Huaisi: Usually, Martial Uncle Ziying looks so serious, seemingly powerful and diligent, but who would have thought that as soon as the yao realm appeared, he'd run faster than anyone, disappearing all day long! Really...

original_text: 璇叶：新入门的弟子的卧房，一般都在剑舞坪周围，从这儿往西北走，过一座长桥就能看见剑舞坪了。
translation: Xuanye: The dormitories for new disciples are usually around the Sword Dance Terrace. From here, head northwest, cross a long bridge, and you'll see the Sword Dance Terrace.

original_text: 璇叶：掌门的外表看起来好年轻，但仙法却十分高深，我猜她不是普通人，说不定就是九天玄女娘娘派来引领我们升仙的仙子呢～
translation: Xuanye: The sect leader looks very young, but her immortal arts are incredibly profound. I guess she's no ordinary person-maybe she's a fairy sent by the Ninth Heaven Xuannv to guide us to ascension~

original_text: 璇叶：那妖界……似乎是很厉害的，十九年前不知有多少前辈被妖怪害死了，我虽然害怕，但也绝不会给琼华派丢脸，一定会拼死一搏的！
translation: Xuanye: That yao realm... seems very powerful. Nineteen years ago, many seniors were killed by yaoguais. Though I'm afraid, I won't disgrace the Qionghua Sect and will fight to the death!

original_text: 璇叶：掌门有令，任何人都不要靠近卷云台上的妖界入口。
translation: Xuanye: The Sect Leader has ordered that no one should approach the yao realm entrance on Cloud Terrace.

original_text: 璇叶：掌门这个时候闭关，我猜她一定是得到了玄女娘娘的指点，在修炼一种对付妖界的仙法！
translation: Xuanye: The sect leader entering seclusion at this time-I suspect she must have received guidance from theNinth Heaven Xuannv and is cultivating an immortal technique to deal with the yao realm!

original_text: 璇叶：妖界……一点动静都没有，这样反而让人更害怕，它们一定是有什么诡计，偏偏我们又看不破……
translation: Xuanye: The yao realm... not a single stir. That actually makes it more frightening. They must have some scheme, yet we just can't see through it...

original_text: 灵修：师父叫我来打扫祭地宫，可这里有点阴气，我好害怕～怎么办？
translation: Lingxiu: Master told me to clean the Earth Palace Shrine, but it's a bit eerie here. I'm so scared~ What should I do?

original_text: 灵修：祭地宫是平时祭拜地下鬼神的地方，究竟怎么祭拜，我也不知道……
translation: Lingxiu: The Earth Palace Shrine is where we usually worship the underground ghosts and deities. As for how exactly to worship, I don't know...

original_text: 灵修：师父带我上山的时候，我还以为可以学炼仙丹，没想到天天都要打扫房间，琼华派那么大，打扫一遍下来，天都黑了……
translation: Lingxiu: When Master brought me up the mountain, I thought I could learn to refine immortal pills. Instead, I have to clean rooms every day. Qionghua Sect is so big; by the time I finish cleaning, it's already dark...

original_text: 灵修：师兄他们跟我说……过段日子会有妖怪出现，让我加紧修行，这不是真的吧？要是真的，不如我现在就下山去算了……
translation: Lingxiu: My Martial Brothers told me... that in a while, yaoguais and demons will appear, and I should intensify my cultivation. That can't be true, right? If it is, I might as well leave the mountain now...

original_text: 灵修：卷云台上那个奇怪的东西就是妖界吗？！师父说里面的妖怪都很凶，会冲出来吃人！所以本派弟子要保护其他人，可我法力那么低，一定第一个被吃，怎么办啊！
translation: Lingxiu: Is that strange thing on Cloud Terrace the yao realm?! Master said the yaoguais inside are very fierce and will rush out to eat people! So our sect disciples must protect others, but my magic is so weak, I'll definitely be eaten first, what should I do!

original_text: 灵修：妖怪这么久还没有出现，是不是因为怕了本派……已经回去了？
translation: Lingxiu: The monsters haven't appeared for so long. Is it because they fear our sect... and have already gone back?

original_text: 静言：琼华宫乃是掌门处理派中大小事务之所，若无要事，请勿打扰。
translation: Jingyan: Qionghua Palace is where the sect leader handles all major and minor affairs of the sect. If you have no important matters, please do not disturb.

original_text: 静言：我自入门始，按道家十六境界修行，从“入道”“求道”修行至如今第七重的“养道”境界，用了十年时间，不算长，却也不算短了。
translation: Jingyan: Since entering the sect, I've cultivated according to the sixteen Taoist realms, from 'Entering the Dao' and 'Seeking the Dao' to the current seventh realm, 'Nurturing the Dao'. It took ten years-not too long, but not too short either.

original_text: 静言：掌门律己律人皆十分严格，我入门修行三年之后，便开始侍奉在她左右，却还是有很多事无法令她满意……
translation: Jingyan: The sect leader is strict with herself and others. After three years of training, I began serving by her side, yet many things still fail to satisfy her...

original_text: 静言：这几日我即将晋入第八重“得道”之境，却在关键之处停滞不前，我只盼在妖界来犯前能够有所成，或许还能为本派稍尽绵薄之力。
translation: Jingyan: These days, I'm about to reach the eighth stage 'Enlightenment', but stalled at the key point. I hope to achieve something before the yao realm attacks, maybe contribute a bit to our sect.

original_text: 静言：掌门正召集长老与众弟子在宫中议事，未奉掌门之令者，不得入内。
translation: Jingyan: The Sect Leader is convening the elders and disciples in the palace for a meeting. Those not summoned are not permitted to enter.

original_text: 静言：如今妖界已现，掌门却并不急于攻入，反而去了禁地，莫非禁地中有对抗妖界之法？
translation: Jingyan: Now that the yao realm has appeared, the Sect Leader isn't rushing to attack, but instead went to the forbidden area. Could it be there's a method to counter the yao realm within the forbidden area?

original_text: 静言：妖界久无动静，也不知在盘算些什么，但愿掌门仙法早成，带大家杀入妖界，一举铲除那些邪恶的妖物！
translation: Jingyan: The yao realm has been quiet for a long time; who knows what they're plotting? I hope the sect leader masters her immortal arts soon, so we can charge into the yao realm and wipe out those evil creatures once and for all!

original_text: 虚清：就算资质稍欠，只要用心修行，总会有所精进，修仙求道须得保持着这种“心”才行。
translation: Xuqing: Even with slightly lacking aptitude, diligent cultivation will bring progress. Seeking the Dao requires maintaining this kind of 'heart'.

original_text: 虚清：师父收我入门，养我长大，这份恩德没齿难忘，若妖界真的来犯，我只有拼死相搏以报师门之恩。
translation: Xuqing: Master took me in as a disciple and raised me. This kindness is unforgettable. If the yao realm truly invades, I will fight to the death to repay the sect's grace.

original_text: 虚清：我拜入师门已经十八年了，修行却仍只到第四重“学道”的境界，不像静言师妹，短短十年就修炼到第七重“养道”的境界。
translation: Xuqing: I've been a disciple for eighteen years, but my cultivation is still only at the fourth stage, 'Learning the Way'. Not like Martial Sister Jingyan, who reached the seventh stage, 'Nurturing the Way', in just ten years.

original_text: 虚清：掌门召集众人在琼华宫中议事，其他人等不得入内。
translation: Xuqing: The Sect Leader has summoned everyone to Qionghua Palace for discussion; no others are allowed inside.

original_text: 虚清：原来卷云台上的庞然大物就是妖界，外面看来像是妖兽的脸，很是狰狞，想必里面的妖怪一定也是穷凶极恶，不好对付。
translation: Xuqing: So that colossal thing on Cloud Terrace is the yao realm. From the outside, it looks like a fierce fiend's face, quite hideous. The yaoguais inside must be vicious and hard to deal with.

original_text: 虚清：原来禁地里一直都住着我派的前辈高人，掌门和他一起修炼，出关之时一定能威慑妖界！
translation: Xuqing: So a senior master of our sect has been living in the forbidden area all along. The sect leader cultivating with him-upon exiting seclusion, they will surely awe the yao realm!

original_text: 虚寂：这“敬天”之中供奉的宝珠，乃是九天玄女赐于我琼华派先祖的“天珠”，普通弟子虽不知它的用处，但想必是十分玄妙了得的宝物。
translation: Xuji: The precious pearl enshrined in this 'Jingtian' Hall is the 'Heavenly Pearl' bestowed upon our Qionghua Sect's ancestors by the Ninth Heaven Xuannv. Although ordinary disciples don't know its use, it must be an extremely profound and remarkable treasure.

original_text: 虚寂：在昆仑八派之中，唯有昆仑派和我琼华派主张炼剑修仙，因而两派之间算是有所往来。
translation: Xuji: Among the eight sects of Kunlun, only the Kunlun Sect and our Qionghua Sect advocate sword refinement for immortality. Thus, the two sects have some dealings.

original_text: 虚寂：妖界随时可能出现，我派弟子当务之急就是加紧修行！无关紧要的事都可暂时搁置。
translation: Xuji: The yao realm could appear at any moment. Our sect's disciples' top priority is to intensify their cultivation! All trivial matters can be set aside for now.

original_text: 虚寂：听闻十九年前，我们与妖界一战，死伤惨重，这些年掌门苦心经营门派，想必为的就是妖界再临之时，能有万全的应对之法！
translation: Xuji: I heard that nineteen years ago, our battle with the yao realm caused heavy casualties. All these years, the sect leader has painstakingly managed the sect, surely to be fully prepared when the yao realm returns!

original_text: 虚寂：紫英师弟平日行事孤僻古怪也就罢了，如今我派和妖界大战在即，所有弟子都在备战，只有他却忽然没了踪影，实在太不像样！
translation: Xuji: Martial Brother Ziying has always been eccentric and aloof in his daily conduct, but now, with our sect on the brink of war against the yao realm, all disciples are preparing for battle. Yet he has suddenly vanished without a trace-utterly disgraceful!

original_text: 虚寂：掌门定是找到了对付妖界的办法，才会在禁地苦修多日，待她出关之日，便是我琼华派杀入妖界之时！前代掌门的大仇一定要报！
translation: Xuji: The Sect Leader must have found a way to deal with the yao realm, which is why she's been cultivating in seclusion in the forbidden area for days. When she emerges, it will be time for our Qionghua Sect to invade the yao realm! We must avenge the previous Sect Leader!

original_text: 怀见：我刚采药回来，正要去前面的龙芽道丹，把草药拿给师父炼丹呢。
translation: Huaijian: I just came back from gathering herbs, heading to Longya Medicines to give the herbs to Master for alchemy.

original_text: 怀见：我和其他师兄弟就住在剑舞坪附近，离龙芽道丹也不远，平时在外面受了小伤，去师父那儿取了药回房，很是方便。
translation: Huaijian: The other Martial Brothers and I live near Sword Dance Terrace, not far from Longya Medicines. When we get minor injuries outside, it's very convenient to get medicine from Master and return to our rooms.

original_text: 怀见：因为每天采药的缘故，我已经用惯了锄头，师父就专为我创了一套修仙的锄法，现在就算外出我也是御锄，别的倒没什么，就是难看了点……
translation: Huaijian: Because I gather herbs every day, I've gotten used to the hoe. My master specially created a set of immortal-cultivating hoe techniques for me. Now, even when I travel, I ride my hoe. It's nothing else, just a bit unsightly...

original_text: 怀见：最近整个门派都在议论妖界之事，依我看，既然十九年前没有赢过它们，反而损兵折将，如今只怕更是凶多吉少啊……
translation: Huaijian: Recently, the whole sect is discussing the yao realm. In my view, since we couldn't win nineteen years ago and suffered heavy losses, now it's likely even more perilous...

original_text: 怀见：卷云台上突然出现了一个可怕的巨物！掌门已下令不准大家靠近，可我刚才远远看见柳师妹跑上了卷云台，不知她想干嘛。
translation: Huaijian: A terrifying giant creature suddenly appeared on Cloud Terrace! The sect leader has ordered everyone not to approach, but I just saw Martial Sister Liu run up there from afar. I wonder what she's up to.

original_text: 怀见：我只知琼华派剑法了得，对妖界用的法术却是一无所知，若是双方交战，妖物又大都狡猾奸诈，我们恐怕很难占上风……
translation: Huaijian: I only know Qionghua Sect's sword techniques are formidable, but I know nothing of the spells used against the yao realm. If we fight, and fiends are mostly cunning and deceitful, we'd likely struggle to gain the upper hand...

original_text: 怀见：现在琼华派所有的弟子都准备和妖界死战，只有紫英师叔却不见踪影，不知发生了什么事……
translation: Huaijian: Now all the disciples of Qionghua Sect are preparing for a life-and-death battle with the yao realm, but only Martial Uncle Ziying is nowhere to be seen. I wonder what happened...

original_text: 怀宁：本派擅铸剑炼铁之术，此间玄珠心镜的饰物，也多出于门下弟子之手。
translation: Huaining: Our sect excels in sword forging and iron smelting. Many of the ornaments here, like the Mystic Pearl Heart Mirror, are made by our disciples.

original_text: 怀宁：昆仑八派之中，碧玉、紫翠两派重炼凝神，因而两派弟子多佩宁神静心的饰物，其材质、造工都是上上之品。
translation: Huaining: Among the Eight Sects of Kunlun, the Biyu and Zicui Sects focus on refining and concentrating the spirit. Thus, their disciples often wear ornaments for calming and focusing the mind. Their materials and craftsmanship are of the highest quality.

original_text: 怀宁：少年人血气方刚，行事冲动鲁莽是难免的，你可以在这里挑几件宁神静气的饰品，戴在身上有平和心境之功用。
translation: Huaining: Young people are full of vigor and often act impulsively. It's unavoidable. You can pick a few calming accessories here; wearing them helps soothe the mind and bring peace.

original_text: 怀宁：璇玑师妹最喜欢到这里来，每次看到新鲜的小饰物，便会磨着师父送她几件，师父说不过她，自然也就只能送她了。
translation: Huaining: Martial Sister Xuanji loves coming here the most. Every time she sees fresh little ornaments, she pesters Master to give her a few. Master can't argue with her, so naturally he just gives them to her.

original_text: 怀宁：掌门身上所佩之玉，蕴有无限灵气，是一件仙家至宝，修仙者将其带在身上，若是修炼得当，可得事半功倍之效。
translation: Huaining: The jade pendant worn by the sect leader contains boundless spiritual energy-a supreme treasure of the immortals. If a cultivator carries it and trains properly, they can achieve twice the result with half the effort.

original_text: 怀宁：妖界已临，掌门于此时去禁地，一定是另有打算，与禁地中不为人知的秘密相关吧。
translation: Huaining: The yao realm has arrived. The Sect Leader going to the forbidden area at this time must have other plans, related to its hidden secrets.

original_text: 怀宁：原来禁地中还有本派的前辈高人，之前不让弟子随意进入，定是怕打扰前辈清修，如今妖界降临，掌门在禁地闭关，应是在接受高人指点，以御妖界强敌。
translation: Huaining: So there are senior masters of our sect in the forbidden area. No wonder disciples weren't allowed to enter freely-it must have been to avoid disturbing the seniors' cultivation. Now, with the yao realm descending and the sect leader in seclusion there, she must be receiving guidance from these masters to fend off the powerful enemies from the yao realm.

original_text: 怀宁：我派和妖界的大战一触即发，我的修为虽不出众，却也绝无退缩之理！
translation: Huaining: The great battle between our sect and the yao realm is imminent. Though my cultivation is not outstanding, I will never retreat!

original_text: 明丹：道家仙丹之要，在神水华池，得神水而后生白金，白金返黄金，黄金返紫金，紫金流液熏结而成丹。此等仙丹之法，炼制之时尚需观天地阴阳五行之气，其中繁复，便是昆仑八派中最擅长炼丹的悬圃、玉英两派，亦无法完全掌控。
translation: Ming Dan: The essence of Taoist immortal elixirs lies in the Divine Water and Jade Pool. Obtain the Divine Water, then give birth to White Gold. White Gold returns to Yellow Gold. Yellow Gold returns to Purple Gold. Purple Gold flows as liquid, fumigated and condensed to form the elixir. This method of immortal elixirs, during its refinement, also requires observing the qi of Heaven and Earth's yin-yang and the five elements. Its complexity is such that even the Xuanpu and Yuying sects, the two most skilled in alchemy among the Eight Sects of Kunlun, cannot fully master it.

original_text: 明丹：所谓还丹，乃炼水银而返为丹者。此间丹炉中只炼雄黄雌黄，不炼水银丹砂，治病治伤的丹药不少，修仙炼气的大小还丹是很少的。
translation: Ming Dan: So-called 'Return Elixir' refers to refining mercury back into cinnabar. The furnaces here only refine realgar and orpiment, not mercury or cinnabar. There are many pills for curing illnesses and injuries, but few major or minor Return Elixirs for cultivation.

original_text: 明丹：道门仙丹炼制，有外丹、内丹之说。昆仑八派之中，悬圃、玉英两派所炼丹药俱为外丹，而以炼气为主的阆风、天墉两派，则修内丹。
translation: Ming Dan: In Taoist immortal pill refinement, there are theories of external elixirs and internal elixirs. Among the eight sects of Kunlun, the Xuanpu and Yuying sects refine external elixirs, while the Langfeng and Tianyong sects, which focus on refining qi, cultivate internal elixirs.

original_text: 明丹：怀见常常采药，用惯了药锄，师父就干脆让他使锄，还为他创了锄法，由剑入锄，虽然招式不同，但归其根本，同我琼华剑法并无两样。
translation: Ming Dan: Huaijian often gathers herbs and is used to the herb hoe, so Master simply let him use a hoe and even created a hoe technique for him. Moving from sword to hoe, though the moves differ, fundamentally it's no different from our Qionghua sword techniques.

original_text: 明丹：自妖界现形以来，怀见师弟常在剑舞坪一练一整日，他的那套锄法也越练越熟，师父已命我教授他下一套锄法了。
translation: Ming Dan: Ever since the yao realm appeared, Martial Brother Huaijian often practices at Sword Dance Terrace from dawn till dusk. His hoe technique grows more proficient by the day, and Master has already ordered me to teach him the next set of hoe techniques.

original_text: 明丹：此间已备足金创药、还神丹，和妖界的大战无论何时开始，我派受伤的弟子都绝不会无药可用。
translation: Ming Dan: We've prepared enough Medicine here. Whenever the battle with the yao realm begins, our injured disciples will never lack medicine.

original_text: 璇云：修行讲究辟谷之术，其实吃东西已是不多，但斋菜总还是要备着。
translation: Xuanyun: Cultivation emphasizes the art of abstaining from grains. In truth, we don't eat much, but vegetarian dishes must still be prepared.

original_text: 璇云：我以前住在山下播仙镇，因为感念山上神仙赐清水给我们，就想上山来拜谢神仙，没想到竟留在这儿修行了，“璇云”这个号也是师父帮我取的。
translation: Xuanyun: I used to live in Boxian Town at the mountain's base. Grateful for the clear water the mountain immortals gave us, I wanted to come up to thank them. Never thought I'd stay here to cultivate. The name 'Xuanyun' was also given by my master.

original_text: 璇云：听说不久妖怪就会来了……派里其他弟子都很用心地在修炼，可我只会做菜，剑术练得不好……万一、万一那些妖怪伤害到山下的人怎么办……
translation: Xuanyun: I heard the fiends will come soon... Other disciples in the sect are diligently cultivating, but I only know how to cook and am not good at sword techniques... What if... what if those fiends harm the people below the mountain...

original_text: 璇云：掌门这几日茶饭不思，如今索性去了禁地，怕是要闭关吧……可惜我没用，根本帮不上她什么忙……
translation: Xuanyun: The Sect Leader hasn't eaten or drunk much these days, and now she's gone to the Forbidden Area, probably to enter seclusion... It's a pity I'm useless and can't help her at all...

original_text: 璇云：我好怕妖界……可我不会逃走的，如果琼华派的弟子都逃了，那山下的人怎么办，不是只能等着被妖怪吃吗……
translation: Xuanyun: I'm so scared of the yao realm... but I won't run away. If all the Qionghua Sect disciples fled, what would happen to the people down the mountain? Wouldn't they just be waiting to be eaten by fiends...

original_text: 怀心：听说本门收了三名新弟子，我入门一年多了，一直都是小师弟，现在终于能当师兄啦，哈哈～
translation: Huaixin: I heard our sect has accepted three new disciples. I've been the Martial Brother for over a year since joining. Now I can finally be a Senior Brother, haha~

original_text: 怀心：因为我入门较晚，所以打扫卧室的事都归我做，师父说修行不只是练气练剑，在山上做的任何一件事情都是修行。
translation: Huaixin: Because I joined the sect later, cleaning the bedrooms falls to me. My master says cultivation isn't just about practicing qi and swords-everything you do on the mountain is part of cultivation.

original_text: 怀心：我终于把琼华派入门的剑法和心法练好了！师父叫我自己去承天剑台找虚冶师伯铸一把新的剑，你说我要什么样的剑才好呢？
translation: Huaixin: I've finally mastered the basic sword techniques and mental cultivation methods of the Qionghua Sect! My master told me to go to Chengtian Sword Platform myself to ask Martial Uncle Xuye to forge a new sword. What kind of sword do you think I should get?

original_text: 怀心：如今妖界即将出现，听说其中都是强大残忍的妖！即使这样，我也不会退缩的，修仙问道本就是为了保护黎民百姓！
translation: Huaixin: Now that the yao realm is about to appear, I hear it's full of powerful and cruel yaoguais! Even so, I won't back down. Cultivating immortality and seeking the Dao is precisely to protect the common people!

original_text: 怀心：现在只要走出屋门就能感到一阵阵阴风从卷云台上吹下来，风里还夹杂着妖气，定是那妖界散发出来的！
translation: Huaixin: Now, just stepping outside the door, you can feel gusts of eerie wind blowing down from the Cloud Terrace, mixed with yao aura. It must be emanating from that yao realm!

original_text: 怀心：妖界现形也有一阵子了，却不见有妖怪跑出来，也不见它离开，不知道里面的妖怪在盘算什么阴谋诡计？
translation: Huaixin: The yao realm has been visible for a while now, but no yaoguais have come out, nor has it left. I wonder what schemes the yaoguais inside are plotting?

original_text: 静语：我乃本派威仪长老座下的执事弟子，协助长老督促弟子言行举止，你初入本派，凡事皆须谨遵师命，切不可随意行事。
translation: Jingyu: I am a disciplinary disciple under the Dignity Elder, assisting in overseeing disciples' conduct. As a new member, you must strictly follow your masters' orders and not act recklessly.

original_text: 静语：掌门在此时收你入门，一定是非常看重你的天资，切勿令她失望啊！
translation: Jingyu: For the Sect Leader to accept you as a disciple at this time, she must highly value your talent. Do not disappoint her!

original_text: 静语：前日里才关照过你不要随意行事，你就私自下山！若不是掌门有令不再追究，我必上报正法长老，罚你面壁！
translation: Jingyu: Just the day before yesterday, I warned you not to act recklessly, and you went down the mountain without permission! If the sect leader hadn't ordered no further investigation, I'd have reported to the Discipline Elder to have you face the wall!

original_text: 静语：十九年一度、妖界将临的日子近了，掌门正忙于对付妖界的大事，其他弟子也应做好殊死一战的准备！此妖界凶残成性，连前代掌门都是被它们害死的！
translation: Jingyu: The yao realm's once-in-nineteen-years arrival nears. The Sect Leader is busy preparing, and all disciples must be ready for a life-or-death fight! That realm is vicious-even the former Sect Leader was killed by them!

original_text: 静语：卷云台上出现的庞然大物正是妖界，不少弟子还不知道，但掌门已下令，所有弟子都不得靠近卷云台！
translation: Jingyu: The colossal entity appearing on Cloud Terrace is precisely the yao realm. Many disciples don't know yet, but the sect leader has ordered that no disciple is to approach Cloud Terrace!

original_text: 静语：这次掌门前往禁地，一定是与对付妖界的事情有关，听师父说过，后山禁地十多年来从未有人入内，不知其中到底藏有什么秘密？
translation: Jingyu: This time, the Sect Leader went to the forbidden area, it must be related to dealing with the yao realm. I heard from Master that no one has entered the forbidden area on the rear mountain for over ten years. I wonder what secrets are hidden inside?

original_text: 静语：其他弟子或许不知，但我却知道，掌门已逐你下山！为何还留在山上？！
translation: Jingyu: Other disciples might not know, but I do-the Sect Leader has already expelled you from the mountain! Why are you still here?!

original_text: 灵观：这里是正法长老的卧房～哎？你不会以为我是正法长老吧？怎么可能嘛？我只是来打扫的～
translation: Lingguan: This is Discipline Elder's bedroom~ Huh? You didn't think I was Discipline Elder, did you? How could that be? I'm just here to clean~

original_text: 灵观：正法长老有事不在山上，但他的房间却还是天天都要打扫，要是他回来以后，发现房间不干净的话，我会挨骂的。
translation: Lingguan: Discipline Elder is away on business, but his room still needs daily cleaning. If he returns and finds the room untidy, I'll get scolded.

original_text: 灵观：上回我在这儿不小心砸碎了一个茶杯！本以为长老一定会责骂我，没想到他只是让我收拾完了就离开，一定是妖界快要来了，长老心事重，顾不上这种小事了……
translation: Lingguan: Last time I accidentally broke a teacup here! I thought the elder would surely scold me, but he just told me to clean up and leave. It must be because the yao realm is coming soon, the elder is preoccupied and can't bother with such small matters...

original_text: 灵观：师兄师姐们本来话就不多，最近听说有大妖怪要出现了，大家更是只顾修炼，和我说话的人越来越少了……
translation: Lingguan: Martial Brothers and sisters never talked much to begin with. Recently, hearing that a great monster is about to appear, everyone just focuses on cultivation. Fewer and fewer people talk to me...

original_text: 灵观：大家都说卷云台上那个怪物就是妖界，掌门还吩咐大家不要靠近，可我们琼华派有这么多厉害的弟子，还有法力无边的掌门和长老，还会怕妖怪吗？
translation: Lingguan: Everyone says the monster on Cloud Terrace is the yao realm, and the Sect Leader ordered everyone not to approach. But our Qionghua Sect has so many powerful disciples, plus the almighty Sect Leader and elders. Would we still fear yaoguais?

original_text: 灵观：那个妖界在天上已经好久了，掌门又去禁地闭关，我们到底什么时候才能把妖界打跑？
translation: Lingguan: That yao realm has been in the sky for so long. The Sect Leader is in seclusion again. When can we finally drive the yao realm away?

original_text: 明常：师父教我的剑法叫作“八卦剑”，师父说其要诀在于“挑托抹挂扁，搜闭扫顺截”，可这十个字什么意思啊？我耍起剑来，还是完全不得要领……
translation: Mingchang: The sword technique my master taught me is called 'Eight Trigrams Sword'. Master said its essence lies in 'lift, support, wipe, hang, flatten, search, close, sweep, follow, intercept'. But what do these ten words mean? When I wield the sword, I still have no clue...

original_text: 明常：我终于明白了！原来练这“八卦剑”的要领全在手腕和手臂的方位，只要方位正确，就能使好剑法！
translation: Mingchang: I finally understand! The key to mastering this 'Eight Trigrams Sword' lies entirely in the positioning of the wrist and arm. As long as the positioning is correct, the sword technique can be executed well!

original_text: 明常：自从领悟了八卦剑修炼的十字要诀，我的剑术和修为都一日千里般精进，如此下去，即便是妖界，我也不怕它了！
translation: Mingchang: Since comprehending the ten-character essential formula for cultivating the Eight Trigrams Sword, my swordsmanship and cultivation have advanced by leaps and bounds. If I continue like this, even the yao realm holds no fear for me!

original_text: 明常：哼！要是那个女贼胆敢把歪主意打到我头上，我就让她尝尝手中这柄八卦剑的厉害！
translation: Mingchang: Hmph! If that female thief dares target me, I'll let her taste the power of this Eight Trigram Sword in my hand!

original_text: 明常：刚才卷云台上突然黑云翻滚、阴风怒号，一定是出大事啦！莫非、莫非是妖界……
translation: Mingchang: Just now, dark clouds suddenly churned and eerie winds howled on the Cloud Terrace-something big must have happened! Could it be... the yao realm...

original_text: 明常：我见柳师妹从这儿往卷云台的方向跑了！她跑得飞快，我叫也叫不住！
translation: Mingchang: I saw Martial Sister Liu running toward the Cloud Terrace from here! She was running so fast, I couldn't stop her!

original_text: 明常：妖界确实非同一般，只是站在这儿，就能感到妖风阵阵，心思稍有不稳，气息就紊乱了……
translation: Mingchang: The yao realm is truly extraordinary. Just standing here, I can feel winds with yao aura. If your mind wavers even slightly, your energy becomes disordered...

original_text: 明常：所谓临危之时见人心，以前大家都说紫英师叔心性稳重，能成大器，现在妖界一出现，他就跑得没影了，这不是胆小怕事是什么？
translation: Mingchang: They say true character shows in crisis. Everyone used to say Martial Uncle Ziying was steady and destined for greatness. Now that the yao realm appears, he's vanished without a trace. Isn't that just cowardice?

original_text: 静慈：师父曾说，现任掌门论才华资质，皆不是当年最优秀的弟子，只是十多年前派中发生剧变，现任掌门只得临危受命，挑起了这副重担。
translation: Jingci: Master once said that the current sect leader's talent and aptitude were not the best among the disciples back then. It's just that over a decade ago, a great upheaval occurred in the sect, and the current leader had to take on this heavy responsibility in a crisis.

original_text: 静慈：“夫剑之道，甚微而易，其意甚幽而深。”我修习剑术九年有余，剑法愈是精进，对这句要旨体会愈深。
translation: Jingci: 'The way of the sword is subtle yet accessible, its meaning profound and deep'. Having practiced swordsmanship for over nine years, the more refined my skills become, the deeper my understanding of this essence grows.

original_text: 静慈：听师父说，西北面的卷云台便是十九年前我派和妖界大战的地方。如我辈弟子，是想像不出当年的场面是何等惨烈的。
translation: Jingci: Master said the Cloud Terrace to the northwest was where our sect battled the yao realm nineteen years ago. Disciples like us can hardly imagine how brutal that scene was.

original_text: 静慈：我正在修习的这套剑法，相传是春秋时一位隐居山林的大师所创，后来虽经琼华派先人琢磨修改，但最初的要诀，却从未更动过。
translation: Jingci: The sword technique I'm currently practicing is said to have been created by a master who lived in seclusion during the Spring and Autumn period. Though later refined and modified by Qionghua Sect ancestors, the original essentials have never been changed.

original_text: 静慈：我派门下弟子皆为品性端正、光明磊落之人，何时出过盗贼？但愿掌门能早日将那女贼逐出师门，以免污了琼华派的清誉！
translation: Jingci: All disciples of our sect are upright and honorable people. When have we ever had thieves? I hope the Sect Leader can expel that female thief from the sect soon, to avoid tarnishing Qionghua Sect's reputation!

original_text: 静慈：掌门吩咐，不可靠近卷云台，莫非那柳梦璃不知道？我见她竟往那个方向跑去！
translation: Jingci: The Sect Leader ordered not to approach Cloud Terrace. Could it be that Liu Mengli doesn't know? I saw her running in that direction!

original_text: 静慈：妖界果然是说来就来，一个时辰前卷云台边还什么都没有，现在却突然出现了这么一个面目狰狞的庞然大物！
translation: Jingci: The yao realm truly comes as it pleases. Just two hours ago, there was nothing at Cloud Terrace, but now this terrifying, monstrous thing has suddenly appeared!

original_text: 静慈：我这套剑法已练得不错，趁现在和妖界的大战没开始，先去承天剑台找虚冶师兄把我手里的剑重铸一番，到时候就能用最厉害的剑法和最称手的宝剑杀妖！
