translation: Jingci: I've practiced this sword technique quite well. Before the big battle with the yao realm starts, I'll go to the Chengtian Sword Platform to have Martial Brother Xuye reforge my sword. Then I can use the most powerful sword technique with the most suitable sword to slay yaoguais!

original_text: 元开：我师从本派肃武长老，如今负责在此指点其他弟子习武，是本派的肃武执事弟子之一。
translation: Yuan Kai: I studied under our sect's Elder Suwu and am now responsible for guiding other disciples in martial training here, serving as one of the sect's Suwu Disciplinary Disciples.

original_text: 元开：习剑之法，贵在“因剑习义”，心剑合一，剑随意走，此乃我琼华派练剑修仙的要旨。
translation: Yuan Kai: The essence of sword training lies in 'learning righteousness through the sword', uniting heart and blade, letting the sword follow intent. This is the core principle of our Qionghua Sect's sword practice for immortality.

original_text: 元开：剑术三不传中有云，“无礼无节者不传”，所以剑意也是礼节，剑是修身养性之道。
translation: Yuan Kai: Among the three prohibitions of swordsmanship, it is said, 'The impolite and undisciplined shall not be taught'. Thus, sword intent is also etiquette; the sword is a path for self-cultivation.

original_text: 元开：现今派中弟子加紧习剑原是好事，但习剑本当适度，切忌练之过劳，否则不仅对修行无益，更可能伤身伤神，最后得不偿失。
translation: Yuan Kai: It's originally good that disciples in the sect are intensifying their sword practice now, but sword practice should be moderate, avoid overtraining. Otherwise, it not only hinders cultivation but may also harm the body and spirit, ultimately being more loss than gain.

original_text: 元开：我琼华派弟子向来都是正直坦荡之人，怎可收一个贼人入门？此等偷鸡摸狗之徒，根本不配修习本派的剑术仙法！
translation: Yuan Kai: We disciples of Qionghua Sect have always been upright and honorable. How could we accept a thief into our ranks? Such a sneaky, petty person is utterly unworthy of learning our sect's sword arts and immortal techniques!

original_text: 元开：近日派中很多弟子的修为都一日千里，若那妖界来犯，形势或许不如想像中那般严峻。
translation: Yuan Kai: Recently, many disciples in the sect have made rapid progress in cultivation. If the yao realm attacks, the situation might not be as dire as imagined.

original_text: 元开：本派剑法看似纷繁复杂，路数极多，实则万宗归一，只要将“走、转、裹、翻、穿、撩、提、按”八字要诀融会贯通，配合心法，便能练好。
translation: Yuan Kai: Our sect's sword techniques may seem complex with many variations, but they all converge into one. As long as you master the eight essentials-'step, turn, wrap, flip, pierce, sweep, lift, press'-and integrate them with the mental method, you can train well.

original_text: 元开：紫英师弟的剑术仙法向来有过人之处，此时我派和妖界的大战一触即发，他却又跑去哪里了？
translation: Yuan Kai: Martial Brother Ziying's sword arts and immortal techniques have always been exceptional. Now with our sect and yao realm on the brink of war, where has he gone again?

original_text: 明弈：我最仰慕紫英师叔的剑法，做梦都想请他指点几招，可惜我一和他说话就紧张……
translation: Mingyi: I admire Martial Uncle Ziying's swordsmanship the most. I dream of asking him for pointers, but I get nervous every time I talk to him...

original_text: 明弈：我师父是个爱剑胜过爱习剑的人，上次他带我看了五灵剑阁里的宝剑，每一把剑的来历他都能说的清清楚楚，毫不含糊！你也想去看的话，五灵剑阁就从南边的桥往东南走，很容易找到～
translation: Mingyi: My master loves swords more than he loves swordplay. Last time, he showed me the precious swords in the Five Elements Sword Pavilion-he could clearly explain the origin of every single one without hesitation! If you want to see it too, the Five Elements Sword Pavilion is easy to find-head southeast from the southern bridge~

original_text: 明弈：真是不公平，掌门为什么不叫紫英师叔来指点我的剑法呢？如果是师叔教我的话，我绝对不会像你一样天天偷懒、惹师叔生气的！
translation: Mingyi: It's so unfair! Why didn't the Sect Leader ask Martial Uncle Ziying to instruct me in swordsmanship? If he were teaching me, I'd never be lazy every day and make him angry like you do!

original_text: 明弈：我师父人是很好，待我也很不错，可是如今妖界快要来了，他却还是整日沉迷于古剑典籍，一点新的仙术剑法都不教我，真是急死人了！
translation: Mingyi: My master is a good person and treats me well, but now that the yao realm is about to arrive, he's still obsessed with ancient sword texts all day, not teaching me any new immortal arts or sword techniques. It's really frustrating!

original_text: 明弈：掌门刚才召集了很多师叔师伯去议事，元开师伯、静慈师叔、连紫英师叔都被召集去了，看来掌门一定是要宣布重要的事。
translation: Mingyi: The sect leader just summoned many uncles and aunts for a meeting-Uncle Yuankai, Aunt Jingci, even Uncle Ziying were called. It seems the sect leader must be announcing something important.

original_text: 明弈：那个柳梦璃是怎么了？从房间里冲出来就往卷云台上跑！
translation: Mingyi: What happened to that Liu Mengli? She rushed out of her room and ran straight to Cloud Terrace!

original_text: 明弈：不久前卷云台上黑云翻滚，我抬头一看，就看见现在的这个庞然大物了！
translation: Mingyi: Not long ago, dark clouds churned over Cloud Terrace. I looked up and saw this colossal thing as it is now!

original_text: 明弈：如今妖界与我们开战在即，我相信紫英师叔绝不会在这种时候弃师门而不顾，他、他一定是下山寻找对抗妖界的方法去了！
translation: Mingyi: With the yao realm about to go to war with us, I believe Uncle Ziying would never abandon the sect at such a time. He... he must have gone down the mountain to find a way to fight the yao realm!

original_text: 璇玉：从这儿往上走就是卷云台，听派中的前辈们说，以前经常有弟子上卷云台静思，但自从十九年前本派与妖界在卷云台一场大战之后，就很少有人上去了。
translation: Xuanyu: Going up leads to Cloud Terrace. Elders say disciples often meditated there, but since the great battle with the yao realm nineteen years ago, few go up now.

original_text: 璇玉：掌门一直是个很严厉的人，派中弟子都很敬畏她，从来没有人敢违抗她的命令。我入门资历尚浅，每次看见掌门都会觉得有些害怕……
translation: Xuanyu: The sect leader has always been a very strict person. Disciples in the sect both respect and fear her; no one dares disobey her orders. My time as a disciple is still short, and I always feel a bit scared whenever I see the sect leader...

original_text: 璇玉：这几天我加紧修炼，终于把师父教给我的第一套剑法练好了，师父说我现在手里的这把剑要拿去重铸，等剑铸好了，再教我新的剑法。
translation: Xuanyu: These past few days, I intensified my training and finally mastered the first sword technique my master taught me. My master said the sword I'm holding now needs to be reforged. Once the sword is ready, she'll teach me a new sword technique.

original_text: 璇玉：我娘就是被山里的妖怪咬死的，幸好当时师父路过，才救了我一条命。我练好仙术，也要像其他师兄师姐一样下山除妖！
translation: Xuanyu: My mother was bitten to death by a mountain yaoguai. Luckily, Master passed by and saved my life. Once I master immortal arts, I'll go down the mountain to slay yaoguais like my Martial Brothers and sisters!

original_text: 璇玉：我刚才去找师父，没想到师父被掌门召了去，听说掌门还召集了很多其他弟子，看来是有重要的事情要宣布。
translation: Xuanyu: I went to find my master earlier, but unexpectedly, the sect leader summoned him. I heard the sect leader also called many other disciples-it seems something important is going to be announced.

original_text: 璇玉：刚才那个是梦璃师妹吧？急急忙忙跑去卷云台，还差点撞到我身上！
translation: Xuanyu: Was that Mengli just now? She rushed off to the Cloud Terrace in such a hurry, almost bumping into me!

original_text: 璇玉：掌门到后山禁地去干什么呢？难道是禁地里藏着对付妖界的宝物，掌门要亲自去取？
translation: Xuanyu: What is the Sect Leader doing at the forbidden area in the rear mountain? Could it be that treasures to deal with the yao realm are hidden there, and the Sect Leader is going to retrieve them personally?

original_text: 璇玉：禁地里面藏的应该是一件能够破除妖界结界的宝物吧？掌门去禁地，一定就是为了那件宝贝！
translation: Xuanyu: What's hidden in the forbidden area should be a treasure capable of breaking the yao realm's barrier, right? The Sect Leader going to the forbidden area must be for that very treasure!

original_text: 虚尘：我派向来着重于练剑修仙，因而祥符阁中所收符箓，大都是剑符。所谓剑符，便是符上咒言排布如一利剑，只要是被鬼邪附体，或沾染阴气邪气等引起的病症，都可以剑符驱之。
translation: Xu Chen: Our sect has always focused on sword cultivation and immortality, so most talismans collected in the Xiangfu Pavilion are Sword Talismans. Sword Talismans have incantations arranged like a sharp blade. They can expel any illness caused by ghostly possession or contamination by Yin or evil energy.

original_text: 虚尘：西蜀的百姓多使用蜀山仙剑派的符箓，其实蜀山派的符箓哪里比得上我们琼华派的？
translation: Xu Chen: The people of Western Shu mostly use talismans from the Shu Mountain Immortal Sword Sect. In truth, how can Shu Mountain's talismans compare to our Qionghua Sect's?

original_text: 虚尘：“太上台星，应变无停，驱邪缚魅，保命护身。智慧明净，心神安宁，三魂永久，魄无丧倾。”
translation: Xu Chen: "The Supreme Star of Tai, adapts without cease, dispels evil and binds demons, protects life and guards the body. Wisdom bright and pure, heart and spirit tranquil, three souls eternal, seven spirits never lost."

original_text: 虚尘：卷云台旁出现的就是妖界，只是那妖界之外有层结界，任凭我用何种符咒都无法破除，因而掌门只让我们先多加戒备，不要随意靠近。
translation: Xu Chen: What appeared beside the Cloud Terrace is the yao realm. However, there's a barrier around that yao realm. No matter what talismans I use, I cannot break it. Thus, the sect leader only ordered us to be more vigilant for now and not approach it recklessly.

original_text: 虚尘：也许禁地之中藏有我派失传已久的“九天玄女破甲神咒”的咒文符法，掌门此去禁地，正是要取那符法来大破妖界。
translation: Xu Chen: Perhaps the forbidden area holds the lost incantations and talismans of our sect's 'Ninth Heaven Xuannv Armor-Breaking Divine Curse'. The sect leader went there precisely to retrieve those arts to crush the yao realm.

original_text: 虚尘：我最近钻研典籍，找到一种剑符，将此符附于剑刃之上，那些妖怪只要被剑刺伤，便会顷刻毙命！这确是我们对抗妖界的利器啊！
translation: Xu Chen: I've been studying ancient texts recently and found a type of sword talisman. Attaching this talisman to a blade, any yaoguai pierced by the sword will die instantly! This is truly a powerful weapon against the yao realm!

original_text: 灵意：万安殿里供奉的，都是琼华派历代先辈，进去祭拜一定要恭敬！
translation: Lingyi: TWan'an Hall enshrines the past generations of Qionghua Sect seniors. Enter to pay respects with reverence!

original_text: 灵意：万安殿内供奉着历代掌门用过的法器，那可都是了不起的法宝呢！
translation: Lingyi: Wan'an Hall enshrines ritual instruments used by past sect leaders-all are remarkable magical treasures!

original_text: 灵意：万安殿里有些灵位，听说是十九年前我派和妖界大战时死去的人……
translation: Lingyi: There are some memorial tablets in the Wan'an Hall. I heard they're for people who died in the great battle between our sect and the yao realm nineteen years ago...

original_text: 灵意：妖界真的来了，过了十九年，我们能打赢吗？……
translation: Lingyi: The yao realm has truly come. After nineteen years, can we win?...

original_text: 静离：我派先祖梦中得九天玄女娘娘指引，创出人剑合一的修仙之法，因而玄女娘娘便是我派尊神，派中弟子皆应供奉参拜。
translation: Jingli: Our sect's ancestors, guided in a dream by the Ninth Heaven Xuannv, created the cultivation method of uniting human and sword. Thus, the Ninth Heaven Xuannv is our revered deity, and all disciples should worship her.

original_text: 静离：师父传授的心法我似乎不甚明了，因而到此静心思索，希望能借玄女娘娘的智慧，让我快些领会。
translation: Jingli: I don't seem to fully understand the mental cultivation method Master taught. So I came here to contemplate quietly, hoping the wisdom of the Ninth Heaven Xuannv will help me grasp it sooner.

original_text: 静离：我梦中见玄女娘娘指点我修习心法，醒来之后，按梦中之法运气修习，果然有所精进！多谢玄女娘娘显灵指点！
translation: Jingli: In my dream, I saw the Ninth Heaven Xuannv instructing me in cultivating the mental method. After waking, I practiced according to the method from the dream, and indeed made progress! Thank you, Ninth Heaven Xuannv, for your divine guidance!

original_text: 静离：入门至今我也曾经多次下山除妖，若那妖界来犯，我也绝不会对它们心慈手软！
translation: Jingli: Since joining the sect, I've gone down the mountain many times to eliminate yaoguais. If the yao realm attacks, I won't show any mercy either!

original_text: 静离：九天玄女娘娘是西王母的弟子，曾授神将轩辕氏兵信神符以破蚩尤，若我派能得玄女娘娘授意，定能大破妖界，全胜而归！
translation: Jingli: The Ninth Heaven Xuannv is a disciple of the Queen Mother of the West. She once bestowed the divine military talisman upon the divine general Xuanyuan to defeat Chiyou. If our sect could receive guidance from the Ninth Heaven Xuannv, we would surely crush the yao realm and return victorious!

original_text: 静离：我在山下除妖之时，常遇穷凶极恶的妖物荼毒生灵，想必这妖界中的妖物更为凶残，只等掌门一声令下，我们定要将它们全部铲除！
translation: Jingli: When exorcising yaoguais below the mountain, I often encounter vicious monsters harming lives. Surely, fiends in the yao realm are even more brutal. Once the sect leader gives the order, we'll eradicate them all!

original_text: 虚止：云经阁乃我派收藏各类道家经书之处，你们是刚入门的弟子，就先从《道德经》念起吧。
translation: Xuzhi: The Cloud Scripture Pavilion is where our sect collects various Taoist scriptures. As newly entered disciples, you shall start by studying the 'Dao De Jing'.

original_text: 虚止：掌门要求派中弟子恪守道家修习之法则，因此所有弟子都会在习剑之余来此翻阅典籍，修心养性。
translation: Xuzhi: The sect leader requires all disciples to adhere to the principles of Taoist cultivation. Therefore, besides practicing swordsmanship, all disciples come here to study texts and cultivate their minds.

original_text: 虚止：阁中收录之典籍史册我大都已经念过，但觉其编目颠倒，篇章混乱，有些典籍甚至还有残缺，看来我得花些时间将其重写整理，以便日后其他弟子借阅。
translation: Xuzhi: I've read most records in the library, but find them disorganized, with some texts even incomplete. I'll need time to rewrite and sort them for future disciples' reference.

original_text: 虚止：我派修习之法，讲求人剑合一之术，但我钻研道家典籍那么多年，却鲜少见典籍之中提起这类修仙之法，想来这是当年玄女娘娘梦中授意的吧？
translation: Xuzhi: Our sect's cultivation method emphasizes the unity of man and sword. Yet, after studying Taoist classics for so many years, I've rarely seen them mention this type of immortal cultivation technique. I suppose it must have been imparted by the Ninth Heaven Xuannv in a dream back then?

original_text: 虚止：要是那些妖怪真的杀来，我可用经卷中记载的无上咒法将它们击退！凭我的修为，保证比其他人用剑杀妖更加厉害！
translation: Xuzhi: If those monsters really attack, I can use the supreme curse techniques recorded in the scriptures to repel them! With my cultivation, I guarantee I'll be more effective at slaying monsters than others using swords!

original_text: 明觉：师父，这本《道德经》我已经背完了。
translation: Mingjue: Master, I've already memorized this 'Dao De Jing'.

original_text: 虚止：很好很好，你将这本《三皇经》拿去，背熟了再来见我。
translation: Xuzhi: Very good, very good. Take this 'Scripture of the Three Sovereigns' and come see me again after you've memorized it.

original_text: 明觉：……师父，你整天只教我背书，到底什么时候才能让我学剑？
translation: Mingjue: ...Master, you only make me memorize books all day, when will you finally let me learn swordsmanship?

original_text: 虚止：呵呵，莫要着急，念书是最基础的修行，如果你连书都背不好，怎么修习高深的仙术？
translation: Xuzhi: Hehe, don't be impatient. Studying is the most basic cultivation. If you can't even memorize texts, how can you learn profound immortal arts?

original_text: 明觉：妖界随时会来，我问师父到底什么时候教我剑术，师父竟然说跟他修习只要背书，不用学剑！我、我能不能去找掌门要求换一个师父啊！
translation: Mingjue: The yao realm could come anytime. I asked Master when he'll finally teach me swordplay, and he actually said studying with him only requires memorizing texts, no need to learn swords! Can I... can I go ask the Sect Leader to change masters?

original_text: 明觉：我整日跟着师父只念书，不学剑，如果妖界真的杀来，我岂不是只有被杀的份？
translation: Mingjue: I spend all day following Master, only studying books, not learning swordsmanship. If the yao realm really attacks, wouldn't I just be waiting to be killed?

original_text: 明觉：自从妖界在卷云台边出现，师父就扔给我一本《琼华符咒录》，让我每天都背诵一段出来，这上面写的都是些我看不明白的东西，怎么背呀！
translation: Mingjue: Ever since the yao realm appeared near Cloud Terrace, Master threw me a copy of 'Qionghua Talisman Records' and made me memorize a section every day. It's all written in things I don't understand-how am I supposed to memorize it!

original_text: 明觉：原来师父给我的这本《琼华符咒录》是他亲自编撰的，里面这些拗口难背的句子，都是很厉害的降妖之术！
translation: Mingjue: So this 'Qionghua Talisman Record' Master gave me was compiled by him personally. These difficult-to-memorize phrases inside are actually powerful yao-subduing techniques!

original_text: 怀真：师父叫我来云经阁取一本《太玄经》，可虚止师叔却说那本书太旧了，再多翻会坏，若我真的要借，就帮他抄一本出来！我不想抄书啊！
translation: Huaizhen: Master told me to fetch a copy of 'Tai Xuanjing' from the Cloud Scripture Pavilion, but Uncle Xuzhi said the book is too old and will break if handled more. If I really want to borrow it, I should copy one for him! I don't want to copy books!

original_text: 怀真：掌门真是个严厉的人，上次我练剑偷懒被她看见了，当下就被罚在最西南的思返谷面壁三天，从那之后我再也不敢偷懒了！
translation: Huaizhen: The sect leader is really strict. Last time she caught me slacking off during sword practice, she immediately punished me with three days of meditation in the southwestern Reflection Valley. Since then, I've never dared to slack off again!

original_text: 怀真：明觉师弟一直很想练剑，可谁叫他命不好，拜了一个只会读书从不练剑的师父？没有掌门的命令，除了他师父之外，没人能教他剑术。
translation: Huaizhen: Martial Brother Mingjue has always wanted to practice swordsmanship, but unfortunately, he apprenticed under a master who only reads books and never practices swordsmanship. Without the sect leader's order, no one except his own master can teach him swordsmanship.

original_text: 怀真：都说妖界随时会来，这几天师父盯着我练剑，练得我腰酸腿也疼，晚上做梦都在挥剑！
translation: Huaizhen: They say the yao realm could come anytime. These days, Master makes me practice swordplay until my back aches and legs hurt, dreaming of swinging swords at night!

original_text: 怀真：师父和很多师叔师伯都被掌门召去了，看样子是有重大的事情要说，我猜这一定又是和妖界有关！
translation: Huaizhen: Master and many senior uncles and aunts have been summoned by the sect leader. It looks like something major is about to be discussed. I bet this is related to the yao realm again!

original_text: 怀真：妖界都已经出现了，虚止师叔还不打算教明觉师弟剑术！难道真的要等妖界攻来，让明觉师弟被那些妖怪吃了不成？
translation: Huaizhen: The yao realm has already appeared, but Uncle Xuzhi still doesn't plan to teach Martial Brother Mingjue sword techniques! Does he really want to wait until the yao realm attacks and let Martial Brother Mingjue be eaten by those monsters?

original_text: 怀真：听明觉师弟说，其实虚止师叔会一种很厉害的咒法，只要念几句咒，就能杀妖怪！我怎么从来不知道本派还有那么厉害的仙术？
translation: Huaizhen: I heard from Martial Brother Mingjue that Uncle Xuzhi actually knows a very powerful curse spell-just chanting a few incantations can kill monsters! How come I never knew our sect had such formidable immortal arts?

original_text: 虚宜：自从十九年前，本派遭逢巨变，长老之位有不少至今仍然空悬，派中以修为尚浅的年轻弟子居多。
translation: Xuyi: Since the great upheaval nineteen years ago, many elder positions remain vacant to this day. The sect is mostly comprised of young disciples whose cultivation is still shallow.

original_text: 虚宜：本派长老分为威仪、肃武、慎行、执剑，所司各有不同，而在这之上，另有正法长老，负责监督其他长老，各长老之下，又设执事弟子，协助长老。
translation: Xuyi: Our sect's elders are divided into Weiyi, Suwu, Shenxing, and Zhijian, each with different duties (ceremony, martial discipline, vigilance, and swordkeeping). Above them, there is an Elder Discipline, responsible for supervising the other elders. Under each elder, there are executive disciples to assist them.

original_text: 虚宜：太一宫乃是掌门修行之所，若无要事，请勿随意闯入。
translation: Xuyi: Taiyi Palace is where the Sect Leader cultivates. If there's no important matter, please do not enter casually.

original_text: 虚宜：刚入门的弟子，须熟知门规，若有违背，视情形而定，可能会交由本派的正法执事弟子处置。
translation: Xuyi: Newly enrolled disciples must be thoroughly familiar with the sect rules. If violated, depending on the circumstances, they may be handed over to the sect's Discipline Enforcement disciples for disciplinary action.

original_text: 虚宜：妖界来犯乃是大事，为何掌门不请青阳、重光两位长老出山相助呢？我听师父说过，他们就隐居在后山清风涧。
translation: Xuyi: The yao realm's invasion is a major event. Why hasn't the Sect Leader invited Elders Qingyang and Chongguang to assist? I heard from my master they live in seclusion at Breezy Brook in the rear mountain.

original_text: 虚宜：原来禁地之中另有高人……想来本派为了对抗妖界，从十九年前便已深谋远虑，立下了种种对策。
translation: Xuyi: So there's another master within the forbidden area... It seems our sect, in preparation against the yao realm, has been planning deeply and establishing various countermeasures since nineteen years ago.

original_text: 璇谨：承天剑台乃是派中重要的铸剑之所，像你这样新入门的弟子一定还没去过吧？通过这里的法阵可直接过去。
translation: Xuanjin: Chengtian Sword Platform is an important forging site in our sect. As a newly enrolled disciple, you probably haven't been there yet, right? You can go directly through the magic array here.

original_text: 璇谨：那日我奉命下山除妖，未料遇到一个道士，还说要卖给我一把好剑，我只看一眼，就知道那是骗人的，琼华派弟子又怎会被这种把戏所骗？
translation: Xuanjin: That day I was ordered to descend the mountain to exterminate monsters, but unexpectedly met a Taoist who claimed to sell me a good sword. With one glance, I knew it was a scam. How could a Qionghua Sect disciple fall for such a trick?

original_text: 璇谨：璇铁师妹拜在虚冶师伯门下快一年了，师伯只教她铸剑之法，不久前才开始教她剑术，想来也是因为妖界即将来犯……
translation: Xuanjin: Martial Sister Xuan Tie has been under Master Xuye for almost a year. He only taught her sword-forging methods and recently began teaching her swordsmanship, likely because the yao realm is about to invade...

original_text: 璇谨：这几天一抬头就能看见妖界，偏偏又杀不进去，害得我一直想着它们什么时候会杀出来，整天都定不下心。
translation: Xuanjin: These days, just looking up I can see the yao realm, yet we can't attack it. It makes me constantly wonder when they'll strike, leaving me unsettled all day.

original_text: 璇谨：掌门闭关那么多天了，到底什么时候才能出关啊？
translation: Xuanjin: The Sect Leader has been in seclusion for so many days now, when exactly will they emerge?

original_text: 璇谨：妖界太平得不寻常！里面那些妖怪一定是在打什么坏主意，我们可得多防着些！
translation: Xuanjin: The yao realm is unnaturally peaceful! Those yaoguais inside must be up to no good; we need to be extra careful!

original_text: 元现：我派仙法讲求修习剑术以吸取天地元灵，只有使用同自身修为相符的剑器，才能有最好的修习成果。
translation: Yuanxian: Our sect's immortal arts emphasize cultivating swordsmanship to absorb the primordial spirit of heaven and earth. Only by using a sword that matches one's own cultivation can the best results be achieved.

original_text: 元现：明穹，你最近练剑虽很用心，但修为精进的速度却不比从前，是不是遇到什么困难了？
translation: Yuanxian: Mingqiong, you've been very diligent in sword practice lately, but your cultivation progress isn't as fast as before. Are you encountering some difficulty?

original_text: 明穹：我只是觉得，越是加紧练剑，从剑中渡来的灵力仙气却越少……师父，这到底是怎么回事？
translation: Ming Qiong: I just feel that the more I intensify my sword practice, the less spiritual energy and immortal qi flows from the sword... Master, what exactly is going on?

original_text: 元现：呵呵，这是好事，因为你的修为已经加深，所以你手中的这柄剑已不合你用了，自己去承天剑台，找你虚冶师伯为你重铸一把新剑吧！
translation: Yuanxian: Hehe, this is a good thing. Because your cultivation has deepened, the sword in your hand is no longer suitable for you. Go to the Chengtian Sword Platform yourself and find your Uncle Xuye to forge a new sword for you!

original_text: 元现：阁中所存的断水、鱼肠、惊鲵、莫邪、照胆五柄神剑，都是青铜铸成，而如今的剑，却都是百炼青钢。
translation: Yuanxian: The five divine swords stored in the pavilion-Duanshui, Yuchang, Jingni, Moye, and Zhaodan-are all cast from bronze, whereas swords today are all forged from refined steel.

original_text: 元现：虚冶师兄的铸剑之术已是不错，与前代执剑长老宗炼亲传的紫英师弟各有千秋，但这二人加起来，只怕也还是比不过宗炼长老啊。
translation: Yuanxian: Martial Brother Xuye's sword-forging skills are already impressive, each excelling in their own way compared to Martial Brother Ziying, who was personally taught by the former Sword Elder Zonglian. But combined, they still likely fall short of Elder Zonglian.

original_text: 元现：剑之五灵，一般是由铸剑的原石所定，但也不全是如此，本阁之中所藏之莫邪剑，同火阁中的干将剑，原出一石，却有两种截然不同的属性。
translation: Yuanxian: The five elements of a sword are generally determined by the original ore used to forge it, but not always. The Moye Sword in our pavilion and the Ganjiang Sword in the Fire Pavilion came from the same ore but have two completely different attributes.

original_text: 元现：妖界按兵不动，我派弟子不如趁此机会再加紧修炼，无论如何，此战只许胜不许败，不然山下生灵涂炭，我们又如何向十九年前过世的掌门和长老交代呢？
translation: Yuanxian: The yao realm holds still. Our disciples should seize this chance to train harder. This battle must be won, or all creatures near the mountain will suffer. How could we face the sect leader and elders lost nineteen years ago?

original_text: 明穹：师父，为何这把鱼肠剑只有半截？只有半截的剑也算宝剑？
translation: Ming Qiong: Master, why is this Fish Gut Sword only half? Can a half sword still be considered a treasure?

original_text: 元现：鱼肠剑乃勇绝之剑，当年专诸以之刺王僚，鱼肠剑刺穿两层狻猊铠甲，刺穿第三层时剑断，然而却还是直直地刺入了王僚的心脏。
translation: Yuanxian: The Yuchang Sword is the sword of ultimate courage. In ancient times, Zhuan Zhu used it to assassinate King Liao. It pierced two layers of lion armor, broke on the third, yet still drove straight into King Liao's heart.

original_text: 明穹：如此说来，鱼肠之所以是名剑，正是因为它虽断却依旧勇往直前，不休不止？
translation: Ming Qiong: So, the reason Yuchang is a famous sword is precisely because it remains brave and relentless even when broken, never stopping?

original_text: 元现：正是此意。
translation: Yuanxian: That's exactly it.

original_text: 明穹：师父说我派五大剑阁中所藏之剑，都是古时宝剑真身，除非这些剑自己“认主”，否则谁也无法使用它们。
translation: Ming Qiong: Master said the swords stored in our sect's five sword pavilions are all ancient true blades. Unless these swords 'choose their masters' themselves, no one can wield them.

original_text: 明穹：我最喜欢的剑就是此阁之中的“照胆”剑，只是我一个小小的入门弟子，仙法低微，根本无力驾驭此剑。
translation: Ming Qiong: My favorite sword here is the 'Zhaodan' sword. But as a mere novice disciple with low cultivation, I'm utterly incapable of wielding it.

original_text: 明穹：终于有了一把适合我自己用的好剑，如今练剑，再也没有那种灵力不足、怎么练都无法精进的感觉了！
translation: Ming Qiong: Finally, I have a good sword suitable for my own use. Now when practicing swordsmanship, I no longer feel that spiritual power is insufficient or that I can't improve no matter how hard I train!

original_text: 明穹：我已经把师父传授的剑法都融会贯通，真想马上跟着掌门杀入妖界，让那些妖怪尝尝我的厉害！
translation: Ming Qiong: I've fully mastered the sword techniques taught by my master. I really want to follow the sect leader into the yao realm right away and let those monsters taste my power!

original_text: 静修：听说当年宗炼长老曾打造出两把剑，剑气灵力都不输于本阁中收藏的宝剑，但是我却从没见过那两把剑，师父在世的时候也很少提起。
translation: Jingxiu: I heard that Elder Zonglian once forged two swords, their sword aura and spiritual power no less than the precious swords in this pavilion. But I've never seen those two swords, and Master rarely mentioned them when he was alive.

original_text: 静修：琼华派以剑为至尊至祥之物，门下弟子即使不会铸剑，却也懂得识剑、相剑之法。
translation: Jingxiu: In Qionghua Sect, the sword is revered as the most supreme and auspicious object. Even disciples who cannot forge swords know how to identify and appraise them.

original_text: 静修：我从小就被师父带上山，记事起就在修习剑法仙术，偶尔也会被掌门派下山去除妖，除此之外就再无其他杂念了。
translation: Jingxiu: I was brought up the mountain by my master as a child and have been practicing swordsmanship and immortal arts since I can remember. Occasionally, the sect leader sends me down to slay yaoguais-no other distractions.

original_text: 静修：妖界……小时候好像听师父提过，师父说妖界里面有众多残忍的妖孽，十九年前就残杀了许多本派的前辈！连前代掌门和长老都被……
translation: Jingxiu: The yao realm... I seem to have heard Master mention it when I was young. Master said there were many cruel yaos inside, and nineteen years ago they slaughtered many of our sect's seniors! Even the former sect leader and elders were...

original_text: 静修：我相信掌门！她一定有万全之策，能带领我们对抗妖界！
translation: Jingxiu: I believe in the Sect Leader! She must have a perfect plan to lead us against the yao realm!

original_text: 静修：掌门已在禁地闭关，看来不日就可练成新的仙法，到时候我们攻入妖界，定然能为十九年前死去的前辈们报仇！
translation: Jingxiu: The Sect Leader is already in seclusion at the forbidden area. It seems he'll soon master a new immortal technique. Once that happens, we'll invade the yao realm and surely avenge the seniors who died nineteen years ago!

original_text: 静修：我不怕那些妖怪，我只相信邪不胜正，上天不会让我们落败的！
translation: Jingxiu: I'm not afraid of those monsters. I only believe that evil cannot prevail over good, and heaven won't let us be defeated!

original_text: 元观：唉……真为这里藏着的宝剑感到可惜！就算是再好再厉害，却从来没人去用，没人用的话，那跟一般士大夫屋子里挂墙用的劣剑，又有什么区别？
translation: Yuan Guan: Sigh... I truly feel sorry for the precious swords hidden here! No matter how excellent or powerful, no one ever uses them. If no one uses them, what difference is there from the inferior swords hung on walls in scholars' houses?

original_text: 元观：人有五灵，剑亦有五灵，我派弟子修习仙剑之术，所用之剑除了需同自身修为相匹配之外，自然还需同自身的五灵相同。
translation: Yuan Guan: Humans have Five Spirits, and so do swords. Our sect disciples practice immortal sword arts; the swords they use must not only match their own cultivation but also align with their personal Five Spirits.

original_text: 元观：修道之人多半要使用法器，用的久了，便有可能成为法宝，派中大部分弟子虽然都是用剑，但用其他兵器的也不是没有。
translation: Yuan Guan: Most cultivators use magical instruments. Over time, these can become treasures. Although most disciples in our sect use swords, some do wield other weapons.

original_text: 元观：禁地之中一定藏着一柄专用来降妖的宝剑！不然为什么要叫禁地呢？那把宝剑说不定威力过大，寻常人连看一眼都承受不了，只有掌门才能驾驭！
translation: Yuan Guan: The forbidden area must hide a sword specially used to subdue yaoguais! Otherwise, why call it forbidden? That sword might be too powerful; ordinary people can't even bear to look at it, only the sect leader can wield it!

original_text: 元观：我所用的佩剑是“雷剑”，雷灵是妖怪最害怕的东西之一，估计这妖界之中的妖怪也一样会怕！
translation: Yuan Guan: The sword I use is the 'Thunder Sword'. Thunder spirits are one of the things monsters fear most. I reckon the monsters in this yao realm will be scared of it too!

original_text: 静悟：听，阁中是不是有龙吟虎啸之声？这是阁中所藏“腾空剑”发出的声音哦～
translation: Jingwu: Listen, is there a dragon's roar and tiger's growl in the pavilion? That's the sound from the 'Soaring Sword' stored here~

original_text: 静悟：我喜欢剑，但不喜欢铸剑。会练剑也是因为喜欢剑，如果不好好练，修为不提升，就不能用更好的剑嘛～
translation: Jingwu: I love swords, but not forging them. I practice swordsmanship because I love swords-if I don't train hard and improve my cultivation, I won't be able to wield better swords~

original_text: 静悟：我所用的剑，是仿此阁中大夏龙雀的外形而铸，其实世间大多宝剑，都已不是真身了，后人仿制的东西，即使再不错，又哪里还有真身的灵气呢？
translation: Jingwu: The sword I use is forged to imitate the shape of the Daxia Longque in this pavilion. In fact, most famous swords in the world are no longer the originals. Things imitated by later generations, even if quite good, where is the spiritual essence of the original?

original_text: 静悟：那妖界入口黑气腾腾，一看就知道是不祥之地，其中的妖怪就算再凶残邪恶也不稀奇了！
translation: Jingwu: That yao realm entrance is seething with black energy; one look and you know it's an ominous place. It's no surprise if the fiends inside are even more vicious and evil!

original_text: 静悟：掌门闭关那么多天，也不见妖界有什么动静，如果我是那些妖怪，就趁现在赶快逃跑，不然掌门出关，就是它们的死期了！
translation: Jingwu: The Sect Leader has been in seclusion for so many days, and there's still no movement from the yao realm. If I were those monsters, I'd escape quickly now, otherwise when the Sect Leader emerges, it will be their end!

original_text: 元安：在五灵剑阁之中，此处的剑气最为祥和，那是由于主天下仁道的湛卢剑，正存于此处，湛卢剑虽能削金断玉，无坚不摧，本身却没有丝毫杀气～
translation: Yuan'an: Among the Five Elements Sword Pavilion, the sword energy here is the most peaceful. That is because the Zhanlu Sword, which embodies the world's benevolence, is stored here. Although the Zhanlu Sword can cut through gold and jade and is indestructible, it carries not a trace of killing intent~

original_text: 元安：相传湛卢剑乃“君有道，剑在侧，国兴旺。君无道，剑飞弃，国破败。”如此说来，既然此剑存于我派，我派必然能够日益壮大。
translation: Yuan'an: Legend says the Zhanlu Sword signifies, 'When the ruler is virtuous, the sword stays by his side, and the nation prospers. When the ruler is unvirtuous, the sword flies away, and the nation falls'. Thus, since this sword resides in our sect, we are destined to grow ever stronger.

original_text: 元安：大家本来安安定定的，该什么时候练功就什么时候练功，该什么时候诵经就什么时候诵经，可一听说妖界要来，大家从早到晚都练剑，已经很少有人来诵经了。
translation: Yuan'an: Usually, everyone is peaceful and settled, practicing when it's time to practice, reciting scriptures when it's time to recite scriptures. But ever since they heard the yao realm was coming, everyone practices swordsmanship from morning till night, and very few come to recite scriptures anymore.

original_text: 元安：掌门吩咐大家不要靠近妖界，看来暂时还不打算进攻？……为什么一定要打呢？难道没有办法以仁义说退妖界？
translation: Yuan'an: The sect leader ordered everyone not to approach the yao realm; it seems there's no plan to attack for now?... Why must we fight? Isn't there a way to persuade the yao realm with benevolence?

original_text: 元安：妖界至今只是与我派对峙，到底要到何时才能打破僵局？难道打破僵局之时，就是血流成河之日？
translation: Yuan'an: The yao realm has only been in a standoff with our sect so far. When will this deadlock break? Will breaking it mean a river of blood?

original_text: 怀望：我一直很奇怪，为什么剑阁里放着这么多好剑，却从来没有人用呢？难道所谓的宝剑就是只能看，不能用的……
translation: Huaiwang: I've always wondered, why are there so many fine swords in the Sword Pavilion, yet no one ever uses them? Could it be that so-called precious swords are only for looking at, not for using...

original_text: 怀望：琼华派的剑术真的好厉害，我入门也不算久，每日修习，就感到体内真气充盈，身子也比以前轻了许多。
translation: Huaiwang: The Qionghua Sect's sword techniques are truly amazing. I haven't been a disciple for long, but with daily practice, I feel my internal qi filling up, and my body has become much lighter than before.

original_text: 怀望：师父说我的资质好，如果用心修行，大概五十年以后就能超过现在的长老，可是五十年耶？五十年一过，我都变成白胡子的老头了！
translation: Huaiwang: Master says my aptitude is good. If I cultivate diligently, I might surpass the current elders in about fifty years. But fifty years? After fifty years, I'll be an old man with a white beard!

original_text: 怀望：妖界已经来了！听说里面的妖怪又厉害又凶狠！所以我要趁现在还没开战的时候，更加努力地修炼！
translation: Huaiwang: The yao realm has arrived! I hear the monsters inside are powerful and fierce! So I must train even harder now, before the battle starts!

original_text: 怀望：妖界一直留在卷云台不走，一定有诡计！我们真应该先下手为强，等他们攻过来，岂不是被动了？
translation: Huaiwang: The yao realm has been lingering at Cloud Terrace without leaving-there must be some scheme! We really ought to strike first. If we wait for them to attack, wouldn't we be passive?

original_text: 怀忍：修仙讲求炼气化神，我派以剑修仙，其实也是通过习剑来吸收天地元灵。
translation: Huai Ren: Cultivating immortality focuses on refining qi into spirit. Our sect uses the sword to cultivate immortality, essentially absorbing the world's primordial energy through sword practice.

original_text: 怀忍：听说蜀山仙剑派也有剑阁，但其中收藏，不能与我派相提并论。
translation: Huai Ren: I heard the Shu Mountain Sword Immortal Sect also has a Sword Pavilion, but its collection cannot compare to ours.

original_text: 怀忍：只要一想到妖界即将来犯，我就心烦意乱，师父让我到处走走，平平心气再练剑，不然一定会走火入魔。
translation: Huai Ren: Just thinking about the impending yao realm invasion makes me restless and distracted. Master told me to walk around to calm my mind before practicing swordplay, otherwise I'll surely fall into demonic madness.

original_text: 怀忍：我已做好与妖界殊死相搏的准备，就算为此丢了性命，只要其他同门能击退妖界，我也算死得其所了！
translation: Huai Ren: I am prepared to fight the yao realm to the death. Even if I lose my life, as long as my fellow disciples can repel the yao realm, my death will have been worthwhile!

original_text: 怀忍：我这几日完全不能平心静气，只想着能快点与妖界对上，痛痛快快地打一场，即使战死，也比现在这样干着急的好！
translation: Huai Ren: These past few days, I can't calm down at all. I just want to confront the yao realm quickly and have a good fight. Even if I die in battle, it's better than just worrying like this!

original_text: 元志：虚冶师兄的铸剑之术是我派中数一数二的，但我所用的佩剑仍是由自己亲手打造，我常来此处，也是为了向虚冶师兄多讨教些铸剑之术。
translation: Yuan Zhi: Martial Brother Xu Ye's sword-forging skills are among the best in our sect. But the sword I use was forged by my own hands. I often come here to seek more advice from Martial Brother Xu Ye on sword-forging techniques.

original_text: 元志：我入门多年，或许是资质不佳，最近几年来修为一直在道家第五重境界徘徊，无论如何修习，也难有寸进。
translation: Yuan Zhi: I've been a disciple for many years, but perhaps due to poor aptitude, my cultivation has stagnated at the fifth Taoist realm for the past few years. No matter how hard I train, I can't make progress.

original_text: 元志：修仙之事，其实也是各凭资质。只有天资极高，且心无杂念者才能修炼成仙。如我这般天资不高之人，即使再怎样用心，尽这一生，恐怕也难窥天道。
translation: Yuan Zhi: The matter of cultivating immortality actually also depends on individual aptitude. Only those with extremely high natural talent and a mind free of distractions can cultivate to become immortals. For someone like me with mediocre aptitude, no matter how diligently I try, even in this lifetime, I'm afraid it's hard to glimpse the heavenly way.

original_text: 元志：掌门派了许多弟子把守禁地，但我记得，以前禁地似乎是无人把守的，其中的秘密怕是只有掌门与长老知道。
translation: Yuan Zhi: The Sect Leader has sent many disciples to guard the forbidden area, but I recall it used to be unguarded. Its secrets are probably known only to the Sect Leader and the elders.

original_text: 元志：紫英师弟以前常来剑台，最近却不出现了，难道真的像有些弟子传言的那样，他被逐出师门了？
translation: Yuan Zhi: Martial Brother Ziying used to come to the Sword Platform often, but lately he hasn't shown up. Could it be true, as some disciples say, that he was expelled from the sect?

original_text: 虚冶：你是紫英师弟的师侄，铸剑之事自然可以由他出马，就不须我班门弄斧了。
translation: Xu Ye: You are Martial Brother Ziying's disciple-nephew. Sword-forging matters naturally fall to him; no need for me to show off before an expert.

original_text: 虚冶：五灵剑阁之中所藏的很多青铜宝剑，其铸造之法都十分高明。只是古人造剑之术大都失传，如今只能看着这些剑，却很难从中参悟出什么来了。
translation: Xu Ye: Many of the bronze swords stored in the Five Elements Sword Pavilion are crafted with highly advanced techniques. It's just that most ancient sword-making methods have been lost; now we can only look at these swords but find it hard to glean any insights from them.

original_text: 虚冶：近日派中弟子都在加紧修习，前来我处要我帮忙重铸他们手中长剑的，也不在少数。
translation: Xu Ye: Recently, disciples in the sect have been intensifying their training. Quite a few have come to me asking to reforge their longswords.

original_text: 虚冶：铸剑之术需配合地利，我派有灵力守护，四季如春，外邪不侵，灵气充盈，是铸剑的最佳场所。
translation: Xu Ye: Sword forging requires matching the geographical advantages. Our sect has spiritual protection, spring-like seasons all year round, free from external evils, and filled with spiritual energy, making it the best place for sword forging.

original_text: 虚冶：一日之中，辰时乃铸剑的最佳时辰，通常我都是在辰时将金石或旧剑入炉，开始冶炼的。
translation: Xu Ye: Within a day, the Chen hour is the best time for sword forging. Usually, I place the metal or old swords into the furnace at Chen hour to begin smelting.

original_text: 虚冶：与妖界开战在即，届时长剑的损毁定然不计其数，我一定要再多铸一些，以备不时之需！
translation: Xu Ye: With the war against the yao realm imminent, countless swords will surely be damaged. I must forge many more to prepare for any need!

original_text: 明炼：嘻嘻，我乃执剑执事弟子——座下的大弟子明炼是也～师傅铸剑的功夫，我已经学了七、八分了～
translation: Minglian: Hehe, I am Minglian, the grand disciple under the Sword-Wielding Steward Disciple~ I've already mastered seven or eight parts of Master's sword-forging skills~

original_text: 璇铁：明炼你少骗人了！谁都知道你才刚入门两年～整日跟在师父身边就知道偷懒～上次还把师父好不容易找来的一块铜石给炼坏了！
translation: Xuantie: Minglian, stop lying! Everyone knows you just entered the sect two years ago~ Lazing around following Master all day~ Last time, you even ruined a rare copper ore Master worked so hard to find!

original_text: 明炼：嘿嘿，璇铁师妹，你别总是揭我老底呀～而且上次那块铜石，后来还不是让师父给炼成了一把好剑？
translation: Minglian: Hehe, Sister Xuantie, don't always expose my old secrets~ And that copper ore last time, didn't Master later forge it into a fine sword?

original_text: 璇铁：我只是说实话而已！师父炼得好是师父的本事，你毁了好石头，是你闯的祸，少把这两件事儿扯到一块儿～
translation: Xuantie: I'm just telling the truth! Master's forging skill is his own ability, you ruined good stones-that's your own mess, don't mix these two things up~

original_text: 明炼：最近一直帮师父铸剑，现在我的铸剑术也有很大的精进～看，我身上的这把剑，就是自己铸的，连师父都夸我呢！
translation: Minglian: Lately, I've been helping Master forge swords constantly, and now my sword-forging skills have greatly improved~ Look, this sword I'm carrying was forged by myself, even Master praised me for it!

original_text: 明炼：师父好像很中意璇铁师妹带回来的并州剑，不过师父也说那剑只是材质好，铸剑的人功夫不怎么样。
translation: Minglian: Master seems quite fond of the Bingzhou Sword that Sister Xuantie  brought back, but Master also said the sword is only good in material; the craftsmanship of the swordsmith isn't much.

original_text: 明炼：为了和妖界对抗，很多同门都到承天剑台来重铸宝剑，师父、师妹和我三个人加起来，好不容易才忙完那些事。
translation: Minglian: To fight the yao realm, many fellow disciples came to the Chengtian Sword Platform to reforge their swords. Master, Martial Sister, and I barely managed to handle all the work together.

original_text: 明炼：妖界和琼华派对峙已久，所有弟子都在备战，我和师妹虽然只是以铸剑术见长，但要斩妖除魔，我们也是义不容辞的！
translation: Minglian: The yao realm and Qionghua have been at a standoff. All disciples are preparing for battle. Though my Martial Sister and I excel in sword-forging, we're duty-bound to slay yaoguais or demons!

original_text: 璇铁：我拜在虚冶师父门下，师父给我取了个名字叫“璇铁”，说什么音同“玄铁”，是上好的造剑之材，可、可哪有女孩子家叫这种名字的呀！
translation: Xuantie: I apprenticed under Master Xuye, who gave me the name 'Xuan Tie', saying it sounds like 'Xuan Iron'-a top-grade sword-making material. But, but what kind of name is that for a girl!

original_text: 璇铁：虚冶师父人很和气，待我们也好，就是整日沉迷铸剑炼铁，教了我御剑术之后，就只教辨石采石、熔炼铸造，再也没教过我别的剑法！
translation: Xuantie: Master Xuye is very kind and treats us well, but he's obsessed with sword forging and metal refining all day. After teaching me Sword Flight, he only taught me stone identification, mining, smelting, and forging, never teaching me any other sword techniques!

original_text: 璇铁：师父终于教我琼华剑术了！师父还说，等我这套剑法练好了，就让我下山去看看，不过条件就是要去并州帮他买些刀剑……
translation: Xuantie: Master finally taught me Qionghua sword techniques! He also said that once I master this set of sword skills, he'll let me go down the mountain to see the world, but on the condition that I buy some swords for him in Bingzhou...

original_text: 明炼：这你就不懂了～师父想让你下山去帮他买剑，所以教了你御剑，又怕你不会武艺遭人欺负，所以才教你别的剑术呀～
translation: Minglian: You don't understand~ Master wanted you to go down the mountain to buy a sword for him, so he taught you Sword Flight. And fearing you'd be bullied without martial skills, he taught you other sword techniques~

original_text: 璇铁：说了半天，师父教我武艺，还是为了帮他买剑啊？那并州的刀剑难道比师父造的更好吗？
translation: Xuantie: After all that talk, Master teaching me martial arts is still just to help him buy swords? Are the blades from Bingzhou really better than what Master forges?

original_text: 明炼：这我就不太清楚了，听闻并州的刀剑号称和春秋时的铸剑大师欧冶子所造的神剑一般厉害！师父一定是听了这种传闻，所以才很想见识一番。
translation: Minglian: I'm not too sure about that. I heard the swords and blades from Bingzhou are said to be as formidable as the divine swords forged by the master swordsmith Ou Yezi from the Spring and Autumn period! Master must have heard such rumors, which is why he's so eager to see them.

original_text: 璇铁：上次我替师父去并州买剑，师父看了我买来的剑，说是铁很好，铸剑的技艺却不怎么样，说来也是，那些人的铸剑术怎会比得上师父呢？
translation: Xuantie: Last time I went to Bingzhou to buy swords for Master. After seeing the swords I bought, Master said the iron was good but the forging skill wasn't great. Indeed, how could those people's sword-forging compare to Master's?

original_text: 璇铁：师父说自己用的剑最好亲手铸造，因为只有自己才最明白自己想用怎样的剑。
translation: Xuantie: Master says the best sword to use is one you forge yourself, because only you truly know what kind of sword you want to wield.

original_text: 璇铁：最近都见不到紫英师叔了，有人说他是因为触犯门规被掌门罚下山了……我不相信！紫英师叔才不是这样的人！
translation: Xuantie: I haven't seen Martial Uncle Ziying lately. Some say he was punished by the Sect Leader and sent down the mountain for violating sect rules... I don't believe it! Martial Uncle Ziying would never do such a thing!

original_text: 静空：虽说紫英师弟的铸剑之法得了前代执剑长老的真传，可能比虚冶师兄更胜一筹，但他平时不太亲自铸剑，其他同门好像也更喜欢找虚冶师兄帮助铸剑。
translation: Jingkong: Although Martial Brother Ziying's sword-forging methods inherited the true teachings of the former Sword Elder and may surpass Martial Brother Xuye, he doesn't forge swords much personally. Other disciples also seem to prefer seeking Martial Brother Xuye's help for forging.

original_text: 静空：承天剑台以太极为形，分为极寒和极热两边，一边用来熔铁，另一边用来淬剑，若是修为不深的弟子来了这里，单是冷热交加便受不住了。
translation: Jingkong: The Chengtian Sword Platform is shaped like a Tai-chi, divided into extremely cold and extremely hot sides. One side is for smelting iron, the other for quenching swords. If disciples with shallow cultivation come here, they can't withstand the alternating cold and heat alone.

original_text: 静空：如今本派弟子的佩剑，大多出自虚冶师兄之手。新入门的弟子会遵师命来此选剑。若已铸好的剑中没有合用的，虚冶师兄便会根据新弟子的资质性格，为他量身定做一把剑。
translation: Jingkong: Nowadays, most of our sect's disciples' swords are crafted by Brother Xuye. New disciples follow their master's orders to come here and choose a sword. If none of the already forged swords suit them, Brother Xuye will tailor-make a sword based on the new disciple's aptitude and personality.

original_text: 静空：妖界既然来了，我们更是要平心静气，不可乱了方寸，给那些妖物可趁之机！
translation: Jingkong: Since the yao realm has come, we must remain calm and composed, not lose our heads and give those monsters an opening!

original_text: 静空：现在大家都等着掌门出关，好带领我们一起对抗妖界，为十九年前死去的前辈们报仇！
translation: Jingkong: Now everyone awaits the Sect Leader's emergence from seclusion to lead us against the yao realm and avenge the seniors who died nineteen years ago!

original_text: 璇慈：所谓“心宁如水，方可映世间万物”，琼华派习剑之要也和修道一样，需心宁气和，才能通过手中长剑，让自身魂魄与天地灵气融为一体。
translation: Xuanci: They say, 'Only when the heart is calm as water can it reflect all things under heaven'. Qionghua Sect's sword practice, like cultivation, requires a calm heart and harmonious energy to unite one's soul with heaven and earth's spiritual energy through the sword.

original_text: 璇慈：上回见到新入门的菱纱师妹在剑舞坪习剑，身手十分灵巧迅捷，一套双剑舞得非常漂亮，却似乎并非紫英师叔所授……
translation: Xuanci: Last time, I saw the newly joined Martial Sister Lingsha practicing swordplay at Sword Dance Terrace. Her movements were agile and swift, and her dual-sword dance was beautiful, yet it didn't seem taught by Martial Uncle Ziying....

original_text: 璇慈：妖界降临势必为祸人间，我们修道中人虽不喜争斗，但斩妖除魔却是我们份内之事，为了天下苍生，琼华派也绝不可在妖界面前退却！
translation: Xuanci: The yao realm's descent is bound to bring calamity to the mortal world. Although we cultivators dislike conflict, vanquishing demons and yaoguai is our duty. For the sake of all living beings, the Qionghua Sect must never retreat before the yao realm!

original_text: 璇慈：掌门闭关，妖界亦久无动静，我看派中有些师兄弟已经有些着急，却不知越是要紧的时刻，越是需要保持心宁如水，“以不变应万变”才是上上之策。
translation: Xuanci: The sect leader is in seclusion, and the yao realm has been quiet for a long time. I see some fellow disciples growing impatient, not realizing that the more critical the moment, the more one must remain calm as still water. 'Responding to change with constancy' is the best strategy.

original_text: 静贤：习剑、修道，虽是一动一静，但都需心神宁和，如能进入“物我两忘”的境界，无论是剑术境界，还是仙法修为，都能一日千里般精进。
translation: Jingxian: Practicing swordsmanship and cultivating the Dao, though one is active and the other still, both require a calm mind. If one can enter the state of 'forgetting both self and object', both swordsmanship and immortal cultivation can advance by leaps and bounds.

original_text: 静贤：年轻弟子容易心浮气躁，实乃修道之大忌。琼华派的习剑心法有助于平心静气，如果你感到无法安静下来，不如回房打坐，多修心法。
translation: Jingxian: Young disciples are prone to restlessness and impatience, which is a major taboo in cultivation. The Qionghua Sect's sword-heart techniques help calm the mind. If you feel unable to quiet down, return to your room to meditate and practice the techniques more.

original_text: 静贤：很多弟子嚷着要杀进妖界为派中前辈血仇，却不知情、爱、怨、仇皆是妄念，修道中人应当心怀苍生，而不是只为一己之私。
translation: Jingxian: Many disciples clamor to invade the yao realm to avenge our sect's predecessors, unaware that emotions like affection, love, resentment, and hatred are all delusions. Those who cultivate the Dao should care for all living beings, not just their own selfish interests.

original_text: 静贤：妖界现形多日，却始终没有动静，不知它们到底在做何打算，如今掌门已经闭关，余下弟子更须小心应对。
translation: Jingxian: The yao realm has manifested for days yet remains inactive. Who knows their plans? With the sect leader in seclusion, remaining disciples must be extra cautious.

original_text: 灵思：师父说修仙要没有“欲求”……可是灵思很想变成仙人，踩着云在天上飞，这个……算不算师父说的“欲求”呢？
translation: Lingsi: Master says cultivating immortality requires having no 'desires'... but I really want to become an immortal, treading on clouds and flying in the sky. Does this... count as the 'desires' Master speaks of?

original_text: 灵思：杀妖怪是行善积德……可是师父教导我的戒律，不是说不能杀生吗？好奇怪哦……灵思不明白，你能明白吗？
translation: Lingsi: Killing yaoguais is doing good and accumulating virtue... But the precepts my master taught me say not to kill. How strange... Lingsi doesn't understand. Can you understand?

original_text: 灵思：上回，我问师父，既然不能杀生，为什么却要杀妖怪？结果师父大发雷霆，罚我在思返谷面壁了整整三天……我、我到底哪里做错了呢……
translation: Lingsi: Last time, I asked Master: since we can't kill living beings, why do we kill yaoguais? Master flew into a rage and punished me to meditate in Reflection Valley for three whole days... Wh-what did I do wrong...

original_text: 灵思：为什么师兄师姐都说妖界很可怕呢？虽然现在风大了一点，但是那个妖界……好像也没什么呀？
translation: Lingsi: Why do all the Martial Brothers and sisters say the yao realm is terrifying? Although the wind is a bit strong now, that yao realm... doesn't seem so bad?

original_text: 静澈：听闻蜀山仙剑派有锁妖塔，门下弟子入世除妖，却仅是将妖投入塔中而已。依我看，妖孽留在世上终是祸害，该全都杀了才是，何必如此麻烦？
translation: Jingche: I've heard Shu Mountain's Immortal Sword Sect has a Demon-Locking Tower; its disciples go into the world to subdue yaoguais but merely throw them into the pagoda. In my view, yaoguais left in the world are always a scourge-they should all be killed. Why go through such trouble?

original_text: 静澈：斩妖除魔是修行之人应尽之责，我昆仑琼华派虽然不像蜀山仙剑派那样经常入世除妖，但弟子偶有下山，遇到妖孽也会尽力除之。
translation: Jingche: Vanquishing demons and yaoguais is the duty of cultivators. Although our Kunlun Qionghua Sect doesn't frequently enter the mortal world to eliminate fiends like the Shu Mountain Immortal Sword Sect, when disciples occasionally descend the mountain and encounter yaoguai, we still do our utmost to eradicate them.

original_text: 静澈：哼！这妖界简直胆大包天，竟敢欺到我琼华派的头上来！若是让它们大摇大摆地走出来为祸人间，我昆仑琼华派的颜面何存？！
translation: Jingche: Hmph! This yao realm are utterly audacious, daring to provoke our Qionghua Sect! If we let them swagger out to wreak havoc in the mortal realm, what face would our Kunlun Qionghua Sect have left?!

original_text: 静澈：不管那妖界到底想做什么，妖孽留在世上总是祸患！就算它们现在没有敌意，也不能保证它们日后不会为祸人间！
translation: Jingche: No matter what the yao realm intends, yaoguais remaining in the world are always a scourge! Even if they're not hostile now, we can't guarantee they won't harm the mortal world later!

original_text: 元贤：我派“人剑合一”的修仙之术，对人和剑的五灵相配极其倚重，对新入门的弟子来说，头等大事就是选择自己的佩剑。
translation: Yuanxian: Our sect's 'Human-Sword Unity' immortal cultivation technique heavily relies on matching the five elements of person and sword. For new disciples, the top priority is choosing their own sword.

original_text: 元贤：派中的师叔师伯大都已经过世，即使仍然健在，也常年云游在外，很少露面。
translation: Yuanxian: Most of the sect's uncles and elders have already passed away. Even those still alive often travel abroad and rarely show themselves.

original_text: 元贤：即使是神兵利刃，如果没有与之匹配的人来使用，也和凡铁无异。虽说宝剑难求，然而真正懂得养剑用剑的人，却也未必比宝剑更多。
translation: Yuanxian: Even divine weapons and sharp blades, if there is no matching person to wield them, are no different from ordinary iron. Although precious swords are hard to come by, those who truly understand how to nurture and use swords are not necessarily more numerous than the swords themselves.

original_text: 元贤：许多前辈都死于十九年前的那场大战，如今我琼华派中，弟子的修为大都并不精深，否则的话，区区妖界，又何足为惧？！
translation: Yuanxian: Many seniors died in the great battle nineteen years ago. Now in our Qionghua Sect, most disciples' cultivation isn't very deep. Otherwise, a mere yao realm-what would there be to fear?!

original_text: 明幽：看你手中这柄长剑，质地奇异，剑芒流转，一定是把来头不小的宝剑！只不过剑身却有些污浊……你是不是很久没有拭剑了？
translation: Mingyou: That longsword in your hand, with its unusual texture and shimmering blade, must be a precious sword of great origin! But the blade seems a bit tarnished... Have you not polished it for a long time?

original_text: 明幽：派中弟子大都用剑，但也有用其他兵刃修行的，比如怀见师弟用的是一柄药锄。不过那位新入门的柳师妹，却用一架箜篌当作兵刃，实在非常罕见。
translation: Mingyou: Most disciples in the sect use swords, but some cultivate with other weapons, like Martial Brother Huaijian who uses a medicine hoe. However, that newly joined Martial Sister Liu uses a konghou as a weapon, which is truly very rare.

original_text: 明幽：听说本派之中流传着一种特殊的文字，乃是九天玄女娘娘亲传，专用以记载铸剑秘法的，即使是派中的弟子，也很少有人能读懂。
translation: Mingyou: I heard there's a special script passed down within our sect, personally taught by the Goddess Ninth Heaven Xuannv, used exclusively to record secret sword-forging methods. Even among sect disciples, very few can read it.

original_text: 明幽：我也想像明炼那样亲手铸造自己的宝剑，可惜师父却说如今和妖界的大战在即，没有时间让我去琢磨铸剑之法……
translation: Mingyou: I also wish to forge my own precious sword like Minglian, but sadly, Master says that with the imminent great battle against the yao realm, there's no time for me to delve into sword-forging methods...

original_text: 明光：派中不收弟子已经很久了，倒是不知掌门为何要破例召见你们，还收你们入门？
translation: Mingguang: The sect hasn't accepted disciples for a long time. I wonder why the Sect Leader made an exception to summon you and even admitted you into the sect?

original_text: 明光：上回你们私自下山，惹得紫英师叔很不高兴，没想到掌门却没有处置你们……
translation: Mingguang: Last time you went down the mountain without permission, making Martial Uncle Ziying very unhappy. I didn't expect the Sect Leader not to punish you...

original_text: 明光：我琼华派弟子一直都是见妖便除的，如今这么大一个妖界竟然欺到我们头上来，掌门却下令不得靠近，这到底是为什么？！
translation: Mingguang: We disciples of Qionghua Sect have always eliminated yaoguais on sight. Now such a huge yao realm is bullying us, yet the sect leader orders us not to approach. Why is that?!

original_text: 明光：妖界已经现形，大家都那么紧张，紫英师叔却还是经常下山，真不知道他到底在干什么！
translation: Mingguang: The yao realm has already manifested. Everyone is so tense, yet Martial Uncle Ziying still frequently goes down the mountain. I really don't know what he's up to!

original_text: 明尘：你们是从播仙镇来的吗？镇上的人现在过得好不好？自从上山之后，我还从来没有回去看过呢……
translation: Mingchen: Are you from Boxian Town? How are the townsfolk doing now? Since coming up the mountain, I've never gone back to visit...

original_text: 明尘：小的时候仰慕山上的天神，我一个人上了仙山，没想到真的被师父收入了门下，只不过山上住的却不是天神，和山下人想的完全不一样，呵呵～
translation: Mingchen: When I was little, I admired the celestial beings on the mountain. I went up the immortal mountain alone and was unexpectedly accepted as a disciple by my master. However, those living on the mountain weren't celestials-completely different from what people below imagined, hehe~

original_text: 明尘：韩师妹他们年纪小，又是刚刚入门，稍微闯一下祸也是情有可原的，希望紫英师叔不要总是罚他们才好……
translation: Mingchen: Martial Sister Han and the others are young and newly enrolled, so it's understandable if they cause a little trouble. I hope Uncle Ziying won't always punish them...

original_text: 明尘：好像很多师兄弟都很在意韩师妹在上山前的行止，但那都是过去的事情了，韩师妹在派中虽然经常闯祸，但也没惹到他们，他们干嘛非要赶走人家？
translation: Mingchen: It seems many fellow disciples are very concerned about Martial Sister Han's conduct before coming up the mountain, but that's all in the past. Although Martial Sister Han often causes trouble in the sect, she hasn't offended them. Why must they drive her away?

original_text: 明尘：我上仙山修行，为的就是能像天神一样保护山下的人，就算我死了，也绝不让妖怪伤及播仙镇分毫！
translation: Mingchen: I came to this immortal mountain to cultivate, all to protect the people at the foot of the mountain like celestials. Even if I die, I won't let monsters harm Boxian Town in the slightest!

original_text: 明尘：等掌门出关，我们就要和妖界正面交锋了吧？如果这次能顺利打退妖界，而且我也能活下来，我一定要下山，回播仙镇上的家里看看爹娘……
translation: Mingchen: Once the Sect Leader emerges from seclusion, we'll be facing the yao realm head-on, right? If we can successfully repel the yao realm this time and I survive, I must go down the mountain and return to my home in Boxian Town to see my parents...

original_text: 璇枢：师父整天盯着我练剑，练得我烦也烦死了！这卷云台平常没什么人来，我偷偷溜上来喘口气，师父一定找不着我～
translation: Xuanshu: Master watches me practice sword all day, it's driving me crazy! Cloud Terrace usually has few visitors. I sneaked up here to catch my breath-Master definitely won't find me~

original_text: 元隐：璇枢！我让你在剑舞坪习剑，你怎么跑这里来偷懒？！
translation: Yuanyin: Xuanshu! I told you to practice swordsmanship at Sword Dance Terrace, why are you slacking off here?!

original_text: 璇枢：啊！师父！我……我练剑时有些地方想不通，所以找个地方静一静！
translation: Xuanshu: Ah! Master! I... I had some doubts while practicing swordplay, so I found a quiet place to think!

original_text: 元隐：此地灵气混乱、煞气颇重，不要长时间留在这里。跟师父下去吧，有不明白的地方，为师的教你便是。
translation: Yuanyin: The spiritual energy here is chaotic, and the baleful aura is heavy. Don't stay long. Follow Master down; if there's anything you don't understand, I'll teach you.

original_text: 璇枢：可、可我想自己静思一会！师父你先下去吧，等我想明白了就来。
translation: Xuanshu: B-but I wish to meditate alone for a while! Master, please go down first. I'll come once I've figured things out.

original_text: 元隐：跟你说了不要待在卷云台上，如果一定要静思，就去思返谷！
translation: Yuanyin: I told you not to stay on Cloud Terrace, if you must meditate, go to Reflection Valley!

original_text: 璇枢：啊？思返谷？！那我、我还是跟师父你下去，向师父讨教就行了……
translation: Xuanshu: Ah? Reflection Valley?! Then I... I'd rather go down with you, Master, and seek your guidance directly...

original_text: 虚合：哈哈，《钉耙秘笈》！真是太好啦！师侄你为寻此物，想必是费了一番功夫吧？日后若需什么灵丹妙药，便到龙芽道丹来看看，师叔我定然不会亏待于你！
translation: Xuhe: Haha, 'Rake Secret Manual'! Excellent! Nephew, you must have gone through quite some trouble to find this, right? In the future, if you need any elixirs or medicines, come to Longya Medicines. Your uncle here definitely won't shortchange you!

original_text: 开启新交易品
translation: New Trade Items Unlocked

original_text: 明锻：玉柄龙吟剑！真的是玉柄龙吟剑！这把剑果然是以奇石所铸，其造剑技艺，不在我师父之下！太感谢了！这几张图谱是我和师弟师妹一起参详所得，送给你当谢礼吧！
translation: Mingduan: The Jade-Hilt DragonSword! It really is the Jade-Hilt DragonSword! This sword is indeed forged from rare ore, and its crafting skill is not inferior to my master's! Thank you so much! These few diagrams are what my Martial Siblings, and I have studied together. I'll give them to you as thanks!

original_text:
我那怀见徒儿用惯了药锄，我特地为他创了一套锄法。以剑法入锄法虽然可行，但两者到底有所区别，若能找到一本《钉耙秘笈》，于我新创锄法必然大有助益！师侄你若有闲，能否帮我找一本《钉耙秘笈》来？
你愿意帮我去找吗？
translation: My disciple Huaijian is used to his medicine hoe, so I created a hoe technique for him. Swordplay can work, but there are differences. A <colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>Rake Manual</colour><dc0> would greatly help my new technique! Martial nephew, could you find one for me? Will you help?</dc0>

original_text:
我听说有一把剑名“玉柄龙吟”，挥剑便有龙吟清啸，十分神奇了得。如果能借来一看，说不定能铸出更好的宝剑。如果你找到这把剑，能拿来此处给我看看吗？
你愿意帮我去找吗？
translation:
I've heard of a sword named 'Jade-Hilt DragonSword'. Wielding it produces a clear dragon's roar, truly marvelous. If I could borrow it for a look, I might forge an even better sword. If you find this sword, could you bring it here for me to see?
Will you help me search for it?

original_text: 1.去月牙河谷
translation: 1. Go to Crescent Valley

original_text: 2.御剑飞行
translation: 2. Sword Flight

original_text: 3.什么都不做
translation: 3. Do Nothing

original_text: 准备<colour red=255 green=102 blue=0 alpha=255>去月牙河谷</colour><dc0>还是</dc0><colour red=255 green=102 blue=0 alpha=255>御剑飞行</colour><dc0>？</dc0>
translation: Proceed to?

original_text: 云天河：房门锁住了……
translation: Yun Tianhe: The door's locked...

original_text: 韩菱纱：有个村子……还有人在吗？
translation: Han Lingsha: There's a village... is anyone still there?

original_text: 柳梦璃：等一下！
translation: Liu Mengli: Wait!

original_text: 柳梦璃：那里……那里有人在喊……让我们救救他！
translation: Liu Mengli: Over there... someone is shouting over there... asking us to save him!

original_text: 云天河：啊？有吗？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Huh? Really?

original_text: 韩菱纱：梦璃说有就有啦！走，我们快过去看看！
translation: Han Lingsha: If Mengli says there is, there is! Come on, let's go check it out!

original_text: 韩菱纱：快住手！
translation: Han Lingsha: Stop that!
Ulan: ...!

original_text: 乌兰：你们！你们是……
translation: Ulan: You! You are...

original_text: 韩菱纱：你在做什么？
translation: Han Lingsha: What are you doing?

original_text: 乌兰：我、没……
translation: Ulan: I, didn't...

original_text: 韩菱纱：那么小的孩子和你有深仇大恨吗？！你居然想把他活活掐死！
translation: Han Lingsha: Do you have a deep-seated hatred for such a small child?! You actually wanted to strangle it to death!

original_text: 乌兰：不是的！！我没有……
translation: Ulan: No!! I didn't...

original_text: 韩菱纱：什么没有！我明明看见的！
translation: Han Lingsha: Didn't?! I clearly saw it!

original_text: 巴图：天吶！乌兰，你竟然做出这样的糊涂事！
translation: Batu: Heavens! Ulan, how could you do such a foolish thing!

original_text: 乌兰：村长！……
translation: Ulan: Village Chief!...

original_text: 巴图：我是听见声音才进来的，没想到你……
translation: Batu: I came in because I heard a noise, I didn't expect you...

original_text: 乌兰：…………村长，我……我也不想的……
translation: Ulan: ...... Village Chief, I... I didn't mean it either...

original_text: 乌兰：只要还有一点办法，我又怎能狠下心来……这孩子毕竟是我的骨血啊！
translation: Ulan: As long as there's the slightest hope, how could I bear to... After all, this child is my own flesh and blood!

original_text: 韩菱纱：啊？！
translation: Han Lingsha: Huh?!

original_text: 柳梦璃：他、他是你的小孩？到底发生了什么事？让你连自己的孩子都要杀？！
translation: Liu Mengli: It...it's your child? What on earth happened? How could you even try to kill your own child?!

original_text: 柳梦璃：……若不是、若不是幼儿灵力极强，令我听见他的求救……
translation: Liu Mengli: ... If not for, if not for the child's extremely strong spiritual power, letting me hear his cries for help...

original_text: 乌兰：…………我又有什么办法……这孩子的姐姐，生下来以后连一岁都不到就死了……水实在太少，食物也是有一顿没一顿的……
translation: Ulan: ...What else could I do... This child's sister died before she was even one year old... There's too little water, and food is sporadic at best...

original_text: 乌兰：往后……让我眼睁睁看着他活不下去，倒不如、不如……
translation: Ulan: In the future... Watching him unable to live on, I'd rather, rather...

original_text: 巴图：乌兰……我知道你自从丈夫和女儿病死之后，一直很伤心，但再怎么苦，都要熬过去啊！
translation: Batu: Ulan... I know you've been heartbroken since your husband and daughter died of illness, but no matter how bitter it is, you have to endure and get through this!

original_text: 巴图：能够带走人性命的，只有天上的神，你要是真的那样做了，死后连灵魂都不能得到神的宽恕！
translation: Batu: Only the gods in heaven can take away human lives. If you really do that, even your soul won't receive the gods' forgiveness after death!

original_text: 乌兰：村长……我……我到底该怎么办！
translation: Ulan: Village Chief... I... what should I do!

original_text: 云天河：你不是说没有水也没有食物吗？我身上的这些都可以给你。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Didn't you say there's no water or food? All of this I have on me can be given to you.

original_text: 韩菱纱：还有我和梦璃的！
translation: Han Lingsha: And mine and Mengli's!

original_text: 乌兰：……
translation: Ulan: ...

original_text: 巴图：你们？这身装扮……天呐！你们是仙山上神的仆人！
translation: Batu: You? These attires... Heavens! You are servants of the celestials from the immortal mountain!

original_text: 韩菱纱：神的仆人？不是啊——
translation: Han Lingsha: Servants of the celestials? No-

original_text: 巴图：求求你们了！能不能帮村子里的人向神祷告，让月牙河再恢复从前的样子？！
translation: Batu: I beg you! Can you pray to the celestials for the villagers, so that the Crescent River can return to its former state?!

original_text: 柳梦璃：……先别急，告诉我们究竟是怎么一回事吧。
translation: Liu Mengli: ... Don't rush. Tell us exactly what happened first.

original_text: 慕容紫英：不错，我也很想知道是怎么一回事！
translation: Murong Ziying: Indeed, I also want to know what happened!

original_text: 云天河：师、师叔？！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Mar-Martial Uncle?!

original_text: 慕容紫英：你们眼里还有我这个师叔？！
translation: Murong Ziying: Do you still see me as your Martial Uncle?!

original_text: 慕容紫英：我倒不知何时吩咐过你们下山办事了！
translation: Murong Ziying: I don't recall ever instructing you to leave the mountain on business!

original_text: 云天河：呃……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Uh...

original_text: 韩菱纱：紫英你先别生气嘛～你不是说过琼华派弟子应该扶危济困？这回我们误打误撞，才发现昆仑山脚下竟有这样缺水的村子，于情于理总该先帮帮他们吧？
translation: Han Lingsha: Ziying, don't be angry~ Didn't you say Qionghua disciples should aid the distressed? By chance, we found this water-starved village at Kunlun's foothills. Shouldn't we help them first, in reason and heart?

original_text: 慕容紫英：……虽是其心可悯，但这与擅自下山却是两回事，回去之后再罚你们。
translation: Murong Ziying: ... Though your intentions may be pitiable, this is separate from leaving the mountain without permission. You will be punished upon return.

original_text: 韩菱纱：……小气……
translation: Han Lingsha: ... Stingy...

original_text: 巴图：……你是？
translation: Batu: ...Who are you?

original_text: 慕容紫英：老人家，在下慕容紫英，乃是昆仑琼华派的弟子。能不能告诉我们，这个村子为何会如此干旱？若能相助，定然义不容辞。
translation: Murong Ziying: Elder, I am Murong Ziying, a disciple of Kunlun's Qionghua Sect. Could you tell us why this village suffers such severe drought? If we can help, we will certainly not shirk our duty.

original_text: 巴图：你们～你们果然是仙山上来的人，这真是上天可怜我们呐！
translation: Batu: You... you really are from the immortal mountain! Heaven truly pities us!

original_text: 巴图：……说起来也已经是很久以前的事了，月牙村曾经是个美丽的绿洲，从昆仑山上流下一条月牙河，养活了整个村子的人。在河的源头还有一片树林，虽然不很大，但是长得特别茂盛。
translation: Batu: ...Speaking of which, it was a long time ago. Crescent Village was once a beautiful oasis, with a Crescent River flowing down from the Kunlun Mountains, sustaining the entire village. At the river's source, there was also a grove, not very large but exceptionally lush.

original_text: 巴图：可是……到我爷爷那一辈，村里来了很多做生意的中原人，说那片树林是传说中的“昆仑圣木”，砍了以后能够卖个好价钱。
translation: Batu: But... by my grandfather's generation, many merchants from the Central Plains came to the village, saying that forest was the legendary 'Kunlun Sacred Wood', and cutting it down could fetch a good price.

original_text: 韩菱纱：这、这怎么可以？！
translation: Han Lingsha: How, how can they do that?!

original_text: 巴图：是啊，可惜那个时候村里的祭司虽然极力反对，但是其他人都想变得和中原商人一样富有，最后还是同意了砍树……那些树倒了之后，月牙河的水就慢慢枯竭了……
translation: Batu: Yes. It's a shame. Back then, the village priest strongly opposed it, but everyone else wanted wealth like the Central Plains merchants. In the end, they agreed to cut down the trees... After those trees fell, the Crescent River slowly dried up...
Liu Mengli: ......

original_text: 巴图：所有人都后悔了，想过很多办法让水源恢复，甚至还修了新的祭坛向上天祷告，但是没有用……天神已经被激怒了……
translation: Batu: Everyone regrets it now. We've tried many ways to restore the water source, even built a new altar to pray to Heaven, but nothing works... The heaven have been angered...

original_text: 巴图：最近几年，月牙河完全干了，不少人因为缺水，都患上重病过世了……也有年轻力壮的，离开这儿想去别处生活，却再也没有回来过……
translation: Batu: In recent years, the Crescent River has completely dried up. Many people have fallen seriously ill and passed away due to lack of water... Some strong young men left here trying to live elsewhere, but never came back...

original_text: 慕容紫英：老人家，不如你们也迁去其他地方吧？此处风尘环伺，实在不宜定居。
translation: Murong Ziying: Elder, perhaps you should also relocate elsewhere? This place is surrounded by dust and wind, truly unsuitable for settlement.

original_text: 巴图：唉，村子里的孤儿寡母，又怎么经得起长途跋涉……
translation: Batu: Alas, how can the widows and orphans in the village endure such a long journey...

original_text: 巴图：更重要的是，月牙村是我们祖祖辈辈安家的地方啊，我身为村长，难道……难道连这故土都保不住…………
translation: Batu: More importantly, Crescent Village is where our ancestors have settled for generations. As the village chief, how can I... how can I fail to protect this homeland...

original_text: 韩菱纱：……就没有其他办法了吗？
translation: Han Lingsha: ...Is there really no other way?

original_text: 巴图：办法是有的，只是太难……
translation: Batu: There is a way, but it's too difficult...

original_text: 巴图：我听已经过世的老祭司说过，这世上有一种叫“水灵珠”的宝物，只要有了它，水源就能恢复，一切也会变回原来的模样。
translation: Batu: I heard from the late old priest that there's a treasure in this world called the Water Spirit Pearl. With it, the water source can be restored, and everything will return to how it was.

original_text: 慕容紫英：水灵珠？！
translation: Murong Ziying: Water Spirit Pearl?!

original_text: 巴图：老祭司他确实是这么告诉我的……
translation: Batu: The old priest really told me that...

original_text: 柳梦璃：师叔，你是不是知道些什么？
translation: Liu Mengli: Martial Uncle, do you know something about this?

original_text: 慕容紫英：若是水灵珠，倒有一线希望，因它正是本门镇派之宝！
translation: Murong Ziying: If we only need the Water Spirit Pearl, there is a glimmer of hope, as it is precisely our sect's treasure!

original_text: 韩菱纱：咦？竟有这样巧的事？！
translation: Han Lingsha: Huh? What a coincidence?!

original_text: 慕容紫英：待我禀明掌门，看是否可将水灵珠借来一用。老祭司说的应该没错，水灵珠乃世间至宝，相信以水灵之力，必能令河源复苏。
translation: Murong Ziying: I will report to the Sect Leader and see if we can borrow the Water Spirit Pearl. The old priest is likely correct. The Water Spirit Pearl is a supreme treasure of this world. I believe its water spirit power can surely revive the river's source.

original_text: 云天河：呵呵，这真是太好了！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Hehe, this is really great!

original_text: 慕容紫英：老人家，我们先将身边的水和食物都留下，请等候消息。
translation: Murong Ziying: Elder, we'll leave the water and food we have with you first, please wait for news.

original_text: 巴图：谢谢你们！你们果然是天神的使者啊！
translation: Batu: Thank you! You really are the messengers of the celestials!

original_text: 乌兰：……谢谢你们……谢谢……
translation: Ulan: ...Thank you... thank you...

original_text: 柳梦璃：别担心，这个孩子的意志力很强，一定会健健康康地长大，成为一个出色的男子汉。
translation: Liu Mengli: Don't worry. This child has strong willpower. He will surely grow up healthy and become an outstanding man.

original_text: 乌兰：谢谢……
translation: Ulan: Thank you...

original_text: 乌兰：如果不是你们，我真要后悔一辈子了……
translation: Ulan: If not for you all, I would have regretted it for a lifetime...

original_text: 慕容紫英：事不宜迟，你们跟我回山上，<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>一同去琼华宫向掌门禀明此事</colour><dc0>。</dc0>
translation: Murong Ziying: There's no time to lose. Follow me back up the mountain,<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> Together, we'll go to Qionghua Palace to report this matter to the Sect Leader</colour><dc0>.</dc0>

original_text: 乌兰：谢谢，如果不是你们，我真要后悔一辈子了……
translation: Ulan: Thank you. If not for you, I would have regretted it for the rest of my life...

original_text: 韩菱纱：这儿是……月牙村？
translation: Han Lingsha: This place is... Crescent Village?

original_text: 云天河：妖界看不见了……梦璃她……真的走了……
translation: Yun Tianhe: The yao realm is gone... Mengli... she really left...

original_text: 韩菱纱：天河，你别难过了……
translation: Han Lingsha: Tianhe, don't be sad...

original_text: 云天河：以前在山上一切都很自在，爹对生死离别也看得很淡……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Back on Qingluan Peak, everything was so carefree, and Father was always indifferent to parting and death...

original_text: 云天河：但我现在不一样了，也许这就是伤心吧……
translation: Yun Tianhe: But I'm different now, maybe this is what sadness feels like...

original_text: 韩菱纱：天河……
translation: Han Lingsha: Tianhe...

original_text: 韩菱纱：……至少，还有另一个“梦璃”陪着我们，就算……她也只是一场梦…………如果……如果在琼华派和幻瞑界之间发生的那些事，也能像做梦一样，醒来之后发觉全是假的，那该有多好……
translation: Han Lingsha: ...At least there's another 'Mengli' with us, even if... she's also just a dream... If... if everything that happened between Qionghua Sect and the Twilight Realm could be like a dream, and upon waking we found it was all an illusion... wouldn't that be wonderful...

original_text: 慕容紫英：人生已如枕梁一梦，我们所以为的“幻境”，说不定仅是梦中之梦，生死则是一场更大的梦。
translation: Murong Ziying: Life is already like a dream on a pillow. What we call an 'illusion' might be merely a dream within a dream, while living is but a even greater dream.

original_text: 韩菱纱：紫英……？
translation: Han Lingsha: Ziying...?

original_text: 慕容紫英：没什么，只是忽然想起了以前宗炼师公说过的话，历经这么多事，我才明白其中的那种无奈……
translation: Murong Ziying: Nothing. I just suddenly remembered something Grandmaster Zonglian once said. After all these experiences, I finally understand the helplessness in his words...

original_text: 云天河：你们……我不懂，人活着，还分什么真的假的？梦璃走了，我心里难过，一定是真的，怎么会有假？还有接下来要去做的很多事……如果这些都是梦，干嘛还要做？
translation: Yun Tianhe: You two... I don't understand. When a person is alive, why would he divide anything into real and fake? Mengli left, and my heart aches-that's real, how could it be fake? And all the things we still have to do... If these are all a dream, then why do them at all?

original_text: 韩菱纱：……
translation: Han Lingsha: ...

original_text: 韩菱纱：天河你啊，一点都没变，总会说出些让人吓一跳的话。
translation: Han Lingsha: Tianhe, you haven't changed at all-you always manage to say things that take people by surprise.

original_text: 云天河：有吗？就是想到什么说什么啊。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Did I? I just say whatever comes to mind.

original_text: 慕容紫英：无论如何，我们还有许多事要做，不能一直耽于感伤……眼前便要将水灵珠交给月牙村的村长。
translation: Murong Ziying: Regardless, we still have many things to do and cannot linger in sorrow... Right now, we must deliver the Water Spirit Pearl to the village chief of Crescent Village.

original_text: 韩菱纱：啊，对了！梦璃是告诉过我，那个人……玄霄他把水灵珠给了天河，这么说来，这里真的能再一次变成绿洲了？！
translation: Han Lingsha: Ah, right! Mengli told me that person... Xuanxiao gave the Water Spirit Pearl to Tianhe. So this place really can become an oasis again?!

original_text: 慕容紫英：到底要如何做，等一下再问村长吧。
translation: Murong Ziying: What exactly to do, let's ask the village chief later.

original_text: 韩菱纱：我这就去告诉村长！
translation: Han Lingsha: I'll go tell the village chief right away!

original_text: 慕容紫英：天河，接下来你如何打算？是否去找……玄霄师叔？
translation: Murong Ziying: Tianhe, what are your plans next? Will you go find... Martial Uncle Xuanxiao?

original_text: 云天河：当然！我要夺回望舒剑！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Of course! I want to take back Wangshu Sword!

original_text: 慕容紫英：……但是，以师叔如今之能，就算你我倾尽全力，只怕也难动他分毫……
translation: Murong Ziying: ... However, given Martial Uncle Xuanxiao's current power, even if we exert our full strength, I'm afraid we can hardly move him an inch...

original_text: 云天河：打不过也要打！不然菱纱——
translation: Yun Tianhe: Even if we can't win, we have to fight! Otherwise Lingsha-

original_text: 云天河：我绝对不能再伤心一次，我不要！
translation: Yun Tianhe: I absolutely cannot be heartbroken again, I won't!

original_text: 慕容紫英：…………
translation: Murong Ziying: ......

original_text: 韩菱纱：天河！紫英！
translation: Han Lingsha: Tianhe! Ziying!

original_text: 韩菱纱：我们……
translation: Han Lingsha: We...

original_text: 慕容紫英：发生何事？！
translation: Murong Ziying: What happened?!

original_text: 韩菱纱：我们……来晚了……村长、还有其他人……他们已经离开了月牙村……
translation: Han Lingsha: We... came too late... The village chief, and the others... They've already left Crescent Village...

original_text: 慕容紫英：……！何时走的？！
translation: Murong Ziying: ...! When did they leave?!

original_text: 韩菱纱：看村长的留书，有一个多月了……他说很感激我们，可是……村里人没办法再等下去了……以前从村里出去的人经商赚了钱，带着商队回来接他们……他们最终还是放弃了，决定穿过沙漠，去绿洲生活……
translation: Han Lingsha: Judging from the village chief's letter, it's been over a month... He said he's very grateful to us, but... the villagers couldn't wait any longer... Someone from the village went out many years ago, made money in business, and returned with a merchant caravan to fetch them... In the end, they gave up and decided to cross the desert to live in another oasis...

original_text: 云天河：……都走了？…………也好，他们能过得比以前好……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... All gone?............ Fine, they can live better than before...

original_text: 韩菱纱：……梦璃走了，月牙村的人也走了，到头来以为能够做成的事，一件都做不成……
translation: Han Lingsha: ... Mengli left, the people of Crescent Village left. In the end, the things I thought we could accomplish, none of them became reality...

original_text: 云天河：……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ...

original_text: 慕容紫英：琼华派所有人……身在昆仑，受人敬仰，却无法泽被山脚下的百姓，如此大过，枉被称为“剑仙”……
translation: Murong Ziying: All members of Qionghua Sect... residing on Kunlun, revered by others, yet unable to bring blessings to the people at the foot of Kunlun mountain. Such a grave fault makes us unworthy of being called 'Sword Immortals'...

original_text: 韩菱纱：紫英……
translation: Han Lingsha: Ziying...

original_text: 云天河：菱纱，让紫英送你去播仙镇吧，你太累了，好好睡上一觉——
translation: Yun Tianhe: Lingsha, let Ziying take you to Boxian Town, you're too tired, get a good sleep-

original_text: 韩菱纱：那你呢？
translation: Han Lingsha: What about you?

original_text: 云天河：我回琼华派，去找玄霄。
translation: Yun Tianhe: I'm returning to Qionghua Sect to find Xuanxiao.

original_text: 韩菱纱：什么？！
translation: Han Lingsha: What?!

original_text: 韩菱纱：不可以，你别去，你根本不是他的对手！
translation: Han Lingsha: No, you mustn't go. You're no match for him at all!

original_text: 韩菱纱：你不是答应过我？要一起回青鸾峰吗？是骗人的？！
translation: Han Lingsha: Didn't you promise me? To go back to Qingluan Peak together? Were you lying?!

original_text: 云天河：我说话算话，不过得先抢回望舒剑，玄霄他们再用那把剑，你会没命的……
translation: Yun Tianhe: I keep my word. But first, we need to get Wangshu Sword back. If Xuanxiao keeps using it, you'll die...

original_text: 韩菱纱：我早说了，不稀罕什么命长命短，你别去！
translation: Han Lingsha: I said it before, I don't care about long or short life, don't go!

original_text: 云天河：……但我稀罕。
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... But I care.

original_text: 韩菱纱：你……
translation: Han Lingsha: You...
Han Lingsha: ......

original_text: 韩菱纱：你！你一定要去的话，我宁可马上就死了，也不要你赔上一条命！
translation: Han Lingsha: You! If you insist on going, I'd rather die right now than have you throw your life away!

original_text: 云天河：你乱说什么！
translation: Yun Tianhe: What nonsense are you saying!

original_text: 慕容紫英：你们，休要再争！
translation: Murong Ziying: You all, cease this arguing!

original_text: 慕容紫英：菱纱所言极是，硬闯琼华派乃是下策，以卵击石，于事无补。
translation: Murong Ziying: Lingsha speaks wisely. Forcing our way into the Qionghua Sect is a poor strategy-like striking a stone with an egg, it would be futile.

original_text: 云天河：那要怎么办？！难道就不管菱纱——
translation: Yun Tianhe: Then what should we do?! Are we just going to ignore Lingsha---

original_text: 慕容紫英：唯今之计，我们不如先去清风涧寻两位长老，问问他们有无他法。
translation: Murong Ziying: For now, we should go to Breezy Brook to find the two elders and ask if they have any other solutions.

original_text: 云天河：我不去！他们根本就是帮着玄霄的！明明知道不可以用望舒剑，对菱纱不好，却一直瞒我们！到现在还会管菱纱的死活吗？说不定他们已经去琼华派找玄霄了！
translation: Yun Tianhe: I won't go! They are clearly helping Xuanxiao! They knew perfectly well that using Wangshu Sword is harmful to Lingsha, yet they kept it from us! Do they even care about Lingsha's life now? Maybe they've already gone to Qionghua Sect to find Xuanxiao!

original_text: 慕容紫英：……两位长老行事，或许亦有苦衷，他们十九年来愧疚难安，一心要助师叔破冰，所以才……
translation: Murong Ziying: ... The two elders' actions might also have their reasons. For nineteen years, they've been tormented by guilt, solely focused on helping Martial Uncle break the ice, so...

original_text: 慕容紫英：假若长老真是心如铁石、是非不分，为何要传授菱纱心法，又将“红魄”交给菱纱，还在我们欲往幻瞑界时多番指点？
translation: Murong Ziying: If the elders truly had a heart of stone and couldn't distinguish right from wrong, why would he teach Lingsha the cultivation method, give her Red Soul Jade and offer guidance when we wanted to go to the Twilight Realm?

original_text: 云天河：……那又怎样？对不起一个人，就可以为他做任何事，为他不顾别人的命吗？玄霄重要，菱纱就什么都不是？
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... So what? If you're sorry to someone, can you do anything for him, disregard others' lives for that reason? Is Xuanxiao so important, while Lingsha is nothing?

original_text: 慕容紫英：……好！就算你心中忿忿难平，也该想想菱纱吧？
translation: Murong Ziying: ... Fine! Even if you're filled with resentment, you should think about Lingsha, right?

original_text: 云天河：……！
translation: Yun Tianhe: ...!

original_text: 慕容紫英：姑且不论两位长老是否已去往琼华派，我只当去清风涧一试运气。
translation: Murong Ziying: Regardless of whether the two elders have gone to Qionghua Sect, I'll still try my luck at Breezy Brook.
Yun Tianhe: ......

original_text: 韩菱纱：你们……你们都别再说了……就这样，大家一起回青鸾峰不好吗？
translation: Han Lingsha: You... all of you, stop talking... How about this, why don't we all just go back to Qingluan Peak together?

original_text: 韩菱纱：天河，就像你讲的……在青阳长老、重光长老的心里，玄霄的份量远远胜过我，你气他们心有偏袒，一定要把人命分个孰重孰轻……
translation: Han Lingsha: Tianhe, just like you said... In the hearts of Elder Qingyang and Elder Chongguang, Xuanxiao's importance far outweighs mine. You're angry that they're biased, insisting on weighing human lives against each other...

original_text: 韩菱纱：既然人命无贵贱，我一条命，你一条命，为什么还要去找玄霄……
translation: Han Lingsha: Since all lives are equal, my one life, your one life, why do we still need to go to fight Xuanxiao...

original_text: 韩菱纱：你以为能活久一点，我一定会高兴吗？就算真的夺回了望舒剑，万一你和紫英有什么……我、我一辈子都不会开心的！
translation: Han Lingsha: Do you think I'd be happy just because I could live a little longer? Even if we really get Wangshu Sword back, if anything happens to you or Ziying... I, I would never be happy for the rest of my life!

original_text: 云天河：菱纱……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Lingsha...

original_text: 韩菱纱：算我求你……不要让我这么难过好不好……
translation: Han Lingsha: I'm begging you... Don't make me so sad, okay...

original_text: 云天河：对不起……对不起…………
translation: Yun Tianhe: Sorry... I'm sorry...

original_text: 韩菱纱：……猪头……出了事就会说对不起，每次还不是让我担心个半死……
translation: Han Lingsha: ... Pighead... You only know how to say sorry when something happens, but every time you still make me worry half to death...

original_text: 云天河：……那个……走吧，<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>我们去清风涧</colour><dc0>……</dc0>
translation: Yun Tianhe: ...Um... let's go, <colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>we're heading to Breezy Brook</colour><dc0>...</dc0>

original_text: 韩菱纱：你？！
translation: Han Lingsha: You?!

original_text: 云天河：我不会就这样去找玄霄了，不过……还是得想办法救你。紫英说两位长老也许会有办法，不管怎样，都要去一趟清风涧！
translation: Yun Tianhe: I won't go find Xuanxiao just like that, but... I still have to find a way to save you. Ziying said the two elders might have a solution. No matter what, we have to go to Breezy Brook!

original_text: 慕容紫英：算一下时日，琼华派应该还未以双剑做成剑柱。我们不要贸然行事，留存实力，此事未必没有转机。
translation: Murong Ziying: Calculating the time, Qionghua likely hasn't yet formed the sword pillars with the dual swords. Let's not act rashly; conserve strength. There may still be a chance.

original_text: 韩菱纱：……嗯……但是太危险的事，千万别去做……
translation: Han Lingsha: ... Mm... but don't do anything too dangerous...

original_text: 云天河：放心吧！都已经答应你了，我们又不去琼华派。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Don't worry! We already promised you, and we're not going to Qionghua Sect.

original_text: 韩菱纱：哼，不单是去找玄霄，其他危险的事也不许做！
translation: Han Lingsha: Hmph, not only are you forbidden from going to find Xuanxiao, you're also not allowed to do any other dangerous things!

original_text: 云天河：好好好，都听你的就是……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Okay okay, I'll listen to you...

original_text: 昆珠：怎么还有人会来我们月牙村？自从月牙河干涸之后，已经很久没有外人来了……
translation: Kunzhu: Why are there still people coming to our Crescent Village? It's been a long time since outsiders visited after the Crescent River dried up...

original_text: 昆珠：听说月牙河还没干涸的时候，村里也有人放牧，也有人种地，还经常有商队经过，现在却什么都没有了……
