translation: Kunzhu: I heard that before the Crescent River dried up, the village had herders, farmers, and frequent merchant caravans passing through. Now, there's nothing left...

original_text: 昆珠：如果不是仙山上的人帮忙送水，我们大概早就撑不下去了，谢谢……
translation: Kunzhu: If not for the people from the immortal mountain helping deliver water, we probably wouldn't have lasted. Thank you...

original_text: 昆珠：不知道为什么，已经很少有仙山上的人来了，日子越来越难过，很多人下定决心要离开了……
translation: Kunzhu: I don't know why, but fewer and fewer people from the immortal mountains come. Life is getting harder, and many have decided to leave...

original_text: 卓西姆：天神已经遗弃月牙村了……这都是天神降给我们的惩罚啊……
translation: Zoxim: Heaven has abandoned Moon Tooth Village... this is the punishment the celestials have given us...

original_text: 卓西姆：每天都有人会送水来，可是……天神什么时候才能原谅我们，让月牙河恢复原样呢……
translation: Zoxim: Someone delivers water every day, but... when will the celestials forgive us and restore the Crescent River to its original state...

original_text: 卓西姆：送水的人也不太来了……村子里越来越多的人离开，可是我还是舍不得月牙村啊……
translation: Zoxim: The water deliverer hardly comes anymore... More and more people are leaving the village, but I still can't bear to leave Crescent Village...

original_text: 纳珠：纳珠好渴……
translation: Nazu: Nazu is so thirsty...

original_text: 纳珠：天神的本事很大，天神让人给我们送水来～过不了多久，还能让水从地下涌出来！
translation: Nazu: The celestials are very powerful. They send us water~ Soon, they'll even make water spring up from the ground!

original_text: 纳珠：鲁桑娜跟着萨西里一家走了，阿娘说，我们也要搬到其他地方去住，到底什么时候才能再见到鲁桑娜呢？
translation: Nazu: Rusanna left with the Saxili family. Mother says we also have to move somewhere else. When will I ever see Rusanna again?

original_text: 萨瓦桑：该试的办法都试过了，还是没有水……月牙河的下面真的已经干了……
translation: Sawasang: We've tried every possible method, but there's still no water... The bottom of the Crescent River has truly dried up...

original_text: 萨瓦桑：我小时候曾经跟爹去过一个叫播仙镇的地方，那里真的是绿洲啊……天神眷顾他们，却遗弃了我们……
translation: Sawasang: When I was little, I went with my father to a place called Boxian Town. It was truly an oasis... The celestials favor them but have abandoned us...

original_text: 萨瓦桑：该走了……虽然现在有人送水和食物来，但河里没水，这里终究是住不下去的……
translation: Sawasang: Time to go... Although someone brings water and food now, with no water in the river, we ultimately can't stay here...

original_text: 鲁桑娜：萨西里，萨西里～我阿爷睡着了，为什么萨瓦桑叔叔要把他埋起来？
translation: Rusanna: Saxili, Saxili~ My grandpa fell asleep. Why did Uncle Sawasang bury him?

original_text: 萨西里：鲁桑娜，你阿爷不是睡着了，你阿爷是……他死了……
translation: Saxili: Rusanna, your grandpa isn't asleep... your grandpa is... he's passed away...

original_text: 鲁桑娜：什么意思……？鲁桑娜不懂……
translation: Rusanna: What do you mean...? Rusanna doesn't understand...

original_text: 萨西里：……
translation: Saxili: ...

original_text: 鲁桑娜：萨西里说我们要去很远很远的地方，可是巴图爷爷不想跟我们一起，鲁桑娜不要离开巴图爷爷……
translation: Rusanna: Saxili says we're going to a very, very far place, but Grandpa Batu doesn't want to come with us. Rusanna doesn't want to leave Grandpa Batu...

original_text: 萨西里：鲁桑娜的阿爷死了……我不知道该怎么和她说……
translation: Saxili: Rusanna's grandfather died... I don't know how to tell her...

original_text: 萨西里：阿爹要带我穿过沙漠，去南边，但是他不肯带鲁桑娜一起走……我会照顾鲁桑娜的！不能丢下她！
translation: Saxili: Father wants to take me across the desert to the south, but he refuses to bring Rusanna along... I'll take care of Rusanna! We can't leave her behind!

original_text: 巴图：只要有了水灵珠，一切都会好起来的……
translation: Batu: As long as we have the Water Spirit Pearl, everything will be fine...

original_text: 巴图：感谢你们！每天都会送来水和食物，村里人的身体又慢慢好了起来。
translation: Batu: Thank you! You bring water and food every day. The villagers are slowly recovering their health.

original_text: 巴图：仙山上是不是发生了什么事？送水的人也很少来了……还有……水灵珠……我们真的还要等下去吗？……
translation: Batu: Has something happened on the immortal mountain? The water deliverers have also come less frequently... And... the Water Spirit Pearl... Should we really keep waiting?...

original_text: 云天河：……对不起……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... I'm sorry...

original_text: 乌娜：月牙弯弯，月光淡淡，这是老奶奶教我唱的，她说以前河里的水很清，有月亮的晚上，月光照在水面上，天上的月儿小小的，月牙村的月儿大大的……
translation: Una: The crescent moon is curved, the moonlight faint. This is what Granny taught me to sing. She said the river water used to be very clear. On moonlit nights, moonlight shone on the water surface. The moon in the sky was small, the moon in Crescent Village was big...

original_text: 乌娜：哥哥要带我离开这里了……他说只要穿过沙漠，以后日子会好的……
translation: Una: My brother is taking me away from here... He says once we cross the desert, life will be better...

original_text: 格齐：巴图爷爷说昆仑山上住着天神，我、我想去找天神！让天神救救大家！……可是，留下我妹妹一个人怎么办……
translation: Gochi: Grandpa Batu says celestials live on Kunlun Mountain. I... I want to find the celestials! Ask them to save everyone!... But what about leaving my little sister alone...

original_text: 格齐：其他人都说要穿过沙漠，去找绿洲，我也要带上妹妹跟他们走……
translation: Gochi: Everyone else says we must cross the desert to find the oasis. I will take my sister and go with them...

original_text: 应元勇：河干了、地干了，连房子都不能再住下去……
translation: Ying Yuanyong: The river dried up, the land dried up, we can't even live in our houses anymore...

original_text: 应元勇：没有水怎么打铁……我就只剩下一些图谱了……
translation: Ying Yuanyong: Without water, how can I forge iron... I only have some blueprints left...

original_text: 应元勇：山上来的人是剑仙吧……但是一直靠他们送水也没用，月牙河的水又不会再恢复了，这里迟早待不下去的……
translation: Ying Yuanyong: The people who came down the mountain were sword immortals, right? But relying on them to deliver water isn't a lasting solution. The Crescent River won't recover, and sooner or later we won't be able to stay here...

original_text: 应元勇：我早说过……靠剑仙也没用，这个村子已经没有希望了……我也打算离开了……
translation: Ying Yuanyong: I've said it before... relying on sword immortals is useless. This village has no hope left... I plan to leave too...

original_text: 依玛：多少年啦……这地方从还有牛羊变成现在的样子，谁的心不痛……
translation: Ima: How many years... this place has changed from having cattle and sheep to what it is now. Whose heart doesn't ache...

original_text: 依玛：……让我离开村子……我舍不得，反正年纪这么大了，又能活多久……我不会走的……
translation: Ima: ...Let me leave the village... I can't bear to. Anyway, I'm so old now, how much longer can I live... I won't go...

original_text: 李元勇：啊！是我的月长石！太好了！小兄弟你真是了不起！这回我终于没什么牵挂了，再过几天就离开这个荒村，不过铺子里还有些矿石，如果你有需要，我可以卖给你。
translation: Li Yuanyong: Ah! It's my moonstone! Wonderful! Young man, you're truly amazing! Now I finally have no more regrets. In a few days, I'll leave this desolate village. But there's still some ore in my shop. If you need any, I can sell it to you.

original_text: 开启新交易品
translation: New Trade Items Unlocked

original_text: 金·水滴好人：像孤魂妹妹那种带两把刀的坏人能在陈州住上下两层的大房子，像我这样的好人却要被流放沙漠头顶烈日，这年头，好人难当啊！
translation: Golden WaterdropGoodPerson: A bad person like that lonely ghost sister with two knives can live in a big two-story house in Chenzhou, while a good person like me gets exiled to the desert under the scorching sun. These days, it's hard to be a good person!

original_text: 金·水滴好人：本来只是在陈州街头迷了路，谁知半夜一阵歪风吹，等我醒来的时候就被埋在这个奇怪的地方了，难道这就是我“金·水滴好人”的宿命？
translation: Golden WaterdropGoodPerson: I just got lost on the streets of Chenzhou. Then, a weird wind blew at midnight, and when I woke up, I was buried in this strange place. Could this be the fate of me, 'Golden WaterdropGoodPerson'?

original_text: 金·水滴好人：年轻人，想知道最后的敌人是谁吗？不告诉你就不告诉你！我很坏，对吧！哇哈哈～～～
translation: Golden WaterdropGoodPerson: Young one, want to know who the final enemy is? I won't tell you, won't tell you! I'm very bad, right? Wahahaha~~~

original_text: 金·水滴好人：年轻人，想知道为啥我的东西都卖一万元吗？唉～ 我也是被逼的……
translation: Golden WaterdropGoodPerson: Young man, want to know why all my things cost 10,000? Sigh~ I was forced into it...

original_text:
很多年前，我外出采矿，不小心将一颗月长石掉入了月牙河。现在月牙河干了，我想在离开村子之前把那颗宝石找回来，但是月牙河谷却有妖怪出没……难道我真的找不回那颗宝石了吗？
你愿意帮我去找找吗？
translation: Many years ago, I went out mining and accidentally dropped a<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> moonstone</colour><dc0> into Crescent River. Now theriver has dried up, and I wanted to find that gem before leaving the village, but monsters have been appearing in Crescent  Valley... Could I get that gem back? Will you help me go look for it?</dc0>

original_text: 1.去醉花荫
translation: 1. Go to Drunken Bower

original_text: 2.御剑飞行
translation: 2. Sword Flight

original_text: 3.什么都不做
translation: 3. Do Nothing

original_text: 准备<colour red=255 green=102 blue=0 alpha=255>去醉花荫</colour><dc0>还是</dc0><colour red=255 green=102 blue=0 alpha=255>御剑飞行</colour><dc0>？</dc0>
translation: Proceed to?

original_text: 云天河：房门锁住了……
translation: Yun Tianhe: The door's locked...

original_text: 云天河：不要去打扰青阳长老了……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Don't disturb Elder Qingyang anymore...

original_text: 云天河：喂～～这里有人吗？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Hey~~ Anyone here?

original_text: 慕容紫英：不得失礼。
translation: Murong Ziying: Do not be rude.

original_text: 慕容紫英：弟子慕容紫英，有要事前来求见二位长老。
translation: Murong Ziying: Disciple Murong Ziying, I have important matters and request an audience with the two elders.

original_text: 青阳：是掌门夙瑶命你来的？
translation: Qingyang: Did Sect Leader Suyao send you?

original_text: 青阳：掌门治派有方，我二人又隐退已久，再没有任何事情能够帮她，你回去吧。
translation: Qingyang: This sect leader manages the sect well, and we two have long retired. There's nothing more we can help her with. You may go back.

original_text: 慕容紫英：并非掌门，而是玄霄师叔命我们来的。
translation: Murong Ziying: It wasn't the Sect Leader, but our Martial Uncle Xuanxiao who ordered us to come.

original_text: 重光：玄霄？！
translation: Chongguang: Xuanxiao?!

original_text: 重光：你！刚才说的的确是玄霄？
translation: Chongguang: You! Was that really Xuanxiao you mentioned just now?

original_text: 慕容紫英：是，弟子不敢有所欺瞒！
translation: Murong Ziying: Yes, this disciple would not dare deceive you!

original_text: 青阳：你们这些后辈弟子，又如何会见到玄霄？
translation: Qingyang: How could junior disciples like you have seen Xuanxiao?

original_text: 云天河：是我……我们偷偷跑去禁地，然后就认识他了～
translation: Yun Tianhe: It's me... We sneaked into the forbidden area and then met him~

original_text: 青阳：天青？！你怎么……
translation: Qingyang: Tianqing?! How did you...

original_text: 重光：青阳，你看清楚，他并非云天青，不过是容貌相似罢了。
translation: Chongguang: Qingyang, look clearly. He is not Yun Tianqing, merely bearing a similar appearance.

original_text: 柳梦璃：二位长老也认识云叔……云天青吗？
translation: Liu Mengli: Do you two elders also know Uncle Yun... Yun Tianqing?

original_text: 青阳：派中弟子，我们怎会不识……
translation: Qingyang: Disciples of our sect, how could we not recognize him...

original_text: 重光：闲话休提，玄霄差你们前来，必是有大事，快快说出！
translation: Chongguang: Enough idle talk. Xuanxiao sent you here, there must be important business. Speak quickly!

original_text: 云天河：哦……玄霄他被封在冰里，现在想要出来了。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Oh... Xuanxiao is sealed in ice, and now he wants to come out.
Qingyang: ...!!

original_text: 云天河：不过还需要三件天下最阴寒的东西帮他抑制身体阳气，他说只有长老才知道哪里能找到。
translation: Yun Tianhe: But he still needs three of the world's most Yin-cold things to help suppress the Yang energy in his body. He said only the elders know where to find them.

original_text: 重光：……玄霄看来如何？他竟有十足把握能破冰而出？！
translation: Chongguang: ... How does Xuanxiao seem? He's actually fully confident he can break free from the ice?!

original_text: 云天河：啊？什么如何？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Huh? What how?

original_text: 云天河：好好一个人，被关上那么多年，肯定很郁闷，要是我的话，一个月也受不了……
translation: Yun Tianhe: A perfectly fine person, locked up for so many years, must be really depressed. If it were me, I couldn't stand even a month...

original_text: 重光：玄霄体内烈阳纵横，单靠几件寒器，怎可能压得住？
translation: Chongguang: Xuanxiao's body is filled with raging yang energy; how could a few cold artifacts possibly suppress it?

original_text: 云天河：他说练了一种叫作“凝冰诀”的功夫，已经好很多了，要那三样东西，也是为了以防万一。
translation: Yun Tianhe: He said he practiced a technique called Cryomancy, feels much better now. Those three items are just for precaution.

original_text: 重光：……凝冰诀…………
translation: Chongguang: ... Cryomancy...

original_text: 云天河：嗯，凝冰诀！我也练了一点点。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Hmm, Cryomancy! I practiced a little bit too.

original_text: 重光：……
translation: Chongguang: ...

original_text: 重光：初学凝冰诀便有此等阴寒之气，玄霄修练多年，看来的确有把握！
translation: Chongguang: To possess such yin-cold energy upon first learning Cryomancy-Xuanxiao, after years of cultivation, indeed seems confident!

original_text: 重光：……只是你不似玄霄体内烈阳纵横，修练凝冰诀竟不会觉得阴寒难耐？
translation: Chongguang: ... But unlike Xuanxiao, who has intense yang energy within, you don't feel unbearably cold while cultivating Cryomancy?

original_text: 云天河：不觉得……
translation: Yun Tianhe: I don't feel that way...

original_text: 重光：嗯……
translation: Chongguang: Hmm...

original_text: 青阳：这委实太过惊人……以短短十九年，便能抑制体内阳气，玄霄当真是个不世出的奇才，可叹造化弄人，当年偏偏落到被冰封的下场…
translation: Qingyang: This is truly astounding... To suppress yang energy in just nineteen years, Xuanxiao is indeed a rare genius. Sadly, fate played tricks; back then, he ended up frozen...

original_text: 青阳：他个性素来孤傲，从不向人求助，今日既已相托，我和重光自当尽力帮忙。
translation: Qingyang: His nature has always been aloof and proud, never asking for help. Since he entrusted us today, Chongguang and I will do our utmost to assist.

original_text: 青阳：……这位小兄弟，你可是云天青和夙玉的儿子？
translation: Qingyang: ... Young brother, are you the son of Yun Tianqing and Suyu?

original_text: 云天河：是啊。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Yeah.

original_text: 青阳：……这，或许都是天意吧……
translation: Qingyang: ...This... perhaps it's all fate...

original_text: 云天河：……？
translation: Yun Tianhe: ...?

original_text: 青阳：看你背上剑匣，你可是宗炼的传人？
translation: Qingyang: Seeing the sword case on your back, are you Zonglian's successor?

original_text: 慕容紫英：宗炼长老乃是弟子师公。
translation: Murong Ziying: Elder Zonglian is this disciple's grandmaster.

original_text: 青阳：果然，想必你的铸剑秘术已尽得宗炼真传，假以时日，或许又是一个可以铸就羲和剑、望舒剑之人。
translation: Qingyang: Indeed, it seems you have fully inherited Zonglian's secret sword-forging techniques. Given time, you might become another one capable of forging Xihe Sword and Wangshu Sword.

original_text: 慕容紫英：羲和、望舒……？
translation: Murong Ziying: Xihe, Wangshu...?

original_text: 青阳：望舒便是这位小兄弟所持之剑，而羲和则是玄霄佩剑。
translation: Qingyang: Wangshu is the sword this young brother holds, while Xihe is Xuanxiao's sword.

original_text: 慕容紫英：……！天河的剑，竟是本门之物？！还是由师公所铸？！
translation: Murong Ziying: ...! Tianhe's sword is actually from our sect?! And forged by Grandmaster?!

original_text: 青阳：……也不算他一人所铸……你还是莫要再多问了，不过是些烟云旧事罢了。
translation: Qingyang: ... It wasn't forged by him alone... Better not ask more. It's just some past events, like fleeting clouds.

original_text: 慕容紫英：……弟子不明，既然望舒剑是本门之物，掌门为何不索回？
translation: Murong Ziying: ... Disciple does not understand. Since Wangshu Sword is an artifact of our sect, why doesn't the Sect Leader demand its return?

original_text: 重光：她上回不拿，并不表示永远不拿。
translation: Chongguang: Not taking it last time doesn't mean she will never take it.

original_text: 云天河：哦……她果然就是小气……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Oh... She really is stingy...

original_text: 青阳：……这位紫衣姑娘气色不佳，灵力又是你们之中最弱的……
translation: Qingyang: ... This young lady in purple looks unwell, and her spiritual power is the weakest among you...

original_text: 青阳：重光，我看不如由你传授她一套心法，让她自行修炼吧。
translation: Qingyang: Chongguang, I think it would be better for you to teach her a set of mental cultivation techniques and let her practice on her own.

original_text: 重光：……也好。
translation: Chongguang: ... That's nice too.

original_text: 韩菱纱：是说我吗？要教我心法？嘻嘻，太谢谢了！
translation: Han Lingsha: Me? You'll teach me a set of cultivation technique? Hehe, thank you so much!

original_text: 重光：口诀我只说一遍，你听好！
translation: Chongguang: I'll only say the incantation once, listen carefully!

original_text: 韩菱纱：身上……暖暖的？
translation: Han Lingsha: My body... feels warm?

original_text: 韩菱纱：琼华派的道法真是厉害，我上山前动不动就头晕，后来练了紫英教的心法，也好了许多～
translation: Han Lingsha: Qionghua Sect's techniques are amazing. Before coming here, I often felt dizzy, but after practicing the method Ziying taught, I've improved a lot~

original_text: 青阳：……
translation: Qingyang: ...

original_text: 柳梦璃：二位长老，看二位神色凝重，可是有什么不对？
translation: Liu Mengli: Elders, seeing your grave expressions, is something wrong?

original_text: 青阳：没什么……你们听好，天下至阴至寒之物虽不多，但也不少于五件，只是踪迹难觅，能寻到三件，已属不易。
translation: Qingyang: It's nothing... Listen well. Although there aren't many supremely yin and cold objects in the world, there are no fewer than five. They're just hard to find. Obtaining three is already quite an achievement.

original_text: 青阳：我也只是听过一些传言，其中之一<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>“光纪寒图”</colour><dc0>曾于数百年前在海边——如今的</dc0><colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>即墨</colour><dc0>现身，而</dc0><colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>“鲲鳞”</colour><dc0>则是北方大鱼的鳞片，那条鱼数年前曾游曳至</dc0><colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>巢湖</colour><dc0>附近，至于第三件，我却也不知是什么，只知道藏在传说中的</dc0><colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>炎帝神农洞</colour><dc0>。</dc0>
translation: Qingyang: I've only heard some rumors. One of them is that the<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> 'Guangji Cold Map'</colour><dc0> appeared centuries ago by the sea-in what is now</dc0><colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> Jimo</colour><dc0>. The</dc0><colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> 'Kun Scale'</colour><dc0> is a scale from a great northern fish, which swam near</dc0><colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> Chao Lake</colour><dc0> a few years ago. As for the third item, I don't know what it is, only that it's hidden in the legendary</dc0><colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> Emperor Yan-Shennong Cave</colour><dc0>.</dc0>

original_text: 青阳：这些地方，我们不妨过去一探。
translation: Qingyang: We might as well go and investigate these places.

original_text: 云天河：“我们”？……可是，我答应玄霄要帮他，我想自己试试……
translation: Yun Tianhe: 'We'? ...But, I promised Xuanxiao I'd help him, I want to try it myself...

original_text: 重光：哼！有胆识，那便自己去吧。
translation: Chongguang: Hmph! You have courage, then go ahead yourself.

original_text: 慕容紫英：请二位长老见谅，天河言辞不当，但绝非拒绝长老好意……
translation: Murong Ziying: Please forgive us, Elders. Tianhe spoke inappropriately, but he definitely isn't rejecting your kindness...

original_text: 青阳：……无妨，年轻人多些历练也是好事，如遇困难再来清风涧，我们必定相助。
translation: Qingyang: ..., it's fine. More experience is good for young people. If you encounter difficulties, come to Breezy Brook. We'll surely help.

original_text: 慕容紫英：多谢长老！
translation: Murong Ziying: Thank you, Elders!

original_text: 重光：都去吧。
translation: Chongguang: All of you go.

original_text: 青阳：……年光飞逝，转眼又是十九年了。
translation: Qingyang: ... The years fly by, and in the blink of an eye, another nineteen years have passed.

original_text: 重光：十九年、三十八年，亦或是昆仑、妖界之争再多少次地往复轮回，又有分别吗？世间除了“玄霄”，还有什么是与你我相关的？
translation: Chongguang: Nineteen years, or thirty-eight years, or however many cycles of conflict between Kunlun and the yao realm repeat-what difference does it make? In this world, besides Xuanxiao, what else is truly relevant to you and me?

original_text: 青阳：……你说的对，他若能破冰而出，你我终可放下愧疚，安心离世了。
translation: Qingyang: ... You're right. If he can break free from the ice, we can finally let go of our guilt and pass away in peace.
Chongguang: ............

original_text: 韩菱纱：那个重光长老，是不是已经修成仙身了？头发、眉毛虽是白的，脸却好年轻！
translation: Han Lingsha: That Elder Chongguang, has he already attained an immortal body? His hair and eyebrows are white, but his face looks so young!

original_text: 慕容紫英：那只是他修炼的道法所至。两位长老的寿命自是比寻常人久上二十年、三十年，但也并非长生不老。
translation: Murong Ziying: That's merely a result of his cultivation method. The two elders' lifespans are indeed twenty or thirty years longer than ordinary people's, but they are not immortal.

original_text: 韩菱纱：……无聊，我翻遍书库里所有典籍，也没见琼华派哪个人是修成仙身的……
translation: Han Lingsha: ..., how boring. I've searched all the ancient texts in the library and haven't seen anyone from Qionghua Sect actually achieve immortality...

original_text: 慕容紫英：书库？典籍？
translation: Murong Ziying: Library? Ancient texts?

original_text: 韩菱纱：没、没有啦……我是说，我们什么时候动身去找那三样东西？
translation: Han Lingsha: N-no... I mean, when are we going to set off to find those three things?

original_text: 云天河：当然是马上就去！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Of course, we'll go right away!

original_text: 柳梦璃：那，要从哪一样开始找呢？
translation: Liu Mengli: So, which one should we look for first?

original_text: 慕容紫英：既然都不简单，任何一样也没有差别了，不如就<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>先从光纪寒图开始找吧</colour><dc0>。</dc0>
translation: Murong Ziying: Since none are simple, any one is as good as another.<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> Let's start by searching for the Guangji Cold Map first</colour><dc0>.</dc0>

original_text: 韩菱纱：好啊，去<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>即墨</colour><dc0>，我可以带路，我认识～就在</dc0><colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>东北方、靠海的边上</colour><dc0>。</dc0>
translation: Han Lingsha: Alright, let's go to<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> Jimo</colour><dc0>. I can lead the way, I know it-it's right</dc0><colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> to the northeast, by the sea</colour><dc0>.</dc0>

original_text: 慕容紫英：青阳、重光二位长老，弟子慕容紫英求见！
translation: Murong Ziying: Elders Qingyang and Chongguang, disciple Murong Ziying requests an audience!

original_text: 青阳：已找齐了三件至阴至寒之物？
translation: Qingyang: Have you gathered all three items of extreme yin and cold?

original_text: 慕容紫英：……不错，弟子等已将三样东西交给师叔，他似乎也已破冰而出。
translation: Murong Ziying: ... Good, we have already handed the three items to Martial Uncle, and it seems he has broken free from the ice.

original_text: 青阳：唔……如此甚好、如此甚好啊！
translation: Qingyang: Hmm... Very good, very good indeed!

original_text: 重光：今日来此，可是玄霄还有他事相求？
translation: Chongguang: Coming here today, does Xuanxiao have another request?

original_text: 云天河：长老！我想问你们，我爹和我娘当初真的是带着望舒剑逃走？才会害了大哥、不，害了玄霄，害他被冰封？！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Elders! I want to ask you, did my father and mother really escape with Wangshu Sword back then? Is that why they harmed Big Brother-no, harmed Xuanxiao, got him sealed in ice?!

original_text: 青阳：这些话，你从哪里听来的？！
translation: Qingyang: Where did you hear these words?!

original_text: 云天河：是掌门告诉我的……
translation: Yun Tianhe: The Sect Leader told me...

original_text: 重光：岂有此理！夙瑶竟如此不知轻重！
translation: Chongguang: Outrageous! Suyao is so reckless!

original_text: 云天河：长老……这都是真的吗？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Elders... is all this true?

original_text: 青阳：……唉，孩子，你知道了又能如何呢？当年之事千头万绪，无论其中因果如何，你爹和你娘确实带走了望舒剑，此举令琼华派升仙功亏一篑，那些弟子的死伤也变得毫无价值啊……
translation: Qingyang: ... Sigh, child, what can you do even if you know? The events of that year are tangled and complex. Regardless of cause and effect, your father and mother indeed took Wangshu Sword. This act caused Qionghua Sect's ascension to fail, rendering those disciples' deaths and injuries meaningless...

original_text: 青阳：最悲惨之人，莫过于玄霄，他内息失调终致走火入魔，不得不被冰封……
translation: Qingyang: The most tragic person is undoubtedly Xuanxiao. His internal energy became disordered, leading to demonic madness, and he had to be sealed in ice...

original_text: 云天河：这么说来，真的是我爹娘害了他……
translation: Yun Tianhe: So it really was my father and mother who harmed him...

original_text: 重光：世事因果自有天意，十九年后，若不是你帮忙，玄霄又怎能破冰？
translation: Chongguang: The cause and effect of worldly affairs follow heaven's will. Nineteen years later, if not for your help, how could Xuanxiao break the ice?

original_text: 韩菱纱：……但是，就算掌门和玄霄想取回望舒剑，也不该骗我们啊！为什么不光明正大说出来呢？！
translation: Han Lingsha: ... But even if the Sect Leader and Xuanxiao wanted to retrieve Wangshu Sword, they shouldn't have deceived us! Why not say it openly?!

original_text: 慕容紫英：菱纱！
translation: Murong Ziying: Lingsha!

original_text: 青阳：…………夙瑶嘛，她的资质原本也算得上出类拔萃，奈何老掌门的其他几位弟子更是万中选一之人……
translation: Qingyang: ............ Suyao, her aptitude was originally considered outstanding, but the old Sect Leader's other disciples were truly one in a million...

original_text: 青阳：夙瑶虽十分刻苦，但若不是大弟子玄震死于十九年前的大战，夙玉、云天青出逃，而玄霄又被冰封，无论如何也轮不到她继任掌门之位。
translation: Qingyang: Though Suyao is very diligent, if the oldest disciple Xuanzhen hadn't died in the great battle nineteen years ago, Suyu and Yun Tianqing hadn't fled, and Xuanxiao hadn't been frozen, she would never have become Sect Leader.

original_text: 青阳：所以……她难免患得患失，任何事情都想思虑周全，她这么做，也有不得已的原因啊……
translation: Qingyang: So... she inevitably worries about gains and losses, wanting to consider everything thoroughly. She acts this way, there are unavoidable reasons for it...

original_text: 韩菱纱：有什么不得已的原因——
translation: Han Lingsha: What unavoidable reasons-

original_text: 重光：够了！当年之事不必再多纠缠，许多事情也不会再有改变。你们若是没有其他事，便请回。
translation: Chongguang: Enough! No need to dwell on the past; many things cannot be changed. If you have no other business, please leave.

original_text: 韩菱纱：可是……
translation: Han Lingsha: But...

original_text: 慕容紫英：长老且慢，我们尚有一事相求，如今妖界又临——
translation: Murong Ziying: Elders, wait. We still have one request. Now that the Yao Realm is approaching again-

original_text: 青阳：哦？掌门若要报十九年前之仇，应是准备多时了，不必我二人再出手了吧……
translation: Qingyang: Oh? If the Sect Leader seeks revenge for nineteen years ago, she must have prepared long ago. No need for us two to intervene anymore...

original_text: 重光：不错，冰封玄霄，我与青阳心存愧疚，至于其他事，则不会理会。
translation: Chongguang: Correct. Regarding sealing Xuanxiao in ice, Qingyang and I feel remorse. As for other matters, we will not interfere.

original_text: 慕容紫英：二位长老误会了，弟子所言，或许匪夷所思，却又千真万确……弟子有个朋友，不，弟子的师侄柳梦璃，她穿过妖界入口的结界，就此失去了踪影……
translation: Murong Ziying: Elders, you misunderstand. What I say may sound unbelievable, but it is absolutely true... I have a friend-no, my junior Martial Niece Liu Mengli-she passed through the barrier at the yao realm entrance and vanished without a trace...

original_text: 青阳：嗯？！且把当时情形细细说来！
translation: Qingyang: Huh?! Tell me the situation at that time in detail!

original_text: 慕容紫英：便让天河来说吧，是他亲眼所见……
translation: Murong Ziying: Let Tianhe tell it, he saw it with his own eyes...

original_text: 青阳：奇怪……如此说来，人是不能穿过那结界的，柳梦璃却又毫发无伤，莫非……她是妖？
translation: Qingyang: Strange... If that's the case, humans cannot pass through that barrier. Yet Liu Mengli emerged unscathed. Could it be... she is a yao?

original_text: 重光：不可能。她的灵力虽比常人高出许多，但若真是妖物，又怎能瞒过你我之眼？
translation: Chongguang: Impossible. Though her spiritual power is much higher than ordinary people's, if she were truly a yao, how could she deceive our eyes?

original_text: 青阳：如此就更奇了……
translation: Qingyang: That makes it even stranger...

original_text: 慕容紫英：……看来二位长老也不知究竟是怎么一回事，我们多有打扰了……
translation: Murong Ziying: ... It seems the two elders also don't know exactly what happened. We've disturbed you...

original_text: 云天河：等等！长老，你们有没有办法让人穿过那个结界？要是梦璃一直不出来，我们就追进去找她！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Wait! Elders, do you have a way for us to pass through that barrier? If Mengli doesn't come out, we'll chase in after her!

original_text: 云天河：琼华派说不定很快就要和妖界打起来了，她一直待在那里，不是很危险？！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Qionghua Sect might soon fight the yao realm. If she stays there, isn't it very dangerous?!

original_text: 重光：荒谬！人入妖界，岂不是如同羊入虎口？！
translation: Chongguang: Preposterous! Humans entering the yao realm is like sheep entering a tiger's den?!

original_text: 慕容紫英：长老，弟子知道这想法乃是异想天开，但弟子也一同请求，若是二位有此办法，请一定告诉我们！
translation: Murong Ziying: Elders, this disciple knows this idea is far-fetched, but I also join in requesting: if you two have such a method, please tell us!

original_text: 韩菱纱：对！就算再难也要试一试！
translation: Han Lingsha: Yes! Even if it's difficult, we must try!

original_text: 青阳：……你们，真的不怕？妖界可不是儿戏之地，人若闯入，说不定顷刻便会身首异处。
translation: Qingyang: ... You all, truly unafraid? The yao realm is no place for games. If humans intrude, they might lose their heads in an instant.

original_text: 慕容紫英：长老，您这么说就是有办法了？！
translation: Murong Ziying: Elder, does that mean you have a way?!

original_text: 青阳：……唉……这世上有种叫“翳影枝”的东西，用它就可以穿过大部分的结界，妖界的结界或许也可以……
translation: Qingyang: ... Sigh... There's a thing called Shadowveil Sprig in this world. It can pass through most barriers, perhaps even the yao realm's...

original_text: 韩菱纱：真的吗？那个翳影枝要去哪里才能弄到呢？
translation: Han Lingsha: Really? Where can we get that Shadowveil Sprig?

original_text: 青阳：翳影枝为鬼界之物，因为鬼卒几乎要去世间所有地方勾魂，自然也必须穿越某些结界，这翳影枝便由厉害的鬼卒随身携带。
translation: Qingyang: The Shadowveil Sprig is an object from the ghost realm. Since ghost guards must go almost everywhere in the world to collect souls, they naturally must pass through certain barriers. This Shadowveil Sprig is carried by powerful ghost guards.

original_text: 韩菱纱：那我们就得找鬼卒抢过来啰？
translation: Han Lingsha: So we have to snatch it from the ghost guards?

original_text: 青阳：不可能、不可能。先不说寻常人能否遇到鬼卒，有些鬼卒也比你们厉害不知多少倍，岂是轻易能够得手？
translation: Qingyang: Impossible, impossible. Forget whether ordinary people can even encounter ghost guards-some are far stronger than you. How could you easily succeed?

original_text: 韩菱纱：这可怎么办？
translation: Han Lingsha: What should we do?

original_text: 青阳：……若是真的想要翳影枝，就只能去鬼界一闯。
translation: Qingyang: ... If you truly want the Shadowveil Sprig, you'll have to venture into the Ghost Realm.

original_text: 云天河：鬼界？是什么地方？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Ghost Realm? What kind of place?

original_text: 青阳：就是人们所说的阴间，群鬼聚集之地。翳影枝源于鬼界，到那里去找，自然能够找到。
translation: Qingyang: It's what people call the Netherworld, where ghosts gather. The Shadowveil Sprig originates from the Ghost Realm. Going there to search is natural.

original_text: 慕容紫英：可是自古阴阳相隔，生人想要进去阴间，必定是困难重重吧？
translation: Murong Ziying: But since ancient times, the realms of yin and yang have been separate. For the living to enter the Netherworld must be extremely difficult, right?

original_text: 青阳：天地既有六界，则六界之间必有往来，从人界入鬼界的方法亦不在少数，最简单的一种，便是由凡间的鬼城酆都所进入，不过进的却是鬼界外围，你们若想取翳影枝，须得去无常殿，那就只有到不周山看看了。
translation: Qingyang: Since heaven and earth have six realms, there must be travel between them. There are also many ways to enter the Ghost Realm from the Human Realm. The simplest one is to enter from the mortal world's ghost city, Fengdu, but that only leads to the outskirts of the Ghost Realm. If you wish to obtain the Shadowveil Sprig, you must go to Impermanence Hall. For that, you'll have to look at Mount Buzhou.

original_text: 慕容紫英：不周山？可是传说在大荒之中、支撑天地的那座山？
translation: Murong Ziying: Mount Buzhou? The legendary mountain in the Great Wasteland that supports heaven and earth?

original_text: 青阳：不错，相传那里有进入幽冥之国、即是鬼界的入口，但究竟要如何开启，我也并不知晓。
translation: Qingyang: Correct. Legend has it that there is an entrance to the Netherworld, that is, the Ghost Realm, but exactly how to open it, I do not know either.

original_text: 云天河：不管怎么样，都要去试试看！
translation: Yun Tianhe: No matter what, we have to go and try!

original_text: 慕容紫英：我与你自然能去一试，但菱纱近来身体欠佳，还是不要去了……
translation: Murong Ziying: You and I can certainly give it a try, but Lingsha hasn't been well lately, better not go...

original_text: 韩菱纱：我没关系的，不过就是有点累，睡一觉醒来什么都好了！
translation: Han Lingsha: I'm fine, just a bit tired. I'll sleep it off and wake up completely better!

original_text: 青阳：……我见这位姑娘确实气色不佳，最近……可是时常体虚畏寒？
translation: Qingyang: ... I see this young lady indeed looks unwell. Recently... have you often felt physically weak and afraid of cold?

original_text: 韩菱纱：对啊，长老你怎么知道？
translation: Han Lingsha: Right, Elder, how did you know?

original_text: 青阳：重光，我看……不如你将“红魄”送给这位姑娘吧？
translation: Qingyang: Chongguang, I think... why don't you give the Red Soul Jade to this young lady?

original_text: 重光：为何？
translation: Chongguang: Why?

original_text: 青阳：唉，你我留着那样东西，又哪里还有什么用处，不如送给她吧，就当是……
translation: Qingyang: Sigh, what use do we have keeping such a thing? Better give it to her, consider it as...

original_text: 重光：不必多说。
translation: Chongguang: No need to say more.

original_text: 韩菱纱：哇！这么盛的红光，还让人觉得暖暖的，这到底是什么好宝贝？
translation: Han Lingsha: Wow! Such a brilliant red light, and it feels so warm too. What kind of amazing treasure is this?

original_text: 青阳：此乃红魄，是世间极难寻到的一种暖玉，当初羲和剑也有一部分是以此铸造。你将它配在胸口，体虚之象会好很多。
translation: Qingyang: This is Red Soul Jade, an extremely rare warm jade. Part of Xihe Sword was forged from it. Wear it over your chest, and your weak constitution will improve greatly.

original_text: 韩菱纱：谢谢长老，你们真是好人！
translation: Han Lingsha: Thank you, elders, you're truly good people!

original_text: 慕容紫英：多谢二位长老指点，弟子等这就去寻访不周山了。
translation: Murong Ziying: Thank you both for your guidance, elders. We will now go search for Mount Buzhou.

original_text: 青阳：……去吧，若真的无法可施，也不必勉强。
translation: Qingyang: ... Go ahead. If there truly is no solution, don't force it.

original_text: 重光：何必多管闲事？你让他们去不周山，岂不是凶多吉少？
translation: Chongguang: Why meddle in others' affairs? Sending them to Mount Buzhou is likely more perilous than safe.

original_text: 青阳：就算我不说出那个办法，他们也不可能轻言放弃，只会自己乱闯，更加凶险。
translation: Qingyang: Even if I don't reveal that method, they won't give up easily. They'll just charge recklessly, making it even more dangerous.

original_text: 重光：这么多年来，你还是老样子，对后辈总存拂照之念……当初捉拿云天青和夙玉时，若不是你心软，又怎会让他二人逃脱？造成今日局面？
translation: Chongguang: All these years, you're still the same, always protective of the younger generation... Back when capturing Yun Tianqing and Suyu, if you hadn't been soft-hearted, how could they have escaped? Leading to today's situation?

original_text: 青阳：说我心软，你又何尝不是？不然你为何要传授那小姑娘心法，又为何愿意将红魄给她？
translation: Qingyang: You say I'm soft-hearted, but aren't you the same? Otherwise, why teach that girl the mental technique, and why give her the Red Soul Jade?

original_text: 重光：……罢了，论口舌我向来不如你，但我心中明白，如今活于世上，我早已算不上一个好人，甚至连人都算不上，我们为赎罪而活，但是否又不断在犯下新的罪……
translation: Chongguang: ... Enough. I've never been as eloquent as you, but I know in my heart that living in this world, I can no longer be called a good man-not even a real man. We live to atone, yet we keep committing new sins...

original_text: 云天河：紫英，那个不周山，你知道在哪里吗？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Ziying, that Mount Buzhou, do you know where it is?

original_text: 慕容紫英：我也只是听师公说起过大致所在，他曾去<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>不周山</colour><dc0>寻找铸剑之材，总之我们先</dc0><colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>御剑往北方飞</colour><dc0>，应该能找到的。</dc0>
translation: Murong Ziying: I've only heard my grandmaster mention its approximate location; he once went to<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> Mount Buzhou</colour><dc0> to search for sword-forging materials. In any case, let's first</dc0><colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> fly by sword northward</colour><dc0>, we should be able to find it.</dc0>

original_text: 云天河：嗯……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Mm...

original_text: 韩菱纱：天河，你别心事重重的，事情总要一件件慢慢解决，烦恼再多也没用。你爹娘和玄霄就算有什么恩恩怨怨，但你毕竟帮过他，以后总有机会见面说清楚……
translation: Han Lingsha: Tianhe, don't be so burdened with worries. Things must be resolved one by one, slowly. Having more worries is useless. Even if there were any grudges between your parents and Xuanxiao, you did help him after all. There will always be a chance to meet and clarify things in the future...

original_text: 韩菱纱：现在先想方法找梦璃，急的事先解决，你说对不对呢～
translation: Han Lingsha: Let's focus on finding Mengli first. The urgent matter takes priority, don't you think so~

original_text: 云天河：知道了……<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>我们马上去不周山！</colour>
translation: Yun Tianhe: Got it...<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>Let's head to Mount Buzhou right away!</colour>

original_text: 韩菱纱：呀——！那是……重光长老？！
translation: Han Lingsha: Yaa-! That's... Elder Chongguang?!

original_text: 慕容紫英：长老！重光长老！！
translation: Murong Ziying: Elder! Elder Chongguang!!

original_text: ？？：…………重光他已西去了……
translation: ??: .........Chongguang has already passed away...

original_text: 韩菱纱：你、你是……？！怎么会……？
translation: Han Lingsha: You... you are...?! How can it be...?

original_text: 慕容紫英：……青阳……长老？
translation: Murong Ziying: ... Qingyang... Elder?

original_text: 青阳：不必惊惶，不过是功力尽散，看来垂老矣矣罢了。
translation: Qingyang: No need to panic. It's merely that my cultivation has dissipated, leaving me appearing aged and feeble.

original_text: 慕容紫英：长老……到底、到底发生了什么事？为什么会这样？！
translation: Murong Ziying: Elder... what exactly happened? Why is it like this?!

original_text: 青阳：……玄霄才离开不久……咳、咳咳——
translation: Qingyang: Xuanxiao just left not long ago... cough, cough--

original_text: 云天河：玄霄！他！他来这里干什么？！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Xuanxiao! He! What did he do?!

original_text: 青阳：……紫英，你先将重光送去屋里吧，不能让他尸骨曝于此地。
translation: Qingyang: ... Ziying, please take Chongguang into the house first. We can't leave his remains exposed here.

original_text: 慕容紫英：是，弟子遵命……
translation: Murong Ziying: Yes, this disciple obeys...

original_text: 慕容紫英：长老，是玄霄……杀了……重光长老？！
translation: Murong Ziying: Elder, was it Xuanxiao... who killed... Elder Chongguang?!

original_text: 青阳：他来此，是为寻一本宗炼留下的手记。
translation: Qingyang: He came here to look for a journal left by Zonglian.

original_text: 慕容紫英：师公的手记？！
translation: Murong Ziying: Grandmaster's journal?!

original_text: 青阳：不错，宗炼生前留下的数本手记，都记载着铸剑、养剑之秘术，如今大部分藏于琼华派五灵剑阁之中……
translation: Qingyang: Yes. Several journals left by Zonglian record secrets of sword forging and nurturing. Most are now in Qionghua Sect's Five Elements Sword Pavilion...

original_text: 青阳：但其中有一本，却是连掌门都未曾得见……
translation: Qingyang: But among them, there is one that even the Sect Leader has never seen...

original_text: 青阳：……咳咳……
translation: Qingyang: ...Cough cough...

original_text: 慕容紫英：长老！
translation: Murong Ziying: Elder!

original_text: 青阳：……无碍。且听我讲完。
translation: Qingyang: ...It's fine. Let me finish.

original_text: 慕容紫英：是……
translation: Murong Ziying: Yes...

original_text: 青阳：宗炼如琼华派历代执剑长老那样，为铸剑耗费一生心血，尤以羲和、望舒双剑为甚。双剑穷吾派三代之力，至宗炼手中乃成，临当此世，再无一人比他更了解双剑种种。
translation: Qingyang: Like the successive sword-crafting elders of Qionghua Sect, Zonglian devoted his life's effort to forging swords, especially the dual swords Xihe and Wangshu. The dual swords consumed three generations of our sect's strength and were completed in Zonglian's hands. In this age, no one understands the intricacies of the dual swords better than he did.

original_text: 青阳：玄霄担心手记中有不利于双剑之记载，他如今正是飞升之前的紧要关头，何况多年修行，与羲和剑早已密不可分，自然不愿手记落在他人之手。
translation: Qingyang: Xuanxiao worries the journal contains records unfavorable to the dual swords. He's now at a critical juncture before ascension; moreover, after years of cultivation, he's long been inseparable from Xihe Sword, naturally unwilling for the journal to fall into others' hands.

original_text: 韩菱纱：那后来呢？后来怎样？！
translation: Han Lingsha: And then? What happened next?!

original_text: 青阳：……人生一世，经历多少风浪起伏，但我和重光做梦也料不到，十九年后重逢玄霄，他周身炽烈无比，眉宇间尽是狂态煞气……这是入邪之兆、入邪之兆……
translation: Qingyang: ... In a lifetime, one experiences many ups and downs, but Chongguang and I never dreamed that nineteen years later, upon reuniting with Xuanxiao, he would be surrounded by intense heat, his brow filled with madness and killing intent... This is a sign of falling into evil, a sign of falling into evil...

original_text: 青阳：我告诉玄霄，宗炼经历与妖界之战，早已万念俱灰，将手记毁去，他虽半信半疑，但也只得作罢。
translation: Qingyang: I told Xuanxiao that Zonglian, having experienced the war with the yao realm, was utterly disheartened long ago and destroyed his journal. Though half-believing, he had to let it go.

original_text: 慕容紫英：如此……重光长老又怎会……
translation: Murong Ziying: If so... how could Elder Chongguang...

original_text: 青阳：事不由人，就算玄霄已有去意，我和重光又怎能让他就此离开？
translation: Qingyang: Things don't always go as one wishes. Even if Xuanxiao already intends to leave, how could Chongguang and I just let him go like that?

original_text: 青阳：我二人劝他放弃飞升之计，他如今心魔深种，照此行事终会酿成大祸。但玄霄一意孤行，早已听不进去，重光便先行发难，欲强夺他手中羲和剑……
translation: Qingyang: We two advised him to abandon the ascension plan. Now deeply consumed by his inner demonic madness, proceeding this way will eventually cause great disaster. But Xuanxiao, stubbornly insisting, long stopped listening. Chongguang took the initiative to attack, trying to seize his Xihe Sword by force...

original_text: 慕容紫英：双剑缺一不可，重光长老想要以此阻止飞升？
translation: Murong Ziying: Both swords are indispensable. Does Elder Chongguang intend to use this to stop the ascension?

original_text: 青阳：不错……只是玄霄功力与十九年前不可同日而语，重光全力相拼也远不敌他……我欲助重光，运功过度，之后气息逆行经络、不可遏制，才会变得如此模样……
translation: Qingyang: Indeed... But Xuanxiao's power is far greater than nineteen years ago. Chongguang fought with all his might but was no match for him... I tried to assist Chongguang, overexerted myself, causing my qi to reverse in my meridians, which led to my current state...

original_text: 韩菱纱：长老……
translation: Han Lingsha: Elder...

original_text: 青阳：姑娘，你心中定然怪我和重光，早知望舒剑一事，却不肯说出……
translation: Qingyang: Young lady, you surely resent me and Chongguang, for knowing about Wangshu Sword matter yet refusing to speak of it...

original_text: 青阳：我二人不敢奢望你原谅……昔日相助玄霄，望他破冰之后修身养性，哪里料到会有今日之局……凝冰诀与三寒器之力终也抵不过他的欲望……
translation: Qingyang: We dare not ask for your forgiveness... In the past, we helped Xuanxiao, hoping that after breaking from ice, he would cultivate his character and nurture his nature. Who could have foreseen today's situation... The power of Cryomancy and Three Cold Artifacts ultimately could not withstand his desires...

original_text: 云天河：……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ...

original_text: 青阳：如今说什么都已太迟，我与重光一错再错……虽不愿承认，但恐怕琼华派数代苦心，终将付诸流水，羲和、望舒双剑再如何冠绝天下，亦是镜花水月，一场虚空……
translation: Qingyang: It's too late for words now. Chongguang and I erred repeatedly... Though loath to admit it, Qionghua Sect's generations of effort may come to naught. No matter how peerless Xihe and Wangshu swords, they're but a mirage, an empty dream...

original_text: 慕容紫英：……长老何出此言？
translation: Murong Ziying: ... Elder, why say such a thing?

original_text: 青阳：飞升成仙，虽是凡人所向，但成与不成，皆看天意。
translation: Qingyang: Ascending to immortality, though desired by mortals, success or failure depends on heaven's will.

original_text: 青阳：合玄霄、夙瑶之力，或能令双剑成为剑柱，然而即便琼华派升起，接近昆仑山上天光所在处，玄霄如此心魔深种，如何能脱去肉体凡胎、成为仙身？
translation: Qingyang: Combining Xuanxiao and Suyao's power might enable the dual swords to become sword pillars. However, even if the Qionghua Sect ascends and approaches Kunlun Radiance Site atop the mountain, with Xuanxiao so deeply consumed by his inner demonic madness, how can he shed his mortal flesh and become an immortal?

original_text: 慕容紫英：神农之言……善心身合成仙，私念难成仙身……
translation: Murong Ziying: Shennong's words... A good heart, makes a body to become immortal; selfish thoughts hinder the immortal form...

original_text: 韩菱纱： （唉……梭罗树仙……）
translation: Han Lingsha: (Sigh... the Suoluo Tree Immortals...)

original_text: 青阳：如今只怕反成了逆天而行，后果不堪设想……
translation: Qingyang: Now I fear it has become defying heaven, the consequences are unimaginable...

original_text: 云天河：意思是说，玄霄……他会死？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Meaning, Xuanxiao... he will die?

original_text: 青阳：死……或是堕入邪道、永不超生。
translation: Qingyang: Death... or falling into evil, never to be redeemed.
Yun Tianhe: ...!!

original_text: 慕容紫英：长老，难道就没有其他办法阻止琼华派飞升吗？弟子等前来，也正是为了此事！
translation: Murong Ziying: Elder, is there truly no other way to stop Qionghua Sect's ascension? We disciples came precisely for this matter!

original_text: 青阳：办法……那唯一的一线希望，却要问一问云天河了。
translation: Qingyang: Other ways... that one slender hope, but we must ask Yun Tianhe about it.

original_text: 云天河：问我……？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Ask me...?

original_text: 青阳：天青生前，可曾交付给你一本手记？
translation: Qingyang: Before Tianqing passed, did he give you a journal?

original_text: 云天河：……爹是留了些书给我，可他什么也没交代……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... Father left me some books, but he never said anything about them...

original_text: 青阳：唉，你再想想吧，那些书中或许就有宗炼的手记——
translation: Qingyang: Sigh, think about it again. Those books might contain Zonglian's journal.

original_text: 慕容紫英：长老，弟子不明……师公的手记，怎会在云前辈那里……
translation: Murong Ziying: Elder, this disciple doesn't understand... how did Grandmaster's journal end up with Senior Yun...

original_text: 青阳：……当年我率众弟子捉拿逃出门派的天青与夙玉，几次交手，却总因一时心软，放他们离去……
translation: Qingyang: ... Back when I led the disciples to capture Tianqing and Suyu who fled the sect, we clashed several times, but I always let them go in a moment of soft-heartedness...

original_text: 青阳：事后想来，心中悔恨交织，若是将夙玉带回门派中，玄霄万万不会走火入魔，亦不会落到被冰封禁地的下场……
translation: Qingyang: Looking back afterward, my heart is filled with regret and remorse. If I had brought Suyu back to the sect, Xuanxiao would never have fallen into demonic madness, nor would he have ended up sealed in ice at the Forbidden Area...

original_text: 青阳：……与重光隐居之后，我不时下山探访，想要找回夙玉。
translation: Qingyang: ... After going into seclusion with Chongguang, I would occasionally go down the mountain to search, hoping to find Suyu.

original_text: 青阳：然而辗转数年，当我在青鸾峰寻到天青时，夙玉却已过世了，那一刻，我自觉想救玄霄已是无望……天下之大，要去何处找一个与夙玉命格体质相合的女子，更毋论令其修习仙术，调合玄霄的阳炎之力……
translation: Qingyang: However, after several years of searching, when I found Tianqing at Qingluan Peak, Suyu had already passed away. At that moment, I felt all hope of saving Xuanxiao was lost... In this vast world, where could one find a woman whose fate and constitution matched Suyu's, let alone have her cultivate immortal arts to balance Xuanxiao's blazing yang power...

original_text: 云天河：……爹，就是那个时候知道了玄霄被冰封……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... Father... that's when he found out Xuanxiao had been sealed in ice...

original_text: 青阳：天青他得知玄霄被囚，心中亦是痛苦不堪，而当时他体内的寒冰之气已不可遏制，命不久矣……我又如何责怪于他？
translation: Qingyang: When Tianqing learned Xuanxiao was imprisoned, he too was in agony. By then, the icy energy within him was uncontrollable, and he hadn't long to live... How could I blame him?

original_text: 青阳：或许……我与重光、宗炼已隐约生念，造就双剑、和妖界之争，是否步步皆错……所以宗炼才会半生都在找寻一种方法，如何在宿主力量失控时，阻止他们继续使用双剑……
translation: Qingyang: Perhaps... Chongguang, Zonglian, and I have vaguely begun to wonder whether forging the dual swords and the war with the yao realm were mistakes at every step... That's why Zonglian spent rest of his life searching for a way to stop the hosts from continuing to use the dual swords if their power went out of control...

original_text: 慕容紫英：……！师公……那个办法，他老人家找到了吗？！
translation: Murong Ziying: ...! Grandmaster... Did he find that method?!

original_text: 青阳：他离世前并未再提，只将关于双剑的手记托付于我，叮嘱万万不可轻易示人，而我不愿琼华派任何人再得到这本手记，遂将其交付给了天青……
translation: Qingyang: Before he passed, he didn't mention it again, only entrusted me with the journal on the dual swords, urging they must never be shown to others lightly. Unwilling for anyone in Qionghua Sect to obtain this journal again, I handed it over to Tianqing...

original_text: 慕容紫英：长老的意思是，若能寻到师公的手记，其中或有记载阻止琼华派飞升之法？
translation: Murong Ziying: Elder means, if we can find Grandmaster's journal, there might be a method recorded within to stop Qionghua Sect's ascension?

original_text: 青阳：……或许……有此一线希望！
translation: Qingyang: ...maybe just maybe... there might be one slender hope!

original_text: 云天河：可是……爹根本没提过什么手记啊……我们要不要回青鸾峰找找？
translation: Yun Tianhe: But... Father never mentioned any journal... Should we go back to Qingluan Peak to look for it?

original_text: 青阳：……我恳求诸位，若是寻到办法，定要阻止玄霄和夙瑶。一是为韩姑娘的性命，我和重光大错铸成，悔之已晚……
translation: Qingyang: ... I beg you all, if you find a way, you must stop Xuanxiao and Suyao. First, for Miss Han's life-Chongguang and I made a grave mistake, and it's too late for regrets...

original_text: 韩菱纱：青阳长老……
translation: Han Lingsha: Elder Qingyang...

original_text: 青阳：二是为了琼华派门人的安危，逆天而行、人不胜天……尤其是玄霄，他如魔附身，心智早已不受控制，亦是身不由己，十九年前无法救他，十九年后竟还要见他入邪疯魔……
translation: Qingyang: Second, for the safety of the Qionghua Sect disciples, defying heaven's will, man cannot overcome heaven... especially Xuanxiao. He is as if possessed by a demon, his mind long out of control, also helpless. Nineteen years ago, we couldn't save him; nineteen years later, we must still watch him descend into madness and evil...

original_text: 云天河：……身不由己……还能救他吗？他早已经不是当初的玄霄了……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... Helpless... Can he still be saved? He's no longer the Xuanxiao he once was...

original_text: 青阳：……不尽然，他的心中或许还存着一丝善念……
translation: Qingyang: ... Not entirely. Perhaps there is still a trace of goodness in his heart...

original_text: 云天河：真的？！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Really?!

original_text: 青阳：玄霄未取我性命，应是念了昔日的拂照之恩……
translation: Qingyang: Xuanxiao did not take my life, likely remembering the kindness I showed him in the past...

original_text: 云天河：这么说……他还有救？！还能变回以前的玄霄……？
translation: Yun Tianhe: So... he can still be saved?! Can Xuanxiao return to be his old nature...?

original_text: 慕容紫英：长老，弟子尚有一事未明……纵然师叔已经走火入魔，掌门却仍是神智清明，琼华派飞升，凶吉未卜，掌门难道不会就此罢手？
translation: Murong Ziying: Elder, this disciple still has one thing unclear... Even if Martial Uncle has fallen into demonic madness, the Sect Leader remains clear-headed. The ascension of Qionghua Sect is uncertain in outcome. Wouldn't the Sect Leader stop now?

original_text: 青阳：……夙瑶素来好强，自是要倾尽全力，达成吾派数代以来的宏愿，她身在局中，怎能轻易放下执念？何况玄霄也不可能让她罢手……
translation: Qingyang: ... Suyao has always been strong-willed, naturally giving her all to achieve our sect's grand aspiration over generations. She is in the thick of it-how can she easily let go of her obsession? Besides, Xuanxiao wouldn't let her stop...

original_text: 青阳：且夙瑶并非望舒之主，勉力施为，定要玄霄相助才能使用望舒剑，又不得不臣服于他……如今整个门派，怕是系于玄霄一念之间……
translation: Qingyang: Moreover, Suyao isn't the host of Wangshu Sword; to force its use, she requires Xuanxiao's help, thus having to submit to him... Now, the whole sect likely hangs on a whim of Xuanxiao...

original_text: 慕容紫英：…………
translation: Murong Ziying: ......

original_text: 青阳：你们去吧，以寻到手记为先……
translation: Qingyang: You go ahead; finding the journal is the priority...

original_text: 青阳：玄霄、夙瑶升仙之前不欲受扰，已在琼华派外做成结界，任何人都不能靠近，结界撤去之时，便是剑柱大成之日！
translation: Qingyang: Xuanxiao and Suyao, not wishing to be disturbed before ascending, have created a barrier outside Qionghua Sect. No one can approach; when the barrier lifts, the sword pillars will be complete!

original_text: 慕容紫英：时间刻不容缓，弟子等这便赶去青鸾峰了……
translation: Murong Ziying: Time is of the essence, we disciples will head to Qingluan Peak immediately...

original_text: 青阳：去吧……我功力已散，阳寿将尽，只求在此静伴老友片刻……
translation: Qingyang: Go ahead... My power is gone, my life is ending. I just wish to stay quietly with my old friend a while...

original_text: 韩菱纱：……青阳长老……留他一个人在这里，真的不要紧吗？
translation: Han Lingsha: ... Elder Qingyang... Is it really alright to leave him alone here?

original_text: 慕容紫英：一切就按长老吩咐的去做吧。
translation: Murong Ziying: Everything shall be done as the elder instructed.

original_text: 韩菱纱：……他和重光长老，都是可怜的人……十九年来没有一点安心，现在……现在又…………
translation: Han Lingsha: ... He and Elder Chongguang are both pitiful people... For nineteen years, they've had no peace, and now... now again...

original_text: 慕容紫英：已经发生的事，不能再改变……但若是我们能阻止师叔，对两位长老，甚至是对师公来说，定然是莫大的欣慰……
translation: Murong Ziying: What has happened cannot be changed... But if we can stop Martial Uncle, that would bring great comfort to the two elders, and even to Grandmaster...

original_text: 云天河：对，至少还有那本手记在。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Right, at least we still have that journal.

original_text: 云天河：菱纱，只要能救你，还有……让玄霄变回以前的玄霄……哪怕是一点点希望，我们都要去试！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Lingsha, as long as we can save you, and... turn Xuanxiao back into his old self... even if there's just one slender hope, we have to try!

original_text: 慕容紫英：不错，师公一生铸剑无数，技艺之精湛、所知之广博，非我能望其项背，他的手记中一定写有十分重要的东西。
translation: Murong Ziying: Indeed, Grandmaster forged countless swords in his lifetime. His exquisite skill and vast knowledge are beyond my reach. His journal must contain something very important.

original_text: 韩菱纱：嗯……
translation: Han Lingsha: Hmm...

original_text: 云天河：…………呃，我……有件事…………
translation: Yun Tianhe: ...... Uh, I... I have something to say...

original_text: 韩菱纱：什么？
translation: Han Lingsha: What?

original_text: 云天河：我想起……爹的书……我烤肉时生火图方便……都……都烧得差不多了…………
translation: Yun Tianhe: I remember... Father's books... I used them to start fires for convenience when roasting meat... all... almost all burned up...
Murong Ziying: .........
Han Lingsha: ...... ...

original_text: 韩菱纱：你！你这傻瓜！大傻瓜！那种东西也能随便乱烧吗？！
translation: Han Lingsha: You! You fool! Big fool! How could you just burn something like that randomly?!

original_text: 云天河：话是这么说没错，但是……那个时候，我又不知道它很重要……
translation: Yun Tianhe: That's true, but... Back then, I didn't know it was important...

original_text: 韩菱纱：还敢说！真要被你气死！可恶可恶可恶！
translation: Han Lingsha: How dare you say that! I'm really angry! Damn it, damn it, damn it!

original_text: 云天河：……对、对不起……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... S-sorry...

original_text: 慕容紫英：天河既然没什么印象，是不是真的烧了，也未可知，总之<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>先去青鸾峰看看再说</colour><dc0>。</dc0>
translation: Murong Ziying: Since Tianhe has no real memory of it, whether it was truly burned or not remains unknown. In any case,<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> let's first go to Qingluan Peak to check</colour><dc0>.</dc0>

original_text: 云天河：对对对！看看再说、看看再说……说不定还在呢……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Yes, yes! Let's check first... maybe it's still there...

original_text: 韩菱纱：…………哼，走啦，猪头……真拿你没办法……
translation: Han Lingsha: ......Hmph, let's go, dummy... I really can't do anything with you...

original_text: 云天河：屋子里没人，还是不要进去为好。
translation: Yun Tianhe: No one's in the house, better not go in.

original_text: 云天河：还是不要进去为好。
translation: Yun Tianhe: It's better not to go in.

original_text: 1.去狐仙居
translation: 1. Go to Fox Immortal's Abode

original_text: 2.御剑飞行
translation: 2. Sword Flight

original_text: 3.什么都不做
translation: 3. Do Nothing

original_text: 准备<colour red=255 green=102 blue=0 alpha=255>去狐仙居</colour><dc0>还是</dc0><colour red=255 green=102 blue=0 alpha=255>御剑飞行</colour><dc0>？</dc0>
translation: Proceed to?

original_text: 1.御剑飞行
translation: 1. Sword Flight

original_text: 2.什么都不做
translation: 2. Do Nothing

original_text: 准备<colour red=255 green=102 blue=0 alpha=255>御剑飞行</colour><dc0>吗？</dc0>
translation: Ready to <colour red=255 green=102 blue=0 alpha=255>use Sword Flight</colour><dc0>?</dc0>

original_text: 韩菱纱：哇～张灯结彩的，好像有什么庆典！
translation: Han Lingsha: Wow~ Decorated with lanterns and streamers, seems like there's some celebration!

original_text: 云天河：让我想起了粽子！哪里、在哪里？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Reminds me of zongzi! Where, where is it?
Han Lingsha: ......

original_text: 云天河：你，听过有个叫光纪寒图的东西吗？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Have you heard of something called the Guangji Cold Map?

original_text: 青年甲：哎呀，别和我说话了，我得赶去狐仙庙，要是不快点把贡品送过去，可不晓得会出什么事！
translation: Youth A: Ah, don't talk to me, I must hurry to the Fox Immortal Temple. If I don't deliver the tribute quickly, who knows what might happen!

original_text: 青年乙：对，要是误了时辰，惹得狐仙不高兴就惨了……
translation: Youth B: Yeah, if we miss the appointed time and anger the fox immortal, it'll be terrible...

original_text: 夏元辰：你们！你们有谁看见我女儿莲宝了？！
translation: Xia Yuanchen: You! Has anyone seen my daughter Lianbao?!

original_text: 青年甲：我说夏书生，你自己的女儿当然要自己顾好，丢了怎么还来问我们？
translation: Youth A: I say, Scholar Xia, your own daughter should be taken care of by yourself. How can you come ask us after losing her?

original_text: 夏元辰：刚刚、刚刚她还跟在我身边，一晃眼就不见了……
translation: Xia Yuanchen: Just now, just now she was still by my side, and in a blink she was gone...

original_text: 屠夫张：不急，俺帮你一起找找！
translation: Butcher Zhang: No rush, I'll help you look!

original_text: 青年乙：……今天可是即墨要办庆典的大日子，所有人都要给狐仙贺寿，为什么偏偏这个时候……
translation: Youth B: ... Today is Jimo's big celebration day. Everyone is supposed to congratulate the fox immortal. Why now of all times...

original_text: 青年乙：要是惹恼了狐仙，我们全部人都得遭殃……
translation: Youth B: If we anger the fox immortal, all of us will suffer...

original_text: 夏元辰：狐仙……说不定、说不定就是他把莲宝带走了！
translation: Xia Yuanchen: The fox immortal... maybe, maybe he's the one who took Lianbao away!

original_text: 屠夫张：啥？！你说小莲宝是被狐仙……那、那俺可能帮不了你了……
translation: Butcher Zhang: What?! You say Little Lianbao was taken by the fox immortal... Then, then I probably can't help you...

original_text: 青年乙：……夏书生啊，狐仙大寿你是不是没诚心庆贺？不然这倒霉的事，怎会落在你头上……
translation: Youth B: ... Scholar Xia, did you not sincerely celebrate the Fox Immortal's grand birthday? Otherwise, how could such misfortune fall upon you...

original_text: 老者：元辰，莲宝她真是被狐仙带走了？
translation: Elder: Yuanchen, was Lianbao really taken by the fox immortal?

original_text: 夏元辰：我……我不知道、我只是猜的……
translation: Xia Yuanchen: I... I don't know, I was just guessing...

original_text: 夏元辰：莲宝她向来很乖，不会随便乱跑……
translation: Xia Yuanchen: Lianbao is always well-behaved, she wouldn't run off randomly...

original_text: 老者：……你说是，那就是了……你好像总能感应到什么，大多时候也都灵验了，大伙儿都是靠你才躲过了不少祸事啊……
translation: Elder: ...If you say so, then it is... You always sense something, and it often comes true. We've avoided many disasters thanks to you...

original_text: 老者：可是这回……你让大伙儿怎么帮忙……
translation: Elder: But this time... how can everyone help...

original_text: 屠夫张：……
translation: Butcher Zhang: ...

original_text: 青年乙：……
translation: Youth B: ...

original_text: 夏元辰：你们别为难，我自己去把莲宝找回来！
translation: Xia Yuanchen: Don't trouble yourselves, I'll go find Lianbao myself!
Elder: Sigh............

original_text: 韩菱纱：……狐仙带走那个书生的女儿，已经够怪了，难道是抢亲？其他人也不帮他找，更是怪上加怪……
translation: Han Lingsha: ... The fox immortal taking the scholar's daughter is strange enough-could it be a forced marriage? That others aren't helping him search is even stranger...

original_text: 柳梦璃：你们看那个人，急得脸都惨白了……我想帮他一起找找看……
translation: Liu Mengli: Look at that person, so anxious his face has turned pale... I want to help him search...

original_text: 慕容紫英：理应如此！
translation: Murong Ziying: As it should be!

original_text: 慕容紫英：这位公子——
translation: Murong Ziying: This young master-

original_text: 夏元辰：你们是……？
translation: Xia Yuanchen: You are...?

original_text: 柳梦璃：我们有事探访，初来乍到，恰巧见到你……你的女儿走失了，不知能帮上什么忙？
translation: Liu Mengli: We are here on a visit, newcomers to this place, and happened to see you... your daughter is missing. We wonder if we can be of any help?

original_text: 慕容紫英：我等乃是昆仑琼华派的弟子，略通剑术，有什么事请尽管开口！
translation: Murong Ziying: We are disciples of the Kunlun Qionghua Sect, somewhat skilled in swordsmanship. Please speak freely if you need anything!

original_text: 夏元辰：竟是修道之人！这太好了！
translation: Xia Yuanchen: Cultivators! That's wonderful!

original_text: 夏元辰：我女儿莲宝十有八九是被隐香山的狐仙带走了，诸位若是愿意，请随我去救救她，<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>隐香山就在狐仙庙的东北</colour><dc0>！</dc0>
translation: Xia Yuanchen: My daughter, Lianbao, is most likely taken by the fox immortal of Mount Yinxiang. If you're willing, please come with me to save her,<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> Mount Yinxiang is northeast of the fox immortal Temple</colour><dc0>!</dc0>

original_text: 韩菱纱：可是，那个狐仙为什么要抓走你女儿呢？狐仙不是应该佑护一方的吗？
translation: Han Lingsha: But, why would that fox immortal take your daughter? Aren't fox immortals supposed to protect the area?

original_text: 夏元辰：这……恐怕一言难尽，眼下我只想快点找到莲宝，看她安然无恙！
translation: Xia Yuanchen: This... I'm afraid it's a long story. Right now, I just want to find Lianbao quickly and see she's safe and sound!

original_text: 柳梦璃：不用多说了，一切等找到你的女儿，再说也不迟。
translation: Liu Mengli: No need to say more. Everything can wait until we find your daughter.

original_text: 夏元辰：谢谢，大恩大德，夏元辰铭记在心！
translation: Xia Yuanchen: Thank you, this great kindness, Xia Yuanchen will remember it!

original_text: 韩菱纱：怎么了……他们那种眼神，不会又像上回在太平村一样吧……
translation: Han Lingsha: What's wrong... That look in their eyes, it won't be like last time in Taiping Village again, will it...

original_text: 云天河：呃……我、我什么也没做……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Uh...I, I didn't do anything...

original_text: 青年甲：你们真的把狐仙打跑了？！
translation: Youth A: You really drove away the fox immortal?!

original_text: 云天河：是、是啊……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Y-yes...

original_text: 青年乙：恩公！！
translation: Youth B: Benefactor!!

original_text: 云天河：啊？！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Huh?!

original_text: 老者：恩公你有所不知，那狐仙强迫我们每年供奉他，却只会做些阴损的事……
translation: Elder: Benefactor, you don't know. That fox immortal forces us to make offerings to him every year, yet he only does sinister, harmful things...

original_text: 老者：向他祈祷风平浪静，他就让海上风浪大起，向他祈祷风调雨顺，他就带来大旱……我们、我们都是苦不堪言呐……
translation: Elder: Pray to him for calm seas, and he stirs up storms; pray for favorable weather, and he brings drought... We... we all suffer unbearably...

original_text: 屠夫张：俺们几个正要上山帮忙找小莲宝，没想到夏书生带着小莲宝回来啦，还说你们打跑了狐仙，俺真不敢相信自己的耳朵！一定要再来问问才能放心！
translation: Butcher Zhang: We were just about to go up the mountain to help look for Little Lianbao, and then Scholar Xia came back with her! He said you drove away the fox immortal. I couldn't believe my ears! I just had to come and ask again to be sure!

original_text: 韩菱纱：咦？你们打算上山？可你们不是很怕那只臭狐狸吗？
translation: Han Lingsha: Huh? You plan to go up the mountain? But aren't you afraid of that stinky fox?

original_text: 屠夫张：……俺、俺们当然还是怕，但是想来想去，总觉得心里不踏实，做人不能只顾自己啊……
translation: Butcher Zhang: ... W-we're still scared, of course, but after thinking it over, we just feel uneasy. One can't just think of oneself...

original_text: 屠夫张：所以俺们也只有豁出去了！总好过一辈子心里都有个疙瘩。
translation: Butcher Zhang: So we have no choice but to go all out! Better than having a knot in our hearts forever.

original_text: 韩菱纱：你们……？
translation: Han Lingsha: You...?

original_text: 青年乙：是啊，再说……夏书生帮过我们不少忙，要是不管他，不就变忘恩负义了……
translation: Youth B: Yes, and besides... Scholar Xia has helped us a lot. If we ignore him, wouldn't that be ungrateful...

original_text: 青年甲：我、我是怕死狐仙了，去隐香山惊扰大仙，这事我平时连想都不敢想，但我更不愿意被人骂不讲义气！
translation: Youth A: I... I'm terrified of the fox immortal. Disturbing the great immortal on Yinxiang Mountain-I usually dare not even think about it. But I don't want to be called a disloyal friend!

original_text: 屠夫张：对对对！俺是没读过啥书，但也明白做人要讲义气，俺还喊上了邻居王家和孙家的人，他们也打算上山去咧！不过，哪晓得你们已经把狐仙打跑了，呵呵……
translation: Butcher Zhang: Right, right! I haven't read many books, but I understand that one must be loyal to friends. I even called the neighbors, the Wang and Sun families, and they also planned to go up the mountain! But who knew you had already driven the fox immortal away, hehe...

original_text: 韩菱纱：嘻嘻，没关系，能有这份心，已经很了不起了，也不枉夏书生那样帮你们。
translation: Han Lingsha: Hehe, it's fine. Having that intention is already admirable, worthy of Scholar Xia's help.

original_text: 青年乙：……那狐仙……他还会再回来吗？
translation: Youth B: ... That fox immortal... will he come back again?

original_text: 慕容紫英：各位安心，他元气大伤，应会收敛许多。
translation: Murong Ziying: Everyone, rest assured. His vitality is severely damaged, he should restrain himself greatly.

original_text: 韩菱纱：我们还说了狠话吓那只臭狐狸，他现在一定怕死了，哈～
translation: Han Lingsha: We even said harsh words to scare that stinky fox; he must be terrified now, ha~

original_text: 青年乙：真、真的吗？！亲耳听到这话，我就放心了！
translation: Youth B: R-really?! Hearing this with my own ears, I can rest assured!

original_text: 青年乙：这天大的好事，大伙儿快去告诉其他人！
translation: Youth B: This is tremendous news! Everyone, hurry and tell the others!

original_text: 青年甲：对对对，让所有人都知道！
translation: Youth A: Yes, yes! Let everyone know!

original_text: 老者：恩公，你们是即墨的大恩人，请一定要留下来，看看今晚的花灯啊！
translation: Elder: Benefactor, you are the great saviors of Jimo. Please stay and see lanterns tonight !

original_text: 韩菱纱：老伯，我们一定去～我最喜欢漂亮的花灯了！
translation: Han Lingsha: Old man, we'll definitely go~ I love beautiful lanterns the most!

original_text: 老者：好、好好～
translation: Elder: Great, Great, Great~

original_text: 云天河：呵呵，这，就是爹说过的行侠仗义吗？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Hehe, this, is this what Father called upholding justice?

original_text: 韩菱纱：是哦～和某些人在太平村的遭遇也差太多了～～
translation: Han Lingsha: That's right~ It's a world of difference from what happened to someone in Taiping Village~~

original_text: 云天河：这样的，比较好～
translation: Yun Tianhe: This way is better~

original_text: 韩菱纱：废话，有谁喜欢被人又打又骂的……
translation: Han Lingsha: Obviously, who likes being beaten and scolded...

original_text: 慕容紫英：唉，妖害人不稀奇，料不到连仙也会为祸一方，今日所见，实在令人心惊。
translation: Murong Ziying: Alas, yaoguais harming humans is no surprise, but who would have thought even an immortal could bring calamity? What we witnessed today is truly shocking.

original_text: 柳梦璃：<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>……我们快些去夏家吧，</colour><dc0>不然天可要黑了。</dc0>
translation: Liu Mengli:<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> ...Let's hurry to the Xia residence,</colour><dc0>otherwise it'll be dark soon.</dc0>

original_text: 夏元辰：你们来了？
translation: Xia Yuanchen: You've come.

original_text: 韩菱纱：夏书生，我该收回在山上讲的话啰！
translation: Han Lingsha: Scholar Xia, I should take back what I said on the mountain!

original_text: 韩菱纱：那些人还是很不错的嘛，有心去找你和小莲宝～
translation: Han Lingsha: Those people are pretty decent, going out of their way to look for you and little Lianbao~

original_text: 夏元辰：是啊，我早说过，无论如何都不会怪他们。
translation: Xia Yuanchen: Yes, I said long ago, no matter what, I wouldn't blame them.

original_text: 韩菱纱：哎，同样是仙，你和臭狐狸对人的态度也差太多了。
translation: Han Lingsha: Sigh, both being immortals, your attitude towards humans is so different from that stinky fox's.

original_text: 夏元辰：……因为，我很喜欢人，才会愿意隐瞒身份，在人间过上百年、千年……六界之中，虽以神、魔最强，但天上寂寥千载、瑶宫寒苦，又怎及得上人与人相依的暖意。
translation: Xia Yuanchen: ...Because I truly like humans, I was willing to conceal my identity and live among them for hundreds, thousands of years... Among the Six Realms, though gods and demons are the strongest, the millennia of solitude in the heavens, the bitter cold of the jade palaces-how could they compare to the warmth of people relying on each other.

original_text: 慕容紫英：……
translation: Murong Ziying: ...

original_text: 韩菱纱：……山神，是不是就可以长生不老呢？凡人到底要怎样，才能活得更久一点？
translation: Han Lingsha: ...Mountain Gods, can they live forever? How can mortals live longer?

original_text: 夏元辰：仙的寿命虽然动辄千年，却依然会有走到尽头的一天，凡人由生到死不过百年，自然会羡慕仙人，但是比起蜉蝣蝼蚁，人又何尝不是寿命长久？
translation: Xia Yuanchen: Although an immortal's lifespan can easily span millennia, there still comes an end. Mortals live only a hundred years from birth to death, naturally envying immortals. But compared to mayflies and ants, aren't humans also long-lived?

original_text: 夏元辰：阳寿天定，强弱自分，这原本就是所谓的“天道”啊，为何要去打破它？
translation: Xia Yuanchen: Lifespan is decreed by heaven, strength and weakness are naturally divided. This is the so-called 'Way of Heaven'. Why try to break it?

original_text: 韩菱纱：可是……
translation: Han Lingsha: But...

original_text: 夏元辰：好了，不说这些了，以几位资质，修道定然有成，说不定假以时日会与我一样位列仙班呢。
translation: Xia Yuanchen: Enough of this. With your talents, cultivation will surely succeed. Given time, you might join the immortal ranks like me.

original_text: 夏元辰：你们，<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>随我去楼上吧</colour><dc0>。</dc0>
translation: Xia Yuanchen: You, <colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>come with me upstairs</colour><dc0>.</dc0>

original_text: 韩菱纱：……
translation: Han Lingsha: ...

original_text: 柳梦璃：菱纱，别心急，你村里的人……你担心的那件事，一定会有办法的。
translation: Liu Mengli: Lingsha, don't worry. The people in your village... the thing you're worried about, there will surely be a way.

original_text: 云天河：对，可能你问他，他刚好不知道……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Right, maybe you asked him, and he just didn't know...

original_text: 韩菱纱：没什么啦，你们俩不用担心，我才没那么容易放弃！
translation: Han Lingsha: It's nothing, you two don't worry, I don't give up that easily!

original_text: 慕容紫英：村里人？……到底何事？
translation: Murong Ziying: People in your village?... What exactly is the matter?

original_text: 韩菱纱：……别问，好吗？
translation: Han Lingsha: ... Don't ask, okay?

original_text: 韩菱纱：其实连天河、梦璃也不是很清楚，不过总有一天我会全告诉你们的，但不是现在……
translation: Han Lingsha: Actually, even Tianhe and Mengli don't know clearly, but one day I'll tell you everything, just not now...

original_text: 慕容紫英：……我知道了，若是有能帮上忙的，你一定要说出来。
translation: Murong Ziying: ...I understand. If there's anything I can help with, you must speak up.

original_text: 韩菱纱：好，一定。
translation: Han Lingsha: Okay, definitely.

original_text: 夏元辰：你们来看，这便是光纪寒图。
translation: Xia Yuanchen: Come look, this is the Guangji Cold Map.

original_text: 夏元辰：相传此乃冬神遗落人间之物，我也是偶然得到。
translation: Xia Yuanchen: Legend says this is something the Winter God left behind in the mortal realm, I obtained it by chance.

original_text: 韩菱纱：闪闪的、好漂亮！一看就是了不起的宝贝！
translation: Han Lingsha: Sparkling, so pretty! Looks like an amazing treasure at first glance!

original_text: 夏元辰：看来，女孩子都差不多，静兰也最喜欢这个呢。
translation: Xia Yuanchen: It seems girls are all similar, Jinglan liked this the most too.

original_text: 韩菱纱：静兰？
translation: Han Lingsha: Jinglan?

original_text: 夏元辰：啊、她、她是我的恋人。
translation: Xia Yuanchen: Ah, she, she's my lover.

original_text: 韩菱纱：嘻，你脸红了～她一定是个很好的人吧？
translation: Han Lingsha: Hehe, you're blushing~ She must be a very good person, right?

original_text: 夏元辰：静兰她又温柔又漂亮……
translation: Xia Yuanchen: Jinglan was so gentle and beautiful...

original_text: 夏元辰：以前，我住在即墨附近的山里，每到夜晚，我就把光纪寒图展开，置于山巅，看起来犹如星尘下凡一般，那是静兰最喜欢的光景。
translation: Xia Yuanchen: Before, I lived in the mountains near Jimo. Every night, I would unfold the Guangji Cold Map and place it on the mountain peak. It looked like stardust descending to earth. That was Jinglan's favorite sight.

original_text: 柳梦璃：那她现在在哪儿？没有和你住一起吗？
translation: Liu Mengli: You said 'was'. Then where is she now? Does she not live with you?

original_text: 夏元辰：她？她已经过世几百年了……
translation: Xia Yuanchen: She? She has passed away hundreds of years ago...
Liu Mengli: ...!!

original_text: 夏元辰：……说不定都投胎转世、几度轮回，我是地仙，而她只是一介凡人，人仙殊途啊……
translation: Xia Yuanchen: ...They've probably all been reincarnated, gone through several cycles. I'm an earth immortal, and she was just a human. Humans and immortals are different paths...

original_text: 柳梦璃：对不起……让你想起伤心事……
translation: Liu Mengli: Sorry... for making you recall sad memories...

original_text: 夏元辰：不必介意。至少那一世我和静兰相守到老，我一直陪着她，看着她归于尘土。
translation: Xia Yuanchen: Don't worry about it. At least in that lifetime, I stayed with Jinglan until old age, accompanying her all the way until she returned to dust.

original_text: 夏元辰：世间多少有情人磨难重重，终究有缘无份，我和静兰已足够幸福，又怎敢再有更多奢求？
translation: Xia Yuanchen: So many lovers in this world face countless hardships, ultimately fated to be apart. Jinglan and I have been fortunate enough; how could we dare ask for more?

original_text: 云天河：呵呵，对啊，只要这辈子过得开心就好，其他许多事想也没用～
translation: Yun Tianhe: Hehe, right, as long as you're happy in this life, there's no use worrying about many other things~

original_text: 夏元辰：小兄弟倒是豁达得很～
translation: Xia Yuanchen: This little man is quite open-minded~

original_text: 夏元辰：来，这光纪寒图你们收好。
translation: Xia Yuanchen: Here, take this Guangji Cold Map.

original_text: 莲宝：爹爹……星星、莲宝喜欢……
translation: Lianbao: Daddy...Stars, Lianbao likes...

original_text: 夏元辰：莲宝，你也喜欢光纪寒图吗？
translation: Xia Yuanchen: Lianbao, do you like the Guangji Cold Map too?

original_text: 夏元辰：可这些哥哥姐姐是我们的恩人，爹爹一定要报答他们，莲宝听话好不好？
translation: Xia Yuanchen: But these big brothers and sisters are our benefactors. Daddy must repay them. Be good, Lianbao, okay?

original_text: 夏元辰：乖孩子～
translation: Xia Yuanchen: Good girl~

original_text: 慕容紫英：……抱歉，君子不夺人所好，实是事出有因——
translation: Murong Ziying: ... My apologies. A gentleman does not take what others cherish, but circumstances compel us-

original_text: 夏元辰：没关系，光纪寒图留在我身边并无用处，倒不如赠给急需之人。
translation: Xia Yuanchen: It's okay. Keeping the Guangji Cold Map with me is useless. Better to give it to someone who needs it urgently.

original_text: 慕容紫英：多谢！
translation: Murong Ziying: Thank you!

original_text: 慕容紫英：……！
translation: Murong Ziying: ...!

original_text: 夏元辰：啊！我倒忘了，光纪寒图性属阴冷，寻常人碰触恐有不适，入手便有天寒地冻之感……
translation: Xia Yuanchen: Ah! I forgot. The Guangji Cold Map is of a cold, yin nature. Ordinary people touching it might feel discomfort, experiencing a freezing sensation upon contact...

original_text: 韩菱纱：那怎么办？是不是要找东西把它包起来再拿？
translation: Han Lingsha: Then what do we do? Do we need to find something to wrap it in before taking it?

original_text: 韩菱纱：呀——！好冰……
translation: Han Lingsha: Yaa-! So cold...

original_text: 夏元辰：姑娘切莫动手，女子体寒，更不可执拿此物，待我想想如何是好……
translation: Xia Yuanchen: Miss, please don't touch it! Women have cold constitutions and must not handle this. Let me think what to do...

original_text: 云天河：还好……不会冷啊。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Works for me... not that cold.

original_text: 夏元辰：小兄弟你……！
translation: Xia Yuanchen: Young man, you...!

original_text: 夏元辰：难道……竟不会觉得寒气渗骨？！
translation: Xia Yuanchen: Could it be... you don't even feel the bone-chilling cold?!

original_text: 云天河：还好吧……摸上去是比其他东西要凉一点，不过也就是一点点。
translation: Yun Tianhe: It's okay... feels a bit cooler than other things to the touch, but just a little bit.

original_text: 夏元辰：……这、这可太好了！
translation: Xia Yuanchen: ...This, this is wonderful!

original_text: 夏元辰：我虽不知为何，这位小兄弟天赋异禀，居然不畏寒气，但光纪寒图可以由他拿着，就不成问题了。
translation: Xia Yuanchen: I don't know why, but this young man has a remarkable talent-he's actually unaffected by the cold. As long as he can hold the Guangji Cold Map, it won't be a problem.

original_text: 云天河：是吗？呵呵～
translation: Yun Tianhe: Really? Hehe~

original_text: 韩菱纱：（……少得意，真不晓得你到底吃什么长大的，连这么冷都受得了……）
translation: Han Lingsha: (...Don't get cocky. I really don't know what you were raised on, to even withstand such cold...)

original_text: 夏元辰：我看这位小兄弟似乎擅使弓箭，这把“开元追月弓”不如一并送给你吧。
translation: Xia Yuanchen: I see this young man seems skilled with a bow. This 'Kaiyuan Moon Bow' might as well be given to you.

original_text: 云天河：啊？这么好的弓，送给我？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Huh? Such a good bow, you give it to me?

original_text: 夏元辰：无妨，我不懂使弓，赠给小兄弟，也算是为它找到真正的主人。
translation: Xia Yuanchen: It's fine. I don't know how to use a bow. Giving it to you, young man, is like finding its true owner.

original_text: 云天河：哈、哈哈！谢谢！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Ha, haha! Thank you!

original_text: 慕容紫英：……感激不尽，既然此间事了，我们便告辞了。
translation: Murong Ziying: ... We are deeply grateful. Since matters here are settled, we shall take our leave.

original_text: 夏元辰：保重，今日一别，不知何时有缘再见了。
translation: Xia Yuanchen: Take care. Parting today, who knows when fate will bring us together again.

original_text: 韩菱纱：夏书生，你告诉其他人了吗？你要离开即墨的事……
translation: Han Lingsha: Scholar Xia, have you told the others? About you leaving Jimo...

original_text: 夏元辰：待会儿我想带莲宝<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>去夜市看花灯</colour><dc0>，到时候再说吧，还真是有点舍不得……</dc0>
translation: Xia Yuanchen: Later, I plan to take Lianbao<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> to the night market to see the lanterns.</colour><dc0> We can talk then. I really am a bit reluctant...</dc0>

original_text: 韩菱纱：舍不得就再回来看看大家嘛，等莲宝变成大姑娘，把他们都吓一跳！
translation: Han Lingsha: If you miss it, just come back and visit everyone. Wait until Lianbao grows up and surprises them all!

original_text: 夏元辰：哈哈，到时候我还是老样子，一点没变，才真的让人吓一跳。
translation: Xia Yuanchen: Haha, by then I'll still look the same, unchanged, that would really give people a scare.

original_text: 韩菱纱：嘻～那倒也是。
translation: Han Lingsha: Heh~that's true too.

original_text: 男孩：大哥哥、大姐姐～这些东西送给你们！
translation: Boy: Big brother, big sister~ these things are for you!

original_text: 韩菱纱：咦？你们是谁家的小孩？干嘛要送东西给我们啊？
translation: Han Lingsha: Huh? Whose children are you? Why are you giving us things?

original_text: 少年：我听祝爷爷说了，你们是打跑狐仙的大英雄！
translation: Youth: I heard from Grandpa Zhu, you're the great heroes who chased away the fox immortal!

original_text: 少年：这些东西本来都是给狐仙的供品，现在通通送给你们～
translation: Youth: These were originally offerings to the fox immortal, now I give them all to you~

original_text: 柳梦璃：我们不缺这些，你们还是自己留下吧。
translation: Liu Mengli: We don't lack these, you should keep them for yourselves.

original_text: 韩菱纱：小朋友～狐仙跑了，是因为他自己做坏事遭报应，不用特地来谢我们。
translation: Han Lingsha: Little one~ The fox immortal ran away because his own misdeeds caught up with him, no need to specially thank us.

original_text: 少年：不、不行，祝爷爷说一定要知恩图报，不然不算男子汉！
translation: Youth: N-no, Grandpa Zhu said we must repay kindness, or we're not real men!

original_text: 少年：小海，我、我们走。
translation: Youth: Xiao Hai, come on, let's go.

original_text: 男孩：大哥哥、大姐姐，等我长大以后，也要做像你们这样的英雄！帮很多很多的人！
translation: Boy: Big brother, big sister, when I grow up, I want to be a hero like you! Help lots and lots of people!

original_text: 云天河：呵呵，有鱼～能烤来吃哦～
translation: Yun Tianhe: Hehe, there are fish~ can roast them to eat~

original_text: 云天河：谢谢你们～～
translation: Yun Tianhe: Thank you~~

original_text: 韩菱纱：呆子！人家一番心意，你居然只注意到鱼……
translation: Han Lingsha: You dummy! They was pouring hearts out, and all you noticed was the fish...

original_text: 柳梦璃：你们看～那些花灯，是不是就是白天说的——
translation: Liu Mengli: Look~ those lanterns, aren't they the ones mentioned during the day-

original_text: 云天河：……我的心里，头一次有这样暖暖的感觉，像是什么东西在跳动一样。
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... For the first time in my heart, I feel this warm sensation, like something is beating inside.

original_text: 云天河：原来……让别人开心，自己也能这么开心啊～
translation: Yun Tianhe: So... Making others happy can make oneself this happy too~

original_text: 慕容紫英：为侠者一生所求，除魔卫道，可不正是为了此情此景、为了这些人脸上的笑容？
translation: Murong Ziying: All that a chivalrous soul seeks in life-to vanquish demons and uphold the Dao-isn't that precisely for this very sight, for the smiles on these people's faces?

original_text: 云天河：嗯，你说的对，紫英！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Mm, you're right, Ziying!

original_text: 慕容紫英：你不叫我“师叔”了？
translation: Murong Ziying: You're not calling me 'Martial Uncle' anymore?

original_text: 云天河：哈，忘了——
translation: Yun Tianhe: Ha, I forgot-

original_text: 慕容紫英：无妨。
translation: Murong Ziying: It's fine.

original_text: 慕容紫英：云天河，我以前或许错看了你，只当你是个任性妄为之人，如今看来，你和菱纱、还有梦璃，却当真有副侠义心肠，抛却辈份之别，让我说不出的敬重！
translation: Murong Ziying: Yun Tianhe, I may have misjudged you before, thinking you were merely someone who acts willfully and recklessly. But now I see that you, Lingsha, and Mengli truly have chivalrous hearts. Setting aside the differences in our seniority, I feel a respect for you that I cannot put into words.

original_text: 韩菱纱：嘻～看来即墨的花灯庆典真不得了，连冰块脸都被融化了。
translation: Han Lingsha: Hehe~ Looks like Jimo's lantern festival is really something-even the ice-face is melting.

original_text: 云天河：菱纱，别这么说，我觉得紫英并不是——
translation: Yun Tianhe: Lingsha, don't say that, I don't think Ziying is-

original_text: 韩菱纱：我开玩笑呢，当什么真！
translation: Han Lingsha: I was joking, don't take it seriously!

original_text: 韩菱纱：好了，说正经的，今天真是好高兴，我但愿我们四个人，一生一世都有这样的机会聚在一起，做自己应做之事！
translation: Han Lingsha: Alright, serious talk: today was truly joyful. I hope the four of us can always have chances like this to gather and do what we ought to do, for a lifetime!

original_text: 云天河：哈哈，这有什么难的？一定可以！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Haha, what's so hard about that? Definitely possible!

original_text: 慕容紫英：希望如此。
translation: Murong Ziying: I hope so.

original_text: 柳梦璃：嗯，我也希望我们能永远在一起，永远都不分开。
translation: Liu Mengli: I too hope we can be together forever, never apart.

original_text: 韩菱纱：紫英你别皱眉头了，是不是担心妖界的事？我相信只要玄霄能破冰而出，我们不会输的！
translation: Han Lingsha: Ziying, don't frown. Worried about the yao realm? I believe if Xuanxiao can break free from the ice, we won't lose!

original_text: 云天河：对，<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>马上把光纪寒图给玄霄，</colour><dc0>他一定很开心，哈哈。</dc0>
translation: Yun Tianhe: Right,<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> let's give the Guangji Cold Map to Xuanxiao immediately,</colour><dc0>he'll be so happy, haha.</dc0>

original_text: 夏元辰：估计<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>晚上的庆典就要开始了</colour><dc0>，小兄弟不妨也去凑个热闹。</dc0>
translation: Xia Yuanchen: I reckon<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> the evening festival is about to begin</colour><dc0>. Young man, why not join in the fun as well?</dc0>

original_text: 莲宝：爹爹……
translation: Lianbao: Daddy...

original_text: 慕容紫英：你，为何要说谎？
translation: Murong Ziying: You, why did you lie?

original_text: 道臻：……何出此言？
translation: Daozhen: ...Why say that?

original_text: 慕容紫英：……听闻赤雪流珠丹乃蜀山至宝，非掌门不可动用，但蜀山如此大派，素来以斩妖除魔为己任，甚至以锁妖塔关押妖物，态度之强硬比琼华派有过之而无不及，掌门怎会将贵重的丹药用在一个半人半妖的孩子身上？
translation: Murong Ziying: ... I've heard that the Red-Snow Pearl Pill is a supreme treasure of the Shu Mountain Sect, usable only by the sect leader. But as a major sect, Shu Mountain has always taken slaying demons and yaoguais  as its duty, even imprisoning them in the Demon-Locking Tower. Their stance is even more rigid than Qionghua Sect's. Why would the sect leader use such a precious pill on a half-human, half-yao child?

original_text: 慕容紫英：何况你说到尊师禀报掌门、取得丹药时，似乎急于掩饰，未免太不自然。
translation: Murong Ziying: Moreover, when you mentioned your master reporting to the Sect Leader and obtaining the Pill, you seemed eager to cover up, which was rather unnatural.

original_text: 道臻：这只是你的猜测，并无实据。
translation: Daozhen: This is merely your speculation, with no solid evidence.

original_text: 慕容紫英：不错……但我越想越是心惊，若我所言不差，尊师和你便是私自取走了赤雪流珠丹，你们为了道闰，竟不惜铤而走险？！
translation: Murong Ziying: That's right... but the more I think about it, the more alarmed I become. If my assumption is correct, your master and you took the Red-Snow Pearl Pill without permission? For Daorun, you'd risk such danger?!

original_text: 道臻：…………盗取丹药乃是我一人所为，师父并不知情。
