translation: Daozhen: ............ Stealing the pill was my doing alone; Master knows nothing about it.

original_text: 慕容紫英：……！果然……你不愿道闰痛苦，所以假意怒斥，再将丹药给他，最后拂袖而去，他更不会起疑……
translation: Murong Ziying: ...! Indeed... You didn't want Daorun to suffer, so you pretended to scold him angrily, then gave him the pill, and finally left in a huff, so he wouldn't suspect anything...

original_text: 道臻：我并非假意，一念之差，我便会杀了那女妖，将道闰带回蜀山。
translation: Daozhen: I'm not being insincere. With one wrong thought, I would have killed that she-yao and brought Daorun back to Mount Shu.

original_text: 道臻：可是，这样做又有什么意义？道闰往后一生都不会再快乐了……
translation: Daozhen: But, what's the point of doing this? Daorun will never be happy again for the rest of his life...

original_text: 慕容紫英：在你心中，他一人之愿终究胜过了门规道义。
translation: Murong Ziying: In your heart, his personal wish ultimately outweighs the sect rules and righteousness.

original_text: 道臻：……道闰很小的时候，我们爹娘便枉死于妖物手中，后来我与他拜入蜀山门下，我发誓遵师门之命，斩妖除魔、守护黎民百姓。
translation: Daozhen: ...When Daorun was very young, our parents were unjustly killed by fiends. Later, he and I joined the Mount Shu sect. I vowed to follow our master's orders, slay demons and yaoguais, and protect the common people.

original_text: 道臻：……可是在更早以前……我也发过誓，要尽我所能照顾这个唯一的弟弟，让他一世幸福。我从未想过，有朝一日，要守住其中一个誓言，便要毁去另一个……
translation: Daozhen: ...But long before that... I also swore to do everything in my power to care for this only younger brother, to ensure his lifelong happiness. I never imagined that one day, to keep one oath, I would have to break another...

original_text: 道臻：如今尘埃落定，我心中反而平静下来，剩下的……便是回师门领罪。
translation: Daozhen: Now that the dust has settled, my heart is calm. What remains... is to return to the sect and accept punishment.

original_text: 慕容紫英：……盗取了蜀山至宝，会被如何定罪？
translation: Murong Ziying: ... For stealing the Shu Mountain treasure, what would the sentence be?

original_text: 道臻：既然大错已成，我听候发落，不作他想。
translation: Daozhen: Since the grave mistake is made, I await judgment without protest.

original_text: 道臻：此事请勿告诉道闰，若说起于私念，也是我的，而非他的，所有罪孽由我一人承担，与他无关。
translation: Daozhen: Please do not tell Daorun about this matter. If it stems from selfish motives, they are mine, not his. All the guilt shall be borne by me alone, and has nothing to do with him.

original_text: 韩菱纱：紫英，原来你在这里。
translation: Han Lingsha: Ziying, so you're here.

original_text: 慕容紫英：……道闰呢？
translation: Murong Ziying: ..., where's Daorun?

original_text: 韩菱纱：他……他和妻子打算去居巢国隐居，已经走了……
translation: Han Lingsha: He... he and his wife planned to seclude themselves in Juchao Kingdom, they've already left...

original_text: 韩菱纱：是我告诉他们可以去那里的……这一次我又帮了妖，你是不是不高兴了？……我知道你讨厌妖，可是——
translation: Han Lingsha: I told them they could go there... I helped yaoguais again-are you unhappy? ...I know you hate yaoguais, but-

original_text: 慕容紫英：不必再说了……
translation: Murong Ziying: No need to say more...

original_text: 韩菱纱：……紫英，你怎么了？神色好像怪怪的……刚才，我好像看见道臻从这儿离开，他和你说了什么吗？
translation: Han Lingsha: ... Ziying, what's wrong? You look strange... Just now, I thought I saw Daozhen leaving from here. What did he say to you?

original_text: 慕容紫英：没什么……他只说该办的事都已经办完了，要回蜀山复命。
translation: Murong Ziying: It's nothing... He only said the matters that needed handling were done, and he's returning to Shu Mountain to report.

original_text: 韩菱纱：哦，这样也好，我还以为……会闹到不可收拾的地步呢，幸好道臻他是真的很疼弟弟，他们的师父心肠也很好……
translation: Han Lingsha: Oh, that's good then. I thought... things might spiral out of control. Luckily, Daozhen truly cares for his brother, and their master is kind-hearted too...

original_text: 慕容紫英：…………
translation: Murong Ziying: ......

original_text: 徐威：看你们的样子，是外乡人吧？即墨背靠大山，面向大海，两边的路都不好走，外人不怎么来的。
translation: Xu Wei: Judging by your appearance, you're outsiders, right? Jimo is backed by mountains and faces the sea, both roads are tough, so outsiders rarely come.

original_text: 徐威：今天可是狐仙大寿的好日子！所有人都要去庙里给他老人家贺寿的！
translation: Xu Wei: Today is the Fox Immortal's grand birthday! Everyone must go to the temple to wish him a happy birthday!

original_text: 徐威：听夏元辰说你们把那狐仙狠狠教训了一顿？！这、这真是太好了！以后是不是都可以安心过日子了？！
translation: Xu Wei: I heard from Xia Yuanchen that you taught that fox immortal a hard lesson?! That's... that's wonderful! Can we finally live in peace from now on?!

original_text: 徐威：狐仙被赶跑后，就再也没回来生事，这都是你们的大恩大德啊～
translation: Xu Wei: After the fox immortal was driven away, it never came back to cause trouble. This is all thanks to your great kindness~

original_text: 殷大娘：狐三太爷可是真神仙～我特地准备了这些鲜果肥鸡给他做寿礼，不知道还合不合他的心意？
translation: Auntie Yin: Third Grand Lord Fox is a true immortal~ I specially prepared these fresh fruits and plump chickens as birthday gifts for him. I wonder if they'll suit his taste?

original_text: 殷大娘：哎呀！大侠，多亏了你！我们以后再也不用受那只狐狸的欺压了！
translation: Auntie Yin: Ah! Hero, thanks to you! We'll never have to suffer under that fox's oppression again!

original_text: 殷大娘：最近的日子好起来了，卖了这阵子晒的鱼干，就可以给儿子裁一件新衣裳。
translation: Auntie Yin: Life has gotten better lately. Selling the dried fish I've been sunning will let me make my son a new set of clothes.

original_text: 王进辉：我这儿最好的酒是醪酒，酒香浓郁，口味醇厚，传说春秋时齐国公朝拜崂山仙人～用的就是这酒。
translation: Wang Jinhui: The best wine I have here is Lao Jiu, rich in aroma and mellow in taste. Legend says during the Spring and Autumn period, the Duke of Qi used this wine to pay homage to the immortal of Mount Lao~.

original_text: 王进辉：今天是狐仙他老人家的寿辰，待会儿我得让娘子带几大坛醪酒送去狐仙庙，这事可不能忘了！
translation: Wang Jinhui: Today is the Fox Immortal's birthday. Later, I must have my wife bring several large jars of rice wine to the Fox Immortal Temple. This matter must not be forgotten!

original_text: 王进辉：托你们的福！酒窖里的陈年老酒再也不用供奉给那只狐狸啦！店里特别开了三坛十年陈的好酒庆贺，大侠们可要来两杯？
translation: Wang Jinhui: Thanks to you all! The aged wine in the cellar no longer has to be offered to that fox! The shop specially opened three jars of ten-year-old fine wine to celebrate. Would you heroes like a couple of cups?

original_text: 王进辉：那狐狸自从被打跑后，就再也没敢回来，真是太感激你了～
translation: Wang Jinhui: That fox hasn't dared come back since being driven off-thank you so much~

original_text: 马开：老赵，这次狐仙大寿，你供了什么啊？
translation: Ma Kai: Old Zhao, what did you offer for the Fox Immortal's birthday this time?

original_text: 赵大山：我？还不是花生、干果、蜜饯，还有狐仙最爱的醪酒！
translation: Zhao Dashan: Me? Just peanuts, dried fruits, preserved fruits, and the fermented wine the fox immortal loves most!

original_text: 马开：我说你怎么年年都供这些东西啊？我这回特地弄了一条十斤重的大黄鱼，还在鱼肚里塞上对虾、扇贝、蟹肉，包准讨他欢心！
translation: Ma Kai: I say, why do you offer the same things every year? This time I specially got a ten-pound large yellow croaker, stuffed its belly with prawns, scallops, and crab meat-guaranteed to please him!

original_text: 赵大山：我们凡人哪里猜得准狐仙的心思呐～还是安稳一些，既然往年的供品都没啥问题，那今年还是如此吧！
translation: Zhao Dashan: How can we mortals guess the fox immortal's mind? Better play it safe. Since past offerings were fine, let's do the same this year!

original_text: 马开：老赵，听说了没？那个神气活现的狐仙被几位奇人打得毫无还手之力，真是大快人心！
translation: Ma Kai: Old Zhao, heard? That arrogant Fox Immortal was beaten helplessly by some extraordinary people, so satisfying!

original_text: 赵大山：唉……救得了一时救不了一世啊～他们总不可能在这儿待一辈子吧？万一狐仙又回来，那可怎么办？
translation: Zhao Dashan: Sigh... We can save them for now, but not forever. They can't possibly stay here their whole lives, right? What if the Fox Immortal returns? What then?

original_text: 马开：老赵那人就是怕这怕那的，我早说狐仙不会再回来生事，可他偏偏不信！瞧，现在大伙儿不都过得好好的？
translation: Ma Kai: Old Zhao fears everything. I said the fox immortal won't return, but he wouldn't believe! See, everyone's fine now, right?

original_text: 赵大山：别人总说我做事瞻前顾后、怕这怕那，其实我只想安安稳稳过日子，所谓“小心驶得万年船”嘛。
translation: Zhao Dashan: People always say I'm overcautious and afraid of everything, but I just want to live a stable life. As the saying goes, 'Caution is the parent of safety'.

original_text: 赵大山：即墨最有名的东西就是花生、对虾和醪酒，不过每年县里最好的干果海产、酒馆里最好的酒，都得供奉给狐仙才是。
translation: Zhao Dashan: Jimo's most famous products are peanuts, prawns, and rice wine. But each year, the county's best dried goods, seafood, and winery wines must be offered to the Fox Immortal.

original_text: 赵大山：我总觉得现在高兴还太早了，那狐仙未必就不敢再生事端，还是少说点话，安安份份过日子吧……
translation: Zhao Dashan: I always feel it's too early to be happy now. That fox immortal might still dare to cause trouble. Better to talk less and live a peaceful life...

original_text: 赵大山：都过这么久了，狐仙竟然真的没回来！总算是天下太平啦～
translation: Zhao Dashan: It's been so long, and the fox immortal really hasn't returned! Peace has finally been restored~

original_text: 宋福：香糯甜润的八宝饭～快来买呀！这位小哥，可要来一个？像今天这么喜庆的日子，买个八宝饭回去，团团圆圆，多好呀！
translation: Song Fu: Fragrant, sticky, sweet Eight-Treasure Rice~ Come buy some! Young sir, care for one? On such a festive day like today, buying Eight-Treasure Rice means family reunion, how wonderful!

original_text: 宋福：宋师父做的糕点可是整个即墨出了名的！不但八宝饭做得好吃，像是糖煎藕、蜜枣包、江米面炸糕……个个色香味俱全！
translation: Song Fu: Master Song's pastries are famous throughout Jimo! Not only is his Eight-Treasure Rice delicious, but dishes like sugar-fried lotus root, honey date buns, and glutinous rice fried cakes... each is a feast for the senses!

original_text: 宋福：那只狐狸被打跑了！从此以后再也不用担心糕点会突然变石头了，哈哈！
translation: Song Fu: That fox was driven away! From now on, we don't have to worry about pastries suddenly turning into stones, haha!

original_text: 宋福：没有那臭狐狸生事，心情都爽朗不少，人人都说我面泛红光，一脸喜色，还以为我要成亲了，哈哈哈！
translation: Song Fu: Without that wretched fox causing trouble, my mood is much brighter. Everyone says I'm glowing with joy and look like I'm about to get married, hahaha!

original_text: 邹师父：最早的时候，即墨可没有狐仙庙，后来，为了让狐仙知道咱们是诚心拜他的，所以就为他建了座庙。
translation: Master Zou: In the earliest days, Jimo had no Fox Immortal Temple. Later, to show the fox immortal our sincere worship, we built a temple for him.

original_text: 邹师父：我那徒儿小时候总是笨手笨脚的，做事总比别人慢半拍，当时我就跟他说了，人笨不要紧，只要勤快些，不怕学不会！
translation: Master Zou: My apprentice was always clumsy as a child, always a step behind others. I told him then, it's okay to be slow; as long as you're diligent, you can learn anything!

original_text: 邹师父：狐三太爷平时常捉弄大家，这回总算被人教训了！哈哈哈！
translation: Master Zou: Third Grand Lord Fox always plays tricks on everyone-this time he finally got taught a lesson! Hahaha!

original_text: 邹师父：小毛那孩子前几日来找我打刀，说是要练武，虽然有志气是不错，但是就他那样瞎练，哪天才能学成啊？
translation: Master Zou: Little Mao came days ago asking me to forge a blade, saying he wants to train. Though ambition is good, with his haphazard practice, when will he ever master it?

original_text: 王大婶：秋兰！让你出来买糕点，送到狐仙庙！你怎么还在这儿？！是不是又在偷懒？！
translation: Aunt Wang: Qiulan! I told you to buy pastries and deliver them to the Fox Immortal Temple! Why are you still here?! Slacking off again?!

original_text: 秋兰：啊！婆婆……您、您只给了我一文钱，买几个白面馒头都不够，让我怎么——
translation: Qiulan: Ah! Granny... you, you only gave me one coin. That's not even enough for a few plain steamed buns. How can I-

original_text: 王大婶：好啊，过门没几天，别的不会，顶嘴的功夫倒是长进了，啊？！要是天黑之前还没把糕点供上，你就自己看着办吧！
translation: Aunt Wang: Well, haven't you learned a lot since marrying in? Not much else, but your backtalk skills have sure improved! If the pastries aren't offered before dark, you'll face the consequences!

original_text: 秋兰：……
translation: Qiulan: ...

original_text: 秋兰：婆婆让我到市集买糕点，但却只给了我一文钱，怎么买啊……
translation: Qiulan: Mother-in-law told me to buy pastries at the market, but she only gave me one coin... how can I buy anything...

original_text: 秋兰：我是从很远的地方嫁过来的，虽然这儿的隐香山不比太平村旁的黄山秀美，但这里东南临海，站在海边望过去，可比巢湖开阔得多，唯一不顺心的，就是婆婆她……
translation: Qiulan: I married here from afar. Though Mount Yinxiang isn't as beautiful as Mount Huang near Taiping Village, the southeast faces the sea. Gazing from the shore, it's far more open than Chao Lake. The only trouble is my mother-in-law...

original_text: 秋兰：狐仙被打跑了，大伙儿都很高兴，可我没买糕点，婆婆还是不高兴，我到底要怎么做才能讨婆婆喜欢呢？……
translation: Qiulan: The fox immortal was driven away, and everyone is happy, but I didn't buy pastries, so mother-in-law is still unhappy. What must I do to please her?...

original_text: 秋兰：娘托人给我捎来村里的茶叶，听说这茶只有县里的青天大老爷才喝得起，婆婆知道了，笑得嘴都合不拢，这好像是她唯一一次夸我了……
translation: Qiulan: Mother sent me some tea from the village. I heard only the county's upright magistrate can afford this tea. When Mother-in-law found out, she smiled so wide she couldn't close her mouth-seems like the only time she ever praised me...

original_text: 汤二娘：方正这人，小时候傻楞楞的，干什么都比别人慢一拍。现在做起事来倒也有模有样，不光打铁，他连木匠的活也会干呢！
translation: Tang Erniang: Fangzheng was a bit slow and dull as a child, always a step behind others in everything. Now he's quite capable in his work-not just blacksmithing, he even does carpentry!

original_text: 汤二娘：想起那时修建狐仙庙，全县的男人，能干活的都出了力，一木一石，都是大伙儿的汗水啊！
translation: Tang Erniang: Thinking back to when the Fox Immortal Temple was built, every able-bodied man in the county contributed. Every piece of wood and stone was soaked with everyone's sweat!

original_text: 汤二娘：狐三太爷不在了？那狐仙庙要来何用？依我看倒不如重新修一下，换尊观音娘娘进去，也好让大家求个吉利～
translation: Tang Erniang: The Third Grand Lord Fox is gone? Then what use is the Fox Immortal Temple? I think it'd be better to renovate it, put a statue of Guanyin inside, so everyone can pray for good fortune~

original_text: 汤二娘：菩萨保佑，千万别让那狐三太爷又回来欺压大伙儿……
translation: Tang Erniang: May the Bodhisattva protect us, please don't let that Lord Fox come back to bully everyone...

original_text: 桑碧荷：相公是海上打鱼的人，不过他喜欢扎花灯，每年给狐仙贺寿的时候，整个即墨的花灯，一大半是他扎的～
translation: Sang Bihe: My husband is a fisherman, but he loves making lanterns. Every year for the fox immortal's birthday celebration, more than half of Jimo's lanterns are made by him~

original_text: 桑碧荷：现在整个即墨，家家户户都挂着花灯，等到晚上点起来，那场面～可比上元节更热闹。
translation: Sang Bihe: Now every household in Jimo is hanging lanterns. When they're lit up at night, the scene will be even livelier than the Lantern Festival.

original_text: 桑碧荷：狐仙真的被教训了吗？上回，大半夜的我相公突然就被变到了隐香山的树林里，第二天早晨醒来，吓都吓死了，幸好没被野兽吃了……
translation: Sang Bihe: Was the fox immortal really taught a lesson? Last time, my husband was suddenly transported to the woods of Mount Yinxiang in the middle of the night. Waking up the next morning, he was scared to death-luckily no wild beasts ate him...

original_text: 桑碧荷：狐仙被赶跑了，大家的日子都好过了，明年若是还有灯会，一定比今年更热闹，欢迎你们再来～
translation: Sang Bihe: With the fox immortal driven away, everyone's days are better. If there's another lantern festival next year, it'll surely be livelier than this year. Welcome to visit again~

original_text: 霍全：我走南闯北几十年，去过的地方无数，还从来没见过哪个城镇，这样看重一只狐狸的……难不成它还真是法力无边的大仙？
translation: Huo Quan: I've traveled north and south for decades, been to countless places, and I've never seen any town value a fox so much... Could it really be an all-powerful immortal?

original_text: 霍全：这儿的醪酒香醇浓厚，实在是不可多得的佳酿，带回江南去卖一定能赚不少，嘿嘿！
translation: Huo Quan: The fermented wine here is rich and mellow, truly a rare fine brew. Taking it back to Jiangnan to sell would surely earn a lot, hehe!

original_text: 霍全：哈哈～我就说嘛，哪有仙人会被凡人打得一败涂地？那狐狸分明就是一只骗人的畜生！
translation: Huo Quan: Haha~ I told you! How could an immortal be utterly defeated by mortals? That fox was clearly a deceitful beast!

original_text: 霍全：上次带回去的醪酒一下子就卖空了，只可惜路途太遥远，我这一来一回，盘缠就花费不少，若能想办法要到酿酒的方子，那就最好～
translation: Huo Quan: The last batch of fermented wine I brought back sold out quickly. It's just too far; travel expenses cost a lot for this round trip. If I could get the brewing recipe, that'd be best~

original_text: 阿奉：客官，你们来得可真巧……今天正好是狐仙的寿辰，晚上有花灯可看，爱凑热闹的就出去瞧瞧吧。
translation: A Feng: Travelers, you've come at just the right time... Today happens to be the Fox Immortal's birthday. There will be lanterns to see tonight. If you like excitement, go out and take a look.

original_text: 阿奉：在我们即墨，一年当中也就只有狐仙的寿辰最热闹，为了给他老人家准备寿礼，很多人都攒了一整年的银钱，就等今天了。
translation: A Feng: In our Jimo, the only really lively time of the year is the Fox Immortal's birthday. To prepare gifts for the old immortal, many people save up money all year, just waiting for today.

original_text: 阿奉：狐仙跑了？！哈哈哈哈！他跑大家才高兴啊！总比以前强颜欢笑强多了！
translation: A Feng: The fox immortal ran away?! Hahahaha! Everyone is happy he ran! Much better than forcing smiles like before!

original_text: 阿奉：那天庆贺狐仙被赶跑的场面，到现在还在我的脑子里呢，都多少年了，大家从没那么开怀过！
translation: A Feng: The scene celebrating the fox immortal being driven away that day is still in my mind. After so many years, everyone had never been so overjoyed!

original_text: 乐陵：奶奶让我把烧肉送去狐仙庙里，让在庙里的阿娘把烧肉给狐仙供上，可是我刚才摔了一跤，那块烧肉被大黄狗叼了去，怎么办？呜……
translation: Yue Ling: Grandma asked me to deliver the roasted meat to the Fox Immortal Temple, so that my mother at the temple could offer it to the Fox Immortal. But I just tripped and fell, and that piece of roasted meat was snatched away by the big yellow dog. What should I do? Woo...

original_text: 乐陵：夏叔叔是好人，上次爹上山被狼咬了，就是夏叔叔背他回来的～莲宝平时虽然不和我们一起玩，但她是夏叔叔的女儿，一定也是好人，为什么狐仙要把她带走呢？
translation: Yue Ling: Uncle Xia is a good person. Last time when father was bitten by a wolf on the mountain, it was Uncle Xia who carried him back~ Although Lianbao doesn't usually play with us, she is Uncle Xia's daughter, so she must be good too. Why did the fox immortal take her away?

original_text: 乐陵：……以后我们都不用给狐仙祝寿了？也就是说不用把烧肉省给他吃了？～
translation: Yue Ling: ...So we don't need to celebrate the Fox Immortal's birthday anymore? That means we don't have to save roasted meat for him?~

original_text: 乐陵：再也不用把好吃的东西都送到狐仙庙去了～昨天我吃了娘煮的肉，真开心，嘻嘻！
translation: Yue Ling: No more having to send all the tasty food to the Fox Immortal Temple~ Yesterday I ate meat Mom cooked, so happy, hehe!

original_text: 刘天宝：要是你打算在即墨住上一段日子，就一定得进这里的狐仙庙拜拜，庙就修在东北面的山上。
translation: Liu Tianbao: If you plan to stay in Jimo awhile, must visit the Fox Immortal Temple here. It's built on the northeast mountain.

original_text: 刘天宝：我们能够得到狐仙的庇护，真是三生有幸啊，绝对不能对他无礼，你们外来人也是，言语中一定要千万注意！
translation: Liu Tianbao: We are truly fortunate to receive the fox immortal's protection. We must never be disrespectful to him. You outsiders too, be extremely careful with your words!

original_text: 刘天宝：你们别不知天高地厚，狐仙的事也敢管！我看还是少管闲事，免得惹祸上身！
translation: Liu Tianbao: You don't know your limits, daring to meddle in the affairs of the fox immortal! I think you should mind your own business, lest you bring trouble upon yourselves!

original_text: 刘天宝：听说你们不费吹灰之力就把狐仙打得满地找牙？！有这么厉害？大侠～能不能收我为徒啊？
translation: Liu Tianbao: Heard you beat the fox immortal effortlessly?! That powerful? Great hero~ can you take me as your disciple?

original_text: 刘天宝：我现在已经正式拜入飞鹰帮门下，师从江湖上有名的“神刀铁胳臂”胡得朔胡大侠，以后再有人来欺负我们，就一点都不怕啦！
translation: Liu Tianbao: I've now officially joined the Flying Eagle Gang, studying under the renowned 'Divine Blade Iron Arm' Hu Deshuo. From now on, if anyone tries to bully us again, I won't be afraid at all!

original_text: 王永芝：这庙里供奉的狐仙是很灵验的，拜他一定要诚心诚意！
translation: Wang Yongzhi: The fox immortal enshrined in this temple is very efficacious. You must be sincere and reverent when worshipping him!

original_text: 王永芝：狐仙在上～小女王永芝祝狐仙福如东海，寿比南山，求您保佑我一家无病无灾，保佑我这一胎一定生个男孩。
translation: Wang Yongzhi: Oh great fox immortal~ Your humble servant Wang Yongzhi wishes you boundless fortune and eternal life. I beg you to protect my family from illness and disaster, and ensure that this pregnancy of mine definitely bears a son.

original_text: 王永芝：大伙儿平时总劝那书生夏元辰来拜拜狐仙，可他从来不听，迟早会遭报应的啊……
translation: Wang Yongzhi: Everyone often advises that scholar Xia Yuanchen to worship the Fox Immortal, but he never listens. He'll face retribution sooner or later...

original_text: 王永芝：那莲宝也是傻人有傻福，命大得很，不过她跟着穷书生，还不是穷命……
translation: Wang Yongzhi: That Lianbao is also blessed in her foolishness, incredibly lucky. But following a poor scholar, she's still destined for poverty...

original_text: 王永芝：我儿子白白胖胖，别提有多可爱了！家里上上下下都把他当宝贝，我就怕长久下去会把他给宠坏了。
translation: Wang Yongzhi: My son is plump and fair, indescribably adorable! The whole family treats him like a treasure. I'm just afraid we'll spoil him if this goes on.

original_text: 叶馨儿：平时常来庙里拜拜，到了狐仙寿辰的时候，再多供奉些上等的瓜果鱼肉，这一年差不多也就能平安度过了。
translation: Ye Xin'er: Usually, I come to the temple often to pray. When the Fox Immortal's birthday comes, I offer more premium fruits, meats, and fish. That's pretty much enough to get through the year safely.

original_text: 叶馨儿：狐仙啊～求您保佑我爹爹妈妈没病没痛，弟弟平安无事，家中别出意外……
translation: Ye Xin'er: Fox Immortal~ Please bless my father and mother to be free from illness and pain, my younger brother to be safe, and our home to avoid any accidents...

original_text: 叶馨儿：照说夏元辰家的莲宝是个痴儿，要了去也得不了什么好处，狐仙他到底为什么要带走莲宝呢？但愿莲宝平安无事……
translation: Ye Xin'er: Lianbao from Xia Yuanchen's family is a simple-minded child-taking her wouldn't bring any benefit. Why would the fox immortal want her? I hope Lianbao is safe...

original_text: 叶馨儿：莲宝平安回来就好，她已经够可怜了，千万别再出事……
translation: Ye Xin'er: As long as Lianbao returns safely. She's suffered enough already-please don't let anything happen...

original_text: 叶馨儿：夏元辰带着女儿离开了，大伙儿这才念起他的好，说他总是帮别人不少忙，莲宝也还是很乖的，哼，马后炮……
translation: Ye Xin'er: Xia Yuanchen left with his daughter, and only then did everyone remember his kindness, saying he always helped others a lot, and Lianbao was still very well-behaved. Hmph, hindsight is 20/20...

original_text: 姚冠华：哎，我家这房子，真是风水宝地，就在狐仙庙旁边，还对着上山的道，所以家里蒙狐仙照应的次数，也是最多的……
translation: Yao Guanhua: Ah, my house is truly a blessed spot-right next to the fox immortal Temple and facing the mountain path. So we receive the fox immortal's care the most often...

original_text: 姚冠华：夏元辰也是个可怜人……一个大男人，带个女儿不容易，偏偏还遇到这种事……
translation: Yao Guanhua: Xia Yuanchen is also a pitiful man... A grown man raising a daughter alone isn't easy, and to encounter such a thing...

original_text: 姚冠华：那狐狸就喜欢捉弄人，我媳妇对他一向诚心，每次上香都毕恭毕敬，每次上供都给最好的东西，可狐狸有哪一次保佑我们家生男孩了！
translation: Yao Guanhua: That fox just loves to play tricks on people. My wife has always been sincere to him, offering the best things every time she worships, but when has that fox ever blessed our family with a son!

original_text: 姚冠华：啊哈哈～老天有眼呐，我媳妇连生三个女孩，这胎终于生了个男孩！我姚家有后了！我姚家有后了！
translation: Yao Guanhua: Ahaha~ Heaven has eyes! My wife gave birth to three girls in a row, but this time she finally had a boy! The Yao family has an heir! The Yao family has an heir!

original_text: 何知润：这里人人都把那狐狸说的像神仙，害我想上山看看它到底长什么样，说不定根本就只是一狐狸精！
translation: He Zhirun: Everyone here talks about that fox like it's a deity, making me want to go up the mountain to see what it really looks like. Maybe it's just a fox immortal after all!

original_text: 何知润：姑娘，往隐香山狐仙居是不是就从这里上山？
translation: He Zhirun: Miss, is this the way up to the Fox Immortal's Abode on Mount Yinxiang?

original_text: 李秀华：问这个做什么？狐仙不喜欢有人上山打扰他，你最好别去啊。
translation: Li Xiuhua: Why ask that? The fox immortal doesn't like people going up the mountain to disturb him. You'd better not go.

original_text: 何知润：嘿嘿，听说狐仙就住在山上，我只是想参拜参拜～
translation: He Zhirun: Hehe, I heard the fox immortal lives on the mountain, I just want to pay my respects~

original_text: 李秀华：想参拜去前面的狐仙庙就行了，这山上的路本来就不好走，你要是迷路了，可是自找的。
translation: Li Xiuhua: If you want to pay respects, just go to the Fox Immortal Temple up ahead. The mountain paths are treacherous. If you get lost, it's your own fault.

original_text: 何知润：原来那狐狸四处害人，根本就是个妖怪！可惜我晚了一步，没能亲自收拾它！
translation: He Zhirun: So that fox harming people everywhere was actually a monster! Pity I was a step too late and couldn't deal with it myself!

original_text: 何知润：这些日子天气好，我也上山去了一趟，原来这山路不难走，只是被那狐狸施了障眼法……
translation: He Zhirun: The weather has been good these past few days, so I went up the mountain. It turns out the path isn't difficult; it was just an illusion cast by that fox...

original_text: 李秀华：这、发带……是我留在方大哥铺子里的……我想送给方大哥，可是我一个女孩子家，怎么好意思嘛～你、<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>你帮我去告诉方大哥</colour><dc0>，发带他自己留着用就好了，我、我改天再去看他……</dc0>
translation: Li Xiuhua: This... hair ribbon... I left it at Brother Fang's shop... I wanted to give it to Brother Fang, but how could a girl like me be so forward? You...<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> please go tell Brother Fang</colour><dc0> that he can keep the ribbon for himself. I'll... I'll visit him another day...</dc0>

original_text: 李秀华：夏元辰的年纪也不轻了，他也不是长得貌丑，只是带着那样一个养女，哪家闺女愿意嫁他呢……
translation: Li Xiuhua: Xia Yuanchen isn't young anymore, and he's not ugly either. But with that adopted daughter he's raising, what family's daughter would be willing to marry him...

original_text: 李秀华：我们受那狐狸的坑害，苦了好多年啦！有人把狐狸赶跑，他们真是即墨的大恩人！
translation: Li Xiuhua: We've suffered from that fox's harm for so many years! Those who drove the fox away are truly Jimo's great benefactors!

original_text: 李秀华：夏元辰带着莲宝去了外地，长途跋涉的，他真懂怎么照顾小孩吗？
translation: Li Xiuhua: Xia Yuanchen took Lianbao out of town. Such a long journey-does he really know how to take care of a child?

original_text: 余小童：即墨人经常会莫名其妙患些小毛小病，也不用什么特别的药，几钱巴豆下肚，清了肠胃就什么都好了，师父说这都是因为有狐三太爷保佑！
translation: Yu Xiaotong: Jimo people often get inexplicable minor illnesses. They don't need special medicine-just a few qian of croton seeds to clear the stomach, and they're fine. Master says this is all thanks to the protection of Third Grand Lord Fox!

original_text: 余小童：狐三太爷保佑，师父刚从行商那儿高价买来的云南田七，千万别变成树干片啊！
translation: Yu Xiaotong: Third Grand Lord Fox, please bless us. Master just bought Yunnan pseudo-ginseng at a high price from a merchant. Please don't let it turn into wood chips!

original_text: 余小童：那个讨厌的狐三太爷终于被赶跑了！店里上好的长白人参再也不会被换成萝卜干了！
translation: Yu Xiaotong: That annoying Third Grand Lord Fox has finally been driven away! The shop's finest Changbai ginseng will never be swapped for dried radish again!

original_text: 余小童：我看都这么久了，狐三太爷也没再回来，八成是被吓破了胆，爬回他的老窝去啦！
translation: Yu Xiaotong: I think after all this time, Lord Fox hasn't returned. He's probably scared out of his wits and crawled back to his den!

original_text: 丁浩：夏小弟人是不错，善良热心，可惜带着个累赘，至今都没成亲……
translation: Ding Hao: Young Xia is a good person, kind and helpful. It's a pity he's burdened with a dependent and hasn't married yet...

original_text: 丁浩：萍儿那丫头，叫她去草棚拿鱼干，怎么到现在还没回来？要是误了给狐三太爷贺寿的吉时，可是不得了！
translation: Ding Hao: That girl Ping'er, I sent her to the shed to get dried fish-why isn't she back yet? If we miss the auspicious time to offer birthday wishes to Lord Fox, it'll be a disaster!

original_text: 丁浩：哇～这不是杀狐大英雄吗？我看不如在庙里给你们立个像吧，这样也好常去拜拜！
translation: Ding Hao: Wow~ Isn't this the great fox-slaying hero? I think we should erect statues of you in the temple, so we can go worship often!

original_text: 丁浩：萍儿丫头嘴里老叨念着夏元辰那小子，不会是看上他了吧？反正人家现在已经离开即墨了，她也好死了这条心！
translation: Ding Hao: That Ping'er girl keeps chattering about that Xia Yuanchen kid; could she have taken a liking to him? Anyway, he's already left Jimo now, so she might as well give up!

original_text: 孙光：即墨紧挨着海，大多数人都以捕鱼为生，要是一个不小心遇上突然来的暴风雨，那可就完了……
translation: Sun Guang: Jimo is right by the sea, most people make a living by fishing. If you're not careful and get caught in a sudden storm, it's all over...

original_text: 孙光：今天晚上有为狐仙祝寿的庆典，到时我一定得诚心祷告，请他保佑海上风平浪静，大家都别出什么意外。
translation: Sun Guang: Tonight there's a celebration for the Fox Immortal's birthday. I must pray sincerely then, asking him to bless calm seas and that no accidents befall anyone.

original_text: 孙光：听说狐仙被你们打跑了？看不出来你们竟这样厉害！了不起！英雄出少年！
translation: Sun Guang: I heard you drove away the fox immortal? Didn't expect you to be so capable! Impressive! Heroes emerge from the young!

original_text: 孙光：呵呵，这段日子海上风平浪静，大伙儿每回出海都能收获很多鱼虾。
translation: Sun Guang: Hehe, the sea has been calm these days. Every time we go out, we catch lots of fish and shrimp.

original_text: 丁萍：刚才我看见夏大哥急急忙忙地跑过去，眉头紧皱，神色慌张，不知道出了什么事啊？
translation: Ding Ping: I just saw Brother Xia rushing past, frowning and looking panicked. I wonder what happened?

original_text: 丁萍：哥哥叫我去草棚拿鱼干，说是要给狐仙当供品，那么臭烘烘的咸鱼，又不是什么稀罕东西，狐仙怎么会喜欢？
translation: Ding Ping: Brother told me to get dried fish from the shed as fox immortal offerings. Stinky salted fish isn't rare-why would the fox immortal like it?

original_text: 丁萍：夏大哥平时常常帮我晒网收网，哥哥病了，夏大哥还带我一起出海，虽然他也帮不上什么忙……但是现在他的女儿被狐仙带走了，我却一点忙都帮不上，我真是太没用了！
translation: Ding Ping: Brother Xia often helps me dry and collect the fishing nets. When my brother was sick, Brother Xia even took me out to sea, though he couldn't help much either... But now his daughter has been taken by the fox immortal, and I can't help at all. I'm really useless!

original_text: 丁萍：看到夏大哥他们平安回来，我真是松了一口气～娘说好人有好报，真是应了这句话。
translation: Ding Ping: Seeing Brother Xia and the others return safely, I'm so relieved~ Mom says good people get good rewards, and that really came true.

original_text: 丁萍：夏大哥离开即墨也有一段日子了，不知道他们父女俩现在过得怎么样？我好想他……不，好想他们……
translation: Ding Ping: Brother Xia has been away from Jimo for a while now. I wonder how he and his daughter are doing now? I miss him... no, I miss them...

original_text: 郭九：总算把所有的灯笼都挂上去了，我还特地用粗绳扎得牢牢的，就算风再大，也绝不会被吹倒！
translation: Guo Jiu: Finally hung up all the lanterns. I even specially tied them securely with thick ropes. No matter how strong the wind, they absolutely won't blow down!

original_text: 郭九：不知道武阳那边的灯笼挂得怎么样了？我去看看，要是挂完了，找他一起喝两杯去！
translation: Guo Jiu: I wonder how the lantern hanging in Wuyang is coming along? I'll go check. If it's done, I'll find him for a couple of drinks!

original_text: 郭九：好久没有这样心情畅快了，哈哈！常年受那死狐狸的欺压，连觉都睡不安稳，还老怕他故意把船弄翻，每次出海都要小心翼翼，现在总算能安心了！
translation: Guo Jiu: It's been so long since I've felt this carefree, haha! Constantly bullied by that damned fox, I couldn't even sleep soundly, always afraid he'd capsize the boat on purpose. Every time I went to sea, I had to be extra careful. Now I can finally relax!

original_text: 郭九：昨天出海捕了一箩筐的虾，个个都有手掌那么大！待会儿到临涛小酌买坛酒回来，煮虾下酒吃。
translation: Guo Jiu: Went out to sea yesterday and caught a whole basket of shrimp, each as big as a palm! Later, I'll buy a jar of wine from Lintao Xiaozhu to cook the shrimp and drink with it.

original_text: 周武阳：小毛，你怎么挂灯笼的？晃悠晃悠的，都快掉下来啦！
translation: Zhou Wuyang: Xiao Mao, how did you hang that lantern? It's swaying and about to fall off!

original_text: 胡小毛：周大叔，你放心好了！那是风大吹的，看着晃悠，其实稳得很！这灯笼可是为狐仙贺寿挂的，我哪敢有半点马虎！
translation: Hu Xiaomao: Uncle Zhou, don't worry! It's just the wind making it sway; it's actually stable! These lanterns are for Fox Immortal's birthday; I wouldn't dare be careless!

original_text: 周武阳：我瞧这灯笼迟早会被风吹下来，我还是上去重新绑一下，免得出什么闪失。
translation: Zhou Wuyang: I think this lantern will be blown down by the wind sooner or later. I'd better go up and tie it again properly to avoid any mishaps.

original_text: 周武阳：狐仙走了的确是大喜事，就怕过一段时间他又回来了，到时候恐怕比现在还惨！
translation: Zhou Wuyang:  The Fox Immortal leaving is indeed a joyous event. I'm just worried he might come back after a while-then it'd probably be worse than now!

original_text: 周武阳：很长时间没过太平日子了，一开始还真有点不习惯呢，呵呵，以后能一直这样就好了～
translation: Zhou Wuyang: It's been a long time without peaceful days. At first, I really wasn't used to it, hehe. I hope it can stay like this forever~

original_text: 胡小毛：桅杆上的灯笼都是我挂的，到了晚上给狐仙庆寿的时候，我得过来把这些灯笼一盏一盏地点上。
translation: Hu Xiaomao: I hung all the lanterns on the mast. When it's time to celebrate the fox immortal's birthday tonight, I'll come light these lanterns one by one.

original_text: 胡小毛：……只见英雄手起刀落，那狐仙的头就掉到了地上！周大哥，你没瞧见那场面，当真是……
translation: Hu Xiaomao: ...Then the hero raised his hand and with one slash, the fox immortal's head fell to the ground! Brother Zhou, you didn't see that scene, it was truly...

original_text: 周武阳：咦？我怎么听说狐仙只是被打跑了，并没有死啊？
translation: Zhou Wuyang: Huh? How come I heard the fox immortal was just driven away, not killed?

original_text: 胡小毛：这……嘿嘿～我当时站在远处，远远看见刀光一闪，至于头掉没掉下来……我也不是很清楚。
translation: Hu Xiaomao: This... hehe~ I was standing far away at the time, and from a distance, I saw a flash of blade light. As for whether the head fell off or not... I'm not very clear either.

original_text: 胡小毛：我前几日找方大哥打了把刀，准备从现在开始好好练武，要是日后有什么狐四太爷敢来欺负大家，我就去给他几刀，杀得他屁滚尿流！
translation: Hu Xiaomao: I asked Brother Fang to make me a knife a few days ago, planning to start practicing martial arts seriously now. If any 'Fourth Grandfather Fox' dares bully everyone in the future, I'll give him a few cuts, scare the wits out of him!

original_text: 廉小雨：这些蔬果海产是我家省了一年才省下来的，希望狐仙他老人家满意。
translation: Lian Xiaoyu: These vegetables, fruits, and seafood are what my family saved up for a whole year. I hope the Fox Immortal is satisfied.

original_text: 廉小雨：夏叔叔是好人，平日里也帮了大家不少忙，只是他不肯供奉狐仙，终于把狐仙惹恼了……这事真是谁也帮不上的呀！
translation: Lian Xiaoyu: Uncle Xia is a good person who helps everyone often, but he refuses to worship the fox immortal and finally angered it... No one can help with this matter!

original_text: 廉小雨：还好……夏叔叔和莲宝都平安回来了，我、我好不应该，还觉得莲宝被抓走是遭了报应，幸好……狐仙跑了，大伙儿不用再像以前那样过日子了。
translation: Lian Xiaoyu: It's a relief... Uncle Xia and Lianbao both returned safely. I... I shouldn't have thought that Lianbao being taken was retribution. Thankfully... the fox immortal is gone, and everyone doesn't have to live like before anymore.

original_text: 廉小雨：以前娘要是生病了，为了省钱给狐仙办寿礼，都不肯去看大夫，现在她也舍得开药了，这样身体才会很快好起来啊～
translation: Lian Xiaoyu: Before, if Mom got sick, she'd save money for the fox immortal's birthday instead of seeing a doctor. Now she's willing to buy medicine, so she'll recover faster~

original_text: 吴芮：今年的天气不太好，上个月刮了两三次狂风，下了十多天大雨……一定得求狐仙多保佑我们啊……
translation: Wu Rui: The weather this year isn't good. Last month there were two or three fierce storms, over ten days of heavy rain... We must pray for the Fox Immortal's protection...

original_text: 吴芮：真是作孽啊！夏家那孩子平时待大伙儿那么好，就是因为对狐仙不敬，女儿才会被带走……
translation: Wu Rui: What a sin! That child from the Xia family was always so good to everyone. It's because he disrespected the Fox Immortal that his daughter was taken away...

original_text: 吴芮：想不到啊、想不到……我还以为没人能管得了那狐仙，以后都得这么过了……那打跑狐仙的人，真是大善人。
translation: Wu Rui: Unbelievable... unbelievable... I thought no one could manage that Fox Immortal, and we'd have to live like this forever... The person who drove off the Fox Immortal is truly a great benefactor.

original_text: 吴芮：王家的媳妇是从南方嫁过来的，她娘家人前些日子捎了些上好的茶叶来，听说是京城里那些大老爷爱喝的东西，王大婶得了那些茶叶，笑得嘴都合不拢。
translation: Wu Rui: The Wang family's daughter-in-law married from the south. Her family sent some premium tea a while back, said to be favored by high officials in the capital. Aunt Wang was so delighted she couldn't stop smiling.

original_text: 任老爹：呵呵，又是宋老板送糕点来了？让我尝尝～
translation: Uncle Ren: Hehe, is it Boss Song delivering pastries again? Let me have a taste~

original_text: 任老爹：嗯～不错、不错～<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>替我告诉宋老板</colour><dc0>，就说绿豆糕的味道特别好，别的嘛，就不怎么样了。</dc0>
translation: Uncle Ren: Hmm~ Not bad, not bad~<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> Tell Boss Song for me</colour><dc0> that the mung bean cakes taste especially good, the rest, well, not so much.</dc0>

original_text: 任老爹：年纪大啦，每次出海回来，这把老骨头都像散了架似的疼。可不出海嘛，说不定什么时候就被狐仙三太爷照应照应……还不如出海的好！
translation: Uncle Ren: Getting old. Every time I return from sea, these old bones ache as if falling apart. But if I don't go to sea, who knows when the Lord Fox might 'look after' me... Better to go to sea!

original_text: 任老爹：哎呀呀，这回可真是太好喽！那臭狐狸欺负我们七、八年了，现在终于遭了报应！英雄您可要在咱即墨多待几天，让大伙儿都好好招待招待您！
translation: Uncle Ren: Oh my, this time it's really wonderful! That damned fox bullied us for seven or eight years, now finally got retribution! Hero, you must stay in Jimo a few more days, let everyone properly entertain you!

original_text: 任老爹：哈哈哈，老头子我才钓了一小会儿鱼，这鱼篓子就满啦！回家拿给儿子媳妇，要煮要卖都随他们！
translation: Uncle Ren: Hahaha! This old man only fished for a little while, and the basket is already full! Taking it home for my son and daughter-in-law-they can cook or sell it as they please!

original_text: 张艳：你是说，这块石头是刘大哥让你带来的？他还是这样，把铸剑用的矿石当宝贝，可惜我一点都不懂呢……
translation: Zhang Yan: You're saying this stone was brought by Brother Liu? He's still like that, treating ore for sword forging as treasure. Unfortunately, I don't understand it at all...

original_text: 张艳：<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>如果你再去寿阳，就帮我告诉刘大哥</colour><dc0>，他喜欢寿阳城外巢湖的水，我却只爱即墨的海，这块石头，还是送给懂得欣赏它们的人吧……</dc0>
translation: Zhang Yan:<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> If you go to Shouyang again, please tell Brother Liu for me</colour><dc0>, he loves the water of Chao Lake outside Shouyang city, but I only love the sea of Jimo. This stone is better given to someone who knows how to appreciate it...</dc0>

original_text: 张艳：海上的天气总是变化无常，就算现在看起来风平浪静，到了夜里说不定就来几场暴风雨。没有经验丰富的渔人陪着，可千万别随便出海。
translation: Zhang Yan: The weather at sea is always unpredictable. Even if it looks calm now, there might be several storms by night. Don't go out to sea casually without experienced fishermen accompanying you.

original_text: 张艳：记得我小的时候，狐三太爷刚来隐香山，有时候还是会帮帮我们的，是后来才渐渐开始欺负人的……不过不管怎么样，这些都是过去的事情啦！
translation: Zhang Yan: I remember when I was little, Lord Fox had just come to Mount Yinxiang and sometimes still helped us. It was later that he gradually started bullying people... But no matter what, these are all things of the past!

original_text: 张艳：以前夏大哥在的时候，总是帮大伙很多忙，爷爷的病也是夏大哥帮忙才治好的……不知道现在夏大哥去了哪里，过得怎么样？
translation: Zhang Yan: When Brother Xia was here before, he always helped everyone a lot; he even helped cure my grandfather's illness... I wonder where Brother Xia has gone now and how he's doing?

original_text: 穆小小：呜呜呜……娘说今年家里没有别的东西了，要杀大牯牛送给狐三太爷做寿礼……呜呜呜，小小不要大牯牛死，呜……
translation: Mu Xiaoxiao: Woo... Mom said there's nothing else at home this year, so we have to slaughter Big Bull as a birthday gift for Lord Fox... Woo, Xiaoxiao doesn't want Big Bull to die, woo...

original_text: 穆小小：哥哥你真是太厉害了，打跑了狐狸，救了莲宝！我长大了，也要像哥哥一样四处去打坏蛋！
translation: Mu Xiaoxiao: Brother, you're really amazing, driving away the fox and saving Lianbao! When I grow up, I want to be like brother, going everywhere to fight bad guys!

original_text: 穆小小：虽然莲宝平常都不怎么跟我说话，可我还是很喜欢她……现在夏叔叔带着莲宝一起走了……我好想莲宝呀！
translation: Mu Xiaoxiao: Although Lianbao usually doesn't talk much with me, I still like her a lot... Now Uncle Xia has taken Lianbao away... I miss Lianbao so much!

original_text: 赵常：咱这“安潮客栈”虽然比不上大城里的客栈舒坦，但是上房的窗户对着海，晚上歇息时，能听到海潮起落的声音，哈哈！
translation: Zhao Chang: Our 'Anchao Inn' may not be as comfortable as those in big cities, but the windows of the best rooms face the sea. At night, you can hear the tide rising and falling, haha!

original_text: 赵常：英雄！您来啦！虽然店里的房间简陋了点儿，不过已经为您打扫干净了！如果您逛累了，随时都可以来歇息！
translation: Zhao Chang: Hero! You've come! Though the rooms in the inn are a bit humble, they've been cleaned for you! If you get tired from wandering, you can come rest anytime!

original_text: 赵常：最近海上风平浪静，出海的人带回来的海产也比以前多，咱店里的各式海味炒菜可是一样也不缺，英雄您可要尝尝不？
translation: Zhao Chang: The sea has been calm lately, and fishermen bring back more seafood than before. Our inn has all kinds of seafood stir-fries available-would you like to try some, hero?

original_text: 宋笑生：这里的人真是奇怪，竟把一只狐狸敬得像神仙？若那狐狸真这么有本事，那我“夺命书生”宋笑生倒想会他一会～
translation: Song Xiaosheng: The people here are really strange, treating a fox like a deity? If that fox is really so capable, then I, 'Deadly Scholar' Song Xiaosheng, would like to meet it~

original_text: 宋笑生：我说那狐狸到底有什么本事，让整个即墨的人都对他如此恭敬？原来也不过是一只狐精，几个名不见经传的小毛孩子就能把他打跑，真是无聊～
translation: Song Xiaosheng: I said, what abilities does that fox actually have to make everyone in Jimo respect him so much? Turns out he's just a fox immortal, driven off by a few unknown little kids. So boring~

original_text: 宋笑生：糟糕！我竟然忘记曾飞鸽传书约唐家堡五小姐陈州相见之事了！唐五小姐向来刁蛮，这回我竟然爽了她的约，可是大大的不妙～
translation: Song Xiaosheng: Oh no! I completely forgot I sent a carrier pigeon to arrange a meeting with the Fifth Miss of the Tang Fort in Chenzhou! Miss Tang is notoriously willful; standing her up this time is a huge mistake~

original_text: 谭九：不是说“夺命书生”宋笑生和唐家堡的三小姐相约陈州吗？可是我今天早上路过狐仙庙时，好像看到了那个“夺命书生”哎？
translation: Tan Jiu: Isn't it said that 'Deadly Scholar' Song Xiaosheng and the Third Miss of the Tang Fort had an appointment in Chenzhou? But this morning when I passed the Fox Immortal Temple, I think I saw that 'Deadly Scholar'?

original_text: 谭九：少侠您年纪不大，修为却不浅，更奇的是我竟然没有在江湖上听过少侠的名号！看少侠的打扮……难道您是传说中的蜀山剑仙？
translation: Tan Jiu: Young master, you're not old, yet your cultivation is profound. Strangely, I've never heard your name in the martial world! Judging by your attire... could you be the legendary Sword Immortal of Mount Shu?

original_text: 谭九：嘿嘿，告诉你一个秘密！在这世上，有一种会走会跑的神秘水滴，总是说一些奇奇怪怪的话，但是那些话中却往往包含着无上天机！
translation: Tan Jiu: Hehe, I'll tell you a secret! In this world, there's a mysterious droplet that walks and runs, always saying weird things, but those words often contain profound heavenly secrets!

original_text: 宋圆：只有绿豆糕的味道特别好？唉……其实这几样糕点当中，只有绿豆糕是我娘子做的，其余都是我的手艺。没想到我精心苦练这么多天，做的糕点仍旧不如娘子啊……这些点心都送给你吧，下次我一定会做出更好吃的点心！
translation: Song Yuan: Only the mung bean cakes taste really good? Sigh... Actually, among these dim sums, only the mung bean cakes were made by my wife, the rest are my handiwork. I never expected that after all my diligent practice these days, my skill still can't match my wife's... Here, you can have these dim sums. Next time I'll definitely make tastier ones!

original_text: 方正：原来、原来是秀华？嘿、嘿嘿～她、她说改天还会再来，哈哈、哈哈哈哈～～来，这几件东西你拿好了，别客气！
translation: Fang Zheng: So... so it was Xiuhua? Heh, hehe~ She... she said she'll come again another day, haha, hahahaha~~ Here, take these few things, don't be shy!

original_text: 余子坚：英雄！您真是我们即墨人的大英雄！打跑了狐仙，还帮我找回了这支救命用的参！这些药是我一直藏着舍不得卖的，送给英雄您，就算是我小小的心意吧！
translation: Yu Zijian: Hero! You truly are the great hero of our Jimonese! You drove away the fox immortal and even helped me retrieve this life-saving ginseng! These medicines are ones I've been hoarding, reluctant to sell. I give them to you, hero, as a small token of my gratitude!

original_text: 花费100文钱住宿吗？
translation: Spend 100 wen to stay the night?

original_text: 谭德海：您身上的钱不够。
translation: Tan Dehai: You don't have enough money on you.

original_text:
哈哈，小哥，如果你有时间，能不能帮我把这包糕点拿去给下面栈道上的任老爹尝尝？
你愿意帮我送去吗？
translation: Hey, young man, if you have a moment, could you deliver this package of pastries to Uncle Ren on the plank road below? Would you be willing to help me out?

original_text:
不知道是什么时候的事情，铺子里忽然多出一条发带，上面还绣了我的名字……可是我用的衣裳帽子都是直接买现成的，从来没见过这种东西！小哥你能帮我去问问，有谁丢了发带？
你愿意帮我去问问吗？
translation: I don't know when it happened, but a hair ribbon suddenly appeared in the shop, and it even has my name embroidered on it... But all the clothes and hats I use are bought ready-made, I've never seen anything like this! Young man, can you<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> help me ask around</colour><dc0>, has anyone lost a hair ribbon?</dc0>

original_text:
唉呀呀！我的天哪！上好的紫蕴玄参，王家婆婆等着救命用的，竟被狐仙他老人家带走了！这可怎么办才好啊！
你愿意帮我去取回来吗？
translation:
Oh dear! Good heavens! The fine Purple Ginseng, which Granny Wang needs to save her life, has been taken away by the Fox Immortal! What should we do now!
Will you help me retrieve it?

original_text: 耀咚：这里是“巢卫队”的机要重地，快走开！
translation: Yaodong: This is the 'Juchao Guard' confidential zone-get out!

original_text: 韩菱纱：这些是！……
translation: Han Lingsha: These are...!

original_text: 韩菱纱：青铜鼎、青铜人面……这里、这里果然就是殷商居巢国的遗迹啊！
translation: Han Lingsha: Bronze tripods, bronze human masks... This place... this is indeed the ruins of Juchao Kingdom from the Shang Dynasty!

original_text: 云天河：这儿住的全是妖怪？长相都好有趣～
translation: Yun Tianhe: All the residents here are yaoguais? They look so interesting~

original_text: 慕容紫英：妖气重重！果然是妖孽聚集之地！！
translation: Murong Ziying: Thick yao aura! Truly a gathering place for evil creatures!!

original_text: 柳梦璃：紫英，你先把剑收起来，好吗？我看这些妖并没有恶意……
translation: Liu Mengli: Ziying, please put away your sword first, okay? I don't think these yaoguais mean harm...

original_text: 慕容紫英：妖本身即是恶，难道还会存有善念？
translation: Murong Ziying: Yaoguais are evil by nature, could they possibly harbor good intentions?

original_text: 云天河：不能这么说吧，像是之前在女萝岩遇到的那几只——
translation: Yun Tianhe: Can't say that, like those few we met earlier in Nvluo Rock-

original_text: 慕容紫英：寿阳女萝岩？你曾去过那里？
translation: Murong Ziying: Nvluo Rock in Shouyang? You've been there?

original_text: 韩菱纱：啊、那个，紫英你说，居巢国里会不会藏着鲲鳞呢？
translation: Han Lingsha: Ah, that, Ziying, do you think we can find the Kun scale in Juchao Kingdom?

original_text: 慕容紫英：……
translation: Murong Ziying: ...

original_text: 柳梦璃：嗯，我觉得有可能，毕竟这里也是灵气汇聚之地，总会有些非同寻常的东西……
translation: Liu Mengli: Hmm, I think it's possible. After all, this place gathers spiritual energy, so there are bound to be unusual things...

original_text: 韩菱纱：那，紫英……不如你留下，<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>我们先去打探打探</colour><dc0>吧？</dc0>
translation: Han Lingsha: Well, Ziying... why don't you stay here,<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> and let us go scout it out first</colour><dc0>?</dc0>

original_text: 韩菱纱：现在就跟这儿的妖翻脸，恐怕不太好……
translation: Han Lingsha: Picking a fight with the yaoguais here now probably isn't good...

original_text: 慕容紫英：……不必，我跟你们一起去！
translation: Murong Ziying: No need, I'll go with you!

original_text: 慕容紫英：虽是以玄霄师叔之事为先，但深入妖类巢穴，绝不可掉以轻心！
translation: Murong Ziying: Although Uncle Xuanxiao's matter is the priority, we must not let our guard down deep in a yao-nest!

original_text: 韩菱纱：……好吧，不到万不得已，我们别和这里的妖起冲突。
translation: Han Lingsha: ... Alright, unless absolutely necessary, let's not start conflicts with the yaoguais here.

original_text: 慕容紫英：……我明白你的顾虑，只是那些受苦的渔民又当如何……
translation: Murong Ziying: ... I understand your concerns, but what about those suffering fishermen...
Han Lingsha: ......

original_text: 柳梦璃：你们快看，那是……
translation: Liu Mengli: Quick, look! That's...

original_text: 韩菱纱：呀～是槐米它们！
translation: Han Lingsha: Ah~ It's Huaimi and his siblings!

original_text: 槐枝：喵喵～你们怎么会来居巢国？
translation: Huaizhi: Meow meow~ What brings you to Juchao Kingdom?

original_text: 柳梦璃：槐枝～还能再见到你，真是太好了，你们——
translation: Liu Mengli: Huaizhi~ It's really wonderful to see you again. You all-

original_text: 槐米：槐枝，快退后！
translation: Huaimi: Huaizhi, step back!

original_text: 槐枝：喵？老大？
translation: Huaizhi: Meow? Boss?

original_text: 槐米：快！你没看见那个人吗？！就是他杀了爹和娘！
translation: Huaimi: Quick! Don't you see that person?! He's the one who killed our parents!

original_text: 槐枝：对！是他，就是他！把爹和娘都害死了！
translation: Huaizhi: Yes! It's him, it's him! He killed our parents!

original_text: 慕容紫英：我道是谁？原来是女萝岩的妖孽，竟还有漏网之鱼！
translation: Murong Ziying: I wonder who you are! So you're the evil creatures from Nvluo Rock, there's still some slipped through!

original_text: 韩菱纱：紫英，你听我说——
translation: Han Lingsha: Ziying, listen to me-

original_text: 慕容紫英：也好！今日我就在此斩草除根！
translation: Murong Ziying: Fine! Today I will eradicate the root of the problem here!

original_text: 柳梦璃：……！
translation: Liu Mengli: ...!

original_text: 云天河：紫英，住手！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Ziying, stop!

original_text: 慕容紫英：……天河，你是什么意思？
translation: Murong Ziying: ... Tianhe, what do you mean?

original_text: 云天河：槐米它们是朋友！
translation: Yun Tianhe: These sophoramons are our friends!

original_text: 慕容紫英：什么？！可笑！人与妖岂能做朋友？
translation: Murong Ziying: What?! Ridiculous! How can humans and yaoguais be friends?

original_text: 慕容紫英：这些妖物曾于女萝岩伤人，如今又潜伏在湖底，伺机拖人溺水，你竟还要回护它们？！
translation: Murong Ziying: These monsters once injured people at Nvluo Rock, and now they lurk at the bottom of the lake, waiting to drag people down and drown them. And you still want to protect them?!

original_text: 槐米：喵！你乱讲！
translation: Huaimi: Meow! You're talking nonsense!

original_text: 槐米：是那些人自己不小心掉进漩涡里，才不是我们害的，我和其他妖还好心把他们推上岸！
translation: Huaimi: Those people fell into the whirlpool by their own carelessness! We didn't harm them. My peers and I even kindly pushed them ashore!

original_text: 慕容紫英：妖会救人？！一派胡言！
translation: Murong Ziying: Yaoguais saving humans?! Utter nonsense!

original_text: 柳梦璃：……紫英，上天有好生之德，它们尚且年幼——
translation: Liu Mengli: Ziying, heaven has a virtue of cherishing life, they are still young-

original_text: 慕容紫英：就算年幼无识，长大之后一样要去害人！
translation: Murong Ziying: Even if young, they'll still harm others when they grow up!

original_text: 槐米：喵喵！我们从来没有害过人！只有人来害我们！
translation: Huaimi: Meow meow! We've never harmed anyone! Only people have harmed us!

original_text: 慕容紫英：哼！那在女萝岩伤人之事又如何说？
translation: Murong Ziying: Hmph! Then what about injuring people in Nvluo Rock?

original_text: 云天河：紫英，人为了填饱肚子，为了保护自己，杀死其他动物、甚至是杀妖怪也没什么，但槐米它们又没做错事，就算它们的爹娘伤过寿阳城的人，这也是两回事，怎么能无缘无故把它们杀了！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Ziying, it's understandable for people to kill other animals or even monsters to fill their stomachs or protect themselves. But Huaimi and the others haven't done anything wrong. Even if their parents harmed people in Shouyang City, that's a separate matter. How can we kill them for no reason!

original_text: 慕容紫英：此时不除去它们，待日后强大起来岂不追悔莫及？！
translation: Murong Ziying: If we don't eliminate them now, won't we regret it when they grow stronger later?!

original_text: 云天河：要是让你在这里痛下杀手，我才真要后悔！
translation: Yun Tianhe: If I let you commit murder here, that's what I'd truly regret!

original_text: 慕容紫英：……你让开！
translation: Murong Ziying: ... Step aside!

original_text: 云天河：不可能！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Impossible!

original_text: 慕容紫英：你！！
translation: Murong Ziying: You!!

original_text: 韩菱纱：紫英，你冷静一下！
translation: Han Lingsha: Ziying, calm down!

original_text: 韩菱纱：为什么你只当妖都是恶的，人都是善的？难道就没有例外？
translation: Han Lingsha: Why do you only see yaoguais as evil and humans as good? Aren't there any exceptions?

original_text: 慕容紫英：菱纱！怎么连你也……
translation: Murong Ziying: Lingsha! How come even you...

original_text: 慕容紫英：……你们，都要拦我？！
translation: Murong Ziying: ... You all! Are you all going to stop me?!

original_text: 柳梦璃：紫英……
translation: Liu Mengli: Ziying...

original_text: 慕容紫英：好、好！
translation: Murong Ziying: Fine!

original_text: 慕容紫英：看来只有我一人最是奇怪！道不同不相为谋，今日你们在此，我不必硬来，就此别过！
translation: Murong Ziying: It seems I am the only odd one out! Those who walk different paths cannot make plans together. Since you are all here today, I need not force the issue. Farewell!

original_text: 云天河：紫英——！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Ziying-!

original_text: 韩菱纱：……
translation: Han Lingsha: ...

original_text: 槐米：喵！
translation: Huaimi: Meow!

original_text: 云天河：……对不起，紫英他、他是我的朋友，就算你们说要报仇，我也会阻止……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... I'm sorry. Ziying, he... he's my friend. Even if you say you want revenge, I'll stop you...

original_text: 槐米：喵！你是你，他是他！朋友还是朋友，仇人还是仇人！
translation: Huaimi: Meow! You're you, and he's him! A friend's a friend, an enemy's an enemy!

original_text: 槐枝：老大说的对，我们现在还小，长大以后要靠自己去报仇！
translation: Huaizhi: Boss is right. We're still young now, but when we grow up, we'll rely on ourselves to get revenge!

original_text: 韩菱纱：为什么……会变成这样……
translation: Han Lingsha: Why... has it come to this...

original_text: 槐米：……喵，你们几个，为什么要来居巢国？
translation: Huaimi: ... Meow, you three, why have you come to Juchao Kingdom?

original_text: 韩菱纱：本来……是想查清楚近日妖怪伤人的事……而且我们还要找一种叫作“鲲鳞”的东西……
translation: Han Lingsha: Originally... we wanted to investigate the recent yaoguai attacks... and we also need to find something called Kun Scale...

original_text: 柳梦璃：你们呢？又怎会住在这里？
translation: Liu Mengli: And you? Why do you live here?

original_text: 槐枝：喵～老大带我们离开女萝岩之后，遇到其他好心的妖，就告诉我们可以来这儿。
translation: Huaizhi: Meow~ After Boss led us out of Nvluo Rock, we met other kind-hearted yaoguai, and they told us we could come here.

original_text: 槐枝：喵～这边的妖很多，但是大家都很好，不会随便伤人的。
translation: Huaizhi: Meow~ There are many yaoguais here, but everyone is very nice and won't hurt people randomly.

original_text: 柳梦璃：离开女萝岩之后，我常常担心你们。现在看到你们都平安无事，终于可以放心了。
translation: Liu Mengli: After leaving Nvluo Rock, I often worried about you all. Now seeing you safe and sound, I can finally be at ease.

original_text: 槐枝：喵～谢谢，你是好人！
translation: Huaizhi: Meow~ Thank you, you're good persons!

original_text: 槐米：……喵！你们说的鲲鳞，是不是一种大鱼的鳞片？
translation: Huaimi: ... Meow! The Kun scale you mentioned, is it a scale from a big fish?

original_text: 云天河：是啊！槐米，你怎么知道？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Yeah! Huaimi, how did you know?

original_text: 槐米：喵！我听居巢国的长老说起过，我帮你们去问他！
translation: Huaimi: Meow! I heard the elder of Juchao Kingdom mention it, I'll help you ask him!

original_text: 槐米：跟我来！喵！
translation: Huaimi: Follow me! Meow!

original_text: 槐米：喵！跟上跟上～
translation: Huaimi: Meow! Keep up, keep up~

original_text: 柳梦璃：……这样，真的可以吗？上次还送给我们土灵珠……
translation: Liu Mengli: ... Is this really okay? Last time you even gave us the Earth Spirit Pearl...

original_text: 槐米：喵！我说了，朋友是朋友，仇人是仇人，朋友有困难，一定要帮！
translation: Huaimi: Meow! I said, friends are friends, enemies are enemies. When friends are in trouble, we must help!

original_text: 槐米：快来！我带弟弟先去<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>长老家</colour><dc0>了，</dc0><colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>在这层平台的最上层</colour><dc0>，你们一会儿就过来，我会告诉其他妖，你们不是敌人！喵～</dc0>
translation: Huaimi: Come quickly! I'll take my brothers to the<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> Elder's house</colour><dc0> first, it's</dc0><colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> on the topmost level of this platform</colour><dc0>. You should come over later, I'll tell the other yaos that you're not enemies! Meow~</dc0>

original_text: 柳梦璃：谢谢，我的朋友……
translation: Liu Mengli: Thank you, my friend...

original_text: 韩菱纱：它们……都是这样善良，和人没有分别，为什么……紫英就是不能明白呢？
translation: Han Lingsha: They... are all so kind, no different from humans. Why... can't Ziying understand that?
Yun Tianhe: ......

original_text: 槐米：……
translation: Huaimi: ...

original_text: 韩菱纱：怎么了？是不是长老也不知道鲲鳞的下落？
translation: Han Lingsha: What's wrong? Does the elder also not know the whereabouts of the Kun Scale?

original_text: 柳梦璃：……没关系的，别难过，最多我们再去其他地方找——
translation: Liu Mengli: ... It's okay, don't be sad. In that case, we'll search elsewhere-

original_text: 韩菱纱：这是……？
translation: Han Lingsha: Is this...?

original_text: 槐米：喵，长老说……他很感激你们帮过妖，很少会有人对妖这么好，他愿意把自己搜集的鲲鳞送给你们，作为报答……
translation: Huaimi: Meow, the elder said... he's very grateful you helped us yaos. It's rare for any human to be so kind to yaos. He's willing to give you the Kun scale he collected as repayment...

original_text: 云天河：真的吗？太好了！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Really? That's great!

original_text: 槐米：喵……这个东西寒气好重，要不是长老在上面施了法，我根本拿不了……
translation: Huaimi: Meow...This object has such a heavy chill... If the Elder hadn't cast a spell on it, I wouldn't be able to hold it at all...

original_text: 柳梦璃：辛苦你了，槐米！还有，谢谢你们的长老！
translation: Liu Mengli: You've worked hard, Huaimi! And thank your elders!

original_text: 槐米：不过，喵，长老还说……他说……
translation: Huaimi: But, meow, the elder also said... he said...

original_text: 云天河：……？
translation: Yun Tianhe: ...?

original_text: 槐米：……他说和你们一起来的那个人太危险了，喵，所以他也不欢迎你们留下，请你们快点离开居巢国……
translation: Huaimi: ... He said the person who came with you is too dangerous, meow. So he doesn't welcome you staying either. Please leave Juchao Kingdom quickly...

original_text: 柳梦璃：槐米……你是在替我们难过吗？
translation: Liu Mengli: Huaimi... are you feeling sad for us?

original_text: 槐米：喵……
translation: Huaimi: Meow...

original_text: 柳梦璃：这没什么的，长老他愿意帮忙，已经令人感激不尽了。
translation: Liu Mengli: It's nothing. The fact that the Elder is willing to help is already something to be immensely grateful for.

original_text: 韩菱纱：对啊，而且长老虽然让我们赶快走，但也没有强行驱赶，说不定下回我们偷偷溜进来找你玩，他也会睁只眼闭只眼的。
translation: Han Lingsha: Right, and although the elder told us to leave quickly, he didn't force us out. Maybe next time we sneak in to play with you, he'll turn a blind eye.

original_text: 槐米：喵～那你们一定要再来哦……
translation: Huaimi: Meow~ Then you must definitely come again...

original_text: 云天河：当然，一定来！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Of course we'll come!

original_text: 柳梦璃：嗯……不过有件事我还是不明白，槐米你说湖里的妖不会伤人，那些人是自己溺水的，可是为什么会突然有这么多人溺水呢？
translation: Liu Mengli: Mm...But there's one thing I still don't understand. Huaimi, you said the yaoguais under the lake don't harm people-those people drowned themselves. But why would so many suddenly drown?

original_text: 槐米：喵，那是因为湖上多了好多漩涡，船划到附近就会被卷走。
translation: Huaimi: Meow, that's because there are many whirlpools on the lake now. Boats get swept away if they go near.

original_text: 韩菱纱：这更奇怪了，我以前来过巢湖附近，那个时候没听说有这些漩涡啊……
translation: Han Lingsha: That's even stranger, I've been near Chao Lake before, and back then I never heard of these whirlpools...

original_text: 槐米：喵，我听长老说，这就像月亮和潮汐的道理，因为有个巨大的岛从巢湖上空飞过，湖面才会变成这样，要过段日子才能恢复以前的样子。
translation: Huaimi: Meow, I heard from the elder that it's like the principle of the moon and tides. Because a huge island flew over Chao Lake, the lake surface became like this. It'll take some time to return to how it was before.

original_text: 韩菱纱：巨大的……岛？那是什么？
translation: Han Lingsha: A huge... island? What is that?

original_text: 槐米：喵……我不知道。
translation: Huaimi: Meow... I don't know.

original_text: 柳梦璃：……这样说来，渔民要更小心才是……
translation: Liu Mengli: ... In that case, the fishermen should be more careful...

original_text: 柳梦璃：嗯……不如我赶回寿阳一趟，请裴大哥在城中发个告示，另外派人通知附近村子的渔民，最好先在家中歇息一段日子，少挣的钱就由县衙补贴他们吧。
translation: Liu Mengli: Mm... How about I hurry back to Shouyang, ask Brother Pei to put up a notice in town, and also send someone to alert the fishermen in nearby villages? They should rest at home for a while, and the county office will compensate them for the lost income.

original_text: 韩菱纱：这是个好办法！由官府出面，也很容易就能破除妖怪害人的传言，想个稳妥些的理由就行。
translation: Han Lingsha: That's a great idea! With the authorities stepping in, it'll be easy to dispel the rumors of monsters harming people. We just need a plausible reason.

original_text: 韩菱纱：<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>那我们快些回岸上吧，</colour><dc0>兵分两路，我和天河把鲲鳞送回琼华派，梦璃就去寿阳。</dc0>
translation: Han Lingsha:<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> Then let's hurry back to shore,</colour><dc0> split up. Tianhe and I will bring back the Kun Scale to Qionghua Sect, while Mengli goes to Shouyang.</dc0>

original_text: 柳梦璃：好。
translation: Liu Mengli: Okay.

original_text: 槐米：喵～～～
translation: Huaimi: Meow~~~

original_text: 柳梦璃：槐米，我们走了，这次多谢了。下次再来看你，还有其他弟弟们。
translation: Liu Mengli: Huaimi, we're leaving. Thank you this time. We'll come see you and your brothers again.

original_text: 柳梦璃：对了，我会带很多很多离香草给你们～
translation: Liu Mengli: Right, I'll bring lots and lots of Parting Herb for you~

original_text: 槐米：喵，说话要算话哦！
translation: Huaimi: Meow, keep your promise!

original_text: 槐米：我和弟弟永远把你们当要好的朋友！
translation: Huaimi: My brothers and I will always consider you good friends!

original_text: 云天河：（……要好的……朋友……吗……）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (...Good..friends... huh...)

original_text: 飓夕：咦？！一定是有认识的妖给你们带路吧？不然居巢国怎么会有人进来？
translation: Stormdusk: Huh?! You must have a yaoguai you know leading the way, right? Otherwise, how could humans enter Juchao Kingdom?

original_text: 飓夕：居巢国有东南西北中五个区域，站在小平台上的圆圈里，一瞬间就能去别的区域了，最适合用来做游戏～
translation: Stormdusk: Juchao Kingdom has five areas: east, south, west, north, and center. Standing in the circle on the small platform instantly teleports you to other areas-perfect for games~

original_text: 飓夕：最近又来了许多妖，以后这里一定会更热闹，变成一个群妖聚集的好地方～
translation: Stormdusk: Many more yaos have come recently. This place will surely become livelier, a great gathering spot for yaos~

original_text: 燎翼：麻烦你们收好兵器，这里的妖大多都很弱小，受不起惊吓。
translation: Liaoyi: Please put away your weapons. Most yaoguais here are very weak and easily frightened.

original_text: 燎翼：居巢国的妖都不希望和外界起任何冲突，只想平平静静过日子，你们只要不伤害这里的妖，我们就能共处。
translation: Liaoyi: The yaoguais in Juchao Kingdom don't want any conflict with the outside world; they just wish to live peacefully. As long as you don't harm the yaoguais here, we can coexist.

original_text: 卫英：身为“巢卫队”的一员，就要以护卫居巢国为头等大事，时刻警惕有没有恶人入侵，这是队长对我们说的！
translation: Wei Ying: As a member of the 'Juchao Guard Team', protecting Juchao Kingdom is our top priority. We must always stay vigilant against invaders-that's what our captain told us!

original_text: 卫英：你也想加入“巢卫队”？虽然你是槐米他们的朋友，但是队长说过，人到底不可信，我们“巢卫队”只收妖，不收人～
translation: Wei Ying: You want to join the 'Juchao Guard'? Though you're friends with Huaimi and the others, our captain says humans can't be trusted. The 'Juchao Guard' only recruits yaoguais, not humans~

original_text: 卫英：最近都没什么人再溺水了，我们“巢卫队”也轻松很多，不然每次都把他们送回岸边，也够累的……
translation: Wei Ying: Lately, hardly anyone has been drowning, so our 'Juchao Guard' has it much easier. Otherwise, ferrying them back to shore every time was exhausting enough...

original_text: 冰儿：居巢国以前只是沉入湖底的古城，是巢祖带着一群能干的妖怪，把它修建成现在这样，后来我们就给巢祖建了一座神殿～
translation: Bing'er: Juchao Kingdom was originally just a sunken ancient city at the lake bottom. Nest Ancestor led a group of capable yaoguais to rebuild it into what it is now, so later we built a shrine for Nest Ancestor~

original_text: 冰儿：你们就是槐米的朋友？还救过他们？看来人有坏的，也有好的，好人就可以和我们做朋友～
translation: Bing'er: So you're Huaimi's friends? And you saved them? It seems some humans are bad, but some are good. Good people can be our friends~

original_text: 冰儿：来投奔居巢国的妖越来越多，看来世上还是有不少和我一样、不喜欢争斗的妖～
translation: Bing'er: More and more yaos are coming to Juchao Kingdom. Seems many in the world dislike fighting, just like me~

original_text: 絮烨：这儿很平静，没有大妖怪来欺负我们，一般人又进不来，不修炼也没关系，是我最喜欢的悠闲日子～
translation: Xu Ye: It's peaceful here; no big monsters bully us, and ordinary people can't enter. Not cultivating is fine too-it's my favorite leisurely days~

original_text: 絮烨：我们虽然不欢迎人，但如果是愿意和妖做朋友的，就另当别论了。
translation: Xu Ye: Although we do not welcome humans, those willing to befriend yaoguais are a different matter.

original_text: 絮烨：我看得多修几间房子了，不然妖越来越多，怎么住得下？
translation: Xu Ye: I think we need to build a few more houses. Otherwise, with more and more yaoguais, how will we all fit?

original_text: 麻八：我就奇怪了～你们是怎么和槐米认识的？一般人不是都不会和妖往来吗？当然，妖也不喜欢人就是了。
translation: PockEight: I'm just curious-how did you get to know Huaimi? Ordinary people don't usually interact with yaoguais, right? And of course, yaoguais don't like humans either.

original_text: 麻八：这段时间居巢国来了很多妖，一下子热闹起来了。以前只有我和铁钳两个玩捉迷藏，现在有好多妖怪能和我们一起玩！
translation: PockEight: Lots of yaoguais have come to Juchao Kingdom recently, and it's gotten lively all of a sudden. Before, only IronClaw and I played hide-and-seek, but now many yaoguais can play with us!

original_text: 大耳茸：以前我住在山上，本事不大，总是被山里的大妖怪欺负，现在搬到水里来，潮是潮了点，总算不被欺负了～
translation: Big Ear Rong: I used to live in the mountains. My skills weren't great, and I was always bullied by the big yaoguais there. Now I've moved into the water. It's a bit damp, but at least I'm not bullied anymore~

original_text: 大耳茸：唉，今天又做错事，被“巢卫队”的老大骂了，他的语气就不能好一点吗？……
translation: Big Ear Rong: Sigh, messed up again today, got scolded by the 'Juchao Guard' boss. Couldn't his tone be a bit nicer?...

original_text: 丝米：影棘上回带了个人类女子回来，从此就一直和她住在一块儿。那女的长得是不错啦～细皮嫩肉的，但是毕竟是人哎！影棘的想法还真古怪！
translation: Simi: Yingji brought back a human woman last time and has been living with her ever since. The woman is quite pretty~ with delicate skin, but she's human after all! Yingji's ideas are really strange!

original_text: 丝米：大家都说我们妖会魅惑人，其实人也会魅惑妖，影棘现在不就被他上次救回来的女子迷得七荤八素嘛～
translation: Simi: Everyone says we yaoguais can charm humans, but humans can charm yaoguais too. Yingji is now completely bewitched by the woman he saved last time~

original_text: 丝米：其实妖喜欢上人，也是说不清道理的……只是人的寿命那么短，到头来最痛苦的还是我们妖啊……
translation: Simi: Actually, there's no clear reason why a yaoguai falls for a human... It's just that human lifespans are so short; in the end, it's us yaoguais who suffer the most...

original_text: 沐璇：……啊？！你们也是人？
translation: Muxuan: ...Ah?! You're human too?

original_text: 云天河：对啊，你是不小心掉下来的吗？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Right, did you fall down by accident?

original_text: 沐璇：嗯……我被一个妖救了，喜欢上了他，我不在乎他是什么，只要能跟他今生今世在一起，我就心满意足了……所以不管你们是谁，求求你们别伤害这里的妖……
translation: Muxuan: Mm... I was saved by a yaoguai and fell in love with him. I don't care what he is; as long as I can be with him in this life, I am content... So no matter who you are, I beg you, please don't harm the yaoguais here...

original_text: 沐璇：当初我被黄天霸逼婚，无路可走只好投湖自尽……多亏影棘救了我，日子一久，我们之间便有了感情……
translation: Muxuan: Back then, forced into marriage by Huang Tianba, I had no choice but to drown myself... Thanks to Yingji saving me, over time, feelings grew between us...

original_text: 沐璇：这儿的妖怪从来不会特别为难我，他们只是看起来有点可怕，其实心地都很善良。
translation: Muxuan: The yaoguais here never trouble me much. They might look scary, but they're actually kind-hearted.

original_text: 霓蝶：其实妖怪也会生病受伤，生病受伤了也都要用药～这用的药呢～也和你们人用的差不多～
translation: Ni Die: Actually, yaoguais also get sick and injured, and when sick or injured, they need medicine too~ The medicine used~ is quite similar to what you humans use~

original_text: 霓蝶：沐璇是我见过的所有人中最最好的了，经常到我店里来帮忙不说，做了点心还不忘给我带一份～
translation: Ni Die: Muxuan is the very best of all the people I've met. Not only does she often come to my shop to help, but she also remembers to bring me dim sum when she makes snacks~

original_text: 霓蝶：这阵子居巢国来了许多妖怪，有几个身上还带着伤，大概是在外头被欺负了，才逃到我们这儿来。
translation: Ni Die: Lately, many yaoguais have come to Juchao Kingdom. Some are even injured, probably bullied outside before escaping to our place.

original_text: 哧溜：哎？又有人来啊？最近来居巢国的“人”也多起来，上回还看见影棘带了一个人类女子进来，这一待就再也不走了～
translation: Chiliu: Huh? humans? Recently, more 'humans' have been coming to Juchao Kingdom. Last time, I even saw Yingji bring a human woman in, and she stayed and never left~

original_text: 哧溜：有一回我偷了别的妖的东西，不巧被他发现，当时我拔起所有的腿就跑，他追也追不上，嘿嘿！
translation: Chiliu: Once I stole something from another yaoguai, but he caught me. I ran with all my legs, and he couldn't catch up, hehe!

original_text: 哧溜：本以为住这儿的妖越来越多，随便找几个偷点东西就能过活，没想到“巢卫队”管得挺严，成天被他们盯着，想做点坏事还真难！
translation: Chiliu: I thought with more yaoguais living here, I could just steal from a few to get by. Who knew the 'Juchao Guard' would be so strict, watching us all day-really hard to do anything shady!

original_text: 河颐：这里有许多殷商时留下的古物，刻着奇怪文字的龟板瓦片和青铜器，上面记载着制造青铜器的方法，我估计啊～所有的妖里大概也只有我能读懂这些字了～
translation: He Yi: There are many artifacts here from the Yin-Shang period-tortoise shells, pottery shards, and bronze hosts inscribed with strange characters. They record methods of bronze-making. I reckon~ among all the yaoguais, I'm probably the only one who can read these characters~

original_text: 河颐：我真正的兴趣不是开店，而是像人一样，开个学堂，教所有的妖认字～
translation: He Yi: My real interest isn't running a shop, but opening a school like humans do, teaching all yaoguais to read~

original_text: 泱瑢：沐璇做的糯米团子真好吃，有豆沙馅的，枣子馅的，还有桂花白糖的，连形状都小巧玲珑～
translation: Deepchime: Muxuan's glutinous rice balls are so delicious-filled with red bean paste, jujube paste, or osmanthus sugar. Even their shape is delicate and lovely~

original_text: 泱瑢：其实像我们这些小妖只要能够吃饱睡足就够了，哪里会想到去害人！很多事情，都是那些大妖怪做的，也算在我们头上……
translation: Deepchime: Actually, little yaoguais like us are content as long as we can eat well and sleep well. Why would we think of harming people? Many things are done by those big yaoguais, but we get blamed for them...

original_text: 泱瑢：既然你们帮过槐米他们，那么应该不是坏人，只是有两三个好人有什么用？大多数人还不是很讨厌妖怪……
translation: Deepchime: Since you've helped Huaimi and the others, you probably aren't bad people. But what good are two or three kind souls? Most people still despise yaoguais...

original_text: 泱瑢：一、二、三，开吃！……哇，好难吃～我做的糯米团子怎么总也不像沐璇做的那么好吃～
translation: Deepchime: One, two, three, let's eat! ... Wow, so bad~ My glutinous rice balls never turn out as delicious as Muxuan's~

original_text: 琰矍：我们“巢卫队”的成员，为了能保护居巢国的大家，每天都在用心修炼～我今天就是奉了队长之命，到铁钺铜爵来买练习用的兵器的！
translation: Yan Jue: We members of the 'Juchao Guard Team' train diligently every day to protect everyone in Juchao Kingdom! Today, I'm here at Iron & Bronze on our captain's orders to buy practice weapons!

original_text: 琰矍：看在你们救过妖的份上，“巢卫队”不会和你们为敌，但如果有一天你们伤了居巢国的妖，“巢卫队”一定不会罢休！
translation: Yan Jue: Since you've saved yaoguais, the 'Juchao Guard' won't oppose you. But if you ever harm yaoguais of the Juchao Kingdom, the 'Juchao Guard' will never let it go!

original_text: 琰矍：最近巡逻的时候都没看见什么人落水了，这是好事，我们也省去麻烦～
translation: Yan Jue: Lately, we haven't seen anyone falling into the water during patrols. That's good, it saves us trouble~

original_text: 碧岫栖：听长老说，当初巢祖为我们建好这个水底宫殿后，就游方四海去了，要是他现在回来，见到大家过得好好的，一定也好开心。
translation: Bi Xiuqi: I heard from the elders that after Ancestor Chao built this underwater palace for us, he wandered the world. If he returned now and saw everyone living well, he'd surely be very happy.

original_text: 碧岫栖：越来越多的妖来我们居巢国住了，那都是因为这里没有谁会欺负谁，更没有人来骚扰～
translation: Bi Xiuqi: More and more yaoguais are coming to live in our Juchao Kingdom, all because here no one bullies anyone, and no humans come to harass us~

original_text: 花红焱：这大锅上面歪歪扭扭刻的什么呀？比我随便画的还丑！
translation: Hua Hongyan: What are these crooked things carved on this big pot? They're even uglier than my random scribbles!

original_text: 花红焱：人还真奇怪，总喜欢把想法什么的用字记下来，哪像我们，从来都不用这样……啊！对了，是他们的记性太差啦～
translation: Hua Hongyan: Humans are odd, always recording thoughts with writing. Not like us, we never need to... Ah! Right, their memory is just too poor~

original_text: 花红焱：铁钺铜爵的河颐常说他要开什么书院，还说要教大家念龟壳瓦片上的字～那种东西，有什么好念的！
translation: Hua Hongyan: He Yi from Iron & Bronze often says he wants to open some academy and teach everyone to read the words on turtle shells and tiles~ What's so good about reading that stuff!

original_text: 影棘：自从我遇到沐璇的那天起，我就喜欢上她了！我发誓要永远和她在一起，她若死了，我就和她一起死!
translation: Yingji: Ever since the day I met Muxuan, I've liked her! I swear to be with her forever. If she dies, I'll die with her!

original_text: 影棘：我家的沐璇很温柔，长得也漂亮，而且还会做好吃的糯米团子，这里的妖都挺喜欢她～
translation: Yingji: My Muxuan is gentle, beautiful, and makes delicious glutinous rice balls. The yaoguais here all quite like her~

original_text: 影棘：这么多妖都喜欢我家沐璇的糯米团子，如果我们像人一样开一间团子铺，生意一定很红火～
translation: Yingji: So many spirits love Muxuan's glutinous rice balls. If we opened a rice ball shop like humans do, business would surely be booming~

original_text: 淼森：人界珍宝虽多，又哪有我们这里的稀罕？你见过像手掌大小的珍珠吗？光这一颗在人界可就价值连城呢～
translation: Miao Sen: The mortal realm has many treasures, but none as rare as ours. Have you seen a pearl the size of a palm? Just one would be priceless in the mortal realm~

original_text: 淼森：长老平时很少露面，看起来不管事，但发生在居巢国的大小事情，没有他不知道的。
translation: Miao Sen: The Elder rarely shows himself and seems uninvolved, but nothing big or small happens in Juchao Kingdom without his knowledge.

original_text: 曲酊：老弟，我说我们这差事还真不错，又清闲又威风～
translation: Qu Ding: Brother, I say our job is really good, both leisurely and impressive~

original_text: 耀咚：清闲是清闲，只是我加入“巢卫队”也有好久了，不知道什么时候才能受到队长重用呢……
translation: Yaodong: It's leisurely, but I've been in the 'Juchao Guard Team' for a long time. I wonder when I'll gain the captain's trust...

original_text: 曲酊：别白日做梦了～就我们这样，连只鸡都不敢杀的，还想受重用？还是安分点，做好份内的事就行～
translation: Qu Ding: Stop daydreaming~ The likes of us wouldn't even dare kill a chicken, how can we expect to be entrusted with important tasks? Better be content and just do our duties~

original_text: 耀咚：我不过随口说说……只是看着队长他们都在里头议事，我们却在门口守着，心里不是滋味……
translation: Yaodong: I was just saying it casually... It's just seeing the captain and the others all inside discussing matters while we're guarding the door, it doesn't sit right with me...

original_text: 曲酊：不断有其他地方的妖迁来，大家都想在这里定居，我们“巢卫队”的责任也越来越重了！
translation: Qu Ding: Yaoguais from other places keep migrating here. Everyone wants to settle down, so the responsibility of our 'Juchao Guard Team' grows heavier and heavier!

original_text: 耀咚：要是以后这里的妖更多了，不知道我这守卫还当不当得成？希望不会有其他妖怪来和我抢……
translation: Yaodong: If there are more yaos here in the future, I wonder if I can still keep this guard job? I hope no other yaoguais come to compete with me...

original_text: 咕噜：要是真有什么剑仙来了居巢国，“巢卫队”应该也没什么用吧？他们其实也都是弱小的妖怪……不过比我强了一点点……
translation: Gulu: If a real sword immortal came to Juchao Kingdom, the 'Juchao Guard' probably wouldn't be much use, right? They're actually weak yaoguais too... though a bit stronger than me...

original_text: 咕噜：这里的妖比从前多了，“巢卫队”也正打算增添人手，我想加入，就是不知道队长收不收我……
translation: Gulu: There are more yaoguais here now. The 'Juchao Guard' is planning to recruit more. I want to join, but I don't know if the captain will accept me...

original_text: 铁钳：啊！你怎么找到我的！我正在和别的妖玩捉迷藏，你可千万不要对别的妖说见过我！
translation: IronClaw: Ah! How did you find me! I'm playing hide-and-seek with other yaoguais, you mustn't tell any other yaoguai you've seen me!

original_text: 铁钳：最近和我一起玩捉迷藏的妖越来越多，能躲的地方就越来越少，三下两下全都被找到，真没意思～
translation: IronClaw: Lately, more and more yaoguais have been joining our game of hide-and-seek, so there are fewer places to hide. Everyone gets found in no time, so boring~

original_text: 普尖：我修炼成妖也才半年，法力都没多少，怎么和人斗？还好找到这么一个容身之所，以后再也不用怕会被人打死。
translation: Pujian: I've only been a yaoguai for half a year, with little magic power. How can I fight humans? Luckily, I found this shelter. I won't have to fear being beaten to death anymore.

original_text: 普尖：这里好是好，可惜没人血可吸，虽然我已经修炼成妖，不用吸血也能活，但总觉得不习惯……
translation: Pujian: This place is good, but there's no human blood to suck. Although I've cultivated into a yaoguai and can live without blood, I still feel unaccustomed...

original_text: 阿萍：我正在和大家玩捉迷藏，可是我刚到这里没几天，都不知道该藏哪儿～怎么办呢？
translation: A Ping: I'm playing hide-and-seek with everyone, but I just got here a few days ago and don't know where to hide~ What should I do?

original_text: 癞头：哇～你看，这里好宽敞好漂亮啊！以前在人界我只能住在山洞中，从来都没待过这么华丽的地方！
translation: Scabbyhead: Wow~ Look, it's so spacious and beautiful here! Back in the human realm, I could only live in caves-never stayed in such a splendid place!

original_text: 冥丝阴风：真是没见过世面！我皇宫都去过，那才叫富丽堂皇，到处都是奇珍异宝！不过嘛……作为一个容身之所，这里也马马虎虎啦。
translation: Mingsi Yinfeng: How provincial! I've been to the imperial palace-now that's magnificent, filled with rare treasures everywhere! But... as a place to stay, this is passable.

original_text: 癞头：这地方好就好在不会有什么剑仙、道士来捉妖，只要不用东躲西藏地过日子，就比什么都好！
translation: Scabbyhead: What's good about this place is that there won't be any sword immortals or Taoist priests coming to capture yaoguais. As long as we don't have to live in hiding, that's better than anything!

original_text: 冥丝阴风：听说这里的“巢卫队”正在招人手哎～我打定主意去了，凭我的实力～一定能行！
translation: Mingsi Yinfeng: I heard the 'Juchao Guard Team' here is recruiting~ I've decided to go. With my skills~ I'm sure to make it!

original_text: 火焱：没错没错，就是这个东西，让我好好钻研一番～
translation: FireBlaze: Yes, yes, this is the thing. Let me study it carefully~

original_text: 火焱：嗯～给你，这是我参悟所得，另外这个玲珑珊瑚，就当是换你的灵骨突吧。
translation: FireBlaze: Hmm~ here, this is what I've gained from my enlightenment. Also, this Exquisite Coral-consider it in exchange for your Spirit Spur.

original_text: 河颐：哈哈，正是这些兽皮和木炭没错！这回终于能开书院啦！现在先清理一下铺子，等我把铺子里所有的石头都卖完了，就安心开书院。
translation: He Yi: Haha, exactly these animal hides and charcoal! Finally, I can open a school! First, I'll clean up the shop. Once I sell all the stones in the shop, I'll open the school with peace of mind.

original_text: 开启新交易品
translation: New Trade Items Unlocked

original_text:
我听说百翎洲巨鸟身上的灵骨突蕴涵着特别的灵力，如果你能帮我找一块来，我可以教你使用其中灵力的方法。
你愿意帮我去找一块来吗？
translation:
I've heard that the Spirit Spur on the giant bird of Bailing Isle contain special spiritual power. If you can find one for me, I can teach you how to harness its power.
Will you help?

original_text:
这居巢国中，青铜鼎上记述着无数前朝旧事，却只有我才能看懂，实在无趣得很，不如开间书院，教大家都来认识认识这些字……不过开书院嘛，还缺十份兽皮和木炭来充当纸笔，你既然是人，要弄那些东西应该不难吧？
你愿意帮我去弄一些吗？
translation: In Juchao Kingdom, the bronze cauldron records countless old tales, but only I can read them. So boring. I might as well open a academy to teach everyone. For that, I need <colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>ten pieces of Beast Hide and Charcoal</colour><dc0> as paper and ink. You're human, so getting those should be easy, right? Will you help?</dc0>

original_text: 云天河：不能再回无常殿那边了，<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>要从南边的出口离开</colour><dc0>。</dc0>
translation: Yun Tianhe: Can't go back to the Hall of Impermanence area anymore.<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> Need to leave through the southern exit</colour><dc0>.</dc0>

original_text: 云天河：房门锁住了……
translation: Yun Tianhe: The door's locked...

original_text: 云天河：牢房锁住了……
translation: Yun Tianhe: The cell's locked...

original_text: 韩菱纱：……这里好阴森……我觉得好不舒服……
translation: Han Lingsha: ... This place is so eerie... I feel really uncomfortable...

original_text: 慕容紫英：悬浮在空中的，应该就是无常殿吧？
translation: Murong Ziying: That floating in the air, should be the Hall of Impermanence, right?

original_text: 云天河：快点！我们这就去取<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>翳影枝</colour><dc0>！</dc0>
translation: Yun Tianhe: Hurry up! Let's go get some <colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>Shadowveil Sprig</colour><dc0>!</dc0>

original_text: 韩菱纱：哎！等一下，我们连<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>翳影枝</colour><dc0>长在哪里都不知道，等会儿万一有了线索，你们先别行动，让我去，我手脚轻，才不会惊动周围！</dc0>
translation: Han Lingsha: Hey! Wait a moment, we don't even know<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> where Shadowveil Sprig grows</colour><dc0>. If we find a clue later, don't act first, let me go. I'm light on my feet and won't alert the surroundings!</dc0>

original_text: 云天河：好！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Okay!

original_text: 云天河：那边，好像有两个人在守着什么……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Over there, seems like two people guarding something...

original_text: 韩菱纱：哎？中间黑乎乎的那些，就是翳影枝吧？
translation: Han Lingsha: Huh? Those dark things in the middle, are they Shadowveil Sprig?

original_text: 韩菱纱：我过去瞧瞧！
translation: Han Lingsha: I'll go check it out!

original_text: 慕容紫英：你一切小心！若有万一，就喊我们！
translation: Murong Ziying: Be careful! If anything happens, call for us!

original_text: 韩菱纱：小紫英～你怎么对我这么没信心，别的做不好，偷东西我可是从没出过差错！
translation: Han Lingsha: Little Ziying~ Why so little faith in me? I might not be good at other things, but I've never messed up stealing!

original_text: 慕容紫英：……
translation: Murong Ziying: ...

original_text: 韩菱纱：好了！我走了，你放宽心，嘻嘻～
translation: Han Lingsha: Alright! I'm leaving, you relax, hehe~

original_text: 鬼卒甲：唉……每天守着这翳影枝，真是无聊死了，这东西在鬼界又不稀奇，谁会想偷拿……
translation: Ghost Guard A: Sigh... Guarding this Shadowveil Sprig every day is so boring. It's not even rare in the ghost realm, who'd want to steal it...

original_text: 鬼卒乙：这翳影枝确实一点都不稀奇，但能让我们鬼卒任意往来六界，对他界生灵来说，应该是求也求不到的宝贝吧！
translation: Ghost Guard B: This Shadowveil Sprig may seem utterly unremarkable, but it allows us ghost guards to travel freely across the Six Realms. For beings of other realms, it must be a treasure beyond their wildest dreams!

original_text: 鬼卒乙：别抱怨了～你嫌这差事不好，难道想被调进无常殿当差，那可是累到不行！
translation: Ghost Guard B: Stop complaining~ You dislike this duty, but would you rather be transferred to the Impermanence Hall? That's exhausting!

original_text: 鬼卒甲：累的差事我才不干……我只是常常想，我们离转轮镜台那么近，却一次也没溜去看过……
translation: Ghost Guard A: Tiring tasks I won't do... I just often think, we're so close to the Wheel Mirror Terrace, yet never sneaked a look...

original_text: 鬼卒乙：哦？原来你也听说过啊，要是站在转轮镜前，诚心想念，就会见到死去亲人的魂魄，可是，你还有亲人在鬼界吗？
translation: Ghost Guard B: Oh? So you've heard of it too. If you stand before the Wheel Mirror and sincerely yearn, you'll see the spirits of deceased loved ones. But do you still have family in the ghost realm?

original_text: 鬼卒甲：我哪知道……他们去投胎，也不一定告诉我……
translation: Ghost Guard A: How would I know... They don't necessarily tell me when they go to be reborn...

original_text: 鬼卒乙：好了好了，别多话，专心看着这几根树枝……
translation: Ghost Guard B: Alright, alright, stop talking. Focus on watching these branches...

original_text: 鬼卒乙：唉，好睏……
translation: Ghost Guard B: Sigh, so sleepy...

original_text: 鬼卒甲：什么声音？
translation: Ghost Guard A: What was that sound?

original_text: 鬼卒乙：喂，你听错了吧？
translation: Ghost Guard B: Hey, you misheard, right?

original_text: 鬼卒甲：是吗？我活着的时候耳朵是不太灵光，想不到死了也还是不灵……
translation: Ghost Guard A: Really? My ears weren't very sharp when I was alive, never thought they'd still be dull after death...

original_text: 鬼卒乙：这不就得了……
translation: Ghost Guard B: That's more like it...

original_text: 韩菱纱：看，三根翳影枝到手！
translation: Han Lingsha: Look, three Shadowveil Spriges obtained!

original_text: 韩菱纱：幸好那两个看守鬼卒呆呆的，反应又慢，不过我不敢拿太多，真被发现就惨了。
translation: Han Lingsha: Luckily those two ghost guards were dim-witted and slow to react. But I didn't dare take too much; getting caught would be terrible.

original_text: 云天河：太棒了！菱纱你果然是大大的盗贼，太厉害了！这下我们可以回去了？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Fantastic! Lingsha, you really are a great bandit, so amazing! Can we go back now?

original_text: 慕容紫英：先找找线索，看有什么办法回到人界吧。
translation: Murong Ziying: Let's first look for clues, see if there's a way to return to the human realm.

original_text: 韩菱纱：我、我有一个想去的地方……
translation: Han Lingsha: I, I have a place I want to go...

original_text: 云天河：啊？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Huh?

original_text: 韩菱纱：刚才……我听那两个鬼卒说，<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>在无常殿的不远处有个叫转轮镜台的地方，</colour><dc0>要是在那里诚心想念，就能见到死去亲人的魂魄……当然，一定要还没有投胎的……</dc0>
translation: Han Lingsha: Just now...
