I heard those two ghost guards say,<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> near the Hall of Impermanence, there's a place called the Wheel Mirror Terrace,</colour><dc0> where if you sincerely think of them, you can see the spirits of deceased loved ones... Of course, only those who haven't been reincarnated yet...</dc0>

original_text: 韩菱纱：我……很想见一见伯父……
translation: Han Lingsha: I...really want to meet my Uncle...

original_text: 云天河：可以见到死去的亲人？是真的吗？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Can see the deceased? Is that true?

original_text: 云天河：那我也想见爹，我有好多话想问他！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Then I want to see father too, I have so much to ask him!
Han Lingsha: ......
Yun Tianhe: ......

original_text: 慕容紫英：你们……别看我，我虽然不想节外生枝，但是你们都想去，我当然也只有奉陪。
translation: Murong Ziying: You all... Don't look at me. Though I don't want complications, since you all want to go, of course I'll accompany you.

original_text: 云天河：哈哈，真的吗？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Haha, really?

original_text: 韩菱纱：嘻嘻～小紫英，我就知道你最好了。
translation: Han Lingsha: Hehe~ Little Ziying, I knew you were the best.

original_text: 韩菱纱：不过～你都没有想要见的亲人吗？
translation: Han Lingsha: But~ don't you have any relatives you want to see?

original_text: 慕容紫英：……我幼时体弱，家中怕我命不长久，将我送上昆仑山修行，自那以后，再也未有联络，可以说此生亲缘极淡，无所记挂。
translation: Murong Ziying: ...In my childhood, I was frail. My family, fearing I wouldn't live long, sent me to cultivate on Kunlun Mountain. Since then, there's been no contact. One could say my familial ties in this life are extremely faint, with nothing to cling to.

original_text: 韩菱纱：……原来是这样哦。
translation: Han Lingsha: ... So that's how it is.

original_text: 韩菱纱：（总觉得紫英虽然从来都不提，但心里一定还是很难过的吧……）
translation: Han Lingsha: (I always feel that although Ziying never mentions it, he must still be very sad deep down...)

original_text: 云天河：我们别等了，走吧！那个台子在哪里？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Let's not wait anymore, let's go! Where is that terrace?

original_text: 韩菱纱：<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>我也只知道在无常殿附近</colour><dc0>啊，要找找看。</dc0>
translation: Han Lingsha:<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> I only know it's near the Hall of Impermanence</colour><dc0>, we'll have to search around.</dc0>

original_text: 云天河：……好大一面镜子，只要在这里喊爹，他就会出现吗？
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... Such a big mirror, if I shout for Father here, will he appear?

original_text: 韩菱纱：不是喊啦！是在心里诚心想念，灵不灵不晓得，只有试试看了。
translation: Han Lingsha: Not shouting! It's sincerely thinking in your heart. Not sure if it works, but we can only try.

original_text: 云天河：（……爹，孩儿、孩儿有好多话想和你说，要是你能听到，就来跟孩儿见上一面吧！）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (...Father, I... I have so much I want to tell you. If you can hear me, please come and meet with me!)

original_text: 韩菱纱：（……大伯，我好想你，你能来见一见菱纱吗？……）
translation: Han Lingsha: (......Uncle, I miss you so much. Could you come see Lingsha?......)

original_text: 云天河：……好像……什么都没有……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ...Seems like... there's nothing at all...

original_text: 韩菱纱：说不定……他们都已经投胎去了……
translation: Han Lingsha: Maybe... they've already been reincarnated...

original_text: 慕容紫英：……我看那边似乎另有出口，不如我们过去看看。
translation: Murong Ziying: ... I see there seems to be another exit over there. Why don't we go check it out?

original_text: 云天河：……好吧。
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... Alright.

original_text: 云天河：（……爹真的投胎去了？还是他气我把墓室弄坏了，所以不想见我？）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (...Did Father really reincarnate? Or is he angry that I ruined the tomb, so he doesn't want to see me?)

original_text: ？？：野小子？！是你？！
translation: ???: Wild kid?! Is it you?!
Yun Tianhe: ...!!

original_text: 云天河：爹！！真的是爹？！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Father!! It's really Father?!

original_text: 云天河：孩儿、孩儿好想你！！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Your son, your son misses you so much!!

original_text: 云天青：你这小子！怎么会在这里？难道你已经……已经——
translation: Yun Tianqing: You brat! Why are you here? Could it be you've already... already-

original_text: 云天河：爹，孩儿还没死啦……只不过因为一些事，来了鬼界，还要回阳间的。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Father, your son isn't dead yet... It's just because of some matters, I came to the Ghost Realm, and I still need to return to the mortal world.

original_text: 云天青：什么？你这小子，玩来玩去竟玩到鬼界来了！这里可不是你说来就来、说走就走的地方！
translation: Yun Tianqing: What? You brat, fooling around and actually ended up in the Ghost Realm! This isn't a place you can come and go as you please!

original_text: 云天河：爹…………
translation: Yun Tianhe: Father......

original_text: 云天青：怎么？才几年不见，野小子都长这么大了，好像烦恼也多了起来，没以前那么天不怕地不怕的神情了～
translation: Yun Tianqing: What? It's only been a few years, the wild kid has grown so big, seems like worries have increased too, not as fearless and carefree as before~

original_text: 云天河：爹……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Father...

original_text: 云天青：你啊！到底是来干嘛的？！再不说老子走人了！
translation: Yun Tianqing: You! What exactly are you here for?! If you don't speak up, I'm leaving!

original_text: 云天河：爹你别走！孩儿有好多事想问你！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Father, don't go! Your son has many things to ask you!

original_text: 云天河：你和娘……你们当初为什么要离开琼华派？害得大哥、不，玄霄，害他被冰封在禁地十九年？
translation: Yun Tianhe: You and Mother... why did you leave Qionghua Sect back then? Causing Big Bro-no, Xuanxiao-to be sealed in ice in the forbidden area for nineteen years?

original_text: 云天青：……果然，我就知道你这小子出现，一定没好事，这么久以前的陈年旧事，都被扯出来了。
translation: Yun Tianqing: ...As expected, I knew your appearance meant trouble. Such old matters from long ago dragged out again.

original_text: 云天河：爹，你告诉孩儿吧！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Father, please tell your son!

original_text: 云天青：你先告诉我，你怎么会知道这些事的？
translation: Yun Tianqing: First tell me, how do you know about these things?

original_text: 云天河：……孩儿……那个…………
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... I... that... ...

original_text: 韩菱纱：哎呀！还是我来说吧。
translation: Han Lingsha: Aiyah! Let me explain.

original_text: 韩菱纱：都是我不好，我以为前辈是传说中的剑仙，墓室里一定有些长生秘宝，所以闯入前辈的墓中，天河追来阻止我，谁知那墓室却塌了，他很害怕前辈责怪他，又很想知道前辈以前的事，所以就下了山……
translation: Han Lingsha: It's all my fault. I thought you two were legendary sword immortals and that your tomb must hold secrets to immortality, so I broke in. Tianhe chased after me to stop me, but then the tomb collapsed. He was afraid you would blame him, and he also wanted to know about his parents' past, so he went down the mountain...

original_text: 韩菱纱：后来发生了许多事情，我们拜入昆仑琼华派，还结识了被关在禁地里的玄霄……
translation: Han Lingsha: Later, many things happened. We joined the Kunlun Qionghua Sect and even met Xuanxiao, who was imprisoned in the forbidden area...

original_text: 云天青：怎会如此？！你这小子，尽会找麻烦！墓室竟被你搞塌了……还有，我不想你修仙，你偏偏跑去琼华派！真是欠揍！
translation: Yun Tianqing: How could this happen?! You troublemaker! You actually collapsed the tomb chamber... And I didn't want you cultivating immortality, yet you ran off to Qionghua Sect! You really need a beating!

original_text: 云天河：爹……你怎么打孩儿都行，但是能不能告诉孩儿，当初你和娘为什么要……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Father... You can beat me all you want, but can you tell me, back then, why did you and Mother...

original_text: 云天青：知道这件事，对你未必有好处，但如果你很想知道，爹还是会说，毕竟你也长大了，我不能永远把你当小孩子看。
translation: Yun Tianqing: Knowing this might not necessarily be good for you, but if you really want to know, I'll still tell you. After all, you've grown up, and I can't keep treating you like a child forever.

original_text: 云天河：……孩儿，想要知道！
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... Your son wants to know!

original_text: 云天青：……你可知我为什么一直没有去投胎？
translation: Yun Tianqing: ...Do you know why I never reincarnated?

original_text: 云天青：因为……我愧对师兄，所以我在阴间等着他。他不来，我不会走，我要亲口对他说声对不起。
translation: Yun Tianqing: Because... I feel guilty toward my Martial Brother, so I'm waiting for him in the Netherworld. I won't leave until he comes. I want to apologize to him in person.

original_text: 云天青：哈，你那什么痛苦表情？真以为我和你娘是十恶不赦的人了？
translation: Yun Tianqing: Ha, what's with that pained expression? Did you really think your mother and I were heinous villains?

original_text: 云天河：我……
translation: Yun Tianhe: I...

original_text: 云天青：我告诉你，我们二人，确实是负过师兄的性命……就算后来没有亲眼所见，我也知道他过得生不如死……但是，我和你娘，从未负过他的情谊。
translation: Yun Tianqing: I tell you, the two of us indeed owe Martial Brother as much as a life... Even though we didn't witness it later, I know he lived a life worse than death... But, your mother and I never betrayed his friendship.

original_text: 云天河：孩儿不懂……
translation: Yun Tianhe: I don't understand...

original_text: 云天青：你既然知道师兄之事，是否也知道琼华派修炼双剑之事？
translation: Yun Tianqing: Since you know about Xuanxiao's matter, do you also know about Qionghua Sect's dual sword cultivation?

original_text: 云天青：想要飞升成仙，就必须拥有强大的灵力，修炼百年，所得不过尔尔，倒不如网缚妖界，从他们那里夺取灵力……当时，门派中很多人都觉得这是个绝妙之法。
translation: Yun Tianqing: To ascend and become an immortal, one must possess immense spiritual power. Cultivating for a hundred years yields only meager gains. It would be better to ensnare the yao realm and seize their power... At the time, many in our sect thought this was a brilliant method.

original_text: 云天青：但是妖界又岂会乖乖就范？于是，双方争斗不休，场面十分惨烈……
translation: Yun Tianqing: But how could the yao realm just submit? Thus, both sides fought endlessly, the scene utterly brutal...

original_text: 云天青：我如今想来，仍觉心寒……我虽然并不讨厌妖，却也不会喜欢妖，但我忍受不了，自己升仙却要以其他生灵的命作为代价……
translation: Yun Tianqing: Thinking back now, it still chills me... Although I don't hate yaoguais, I don't like them either, yet I couldn't bear ascending to immortality at the cost of other living beings' lives...

original_text: 云天青：那段日子，简直像在炼狱一般，许多弟子见妖就杀，连幼儿也不放过……琼华派同样死伤不少，连掌门都被杀死，虽然那以后妖界之主不再露面，但再次出现之时，又有何人能够抵挡？
translation: Yun Tianqing: Those days were like living in hell. Many disciples killed any yaoguais they saw, not sparing even children... Qionghua Sect also suffered many casualties, even the sect leader was killed. Though the Mistress of the Yao Realm hasn't appeared since, when she does return, who could possibly resist?

original_text: 云天青：渐渐地，门派中有了不同意见，一派主张继续打下去，另一派则主张放妖界离去，减少己方伤亡。
translation: Yun Tianqing: Gradually, different opinions emerged within the sect. One faction advocated continuing the fight, while the other argued for letting the yao realm leave to reduce our own casualties.

original_text: 云天青：我觉得，再打下去，也只是生灵涂炭，不管是人还是妖……眼看当初一同入门的师兄弟，一个接一个地死去，变成冷冰冰的尸骨，就像一场噩梦……
translation: Yun Tianqing: I think continuing to fight would only lead to widespread suffering, whether for humans or yaoguais... Watching fellow disciples who entered the sect together die one after another, turning into cold bones, it was like a nightmare...

original_text: 云天青：夙玉和我想的一样，她不愿再使用望舒剑，长老们虽说会考虑她的话，其实却只是拖延时间，想让她与玄霄继续网缚住妖界。
translation: Yun Tianqing: Suyu thought the same as me. She refused to use Wangshu Sword again. The elders said they'd consider her words, but they were just stalling, wanting her and Xuanxiao to continue binding the yao realm.

original_text: 云天青：还有一人……本是与我们俩最亲密之人，却又与我们想的完全不同。
translation: Yun Tianqing: And another person... originally the closest to both of us, yet whose thoughts were completely different from ours.

original_text: 云天河：那个人……就是……玄霄？
translation: Yun Tianhe: That person... is... Xuanxiao?

original_text: 云天青：不错。师兄他非常清楚自己想要什么，绝不会半途而废。我和夙玉虽想劝他，反被他大骂妇人之仁……
translation: Yun Tianqing: Exactly. Martial Brother knows very clearly what he wants and would never give up halfway. Though Suyu and I tried to persuade him, he instead scolded us for being overly sentimental...

original_text: 云天青：被自己私心爱慕的人痛骂，夙玉当时已是伤心欲绝。这个时候又有弟子说我是叛徒，因为他们看到我救了一只年幼的、身受重伤的妖。
translation: Yun Tianqing: Being harshly scolded by the person she secretly admired, Suyu was already heartbroken. Then, some disciples called me a traitor because they saw me rescue a young, severely injured yaoguai.

original_text: 韩菱纱：……！
translation: Han Lingsha: ...!

original_text: 云天青：我和夙玉已无法可想，妖界就算是强弩之末，也绝对会战个不死不休，唯一能阻止这场大战的，惟有我们带着望舒剑逃下山去，这样琼华派升仙的美梦也就化为了泡影。
translation: Yun Tianqing: Suyu and I were at our wits' end. Even if the yao realm was at its last gasp, they would certainly fight to the death. The only way to stop this great battle was for us to take Wangshu Sword and flee down Kunlun mountain. That way, Qionghua Sect's dream of ascension would come to naught.

original_text: 云天青：我们趁夜逃出门派……后来的事你多少也知道一些，夙玉没有羲和之力的支撑，渐渐被冰寒侵体，我运功替她抵御寒气，却是杯水车薪……
translation: Yun Tianqing: We fled the sect under cover of night... You know some of what happened later. Without the support of Xihe's power, Suyu was gradually invaded by cold. I used my energy to help her resist the chill, but it was like a drop in the bucket...

original_text: 云天青：我不死心，在黄山诸峰之间，寻找传说中的阴阳紫阙——
translation: Yun Tianqing: I refused to give up, searching among the peaks of Mount Huang for the legendary Yin-Yang Celestial Jades-

original_text: 韩菱纱：呀！阴阳紫阕！
translation: Han Lingsha: Yikes! Yin-Yang Celestial Jades!

original_text: 云天青：原来姑娘你也知道那件宝物啊，难得！我少年时游历江湖，听说过许多奇珍异宝，阴阳紫阙就是其中之一。
translation: Yun Tianqing: So you know of that treasure too, miss? How rare! In my youth, traveling the world, I heard of many rare treasures; the Yin-Yang Celestial Jades was one of them.

original_text: 云天青：当时也是再没有其他办法了，我想到用阴阳紫阙“阳”的那一半，抑制夙玉身上的寒气……
translation: Yun Tianqing: Back then, there was no other way. I thought of using the 'yang' half of the Yin-Yang Celestial Jades to suppress Suyu's cold energy...

original_text: 云天河：爹，那后来呢？你找到了吗？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Father, what happened next? Did you find it?

original_text: 云天青：……差不多把整个黄山都找遍了，我终于寻得“阳”的那一半，给夙玉服下，她的身体果然好转，我们以为这样就没事了……没多久就成了亲，定居在黄山青鸾峰上……
translation: Yun Tianqing: ...After searching almost the entire Mount Huang, I finally found the 'Yang' half and gave it to Suyu to take. Her health indeed improved. We thought everything would be fine then... Not long after, we married and settled on Qingluan Peak of Mount Huang...

original_text: 云天青：可是……后来还是不行，夙玉的身体时好时坏，生下你之后，不久便过世了，但奇怪的是，我们一直担心你会先天体寒，你却十分健康……
translation: Yun Tianqing: But... later it still didn't work. Suyu's health fluctuated, and soon after giving birth to you, she passed away. Strangely, we were always worried you'd be born with a cold constitution, but you turned out very healthy...

original_text: 云天青：我因为曾替夙玉运功驱寒，也被冰寒之气反噬，过不了几年便这样归位了，唉～
translation: Yun Tianqing: Because I once helped Suyu circulate energy to dispel cold, I also suffered backlash from the icy energy. In a few years, I passed on like this, sigh~

original_text: 云天青：这就是全部的事了。有些事说严重也很严重，说不严重也很不严重，就看你怎么想了。
translation: Yun Tianqing: That's the whole story. Some matters can be seen as very serious or not serious at all-it all depends on how you think about it.

original_text: 云天河：嗯……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Mm...

original_text: 云天青：天河，你如今身体可有不适？会不会怕冷？
translation: Yun Tianqing: Tianhe, are you feeling unwell now? Are you afraid of the cold?

original_text: 云天河：孩儿一切都好，并不会像爹和娘那样……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Your son is doing fine, won't be like Father and Mother...

original_text: 云天青：这就太好了，就算你小时候看来没什么，我也还是放心不下。
translation: Yun Tianqing: That's great, even if you seemed fine as a kid, I still couldn't stop worrying.

original_text: 韩菱纱：前辈，您说、您说天河的娘爱慕着玄霄，那她……
translation: Han Lingsha: Senior, you said, you said Tianhe's mother admired Xuanxiao, then she...

original_text: 云天青：……我知道你想问什么……不过，夙玉她深心里究竟爱着谁、亦或怨着谁，怕是只有她自己才知晓……
translation: Yun Tianqing: ...I know what you want to ask... But as for who Suyu truly loved in her heart, or who she resented, I'm afraid only she herself would know...

original_text: 云天青：至少，在她刚入师门时，眼里根本没有我，只有玄霄师兄……
translation: Yun Tianqing: At least, when she first joined the sect, her eyes didn't have me in mind at all, only Martial Brother Xuanxiao...

original_text: 云天青：那一天在剑舞坪，当我和师兄第一次见到夙玉……她那时的模样，我永远都忘不了，她就好像后山的凤凰花一样美，虽然神色冷冷淡淡，眼里却透着明澈聪慧……
translation: Yun Tianqing: That day on Sword Dance Terrace, when my Martial Brother and I first saw Suyu... I'll never forget how she looked. She was as beautiful as the phoenix flowers on rear mountain. Though her expression was cool, her eyes shone with clarity and wisdom...

original_text: 云天青：虽然我和夙玉都是不信天命之人，但是如今回想起来，或许从那一刻起，我们三人之间的某些东西，已是不可更改了……
translation: Yun Tianqing: Although Suyu and I both didn't believe in fate, looking back now, perhaps from that moment on, something between the three of us had already become unchangeable...

original_text: 云天青：夙玉的性情外柔内刚，兼之以望舒剑修炼，身染阴寒，性情中更是有着相当绝决的一面。当初师兄与她决裂，令她十分伤心，日后嫁我，至死都不再提“玄霄”二字。
translation: Yun Tianqing: Suyu's nature was soft on the outside but strong within. Coupled with cultivating with Wangshu Sword, she was tainted by yin cold, and her disposition held a rather resolute side. Back then, when Martial Brother broke with her, it hurt her deeply. Later, when she married me, until her death she never mentioned the name 'Xuanxiao' again.

original_text: 云天青：可我知道，夙玉一直没有忘记那个人……她临死前的几天，被冰寒侵体，心魔深种，已经六亲不认，却忽尔清醒了一瞬，只求我一件事，便是把灵光藻玉放在她身边作为陪葬。
translation: Yun Tianqing: But I know, Suyu never forgot that person... In her final days, consumed by icy cold and inner demonic madness, she no longer recognized anyone. Yet she suddenly had a moment of clarity, begging me for just one thing-to bury the Spiritual Light Jade with her.

original_text: 云天青：我知道，灵光藻玉这世上只有两块，是打开琼华派禁地大门的秘钥，她与师兄于禁地修炼双剑时各持一块，对她来说，有着不凡的意义……
translation: Yun Tianqing: I know there are only two Spiritual Light Jades in the world, secret keys to open the forbidden area of Qionghua Sect. She and her Martial Brother each held one while cultivating dual swords in the forbidden area. To her, it held extraordinary meaning...

original_text: 云天河：……那，孩儿把那块玉带出墓室，不是会让娘很伤心？
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... Then, since I took that jade out of the tomb, wouldn't that make Mother very sad?

original_text: 云天青：无妨，夙玉她已转世去了，再也不会为任何人伤心。
translation: Yun Tianqing: It's fine. Suyu has already reincarnated, will never be sad for anyone again.

original_text: 云天河：……为什么？娘不像你一样，等着玄霄呢？
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... Why doesn't Mother wait for Xuanxiao like you do?

original_text: 云天青：……夙玉曾告诉我，她这一世活得太累，耗了太多心力，若是死了，一定会很快投胎，让一切重新开始，把这一世的喜怒哀乐通通忘记。她是个说到做到的人，早就已经入了轮回吧……
translation: Yun Tianqing: ...Suyu once told me she lived this life too tired, expended too much mental efforts. If she died, she would reincarnate quickly, start everything anew, forget all the joys and sorrows of this life. She was a woman of her word, probably already entered the cycle of rebirth...

original_text: 云天河：……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ...

original_text: 慕容紫英：云前辈……你刚才所说，曾经救下一个年幼的妖，指的可是柳梦璃？
translation: Murong Ziying: Senior Yun... Earlier, you mentioned saving a young yao child-were you referring to Liu Mengli?

original_text: 云天青：不错，你们……竟也认识璃儿？
translation: Yun Tianqing: Well, you... actually know Lili too?

original_text: 慕容紫英：她是妖！？但是为何她……
translation: Murong Ziying: She's a yaoguai?! But why does she...

original_text: 云天青：哈，你这小子，真是无聊得很，一看就知道是琼华派教出来的！什么人啊妖啊，有必要分那么清楚吗？
translation: Yun Tianqing: Ha, you kid, you're really quite boring, I can tell at a glance you were taught by the Qionghua Sect! What's the point of distinguishing so clearly between humans and yaoguais?

original_text: 慕容紫英：前辈……
translation: Murong Ziying: Senior...

original_text: 云天青：你看看这鬼界，一旦阳寿尽了，都是鬼魂，不分人与妖，说不定你今世是人，来世便要做妖，那你一直坚持的东西岂不可笑？！
translation: Yun Tianqing: Look at this ghost realm-once mortal life ends, all are ghosts, no distinction between humans and yaoguais. You might be a human in this life, but a yao in the next. Then what you stubbornly cling to would be laughable, wouldn't it?!

original_text: 慕容紫英：……！今世是人，来世做妖……
translation: Murong Ziying: ...! A human in this life, a yaoguai in the next life ...

original_text: 云天青：小子，你自己慢慢想去吧，最好想得通透点！
translation: Yun Tianqing: Kid, you think it over slowly yourself, best think it through clearly!

original_text: 慕容紫英：…………
translation: Murong Ziying: ......

original_text: 韩菱纱：（今世是人，来世做妖……）
translation: Han Lingsha: (A human in this life, a yaoguai in the next life ...)

original_text: 韩菱纱：（紫英……他的心里一定很不好受吧？多年以来在琼华派所知道的观念，居然……居然有一天变的什么都不是了……）
translation: Han Lingsha: (Ziying... He must be feeling really bad inside, right? All the beliefs he's held in the Qionghua Sect for so many years... actually... one day turned out to be nothing at all...)

original_text: 云天青：天河，告诉爹，你又是如何认识璃儿的？
translation: Yun Tianqing: Tianhe, tell Father, how did you come to know Lili?

original_text: 云天河：孩儿是在寿阳认识她的，后来我们一起去了琼华派，可是……妖界来时，她却跳进了那个入口，失踪了……
translation: Yun Tianhe: I met her in Shouyang, and later we went to the Qionghua Sect together, but... when the yao realm arrived, she jumped into that entrance and disappeared...

original_text: 云天青：……妖比人早慧，或许她已经找回记忆了……
translation: Yun Tianqing: ...Yaoguais mature earlier than humans, perhaps she has already regained her memories...

original_text: 云天青：不对！！没有双剑网缚，璃儿怎有机会回妖界？！就算望舒剑重回琼华派，剑未苏醒，他们根本用不了啊！
translation: Yun Tianqing: No!! Without the dual swords ensnaring it, how could Lili have had a chance to return to the yao realm?! Even if Wangshu Sword returned to Qionghua Sect, if the sword hasn't awakened, no way they can use it!

original_text: 云天河：爹？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Father?

original_text: 云天青：不可能、这不可能，除非有个人，与夙玉一般……
translation: Yun Tianqing: Impossible, this is impossible, unless there is someone, like Suyu...

original_text: 云天青：姑娘，你——！！
translation: Yun Tianqing: Miss, you-!!

original_text: 云天河：爹！——
translation: Yun Tianhe: Father!-

original_text: 雅：快走！快走！
translation: Ya: Hurry! Go! Go!

original_text: 云天河：什么？！
translation: Yun Tianhe: What?!

original_text: 风：无常殿已经把转轮镜台的灵力暂时消去了，他们发现你们了！
translation: Feng: The Hall of Impermanence has temporarily dispelled the power of the Mirror. They've discovered you!

original_text: 云天河：那我爹——
translation: Yun Tianhe: Then my father-

original_text: 颂：走吧，他不会再出现了……
translation: Song: You should leave, he won't appear again...

original_text: 云天河：爹……他不会有事吧？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Father... Will he be alright?

original_text: 雅：有事的是你们！
translation: Ya: You're the ones in trouble!

original_text: 风：对啊，我们可是一番好心，才来示警的，要是被发现，这个月的俸禄又没了。
translation: Feng: Right, we came to warn you out of kindness. If we get caught, our salary for this month is gone again.

original_text: ？？：风雅颂，你们这三只笨鸟，还不快离开！被发现我可不救你们！
translation: ???: Feng, Ya, Song, you three dumb birds, hurry up and leave! If you're discovered, I won't save you!

original_text: 颂：闪了、闪了……
translation: Song: Gotta go, gotta go...

original_text: 韩菱纱：你是……？
translation: Han Lingsha: You are...?

original_text: ？？：我叫壬癸，是个鬼差。
translation: ??: I'm Rengui, a ghost officer.

original_text: 壬癸：你们快走吧，马上就会有大批的鬼卒追过来了，转轮镜台是不许私会鬼魂的。
translation: Rengui: You must leave quickly. A large number of ghost guards will be chasing after you soon. Private meetings with spirits are forbidden at the Wheel Mirror Terrace.

original_text: 云天河：但是……
translation: Yun Tianhe: But...

original_text: 壬癸：别但是了！抓紧时间，<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>往南面的出口走，就可以去放逐渊了</colour><dc0>，那里是孤魂野鬼聚集之地，鬼卒也不容易搜寻，你们快来！我在那里等你们！</dc0>
translation: Rengui: No buts! Hurry up, head south through the exit to reach Exile Abyss. It's where lost souls gather, and ghost guards rarely search there. Come quickly! I'll wait for you!

original_text: 韩菱纱：现在怎么办……？
translation: Han Lingsha: What do we do now...?

original_text: 云天河：那个人……不是让我们去南边找他吗？
translation: Yun Tianhe: That person... didn't he tell us to catch him in the south?

original_text: 韩菱纱：可是……我都没有见到大伯……
translation: Han Lingsha: But... I didn't even get to see my Uncle...

original_text: 慕容紫英：不能再等了，我们已经惊动鬼界，再不走就来不及了！
translation: Murong Ziying: We can't wait any longer. We've alerted the ghost realm-if we don't leave now, it'll be too late!

original_text: 云天河：……走吧……爹好像还有很重要的话想说，最后也没有说，就不见了……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... Let's go... Father seemed to have something very important to say, but in the end didn't say it, and then was gone...

original_text: 韩菱纱：大伯……
translation: Han Lingsha: Uncle...

original_text: 甲丑：你们是新鬼？既然无人拘束，应该已经是要跳轮回井了，怎么还跑来无常殿！快滚！小心秦广王发怒，问你们的罪！
translation: Jia Chou: New ghosts? Since no one's restraining you, you should be heading to the Reincarnation Well. Why come to Impermanence Hall! Scram! Be careful King Qinguang gets angry and punishes you!

original_text: 书勤：咦？！迷路的新鬼吗？快逃！快逃！！要是被无常殿的秦广王发现，那就完了……
translation: Shu Qin: Huh?! A lost new ghost? Run! Run!! If discovered by King Qinguang of Impermanence Hall, it's over...

original_text: 夏小永：……我在这里待了好久……可还是不敢靠近无常殿后面的转轮镜台……怎么办……我只是想见一见亲人的魂魄，轮回井离这里太远，听说在转轮镜台上诚心诚意地祈求，亲人也是会出现的……
translation: Xia Xiaoyong: ...I've been here for a long time... but I still don't dare approach the Wheel Mirror Terrace behind the Hall of Impermanence... What should I do... I just want to see the spirits of my loved ones. The Reincarnation Well is too far from here. I heard that if you pray sincerely on the Mirror Terrace, your loved ones might appear...

original_text: 蔡婆：整年整年在这打扫，年俸就只有十文纸钱……要是有个亲戚在阳间，什么都不用做，一年得几千两也不算多……唉，老婆子做人时命苦，做了鬼一样命苦……
translation: Granny Cai: Sweeping here year after year, the annual salary is only ten paper coins... If I had a relative in the mortal world, doing nothing, getting thousands of taels a year wouldn't be too much... Sigh, my fate was bitter when I was alive, and it's just as bitter as a ghost...

original_text: 蔡婆：我在阴间待了几百年啦，常常听说有在轮回井口不肯跳的鬼，有的为了等阳世人下来相见，有的不肯忘记上辈子的事，其实何苦啊？死都死了，投胎就投胎吧……
translation: Granny Cai: I've been in the Netherworld for hundreds of years. I often hear of ghosts lingering at the Reincarnation Well, unwilling to jump. Some wait to meet the living, others refuse to forget their past lives. But why cling? Death is death; reincarnate and be done with it...

original_text: 戊未：最近轮回井那儿要投胎的～壁山河边从左往右第三棵树下第六棵止血草、死在黄河边的公牛一只、太平村宋氏母鸡小花，陈州秦府姜氏……
translation: Wu Wei: Recently at the Reincarnation Well, those waiting to be reborn~ Sixth Mending Herb under the third tree from left by the Bishan River, a bull that died by the Yellow River, Little Flower the hen of the Song family in Taiping Village, Lady Jiang of the Qin mansion in Chenzhou...

original_text: 戊未：哈哈，这就是转生名册了！趁大人不在，我偷偷看一下，你这种小鬼可不能多嘴啊！
translation: Wu Wei: Haha, this is the Reincarnation Register! While the boss is away, I'll sneak a peek. You little brat better not blab!

original_text: 戊未：这人呢，该死的时候不肯死，只能由无常殿的鬼卒去招魂，到了该转生的时候呢，又不想活，没事就在阴间飘来飘去，一个比一个想不开！
translation: Wu Wei: People! When it's time to die, they refuse, forcing the ghost officers of Impermanence Hall to summon their souls. When it's time to be reborn, they don't want to live, just drifting around the Netherworld for no reason-each more troubled than the last!

original_text: 丁寅：六界之中，仙和妖也就是比人活久一点，死了一样是鬼嘛，可他们总住在奇奇怪怪的地方，要是没有翳影枝，还真勾不到他们的魂！
translation: Ding Yin: Among the Six Realms, immortals and demons just live longer than humans; when they die, they become ghosts too! But they always live in strange places. Without the Shadowveil Sprig, it'd be hard to hook their souls!

original_text: 丁寅：鬼卒勾了人的魂魄，先带回这无常殿听候发落，再决定送那些鬼去哪儿，像你这样迷了路的，最好快快离开，不然一不小心进了哪层地狱，可就冤了。
translation: Ding Yin: Ghost minions capture human souls, first bring them to this Impermanence Hall for judgment, then decide where to send those ghosts. For someone like you who's lost, better leave quickly. Otherwise, if you accidentally enter some level of hell, it'd be a great injustice.

original_text: 张鸳渊：人界有人界的生意，鬼界有鬼界的生意，只要有钱，都能做买卖，没听过“有钱能使鬼推磨”吗～
translation: Zhang Yuanyuan: The mortal realm has its business, the ghost realm has its business. As long as you have money, you can trade anywhere. Haven't you heard 'money makes the ghost turn the millstone'?~

original_text: 小怜：相公……相公……
translation: Xiaolian: Husband... husband...

original_text: 刘宝庆：你……你是小怜！！小怜你快救救我！他们要把我送进地狱，让我永世不得超生，你救救我！
translation: Liu Baoqing: You... you're Xiaolian!! Xiaolian, save me! They want to send me to hell, make me suffer eternally without rebirth. Save me!

original_text: 小怜：难为相公还记得小怜，我还以为你心里只有长生不老，早就忘记小怜了……你当年为炼丹药，逼着身怀六甲的我跳入丹炉之时，可曾想过会有今日？
translation: Xiaolian: How touching that you still remember Xiaolian. I thought you only had immortality in your heart and had long forgotten about me... Back then, when you forced me, pregnant with child, to jump into the alchemy furnace to refine the elixir, did you ever imagine there would be a day like this?

original_text: 刘宝庆：我知道，都是我的错，都是我的错！小怜！你就念在我们夫妻一场的份上，快想办法救我吧！
translation: Liu Baoqing: I know, it's all my fault, all my fault! Xiaolian! For the sake of our time as husband and wife, please think of a way to save me!

original_text: 小怜：这些都是因果业报……小怜此来，只是为了看你的报应，相公你好自为之吧。
translation: Xiaolian: All of this is karmic retribution... Xiaolian came only to witness your punishment. Husband, you'd better take care of yourself.

original_text: 刘宝庆：小怜！！救救我啊！！！
translation: Liu Baoqing: Xiaolian!! Save me!!!

original_text: 刘宝庆：当年我一心只想炼长生不老药，竟然鬼迷心窍，强逼怀着身孕的妻子投身丹炉……结果药未成，却罪孽累累，如今真是后悔莫及啊！
translation: Liu Baoqing: Back then, I was solely focused on refining the elixir of immortality. I was so bewitched that I forced my pregnant wife to throw herself into the alchemy furnace... In the end, the elixir wasn't completed, but I am burdened with heavy sins. Now I truly regret it deeply!

original_text: 庚卯：不久前才从陈州带回来的那个女鬼，在阴间找不到她相公，就急着投胎去了……呵呵，我看过她的生死簿，她和她相公缘分已尽，以后再也遇不着啦。
translation: Geng Mao: That female ghost brought back from Chenzhou not long ago, unable to find her husband in the Netherworld, rushed off to be reincarnated... Heh, I've seen her Book of Life and Death; her bond with her husband is severed, they'll never meet again.

original_text: 庚卯：再过去便是转轮镜台了，那地方很神秘，就算是鬼卒也不允许靠近，其实，我一直很想溜过去看看呢。
translation: Geng Mao: Ahead is the Wheel Mirror Terrace. That place is mysterious; even ghost guards aren't allowed near. Actually, I've always wanted to sneak over and take a look.

original_text: 辛酉：你是新来的？不用害怕，我看你一脸正气，无甚罪孽，这无常殿便是十殿中的第一殿，若是生前善恶相抵之人，过了无常殿便可往第十殿转轮王处听凭投胎的安排。
translation: Xin You: New here? Don't fear. You seem upright, with little sin. This Impermanence Hall is the first of the Ten Courts. Those whose good and evil balance in life pass through to the Tenth Court, King of Reincarnation, for rebirth arrangements.

original_text: 幽骑：你们是新鬼？以前怎么没见过？难道是无常殿的大人召你们去？
translation: Ghost Rider: Are you new ghosts? I haven't seen you before. Could it be that the lords of Impermanence Hall summoned you?

original_text: 白额：那翳影枝可是个好东西，有了它，天底下什么被法力封住的地方都能进去，可惜不能采几枝来卖，可惜啊可惜……
translation: Bai E: That Shadowveil Sprig is a good thing. With it, you can enter any place sealed by magic power in the world. Pity we can't pick a few to sell, what a shame, what a shame...

original_text: 福昌贵：小兄弟，告诉你！我生前乃是江南首富，家财万贯，大江以南的青楼赌坊，全都是我开的！如果你能放我出去，我就把所有的钱都给你！
translation: Fuchanggui: Young man, let me tell you! In life, I was the wealthiest man in Jiangnan, with vast fortunes. All the brothels and gambling dens south of the great river were mine! If you release me, I'll give you all my money!

original_text: 福昌贵：放我出去！放我出去！我不要下地狱！！你们这群牛头马面，我用银子都能把你们砸死！
translation: Fuchanggui: Let me out! Let me out! I don't want to go to hell!! You ox-headed and horse-faced demons, I can crush you with my silver!

original_text: 王济新：咳咳，对，咳咳，就是这个叶子，咳咳，让我用来试试！
translation: Wang Jixin: Cough, right, cough, this leaf, cough, let me try using it!

original_text: 王济新：呼……噎了几百年了，现在终于舒服了！小子你的本事还不错，这几样东西就拿去玩着吧！
translation: Wang Jixin: Whew... I've been choked up for hundreds of years, finally comfortable now! Kid, your skills are not bad. Take these few things to play with!

original_text:
咳咳咳咳，我生前炼丹～咳咳，不慎在吃丹药、咳咳、时噎死，死后、咳咳，说话也不利索，难受得紧～我听说，咳咳，有一种沾染圣水的叶子，咳咳咳咳，叫“濡润叶”的，说不定，咳咳咳咳，可以帮到我……
你愿意帮我去找来吗？
translation:
Cough, cough, ... In life, I was refining pills-cough-and accidentally choked to death while taking one, cough. After death, cough, I can't even speak smoothly, it's terribly uncomfortable-cough. I heard, cough, there's a leaf soaked in holy water, cough, called Moist Leaf, that might, cough, help me...
Can you help me find it?

original_text: 韩菱纱：……这个划船的人好奇怪，一句话都不说，却愿意帮我们，应该是壬癸的朋友吧？
translation: Han Lingsha: ... This boatman is so strange-he doesn't say a word but is willing to help us. He must be Rengui's friend, right?

original_text: 云天河：不知道……
translation: Yun Tianhe: I don't know...

original_text: 慕容紫英：……
translation: Murong Ziying: ...

original_text: 云天河：紫英，你在想什么？是不是……很在意梦璃是妖？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Ziying, what are you thinking? Is it... that you mind Mengli being a yaoguai?

original_text: 韩菱纱：（天呐！笨死了，哪壶不开提哪壶！）
translation: Han Lingsha: (Heavens! So stupid-bringing up the sorest point!)

original_text: 慕容紫英：……想不到……我竟与一个妖相处了这么久，而且毫无所觉……
translation: Murong Ziying: ... I never thought... I've been with a yaoguai for so long, completely unaware...

original_text: 云天河：可是，在意这种事根本没啥用吧？我爹说的话，你不也听到了？
translation: Yun Tianhe: But, what's the point of minding about such things? Didn't you hear what my father said?

original_text: 慕容紫英：……我不知道……该怎么做才是对的，就像那个时候向掌门要水灵珠，似乎是我错了，但究竟错在哪里，却一点都不明白……
translation: Murong Ziying: ... I don't know... what's the right thing to do? Like when I asked Sect Leader for the Water Spirit Pearl, it seems I was wrong, but I don't understand at all where exactly I went wrong...

original_text: 云天河：不一样，那个时候根本是小气掌门的错吧！
translation: Yun Tianhe: It's different, that time it was clearly the petty Sect Leader's fault!

original_text: 云天河：我觉得……要是你不知道该怎么办，干脆先什么都别想了，一切等我们找到梦璃再说。
translation: Yun Tianhe: I think... if you don't know what to do, maybe just stop thinking for now. Wait till we find Mengli to decide anything.

original_text: 慕容紫英：嗯……
translation: Murong Ziying: Hmm...

original_text: 韩菱纱：你们看！那边有亮光，是不是快到人间了？
translation: Han Lingsha: Look! There's light over there, are we almost to the mortal realm?

original_text: 韩菱纱：（咦？这个人……）
translation: Han Lingsha: (Huh? This person...)

original_text: 慕容紫英：多谢相助，我等感激不尽，能否告知尊驾姓名？
translation: Murong Ziying: Thank you for your assistance. We are most grateful. May we know your name?

original_text: 划船人：……
translation: Boatman: ...

original_text: 慕容紫英：……如此，是我冒昧了。
translation: Murong Ziying: ... In that case, it was my presumption.

original_text: 云天河：他不愿意说就算了吧，大不了我们也帮他多烧点那个什么纸钱。
translation: Yun Tianhe: If he doesn't want to say it, forget it. At most, we'll just help him burn more of that paper money or whatever.

original_text: 韩菱纱：你……把头抬起来，让我看一看好吗？
translation: Han Lingsha: You... Lift your head-let me take a look, okay?

original_text: 慕容紫英：菱纱？
translation: Murong Ziying: Lingsha?

original_text: 韩菱纱：你、你不敢吗？！你到底是谁？
translation: Han Lingsha: You... you don't dare?! Who are you, really?
Boatman: ......

original_text: 韩菱纱：……
translation: Han Lingsha: ...

original_text: 划船人：……唉，丫头，你还是这么精灵，真拿你没办法……
translation: Boatman: ... Sigh, girl, still so clever, really don't know what to do with you...

original_text: 韩菱纱：伯父，真的是你？！怎么可能？！
translation: Han Lingsha: Uncle, is it really you?! How is that possible?!

original_text: 慕容紫英：……！
translation: Murong Ziying: ...!

original_text: 韩菱纱：伯父，为什么你会在这里？为什么你要装作不认识我？要不是、要不是我认出你的轮廓……
translation: Han Lingsha: Uncle, why are you here? Why are you pretending not to know me? If it weren't... if it weren't for me recognizing your silhouette...

original_text: 韩北旷：丫头，你就当作没看见伯父好不好？
translation: Han Beikuang: Girl, just pretend you didn't see your uncle, okay?

original_text: 韩菱纱：不好！我明明看见了！你都不知道，我有多想你，在转轮镜台的时候，我以为你已经转世去了，所以才不出现……
translation: Han Lingsha: No! I saw it clearly! You have no idea how much I missed you. At the Wheel Mirror Terrace, I thought you had already reincarnated, that's why you didn't appear...

original_text: 韩北旷：傻丫头，我要是转世，今天不就救不了你了？
translation: Han Beikuang: Silly girl, if I had reincarnated, wouldn't I have been unable to save you today?

original_text: 韩菱纱：……伯父，你说什么救不了我？为什么你会在这里划船？
translation: Han Lingsha: ... Uncle, what do you mean you can't save me? Why are you rowing a boat here?

original_text: 韩北旷：……不止是我……几乎所有韩家人，死后都会在鬼界做苦役……我便是负责摆渡这青竹船，必要时往来人鬼两界……
translation: Han Beikuang: ...Not just me... almost all Han family members end up doing hard labor in the ghost realm after death... I ferry this bamboo boat, traveling between the human and ghost realms when needed...

original_text: 韩菱纱：苦役？那是什么？他们怎么能让你做这种事呢？！
translation: Han Lingsha: Hard labor? What's that? How could they make you do such a thing?!
Han Beikuang: ............

original_text: 韩菱纱：伯父，你说嘛！告诉我好不好？
translation: Han Lingsha: Uncle, tell me! Please tell me!

original_text: 韩北旷：丫头，我刚才不想与你相认，就是在犹豫要不要告诉你一些事，对你来讲，现在就知道这些，未免过于沉重了……
translation: Han Beikuang: Girl, I hesitated to acknowledge you earlier because I was unsure whether to tell you certain things. For you to learn them now would be far too heavy a burden...

original_text: 韩菱纱：伯父，到底是怎么回事？！我要知道！
translation: Han Lingsha: Uncle, what exactly happened?! I need to know!

original_text: 韩北旷：唉……韩氏世代盗墓，总以为人已入土，墓中器皿当可拿来救助活人，但如今你来了鬼界，应该知晓，鬼也如活人一般，有自己的感情、自己的种种思念……
translation: Han Beikuang: Alas... The Han family has been tomb raiding for generations, always thinking that once a person is buried, the artifacts in the tomb can be taken to help the living. But now that you've come to the ghost realm, you should know that ghosts, like the living, have their own emotions and longings...

original_text: 韩北旷：我们一族惊扰死者，不仅生死薄上阳寿短暂，很多都只活到二三十岁，即便死后，也一样要做苦役来赎罪，待到罪孽偿清，才可再入轮回了……
translation: Han Beikuang: Our clan disturbs the dead, not only do we have short lifespans on the Book of Life and Death, many only live to their twenties or thirties, but even after death, we must also perform hard labor to atone for our sins. Only after our sins are fully redeemed can we re-enter the cycle of reincarnation...

original_text: 韩菱纱：竟然、竟然这样……
translation: Han Lingsha: How could, how could this be...

original_text: 韩菱纱：也就是说……我一直在找的长生之法，根本没有用？不管我怎么努力，也不能让族人活得更长久一些……
translation: Han Lingsha: So... the longevity art I've sought is useless? No matter how hard I try, I can't make our clan live longer...

original_text: 韩北旷：丫头，我知道你很努力了，但是有些东西，冥冥之中自有安排，不是你一个人能够争得过……
translation: Han Beikuang: Girl, I know you've tried very hard, but some things are fated by destiny, not something one person can fight against...

original_text: 韩菱纱：那，爹和娘呢？他们在哪？
translation: Han Lingsha: Then, what about dad and mom? Where are they?

original_text: 韩北旷：……自然也在鬼界的其他地方赎罪。
translation: Han Beikuang: ...Naturally, also atoning in other places in the ghost realm.

original_text: 韩北旷：丫头，你老实告诉我，你是不是一直很气自己爹娘？觉得他们待你不好？
translation: Han Beikuang: Girl, tell me honestly-have you always resented your parents? Felt they treated you poorly?

original_text: 韩菱纱：我……
translation: Han Lingsha: I...

original_text: 韩北旷：唉，他们啊，知道自己多半命不长久，所以才故意对你冷淡，就是怕你依赖惯了，万一双亲离世，会太伤心，这世上又哪有爹娘不喜欢自己的孩子呢？
translation: Han Beikuang: Ah, they knew their time was short, so they acted cold, fearing you'd rely on them and grieve too much when they passed. What kind of parents don't love their child?

original_text: 韩菱纱：伯父，你说的、都是真的吗？！
translation: Han Lingsha: Uncle, what you said... is it true?!

original_text: 韩北旷：当然是真的！记得你还小的时候，你爹每天晚上非要在床边看你睡着了，他才肯睡，他就是有股傻劲，总觉得不多看几眼，多唤你几声名字，以后就没机会了……
translation: Han Beikuang: Of course it's true! When you were little, your father wouldn't sleep until he'd watched you fall asleep each night. He had this silly stubbornness, fearing if he didn't look a few more times or call your name, he'd miss his chance...

original_text: 韩菱纱：……真是个傻爹爹，还有娘，也好笨！
translation: Han Lingsha: ... Such a silly father, and Mother too-so foolish!

original_text: 韩菱纱：人活一辈子，本来就够短暂了，他们还要在意这在意那，害我伤心了好多年……
translation: Han Lingsha: A human life is already short enough. They still have to worry about this and that, making me sad for so many years...

original_text: 韩北旷：……丫头……你真的长大了，看事情有自己的想法了……
translation: Han Beikuang: ...Girl... you've really grown up, you have your own thoughts about things now...

original_text: 韩北旷：……似乎、也结识了很好的朋友……旁边这两位都是吧？
translation: Han Beikuang: ...It seems... you've also made good friends... these two beside you, they are your friends, right?

original_text: 云天河：对啊，我和菱纱是很要好的朋友，呵呵。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Right, Lingsha and I are very good friends, hehe.

original_text: 慕容紫英：晚辈慕容紫英，刚才多有失礼了。
translation: Murong Ziying: I, Murong Ziying, apologize for my rudeness earlier.

original_text: 韩北旷：慕容？难道是大燕国的遗族？
translation: Han Beikuang: Murong? Could you be descendants of the Great Yan Kingdom?

original_text: 慕容紫英：……！前辈如何得知？
translation: Murong Ziying: ...! How did you know, senior?

original_text: 韩北旷：唉，我也是脑中灵光一闪而过，想到很久以前有一对夫妇，前去轮回井投胎……眉目间和你很有几分神似……而且慕容这个姓可不多见，曾是燕国的大家之姓……
translation: Han Beikuang: Ah, a flash of insight struck me. Long ago, a couple went to the Reincarnation Well to be reborn... their features bore a strong resemblance to yours. And the surname Murong is rare-once a great clan of the Yan kingdom...

original_text: 韩北旷：你爹……是不是叫慕容承？
translation: Han Beikuang: Your father... is his name Murong Cheng?

original_text: 慕容紫英：……正是家父。
translation: Murong Ziying: ... That is my father.

original_text: 韩北旷：那就没错了。
translation: Han Beikuang: Then it's correct.

original_text: 慕容紫英：…………原来……原来爹和娘都已经过世……这么久了……
translation: Murong Ziying: ...... So... so Father and Mother have already passed away... It's been so long...

original_text: 韩北旷：你也不用太过伤心，你爹和你娘神色平和，生前应该是过得很安泰。
translation: Han Beikuang: You don't need to be too heartbroken. Your father and mother looked peaceful; they probably lived very content lives.

original_text: 韩北旷：只是他们似乎有些遗憾，没能在死之前再见自己的小儿子一面，说是因为那孩子年幼时体弱，家里不但请来道士替他批命取名，更是将他送去了仙山上修行，但愿他能活得长命百岁。
translation: Han Beikuang: But they seemed to have some regret, not being able to see their youngest son one last time before death. They said because the child was frail in youth, the family not only had a Taoist divine his fate and name him, but also sent him to an immortal mountain to cultivate, hoping he would live a long life.

original_text: 慕容紫英：……爹、娘…………
translation: Murong Ziying: ... Father, Mother...

original_text: 韩菱纱：（紫英……）
translation: Han Lingsha: (Ziying...)

original_text: 韩北旷：鬼界有种说法，叫作生前种种隔世抛，与其一直挂念，不如在心里希望过世的亲人朋友，投胎以后能够一生顺遂……
translation: Han Beikuang: In the ghost realm, there's a saying: 'Leave past lives behind in the cycle of rebirth'. Rather than clinging to memories, it's better to wish departed loved ones a smooth life after reincarnation...

original_text: 慕容紫英：……多谢前辈指点，晚辈……晚辈都明白……
translation: Murong Ziying: ... Thank you for your guidance, senior... I... I understand...

original_text: 韩菱纱：（哪有那么容易看透，紫英你又在逞强了……不然为什么要露出那种悲伤的神情……）
translation: Han Lingsha: (It's not that easy to see through. Ziying, you're being stubborn again... otherwise why show that sorrowful expression...)

original_text: 韩北旷：唉，是我该谢谢你们，一直照顾我家丫头。
translation: Han Beikuang: Ah, it's I who should thank you, for always looking after my girl.

original_text: 韩菱纱：伯父，你说什么呢……旁边这个倒也罢了，后面的那个啊，可是我一直在照顾他呀！
translation: Han Lingsha: Uncle, what are you saying... The one beside me is one thing, but the one behind, I've been taking care of him all along!

original_text: 韩北旷：哈哈，不管怎样，伯父今天能见到你，觉得很高兴……
translation: Han Beikuang: Haha, no matter what, I am very happy to see you today...

original_text: 韩菱纱：我也是……伯父，你先别走，再多和我说些话好不好？
translation: Han Lingsha: Me too... Uncle, please don't leave yet, could you talk with me a little longer?

original_text: 韩北旷：……时候差不多，你们该回阳间了。
translation: Han Beikuang: ...It's about time, you should return to the mortal world.

original_text: 韩菱纱：伯父，我会告诉族人，让他们别再去惊扰死者了……不过有机会的话，我还是要去找长生之法。
translation: Han Lingsha: Uncle, I'll tell my clansmen not to disturb the deceased anymore... But if I get the chance, I still want to search for longevity art.

original_text: 韩北旷：丫头，别总那样辛苦，多为自己想想吧。
translation: Han Beikuang: Girl, don't always work so hard. Think more about yourself.

original_text: 韩北旷：你出落得这么漂亮，记得找个好相公嫁了！我看你身后两个都不错啊！哈哈！
translation: Han Beikuang: You've grown so beautiful; remember to find a good husband to marry! I think the two behind you are quite good! Haha!

original_text: 韩菱纱：伯父！
translation: Han Lingsha: Uncle!

original_text: 1.御剑飞行
translation: 1. Sword Flight

original_text: 2.什么都不做
translation: 2. Do Nothing

original_text: 准备<colour red=255 green=102 blue=0 alpha=255>御剑飞行</colour><dc0>吗？</dc0>
translation: Ready to <colour red=255 green=102 blue=0 alpha=255>use Sword Flight</colour><dc0>?</dc0>

original_text: 马彪：前方为酆都大帝殿，平日不能上山拜访，请回。
translation: Ma Biao: Ahead is the Hall of Lord Fengdu. No visits are allowed on ordinary days. Please turn back.

original_text: 慕容紫英：……看来……我们已经回到人间了，这里似乎是蜀中的鬼城酆都。
translation: Murong Ziying: ... It seems... we've returned to the mortal world. This appears to be Fengdu, the Ghost City in Shu.

original_text: 韩菱纱：……伯父……呜……
translation: Han Lingsha: ... Uncle... woo...

original_text: 云天河：菱纱，你、你别哭了……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Lingsha, you, don't cry...

original_text: 云天河：你这样哭，我也好难过……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Seeing you cry like this, I feel so sad too...

original_text: 韩菱纱：你……你又难过什么？
translation: Han Lingsha: Why... Why are you sad too?

original_text: 云天河：去了趟鬼界，听到那些事情，我好像变得都不是我了……
translation: Yun Tianhe: After going to the ghost realm and hearing all those things, I feel like I'm not even myself anymore...

original_text: 云天河：……原来，娘最喜欢的人，不是爹，而是……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... So... Mother's favorite person wasn't Father, but...

original_text: 韩菱纱：我也觉得……为什么许多事情……和原本想的完全不一样……
translation: Han Lingsha: I feel it too... Why are so many things... completely different from what we originally thought...

original_text: 慕容紫英：……走吧，我们回琼华派去，也不知道门派里到底如何了。
translation: Murong Ziying: ... Let's go, back to Qionghua Sect. I wonder how things are at the sect.

original_text: 云天河：嗯，翳影枝拿到了，我要去找梦璃！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Mm, we got the Shadowveil Sprig, I'm going to find Mengli!

original_text: 韩菱纱：……天河，等一下。
translation: Han Lingsha: ... Tianhe, wait a moment.

original_text: 云天河：怎么了……？
translation: Yun Tianhe: What's wrong...?

original_text: 韩菱纱：我想……你陪我去做一件事好吗？
translation: Han Lingsha: I want... could you accompany me to do something?

original_text: 云天河：啥？很急吗？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Huh? Is it urgent?

original_text: 韩菱纱：哎，问那么多干嘛，来就是了，反正很重要的！
translation: Han Lingsha: Hey, why ask so many questions? Just come along, it's really important anyway!

original_text: 慕容紫英：什么事？不需要我帮忙吗？
translation: Murong Ziying: What is it? Don't you need my help?

original_text: 韩菱纱：嗯……你来也好……
translation: Han Lingsha: Hmm... It's good you came too...

original_text: 韩菱纱：不，紫英你还是别来了……
translation: Han Lingsha: No, Ziying, you'd better not come...

original_text: 慕容紫英：到底何事？
translation: Murong Ziying: What exactly is the matter?

original_text: 韩菱纱：其实……刚才在城里的时候，我想了很久，想伯父说的那些话，我决定了却自己的一个心愿，以后就再也不盗墓了。
translation: Han Lingsha: Actually... I thought a lot back in the city, about what Uncle said. I've decided to fulfill one last wish of mine, and after that, I'll never tomb-raiding again.

original_text: 云天河：意思就是……还要去盗一次？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Meaning... you have to steal again?

original_text: 韩菱纱：那是有原因的嘛～你、可以陪我去吗？
translation: Han Lingsha: There's a reason~ You-can you accompany me?

original_text: 云天河：不行！
translation: Yun Tianhe: No!

original_text: 韩菱纱：为什么？
translation: Han Lingsha: Why?

original_text: 云天河：我虽然不是很懂，但也知道，盗墓不是好事，对你不好，会减你的寿命，所以不能去。
translation: Yun Tianhe: I may not fully understand, but I know tomb raiding isn't good, bad for you, shortens your life, so we can't go.

original_text: 韩菱纱：哪有这么严重……就去一次！以前那么多年都这样过了，还在乎这一次吗？
translation: Han Lingsha: It's not that serious... just once! After all these years, what's one more time?

original_text: 云天河：不行！你的命就算是减了一个月、一天也不行！
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... Your life, even if reduced by a month or a day, is unacceptable!

original_text: 云天河：为啥突然要去？！再说梦璃的事也还没——
translation: Yun Tianhe: Why go suddenly?! Besides, Mengli's matter isn't even-

original_text: 韩菱纱：哼！别总是梦璃、梦璃的，我当然明白梦璃的事很重要！但我也不是胡闹。
translation: Han Lingsha: Hmph! Stop always saying Mengli, Mengli. Of course I know Mengli's matter is important! But I'm not fooling around either.

original_text: 韩菱纱：只要这件事一办完，我们马上就回琼华派，去妖界找梦璃！
translation: Han Lingsha: Once this matter is settled, we'll return to Qionghua Sect immediately and go to the yao realm to find Mengli!

original_text: 慕容紫英：……何等大事，一定要在这个时候去办？你却又不肯说清楚因果……
translation: Murong Ziying: ... What major matter must be handled at this time? Yet you refuse to explain the cause and effect clearly...

original_text: 慕容紫英：菱纱，攸关你的生死，你要想明白，不可儿戏。
translation: Murong Ziying: Lingsha, this concerns your life and death. Think carefully, don't treat it lightly.

original_text: 云天河：是啊，菱纱，你平时就很爱玩，但也别拿自己的命来玩啊！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Yeah, Lingsha, you usually love to play around, but don't play with your life like this!

original_text: 韩菱纱：你当我是在玩？
translation: Han Lingsha: You think I'm playing around?

original_text: 韩菱纱：你们都以为我是说疯话？！
translation: Han Lingsha: You all think I'm talking nonsense?!
Yun Tianhe: ......

original_text: 慕容紫英：…………
translation: Murong Ziying: ......

original_text: 韩菱纱：好，两个大男人婆婆妈妈的不肯去，我自己去总行了吧？！
translation: Han Lingsha: Fine, if you two men are too hesitant to go, I'll go by myself, alright?!

original_text: 云天河：等等！你别走！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Wait! Don't go!

original_text: 韩菱纱：我干嘛要理你！
translation: Han Lingsha: Why should I listen to you!

original_text: 韩菱纱：你们不愿意陪我，还不许我自己去，那干脆把我打昏，直接扛回琼华派算了！
translation: Han Lingsha: You two won't accompany me, and you two won't let me go alone. Then just knock me out and carry me back to Qionghua Sect!

original_text: 云天河：话不能这么说，总之你不能——
translation: Yun Tianhe: You can't say it like that, in short you can't-

original_text: 韩菱纱：哼！
translation: Han Lingsha: Hmph!

original_text: 韩菱纱：紫英你、干嘛妨碍我？！
translation: Han Lingsha: Ziying, why are you getting in my way?!

original_text: 慕容紫英：……那件事，你一定要做？
translation: Murong Ziying: ... That matter, must you do it?

original_text: 韩菱纱：对！你们不去，我一个人也能办成，大不了死在那边，横竖也就是一条命。
translation: Han Lingsha: Right! If you won't go, I can handle it alone. At worst, I'll die over there-it's just one life anyway.

original_text: 韩菱纱：那是一件很重要的事，一个很重要的心愿，如果我的阳寿真的很短，那我一定……要在死之前做到……
translation: Han Lingsha: It's a very important matter, a very important wish. If my life really is short, then I must... accomplish it before I die...

original_text: 云天河：……你！
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... you!

original_text: 韩菱纱：而且去妖界会很危险……我只想……此生不要留下遗憾……
translation: Han Lingsha: And going to the yao realm will be dangerous... I just... don't want to have regrets in this life...

original_text: 云天河：不行不行，话不能这么说，不管你怎么说都不行！
translation: Yun Tianhe: No, no, that's not right to say, no matter what you say, it's not okay!

original_text: 慕容紫英：……好吧，我去。
translation: Murong Ziying: ... Alright, I'll go.

original_text: 云天河：啊？！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Huh?!

original_text: 慕容紫英：与其让你一人涉险，倒不如我跟去……
translation: Murong Ziying: Rather than letting you risk it alone, I might as well go along...

original_text: 韩菱纱：真的？！
translation: Han Lingsha: Really?!

original_text: 韩菱纱：哈，那就这么说定了，还是小紫英最明事理。
translation: Han Lingsha: Ha, it's settled then. Little Ziying is still the most reasonable.

original_text: 云天河：这怎么行？我不干！
translation: Yun Tianhe: How can that be? I won't do it!

original_text: 韩菱纱：喂，紫英都已经答应了，你还找碴啊？
translation: Han Lingsha: Hey, Ziying already agreed-still picking a fight?

original_text: 慕容紫英：莫要误会，我并未答应你什么，只是跟你同去，免得你胡闹，反而令自己身陷险境。
translation: Murong Ziying: Don't misunderstand. I haven't agreed to anything. I'm merely accompanying you to prevent your reckless actions from landing you in danger.

original_text: 慕容紫英：如果此行有任何损阴德之事，我会立刻阻止你！
translation: Murong Ziying: If this journey involves any act that damages virtue, I will stop you immediately!

original_text: 韩菱纱：有什么不一样，反正就是要陪我去嘛。
translation: Han Lingsha: What's the difference? You're coming with me anyway.

original_text: 云天河：……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ...
Yun Tianhe: .........

original_text: 云天河：为啥女孩子会这么麻烦啊啊啊？不顺你的意就要闹闹闹！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Why are girls so troublesome? If things don't go their way, they just fuss and fuss!

original_text: 云天河：烦死我了～～～烦死我了～～～烦死我了～～～！！
translation: Yun Tianhe: So annoying~~~ So annoying~~~ So annoying~~~!!

original_text: 云天河：一个不见了，一个明明知道会减寿命还要去盗墓，我真是搞不懂女孩子在想什么！
translation: Yun Tianhe: One disappears, another goes tomb-raiding knowing it shortens her life. I really don't understand what girls are thinking!

original_text: 韩菱纱：嘻，这么说，你也同意啰？
translation: Han Lingsha: Hehe, so you agree, then?

original_text: 云天河：唉，还是以前在山上打猎的时候最好，没那么多烦心事……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Sigh, it was best back when hunting in the mountains-not so many worries...

original_text: 云天河：（真想回山上……）
translation: Yun Tianhe: (Really want to go back to the mountain...)

original_text: 韩菱纱：好啦，别臭着一张脸，想吓谁啊，反正我当你答应了。
translation: Han Lingsha: Alright, don't look so grumpy, who are you trying to scare? Anyway, I'll take that as a yes.

original_text: 韩菱纱：走吧！那个地方叫<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>封神陵</colour><dc0>，</dc0><colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>在陈州的北面</colour><dc0>，因为悬浮于半空，常人根本不能靠近，好在我们几个没问题，御剑过去就好了！</dc0>
translation: Han Lingsha: Let's go! That place is called<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>Fengshen Mausoleum</colour><dc0>, </dc0><colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>north of Chenzhou</colour><dc0>. Since it floats in mid-air, ordinary people can't get close at all, but luckily we have no problem-we can just fly over on swords!</dc0>

original_text: 云天河：我……我实在是……都不知道该说什么了……
translation: Yun Tianhe: I... I really... don't even know what to say anymore...

original_text: 韩菱纱：……这、这是什么法术？我的头好像没有刚才那样晕了……
translation: Han Lingsha: ... Wh-what kind of spell is this? My head doesn't feel as dizzy as before...

original_text: ？？：在下道臻，刚才施展的乃是蜀山仙剑派的理气通脉之法。
translation: ??: I am Daozhen. What I just performed was the Liqi Tongmai technique of the Shu Mountain Immortal Sword Sect.

original_text: 道臻：另外，这几味丹药可助姑娘凝气定神，如有不适，可随时服用。
translation: Daozhen: Also, these elixirs can help you stabilize qi and calm spirit. If you feel unwell, you can take them anytime.

original_text: 韩菱纱：谢谢……
translation: Han Lingsha: Thank you...

original_text: 道臻：区区小事，不足挂齿，告辞。
translation: Daozhen: A trivial matter, not worth mentioning. Farewell.

original_text: 韩菱纱：啊，你等一下——
translation: Han Lingsha: Ah, wait a moment-

original_text: 慕容紫英：这位兄台，请留步。
translation: Murong Ziying: Sir, please wait.

original_text: 慕容紫英：在下慕容紫英，乃是昆仑琼华派门下。
translation: Murong Ziying: I am Murong Ziying, a disciple of the Qionghua Sect of Mount Kunlun.

original_text: 慕容紫英：冒昧一问，兄台腰间坠有蜀山派的守剑文佩，据我所知，此乃入室弟子专用，且分为紫、青、蓝、绿四等，弟子领命下山时才会佩戴，兄台所佩竟是最高级数的紫色，是否蜀山上发生了什么大事？
translation: Murong Ziying: May I ask presumptuously? Brother, you wear a Shu Mountain Sect Sword-Guarding Talisman Pendant at your waist. To my knowledge, this is reserved for inner-chamber disciples and comes in four grades: purple, cyan, blue, and green. It's worn only when disciples are sent down the mountain on missions. The one you wear is the highest-grade purple. Has something major happened on Shu Mountain?

original_text: 道臻：……与你何干？
translation: Daozhen: ...What's it to you?

original_text: 慕容紫英：在下无意打探其他门派秘事，只不过蜀山派向来以侠义之举闻名天下，令人钦佩，若此回事态紧急，在下力之所及，或许也能略尽心意。
translation: Murong Ziying: I have no intention of prying into the secrets of other sects. However, the Shu Mountain Sect has always been renowned throughout the world for its righteous deeds, which is admirable. If the situation is urgent this time, within my capabilities, I might also be able to offer some assistance.

original_text: 道臻：好意心领，不敢劳驾。我此次下山与行侠无关，乃是为了铲除门中叛徒，寻回一件失物。
translation: Daozhen: I appreciate the goodwill, but dare not trouble you. My descent this time is not for chivalry, but to eliminate a sect traitor and retrieve a lost item.

original_text: 道臻：时间紧迫，<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>我要赶往即墨附近</colour><dc0>，不敢耽搁，就此告辞了。</dc0>
translation: Daozhen: Time is of the essence.<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> I must head to the vicinity of Jimo</colour><dc0> and dare not delay any longer, so I bid you farewell now.</dc0>

original_text: 韩菱纱：…………想不到、真想不到，这世上有比小紫英还要冷颜冷面的人呐，当真是一山还比一山高。
translation: Han Lingsha: ...... Unbelievable, truly unbelievable. There's actually someone in this world with a colder face than little Ziying. Truly, there's always a higher mountain.

original_text: 韩菱纱：好啦，我开玩笑的嘛，其实我们都知道你是面冷心热～
translation: Han Lingsha: Alright, I was just joking. Actually, we all know you're cold on the outside but warm on the inside~

original_text: 韩菱纱：说起来，那个人也是呢，刚才我突然觉得头晕不舒服，多亏他用法术帮我缓解了许多。
translation: Han Lingsha: Speaking of which, that person is too. Just now I suddenly felt dizzy and unwell. Thanks to him using magic to help relieve it, I feel much better.

original_text: 云天河：那现在呢？你怎么样，还难受吗？！
translation: Yun Tianhe: And now? How are you, still feeling bad?!

original_text: 韩菱纱：已经好了，瞧你紧张的，我最近时常这样，一点小毛病，最后还不都没事？
translation: Han Lingsha: It's already fine, see how nervous you are. I've been like this often lately, just a minor issue, and it always turns out okay.

original_text: 云天河：哦……没事就好、没事就好～
translation: Yun Tianhe: Oh...It's good that you're fine, it's good~

original_text: 韩菱纱：紫英，你还是很在意蜀山的事吗？
translation: Han Lingsha: Ziying, are you still concerned about the Shu Mountain matter?

original_text: 韩菱纱：那个人说要铲除叛徒，找回一件失物，应该是有弟子把蜀山派的什么东西偷走了吧？
translation: Han Lingsha: That person said to eliminate a traitor and retrieve a lost item. Probably a disciple stole something from the Shu Mountain Sect, huh?

original_text: 慕容紫英：既然对方不愿多言，应是不想被门派以外的人知道，我们也毋须猜测。
translation: Murong Ziying: Since the other party is unwilling to say more, likely they don't want outsiders to know. We need not speculate.

original_text: 韩菱纱：嗯……就不晓得是怎样贵重的宝贝弄丢了，让蜀山派那么紧张……
translation: Han Lingsha: Hmm... Just wonder what kind of precious treasure was lost to make the Shu Mountain Sect so anxious...

original_text: 石广知：酆都自古就被称为鬼都，那是因为这里和阴间最接近，傻小子～你知道从哪里才能进入鬼界吗？
translation: Shi Guangzhi: Fengdu has been called the Ghost Capital since ancient times because it's closest to the Netherworld. Silly lad~ Do you know where one can enter the ghost realm?

original_text: 刘保柱：只要是酆都人都知道啊，在子时到城门口就行了。
translation: Liu Baozhu: Anyone from Fengdu knows, just go to the city gate at the hour of Zi.

original_text: 石广知：唔，知道这也不稀奇，但你知道要怎么从鬼界回来吗？告诉你，我听一个做法事的道士说过，得乘着冥河上的船从鬼界漂回来！那冥河是阴间的，到了阳世便是酆都的龙河了！
translation: Shi Guangzhi: Hmm, knowing that isn't strange, but do you know how to return from the Ghost Realm? I'll tell you-I heard from a Taoist priest who performs rites that you must ride a boat on the River Styx to drift back from the Ghost Realm! That River Styx belongs to the Netherworld; in the mortal world, it becomes Loong River in Fengdu!

original_text: 石广知：上回那个道士告诉我，最近阴间怕是出事了，青竹船也不许再往来阴阳两界！
translation: Shi Guangzhi: Last time, that Taoist told me something must have happened in the Netherworld recently, and the Green Bamboo Boats are no longer allowed to travel between yin and yang!

original_text: 刘保柱：虽说子时从城门就能去鬼界，不过奶奶从不让我去，她说好端端的活人去阴间，会沾染阴气，小则招惹鬼邪，严重一点的话，可就是要命了！
translation: Liu Baozhu: Although you can go to the ghost realm from the city gate at midnight, Grandma never lets me go. She says that living people going to the Netherworld for no reason will attract yin energy, at best inviting ghosts and evil spirits, and at worst, it could be fatal!

original_text: 刘保柱：石叔叔虽然见多识广，但他总说从鬼界回来是坐什么船，一听就知道是乱说！阳间要是有河通阴间，不是随便谁都能去了吗？
translation: Liu Baozhu: Uncle Shi may be knowledgeable, but he always says you need to take some boat to get back from the ghost realm-clearly nonsense! If there were a river from the mortal world to the underworld, couldn't anyone go?

original_text: 刘保柱：我奶奶天天祭拜鬼神，现在都九十岁了身体还好得很，每顿能吃下三大碗白米饭，你说这不是鬼神保佑是什么？
translation: Liu Baozhu: My grandma worships ghosts and deities every day, and now she's ninety years old but still in great health-she can eat three big bowls of rice per meal. If that's not the protection of ghosts and deities, what is?

original_text: 阿娇：告诉你哦～沿着大路走过鬼门关，酒馆旁边卦摊上的蒋大师，是个很厉害的道士！我经常求他做法唤我死去的爹回来相见，每次都很灵验呢！
translation: A Jiao: Let me tell you~ Go along the main road past the Ghost Gate, and next to the winery at the fortune-telling stall, Master Jiang is a very powerful Taoist! I often ask him to perform rituals to summon my deceased father to meet me, and it works every time!

original_text: 阿娇：来酆都的外乡人可不能错过孟婆婆的粥～孟婆婆的小摊就在奈何桥旁边，沿着路往山上走就能瞧见。
translation: A Jiao: Outsiders coming to Fengdu must not miss Granny Meng's porridge~ Granny Meng's stall is right next to Naihe Bridge. Follow the road up the mountain and you'll see it.

original_text: 阿娇：蒋大师说阴间出了事，冥河上的青竹船不许再开，那是不是没办法往来阴阳两界了？
translation: A Jiao: Master Jiang said something happened in the Netherworld, the green bamboo boats on the Styx are no longer allowed to sail. Does that mean travel between the realms of yin and yang is impossible now?

original_text: 彭巧娘：葛大娘的儿子突然犯了癫痫，口中胡言乱语还全身发抖，那样子真可怕！我活了大半辈子还头一回见到！
translation: Peng Qiaoniang: Auntie Ge's son suddenly had a seizure, babbling nonsense and shaking all over-it was truly terrifying! I've lived most of my life and never seen anything like it!

original_text: 彭巧娘：以前我一直不知道，总觉得这龙河阴气太重，后来听人家说，龙河流到阴间就是冥河，这阴气能不重吗？！
translation: Peng Qiaoniang: I never understood before, always felt the Loong River had too much yin energy. Later, I heard people say the Loong River flows into the Netherworld as the River Styx. How could the yin energy not be heavy?!

original_text: 彭巧娘：葛大娘家三宝的癫痫好了，听说是请了蒋道士来做法驱邪，那蒋道士留下三张符纸，烧了符纸，将符灰兑了水一喝，三宝就立刻好起来了！
translation: Peng Qiaoniang: The epilepsy of Auntie Ge's Sanbao has been cured. I heard they invited Taoist Jiang to perform an exorcism ritual. Taoist Jiang left three talismans; after burning them, mixing the ashes with water and drinking it, Sanbao recovered immediately!

original_text: 马大婶：哎哟，小哥～看你不是本地人吧？你们可能不知道，酆都阴气盛，要给阎王鬼差上香才能常保平安，大妈这儿就有现成的香烛，看你长得俊，就给你打九折好了～
translation: Auntie Ma: Oh, young man~ You don't look like a local, do you? You might not know, but Fengdu is heavy with yin energy. You need to offer incense to the King of Hell and his ghostly officers to stay safe. Auntie here has ready-made incense and candles. Seeing you're such a handsome lad, I'll give you a 10% discount~

original_text: 李超：这口楠木棺是城里一个大户人家订做的，不是真死了人，而是为家里的老人存“材”保长寿～
translation: Li Chao: This nanmu coffin was ordered by a wealthy family in the city. No one has really died; it's for storing 'material' to ensure the elderly's longevity~

original_text: 李超：祖上传下来的规矩，棺材店天一黑就要打烊，说是夜里做棺材会招鬼，客官您要是有什么事儿就现在说，别等我要打烊了才来敲大门。
translation: Li Chao: The rule passed down from our ancestors is that the coffin shop must close at dusk. They say making coffins at night attracts ghosts. If you have any business, sir, please say it now. Don't wait until I'm about to close to knock on the main gate.

original_text: 莫晔：小哥你知道蜀山剑仙吧？就是斩妖除魔最厉害的人！连他们都用我打的刀剑，你说我的刀剑好不好～
translation: Mo Ye: Young man, you know about the Shu Mountain Sword Immortals, right? They're the best at slaying demons and monsters! Even they use the swords and blades I forge-tell me, are my blades good~

original_text: 莫晔：城里的人天天就只知道求啊拜的，香烛摊的大婶生意最好！我倒觉得与其求神拜佛，不如练武强身，你说是吧？
translation: Mo Ye: People in the city only know how to pray and worship all day-the auntie at the incense stall has the best business! I think it's better to train in martial arts to strengthen your body than to pray to gods and buddhas, don't you agree?

original_text: 莫晔：你知道我这店里哪件东西卖得最好？竟然是桃木剑……唉，真是半点也显不出我的手艺来……
translation: Mo Ye: Do you know what sells best in my shop? It's actually peach wood swords... Sigh, it really doesn't showcase my craftsmanship at all...

original_text: 潘大爷：我那孙儿也不知发的什么疯，竟然说要去蜀山当剑仙，就这么丢下我一个老头子，病得快死了也没人管！
translation: Uncle Pan: My grandson has gone mad, saying he wants to go to Mount Shu to become a sword immortal. He just left me, an old man, behind. Even when I'm sick and near death, no one cares!

original_text: 潘大爷：沿大路一直往上走，就可以看到酆都大帝殿，不过官府怕惊扰了鬼神，如今那里有卫兵把守，平常时候不能上去啰……
translation: Uncle Pan: Follow the main road straight up, and you'll see the Hall of the Great Emperor of Fengdu. But the authorities, fearing to disturb the spirits, now have guards posted; you can't go up normally...

original_text: 潘大爷：我孙儿前几日从蜀山回来了，原来他是看我病得厉害，去替我求仙丹啊！这么孝顺的孩子真是世间少有，以前真是我误会他了～
translation: Uncle Pan: My grandson returned from Mount Shu the other day. Turns out he went to seek immortal pills for me because I was gravely ill! Such a filial child is rare in this world. I really misunderstood him before~

original_text: 蒋子牙：你们几个～尤其是那红衣服的小姑娘！年纪轻轻，身上阴气怎那么重？是不是去了什么不该去的地方？
translation: Jiang Ziya: You all-especially that girl in red! So young, yet such heavy yin energy? Have you been somewhere you shouldn't have?

original_text: 蒋子牙：城里的小牛哥真是深情，娘子都死了好几年了，他还每月求我做法招魂魄回来相见。
translation: Jiang Ziya: Young Brother Niu in the city is truly devoted. His wife died years ago, yet he begs me every month to summon her spirit for a meeting.

original_text: 蒋子牙：我听鬼差说，上回有人乱闯鬼界，还乘青竹船逃回了阳间，阎王一怒之下，最近都不许青竹船再开了……
translation: Jiang Ziya: I heard from ghost officers that someone barged into the ghost realm last time and escaped back to the mortal world on a green bamboo boat. The King of Hell was furious and recently banned all green bamboo boats...

original_text: 霍琳：每逢九月九，山上酆都大帝殿前就会有庙会，大家都赶着上山参拜进香，那场面可热闹着呢！
translation: Huo Lin: Every year on the Double Ninth Festival, there's a temple fair in front of the Fengdu Great Emperor's hall on the mountain. Everyone rushes up the mountain to worship and offer incense. The scene is so lively!

original_text: 霍琳：听说地府中的刑罚多到数不清，什么拔舌剥皮、上刀山下火海、炸油锅……听听就寒毛直竖，所以人呐，活着的时候可不能做坏事！
translation: Huo Lin: I hear hell has countless punishments: tongue-pulling, skinning, climbing knife mountains, crossing fire seas, boiling oil... Just hearing it makes my hair stand on end. So, people mustn't do evil while alive!

original_text: 霍琳：酆都附近从来也没有闹过妖怪，一来有鬼神守着，二来在蜀山剑仙的眼皮底下，妖怪还不早吓跑了？
translation: Huo Lin: There have never been any demon disturbances near Fengdu. First, there are ghosts and gods guarding it; second, under the watchful eyes of Shu Mountain sword immortals, demons would have been scared off long ago!

original_text: 孟巧菱：奈何桥就在前面了，喝了孟婆粥，好过奈何桥～这瘦肉榨菜茶汁煮的，是男粥，这泉水豆汁煮的，是女粥～你们可要尝一尝？
translation: Meng Qiaoling: Naihe Bridge is just ahead. Drink Mengpo porridge to cross Naihe Bridge~ This one with lean pork, pickled mustard, and tea broth is men's porridge; this with spring water and bean broth is women's porridge~ Care to try?

original_text: 孟巧菱：酆都的豆腐乳，叫做仙家豆腐乳，是平都山上的仙人传下来的方子，别处可吃不着～
translation: Meng Qiaoling: Fengdu's fermented tofu is called Immortal's Fermented Tofu. It's made from a recipe passed down by immortals from Mount Pingdu. You can't get it anywhere else~

original_text: 孟巧菱：酆都附近的山上有很多庙，常有和尚来我婆婆的摊上买豆腐乳，好吃的东西谁都爱吃嘛。
translation: Meng Qiaoling: There are many temples on the mountains near Fengdu. Monks often come to my mother-in-law's stall to buy fermented tofu. Everyone loves delicious food.

original_text: 仇仲：老板娘～来两碗孟婆粥！荤的素的各一碗，我都要尝尝！
translation: Qiu Zhong: Boss lady~ Two bowls of Mengpo Porridge! One meat, one veggie, I want to try both!

original_text: 孟祝：这可不行，喝孟婆粥，男荤女素是定好的，你还是喝荤粥好了。
translation: Meng Zhu: That won't do. Drinking Mengpo Porridge, men get meat, women get vegetarian, that's the rule. You should drink the meat porridge.

original_text: 仇仲：真麻烦！我一个大男人，喝了这素粥还会变女人不成！我就是不信邪，今天一定要喝一碗素粥！
translation: Qiu Zhong: So troublesome! I'm a grown man-drinking this vegetarian porridge won't turn me into a woman! I refuse to believe it; today I must have a bowl of vegetarian porridge!

original_text: 仇仲：别看这酆都好像阳间的阴曹地府一样，其实这什么鬼门关、奈何桥，还不都是活人造的，有什么好怕？！
translation: Qiu Zhong: Don't think this Fengdu is like the Netherworld of the living world. In fact, things like the Ghost Gate and Naihe Bridge are all made by the living, what's there to be afraid of?!

original_text: 仇仲：蜀山派斩妖除魔，在西蜀一带颇有威名，我定要找时间上山拜访一下！
translation: Qiu Zhong: The Shu Mountain Sect slays demons and monsters, quite renowned in the western Shu region. I must find time to visit the mountain!

original_text: 石丫头：客官可要来一坛咱们酆都的麻咂酒尝尝？记好哟！开了坛子先灌开水，过半个时辰，用竹管插进坛子吸着喝才最有味道。
translation: Shi Yatou: Would you like to try a jar of our Fengdu maza wine? Remember this! After opening the jar, first pour in boiling water, wait an hour, then insert a bamboo tube and sip it-that's the best way to enjoy it.

original_text: 石丫头：听说人死后到了地府，要是阳寿未尽还能还阳呢！怪不得有的人气都断了还能突然活过来，这鬼差也有抓错人的时候呐。
translation: Shi Yatou: I heard that when people die and go to the Netherworld, if their lifespan isn't up yet, they can return to life! No wonder some people who've stopped breathing can suddenly revive. Even ghost officers make mistakes sometimes.

original_text: 石丫头：店里那外地商人刚到我们城里就直嚷着要回去，可她在这儿一住数日，现在也没有想走的意思嘛！真是个怪人。
translation: Shi Yatou: That out-of-town merchant at the shop kept clamoring to go back as soon as she arrived in our city, but she's been staying here for days now and still shows no sign of leaving! What a strange person.

original_text: 汤金花：酆都城果真和传闻中的一样阴森，晚上睡在客栈里还有怪声传来，真是毛骨悚然！亏这里的人还能一直住下去！
translation: Tang Jinhua: Fengdu City is indeed as eerie as the rumors say. Strange sounds come from the inn at night-it's absolutely chilling! I can't believe the people here can keep living here!

original_text: 汤金花：我听说酆都的符纸生意好，就想着来这儿卖符纸大赚一笔，没想到这地方简直就是个阴曹地府，鬼门关、奈何桥、阎王殿，就差没十八层地狱了！
translation: Tang Jinhua: I heard the talisman paper business was good in Fengdu, so I thought I'd come here to make a fortune selling talisman paper. Who knew this place is practically the Netherworld itself-Ghost Gate, Naihe Bridge, King Yama's Hall, all that's missing are the Eighteen Levels of Hell!

original_text: 汤金花：在这儿住久了，也觉得没刚来时那么阴森，符纸的生意当然还得做，否则我这一来一回的车马费，可就白费啦！
translation: Tang Jinhua: Having lived here a while, it doesn't feel as eerie as when I first arrived. Of course, the talisman paper business must go on, otherwise my round-trip travel expenses would be wasted!

original_text: 洛淑娴：每年中元节，城里都有庙会，到时候，从山脚一直到山顶酆都大帝庙门前，满城都是冥纸、冥衣、线香、烛火……该有的一样不少！
translation: Luo Shuxian: Every year during the Ghost Festival, there's a temple fair in the city. From the mountain foot all the way to the gate of the Great Emperor of Fengdu's temple at the summit, the whole city is filled with spirit money, spirit clothes, incense sticks, candle flames... everything that should be there is there!

original_text: 洛淑娴：夜里子时，从山下的城门口，可以去鬼界，不过听人说，那也只是鬼界最外头，进不到更里面，想要见到死去的亲人更是难上加难！
translation: Luo Shuxian: At midnight, you can go to the Ghost Realm from the city gate at the mountain's base. But I've heard that's only the outermost part of the Ghost Realm; you can't go deeper inside. Wanting to see deceased relatives is even more difficult!

original_text: 洛淑娴：俗话说“七月十五鬼乱窜”，中元节那天，我坐在家里就能看见窗外山上鬼火簇簇，还听到哭声呢！
translation: Luo Shuxian: As the saying goes, 'On the fifteenth of July, ghosts run amok'. On the Ghost Festival, sitting at home I can see clusters of will-o'-the-wisps on the mountain outside the window and hear crying!

original_text: 卢定屏：酆都城外的平都山，是道家七十二福地之一，汉时还有王方平、阴长生两人在此得道成仙，如此说来，这酆都应是仙城，而不是如今这般的鬼城呀？
translation: Lu Dingping: Pingdu Mountain outside Fengdu City is one of the seventy-two blessed lands of Taoism. In the Han Dynasty, Wang Fangping and Yin Changsheng even attained immortality there. So, Fengdu should be a city of immortals, not the ghost city it is today, right?

original_text: 卢定屏：蜀山仙剑派的仙人个个法力高深，行走江湖时不仅斩妖除魔，更是惩奸除恶，实乃真英雄、真仙人也！
translation: Lu Dingping: The immortals of the Shu Mountain Sword Sect are all highly skilled in magic. When traveling the jianghu, they not only slay demons and monsters but also punish evildoers, truly real heroes and immortals!

original_text: 小峰：潘家哥哥人真好，天天服侍他爷爷，这回他爷爷病了，他还特地上蜀山去求仙丹呢！
translation: Xiao Feng: Brother Pan is so kind, serving his grandfather every day. Now that his grandfather is sick, he even went to Mount Shu to seek immortal pills!

original_text: 小峰：你看！这是潘家哥哥给我做的竹剑，不错吧？看起来是不是像蜀山仙人一样神气？嘻嘻～
translation: Xiao Feng: Look! This bamboo sword was made for me by Brother Pan. Nice, right? Doesn't it look as impressive as an immortal from Mount Shu? Hehe~

original_text: 小峰：潘家哥哥去蜀山求仙丹回来了！他说蜀山的仙人都很好，一听他说是帮爷爷求药，马上就把仙丹给了他～
translation: Xiao Feng: Brother Pan has returned from seeking immortal pills at Shu Mountain! He said the immortals there are very kind. As soon as he mentioned he was seeking medicine for his grandfather, they immediately gave him the pills~

original_text: 商老太：眼前这桥就是奈何桥，那边不远处的池子叫做“血河池”，我常在这儿烧纸钱、供香火，希望以后在阴间的日子能过的好些。
translation: Granny Shang: This bridge ahead is Naihe Bridge. The pool not far over there is called 'Blood River Pool'. I often burn paper money and offer incense here, hoping for a better afterlife in the Netherworld.

original_text: 商老太：阴间的奈何桥可是和这座不太一样，听说窄得很呐，只有生前为善的人才能通过，生前为恶的人，只能掉下去，被河里的毒虫吃掉！
translation: Granny Shang: The Naihe Bridge in the Netherworld is quite different from this one. I heard it's very narrow! Only those who did good deeds in life can pass. Those who did evil in life can only fall down and be eaten by the poisonous insects in the river!

original_text: 傅继德：少侠，要不要在我这儿买几张符纸辟邪？随身带着总是好的～
translation: Fu Jide: Young hero, want to buy some talisman paper from me to ward off evil? It's always good to carry some~

original_text: 傅继德：告诉你别不信，我这画符的法子是蜀山仙人教的，不仅能驱邪护身，还能斩妖除魔呢～
translation: Fu Jide: Don't you not believe me! This talisman-drawing method was taught by an immortal from Mount Shu. It can not only ward off evil and protect the body but also slay demons and monsters~

original_text: 傅继德：最近来了个外乡人，也是卖符纸的！他那不知从哪里学来的邪门歪道，怎么比得上我这蜀山仙人亲传的符法？想跟我抢生意，作梦！
translation: Fu Jide: Recently, an outsider came, also selling talisman paper! His shady methods, learned from who knows where, how can they compare to my talisman arts personally passed down by the Shu Mountain Immortal? Trying to compete with me for business? Dream on!

original_text: 董桂花：那次我在山中被毒蛇咬伤，幸好被一个路过的剑仙所救，他长得好英俊呀～可人家不是说仙人都很长寿的吗？他不会已经几百岁了吧？
translation: Dong Guihua: That time I was bitten by a poisonous snake in the mountains, luckily saved by a passing sword immortal. He was so handsome~ But don't they say immortals live very long? Could he already be hundreds of years old?

original_text: 董桂花：听说蜀山派的仙人大都清心寡欲，一心只为修仙，难道他们都不结婚生子吗？
translation: Dong Guihua: I heard most immortals of the Shu Mountain Sect are pure-hearted and desireless, focused solely on cultivation. Do they not marry and have children?

original_text: 董桂花：我才刚知道，原来蜀山上也有女仙人的，你看我怎么样～要是努力修行，也能得道吗？
translation: Dong Guihua: I just learned that there are female immortals on Mount Shu too. What do you think of me~ If I cultivate diligently, can I also attain the Way?

original_text: 常梦如：我们药栈的紫菁玉蓉膏，是我姐姐上蜀山求了仙人三天三夜，仙人才给她的秘方！不管你有什么病，只要一瓶药，保管你立刻就好起来！
translation: Chang Mengru: Our pharmacy's Renewal Salve is a secret recipe my sister begged the immortals on Mount Shu for three days and three nights before they gave it to her! No matter what illness you have, just one bottle will guarantee you recover instantly!

original_text: 常梦如：我的天啊！姐姐炼的仙丹被家里的小花偷吃了，它吃过就断气了，也不知是不是尸解成仙了？
translation: Chang Mengru: Oh my goodness! The immortal elixir Sister refined was stolen and eaten by our Xiao Hua. It died right after eating it. Could it have ascended to immortality?

original_text: 常梦如：唉，小花托梦给我，说它吃了姐姐炼的丹药，已经变成了一只仙猪，以后都不会再回来了……
translation: Chang Mengru: Sigh, Xiao Hua appeared in my dream and said it ate the elixir Sister refined, turned into an immortal pig, and will never come back...

original_text: 孙安：我师父真是个神医，连仙丹都能炼出来！上回我亲眼看见后院的猪吃了仙丹，立刻就升天了，只留下一副臭皮囊！
translation: Sun An: My master is truly a divine physician-he can even refine immortal elixirs! Last time, I saw with my own eyes a pig in the backyard eat an elixir and immediately ascend to heaven, leaving behind only a stinky carcass!

original_text: 孙安：师父上次炼成的仙丹不小心被后院的猪吃了，后来就再也没炼成第二颗，她为了这事烦恼得要命……
translation: Sun An: The immortal elixir Master refined last time was accidentally eaten by the pig in the backyard. She hasn't been able to refine a second one since and is terribly upset about it...

original_text: 黄凤苹：前阵子我在城外山上被仇家打伤，逃进城来买伤药，常大夫给了我一瓶紫菁玉容膏，才用了一回，我的伤就好了大半～
translation: Huang Fengping: A while ago, I was injured by an enemy outside the city on the mountain and fled into town to buy medicine. Dr. Chang gave me a bottle of Renewal Salve, and after just one use, my wound was mostly healed~

original_text: 黄凤苹：那天我被仇家追杀，夜半进城，在城门处看到一道青光，几个人就凭空消失了！第二天听城里人说起，才知道子时能从城门口去鬼界……
translation: Huang Fengping: That day, I was being chased by enemies and entered the city late at night. At the city gate, I saw a blue light, and several people vanished into thin air! The next day, I heard from townsfolk that you can go to the Ghost Realm from the city gate at midnight...

original_text: 黄凤苹：江湖上打打杀杀的事我已经厌了，这几天想着干脆就上蜀山拜师修仙，从此远离纷争，但又不知蜀山派收不收我这满手血腥的江湖人。
translation: Huang Fengping: I'm tired of the fighting and killing in the martial world. These days, I'm thinking of simply going to Mount Shu to seek apprenticeship and cultivate immortality, staying away from conflicts. But I don't know if the Shu Mountain Sect would accept a martial artist with bloodstained hands.

original_text: 贾大嘴：酆都大帝殿就在山顶上，只有十殿阎王、玉皇大帝、王母娘娘生辰的日子才能进殿拜祭，其余时候一律不得上山！
translation: Big-Mouth Jia: The Hall of the Great Emperor of Fengdu is atop the mountain. You can only enter to worship on the birthdays of the Ten Kings of Hell, the Jade Emperor, and the Queen Mother. All other times, no one is allowed up!

original_text: 贾大嘴：马彪他娘子都死了好几年了，他不再娶，还每月请道士做法让他娘子还阳来相见，真比女人还死心眼！
translation: Big-Mouth Jia: Ma Biao's wife died years ago. He won't remarry and hires Taoists every month to summon her spirit. Stubborn as a woman!

original_text: 马彪：平日不能上山的，你请回吧，要是想拜酆都大帝，每年的九月九再来。
translation: Ma Biao: Normally, you can't go up the mountain. Please turn back. If you want to worship the Emperor of Fengdu, come again on the ninth day of the ninth month each year.

original_text: 葛大娘：蒋道士！您救救我家三宝吧！有天夜里他从坟地回来，就突然犯了癫痫，话也说不出，饭也喂不进！
translation: Auntie Ge: Taoist Jiang! Please save my Sanbao! One night he returned from the graveyard and suddenly had a seizure, couldn't speak, and couldn't eat!

original_text: 蒋子牙：莫急莫急，令郎这是冲犯了死人，恶鬼上身哪。
translation: Jiang Ziya: Don't worry, don't worry. Your son has offended the dead; an evil spirit has possessed him.

original_text: 葛大娘：这小子常常往坟地里跑，也不知道他是去干嘛了！这回终于闯祸了，道士您可千万要救救他啊！
translation: Auntie Ge: That boy often runs off to the graveyard, and I've no idea what he's up to! Now he's finally gotten into trouble. Taoist master, you must save him!

original_text: 蒋子牙：我给你三道符，你将它们供到祭桌上，早中晚各三柱香，到第二天将符纸拿到香烛上烧了，符灰兑水给令郎喝，就该没事了。
translation: Jiang Ziya: I'll give you three talismans. Place them on the altar table, burn three incense sticks morning, noon, and night. The next day, burn the talismans over a candle, mix the ashes with water, and have your son drink it. He should be fine then.

original_text: 葛大娘：上次我家三宝莫名其妙犯癫痫，多亏了蒋道士给的符，才让他捡回一条小命！后来三宝自己说，以前总去别人的坟头偷供品吃！这孩子，真是不要命了！
translation: Auntie Ge: Last time, my Sanbao suddenly had a seizure for no reason! Thanks to Taoist Jiang's talisman, he barely escaped with his life! Later, Sanbao admitted he used to steal offerings from others' graves to eat! That child, really reckless with his life!

original_text: 罗天海：其实这山上只是酆都城的一部分，山下的房子和人更多，店家也更热闹，我一直都很想搬到山下去住，却又担心随便移居引来鬼神不满……
translation: Luo Tianhai: Actually, this mountain is only part of Fengdu City. There are more houses and people below the mountain, and the shops are livelier. I've always wanted to move down the mountain, but I worry that moving arbitrarily might displease the ghosts and deities...

original_text: 罗天海：“能上山、莫下水”，要不是我这把老骨头经不起每天在山里头砍柴打猎的折腾，也不用每天到山下的大江里去吃风浪啦！
translation: Luo Tianhai: 'Better climb mountains than go down to water'. If my old bones could withstand chopping wood and hunting in the mountains every day, I wouldn't have to brave the winds and waves in the big river below!

original_text: 顾思：傅师父画符的本事高着呢！我每天都在铺子里看他画，明明只要用毛笔沾了朱砂就行，可我就怎么都学不来……
translation: Gu Si: Master Fu's talisman-drawing skills are superb! I watch him draw in the shop every day. It seems like all you need is a brush dipped in cinnabar, but I just can't learn it no matter what...

original_text: 顾思：听傅师父说，各路神仙道士画的符，还全都是不一样的！这……反正符纸上画什么我也看不明白，只要能驱鬼辟邪，还不是全一样～
translation: Gu Si: I heard from Master Fu that the talismans drawn by various immortals and Taoist priests are all different! This... Anyway, I can't understand what's drawn on the talisman paper. As long as it can exorcise ghosts and ward off evil, isn't it all the same~

original_text: 芳蕊：城里会画符的人很多，不过傅师父画符的本事，听说是跟蜀山上的仙人学来的，符上的咒术可厉害呢！
translation: Fang Rui: Many in the city can draw talismans, but Master Fu's talisman skills are said to be learned from immortals on Mount Shu. The spells on his talismans are incredibly powerful!

original_text: 芳蕊：酆都阴气重，在城里是不太要紧，但要是上山采茶采药的，总得带些符纸在身上，即使遇到什么不干净的东西，有符在身就不用怕。
