translation: Fang Rui: Fengdu has heavy yin energy. It's not too serious in the city, but those who go up the mountain to pick tea or herbs should carry some talismans. Even if they encounter something unclean, with talismans, there's nothing to fear.

original_text: 甘将：这把木剑的做工看起来很精细，不错、不错～我就用这把函灵剑换你的木剑吧，就算加上替我跑腿的盘缠，小兄弟你也不吃亏。
translation: Gan Jiang: This wooden sword's craftsmanship looks quite refined, good, good~ I'll trade you this Spiritcall Sword for your wooden sword. Even counting the travel expenses for running my errand, Young man, you're not losing out.

original_text: 花费150文钱住宿吗？
translation: Spend 150 wen to stay the night?

original_text: 石崇：您身上的钱不够。
translation: Shi Chong: You don't have enough money on you.

original_text:
我这铁铺别的东西卖不掉，只有这驱鬼用的桃木剑，总是有人要买。不过我是个铁匠，不怎么擅长做木剑，小兄弟，能帮我找把木剑来，让我好好学一学吗？
你愿意帮我去找把吗？
translation:
Nothing else in my smithy sells, only these peachwood swords for warding off ghosts always find buyers. But I'm a blacksmith, not very skilled at making wooden swords. Young man, could you help me find a wooden sword so I can properly learn?
Will you help me find one?

original_text: 云天河：还是不要进去为好。
translation: Yun Tianhe: It's better not to go in.

original_text: 云天河：那边不知道是哪里，现在还有其他重要的事要做。
translation: Yun Tianhe: I don't know what's over there, and there are other important things to do now.

original_text: 韩菱纱：……妖界，看起来和人间果然差好多……
translation: Han Lingsha: ... The yao realm... it really looks so different from the human world...

original_text: 云天河：那个发光的球是啥？
translation: Yun Tianhe: What's that glowing orb?

original_text: 瞳幽：……！！你们！是怎么穿过结界的？！
translation: Tongyou: ...!! You! How did you pass through the barrier?!

original_text: 瞳寂：蓝衣白衫！他们是琼华派的人！！
translation: Tongji: Blue robes, white garments! They're from Qionghua Sect!!

original_text: 韩菱纱：哎？！等等，我们不是——
translation: Han Lingsha: Huh?! Wait, we're not-

original_text: 瞳幽：不管你们如何穿过结界！琼华派的就要受死！
translation: Tongyou: No matter how you passed the barrier! Qionghua Sect members must die!

original_text: 韩菱纱：等等！你们听我把话说完呀！
translation: Han Lingsha: Wait! Let me finish speaking!

original_text: 慕容紫英：小心！！
translation: Murong Ziying: Watch out!!

original_text: 瞳幽：杀、杀了我们也没用！你们人休想攻下幻瞑界……
translation: Tongyou: K-killing us is pointless! You humans will never conquer Twilight Realm...

original_text: 慕容紫英：死到临头，还逞口舌之利。
translation: Murong Ziying: At death's door, and still so sharp-tongued?

original_text: 韩菱纱：慢着！紫英，他们说不定是梦璃的族人，怎么可以痛下杀手呢？！
translation: Han Lingsha: Wait! Ziying, they might be Mengli's clansmen. How can we kill them mercilessly?!

original_text: 慕容紫英：族人……
translation: Murong Ziying: Clansmen...

original_text: ？？：婵幽大人说的没错，果然有人毫发无伤地穿过结界。
translation: ??: Lady Chanyou was right, someone indeed passed through the barrier unscathed.

original_text: ？？：你们，闯入我幻瞑界，便该做好有来无回的准备！！
translation: ??: You, who trespass into my Twilight Realm, should be prepared to never return!!

original_text: 云天河：这个人……好强的杀气……
translation: Yun Tianhe: This person... has such a strong killing intent...

original_text: 云天河：菱纱，你先退后！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Lingsha, step back first!

original_text: 韩菱纱：可是，为什么要打？！我们不是敌人啊！
translation: Han Lingsha: But, why fight?! We're not enemies!

original_text: ？？：拖延时间，莫非是在等其他援手？
translation: ???: Delaying, are you waiting for other reinforcements?

original_text: ？？：休想如愿！
translation: ??: Don't even think about it!

original_text: 云天河：这个人……不好对付……
translation: Yun Tianhe: This person... not easy to deal with...

original_text: ？？：哼，顽抗下去，不过是垂死挣扎！
translation: ???: Hmph, resisting is just a futile struggle!

original_text: 柳梦璃：归邪将军，请住手！
translation: Liu Mengli: General Guixie, please stop!

original_text: 云天河：梦璃？！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Mengli?!

original_text: 归邪：少主？！您怎么来了？
translation: Guixie: Young Mistress?! Why are you here?

original_text: 柳梦璃：我听说有人穿过了结界，所以来看看……
translation: Liu Mengli: I heard someone passed through the barrier, so I came to see...

original_text: 柳梦璃：将军，他们是我的朋友，请不要伤害他们！
translation: Liu Mengli: General, they are my friends, please don't harm them!

original_text: 归邪：……
translation: Guixie: ...

original_text: 云天河：梦璃，你、你没事吧？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Mengli, are... are you alright?

original_text: 柳梦璃：云公子，我……
translation: Liu Mengli: Yun, I...

original_text: 韩菱纱：好梦璃，你怎么能一声不吭就跑了？你知道我有多担心吗？
translation: Han Lingsha: My dear Mengli, how could you run off without a word? Do you know how worried I was?

original_text: 柳梦璃：对不起，我当日也是情非得已，我不知道要如何向你们解释……
translation: Liu Mengli: I'm sorry, I had no choice that day. I didn't know how to explain it to you all...

original_text: 慕容紫英：……你，是属于此界的妖？
translation: Murong Ziying: ... So, are you a yaoguai belonging to this realm?

original_text: 柳梦璃：嗯……不错，我乃是幻瞑界族长的女儿。
translation: Liu Mengli: Mm... Correct, I am the daughter of the clan leader of the Twilight Realm.

original_text: 慕容紫英：……！
translation: Murong Ziying: ...!

original_text: 柳梦璃：十九年前在妖界和琼华派大战之时，我尚且年幼，差点死于琼华派弟子之手，幸好云叔救了我，把我送去人间……
translation: Liu Mengli: Nineteen years ago, during the war between yao realm and Qionghua Sect, I was young and nearly killed by a Qionghua disciple. Luckily, Uncle Yun saved me and sent me to the mortal world...

original_text: 柳梦璃：不知是否妖界临近的缘故，这段原本很模糊的记忆，在那天突然变得清晰起来……大战在即，我不可能抛下自己的族人，所以一定要回来。
translation: Liu Mengli: I don't know if it's because the yao realm is approaching, but that originally very vague memory suddenly became clear that day... With the great battle imminent, I cannot abandon my own clan, so I had to return.

original_text: 慕容紫英：以妖类而言，你修为不算精深，为何连二位长老都无法觉察你的身份？
translation: Murong Ziying: For a yao, your cultivation isn't deep. Why couldn't even our two Elders detect your identity?

original_text: 柳梦璃：……幻瞑界入口的结界并未被强行突破，你们……究竟是如何进来的？
translation: Liu Mengli: ...The barrier at the entrance to the Twilight Realm wasn't forcibly breached. How... how did you all get in?

original_text: 归邪：少主，属下不敬，只不过即便是少主的朋友，毕竟是“人”，进入幻瞑界中，并不妥当！
translation: Guixie: Young Mistress, this subordinate is being disrespectful, but even if they are your friends, they are all 'humans'. It is not proper for them to enter the Twilight Realm!

original_text: 柳梦璃：我知道，所以我要让他们去幻瞑宫拜见我娘，如何行止，由娘来定夺。若是娘怪罪下来，一切罪责由我承担。
translation: Liu Mengli: I know. That's why I want them to go to Twilight Palace to pay respects to my mother. How to proceed will be up to her. If Mother blames anyone, I will bear all responsibility.

original_text: 归邪：……是。
translation: Guixie: ...Yes.

original_text: 柳梦璃：你们来此一事，我要先去禀报我娘，也就是幻瞑界之主……
translation: Liu Mengli: About your coming here, I need to report first to my mother, the mistress of Twilight Realm...

original_text: 柳梦璃：我们等一下就在<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>旋梦底层的幻瞑宫</colour><dc0>相见吧。</dc0>
translation: Liu Mengli: Let's meet later at<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> the Twilight Palace on the bottom floor of Spindream</colour><dc0>.</dc0>

original_text: 韩菱纱：可是……
translation: Han Lingsha: But...

original_text: 柳梦璃：不必担心，没有妖会伤害你们的。
translation: Liu Mengli: Don't worry, no one will harm you.

original_text: 柳梦璃：若想进入<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>旋梦</colour><dc0>，走近那个</dc0><colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>巨大光球旁的法阵</colour><dc0>便是。</dc0>
translation: Liu Mengli: To enter<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> Spindream</colour><dc0>, just approach the</dc0><colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> magic array beside the giant orb of light</colour><dc0>.</dc0>

original_text: 韩菱纱：那个……真的是梦璃吗？
translation: Han Lingsha: ... Is that really Mengli?

original_text: 云天河：当然是！一眼就能认出来吧……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Of course! You can tell at a glance...

original_text: 韩菱纱：哎，我说的不是那种啦，总觉得……她虽然看起来没有变，可是偏偏离我们好远……
translation: Han Lingsha: Ah, I didn't mean that. It feels like... she seems unchanged, yet somehow so distant from us...

original_text: 云天河：也对。她怎么了？对我们好冷淡……
translation: Yun Tianhe: That's true. What's wrong with her? She's so cold to us...

original_text: 慕容紫英：一切的事情，恐怕只有她能告诉我们，不妨等下见面再说。
translation: Murong Ziying: All the answers probably only she can tell us. We might as well wait until we meet her to discuss.

original_text: 婵幽：璃儿，你说的朋友……便是这几人？
translation: Chanyou: Lili, the friends you spoke of... are they?

original_text: 柳梦璃：……正是。
translation: Liu Mengli: ... Exactly.

original_text: 柳梦璃：这位便是我娘，也是幻瞑界的主人。
translation: Liu Mengli: This is my mother, also the Mistress of Twilight Realm.

original_text: 婵幽：哼，岂有此理！
translation: Chanyou: Hmph, how preposterous!

original_text: 柳梦璃：……娘？
translation: Liu Mengli: ... Mother?

original_text: 婵幽：璃儿，你愿意回到我族，我十分高兴，但想不到你竟把“人”都带进了幻瞑宫！
translation: Chanyou: Lili, I'm overjoyed that you're willing to return to our clan, but I never expected you'd bring 'humans' into the Twilight Palace!

original_text: 柳梦璃：娘！他们、他们是我的朋友，不是敌人……
translation: Liu Mengli: They, they are my friends, not enemies...

original_text: 婵幽：不是敌人？莫非我看错了，那个穿蓝衣、背剑匣的，不是昆仑琼华派的人？！
translation: Chanyou: Not enemies? Could I be mistaken? That person in blue, carrying a sword case, isn't he from the Kunlun Qionghua Sect?!

original_text: 柳梦璃：……他……他与其他人不一样的。
translation: Liu Mengli: ... He... he's different from other people.

original_text: 婵幽：璃儿，我确实很感激当年救了你的那个人，他将你送给可靠之人抚养，更赠你宝物帝女翡翠，以掩盖身上妖气……没有他，我们母女又何来日后重逢！
translation: Chanyou: Lili, I am truly grateful to the person who saved you back then. He entrusted you to reliable foster parents and even gave you the Princess Jadeite to conceal your yao aura... Without him, how could Mother and you have reunited nineteen years later!

original_text: 婵幽：但是，人终究是人！你要与人为伍，也要先想清楚，他们是不是真的接纳你！还是将你当作异类来看！
translation: Chanyou: But humans are still humans! If you want to be among them, think carefully first: do they truly accept you? Or do they see you as an outsider?

original_text: 韩菱纱：不是的！
translation: Han Lingsha: That's not truth!

original_text: 韩菱纱：我们真的是把梦璃当作好朋友，才不在乎她的身份！
translation: Han Lingsha: We truly consider Mengli a good friend, that's why we don't care about her identity!

original_text: 婵幽：哦？那你们倒是说来听听，区区三个人，便敢胆大包天闯入此地，到底是为了什么？莫非仗着梦璃是幻瞑界少主，就以为能得到她的庇护？
translation: Chanyou: Oh? Then tell me, why do you three dare to be so audacious as to intrude here? Do you rely on Mengli being the young mistress of the Twilight Realm, thinking you can gain her protection?

original_text: 云天河：我们不知道梦璃是什么少主，来这里也只不过因为她忽然离开，我们担心她遇到危险，现在看她没事，也就放心了。
translation: Yun Tianhe: We didn't know Mengli was some kind of mistress. We came here only because she left suddenly, and we worried she might be in danger. Seeing she's fine now, we're relieved.

original_text: 柳梦璃：云公子……
translation: Liu Mengli: Yun...

original_text: 婵幽：……你们如何穿过入口结界的？
translation: Chanyou: ...How did you pass through the entrance barrier?

original_text: 婵幽：自从十九年前，被那些可憎之人攻到幻瞑宫前，我便立下决心，妖界若能不亡，我定要在入口布下强大结界，让擅闯之人不得好死！但你们几个……竟能毫发无伤地穿过？
translation: Chanyou: Ever since nineteen years ago, when those detestable people attacked right before the Twilight Palace, I resolved that if our yao realm could survive, I would definitely set up a powerful barrier at the entrance, making any intruders meet a terrible end! But you few... actually passed through unscathed?

original_text: 云天河：我们去了鬼界……
translation: Yun Tianhe: We went to the Ghost Realm...

original_text: 柳梦璃：鬼界！……
translation: Liu Mengli: Ghost Realm!...

original_text: 云天河：取了一种叫翳影枝的东西，听说只要有了它，天底下大多数地方都能随便来去。
translation: Yun Tianhe: We got something called Shadowveil Sprig. Heard that with it, you can go almost anywhere on earth freely.
Liu Mengli: ......

original_text: 婵幽：哦，那可真不简单。
translation: Chanyou: Oh, that's truly remarkable.

original_text: 婵幽：既然诸位为我女儿煞费苦心，只是担心她的安危，那眼见她平安无事，就请回吧。
translation: Chanyou: Since you all have gone to such lengths for my daughter, merely concerned for her safety, now that you see she's safe and sound, please return.

original_text: 柳梦璃：娘！
translation: Liu Mengli: Mother!

original_text: 婵幽：如何？你舍不得吗？是舍不得他们全部？还是舍不得其中哪一个呢？
translation: Chanyou: Well? Can't bear to part? Is it all of them? Or is it one in particular?
Xizhong: ...?!

original_text: 柳梦璃：娘……女儿想带他们去里幻瞑宫，让他们知晓当年之事……
translation: Liu Mengli: Mother... Daughter wishes to take them to Inner Twilight Palace, to let them know about the past events...

original_text: 婵幽：放肆！里幻瞑宫为妖界重地，连本族也很少入内，你，要带三个外人前去？
translation: Chanyou: How dare you! The Inner Twilight Palace is a crucial place of our yao realm, rarely entered even by our own kind. And you want to bring three outsiders there?

original_text: 柳梦璃：娘，我求求您，云公子的爹就是当年救了我的云叔啊！
translation: Liu Mengli: Mother, I beg you. Yun's father is Uncle Yun, who saved me back then!

original_text: 婵幽：哦？他竟是那人的孩子？
translation: Chanyou: Oh? He's actually that person's son?

original_text: 柳梦璃：嗯……幻瞑昆仑之战，云公子一定也是满腹疑惑，我只想让他看看当年之事……
translation: Liu Mengli: Mm... Regarding the battle between Twilight and Kunlun, Yun must have many questions. I just want him to see what happened back then...

original_text: 云天河：是爹……以前的事？！
translation: Yun Tianhe: It's Father's... matters from the past?!

original_text: 婵幽：……我族向来恩怨分明……
translation: Chanyou: ...My clan has always been clear about debts and favors...

original_text: 婵幽：好吧，璃儿，看在他爹对我们母女有恩的份上，我便依你一次，但这几人若有不轨之心，我定不饶恕！
translation: Chanyou: Very well, Lili. For the sake of the kindness his father showed us, I will agree this once. But if these people harbor ill intentions, I will not spare them!

original_text: 柳梦璃：谢谢娘！
translation: Liu Mengli: Thanks, Mother!

original_text: 婵幽：……若想好要进<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>里幻瞑宫</colour><dc0>了，便来</dc0><colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>告诉我</colour><dc0>，我送你们前去。</dc0>
translation: Chanyou: ...If you've decided to enter the<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> Inner Twilight Palace</colour><dc0>, come</dc0><colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> tell me</colour><dc0>, and I'll send you there.</dc0>

original_text: 奚仲：大人……您的身体，怕是不宜再施展法术……
translation: Xizhong: My Lady... your body likely cannot withstand casting spells anymore...

original_text: 婵幽：无妨，我自有分寸。
translation: Chanyou: No matter, I know my limits.

original_text: 奚仲：是……
translation: Xizhong: Yes...

original_text: 韩菱纱：梦璃，你要带我们去哪里？
translation: Han Lingsha: Mengli, where are you taking us?

original_text: 柳梦璃：是一个可以重现梦境的地方，我想，你们看过之后便会明白，幻瞑昆仑之战的那些渊源。
translation: Liu Mengli: It's a place where dreams can be recreated. I think after you see it, you'll understand the origins of the war between Twilight and Kunlun.

original_text: 慕容紫英：……与琼华派相关？
translation: Murong Ziying: ... Related to Qionghua Sect?

original_text: 柳梦璃：紫英……我知道，你对妖的厌恶、十几年来根深蒂固的想法，并非一朝一夕可以改变……
translation: Liu Mengli: Ziying... I know your hatred for yaoguais, deeply ingrained over more than a decade, cannot be changed overnight...

original_text: 柳梦璃：去了<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>里幻暝宫</colour><dc0>，我会告诉你们一些当年往事……或许，你会明白，人自然有人的想法，但我们也有我们的无奈……</dc0>
translation: Liu Mengli: After going to<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> the inner Twilight Palace</colour><dc0>, I will tell you some things from the past... Perhaps you will understand that humans naturally have their own thoughts, but we also have our own helplessness...</dc0>

original_text: 慕容紫英：……
translation: Murong Ziying: ...

original_text: 柳梦璃：我们并不是像许多人以为的那样凶残，一定要吃人伤人……
translation: Liu Mengli: We aren't as cruel as many think, that we must eat or harm humans...

original_text: 慕容紫英：但妖与人相争，人力多半微小不可及，只能任由宰割，这却是不争的事实……
translation: Murong Ziying: But in conflicts between yaoguais and humans, human power is often insignificant, leaving them helplessly slaughtered-this is an undeniable fact...

original_text: 柳梦璃：人力虽然微渺，可是人的相争之心，却比任何东西都要可怕。
translation: Liu Mengli: Human strength may be feeble, but the human heart's love for strife is more terrifying than anything.

original_text: 慕容紫英：相争之心……
translation: Murong Ziying: The love for strife...

original_text: 韩菱纱：不管怎么样，<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>我们先和梦璃去里幻瞑宫吧，</colour><dc0>梦璃一定有她的道理的，绝不会随随便便这样讲。</dc0>
translation: Han Lingsha: No matter what,<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> let's first go with Mengli to the inner Twilight Palace,</colour><dc0> Mengli must have her reasons, she wouldn't say something like that lightly.</dc0>

original_text: 云天河：对啊，要是妖真的不好，那我们一见梦璃的娘，早就打起来了……可是她娘也没怎么啊，她还谢谢我爹救了梦璃呢。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Right, if yaoguais were truly bad, we'd have fought Mengli's mother the moment we saw her... But she wasn't like that. She even thanked Father for saving Mengli.

original_text: 慕容紫英：……我明白了。
translation: Murong Ziying: ... I understand.

original_text: 慕容紫英：梦璃，请你把当年往事原原本本地告诉我，我要弄清楚，还有什么是我不知道的隐情，又有什么，是我一直以来都没有想过的……
translation: Murong Ziying: Mengli, please tell me the whole story of what happened back then. I need to understand what other hidden circumstances I don't know about, and what I have never considered all along...

original_text: 柳梦璃：嗯……谢谢你，紫英，你愿意这么说，我已经很开心、很开心了……
translation: Liu Mengli: Mm... Thank you, Ziying. I'm very, very happy that you're willing to say that...

original_text: 婵幽：……都准备好了？
translation: Chanyou: ...Is everyone ready?

original_text: 婵幽：梦影雾花，尽是虚空，因心想念动，方万物有生，随之～虚～实～乃～成！
translation: Chanyou: Dream shadows, misty flowers-all are emptiness. Because the heart thinks and stirs, all things come to life, and thus, reality and illusion are formed!

original_text: 韩菱纱：啊！那些是什么？好漂亮……
translation: Han Lingsha: Ah! What are those? So pretty...

original_text: 柳梦璃：那是……许多人的梦。
translation: Liu Mengli: Those are... dreams from many people.

original_text: 韩菱纱：梦？
translation: Han Lingsha: Dreams?

original_text: 柳梦璃：幻瞑界乃是“梦貘”一族，我们能够往来于梦中，以吞吃人的梦境为食。
translation: Liu Mengli: The Twilight Realm is the realm of the 'Baku' clan. We can travel through dreams, feeding on human dreams.

original_text: 韩菱纱：这样讲的话，梦璃你也是……？
translation: Han Lingsha: If you put it that way, Mengli, you too...?

original_text: 柳梦璃：不过，貘并不会伤害到人，也不会轻易窥视别人的梦境，若遭吞噬的是恶梦，反而于人有益。
translation: Liu Mengli: However, Bakus don't harm humans and don't easily peek into others' dreams. If they devour nightmares, it's actually beneficial to humans.

original_text: 慕容紫英：……但是，妖毕竟是妖，竟然要靠食人之梦而活……
translation: Murong Ziying: ... But yaos are still yaos, to think they survive by feeding on human dreams...

original_text: 云天河：那也没差吧，人不也要吃猪吃熊？
translation: Yun Tianhe: What's the difference? Don't humans eat pigs and bears too?

original_text: 柳梦璃：对不起，在妖界之中，你们一定感到很不自在吧？
translation: Liu Mengli: I'm sorry, you must feel very uncomfortable here in the yao realm.

original_text: 柳梦璃：不单人会排除异己，妖也会排除异己……我娘，她很讨厌人……
translation: Liu Mengli: It's not just humans who reject outsiders; yaoguais do too... My mother, she detested humans...

original_text: 韩菱纱：这没什么，是人先来攻打妖界的吧？你娘要是喜欢人，那才古怪呢。
translation: Han Lingsha: That's nothing. Humans attacked the yao realm first, right? It would be weird if your mother liked humans.

original_text: 柳梦璃：你们……
translation: Liu Mengli: You all...

original_text: 韩菱纱：……？
translation: Han Lingsha: ...?

original_text: 柳梦璃：……亲眼看见你们出现在幻瞑界时，我几乎不敢相信自己的眼睛……为什么、为什么要冒这样大的危险闯进来？万一出了什么事，我永远都不会原谅自己的！
translation: Liu Mengli: ... When I saw you appear in the Twilight Realm with my own eyes, I could hardly believe it... Why, why take such a great risk to break in? If anything happened, I would never forgive myself!

original_text: 云天河：梦璃，你生气了？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Mengli, are you angry?

original_text: 云天河：你突然跑进妖界，我很担心你，如果不闯进来看看，万一你出了什么事，我才永远都不会原谅自己。
translation: Yun Tianhe: You suddenly ran into the yao realm, and I was really worried about you. If I hadn't barged in to check, and something happened to you, I would never forgive myself too.

original_text: 云天河：没想到你是什么少主，其实也不用担心什么的……
translation: Yun Tianhe: I didn't expect you to be some sort of young mistress, so there's no need to worry...

original_text: 柳梦璃：不是的，云公子……你……你们能来，梦璃真的好开心……
translation: Liu Mengli: No, Yun... I'm... I'm really so happy you all came...

original_text: 柳梦璃：只是……你们为了能进幻瞑界，四方奔走，甚至还去了鬼界……每个人都瘦了，脸上都是风尘仆仆的……梦璃又好心痛……
translation: Liu Mengli: But... you've been running around everywhere to enter the Twilight Realm, even been to the Ghost Realm... Everyone has lost weight, your faces weary from the journey... Mengli's heart aches...

original_text: 柳梦璃：而且……娘很讨厌人，我不能与你们太过亲近，若是她心中不悦，我不知道……能不能保护你们……
translation: Liu Mengli: And... Mother hates humans. I can't get too close to you. If she becomes displeased, I don't know... if I can protect you...

original_text: 韩菱纱：好梦璃，你别难过，其实就像你娘说的，只要看到你平安，我们就放心了。
translation: Han Lingsha: My dear Mengli, don't be sad. Actually, just like your mother said, as long as we see you safe, we're relieved.

original_text: 韩菱纱：只不过，我们还想问问你……
translation: Han Lingsha: It's just, we still wanted to ask you...

original_text: 柳梦璃：什么……？
translation: Liu Mengli: What...?

original_text: 韩菱纱：现在琼华派和幻瞑界还没有短兵相接，我和天河、紫英，都不愿意见到双方杀个你死我活……
translation: Han Lingsha: Right now, Qionghua Sect and Twilight Realm haven't clashed directly yet. Tianhe, Ziying, and I don't want to see both sides fight to the death...

original_text: 韩菱纱：要是有办法让幻瞑界脱离双剑的束缚，是不是就可以免去这场大战呢？
translation: Han Lingsha: If there's a way to free Twilight Realm from the dual swords' bindings, could we avoid this great battle?

original_text: 柳梦璃：你说的没有错，但是……只怕是不可能了。
translation: Liu Mengli: What you say is true, but... I'm afraid it's impossible.

original_text: 云天河：为什么？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Why?

original_text: 柳梦璃：因为……我族在十九年前的大战中遭受巨创，现在只能勉强守住幻瞑界入口，想要脱离双剑的束缚……谈何容易……
translation: Liu Mengli: Because... my clan suffered heavy losses in the war nineteen years ago. Now we can barely guard the entrance to the Twilight Realm. Breaking free from the dual swords' bindings... is no easy task...

original_text: 柳梦璃：琼华派也绝不会就此罢手，没有得到他们真正想要的东西……是不会罢手的……
translation: Liu Mengli: Qionghua Sect will never give up. They won't stop until they get what they truly want...

original_text: 慕容紫英：真正想要的东西？双剑网缚此地，不是为了直接引取灵力？
translation: Murong Ziying: What they truly want? Using the dual swords to bind this place isn't for directly drawing spiritual power?

original_text: 柳梦璃：……不错，可你们只知其一，不知其二。
translation: Liu Mengli: ... Correct, but you only know one side of the story, not the other.

original_text: 柳梦璃：幻瞑界被缚住之后，琼华派的确能够通过双剑引取灵力，但那只是幻瞑界灵力的一小部分，我族真正的力量来源乃是此地遍布的紫晶石。
translation: Liu Mengli: After the Twilight Realm was bound, Qionghua Sect could indeed draw spiritual power through the dual swords, but that's only a small part of the Twilight Realm's power. Our clan's true energy source is the amethyst ore all over here.

original_text: 韩菱纱：啊！你是说，琼华派的人想抢这些有灵力的石头？
translation: Han Lingsha: Ah! You mean, Qionghua Sect wants to steal these powerful stones?

original_text: 柳梦璃：我族虽食梦为生，但在千年以前，也只是灵力十分寻常的妖。自从偶然发现了这处奇地，其间灵力充盈，尤其是这些紫晶石，令族人的修为突飞猛进。
translation: Liu Mengli: Though my clan feeds on dreams, a millennium ago, we were ordinary spirits. After discovering this wondrous place rich in spiritual energy, especially these amethysts, our cultivation advanced rapidly.

original_text: 柳梦璃：而族长通过紫晶石的力量，才能令整个幻瞑界隐去，避过许多无谓的灾祸。
translation: Liu Mengli: And our clan leader, using the power of the amethyst, can make the entire Twilight Realm disappear, avoiding many unnecessary disasters.

original_text: 慕容紫英：如此说来，是双剑之力令此地现形？
translation: Murong Ziying: So it's the power of the dual swords that made this place appear?

original_text: 柳梦璃：对……一切都是从琼华派发现了幻瞑界开始……他们虽不知紫晶石的存在，却也明白这里蕴涵着强大的灵气……
translation: Liu Mengli: Yes... everything began when Qionghua Sect discovered the Twilight Realm... Although they didn't know about the existence of the Amethyst crystals, they understood this place contained immense spiritual energy...

original_text: 柳梦璃：十九年前，幻瞑界的入口并无结界，琼华派攻入之后，终于发现了紫晶石的秘密，也夺去了不少……如今，他们又怎会罢手？
translation: Liu Mengli: Nineteen years ago, the entrance to Twilight Realm had no barrier. After Qionghua Sect invaded, they finally discovered the secret of the Amethyst Ore and took much of it... Now, how could they possibly stop?

original_text: 慕容紫英：…………
translation: Murong Ziying: ......

original_text: 柳梦璃：看过这些梦境以后，当年之事，你们会更加清楚……
translation: Liu Mengli: After seeing these dreams, you will understand the events of that year more clearly...

original_text: 柳梦璃：来吧，我带你们进到几个梦里，把自己当成旁观者，心念放松即可。
translation: Liu Mengli: Come, I'll take you into a few dreams. Just think of yourselves as observers and relax your minds.

original_text: 云天河：……大哥…………
translation: Yun Tianhe: ...Big brother......

original_text: 柳梦璃：这，便是玄霄的梦，是他十九年来反复回忆起的往事……
translation: Liu Mengli: These... are Xuanxiao's dreams, the past he has recalled repeatedly for nineteen years...

original_text: 韩菱纱：天啊，琼华派和妖界的大战，引发了这么多惨事……要是这一回再打起来，我真不敢想像……
translation: Han Lingsha: Heavens, the great war between Qionghua Sect and yao realm caused so much tragedy... If they fight again this time, I really can't imagine...

original_text: 柳梦璃：其实……妖界已经很衰弱了，六位幻瞑护将，如今只剩两位，其余的早已战死……
translation: Liu Mengli: Actually... yao realm has already greatly weakened. Of the six Twilight Guardians, only two remain now; the rest have long since perished in battle...

original_text: 云天河：但我听大哥说妖界……说你娘很厉害，十九年前一战，连太清真人也打不过她。
translation: Yun Tianhe: But I heard from Big Brother that the yao realm... said your mother was very powerful. In the battle nineteen years ago, even Taiqing Perfected Person couldn't defeat her.

original_text: 柳梦璃：其实娘已经……
translation: Liu Mengli: Actually, Mother already...

original_text: 韩菱纱：啊——！
translation: Han Lingsha: Ah-!

original_text: 慕容紫英：菱纱！
translation: Murong Ziying: Lingsha!

original_text: 韩菱纱：……又、又是那种感觉，好像全身的力气都被抽走了一样……好冷……
translation: Han Lingsha: ...Again... that feeling again, as if all the strength in my body has been drained... so cold...

original_text: 柳梦璃：还好吗？要不要我用香——
translation: Liu Mengli: Are you alright? Should I use incense-

original_text: 韩菱纱：……没关系……总是这样，歇息一下就没事了……
translation: Han Lingsha: ... It's okay... It's always like this, I'll be fine after resting a bit...

original_text: 云天河：很冷……？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Very cold...?

original_text: 云天河：菱纱，这样呢？……这样会不会好一点？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Lingsha, how about this? ... Does this feel a bit better?
Han Lingsha: ..., mm...

original_text: 韩菱纱：天河……你怎么……？
translation: Han Lingsha: Tianhe...How can you...?

original_text: 韩菱纱：这是什么法术？有种暖暖的感觉，和“红魄”有点像……我、我一下子好多了……
translation: Han Lingsha: What kind of spell is this? Feels warm, similar to 'Red Soul Jade'... I, I feel much better all of a sudden...

original_text: 云天河：我也不知道……只要一想，身体自然就有气息涌出，有时暖暖的，有时冷冷的……不过，只要你没事就好——
translation: Yun Tianhe: I don't know either... Whenever I think about it, energy naturally surges in my body, sometimes warm, sometimes cold... But as long as you're okay-

original_text: 慕容紫英：天河，在不周山时这两道阴阳之气令你相当难受，现在还是如此？
translation: Murong Ziying: Tianhe, those two yin and yang energies made you very uncomfortable at Mount Buzhou. Is it still the same now?

original_text: 云天河：有时有点难受，有时又很舒服，不过我发现只要全身放松就好了，这两道气息都会随便乱跑，跑着跑着就不见了。
translation: Yun Tianhe: Sometimes it feels a bit uncomfortable, sometimes quite pleasant, but I found that as long as I relax my whole body, these two streams of energy just wander around randomly, and after a while, they disappear.

original_text: 韩菱纱：玄霄的凝冰诀真的很厉害，现在野人手上又有了神兵利器，看来快变成一代奇侠了～
translation: Han Lingsha: Xuanxiao's Cryomancy is really powerful. Now that the barbarian has a divine weapon, he's becoming a legendary hero~

original_text: 云天河：奇侠是啥？我只觉得现在去打猎的话，一定会有很大的收获～
translation: Yun Tianhe: What's 'legendary'? I just feel if we go hunting now, we'd definitely get a big haul~

original_text: 韩菱纱：喂～你别太过份了，拿着后羿射日弓去猎野猪，小心遭天谴！
translation: Han Lingsha: Hey~ Don't go too far. Using Houyi Sun Bow to hunt wild boars, be careful of divine retribution!

original_text: 慕容紫英：我却觉得不单是凝冰诀一个原因，天河能拿取常人无法触碰的炙炎石与三寒器，似乎——
translation: Murong Ziying: But I think it's not just because of Cryomancy. Tianhe can take the Flamestone and Three Cold Artifacts that ordinary people cannot touch, it seems-
Yun Tianhe: ...?!

original_text: 柳梦璃：……糟了！！入口的结界被打破了！
translation: Liu Mengli: Oh no!! The entrance barrier has been broken!

original_text: 云天河：怎么会？！你娘不是说……那个结界很厉害？！
translation: Yun Tianhe: How could that be?! Didn't your mother say... that barrier was very powerful?!

original_text: 柳梦璃：……娘……她十九年前虽然打败了太清真人，但是为求险胜，斗法时强行催动妖力，元气大伤，之后一直都很虚弱，如今也只是在强撑罢了……
translation: Liu Mengli: ... Mother... Nineteen years ago, although she defeated Taiqing Perfected Person, to secure a risky victory, she forcibly activated her power during the duel, severely damaging her vitality. She has been very weak ever since, and now is just barely holding on...

original_text: 柳梦璃：幻瞑界又被双剑网住，灵力也正在不断流失，我们心里都很清楚，结界被破，恐怕只是早晚的事情，惟有殊死一战……
translation: Liu Mengli: The Twilight Realm is trapped again by the dual swords, and our spiritual power is constantly draining. We all know clearly that the barrier breaking is only a matter of time; we must fight to the death...

original_text: 韩菱纱：难道……琼华派已经攻了进来？！
translation: Han Lingsha: Could it be... Qionghua Sect has already attacked?!

original_text: 柳梦璃：但愿不是……<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>我们快些出去看看！</colour>
translation: Liu Mengli: I hope not... <colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>Let's go out and check quickly!</colour>

original_text: 云天河：好！！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Good!!

original_text: 奚仲：你……！
translation: Xizhong: You...!

original_text: 奚仲：婵幽大人！你快走！去里幻瞑宫！
translation: Xizhong: Lady Chanyou! You must go! To the Inner Twilight Palace!

original_text: 婵幽：……无妨。
translation: Chanyou: ...It's fine.

original_text: 婵幽：他再如何神通，让灵体之像出现在幻瞑宫，也已是极限，不能再伤及你我分毫！
translation: Chanyou: No matter how powerful he is, manifesting a spiritual image in the Twilight Palace is already his limit. He can't harm us in the slightest!

original_text: 玄霄：你，便是妖界之主？
translation: Xuanxiao: You! Are you the Mistress of the Yao Realm?

original_text: 婵幽：婵幽不必理会登堂入室、屠戮我族的无耻之人！
translation: Chanyou: I need not acknowledge those who shamelessly invade our home and slaughter our clan!
Chanyou: ...!

original_text: 玄霄：妄动气息，便是寻死！
translation: Xuanxiao: Recklessly stirring your qi is seeking death!

original_text: 玄霄：以你自身为凭的结界遭破，灵力反噬，你必已身受巨创。
translation: Xuanxiao: A barrier formed with your own essence was broken, and the spiritual backlash must have inflicted severe injuries upon you.

original_text: 玄霄：妖界之主，我曾渴望与你一战！
translation: Xuanxiao: Mistress of the Yao Realm, I once longed to battle you!

original_text: 玄霄：当年在我看来遥不可追的太清，都被你轻取性命！妖界之主是何等的强大风光！
translation: Xuanxiao: Back then, Taiqing, who seemed unreachable to me, was easily killed by you! How powerful and glorious the Mistress of the Yao Realm must be!

original_text: 玄霄：如今一见，却令人失望，你不过是个废人罢了。
translation: Xuanxiao: Seeing you now is disappointing. You are merely a useless person.

original_text: 玄霄：原来当年是两败俱伤之局，你这个妖界之主装假逞强倒是有模有样，把琼华派上下全部蒙骗！
translation: Xuanxiao: So it was a situation where both sides suffered heavy losses back then. You, the Mistress of the Yao Realm, put on a convincing act of false bravado, deceiving the entire Qionghua Sect!

original_text: 婵幽：……万灵盛衰，乃是常理，无恒强、无恒弱。
translation: Chanyou: ...The rise and fall of all beings is natural law, nothing is eternally strong, nothing eternally weak.

original_text: 婵幽：你今日体内烈阳与冰寒之气纵横交织，相距甚远都可感到凶煞之气，人非人、怪非怪，在我看来，异日必遭天谴！
translation: Chanyou: Today, the fierce yang and icy yin energies within your body are intertwined violently. Even from afar, anyone can sense the malevolent aura. Neither human nor monster-in my eyes, you will inevitably face divine retribution someday!

original_text: 玄霄：我此一生，已无回头之路！
translation: Xuanxiao: In this life, I have past the point of no return!

original_text: 玄霄：……竟被一个无能的掌门冰封，如今琼华已非昔日琼华，枉我一心为门派雪耻！妖界也衰弱到不堪一击！
translation: Xuanxiao: ... To be sealed in ice by an incompetent sect leader... Now Qionghua is no longer the Qionghua of old. All my efforts to restore the sect's honor are in vain! Even the yao realm has weakened to the point of being utterly vulnerable!!

original_text: 玄霄：妖界之主，我厌烦了这一切，劝你不必躲藏，出来受死！让我快快结束这场空虚……
translation: Xuanxiao: Mistress of the Yao Realm, I am weary of all this. I advise you not to hide; come out and face death! Let me swiftly end this emptiness...

original_text: 柳梦璃：娘！您怎么样？有没有受伤？！
translation: Liu Mengli: Mother! How are you? Are you hurt?!

original_text: 婵幽：……我没事……结界遭破，灵力反噬而已……
translation: Chanyou: ...I'm fine... the barrier was broken, just spiritual backlash...

original_text: 婵幽：但是……有人攻进来了……
translation: Chanyou: But... someone has attacked...

original_text: 婵幽：我派了归邪去守入口，但我很担心……他会孤注一掷……
translation: Chanyou: I sent Guixie to guard the entrance, but I'm worried... he might take a desperate gamble...

original_text: 柳梦璃：娘……
translation: Liu Mengli: Mother...

original_text: 婵幽：旋梦外围的法阵已经发动……能撑一时便是一时吧……到万不得已之时，我族宁可与人同归于尽，也不能让他们侵占此地……
translation: Chanyou: The formation outside Spindream has been activated... We'll hold out as long as we can... In a desperate situation, our clan would rather perish together with others than let them occupy this place...

original_text: 柳梦璃：娘，我也<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>去外面</colour><dc0>！我去阻止那些人！</dc0>
translation: Liu Mengli: Mother, I'll also <colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>go outside</colour><dc0>! I'll stop those people!</dc0>

original_text: 云天河：梦璃，我跟你一起去！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Mengli, I'll go with you!

original_text: 韩菱纱：我也是！
translation: Han Lingsha: Me too!

original_text: 婵幽：璃儿，你去吧……
translation: Chanyou: Lili, you may go...

original_text: 婵幽：……可以的话，我不愿你去涉险，可是你身为幻瞑界少主，这种时候，即便是死了，也要挺身保护自己的子民……
translation: Chanyou: ...If possible, I wouldn't want you to take risks. But as the young mistress of Twilight Realm, in times like these, even if it means death, you must step forward to protect your people...

original_text: 柳梦璃：娘！您别说了，我都明白的！
translation: Liu Mengli: Mother! Please don't say anymore, I understand everything!

original_text: 奚仲：少主，请让奚仲陪您一起去！
translation: Xizhong: Young mistress, please allow me to accompany you!

original_text: 柳梦璃：不！你留下照顾娘，万一……
translation: Liu Mengli: No! You stay and take care of Mother, in case...

original_text: 柳梦璃：总之，让我先去。
translation: Liu Mengli: Anyway, let me go first.

original_text: 奚仲：……是。
translation: Xizhong: ...Yes.

original_text: 韩菱纱：唔……
translation: Han Lingsha: Hmm...

original_text: 柳梦璃：菱纱！你终于醒了！
translation: Liu Mengli: Lingsha! You're finally awake!

original_text: 韩菱纱：……身上的骨头，有点像是散了架……
translation: Han Lingsha: ... My bones feel like they're falling apart...

original_text: 韩菱纱：天河呢？还有紫英？
translation: Han Lingsha: Where's Tianhe? And Ziying?

original_text: 柳梦璃：……大家都还在幻瞑界，紫英去处理怀朔的后事了，他说要把尸体烧了，骨灰带回怀朔的故乡……
translation: Liu Mengli: ... Everyone is still in Twilight Realm. Ziying is handling Huaishuo's funeral arrangements. He said he'll cremate the body and bring the ashes back to Huaishuo's hometown...

original_text: 柳梦璃：至于云公子……
translation: Liu Mengli: As for Yun...

original_text: 柳梦璃：……菱纱你体内的冰寒之气很重，他运功替你驱寒，见你有起色之后，就一直站在那边，沉默不语了……
translation: Liu Mengli: ... Lingsha, the icy energy within your body is very strong. He used his energy to drive out the cold for you. After seeing you improve, he just stood there silently...

original_text: 韩菱纱：他怎么了……？
translation: Han Lingsha: What's wrong with him...?

original_text: 柳梦璃：你昏了过去……所以不知道，不久前，发生了好多事……
translation: Liu Mengli: You were unconscious... so you don't know, not long ago, many things happened...

original_text: 韩菱纱：……原来，是这样吗？
translation: Han Lingsha: ...So, that's how it is?

original_text: 柳梦璃：我想，玄霄的转变对云公子打击实在很大……
translation: Liu Mengli: I think Xuanxiao's change has truly been a heavy blow to Yun...

original_text: 柳梦璃：而且，他更不能释怀望舒剑的事情……他觉得，是他害了你……
translation: Liu Mengli: Moreover, he finds it even harder to let go of the matter concerning Wangshu Sword... He feels he is the one who harmed you...

original_text: 韩菱纱：傻瓜……
translation: Han Lingsha: Foolish...

original_text: 柳梦璃：菱纱，你的身体……
translation: Liu Mengli: Lingsha, your health...

original_text: 韩菱纱：别担心我，我还没有告诉你吧，我们韩家人注定都是短命的，所以对生死之事，已经看的开了，虽然，临到自己头上还是有点难过，但是真的没什么……
translation: Han Lingsha: Don't worry about me. I haven't told you before, but my Han family is destined to die young, so I've already come to terms with life and death. Although, when it's my turn, it's still a bit sad... but really, it's nothing...

original_text: 韩菱纱：我去看看天河吧，想办法让他打起精神来！
translation: Han Lingsha: I'll go check on Tianhe, try to cheer him up!

original_text: 韩菱纱：天～河～
translation: Han Lingsha: Tian~he~

original_text: 云天河：……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ...

original_text: 韩菱纱：天河！
translation: Han Lingsha: TIAN-HE!

original_text: 韩菱纱：云天河！！
translation: Han Lingsha: YUN TIAN-HE!!
Yun Tianhe: ......

original_text: 云天河：好痛啊！
translation: Yun Tianhe: That hurts!

original_text: 韩菱纱：怕痛就应该早点回答我！
translation: Han Lingsha: If you're afraid of hurt, you should have answered me sooner!

original_text: 韩菱纱：干嘛？一脸哀怨，我长得有这么不堪入目吗？！
translation: Han Lingsha: What? Why the long face? Am I really that unpleasant to look at?!

original_text: 韩菱纱：喂，你再不说话，我真要生气了！
translation: Han Lingsha: Hey, if you don't say anything, I'll really get angry!

original_text: 云天河：说、说什么？
translation: Yun Tianhe: S-say what?

original_text: 韩菱纱：笨，看了就有气……
translation: Han Lingsha: Stupid, just looking at you makes me angry...

original_text: 韩菱纱：我在其他人面前好歹也是人见人爱，可是遇上你这野人，总是一肚子火……不知道的人还以为我很爱生气呢，真是……
translation: Han Lingsha: In front of others, I'm at least quite likable, but when I run into you barbarian, I always get so angry... People who don't know might think I'm always in a bad mood, really...

original_text: 云天河：哦……我、我是笨了点……常常闯祸……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Oh... I, I am a bit dumb... often cause trouble...

original_text: 韩菱纱：……望舒剑的事，梦璃都跟我说了，又不是你的错，你一副苦瓜脸干什么！
translation: Han Lingsha: ..., Mengli told me about Wangshu Sword. It's not your fault, so why the long face!

original_text: 云天河：…………可是、是我害了你……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ...... But, it was me who harmed you...

original_text: 韩菱纱：你说什么呀？那最初的原因还不是我自己？我不进去你爹的墓，就什么事都没了。
translation: Han Lingsha: What are you talking about? Wasn't the original cause myself? If I hadn't entered your father's tomb, none of this would have happened.

original_text: 云天河：话是这么说没错，但是……
translation: Yun Tianhe: That's true, but...

original_text: 云天河：唉！我真没用！还说要保护你，让你活得长长久久，结果什么都做不到！我……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Ugh! I'm so useless! Said I'd protect you, let you live a long life, but I can't do anything! I...

original_text: 韩菱纱：你啊，平时不想事情，一想事情脑子就打结……
translation: Han Lingsha: You... usually don't think at all, and when you do, your mind just gets all tangled up...

original_text: 韩菱纱：告诉你吧，天河，人根本改变不了所谓的命。
translation: Han Lingsha: Let me tell you, Tianhe, men can't change what's called fate.

original_text: 云天河：……！
translation: Yun Tianhe: ...!

original_text: 韩菱纱：你听过吗？人的命运总是按既定的方向在前进，即使你改变了过程，也改不了结果。
translation: Han Lingsha: Have you heard? A person's fate always moves in a set direction; even if you change the process, you can't change the outcome.

original_text: 韩菱纱：你或许会想，要是你没有遇见我，没有去昆仑山就好了，但是，我们可能会以另外的方式相遇吧？
translation: Han Lingsha: You might think, if you hadn't met me, hadn't gone to Kunlun Mountain, it would have been better. But perhaps we would have met in another way?

original_text: 韩菱纱：要是你觉得，你不帮玄霄就好了，但或许我会很想帮他，我们还是会去找三寒器。
translation: Han Lingsha: If you think it would have been better if you hadn't helped Xuanxiao, perhaps I would have wanted to help him, and we would still have gone to find Three Cold Artifacts.

original_text: 韩菱纱：人的命运就是这个样子，什么我命由我不由天，我曾经也很相信呢，所以我不信邪，一直在找可以令人长生的法子，我觉得自己总有一天能胜过这个所谓的天命……
translation: Han Lingsha: Human fate is just like this. 'My fate is mine to command, not Heaven's'-I used to believe that too. So I refused to accept the inevitable and kept searching for ways to make people live longer. I thought one day I could overcome this so-called destiny...

original_text: 韩菱纱：直到在鬼界遇见伯父，我才明白……原来人可以做的努力是那样微小，人不能胜天，这是很平常的啊……
translation: Han Lingsha: Only after meeting Uncle in the ghost realm did I understand... Human effort is so tiny, humans cannot overcome heaven-it's common...

original_text: 云天河：不是的……我觉得不是这样的……
translation: Yun Tianhe: That's not it... I don't think it's like that...

original_text: 韩菱纱：好啦！不管是哪样的，反正我也没指望真能说服你这颗木鱼脑袋。
translation: Han Lingsha: Alright! Whatever the case, I never really expected to get through that thick skull of yours anyway.

original_text: 韩菱纱：但是至少……你不要这样好不好？
translation: Han Lingsha: But at least... don't be like this, okay?

original_text: 韩菱纱：你啊，怎么说也是我最好的朋友，我可不想看见好朋友整天一副要死不活的样子，看得我都好累……
translation: Han Lingsha: You... no matter what, you're my best friend. I don't want to see my best friend looking half-dead all day long. It's exhausting just watching...

original_text: 韩菱纱：哎呀！人家难得下定决心讲这么恶心的话，你居然一点反应都没有，真不给面子……
translation: Han Lingsha: Aiya! I finally worked up the nerve to say such mushy words, and you have no reaction at all, so rude...

original_text: 韩菱纱：啊！……
translation: Han Lingsha: Ah!...

original_text: 云天河：菱纱……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Lingsha...

original_text: 韩菱纱：……
translation: Han Lingsha: ...

original_text: 韩菱纱：你都这么大了，还撒娇啊……
translation: Han Lingsha: You're so grown up, still acting spoiled...

original_text: 韩菱纱：天河……你可还记得？我说过，想找个像青鸾峰那样的地方隐居，过不理世事的日子。
translation: Han Lingsha: Tianhe... Do you still remember? I said I wanted to find a place like Qingluan Peak to live in seclusion, away from worldly affairs.

original_text: 云天河：……嗯。
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... Hmm.

original_text: 韩菱纱：不如……等琼华派的事了了之后，我再去看过族人，我们就回青鸾峰吧，要是你想的话，也叫上梦璃、紫英……
translation: Han Lingsha: How about... after the Qionghua Sect matter is settled, I'll visit my clan, then we return to Qingluan Peak. If you want, we can invite Mengli and Ziying too...

original_text: 韩菱纱：我希望……不管自己还能活多久，半年、几个月、几十天都没有关系……只要大家开开心心地活着，不要想伤心的事。
translation: Han Lingsha: I hope... no matter how long I have left to live-half a year, a few months, or even just days-it doesn't matter... as long as everyone lives happily and doesn't dwell on sad things.

original_text: 云天河：……我不会让你死的，我要去找玄霄，把望舒剑抢回来，不能让他做成剑柱！
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... I won't let you die. I'll go find Xuanxiao, seize Wangshu Sword back, and stop him from completing the sword pillar!

original_text: 云天河：等到那个时候，我们再一起回青鸾峰，我多盖几间屋子，让梦璃和紫英住。
translation: Yun Tianhe: When that time comes, we'll go back to Qingluan Peak together. I'll build more houses for Mengli and Ziying to live in.

original_text: 韩菱纱：傻瓜，我都说了，你不用太勉强……
translation: Han Lingsha: Silly, I already said, you don't need to force yourself too much...

original_text: 柳梦璃：……
translation: Liu Mengli: ...

original_text: 奚仲：少主，仪式已经准备得差不多了，婵幽大人请您即刻去里幻瞑宫。
translation: Xizhong: Young Mistress, the ceremony is almost ready. Lady Chanyou asks you to go to the Inner Twilight Palace immediately.

original_text: 柳梦璃：我知道了。
translation: Liu Mengli: I understand.

original_text: 韩菱纱：是不是有事情？
translation: Han Lingsha: Anything wrong?

original_text: 柳梦璃：我……
translation: Liu Mengli: I...

original_text: 奚仲：婵幽大人的身体越来越虚弱了，她希望少主能够尽快继承幻瞑界主人之位。
translation: Xizhong: Lady Chanyou's health is growing weaker. She hopes our young Mistress can soon inherit the position as Mistreess of the Twilight Realm.

original_text: 韩菱纱：啊？
translation: Han Lingsha: Huh?

original_text: 柳梦璃：你们……跟我一起来吧，我也派人去喊紫英了。
translation: Liu Mengli: Come with me, I've also sent someone to call Ziying.

original_text: 柳梦璃：我希望，那个时刻来临时，我的朋友都能在身边……
translation: Liu Mengli: I hope, when that moment comes, all my friends can be by my side...

original_text: 云天河：做了妖界的主人，你跟以前会有不一样吗？
translation: Yun Tianhe: As the Mistreess of a yao realm, will you be any different from before?

original_text: 柳梦璃：我还是我，不一样的是其他事情吧……
translation: Liu Mengli: I'm still me. What's different is everything else, I suppose...

original_text: 云天河：……？
translation: Yun Tianhe: ...?

original_text: 柳梦璃：先去<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>里幻瞑宫</colour><dc0>吧，</dc0><colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>幻瞑宫外通往那里的法阵</colour><dc0>已经打开，有话去那边再说也无妨。</dc0>
translation: Liu Mengli: Let's go to the<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> Inner Twilight Palace</colour><dc0> first. The</dc0><colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> magic array leading there from outside the Twilight Palace</colour><dc0> is already open; we can talk more over there.</dc0>

original_text: 柳梦璃：娘，我来了……
translation: Liu Mengli: Mother, I'm here...

original_text: 婵幽：世事难料，璃儿你刚回来不久，却已经要担起这样的重任。
translation: Chanyou: The world is unpredictable. Lili, you've just returned, yet already must shoulder such a heavy responsibility.

original_text: 婵幽：……我要谢谢你们几个，在琼华派攻进来时，对我族施以援手。
translation: Chanyou: ...I want to thank you all for lending a hand to my clan when Qionghua Sect attacked.

original_text: 云天河：这也没什么啦，呵呵。
translation: Yun Tianhe: It's nothing really, hehe.

original_text: 婵幽：谢你们绝非矫情，但我还是不赞成人与妖交朋友，本想立刻将你们送回人间，但璃儿她希望你们待到仪式之后……
translation: Chanyou: My thanks are not mere courtesy, but I still don't approve of humans and yaos being friends. I intended to send you back to the human realm immediately, but Lili hopes you'll stay until after the ceremony...

original_text: 婵幽：所以若有什么话，便趁此机会说完吧。
translation: Chanyou: So if you have anything to say, finish all of them now while you have the chance.

original_text: 云天河：说完？为什么？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Finish all of them? What do you mean?

original_text: 婵幽：璃儿她即将继承幻瞑界主人之位，而你们，则会被送回人间，恐怕日后再无会面之期。
translation: Chanyou: Lili is about to inherit the position of master of the Twilight Realm. As for you three, you will be sent back to the mortal world. I am afraid you will not have chance to meet again.

original_text: 云天河：什么？！
translation: Yun Tianhe: What?!

original_text: 云天河：梦璃你……你要走？！你要……离开……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Mengli you... you're going?! You're... leaving away from...

original_text: 柳梦璃：娘刚才都已经说了……
translation: Liu Mengli: Mother just said...

original_text: 云天河：为什么一定要走？妖界都已经变成这样，难道不可以让大家一起去人间生活？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Why must you leave? The yao realm is already like this. Can't everyone go live in the mortal world together?

original_text: 柳梦璃：幻瞑界便是我族故乡，我族宁可灭亡，也不会离开这里的……
translation: Liu Mengli: Twilight Realm is my clan's homeland. My clan would rather perish than leaving this place...

original_text: 韩菱纱：可是、可是这样我会很想你，又见不到你……
translation: Han Lingsha: But... but then I'll miss you so much, and not be able to see you...

original_text: 柳梦璃：我也会想你……菱纱，你千万不要放弃，一定还有替你延命的办法！
translation: Liu Mengli: I'll miss you too... Lingsha, you must not give up. There must still be a way to extend your life!

original_text: 柳梦璃：我走以后，你要好好照顾自己，还有……照顾好云公子……
translation: Liu Mengli: After I leave, take good care of yourself, and also... take care of Yun...

original_text: 云天河：梦璃……你一直都对我很好……我不想你离开……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Mengli... You've always been so good to me... I don't want you to leave...

original_text: 柳梦璃：我……希望你们过得幸福。
translation: Liu Mengli: I... I hope you two live happily.

original_text: 韩菱纱：……！
translation: Han Lingsha: ...!

original_text: 韩菱纱：梦璃，我们、我们并不是你想的那样啊！你知道，我不能——
translation: Han Lingsha: Mengli, we... we're not what you think! You know, I can't-

original_text: 柳梦璃：菱纱，什么都别说，我明白你在担心什么……但是，我还是请你不要放弃……
translation: Liu Mengli: Lingsha, don't say anything. I understand what you're worried about... but I still ask you not to give up...

original_text: 柳梦璃：云公子，拜托你把这个离香草的香囊带回寿阳，交给爹和娘……告诉他们，女儿不孝，不能长伴他们左右，亦不能为他们养老，请裴大哥替我……替我略尽孝道，梦璃感激不尽……
translation: Liu Mengli: Yun, please take this Sachet of Parting Herb incense back to Shouyang and give it to my Father and Mother... Tell them their daughter is unfilial, unable to stay by their side or care for them in their old age. Ask Brother Pei to... to fulfill some filial duty on my behalf, and Mengli would be eternally grateful...

original_text: 云天河：……我……我一定带到。
translation: Yun Tianhe: ...I... I'll definitely deliver it.

original_text: 柳梦璃：还有这个……云叔送给我的帝女翡翠，如今我已经用不上了，留给你做个纪念吧。
translation: Liu Mengli: Also, this... the Princess Jadeite that Uncle Yun gave me, I have no use for it now. I'll leave it with you as a keepsake.

original_text: 云天河：嗯……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Mm...

original_text: 柳梦璃：……你的弓，已经换了新的吗？
translation: Liu Mengli: Your bow, have you already replaced it with a new one?

original_text: 云天河：这……是菱纱带我去一个地方取的。不过，你送的，我也一直留在身边！以后也不会丢掉的！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Lingsha took me to a place to get it. But the one you gave me, I've kept it with me all this time! And I'll never abandon it!

original_text: 柳梦璃：……不必如此，若是旧了、不能用了，就扔了它吧……
translation: Liu Mengli: ... No need for that. If it's old and unusable, just discard it...

original_text: 云天河：我、我不会扔！你送的东西，除非我死！不然我一定保管得好好的！
translation: Yun Tianhe: I... I won't discard it! What you gave me, unless I die, I'll definitely keep it safe!

original_text: 慕容紫英：梦璃……
translation: Murong Ziying: Mengli...

original_text: 柳梦璃：紫英，谢谢你。
translation: Liu Mengli: Ziying, thank you.

original_text: 柳梦璃：无须多言……我知道，你不喜欢妖，可是到最后，你还是愿意帮助我族，我很感激……
translation: Liu Mengli: No need to say more... I know you dislike yaoguais, but in the end, you were still willing to help my kind. I am very grateful...

original_text: 柳梦璃：我……我不太会说话，但是紫英你、永远都是我的挚友。
translation: Liu Mengli: I... I'm not very good with words, but Ziying, you... will always be one of my dearest friends.

original_text: 慕容紫英：……我也一样。
translation: Murong Ziying: ... Same here.

original_text: 慕容紫英：保重！
translation: Murong Ziying: Take care!

original_text: 婵幽：璃儿，你如此伤怀，又怎能安心继位？
translation: Chanyou: Lili, how can you succeed the throne with such sorrow in your heart?

original_text: 婵幽：不如我将你们彼此间的记忆通通消去，日后再无想念，自然也就不会伤心——
translation: Chanyou: How about I erase all the memories between you? In the future, there will be no longing, and naturally, no sadness-

original_text: 云天河：不要！我不愿意忘了梦璃！
translation: Yun Tianhe: No! I don't want to forget Mengli!

original_text: 婵幽：……你们人有种说法，叫作“因爱故生忧，因爱故生怖”，既然种种烦恼，都是由想或念而起，将烦恼的根源消去，岂不是一了百了？
translation: Chanyou: ... You humans have a saying: 'From love comes worry; from love comes fear'. Since all kinds of troubles arise from thoughts or attachments, wouldn't eliminating the root of troubles settle everything once and for all?

original_text: 云天河：以后我想到梦璃，也许会很伤心，因为她又不在我身边……但是我也会想到，大家还在一起时，很多开心的事……
translation: Yun Tianhe: In the future, thinking of Mengli might make me sad, because she's not by my side... but I'll also remember many happy times when we were all together...

original_text: 云天河：要是把这些都忘了，虽然不会难过，可是脑子里有一块地方都是空的，还有什么意思？
translation: Yun Tianhe: If you forget all that, you won't feel sad, but there'd be an empty space in your mind. What's the point then?

original_text: 婵幽：……年轻人，你倒比我想的更有良心，只可惜……
translation: Chanyou: ...Young man, you have more conscience than I thought, it's just a pity...

original_text: 婵幽：奚仲，你去月神殿将“梦见樽”取来。
translation: Chanyou: Xizhong, go to the Moon Deity Hall and fetch the 'dreaming vessel'.

original_text: 奚仲：是！
translation: Xizhong: Yes!

original_text: 柳梦璃：娘……？
translation: Liu Mengli: Mother...?

original_text: 婵幽：你放心，我并不会将你们的记忆消去，但你须答应我，继位之后一切以幻瞑界为重，绝不可溺于感伤，耗费心神！
translation: Chanyou: Rest assured, I won't erase your memories. But you must promise me that after succeeding to the throne, you'll prioritize Twilight Realm above all else. Never indulge in sentimentality or waste your spirit!

original_text: 柳梦璃：是……璃儿…………答……应……娘……
translation: Liu Mengli: Yes... Lili... pro...mises... Mother...

original_text: 奚仲：婵幽大人，梦见樽已经取来。
translation: Xizhong: Lady Chanyou, the dreaming vessel has been brought.

original_text: 柳梦璃：娘，这是……？
translation: Liu Mengli: Mother, what is this...?

original_text: 婵幽：……你且看好！
translation: Chanyou: ...Watch closely!

original_text: 婵幽：万灵悉来，神光映幽！引诸方想愿，入梦见之樽——无中而出、虚空即有！！
translation: Chanyou: All spirits gather, divine light illuminates the depths! Draw forth the wishes of all directions, enter the dreaming vessel-from nothingness emerges, emptiness becomes existence!!

original_text: 韩菱纱：怎么会……有两个梦璃？！
translation: Han Lingsha: How can... there be two Mengli?!

original_text: 婵幽：梦见樽乃是藏有神秘之力的法器，能够令人幻梦成真。
translation: Chanyou: The dreaming vessel is an artifact holding mysterious power, capable of making dreams come true.

original_text: 婵幽：既然你们不愿璃儿离去，而她对你们亦是依依不舍，我便将此份思念之情，注入梦见樽，诞出另外一个璃儿……
translation: Chanyou: Since you are unwilling for Lili to leave, and she is also reluctant to part with you, I shall infuse this feeling of longing into the dreaming vessel, giving birth to another Lili...

original_text: 婵幽：她虽只是傀儡，口不能言，亦无心智，有形而又无形，但却能如常人一般行动，往后便让她伴在你们身侧，犹如璃儿常在……
translation: Chanyou: Although she is merely a puppet, unable to speak or possess a mind, tangible yet intangible, she can move like an ordinary person. From now on, let her accompany you by your side, as if Lili is always there...

original_text: 婵幽：她不过是一场幻梦，当你们渐渐淡忘璃儿，梦就醒了，她也会消散无踪。
translation: Chanyou: She is but a dream. When you gradually forget Lili, the dream will be awakened from, and she will vanish without a trace.

original_text: 云天河：不会！我们不会忘记梦璃的，因为这一切根本就不是梦，又哪来的梦醒……
translation: Yun Tianhe: No! We won't forget Mengli. Because none of this was a dream to begin with, so how could we awake from it...

original_text: 柳梦璃：……娘，谢谢您！
translation: Liu Mengli: ... Mother, thank you!

original_text: 婵幽：你不必谢我，记得你答应过我什么，言出必行，才是我的好女儿。
translation: Chanyou: No need to thank me. Remember what you promised me. Keeping your word is what makes you my good daughter.

original_text: 柳梦璃：璃儿不敢或忘，定会时刻铭记在心。
translation: Liu Mengli: Lili dares not forget, I will always keep it in mind.

original_text: 婵幽：好了，随我过来祭坛，我要正式传位于你！
translation: Chanyou: Enough, follow me to the altar. I will formally pass the throne to you!

original_text: 韩菱纱：梦璃……
translation: Han Lingsha: Mengli...

original_text: 韩菱纱：……天河，你这傻瓜……为什么不说几句挽留梦璃的话呢？
translation: Han Lingsha: ... Tianhe, you fool... Why didn't you say anything to make Mengli stay?

original_text: 云天河：说了……她就不会走吗？
translation: Yun Tianhe: If I say it... will she stay?

original_text: 韩菱纱：你……你太不懂女孩子的心了，梦璃她太可怜了……
translation: Han Lingsha: You... You really don't understand a girl's heart, Mengli is so pitiful...

original_text: 云天河：我知道……她不会留下的，看她的眼睛就明白了，就算再舍不得，她也会选择和自己的族人在一起，同生共死。
translation: Yun Tianhe: I know... she won't stay. You can tell by looking in her eyes. Even if it pains her to leave, she'll choose to be with her own clan, sharing life and death.

original_text: 婵幽：璃儿……现在，我将梦境之力传予你，我族始祖将于幻梦源头向你诉说亘古之谜，你知悉所有，须得护佑所有。
translation: Chanyou: Lili... Now, I bestow upon you the power of dreams. Our clan's progenitor will tell you the ancient mysteries at the source of dreams. Knowing all, you must protect all.

original_text: 婵幽：自那一刻起，你便是幻瞑界之主，与我族共存共亡，生死相依，离异之心将引祸端，背弃之举必遭天罚。
translation: Chanyou: From that moment on, you are the mistress of the Twilight Realm, coexisting and sharing life and death with our clan. Thoughts of separation will bring disaster, and acts of betrayal will surely incur divine punishment.

original_text: 奚仲：梦璃大人，如今您已是幻瞑界主人，奚仲在此发誓，会永远以自己的生命辅佐您、保护您，绝无背叛。
translation: Xizhong: Lady Mengli, now that you are the mistress of the Twilight Realm, Xizhong swears to forever assist and protect you with my life, without any betrayal.

original_text: 婵幽：奚仲，璃儿以后就交给你了，你们两人应该能体会我的安排。
translation: Chanyou: Xizhong, I entrust Lili to you from now on, you two should understand my arrangements.

original_text: 奚仲：是！奚仲知道。
translation: Xizhong: Yes! Xizhong understands.

original_text: 柳梦璃：娘！璃儿……璃儿……不能……
translation: Liu Mengli: Mother! Lili... Lili... cannot...

original_text: 婵幽：璃儿，时候不早，你该命奚仲将你的朋友送回人间了。
translation: Chanyou: Lili, it's getting late. You should have Xizhong send your friends back to the human world.

original_text: 婵幽：我灵力已耗去太多，须得沉眠一段时日，勿要相扰……
translation: Chanyou: My spiritual power is mostly depleted, I must enter deep slumber for a time, do not disturb...

original_text: 柳梦璃：娘……您保重。
translation: Liu Mengli: Mother... take care.

original_text: 柳梦璃：奚仲。
translation: Liu Mengli: Xizhong.

original_text: 奚仲：属下在。
translation: Xizhong: Your subordinate is here.

original_text: 柳梦璃：我以妖界主人的名义，命你将云天河等人带往尊神坛，送返人间！
translation: Liu Mengli: In the name of the yao realm's mistress, I order you to take Yun Tianhe and the others to the Divine Altar and return them to the human world!

original_text: 奚仲：诸位请随我来。
translation: Xizhong: Everyone, please follow me.

original_text: 韩菱纱：梦璃……再见了……
translation: Han Lingsha: Mengli... Goodbye...

original_text: 云天河：梦璃，我……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Mengli, I...

original_text: 云天河：我……
translation: Yun Tianhe: I...

original_text: 云天河：我走了。
translation: Yun Tianhe: I'm leaving.

original_text: 柳梦璃：……云公子！
translation: Liu Mengli: ...Yun!

original_text: 云天河：梦璃……
translation: Yun Tianhe: Mengli...

original_text: 柳梦璃：我……云公子，我想要谢谢你……
translation: Liu Mengli: I... Yun, I want to thank you...

original_text: 柳梦璃：谢谢你……给我留下那么多开心的回忆……我们一起御剑而飞，一起跋山涉水，一起在即墨看那些美丽的花灯……这些事情，我永远、永远不会忘记……
translation: Liu Mengli: Thank you... for leaving me with so many happy memories... Flying together on swords, traveling over mountains and rivers, watching those beautiful lanterns in Jimo together... These things, I will never, ever forget...

original_text: 柳梦璃：遇上了你，我才明白……什么叫在意一个人、忧心一个人，还有……喜欢一个人…………
translation: Liu Mengli: Meeting you made me understand... what it means to care for someone, worry about someone, and... love someone...

original_text: 柳梦璃：所以……往后请云公子一定要好好保重自己，千万不要让璃儿担心……
translation: Liu Mengli: So... from now on, please, Yun, you must take good care of yourself. Don't make Lili worry...

original_text: 云天河：……我会的……去一趟月牙村，再找玄霄夺回望舒剑之后，我就回到青鸾峰，再也不理山下这些打打杀杀的事……
translation: Yun Tianhe: ... I will... after going to Crescent Village and retrieving Wangshu Sword from Xuanxiao, I'll return to Qingluan Peak and never bother with all the fights and killings in the world...

original_text: 云天河：我一定……每天都会想起你，不会忘记你，不会让另外一个“梦璃”消失，就好像你还陪在我们身边一样……
translation: Yun Tianhe: I will... think of you every day, won't forget you, won't let the other 'Mengli' disappear, as if you're still by our side...

original_text: 柳梦璃：…………菱纱……有的时候，我宁可自己是她，就算……就算…………
translation: Liu Mengli: ...... Lingsha... sometimes, I wish I were her, even if... even if............

original_text: 柳梦璃：至少，我是真的陪在云公子的身边……
translation: Liu Mengli: At least... that can I truly stay by your side, Yun...

original_text: 云天河：不，你就是你，不用是其他人。
translation: Yun Tianhe: No, you are you, you don't need to be anyone else.

original_text: 柳梦璃：云公子，我……可以喊你一声“天河”吗？

original_text: 云天河：当然……

original_text: 柳梦璃：天河……今生有缘无份，若有来生……若有来生，我们再……
translation: Liu Mengli: Tianhe... In this life, fate brought us together but not to stay. If there is a next life... if there is, we'll...

original_text: 云天河：来生？就是下辈子？那要有多远？
translation: Yun Tianhe: Next life? You mean the next lifetime? How far away is that?

original_text: 柳梦璃：多远璃儿都不怕，就算人和妖的寿命差许多，你比我先入轮回……
translation: Liu Mengli: No matter how far, Lili isn't afraid. Even if humans and yaos have different lifespans, you'll enter reincarnation before me...

original_text: 柳梦璃：璃儿会努力的……一定会去找你的转世，到那个时候，我们再像从前一样，跋山涉水、游历天下……
translation: Liu Mengli: Lili will work hard... I will definitely find your reincarnation. When that time comes, we'll travel over mountains and rivers, roaming the world like before...

original_text: 柳梦璃：天河……好吗？
translation: Liu Mengli: Tianhe... shall we?

original_text: 云天河：我不要，根本不用等到那个时候！
translation: Yun Tianhe: I don't want to, there's no need to wait until then!

original_text: 云天河：梦璃，我知道的，每隔十九年，你们会再来人间！
translation: Yun Tianhe: Mengli, I know, every nineteen years, you will return to the mortal world!

original_text: 柳梦璃：……！
translation: Liu Mengli: ...!

original_text: 云天河：我跟你约好，十九年！十九年以后，我们再在昆仑山上相见！
translation: Yun Tianhe: I'll make a promise with you, nineteen years! Nineteen years from now, we'll meet again on Kunlun Mountain!

original_text: 柳梦璃：天河，你知道这是不可能的……
translation: Liu Mengli: Tianhe, you know this is impossible...

original_text: 云天河：你一定要来！
translation: Yun Tianhe: You must come!

original_text: 柳梦璃：天河……
translation: Liu Mengli: Tianhe...

original_text: 云天河：不管多久……我都会等……
translation: Yun Tianhe: No matter how long... I will wait...

original_text: 柳梦璃：……谁言别后终无悔，寒月清宵绮梦回……深知身在情长在，前尘不共彩云飞……
translation: Liu Mengli: ...Who says no regret follows our farewell?  When cold moon sets, sweet dreams return to dwell. While I draw breath, my heart's love never flies- But dust of past no more with rainbow dyes.

original_text: 奚仲：即使你们是少主的朋友，在幻瞑界也请一切自重。
