original_text: 云天河：琼华派的人已经冲了进来，<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255>现在要赶快赶去旋梦外围</colour><dc0>。</dc0>
translation: Yun Tianhe: The Qionghua Sect disciples have already charged in.<colour red=255 green=187 blue=0 alpha=255> We need to hurry to Outer Spindream now.</colour><dc0></dc0>

original_text: 觉糜：幻瞑界不应该有人进来！就算你们认识少主也一样！
translation: Juemi: No humans should enter the Twilight Realm! Even if you know the Young Mistress, it's the same!

original_text: 梦筱筱：你们……认识少主？……可是娘告诉我说，不管怎样，都不能相信人，不然下场一定会很惨……
translation: Mengxiaoxiao: You... know the young master?... But Mother told me that no matter what, I must never trust humans, or the outcome will surely be tragic...

original_text: 梦筱筱：呜呜呜！怎么会这样！大家都被人杀死了……呜……
translation: Mengxiaoxiao: Woo! How could this be! Everyone was killed by humans... Woo...

original_text: 梦筱筱：都是你们……是你们带那些人来杀大家的吧？娘说的对，绝对不能相信人……
translation: Mengxiaoxiao: It's all you... you brought those humans to kill everyone, right? Mother was right, humans absolutely cannot be trusted...

original_text: 子陌：在这战堂中修炼，修为就会提升很快，这一次我们绝不会败！
translation: Zimo: Training in this War Hall makes cultivation progress quickly, this time we definitely won't lose!

original_text: 子陌：我喜欢幻瞑界，喜欢住在幻瞑界的大家，任何人要破坏这里，我一定会拼死守护！
translation: Zimo: I love Twilight Realm, love everyone living here. Anyone who tries to destroy this place, I'll defend it with my life!

original_text: 梦北柯：原本我并不憎恨人，十九年一次接近人间，倒也可以看看人间草木，但是如果人想挑起争端，我们也不可能示弱！
translation: Mengbike: I didn't hate humans originally. Getting close to the human world every nineteen years lets us see its flora. But if humans provoke conflict, we won't back down!

original_text: 梦北柯：你是少主的朋友？那又如何？人真的可信吗？
translation: Mengbeike: You're the young master's friend? So what? Can human really be trusted?

original_text: 幼幻：听说有许多其他的妖住在人间，人和他们也是整天杀来杀去，为什么人都那么坏？
translation: Illuspawn: I heard many other yaos live among humans, and humans fight them all the time. Why are humans so cruel?

original_text: 幼幻：我虽然还很小，法力也不高，但是如果有人要打幻瞑界，我也要一起战斗！
translation: Illuspawn: Though I'm still small and my power isn't great, if anyone attacks the Twilight Realm, I'll fight too!

original_text: 琢韵：归邪将军说我有点笨，修炼起来会比其他貘辛苦，但是只要能守护幻瞑界，再辛苦的修炼我也不怕！
translation: ChiselRhyme: General Guixie says I'm a bit slow, and cultivation will be harder for me than for other bakus. But as long as I can protect Twilight Realm, I'm not afraid of any hardship in cultivation!

original_text: 琢韵：那些人只是想成仙，就要杀我们吗？……成仙可以自己修炼啊，为什么一定要来害我们呢？
translation: ChiselRhyme: Those people just want to become immortals, so they have to kill us? ...Can't they cultivate on their own to become immortals? Why must they harm us?

original_text: 琢韵：呜呜呜～归邪将军……他死了……虽然他以前一直说我笨，但其实对我很好很好的……
translation: ChiselRhyme: Wuwu~ General Gui Xie... he's dead... Although he always called me foolish before, he was actually very, very kind to me...

original_text: 幻天影：人总是把“不能滥杀无辜”挂在嘴边？那为什么就要来杀我们呢？幻瞑界哪里犯到人间了？！
translation: Mirage: Humans always say 'don't kill innocents'? Then why do they come to kill us? What has the Twilight Realm ever done to the human world?!

original_text: 幻天影：梦璃少主说她是被人养大的，这怎么可能？！人居然也有善待妖的？！我不相信，所以就算你是少主的朋友，我也不欢迎你！
translation: Mirage: Young Mistress Mengli says she was raised by humans-how is that possible?! Humans actually treating yaos kindly?! I don't believe it, so even if you're the young mistress's friend, I don't welcome you!

original_text: 幻天影：你们人真是狠心，为了成仙，连自己的朋友都可以杀……还有什么事是不能做的……
translation: Mirage: You humans are truly cruel. To become immortals, you'd even kill your own friends... Is there anything you wouldn't do...

original_text: 幻天影：归邪和奚仲两位将军是十九年前那场大战后，仅剩的幻瞑护将了，如今连归邪将军也被杀害了，以后再和人开战，我们还有胜算吗？
translation: Mirage: Generals Guixie and Xizhong are the only remaining Twilight guardians left after the great battle nineteen years ago. Now even General Guixie has been killed. If we go to war with humans again in the future, do we still have a chance of winning?

original_text: 明迷：十九年前元气大伤，也许这一次我们根本就没有力量对抗琼华派了，但是只要有一口气在，我们也要保护幻瞑界！
translation: Mingmi: Nineteen years ago, we suffered heavy losses. Perhaps this time, we simply lack the strength to oppose Qionghua Sect. But as long as we draw breath, we must protect Twilight Realm!

original_text: 明迷：婵幽大人她……是不是已经快不行了呢？如今归邪将军也死了，我们能依靠的只有少主了……
translation: Mingmi: Lady Chanyou... is she nearing her end? Now that General Guixie is also dead, we can only rely on the young master...

original_text: 明迷：求仙到底是什么？那些人为了成仙，竟然连同伴也杀！
translation: Mingmi: What exactly is seeking immortality? Those people, for the sake of becoming immortals, even kill their own companions!

original_text: 束幻：咳咳、咳咳咳……十九年啦……又是一场浩劫啊，不知道……咳咳……我幻瞑界能不能……咳咳……躲过这一次……
translation: Shuhuan: Cough, cough... Nineteen years... Another calamity... Cough... I wonder... cough... if our Twilight Realm can... cough... survive this time...

original_text: 束幻：我、咳咳……叫我家幼幻……待在这里安分一点，他偏要跑到、咳咳……外头，说什么，跟人……去拼命……就凭他、他那点能耐，那是去……咳咳，去送死啊！
translation: Shuhuan: I, cough... tell my child Illuspawn... to stay here quietly, but he insists on running, cough... outside, saying he wants to... fight with others... with his, his meager abilities, that's just... cough, courting death!

original_text: 束幻：我家幼幻……刚才一点都……咳咳，一点都不怕，很勇敢地迎敌，虽然……咳咳，还是敌、敌不过……但也总算……为保护……咳咳、大家出了力，没有白死啊……
translation: Shuhuan: My little Huan... just now, not at all... *cough*... not afraid at all, bravely faced the enemy. Though... *cough*... still couldn't defeat... but at least... protected... *cough*... everyone, didn't die in vain...

original_text: 束幻：……儿子死了很多年，咳咳，现在连孙儿、孙儿也死在人的手里……这到底是为什么啊？……
translation: Shuhuan: ...My son died many years ago, cough, and now even my grandson... grandson died at the hands of humans... Why is this?...

original_text: 灵梦：我听说，人间是个很大很大的地方，有各种各样我们幻瞑界没有的东西，可是人都很可怕……我们去不了人间玩……
translation: Lingmeng: I heard the human world is vast, with many things we don't have in the Twilight Realm. But humans are scary... We can't go play there...

original_text: 灵梦：子陌和幼幻都是我最好的朋友，可现在、现在他们都不在了……等我长大了，一定要杀了那些人，给他们报仇！
translation: Lingmeng: Zimo and Illuspawn were both my best friends, but now, now they're gone... When I grow up, I will definitely kill those people and avenge them!

original_text: 灵梦：梦璃姐姐一定会成为幻瞑界的主人吧？我知道，婵幽大人的身体越来越不好了，已经不能再像以前一样带着我们对抗人了……
translation: Lingmeng: Will Sister Mengli become the Mistreess of the Twilight Realm? I know, Lady Chanyou's health is getting worse; she can no longer lead us against humans like before...

original_text: 幽蒙：唉，人总说我们妖是怪物，在我看来，人才是怪物，为了得到他们想要的，什么事都做得出来……
translation: Youmeng: Sigh, humans always say we yaoguais are monsters. In my view, humans are the monsters, doing anything to get what they want...

original_text: 幽蒙：你是梦璃少主的朋友吧？……唉，这世上能和妖好好共处的人实在是不多……也算难得了……
translation: Youmeng: You're a friend of Young Mistress Mengli, right? ...Sigh, there are very few human in this world who can get along well with yaoguais... That's quite rare...

original_text: 幽蒙：婵幽大人会让梦璃少主继承她的位子吧？毕竟这些年来，她勉强支撑，灵力耗费得已经差不多了……也许不久之后，她就会离开我们……
translation: Youmeng: Lady Chanyou will let Young Mistress Mengli succeed her position, right? After all, these years she's been barely holding on, her spiritual power is almost exhausted... Maybe soon, she'll leave us...

original_text: 幽蒙：梦璃少主还年轻得很，就要肩负起整个幻瞑界了……幸好奚仲大人还能在她身边帮她……
translation: Youmeng: Young Mistress Mengli is still so young, yet she must shoulder the entire Twilight Realm... Fortunately, Lord Xizhong can still be by her side to assist her...

original_text: 清乐：琼华派迟早会攻破结界的，我宁可跟他们同归于尽，也好过坐以待毙！
translation: Clearjoy: Qionghua Sect will break through the barrier sooner or later. I'd rather perish with them than wait for death!

original_text: 清乐：人常常做一些稀奇古怪的东西，我就看过他们的梦，也学会做一些人间的东西，我知道，并不是所有人都像琼华派那样可恨的……
translation: Clearjoy: Humans often make strange things. I've seen their dreams and learned to make some human things. I know not everyone is as hateful as the Qionghua Sect...

original_text: 清乐：下一个十九年，梦璃少主真的能重振幻瞑界吗？……是不是过了十九年，又要和人拼个不死不休……
translation: Clearjoy: In the next nineteen years, can Mistress Mengli really revive Twilight Realm?... Will we have to fight humans to the death again after nineteen years...

original_text: 昔琳：十九年前那场大战，那些人不仅杀了好多貘，还耗损了我们不少灵力，能活下来的，也都变得体弱多病，不能再战了……
translation: Silin: In that great battle nineteen years ago, those people not only killed many bakus but also drained much of our spiritual power. Those who survived became weak and sickly, unable to fight anymore...

original_text: 昔琳：真没想到……你们这些人竟然反过来帮貘，我一开始还不是很相信你们，现在看来，你们的确是少主的朋友啊……
translation: Silin: I truly never expected... you mortals would actually help the bakus in return. At first, I wasn't very convinced about you, but now it seems you really are the Young Mistress's friends...

original_text: 昔琳：能活着看到少主继位，我就已经满足了……不知什么时候，幻瞑界才能恢复往日的繁华……
translation: Silin: Being alive to see the Young Mistress ascend to the throne is enough for me... I wonder when the Twilight Realm will regain its former prosperity...

original_text: 意菲菲：……我不和人说话的！就算是少主的朋友也一样……
translation: Yifeifei: ...I don't talk to humans! Even if you're the young Mistress's friend, it's the same...

original_text: 意菲菲：……谢谢你帮了我们……但是……幻瞑界和人还是有仇，我永远都不会饶过那些人……我也忘不了死了的子陌他们……
translation: Yifeifei: ...Thank you for helping us... But... the Twilight Realm and humans are still enemies; I will never forgive those humans... Nor can I ever forget those who died, like Zimo...

original_text: 澈磨：我年纪大了，都快死了……可我放不下自己的孩子，那些人都是很残忍的，连这么小的孩子他们也不会放过，十九年前就是这样……
translation: Chemo: I'm old, almost dying... but I can't let go of my child. Those people are cruel; they won't even spare such a young child. It was the same nineteen years ago...

original_text: 澈磨：传说在人间有个叫蜀山的地方，那里有真正的妖界，不会受到人的扰乱和攻打，为什么、为什么幻瞑界却是这样惨……
translation: Chemo: They say there's a place in the mortal world called Mount Shu, where a true yao realm exists, undisturbed and unassailed by humans. Why, why must the Twilight Realm suffer so tragically...

original_text: 澈磨：幻瞑界就算毁灭了，也不是被那些卑劣的人打败的，我们都宁可像归邪将军那样战死……
translation: Chemo: Even if the Twilight Realm is destroyed, it won't be defeated by those despicable people. We'd all rather die fighting like General Guixie...

original_text: 惑影：束幻爷爷身上有道很深的伤口，听说是以前被人打伤的，一直都好不了，一定是用了什么厉害的法术吧……就像婵幽大人，她的伤也是很久很久没好了……
translation: Glamour: Grandpa Shuhuan has a deep wound on his body. I heard he was injured by someone long ago, and it never healed. Must have been some powerful spell... Just like Lady Chanyou-her injury also hasn't healed for a very, very long time...

original_text: 惑影：我、我不知道以后该怎么办，再过十九年，又要和人开战了，我一定要好好修炼，让自己变得很强很强，强到可以保护大家！
translation: Glamour: I... I don't know what to do in the future. In another nineteen years, we'll have to fight humans again. I must cultivate diligently, become very, very strong, strong enough to protect everyone!

original_text: 思尘落：幻瞑界曾经有六个很厉害的将军，可是十九年前人来打我们，有四个将军为了保护大家就战死了……现在只剩下归邪大人和奚仲大人……
translation: Sichenluo: The Twilight Realm once had six powerful generals, but nineteen years ago when humans attacked us, four generals died protecting everyone... Now only Lord Guixie and Lord Xizhong remain...

original_text: 思尘落：梦璃姐姐也很厉害，有她在，我不怕那些人，就算以后要再和他们拼命，我也不怕……
translation: Sichenluo: Sister Mengli is also very capable. With her here, I'm not afraid of those people. Even if I have to fight them desperately again in the future, I'm not afraid...

original_text: 雾惑：你们人啊，口是心非、表里不一，白天兄弟相称，梦里刀剑相向，我看多了人的梦，对这种事情最了解了。
translation: Fogglamour: You humans, saying one thing while meaning another, brothers by day but crossing swords in dreams. I've seen many human dreams and understand this best.

original_text: 雾惑：总有孩子想出去看看外面的世界，对他们来说，也许不想天天闷在这个地方，但是人妖不两立，他们去了人间只是送死啊……不是人人都像少主这样好运的。
translation: Fogglamour: There are always children who want to go out and see the world. For them, perhaps they don't want to be cooped up in this place every day. But humans and yaos cannot coexist; if they go to the human world, they'd just be walking to their deaths... Not everyone is as fortunate our young Mistress.

original_text: 雾惑：那些人要靠吸取幻瞑界的灵力来修仙，自己不努力，却梦想一步登天，你们人从来都这样贪心不足的！
translation: Fogglamour: Those people rely on absorbing the spiritual energy of the Twilight Realm to cultivate immortality. They don't work hard themselves but dream of reaching the heavens in one step. You humans have always been this insatiably greedy!

original_text: 觉珑纱：人是个怪东西，路边的乞丐梦见一块烧肉就笑得合不拢嘴，住大宅子的富豪梦见自己埋在财宝里，却还想要更多，这都是为什么呢？
translation: Juelongsha: Humans are strange creatures. A beggar on the roadside dreams of a piece of roasted meat and can't stop smiling, while a wealthy man living in a mansion dreams of being buried in treasure yet still wants more. Why is that?

original_text: 觉珑纱：我喜欢归邪将军……不想他死……可娘说他不可能再活过来了……为什么啊……
translation: Juelongsha: I like General Guixie... I don't want him to die... But Mother says he can't come back to life... Why...

original_text: 凝莫彻：少主被人养育了十九年，到如今才突然回来，说不定她对人的感情反而更深，不然又怎会让你们进来幻瞑界……
translation: Ningmoche: The young mistress was raised by humans for nineteen years and only returned suddenly now. It's possible her feelings for humans run deeper. Otherwise, why would she let you enter Twilight Realm...

original_text: 凝莫彻：我不知道少主是怎么想的，可婵幽大人一定会让她成为新的幻瞑之主，你们还是快点离开吧，妖和人注定不能相交的。
translation: Ningmoche: I don't know what the young mistress is thinking, but Lady Chanyou will surely make her the new Mistress of Twilight. You'd better leave quickly; Yaoguais and humans are fated not to intertwine.

original_text: 风黎：幻瞑界中，以婵幽大人的灵力最强，只是十九年前她被人重伤，不宜再催动灵力，如今的少主又还不够强，这一次确是凶多吉少啊……
translation: Mengli: In the Twilight Realm, Lady Chanyou has the strongest spiritual power. But nineteen years ago, she was severely injured and shouldn't exert her power further. The current young mistress isn't strong enough yet. This time, the odds are truly against us...

original_text: 风黎：婵幽大人支撑幻瞑界这么久，也是该歇息歇息了……以后就靠少主和奚仲大人了……
translation: Mengli: Lady Chanyou has supported Twilight Realm for so long, it's time for her to rest... From now on, it's up to the Young Mistress and Lord Xizhong...

original_text: 晓雾：明知敌不过，扉衣他们却还是要坚持死守……我、我真的不喜欢打打杀杀的事情，为什么不能想别的办法解决呢？
translation: Dawnhaze: Knowing full well they cannot win, Feiyi and the others still insist on holding their ground to the death... I... I really don't like fighting and killing. Why can't we think of other ways to resolve this?

original_text: 晓雾：那些人太残忍了！！扉衣身上中了好几剑，是被他们活活砍死的！我、我以后要一直修炼，一定要变强，替扉衣、还有其他的貘报仇！！
translation: Dawnhaze: Those people are too cruel!! Feiyi was stabbed several times, hacked to death by them! I... I'll keep training from now on, I must become strong, to avenge Feiyi and the other Bakus!!

original_text: 莫云光：貘能吃人的梦，知道人心里在想些什么，可是人却只活在自己的世界中，他们根本不愿意了解其他的东西，只要被他们归为异类，就会格杀勿论！
translation: Moyunguang: Bakus can eat human's dreams and know what's in their hearts, but humans only live in their own world. They simply aren't willing to understand other things. As long as they classify something as alien, they'll exterminate it without mercy!

original_text: 莫云光：幻瞑界如天轨运移，每十九年最接近人间一次，这原本也是自然之理，如今却变成了整个幻瞑界最大的浩劫……
translation: Moyunguang: The Twilight Realm moves like celestial orbits, coming closest to the mortal world every nineteen years. This was originally natural, but now it has become the greatest calamity for Twilight Realm...

original_text: 莫云光：真正的仙人我也见过，那是逍遥自在、无欲无求的境界，那些昆仑琼华派的人满面狰狞，哪里有半点仙风道骨的样子！
translation: Moyunguang: I've seen true immortals-they embody freedom and desirelessness. Those people from the Kunlun Qionghua Sect look ferocious, without a trace of immortal grace!

original_text: 寂同岚：梦貘一族世世代代居于幻瞑界，与别的妖界并无往来，貘的法力虽然来自于幻境，会吞食别人的梦，但我们不会害人，也不会轻易去窥探那些梦。
translation: Solitary-Haze: The Baku clan has lived in the Twilight Realm for generations and has no contact with other yao realms. Although the Bakus' power comes from illusions and they consume others' dreams, we do not harm people, nor do we easily pry into those dreams.

original_text: 寂同岚：幻瞑界原本悠游于天地之间，从不参与六界纷争，若不是人来犯我，又怎会有今日的局面？
translation: Solitary-Haze: The Twilight Realm originally roamed freely between heaven and earth, never involved in the disputes of the six realms. If humans hadn't invaded us, how could we have come to this situation today?

original_text: 寂同岚：任何一族都会有兴衰，如今幻瞑界虽是处境艰难，但只要不遭灭族，我们必有再兴起的一日。
translation: Solitary-Haze: Every clan has its rise and fall. Although the Twilight Realm is in a difficult situation now, as long as we are not exterminated, we will surely rise again one day.

original_text: 游非：婵幽大人从前经常与诸位将军在幻瞑宫内共商大事，可是如今她的身体一日比一日差，几乎从不踏出幻瞑宫，只有少主从人间回来的事，让她很是高兴，精神好了一些。
translation: Youfei: Lady Chanyou used to frequently discuss important matters with the generals in the Twilight Palace. But now her health worsens day by day, and she hardly ever steps out of the palace. Only the news of the young master's return from the mortal world made her very happy and lifted her spirits somewhat.

original_text: 游非：梦璃少主继承了婵幽大人的血脉，又有奚仲将军从旁辅佐，日后一定会成为出色的幻瞑之主吧。
translation: Youfei: Young Lady Mengli has inherited Lady Chanyou's bloodline, and with General Xizhong assisting from the side, she will surely become an outstanding master of Twilight in the future.

original_text: 烟漠漠：娘的身体一直不好，听族里的前辈们说，是很久以前被仙人打伤的，就像婵幽大人的伤一样……
translation: Yanmomo: Mother's health has never been good. I heard from elders in the clan that she was injured by an immortal long ago, just like Lady Chanyou's injury...

original_text: 烟漠漠：这些弟弟妹妹们的爹娘都被琼华派的人杀死了，不过我会照顾他们，让他们快快长大，以后大家一起保护幻瞑界，保护梦璃大人！
translation: Yanmomo: The parents of these younger brothers and sisters were all killed by the Qionghua Sect, but I will take care of them, help them grow up quickly, so we can all protect the Twilight Realm and protect Lady Mengli together!

original_text: 思宁：月神带来宁静的夜晚，夜晚带来美丽的梦幻，我们幻瞑一族以梦为食，以月华为灵，从来都是与世无争，却怎会招惹了琼华派那样的凶恶之人？
translation: Sining: The Moon Goddess brings peaceful nights, and nights bring beautiful dreams. Our Twilight clan feeds on dreams and draws spirit from moonlight, always living in harmony with the world. How could we have provoked such vicious people as the Qionghua Sect?

original_text: 思宁：修仙的事情，我不太懂，但至少知道“修成正果”需行善积德，琼华派人如此滥杀无辜，怎么可能修成仙身？！
translation: Sining: I don't understand much about cultivating immortality, but at least I know 'attaining enlightenment' requires doing good deeds and accumulating virtue. How could the Qionghua Sect members, who kill innocents so wantonly, ever achieve immortal bodies?!

original_text: 空月：五界生灵寂灭为鬼，人与妖、仙与兽，全都是一样的，人们为什么总是以为妖是害人的，仙才是救人的呢？
translation: Kongyue: When beings from the five realms perish, they become ghosts-humans, yaoguais, immortals, beasts, all are the same. Why do mortal always think yaos harm while immortals save?

original_text: 空月：可笑那些琼华弟子，杀我们的时候就说“妖即是恶”，可他们杀自己人的时候，不也一样毫不手软？哼！
translation: Kongyue: It's laughable, those Qionghua disciples. When killing us, they say 'yaoguais are evil', but when killing their own kind, aren't they just as ruthless? Hmph!

original_text: 承清影：人们总是说“仙人”是没有感情和欲望的“人”，可是我知道，“仙人”在梦里也还是一样会哭会笑，和普通“人”没什么不一样。
translation: Chengqingying: People always say that 'Immortals' are 'mortal' without emotions or desires, but I know that 'Immortals' still cry and laugh in their dreams, no different from ordinary 'people'.

original_text: 承清影：修仙的人最爱说“拯救苍生”……其实根本就是胡说！难道妖就不属“苍生”，可以随意屠戮吗？
translation: Chengqngying: Those who cultivate immortality love to talk about 'saving all living beings'... It's utter nonsense! Are yaoguais not part of 'all living beings', to be slaughtered at will?

original_text: 枕影：谢谢，谢谢你！这回束幻爷爷可有救了！这些黄色的星星是我的宝贝，送给你，谢谢你对我们这么好！
translation: Zhenying: Thank you, thank you! This time, Grandpa Shuhuan can be saved! These yellow stars are my treasures, I give them to you. Thank you for being so kind to us!

original_text: 溪玉幻：是炼火珠？不错、不错，没想到还有人会帮我们貘……
translation: Xiyuhuan: The Flame Pearl? Good, good. I didn't expect someone to help us Bakus...

original_text: 溪玉幻：这几种新的注灵方法是我自创的，现在告诉你，算是报答你对我们这么好。
translation: Xiyuhuan: These new enchantment methods are my own creation. I'm telling you now as thanks for being so good to us.

original_text:
束幻爷爷身上的旧伤又复发了，可是我这里的药有点不太够，你能帮我找一些紫陌清风和无衣神水吗？量也不能少了，至少得各五瓶。治好了束幻爷爷，我会报答你的！
你愿意帮我去找一些吗？
translation:
Grandpa Shuhuan's old injury flared up again, but I'm low on medicine. Could you help me find some WorldwideBreeze and Divine Water? At least five bottles of each. If we can cure Grandpa Shuhuan, I'll repay you!
Are you willing to help me find some?

original_text:
我冷焰寮中铸炼兵刃的火焰乃是以紫晶石的灵力幻化，虽含极强的灵力，但却始终不够热，若能取得传说中的炼火珠，对我铸造兵刃必然大有助益。
你愿意帮我去找来吗？
translation:
The flame in my Cold Flame Forge for smithing weapons is conjured from the spiritual power of amethyst. Though it contains strong spiritual energy, it's never hot enough. If I could obtain the legendary Flame Pearl, it would greatly aid my weapon forging.
Will you help me find it?
